Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine Zufallszahl zwischen einem gegebenen Minimum und Maximum (inklusive).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i
        iv_max TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_number.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = iv_min max = iv_max ).
    rv_random_number = lo_random->get_next( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_random_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_int_generator( ).

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und moderne Tabellenoperationen wie `SELECT` und `READ TABLE INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_flight) TYPE ty_flight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_no_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flights( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
                                            carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                            connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_data.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_flights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_random_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_flight_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_data_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_no_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).
    DATA(ls_random_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_random_flight-carrid exp = abap_false msg = 'Flight carrier ID should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_random_flight-connid exp = abap_false msg = 'Flight connection ID should not be initial' ).

    " Verify if the selected flight actually exists in sflights
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @ls_random_flight-carrid
        AND connid = @ls_random_flight-connid
        AND fldate = @ls_random_flight-fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_check).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_sflight_check exp = abap_false msg = 'Selected flight must exist in sflights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_data_exception.
    " To test this, we would need to mock sflights or ensure it's empty.
    " For simplicity, we assume sflights has data for the positive test case.
    " A proper test would involve dependency injection or test doubles.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).
    TRY.
        " Simulate empty sflights (not directly possible here without mocking)
        " For demonstration, we'll just call it and expect an exception if sflights were empty.
        lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_sy_no_data was expected but not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_data.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_sy_no_data correctly raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` mit modernen ABAP-SQL- und Tabellenoperationen. `VALUE #( FOR ... )` wird verwendet, um Daten aus `sflights` in eine interne Tabelle zu füllen. Die Zufallszahl wird dann genutzt, um einen Index für den Zugriff auf die Tabelle zu generieren. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `cx_sy_no_data` ist ebenfalls ein Best Practice.
keywords: RANDOM, CLASS, SFLIGHTS, INTERNAL TABLES, SELECT, VALUE, CX_SY_NO_DATA

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Klasse, die Objekte einer anderen Klasse mit zufällig generierten Attributen (z.B. ID, Name) erzeugt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine statische Factory-Methode und `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_UUID` oder `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`.

CLASS zcl_random_person DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

    me->mv_name = iv_name.

CLASS zcl_person_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_random_person

        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_person_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_random_person.

    ro_person = NEW zcl_random_person( iv_id = lv_uuid iv_name = lv_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lt_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Alice' ) ( 'Bob' ) ( 'Charlie' ) ( 'David' ) ( 'Eve' ) ).
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_names ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle zufällig durch.
hint: Fügen Sie eine Zufallszahl als Sortierkriterium hinzu und sortieren Sie die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sort_item,
             random_key TYPE i,
             item       TYPE ty_item,
           END OF ty_sort_item.
    TYPES: tt_sort_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sort_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 1000000 ). " Large range for better randomness

    DATA(lt_sort_items) = VALUE tt_sort_items( FOR ls_item IN it_input_table
                                                ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( ),
                                                  item       = ls_item ) ).

    SORT lt_sort_items BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_table = VALUE tt_items( FOR ls_sort_item IN lt_sort_items ( ls_sort_item-item ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' )
      ( id = 4 value = 'D' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) msg = 'Table size must remain the same' ).

    " Probabilistic check: order should be different most of the time
    DATA(lv_is_same_order) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_original INTO DATA(ls_original_item).
      READ TABLE lt_shuffled INTO DATA(ls_shuffled_item) INDEX sy-tabix.
      IF ls_original_item <> ls_shuffled_item.
        lv_is_same_order = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that it's not the same order (highly probable for random shuffle)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_same_order exp = abap_false msg = 'Table order should be different after shuffle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode mischt eine interne Tabelle, indem sie jedem Eintrag einen zufälligen Sortierschlüssel zuweist und die Tabelle dann nach diesem Schlüssel sortiert. Dies ist eine gängige und effiziente Methode zum Mischen von Daten. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und `SORT` mit einem dynamisch generierten Schlüssel ist ein modernes ABAP-Muster.
keywords: RANDOM, INTERNAL TABLES, SORT, SHUFFLE, CLASS, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen zufälligen String einer bestimmten Länge, bestehend aus alphanumerischen Zeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für die Auswahl der Zeichen und eine Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_chars_len - 1 ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_string_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_string_content FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_string_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 10.
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( lv_length ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_string ) exp = lv_length msg = 'Generated string must have correct length' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_string_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( 20 ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_allowed_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.

    DATA(lv_is_alphanumeric) = abap_true.
    DO strlen( lv_random_string ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = lv_random_string+sy-index(1).
      IF NOT ( lc_allowed_chars CS lv_char ).
        lv_is_alphanumeric = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_alphanumeric exp = abap_true msg = 'Generated string must contain only alphanumeric characters' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Klasse generiert einen zufälligen String, indem sie Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Satz von alphanumerischen Zeichen zufällig auswählt. `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` wird verwendet, um den Index des nächsten Zeichens zu bestimmen. Die String-Verkettung mit `&&` ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode.
keywords: RANDOM, STRING, CLASS, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, STRING PROCESSING

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Liste von Elementen (z.B. Flugbuchungen) zufällig einen von zwei Status ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED') zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für eine 50/50-Entscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_booking_status_assigner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_booking.
    TYPES: tt_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_random_status
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_bookings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_bookings) TYPE tt_bookings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_booking_status_assigner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_random_status.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = 1 ).

    rt_updated_bookings = VALUE tt_bookings( FOR ls_booking IN it_bookings
                                               LET lv_random_val = lo_random->get_next( )
                                               IN
                                               ( bookid = ls_booking-bookid,
                                                 status = COND #( WHEN lv_random_val = 0 THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE 'CANCELLED' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_status_assignment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_status_assignment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_booking_status_assigner( ).
    DATA(lt_original_bookings) = VALUE zcl_booking_status_assigner=>tt_bookings(
      ( bookid = '00000001' )
      ( bookid = '00000002' )
      ( bookid = '00000003' )
      ( bookid = '00000004' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_updated_bookings) = lo_cut->assign_random_status( lt_original_bookings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_updated_bookings ) exp = lines( lt_original_bookings ) msg = 'Table size must remain the same' ).

    LOOP AT lt_updated_bookings INTO DATA(ls_booking).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_booking-status = 'CONFIRMED' OR ls_booking-status = 'CANCELLED' )
                                         msg = 'Status must be either CONFIRMED or CANCELLED' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` in Kombination mit modernen Tabellenoperationen wie `FOR` und dem `COND` Operator verwendet, um Daten zufällig zu aktualisieren. Die Zuweisung eines Status basierend auf einer 50/50-Zufallsentscheidung ist eine elegante Lösung für die Simulation von Daten.
keywords: RANDOM, CLASS, CONDITIONAL LOGIC, SBOOK, FOR, COND, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die basierend auf einer Zufallszahl dynamisch eine von mehreren Methoden ausführt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und dynamischen Methodenaufruf (`CALL METHOD`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_random_method
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_executed_method) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS method_a
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_c
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_random_method.
    DATA(lt_methods) = VALUE string_table( ( 'METHOD_A' ) ( 'METHOD_B' ) ( 'METHOD_C' ) ).
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_methods ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_methods INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(lv_method_name).

    CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF me RECEIVING rv_name = rv_executed_method.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_a.
    rv_name = 'Method A executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_name = 'Method B executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_c.
    rv_name = 'Method C executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_random_method( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_result = 'Method A executed' OR
                                               lv_result = 'Method B executed' OR
                                               lv_result = 'Method C executed' )
                                       msg = 'One of the methods should have been executed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf (`CALL METHOD`) in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT`. Eine Zufallszahl wird verwendet, um einen Methodennamen aus einer Liste auszuwählen, der dann zur Laufzeit aufgerufen wird. Dies ist nützlich für flexible Architekturen oder Test-Frameworks.
keywords: RANDOM, CLASS, DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING, CALL METHOD, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Teilen Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights` zufällig in eine vorgegebene Anzahl von Batches auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und `GROUP BY` oder `FOR` mit `GROUP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_batch_assigner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_batch,
             batch_id TYPE i,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_with_batch.
    TYPES: tt_flights_with_batch TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_batch WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_batch_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF tt_flights_with_batch WITH UNIQUE KEY batch_id.

    METHODS assign_flights_to_random_batches
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_batches TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_batch_map) TYPE ty_batch_map
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_batch_assigner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_flights_to_random_batches.
    IF iv_num_batches <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error MESSAGE e001(zmsg_error) WITH 'Number of batches must be positive'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = iv_num_batches ).

    DATA(lt_flights_with_batch) = VALUE tt_flights_with_batch( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights (
                                                                  batch_id = lo_random->get_next( ),
                                                                  carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                                                  connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                                                  fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).

    rt_batch_map = VALUE ty_batch_map( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_flights_with_batch BY ls_flight-batch_id
                                        ( batch_id = ls_flight-batch_id,
                                          TABLE = VALUE tt_flights_with_batch( FOR group_member IN GROUP ( group_member-carrid = group_member-carrid
                                                                                                           group_member-connid = group_member-connid
                                                                                                           group_member-fldate = group_member-fldate ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_list_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_entry.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_any_table ).

    IF lv_table_size IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_data.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_table_size ).

    READ TABLE it_any_table INDEX lv_random_index ASSIGNING <fs_entry>.

    CREATE DATA rs_random_entry LIKE <fs_entry>.
    ASSIGN rs_random_entry->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
    <fs_target> = <fs_entry>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von N eindeutigen Zufallszahlen innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und eine `HASHED TABLE` zur Überprüfung der Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_random_numbers.
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR iv_min > iv_max OR iv_count > ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error MESSAGE e001(zmsg_error) WITH 'Invalid input parameters for unique random numbers'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = iv_min max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_generated_numbers) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_new_number INTO TABLE lt_generated_numbers.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Number already exists, try again
        DO.
          lv_new_number = lo_random->get_next( ).
          INSERT lv_new_number INTO TABLE lt_generated_numbers.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rt_unique_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN lt_generated_numbers ( number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unique_random_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_parameters FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 5.
    DATA(lv_min) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max) = 10.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->generate_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = lv_count iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = lv_count msg = 'Correct number of unique random numbers' ).

    DATA(lt_check_uniqueness) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      INSERT lv_number INTO TABLE lt_check_uniqueness.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_uniqueness ) exp = lv_count msg = 'All generated numbers must be unique' ).

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO lv_number.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lv_number low = lv_min high = lv_max msg = 'Number must be within range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_parameters.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_generator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->generate_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 10 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_sy_arithmetic_error expected for count > range' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_sy_arithmetic_error correctly raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->generate_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 10 iv_max = 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_sy_arithmetic_error expected for min > max' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_sy_arithmetic_error correctly raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Klasse generiert eine angegebene Anzahl von eindeutigen Zufallszahlen innerhalb eines Bereichs. Bei Duplikaten wird eine neue Zahl generiert, bis eine eindeutige gefunden wird. Dies ist eine robuste Lösung für Szenarien, die eindeutige Zufallswerte erfordern.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT` über eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_free_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ). " Assuming seatsocc is occupied seats, so free seats = seatsmax - seatsocc
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_seats >= 0 ).

    " To make it more robust, we could mock SFLIGHTS data or use a fixed dataset.
    " For this example, let's assume a simple case.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( seatsocc = 10 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_test_flight).
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_test_flight-seatsocc.
    ENDLOOP.

    " This part of the test would require modifying the solution to accept a table
    " or mocking the database access, which is beyond a simple unit test for this context.
    " The current test checks for non-negative result.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Flugnummer, Datum, Preis) in ein CSV-Format als XSTRING, um es als E-Mail-Anhang zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` nach dem Aufbau des CSV-Strings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flights_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flights_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string,
          lv_header     TYPE string.

    lv_header = 'Airline;Date;Price' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    lv_csv_string = lv_header.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string &&
                      |{ ls_flight-carrid };{ ls_flight-fldate };{ ls_flight-price }| &&
                      cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
          iv_string = lv_csv_string
          iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
        ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_convert_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_convert_flights_to_csv_xstring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_flights_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_csv_xstring( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_bcs_csv_xstring=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_bcs_csv_xstring=>ty_flight_data( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_bcs_csv_xstring=>ty_flight_data( carrid = 'UA' fldate = '20251202' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_flights_to_csv_xstring( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xstring ).

    " Verify content by converting back (optional, but good for robust testing)
    DATA lv_string_back TYPE string.
    TRY.
        lv_string_back = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string(
          iv_xstring = lv_xstring
          iv_codepage = '4103'
        ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_convert_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Conversion back to string failed' ).
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lv_expected_csv) = 'Airline;Date;Price' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                             'LH;20251201;100.00' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                             'UA;20251202;200.00' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_string_back exp = lv_expected_csv ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_bcs_convert` ist essenziell für die Umwandlung von Daten zwischen verschiedenen Formaten (z.B. String, XSTRING, SOLIX_TAB) und Zeichensätzen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Erstellung von E-Mail-Anhängen oder die Verarbeitung von externen Dateiinhalten. String-Templates (`|...|`) machen die CSV-Generierung sehr lesbar.
keywords: cl_bcs_convert, XSTRING, CSV, Email Attachment, Data Conversion, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_item.
    DATA lt_local_items TYPE tt_items.

    rt_items = lt_local_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das aktuelle Alter in Jahren basierend auf einem Geburtsdatum. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei den aktuellen Systemtag.
hint: Nutzen Sie Datumsarithmetik und `CL_ABAP_SYST=>GET_DATUM()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_age_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_syst=>get_datum( ).
    rv_age = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4). " Initial year difference

    " Adjust if birthday hasn't occurred yet this year
    IF lv_current_date(4) = iv_birth_date(4). " Same year, age is 0 or 1
      IF lv_current_date < iv_birth_date. " Birth date is in the future, should not happen for age calculation
        rv_age = 0.
      ENDIF.
    ELSEIF lv_current_date(6) < iv_birth_date(6). " Month and day of current year before birth month and day
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ELSEIF lv_current_date(6) = iv_birth_date(6) AND lv_current_date(8) < iv_birth_date(8). " Same month, but current day before birth day
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der verbleibenden Arbeitstage im aktuellen Monat, ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum. Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag) sollen dabei ignoriert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie Datumsarithmetik, Schleifen, `CL_ABAP_SYST=>GET_DATUM()` und `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>GET_WEEKDAY()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_remaining_working_days
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_remaining_working_days.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_syst=>get_datum( ).
    DATA(lv_year)  = lv_current_date(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = lv_current_date+4(2).

    DATA(lv_last_day_of_month) TYPE sy-datum.
    lv_last_day_of_month = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_last_day_of_month(
      iv_date = lv_current_date
    ).

    DATA(lv_temp_date) TYPE sy-datum.
    lv_temp_date = lv_current_date.

    WHILE lv_temp_date <= lv_last_day_of_month.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_weekday(
        iv_date = lv_temp_date
      ).
      " 1 = Monday, ..., 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
      IF lv_weekday < 6. " Not Saturday or Sunday
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_temp_date = lv_temp_date + 1. " Move to next day
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_working_days) = lo_calculator->get_remaining_working_days( ).

    " This test is dependent on the current system date.
    " For a robust test, one would mock cl_abap_syst=>get_datum().
    " As a basic check, we assert it's not negative.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_working_days >= 0 )
      msg = 'Working days should be non-negative' ).

    " Example for a specific month (e.g., November 2025, starting from 28th)
    " 28.11.2025 (Fri), 29.11.2025 (Sat), 30.11.2025 (Sun)
    " Remaining working days from 28.11.2025: 1 (28th)
    " This requires mocking or a fixed date for precise testing.
    " For now, a simple non-negative check.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne und klare Art, komplexe Datumslogik zu implementieren.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT). Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Anzahl der freien Sitze pro Flug, indem Sie die belegten Sitze von der maximalen Kapazität subtrahieren und dann den Durchschnitt bilden. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` um die freien Sitze pro Flug zu berechnen und `REDUCE` für den Durchschnitt.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
         carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
         connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
         fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
         seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
         seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
       END OF ty_sflight_data.
TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sflight_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_avg_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_free_seats) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_free_seats.
    DATA(lt_free_seats_per_flight) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight
      ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).

    IF lines( lt_free_seats_per_flight ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_free_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                            FOR lv_free_seats IN lt_free_seats_per_flight
                                            NEXT sum = sum + lv_free_seats ).
      rv_avg_free_seats = lv_total_free_seats / lines( lt_free_seats_per_flight ).
    ELSE.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob das aktuelle Systemdatum ein Werktag ist (Montag bis Freitag). Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_SYST` und `SWITCH` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_SYST=>GET_DATUM()` in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>GET_WEEKDAY()` und der `SWITCH` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_is_working_day DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_current_day_working_day
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_working_day) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_is_working_day IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_current_day_working_day.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_syst=>get_datum( ).
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_weekday(
      iv_date = lv_current_date
    ).

    rb_is_working_day = SWITCH abap_bool(
      lv_weekday
      WHEN 1 THEN abap_true " Monday
      WHEN 2 THEN abap_true " Tuesday
      WHEN 3 THEN abap_true " Wednesday
      WHEN 4 THEN abap_true " Thursday
      WHEN 5 THEN abap_true " Friday
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_working_day.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_is_working_day( ).
    DATA(lb_is_working_day) = lo_checker->is_current_day_working_day( ).

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_weekday(
      iv_date = lv_current_date
    ).

    DATA(lb_expected_result) TYPE abap_bool.
    IF lv_weekday >= 1 AND lv_weekday <= 5.
      lb_expected_result = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      lb_expected_result = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = lb_expected_result
      msg = 'Result should correctly identify working day' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD display_sflights_tree.

      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
      cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
      cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
    ) ).

    ro_column_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      parent = iv_container
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).

    create_tree_columns( ro_column_tree ).
    fill_tree_data( io_column_tree = ro_column_tree it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    ro_column_tree->set_first_visible_node( i_node_key = '1' ).
    ro_column_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_tree_columns.
    DATA: ls_column TYPE lvc_s_coln.

    ls_column-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_column-col_id    = 'CARRID'.
    ls_column-text      = 'Airline'.
    ls_column-width     = 10.
    io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).

    ls_column-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_column-col_id    = 'CONNID'.
    ls_column-text      = 'Flight No.'.
    ls_column-width     = 10.
    io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).

    ls_column-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_column-col_id    = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_column-text      = 'Flight Date'.
    ls_column-width     = 12.
    io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).

    ls_column-fieldname = 'CITYFROM'.
    ls_column-col_id    = 'CITYFROM'.
    ls_column-text      = 'From City'.
    ls_column-width     = 15.
    io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).

    ls_column-fieldname = 'CITYTO'.
    ls_column-col_id    = 'CITYTO'.
    ls_column-text      = 'To City'.
    ls_column-width     = 15.
    io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_item_data TYPE lvc_t_itm,
          ls_item_data TYPE lvc_s_itm,
          lv_node_key  TYPE lvc_nkey.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CLEAR lt_item_data.

      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
      ls_item_data-value     = ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.

      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
      ls_item_data-value     = ls_sflight-connid.
      APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.

      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
      ls_item_data-value     = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|. " Modern string template for date
      APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.

      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CITYFROM'.
      ls_item_data-value     = ls_sflight-cityfrom.
      APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.

      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CITYTO'.
      ls_item_data-value     = ls_sflight-cityto.
      APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.

      lv_node_key = io_column_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_node_root
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_item_table     = lt_item_data
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    io_column_tree->expand_tree( ). " Expand all nodes for visibility
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      CLEAR lt_item_data.

      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-connid. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_item_data-value = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CITYFROM'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-cityfrom. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CITYTO'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-cityto. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      lv_node_key = io_column_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_node_root
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_item_table     = lt_item_data
        i_node_text      = |{ ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    io_column_tree->expand_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    DATA: lt_item_data TYPE lvc_t_itm.
    IF mo_column_tree IS BOUND.
      mo_column_tree->get_item_data(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = node_key
        IMPORTING
          et_item_data = lt_item_data
      ).
      DATA(lv_message) = |Selected Node: { node_key }\n|.
      LOOP AT lt_item_data INTO DATA(ls_item).
        lv_message = lv_message && |{ ls_item-fieldname }: { ls_item-value }\n|.
      ENDLOOP.
      MESSAGE lv_message TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle zur Speicherung der Spaltendefinitionen und iterieren Sie diese, um `ADD_COLUMN` aufzurufen. Die Daten für die Knoten müssen ebenfalls dynamisch aufbereitet werden.

CLASS zcl_gui_col_tree_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_config,

      IMPORTING
        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree

        io_column_tree   TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree

CLASS zcl_gui_col_tree_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_tree.
    DATA(lt_column_config) = VALUE tt_column_config(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' col_id = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' width = 10 )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' col_id = 'CONNID' text = 'Flight No.' width = 10 )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' col_id = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' width = 12 )
      ( fieldname = 'CITYFROM' col_id = 'CITYFROM' text = 'From City' width = 15 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 10 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
      cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
      cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
    ) ).

    ro_column_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      parent = iv_container
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).

    create_dynamic_columns( io_column_tree = ro_column_tree it_column_config = lt_column_config ).
    fill_dynamic_tree_data( io_column_tree = ro_column_tree it_sflights = lt_sflights it_column_config = lt_column_config ).

    ro_column_tree->set_first_visible_node( i_node_key = '1' ).
    ro_column_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dynamic_columns.
    LOOP AT it_column_config INTO DATA(ls_config).
      DATA(ls_column) = VALUE lvc_s_coln(
        fieldname = ls_config-fieldname
        col_id    = ls_config-col_id
        text      = ls_config-text
        width     = ls_config-width
      ).
      io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_dynamic_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_item_data TYPE lvc_t_itm, ls_item_data TYPE lvc_s_itm, lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CLEAR lt_item_data.
      LOOP AT it_column_config INTO DATA(ls_config).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_config-fieldname OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ls_item_data-fieldname = ls_config-fieldname.
          ls_item_data-value     = |{ <lv_value> }|.
          APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_node_key = io_column_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_node_root
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_item_table     = lt_item_data
        i_node_text      = |{ ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    io_column_tree->expand_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 10 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,

    ls_column-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_column-col_id = 'CONNID'. ls_column-text = 'Flight No.'. ls_column-width = 10. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).

    ls_column-fieldname = 'CITYFROM'. ls_column-col_id = 'CITYFROM'. ls_column-text = 'From City'. ls_column-width = 15. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ls_column-fieldname = 'CITYTO'. ls_column-col_id = 'CITYTO'. ls_column-text = 'To City'. ls_column-width = 15. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_item_data TYPE lvc_t_itm, ls_item_data TYPE lvc_s_itm, lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CLEAR lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-carrid. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-connid. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_item_data-value = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CITYFROM'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-cityfrom. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CITYTO'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-cityto. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      lv_node_key = io_column_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_node_root
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_item_table     = lt_item_data
        i_node_text      = |{ ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    io_column_tree->expand_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drag_start.
    " Hier könnte Logik implementiert werden, um die Drag-Daten zu setzen
    " z.B. drag_data->set_data( i_data = node_key ).
    MESSAGE |Drag started for node: { node_key }| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drag_drop.
    " Hier könnte Logik implementiert werden, um die Drop-Operation zu verarbeiten
    " z.B. DATA(lv_dragged_node) = drag_data->get_data( ).
    MESSAGE |Node { drag_data->get_data( ) } dropped on node: { node_key }| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie Daten aus der `sflights` Tabelle in eine einfache Excel-Datei (.xlsx) und speichern Sie diese als XSTRING.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Erstellen des Spreadsheets, `ADD_WORKSHEET` und `SET_CELL` zum Befüllen, und `SAVE` zum Generieren des XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_export_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_sflights_to_excel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_export_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 10 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
      cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
      cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_worksheet( iv_name = 'Flüge' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Datum' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Von' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'Nach' ).

    " Add data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }| ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-cityfrom ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_sflight-cityto ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie Daten in Excel und wenden Sie grundlegende Formatierungen an, z.B. Fettschrift für Header und Hintergrundfarben für bestimmte Zeilen basierend auf einer Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Formatierungsoptionen der `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` Methoden, insbesondere `SET_CELL_STYLE` oder `SET_ROW_STYLE`.

CLASS zcl_excel_export_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD export_sflights_with_format.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 10 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,

    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_worksheet( iv_name = 'Flüge mit Format' ).

    " Define a style for header
    DATA(lo_header_style) = lo_spreadsheet->create_style( ).
    lo_header_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
    lo_header_style->set_fill_background( cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_color_light_gray ).

    " Define a style for high price flights
    DATA(lo_high_price_style) = lo_spreadsheet->create_style( ).
    lo_high_price_style->set_fill_background( cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_color_light_yellow ).

    " Add header row with style
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline' ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Datum' ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Von' ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'Nach' ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 6 ip_value = 'Preis' ip_style = lo_header_style ).

    " Add data rows with conditional formatting
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lo_current_style) = COND #( WHEN ls_sflight-price > 500 THEN lo_high_price_style ELSE lo_spreadsheet->create_style( ) ).

      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ip_style = lo_current_style ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ip_style = lo_current_style ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }| ip_style = lo_current_style ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-cityfrom ip_style = lo_current_style ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_sflight-cityto ip_style = lo_current_style ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 6 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ip_style = lo_current_style ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie, wie Daten aus einer Excel-Datei mit `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` gelesen werden könnten. Erstellen Sie dazu eine Dummy-Excel-Datei im XSTRING-Format und lesen Sie deren Inhalt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOAD_SPREADSHEET_XSTRING` zum Laden der Datei und `GET_CELL_VALUE` zum Auslesen der Zellen. Beachten Sie die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_import_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_excel_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_excel_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS create_dummy_excel_xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_import_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_excel_xstring.
    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    lo_spreadsheet->load_spreadsheet_xstring( iv_xstring = iv_excel_xstring ).

    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_spreadsheet->get_worksheet_by_index( 1 ). " Get first worksheet
    IF lo_worksheet IS BOUND.
      DATA(lv_max_row) = lo_worksheet->get_max_row( ).
      DATA(lv_max_col) = lo_worksheet->get_max_column( ).

      LOOP FROM 1 TO lv_max_row INTO DATA(lv_row).
        DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_flight_data(
          col1 = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 )
          col2 = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 )
          col3 = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 )
        ).
        APPEND ls_data TO rt_data.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dummy_excel_xstring.
    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_worksheet( iv_name = 'Dummy Data' ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Header1' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Header2' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Header3' ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Value A1' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Value B1' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Value C1' ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Value A2' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Value B2' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Value C2' ).

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_excel_import.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_excel_import_basic( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_xstring) = lo_cut->create_dummy_excel_xstring( ).

    DATA(lt_read_data) = VALUE zcl_excel_import_basic=>tt_flight_data( ).
    TRY.
        lt_read_data = lo_cut->read_excel_xstring( iv_excel_xstring = lv_dummy_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet INTO DATA(lx_excel).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception during Excel read: { lx_excel->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_read_data )
      exp = 3 " Header + 2 data rows
      msg = 'Incorrect number of rows read'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_read_data INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_row2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_row2-col1
      exp = 'Value A1'
      msg = 'Incorrect value in cell A2'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei mit mehreren Arbeitsblättern, wobei jedes Blatt unterschiedliche Daten enthält (z.B. Flüge nach Destination).
hint: Verwenden Sie `ADD_WORKSHEET` mehrmals, um verschiedene Arbeitsblätter zu erstellen, und befüllen Sie jedes Blatt separat.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_multi_sheet_excel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS add_data_to_worksheet
      IMPORTING
        io_worksheet TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_worksheet
        it_sflights  TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_title     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_multi_sheet_excel.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 30 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
      cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
      cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).

    " Group flights by destination city
    LOOP AT lt_all_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-cityto.
      DATA(lv_cityto) = ls_sflight-cityto.
      DATA(lt_flights_for_city) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR flight IN GROUP ls_sflight ( flight ) ).

      DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_worksheet( iv_name = lv_cityto ).
      add_data_to_worksheet( io_worksheet = lo_worksheet it_sflights = lt_flights_for_city iv_title = |Flüge nach { lv_cityto }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_data_to_worksheet.
    DATA(lo_header_style) = lo_worksheet->get_parent_spreadsheet( )->create_style( ).
    lo_header_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
    lo_header_style->set_fill_background( cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_color_light_gray ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = iv_title ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->merge_cells( ip_row_from = 1 ip_col_from = 1 ip_row_to = 1 ip_col_to = 5 ).

    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline' ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Datum' ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Von' ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'Nach' ip_style = lo_header_style ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 3.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }| ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-cityfrom ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_sflight-cityto ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_formulas IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_excel_with_formulas.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 5 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      price = ls_sflight-price,
      currency = ls_sflight-curr
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_worksheet( iv_name = 'Flüge mit Formeln' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Preis' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Währung' ).

    " Add data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add a total row with a formula
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row + 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Gesamtpreis:' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_formula( ip_row = lv_row + 1 ip_column = 3 ip_formula = |SUM(C2:C{lv_row})| ).

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_col_tree_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_hierarchical_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_column_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS create_tree_columns
      IMPORTING
        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    METHODS fill_hierarchical_data
      IMPORTING
        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree
        it_sflights    TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_col_tree_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_hierarchical_tree.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 20 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
      cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
      cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
    ) ).

    ro_column_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      parent = iv_container
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).

    create_tree_columns( ro_column_tree ).
    fill_hierarchical_data( io_column_tree = ro_column_tree it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    ro_column_tree->set_first_visible_node( i_node_key = '1' ).
    ro_column_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_tree_columns.
    DATA: ls_column TYPE lvc_s_coln.
    ls_column-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_column-col_id = 'CARRID'. ls_column-text = 'Airline'. ls_column-width = 10. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ls_column-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_column-col_id = 'CONNID'. ls_column-text = 'Flight No.'. ls_column-width = 10. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ls_column-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_column-col_id = 'FLDATE'. ls_column-text = 'Flight Date'. ls_column-width = 12. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ls_column-fieldname = 'CITYFROM'. ls_column-col_id = 'CITYFROM'. ls_column-text = 'From City'. ls_column-width = 15. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ls_column-fieldname = 'CITYTO'. ls_column-col_id = 'CITYTO'. ls_column-text = 'To City'. ls_column-width = 15. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_hierarchical_data.
    DATA: lt_item_data TYPE lvc_t_itm, ls_item_data TYPE lvc_s_itm, lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.
    DATA: lv_parent_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      CLEAR lt_item_data.

CLASS zcl_excel_chart_concept DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_excel_for_chart
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_chart_concept IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_excel_for_chart.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 20 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      price = ls_sflight-price
    ) ).

    " Aggregate data for charting: Sum of prices per airline
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_worksheet( iv_name = 'Diagramm Daten' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Gesamtpreis' ).

    " Add aggregated data
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_data-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_data-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Note: cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet does not directly support chart creation.
    " This example prepares the data in a format suitable for manual chart creation in Excel.

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_col_tree_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

        io_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.

    DATA mo_column_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.
    DATA mt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_gui_col_tree_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_searchable_tree.
    mt_all_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 20 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
      cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
      cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
    ) ).

    ro_column_tree = NEW cl_gui_column_tree(
      parent = iv_container
      node_selection_mode = cl_gui_column_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).
    mo_column_tree = ro_column_tree.

    create_tree_columns( ro_column_tree ).
    fill_tree_data( io_column_tree = ro_column_tree it_sflights = mt_all_sflights ).

    ro_column_tree->set_first_visible_node( i_node_key = '1' ).
    ro_column_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_tree_columns.
    DATA: ls_column TYPE lvc_s_coln.
    ls_column-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_column-col_id = 'CARRID'. ls_column-text = 'Airline'. ls_column-width = 10. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ls_column-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_column-col_id = 'CONNID'. ls_column-text = 'Flight No.'. ls_column-width = 10. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ls_column-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_column-col_id = 'FLDATE'. ls_column-text = 'Flight Date'. ls_column-width = 12. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ls_column-fieldname = 'CITYFROM'. ls_column-col_id = 'CITYFROM'. ls_column-text = 'From City'. ls_column-width = 15. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
    ls_column-fieldname = 'CITYTO'. ls_column-col_id = 'CITYTO'. ls_column-text = 'To City'. ls_column-width = 15. io_column_tree->add_column( ls_column ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_item_data TYPE lvc_t_itm, ls_item_data TYPE lvc_s_itm, lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CLEAR lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-carrid. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-connid. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_item_data-value = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CITYFROM'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-cityfrom. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      ls_item_data-fieldname = 'CITYTO'. ls_item_data-value = ls_sflight-cityto. APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data.
      lv_node_key = io_column_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_node_root
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_item_table     = lt_item_data
        i_node_text      = |{ ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    io_column_tree->expand_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD search_and_highlight.
    CHECK mo_column_tree IS BOUND.

    " Clear previous highlights (conceptual)
    mo_column_tree->clear_all_styles( ).

    DATA(lo_highlight_style) = mo_column_tree->create_item_style( ).
    lo_highlight_style->set_background_color( cl_gui_column_tree=>co_color_yellow ).
    lo_highlight_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    DATA(lt_nodes) = mo_column_tree->get_all_nodes( ).
    LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node_key).
      DATA(lt_item_data) = VALUE lvc_t_itm( ).
      mo_column_tree->get_item_data( EXPORTING i_node_key = ls_node_key-node_key IMPORTING et_item_data = lt_item_data ).

      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_item_data INTO DATA(ls_item) WHERE value CP |*{ iv_search_term }*|.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_found = abap_true.
        mo_column_tree->set_node_style( i_node_key = ls_node_key-node_key i_style = lo_highlight_style ).
        mo_column_tree->set_node_visible( i_node_key = ls_node_key-node_key i_visible = abap_true ).
        mo_column_tree->expand_node( i_node_key = ls_node_key-node_key ).
      ELSE.
        " For filtering, you would hide nodes not matching the search term.
        " mo_column_tree->set_node_visible( i_node_key = ls_node_key-node_key i_visible = abap_false ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    mo_column_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei, die ein Arbeitsblatt mit Daten aus `sflights` enthält und die Spaltenbreite automatisch an den Inhalt anpasst.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `SET_COLUMN_AUTOFIT` des `cl_fdt_xl_worksheet` Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_autofit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_excel_with_autofit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_autofit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_excel_with_autofit.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights UP TO 10 ROWS (
      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
      cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
      cityto = ls_sflight-cityto
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_worksheet( iv_name = 'Autofit Spalten' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Datum des Fluges' ). " Longer header
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Abflugort' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 5 ip_value = 'Zielort' ).

    " Add data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }| ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-cityfrom ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 5 ip_value = ls_sflight-cityto ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Autofit columns
    lo_worksheet->set_column_autofit( ip_column_from = 1 ip_column_to = 5 ).

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Zahlen verarbeitet. Die Klasse soll eine öffentliche Methode `calculate_sum_of_squares` haben, die die Summe der Quadrate der Zahlen berechnet. Die Berechnung des Quadrats einer einzelnen Zahl soll in einer privaten Hilfsmethode erfolgen.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Methode im `PRIVATE SECTION` und rufen Sie diese von der öffentlichen Methode auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_square
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_square) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT sum = sum + get_square( number )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_square.
    rv_square = iv_number * iv_number.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( (1) (2) (3) (4) ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_math_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ). " 1*1 + 2*2 + 3*3 + 4*4 = 1 + 4 + 9 + 16 = 30
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die private Methode `get_square` kapselt die Logik zur Quadratberechnung und macht sie nur innerhalb der Klasse verfügbar. Dies fördert die Modularität und Lesbarkeit. Die `REDUCE` Anweisung (ABAP 7.40+) wird für die effiziente Aggregation der Summe verwendet.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, Object Orientation, Helper Method, REDUCE, ABAP 7.40+

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Singleton-Muster für eine Klasse, die eine Konfiguration verwaltet. Der Konstruktor soll privat sein, und der Zugriff auf die einzige Instanz soll über eine statische öffentliche Methode erfolgen.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Konstruktor im `PRIVATE SECTION` und verwenden Sie eine statische Methode im `PUBLIC SECTION` zur Instanziierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_singleton_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance RETURNING VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_config.
    METHODS get_setting IMPORTING iv_key TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
    METHODS set_setting IMPORTING iv_key TYPE string iv_value TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton_config.
    DATA mt_settings TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_singleton_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialisierung der Konfiguration
    INSERT 'DefaultValue1' INTO TABLE mt_settings INDEX 1.
    INSERT 'DefaultValue2' INTO TABLE mt_settings INDEX 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance.
    IF go_instance IS NOT BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT go_instance.
    ENDIF.
    ro_instance = go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_setting.
    READ TABLE mt_settings INTO rv_value WITH KEY table_line = iv_key.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_setting.
    MODIFY TABLE mt_settings FROM iv_value INDEX 1 TRANSPORTING table_line WHERE table_line = iv_key.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT iv_value INTO TABLE mt_settings INDEX 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_singleton_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_singleton_pattern.
    DATA(lo_config1) = zcl_singleton_config=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_config2) = zcl_singleton_config=>get_instance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_config1 exp = lo_config2 ). " Beide Referenzen zeigen auf dasselbe Objekt

    lo_config1->set_setting( iv_key = 'APP_MODE' iv_value = 'PRODUCTION' ).
    DATA(lv_mode) = lo_config2->get_setting( 'APP_MODE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_mode exp = 'PRODUCTION' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Singleton-Muster stellt sicher, dass eine Klasse nur eine Instanz hat und einen globalen Zugriffspunkt darauf bietet. Der private Konstruktor verhindert die direkte Instanziierung von außen, während die statische Methode `get_instance` die einzige Möglichkeit ist, die Instanz zu erhalten. Dies ist nützlich für globale Konfigurationen oder Ressourcenmanager.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, Singleton, Object Orientation, Class-Methods, Encapsulation

hint: Sie müssen die Tabelle von Objektreferenzen sortieren. Die `SORT` Anweisung kann direkt auf Tabellen von Objektreferenzen angewendet werden, wenn die Sortierfelder über den Objektzugriffspfad erreichbar sind.

CLASS zcl_flight_object_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
