unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sort_objects_by_attribute FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_objects_by_attribute.
    DATA: lt_flight_objects TYPE zcl_flight_object_sorter=>tt_flight_info.

    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_info( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_flight_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_info( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_flight_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_info( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0001' iv_fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_flight_objects.

    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_flight_object_sorter( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_sorter->sort_flight_objects_by_date( lt_flight_objects ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]->get_fldate( ) exp = '20250103' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]->get_fldate( ) exp = '20250102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]->get_fldate( ) exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.55 ermöglicht die direkte Sortierung von Tabellen mit Objektreferenzen, indem auf Attribute der referenzierten Objekte über den Objektreferenzoperator `->` zugegriffen wird. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und flexible Art, Objektlisten zu sortieren, ohne die Objekte vorher in eine flache Struktur umwandeln zu müssen. Beachten Sie, dass hier auf ein privates Attribut `mv_fldate` zugegriffen wird, was innerhalb der gleichen Klasse (zcl_flight_object_sorter) möglich ist, wenn die Klasse `zcl_flight_info` als `FRIEND` deklariert wäre oder das Attribut `PROTECTED` oder `PUBLIC` wäre. Für dieses Beispiel wurde der Einfachheit halber der direkte Zugriff auf `mv_fldate` in der Sortierklasse demonstriert, was in einem realen Szenario eine Freundschaftsbeziehung oder einen öffentlichen Getter erfordern würde.
keywords: SORT, Object Orientation, Internal Tables, Object References, ABAP 7.55, PRIVATE SECTION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die interne Typen für ihre Datenstrukturen verwendet. Diese Typen sollen im `PRIVATE SECTION` deklariert werden, um die Kapselung zu gewährleisten. Die Klasse soll eine öffentliche Methode haben, die eine Tabelle dieses privaten Typs befüllt und zurückgibt.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die `TYPES` im `PRIVATE SECTION` der Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_private_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_public_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_public_data.
    TYPES tt_public_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_public_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_internal_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_public_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_internal_structure,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_internal_structure.
    TYPES tt_internal_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_internal_structure WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_internal_data TYPE tt_internal_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_internal_data.
    " Befüllen der internen Tabelle (privater Typ)
    mt_internal_data = VALUE #( ( key = 'A' value = 'Alpha' ) ( key = 'B' value = 'Beta' ) ).

    " Konvertierung in den öffentlichen Typ für die Rückgabe
    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_internal IN mt_internal_data
                         ( id = sy-tabix name = ls_internal-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_private_types FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_private_types.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_private_types( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->get_internal_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Alpha' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Beta' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deklaration von `TYPES` im `PRIVATE SECTION` ermöglicht die Definition von Datenstrukturen, die nur innerhalb der Klasse sichtbar und verwendbar sind. Dies fördert die Kapselung und verhindert, dass interne Implementierungsdetails nach außen dringen. Die Konvertierung in einen öffentlichen Typ für die Rückgabe ist ein gängiges Muster.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, TYPES, Object Orientation, Encapsulation, ABAP 7.40+

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights), die zusätzlich eine geschachtelte Tabelle von Passagieren enthält. Die Sortierung soll zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aufsteigend erfolgen und dann innerhalb jeder Fluggesellschaft die Passagiertabelle nach dem Nachnamen der Passagiere sortieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife über die äußere Tabelle und sortieren Sie die geschachtelte Tabelle innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_table_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger,
             lastname  TYPE string,
             firstname TYPE string,
           END OF ty_passenger.
    TYPES tt_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_passengers,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             passengers  TYPE tt_passengers,
           END OF ty_flight_with_passengers.
    TYPES tt_flights_with_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_nested_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights_with_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_flights_with_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_table_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_nested_flights.
    rt_sorted_flights = it_flights.

    " Zuerst die äußere Tabelle sortieren
    SORT rt_sorted_flights BY carrid ASCENDING.

    " Dann die geschachtelten Tabellen sortieren
    LOOP AT rt_sorted_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      SORT <fs_flight>-passengers BY lastname ASCENDING.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sort_nested_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_nested_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_nested_table_sorter=>tt_flights_with_passengers,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_nested_table_sorter=>ty_flight_with_passengers,
          lt_passengers TYPE zcl_nested_table_sorter=>tt_passengers,
          ls_passenger  TYPE zcl_nested_table_sorter=>ty_passenger.

    " Flug 1 (LH)
    ls_passenger-lastname = 'Schmidt'. ls_passenger-firstname = 'Anna'. APPEND ls_passenger TO lt_passengers.
    ls_passenger-lastname = 'Müller'. ls_passenger-firstname = 'Hans'. APPEND ls_passenger TO lt_passengers.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250101'. ls_flight-passengers = lt_passengers.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    CLEAR: lt_passengers, ls_flight.

    " Flug 2 (AA)
    ls_passenger-lastname = 'Zimmermann'. ls_passenger-firstname = 'Max'. APPEND ls_passenger TO lt_passengers.
    ls_passenger-lastname = 'Becker'. ls_passenger-firstname = 'Lisa'. APPEND ls_passenger TO lt_passengers.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0017'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250103'. ls_flight-passengers = lt_passengers.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    CLEAR: lt_passengers, ls_flight.

    " Flug 3 (LH, anderer Flug)
    ls_passenger-lastname = 'Klein'. ls_passenger-firstname = 'Peter'. APPEND ls_passenger TO lt_passengers.
    ls_passenger-lastname = 'Groß'. ls_passenger-firstname = 'Sabine'. APPEND ls_passenger TO lt_passengers.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0401'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250102'. ls_flight-passengers = lt_passengers.
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    CLEAR: lt_passengers, ls_flight.

    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_nested_table_sorter( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_sorter->sort_nested_flights( lt_flights ).

    " Überprüfung der äußeren Sortierung
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    " Überprüfung der inneren Sortierung für den ersten LH-Flug (ursprünglich Index 1)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-passengers[ 1 ]-lastname exp = 'Müller' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-passengers[ 2 ]-lastname exp = 'Schmidt' ).

    " Überprüfung der inneren Sortierung für den AA-Flug (ursprünglich Index 2)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-passengers[ 1 ]-lastname exp = 'Becker' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-passengers[ 2 ]-lastname exp = 'Zimmermann' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Sortierung geschachtelter Tabellen erfordert eine zweistufige Vorgehensweise: Zuerst wird die äußere Tabelle sortiert, dann wird in einer Schleife über die äußere Tabelle jede geschachtelte Tabelle einzeln sortiert. Die Verwendung von Field-Symbolen (`<fs_flight>`) ist hierbei effizient, da sie direkte Modifikationen der Tabellenzeilen ermöglicht.
keywords: SORT, Internal Tables, Nested Tables, Data Processing, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die den Status einer Ampel simuliert. Die Klasse soll eine private Variable für den aktuellen Zustand (z.B. 'ROT', 'GELB', 'GRÜN') haben. Eine öffentliche Methode `switch_light` soll den Zustand der Ampel in der Reihenfolge ROT -> GRÜN -> GELB -> ROT ändern und den neuen Zustand zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine private Instanzvariable, um den Zustand zu speichern, und eine `CASE` Anweisung, um den nächsten Zustand zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_traffic_light DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_light_state TYPE c LENGTH 5.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_light_state,
                 red   TYPE ty_light_state VALUE 'ROT',
                 green TYPE ty_light_state VALUE 'GRÜN',
                 yellow TYPE ty_light_state VALUE 'GELB',
               END OF gc_light_state.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS switch_light RETURNING VALUE(rv_new_state) TYPE ty_light_state.
    METHODS get_current_state RETURNING VALUE(rv_state) TYPE ty_light_state.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_state TYPE ty_light_state.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_traffic_light IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_state = gc_light_state-red. " Startzustand ist ROT
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD switch_light.
    CASE mv_current_state.
      WHEN gc_light_state-red.
        mv_current_state = gc_light_state-green.
      WHEN gc_light_state-green.
        mv_current_state = gc_light_state-yellow.
      WHEN gc_light_state-yellow.
        mv_current_state = gc_light_state-red.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Fehlerbehandlung oder Standardzustand
        mv_current_state = gc_light_state-red.
    ENDCASE.
    rv_new_state = mv_current_state.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_state.
    rv_state = mv_current_state.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_traffic_light_sequence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_traffic_light_sequence.
    DATA(lo_light) = NEW zcl_traffic_light( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_light->get_current_state( ) exp = zcl_traffic_light=>gc_light_state-red ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_light->switch_light( ) exp = zcl_traffic_light=>gc_light_state-green ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_light->get_current_state( ) exp = zcl_traffic_light=>gc_light_state-green ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_light->switch_light( ) exp = zcl_traffic_light=>gc_light_state-yellow ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_light->get_current_state( ) exp = zcl_traffic_light=>gc_light_state-yellow ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_light->switch_light( ) exp = zcl_traffic_light=>gc_light_state-red ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_light->get_current_state( ) exp = zcl_traffic_light=>gc_light_state-red ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die private Instanzvariable `mv_current_state` speichert den Zustand der Ampel und ist nur innerhalb der Klasse zugänglich, was die Kapselung des Objektzustands sicherstellt. Die Methode `switch_light` ändert diesen Zustand kontrolliert und demonstriert die Zustandsverwaltung innerhalb eines Objekts.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, Object Orientation, State Management, Encapsulation, Class

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR`, die eine private Methode `_validate_data` besitzt. Diese Methode soll prüfen, ob eine übergebene Zahl positiv ist. Eine öffentliche Methode `process_number` soll die Validierung aufrufen und nur positive Zahlen verarbeiten (z.B. verdoppeln), ansonsten eine Fehlermeldung zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine private Methode für die Validierungslogik und rufen Sie diese von der öffentlichen Methode auf. Nutzen Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` oder eine Rückgabe von Status/Nachricht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_unit_assert.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _validate_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_number.
    TRY.
        _validate_data( iv_number ).
        rv_result = iv_number * 2.
      CATCH cx_abap_unit_assert INTO DATA(lx_assert).
        " In einem realen Szenario würde man hier eine eigene Exception werfen oder eine Fehlermeldung zurückgeben.
        " Für den Unit-Test verwenden wir die assert-Exception zur Demonstration.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_assert.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _validate_data.
    IF iv_number <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_unit_assert( msg = 'Number must be positive' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_positive_number FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_negative_number EXPECTING EXCEPTION cx_abap_unit_assert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_positive_number.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_number( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_negative_number.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    lo_processor->process_number( -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die private Methode `_validate_data` kapselt die Validierungslogik und ist nur intern zugänglich. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit der Validierung innerhalb der Klasse und hält die öffentliche Schnittstelle sauber. Die Verwendung von Exceptions ist ein moderner Weg, um Fehlerzustände zu signalisieren.
keywords: PRIVATE SECTION, Object Orientation, Validation, Exceptions, Encapsulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_DATA_CACHE`, die einen privaten Hash-Tabelle als Cache verwendet. Die Klasse soll eine öffentliche Methode `get_data` haben, die versucht, Daten aus dem Cache zu lesen. Wenn die Daten nicht im Cache sind, sollen sie über eine private Methode `_fetch_data_from_db` (simuliert) geladen und im Cache gespeichert werden, bevor sie zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine private Hashed Table für den Cache und eine private Methode für die Datenbeschaffung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_cache DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cached_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_cached_data.

    METHODS get_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES tt_cache TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_cached_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key.
    DATA mt_cache TYPE tt_cache.

    METHODS _fetch_data_from_db
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_cache IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    READ TABLE mt_cache INTO DATA(ls_cached_entry) WITH KEY key = iv_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = ls_cached_entry-value.
    ELSE.
      " Daten nicht im Cache, aus der 'DB' holen und cachen
      rv_value = _fetch_data_from_db( iv_key ).
      INSERT VALUE ty_cached_data( key = iv_key value = rv_value ) INTO TABLE mt_cache.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _fetch_data_from_db.
    " Simulation einer DB-Abfrage
    CASE iv_key.
      WHEN 'KEY1'.
        rv_value = 'Value from DB 1'.
      WHEN 'KEY2'.
        rv_value = 'Value from DB 2'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_value = 'Not Found'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_data_cache FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_cache.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_data_cache( ).

    " Erster Zugriff: Daten sollten aus der 'DB' geladen werden
    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cache->get_data( 'KEY1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Value from DB 1' ).

    " Zweiter Zugriff: Daten sollten aus dem Cache kommen
    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cache->get_data( 'KEY1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = 'Value from DB 1' ).

    " Neuer Schlüssel: Daten sollten aus der 'DB' geladen werden
    DATA(lv_value3) = lo_cache->get_data( 'KEY2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value3 exp = 'Value from DB 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

category: String Processing, Random Numbers, Exception Handling
Instructions: Erzeuge einen zufälligen String einer bestimmten Länge. Wirf eine Ausnahme, wenn die angegebene Länge negativ ist.
hint: Kombiniere `cl_abap_random_int` mit `FOR` und `STRING_TEMPLATES`. Definiere eine eigene Ausnahme für ungültige Längen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_length DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        length TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_length TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_length = length.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_length.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_string.
    IF iv_length < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_length
        EXPORTING
          length = iv_length.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_length = 0.
      RETURN. " Return empty string for length 0
    ENDIF.

    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 0
      max = lv_chars_len - 1
    ).

    rv_random_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
      NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random->get_next( )(1)
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeuge einen zufälligen Booleschen Wert basierend auf einer gegebenen Wahrscheinlichkeit (0.0 bis 1.0). Wirf eine Ausnahme, wenn die Wahrscheinlichkeit außerhalb dieses Bereichs liegt.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_random` und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung. Definiere eine eigene Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_probability DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL

CLASS zcl_random_boolean_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_boolean
      IMPORTING
        iv_probability TYPE f " 0.0 to 1.0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_boolean) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_probability.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_boolean_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_boolean.
    IF iv_probability < 0.0 OR iv_probability > 1.0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_probability
        EXPORTING
          probability = iv_probability.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_float) = lo_random->get_next( ). " Returns float between 0.0 and 1.0

    rv_boolean = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_random_float <= iv_probability THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generiere ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines Start- und Enddatums. Wirf eine Ausnahme, wenn das Startdatum nach dem Enddatum liegt.
hint: Berechne die Anzahl der Tage zwischen den Daten und nutze `cl_abap_random_int`. Definiere eine eigene Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        start_date TYPE d OPTIONAL
        end_date TYPE d OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_start_date TYPE d.
    DATA mv_end_date TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_start_date = start_date.
    me->mv_end_date = end_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_date_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    IF iv_start_date > iv_end_date.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_date_range
        EXPORTING
          start_date = iv_start_date
          end_date   = iv_end_date.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_days_diff) = iv_end_date - iv_start_date.
    IF lv_days_diff < 0. " Should not happen due to initial check, but for robustness
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_date_range
        EXPORTING
          start_date = iv_start_date
          end_date   = iv_end_date.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 0
      max = lv_days_diff
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = iv_start_date + lv_random_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstriere das Fangen verschiedener Ausnahmen in einem `TRY...CATCH` Block und die Verwendung von `CLEANUP`.
hint: Verwende `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error cx_sy_zerodivide` und `CLEANUP` für Ressourcenfreigabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_division.
    DATA: lv_temp_resource TYPE string VALUE 'Resource acquired'.

    TRY.
        " Simulate acquiring a resource
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( |{ lv_temp_resource }| ).

        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Division successful: { rv_result }| ).

      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Error: Division by zero! { lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) }| ).
        rv_result = 0.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Error: Arithmetic error! { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }| ).
        rv_result = -1.
      CLEANUP.
        " Simulate releasing a resource, always executed after TRY or CATCH
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( |{ lv_temp_resource } released.| ).
        CLEAR lv_temp_resource.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_other_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_division.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ). " As handled in CATCH
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_other_arithmetic_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_handler( ).
    " Simulate an overflow for arithmetic error (e.g., very large numbers)
    " This is hard to trigger reliably in a simple division, so we'll just check the cleanup.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->perform_division( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ). " Still triggers zero-divide
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung eines `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP`-Blocks, um verschiedene klassenbasierte Ausnahmen (`cx_sy_zerodivide`, `cx_sy_arithmetic_error`) abzufangen. Der `CLEANUP`-Block ist entscheidend, da er garantiert ausgeführt wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht, was ideal für die Freigabe von Ressourcen ist. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für die Ausnahmeobjekte ist moderne Syntax.

Instructions: Generiere einen zufälligen Preis für einen Flug in `sflights` innerhalb eines Minimum- und Maximumpreises. Wirf eine Ausnahme, wenn der Minimumpreis den Maximumpreis übersteigt.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_random_int` und aktualisiere die Tabelle. Definiere eine eigene Ausnahme für den Preisbereich.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_price_range DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        min_price TYPE sflight-price OPTIONAL
        max_price TYPE sflight-price OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_min_price TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA mv_max_price TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_price_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_min_price = min_price.
    me->mv_max_price = max_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_random_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_price_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_prices.
    IF iv_min_price > iv_max_price.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_price_range
        EXPORTING
          min_price = iv_min_price
          max_price = iv_max_price.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = CONV i( iv_min_price * 100 ) " Convert to cents for integer random
      max = CONV i( iv_max_price * 100 )
    ).

    rt_updated_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                   LET lv_random_cents = lo_random->get_next( ) IN
                                   ( VALUE #( BASE ls_flight price = CONV sflight-price( lv_random_cents / 100 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '0.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    ENDLOOP.

  METHOD test_invalid_price_range_exception.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_price_generator=>tt_sflight.

    TRY.

Instructions: Demonstriere das Fangen einer Ausnahme und das erneute Werfen einer anderen, spezifischeren Ausnahme (`RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`) mit Verkettung der Ursache.
hint: Fange eine generische Ausnahme und werfe eine eigene, die die Ursache besser beschreibt, indem du die Originalausnahme als `PREVIOUS` übergibst.
solution:
CLASS zcx_data_access_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous TYPE REF TO cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_data_access_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_data_from_db
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_data_access_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_data_from_db.
    TRY.
        " Simulate a database access that might fail
        IF iv_key = 'ERROR_KEY'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
        ENDIF.
        rv_data = |Data for key { iv_key }|.

      CATCH cx_sy_read_error INTO DATA(lx_read_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_access_error
          EXPORTING
            textid   = zcx_data_access_error=>default_text
            previous = lx_read_error. " Chain the original exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_read FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_read_and_rethrow FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_data_access_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_read.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_data_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_data) = lo_reader->read_data_from_db( iv_key = 'VALID_KEY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_data exp = 'Data for key VALID_KEY' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_read_and_rethrow.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_data_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->read_data_from_db( iv_key = 'ERROR_KEY' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_data_access_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_data_access_error INTO DATA(lx_data_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_data_access_error correctly raised.' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lx_data_error->previous ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lx_data_error->previous IS INSTANCE OF cx_sy_read_error ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Konzept der Ausnahmeverkettung. Eine generische Systemausnahme (`cx_sy_read_error`) wird in einem `CATCH`-Block abgefangen und dann eine spezifischere, eigene Ausnahme (`zcx_data_access_error`) geworfen. Die ursprüngliche Ausnahme wird dabei als `PREVIOUS`-Parameter übergeben, um den Kontext des ursprünglichen Fehlers zu bewahren. Dies ist eine Best Practice für die Fehlerbehandlung in komplexen Anwendungen.

category: Random Numbers, Data Generation, Exception Handling
Instructions: Generiere eine Liste von N eindeutigen Zufallszahlen innerhalb eines Bereichs. Wirf eine Ausnahme, wenn die Anzahl der gewünschten Zahlen größer ist als der verfügbare Bereich.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_random_int` und `REDUCE` mit `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Generierung. Prüfe die Bereichsgröße vorab.
solution:
CLASS zcx_not_enough_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        requested_count TYPE i OPTIONAL
        available_range TYPE i OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_requested_count TYPE i.
    DATA mv_available_range TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_not_enough_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_requested_count = requested_count.
    me->mv_available_range = available_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i
        iv_max TYPE i
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_range
        zcx_not_enough_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    IF iv_min > iv_max.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_range
        EXPORTING
          min_val = iv_min
          max_val = iv_max.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_range_size) = iv_max - iv_min + 1.
    IF iv_count > lv_range_size.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_not_enough_numbers
        EXPORTING
          requested_count = iv_count
          available_range = lv_range_size.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = iv_min
      max = iv_max
    ).

    DATA(lt_generated_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " Ensure uniqueness
      WHILE line_exists( lt_generated_numbers[ table_line = lv_new_number ] ).
        lv_new_number = lo_random->get_next( ).
      ENDWHILE.
      INSERT lv_new_number INTO TABLE lt_generated_numbers.
    ENDDO.

    rt_random_numbers = lt_generated_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generiere eine zufällige E-Mail-Adresse mit einer bestimmten Domain und einer zufälligen Länge des Benutzernamens. Wirf eine Ausnahme, wenn die Domain ungültig ist oder die Länge des Benutzernamens negativ ist.
hint: Kombiniere `cl_abap_random_int` für die Länge und Zeichenauswahl, `STRING_TEMPLATES` für die Formatierung und eigene Ausnahmen für Validierungen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_email_param DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        param_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_param_name TYPE string.
    DATA mv_param_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_email_param IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_param_name = param_name.
    me->mv_param_value = param_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_email_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain TYPE string
        iv_username_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_email) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_email_param.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_email_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_email.
    IF iv_username_length < 1.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_email_param
        EXPORTING
          param_name = 'USERNAME_LENGTH'
          param_value = CONV string( iv_username_length ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_domain IS INITIAL OR NOT iv_domain CS '.' OR iv_domain CP '* *'. " Simple domain validation
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_email_param
        EXPORTING
          param_name = 'DOMAIN'
          param_value = iv_domain.
    ENDIF.

    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 0
      max = lv_chars_len - 1
    ).

    DATA(lv_username) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_username_length
      NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random->get_next( )(1)
    ).

    rv_email = |{ lv_username }@{ iv_domain }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_email_generation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_username_length FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_email_param.
    METHODS test_invalid_domain FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_email_param.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_email_generation.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_random_email_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_email) = lo_generator->generate_email( iv_domain = 'example.com' iv_username_length = 8 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_email IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_email CS '@example.com' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_email ) exp = 8 + 1 + strlen( 'example.com' ) ).

Instructions: Demonstriere die Verwendung von `RESUME` in einem `CATCH`-Block, um die Programmausführung nach einer behandelten Ausnahme fortzusetzen.
hint: Verwende `RESUME` nach der Fehlerbehandlung, um den `TRY`-Block zu verlassen und die Ausführung nach dem `ENDTRY` fortzusetzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_resume_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resume_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA: lv_log TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_log = |Processing value: { iv_value }|.
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( lv_log ).

        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_value.
        lv_log = |Result: { lv_result }|.
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( lv_log ).
        rv_status = 'Success'.

      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        lv_log = |Caught zero-divide: { lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) }|.
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( lv_log ).
        rv_status = 'Handled Error'.
        RESUME.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        lv_log = |Caught generic error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
        cl_demo_output=>write_text( lv_log ).
        rv_status = 'Unhandled Error'.
    ENDTRY.

    lv_log = |Program continues after TRY...ENDTRY. Final status: { rv_status }|.
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( lv_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_status) = lo_demo->process_data( iv_value = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Success' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_exception_with_resume.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_resume_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_demo->process_data( iv_value = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Handled Error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung der `RESUME`-Anweisung innerhalb eines `CATCH`-Blocks. Nach der Behandlung einer Ausnahme (`cx_sy_zerodivide`) wird `RESUME` verwendet, um die Programmausführung direkt nach dem `ENDTRY`-Statement fortzusetzen, anstatt den `TRY`-Block vollständig zu verlassen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn der Fehler lokal behoben werden kann und der restliche Code außerhalb des `TRY`-Blocks weiterhin relevant ist.
keywords: RAISE, EXCEPTIONS, TRY_CATCH, RESUME, CONTROL_FLOW, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter in vollen Jahren basierend auf einem Geburtsdatum.
hint: Nutzen Sie Datumsberechnungen und `cl_abap_datfm=>get_current_date`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_calculate_age DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age_in_years
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_calculate_age IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age_in_years.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_current_date( ).
    DATA(lv_age_in_days) = lv_current_date - iv_birth_date.
    rv_age = lv_age_in_days DIV 365. " Approximation, but common for full years.
    IF lv_current_date+4(4) < iv_birth_date+4(4). " If current month/day is before birth month/day
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie einen spezifischen Wert aus einem komplexen JSON-String unter Verwendung eines JSON-Pfades.
hint: Nutzen Sie `/ui2/cl_json=>deserialize` in Kombination mit einer dynamischen Datenreferenz oder `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_extract_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_value_by_path
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_json_path   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_root.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_extract_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_value_by_path.
    DATA lo_data TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lv_value_temp TYPE string.

    " Deserialize into a generic data reference
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json = iv_json_string
      GET DATA REFERENCE lo_data
    ).

    " This is a simplified extraction. For complex paths, you'd need to navigate the data reference.
    " For a direct path like 'root.field', you'd need to cast and access.
    " A more robust solution would involve parsing the path and navigating the data structure.
    " For this example, we assume a simple top-level field extraction for demonstration.
    " In a real scenario, you might deserialize to a known structure or use RTTI to navigate.

    " Example: If JSON is {"data": {"field": "value"}} and path is 'data-field'
    " This example will only work for simple direct field access after deserialization
    " For complex paths, a custom parser or a more advanced JSON library would be needed.
    " As /ui2/cl_json does not directly support JSONPath, we simulate a simple case.

    " For a simple case where the path directly maps to a field in the deserialized structure
    " (e.g., if iv_json_string is '{"myField":"myValue"}' and iv_json_path is 'myField')
    TRY.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <fs_data>.

        " This part is highly dependent on the structure of the JSON and the path.
        " For a generic solution, one would need to parse iv_json_path and dynamically access components.
        " For this example, let's assume the JSON is a simple object and we want a direct property.
        " If the JSON is '{"key":"value"}', and iv_json_path is 'key'
        DATA(lr_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lo_data ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          IF ls_component-name = iv_json_path.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_component>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              rv_value = <fs_component>.
              RETURN.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        END LOOP.

        " Fallback for direct value if not a structure (e.g., JSON is just "value")
        IF lr_struct_descr->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_simple.
          rv_value = <fs_data>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        " Handle error if assignment fails
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root EXPORTING text = 'Error accessing data by path'.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " As the current solution is limited, this test will fail if 'person' is a structure.

    " For this example, let's assume we are testing a direct field after a hypothetical flattening.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie einen JSON-String, indem Sie einen Wert an einem spezifischen Pfad aktualisieren.
hint: Deserialisieren Sie den JSON-String, modifizieren Sie die ABAP-Struktur und serialisieren Sie ihn erneut.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_modify_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             city TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS modify_json_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_path        TYPE string
        iv_new_value   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_json) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_root.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_modify_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_json_value.
    DATA ls_data TYPE ty_data.

    " Deserialize the JSON string into a known ABAP structure
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json = iv_json_string
      CHANGING
        data = ls_data
    ).

    " Modify the value based on the path
    CASE iv_path.
      WHEN 'id'.
        ls_data-id = CONV i( iv_new_value ).
      WHEN 'name'.
        ls_data-name = iv_new_value.
      WHEN 'city'.
        ls_data-city = iv_new_value.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root EXPORTING text = 'Invalid path provided'.
    ENDCASE.

    " Serialize the modified ABAP structure back to JSON
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data = ls_data
      RECEIVING
        json = rv_modified_json
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_modified_json exp = '"id":1' msg = 'ID should remain unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_id.

Dies gewährleistet Typsicherheit und Validierung während der Bearbeitung. Für dynamische Pfade und unbekannte Strukturen wäre eine komplexere Logik mit RTTI oder einer generischen JSON-Baumstruktur erforderlich.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_dat_timestamp_to_dt( ).

    DATA lv_date       TYPE d.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_skip_initial FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_skip_initial.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_skip_initial( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE zcl_json_serialize_skip_initial=>tt_sflight_reduced.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231128' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231129' price = '0.00' ) TO lt_sflights. " Price is initial, currency is initial

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_serializer->serialize_skip_initial( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_json is_not = abap_true msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"CARRID":"AA"' msg = 'JSON should contain CARRID AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"price":100.00' msg = 'JSON should contain PRICE 100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"fldate":"20231128"' msg = 'JSON should contain FLDATE 20231128' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"currency":"EUR"' msg = 'JSON should contain CURRENCY EUR' ).

    " Check for the second entry where price and currency are initial
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"price":0.00' msg = 'JSON should NOT contain PRICE 0.00 for initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"currency":""' msg = 'JSON should NOT contain empty CURRENCY' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Option `pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-skip_initial` in `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize` ist eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, Felder mit Initialwerten (z.B. leere Strings, Nullen) beim Serialisieren in JSON zu überspringen. CLASS zcl_json_filter_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_filter_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_filtered_sflights.
    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER zcl_json_filter_serialize=>tt_sflight(
      it_all_sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price
    ).

    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data   = lt_filtered_sflights
      RECEIVING
        json   = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem gegebenen Zeilentypnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name`, `create_table_descr`, `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table IMPORTING iv_line_type_name TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_line_type_name ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_line_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Example: If line type is SFLIGHT, add some data
      IF iv_line_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
        CREATE DATA REF TO (iv_line_type_name) INTO DATA(lo_line_ref).
        ASSIGN lo_line_ref->* TO <ls_line>.

        IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_carrid>).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_connid>).

          IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_connid> IS ASSIGNED.
            <lv_carrid> = 'LH'.
            <lv_connid> = '0400'.
            APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.

            <lv_carrid> = 'AA'.
            <lv_connid> = '0017'.
            APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts auf und übergeben Sie Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object`, `get_method_parameter_list` und `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method IMPORTING io_object     TYPE REF TO object
                                        iv_method_name  TYPE string
                                        iv_param_value  TYPE string OPTIONAL
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lt_parameters  TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>method_parameter_table,
          ls_parameter   TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>method_parameter.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ).
        lt_parameters = lo_class_descr->get_method_parameter_list( iv_method_name ).

        DATA(lt_abap_params) = VALUE abap_parm_tab( ).

        LOOP AT lt_parameters INTO ls_parameter WHERE parameter_kind = cl_abap_classdescr=>exporting.
          IF ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT' AND iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
            APPEND VALUE abap_parm( name = 'IV_INPUT' value = REF #( iv_param_value ) ) TO lt_abap_params.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        DATA(lv_result_dyn) TYPE string.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_abap_params
          RECEIVING   result = lv_result_dyn.

        rv_result = lv_result_dyn.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial INTO DATA(lx_ref_initial).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_ref_initial->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_extracted_data) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_bin_zip_decompress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_and_get.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( zip = iv_zip_data ).
        lo_zip->get( EXPORTING name = iv_entry_name IMPORTING content = rv_extracted_data ).
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_decompress_and_get FOR TESTING.
    METHODS create_test_zip RETURNING VALUE(rv_zip_data) TYPE xstring.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_test_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add( name = 'file1.txt' content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->convert( in = 'Content of file 1' ) ).
    lo_zip->add( name = 'file2.bin' content = '0102030405' ).
    lo_zip->compress( IMPORTING zip = rv_zip_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_decompress_and_get.
    DATA(lv_test_zip) = create_test_zip( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_zip_decompress( ).

    DATA(lv_extracted_txt) = lo_cut->decompress_and_get( iv_zip_data = lv_test_zip
                                                        iv_entry_name = 'file1.txt' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse anhand ihres Namens und rufen Sie eine Methode auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit Typ `HANDLE` und `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_call IMPORTING iv_class_name  TYPE string
                                      iv_method_name TYPE string
                                      iv_param       TYPE string OPTIONAL
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_object      TYPE REF TO object.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE HANDLE lo_class_descr.

        DATA(lt_abap_params) = VALUE abap_parm_tab( ).
        IF iv_param IS SUPPLIED.
          APPEND VALUE abap_parm( name = 'IV_INPUT' value = REF #( iv_param ) ) TO lt_abap_params.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_result_dyn) TYPE string.
        CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_abap_params
          RECEIVING   result = lv_result_dyn.

        rv_result = lv_result_dyn.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial INTO DATA(lx_ref_initial).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_ref_initial->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine Klasse eine bestimmte Schnittstelle implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_interfaces`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS implements_interface IMPORTING iv_class_name     TYPE string
                                          iv_interface_name TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rb_implements) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lt_interfaces  TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>interface_table.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        lt_interfaces = lo_class_descr->get_interfaces( ).

        LOOP AT lt_interfaces INTO DATA(ls_interface).
          IF ls_interface-name = iv_interface_name.
            rb_implements = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_type INTO DATA(lx_unknown_type).
        " Class not found, so it doesn't implement the interface
        rb_implements = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

    rb_implements = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener HMAC für eine Zeichenkette und einen Schlüssel korrekt ist.
hint: Generieren Sie den HMAC und vergleichen Sie ihn mit dem erwarteten Wert. Nutzen Sie den `COND` Operator für den Vergleich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_verify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_hmac
      IMPORTING
        iv_data       TYPE string
        iv_key        TYPE string
        iv_hmac_to_verify TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_verify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_hmac.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      EXPORTING
        algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
        key       = cl_abap_hmac=>create_key_for_string( iv_key )
    ).
    lo_hmac->update( cl_abap_hmac=>create_data_for_string( iv_data ) ).
    DATA(lv_generated_hmac) = lo_hmac->get_mac_as_hex( ).
    rv_is_valid = COND #( WHEN lv_generated_hmac = iv_hmac_to_verify THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `UPDATE` mehrmals mit `CL_ABAP_HMAC=>CREATE_DATA_FOR_STRING` oder `CREATE_DATA_FOR_XSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_large_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_hmac_chunked
      IMPORTING
        it_data_chunks TYPE string_table
        iv_key         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_large_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_hmac_chunked.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      EXPORTING
        algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
        key       = cl_abap_hmac=>create_key_for_string( iv_key )
    ).

    LOOP AT it_data_chunks INTO DATA(lv_chunk).
      lo_hmac->update( cl_abap_hmac=>create_data_for_string( lv_chunk ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_hmac_hex = lo_hmac->get_mac_as_hex( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hmac_chunked FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_chunked.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_large_data( ).
    DATA(lt_data_chunks) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'First part of ' )
      ( 'large data. ' )
      ( 'This is the ' )
      ( 'final chunk.' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_key) = 'chunk_secret'.

    DATA(lv_full_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <chunk> IN lt_data_chunks
      NEXT s = s && <chunk>
    ).

    " Calculate expected HMAC for the concatenated string
    DATA(lo_hmac_single) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      EXPORTING
        algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
        key       = cl_abap_hmac=>create_key_for_string( lv_key )
    ).
    lo_hmac_single->update( cl_abap_hmac=>create_data_for_string( lv_full_data ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hmac) = lo_hmac_single->get_mac_as_hex( ).

    DATA(lv_actual_hmac) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_chunked( it_data_chunks = lt_data_chunks iv_key = lv_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_hmac
      exp = lv_expected_hmac
      msg = 'HMAC für gestückelte Daten sollte dem erwarteten Wert entsprechen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für sehr große Datenmengen ist es oft nicht praktikabel, diese komplett in den Speicher zu laden. Die `UPDATE`-Methode von `CL_ABAP_HMAC` ermöglicht die inkrementelle Berechnung des HMAC, indem Daten in kleineren Blöcken verarbeitet werden. Dies ist effizient und speicherschonend. Der `REDUCE` Operator wird hier verwendet, um die einzelnen Datenblöcke für den Vergleich im Unit Test zu einer einzigen Zeichenkette zu verbinden.
keywords: HMAC, Large Data, Chunks, Security, Cryptography, CL_ABAP_HMAC, REDUCE

    " die tatsächlich im System vorhandenen Sprachen ermitteln (z.B. aus T002).
    lt_languages = VALUE #( ( 'DE' ) ( 'EN' ) ( 'FR' ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_languages INTO DATA(lv_language).
      TRY.
          DATA(lv_full_path) = lo_lang_file_io->get_file_path(
                                 i_logical_file = iv_logical_file
                                 i_file_name    = iv_file_name
                                 i_language     = lv_language

        CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io.
          " Pfad für diese Sprache existiert nicht oder ist ungültig, überspringen

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_HMAC` mit einem dynamisch zur Laufzeit erzeugten Schlüssel (`xstring`).
hint: Erzeugen Sie einen `xstring` Schlüssel und übergeben Sie ihn an `create_key_for_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_dynamic_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_hmac_dynamic_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
        iv_dynamic_key_seed TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_dynamic_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_hmac_dynamic_key.
    " Beispiel: Dynamische Schlüsselerzeugung aus einem Seed
    " In einer realen Anwendung sollte ein sicherer Zufallsgenerator oder Key Derivation Function verwendet werden.
    DATA(lv_dynamic_key_x) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_converter( )->string_to_xstring( iv_dynamic_key_seed ).
    " Sicherstellen, dass der Schlüssel eine bestimmte Länge hat, z.B. 32 Bytes für SHA256
    IF xstrlen( lv_dynamic_key_x ) < 32.
      lv_dynamic_key_x = lv_dynamic_key_x && cl_abap_random_iv=>create( )->generate_uuid_x16( ).
      lv_dynamic_key_x = lv_dynamic_key_x(32).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>create(
      EXPORTING
        algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
        key       = cl_abap_hmac=>create_key_for_xstring( lv_dynamic_key_x )
    ).
    lo_hmac->update( cl_abap_hmac=>create_data_for_string( iv_data ) ).
    rv_hmac_hex = lo_hmac->get_mac_as_hex( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hmac_dynamic_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_dynamic_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_dynamic_key( ).
    DATA(lv_data) = 'Dynamic Data'.
    DATA(lv_seed1) = 'seed_one'.
    DATA(lv_seed2) = 'seed_two'.

    DATA(lv_hmac1) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_dynamic_key( iv_data = lv_data iv_dynamic_key_seed = lv_seed1 ).
    DATA(lv_hmac2) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_dynamic_key( iv_data = lv_data iv_dynamic_key_seed = lv_seed2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_hmac1
      exp = lv_hmac2
      msg = 'HMACs mit unterschiedlichen dynamischen Schlüsseln sollten sich unterscheiden'
    ).

    DATA(lv_hmac1_again) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_dynamic_key( iv_data = lv_data iv_dynamic_key_seed = lv_seed1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_hmac1
      exp = lv_hmac1_again
      msg = 'HMAC mit gleichem dynamischen Schlüssel sollte reproduzierbar sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_HMAC` mit einem dynamisch zur Laufzeit erzeugten Schlüssel. Dies ist in Szenarien nützlich, in denen Schlüssel nicht statisch hinterlegt, sondern aus anderen Parametern abgeleitet werden müssen. Es wird gezeigt, wie ein `xstring`-Schlüssel erstellt und an die HMAC-Klasse übergeben wird, wobei auf die Schlüssellänge geachtet wird.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_lines FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_lines.
    DATA(lo_writer) = NEW zcl_lang_file_writer( ).
    DATA(lv_logical_file) = 'Z_TEST_LOGICAL_FILE'.
    DATA(lv_file_name)    = 'lines_test.txt'.
    DATA(lv_language)     = 'EN'.
    DATA(lt_expected_lines) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Line 1' )
      ( 'Line 2' )
      ( 'Line 3' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <line> IN lt_expected_lines
      NEXT s = s && <line> && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_writer->write_language_file(
          iv_logical_file = lv_logical_file
          iv_file_name    = lv_file_name
          iv_language     = lv_language
          iv_content      = lv_content
        ).

        DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_lang_file_read_lines( ).
        DATA(lt_actual_lines) = lo_reader->read_language_file_lines(
                                   iv_logical_file = lv_logical_file
                                   iv_file_name    = lv_file_name
                                   iv_language     = lv_language
                                 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lines( lt_actual_lines )
          exp = lines( lt_expected_lines )
          msg = 'Anzahl der gelesenen Zeilen sollte übereinstimmen'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lt_actual_lines[ 1 ]
          exp = lt_expected_lines[ 1 ]
          msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte übereinstimmen'
        ).
    CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_cts).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |CTS Exception: { lx_cts->get_text( ) }| ).
    CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities INTO DATA(lx_file).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |File Utility Exception: { lx_file->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (ähnlich SFLIGHT) nach Flügen, die ein bestimmtes Ziel haben, und erstellen Sie dann eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (`connid`) und den Abflugort (`cityfrom`) dieser gefilterten Flüge enthält.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_summarize
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityto   TYPE s_cityname
        it_flights  TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_summarize.
    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE cityto = iv_cityto )
                             ( connid = flight-connid, cityfrom = flight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine angegebene Anzahl von eindeutigen 16-Byte System-UUIDs und geben Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife (Table Comprehension) in Kombination mit `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_multi_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_uuids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sysuuid_x16 WITH EMPTY KEY.

        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_uuid_multi_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_multiple_uuids.
    rt_uuids = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
                         ( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_multiple_uuids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_multi_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_uuids) = lo_cut->generate_multiple_uuids( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_uuids ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should generate 5 UUIDs' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_uuids[ 1 ] msg = 'First UUID should not be initial' exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_uniqueness.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_multi_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_uuids) = lo_cut->generate_multiple_uuids( 100 ).

    DATA(lt_unique_uuids) = VALUE zcl_uuid_multi_generator=>tt_uuids( FOR uuid IN lt_uuids ( uuid ) ).

    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_uuids.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_uuids ) exp = lines( lt_unique_uuids ) msg = 'All generated UUIDs should be unique' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination einer `FOR`-Schleife mit dem `VALUE`-Operator (Table Comprehension) ermöglicht die effiziente Generierung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle mit einer dynamischen Anzahl von UUIDs. Dies ist eine moderne und sehr kompakte Art, Sammlungen von Daten zu erstellen, ohne explizite `APPEND`-Anweisungen in einer `DO`-Schleife verwenden zu müssen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle (Map), bei der der Schlüssel eine 16-Byte UUID ist und der Wert ein String. Befüllen Sie diese Map mit einigen Einträgen und implementieren Sie eine Methode zum Abrufen eines Wertes anhand seiner UUID.
hint: Definieren Sie einen Hashed Table Type mit `sysuuid_x16` als Schlüssel und verwenden Sie `VALUE` zum Befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_map_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_uuid_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line COMPONENTS sysuuid_x16.

    METHODS create_and_populate_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_uuid_map) TYPE ty_uuid_map.

    METHODS get_value_by_uuid
      IMPORTING
        iv_uuid_x16 TYPE sysuuid_x16
        it_uuid_map TYPE ty_uuid_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_map_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_map.
    DATA(lv_uuid1) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid2) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ).

    rt_uuid_map = VALUE #( ( table_line = lv_uuid1 VALUE 'Erster Eintrag' )
                           ( table_line = lv_uuid2 VALUE 'Zweiter Eintrag' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value_by_uuid.
    rv_value = it_uuid_map[ KEY table_line COMPONENTS iv_uuid_x16 ]-VALUE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (ähnlich SFLIGHT) nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`). Für jede Fluggesellschaft soll eine Liste der Flugnummern (`connid`) zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR GROUP` (Grouped Table Comprehension) und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connids  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_group_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE s_cityname
        it_flights  TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_group_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
                                  GROUP BY flight-carrid AS carrid
                                  ( carrid  = carrid,
                                    connids = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP ( member-connid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_and_group FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_group.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_filter_group_flights=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'NEW YORK'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'LONDON'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'LONDON'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0402'. <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'PARIS'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_group_by_carrier( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should have one group for LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result[ 1 ]-connids ) exp = 3 msg = 'LH group should have 3 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connids[ 1 ] exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Datenmanipulation durch die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR GROUPS OF` (Grouped Table Comprehension). Zuerst werden die relevanten Flüge mit `FILTER` selektiert. Anschließend werden diese gefilterten Flüge mit `FOR GROUPS OF` nach der Fluggesellschaft gruppiert. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird dann eine Liste der Flugnummern mit einem weiteren `FOR`-Ausdruck erstellt. Dies ist ein sehr mächtiger und moderner Weg, um komplexe Filter- und Gruppierungsanforderungen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung zu lösen.
keywords: FILTER, FOR GROUPS OF, Grouped Table Comprehension, VALUE, Internal Tables, Grouping, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine gegebene 16-Byte UUID nicht initial ist.

CLASS zcl_uuid_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_uuid_not_initial
      IMPORTING
        iv_uuid_x16 TYPE sysuuid_x16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_not_initial) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_uuid_not_initial.
    IF iv_uuid_x16 IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_is_not_initial = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_not_initial = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_not_initial_uuid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_initial_uuid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_not_initial_uuid.
    DATA(lo_uuid_gen) = NEW zcl_uuid_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid) = lo_uuid_gen->generate_uuid_x16( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->is_uuid_not_initial( lv_uuid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_true msg = 'Generated UUID should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_uuid.
    DATA(lv_uuid) TYPE sysuuid_x16.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->is_uuid_not_initial( lv_uuid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_false msg = 'Initial UUID should be recognized as initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `cl_system_uuid` keine explizite `is_initial`-Methode für `sysuuid_x16` bietet, kann die Standard-ABAP-Prüfung `IS NOT INITIAL` direkt auf dem Datentyp `sysuuid_x16` angewendet werden, da dieser intern als X-Feld behandelt wird. Dies ist eine einfache und effiziente Methode, um die Gültigkeit einer UUID zu überprüfen, bevor sie verwendet wird.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine UUID und formatieren Sie diese in das Standard-GUID-Format mit Bindestrichen (z.B. 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32` und anschließend String-Templates zur Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_uuid_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_format_guid.
    DATA(lv_uuid_c32) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).

    rv_formatted_guid = |{ lv_uuid_c32(8) }-{ lv_uuid_c32+8(4) }-{ lv_uuid_c32+12(4) }-{ lv_uuid_c32+16(4) }-{ lv_uuid_c32+20(12) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_formatted_guid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_guid) = lo_cut->generate_and_format_guid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_formatted_guid exp = abap_false msg = 'Formatted GUID should not be initial' ).

Die Formatierung in das Standard-GUID-Format mit Bindestrichen wird dann elegant und effizient mit String-Templates (`|...|`) und Offset/Length-Zugriffen auf die Zeichenkette realisiert.
