Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (ähnlich SFLIGHT) nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug eine String-Repräsentation im Format 'Fluggesellschaft: Flugnummer (Abflugort -> Zielort)' enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_format_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES tt_formatted_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_format
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE s_cityname
        it_flights  TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_flights) TYPE tt_formatted_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_format_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_format.
    rt_formatted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
                                    ( |{ flight-carrid }: { flight-connid } ({ flight-cityfrom } -> { flight-cityto })| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_and_format FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_format.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_filter_format_flights=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'NEW YORK'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'LONDON'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'. <fs_flight>-cityto = 'LONDON'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_format_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_format( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'LH: 0400 (FRANKFURT -> NEW YORK)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'LH: 0401 (FRANKFURT -> LONDON)' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FILTER` zur Selektion von Daten mit `FOR` und String-Templates zur Transformation und Formatierung der Ergebnisse. Die gefilterten Flugdaten werden direkt in einer `FOR`-Schleife verarbeitet, wobei für jeden Eintrag ein formatierter String mit einem String-Template erstellt wird. Dies ist ein sehr ausdrucksstarker und effizienter Weg, um Daten zu filtern, zu transformieren und in einem gewünschten Format auszugeben, alles in einer einzigen, gut lesbaren Anweisung.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine UUID und speichern Sie diese zusammen mit einem Zeitstempel in einer internen Tabelle. Filtern Sie anschließend diese Tabelle, um alle UUIDs zu finden, die nach einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt generiert wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16` für die UUID und `get_current_timestamp()` für den Zeitstempel. Filtern Sie die Tabelle mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_timestamp_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_uuid_entry,
             uuid      TYPE sysuuid_x16,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_uuid_entry.
    TYPES tt_uuid_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_uuid_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_and_store_uuids
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_entries) TYPE tt_uuid_entries.

    METHODS filter_uuids_by_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        it_entries TYPE tt_uuid_entries
        iv_min_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_uuids) TYPE tt_uuid_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_timestamp_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_store_uuids.
    rt_entries = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
                         ( uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ),
                           timestamp = get_current_timestamp( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_uuids_by_timestamp.
    rt_filtered_uuids = FILTER #( it_entries WHERE timestamp > iv_min_timestamp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_uuid_timestamp_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_uuid_timestamp_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_timestamp_filter( ).

    " Generate some UUIDs with timestamps
    DATA(lt_all_uuids) = lo_cut->generate_and_store_uuids( 3 ).

    " Wait a bit to ensure different timestamps
    WAIT UP TO '0.001' SECONDS.

    DATA(lv_mid_timestamp) = get_current_timestamp( ).

    WAIT UP TO '0.001' SECONDS.

    DATA(lt_more_uuids) = lo_cut->generate_and_store_uuids( 2 ).
    APPEND LINES OF lt_more_uuids TO lt_all_uuids.

    " Filter UUIDs generated after lv_mid_timestamp
    DATA(lt_filtered_uuids) = lo_cut->filter_uuids_by_timestamp( it_entries = lt_all_uuids iv_min_timestamp = lv_mid_timestamp ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_all_uuids ) exp = 5 msg = 'Total UUIDs should be 5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_uuids ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should filter 2 UUIDs generated after mid timestamp' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_uuids[ 1 ]-uuid exp = lt_more_uuids[ 1 ]-uuid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die praktische Anwendung von UUIDs in Kombination mit Zeitstempeln und die effiziente Filterung dieser Daten. UUIDs werden mit `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16` generiert und zusammen mit dem aktuellen Zeitstempel (`get_current_timestamp()`) in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert. Die anschließende Filterung der Tabelle nach einem Zeitstempel mit dem `FILTER`-Ausdruck ist ein klares und modernes Muster für die Datenanalyse und -selektion.
keywords: UUID, cl_system_uuid, get_current_timestamp, FILTER, Internal Tables, Timestamp, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den SHA256-Hash eines gegebenen Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_message_digest` mit dem Algorithmus `SHA256` und `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce` für die Hex-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sha256_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256_hash.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    lo_digest->update_text( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->get_digest( ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_converter( )->convert( lv_hash_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sha256_hash.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = NEW zcl_hash_string( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_expected_hash) = 'A591A6D40BF420404A011733CFB7B190D62C65BF0BCDA32B57B277D9AD9F146E'.
    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_hasher->calculate_sha256_hash( lv_input ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen SHA256-Hash für jede Zeile der Tabelle `sflights`, basierend auf einer Kombination von Schlüsselfeldern (`carrid`, `connid`, `fldate`), um eine eindeutige Zeilen-ID zu generieren.
hint: Konkatenieren Sie die Schlüsselfelder zu einem String mit String Templates und nutzen Sie `FOR` sowie `cl_abap_message_digest=>get_digest_as_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_sflight_row DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_hashed,
        carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate     TYPE s_date,
        hash_id    TYPE string,
      END OF ty_sflight_hashed,
      tt_sflight_hashed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_hashed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hashed_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_sflight_row IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hashed_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_hashed_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
                                 LET lv_input_string = |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }{ <fs_sflight>-connid }{ <fs_sflight>-fldate }| IN
                                 (
                                   carrid  = <fs_sflight>-carrid,
                                   connid  = <fs_sflight>-connid,
                                   fldate  = <fs_sflight>-fldate,
                                   hash_id = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, lv_input_string )
                                 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hashed_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hashed_sflights.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = NEW zcl_hash_sflight_row( ).
    DATA(lt_hashed_flights) = lo_hasher->get_hashed_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_hashed_flights ),
      msg = 'Should retrieve some hashed flights',
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_hashed_flights INTO DATA(ls_hashed_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = ls_hashed_flight-hash_id,
        msg = 'Hash ID should not be initial',
        reverse = abap_true
      ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FOR` zur Transformation einer internen Tabelle und `String Templates` zur einfachen Konkatenation der Felder. `cl_abap_message_digest=>get_digest_as_string` ist eine bequeme statische Methode für direkte String-Hashes. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um eindeutige, manipulationssichere IDs für Tabellenzeilen zu generieren.
keywords: cl_abap_message_digest, Hashing, Internal Tables, FOR, String Templates, sflight, Security, DATA

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, ändern Sie dessen Wert und stellen Sie sicher, dass der Feldsymbol nach Gebrauch ordnungsgemäß freigegeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und `UNASSIGN <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
      END OF ty_data.

    METHODS modify_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_field_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          IF iv_field_name = 'FIELD2'.
            <fs_field> = CONV i( iv_new_value ).
          ELSE.
            <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
          ENDIF.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Feldsymbol explizit freigeben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_field_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_field_fail_name FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_field_fail_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_field_success.
    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data( field1 = 'Initial' field2 = 10 ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_modifier->modify_field_dynamically(
      iv_field_name = 'FIELD1',
      iv_new_value  = 'Modified String',
      CHANGING
        cs_data       = ls_data
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Modification of FIELD1 should be successful' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 'Modified String' msg = 'FIELD1 should be modified' ).

    lv_success = lo_modifier->modify_field_dynamically(
      iv_field_name = 'FIELD2',
      iv_new_value  = '20',
      CHANGING
        cs_data       = ls_data
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Modification of FIELD2 should be successful' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 20 msg = 'FIELD2 should be modified' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_field_fail_name.
    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data( field1 = 'Initial' field2 = 10 ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_modifier->modify_field_dynamically(
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD',
      iv_new_value  = 'Some Value',
      CHANGING
        cs_data       = ls_data
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Modification of non-existent field should fail' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_field_fail_type.
    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>ty_data( field1 = 'Initial' field2 = 10 ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_modifier->modify_field_dynamically(
      iv_field_name = 'FIELD2',
      iv_new_value  = 'Not a number',
      CHANGING
        cs_data       = ls_data
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Modification with wrong type should fail' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `UNASSIGN` ein älteres Statement ist, ist es bei der dynamischen Programmierung mit Feldsymbolen weiterhin relevant, um Ressourcen freizugeben und undefiniertes Verhalten zu vermeiden. Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols zu einer Strukturkomponente und dessen explizite Freigabe. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für die Typkonvertierung ist ein modernes Fehlerbehandlungsmuster.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, TRY...CATCH, DATA

Instructions: Suchen Sie eine bestimmte Zeile in einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) und ändern Sie ein Feld dieser Zeile mithilfe eines Feldsymbols. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Feldsymbol nach der Bearbeitung unzugewiesen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <fs>` und `UNASSIGN <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_and_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_sflight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_and_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_sflight_status.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    rv_modified = abap_false.

    READ TABLE ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight>-planetype = 'A380'. " Beispieländerung
      rv_modified = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>. " Feldsymbol explizit freigeben
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_sflight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_sflight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_sflight_found.
    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_modify_and_unassign( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '747' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '737' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_modified) = lo_modifier->modify_sflight_status(
      iv_carrid = 'LH',
      iv_connid = '0400',
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights = lt_sflights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_modified exp = abap_true msg = 'Flight should be modified' ).
    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_sflight_modified).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_modified-planetype exp = 'A380' msg = 'Planetype should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_sflight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_modify_and_unassign( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum planetype = '737' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_modified) = lo_modifier->modify_sflight_status(
      iv_carrid = 'LH',
      iv_connid = '0400',
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights = lt_sflights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_modified exp = abap_false msg = 'Flight should not be modified' ).

ASSIGNING` ist eine effiziente Methode, um Zeilen in internen Tabellen zu finden und direkt zu bearbeiten.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Integrität einer Liste von Datenstrukturen überprüft, indem sie für jede Struktur einen Hash berechnet und mit einem erwarteten Hash vergleicht. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der Prüfergebnisse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_message_digest` für die Hash-Berechnung und `REDUCE` für die Ergebnisaggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_integrity_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data_record,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data_record,
      tt_data_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_record WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_check_result,
        id      TYPE i,
        is_valid TYPE abap_bool,
        actual_hash TYPE string,
        expected_hash TYPE string,
      END OF ty_check_result,
      tt_check_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_check_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_data_integrity
      IMPORTING
        it_data_records TYPE tt_data_records
        it_expected_hashes TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_check_result WITH UNIQUE KEY id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_check_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_integrity_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_data_integrity.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).

    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR ls_record IN it_data_records
                          LET lv_input_string = |{ ls_record-id }{ ls_record-value }|,
                              lv_actual_hash = lo_digest->get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, lv_input_string ),
                              ls_expected_hash_entry = it_expected_hashes[ id = ls_record-id DEFAULT id = 0 ] IN
                          (
                            id           = ls_record-id,
                            is_valid     = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_actual_hash = ls_expected_hash_entry-expected_hash THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ),
                            actual_hash  = lv_actual_hash,
                            expected_hash = ls_expected_hash_entry-expected_hash
                          ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_data_integrity_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_integrity_check.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_data_integrity_check( ).

    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_data_integrity_check=>tt_data_records.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'Data A' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 'Data B' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 'Data C' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA lt_expected_hashes TYPE zcl_data_integrity_check=>tt_check_results.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 expected_hash = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, '1Data A' ) ) TO lt_expected_hashes.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 expected_hash = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, '2Data B_MODIFIED' ) ) TO lt_expected_hashes. " Deliberate mismatch
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 expected_hash = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, '3Data C' ) ) TO lt_expected_hashes.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_checker->check_data_integrity(
      it_data_records    = lt_data,
      it_expected_hashes = lt_expected_hashes
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY id = 1 INTO DATA(ls_res1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res1-is_valid exp = abap_true msg = 'Record 1 should be valid' ).

    READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY id = 2 INTO DATA(ls_res2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res2-is_valid exp = abap_false msg = 'Record 2 should be invalid' ).

    READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY id = 3 INTO DATA(ls_res3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res3-is_valid exp = abap_true msg = 'Record 3 should be valid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Überprüfung der Datenintegrität mithilfe von SHA256-Hashes. Die Verwendung von `FOR` mit `LET` und `COND` ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Transformation der Eingabedaten in Prüfergebnisse. Dies ist ein modernes Muster für die Verarbeitung interner Tabellen und die Anwendung von Geschäftslogik.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle nach einem Feld sortiert, dessen Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole und `UNASSIGN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` innerhalb eines `SORT` Statements und `UNASSIGN` danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        key_field TYPE string,
        value     TYPE i,
      END OF ty_data,
      tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data       TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    IF ct_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Prüfen, ob das Feld existiert
    READ TABLE ct_data INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_first_row>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_first_row> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        SORT ct_data BY (iv_field_name).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Feldsymbol freigeben
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-key_field exp = 'A' msg = 'First element should be A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-key_field exp = 'B' msg = 'Second element should be B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-key_field exp = 'C' msg = 'Third element should be C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_value.
    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'C' value = 30 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'A' value = 10 ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'B' value = 20 ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_sorter->sort_table_dynamically(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-value exp = 20 msg = 'Second element should be 20' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-value exp = 30 msg = 'Third element should be 30' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_non_existent_field.
    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 'C' value = 30 ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_sorter->sort_table_dynamically(
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT',
      CHANGING
        ct_data       = lt_data
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Sort by non-existent field should fail' ).

  METHOD test_sort_empty_table.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Sorting an empty table should succeed (no-op)' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` nimmt, bestimmte Felder (z.B. `carrid`, `connid`) hashen und die gehashten Werte in einer neuen Tabelle zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `MAP` für die Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_message_digest` und den `MAP`-Operator für die Transformation der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_and_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_hashed_mapped,
        carrid_hash TYPE string,
        connid_hash TYPE string,
        fldate      TYPE s_date,
        price       TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_sflight_hashed_mapped,
      tt_sflight_hashed_mapped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_hashed_mapped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS hash_sflight_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed_mapped.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_and_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD hash_sflight_fields.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).

    rt_hashed_flights = MAP #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                ( carrid_hash = lo_digest->get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, ls_sflight-carrid ),
                                  connid_hash = lo_digest->get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, ls_sflight-connid ),
                                  fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                  price       = ls_sflight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse basierend auf einem übergebenen Klassennamen erstellt. Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE` und `UNASSIGN` für Feldsymbole, falls diese intern verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name)` und `UNASSIGN` für temporäre Feldsymbole.
solution:
CLASS zif_dynamic_object_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_handler.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_object_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_instance
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zif_dynamic_object_factory
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_object_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_instance.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE REF TO zif_dynamic_object_factory.

    CREATE OBJECT ro_instance TYPE (iv_class_name).
    ASSIGN ro_instance TO <fs_object>.
    " <fs_object> ist hier nur zur Demonstration der Zuweisung und Freigabe
    " In diesem spezifischen Fall ist es nicht zwingend notwendig, da ro_instance direkt verwendet wird.
    " Aber es zeigt das Prinzip der Freigabe eines Feldsymbols nach Gebrauch.
    UNASSIGN <fs_object>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den MD5-Hash eines Strings. Obwohl MD5 nicht mehr für kryptografische Sicherheit empfohlen wird, ist es für Prüfsummen oder schnelle Identifikation noch relevant.

solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_md5_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_md5_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_hex) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_md5_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_md5_hash.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_md5 ).
    lo_digest->update_text( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->get_digest( ).
    rv_hash_hex = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_converter( )->convert( lv_hash_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` nach einem Kriterium (z.B. `price > 500`) und hashen Sie nur die `carrid` der gefilterten Zeilen. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `FOR`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit `FOR` und `cl_abap_message_digest`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_hash DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_filtered_hashed,
        carrid_hash TYPE string,
        connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
        price       TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_filtered_hashed,
      tt_filtered_hashed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_hashed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_hashed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_hashed) TYPE tt_filtered_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_hash IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_hashed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).

    rt_filtered_hashed = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price )
                                  ( carrid_hash = lo_digest->get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, ls_sflight-carrid ),
                                    connid      = ls_sflight-connid,
                                    price       = ls_sflight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_hash FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_hash.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_filter_and_hash( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_hashed) = lo_processor->get_filtered_hashed_flights( 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_filtered_hashed ) msg = 'Should return some filtered and hashed flights' reverse = abap_true ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_hashed INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_entry-carrid_hash reverse = abap_true msg = 'Carrid hash should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_entry-price > 500 ) msg = 'Price should be greater than 500' ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Muster zur Verarbeitung interner Tabellen. Hier wird zuerst gefiltert und dann die Transformation (Hashing) auf die gefilterten Elemente angewendet. Dies ist effizient und sehr lesbar.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die versucht, dynamisch auf ein Attribut eines Objekts zuzugreifen. Wenn der Zugriff fehlschlägt (Attribut existiert nicht oder ist nicht sichtbar), soll der verwendete Feldsymbol explizit mit `UNASSIGN` freigegeben werden und ein Fehler gemeldet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` (oder `ASSIGN (attribute_name) TO <fs>`) und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`. Nutzen Sie `UNASSIGN` im Fehlerfall.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_attribute_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attribute_value_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_attr_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_attribute_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attribute_value_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_attribute> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN (iv_attr_name) OF io_object->* TO <fs_attribute>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      UNASSIGN <fs_attribute>. " Explizite Freigabe im Fehlerfall
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Attribute '{ iv_attr_name }' not found or not accessible.|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <fs_attribute>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_attribute>. " Explizite Freigabe nach erfolgreicher Nutzung
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_attribute_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_attribute_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_attribute_success.
    DATA(lo_test_object) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ). " Reuse a simple class
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_attribute_access( ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_value) = lo_accessor->get_attribute_value_dynamically(
          io_object    = lo_test_object,
          iv_attr_name = 'FIELD1' " Assuming zcl_dynamic_field_access has a public attribute FIELD1 for testing
        ).
        " Note: zcl_dynamic_field_access does not have public attributes, only types.
        " This test needs a class with public attributes.
        " Let's create a dummy class for testing.
        DATA: BEGIN OF ls_dummy_data,
                field1 TYPE string VALUE 'TestValue',
                field2 TYPE i VALUE 123,
              END OF ls_dummy_data.
        DATA(lo_dummy_object) = NEW zcl_dynamic_attribute_access( ). " Just to have an object reference
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dummy_data> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN ls_dummy_data TO <fs_dummy_data>.

        DATA(lv_value_field1) = lo_accessor->get_attribute_value_dynamically(
          io_object    = <fs_dummy_data>,
          iv_attr_name = 'FIELD1'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value_field1 exp = 'TestValue' msg = 'Should retrieve FIELD1 value' ).

        DATA(lv_value_field2) = lo_accessor->get_attribute_value_dynamically(
          io_object    = <fs_dummy_data>,
          iv_attr_name = 'FIELD2'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value_field2 exp = '123' msg = 'Should retrieve FIELD2 value' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected cx_sy_assign_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_attribute_fail.
    DATA(lo_test_object) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_attribute_access( ).

    TRY.
        lo_accessor->get_attribute_value_dynamically(
          io_object    = lo_test_object,
          iv_attr_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_ATTRIBUTE'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_assign_error expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_assign_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die sichere dynamische Attributzugriff auf Objekte. Die explizite Verwendung von `UNASSIGN` im Fehlerfall und nach erfolgreicher Nutzung ist eine Best Practice, um die Lebensdauer von Feldsymbolen zu kontrollieren und potenzielle Probleme zu vermeiden. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` ist der moderne Weg, um Ausnahmen zu signalisieren.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, ASSIGN, Error Handling, cx_sy_assign_error

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strings auf Gleichheit, indem Sie deren SHA256-Hashes berechnen und diese vergleichen. Dies ist nützlich, um Timing-Angriffe bei direkten String-Vergleichen zu vermeiden.
hint: Berechnen Sie die Hashes beider Strings mit `cl_abap_message_digest` und vergleichen Sie die Hex-Repräsentationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_secure_string_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_strings_by_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1 TYPE string
        iv_string2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secure_string_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_strings_by_hash.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).

    DATA(lv_hash1) = lo_digest->get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, iv_string1 ).
    DATA(lv_hash2) = lo_digest->get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, iv_string2 ).

    IF lv_hash1 = lv_hash2.
      rv_are_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_equal_strings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_compare_unequal_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_equal_strings.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_secure_string_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_comparer->compare_strings_by_hash( iv_string1 = 'SecretPassword' iv_string2 = 'SecretPassword' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_true msg = 'Equal strings should return true' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_compare_unequal_strings.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_secure_string_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_comparer->compare_strings_by_hash( iv_string1 = 'SecretPassword' iv_string2 = 'WrongPassword' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_false msg = 'Unequal strings should return false' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Vergleich von Hashes anstelle von Klartext-Strings kann in sicherheitskritischen Kontexten (z.B. Passwortprüfung) Timing-Angriffe verhindern. `cl_abap_message_digest` bietet eine einfache und standardisierte Möglichkeit, Hashes zu berechnen. Die Methode ist klar und nutzt modernen ABAP-Stil.
keywords: cl_abap_message_digest, Hashing, Security, String Comparison, Timing Attack, Data Comparison

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` nimmt und dynamisch eine neue Spalte hinzufügt, deren Wert aus einer Berechnung basierend auf anderen Spalten abgeleitet wird. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole für den dynamischen Zugriff und `UNASSIGN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT COMPONENT` für die dynamische Spalte und Feldsymbole für den Zugriff auf die Zeilen und die neue Spalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_extended,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
        calculated_value TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_sflight_extended,
      tt_sflight_extended TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_extended WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_calculated_column
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_extended_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_extended.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_calculated_column.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Initialisierung der Rückgabetabelle mit der erweiterten Struktur
    rt_extended_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                   ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                     connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                     fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                     price    = ls_sflight-price,
                                     currency = ls_sflight-currency,
                                     calculated_value = 0 ) ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row> TYPE ty_sflight_extended.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_price> TYPE s_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_calculated_value> TYPE decfloat16.

    LOOP AT rt_extended_flights ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_price>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CALCULATED_VALUE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_calculated_value>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Beispielberechnung: Preis * 1.19 (für 19% MwSt)
        <fs_calculated_value> = <fs_price> * '1.19'.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_price>.
      UNASSIGN <fs_calculated_value>.
    ENDLOOP.
    UNASSIGN <fs_row>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_calculated_column FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_calculated_column.
    DATA(lo_adder) = NEW zcl_dynamic_column_add( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_extended_flights) = lo_adder->add_calculated_column( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_extended_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should return 2 extended flights' ).

    READ TABLE lt_extended_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-calculated_value exp = '119.00' msg = 'Calculated value for flight 1 should be 119.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_extended_flights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-calculated_value exp = '238.00' msg = 'Calculated value for flight 2 should be 238.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch eine neue Spalte zu einer internen Tabelle hinzufügt und deren Werte berechnet. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen (`<fs_row>`, `<fs_price>`, `<fs_calculated_value>`) ermöglicht den flexiblen Zugriff auf die Daten. `UNASSIGN` wird verwendet, um die Feldsymbole nach jeder Iteration und am Ende der Methode explizit freizugeben, was eine gute Praxis für die Ressourcenverwaltung ist. Die Initialisierung der Zieltabelle mit `VALUE FOR` ist ein modernes ABAP-Muster.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, VALUE FOR, sflight

Instructions: Anonymisieren Sie sensible Daten in einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights` Passagiernamen, falls vorhanden, hier simuliert durch `carrid`) durch Hashing. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die anonymisierten Daten zu sammeln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_message_digest` für das Hashing und `REDUCE` für die Transformation der Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_anonymize_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_anonymized,
        carrid_anon TYPE string,
        connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate      TYPE s_date,
        price       TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_sflight_anonymized,
      tt_sflight_anonymized TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_anonymized WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS anonymize_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_anonymized_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_anonymized.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_anonymize_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD anonymize_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).

    rt_anonymized_flights = REDUCE tt_sflight_anonymized(
      INIT r = VALUE tt_sflight_anonymized( )
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      NEXT r = VALUE tt_sflight_anonymized( BASE r
                                            ( carrid_anon = lo_digest->get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, ls_sflight-carrid ),
                                              connid      = ls_sflight-connid,
                                              fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                              price       = ls_sflight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_anonymize_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_anonymize_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_anonymizer) = NEW zcl_anonymize_data( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_anonymized_flights) = lo_anonymizer->anonymize_sflight_data( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_anonymized_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should return 2 anonymized flights' ).

    READ TABLE lt_anonymized_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_anon_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_anon_flight1-carrid_anon reverse = abap_true msg = 'Anonymized carrid should not be initial' ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_lh) = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_anon_flight1-carrid_anon exp = lv_expected_hash_lh msg = 'Anonymized carrid for LH should match' ).

    READ TABLE lt_anonymized_flights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_anon_flight2).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash_aa) = cl_abap_message_digest=>get_digest_as_string( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256, 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_anon_flight2-carrid_anon exp = lv_expected_hash_aa msg = 'Anonymized carrid for AA should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anonymisierung von Daten durch Hashing ist eine wichtige Technik im Datenschutz. Der `REDUCE`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht eine funktionale und effiziente Transformation einer internen Tabelle, indem er die gehashten Werte in einer neuen Tabelle sammelt. Dies ist ein modernes und sicheres Vorgehen.
keywords: cl_abap_message_digest, Hashing, Anonymization, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Security, sflight

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` und einen Feldnamen als String akzeptiert. Die Methode soll den Wert dieses Feldes für jede Zeile in einer neuen Tabelle sammeln. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole und `UNASSIGN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_row>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS collect_dynamic_field_values
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_dynamic_field_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field_value>.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        UNASSIGN <fs_field_value>. " Freigabe im Fehlerfall
        UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>. " Freigabe der Zeilenreferenz
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in sflight structure.|.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND |{ <fs_field_value> }| TO rt_values.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field_value>. " Freigabe nach Nutzung
    ENDLOOP.
    UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>. " Freigabe nach Schleifenende
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur kopiert, wobei die Feldnamen teilweise unterschiedlich sind, aber logisch zusammenpassen. Nutzen Sie hierfür `cl_abap_corresponding`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_corresponding=>create` und die Methode `map` für die Zuweisung. Definieren Sie die Feldzuordnungen explizit mit `MAPPING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             departure_city TYPE s_from_cit,
             arrival_city TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = is_source
      destination = rs_target
      mapping     = VALUE sabp_dyn_map_mapping_tab(
        ( source = 'CARRID' destination = 'AIRLINE_ID' )
        ( source = 'CONNID' destination = 'FLIGHT_ID' )
        ( source = 'CITYFROM' destination = 'DEPARTURE_CITY' )
        ( source = 'CITYTO' destination = 'ARRIVAL_CITY' )
      )
    ).
    lo_mapper->map( EXPORTING source = is_source CHANGING destination = rs_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_basic=>ty_source(
      carrid   = 'LH'

      cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'

    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-airline_id
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Airline ID should be mapped correctly'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-flight_id
      exp = '0400'
      msg = 'Flight ID should be mapped correctly'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-departure_city
      exp = 'FRANKFURT'
      msg = 'Departure City should be mapped correctly'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-arrival_city
      exp = 'NEW YORK'
      msg = 'Arrival City should be mapped correctly'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_corresponding` ermöglicht eine flexible und dynamische Zuweisung von Komponenten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen. Durch die explizite `MAPPING`-Tabelle können Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen zugewiesen werden, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als manuelle Zuweisungen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Strukturen nicht identisch sind oder sich im Laufe der Zeit ändern können.
keywords: cl_abap_corresponding, dynamic mapping, corresponding, MAPPING, structures

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei alle Felder mit gleichem Namen zugewiesen werden sollen, außer einem spezifischen Feld, das ausgeschlossen werden muss. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` mit der `EXCEPT`-Klausel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `EXCEPT` im `create`-Aufruf von `cl_abap_corresponding`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode, " This field should not be mapped from source

solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_filtered,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_avg_price_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_above_threshold
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_filtered.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_above_threshold.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING AVG( price ) > @iv_threshold
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_prices.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_avg_price_above_threshold FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_price_above_threshold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_having( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_above_threshold( '500.00' ).

    " Assert that the result table is not empty (assuming some carriers have avg price > 500)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_avg_prices )
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty for threshold 500'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    " Check if all returned average prices are indeed above the threshold
    LOOP AT lt_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_entry-avg_price > '500.00'
        msg = 'Average price should be above 500'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `HAVING`-Klausel in Open SQL ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse einer `GROUP BY`-Aggregation basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern, die auf den aggregierten Werten basieren. Dies ist vergleichbar mit `WHERE` für einzelne Zeilen, aber `HAVING` operiert auf den Gruppen. Es ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um spezifische Gruppen von Daten effizient zu selektieren.
keywords: AVERAGE, SQL, HAVING, GROUP BY, aggregate, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für jede Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT AVG(price) AS avg_price` und runden Sie das Ergebnis in ABAP oder nutzen Sie eine Datenbankfunktion, falls verfügbar (hier ABAP-Rundung).
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_rounded DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_rounded,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_rounded.
    TYPES: tt_avg_price_rounded TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_rounded WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_rounded
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_rounded.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_rounded IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_rounded.
    DATA: lt_raw_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_rounded WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_raw_avg.

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_avg (
      carrid = ls_raw-carrid
      avg_price = round( val = ls_raw-avg_price dec = 2 )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_avg_price_rounded FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_price_rounded.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_rounded( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_rounded( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_avg_prices )
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_avg_prices INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_entry).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_first_entry-avg_price >= 0
        msg = 'Average price should be non-negative'
      ).
      " Check if the price is rounded (e.g., no more than 2 decimal places)
      DATA(lv_string_price) = |{ ls_first_entry-avg_price }|.
      DATA(lv_decimal_part) = ''''''.
      FIND REGEX '\.\d+' IN lv_string_price MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_decimal_part = lv_string_price+lv_offset.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = strlen( lv_decimal_part ) <= 3 " . and two digits
          msg = 'Price should be rounded to 2 decimal places'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Während `AVG` den Durchschnitt auf der Datenbank berechnet, ist die Rundung oft eine Anforderung der Anwendungslogik. Hier wird der Durchschnitt zunächst von der Datenbank geholt und dann in ABAP mit der modernen `round()`-Funktion gerundet. Die Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation der internen Tabelle ist ein Beispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Code.
keywords: AVERAGE, SQL, GROUP BY, round, functional programming, sflights, internal tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur kopiert, wobei die Mapping-Regeln dynamisch zur Laufzeit aus einer Konfigurationstabelle gelesen werden. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` und `SABP_DYN_MAP`.
hint: Simulieren Sie eine Konfigurationstabelle, die die Mapping-Regeln enthält, und übergeben Sie diese an `cl_abap_corresponding`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config_mapping,
             source_field TYPE string,
             target_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config_mapping.
    TYPES: tt_config_mapping TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config_mapping WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             target_field1 TYPE string,
             target_field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_from_config
      IMPORTING
        is_source_data TYPE ty_source_data
        it_config_rules TYPE tt_config_mapping
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target_data) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_from_config.
    DATA(lt_dyn_map_rules) = VALUE sabp_dyn_map_mapping_tab(
      FOR ls_config IN it_config_rules (
        source      = ls_config-source_field
        destination = ls_config-target_field
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_mapper) = cl_abap_corresponding=>create(
      source      = is_source_data
      destination = rs_target_data
      mapping     = lt_dyn_map_rules
    ).
    lo_mapper->map( EXPORTING source = is_source_data CHANGING destination = rs_target_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_from_config FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_from_config.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_config( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_config=>ty_source_data(
      field1 = 'Config Value'
      field2 = 999
    ).

    DATA(lt_config_rules) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_config=>tt_config_mapping(
      ( source_field = 'FIELD1' target_field = 'TARGET_FIELD1' )
      ( source_field = 'FIELD2' target_field = 'TARGET_FIELD2' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_from_config( is_source_data = ls_source it_config_rules = lt_config_rules ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-target_field1
      exp = 'Config Value'
      msg = 'Target_Field1 should be mapped from config'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-target_field2
      exp = 999
      msg = 'Target_Field2 should be mapped from config'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_abap_corresponding` in Verbindung mit einer externen Konfiguration für das Mapping verwendet werden kann. Die Mapping-Regeln werden aus einer internen Tabelle (`it_config_rules`) zur Laufzeit in den Typ `SABP_DYN_MAP_MAPPING_TAB` umgewandelt und dann an `cl_abap_corresponding` übergeben. Dies ermöglicht eine hochflexible und wartbare Lösung für komplexe Integrationsszenarien, bei denen die Feldzuordnungen nicht fest im Code definiert sind.
keywords: cl_abap_corresponding, SABP_DYN_MAP, dynamic mapping, configuration, RTTI, runtime, structures

CLASS zcl_append_lines_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES ty_t_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS aggregate_flights IMPORTING it_source TYPE ty_t_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_t_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_lines_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flights.
    rt_result = REDUCE ty_t_carrid_count(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_t_carrid_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN it_source GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) TO result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reca_date_age_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person_in,
             name      TYPE string,
             birthdate TYPE sy-datum,
           END OF ty_person_in.
    TYPES ty_t_person_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_person_in WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person_out,
             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_person_out.
    TYPES ty_t_person_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_person_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_reca_date_age_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_ages.
    rt_persons_with_age = VALUE #( FOR <fs_person> IN it_persons
                                   LET lo_birthdate = cl_reca_date=>create_date_object( <fs_person>-birthdate )
                                       lv_days_diff = lo_birthdate->get_difference_in_days( iv_date_to = iv_current_date )
                                       lv_age = lv_days_diff DIV 365 " Vereinfachte Altersberechnung
                                   IN ( name = <fs_person>-name age = lv_age ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_component IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf dem Wert einer zur Laufzeit angegebenen Spalte und geben Sie die gefilterten Zeilen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in Kombination mit einer `FOR` Expression für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_sflight_subset.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_temp_filtered TYPE tt_sflight_subset.
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND |{ <fs_component> }| = iv_filter_value.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_subset( carrid = <fs_line>-carrid
                                        connid = <fs_line>-connid
                                        fldate = <fs_line>-fldate
                                        price  = <fs_line>-price ) TO lt_temp_filtered.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rt_filtered_data = lt_temp_filtered.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_test,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_test.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_test WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_filter_table_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_table_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_test.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_test( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_test( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_test( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamic( it_data = lt_sflights
                                                          iv_component_name = 'CARRID'
                                                          iv_filter_value = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_lh ) exp = 2 msg = 'Filter by CARRID failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_lh[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First filtered CARRID incorrect' ).

                                                            iv_component_name = 'CARRID'
                                                            iv_filter_value = 'XX' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_fldate) = lo_cut->filter_table_dynamic( it_data = lt_sflights

explanation: Diese Lösung zeigt, wie man eine interne Tabelle dynamisch filtern kann, indem der Feldname zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Die Kombination aus `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den generischen Zugriff auf die Daten. Die gefilterten Zeilen werden dann in einer neuen Tabelle gesammelt. Obwohl `FOR` für die Filterung verwendet werden könnte, ist der direkte dynamische Feldzugriff innerhalb einer `LOOP` oft klarer und performanter.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `CALL METHOD` (dynamisch).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_dynamic_callable.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_dynamic_callable.
  METHODS get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_farewell RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_method> TYPE REF TO if_dynamic_callable=>get_greeting.

    TRY.
        ASSIGN ('(IO_OBJECT)->' && iv_method_name) TO <fs_method>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL METHOD <fs_method> RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or not callable.|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur (Liste von Feldnamen und Typen) und füllen Sie diese mit Werten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES: tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
        it_data_rows TYPE string_table " Jede Zeile ist ein kommaseparierter String von Werten
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_field_def-name
        type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( ls_field_def-type ) ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(lv_data_row).
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_line> TO <fs_line>.

      SPLIT lv_data_row AT ',' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_values).
      DO lines( lt_components ) TIMES.
        DATA(lv_index) = sy-index.
        DATA(lv_component_name) = lt_components[ lv_index ]-name.
        DATA(lv_value) = lt_values[ lv_index ].

        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_component> = lv_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of rows' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_text> TYPE string.

Die Befüllung erfolgt durch dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`) innerhalb einer Schleife, was maximale Flexibilität bei der Datenverarbeitung bietet.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sgos_atta_mock,

      ( objtp = iv_object_type objkey = iv_object_key gos_objid = '1' gos_objtyp = 'ATTA' gos_objdes = 'Rechnung.pdf' gos_creadate = sy-datum gos_creatime = sy-uzeit gos_creator = 'USERA' )

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen akzeptiert. Die Methode soll den Wert dieses Feldes für jede Zeile in der Tabelle auf einen neuen Wert setzen, der ebenfalls dynamisch übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff und die Wertzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data " Generische Tabellenreferenz
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Zuweisung des neuen Wertes zum dynamisch zugewiesenen Feld
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und eine Liste von Feldnamen akzeptiert. Die Methode soll eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgeben, die nur die angegebenen Felder enthält (Projektion).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` zur dynamischen Strukturerstellung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zur Datenübertragung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS project_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table TYPE REF TO data " Generische Quelltabelle
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_projected_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD project_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_projected_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_projected_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_projected_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_source_table->* TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lo_source_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components_proj   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_projected_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_projected_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lo_source_line_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table>[ 1 ] ) AS cl_abap_structdescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      DATA(ls_source_component) = lo_source_line_descr->get_component( lv_field_name ).
      DATA(ls_projected_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_source_component-name
        type = ls_source_component-type
        as_include = ls_source_component-as_include ).
      APPEND ls_projected_component TO lt_components_proj.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_projected_line_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components_proj ).
    lo_projected_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_projected_line_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_projected_table TYPE HANDLE lo_projected_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_projected_table->* TO <fs_projected_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA <fs_projected_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_projected_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_projected_line>.

      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_projected_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_projected_field> = <fs_source_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_projected_line> INTO TABLE <fs_projected_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_full( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_projection( ).

    DATA(lt_fields_to_project) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ).
    DATA(lr_projected_table) = lo_cut->project_table( ir_source_table = REF #( lt_sflights )
                                                       it_field_names = lt_fields_to_project ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_projected_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_projected_table->* TO <fs_projected_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_projected_table> msg = 'Projected table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_projected_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of rows in projected table' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_projected_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <fs_projected_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_projected_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_projected_line> msg = 'First projected row not found' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_carrid> TYPE s_carr_id.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_carrid> exp = 'LH' msg = 'Incorrect CARRID in projected table' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_price> TYPE s_price.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_price>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_price> exp = '100.00' msg = 'Incorrect PRICE in projected table' ).

    " Verify that 'CONNID' is not present
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_connid> TYPE s_conn_id.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_connid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc exp = 4 msg = 'CONNID should not be in projected table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies wird durch die Kombination von RTTI (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) zur dynamischen Typdefinition und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zur Übertragung der Daten realisiert.
