Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf `CARRID` und `CONNID` in eine Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-fldate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'LH' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SELECT SINGLE` ist die effizienteste Methode, um einen einzelnen Datensatz aus der Datenbank zu lesen. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist ein modernes Feature ab ABAP 7.40, das die Lesbarkeit verbessert und SQL-Injections vorbeugt. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` füllt Felder mit gleichem Namen automatisch.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF, Hostvariable, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flugdatensatz mit bestimmten `CARRID` und `CONNID` in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flight_exists.
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @DATA(dummy). 
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_exists( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um die Existenz eines Datensatzes zu prüfen, ist `SELECT SINGLE` ohne Angabe von Feldern und `INTO @DATA(dummy)` die performanteste Methode. Das Ergebnis wird nicht benötigt, nur der `sy-subrc` Wert.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, sy-subrc, Existenzprüfung, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie den ersten verfügbaren Flugdatensatz für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in eine Struktur. Verwenden Sie `UP TO 1 ROWS`.
hint: `UP TO 1 ROWS` ist eine moderne Alternative zu `SINGLE` und kann flexibler eingesetzt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_up_to_1_rows DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_first_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_up_to_1_rows IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate ASC
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_up_to_1_rows( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_first_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'LH' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-fldate ).

    ls_flight = lo_cut->get_first_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UP TO 1 ROWS` ist eine flexible Alternative zu `SINGLE`, besonders wenn man eine `ORDER BY`-Klausel verwenden möchte, um einen spezifischen "ersten" Datensatz zu erhalten. Es ist ab ABAP 7.50 verfügbar und wird oft in Kombination mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` oder `INTO @DATA(...)` verwendet.
keywords: SELECT, UP TO 1 ROWS, ORDER BY, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Flugdatensatz aus `SFLIGHTS`. Der `CONNID` ist optional. Wenn er nicht angegeben wird, soll der erste Flug für die `CARRID` zurückgegeben werden.

CLASS zcl_select_single_optional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_flight_optional
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_optional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_optional.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND (   @iv_connid IS SUPPLIED
             AND connid = @iv_connid
             OR  @iv_connid IS NOT SUPPLIED )
      ORDER BY fldate ASC
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_optional FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_optional.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_optional( ).
    DATA(ls_flight_specific) = lo_cut->get_flight_optional( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'LH' act = ls_flight_specific-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '0400' act = ls_flight_specific-connid ).

    DATA(ls_flight_first) = lo_cut->get_flight_optional( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'LH' act = ls_flight_first-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight_first-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `IS SUPPLIED` in der `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht es, optionale Parameter direkt in der Datenbankabfrage zu berücksichtigen, ohne dynamisches SQL oder komplexe `IF`-Bedingungen im ABAP-Code. Dies ist ein sehr elegantes und performantes Feature ab ABAP 7.50.
keywords: SELECT, IS SUPPLIED, OPTIONAL, WHERE, UP TO 1 ROWS

Instructions: Lesen Sie spezifische Felder eines Flugdatensatzes aus `SFLIGHTS` direkt in deklarierte Variablen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit einer expliziten Feldliste und `INTO (@var1, @var2)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      EXPORTING
        ev_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        ev_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT SINGLE fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO (@ev_fldate, @ev_planetype).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA: lv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
          lv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_fields( ).
    lo_cut->get_flight_details(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid = 'LH'
        iv_connid = '0400'
      IMPORTING
        ev_fldate = lv_fldate
        ev_planetype = lv_planetype
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_fldate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_planetype ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'BOEING 747-400' act = lv_planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das direkte Einlesen von Feldern in eine Liste von Hostvariablen (`INTO (@var1, @var2)`) ist eine präzise und effiziente Methode, um nur die benötigten Daten zu extrahieren. Dies ist ab ABAP 7.40 verfügbar und vermeidet das Erstellen einer temporären Struktur, wenn nur wenige Felder benötigt werden.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, INTO, Hostvariable, Feldliste

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein internes ABAP-Datum (`YYYYMMDD`) in ein externes, benutzerfreundliches Format (`DD.MM.YYYY`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT DATE`.

        VALUE(rv_external_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_convert_date_external IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_date_to_external.
    DATA(lv_date_char8) = iv_date.
    CONVERT DATE lv_date_char8 INTO INVERTED-DATE lv_date_char8.
    rv_external_date = lv_date_char8.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_date_external( ).
    DATA(lv_external_date) = lo_cut->convert_date_to_external( '20251128' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '28.11.2025' act = lv_external_date ).
    lv_external_date = lo_cut->convert_date_to_external( '19990101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '01.01.1999' act = lv_external_date ).

explanation: Der `CONVERT DATE` Befehl ist der Standardweg, um Datumsformate in ABAP zu transformieren. `INVERTED-DATE` ist ein vordefiniertes Format, das `DD.MM.YYYY` entspricht. Obwohl es älter ist, ist es immer noch die idiomatische Art, diese Konvertierung durchzuführen, und wird in modernen Kontexten weiterhin verwendet.
keywords: CONVERT DATE, Datumskonvertierung, INVERTED-DATE

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Menge von einer Einheit in eine andere (z.B. Kilogramm in Gramm).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONVERT UNIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_convert_unit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_quantity_unit
      IMPORTING
        iv_quantity TYPE p DECIMALS 3
        iv_unit_from TYPE meins
        iv_unit_to TYPE meins
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_quantity) TYPE p DECIMALS 3.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_convert_unit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_quantity_unit.
    DATA: lv_quantity_in TYPE p DECIMALS 3,
          lv_quantity_out TYPE p DECIMALS 3.

    lv_quantity_in = iv_quantity.

    CONVERT UNIT iv_unit_from
      AMOUNT lv_quantity_in
      INTO UNIT iv_unit_to
      AMOUNT lv_quantity_out.

    rv_converted_quantity = lv_quantity_out.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_unit FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_unit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_unit( ).
    DATA(lv_converted_g) = lo_cut->convert_quantity_unit(
                              iv_quantity = '1.000'
                              iv_unit_from = 'KG'
                              iv_unit_to = 'G' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '1000.000' act = lv_converted_g ).

    DATA(lv_converted_kg) = lo_cut->convert_quantity_unit(
                              iv_quantity = '2000.000'
                              iv_unit_from = 'G'
                              iv_unit_to = 'KG' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '2.000' act = lv_converted_kg ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONVERT UNIT` Befehl ist essenziell für die Umrechnung von Mengen zwischen verschiedenen Einheiten, basierend auf den im Customizing hinterlegten Umrechnungsfaktoren. Dies gewährleistet korrekte und konsistente Umrechnungen im gesamten System.
keywords: CONVERT UNIT, Einheitenumrechnung, Menge

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen numerischen String in einen Integer-Wert unter Verwendung des `CONV`-Operators.
hint: Der `CONV`-Operator ist eine moderne und prägnante Art der Typkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS string_to_integer
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD string_to_integer.
    TRY.
        rv_integer = CONV i( iv_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_integer = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_to_integer FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_string_to_integer_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_to_integer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_integer) = lo_cut->string_to_integer( '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 123 act = lv_integer ).

    lv_integer = lo_cut->string_to_integer( '-45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = -45 act = lv_integer ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_string_to_integer_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_integer) = lo_cut->string_to_integer( 'abc' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 0 act = lv_integer ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine kompakte Syntax für Typkonvertierungen. Er ist Teil der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP und sollte in modernen Programmen bevorzugt werden. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` ist wichtig, um Laufzeitfehler bei ungültigen Konvertierungen abzufangen.
keywords: CONV, Typkonvertierung, String, Integer, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen `XSTRING` (binäre Daten) in einen `STRING` (Textdaten) unter Berücksichtigung der Kodierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` für die Konvertierung mit Kodierungsangabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding TYPE string DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD xstring_to_string.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      input       = iv_xstring
      encoding    = iv_encoding
      endian      = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_little
    ).
    lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_xstring_to_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xstring_to_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_xstring_string( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                                  source      = 'Hello World'
                                  target_codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_string) = lo_cut->xstring_to_string( lv_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Hello World' act = lv_string ).

    DATA(lv_xstring_german) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                                  source      = 'Grüße'
                                  target_codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_string_german) = lo_cut->xstring_to_string( lv_xstring_german ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Grüße' act = lv_string_german ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung zwischen `XSTRING` und `STRING` erfordert oft die Berücksichtigung der Zeichenkodierung. Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` (und `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` für die umgekehrte Richtung) bietet eine robuste und moderne Möglichkeit, diese Konvertierungen durchzuführen, indem sie die Kodierung explizit angibt.
keywords: CONVERT, XSTRING, STRING, Kodierung, CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE

Instructions: Lesen Sie den `PLANETYPE` eines Fluges aus `SFLIGHTS` direkt in eine skalare Variable. Wenn der Flug nicht gefunden wird, soll ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO @DATA(variable)` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` oder nutzen Sie eine Fallunterscheidung nach der Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_planetype_with_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_planetype) TYPE sflight-planetype.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_planetype_with_default.
    SELECT SINGLE planetype
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @rv_planetype.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_planetype = 'UNKNOWN'. " Standardwert
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_planetype_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_planetype_not_found FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_planetype_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_default( ).
    DATA(lv_planetype) = lo_cut->get_planetype_with_default( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'BOEING 747-400' act = lv_planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_planetype_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_default( ).
    DATA(lv_planetype) = lo_cut->get_planetype_with_default( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'UNKNOWN' act = lv_planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das direkte Einlesen eines einzelnen Feldes in eine skalare Variable (`INTO @rv_planetype`) ist ab ABAP 7.40 möglich. Die Prüfung von `sy-subrc` nach der `SELECT SINGLE`-Anweisung ist der Standardweg, um festzustellen, ob ein Datensatz gefunden wurde, und ermöglicht das Setzen eines Standardwertes, falls nicht.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, INTO, skalare Variable, sy-subrc, Standardwert

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein internes ABAP-Datum (`YYYYMMDD`) in ein externes Format, das dem Benutzerdatumformat entspricht, das in den Benutzereinstellungen definiert ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_convert_date_user_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_convert_date_user_format IMPLEMENTATION.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_date_user FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_date_user.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_date_user_format( ).
    " This test assumes a specific user date format (e.g., DD.MM.YYYY or MM/DD/YYYY)
    " For robust testing, you might need to set user parameters or mock the CONVERT behavior.
    " Here, we'll assume a common format for demonstration.
    DATA(lv_user_date) = lo_cut->convert_date_to_user_format( '20251128' ).
    " The actual expected value depends on the user's settings. 
    " For example, if user format is 'DD.MM.YYYY', then '28.11.2025'
    " If user format is 'MM/DD/YYYY', then '11/28/2025'
    " We'll assert it's not initial and has a plausible length.

Dies ist wichtig für die Internationalisierung und Benutzerfreundlichkeit von Anwendungen.
keywords: CONVERT DATE, Benutzerformat, Datumskonvertierung, Internationalisierung

Instructions: Lesen Sie den `PLANETYPE` eines Fluges aus `SFLIGHTS` direkt in eine skalare Variable. Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator, um einen Standardwert zu setzen, falls der Flug nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit dem `VALUE` Operator für eine kompakte Zuweisung mit Fallback-Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_value_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_planetype_value_op
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_planetype) TYPE sflight-planetype.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_value_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_planetype_value_op.
    DATA(lv_planetype_tmp) TYPE sflight-planetype.

    SELECT SINGLE planetype
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @lv_planetype_tmp.

    rv_planetype = VALUE #( COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN lv_planetype_tmp ELSE 'DEFAULT_PLANE' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_planetype_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_planetype_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_planetype_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_value_op( ).
    DATA(lv_planetype) = lo_cut->get_planetype_value_op( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'BOEING 747-400' act = lv_planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_planetype_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_value_op( ).
    DATA(lv_planetype) = lo_cut->get_planetype_value_op( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'DEFAULT_PLANE' act = lv_planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `SELECT SINGLE` mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und einer `COND`-Expression (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Zuweisung eines Wertes, der entweder aus der Datenbank stammt oder ein vordefinierter Standardwert ist, falls der Datensatz nicht gefunden wurde. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von separaten `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, VALUE, COND, sy-subrc, Standardwert, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf `carrid` und `connid` und geben Sie die Flugnummer (`fldate`) zurück. Nutzen Sie Inline-Deklaration für die Zielstruktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE * FROM ... INTO @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_select_single_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_dbq_select_single_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_flight_or_default.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_result)

CLASS zcl_dbq_count_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) in der Tabelle `sflights` und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Hash-Tabelle (Map), wobei der `carrid` der Schlüssel und die Anzahl der Flüge der Wert ist. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Befüllung der Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY ...` in eine temporäre interne Tabelle und dann `VALUE #( FOR ... )` zum Befüllen der Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_count_to_hashmap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rm_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_count_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_count_to_hashmap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_map.
    DATA: lt_temp_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_temp_counts.

    rm_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR ls_temp IN lt_temp_counts ( ls_temp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen Tabelle (`SFLIGHTS`), aber nur mit ausgewählten Feldern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` mit einer gefilterten Komponentenliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_filtered_sflights_table
      IMPORTING
        it_fields TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_filtered_sflights_table.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA(lo_sflights_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ) ).
    DATA(lt_all_components) = lo_sflights_table_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_components) = VALUE abap_component_tab(
      FOR ls_comp IN lt_all_components WHERE ( table_line-name IN it_fields )
      ( ls_comp )
    ).

    DATA(lo_new_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_filtered_components )
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique = abap_false
    ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS field_exists_in_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD field_exists_in_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_table_descr->get_components( ).

    TRY.
        READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Strukturen zweier interner Tabellen zur Laufzeit und geben Sie an, ob sie identisch sind (gleiche Feldnamen und -typen in gleicher Reihenfolge).

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_table_structures
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE any table
        it_table2 TYPE any table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_identical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_structures.
    DATA(lo_table_descr1) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table1 ) ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr2) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table2 ) ).

    DATA(lt_components1) = lo_table_descr1->get_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components2) = lo_table_descr2->get_components( ).

    IF lines( lt_components1 ) <> lines( lt_components2 ).
      rv_are_identical = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_components1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
      DATA(lv_index) = sy-tabix.
      DATA(ls_comp2) = lt_components2[ lv_index ].

      IF ls_comp1-name <> ls_comp2-name OR
         ls_comp1-type->type_kind <> ls_comp2-type->type_kind OR
         ls_comp1-type->length <> ls_comp2-type->length OR
         ls_comp1-type->decimals <> ls_comp2-type->decimals.
        rv_are_identical = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_are_identical = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_sflights_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflights_zip_csv
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_sflights_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_zip_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_csv_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = 'CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE,PRICE,CURRENCY,PLANETYPE,SEATSMAX,SEATSOCC,PAYMENTSUM,FLTYPE' & cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = s && |{ ls_sflight-carrid },{ ls_sflight-connid },{ ls_sflight-fldate },{ ls_sflight-price },{ ls_sflight-currency },{ ls_sflight-planetype },{ ls_sflight-seatsmax },{ ls_sflight-seatsocc },{ ls_sflight-paymentsum },{ ls_sflight-fltype }| & cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      name    = 'sflights.csv'
      content = cl_abap_con_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( lv_csv_string ) " Convert string to XSTRING
    ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->get_zip( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_check_file_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS file_exists_in_zip
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_file_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_abap_zip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_check_file_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD file_exists_in_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).

    DATA(lt_zip_entries) = lo_zip->get_files( ).

    TRY.
        READ TABLE lt_zip_entries WITH KEY name = iv_file_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_table_to_textfile DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_zip_table_to_textfile IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_from_string_table.
    DATA(lv_file_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR line IN it_lines
      NEXT s = s && line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      name    = iv_file_name
      content = cl_abap_con_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( lv_file_content )
    ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->get_zip( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

CLASS zcl_zip_table_to_textfile DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_zip_from_string_table

        iv_file_name TYPE string
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_zip_table_to_textfile IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_from_string_table.
    DATA(lv_file_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR line IN it_lines
      NEXT s = s && line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      name    = iv_file_name
      content = cl_abap_con_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( lv_file_content )
    ).
    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->get_zip( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahiere Tag, Monat und Jahr aus einem Datumstring im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD' und gib sie als Struktur zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit Capturing Groups und `get_match_offset`/`get_match_length`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_extract_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_parts,
             year  TYPE string,
             month TYPE string,
             day   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_date_parts.

    METHODS extract_date_parts
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_date_parts) TYPE ty_date_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_date_parts.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = '(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})'
      case_sensitive = abap_false
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_date_string ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) = abap_true.
      rs_date_parts-year  = iv_date_string+lo_matcher->get_match_offset( group = 1 )( lo_matcher->get_match_length( group = 1 ) ).
      rs_date_parts-month = iv_date_string+lo_matcher->get_match_offset( group = 2 )( lo_matcher->get_match_length( group = 2 ) ).
      rs_date_parts-day   = iv_date_string+lo_matcher->get_match_offset( group = 3 )( lo_matcher->get_match_length( group = 3 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_validate_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_email.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines regulären Ausdrucks (z.B. Komma oder Semikolon, gefolgt von optionalen Leerzeichen) in eine interne Tabelle von Substrings auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und eine `REDUCE` Expression, um die Substrings zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_split_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_split_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = cl_abap_regex=>create_from_pattern(
      pattern = iv_pattern
      case_sensitive = abap_false
    ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.
    rt_parts = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT parts = VALUE string_table( )
           current_offset = 0
      FOR  <match> IN lo_matcher->find_all( )
      NEXT parts = VALUE string_table( BASE parts ( iv_text+current_offset( <match>-offset - current_offset ) ) )
           current_offset = <match>-offset + <match>-length
    ).
    APPEND iv_text+lv_last_offset TO rt_parts. " Add the last part
    " Remove empty strings if the pattern matches at the beginning or end, or multiple times
    DELETE rt_parts WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_modify_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_column_header
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_fieldname TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_header TYPE lvc_coltext
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_salv_table) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_modify_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_column_header.
    DATA: lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    cl_salv_controller_metadata_util=>get_field_catalog_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_data_ref = REF #( it_data )
      IMPORTING
        et_field_catalog = lt_fcat
    ).

    TRY.
        " Find and modify the field catalog entry
        ASSIGN lt_fcat[ fieldname = iv_fieldname ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat_entry>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_fcat_entry>-seltext_l = iv_new_header.
          <fs_fcat_entry>-seltext_m = iv_new_header.
          <fs_fcat_entry>-seltext_s = iv_new_header.
        ENDIF.

        " Create ALV instance
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table = it_data
        ).

        " Set the modified field catalog
        ro_salv_table->set_field_catalog( lt_fcat ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

          CHANGING
            t_table = it_data
        ).

        " Set the modified field catalog
        ro_salv_table->set_field_catalog( lt_fcat ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.

CLASS zcl_alv_reorder_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS reorder_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_first_column TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_salv_table) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reorder_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reorder_columns.
    DATA: lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    cl_salv_controller_metadata_util=>get_field_catalog_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_data_ref = REF #( it_data )
      IMPORTING
        et_field_catalog = lt_fcat
    ).

    " Reorder field catalog: move iv_first_column to the beginning
    DATA(lt_fcat_reordered) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR <fcat_entry> IN lt_fcat WHERE ( fieldname = iv_first_column ) ( <fcat_entry> )
      FOR <fcat_entry> IN lt_fcat WHERE ( fieldname <> iv_first_column ) ( <fcat_entry> )
    ).

    " Assign new column positions
    LOOP AT lt_fcat_reordered ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat_entry>).
      <fs_fcat_entry>-col_pos = sy-tabix.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        " Create ALV instance
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table = it_data
        ).

        " Set the reordered field catalog
        ro_salv_table->set_field_catalog( lt_fcat_reordered ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Setzen Sie eine Spalte in einem ALV auf unsichtbar, indem Sie den Feldkatalog anpassen.
hint: Setzen Sie das Feld `no_out` im entsprechenden `lvc_s_fcat` Eintrag auf `abap_true`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_hide_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS hide_column
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_fieldname TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_salv_table) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_hide_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD hide_column.
    DATA: lt_fcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    cl_salv_controller_metadata_util=>get_field_catalog_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_data_ref = REF #( it_data )
      IMPORTING
        et_field_catalog = lt_fcat
    ).

    " Find and modify the field catalog entry to hide the column
    ASSIGN lt_fcat[ fieldname = iv_fieldname ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fcat_entry>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_fcat_entry>-no_out = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        " Create ALV instance
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table = it_data
        ).

        " Set the modified field catalog
        ro_salv_table->set_field_catalog( lt_fcat ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Wenn Data Aging aktiv ist und die Session-Temperatur 'COLD' ist, filtern Sie nur Flüge, die älter als ein Jahr sind. Andernfalls lesen Sie alle Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE mit einem dynamischen WHERE-Zusatz oder FILTER-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_aging_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_aging_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    DATA(lv_is_aging_active) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>is_data_aging_active( ).
    DATA(lv_session_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_session_temperature( ).

    IF lv_is_aging_active = abap_true AND lv_session_temp = cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_temperature_cold.
      DATA(lv_one_year_ago) = sy-datum - 365.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_flights WHERE fldate < @lv_one_year_ago.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Informationen von CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE genutzt werden können, um das Datenzugriffsverhalten dynamisch anzupassen. Dies ist ein typisches Szenario im Kontext von Data Aging, um je nach Session-Temperatur unterschiedliche Datenmengen zu verarbeiten.

    " DATA(lv_db_schema) = cl_db_sys=>get_db_schema( ). " Schema information from CL_DB_SYS is not directly used for this specific check in ABAP.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei Felder mit unterschiedlichen, aber kompatiblen Typen automatisch konvertiert werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE` und `CONV`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field_a TYPE i,
             field_b TYPE d,
           END OF ty_target.

    CLASS zcl_conv_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS convert_structure
          IMPORTING
            is_source TYPE ty_source
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( rs_target ) is_source MAPPING field_a = CONV i( is_source-field_a )
                                                                  field_b = CONV d( is_source-field_b ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_structure_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_structure_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE ty_source( field_a = '123' field_b = '20231128' ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->convert_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_a exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_b exp = '20231128' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `CORRESPONDING` und `CONV` ermöglicht eine elegante und typsichere Konvertierung zwischen Strukturen, selbst wenn die Feldtypen unterschiedlich sind. `BASE` sorgt dafür, dass die Zielstruktur initialisiert wird.
keywords: CONV, CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Transfer, MAPPING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie die Werte eines bestimmten Feldes aus einer Quelltabelle in einen anderen Typ konvertieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `CONV`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id    TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES: tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES: tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_conv_for_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS convert_table_data
          IMPORTING
            it_source TYPE tt_source_table
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_for_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_data.
    rt_target = VALUE tt_target_table(
                      FOR ls_source IN it_source
                      ( id = CONV i( ls_source-id DEFAULT 0 )
                        value = CONV i( ls_source-value DEFAULT 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_conversion_with_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_for_table( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_source_table(
                            ( id = '1' value = '100' )
                            ( id = '2' value = '200' ) ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->convert_table_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-value exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_conversion_with_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_for_table( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_source_table(
                            ( id = 'A' value = '100' )
                            ( id = '2' value = 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->convert_table_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 0 ). " Default value
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-value exp = 0 ). " Default value
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `CONV` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation von internen Tabellen, ohne explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen.
keywords: CONV, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Transformation

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in einen Integer, aber nur, wenn der String eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt (z.B. nur positive Zahlen). Andernfalls geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CONV` mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_conditionally.
    rv_integer = COND i( WHEN iv_input_string CA '123456789' AND iv_input_string NP '*[^0-9]*'
                             THEN CONV i( iv_input_string )
                             ELSE 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

                      IMPORTING out   = rv_latin1_string
                                noconv = DATA(lv_noconv) ).

    IF lv_noconv > 0.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine interne Tabelle von Integern, wobei leere Strings ignoriert werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `CONV`.
solution:
TYPES: tt_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: tt_integer_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_conv_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_and_filter_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE tt_string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_integers) TYPE tt_integer_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_filter_table.
    rt_integers = VALUE tt_integer_table(
                    FOR lv_string IN FILTER tt_string_table(
                                            it_input_strings WHERE table_line IS NOT INITIAL )
                    ( CONV i( lv_string ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge von Lufthansa (Carrier 'LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights` und speichere sie in einer internen Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_lh_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_lh_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_lh_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found for LH' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights should be found for LH' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

keywords: SELECT, INTO TABLE, DATA, WHERE, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Lese einen einzelnen Flug von Lufthansa mit der Flugnummer '0400' und dem Datum '20250101' aus `sflights` in eine Struktur.
hint: Verwende `SELECT SINGLE ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_single_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_sflight_single_reader IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.

INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...)`-Syntax ermöglicht das effiziente Lesen eines einzelnen Datensatzes. `CORRESPONDING FIELDS` sorgt für die automatische Zuordnung von Datenbankfeldern zu gleichnamigen Feldern in der Zielstruktur, was den Code vereinfacht. Die `@`-Escape-Zeichen kennzeichnen Hostvariablen.

Instructions: Ermittle die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `SELECT ... GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen wie `COUNT` und `AVG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats,
           tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_statistics RETURNING VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(price) AS avg_price
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_carrier_statistics FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_statistics.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_aggregator->get_carrier_statistics( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Statistics should not be empty' act = lines( lt_stats ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_stats INTO DATA(ls_lh_stats) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH flight count should not be initial' act = ls_lh_stats-flight_count ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH average price should not be initial' act = ls_lh_stats-avg_price ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'LH statistics not found' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Verwendung von `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen (`COUNT`, `AVG`) direkt im `SELECT`-Statement. Dies ermöglicht die Berechnung von Statistiken auf der Datenbankebene, was oft performanter ist als die Aggregation in ABAP. Die Ergebnisse werden direkt in eine intern deklarierte Tabelle gelesen.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, COUNT, AVG, Aggregate Functions, Database Aggregation

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_join_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_name,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,

CLASS zcl_sflight_join_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lese die 5 teuersten Flüge von Lufthansa aus `sflights`.
hint: Kombiniere `ORDER BY` und `UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_top_n_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_top_n  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_top_n_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_expensive_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY price DESCENDING
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_top_n_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_top_n_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_top_n_expensive_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_top_n = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should return 3 flights' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    IF lines( lt_flights ) = 3.
      " Check if prices are in descending order
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'First flight should be more expensive than second' act = ( lt_flights[1]-price >= lt_flights[2]-price ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Second flight should be more expensive than third' act = ( lt_flights[2]-price >= lt_flights[3]-price ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert `ORDER BY ... DESCENDING` mit `UP TO N ROWS`, um die teuersten Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft effizient direkt von der Datenbank abzurufen. Dies ist performanter, da die Datenbank nur die benötigten Datensätze sortiert und zurückgibt, anstatt alle Daten zu übertragen und dann in ABAP zu filtern.
keywords: SELECT, ORDER BY, UP TO N ROWS, Performance, Top N

Instructions: Gegeben eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften, lese alle Flüge für diese Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights`.
hint: Nutze `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einer vorbereiteten internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrid,
           tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_fae_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_for_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_fae_reader( ).

    DATA(lt_input_carriers) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae_reader=>tt_carrid(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_input_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights should be found for specified carriers' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrier should be LH or AA' act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with empty input table
    DATA(lt_empty_carriers) = VALUE zcl_sflight_fae_reader=>tt_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_empty_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights should be returned for empty carrier list' act = lines( lt_empty_flights ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ist eine leistungsstarke Klausel, um Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle basierend auf den Werten in einer internen Tabelle zu lesen. Es vermeidet N+1-Probleme (viele einzelne `SELECT`-Statements) und ist oft performanter als `IN`-Operatoren bei großen Datenmengen. Wichtig ist die Prüfung, ob die interne Tabelle für `FOR ALL ENTRIES` nicht initial ist.
keywords: SELECT, FOR ALL ENTRIES, Performance, Internal Tables, Database Access

Instructions: Lese Flüge aus `sflights` und füge ein Feld hinzu, das den Status des Fluges basierend auf dem Preis angibt (z.B. 'Günstig' < 200, 'Normal' >= 200 und < 500, 'Teuer' >= 500).
hint: Nutze einen `CASE`-Ausdruck direkt im `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_status_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status,
           tt_flight_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_status_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price,
           CASE
             WHEN price < 200 THEN 'Günstig'
             WHEN price >= 200 AND price < 500 THEN 'Normal'
             ELSE 'Teuer'
           END AS flight_status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_status_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights with status should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    DATA(lv_cheap_found)  = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_normal_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_expensive_found) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price < 200 AND ls_flight-flight_status = 'Günstig'.
        lv_cheap_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-price >= 200 AND ls_flight-price < 500 AND ls_flight-flight_status = 'Normal'.
        lv_normal_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-price >= 500 AND ls_flight-flight_status = 'Teuer'.
        lv_expensive_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one cheap flight should be found' act = lv_cheap_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one normal flight should be found' act = lv_normal_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one expensive flight should be found' act = lv_expensive_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 können `CASE`-Ausdrücke direkt in `SELECT`-Statements verwendet werden, um bedingte Logik auf der Datenbankebene auszuführen. Dies ermöglicht die Berechnung abgeleiteter Felder wie `flight_status` direkt in der Abfrage, was die Datenverarbeitung vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert, da keine Nachbearbeitung in ABAP erforderlich ist.
keywords: SELECT, CASE, Conditional Logic, Database Expression, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erhöhe den Preis aller Flüge von Lufthansa in `sflights` um 10% und speichere die aktualisierten Preise in einer neuen internen Tabelle, ohne die Datenbank zu ändern.
hint: Nutze `SELECT` mit einem arithmetischen Ausdruck und `VALUE` für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_new_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             old_price TYPE sflight-price,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_new_price,
           tt_sflight_new_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_new_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_increased_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase_percent TYPE p DECIMALS 2 DEFAULT '0.10'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_new_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_increased_prices.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price AS old_price,
           price * ( 1 + @iv_increase_percent ) AS new_price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_increased_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_increased_prices.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflight_price_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_calculator->calculate_increased_prices( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_increase_percent = '0.10' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights with new prices should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'New price should be 10% higher than old price' act = ls_flight-new_price exp = ls_flight-old_price * '1.10' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.52 können arithmetische Ausdrücke direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste verwendet werden, um berechnete Felder zu erzeugen. Hier wird der `price` um einen Prozentsatz erhöht und als `new_price` zurückgegeben, ohne die Datenbank zu modifizieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Daten vor der Übertragung in das ABAP-Programm zu transformieren.
keywords: SELECT, Arithmetic Expression, Calculated Field, ABAP 7.52, Data Transformation

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf einer Verzögerungszeit.

CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Produkt aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_product
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = 1
      FOR <number> IN it_numbers
      NEXT result = result * <number>
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_product_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_product_with_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_product_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_product_positive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_product_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_product_calculator=>tt_numbers( ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lv_product) = lo_cut->calculate_product( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_product exp = 24 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_product_with_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_product_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_product_calculator=>tt_numbers( ( 2 ) ( 0 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lv_product) = lo_cut->calculate_product( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_product exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_product_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_product_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_product_calculator=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_product) = lo_cut->calculate_product( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_product exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle zu einem einzelnen Ergebniswert. Hier wird er verwendet, um das Produkt aller Elemente deklarativ und effizient zu berechnen.
keywords: REDUCE, MULTIPLY, Functional Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Wandeln Sie einen numerischen Monat in seinen deutschen Namen um.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_month_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_month_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_month_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_month_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_month_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_month_name.
    rv_month_name = SWITCH string( iv_month_number
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Januar'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Februar'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'März'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Mai'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Juni'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Juli'
      WHEN 8 THEN 'August'
      WHEN 9 THEN 'September'
      WHEN 10 THEN 'Oktober'
      WHEN 11 THEN 'November'
      WHEN 12 THEN 'Dezember'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Monat'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_month_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_month_mapper( ).
    DATA(lv_month) = lo_cut->get_month_name( 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_month exp = 'März' ).

  METHOD test_month_invalid.

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck bietet eine elegante und prägnante Möglichkeit, einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Eingabewerten zuzuweisen, ähnlich einem `CASE`-Statement, aber als Ausdruck.
keywords: SWITCH, WHEN, Conditional Logic, Mapping

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Typ eines übergebenen Objekts zur Laufzeit und geben Sie eine spezifische Beschreibung aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE TYPE OF` für die RTTI-Prüfung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Kreis mit Radius { mv_radius }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Quadrat mit Seitenlänge { mv_side }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_analysis) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_analysis = |Analysierter Kreis: { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_description( ) }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_square INTO DATA(lo_square).
        rv_analysis = |Analysiertes Quadrat: { lo_square->zif_shape~get_description( ) }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_analysis = 'Unbekannte Form'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_analyze_circle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_analyze_square FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_analyze_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyze_circle.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_shape_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = 5 ).
    DATA(lv_analysis) = lo_analyzer->analyze_shape( lo_circle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_analysis exp = 'Analysierter Kreis: Kreis mit Radius 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_analyze_square.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_shape_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lo_square) = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = 10 ).
    DATA(lv_analysis) = lo_analyzer->analyze_shape( lo_square ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_analysis exp = 'Analysiertes Quadrat: Quadrat mit Seitenlänge 10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_analyze_unknown.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_shape_analyzer( ).
    CLASS zcl_triangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_shape.
        METHODS zif_shape~get_description.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_triangle IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
        rv_desc = 'Dreieck'.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
    DATA(lo_triangle) = NEW zcl_triangle( ).
    DATA(lv_analysis) = lo_analyzer->analyze_shape( lo_triangle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_analysis exp = 'Unbekannte Form' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` ermöglicht die dynamische Typidentifikation und -behandlung von Objekten zur Laufzeit (RTTI). In Kombination mit der Inline-Deklaration (`INTO DATA(...)`) bietet es eine sehr elegante und typsichere Methode, um auf spezifische Subtypen zu reagieren.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, WHEN TYPE, RTTI, Object Orientation, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Flugpreise aus `sflights` enthält, multipliziert mit einem Umrechnungsfaktor.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_converted_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_factor TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_converted_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_converted_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        price    = ls_flight-price * iv_factor
        currency = ls_flight-curr
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_factor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_zero_factor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_factor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lt_converted) = lo_cut->get_converted_prices( iv_factor = '1.1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_converted ) ).
    IF lines( lt_converted ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_original) = VALUE sflights( SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights UP TO 1 ROWS ).
      DATA(ls_first_converted) = lt_converted[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_first_converted-price
        exp = ls_first_original-price * '1.1'
        msg = 'Price should be multiplied by factor'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_zero_factor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lt_converted) = lo_cut->get_converted_prices( iv_factor = '0.0' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_converted ) ).
    IF lines( lt_converted ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_converted) = lt_converted[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_first_converted-price
        exp = 0
        msg = 'Price should be zero with zero factor'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #` ermöglicht die deklarative und effiziente Erstellung neuer interner Tabellen durch Iteration über eine bestehende Tabelle und Transformation der Elemente, hier inklusive einer Multiplikation.
keywords: FOR, VALUE #, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, MULTIPLY, sflights
