Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge aus `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität in der Economy Class haben und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_with_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_with_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_sflights
      WHERE fldate > sy-datum
        AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_capacity
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_with_capacity( iv_min_capacity = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty if data exists' act = lines( lt_filtered ) ).
    IF lines( lt_filtered ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum ) msg = 'Flight date must be in the future' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc >= 100 ) msg = 'Capacity must be >= 100' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_with_capacity( iv_min_capacity = 9999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 0 msg = 'No flights should match high capacity' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern von internen Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft performanterem Code im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukten.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming, WHEN, sflights

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Multiplikation mit Dezimalzahlen durch und fangen Sie mögliche Überläufe mit `COMPUTE IN EXACT MODE` ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COMPUTE ... IN EXACT MODE` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exact_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS multiply_exact
      IMPORTING
        iv_operand1 TYPE decfloat34
        iv_operand2 TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exact_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_exact.
    TRY.
        COMPUTE rv_result = iv_operand1 * iv_operand2 IN EXACT MODE.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow INTO DATA(lx_overflow).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_overflow.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiply_normal FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiply_overflow RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiply_normal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exact_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->multiply_exact( iv_operand1 = '10.5' iv_operand2 = '2.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '21.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiply_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exact_multiply( ).
    " Max decfloat34 is approx 9.999...E+614
    DATA(lv_large_num) = '1E+300'.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->multiply_exact( iv_operand1 = lv_large_num iv_operand2 = lv_large_num ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COMPUTE ... IN EXACT MODE` erzwingt eine exakte arithmetische Berechnung und löst eine Ausnahme (`cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow`) aus, wenn ein Überlauf auftritt. Dies ist entscheidend für finanzmathematische oder wissenschaftliche Berechnungen, bei denen Präzision und Fehlerbehandlung unerlässlich sind. Die Verwendung von `decfloat34` bietet zudem eine hohe Präzision für Dezimalzahlen.
keywords: MULTIPLY, EXACT MODE, decfloat34, Error Handling, cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der je nach Wert einer Variablen unterschiedliche Textelemente enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit eingebetteten `COND` Ausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_value  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_message.
    rv_message = |Der Status ist { COND string( WHEN iv_status = 'A' THEN 'Aktiv' WHEN iv_status = 'I' THEN 'Inaktiv' ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) } und der Wert ist { iv_value * 2 }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_format_inactive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_active.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->format_message( iv_status = 'A' iv_value = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Der Status ist Aktiv und der Wert ist 20.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_format_inactive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->format_message( iv_status = 'I' iv_value = 5 ).

explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglichen die einfache und lesbare Erstellung formatierter Strings. Die Möglichkeit, Ausdrücke wie `COND` und arithmetische Operationen (`*`) direkt einzubetten, macht sie extrem flexibel und leistungsfähig für die dynamische String-Generierung.
keywords: String Templates, COND, WHEN, MULTIPLY, Conditional Logic, String Processing

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazität und die Anzahl der Flüge. Multiplizieren Sie die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazität mit einem Faktor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` oder `SUM` und Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats TYPE i,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_capacity_factor TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_seats = 0
        FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + <member>-seatsmax
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        total_seats = lv_total_seats * iv_capacity_factor
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouping_and_multiplication FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_grouping_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping_and_multiplication.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( iv_capacity_factor = '1.5' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Summary table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_summary ) ).

    DATA(ls_summary_lh) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouping=>ty_flight_summary( 
      lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL
    ).
    IF ls_summary_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_expected_seats_lh) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_seats = 0
        FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
        NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + ls_sflight-seatsmax
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_summary_lh-total_seats
        exp = lv_expected_seats_lh * '1.5'
        msg = 'Total seats for LH should be correctly multiplied'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_grouping_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( iv_capacity_factor = '1.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 0 msg = 'Summary table should be empty for empty sflights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für Aggregationen innerhalb der Gruppen und direkten arithmetischen Operationen (`*`) bietet sie eine moderne und effiziente Methode zur Datenanalyse.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, MULTIPLY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Grouping, sflights

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Methode basierend auf einem übergebenen Methodennamen aus und geben Sie das Ergebnis zurück. Nutzen Sie dabei `SWITCH` für die Methodenauswahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` für RTTI und `SWITCH` für die dynamische Methodenauswahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_value       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _add IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_res) TYPE i.
    METHODS _multiply IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_res) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    rv_result = SWITCH i( iv_method_name
      WHEN '_add' THEN _add( iv_val = iv_value )
      WHEN '_multiply' THEN _multiply( iv_val = iv_value )
      ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
             EXPORTING
               text = |Method { iv_method_name } not supported.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _add.
    rv_res = iv_val + 10.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _multiply.
    rv_res = iv_val * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_execute_add FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_execute_multiply FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_execute_invalid RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_execute_add.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_executor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = '_add' iv_value = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_execute_multiply.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_executor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = '_multiply' iv_value = 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 14 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_execute_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_executor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = '_subtract' iv_value = 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_call_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'cx_sy_dyn_call_error caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `SWITCH`-Ausdruck und der dynamischen Methodenauswahl ermöglicht eine flexible und erweiterbare Architektur. Anstatt viele `IF`- oder `CASE`-Statements zu verwenden, um Methoden aufzurufen, kann der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck direkt den Rückgabewert der passenden Methode zuweisen, was den Code kompakter und wartbarer macht. Hier wird auch die Multiplikation innerhalb einer der dynamisch aufgerufenen Methoden demonstriert.
keywords: SWITCH, WHEN, Dynamic Programming, Method Call, MULTIPLY, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum ein Wochentag oder ein Wochenende ist.

CLASS zcl_date_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_weekend
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_weekend) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_weekend.
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_day_of_week( iv_date = iv_date ).
    rv_is_weekend = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN lv_day_of_week = 6 OR lv_day_of_week = 7 THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights`, wobei die Flugpreise nur für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften multipliziert werden und andere unverändert bleiben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit einem eingebetteten `COND` für die bedingte Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_price_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_mod,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_price_mod.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_mod WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_conditionally_modified_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers_to_modify TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_factor             TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_prices) TYPE tt_flight_price_mod.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_price_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditionally_modified_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    rt_modified_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        price    = COND s_price(
                     WHEN ls_flight-carrid IN it_carriers_to_modify THEN ls_flight-price * iv_factor
                     ELSE ls_flight-price
                   )
        currency = ls_flight-curr
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_multiplication FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_modification FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_multiplication.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_price_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_modified) = lo_cut->get_conditionally_modified_prices( 
      it_carriers_to_modify = lt_carriers
      iv_factor             = '1.2'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Modified table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_modified ) ).

    DATA(ls_original_lh) = VALUE sflights( SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' UP TO 1 ROWS ).
    IF ls_original_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(ls_modified_lh) = lt_modified[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_modified_lh-price
        exp = ls_original_lh-price * '1.2'
        msg = 'LH price should be multiplied'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_original_ua) = VALUE sflights( SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'UA' UP TO 1 ROWS ).
    IF ls_original_ua IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(ls_modified_ua) = lt_modified[ carrid = 'UA' ] OPTIONAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_modified_ua-price
        exp = ls_original_ua-price
        msg = 'UA price should remain unchanged'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_modification.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_price_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id( ). " Empty table, no carriers to modify
    DATA(lt_modified) = lo_cut->get_conditionally_modified_prices( 
      it_carriers_to_modify = lt_carriers
      iv_factor             = '1.2'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Modified table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_modified ) ).

    DATA(ls_original_any) = VALUE sflights( SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights UP TO 1 ROWS ).
    IF ls_original_any IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(ls_modified_any) = lt_modified[ 1 ] OPTIONAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_modified_any-price
        exp = ls_original_any-price
        msg = 'Any price should remain unchanged'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Ansatz kombiniert den `FOR`-Ausdruck für die Transformation interner Tabellen mit einem eingebetteten `COND`-Ausdruck. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und deklarative bedingte Logik direkt während der Datenverarbeitung, hier um Preise nur für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften zu multiplizieren.
keywords: FOR, VALUE #, COND, WHEN, MULTIPLY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Conditional Logic, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Produkte von zwei Listen von Zahlen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem eingebetteten `FOR` Ausdruck und Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_of_products DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_products
      IMPORTING
        it_list1 TYPE tt_numbers
        it_list2 TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_of_products IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_products.
    " Assuming lists are of equal size for simplicity
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_sum = 0
      FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i < lines( it_list1 )
      NEXT total_sum = total_sum + ( it_list1[ i + 1 ] * it_list2[ i + 1 ] )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_of_products FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_of_products_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_of_products_single FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_products.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_of_products( ).
    DATA(lt_list1) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lt_list2) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_numbers( ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_products( it_list1 = lt_list1 it_list2 = lt_list2 ).
    " Expected: (1*4) + (2*5) + (3*6) = 4 + 10 + 18 = 32
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 32 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_of_products_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_of_products( ).
    DATA(lt_list1) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_list2) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_products( it_list1 = lt_list1 it_list2 = lt_list2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_of_products_single.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_of_products( ).
    DATA(lt_list1) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_numbers( ( 7 ) ).
    DATA(lt_list2) = VALUE zcl_sum_of_products=>tt_numbers( ( 8 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_products( it_list1 = lt_list1 it_list2 = lt_list2 ).
    " Expected: (7*8) = 56
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 56 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Ansatz nutzt den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine Summe zu aggregieren, während er gleichzeitig über Indizes iteriert. Innerhalb der Iteration werden Elemente aus zwei Listen multipliziert und zur Gesamtsumme addiert. Dies demonstriert eine leistungsstarke Kombination von funktionalen Ausdrücken für komplexe mathematische Operationen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, MULTIPLY, Functional Programming, Math, Internal Tables

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter verschiedene Objekttypen einer gemeinsamen Schnittstelle erstellt. Nutzen Sie `COND` für die Objekterzeugung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` mit `NEW` für die bedingte Objekterzeugung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_invoice DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
    METHODS zif_document~get_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_invoice IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Rechnung'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
    METHODS zif_document~get_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Bestellung'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_document_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zif_document
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    ro_document = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_document_type = 'INVOICE' THEN NEW zcl_invoice( )
      WHEN iv_document_type = 'ORDER'   THEN NEW zcl_order( )
      ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
             EXPORTING
               text = |Unknown document type: { iv_document_type }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_invoice FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_order FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_invoice.
    DATA(lo_document) = zcl_document_factory=>create_document( 'INVOICE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_document->get_type( ) exp = 'Rechnung' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_order.
    DATA(lo_document) = zcl_document_factory=>create_document( 'ORDER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_document->get_type( ) exp = 'Bestellung' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid.
    TRY.
        zcl_document_factory=>create_document( 'REPORT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_create_object_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'cx_sy_create_object_error caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung des `COND`-Ausdrucks in einer Factory-Methode ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und deklarative Implementierung der bedingten Objekterzeugung. Anstatt mehrerer `IF`- oder `CASE`-Statements mit `CREATE OBJECT`, kann die gesamte Logik in einer einzigen Zeile zusammengefasst werden, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: COND, WHEN, Object Orientation, Factory Method, Conditional Logic, NEW

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Parameter und deren dekodierte Werte aus einem URL-Query-String und speichern Sie diese in einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SPLIT`, `cl_http_utility=>decode_url` und `VALUE #(...)` für die Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_param_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_param,
        name  TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_param,
      tt_params TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_param WITH UNIQUE KEY name.

    CLASS-METHODS parse_query_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_query_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_params) TYPE tt_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_param_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_query_string.
    IF iv_query_string IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_pairs) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_query_string AT '&' INTO TABLE lt_pairs.

    rt_params = VALUE tt_params(
      FOR <pair> IN lt_pairs
        LET lv_name_value = VALUE string_table( ) IN
        ( SPLIT <pair> AT '=' INTO TABLE lv_name_value )
        IN
        ( name  = cl_http_utility=>decode_url( lv_name_value[1] )
          value = cl_http_utility=>decode_url( lv_name_value[2] OPTIONAL ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_parse_simple.
    DATA(lt_params) = zcl_http_param_parser=>parse_query_string( 'param1=value1&param2=value2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_params[ name = 'param1' ]-value exp = 'value1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_params[ name = 'param2' ]-value exp = 'value2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_params ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_complex.
    DATA(lt_params) = zcl_http_param_parser=>parse_query_string( 'name=John%20Doe&city=New%20York%20%C3%9C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_params[ name = 'name' ]-value exp = 'John Doe' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_params[ name = 'city' ]-value exp = 'New York Ü' ).

    DATA(lt_params) = zcl_http_param_parser=>parse_query_string( '' ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen URL-Query-String aus einer Hash-Tabelle von Parametern, wobei die Namen und Werte URL-kodiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_http_utility=>encode_url`, String-Templates und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_query_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_param,
        name  TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_param,
      tt_params TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_param WITH UNIQUE KEY name.

    CLASS-METHODS build_query_string
      IMPORTING
        it_params TYPE tt_params
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_query_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_query_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_query_string.
    IF it_params IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_query_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR <param> IN it_params
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN
          |{ cl_http_utility=>encode_url( <param>-name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>encode_url( <param>-value ) }|
        ELSE
          |{ result }&{ cl_http_utility=>encode_url( <param>-name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>encode_url( <param>-value ) }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den MIME-Typ einer Datei basierend auf ihrer Dateierweiterung. Implementieren Sie dies als Utility-Methode.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND` für die Dateierweiterung und den `SWITCH` Ausdruck für die Zuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_mime_detector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_mime_type_by_extension
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_mime_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type_by_extension.
    DATA(lv_extension) = ''.
    FIND REGEX '\.([^\.]+)$' IN iv_filename SUBMATCHES lv_extension.
    lv_extension = to_lower( lv_extension ).

    rv_mime_type = SWITCH string( lv_extension
      WHEN 'html' THEN 'text/html'
      WHEN 'htm'  THEN 'text/html'
      WHEN 'css'  THEN 'text/css'
      WHEN 'js'   THEN 'application/javascript'
      WHEN 'json' THEN 'application/json'
      WHEN 'xml'  THEN 'application/xml'
      WHEN 'jpg'  THEN 'image/jpeg'
      WHEN 'jpeg' THEN 'image/jpeg'
      WHEN 'png'  THEN 'image/png'
      WHEN 'gif'  THEN 'image/gif'
      WHEN 'pdf'  THEN 'application/pdf'
      WHEN 'txt'  THEN 'text/plain'
      ELSE 'application/octet-stream'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sanitisieren Sie einen String, der als HTTP-Header-Wert verwendet werden soll, um unerwünschte Zeichen zu entfernen oder zu ersetzen, die zu Header-Injection-Angriffen führen könnten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_header_sanitizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS sanitize_header_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_raw_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sanitized_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_header_sanitizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sanitize_header_value.
    " Entfernt Zeilenumbrüche und andere potenziell schädliche Zeichen
    rv_sanitized_value = iv_raw_value.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[\r\n]' IN rv_sanitized_value WITH ''.
    " Optional: Weitere Zeichen ersetzen oder kodieren, je nach Kontext
    " rv_sanitized_value = cl_http_utility=>encode_url( rv_sanitized_value ).
    " Für Header-Werte ist oft eine striktere Filterung oder Kodierung nötig.
    " Hier wird eine einfache Entfernung von Zeilenumbrüchen demonstriert.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kodieren Sie einzelne Pfadsegmente eines URL-Pfades, um sicherzustellen, dass sie korrekt interpretiert werden und keine Sonderzeichen enthalten, die die Pfadstruktur verändern könnten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_utility=>encode_url` für jedes Segment und String-Templates zum Zusammenfügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_path_encoder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS encode_path_segments
      IMPORTING
        it_segments TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_encoded_path) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_path_encoder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encode_path_segments.
    IF it_segments IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_encoded_path = REDUCE string(
      INIT path = ''
      FOR segment IN it_segments
      NEXT path = |{ path }/{ cl_http_utility=>encode_url( segment ) }|
    ).
    " Entferne den führenden '/' wenn der Pfad nicht leer ist
    IF rv_encoded_path IS NOT INITIAL AND rv_encoded_path(1) = '/'.
      rv_encoded_path = rv_encoded_path+1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine grundlegende Validierung eines Strings durch, um festzustellen, ob er die Struktur einer gültigen URL aufweist (z.B. mit einem Schema wie 'http://' oder 'https://').
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND` mit `REGEX` für die Schema-Prüfung und `cl_http_utility=>encode_url` zur Robustheitsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_url_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_valid_url_basic
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_url_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_url_basic.
    DATA(lv_schema_found) = abap_false.
    FIND REGEX '^(http|https)://' IN iv_url MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_offset = 0.
      lv_schema_found = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_schema_found = abap_false.
      rb_is_valid = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Zusätzliche Robustheitsprüfung: Versuchen, die URL zu kodieren.
    " Eine ungültige URL könnte hier eine Exception werfen oder unerwartete Ergebnisse liefern.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_encoded_url) = cl_http_utility=>encode_url( iv_url ).
        " Eine sehr einfache Prüfung, ob die Kodierung nicht komplett anders ist
        IF lv_encoded_url IS NOT INITIAL.
          rb_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rb_is_valid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rb_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch mehrere `cl_gui_label`-Objekte in einem `cl_gui_flow_container` basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Texten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_flow_container` und eine `LOOP AT` Schleife zur dynamischen Erstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_labels DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_labels
      IMPORTING
        it_texts TYPE string_table
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_flow_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_flow_container.
    DATA mt_labels TYPE TABLE OF REF TO cl_gui_label. " Speichert Referenzen auf dynamisch erstellte Labels
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_labels IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_labels.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Custom Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_flow_container
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Flow Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_texts INTO DATA(lv_text).
      DATA(lo_label) = NEW cl_gui_label(
        parent = mo_flow_container
        text   = lv_text
      ).
      APPEND lo_label TO mt_labels.
    ENDLOOP.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim GUI Flush' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_io DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_process_textedit
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_text TYPE string
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
      EXPORTING

    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_io IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_process_textedit.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Custom Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
        wordwrap_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_fixed_position
        wordwrap_position = 80
        wordwrap_to_linebreak_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>true
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Textedit Controls' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( iv_initial_text ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim GUI Flush' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.

    " In einem echten Szenario würde hier eine Benutzerinteraktion stattfinden.
    " Für den Test lesen wir den Text direkt wieder aus.
    mo_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = ev_final_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_gui_simple_tree_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_simple_tree_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_simple_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Custom Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_simple_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Simple Tree Controls' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Wurzelknoten hinzufügen
    DATA(lv_root_key) = 'ROOT'.
    mo_simple_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_key = lv_root_key
        i_text     = 'Wurzelknoten'
    ).

    " Kindknoten hinzufügen
    mo_simple_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_key = 'CHILD1'
        i_relat_node_key = lv_root_key
        i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_text     = 'Kind 1'
    ).

    mo_simple_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_key = 'CHILD2'
        i_relat_node_key = lv_root_key
        i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_text     = 'Kind 2'
    ).

    mo_simple_tree->expand_node( lv_root_key ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim GUI Flush' TYPE 'E'.

CLASS zcl_find_regex_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_emails IMPORTING iv_text    TYPE string
                             RETURNING VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_regex_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex) = ` [A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,} `.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    rt_emails = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_matches
                           ( iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) ) ).

CLASS zcl_find_in_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_find_in_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF 'LH' IN ls_flight-carrid IS NOT INITIAL )

CLASS zcl_find_any_keyword DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_any_keyword IMPORTING iv_text     TYPE string
                                     it_keywords TYPE string_table
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_any_keyword IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_any_keyword.
    rv_found = abap_false.
    LOOP AT it_keywords INTO DATA(lv_keyword).
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_keyword IN iv_text.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_found = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_prefixed_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers IMPORTING iv_text    TYPE string
                                iv_prefix  TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_prefixed_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lv_regex) = iv_prefix && `\s*(\d+)`.

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR ls_submatch IN lt_submatches
                            WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL )
                            ( CONV i( ls_submatch ) ) ).

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Einträgen, bei denen die Fluggesellschaft ('CARRID') oder die Flugnummer ('CONNID') einen bestimmten Suchbegriff enthält. Geben Sie die gesamte Zeile der gefundenen Flüge zurück.

CLASS zcl_find_in_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS search_flights IMPORTING iv_search_term TYPE string
                             RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_in_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_sflights).

    rt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                              WHERE (   carrid CP '*' && iv_search_term && '*'
                                     OR connid CP '*' && iv_search_term && '*' ) ).

    " Alternativ mit FIND (weniger performant für einfache Wildcard-Suchen, aber demonstriert FIND)
    " rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_sflights
    "                          WHERE (   FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_search_term IN ls_flight-carrid IS NOT INITIAL
    "                                 OR FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_search_term IN ls_flight-connid IS NOT INITIAL )
    "                          ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Inhalt zwischen zwei spezifischen Markierungen (z.B. '<start>Inhalt<end>') aus einem Text. Es soll nur das erste Vorkommen extrahiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE` mit `MATCH OFFSET` und `MATCH LENGTH` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_between_markers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_content IMPORTING iv_text       TYPE string
                                iv_start_marker TYPE string
                                iv_end_marker   TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_between_markers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_content.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_start_marker IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(ls_start_match).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_start_pos) = ls_start_match-offset + ls_start_match-length.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_end_marker IN iv_text STARTING AT lv_start_pos RESULTS DATA(ls_end_match).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lv_length) = ls_end_match-offset - lv_start_pos.
        rv_content = iv_text+lv_start_pos(lv_length).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Text mit einem der vordefinierten Präfixe beginnt. Geben Sie 'TRUE' zurück, wenn ein passendes Präfix gefunden wird, ansonsten 'FALSE'.

CLASS zcl_find_any_prefix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS starts_with_any IMPORTING iv_text     TYPE string
                                it_prefixes TYPE string_table
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_any_prefix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD starts_with_any.
    rv_found = abap_false.
    LOOP AT it_prefixes INTO DATA(lv_prefix).
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_prefix IN iv_text STARTING AT 1.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_found = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_hashtags DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_find_hashtags IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_regex) = `\#(\w+)`.

    rt_hashtags = VALUE #( FOR ls_submatch IN lt_submatches
                             WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL )

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that takes a domain name as input and returns an internal table containing its fixed values (value and short text).
hint: Use the function module `DD_DOMA_GET` and process its output with modern ABAP syntax like `VALUE` constructor expressions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             value TYPE domvalue_l,
             text  TYPE ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value.
    TYPES tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_fixed_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domname TYPE domname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fixed_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest. " Placeholder for a more specific exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fixed_values.
    DATA: lt_dd07v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.

    CALL FUNCTION 'DD_DOMA_GET'
      EXPORTING
        domname   = iv_domname
        langu     = sy-langu
      TABLES
        dd07v_tab = lt_dd07v
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS    = 1.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_message_digest( text = 'Domain not found or error reading.' ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_fixed_values = VALUE #( FOR <fs_dd07v> IN lt_dd07v
                               WHERE ( domvalue_l IS NOT INITIAL )
                               ( value = <fs_dd07v>-domvalue_l
                                 text  = <fs_dd07v>-ddtext ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 fixed values for XFELD' act = lines( lt_fixed_values ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_fixed_values WITH KEY value = 'X' INTO DATA(ls_x).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value X not found' act = ls_x-value exp = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Text for X incorrect' act = ls_x-text exp = 'Yes' ).

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_ddic_domain_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_fixed_values( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT_DOMAIN' ).

CLASS zcl_xlsx_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflight_to_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_ehfnd_xlsx,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO if_ehfnd_xlsx_worksheet.

    " Create new XLSX document
    lo_xlsx_document = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).

    " Add a worksheet
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_worksheet( iv_title = 'SFLIGHT Data' ).

    " Write header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 1 iv_value = 'Airline ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 2 iv_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 3 iv_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 4 iv_value = 'Price' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 5 iv_value = 'Currency' ).

    " Write data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 iv_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 iv_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 3 iv_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 4 iv_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 5 iv_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Get binary data of the XLSX file
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xlsx_document->get_xlsx_data( ).

    " Save to application server
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>write_xstring_to_file(
      EXPORTING
        i_xstring = lv_xstring
        i_filename = iv_filename
        i_overwrite = abap_true
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_static_check( text = 'Error writing XLSX file to application server.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implement a method that reads data from a simple XLSX file (e.g., containing `SFLIGHT` data) from the application server into an internal table. Assume the first row is a header.
hint: Use `CL_EHFND_XLSX` to parse the XLSX file and `CL_ABAP_FILE_UTILITIES` to read it.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS import_sflight_from_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD import_sflight_from_xlsx.
    DATA: lv_xstring       TYPE xstring,
          lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_ehfnd_xlsx,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO if_ehfnd_xlsx_worksheet.

    " Read XLSX file from application server
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>read_xstring_from_file(
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_filename
      IMPORTING
        e_xstring = lv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_static_check( text = 'Error reading XLSX file from application server.' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Parse XLSX document
    lo_xlsx_document = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( iv_xstring = lv_xstring ).
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->get_worksheet( iv_index = 1 ). " Get first worksheet

    IF lo_worksheet IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_static_check( text = 'No worksheet found in XLSX file.' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_row) = lo_worksheet->get_max_row( ).
    IF lv_max_row < 2. " Only header or empty
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Read data rows (starting from row 2, assuming row 1 is header)
    LOOP AT sy-tab_lines FROM 2 TO lv_max_row INTO DATA(lv_row).
      DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
        carrid   = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 )
        connid   = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 )
        fldate   = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 3 )
        price    = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 4 )
        currency = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 5 )
      ).
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflight_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Create a method that checks if a given value is valid for a specified DDIC domain (i.e., exists in its fixed values).
hint: Reuse the logic for getting fixed values and then use `LINE_EXISTS` or `COND` for checking.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS is_valid_domain_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_domname TYPE domname
        iv_value   TYPE domvalue_l
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             value TYPE domvalue_l,
             text  TYPE ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value.
    TYPES tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_fixed_values_static
      IMPORTING
        iv_domname TYPE domname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fixed_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_domain_value.
    DATA(lt_fixed_values) = get_fixed_values_static( iv_domname ).

    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN line_exists( lt_fixed_values[ value = iv_value ] ) THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_fixed_values_static.
    DATA: lt_dd07v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.

    CALL FUNCTION 'DD_DOMA_GET'
      EXPORTING
        domname   = iv_domname
        langu     = sy-langu
      TABLES
        dd07v_tab = lt_dd07v
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS    = 1.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_message_digest( text = 'Domain not found or error reading.' ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_fixed_values = VALUE #( FOR <fs_dd07v> IN lt_dd07v
                               WHERE ( domvalue_l IS NOT INITIAL )
                               ( value = <fs_dd07v>-domvalue_l
                                 text  = <fs_dd07v>-ddtext ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implement a method that dynamically retrieves the short, medium, and long texts for a given domain value, considering the current logon language.
hint: Use `DD_DOMA_GET` to retrieve all texts and then filter/map them using modern internal table operations.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_texts DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_domain_text,
             value TYPE domvalue_l,
             short_text TYPE ddtext,
             medium_text TYPE ddtext,
             long_text TYPE ddtext,
           END OF ty_domain_text.
    TYPES tt_domain_texts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_domain_text WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_domain_value_texts
      IMPORTING
        iv_domname TYPE domname
        iv_value   TYPE domvalue_l
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_domain_text) TYPE ty_domain_text
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-METHODS get_all_domain_texts
      IMPORTING
        iv_domname TYPE domname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dd07v) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_texts IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_domain_value_texts.
    DATA(lt_dd07v) = get_all_domain_texts( iv_domname ).

    READ TABLE lt_dd07v INTO DATA(ls_dd07v) WITH KEY domvalue_l = iv_value.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_message_digest( text = |Value '{ iv_value }' not found for domain '{ iv_domname }'.| ).
    ENDIF.

    rs_domain_text = VALUE ty_domain_text(
      value       = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l
      short_text  = ls_dd07v-ddtext
      medium_text = ls_dd07v-ddtext_m
      long_text   = ls_dd07v-ddtext_l
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_domain_texts.
    CALL FUNCTION 'DD_DOMA_GET'
      EXPORTING
        domname   = iv_domname
        langu     = sy-langu
      TABLES
        dd07v_tab = rt_dd07v
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS    = 1.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_message_digest( text = 'Domain not found or error reading.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_texts-medium_text exp = 'Yes' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_texts-long_text exp = 'Yes' ).

  METHOD test_invalid_value.

Instructions: Create a method to export data to an XLSX file with multiple worksheets, each containing different `SFLIGHT` data subsets (e.g., by airline).
hint: Use `add_worksheet` multiple times and populate each sheet independently.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_multi_sheet_sflight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_filename     TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS write_sheet_data
      IMPORTING
        io_worksheet    TYPE REF TO if_ehfnd_xlsx_worksheet
        it_data         TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_multi_sheet_sflight.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_ehfnd_xlsx,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO if_ehfnd_xlsx_worksheet.

    lo_xlsx_document = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).

    " Group data by airline
    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflight_data GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP ls_sflight ( member ) ) )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_data INTO DATA(lt_airline_data).
      DATA(lv_carrid) = lt_airline_data[ 1 ]-carrid.
      lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_worksheet( iv_title = |Flights for { lv_carrid }| ).
      write_sheet_data( io_worksheet = lo_worksheet it_data = lt_airline_data ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xlsx_document->get_xlsx_data( ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>write_xstring_to_file(
      EXPORTING
        i_xstring = lv_xstring
        i_filename = iv_filename
        i_overwrite = abap_true
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_static_check( text = 'Error writing multi-sheet XLSX file.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD write_sheet_data.
    " Write header row
    io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 1 iv_value = 'Airline ID' ).
    io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 2 iv_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 3 iv_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 4 iv_value = 'Price' ).
    io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 5 iv_value = 'Currency' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 iv_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 iv_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 3 iv_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 4 iv_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      io_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 5 iv_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_export_multi_sheet FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_export_multi_sheet.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflight_data.

    DATA(lv_filename) = '/tmp/sflight_multi_sheet_test.xlsx'.

    DATA(lo_exporter) = NEW zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet( ).
    lo_exporter->export_multi_sheet_sflight(
      it_sflight_data = lt_sflight_data
      iv_filename     = lv_filename
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = cl_abap_file_utilities=>file_exists( lv_filename )
      msg = 'Multi-sheet XLSX file should exist'
    ).

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_filename ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = cl_abap_file_utilities=>file_exists( lv_filename )
      msg = 'Multi-sheet XLSX file should be deleted'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

It uses the `FOR GROUPS OF` expression (ABAP 7.50+) to group the `SFLIGHT` data by airline ID. For each group, a new worksheet is added to the `CL_EHFND_XLSX` document, and the grouped data is written to it. This is a powerful feature for organizing large datasets into a single, structured Excel report.

Instructions: Filter an internal table of `SFLIGHT` data to only include flights with a price greater than 200 and a specific currency (e.g., 'EUR').
hint: Use the `FILTER` operator with a `WHERE` condition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_price_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
        iv_currency    TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_price_currency.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights
                                    WHERE price > iv_min_price
                                    AND currency = iv_currency ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Calculate the total price of all `SFLIGHT` entries for a specific airline using a `REDUCE` expression.
hint: Use the `REDUCE` operator to aggregate values.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_airline
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_airline.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT total = total + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_price.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_itab_reduce=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price_by_airline(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_data
      iv_carrid      = 'AA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '220.00' ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price_by_airline(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_data
      iv_carrid      = 'LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '250.50' ).

    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price_by_airline(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_data
      iv_carrid      = 'XX'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: This example demonstrates the `REDUCE` operator (ABAP 7.50+), which is used for aggregating values from an internal table into a single result. It initializes a `total` variable and then iterates through the `SFLIGHT` entries, summing up the `price` for a specific airline. The `WHERE` clause within `FOR` allows for inline filtering. `REDUCE` provides a functional and highly readable way to perform aggregations, replacing traditional `LOOP AT ... SUM` or manual accumulation loops.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, Functional Programming

Instructions: Transform an internal table of `SFLIGHT` data into a new table containing only the airline ID and connection ID, using a `FOR` expression.

CLASS zcl_itab_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_to_flight_keys
      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.

CLASS zcl_itab_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_to_flight_keys.
    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                 connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implement a method that returns a status text ('Active', 'Inactive', 'Blocked') based on an input status code ('A', 'I', 'B') using a `SWITCH` expression.
hint: Use the `SWITCH` operator for concise conditional assignments.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_status_code
                                WHEN 'A' THEN 'Active'
                                WHEN 'I' THEN 'Inactive'
                                WHEN 'B' THEN 'Blocked'
                                ELSE 'Unknown' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_status) = NEW zcl_switch_expression( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_status_text( 'A' ) exp = 'Active' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_status_text( 'I' ) exp = 'Inactive' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_status_text( 'B' ) exp = 'Blocked' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_status_text( 'X' ) exp = 'Unknown' ).

It allows assigning a value based on different cases of an input expression, similar to a `CASE` statement but as an expression. Instructions: Select data from the `SFLIGHT` table into an internal table using the new inline declaration syntax.
hint: Use `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` for inline declaration of the target internal table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_inline_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_flights_by_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_inline_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Dynamically get the field names and types of a given internal table using RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Use `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` and `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` to access table and component descriptions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_field_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_info) TYPE tt_field_info
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_table_param.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_field_info.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        rt_field_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
                                   ( name = ls_comp-name
                                     type = ls_comp-type_descr_ref->get_ddic_type( )
                                     length = ls_comp-type_descr_ref->length ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_abap_invalid_table_param.
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_abap_invalid_table_param( text = 'Input is not a valid internal table.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_rtti_sflight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_rtti_simple_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_rtti_invalid_input FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 1 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_field_info) = lo_analyzer->get_table_field_info( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field info should not be empty' act = lines( lt_field_info ) exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_field_info ) > 5 ) msg = 'Expected many fields for SFLIGHT' ).

    READ TABLE lt_field_info WITH KEY name = 'CARRID' INTO DATA(ls_carrid_info).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrid_info-type exp = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrid_info-length exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_rtti_simple_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test,
             id TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test.
    DATA: lt_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_field_info) = lo_analyzer->get_table_field_info( lt_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_field_info ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_field_info WITH KEY name = 'ID' INTO DATA(ls_id_info).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_id_info-type exp = 'I' ).
    READ TABLE lt_field_info WITH KEY name = 'TEXT' INTO DATA(ls_text_info).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_text_info-type exp = 'STRING' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_rtti_invalid_input.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    TRY.
        lo_analyzer->get_table_field_info( lv_string ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for non-table input' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_table_param.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: This example demonstrates the use of RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) to dynamically inspect the structure of an internal table. It uses `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` to get a type description for the input table, then casts it to `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` to access table-specific information, and finally to `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` to retrieve the components (fields) of the table line. The `VALUE` constructor expression is used to map the component information into a custom structure. RTTI is a powerful feature for generic programming and meta-programming in ABAP 7.50+.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Type Description, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, VALUE, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_for_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_for_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

                              WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND fldate > sy-datum )
                              ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid fldate = flight-fldate ) ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Passagierkapazität aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine einzelne Summe aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach dem Flugdatum gruppiert und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einem `FOR` Loop.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY ...` in Kombination mit `VALUE #()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_by_date,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count_by_date.
    TYPES tt_flight_count_by_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_by_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_by_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ( fldate = flight-fldate )
                                 ( fldate = flight-fldate
                                   count  = lines( GROUP flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_count_by_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_count_by_date.
    " Für einen aussagekräftigen Test müssten Testdaten in SFLIGHT eingefügt werden.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob die Methode ohne Fehler läuft und eine Tabelle zurückgibt.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_date( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Es sollten Flugzählungen nach Datum gefunden werden.'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR ... GROUP BY ...` Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.50) in Kombination mit `VALUE #()` ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und performante Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt komplexe `LOOP AT ... AT NEW/END OF` Konstrukte und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FOR Operator, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Class Methods

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und die um 10% erhöhten Preise von Flügen nach 'NEW YORK' aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator und den `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ny_flights_with_increased_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_flights_with_increased_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
        ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid = ls_sflight-connid
          price  = ls_sflight-price * '1.1' ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_ny_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ny_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_ny_flights_with_increased_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price > 0 AND lt_result[ 1 ]-price IS NOT INITIAL
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Price should be increased and not initial'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit dem `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge direkt während der Iteration.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, Filter
