Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` für Flüge von 'LH' und 'AA' und kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UNION ALL SELECT ...` in einer Open SQL Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_combined_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).
    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_aa_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_lh_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_aa_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION ALL` in Open SQL ermöglicht das Kombinieren der Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT` Anweisungen. `UNION ALL` behält alle Duplikate bei, während `UNION` (ohne `ALL`) Duplikate entfernt. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für komplexe Datenabfragen direkt auf der Datenbankebene.
keywords: UNION ALL, Open SQL, sflights, Database Query

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei interne Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Strukturen, aber einigen gemeinsamen Feldern, in eine neue Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `( CORRESPONDING #( table1[] ) UNION CORRESPONDING #( table2[] ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data1,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value1 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data1.
    TYPES: tt_data1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data1 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data2,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value2 TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_data2.
    TYPES: tt_data2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data2 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value1 TYPE i,
             value2 TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_combined_data.
    TYPES: tt_combined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE tt_data1
        it_table2 TYPE tt_data2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined) TYPE tt_combined_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_corresponding.
    rt_combined = VALUE #(
      ( CORRESPONDING #( it_table1[] ) )
      UNION
      ( CORRESPONDING #( it_table2[] ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_table1) = VALUE zcl_union_corresponding=>tt_data1(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value1 = 10 )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value1 = 20 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_table2) = VALUE zcl_union_corresponding=>tt_data2(
      ( id = 3 name = 'Item C' value2 = 30 status = 'X' )
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value2 = 15 status = 'Y' ) 
    ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_corresponding( it_table1 = lt_table1 it_table2 = lt_table2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 4 ). 
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 1 ]-value1 exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 3 ]-id exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 3 ]-value2 exp = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 4 ]-status exp = 'Y' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `UNION` ermöglicht das flexible Kombinieren von internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Strukturen. Felder mit gleichem Namen werden automatisch zugewiesen, während fehlende Felder initialisiert werden. Dies vereinfacht die Datenintegration erheblich.
keywords: UNION, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, VALUE, Data Transformation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft für Flüge im Jahr 2000 und 2005 separat und kombinieren Sie diese Ergebnisse in einer einzigen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY ... UNION ALL SELECT ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_agg_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             year   TYPE n LENGTH 4,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES: tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_prices_by_year
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_agg_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_prices_by_year.
    SELECT carrid, '2000' AS year, AVG(price) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20000101' AND '20001231'
      GROUP BY carrid
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, '2005' AS year, AVG(price) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20050101' AND '20051231'
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_prices.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_avg_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_agg_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_prices_by_year( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_avg_prices ) > 0 ).
    DATA(lv_2000_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_2005_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_price).
      IF ls_price-year = '2000'.
        lv_2000_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_price-year = '2005'.
        lv_2005_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_2000_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_2005_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Kombination von aggregierten Daten aus der Datenbank mittels `UNION ALL`. Durch die Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in jeder `SELECT`-Anweisung können separate Aggregationen durchgeführt und anschließend zusammengeführt werden, was eine effiziente Analyse über verschiedene Datensegmente hinweg ermöglicht.
keywords: UNION ALL, Open SQL, GROUP BY, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten von 'LH' und 'UA' aus `sflights` und sortieren Sie die gesamte Ergebnismenge nach Flugdatum und Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UNION ALL SELECT ... ORDER BY ...`. Beachten Sie, dass `ORDER BY` am Ende der gesamten `UNION`-Anweisung steht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_order_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ordered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_order_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ordered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'UA'
      ORDER BY fldate ASC, carrid ASC
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_ordered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_ordered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_order_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_ordered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) >= 2.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate LE lt_flights[ 2 ]-fldate ) ).
      IF lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate = lt_flights[ 2 ]-fldate.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid LE lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_ua_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'UA'.
        lv_ua_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_lh_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_ua_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ORDER BY` Klausel nach einer `UNION`-Anweisung in Open SQL sortiert die gesamte kombinierte Ergebnismenge. Dies ist nützlich, um eine konsistente Reihenfolge über heterogene Datensätze hinweg zu gewährleisten, die aus verschiedenen Quellen stammen.
keywords: UNION ALL, Open SQL, ORDER BY, Sorting, sflights

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Iterationen, die benötigt werden, um eine Zufallszahl größer als 90 zu generieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife und die Klasse `cl_abap_random_int` für Zufallszahlen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_random_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_until_high_random
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_iterations) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_random_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_until_high_random.
    DATA(lv_random_number) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 0.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 100 ).

    WHILE lv_random_number <= 90.
      lv_random_number = lo_random->get_next( ).
      lv_iterations = lv_iterations + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
    rv_iterations = lv_iterations.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_random FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_random.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_random_count( ).
    DATA(lv_iterations) = lo_cut->count_until_high_random( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_iterations > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_iterations < 1000 ). 
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHILE` Schleife ist ideal, wenn die Anzahl der Iterationen nicht im Voraus bekannt ist, sondern von einer dynamischen Bedingung abhängt, die sich während der Schleifenausführung ändert. Hier wird sie verwendet, um eine Aktion zu wiederholen, bis eine bestimmte Zufallszahl generiert wurde.
keywords: WHILE, Loops, Random Numbers, Dynamic Condition

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden Nullen aus einem String, der eine Zahl darstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife und String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_remove_leading_zeros DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_leading_zeros
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_remove_leading_zeros IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_leading_zeros.
    rv_output = iv_input.
    WHILE rv_output IS NOT INITIAL AND rv_output(1) = '0'.
      rv_output = rv_output+1. 
    ENDWHILE.
    IF rv_output IS INITIAL AND iv_input IS NOT INITIAL. 
      rv_output = '0'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_zeros FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_zeros.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_remove_leading_zeros( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_leading_zeros( '00123' ) exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_leading_zeros( '123' ) exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_leading_zeros( '0' ) exp = '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_leading_zeros( '000' ) exp = '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_leading_zeros( '' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_leading_zeros( '0A1' ) exp = 'A1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine `WHILE` Schleife ist hier effektiv, um Zeichen sequenziell von einem String zu entfernen, solange eine bestimmte Bedingung (führende Null) erfüllt ist. Dies ist eine direkte und verständliche Methode für solche String-Manipulationen.
keywords: WHILE, String Processing, Loops, String Manipulation

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie Elemente aus einer Warteschlange (simuliert durch eine interne Tabelle), bis diese leer ist. Fügen Sie während der Verarbeitung neue Elemente hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife und `READ TABLE ... INDEX 1` gefolgt von `DELETE TABLE ... INDEX 1` für die Warteschlangenlogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_queue_processing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_queue_item TYPE string.
    TYPES: tt_queue TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_queue_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_queue TYPE tt_queue
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE tt_queue.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_queue_processing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_current_queue) = it_initial_queue.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.

    WHILE lt_current_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_current_queue INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_item).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DELETE TABLE lt_current_queue INDEX 1.
        APPEND lv_item TO rt_processed_items.
        lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.

        IF lv_item = 'A' AND lv_counter < 5. 
          APPEND 'X' TO lt_current_queue.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_queue FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_queue.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_queue_processing( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_queue) = VALUE zcl_while_queue_processing=>tt_queue( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_queue( it_initial_queue = lt_initial_queue ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_processed ) > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ] exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ] exp = 'B' ).
    DATA(lv_x_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_processed INTO DATA(lv_item).
      IF lv_item = 'X'.
        lv_x_count = lv_x_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_x_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_x_count LE 4 ). 
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den Einsatz einer `WHILE` Schleife zur Implementierung einer Warteschlangenverarbeitung. Die Schleife läuft, solange Elemente in der Warteschlange sind, und ermöglicht das Hinzufügen neuer Elemente während der Laufzeit, was für dynamische Verarbeitungsflüsse unerlässlich ist.
keywords: WHILE, Queue, Internal Tables, Data Structures, Dynamic Processing

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl iterativ mit einer `WHILE` Schleife.
hint: Initialisieren Sie ein Ergebnis auf 1 und multiplizieren Sie es in der Schleife, während der Zähler größer als 1 ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = 1.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 1.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factorial FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factorial_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factorial_negative EXPECT EXCEPTION cx_sy_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factorial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_factorial( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 5 ) exp = 120 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 3 ) exp = 6 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 1 ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factorial_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_factorial( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 0 ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factorial_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_factorial( ).
    lo_cut->calculate_factorial( -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHILE` Schleife ist eine natürliche Wahl für iterative Berechnungen wie die Fakultät, bei der die Schleife fortgesetzt wird, solange eine bestimmte Bedingung (Zahl größer als 1) erfüllt ist. Dies ist eine klassische Anwendung für `WHILE` Schleifen.
keywords: WHILE, Loops, Factorial, Mathematical Operations

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Teilstrings aus einem größeren String, bis keine weiteren Vorkommen gefunden werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife in Kombination mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_replace_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_all_substrings
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_substring    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_replace_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_all_substrings.
    rv_output_string = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_old_string) TYPE string.

    WHILE lv_old_string <> rv_output_string.
      lv_old_string = rv_output_string.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_substring IN rv_output_string WITH ''.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_substrings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_remove_overlapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_substrings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_replace_all( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_all_substrings( iv_input_string = 'ABABCAB' iv_substring = 'AB' ) exp = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_all_substrings( iv_input_string = 'XXXXX' iv_substring = 'X' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_all_substrings( iv_input_string = 'TEST' iv_substring = 'XYZ' ) exp = 'TEST' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_all_substrings( iv_input_string = '' iv_substring = 'A' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_all_substrings( iv_input_string = 'AAA' iv_substring = 'AA' ) exp = 'A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_remove_overlapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_replace_all( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_all_substrings( iv_input_string = 'BANANA' iv_substring = 'ANA' ) exp = 'B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine `WHILE` Schleife, um sicherzustellen, dass alle (auch überlappende oder durch Ersetzung neu entstehende) Vorkommen eines Teilstrings entfernt werden. Die Schleife läuft, solange sich der String durch die Ersetzung ändert, was eine robuste Lösung für komplexe String-Manipulationen bietet.
keywords: WHILE, String Processing, REPLACE, Loops, String Manipulation

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse zweier Filteroperationen auf einer internen Tabelle. Filtern Sie einmal nach 'A' und einmal nach 'B' und führen Sie die Ergebnisse zusammen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `UNION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_filter_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_filtered_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_filter_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_filtered_items.
    DATA(lt_filtered_a) = FILTER #( it_source_table WHERE value = 'A' ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_b) = FILTER #( it_source_table WHERE value = 'B' ).

    rt_combined_items = VALUE #( lt_filtered_a[] UNION lt_filtered_b[] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_filtered FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_filtered.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_filter_tables( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_union_filter_tables=>tt_item(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' )
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' )
      ( id = 4 value = 'A' )
      ( id = 5 value = 'D' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_filtered_items( it_source_table = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 3 ). 
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 1 ]-value exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 2 ]-value exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 3 ]-value exp = 'B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination von zwei gefilterten Ergebnissen einer internen Tabelle mittels `UNION`. Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante und effiziente Filterung, während `UNION` die Ergebnisse ohne Duplikate zusammenführt, was zu sauberem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: UNION, FILTER, Internal Tables, VALUE, Data Filtering

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft für Flüge, die vor dem Jahr 2000 und nach dem Jahr 2010 stattgefunden haben, und kombinieren Sie diese aggregierten Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... COUNT(*) ... GROUP BY ... UNION ALL SELECT ... COUNT(*) ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_count_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             period TYPE string,

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Fibonacci-Sequenz-Berechnung mit einer `WHILE` Schleife, die abbricht, sobald ein Wert einen bestimmten Maximalwert überschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife und zwei Variablen, um die vorherigen Werte zu speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_fibonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_fibonacci_until
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fibonacci_sequence) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_fibonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_fibonacci_until.
    DATA(lv_a) = 0.
    DATA(lv_b) = 1.
    DATA(lv_next) = 0.

    IF iv_max_value < 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_max_value >= 0.
      APPEND lv_a TO rt_fibonacci_sequence.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_max_value >= 1.
      APPEND lv_b TO rt_fibonacci_sequence.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_next <= iv_max_value.
      lv_next = lv_a + lv_b.
      IF lv_next > iv_max_value.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_next TO rt_fibonacci_sequence.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_next.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Fakultät einer gegebenen positiven Ganzzahl iterativ. Verwende dabei eine `WHILE`-Schleife und den `REDUCE`-Operator, um das Ergebnis zu akkumulieren.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` für die Akkumulation und eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um den Zähler herunterzuzählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input must be a non-negative integer.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.
    rv_factorial = REDUCE i( INIT result = 1
                              WHILE lv_current_number > 0
                              NEXT result = result * lv_current_number
                                   lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simuliere eine Datenabfrage, die von einem Cache profitieren könnte (z.B. das Abrufen von Konfigurationsdaten). Erkläre, wie in einem realen SAP-System ein Enterprise Search (ESH) Cache geprüft und genutzt werden würde, um die Performance zu optimieren.
hint: Die Klasse `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK` mit dem Cache-ID `S_ESH_ENG_CACHE` wird für ESH-Cache-Prüfungen verwendet. Implementiere eine einfache Datenabfrage und erwähne die Cache-Prüfung in der Erklärung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cache_simulation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_config_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_config_cache TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cache_simulation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_config_value.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier CL_ESH_CA_CHECK::CHECK_CACHE_ENTRY verwendet werden.
    " Für diese Simulation prüfen wir einen einfachen In-Memory-Cache.
    IF gt_config_cache IS INITIAL.
      " Simulate expensive database/system call
      gt_config_cache = VALUE #( ( 'SETTING_A' ) ( 'SETTING_B' ) ( 'SETTING_C' ) ).
      " In einem realen ESH-Szenario würde hier der Cache mit CL_ESH_CA_CHECK::ADD_CACHE_ENTRY gefüllt.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE gt_config_cache WITH KEY table_line = iv_key TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |Value for { iv_key } from cache (simulated).|.
    ELSE.
      " Simulate expensive database/system call
      rv_value = |Value for { iv_key } from backend (simulated).|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_cache_miss FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cache_hit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cache_simulation( ).
    " First call populates the simulated cache
    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_config_value( 'SETTING_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Value for SETTING_A from cache (simulated).' ).

    " Second call should hit the simulated cache
    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_config_value( 'SETTING_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = 'Value for SETTING_A from cache (simulated).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cache_miss.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cache_simulation( ).
    " This key is not in the initial simulated cache
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_config_value( 'UNKNOWN_SETTING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Value for UNKNOWN_SETTING from backend (simulated).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert eine Caching-Logik für Konfigurationswerte. In einem realen SAP-System würde man für Enterprise Search (ESH) relevante Daten den ESH-Cache nutzen. Die Klasse `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK` bietet Methoden wie `CHECK_CACHE_ENTRY` und `ADD_CACHE_ENTRY` für die Interaktion mit dem Cache. Der Cache-ID `S_ESH_ENG_CACHE` ist ein Standard-Cache für ESH-Engine-Daten. Die Verwendung eines Caches reduziert die Last auf die Datenbank und verbessert die Antwortzeiten bei häufig abgefragten Daten.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zähle die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwende den `FOR ... GROUP BY ...` Ausdruck.
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwende RTTI, um die Komponenten einer Struktur dynamisch auszulesen und deren Werte in einer internen Tabelle zu speichern. Die Struktur soll dabei Flugdaten aus `sflight` enthalten.
hint: Nutze `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_value.
    TYPES tt_component_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lv_value_string TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component_value> TYPE any.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            lv_value_string = |{ <fs_component_value> }|.
            APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_component-name value = lv_value_string ) TO rt_components.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error if is_data is not a structure
        APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Error' value = 'Input is not a structure' ) TO rt_components.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp (z.B. 'SFLIGHT_TAB') erzeugt und mit einigen Dummy-Daten füllt. Verwende dabei `CREATE DATA` und Field-Symbols.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `ASSIGN` mit Field-Symbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT_TAB' or 'SFLIGHT'
      EXPORTING
        eo_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.

    DATA lv_line_type TYPE string.

    IF iv_table_type CS '_TAB'. " Check if it's a table type
      lv_line_type = iv_table_type.
    ELSE.
      lv_line_type = iv_table_type.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA eo_dynamic_table TYPE TABLE OF (lv_line_type).
    ASSIGN eo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not create data for type { iv_table_type }|.
    ENDIF.

    " Fill with dummy data (example for SFLIGHT)
    IF lv_line_type = 'SFLIGHT'.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lo_sflight_line) TYPE sflight.
      ASSIGN lo_sflight_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <ls_dynamic_line>-carrid = 'AZ'.
        <ls_dynamic_line>-connid = '123'.
        <ls_dynamic_line>-fldate = sy-datum.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        <ls_dynamic_line>-carrid = 'BA'.
        <ls_dynamic_line>-connid = '456'.
        <ls_dynamic_line>-fldate = sy-datum + 1.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_next_working_day DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_next_working_day IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ld_current_date) = id_start_date.
    DATA(lv_day_of_week)  = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( ld_current_date ).

    " Start with the next day
    ld_current_date = ld_current_date + 1.

    WHILE cl_abap_date_helper=>is_weekend( ld_current_date ) = abap_true.

    ENDWHILE.

    rd_next_working_day = ld_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entferne alle führenden und abschließenden Leerzeichen sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings. Verwende dabei moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Nutze `CONDENSE` und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit `WHILE` oder `FIND/REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input_string.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces and replace multiple spaces with single space
    rv_cleaned_string = condense( rv_cleaned_string ).

    " Ensure no double spaces remain (CONDENSE might leave some if not used carefully or with specific patterns)
    " A more robust way for multiple spaces is often a loop or regex, but CONDENSE is usually sufficient.
    " For demonstration, let's ensure with a WHILE loop for multiple spaces if CONDENSE isn't enough.
    DATA(lv_old_string) = rv_cleaned_string.
    WHILE rv_cleaned_string CS '  '. " Check for double spaces
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '  ' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ' '.
      IF rv_cleaned_string = lv_old_string. " Prevent infinite loop if '  ' is not found but loop condition is true
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_old_string = rv_cleaned_string.
    ENDWHILE.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Funktion `CONDENSE` (ab ABAP 7.40 mit erweiterter Funktionalität für String-Typen) entfernt führende und abschließende Leerzeichen und ersetzt interne Sequenzen von Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen. Die zusätzliche `WHILE`-Schleife mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` stellt sicher, dass auch bei komplexeren Leerzeichenmustern (die `CONDENSE` manchmal nicht vollständig bereinigt) alle doppelten Leerzeichen eliminiert werden, was zu einem sauberen String führt. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode zur String-Bereinigung.
keywords: String Processing, CONDENSE, REPLACE, WHILE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Implementiere eine Schnittstelle `ZIF_FLIGHT_PROVIDER` mit einer Methode `GET_FLIGHT_DETAILS`. Erstelle eine Klasse `ZCL_SFLIGHT_PROVIDER`, die diese Schnittstelle implementiert und Flugdetails aus der `sflight`-Tabelle abruft. Nutze dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Definiere die Schnittstelle und implementiere sie in der Klasse. Verwende `SELECT SINGLE` mit Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_provider.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
           carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
         END OF ty_flight_detail.

  METHODS get_flight_details
    IMPORTING
      iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rs_flight_detail) TYPE ty_flight_detail
    RAISING
      cx_sy_read_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_provider~get_flight_details.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @rs_flight_detail.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle binären Verknüpfungen für ein gegebenes Geschäftsobjekt und geben Sie die verknüpften Objektschlüssel zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_BINARY_RELATION=>READ_LINKS` und die `VALUE #(...) FOR ...` Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_linked_object,
             objtype TYPE sibftypeid,
             objkey  TYPE sibfkey,
           END OF ty_linked_object.
    TYPES tt_linked_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_linked_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_links_for_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_linked_objects) TYPE tt_linked_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_links_for_object.
    DATA: lt_links TYPE sibflsrel.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
          EXPORTING
            is_object = VALUE sibfbori( objtype = iv_object_type objkey = iv_object_key )
          IMPORTING
            et_links  = lt_links
        ).

        rt_linked_objects = VALUE #( FOR ls_link IN lt_links
                                     ( objtype = ls_link-sbo_type
                                       objkey  = ls_link-sbo_key ) ).
      CATCH cx_bo_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. leere Tabelle zurückgeben
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie mehrere binäre Verknüpfungen zu einem Geschäftsobjekt. Wenn eine Verknüpfung fehlschlägt, sollen alle Verknüpfungen zurückgerollt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Schleife mit `CREATE_LINK` und Transaktionskontrolle (`COMMIT WORK`, `ROLLBACK WORK`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_relation_mass_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_document_info,
             doc_type TYPE sibftypeid,
             doc_key  TYPE sibfkey,
           END OF ty_document_info.
    TYPES tt_document_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_document_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_multiple_links
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfkey
        it_documents   TYPE tt_document_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_relation_mass_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multiple_links.
    DATA: lv_all_successful TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.

    LOOP AT it_documents INTO DATA(ls_document).
      TRY.
          cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
            ip_obj_type = iv_object_type
            ip_obj_key  = iv_object_key
            ip_rel_type = 'ATTA'
            ip_sbo_type = ls_document-doc_type
            ip_sbo_key  = ls_document-doc_key
          ).
        CATCH cx_bo_error.
          lv_all_successful = abap_false.
          " Hier könnte eine detailliertere Fehlerprotokollierung erfolgen
          EXIT. " Schleife abbrechen, da ein Fehler aufgetreten ist
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_all_successful = abap_true.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK. " Alle Änderungen zurückrollen, wenn ein Fehler auftrat
    ENDIF.
    rv_success = lv_all_successful.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den aktuellen Inhalt eines `CL_GUI_ABAPEDIT`-Controls und geben Sie ihn als einzelnen String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_TEXT_AS_R3TABLE` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_get_code DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_abap_code
      IMPORTING
        io_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_code) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_get_code IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_abap_code.
    DATA: lt_code_table TYPE cl_gui_abapedit=>t_text_table.

    TRY.
        io_editor->get_text_as_r3table(
          IMPORTING
            table = lt_code_table
        ).

        " Zusammenführen der Zeilen zu einem einzelnen String mit Zeilenumbrüchen
        rv_code = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ``
          FOR line IN lt_code_table
          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN line ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && line )
        ).

      CATCH cx_gui_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. leeren String zurückgeben
        rv_code = ``.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Strings im ABAP Editor durch einen anderen String.
hint: Lesen Sie den Code, verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` und setzen Sie den Code zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_text_in_editor
      IMPORTING
        io_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit
        iv_old_text TYPE string
        iv_new_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_replacements_made) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_text_in_editor.
    DATA: lt_code_table TYPE cl_gui_abapedit=>t_text_table.
    DATA: lv_replacements TYPE i VALUE 0.

    TRY.
        io_editor->get_text_as_r3table(
          IMPORTING
            table = lt_code_table
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_code_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
          REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_text IN <fs_line> WITH iv_new_text IGNORING CASE.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            lv_replacements = lv_replacements + sy-dbcnt.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        io_editor->set_text_as_r3table(
          EXPORTING
            table = lt_code_table
        ).
        rv_replacements_made = lv_replacements.

      CATCH cx_gui_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        rv_replacements_made = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lo_mock_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_editor.

    DATA(lv_initial_code) = 'DATA: lv_value TYPE i.' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                              'lv_value = 10.' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                              'MESSAGE ''Value is lv_value'' TYPE ''I''.'.

    SPLIT lv_initial_code AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_set_code.
    lo_mock_editor->set_text_as_r3table( table = lt_set_code ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_replacements) = lo_cut->replace_text_in_editor(
      io_editor = lo_mock_editor
      iv_old_text = 'lv_value'
      iv_new_text = 'g_amount'
    ).

Die Verwendung von Field-Symbols (`<fs_line>`) in der Schleife ist effizient, da sie direkte Änderungen an den Zeilen der internen Tabelle ermöglicht, ohne diese kopieren zu müssen. `IGNORING CASE` macht die Ersetzung flexibler.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile an einer bestimmten Position im ABAP Editor ein.
hint: Lesen Sie den Code, manipulieren Sie die interne Tabelle und setzen Sie den Code zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_insert_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_line_into_editor
      IMPORTING
        io_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit
        iv_line_number TYPE i
        iv_new_line_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_insert_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_line_into_editor.
    DATA: lt_code_table TYPE cl_gui_abapedit=>t_text_table.

    TRY.
        io_editor->get_text_as_r3table(
          IMPORTING
            table = lt_code_table
        ).

        " Überprüfen, ob die Zeilennummer gültig ist
        IF iv_line_number > lines( lt_code_table ) + 1 OR iv_line_number < 1.
          " Ungültige Zeilennummer, Fehlerbehandlung
          rv_success = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Neue Zeile einfügen
        INSERT iv_new_line_content INTO TABLE lt_code_table INDEX iv_line_number.

        io_editor->set_text_as_r3table(
          EXPORTING
            table = lt_code_table
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_gui_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_link_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_flight_doc_links
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_doc_ids) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_binary_link_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flight_doc_links.
    DATA(lv_flight_obj_type) = 'Z_SFLIGHT'.
    DATA(lv_flight_obj_key)  = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid }{ iv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    DATA(lo_object_a) = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                            i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                            i_obj_key  = lv_flight_obj_key ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_links) = cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
                            EXPORTING
                              ip_object_a = lo_object_a
                              ip_relation = 'Z_FLIGHT_DOC'
                              ip_direction = cl_binary_relation=>c_direction_a_b
                        ).

        rt_doc_ids = VALUE #( FOR link IN lt_links ( link-object_b->get_object_key( ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_burel_error INTO DATA(lx_burel_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Relationstypen, die für ein bestimmtes Objekt existieren. Nutzen Sie hierfür die dynamischen Fähigkeiten der 'cl_binary_relation' Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'cl_binary_relation=>read_links' ohne Angabe eines Relationstyps und extrahieren Sie die 'relation' Eigenschaft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_link_rel_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_relation_types_for_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_obj_type TYPE string
        iv_obj_key  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_relation_types) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_link_rel_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_relation_types_for_object.
    DATA(lo_object) = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                          i_obj_type = iv_obj_type
                          i_obj_key  = iv_obj_key ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_links) = cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
                            EXPORTING
                              ip_object_a = lo_object
                              ip_direction = cl_binary_relation=>c_direction_a_b
                        ).

        rt_relation_types = VALUE #( FOR link IN lt_links (
                                       COND string( WHEN link-relation IS NOT INITIAL THEN link-relation ELSE '' ) ) ).
        DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_relation_types.

      CATCH cx_burel_error INTO DATA(lx_burel_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_relation_types.
    DATA(lo_create) = NEW zcl_binary_link_create( ).
    DATA(lo_delete) = NEW zcl_binary_link_delete( ).
    DATA(lo_cut)    = NEW zcl_binary_link_rel_types( ).
    DATA(lv_doc_id1) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lv_doc_id2) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_flight_obj_type) = 'Z_SFLIGHT'.
    DATA(lv_flight_obj_key)  = |{ lv_carrid }{ lv_connid }{ lv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    " Setup: Zwei Links mit unterschiedlichen Relationstypen erstellen
    lo_create->create_flight_doc_link(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
      iv_doc_id = lv_doc_id1
    ).
    " Erstellen Sie einen zweiten Link mit einem anderen Relationstyp (simuliert)
    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            ip_object_a = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                              i_obj_key  = lv_flight_obj_key )
            ip_object_b = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = 'Z_ANOTHER_DOC'
                              i_obj_key  = lv_doc_id2 )
            ip_relation = 'Z_FLIGHT_NOTE' " Anderer Relationstyp
        ).
      CATCH cx_burel_error.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lt_relation_types) = lo_cut->get_relation_types_for_object(
      iv_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
      iv_obj_key  = lv_flight_obj_key
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_relation_types ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_relation_types[ 1 ] exp = 'Z_FLIGHT_DOC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_relation_types[ 2 ] exp = 'Z_FLIGHT_NOTE' ).

    " Teardown: Links löschen
    lo_delete->delete_flight_doc_link(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
      iv_doc_id = lv_doc_id1
    ).
    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
          EXPORTING
            ip_object_a = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                              i_obj_key  = lv_flight_obj_key )
            ip_object_b = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = 'Z_ANOTHER_DOC'
                              i_obj_key  = lv_doc_id2 )
            ip_relation = 'Z_FLIGHT_NOTE'
        ).
      CATCH cx_burel_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch das Aufrufen von 'cl_binary_relation=>read_links' ohne Angabe eines 'ip_relation' Parameters werden alle Verknüpfungen für das Objekt zurückgegeben. Anschließend können die 'relation' Attribute extrahiert und mit 'DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES' bereinigt werden, um eine Liste der eindeutigen Relationstypen zu erhalten.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, read_links, dynamic, relation types, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer Nachrichtenliste eine Nachricht mit dynamisch ermitteltem Nachrichtentyp hinzu (z.B. basierend auf einem Schwellenwert).
hint: Verwenden Sie 'add_message' und eine 'CASE'-Anweisung oder 'COND' für den Nachrichtentyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_list_dynamic_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_dynamic_message
      IMPORTING
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list
        iv_value        TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_list_dynamic_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_dynamic_message.
    DATA(lv_msgty) = COND sy-msgty(
      WHEN iv_value > 100 THEN 'E'
      WHEN iv_value > 50  THEN 'W'
      ELSE 'S'
    ).

    io_message_list->add_message(
      i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      i_msgno = '004'
      i_msgty = lv_msgty
      i_msgv1 = |Wert: { iv_value }|
      i_msgv2 = 'Schwellenwert'
    ).
    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_message.
    DATA(lo_msg_list) = cf_reca_message_list=>create( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_list_dynamic_add( ).

    lo_cut->add_dynamic_message( io_message_list = lo_msg_list iv_value = 120 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_msg_list->has_errors( ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_msg_list->get_number_of_messages( ) exp = 1 ).
    lo_msg_list->clear_messages( ).

    lo_cut->add_dynamic_message( io_message_list = lo_msg_list iv_value = 70 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_msg_list->has_warnings( ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_msg_list->get_number_of_messages( ) exp = 1 ).
    lo_msg_list->clear_messages( ).

    lo_cut->add_dynamic_message( io_message_list = lo_msg_list iv_value = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_msg_list->has_errors( ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_msg_list->has_warnings( ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_msg_list->get_number_of_messages( ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode 'add_message' erlaubt das Hinzufügen einer Nachricht mit einem explizit angegebenen Nachrichtentyp. Hier wird 'COND' verwendet, um den Nachrichtentyp basierend auf einem Wert dynamisch zu bestimmen, was zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code führt.
keywords: cf_reca_message_list, add_message, dynamic message type, COND, message handling

CLASS zcl_binary_link_flight_conn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_connecting_flight_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_a TYPE s_carr_id

        iv_fldate_a TYPE s_date
        iv_carrid_b TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid_b TYPE s_conn_id

CLASS zcl_binary_link_flight_conn IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_flight_key_b)  = |{ iv_carrid_b }{ iv_connid_b }{ iv_fldate_b DATE = ISO }|.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            ip_object_a = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                              i_obj_key  = lv_flight_key_a )
            ip_object_b = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                              i_obj_key  = lv_flight_key_b )
            ip_relation = 'Z_CONNECTING_FLIGHT' " Custom relation type
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_burel_error INTO DATA(lx_burel_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lv_fldate2) = sy-datum + 1.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_connecting_flight_link(
      iv_carrid_a = lv_carrid1
      iv_connid_a = lv_connid1
      iv_fldate_a = lv_fldate1
      iv_carrid_b = lv_carrid2
      iv_connid_b = lv_connid2
      iv_fldate_b = lv_fldate2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Teardown: Link löschen (würde eine entsprechende Delete-Methode erfordern)
    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
          EXPORTING
            ip_object_a = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = 'Z_SFLIGHT'
                              i_obj_key  = |{ lv_carrid1 }{ lv_connid1 }{ lv_fldate1 DATE = ISO }| )
            ip_object_b = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = 'Z_SFLIGHT'
                              i_obj_key  = |{ lv_carrid2 }{ lv_connid2 }{ lv_fldate2 DATE = ISO }| )
            ip_relation = 'Z_CONNECTING_FLIGHT'
        ).
      CATCH cx_burel_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Flexibilität von 'cl_binary_relation', um Beziehungen zwischen Objekten desselben Typs zu modellieren. Die Verwendung von String-Templates für die Schlüsselbildung ist eine moderne ABAP-Praxis.

Instructions: Sammeln Sie Nachrichten während einer Schleife über Flugdaten und verwenden Sie 'REDUCE', um eine Zusammenfassung der aufgetretenen Fehlertypen zu erstellen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie 'cf_reca_message_list', 'add_e' und 'REDUCE' mit einer 'GROUP BY' Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_list_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_error_summary,
             msgid TYPE sy-msgid,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_error_summary,
           ty_error_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_error_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_errors_from_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_error_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_list_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_errors_from_flights.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cf_reca_message_list=>create( ).

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-planetype IS INITIAL.
        lo_message_list->add_e(
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          i_msgno = '005'
          i_msgv1 = ls_flight-carrid
          i_msgv2 = ls_flight-connid
          i_msgv3 = 'Flugzeugtyp fehlt'
        ).
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_flight-seatsocc > ls_flight-seatsmax.
        lo_message_list->add_e(
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          i_msgno = '006'
          i_msgv1 = ls_flight-carrid
          i_msgv2 = ls_flight-connid
          i_msgv3 = 'Überbuchung'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_message_list->get_messages( ).

    rt_summary = REDUCE ty_error_summary_tab(
      INIT summary = VALUE ty_error_summary_tab( )
      FOR msg IN lt_all_messages WHERE msgty = 'E'
      GROUP BY msg-msgid AS msg_id
      ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(group_key)
      ( VALUE #( msgid = group_key-msg_id count = count( ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Dokumente, die mit Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft verknüpft sind. Dies erfordert das Lesen von 'sflights' und dann das Abrufen der binären Verknüpfungen für jeden Flug.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'FOR' und 'REDUCE' um die Flugschlüssel zu generieren und dann 'cl_binary_relation=>read_links' in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_link_read_by_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_docs_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_doc_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_link_read_by_carr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_docs_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    DATA(lv_flight_obj_type) = 'Z_SFLIGHT'.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_flight_obj_key) = |{ ls_flight-carrid }{ ls_flight-connid }{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
      DATA(lo_object_a) = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                              i_obj_key  = lv_flight_obj_key ).

      TRY.
          DATA(lt_links) = cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
                              EXPORTING
                                ip_object_a = lo_object_a
                                ip_relation = 'Z_FLIGHT_DOC'
                                ip_direction = cl_binary_relation=>c_direction_a_b
                          ).

          APPEND LINES OF VALUE #( FOR link IN lt_links ( link-object_b->get_object_key( ) ) ) TO rt_all_doc_ids.

        CATCH cx_burel_error INTO DATA(lx_burel_error).
          " Fehlerbehandlung
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_all_doc_ids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_list_group_by_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine bidirektionale Verknüpfung zwischen zwei Flügen, um eine 'Partnerflug'-Beziehung zu modellieren. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Verknüpfung in beide Richtungen gelesen werden kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'cl_binary_relation=>create_link' und stellen Sie sicher, dass der Relationstyp bidirektional ist oder erstellen Sie zwei Links.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_link_bidirectional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_partner_flight_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_a TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid_a TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate_a TYPE s_date
        iv_carrid_b TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid_b TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate_b TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS read_partner_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_partner_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_link_bidirectional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_partner_flight_link.
    DATA(lv_flight_obj_type) = 'Z_SFLIGHT'.
    DATA(lv_flight_key_a)  = |{ iv_carrid_a }{ iv_connid_a }{ iv_fldate_a DATE = ISO }|.
    DATA(lv_flight_key_b)  = |{ iv_carrid_b }{ iv_connid_b }{ iv_fldate_b DATE = ISO }|.

    TRY.
        " Erstellen Sie den Link von A nach B
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            ip_object_a = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                              i_obj_key  = lv_flight_key_a )
            ip_object_b = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                              i_obj_key  = lv_flight_key_b )
            ip_relation = 'Z_PARTNER_FLIGHT' " Custom relation type
        ).
        " Erstellen Sie den Link von B nach A für Bidirektionalität
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            ip_object_a = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                              i_obj_key  = lv_flight_key_b )
            ip_object_b = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                              i_obj_key  = lv_flight_key_a )
            ip_relation = 'Z_PARTNER_FLIGHT'
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_burel_error INTO DATA(lx_burel_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_partner_flights.
    DATA(lv_flight_obj_type) = 'Z_SFLIGHT'.
    DATA(lv_flight_obj_key)  = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid }{ iv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    DATA(lo_object_a) = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                            i_obj_type = lv_flight_obj_type
                            i_obj_key  = lv_flight_obj_key ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_links) = cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
                            EXPORTING
                              ip_object_a = lo_object_a
                              ip_relation = 'Z_PARTNER_FLIGHT'
                              ip_direction = cl_binary_relation=>c_direction_a_b
                        ).

        DATA(lt_partner_keys) = VALUE string_table( FOR link IN lt_links ( link-object_b->get_object_key( ) ) ).

        LOOP AT lt_partner_keys INTO DATA(lv_partner_key).
          DATA(ls_partner_flight) = VALUE sflight(
            carrid = lv_partner_key(2)
            connid = lv_partner_key+2(4)
            fldate = lv_partner_key+6(8) AS sy-datum
          ).
          APPEND ls_partner_flight TO rt_partner_flights.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_burel_error INTO DATA(lx_burel_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_bidirectional_link FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bidirectional_link.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_binary_link_bidirectional( ).
    DATA(lo_delete) = NEW zcl_binary_link_delete( ). " Annahme: Klasse existiert

    DATA(lv_carrid1) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid1) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate1) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_carrid2) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid2) = '0010'.
    DATA(lv_fldate2) = sy-datum + 1.

    " Erstellen der bidirektionalen Verknüpfung
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_partner_flight_link(
      iv_carrid_a = lv_carrid1
      iv_connid_a = lv_connid1
      iv_fldate_a = lv_fldate1
      iv_carrid_b = lv_carrid2
      iv_connid_b = lv_connid2
      iv_fldate_b = lv_fldate2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Lesen der Partnerflüge von Flug A
    DATA(lt_partners_a) = lo_cut->read_partner_flights(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid1
      iv_connid = lv_connid1
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_partners_a ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_partners_a[ 1 ]-carrid exp = lv_carrid2 ).

    " Lesen der Partnerflüge von Flug B
    DATA(lt_partners_b) = lo_cut->read_partner_flights(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid2
      iv_connid = lv_connid2
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_partners_b ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_partners_b[ 1 ]-carrid exp = lv_carrid1 ).

    " Teardown: Links löschen
    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
          EXPORTING
            ip_object_a = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = 'Z_SFLIGHT'
                              i_obj_key  = |{ lv_carrid1 }{ lv_connid1 }{ lv_fldate1 DATE = ISO }| )
            ip_object_b = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = 'Z_SFLIGHT'
                              i_obj_key  = |{ lv_carrid2 }{ lv_connid2 }{ lv_fldate2 DATE = ISO }| )
            ip_relation = 'Z_PARTNER_FLIGHT'
        ).
        cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
          EXPORTING
            ip_object_a = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = 'Z_SFLIGHT'
                              i_obj_key  = |{ lv_carrid2 }{ lv_connid2 }{ lv_fldate2 DATE = ISO }| )
            ip_object_b = cl_burel_object_factory=>create_object(
                              i_obj_type = 'Z_SFLIGHT'
                              i_obj_key  = |{ lv_carrid1 }{ lv_connid1 }{ lv_fldate1 DATE = ISO }| )
            ip_relation = 'Z_PARTNER_FLIGHT'
        ).
      CATCH cx_burel_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um eine bidirektionale Verknüpfung zu erstellen, müssen zwei separate Links in entgegengesetzter Richtung erstellt werden. Die 'read_partner_flights' Methode demonstriert, wie diese Links aus beiden Richtungen gelesen und die Objektschlüssel wieder in die ursprünglichen Flugdaten umgewandelt werden können.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, create_link, read_links, bidirectional, sflight, String Templates

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) basierend auf einer RANGES-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator kann direkt mit einer RANGES-Tabelle verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights

CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic_exclude DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic_exclude IMPLEMENTATION.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'NE' low = iv_exclude2 ) TO lt_exclude_range.

CLASS zcl_rng_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_carriers    TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                                            WHERE carrid IN it_carriers )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, die einen bestimmten Flugdatum-Bereich nicht erfüllen, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit `COND`.

CLASS zcl_del_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_date_range
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_start_date  TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_end_date    TYPE sflight-fldate

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_for_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_date_range.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                   WHERE ( fldate GE iv_start_date AND fldate LE iv_end_date )
                                   ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_date_range FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_date_range.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250115' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250130' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

CLASS zcl_pak_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_package_query) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von einer Struktur in eine andere, wobei nur ausgewählte Felder übernommen und umbenannt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` und `MAPPING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_field1 TYPE string,
             target_field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target,
           tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                         ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING field1 = target_field1
                                                      field2 = target_field2 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Feldzuordnung und -umbenennung, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Werten in einen durch Kommas getrennten String.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Funktion `CONCAT_LINES_OF` oder `REDUCE` mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_list_to_string
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE string_table
        iv_delimiter TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_list_to_string.
    IF iv_delimiter IS INITIAL.
      iv_delimiter = ', '.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR value IN it_values NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN value ELSE s && iv_delimiter && value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Struktur, wobei die Flugzeit in Minuten berechnet und ein Statusfeld basierend auf der Auslastung hinzugefügt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE #()`, `COND` und arithmetischen Ausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_time_min TYPE i,
             occupancy_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext,
           tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_ext) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights.
    rt_sflights_ext = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                LET lv_flight_time = ( ls_sflight-arrtime - ls_sflight-deptime ) / 60
                                    lv_occupancy = COND string(
                                      WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc / ls_sflight-seatsmax > '0.8' THEN 'High'
                                      WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc / ls_sflight-seatsmax > '0.5' THEN 'Medium'
                                      ELSE 'Low' )
                                IN
                                ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                  connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                  fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                  flight_time_min = lv_flight_time,
                                  occupancy_status = lv_occupancy ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine Tabelle von Integern, wobei ungültige Einträge übersprungen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `FILTER` und `TRY ... CATCH ...` für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_to_int_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_strings_to_integers
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_integers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_to_int_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_strings_to_integers.
    rt_integers = VALUE #( FOR lv_string IN it_strings
                           LET lv_int = 0 IN
                           ( TRY. lv_int = lv_string. CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error. CONTINUE. ENDTRY.
                             lv_int ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen in eine andere, indem Sie Felder dynamisch basierend auf einer Mapping-Tabelle zuordnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #()` mit `BASE` und einer dynamischen Feldzuordnung (obwohl `MAPPING` statisch ist, kann die Logik drumherum dynamisch sein). Für dieses Beispiel wird eine statische `MAPPING` verwendet, da dynamisches Mapping komplexer ist und über die reine `CONVERT` Syntax hinausgeht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source_data,
           tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             key_id TYPE i,
             item_name TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target_data,
           tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                         ( CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( ) ls_source MAPPING id = key_id
                                                                  name = item_name
                                                                  value = amount ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-key_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_name exp = 'Product A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-amount exp = '100.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-key_id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-item_name exp = 'Product B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-amount exp = '200.75' ).

explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING #()`-Anweisung mit `MAPPING` ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Transformation von Strukturen und internen Tabellen. Es ermöglicht eine explizite und lesbare Zuordnung von Feldern mit unterschiedlichen Namen, was besonders bei der Integration von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen nützlich ist. `BASE ( )` stellt sicher, dass die Zielstruktur initialisiert wird, bevor die gemappten Felder zugewiesen werden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Bildschirm mit einem horizontal geteilten Bereich, in dem zwei separate Custom Controls platziert werden können.

CLASS zcl_splitter_h_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
