Instructions: Konfigurieren Sie einen Splitter so, dass eine der Zeilen/Spalten eine feste Größe hat und die andere den verbleibenden Platz einnimmt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_row_mode` oder `set_column_mode` mit `cl_gui_splitter_container=>mode_absolute` und `cl_gui_splitter_container=>mode_proportional`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_dynamic_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_dynamic_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).

    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      EXPORTING
        parent  = lo_parent_container
        rows    = 2
        columns = 1
    ).
    lo_splitter->set_orientation( cl_gui_splitter_container=>orientation_horizontal ).

    " Set first row to fixed height of 100 pixels
    lo_splitter->set_row_mode(
      EXPORTING
        row    = 1
        mode   = cl_gui_splitter_container=>mode_absolute
        value  = 100 " 100 pixels
    ).
    " Second row will take remaining space (default proportional)
    lo_splitter->set_row_mode(
      EXPORTING
        row    = 2
        mode   = cl_gui_splitter_container=>mode_proportional
        value  = 100 " 100% of remaining space
    ).

    out->write( |Splitter with dynamic sizing configured. First row fixed to 100px, second row proportional.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Reaktion auf das Ereignis, wenn der Benutzer einen Splitter verschiebt.
hint: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `SPLITTER_MOVED`-Ereignis des Splitters.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_output TYPE REF TO if_oo_adt_classrun_out.
    METHODS handle_splitter_moved FOR EVENT splitter_moved OF cl_gui_splitter_container
      IMPORTING
        row
        column
        new_row_height
        new_column_width.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    mo_output = out.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent  = lo_parent_container
        rows    = 2
        columns = 1.
    mo_splitter->set_orientation( cl_gui_splitter_container=>orientation_horizontal ).

    SET HANDLER handle_splitter_moved FOR mo_splitter.

    mo_output->write( |Splitter created. Try moving the splitter bar. Check the console for event output.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_splitter_moved.
    mo_output->write( |Splitter moved: Row { row }, Column { column }, New Height: { new_row_height }, New Width: { new_column_width }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    DATA(lo_parent_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW cl_gui_splitter_container(
      EXPORTING
        parent  = lo_parent_container
        rows    = 2
        columns = 1
    ).

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_splitter_event_handler( ).
    " Attempt to set handler. If no exception, it's considered registered.
    " Actual event firing requires UI interaction, not possible in unit test.
    TRY.
        SET HANDLER lo_handler->handle_splitter_moved FOR lo_splitter.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'Event handler registered without error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Failed to register event handler' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die ereignisgesteuerte Programmierung mit `SET HANDLER` ermöglicht es, auf Benutzerinteraktionen wie das Verschieben eines Splitters zu reagieren. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept für interaktive und dynamische ABAP-GUI-Anwendungen.
keywords: cl_gui_splitter_container, UI, Events, SPLITTER_MOVED, Event Handling

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum ein gültiges Datum ist und ob es in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_reca_date=>create_checked` und `IS_FUTURE_DATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_future_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_future_date.
    DATA lo_date TYPE REF TO cl_reca_date.
    TRY.
        lo_date = cl_reca_date=>create_checked( iv_date ).
        IF lo_date->is_future_date( ) = abap_true.
          rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_reca_date_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_validation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = cl_reca_date=>create( lv_today )->add_days( 1 )->get_date( ).
    DATA(lv_yesterday) = cl_reca_date=>create( lv_today )->add_days( -1 )->get_date( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_future_date( lv_tomorrow ) exp = abap_true ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_valid_future_date( lv_yesterday ) exp = abap_false ).

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_date_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lo_birth_date) = cl_reca_date=>create( iv_birth_date ).
    DATA(lo_current_date) = cl_reca_date=>create( iv_current_date ).

    rv_age = lo_current_date->get_year( ) - lo_birth_date->get_year( ).

    IF lo_current_date->get_month( ) < lo_birth_date->get_month( ) OR
       ( lo_current_date->get_month( ) = lo_birth_date->get_month( ) AND
         lo_current_date->get_day( ) < lo_birth_date->get_day( ) ).
      rv_age = rv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.

    IF rv_age < 0.
      rv_age = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Wochentag (z.B. Montag, Dienstag) für ein gegebenes Datum.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lo_date) = cl_reca_date=>create( iv_date ).
    DATA(lv_weekday_num) = lo_date->get_weekday( ). " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF lc_weekdays,
                 monday    TYPE string VALUE 'Montag',
                 tuesday   TYPE string VALUE 'Dienstag',
                 wednesday TYPE string VALUE 'Mittwoch',
                 thursday  TYPE string VALUE 'Donnerstag',
                 friday    TYPE string VALUE 'Freitag',
                 saturday  TYPE string VALUE 'Samstag',
                 sunday    TYPE string VALUE 'Sonntag',
               END OF lc_weekdays.

    CASE lv_weekday_num.
      WHEN 1. rv_weekday_name = lc_weekdays-monday.
      WHEN 2. rv_weekday_name = lc_weekdays-tuesday.
      WHEN 3. rv_weekday_name = lc_weekdays-wednesday.
      WHEN 4. rv_weekday_name = lc_weekdays-thursday.
      WHEN 5. rv_weekday_name = lc_weekdays-friday.
      WHEN 6. rv_weekday_name = lc_weekdays-saturday.
      WHEN 7. rv_weekday_name = lc_weekdays-sunday.
      WHEN OTHERS. rv_weekday_name = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_cityfrom TYPE s_city
        iv_cityto   TYPE s_city
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_insert_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight.
    " Initialisiere eine leere Tabelle
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight( ).

    " Füge einen neuen Eintrag mit dem VALUE Operator ein
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                    connid = iv_connid
                    cityfrom = iv_cityfrom
                    cityto = iv_cityto )
           INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    rt_sflights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die Einträge aus einer bestehenden Tabelle enthält, aber mit zusätzlichen Feldern, die mit dem FOR Operator berechnet werden, und füge diese dann in eine andere Tabelle ein.
hint: Nutze `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE @( FOR ... )` oder erstelle die Tabelle mit FOR und füge sie dann ein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_base,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_base.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_base TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_base WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             key    TYPE string, " Zusätzliches Feld
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_in TYPE tt_sflight_base
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_out) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    " Erstelle eine neue Tabelle mit dem FOR-Operator
    DATA(lt_processed_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_ext(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_in
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid
          key    = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }| ) ).

    " Füge die verarbeiteten Zeilen in die Ausgabetabelle ein
    INSERT LINES OF lt_processed_flights INTO TABLE rt_flights_out.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_for( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_insert_for=>tt_sflight_base(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Zeilen eingefügt werden.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-key
      exp = 'LH-0400'
      msg = 'Der Schlüssel der ersten Zeile ist falsch.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ]-key
      exp = 'AA-0001'
      msg = 'Der Schlüssel der zweiten Zeile ist falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. In Kombination mit INSERT LINES OF wird eine effiziente und lesbare Methode zum Füllen von Tabellen mit transformierten Daten geboten.
keywords: INSERT, FOR, Internal Table, String Templates, Modern ABAP

    DELETE FROM zdemo_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_single( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_single_flight(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '0400'
      iv_fldate = sy-datum ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

      msg = 'Einfügen sollte erfolgreich sein.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Der eingefügte Datensatz sollte gefunden werden.' ).

    lo_cut->insert_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = lv_date ).

    " Zweiter Insert mit gleichen Schlüsseln sollte fehlschlagen
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_single_flight(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '0400'
      iv_fldate = lv_date ).

      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Einfügen eines Duplikats sollte fehlschlagen.' ).

CLASS zcl_insert_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field4 TYPE string, " Feld, das in Source nicht existiert
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING

Instructions: Füge einen Datensatz nur dann in eine interne Tabelle ein, wenn ein Datensatz mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel noch nicht existiert.
hint: Kombiniere `INSERT` mit einer `IF NOT line_exists(...)` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS add_unique_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_unique_flight.
    rv_inserted = abap_false.
    IF NOT line_exists( ct_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      INSERT VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                      connid = iv_connid
                      fldate = iv_fldate )
             INTO TABLE ct_sflights.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_inserted = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_unique_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_flight FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_insert_cond=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) ).

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->add_unique_flight(
      iv_carrid = 'AA'
      iv_connid = '0001'
      iv_fldate = sy-datum
      CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_inserted
      msg = 'Neuer Flug sollte eingefügt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Tabelle sollte zwei Zeilen enthalten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_insert_cond=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = lv_date ) ).

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->add_unique_flight(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_connid = '0400'
      iv_fldate = lv_date
      CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_inserted
      msg = 'Duplikat sollte nicht eingefügt werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Tabelle sollte weiterhin eine Zeile enthalten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit `INSERT` ermöglicht eine präzise Kontrolle über das Einfügen von Datensätzen, um Duplikate zu vermeiden. CLASS zcl_insert_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Füge Datensätze in eine Datenbanktabelle ein, wobei Duplikate ignoriert werden sollen, ohne dass die Operation fehlschlägt.
hint: Nutze `INSERT ... FROM TABLE @(itab) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS`.
solution:
" Annahme: Eine transparente Tabelle ZDEMO_FLIGHTS existiert mit Feldern CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE.
" CREATE TABLE ZDEMO_FLIGHTS ( CARRID S_CARR_ID, CONNID S_CONN_ID, FLDATE S_DATE ) PRIMARY KEY ( CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE ).

CLASS zcl_db_insert_accept DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_with_duplicate_handling
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_accept IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_with_duplicate_handling.
    INSERT zdemo_flights FROM TABLE @it_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_no_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_with_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DELETE FROM zdemo_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM zdemo_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_no_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_accept( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_to_insert) = VALUE zcl_db_insert_accept=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ) ).

    DATA(lv_inserted_count) = lo_cut->insert_with_duplicate_handling( lt_flights_to_insert ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_inserted_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Datensätze eingefügt werden.' ).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zdemo_flights INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Datenbank sollte zwei Datensätze enthalten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_with_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_accept( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_db_insert_accept=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = lv_date ) ).
    lo_cut->insert_with_duplicate_handling( lt_initial_flights ).

    DATA(lt_flights_with_duplicate) = VALUE zcl_db_insert_accept=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = lv_date ) " Duplikat
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0007' fldate = lv_date ) ).

    DATA(lv_inserted_count) = lo_cut->insert_with_duplicate_handling( lt_flights_with_duplicate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_inserted_count
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Es sollte nur ein neuer Datensatz eingefügt werden.' ).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zdemo_flights INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Datenbank sollte insgesamt zwei Datensätze enthalten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Erweiterung `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` bei der `INSERT`-Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen ist eine moderne und robuste Methode, um Fehler bei Duplikaten zu vermeiden. Statt eines Laufzeitfehlers oder eines SY-SUBRC <> 0 für die gesamte Operation, werden nur die Duplikate ignoriert und SY-SUBRC bleibt 0, während SY-DBCNT die Anzahl der tatsächlich eingefügten Zeilen zurückgibt.
keywords: INSERT, Database, Open SQL, Duplicates, ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS, Modern ABAP

solution:
" Annahme: Eine transparente Tabelle ZDEMO_FLIGHTS existiert mit Feldern CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE.
" CREATE TABLE ZDEMO_FLIGHTS ( CARRID S_CARR_ID, CONNID S_CONN_ID, FLDATE S_DATE ) PRIMARY KEY ( CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE ).

CLASS zcl_db_insert_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_from_select.
    " Füge Flüge von SFLIGHTS in ZDEMO_FLIGHTS ein, die einem bestimmten CARRID entsprechen
    INSERT zdemo_flights FROM (
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_sflights_count).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

FROM (SELECT ...)`-Syntax ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Daten direkt von einer Datenbanktabelle in eine andere zu kopieren, ohne den Umweg über eine interne Tabelle im Applikationsserver. Dies reduziert den Datenverkehr und verbessert die Performance erheblich, da die Operation vollständig auf der Datenbankebene ausgeführt wird.
keywords: INSERT, SELECT, Database, Open SQL, Performance, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String und extrahieren Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Knotens (z.B. den Textinhalt des Knotens 'Item').
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_XML_DOCUMENT` zum Parsen und `GET_PROPERTY` oder `GET_TEXT` für den Knotenwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parse_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_item_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_item_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_item_value.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_xml_node) = lo_xml_document->get_element_by_tag_name( 'Item' ).
        IF lo_xml_node IS BOUND.
          rv_item_value = lo_xml_node->get_text( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_item_value = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Anschließend wird mit `get_element_by_tag_name` direkt auf den gewünschten Knoten zugegriffen und dessen Textinhalt mit `get_text` extrahiert. Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches XML-Dokument mit einem Root-Element und mehreren Kind-Elementen programmatisch.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_XML_DOCUMENT` und Methoden wie `CREATE_ELEMENT`, `APPEND_CHILD` und `SET_TEXT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_generate_doc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_simple_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_root_name TYPE string
        it_items     TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_generate_doc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_simple_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( iv_root_name ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_items INTO DATA(lv_item_text).
      DATA(lo_item_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Item' ).
      lo_item_node->set_text( lv_item_text ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_item_node ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xml_document->render_xstring( ).
    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_xml FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_generate_doc( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected_xml_part) = `<Root><Item>Apple</Item><Item>Banana</Item></Root>`.
    DATA(lv_result_xml) = lo_cut->generate_simple_xml( iv_root_name = 'Root' it_items = lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = lv_expected_xml_part in = lv_result_xml msg = 'Generated XML should contain expected structure' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_generate_doc( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_xml_part) = `<Root></Root>`.
    DATA(lv_result_xml) = lo_cut->generate_simple_xml( iv_root_name = 'Root' it_items = lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = lv_expected_xml_part in = lv_result_xml msg = 'Generated XML should be valid even with empty items' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung eines XML-Dokuments mit `CL_XML_DOCUMENT`. Es wird ein Root-Element erstellt und Kind-Elemente hinzugefügt, deren Textinhalte gesetzt werden. Die `render_xstring`-Methode serialisiert das Dokument in eine `XSTRING`, die dann in einen `STRING` konvertiert wird. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der internen Tabelle und Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.
keywords: XML, CL_XML_DOCUMENT, Generation, CREATE_ELEMENT, APPEND_CHILD, SET_TEXT, XSTRING, STRING_TABLE

CLASS zcl_string_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS convert_string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string    TYPE string
        iv_codepage  TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT 'UTF-8'

        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_string_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_codepage

    TRY.
        lo_conv->convert(
          EXPORTING
            data   = iv_string
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_conv_ce_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. leere XSTRING zurückgeben oder Fehler loggen
        CLEAR rv_xstring.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie ein XML-Dokument mithilfe einer eingebetteten XSLT-Transformation. Das XSLT soll ein einfaches XML in ein anderes Format umwandeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit `ID` für die XSLT-ID und `SOURCE`/`RESULT` für die XML-Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_xml TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_transformed_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xslt_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_xml.
    DATA: lv_xslt_id TYPE string VALUE 'Z_SIMPLE_XSLT'. " XSLT-Programmname
    DATA: lv_source_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lv_result_xstring TYPE xstring.

    lv_source_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_source_xml ).

    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION (lv_xslt_id)
          SOURCE XML lv_source_xstring
          RESULT XML lv_result_xstring.

        rv_transformed_xml = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_result_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_xslt_exception INTO DATA(lx_xslt_error).
        rv_transformed_xml = |XSLT Error: { lx_xslt_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        rv_transformed_xml = |Dynamic Call Error: { lx_dyn_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" HINWEIS: Für dieses Beispiel muss ein XSLT-Programm 'Z_SIMPLE_XSLT' im System existieren.
" Beispielinhalt für Z_SIMPLE_XSLT:
" <xsl:transform version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
"   <xsl:output method="xml" indent="yes"/>
"   <xsl:template match="/Input">
"     <Output>
"       <xsl:value-of select="Data"/>
"     </Output>
"   </xsl:template>
" </xsl:transform>

Instructions: Validieren Sie ein XML-Dokument gegen ein XML-Schema (XSD), das als String vorliegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_XML_SCHEMA` zum Laden des Schemas und `VALIDATE` zur Prüfung des XML-Dokuments.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_schema_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_xml_with_xsd
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xsd_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_schema_validate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_xml_with_xsd.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_xml_schema   TYPE REF TO cl_xml_schema.

    TRY.
        " XML-Dokument parsen
        lo_xml_document = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).

        " XML-Schema laden
        lo_xml_schema = NEW cl_xml_schema( ).
        lo_xml_schema->load_xsd_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xsd_string ) ).

        " Validierung durchführen
        lo_xml_schema->validate( lo_xml_document ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        " XML-Parsing-Fehler
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_xml_schema_error INTO DATA(lx_schema_error).
        " Schema-Fehler (z.B. ungültiges XSD oder Validierungsfehler)
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        " Allgemeine Fehler
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Binärdatei vom Applikationsserver in eine `XSTRING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Funktionsbausteine `ARCHIVFILE_SERVER_TO_CLIENT` oder `SCMS_XSTRING_TO_BINARY` in Kombination mit `OPEN DATASET` und `READ DATASET` für den Applikationsserver.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_read_app_server DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_binary_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_file_content) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_read_app_server IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_binary_file.
    DATA: lv_file_size TYPE i,
          lv_offset    TYPE i VALUE 0.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      GET DATASET iv_file_path POSITION lv_file_size.
      IF lv_file_size > 0.
        " Dynamische Zuweisung für XSTRING
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_xstring> TYPE xstring.
        CREATE DATA rv_file_content TYPE xstring.
        ASSIGN rv_file_content TO <fs_xstring>.

        READ DATASET iv_file_path INTO <fs_xstring> MAXIMUM LENGTH lv_file_size.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          CLEAR rv_file_content.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit komplexen Strukturen in ein XML-Dokument und deserialisieren Sie es zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` mit der Standardtransformation `ID` für die Serialisierung/Deserialisierung von ABAP-Daten in/aus XML.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_itab_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES: ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_flights_to_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS deserialize_xml_to_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_itab_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights_to_xml.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE flights = it_flights
          RESULT XML lv_xstring.
        rv_xml_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lv_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_xslt_exception INTO DATA(lx_xslt_error).
        rv_xml_string = |Serialization Error: { lx_xslt_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_xml_to_flights.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    lv_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ).
    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE XML lv_xstring
          RESULT flights = rt_flights.
      CATCH cx_xslt_exception INTO DATA(lx_xslt_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        CLEAR rt_flights.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Parsen eines syntaktisch ungültigen XML-Strings mit `CL_XML_DOCUMENT`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_handle_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_handle_error.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_xml_string ) ).
        rv_error_message = 'XML successfully parsed.'.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        rv_error_message = |XML Parse Error: { lx_parse_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        rv_error_message = |General Error: { lx_general_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine `XSTRING` in eine interne Tabelle von `RAW` (binäre Zeilen fester Länge).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife mit `DO...VARYING` oder `SPLIT` für `XSTRING` in `RAW`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xstring_to_raw_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_s_raw_line TYPE raw255.
    TYPES: ty_t_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_raw_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_xstring_to_raw_itab
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_line_len TYPE i DEFAULT 255
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_raw_data) TYPE ty_t_raw_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xstring_to_raw_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_raw_itab.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_length TYPE i.

    lv_length = xstrlen( iv_xstring ).

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_length.
      DATA(lv_current_len) = COND #( WHEN ( lv_length - lv_offset ) < iv_line_len THEN ( lv_length - lv_offset ) ELSE iv_line_len ).
      APPEND iv_xstring+lv_offset(lv_current_len) TO rt_raw_data.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_current_len.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_amount) TYPE sflight-payments VALUE '123.45'.
    DATA(lv_expected_int) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 0 VALUE '123'.
    DATA(lv_actual_int) = lo_cut->convert_currency_to_dec( lv_amount ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_int,
      exp = lv_expected_int,
      msg = 'Currency to integer conversion failed.'

    ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV` Operator ist auch für die Konvertierung zwischen numerischen Typen mit unterschiedlichen Dezimalstellen sehr nützlich. Durch die Angabe des Zieltyps (hier `p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 0`) oder die Verwendung von `CONV #` (Target Type Inference) kann ABAP die Konvertierung und ggf. Rundung automatisch vornehmen, was den Code kürzer und sicherer macht.
keywords: CONV, Currency, Type Conversion, Decimal, Numeric, Rounding, Target Type Inference

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Wert eines generischen Feldsymbols (`FIELD-SYMBOL TYPE ANY`) in einen spezifischen Typ (z.B. `string`).
hint: `CONV` kann auch mit Feldsymbolen verwendet werden, um deren Inhalt in einen bestimmten Typ zu konvertieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_fs_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_field_symbol_to_string
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_fs_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_field_symbol_to_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_any>.

    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_string_value = CONV string( <fs_any> ).
    ELSE.
      rv_string_value = 'Field symbol not assigned'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fs_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_fs_to_string( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = 'Hello World'.

    DATA(lv_actual_string) = lo_cut->convert_field_symbol_to_string( lr_data ).

    ).

explanation: Der `CONV` Operator ist flexibel genug, um auch mit Feldsymbolen zu arbeiten. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Szenarien der dynamischen Programmierung, wo der genaue Typ eines Wertes zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist. `CONV` ermöglicht eine sichere und typspezifische Konvertierung des Inhalts eines generischen Feldsymbols in den gewünschten Zieltyp.
keywords: CONV, Field Symbol, Dynamic Programming, Type Conversion, ANY

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von zwei verschiedenen Fluggesellschaften (`LH` und `AA`) aus `sflights` in einer einzigen internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `UNION ALL`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UNION ALL SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_union_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_union,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_union.
    TYPES tt_flight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_union_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_union_flights) TYPE tt_flight_union.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_union_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_union_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_union_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_union_all( ).
    DATA(lt_union_flights) = lo_cut->get_union_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_union_flights,
      msg = 'Internal table should not be initial.',
      exp = abap_false
    ).

    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_union_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_count_lh,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Should contain flights for LH.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_count_aa,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Should contain flights for AA.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UNION ALL` Klausel in Open SQL ermöglicht das Kombinieren der Ergebnismengen mehrerer `SELECT`-Anweisungen in einem einzigen Datenbankzugriff. Dies ist effizienter als separate `SELECT`-Anweisungen und das anschließende Zusammenführen in ABAP. Die Ergebnisse werden direkt mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` in eine interne Tabelle geladen, was den Code schlank und performant hält.
keywords: INTO TABLE, SELECT, UNION ALL, Internal Tables, Open SQL, Combining Data

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights` in eine interne Tabelle, deren Fluggesellschaften in der Tabelle `scarr` als 'Lufthansa' oder 'American Airlines' registriert sind. Verwenden Sie eine Subquery.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...) FROM ... WHERE carrid IN ( SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.

CLASS zcl_itab_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_name.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid IN (
        SELECT carrid FROM scarr WHERE carrname = 'Lufthansa' OR carrname = 'American Airlines'
      ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_subquery_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_subquery_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_subquery( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier_name( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_flights,
      msg = 'Internal table should not be initial.',
      exp = abap_false
    ).

    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_aa_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_found = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' ),
        msg = 'Only flights from Lufthansa or American Airlines should be present.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_lh_found,
      msg = 'Lufthansa flights should be found.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_aa_found,
      msg = 'American Airlines flights should be found.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Subqueries in der `WHERE`-Klausel von Open SQL-Statements ermöglichen komplexe Filterbedingungen, die auf den Ergebnissen einer anderen `SELECT`-Anweisung basieren. keywords: INTO TABLE, SELECT, Subquery, WHERE IN, Internal Tables, Open SQL, Filtering

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (price) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode (carrid) unter Verwendung eines funktionalen Reduktionsausdrucks. Nutzen Sie die minimale Code-Menge.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR  ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining) in einer Klasse, die einfache mathematische Operationen durchführt, um den Code kompakter und flüssiger zu gestalten.
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden `ME` zurück, um weitere Aufrufe zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_math_chain.
    METHODS subtract IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_math_chain.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_math_chain.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_result = mv_result - iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_chain( 10 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_math->add( 5 )->subtract( 2 )->multiply( 3 )->get_result( ).

    " (10 + 5 - 2) * 3 = 13 * 3 = 39
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 39 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile aneinandergereiht werden. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent API, MINIMUM

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (sflight) nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und Flugnummer (connid) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE` und `GROUP REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_group_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_sflight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_sflight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier_connid.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight_entry) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight_entry-carrid
                                                              connid = ls_flight_entry-connid
                                                              group_size = GROUP SIZE
                                                              avg_price = GROUP REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                                                                           FOR  <fs_member> IN GROUP
                                                                                           NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-price ) )
                                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_avg_price) = COND #( WHEN ls_group_key-group_size > 0 THEN ls_group_key-avg_price / ls_group_key-group_size ELSE 0.00 ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_group_result(
        carrid       = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid       = ls_group_key-connid
        flight_count = ls_group_key-group_size
        avg_price    = lv_avg_price
      ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier_connid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_grouped_data ) > 0 ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob eine bestimmte Gruppe existiert und plausible Werte hat
    DATA(ls_test_group) = VALUE zcl_group_by_sflight=>ty_sflight_group_result(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped_data INTO ls_test_group WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_test_group-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_test_group-avg_price > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_empty_table.
    " Für diesen Test müsste die SFLIGHT-Tabelle leer sein oder ein Mock verwendet werden.
    " Da SFLIGHT eine Standardtabelle ist, wird hier nur die Funktionalität bei vorhandenen Daten getestet.
    " Ein leerer Fall würde eine leere Ergebnistabelle liefern.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_sflight( ).
    " Um einen leeren Fall zu simulieren, müsste man die SELECT-Anweisung mocken oder eine leere Tabelle übergeben.
    " Hier wird angenommen, dass die Methode mit einer leeren SFLIGHT-Tabelle eine leere Ergebnistabelle zurückgibt.
    " Da SFLIGHT selten leer ist, ist dieser Test eher konzeptionell.
    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier_connid( ).
    " Wenn SFLIGHT leer wäre, wäre lines(lt_grouped_data) = 0.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_grouped_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Syntax, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Es ersetzt komplexe Schleifen und `AT NEW`/`AT END` Konstrukte und macht den Code deutlich deklarativer und effizienter.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Advanced

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (sflight) und entfernen Sie alle Duplikate basierend auf Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und Flugnummer (connid), wobei der erste Eintrag beibehalten wird. Nutzen Sie die minimale Code-Menge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` nach dem Sortieren oder `NEW` mit `FOR` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_remove_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_duplicate_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_remove_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicate_flights.
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = it_sflight.
    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_sorted_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
    rt_unique_flights = lt_sorted_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_remove_duplicates=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight LIKE LINE OF lt_sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '120.00' ). " Duplikat
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_remove_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = lo_cut->remove_duplicate_flights( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20251201' ). " Erster Eintrag bleibt
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_unique_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_remove_duplicates=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight LIKE LINE OF lt_sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_remove_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = lo_cut->remove_duplicate_flights( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_flights ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_remove_duplicates=>tt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_remove_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = lo_cut->remove_duplicate_flights( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_unique_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente und moderne Anweisung, um Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, nachdem diese nach den relevanten Schlüsselfeldern sortiert wurde. Dies ist eine minimale und performante Lösung im Vergleich zu manuellen Schleifen mit Hash-Tabellen oder ähnlichem.
keywords: Internal Tables, Duplikate, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Sortierung, MINIMUM

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die dynamisch Instanzen verschiedener Klassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt. Nutzen Sie dabei den `NEW`-Operator mit Typ-Referenzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE` oder den `NEW`-Operator mit einer Typ-Referenz.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS zif_product~get_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS zif_product~get_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    DATA: lv_class_name TYPE clike.

    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_PRODUCT_A'.
      WHEN 'B'.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_PRODUCT_B'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Produkttyp: { iv_product_type }|.
    ENDCASE.

    ro_product = NEW #( (lv_class_name) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_product_a FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_create_unknown_product RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_product_a.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_product_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_product) = lo_factory->create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Product A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_product_b.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_product_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_product) = lo_factory->create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Product B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_unknown_product.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_product_factory( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = lo_factory->create_product( 'C' ) EXPECTED_CLASS = cx_sy_create_object_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung des `NEW`-Operators mit einer dynamischen Typ-Referenz (Klassenname als String in Klammern) ist die modernste und flexibelste Art, Objekte dynamisch in ABAP zu instanziieren. Dies ist ein Schlüsselkonzept für Design-Patterns wie Factory und ermöglicht eine entkoppelte und erweiterbare Architektur.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory, Dynamic Object Creation, NEW Operator, Advanced

Instructions: Fügen Sie Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur die Felder übernommen werden, die in beiden Tabellenstrukturen vorhanden sind. Nutzen Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit Tabellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit `EXPANDING TABLES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corresponding_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             extra  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corresponding_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING it_source_data TO rt_target_data EXPANDING TABLES.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transfer_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_source FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transfer_data.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_move_corresponding_tables=>tt_source_data,
          ls_source LIKE LINE OF lt_source.

    ls_source = VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Item 1' value = '10.50' extra = 'Info A' ).
    APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.
    ls_source = VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Item 2' value = '20.75' extra = 'Info B' ).
    APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_corresponding_tables( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transfer_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Item 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = '10.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-status ). " Feld 'extra' wird nicht übernommen, 'status' bleibt initial
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_source.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_move_corresponding_tables=>tt_source_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_corresponding_tables( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transfer_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit dem Zusatz `EXPANDING TABLES` ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Methode, um Daten zwischen internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Strukturen zu übertragen. Es kopiert automatisch gleichnamige Felder und ist wesentlich kompakter als eine explizite Schleife mit `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` für jede Zeile.
keywords: Internal Tables, MOVE-CORRESPONDING, EXPANDING TABLES, Datenübertragung, MINIMUM

Instructions: Prüfen Sie den Status eines Enterprise Search Caches (konzeptionell, da `cl_esh_ca_check` eine interne Klasse ist) und geben Sie eine Statusmeldung zurück. Simulieren Sie die Prüfung mit einer einfachen Logik.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine statische Methode, um den Cache-Status zu simulieren. `cl_esh_ca_check` ist eine interne Klasse, daher wird hier eine konzeptionelle Annäherung gewählt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_status,
             cache_name TYPE string,
             is_active  TYPE abap_bool,
             last_update TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_status.

    CLASS-METHODS get_cache_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_cache_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status) TYPE ty_cache_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cache_status.
    rs_status-cache_name = iv_cache_id.
    IF iv_cache_id = 'S_ESH_ENG_CACHE'.
      rs_status-is_active = abap_true.
      GET TIME STAMP FIELD rs_status-last_update.
    ELSEIF iv_cache_id = 'OTHER_CACHE'.
      rs_status-is_active = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_esh_cache_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_esh_cache_check.
    DATA(ls_status_esh) = zcl_esh_cache_status=>get_cache_status( 'S_ESH_ENG_CACHE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status_esh-is_active exp = abap_true msg = 'S_ESH_ENG_CACHE sollte aktiv sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_status_esh-last_update msg = 'Last update sollte gesetzt sein' ).

    DATA(ls_status_other) = zcl_esh_cache_status=>get_cache_status( 'OTHER_CACHE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status_other-is_active exp = abap_false msg = 'OTHER_CACHE sollte inaktiv sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert die Prüfung eines Enterprise Search Caches. Da `cl_esh_ca_check` eine interne Klasse ist, wird hier eine eigene Klasse `zcl_esh_cache_status` erstellt, die den Status konzeptionell abfragt und eine Struktur mit Cache-Informationen zurückgibt. Dies zeigt die Verwendung von `CLASS-METHODS` und strukturierten Typen.
keywords: cl_esh_ca_check, S_ESH_ENG_CACHE, Cache check, Enterprise Search, Static Methods

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem Mindestpreis unter Verwendung der `FILTER`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #()` um interne Tabellen effizient zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_cache_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price   TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cache_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_cache_filter=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '250.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251203' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_cache_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = '100.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge gefunden werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Erster Flugpreis falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = '250.00' msg = 'Zweiter Flugpreis falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Methode, um interne Tabellen zu filtern. Sie ermöglicht es, Filterkriterien direkt in einer Zeile zu definieren, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, sflights, Data Filtering

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, unter Verwendung der `FOR`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_flight_cache_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_raw,
           tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) unter Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #()` um Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_cache_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_stats,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_stats.

    METHODS calculate_flight_stats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_stats) TYPE ty_flight_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cache_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_flight_stats.
    DATA(ls_temp_stats) = REDUCE ty_flight_stats(
      INIT total_flights = 0 average_price = '0.00'
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT total_flights = total_flights + 1
           average_price = average_price + ls_flight-price
    ).

    rs_stats-total_flights = ls_temp_stats-total_flights.
    IF ls_temp_stats-total_flights > 0.
      rs_stats-average_price = ls_temp_stats-average_price / ls_temp_stats-total_flights.
    ELSE.
      rs_stats-average_price = '0.00'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-average_price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Durchschnittspreis falsch' ).

CLASS zcl_dynamic_cache_invalidator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD invalidate_cache_by_type.
    DATA(lv_method_name) = |INVALIDATE_{ iv_cache_type }_CACHE|.

        MESSAGE |Cache '{ iv_cache_type }' erfolgreich invalidiert.| TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        MESSAGE |Fehler: Methode '{ lv_method_name }' für Cache-Typ '{ iv_cache_type }' nicht gefunden.| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD invalidate_flight_cache.
    " Logik zur Invalidierung des Flug-Caches
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD invalidate_user_cache.
    " Logik zur Invalidierung des Benutzer-Caches
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entwerfen Sie ein Interface für ein generisches Cache-Management (Lesen, Schreiben, Invalidieren) und implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die dieses Interface nutzt, um Flugdaten (`sflights`) zu cachen. Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle als einfachen In-Memory-Cache.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INTERFACE` mit modernen Datenstrukturen und Methoden. Nutzen Sie `sflights` als Datenquelle und eine interne Tabelle als Cache-Speicher.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_generic_cache_manager PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_entry,
           key   TYPE string,
           value TYPE xstring, " Für serialisierte Daten
           expiry TYPE timestampl,
         END OF ty_cache_entry,
         tt_cache_entries TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_cache_entry WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

  METHODS get_from_cache
    IMPORTING
      iv_key TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_value) TYPE xstring.

  METHODS put_to_cache
    IMPORTING
      iv_key   TYPE string
      iv_value TYPE xstring
      iv_expiry_minutes TYPE i DEFAULT 60.

  METHODS invalidate_cache
    IMPORTING
      iv_key TYPE string OPTIONAL.

  METHODS clear_all_cache.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_cache DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_generic_cache_manager.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_connid,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-DATA gt_in_memory_cache TYPE zif_generic_cache_manager=>tt_cache_entries.
    CLASS-METHODS serialize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_data) TYPE xstring.
    CLASS-METHODS deserialize_flights
      IMPORTING
        ix_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_cache IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_generic_cache_manager~get_from_cache.
    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ).
    READ TABLE gt_in_memory_cache WITH TABLE KEY key = iv_key INTO DATA(ls_entry).
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_entry-expiry > lv_current_timestamp.
      rv_value = ls_entry-value.
    ELSE.
      " Cache-Eintrag nicht gefunden oder abgelaufen
      DELETE TABLE gt_in_memory_cache WITH TABLE KEY key = iv_key.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_generic_cache_manager~put_to_cache.
    DATA(lv_expiry_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ) minutes = iv_expiry_minutes ).
    gt_in_memory_cache = VALUE #( BASE gt_in_memory_cache
                                  ( key = iv_key value = iv_value expiry = lv_expiry_timestamp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_generic_cache_manager~invalidate_cache.
    IF iv_key IS SUPPLIED.
      DELETE TABLE gt_in_memory_cache WITH TABLE KEY key = iv_key.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR gt_in_memory_cache.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_generic_cache_manager~clear_all_cache.
    CLEAR gt_in_memory_cache.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD serialize_flights.
    " Einfache Serialisierung für Demo-Zwecke
    DATA(lv_json_string) = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = it_flights pretty_name = abap_false ).
    rx_data = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_json_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_flights.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>ccpu( ix_data ).
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_json_string CHANGING data = rt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cache_operations FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cache_expiry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cache_operations.
    DATA(lo_cache_manager) = NEW zcl_flight_data_cache( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_data_cache=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    DATA(lx_serialized_flights) = zcl_flight_data_cache=>serialize_flights( lt_flights ).

    " Put to cache
    lo_cache_manager->zif_generic_cache_manager~put_to_cache( iv_key = 'FLIGHT_LH_0400' iv_value = lx_serialized_flights iv_expiry_minutes = 1 ).

    " Get from cache
    DATA(lx_retrieved_flights) = lo_cache_manager->zif_generic_cache_manager~get_from_cache( 'FLIGHT_LH_0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_retrieved_flights msg = 'Flüge sollten aus dem Cache abgerufen werden' ).
    DATA(lt_deserialized_flights) = zcl_flight_data_cache=>deserialize_flights( lx_retrieved_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_deserialized_flights ) exp = 1 msg = 'Anzahl der deserialisierten Flüge falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_deserialized_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Fluggesellschaft falsch' ).

    " Invalidate specific key
    lo_cache_manager->zif_generic_cache_manager~invalidate_cache( 'FLIGHT_LH_0400' ).
    lx_retrieved_flights = lo_cache_manager->zif_generic_cache_manager~get_from_cache( 'FLIGHT_LH_0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lx_retrieved_flights msg = 'Flüge sollten nach Invalidierung nicht mehr im Cache sein' ).

    " Clear all
    lo_cache_manager->zif_generic_cache_manager~put_to_cache( iv_key = 'FLIGHT_LH_0400_2' iv_value = lx_serialized_flights ).
    lo_cache_manager->zif_generic_cache_manager~clear_all_cache( ).
    lx_retrieved_flights = lo_cache_manager->zif_generic_cache_manager~get_from_cache( 'FLIGHT_LH_0400_2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lx_retrieved_flights msg = 'Cache sollte nach Clear All leer sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cache_expiry.
    DATA(lo_cache_manager) = NEW zcl_flight_data_cache( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_data_cache=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    DATA(lx_serialized_flights) = zcl_flight_data_cache=>serialize_flights( lt_flights ).

    " Put to cache with short expiry (1 second)
    lo_cache_manager->zif_generic_cache_manager~put_to_cache( iv_key = 'EXPIRED_KEY' iv_value = lx_serialized_flights iv_expiry_minutes = 0 ).

    " Wait for expiry (simulate time passing)
    WAIT UP TO '0.001' SECONDS. " Minimal wait to ensure timestamp changes

    DATA(lx_retrieved_flights) = lo_cache_manager->zif_generic_cache_manager~get_from_cache( 'EXPIRED_KEY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lx_retrieved_flights msg = 'Abgelaufener Cache-Eintrag sollte nicht abgerufen werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt ein umfassendes Cache-Management-Interface und dessen Implementierung. Es nutzt eine HASHED TABLE für effizienten Zugriff, `xstring` für die Speicherung serialisierter Daten (hier JSON mit `/ui2/cl_json`), und `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitstempelverwaltung. Die `VALUE`-Expression wird für die Initialisierung von Cache-Einträgen verwendet. Dies demonstriert fortgeschrittene Objektorientierung und den Umgang mit In-Memory-Caches.
keywords: INTERFACE, Cache Management, Object Orientation, HASHED TABLE, xstring, cl_abap_tstmp, /ui2/cl_json, S_ESH_ENG_CACHE (conceptual), sflights

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis, unter Verwendung der `GROUP BY` Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` für effiziente Gruppierungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats,
           tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: ls_carrier_stats TYPE ty_carrier_stats.

    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                                 INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      CLEAR ls_carrier_stats.
      ls_carrier_stats-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_flight).
        ls_carrier_stats-flight_count = ls_carrier_stats-flight_count + 1.
        ls_carrier_stats-total_price = ls_carrier_stats-total_price + ls_group_flight-price.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_carrier_stats TO rt_carrier_stats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Barcode generiert und bei einem Fehler eine benutzerdefinierte Fehlermeldung mit String-Templates zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` und String-Templates für die Fehlermeldung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_error_msg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_barcode_with_msg
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE REF TO data
      EXCEPTIONS
        barcode_error.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_barcode_result,
             barcode_xstring TYPE xstring,
             error_message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_barcode_result.

    METHODS generate_barcode_with_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status) TYPE ty_barcode_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_error_msg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_barcode_with_msg.
    DATA(lv_barcode_type) = 'CODE128'.
    DATA(lv_width) = 200.
    DATA(lv_height) = 100.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA rs_result TYPE xstring.
        GET REFERENCE OF cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>create_barcode_bmp_xstring(
          i_barcode_type = lv_barcode_type
          i_barcode_data = iv_data
          i_width        = lv_width
          i_height       = lv_height
        ) INTO rs_result.
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_barcode_error).
        MESSAGE lx_barcode_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING barcode_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD generate_barcode_with_status.
    DATA(lv_barcode_type) = 'CODE128'.
    DATA(lv_width) = 200.
    DATA(lv_height) = 100.

    TRY.
        rs_status-barcode_xstring = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>create_barcode_bmp_xstring(
          i_barcode_type = lv_barcode_type
          i_barcode_data = iv_data
          i_width        = lv_width
          i_height       = lv_height
        ).
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_barcode_error).
        rs_status-error_message = |Barcode-Generierung fehlgeschlagen für '{ iv_data }': { lx_barcode_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
