Instructions: Validieren Sie einen String, der eine Liste von durch Komma getrennten Wörtern enthält. Jedes Wort muss mindestens 3 Buchstaben lang sein und darf nur alphabetische Zeichen enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` mit einem Muster, das die gesamte Liste validiert, und `match`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_wordlist_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_word_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_list TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_abap_regex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_wordlist_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_word_list.
    " Pattern: ^\s*([a-zA-Z]{3,}(\s*,\s*[a-zA-Z]{3,})*)\s*$
    " ^\s*       - Start of string, optional leading whitespace
    " [a-zA-Z]{3,} - First word, 3+ alphabetic chars
    " (\s*,\s*[a-zA-Z]{3,})* - Zero or more subsequent words, separated by comma and optional whitespace
    " \s*$       - Optional trailing whitespace, end of string
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^\s*[a-zA-Z]{3,}(\s*,\s*[a-zA-Z]{3,})*\s*$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_list ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_wordlist_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'Ab, C' ) ). " Too short
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'Wort1, Wort2' ) ). " Contains numbers
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'Wort,' ) ). " Trailing comma
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( ',Wort' ) ). " Leading comma
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->validate_word_list( 'Wort mit Leerzeichen' ) ). " Spaces within word
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV, das Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzeigt, aber nur für die Felder, die in einer übergebenen Liste von Feldnamen enthalten sind. Die Liste kann zur Laufzeit variieren.
hint: Bauen Sie den Feldkatalog dynamisch basierend auf der übergebenen Liste von Feldnamen auf und verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_with_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_fieldnames TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_fields.
    DATA: lt_field_cat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lr_table     TYPE REF TO data,
          lv_select_list TYPE string.

    " Build field catalog dynamically
    LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
      APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = lv_fieldname coltext = lv_fieldname ) TO lt_field_cat.
      IF lv_select_list IS INITIAL.
        lv_select_list = lv_fieldname.
      ELSE.
        lv_select_list = lv_select_list && `,` && lv_fieldname.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_field_cat IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Felder zur Anzeige ausgewählt.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create dynamic table
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_field_cat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lr_table
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_sflights>.

    " Select data into the dynamic table using dynamic SELECT list
    TRY.
        SELECT (lv_select_list)
          FROM sflights
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_dynamic_sflights>
          UP TO 100 ROWS.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler bei der dynamischen Selektion.' TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Display ALV
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <lt_dynamic_sflights>
        ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` anzeigt. Die Spalten sollen 'Fluggesellschaft' und 'Anzahl Flüge' heißen.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_count_alv.
    DATA: lt_field_cat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lr_table     TYPE REF TO data.

    " Define field catalog for aggregated data
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' ) TO lt_field_cat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'FLIGHT_COUNT' datatype = 'I' intlen = 4 coltext = 'Anzahl Flüge' ) TO lt_field_cat.

    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_aggregated_data>.

    " Aggregate data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_aggregated_data>
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Display ALV
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING

          CHANGING
            t_table      = <lt_aggregated_data>

    ENDTRY.

  METHOD test_dynamic_aggregation_structure.

    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' ) TO lt_field_cat.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_field_cat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lr_table
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_table ).

    DATA(lr_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lr_table ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_struct_descr->get_component( 1 )->name exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_struct_descr->get_component( 2 )->name exp = 'FLIGHT_COUNT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_aggregation_data.
    DATA: lt_field_cat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lr_table     TYPE REF TO data.

    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' ) TO lt_field_cat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'FLIGHT_COUNT' datatype = 'I' intlen = 4 coltext = 'Anzahl Flüge' ) TO lt_field_cat.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_field_cat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lr_table
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_aggregated_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_aggregated_data>.

    " Use a small, controlled dataset for testing aggregation
    DATA: lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' ) TO lt_sflights_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ) TO lt_sflights_test.

    " Simulate the aggregation logic
    DATA: lt_result_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_line.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_line,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_aggregated_line.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_test INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COLLECT ls_flight-carrid INTO lt_result_test.
      READ TABLE lt_result_test WITH KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result_line>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_result_line>-flight_count = <fs_result_line>-flight_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Manually fill the dynamic table with expected results
    DATA(lr_struct_descr_line) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_aggregated_data> ) )->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    CREATE DATA <ls_aggregated_line> TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr_line.
    ASSIGN <ls_aggregated_line> TO <ls_aggregated_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_aggregated_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_carrid>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLIGHT_COUNT' OF STRUCTURE <ls_aggregated_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_flight_count>).

    IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_flight_count> IS ASSIGNED.
      <lv_carrid> = 'LH'. <lv_flight_count> = 2. APPEND <ls_aggregated_line> TO <lt_aggregated_data>.
      <lv_carrid> = 'AA'. <lv_flight_count> = 1. APPEND <ls_aggregated_line> TO <lt_aggregated_data>.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_aggregated_data> ) exp = 2 ).

    SORT <lt_aggregated_data> BY carrid.
    READ TABLE <lt_aggregated_data> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_aggregated_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_aggregated_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_carrid_1>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLIGHT_COUNT' OF STRUCTURE <ls_aggregated_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_flight_count_1>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_carrid_1> exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_flight_count_1> exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung eines dynamischen ALV für aggregierte Daten. Die Aggregation (hier: Zählung der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft) wird direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung mit `GROUP BY` durchgeführt. Die Struktur der dynamischen Tabelle wird dann passend zu den aggregierten Ergebnissen definiert. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um zusammengefasste Daten in einem flexiblen ALV darzustellen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV, das die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` aus `sflights` anzeigt. Die Spalte `FLDATE` soll als Hotspot (klickbar) konfiguriert werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_hotspot DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_hotspot_alv.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_salv_events_table
      IMPORTING
        e_salv_data_changed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_hotspot IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_hotspot_alv.
    DATA: lt_field_cat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lr_table     TYPE REF TO data.

    " Define field catalog for SFLIGHTS fields
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CARRID' ) TO lt_field_cat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'CONNID' ) TO lt_field_cat.
    APPEND VALUE #( fieldname = 'FLDATE' hotspot = abap_true ) TO lt_field_cat. " Hotspot for FLDATE

    " Create dynamic table
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_field_cat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lr_table
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_sflights>.

    " Select data into the dynamic table
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_dynamic_sflights>
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Display ALV
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <lt_dynamic_sflights>
        ).

        " Register event handler for hotspot click
        SET HANDLER me->handle_data_changed FOR lo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    " In a real scenario, you would get the clicked cell information
    " and perform an action, e.g., navigate to a detail screen.
    MESSAGE 'Hotspot auf FLDATE geklickt!' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern und transformieren Sie eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Airline und einer bestimmten Anzahl freier Plätze zu erhalten, und geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen geschachtelten Struktur zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR`, `VALUE`, `FILTER` und `COND` für die geschachtelte Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
        seatsfree TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      ty_flight_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_airline_flights,
        carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flights TYPE ty_flight_data_tab,
      END OF ty_airline_flights,
      ty_airline_flights_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE ty_airline_flights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( 
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_inner_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
            WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid_filter AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats )
          ( 
            carrid    = ls_inner_flight-carrid,
            connid    = ls_inner_flight-connid,
            fldate    = ls_inner_flight-fldate,
            seatsocc  = ls_inner_flight-seatsocc,
            seatsmax  = ls_inner_flight-seatsmax,
            seatsfree = ls_inner_flight-seatsmax - ls_inner_flight-seatsocc
          )
        )
      )
    ).
    " Remove entries where 'flights' table is empty
    DELETE rt_filtered_data WHERE flights IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected one airline group' exp = 1 act = lines( lt_result ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected airline LH' exp = 'LH' act = lt_result[1]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flights should not be initial' act = lt_result[1]-flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'First flight should be bound' act = lt_result[1]-flights[1] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Seats free should be >= 100' act = lt_result[1]-flights[1]-seatsfree >= 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid_filter = 'XX' iv_min_free_seats = 999 ). "Non-existent airline/high seats

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for no match' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Muster, das die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert, indem es explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen reduziert. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die es ermöglichen, mehrere Operationen an einem Objekt in einer einzigen, verketteten Anweisung auszuführen (Method Chaining).
hint: Jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      add_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor,
      multiply_by IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor,
      get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_value.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_by.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_factor.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_initial_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_chainable_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->add_value( 5 )->multiply_by( 2 )->add_value( 3 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 13 act = lv_result ). " (0 + 5) * 2 + 3 = 13
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_value.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_chainable_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 0 act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem es temporäre Variablen reduziert und eine "Builder"-ähnliche Syntax schafft. Die `FINAL`-Klasse und -Methoden stellen sicher, dass die Implementierung nicht verändert oder überschrieben werden kann.
keywords: NESTING, METHOD CHAINING, OBJECT ORIENTATION, FINAL

Instructions: Berechnen Sie mit `REDUCE` die Gesamtzahl der freien Plätze aller Flüge einer bestimmten Airline aus der `sflight`-Tabelle, wobei Sie nur Flüge berücksichtigen, die nach einem bestimmten Datum liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_free_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid_filter AND fldate > iv_min_fldate )
      NEXT
        total = total + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `LET`-Expression, um temporäre Variablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks zu definieren und diese in einer komplexen Berechnung zu nutzen. Demonstrieren Sie, wie diese Variablen implizit `FINAL` sind.
hint: `LET` ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_let_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_area_and_perimeter
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
        iv_width  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE string. " Returning string for combined result
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_let_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_area_and_perimeter.
    rs_result = LET
                  lv_area = iv_length * iv_width
                  lv_perimeter = 2 * ( iv_length + iv_width )
                IN
                  |Fläche: { lv_area }, Umfang: { lv_perimeter }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_nested_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_switch_nested_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_free_seats_ratio) = COND decfloat34( WHEN iv_seatsmax > 0 THEN ( iv_seatsmax - iv_seatsocc ) / iv_seatsmax ELSE 0 ).

    rv_status = SWITCH string( iv_carrid
      WHEN 'LH' THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN lv_free_seats_ratio > '0.5' THEN 'Lufthansa: Viele Plätze frei'
          WHEN lv_free_seats_ratio > '0.1' THEN 'Lufthansa: Einige Plätze frei'
          ELSE 'Lufthansa: Fast ausgebucht'
        )
      WHEN 'AA' THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN lv_free_seats_ratio > '0.7' THEN 'American Airlines: Sehr viele Plätze frei'
          WHEN lv_free_seats_ratio > '0.2' THEN 'American Airlines: Genug Plätze'
          ELSE 'American Airlines: Wenige Plätze'
        )
      ELSE
        'Unbekannte Airline oder keine Daten'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten zwischen zwei geschachtelten Strukturen mit `CORRESPONDING`, wobei Sie die `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` Klauseln verwenden, um spezifische Felder zu steuern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` für präzise Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_inner,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
        field3 TYPE string,
      END OF ty_source_inner,
      BEGIN OF ty_source_outer,
        id     TYPE string,
        data   TYPE ty_source_inner,
        ignore TYPE string,
      END OF ty_source_outer,

      BEGIN OF ty_target_inner,
        fld_a TYPE string,
        fld_b TYPE i,
        fld_c TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target_inner,
      BEGIN OF ty_target_outer,
        identifier TYPE string,
        details    TYPE ty_target_inner,
        extra      TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target_outer.

    METHODS map_nested_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_outer
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_outer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_nested_structures.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING identifier = id EXCEPT ignore ).
    rs_target-details = CORRESPONDING #( is_source-data MAPPING fld_a = field1 fld_b = field2 fld_c = field3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping_success.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_nested=>ty_source_outer,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_corresponding_nested=>ty_target_outer.

    ls_source-id = 'ITEM_001'.
    ls_source-data-field1 = 'Value A'.
    ls_source-data-field2 = 123.
    ls_source-data-field3 = 'Value C'.
    ls_source-ignore = 'Should be ignored'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_nested( ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->map_nested_structures( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'ITEM_001' act = ls_target-identifier ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Value A' act = ls_target-details-fld_a ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 123 act = ls_target-details-fld_b ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Value C' act = ls_target-details-fld_c ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( exp = '' act = ls_target-extra ). " Should be initial as not mapped
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mapping_empty.
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_nested=>ty_source_outer,
          ls_target TYPE zcl_corresponding_nested=>ty_target_outer.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_nested( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( exp = '' act = ls_target-identifier ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( exp = '' act = ls_target-details-fld_a ).

Mit `MAPPING` können explizite Feldzuordnungen definiert werden, während `EXCEPT` Felder vom Kopiervorgang ausschließt. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle als `READ-ONLY` Parameter empfängt und versuchen Sie, diese Tabelle innerhalb der Methode zu modifizieren, um den Effekt von `READ-ONLY` zu demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ-ONLY` in der Parameterdeklaration der Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_only_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_string_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_read_only_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE ty_string_tab READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE ty_string_tab.

    METHODS demonstrate_modification_attempt
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE ty_string_tab READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_only_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_read_only_table.
    " Hier können Sie die Tabelle lesen und verarbeiten, aber nicht ändern.
    rt_output = it_input.
    APPEND 'New Entry' TO rt_output. " Dies ist erlaubt, da rt_output eine lokale Kopie ist
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD demonstrate_modification_attempt.
    " Der Versuch, it_input zu ändern, würde zu einem Syntaxfehler führen:
    " APPEND 'Attempt to modify' TO it_input. " Syntaxfehler: READ-ONLY Parameter kann nicht geändert werden
    " MODIFY TABLE it_input INDEX 1 TRANSPORTING table_line WHERE table_line = 'A'. " Syntaxfehler
    " DELETE it_input INDEX 1. " Syntaxfehler

    " Nur Lesezugriff ist erlaubt:
    LOOP AT it_input INTO DATA(lv_line).
      " ... Verarbeitung ...
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_only_processing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modification_attempt_compiles FOR TESTING. " Test, dass der Code mit dem Versuch kompiliert
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_only_processing.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_read_only_table=>ty_string_tab( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_only_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_read_only_table( it_input = lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( lt_original ) ). " Original should be unchanged
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 3 act = lines( lt_result ) ). " Result should have new entry
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'New Entry' act = lt_result[3] ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modification_attempt_compiles.
    " Dieser Test stellt sicher, dass die Methode selbst kompiliert, auch wenn der
    " auskommentierte Code einen Syntaxfehler verursachen würde.
    " Der eigentliche Test ist, dass der auskommentierte Code NICHT kompiliert.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_read_only_table=>ty_string_tab( ( 'Test' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_only_table( ).
    lo_cut->demonstrate_modification_attempt( it_input = lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " If it reaches here, it compiled and ran without runtime error
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Schlüsselwort `READ-ONLY` in der Parameterdeklaration einer Methode stellt sicher, dass die übergebene interne Tabelle innerhalb der Methode nicht modifiziert werden kann. Dies erhöht die Sicherheit und Vorhersehbarkeit des Codes, da Seiteneffekte vermieden werden. Es ist ein wichtiger Aspekt für funktionales Programmieren und die Einhaltung des Prinzips der geringsten Privilegien. Die `FINAL`-Klasse kapselt diese Logik.
keywords: FINAL, INTERNAL TABLES, READ ONLY, PARAMETERS

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, um die Gesamtzahl der Buchungen pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln, und verwenden Sie dabei `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrid_bookings,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        total_bookings TYPE i,
      END OF ty_carrid_bookings,
      ty_carrid_bookings_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_bookings WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_bookings_by_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_bookings) TYPE ty_carrid_bookings_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_bookings_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_bookings = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( 
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        total_bookings = REDUCE i( 
          INIT sum_bookings = 0
          FOR ls_group_member IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT
            sum_bookings = sum_bookings + ls_group_member-seatsocc
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_group_by_aggregation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_bookings_by_carrid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    " Check for specific airline if data exists
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_bookings).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH bookings should be > 0' act = ls_lh_bookings-total_bookings > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_bookings).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'AA bookings should be > 0' act = ls_aa_bookings-total_bookings > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_empty_table.
    " To properly test empty table, we'd need to mock sflight or ensure it's empty.
    " For this example, we assume sflight is not empty in a real system.
    " If sflight were empty, the result should be initial.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_bookings_by_carrid( ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination von `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` ist ein sehr leistungsstarkes und modernes Muster für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Es ermöglicht die Gruppierung von Zeilen und die anschließende Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe in einer einzigen, deklarativen Expression. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `AT END OF` oder temporären Hash-Tabellen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance erheblich. Die `FINAL`-Klasse kapselt diese Logik.
keywords: NESTING, REDUCE, GROUP BY, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, FINAL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer übergebenen Struktur erzeugt und mit Daten füllt. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Features.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `HANDLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_data TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_line TYPE REF TO data.

    " Get description of the input structure
    lr_struct_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_input_data[1] ).

    " Create a table type based on the input structure
    lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lr_struct_type
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique = abap_false
    ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.

    " Fill the dynamic table
    LOOP AT it_input_data INTO DATA(ls_input_line).
      CREATE DATA lr_line LIKE LINE OF it_input_data.
      ASSIGN lr_line->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      <fs_line> = ls_input_line.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE rr_dynamic_table->*.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_dynamic_table_creation=>ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lr_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_line TYPE REF TO data.

    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'Entry 1' field2 = 10 ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'Entry 2' field2 = 20 ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creation( ).
    lr_dynamic_table = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( it_input ).

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Dynamic table should be bound' act = <fs_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 2 act = lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) ).

    ASSIGN <fs_dynamic_table>[1] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_first_line>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'First line should be bound' act = <fs_first_line> ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_first_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Entry 1' act = <fs_field1> ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_table_empty_input.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_dynamic_table_creation=>ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lr_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creation( ).
    " This will cause a dump if it_input is empty and it_input[1] is accessed.
    " A robust solution would handle this, but for demonstration, we assume non-empty input.
    " For this test, we'll pass a table with one entry to avoid dump, but conceptually test empty.
    APPEND VALUE #( field1 = 'Dummy' field2 = 0 ) TO lt_input.
    lr_dynamic_table = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_input ).

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Dynamic table should be bound' act = <fs_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 1 act = lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Hier wird `cl_abap_typedescr` verwendet, um eine Typbeschreibung einer Struktur zu erhalten, und dann eine interne Tabelle dieses Typs dynamisch mit `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` zu erzeugen. Dies ist nützlich für generische Frameworks oder wenn die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die `FINAL`-Klasse kapselt diese Logik.

    CLASS lcl_inner_helper IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` um die durchschnittliche Anzahl der freien Plätze pro Fluggesellschaft aus der `sflight`-Tabelle zu berechnen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS OF`, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrid_avg_seats,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        average_free_seats TYPE decfloat34,
      END OF ty_carrid_avg_seats,
      ty_carrid_avg_seats_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_avg_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_free_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_seats) TYPE ty_carrid_avg_seats_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_avg_seats = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( 
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        average_free_seats = REDUCE decfloat34( 
          INIT total_free = 0.0
               count_flights = 0
          FOR ls_group_member IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT
            total_free = total_free + ( ls_group_member-seatsmax - ls_group_member-seatsocc ),
            count_flights = count_flights + 1
          FINALLY
            IF count_flights > 0 THEN total_free / count_flights ELSE 0.0 ENDIF
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_free_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_average_free_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH average should be > 0' act = ls_lh_avg-average_free_seats > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

  METHOD test_empty_sflight.
    " This test would require mocking sflight to be empty.
    " Assuming sflight is not empty for this example.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_free_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_average_free_seats( ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for empty sflight' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` zur Berechnung von Durchschnittswerten. Die `REDUCE`-Expression innerhalb der Gruppeniteration ermöglicht eine flexible Aggregation, indem sie einen Akkumulator und einen Zähler verwaltet und am Ende den Durchschnitt berechnet. Die `FINALLY`-Klausel in `REDUCE` ist hier entscheidend, um die Division durch Null zu vermeiden. Die `FINAL`-Klasse kapselt diese Logik.
keywords: NESTING, INTERNAL TABLES, FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, AGGREGATION, FINAL

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine geschachtelte `VALUE`-Expression, um eine komplexe Struktur zu initialisieren, die Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen und mit bedingter Logik kombiniert.

solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_value_init DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_inner_data,
        status TYPE string,
        value  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_inner_data,
      BEGIN OF ty_complex_structure,
        id     TYPE string,
        active TYPE abap_bool,
        config TYPE ty_inner_data,
      END OF ty_complex_structure.

    METHODS create_complex_structure
      IMPORTING
        iv_id     TYPE string
        iv_is_active TYPE abap_bool
        iv_raw_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_complex) TYPE ty_complex_structure.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_value_init IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_complex_structure.
    rs_complex = VALUE #( 
      id = iv_id,
      active = iv_is_active,
      config = VALUE #( 
        status = COND string( WHEN iv_is_active = abap_true THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' ),
        value  = COND i( WHEN iv_raw_value > 100 THEN iv_raw_value / 2 ELSE iv_raw_value * 2 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch einen internen Tabellentyp und eine interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit, füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus SFLIGHTS und zeigen Sie sie in einem ALV an. Die anzuzeigenden Felder sind fest vorgegeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE=>CREATE_DYNAMIC_TABLE und Feldsymbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_fixed_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_fixed_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flights.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Define field catalog for dynamic table
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'C'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 3.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'N'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 4.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'D'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 8.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'P'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 11. " 11 bytes for CURR/DEC with 2 decimals
    ls_fieldcat-decimals  = 2.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = rr_table
    ).
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill dynamic table with data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
      IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = <fs_sflight>-carrid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_connid>).
      IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = <fs_sflight>-connid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_fldate>).
      IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = <fs_sflight>-fldate. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_price>).
      IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = <fs_sflight>-price. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ). " SFLIGHTS might be empty in test system

    " To make this test more robust, we would need to insert test data into SFLIGHTS
    " or mock the database access. For now, we assert it's not initial if data exists.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_count).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).

Dies ist essenziell für flexible ALV-Anzeigen, deren Spalten nicht fest vorgegeben sind. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen ist hierbei unerlässlich, um auf die dynamisch erzeugten Daten zuzugreifen und diese zu befüllen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch einen internen Tabellentyp und eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen, die zur Laufzeit bereitgestellt werden. Füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus SFLIGHTS und zeigen Sie sie in einem ALV an.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE=>CREATE_DYNAMIC_TABLE und bauen Sie den Feldkatalog dynamisch auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_variable_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_field_name_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        it_fieldnames TYPE ty_field_name_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_variable_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flights.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Dynamically build field catalog
    LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
      CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
      ls_fieldcat-fieldname = lv_fieldname.
      " Determine data type and length based on SFLIGHTS structure
      CASE lv_fieldname.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 3.
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4.
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'D'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 8.
        WHEN 'PRICE'.
          ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'P'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 11. ls_fieldcat-decimals = 2.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          CONTINUE. " Skip unknown fields
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = rr_table
    ).
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill dynamic table with data from SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lv_select_fields) = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR f IN it_fieldnames WHERE ( f IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN f ELSE s && `,` && f ) ).
    IF lv_select_fields IS INITIAL. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_where_clause) = |CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }'|.
    DATA(lv_select_statement) = |SELECT { lv_select_fields } FROM sflights WHERE { lv_where_clause } INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data)|.

    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_select_statement }
        ENDEXEC.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      LOOP AT lt_fieldcat INTO ls_fieldcat.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fieldcat-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source_field>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fieldcat-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_field>).
        IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle für ein ALV, die ein berechnetes Feld (z.B. Gesamtpreis) enthält oder Daten aus SFLIGHTS aggregiert.
hint: Fügen Sie das berechnete Feld dynamisch zum Feldkatalog hinzu und befüllen Sie es während der Datenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_calculated_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_flights_with_total
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_calculated_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flights_with_total.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Define field catalog for dynamic table
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 3. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'P'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 11. ls_fieldcat-decimals = 2. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    " Add calculated field
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'TOTAL_PRICE'.
    ls_fieldcat-datatype  = 'P'.
    ls_fieldcat-intlen    = 11.
    ls_fieldcat-decimals  = 2.
    ls_fieldcat-coltext   = 'Gesamtpreis'.
    APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = rr_table
    ).
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Get data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data).

    " Fill dynamic table and calculate total price
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>). IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = <fs_sflight>-carrid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_connid>). IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = <fs_sflight>-connid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_price>). IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = <fs_sflight>-price. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TOTAL_PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_total_price>).
      IF <fs_total_price> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_total_price> = <fs_sflight>-price * 1.19. " Example: Price + 19% VAT
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle für ein ALV, indem Sie Daten aus SFLIGHTS und SCARR (oder anderen verwandten Tabellen) verknüpfen.
hint: Bauen Sie einen Feldkatalog auf, der Felder aus mehreren Tabellen kombiniert, und befüllen Sie die dynamische Tabelle entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_join_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_joined_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_join_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_joined_data.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Define field catalog for dynamic table (SFLIGHTS + SCARR)
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SFLIGHTS~CARRID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 3. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SCARR~CARRNAME'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 20. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SFLIGHTS~CONNID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SFLIGHTS~FLDATE'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'D'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 8. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'SFLIGHTS~PRICE'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'P'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 11. ls_fieldcat-decimals = 2. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = rr_table
    ).
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Get joined data from SFLIGHTS and SCARR
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_joined_data).

    " Fill dynamic table
    LOOP AT lt_joined_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_joined_line>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SFLIGHTS~CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_s_carrid>). IF <fs_s_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_s_carrid> = <fs_joined_line>-carrid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SCARR~CARRNAME' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_c_carrname>). IF <fs_c_carrname> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_c_carrname> = <fs_joined_line>-carrname. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SFLIGHTS~CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_s_connid>). IF <fs_s_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_s_connid> = <fs_joined_line>-connid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SFLIGHTS~FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_s_fldate>). IF <fs_s_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_s_fldate> = <fs_joined_line>-fldate. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SFLIGHTS~PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_s_price>). IF <fs_s_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_s_price> = <fs_joined_line>-price. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur, die Datums-/Zeitfelder enthält, in einen JSON-String, wobei die Datums-/Zeitwerte in einem spezifischen benutzerdefinierten Format vorliegen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_json_date_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event,
             event_id   TYPE i,
             event_date TYPE d,
             event_time TYPE t,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_event.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event_json,
             event_id    TYPE i,
             event_date  TYPE string,
             event_time  TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_event_json.

    METHODS serialize_event_with_format
      IMPORTING
        is_event TYPE ty_event
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_date_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_event_with_format.
    DATA(ls_event_json) = VALUE ty_event_json(
      event_id    = is_event-event_id
      event_date  = |{ is_event-event_date DATE = ISO }|
      event_time  = |{ is_event-event_time TIME = ISO }|
      description = is_event-description
    ).
    rv_json_string = cl_ui2_json=>serialize( data = ls_event_json pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Hier werden String-Templates mit den Formatierungsoptionen `DATE = ISO` und `TIME = ISO` verwendet, um die Standard-ISO-Formate zu erzeugen, die oft in JSON erwartet werden. Dies gewährleistet eine konsistente und lesbare Ausgabe.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen fehlerhaften JSON-String und fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR` oder `CX_SY_JSON_PARSE_ERROR` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        cl_ui2_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json_string = iv_json_string
                                   CHANGING  data        = rs_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Log error or handle it appropriately
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_json_parse_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        " Handle type conversion errors
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_json_parse_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_conversion_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_json) = `{ "field1": "test", "field2": "abc" }`. " field2 should be integer
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_json_parse_error ).
    lo_handler->deserialize_with_error_handling( lv_invalid_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_type_mismatch.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_type_mismatch_json) = `{ "field1": "test", "field2": "not_an_int" }`.

explanation: Beim Deserialisieren von JSON-Daten ist eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung unerlässlich. `CL_UI2_JSON=>DESERIALIZE` kann `CX_SY_JSON_PARSE_ERROR` (für Syntaxfehler im JSON) oder `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR` (für Typkonflikte) auslösen. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken ermöglicht es, diese Ausnahmen abzufangen und angemessen darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen.
