Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle für ein ALV, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit aus einer beliebigen ABAP-Struktur mittels RTTI abgeleitet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE=>CREATE_DYNAMIC_TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_table_from_rtti
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_from_rtti.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF <fs_data> IS NOT BOUND. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Get type description using RTTI
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ).
    DATA(lo_struct_type) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_struct_descr ).

    " Build field catalog from RTTI components
    LOOP AT lo_struct_type->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      CLEAR ls_fieldcat.
      ls_fieldcat-fieldname = ls_component-name.
      ls_fieldcat-datatype  = ls_component-type_descr->type_kind.
      ls_fieldcat-intlen    = ls_component-type_descr->length.
      ls_fieldcat-decimals  = ls_component-type_descr->decimals.
      APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = rr_table
    ).
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Append the initial data to the dynamic table
    APPEND <fs_data> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rtti_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_rtti( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
             value TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE ty_test_data( id = 1 text = 'Test Entry' value = '123.45' ).

    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO ls_test_data.
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->get_dynamic_table_from_rtti( ir_data = lr_data ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 1 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN <lt_dynamic_table>[ 1 ] TO <ls_line>.
    IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_id>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TEXT' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_text>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'VALUE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_id> exp = 1 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_text> exp = 'Test Entry' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_value> exp = '123.45' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) mit der dynamischen Tabellenerstellung. Mittels `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` wird die Struktur einer beliebigen ABAP-Datenreferenz zur Laufzeit analysiert, um daraus einen Feldkatalog zu generieren. Dieser Feldkatalog wird dann verwendet, um eine dynamische interne Tabelle zu erstellen. Dies ist extrem nützlich für generische ALV-Anzeigen, die mit beliebigen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, ALV, RTTI, CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, Field Symbols

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV mit `CL_SALV_TABLE` und einer zur Laufzeit erzeugten internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE=>CREATE_DYNAMIC_TABLE` für die Tabelle und `CL_SALV_TABLE=>FACTORY` für das ALV.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_salv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_salv
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_salv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_salv.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Define field catalog
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 3. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'D'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 8. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    DATA lr_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lr_table
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill dynamic table with data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>). IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = <fs_sflight>-carrid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_connid>). IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = <fs_sflight>-connid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_fldate>). IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = <fs_sflight>-fldate. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Display ALV using CL_SALV_TABLE
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <lt_dynamic_table>
        ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error, e.g., display message
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_salv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_salv.
    DATA(lo_alv_displayer) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_salv( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.

    " This test can only verify that the method runs without immediate error.
    " Actual ALV display cannot be asserted in a unit test.
    " A more advanced test would involve mocking CL_SALV_TABLE or checking for side effects.
    lo_alv_displayer->display_dynamic_salv( iv_carrid = lv_carrid ).

    " Assert that no exception was raised (implicit by not catching one here)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Placeholder for successful execution " ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die dynamische Tabellenerstellung mit der modernen ALV-Klasse `CL_SALV_TABLE`. Nach der dynamischen Erzeugung und Befüllung der internen Tabelle wird diese an die `CL_SALV_TABLE=>FACTORY`-Methode übergeben, um ein ALV zu instanziieren und anzuzeigen. `CL_SALV_TABLE` bietet eine objektorientierte und flexible Möglichkeit, ALVs zu steuern.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, ALV, CL_SALV_TABLE, CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE, Object Orientation

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in ein JSON-Array, wobei bestimmte Felder umbenannt oder weggelassen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Zwischenstruktur oder `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und `EXCEPT` vor der Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_transform_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: ty_flights_raw_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_json_output,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE string,
             cost       TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_json_output.
    TYPES: ty_flights_json_output_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_json_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_and_serialize
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_raw TYPE ty_flights_raw_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_transform_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_serialize.
    DATA(lt_transformed_flights) = VALUE ty_flights_json_output_tt(
      FOR ls_raw IN it_flights_raw
      ( airline_id  = ls_raw-carrid
        flight_num  = ls_raw-connid
        flight_date = |{ ls_raw-fldate DATE = ISO }|
        cost        = ls_raw-price )
    ).
    rv_json_string = cl_ui2_json=>serialize( data = lt_transformed_flights pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_and_serialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_and_serialize.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_json_transform_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE zcl_json_transform_fields=>ty_flights_raw_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251225' price = '123.45' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251226' price = '500.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_transformer->transform_and_serialize( it_flights_raw = lt_raw_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"airline_id":"LH"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"flight_num":"0400"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"flight_date":"2025-12-25"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"cost":123.45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"currency"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"carrid"' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Transformation von Daten vor der JSON-Serialisierung. Mittels eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks wird eine neue interne Tabelle mit der gewünschten Struktur und den umbenannten/formatierten Feldern erstellt. Nicht benötigte Felder werden einfach weggelassen. Dies ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, Daten für die JSON-Ausgabe vorzubereiten.
keywords: JSON, SERIALIZE, Data Transformation, FOR, String Templates, CL_UI2_JSON, Field Renaming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV, das Daten aus SFLIGHTS basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit definierten Filterkriterium anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE` und dynamische `WHERE`-Klauseln oder `FILTER` Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Define field catalog
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 3. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'P'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 11. ls_fieldcat-decimals = 2. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    DATA lr_table_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lr_table_ref
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_table_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Get data from SFLIGHTS with dynamic WHERE clause
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = |CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }' AND PRICE >= { iv_min_price }|.
    DATA(lv_select_statement) = |SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights WHERE { lv_where_clause } INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data)|.

    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_select_statement }
        ENDEXEC.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error.
        " Handle error
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Fill dynamic table
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>). IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = <fs_sflight>-carrid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_connid>). IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = <fs_sflight>-connid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_price>). IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = <fs_sflight>-price. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rr_table = lr_table_ref.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_min_price) = '200.00'.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_min_price = lv_min_price ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND price >= @lv_min_price INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    IF lv_count > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = lv_count ).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN <lt_dynamic_table>[ 1 ] TO <ls_line>.
      IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price>).
        IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_carrid> exp = lv_carrid ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_price> >= lv_min_price ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung eines dynamischen ALV mit Filterung der Daten basierend auf zur Laufzeit übergebenen Kriterien. Die Filterung wird hier über eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel in einem Native SQL `SELECT`-Statement realisiert, was maximale Flexibilität bei der Abfrage ermöglicht. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Muster für Berichte, bei denen die Filterbedingungen nicht fest codiert sind.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, ALV, Filtering, Dynamic WHERE, Native SQL, CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV und passen Sie zur Laufzeit die Spaltenüberschriften und die Sichtbarkeit von Feldern an.
hint: Manipulieren Sie den Feldkatalog nach der Erstellung, um Spalteneigenschaften zu ändern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_customize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_customized_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_customize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_customized_flights.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fieldcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    " Define initial field catalog
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'C'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 3. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'N'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 4. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'D'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 8. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.
    ls_fieldcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'. ls_fieldcat-datatype = 'P'. ls_fieldcat-intlen = 11. ls_fieldcat-decimals = 2. APPEND ls_fieldcat TO lt_fieldcat.

    " Customize field catalog: Change text, hide field
    LOOP AT lt_fieldcat INTO ls_fieldcat.
      CASE ls_fieldcat-fieldname.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft'.
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Flugnummer'.
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          ls_fieldcat-no_out = abap_true. " Hide this column
        WHEN 'PRICE'.
          ls_fieldcat-coltext = 'Kosten'.
      ENDCASE.
      MODIFY lt_fieldcat FROM ls_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create dynamic internal table
    DATA lr_table_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = lr_table_ref
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_table_ref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill dynamic table (simplified, assuming all fields are selected)
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>). IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = <fs_sflight>-carrid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_connid>). IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = <fs_sflight>-connid. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_fldate>). IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = <fs_sflight>-fldate. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_price>). IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = <fs_s_flight>-price. ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rr_table = lr_table_ref.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_customize_alv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_customize_alv.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_customize( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->get_customized_flights( iv_carrid = lv_carrid ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    IF lv_count > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = lv_count ).
      " Cannot directly assert ALV display properties in unit test.
      " This test primarily verifies table creation and data filling.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der Feldkatalog eines dynamischen ALV zur Laufzeit angepasst werden kann, um Spaltenüberschriften zu ändern (`coltext`) oder Spalten auszublenden (`no_out`). Diese Flexibilität ist entscheidend für die Erstellung von ALV-Berichten, die sich an unterschiedliche Benutzeranforderungen oder Konfigurationen anpassen müssen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, ALV, Customization, Field Catalog, CL_ALV_TABLE_CREATE, Column Properties

Instructions: Berechne die Summe und den Durchschnitt des Flugpreises aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Nutze die `CALCULATE` Anweisung mit `SUM` und `AVG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_aggregates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      EXPORTING
        ev_total_price TYPE s_price
        ev_average_price TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_aggregates.
    CALCULATE SUM( price ) AS total_price,
              AVG( price ) AS average_price
      FROM it_flights
      INTO (ev_total_price, ev_average_price).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregates.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_flights,
          lv_total_price TYPE s_price,
          lv_average_price TYPE s_price.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    lo_cut->calculate_aggregates( EXPORTING it_flights = lt_flights
                                  IMPORTING ev_total_price = lv_total_price
                                            ev_average_price = lv_average_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '600.00' msg = 'Total price incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average_price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Average price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CALCULATE` Anweisung (ABAP 7.52+) ermöglicht es, Aggregationen wie SUM und AVG direkt auf interne Tabellen anzuwenden, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `REDUCE`-Ausdrücke, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: CALCULATE, SUM, AVG, Internal Tables

Instructions: Füge einer internen Tabelle eine neue Spalte hinzu, die den Gesamtpreis (Flugpreis * Anzahl Passagiere) berechnet.
hint: Nutze `CALCULATE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und `VALUE` um eine neue Tabelle mit der berechneten Spalte zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_total_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES tt_flights_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             price      TYPE s_price,
             passengers TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES tt_flights_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_total) TYPE tt_flights_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_total_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rt_flights_with_total = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                     ( ls_flight
                                       total_price = ls_flight-price * ls_flight-passengers ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA: lt_flights_in TYPE zcl_flight_total_price=>tt_flights_in.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' passengers = 2 ) TO lt_flights_in.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '200.00' passengers = 1 ) TO lt_flights_in.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_total_price( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_out) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights_in ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights_out ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights_out[ 1 ]-total_price exp = '200.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights_out[ 2 ]-total_price exp = '200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine neue, wobei neue Spalten berechnet oder bestehende modifiziert werden können. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und effizienter als eine explizite Schleife.
keywords: CALCULATE, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittswert einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: `REDUCE` kann für Aggregationen verwendet werden, indem man eine Summe und einen Zähler akkumuliert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average.
    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_data IN it_data NEXT s = s + ls_data-value ).
    rv_average = lv_sum / lines( it_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE f.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER zcl_filter_reduce_avg=>tt_flights FROM it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights NEXT s = s + ls_flight-price ).
    rv_average_price = lv_sum / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt der durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Dies erfordert eine zweistufige Aggregation, z.B. zuerst `FOR GROUPS` für die Durchschnittspreise pro Fluggesellschaft, dann `REDUCE` für den Gesamtdurchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_of_avgs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_of_carrier_averages
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_overall_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_of_avgs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_of_carrier_averages.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_overall_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_carrier_averages) = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        price = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + ls_group_flight-price ) / lines( GROUP ls_flight ) ) ).

    IF lt_carrier_averages IS INITIAL.
      rv_overall_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum_of_averages) = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_avg IN lt_carrier_averages NEXT s = s + ls_avg-price ).
    rv_overall_average = lv_sum_of_averages / lines( lt_carrier_averages ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_avg_of_avgs FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_of_avgs.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_avg_of_avgs=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_of_avgs( ).
    DATA(lv_overall_average) = lo_cut->get_average_of_carrier_averages( lt_flights ).

    " LH average: (100+200)/2 = 150
    " AA average: (50+150)/2 = 100
    " Overall average: (150+100)/2 = 125
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_overall_average exp = 125.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_avg_of_avgs=>tt_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_of_avgs( ).
    DATA(lv_overall_average) = lo_cut->get_average_of_carrier_averages( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_overall_average exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_carrier.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_avg_of_avgs=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_of_avgs( ).
    DATA(lv_overall_average) = lo_cut->get_average_of_carrier_averages( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_overall_average exp = 150.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS` (ABAP 7.55+) und `REDUCE` ermöglicht komplexe, mehrstufige Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen. Zuerst werden die Daten nach Fluggesellschaft gruppiert und der Durchschnitt pro Gruppe berechnet. Anschließend wird der Durchschnitt dieser Gruppendurchschnitte ermittelt. Dies ist ein sehr fortgeschrittener und funktionaler Ansatz.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, AVERAGE, Internal Tables, Nested Aggregation

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug den Flugpreis um 10% erhöht und zusätzlich den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis aller Flüge der gleichen Fluggesellschaft als Referenzspalte enthält.
hint: Zuerst die durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft berechnen, dann `FOR` Ausdruck mit `VALUE` verwenden, um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren und die Werte hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES tt_flights_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid          TYPE s_conn_id,
             original_price  TYPE s_price,
             increased_price TYPE s_price,
             avg_carrier_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES tt_flights_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights_with_avg
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flights_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights_with_avg.
    DATA: lt_carrier_avg_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF
          BEGIN OF HASHED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid,
            carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
            avg_price TYPE s_price,
          END OF HASHED TABLE.

    IF it_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      CALCULATE AVG( price ) AS avg_price
        FROM it_flights
        GROUP BY carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_carrier_avg_prices.
    ENDIF.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                      LET lv_avg_price = lt_carrier_avg_prices[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-avg_price IN
                                      ( carrid          = ls_flight-carrid,
                                        connid          = ls_flight-connid,
                                        original_price  = ls_flight-price,
                                        increased_price = ls_flight-price * '1.10',
                                        avg_carrier_price = lv_avg_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights_in TYPE zcl_flight_transform_avg=>tt_flights_in.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights_in.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights_in.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_flights_in.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transform_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights_with_avg( lt_flights_in ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_flight1) = lt_transformed[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_flight1-original_price exp = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_flight1-increased_price exp = '110.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_flight1-avg_carrier_price exp = '150.00' ). " (100+200)/2

    DATA(ls_aa_flight1) = lt_transformed[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_flight1-original_price exp = '50.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_flight1-increased_price exp = '55.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_flight1-avg_carrier_price exp = '50.00' ). " Only one AA flight
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights_in TYPE zcl_flight_transform_avg=>tt_flights_in.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transform_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights_with_avg( lt_flights_in ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_transformed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die `CALCULATE`-Anweisung (ABAP 7.52+) für eine Voraggregation (Durchschnittspreise pro Fluggesellschaft) mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `VALUE` (ABAP 7.40+) für die Transformation der ursprünglichen Tabelle. Der `LET`-Ausdruck innerhalb des `FOR` ermöglicht es, Zwischenergebnisse (hier: den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis der Fluggesellschaft) zu verwenden, um neue Spalten zu berechnen. Dies ist ein sehr mächtiges Muster für komplexe Datenmanipulationen.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die den Durchschnitt einer beliebigen numerischen Spalte einer internen Tabelle berechnet, deren Name dynamisch übergeben wird.
hint: Nutze RTTI (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) und dynamische Feldzugriffe (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_generic_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE decfloat16,
             field3 TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_generic_data.
    TYPES tt_generic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_generic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_average
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_generic_data
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_average.
    DATA: lv_sum TYPE decfloat34,
          lv_count TYPE i.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht gefunden oder nicht numerisch.|.
      ENDIF.

      " Check if the field is numeric
      IF <fs_value> IS NOT BOUND OR NOT <fs_value> IS NUMERIC.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' ist nicht numerisch.|.
      ENDIF.

      lv_sum = lv_sum + <fs_value>.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den gleitenden Durchschnitt (Moving Average) der letzten N Werte einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze eine Schleife mit `REDUCE` oder `SUM` auf einer Teilmenge der Tabelle für jeden Punkt des gleitenden Durchschnitts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_moving_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_moving_avg_result,
             id          TYPE i,
             value       TYPE i,
             moving_avg  TYPE f,
           END OF ty_moving_avg_result.
    TYPES tt_moving_avg_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_moving_avg_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_moving_average
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE tt_values
        iv_window_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_moving_avg_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_moving_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_moving_average.
    DATA: lv_sum TYPE i,
          lv_count TYPE i.

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(ls_value).
      DATA(lv_index) = sy-tabix.
      DATA(lv_start_index) = COND i( WHEN lv_index > iv_window_size THEN lv_index - iv_window_size + 1 ELSE 1 ).

      lv_sum = 0.
      lv_count = 0.

      LOOP AT it_values FROM lv_start_index TO lv_index INTO DATA(ls_window_value).
        lv_sum = lv_sum + ls_window_value-value.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE #( id = ls_value-id
                      value = ls_value-value
                      moving_avg = COND f( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum / lv_count ELSE 0 ) ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_grouped_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_grouped_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_cond_grouped_aggregates.
    CALCULATE AVG( price ) AS avg_price,
              COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      FROM it_flights
      WHERE price > iv_price_threshold
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne den gewichteten Durchschnitt einer numerischen Spalte, wobei die Gewichte in einer anderen Spalte der gleichen internen Tabelle gespeichert sind.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` um die Summe der Produkte (Wert * Gewicht) und die Summe der Gewichte zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_data,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             weight TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_weighted_data.
    TYPES tt_weighted_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weighted_average
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_weighted_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weighted_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_average.
    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_weighted_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum_products) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_data IN it_data NEXT s = s + ( ls_data-value * ls_data-weight ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum_weights) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT w = 0 FOR ls_data IN it_data NEXT w = w + ls_data-weight ).

    IF lv_sum_weights > 0.
      rv_weighted_average = lv_sum_products / lv_sum_weights.
    ELSE.
      rv_weighted_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Hier wird der `REDUCE`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) zweimal verwendet: einmal, um die Summe der Produkte aus Wert und Gewicht zu berechnen, und einmal, um die Summe der Gewichte zu ermitteln. CLASS zcl_db_cursor_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflights_chunked
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflights_chunked.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_package) PACKAGE SIZE @iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_flights_package TO rt_all_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reca_msg_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_reca_msg_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_and_display_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Flugdaten' iv_msgv2 = 'erfolgreich' iv_msgv3 = 'verarbeitet' ).

    IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
      lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler' iv_msgv2 = 'bei der Verarbeitung' iv_msgv3 = 'aufgetreten' ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_message_count = lo_message_list->get_message_count( ).

    " Ausgabe der gesammelten Nachrichten (für Demo-Zwecke)
    LOOP AT lo_message_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
      WRITE: / ls_message-msgty, ls_message-msgid, ls_message-msgno, ls_message-msgv1, ls_message-msgv2, ls_message-msgv3.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Datenbankoperation mit `OPEN CURSOR` durch, die nach einer bestimmten Anzahl von Zeilen oder bei einem Fehler den Cursor schließt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung und `CLOSE CURSOR` im `FINALLY`-Block.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` in Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_safe_close DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflights_with_safe_close
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_safe_close IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflights_with_safe_close.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid
            FROM sflight.

        DO iv_max_rows TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @DATA(ls_flight_key).
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_flight_key TO rt_flight_keys.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_safe_close FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_safe_close_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_close.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_cursor_safe_close( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->read_sflights_with_safe_close( iv_max_rows = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flight_keys ). " SFLIGHTS might be empty in test systems

    " To make it more robust, insert some test data if needed
    " INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = sy-datum ) ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = sy-datum ) ) ).
    " lt_flight_keys = lo_cut->read_sflights_with_safe_close( iv_max_rows = 1 ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_keys ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_safe_close_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_cursor_safe_close( ).
    " Simulate an error by trying to open a cursor on a non-existent table (not directly possible with SFLIGHT)
    " For a real test, one might mock the database layer or use a test double.
    " Here, we just ensure the FINALLY block is always executed.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->read_sflights_with_safe_close( iv_max_rows = 0 ). " This will just return empty, no error
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " If an error occurs, this path is taken
    ENDTRY.
    " The main point is that CLOSE CURSOR is called regardless of error.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CLOSE CURSOR` im `FINALLY`-Block eines `TRY...CATCH`-Blocks stellt sicher, dass der Datenbank-Cursor auch im Falle einer Ausnahme ordnungsgemäß geschlossen wird. Dies ist entscheidend für die Freigabe von Datenbankressourcen und die Vermeidung von Sperren oder Performance-Problemen. Inline-Deklarationen und moderne Fehlerbehandlung sind hier kombiniert.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, TRY...CATCH...FINALLY, Resource Management, Database

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Nachrichten mit `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY` sammelt und eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn kritische Fehlermeldungen vorhanden sind. Die Ausnahme soll die gesammelten Nachrichten enthalten.

CLASS zcx_critical_messages DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mo_message_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid        LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous      LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        io_message_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_critical_messages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mo_message_list = io_message_list.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reca_msg_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_data_ok TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_critical_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reca_msg_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    IF iv_data_ok = abap_false.
      lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgv1 = 'Kritischer Fehler' ).
      lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '004' iv_msgv1 = 'Warnung' ).
    ELSE.
      lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Daten erfolgreich' ).
    ENDIF.

    IF lo_message_list->has_errors( ) = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_critical_messages
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_critical_messages=>default_text
          io_message_list = lo_message_list.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die von einem bestimmten Carrier durchgeführt werden, und sammeln Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dafür eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE`-Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Syntax `FOR <wa> IN <itab> WHERE <cond>`. Die Zieltabelle kann direkt mit `VALUE` initialisiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid
                                     fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS mithilfe des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator kann verwendet werden, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_reduce_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE sflight_tab_type(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0019' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 150 )
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_test_data.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 250 msg = 'Die Gesamtzahl der Sitze sollte 250 sein.' ).
    DELETE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_test_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Berechnungen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung zusammenzufassen, was den Code kürzer und wartungsfreundlicher macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

hint: Der `COND`-Operator funktioniert ähnlich wie ein `CASE`-Statement, aber für die Zuweisung von Werten.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_occupied TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seats_max      TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = COND decfloat34(
                                 WHEN iv_seats_max > 0 THEN ( iv_seats_occupied / iv_seats_max ) * 100
                                 ELSE 0 ).

    rv_status_text = COND string(
                       WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 90 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
                       WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 50 THEN 'Teilweise belegt'
                       ELSE 'Gering belegt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_it_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur (z.B. einer Zeile aus SFLIGHTS) zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte aus. Verwenden Sie dafür RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_analysis DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_sflight_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_data TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_sflight_structure.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_sflight_data ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(lv_component_name) = ls_component-name.
      DATA(lv_component_value) = SWITCH string(
                                   ls_component-type_descr->type_kind
                                   WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char THEN is_sflight_data-(lv_component_name)
                                   WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num THEN is_sflight_data-(lv_component_name)
                                   WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int THEN is_sflight_data-(lv_component_name)
                                   WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date THEN is_sflight_data-(lv_component_name) DATE = USER
                                   WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time THEN is_sflight_data-(lv_component_name) TIME = USER
                                   WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed THEN is_sflight_data-(lv_component_name)
                                   WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat THEN is_sflight_data-(lv_component_name)
                                   ELSE 'Nicht darstellbar' ).
      APPEND |{ lv_component_name }: { lv_component_value }| TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rtti_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_analysis( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight_test) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = sy-datum
      planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100
    ).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->analyze_sflight_structure( ls_sflight_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_components msg = 'Komponentenliste sollte nicht leer sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_components[ 1 ] exp = 'CARRID: LH' msg = 'CARRID sollte gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_components[ 2 ] exp = 'CONNID: 400' msg = 'CONNID sollte gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_components[ 3 ] exp = |FLDATE: { sy-datum DATE = USER }| msg = 'FLDATE sollte gefunden werden.' ).

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die Analyse von Datentypen und -strukturen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme, Frameworks oder Tools. Die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` in Kombination mit dem `SWITCH`-Operator für die dynamische Wertauslesung demonstriert moderne und flexible Programmierung.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, Dynamic Programming, SWITCH, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellennamen (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') liest und die ersten N Zeilen zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie dynamisches Open SQL und RTTI.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT * FROM (<table_name>)` mit `UP TO <n> ROWS` und RTTI zur Typbeschreibung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_up_to_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ) ).

    CREATE DATA rt_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rt_data->* TO <lt_data>.

    TRY.
        SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) UP TO iv_up_to_rows ROWS
          INTO TABLE <lt_data>.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_dyn_sql_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_read_table( ).

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_sflight> msg = 'Tabelle sollte Daten enthalten.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflight> ) exp = 5 msg = 'Es sollten 5 Zeilen gelesen werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existent_table.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->read_dynamic_table( iv_table_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Ausnahme cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error erwartet.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Ausnahme erfolgreich abgefangen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von dynamischem Open SQL (`FROM (iv_table_name)`) mit RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_NAME`) zur Laufzeit. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature für generische Programme, die mit beliebigen Tabellenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `CREATE DATA` ist hierbei unerlässlich.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Open SQL, RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, FIELD-SYMBOLS, CREATE DATA

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Carrier-ID und Flugdatum und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie dafür den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `FOR`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_group.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid, fldate = ls_group-fldate ) ASCENDING
                                   ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                     fldate = ls_group-fldate
                                     flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE sflight_tab_type(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0019' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0020' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0021' fldate = sy-datum + 1 )
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_group( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 Gruppen gefunden werden.' ).

    DATA(ls_group_lh_today) = lt_grouped[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' fldate = sy-datum ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_lh_today-flight_count exp = 3 msg = 'LH heute sollte 3 Flüge haben.' ).

    DATA(ls_group_aa_today) = lt_grouped[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' fldate = sy-datum ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_aa_today-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'AA heute sollte 1 Flug haben.' ).

    DELETE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_test_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`-Ausdruck ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature für die Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Gruppierungslogik in einer einzigen Anweisung zu implementieren, was den Code extrem kompakt und effizient macht. `GROUP SIZE` liefert dabei direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe.
keywords: FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

solution:
CLASS zcl_dummy_appointment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_appointment_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id          TYPE string,
             date        TYPE d,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mapped_appointment.

    METHODS map_appointments
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_dummy_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mapped_appointments) TYPE tt_mapped_appointment.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_appointments.
    rt_mapped_appointments = VALUE #( FOR appointment IN it_appointments
                                       ( id          = appointment->id
                                         date        = appointment->date
                                         status_text = COND string(
                                                         WHEN appointment->get_status( ) = 'OPEN' THEN 'Offen'
                                                         WHEN appointment->get_status( ) = 'CLOSED' THEN 'Geschlossen'
                                                         WHEN appointment->get_status( ) = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'Abgesagt'

      IF lo_appointment->get_date( ) < iv_cutoff_date.
        lo_appointment->set_status( 'CLOSED' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_appointment_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_appointment_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_unique_appointment.
    IF NOT LINE_EXISTS( ct_appointments WHERE get_id( ) = io_new_appointment->get_id( ) ).

      rv_added = abap_true.
    ELSE.

  METHOD test_add_unique_appointment.
    DATA: lt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_dummy_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_existing_appointment) = NEW zcl_dummy_appointment( iv_id = 'O002' iv_date = '20260116' iv_description = 'Existing' iv_status = 'OPEN' ).

    DATA(lo_duplicate_appointment) = NEW zcl_dummy_appointment( iv_id = 'O002' iv_date = '20260117' iv_description = 'Duplicate' iv_status = 'OPEN' ).

INTO TABLE` ist die moderne und sichere Art, Einträge in interne Tabellen hinzuzufügen und dabei Duplikate zu vermeiden. `LINE_EXISTS` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel prüft effizient, ob ein Eintrag bereits existiert, bevor der `INSERT` ausgeführt wird. Dies ist eine klare und performante Alternative zu älteren Methoden mit `READ TABLE` und `SY-SUBRC` Prüfungen.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, LINE_EXISTS, IF

ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ideal für die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle. Hier wird es verwendet, um Dateinamen mit einem Komma zu verketten, wobei `COND` eine elegante Behandlung des ersten Elements ermöglicht.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Schnittstelle für eine Datenquelle und implementieren Sie diese in einer Klasse, die Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) liefert. Verwenden Sie Aliase für die Schnittstellenmethoden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE` und `ALIASES` für die Methoden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_source.
  METHODS get_data
    IMPORTING iv_max_rows TYPE i OPTIONAL
    RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
  ALIASES get_flights FOR get_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_source.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_source~get_data.
    IF iv_max_rows IS SUPPLIED AND iv_max_rows > 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @rt_data UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @rt_data UP TO 10 ROWS.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_interface_implementation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_implementation.
    DATA lo_data_source TYPE REF TO zif_data_source.
    lo_data_source = NEW zcl_sflight_source( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_data_source->get_flights( iv_max_rows = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Interfaces fördert die lose Kopplung und ermöglicht polymorphes Verhalten. `ALIASES` verbessern die Lesbarkeit und ermöglichen es, Schnittstellenmethoden mit aussagekräftigeren Namen in der implementierenden Klasse aufzurufen, ohne die Schnittstellendefinition zu ändern. Die Inline-Deklaration `@DATA` und die neue Open SQL Syntax sind weitere moderne Elemente.
keywords: INTERFACE, ALIASES, Object Orientation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, wobei die Flugnummer als String formatiert ist. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    METHODS transform_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_transformed_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                     connid = |{ ls_sflight-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_for_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_transformation.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_sflight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` können neue Tabellen oder Strukturen direkt initialisiert und gefüllt werden. String-Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine moderne und lesbare Art der String-Formatierung.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, String Templates, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze (SEATSMAX) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ...` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats_lh) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_seats( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats_aa) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_seats( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total_seats_lh exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total_seats_aa exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_seats_lh > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er initialisiert einen Akkumulator (`INIT sum = 0`) und wendet dann eine Operation (`NEXT sum = sum + ...`) auf jedes Element der Tabelle an, was zu einem einzigen Ergebnis führt. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu klassischen LOOP-Anweisungen mit expliziter Summenbildung.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'UA') und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen (z.B. > 100) zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND
                                          seatsocc < ( seatsmax - iv_min_free_seats ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_expression.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_free_seats = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` und `DELETE ... WHERE ...` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich. Die Verwendung von `USING KEY primary_key` ist optional, kann aber die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessern.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Filtering, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'SQ') und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie die neue Open SQL Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration.

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit vordefinierten Flugdaten und erstellen Sie eine Instanz einer Klasse. Verwenden Sie Konstruktor-Ausdrücke (`VALUE` und `NEW`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...)` für Tabellen und `NEW #()` für Objekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_constructor_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_simple_flight.
    METHODS get_initial_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simple_flight.
    METHODS create_instance
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_constructor_expr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_constructor_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_instance.
    ro_instance = NEW #( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_constructor_expressions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_expressions.
    DATA(lo_test_obj) = NEW zcl_constructor_expr( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = lo_test_obj->get_initial_flights( ).
    DATA(lo_new_instance) = lo_test_obj->create_instance( ).

Das `#`-Zeichen steht dabei für den Typ des Zielobjekts, der vom Compiler abgeleitet wird. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Übersichtlichkeit.
keywords: VALUE, NEW, Constructor Expressions, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die sich ketten lassen (Method Chaining), um eine Reihe von Operationen auf einem Objekt auszuführen.
hint: Methoden müssen `ME` zurückgeben, um chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_ops.
    METHODS add_value IMPORTING iv_add TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_ops.
    METHODS multiply_value IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_ops.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_value.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_factor.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_chainable_ops( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->set_value( 5 )->add_value( 3 )->multiply_value( 2 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 ). " (5 + 3) * 2 = 16
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenketten) ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede 'chainable' Methode eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgibt. Es führt zu einem flüssigeren, lesbareren Code, der oft als 'Fluent API' bezeichnet wird.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent API

                                WHEN 'A' THEN 'Abflug bereit'

                                ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).

ENDCASE` für die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Codezeilen, insbesondere bei mehreren Bedingungen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage nach einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt. Verwenden Sie die moderne Datumskalkulation.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit (RTTI) und geben Sie den Namen des Typs zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `GET_DATA_TYPE_HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_type_name
      IMPORTING ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.

Instructions: Definiere Status-Konstanten in einer Klasse und summiere nur die Werte aus einer internen Tabelle, die einem dieser Status entsprechen. Verwende `CLASS-CONSTANTS` und eine `FOR` Schleife mit `SUM`.
