Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Tabellentypnamen und fülle sie mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF (type_name)` und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table)    TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp>  TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Assuming the table type is SFLIGHT for demonstration
      " In a real scenario, you'd use RTTI to get component info
      IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
        CREATE DATA <fs_line> TYPE sflight.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
        IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_comp> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
        IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_comp> = '0400'. ENDIF.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
        IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_comp> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
        IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_comp> = '0017'. ENDIF.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
      ENDIF.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften in der `SFLIGHT` Tabelle, ohne die Datenbank zu lesen, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit einer lokalen Hash-Tabelle (`HASH h = VALUE hash_table( )`) um bereits gesehene Werte zu verfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_distinct_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_distinct_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_distinct_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distinct_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_distinct_carriers.
    TYPES: ty_seen_carriers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    rv_distinct_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
           seen_carriers = VALUE ty_seen_carriers( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( NOT line_exists( seen_carriers[ flight-carrid ] ) )
      NEXT seen_carriers = VALUE ty_seen_carriers( BASE seen_carriers ( flight-carrid ) ),
           count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_distinct_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_distinct_count.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_distinct_counter=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_distinct_counter=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'DL'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_distinct_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_distinct_carriers( it_flights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 4 msg = 'Should count 4 distinct carriers' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    lv_count = lo_cut->count_distinct_carriers( it_flights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 1 msg = 'Should count 1 distinct carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese `REDUCE`-Anweisung zählt effizient eindeutige Werte in einer internen Tabelle. Durch die Verwendung einer lokalen Hash-Tabelle (`seen_carriers`) innerhalb von `REDUCE` wird der Overhead minimiert und eine schnelle Überprüfung auf Duplikate ermöglicht. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und performante Art, solche Zählungen durchzuführen.
keywords: COUNT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Hash Table, Distinct Values, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine Struktur und fülle ein Feld mit einem Wert, wobei der Feldname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` für die Struktur und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_struct
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_type_name TYPE string
        iv_field_name       TYPE string
        iv_field_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_struct)    TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_struct.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field>  TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rr_struct TYPE (iv_struct_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_struct->* TO <fs_struct>.

    IF <fs_struct> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        TRY.
            <fs_field> = iv_field_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Handle conversion error
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für hochflexible Anwendungen.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Flüge, bei denen die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) größer ist als die Hälfte der maximalen Sitze (`maxseats`), unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit einer Bedingung, die auf einer Berechnung basiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             maxseats TYPE sflight-maxseats,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_high_ratio_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_high_ratio_flights.
    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( flight-seatsocc > ( flight-maxseats / 2 ) )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_high_ratio_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_ratio_count.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_flight_occupancy_counter=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_flight_occupancy_counter=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 100. ls_sflight-maxseats = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights. " 100 > 75 -> YES
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 50.  ls_sflight-maxseats = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights. " 50 > 75 -> NO
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 200. ls_sflight-maxseats = 300. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights. " 200 > 150 -> YES
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 10.  ls_sflight-maxseats = 20.  APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights. " 10 > 10 -> NO

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_high_ratio_flights( it_flights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Should count 2 flights with high occupancy ratio' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'BA'. ls_sflight-seatsocc = 10. ls_sflight-maxseats = 100. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    lv_count = lo_cut->count_high_ratio_flights( it_flights = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Should count 0 flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ermöglicht komplexe Bedingungen in der `WHERE`-Klausel, einschließlich Berechnungen zwischen Feldern. Dies macht den Code sehr ausdrucksstark und vermeidet manuelle Schleifen für solche Zählungen.
keywords: COUNT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Flüge in der `SFLIGHT` Tabelle, die in einem bestimmten Zeitraum liegen, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, die Datumsbereiche prüft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_date_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_in_period
      IMPORTING
        id_start_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        id_end_date   TYPE sflight-fldate
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_date_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_in_period.
    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( flight-fldate BETWEEN id_start_date AND id_end_date )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_date_period_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_period_count.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_flight_date_counter=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_flight_date_counter=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight-fldate = '20251120'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-fldate = '20251125'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-fldate = '20251130'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-fldate = '20251205'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_date_counter( ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_flights_in_period(
      id_start_date = '20251120'
      id_end_date   = '20251130'
      it_flights    = lt_sflights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 msg = 'Should count 3 flights in period' ).

    lv_count = lo_cut->count_flights_in_period(
      id_start_date = '20251201'
      id_end_date   = '20251231'
      it_flights    = lt_sflights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 1 msg = 'Should count 1 flight in December' ).

    lv_count = lo_cut->count_flights_in_period(
      id_start_date = '20250101'
      id_end_date   = '20250131'
      it_flights    = lt_sflights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Should count 0 flights in January' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung mit der `WHERE`-Klausel, die den `BETWEEN`-Operator für Datumsbereiche verwendet, ist eine sehr elegante und effiziente Methode, um bedingte Zählungen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Dies ist ein Beispiel für moderne, deklarative Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: COUNT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Date/Time, BETWEEN, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine Referenz auf eine Variable eines zur Laufzeit bekannten Typs und weise ihr einen Wert zu.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE (type_name)` und `ASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_ref_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_assign_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name  TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_ref_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_assign_dynamic_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE (iv_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          <fs_data> = iv_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_dynamic_data_ref_assign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_data_ref_assign( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_string> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN lr_string->* TO <fs_string>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_string> exp = 'Dynamic String' msg = 'Should assign string value' ).

    DATA(lr_int) = lo_cut->create_and_assign_dynamic_data( iv_type_name = 'I' iv_value = '999' ).

    DATA(lr_int_fail) = lo_cut->create_and_assign_dynamic_data( iv_type_name = 'I' iv_value = 'ABC' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_int_fail> TYPE i.
    ASSIGN lr_int_fail->* TO <fs_int_fail>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_int_fail> exp = 0 msg = 'Should handle conversion error (default value)' ).

explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von Datenreferenzen und die Zuweisung von Werten zu den referenzierten Datenobjekten. `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE (type_name)` ermöglicht die Typspezifikation zur Laufzeit, und `ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_data>` ist der moderne Weg, um auf den Inhalt der Referenz zuzugreifen und ihn zu manipulieren.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen Code-128-Barcode als BMP-Grafik (XSTRING) für einen gegebenen Text. Der Barcode soll den Text 'HELLO_ABAP_WORLD' darstellen.

CLASS zcl_barcode_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_barcode_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

          lv_error_message    TYPE string.

        ).
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_barcode_error).
        lv_error_message = lx_barcode_error->get_text( ).
        " In a real scenario, log the error or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lv_error_message TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Datentyp, die Länge und die Anzahl der Dezimalstellen einer beliebigen Variablen zur Laufzeit mittels RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und casten Sie das Ergebnis auf `CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_type_info,
             kind        TYPE string,
             length      TYPE i,
             decimals    TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_type_info.

    METHODS get_type_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_type_info) TYPE ty_type_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_info.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lo_elemdescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    rs_type_info-kind = lo_typedescr->type_kind.
    rs_type_info-length = lo_typedescr->length.
    rs_type_info-description = lo_typedescr->get_relative_name( ).

    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_dec OR
       lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed OR
       lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
      lo_elemdescr ?= lo_typedescr.
      rs_type_info-decimals = lo_elemdescr->decimals.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_integer_type FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_string_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA: lv_test_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'.
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_type_info( REF #( lv_test_string ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-length exp = 0 ). " String length is dynamic
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-decimals exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_integer_type.

    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_type_info( REF #( lv_test_int ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-length exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-decimals exp = 0 ).

  METHOD test_decimal_type.

    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_type_info( REF #( lv_test_dec ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-length exp = 8 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-decimals exp = 2 ).

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF` liefert ein Typ-Deskriptor-Objekt, von dem spezifische Informationen wie Typ-Art, Länge und Dezimalstellen (nach Cast auf `CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR`) abgefragt werden können. Dies ist nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF, Type Information, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, die die gleiche Struktur wie die Standardtabelle `SFLIGHT` hat, und fügen Sie einen Eintrag hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_NAME` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line         TYPE REF TO data.

    " 1. Get structure description of SFLIGHT
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " 2. Create a table type description based on the structure
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    " 3. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    " 4. Create a dynamic work area (line) for the table
    CREATE DATA lr_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

    " 5. Assign values to the dynamic work area
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight_line> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_sflight_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight_line>-carrid   = 'LH'.
      <fs_sflight_line>-connid   = '0400'.
      <fs_sflight_line>-fldate   = sy-datum.
      <fs_sflight_line>-planetype = 'A320'.
      " ... fill other fields as needed

      " 6. Append the line to the dynamic table
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
      ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_sflight_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' act = lr_table IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' act = lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_table ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_line_type( ).
    DATA(lo_sflight_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Line type should match SFLIGHT' act = lo_line_descr->get_relative_name( ) exp = lo_sflight_descr->get_relative_name( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI und `CREATE DATA` dynamisch interne Tabellen zur Laufzeit erzeugt. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Es demonstriert die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` sowie Field-Symbols für den Zugriff auf die dynamisch erzeugten Daten.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle nach Flügen mit der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' und transformieren Sie die Ergebnisse in eine neue Tabelle, die nur `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` enthält, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( ... )`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight

CLASS zcl_for_operator_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_data = VALUE tt_sflight_filtered(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight_data WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).

ENDCLASS.

Er kombiniert Schleifen, Filterung (`WHERE`) und die Transformation von Daten in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft performanterem Code im Vergleich zu klassischen `LOOP AT` mit `IF`-Bedingungen und `APPEND`.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der `PRICE`-Spalte aus einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHT`-Daten, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') enthält, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ...` mit einer `INIT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_price
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT lv_sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flight_data WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT lv_sum = lv_sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_operator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_operator.
    DATA: lt_prices TYPE zcl_reduce_operator_demo=>tt_flight_price.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_reduce_operator_demo=>ty_flight_price( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_prices.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_reduce_operator_demo=>ty_flight_price( carrid = 'AA' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_prices.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_reduce_operator_demo=>ty_flight_price( carrid = 'LH' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_prices.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flight_data = lt_prices iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for LH incorrect' act = lv_total exp = '250.00' ).

    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flight_data = lt_prices iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for AA incorrect' act = lv_total exp = '200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die funktionale Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle zu durchlaufen und einen einzelnen Wert (z.B. eine Summe, einen Zähler oder ein komplexeres Ergebnis) zu berechnen, ohne explizite Schleifen und Zwischenvariablen deklarieren zu müssen. Dies macht den Code sehr prägnant und ausdrucksstark.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Sum, Internal Table, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT`-Daten nach `CARRID` und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `LOOP AT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(KEY)`. Die Aggregation kann mit `COUNT(*)` erfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_group_member>).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lv_count
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0200' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0600' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_sflight_mock ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 3 entries' act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_counts[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH flight count incorrect' act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_counts[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA flight count incorrect' act = ls_aa_count-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Erweiterung im `LOOP AT`-Statement (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen direkt im Schleifenkonstrukt. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Alternative zu manuellen Sortierungen und Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`. Es vereinfacht die Gruppierung und Aggregation erheblich und macht den Code lesbarer und effizienter.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie Field-Symbols und die `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO ...`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die dynamische Feldzugriffsmöglichkeit mittels Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...` ist ein Kernstück der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP. Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere funktionale Ausdrücke, um eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `SFLIGHT` zu erhalten, die nur eindeutige Einträge enthält und alphabetisch sortiert ist.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`, `DISTINCT` und `SORT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sorted_unique_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_unique_carriers.
    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflight_data
                           ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).
    " The target table type SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY automatically handles sorting and uniqueness
    " If target was standard table, explicit SORT and DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES would be needed
    " or using REDUCE with a HASHED TABLE for uniqueness.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHOD test_chaining_carriers.
      DATA: lt_sflight_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0200' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.
      APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0600' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_mock.

      DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_chaining( ).
      DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = lo_cut->get_sorted_unique_carriers( lt_sflight_mock ).

      DATA(lt_expected_carriers) = VALUE zcl_functional_chaining=>rt_carriers(
        ( 'AA' ) ( 'BA' ) ( 'LH' ) ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of unique carriers incorrect' act = lines( lt_unique_carriers ) exp = 3 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Unique carriers list incorrect' act = lt_unique_carriers exp = lt_expected_carriers ).
    ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit funktionaler Ausdrücke in ABAP, indem es `FOR` verwendet, um eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften zu extrahieren. Die Verwendung einer `SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY` als Zieltyp stellt automatisch sicher, dass die Liste sortiert ist und nur eindeutige Einträge enthält. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu verarbeiten und zu aggregieren, die den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: Functional Programming, FOR, Internal Table, Unique, Sorted, SFLIGHT

CLASS zcl_data_aging_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_temperature_counts,
             hot_count  TYPE i,
             warm_count TYPE i,
             cold_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_temperature_counts.

    METHODS aggregate_temperature_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_object_ids TYPE string_table
        io_aging_service TYPE REF TO zif_data_aging_service
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_counts) TYPE ty_temperature_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_temperature_counts.
    rs_counts = REDUCE ty_temperature_counts(
      INIT hot_c  = 0
           warm_c = 0
           cold_c = 0
      FOR id IN it_object_ids
      DATA(ls_temp_info) = io_aging_service->get_data_temperature( id )
      NEXT
        hot_c  = hot_c  + COND #( WHEN ls_temp_info-temperature = 'HOT'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
        warm_c = warm_c + COND #( WHEN ls_temp_info-temperature = 'WARM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
        cold_c = cold_c + COND #( WHEN ls_temp_info-temperature = 'COLD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_action_decider IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_temp_info) = io_aging_service->get_data_temperature( iv_object_id ).

      ls_temp_info-temperature
      WHEN 'HOT'  THEN 'Process Immediately'
      WHEN 'WARM' THEN 'Monitor and Archive Soon'

      ELSE 'Unknown Action'

INTERFACE zif_data_aging_service PUBLIC.

    ).
    rs_temp_info-is_aged = COND abap_bool(

CLASS zcl_flight_aging_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_aging,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             temperature TYPE string,
             is_aged     TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_sflight_aging.
    TYPES tt_sflight_aging TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_aging WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_aging_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        io_aging_service TYPE REF TO zif_data_aging_service
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_aging) TYPE tt_sflight_aging.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aging_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_aging_status.
    rt_sflight_aging = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight_data
                                 LET lv_object_id = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }{ ls_sflight-connid }|
                                     ls_temp_info = io_aging_service->get_data_temperature( lv_object_id )
                                 IN
                                 ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight EXCEPT carrid connid fldate )
                                   carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   connid      = ls_sflight-connid
                                   fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate
                                   temperature = ls_temp_info-temperature
                                   is_aged     = ls_temp_info-is_aged ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_aging_status.
    DATA(lo_aging_service) = NEW zcl_data_aging_mock_service( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_aging_processor( ).

    DATA lt_sflight_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_test.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflight_test.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->get_sflight_aging_status( it_sflight_data = lt_sflight_test io_aging_service = lo_aging_service ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-temperature exp = 'HOT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_aged exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-temperature exp = 'WARM' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-is_aged exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-temperature exp = 'COLD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-is_aged exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch anhand ihres Namens auf. Die Methode soll einen String als Parameter akzeptieren und einen modifizierten String zurückgeben (z.B. in Großbuchstaben umwandeln).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)` und `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_method_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS to_upper
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS to_lower
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE string.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).

    <fs_data> = iv_input_string.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF <fs_data> INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    CLEAR ls_parameter.
    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF rv_output_string INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    TRY.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_sflight_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS set_field_value
      CHANGING
        cs_data     TYPE ty_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'ERROR: Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error if new_value cannot be assigned to field type
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen SELECT-Befehl auf der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` aus, wobei die WHERE-Klausel dynamisch aus einer Liste von Bedingungen generiert wird. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_and_generate_where_clause` zur sicheren Generierung.
hint: `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_and_generate_where_clause` hilft bei der Validierung und Generierung von dynamischen WHERE-Klauseln, um SQL-Injections zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_result,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_result.
    TYPES ty_sflight_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_sflight_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_conditions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE ty_sflight_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_sflight_dynamically.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string,
          lt_sflight_db   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_and_generate_where_clause(
          EXPORTING
            i_tab_name     = 'SFLIGHT'
            i_where_clauses = it_conditions
          IMPORTING
            e_where_clause = lv_where_clause
        ).

        IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
            FROM sflight
            INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_db
            WHERE (lv_where_clause).
        ELSE.
          " If no valid WHERE clause, select all (or handle as error)
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
            FROM sflight
            INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_db.
        ENDIF.

        rt_sflight_data = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflight_db ).

    CATCH cx_abap_dyn_prg_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_prg_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid WHERE clause syntax
        MESSAGE lx_dyn_prg_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein Best Practice für dynamische Datenbankzugriffe in modernen ABAP-Anwendungen, die Benutzereingaben verarbeiten.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie ein Datenobjekt dynamisch basierend auf dem Typ einer vorhandenen internen Tabelle (z.B. einer Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHT`). Fügen Sie dann Daten in das dynamisch erzeugte Objekt ein.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_table_descr` und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_data_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_template_table TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data        TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        " Get type description of the template table
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_template_table ).

        " Create dynamic internal table based on the description
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        " Assign to field symbol to work with it
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_table>).

        IF <fs_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Fill the dynamic table with data from the template
          <fs_dynamic_table> = it_template_table.
        ENDIF.

        rr_dynamic_table = lr_data.

    CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle errors during RTTI or data creation
        CLEAR rr_dynamic_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Dynamic table should have 2 lines' ).

Mit `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` wird die Typbeschreibung einer vorhandenen Tabelle zur Laufzeit ermittelt. Anschließend wird mit `CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr` ein neues Datenobjekt desselben Typs dynamisch erzeugt. Dies ist extrem flexibel, wenn die Struktur der zu verarbeitenden Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. beim Import von externen Daten oder in generischen Tools.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines öffentlichen Attributs eines Objekts dynamisch mit RTTI. Das Objekt soll eine einfache Klasse mit mehreren Attributen sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_struct_descr` für die Attributinformationen und Field Symbols für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_my_data_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_id     TYPE i READ-ONLY,
          mv_name   TYPE string READ-ONLY,
          mv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1 READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_id     TYPE i
        iv_name   TYPE string
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_data_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_id = iv_id.
    me->mv_name = iv_name.
    me->mv_status = iv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attribute_value
      IMPORTING
        io_object       TYPE REF TO object
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_attribute_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attribute_value.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          ls_attribute    TYPE abap_compdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_attribute> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_attribute_type( iv_attribute_name ).

        " Get reference to the attribute
        ASSIGN (io_object->(iv_attribute_name)) TO <fs_attribute>.

        IF <fs_attribute> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_value = <fs_attribute>.
        ELSE.
          rv_value = 'ERROR: Attribute not found or not accessible'.
        ENDIF.

    CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_rtti_error).
        rv_value = |ERROR: RTTI failed - { lx_rtti_error->get_text( ) }|.
    CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        rv_value = |ERROR: Assignment failed - { lx_assign_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) dynamisch. Wenn das Flugdatum älter als ein Jahr ist, soll es als 'kalt' betrachtet und herausgefiltert werden. Nur 'heiße' Daten (Flugdatum innerhalb des letzten Jahres oder in der Zukunft) sollen zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer dynamisch berechneten Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_data_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_data_temperature
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight_table
        iv_days_threshold TYPE i " e.g., 365 for one year
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hot_data) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_data_temperature.
    DATA(lv_threshold_date) = sy-datum - iv_days_threshold.

    rt_hot_data = FILTER #( it_sflight_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate >= lv_threshold_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Datenfilterung mit dem `FILTER` Operator, der seit ABAP 7.40 verfügbar ist. Die 'Datentemperatur' wird hier durch einen dynamisch berechneten Schwellenwert (`lv_threshold_date`) simuliert. Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Syntax, um Elemente einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung auszuwählen. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um große Datenmengen vorzuverarbeiten, ähnlich wie es bei Data Aging-Strategien der Fall wäre, um nur relevante 'heiße' Daten zu verarbeiten.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (z.B. 'HOT' oder 'COLD') dynamisch Daten aus einer von zwei möglichen Tabellen (`SFLIGHT` oder einer simulierten Archivtabelle `Z_SFLIGHT_ARCHIVE`) liest.
hint: Verwenden Sie dynamische Tabellennamen in der `SELECT`-Anweisung. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Archivtabelle existiert oder simuliert wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_datasource_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_result,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_result.
    TYPES ty_sflight_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_data_by_temperature
      IMPORTING
        iv_data_temperature TYPE string " 'HOT' or 'COLD'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE ty_sflight_results.
ENDCLASS.

" Simulate an archive table if it doesn't exist
" This would typically be a real table in a productive system
DATA: BEGIN OF z_sflight_archive OCCURS 0,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF z_sflight_archive.

CLASS zcl_dyn_datasource_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_data_by_temperature.
    DATA: lv_table_name TYPE tabname.

    CASE iv_data_temperature.
      WHEN 'HOT'.
        lv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
      WHEN 'COLD'.
        lv_table_name = 'Z_SFLIGHT_ARCHIVE'. " Use simulated archive table
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default to HOT or raise error
        lv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
    ENDCASE.

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
          FROM (lv_table_name)
          INTO TABLE @rt_sflight_data
          UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., table not found
        MESSAGE lx_dyn_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) dynamisch. Für 'heiße' Daten (Flugdatum in der Zukunft oder nahe Vergangenheit, z.B. innerhalb der letzten 30 Tage) soll die Summe der Passagiere berechnet werden. Für 'kalte' Daten (Flugdatum weit in der Vergangenheit) soll der Durchschnitt der Passagiere berechnet werden. Die Aggregation soll pro Fluggesellschaft erfolgen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` oder `LOOP AT GROUP` in Kombination mit dynamischer Logik und dem `COND` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_data_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_result,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
             average_passengers TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_aggregated_result.
    TYPES ty_aggregated_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_by_data_temperature
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight_table
        iv_hot_threshold_days TYPE i " e.g., 30 days for hot data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE ty_aggregated_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_by_data_temperature.
    DATA(lv_hot_date_threshold) = sy-datum - iv_hot_threshold_days.

    rt_aggregated_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflight_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                  ( VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                             total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                                          FOR <fs_line> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                                                          WHERE ( <fs_line>-fldate >= lv_hot_date_threshold )
                                                                          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_line>-seatsocc )
                                             average_passengers = COND decfloat16(
                                                                    WHEN lines( FILTER #( GROUP ls_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate < lv_hot_date_threshold ) ) > 0
                                                                    THEN REDUCE decfloat16( INIT avg = 0
                                                                                           count = 0
                                                                                           FOR <fs_line> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                                                                           WHERE ( <fs_line>-fldate < lv_hot_date_threshold )
                                                                                           NEXT count = count + 1, avg = avg + <fs_line>-seatsocc ) / lines( FILTER #( GROUP ls_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate < lv_hot_date_threshold ) )
                                                                    ELSE 0
                                                                  )
                                           ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mixed_data_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_data_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = zcl_dyn_data_aggregation=>ty_sflight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum - 10 seatsocc = 50 ) " Hot
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum - 20 seatsocc = 60 ) " Hot
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum - 100 seatsocc = 30 ) " Cold
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '004' fldate = sy-datum - 5 seatsocc = 70 ) " Hot
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '005' fldate = sy-datum - 200 seatsocc = 40 ) " Cold
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '006' fldate = sy-datum - 250 seatsocc = 20 ) " Cold
    ).

    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_by_data_temperature( it_sflight_data = lt_sflight iv_hot_threshold_days = 30 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 aggregated entries' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-total_passengers exp = 110 msg = 'LH Hot sum should be 110' ). " 50 + 60
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-average_passengers exp = '30.00' msg = 'LH Cold average should be 30' ). " 30 / 1

    DATA(ls_aa_result) = lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-total_passengers exp = 70 msg = 'AA Hot sum should be 70' ). " 70
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-average_passengers exp = '30.00' msg = 'AA Cold average should be 30' ). " (40 + 20) / 2
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_only_hot_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_data_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = zcl_dyn_data_aggregation=>ty_sflight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum - 10 seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum - 20 seatsocc = 60 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_by_data_temperature( it_sflight_data = lt_sflight iv_hot_threshold_days = 30 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_aggregated[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-total_passengers exp = 110 msg = 'LH Hot sum should be 110' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-average_passengers exp = '0.00' msg = 'LH Cold average should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_only_cold_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_data_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = zcl_dyn_data_aggregation=>ty_sflight_table(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum - 100 seatsocc = 30 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '004' fldate = sy-datum - 120 seatsocc = 40 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_by_data_temperature( it_sflight_data = lt_sflight iv_hot_threshold_days = 30 ).

hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` für die dynamische Typdefinition und Field Symbols für den Datenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS project_table_by_field
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_projected_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD project_table_by_field.
    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_source_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_field_descr        TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr,
          lt_components         TYPE abap_compdescr_tab,
          ls_component          TYPE abap_compdescr,
          lo_projected_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_projected_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_projected_data     TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table>    TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line>     TYPE any,
                   <fs_source_field>    TYPE any,
                   <fs_projected_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_projected_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_projected_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        " 1. Get description of the source table and its line type
        lo_source_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
        lo_source_line_descr  ?= lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        " 2. Get description of the specific field
        lo_field_descr ?= lo_source_line_descr->get_component_type( iv_field_name ).

        " 3. Create description for the projected line type (single field)
        ls_component-name = iv_field_name.
        ls_component-type = lo_field_descr.
        INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.
        lo_projected_line_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

        " 4. Create description for the projected table type
        lo_projected_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
          p_line_type = lo_projected_line_descr
          p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
          p_unique = abap_false
        ).

        " 5. Create the dynamic projected table
        CREATE DATA lr_projected_data TYPE HANDLE lo_projected_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_projected_data->* TO <fs_projected_table>.

        " 6. Fill the projected table
        ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
        LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
          IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            CREATE DATA lr_projected_data TYPE HANDLE lo_projected_line_descr.
            ASSIGN lr_projected_data->* TO <fs_projected_line>.
            IF <fs_projected_line> IS ASSIGNED.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_projected_line> TO <fs_projected_field>.
              IF <fs_projected_field> IS ASSIGNED.
                <fs_projected_field> = <fs_source_field>.
                INSERT <fs_projected_line> INTO TABLE <fs_projected_table>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        rr_projected_table = lr_projected_data.

    CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_assign_error.
        " Handle errors
        CLEAR rr_projected_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und eine Liste von Feldnamen akzeptiert. Die Methode soll dann dynamisch eine neue interne Tabelle mit nur diesen spezifischen Feldern und deren Werten zurückgeben (ähnlich einer SQL-Projektion mit mehreren Feldern).
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` für die dynamische Typdefinition. Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` für die Zuweisung, falls die Feldnamen übereinstimmen, oder Field Symbols für den expliziten Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_multi_field_proj DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS project_table_by_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_field_names  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_projected_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_multi_field_proj IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD project_table_by_fields.
    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_source_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components         TYPE abap_compdescr_tab,
          ls_component          TYPE abap_compdescr,
          lo_projected_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_projected_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_projected_data     TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table>    TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line>     TYPE any,
                   <fs_projected_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_projected_line>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        " 1. Get description of the source table and its line type
        lo_source_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
        lo_source_line_descr  ?= lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        " 2. Build components for the projected line type
        LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
          TRY.
              ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
              ls_component-type ?= lo_source_line_descr->get_component_type( lv_field_name ).
              INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.
            CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
              " Skip invalid field names
          ENDTRY.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
          " No valid fields to project
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " 3. Create description for the projected line type
        lo_projected_line_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

        " 4. Create description for the projected table type
        lo_projected_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
          p_line_type = lo_projected_line_descr
          p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
          p_unique = abap_false
        ).

        " 5. Create the dynamic projected table
        CREATE DATA lr_projected_data TYPE HANDLE lo_projected_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_projected_data->* TO <fs_projected_table>.

        " 6. Fill the projected table using CORRESPONDING for matching fields
        ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
        LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
          CREATE DATA lr_projected_data TYPE HANDLE lo_projected_line_descr.
          ASSIGN lr_projected_data->* TO <fs_projected_line>.
          IF <fs_projected_line> IS ASSIGNED.
            " Use CORRESPONDING to copy matching fields
            <fs_projected_line> = CORRESPONDING #( <fs_source_line> MAPPING ( iv_field_name = lv_field_name FOR lv_field_name IN it_field_names ) ).
            INSERT <fs_projected_line> INTO TABLE <fs_projected_table>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        rr_projected_table = lr_projected_data.

    CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_assign_error.
        " Handle errors
        CLEAR rr_projected_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und einen Feldnamen als Schlüssel akzeptiert. Die Methode soll dann dynamisch eine Hash-Tabelle (Hashed Table) mit diesem Feld als eindeutigem Schlüssel aus der Quelltabelle erzeugen und zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr`) und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` für die dynamische Typdefinition einer Hashed Table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_hashed_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_hashed_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_key_field    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_hashed_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_hashed_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_hashed_table_dynamically.
    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_source_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_key_field_descr    TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr,
          lt_key_components     TYPE abap_keydescr_tab,
          ls_key_component      TYPE abap_keydescr,
          lo_hashed_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_hashed_data        TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table>  TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line>   TYPE any,
                   <fs_hashed_table>  TYPE HASHED TABLE.

    TRY.
        " 1. Get description of the source table and its line type
        lo_source_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
        lo_source_line_descr  ?= lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        " 2. Get description of the key field
        lo_key_field_descr ?= lo_source_line_descr->get_component_type( iv_key_field ).

        " 3. Define the key for the hashed table
        ls_key_component-name = iv_key_field.
        INSERT ls_key_component INTO TABLE lt_key_components.

        " 4. Create description for the hashed table type
        lo_hashed_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
          p_line_type = lo_source_line_descr
          p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed
          p_unique = abap_true
          p_key_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>keykind_user
          p_key_def = lt_key_components
        ).

        " 5. Create the dynamic hashed table
        CREATE DATA lr_hashed_data TYPE HANDLE lo_hashed_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_hashed_data->* TO <fs_hashed_table>.

        " 6. Fill the hashed table
        ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
        LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
          INSERT <fs_source_line> INTO TABLE <fs_hashed_table>.
        ENDLOOP.

        rr_hashed_table = lr_hashed_data.

    CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_assign_error cx_sy_table_line_duplicate.
        " Handle errors, e.g., duplicate key during insert
        CLEAR rr_hashed_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_table_to_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zip_sflights_to_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights.zip'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_table_to_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zip_sflights_to_file.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_content  TYPE string.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Prepare content for the file using string templates and REDUCE
    lv_content = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = |{ s }{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }, { <fs_sflight>-connid }, { <fs_sflight>-fldate }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      i_name    = 'sflights_data.txt'
      i_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_content )
    ).
    rv_xstring = lo_zip->get_zipped_xcontent( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entpacken Sie eine ZIP-Datei, die eine Textdatei enthält, und lesen Sie deren Inhalt zeilenweise in eine interne Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_unzip_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS unzip_file_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_content) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unzip_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD unzip_file_to_table.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
        DATA(lv_xcontent) = lo_zip->get( iv_filename ).
        DATA(lv_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_xcontent ).
        SPLIT lv_content AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE rt_content.
        DELETE rt_content WHERE table_line IS INITIAL. " Remove empty lines
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_zip_error EXPORTING previous = lx_zip_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_files DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_files IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

        i_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( <fs_file>-content )
      ).

    rv_xstring = lo_zip->get_zipped_xcontent( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_zip_filter_files DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_file_names
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_pattern     TYPE string " e.g., '*.txt'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_file_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_filter_files IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_file_names.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
        DATA(lt_all_files) = lo_zip->get_file_list( ).

        " Filter files based on pattern
        rt_file_names = VALUE string_table(
          FOR <fs_file> IN lt_all_files
          WHERE ( <fs_file>-name CP iv_pattern )
          ( <fs_file>-name )
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_zip_error EXPORTING previous = lx_zip_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Daten aus `sflight` an und fügen Sie eine berechnete Spalte hinzu, die die Differenz zwischen Maximal- und Normalgewicht anzeigt. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator zur Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit der berechneten Spalte unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_calc_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_calc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_calc_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_calc.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             max_w    TYPE sflight-max_w,
             actual_w TYPE sflight-actual_w,
             weight_diff TYPE sflight-max_w, " New calculated column
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    " Prepare data with calculated column using VALUE and FOR
    DATA(lt_sflights_ext) = VALUE tt_sflight_ext(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      (
        carrid    = <fs_sflight>-carrid,
        connid    = <fs_sflight>-connid,
        fldate    = <fs_sflight>-fldate,
        planetype = <fs_sflight>-planetype,
        max_w     = <fs_sflight>-max_w,
        actual_w  = <fs_sflight>-actual_w,

CLASS zcl_zip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_with_error.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->add(
          i_name    = 'non_existent_file.txt'
          i_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( 'Dummy content' )
        ).
        " Simulate an error by trying to add a file that might cause issues (e.g., invalid path/name)
        " For cl_abap_zip, direct 'file not found' on add is not typical as content is passed directly.
        " We'll simulate a scenario where get_zipped_xcontent might fail if content is too large or invalid.
        " A more realistic error would be during load/get if the ZIP is corrupt.
        DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_zip->get_zipped_xcontent( ).
        rv_error_message = 'No error occurred (simulated error not triggered)'.
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_zip_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie aggregierte Daten (z.B. Summe der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft) aus `sflight` in einem `cl_salv_table` an. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` Operator zur Datenaggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` oder `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.

CLASS zcl_salv_aggregated_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_aggregated_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Aggregate data using LOOP AT ... GROUP BY and REDUCE
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_agg(
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_group>-carrid
      ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid,
        total_passengers = REDUCE i(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP <fs_group>
          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsocc
        )
      )
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_salv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( CHANGING t_table = lt_aggregated_data ).
        lo_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_zip_csv_from_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_zip_csv_from_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_with_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Generate CSV header
    DATA(lv_csv_content) = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    lv_csv_content = lv_csv_content && REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = |{ s }{ <fs_sflight>-carrid };{ <fs_sflight>-connid };{ <fs_sflight>-fldate };{ <fs_sflight>-planetype };{ <fs_sflight>-seatsmax };{ <fs_sflight>-seatsocc }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      i_name    = 'sflights_data.csv'
      i_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_csv_content )
    ).
    rv_xstring = lo_zip->get_zipped_xcontent( ).

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip`, `SPLIT` und den `MAP` Operator für das Parsen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unzip_csv_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_parsed,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_parsed.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_parsed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_parsed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS unzip_csv_to_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_filename    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_parsed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unzip_csv_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD unzip_csv_to_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
        DATA(lv_xcontent) = lo_zip->get( iv_filename ).
        DATA(lv_csv_content) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_xcontent ).

        DATA(lt_csv_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
        SPLIT lv_csv_content AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_csv_lines.
        DELETE lt_csv_lines WHERE table_line IS INITIAL. " Remove empty lines
        DELETE lt_csv_lines INDEX 1. " Remove header line

        " Parse CSV lines into internal table using MAP
        rt_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight_parsed(
          FOR <fs_line> IN lt_csv_lines
          LET parts = VALUE string_table( )
              IN
              SPLIT <fs_line> AT ';' INTO TABLE parts
          IN
          ( carrid    = parts[ 1 ],
            connid    = parts[ 2 ],
            fldate    = parts[ 3 ],
            planetype = parts[ 4 ],
            seatsmax  = CONV #( parts[ 5 ] ),
            seatsocc  = CONV #( parts[ 6 ] ) )
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_zip_error EXPORTING previous = lx_zip_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unzip_csv_to_table.
    " Create a dummy ZIP file content with CSV
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                         `LH;0400;20250101;A320;150;100` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                         `AA;0010;20250102;737;180;120`.
    DATA(lo_zip_creator) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_creator->add( i_name = 'test_data.csv' i_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_csv_data ) ).
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_zip_creator->get_zipped_xcontent( ).

CLASS zcl_it_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_it_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_it_left_outer_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_local_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_local_types IMPLEMENTATION.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             passname TYPE string,
             seat     TYPE sbook-seat,
           END OF ty_flight_passenger.

    DATA: ls_flight_passenger TYPE ty_flight_passenger.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_flight_passenger.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_flight_passenger-passname = 'John Doe'. " Dummy passenger
      ls_flight_passenger-seat = '01A'.
      rs_info = |Flight { ls_flight_passenger-carrid } { ls_flight_passenger-connid } on { ls_flight_passenger-fldate } | &
                |with passenger { ls_flight_passenger-passname } on seat { ls_flight_passenger-seat }|.
    ELSE.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

    " READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_res>).
