Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, indem Sie eine Join-ähnliche Logik mit `REDUCE` und `FOR` verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_join_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_join_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET current_carrid = flight-carrid IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( BASE result
                                            ( carrid = current_carrid
                                              count  = GROUP SIZE ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_aggregation.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_join_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( it_sflight = lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_res>) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_res>-count exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_res> WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_res>-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt oft komplexe Schleifen und `COLLECT`-Anweisungen und ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, die indirekt eine Join-ähnliche Gruppierung und Zusammenfassung von Daten ermöglicht.
keywords: JOIN, REDUCE, FOR, Aggregation, Functional Programming, GROUP BY

    " READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'XX' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_res>).
    " IF sy-subrc = 0.
    "   cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_res>-carrname ).
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` in einem `SELECT`-Statement ist entscheidend, wenn alle Einträge der linken Tabelle (hier `SFLIGHT`) beibehalten werden sollen, auch wenn keine passenden Einträge in der rechten Tabelle (`SCARR`) gefunden werden. Die Felder der rechten Tabelle sind dann initial. Dies ist eine gängige Anforderung in der Datenintegration und -analyse.

Instructions: Verbinden Sie zwei interne Tabellen mit `CORRESPONDING` und der `BASE` Option, um Felder basierend auf übereinstimmenden Schlüsseln zu aktualisieren oder hinzuzufügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( BASE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_update,
             id    TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item_update.
    TYPES tt_item_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_update WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS update_items
      IMPORTING
        it_base_items   TYPE tt_item
        it_price_updates TYPE tt_item_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_items.
    rt_updated_items = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( it_base_items ) it_price_updates MAPPING id = id price = price EXCEPT name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_corresponding_base FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_base.
    DATA lt_base_items TYPE zcl_corresponding_join=>tt_item.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 'A' name = 'Apple' price = '1.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_base_items.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 'B' name = 'Banana' price = '0.50' ) INTO TABLE lt_base_items.

    DATA lt_price_updates TYPE zcl_corresponding_join=>tt_item_update.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 'A' price = '1.20' ) INTO TABLE lt_price_updates.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 'C' price = '2.00' ) INTO TABLE lt_price_updates. " New item

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->update_items( it_base_items = lt_base_items it_price_updates = lt_price_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ). " A, B, C

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>) WITH KEY id = 'A'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_item>-price exp = '1.20' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_item>-name exp = 'Apple' ). " Name should be preserved

    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_item> WITH KEY id = 'C'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_item>-price exp = '2.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_item>-name ). " Name not mapped for new item
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit der `BASE`-Option ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um Daten zwischen internen Tabellen oder Strukturen zu verschieben und zu aktualisieren. Er ermöglicht das Zusammenführen von Daten, wobei vorhandene Einträge aktualisiert und neue hinzugefügt werden können, ähnlich einem 'UPSERT'-Verhalten, und bietet flexible Mapping-Optionen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und dann durch die Anzahl der Einträge zu teilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_average_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ) / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->get_average_price( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Average price should not be initial for sflight data' act = lv_average exp = 0.0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equals ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average price should be positive' act = lv_average > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->get_average_price( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average price should not be negative' act = lv_average >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck aggregiert die Preise der Flüge in einer Schleife und summiert sie auf. Anschließend wird die Summe durch die Anzahl der Zeilen geteilt, um den Durchschnitt zu erhalten. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: DIVIDE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflight, Aggregation

Instructions: Verteilen Sie einen Gesamtbetrag proportional auf eine Liste von Posten basierend auf deren individuellen Werten. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Berechnen Sie den Anteil jedes Postens am Gesamtbetrag und multiplizieren Sie diesen mit dem zu verteilenden Betrag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_distribute_amount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE decfloat16,
        share TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_item,
      ty_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS distribute
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_amount TYPE decfloat16
        it_items_in     TYPE ty_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items_out) TYPE ty_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distribute_amount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD distribute.
    DATA(lv_sum_values) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT s = 0.0
      FOR item IN it_items_in
      NEXT s = s + item-value
    ).

    IF lv_sum_values = 0.
      rt_items_out = it_items_in.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_items_out = VALUE ty_items(
      FOR item IN it_items_in
      ( id    = item-id
        value = item-value
        share = item-value / lv_sum_values * iv_total_amount )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_distribution FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_items FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_sum_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_distribution.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_distribute_amount( ).
    DATA(lt_items_in) = VALUE zcl_distribute_amount=>ty_items(
      ( id = 1 value = '10.0' )
      ( id = 2 value = '20.0' )
      ( id = 3 value = '30.0' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total_amount) = '120.0'.
    DATA(lt_items_out) = lo_cut->distribute( iv_total_amount = lv_total_amount it_items_in = lt_items_in ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items_out[ id = 1 ]-share exp = '20.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items_out[ id = 2 ]-share exp = '40.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items_out[ id = 3 ]-share exp = '60.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_distribute_amount( ).
    DATA(lt_items_in) = VALUE zcl_distribute_amount=>ty_items( ).
    DATA(lv_total_amount) = '100.0'.
    DATA(lt_items_out) = lo_cut->distribute( iv_total_amount = lv_total_amount it_items_in = lt_items_in ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_items_out ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_sum_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_distribute_amount( ).
    DATA(lt_items_in) = VALUE zcl_distribute_amount=>ty_items(
      ( id = 1 value = '0.0' )
      ( id = 2 value = '0.0' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total_amount) = '100.0'.
    DATA(lt_items_out) = lo_cut->distribute( iv_total_amount = lv_total_amount it_items_in = lt_items_in ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items_out[ id = 1 ]-share exp = '0.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items_out[ id = 2 ]-share exp = '0.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck wird verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, wobei für jeden Posten der proportionale Anteil des Gesamtbetrags berechnet wird. Zuvor wird mit `REDUCE` die Summe der Werte ermittelt. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Transformation von Tabellen.
keywords: DIVIDE, FOR, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Proportional Distribution

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere und dividieren Sie dabei einen Wert während der Zuweisung. Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und einem arithmetischen Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_source_data,
      ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
        id    TYPE i,
        half_value TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_target_data,
      ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rt_target_table = CORRESPONDING #( 
      it_source_table MAPPING half_value = value / 2 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_divide( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_divide=>ty_source_table(
      ( id = 1 value = '100.0' )
      ( id = 2 value = '50.0' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->process_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 1 ]-half_value exp = '50.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ id = 2 ]-half_value exp = '25.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_divide( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_divide=>ty_source_table( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->process_data( lt_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_target ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine elegante und performante Zuweisung von Daten zwischen strukturgleichen oder -ähnlichen internen Tabellen. Mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel kann man Felder umbenennen oder, wie hier gezeigt, direkt arithmetische Operationen während der Zuweisung durchführen.
keywords: DIVIDE, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Mapping

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface für eine Berechnungsfunktion und implementieren Sie diese in zwei verschiedenen Klassen. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie durch die Instanziierung der Klassen und den Aufruf der Methode über eine Interface-Referenz.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING`, `NEW` und `CAST`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculator.
  METHODS calculate
    IMPORTING
      iv_num1 TYPE i
      iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_adder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculator~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiplier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiplier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculator~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_num1 * iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphism_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_calculations
      IMPORTING
        io_calculator TYPE REF TO zif_calculator
        iv_num1       TYPE i
        iv_num2       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphism_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_calculations.
    rv_result = io_calculator->calculate( iv_num1 = iv_num1 iv_num2 = iv_num2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_adder FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiplier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adder.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_polymorphism_demo( ).
    DATA(lo_adder) = NEW zcl_adder( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_demo->run_calculations( io_calculator = lo_adder iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiplier.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_polymorphism_demo( ).
    DATA(lo_multiplier) = NEW zcl_multiplier( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_demo->run_calculations( io_calculator = lo_multiplier iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert Polymorphie durch die Verwendung eines Interfaces. Die Methode `run_calculations` akzeptiert eine Referenz auf das Interface `zif_calculator`. Je nachdem, welche konkrete Klasse (z.B. `zcl_adder` oder `zcl_multiplier`) übergeben wird, wird die entsprechende Implementierung der `calculate`-Methode aufgerufen. Die Instanziierung erfolgt modern mit `NEW`.
keywords: INTERFACE, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, NEW, CAST

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen von Klassen zurückgibt, die ein bestimmtes Interface implementieren. Die Factory-Methode soll entscheiden, welche Implementierung basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter zurückgegeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING`, `NEW` und den Interface-Typ als Rückgabetyp der Factory-Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_logger
      IMPORTING
        iv_logger_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_logger) TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_logger.
    CASE iv_logger_type.
      WHEN 'CONSOLE'.
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
      WHEN 'FILE'.
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_file_logger( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_console_logger FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_file_logger FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_default_logger FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = zcl_logger_factory=>get_logger( 'CONSOLE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_logger ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_logger IS INSTANCE OF zcl_console_logger ).
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for console' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_file_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = zcl_logger_factory=>get_logger( 'FILE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_logger ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_logger IS INSTANCE OF zcl_file_logger ).
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for file' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_default_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = zcl_logger_factory=>get_logger( 'UNKNOWN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_logger ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_logger IS INSTANCE OF zcl_console_logger ).
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for unknown type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt das Factory-Pattern, bei dem eine statische Methode (`get_logger`) Instanzen von Klassen erzeugt, die ein gemeinsames Interface (`zif_logger`) implementieren. Der Rückgabetyp der Factory-Methode ist das Interface, was die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit des Codes erhöht. Die Instanziierung erfolgt mit `NEW`.
keywords: INTERFACE, Factory Method, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, NEW

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Konzept von 'Default Methods' in Interfaces, indem Sie eine Hilfsklasse verwenden, die eine Standardimplementierung für eine Interface-Methode bereitstellt, die von implementierenden Klassen optional überschrieben werden kann.
hint: Interfaces in ABAP haben keine echten Default Methods wie in Java. Man kann dies aber mit einer abstrakten Basisklasse oder einer Hilfsklasse simulieren. Hier wird eine Hilfsklasse verwendet, die eine Methode des Interfaces implementiert und von den konkreten Klassen aufgerufen werden kann.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processor.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_default_processing_info
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_default_processor_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_default_info_impl RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_default_processor_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_default_info_impl.
    rv_info = 'Default processing logic applied.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processor.
    ALIASES:
      process_data FOR zif_processor~process_data,
      get_default_processing_info FOR zif_processor~get_default_processing_info.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_helper TYPE REF TO zcl_default_processor_helper.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processor~process_data.
    rv_output = |Simple: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_processor~get_default_processing_info.
    mo_helper = NEW zcl_default_processor_helper( ).
    rv_info = mo_helper->get_default_info_impl( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_advanced_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processor.
    ALIASES:
      process_data FOR zif_processor~process_data,
      get_default_processing_info FOR zif_processor~get_default_processing_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_advanced_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processor~process_data.
    rv_output = |Advanced: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_processor~get_default_processing_info.
    rv_info = 'Custom advanced processing info.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simple_processor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_advanced_processor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simple_processor.
    DATA(lo_processor) = CAST zif_processor( NEW zcl_simple_processor( ) ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_processor->process_data( 'Data' ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_processor->get_default_processing_info( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = 'Simple: Data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'Default processing logic applied.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_advanced_processor.
    DATA(lo_processor) = CAST zif_processor( NEW zcl_advanced_processor( ) ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_processor->process_data( 'Data' ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_processor->get_default_processing_info( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = 'Advanced: Data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_info exp = 'Custom advanced processing info.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Da ABAP keine nativen Default Methods in Interfaces bietet, wird hier eine Hilfsklasse (`zcl_default_processor_helper`) verwendet, um eine Standardimplementierung für `get_default_processing_info` bereitzustellen. Implementierende Klassen können diese Standardlogik nutzen oder, wie `zcl_advanced_processor`, ihre eigene Implementierung bereitstellen. Dies simuliert das Konzept von Default Methods.
keywords: INTERFACE, Default Methods (simulated), Object Orientation, Polymorphism, ALIASES

Instructions: Verwenden Sie ein Interface, um eine Liste von Objekten zu verarbeiten, die unterschiedliche Implementierungen einer gemeinsamen Funktionalität bereitstellen. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Iteration.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Tabelle von Interface-Referenzen und iterieren Sie diese mit `FOR`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_actionable.
  METHODS execute_action
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_log_entry) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_action_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_actionable~execute_action.
    rv_log_entry = 'Action A executed.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_actionable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_actionable~execute_action.
    rv_log_entry = 'Action B executed.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_actions
      IMPORTING
        it_actions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_actionable WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_actions.
    rt_log = VALUE string_table(
      FOR action_obj IN it_actions
      ( action_obj->execute_action( ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_actions FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_actions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_actions.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_action_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_actions) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_actionable(
      ( NEW zcl_action_a( ) )
      ( NEW zcl_action_b( ) )
      ( NEW zcl_action_a( ) )
    ).
    DATA(lt_log) = lo_processor->process_actions( lt_actions ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_log ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 1 ] exp = 'Action A executed.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 2 ] exp = 'Action B executed.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 3 ] exp = 'Action A executed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_actions.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_action_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_actions) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_actionable(
    ).
    DATA(lt_log) = lo_processor->process_actions( lt_actions ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_log ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt Interfaces, um eine Sammlung von Objekten mit unterschiedlichen Implementierungen einer gemeinsamen Methode (`execute_action`) zu verarbeiten. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Iteration über die Tabelle von Interface-Referenzen und den Aufruf der polymorphen Methode.
keywords: INTERFACE, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, FOR, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle als Parameter akzeptiert. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse und verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Implementierung, um die übergebene Tabelle zu verarbeiten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INTERFACE`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine funktionale Datenverarbeitung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_analyzer.
  TYPES: ty_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
  METHODS analyze_numbers
    IMPORTING
      it_numbers TYPE ty_numbers
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_sum_of_evens) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_even_number_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_analyzer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_even_number_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_analyzer~analyze_numbers.
    DATA(lt_even_numbers) = FILTER zif_data_analyzer=>ty_numbers(
      it_numbers WHERE ( table_line MOD 2 = 0 )
    ).

    rv_sum_of_evens = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR num IN lt_even_numbers
      NEXT sum = sum + num
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_analyze_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_evens FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyze_numbers.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = CAST zif_data_analyzer( NEW zcl_even_number_analyzer( ) ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zif_data_analyzer=>ty_numbers(
      ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_analyzer->analyze_numbers( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 12 ). " 2 + 4 + 6
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_evens.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = CAST zif_data_analyzer( NEW zcl_even_number_analyzer( ) ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zif_data_analyzer=>ty_numbers(
      ( 1 ) ( 3 ) ( 5 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_analyzer->analyze_numbers( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = CAST zif_data_analyzer( NEW zcl_even_number_analyzer( ) ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zif_data_analyzer=>ty_numbers(
    ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_analyzer->analyze_numbers( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von Interfaces mit funktionalen Ausdrücken wie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Die Interface-Methode `analyze_numbers` akzeptiert eine Tabelle, die dann innerhalb der Implementierung mit `FILTER` nach geraden Zahlen gefiltert und anschließend mit `REDUCE` summiert wird. Dies zeigt eine moderne und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung in ABAP.
keywords: INTERFACE, FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Object Orientation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein einfaches Interface und eine Klasse, die dieses Interface implementiert. Rufen Sie eine Methode des Interfaces über eine Referenz auf die implementierende Klasse auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING` und den direkten Methodenaufruf.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_greeter.
  METHODS say_hello
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_english_greeter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_greeter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_english_greeter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_greeter~say_hello.
    rv_greeting = 'Hello from English Greeter!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_greeter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_greeter.
    DATA(lo_greeter) = NEW zcl_english_greeter( ).
    DATA(lv_greeting) = lo_greeter->zif_greeter~say_hello( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_greeting exp = 'Hello from English Greeter!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Definition und Implementierung eines Interfaces. Eine Klasse implementiert das Interface und stellt die konkrete Logik für die Interface-Methode bereit. Der Aufruf erfolgt über die Instanz der implementierenden Klasse, qualifiziert mit dem Interface-Namen.
keywords: INTERFACE, Object Orientation, Basic Implementation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die einen optionalen Parameter hat. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface und demonstrieren Sie den Aufruf der Methode mit und ohne den optionalen Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPTIONAL` für den Parameter in der Interface-Definition und `DEFAULT` in der Implementierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_printer.
  METHODS print_text
    IMPORTING
      iv_text TYPE string
      iv_prefix TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_printer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_printer~print_text.
    DATA(lv_output) = iv_text.
    IF iv_prefix IS SUPPLIED.
      lv_output = |{ iv_prefix }: { iv_text }|.
    ENDIF.
    " In a real scenario, this would print to some output
    " For unit test, we just simulate.
    " cl_demo_output=>display( lv_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_print_without_prefix FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_print_with_prefix FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_print_without_prefix.
    DATA(lo_printer) = CAST zif_printer( NEW zcl_simple_printer( ) ).
    lo_printer->print_text( iv_text = 'Hello World' ).
    " No direct assertion for output, as it's a side effect.
    " In a real test, you'd check if the output was generated correctly.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( 1 = 1 ). " Placeholder assertion
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_print_with_prefix.
    DATA(lo_printer) = CAST zif_printer( NEW zcl_simple_printer( ) ).
    lo_printer->print_text( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_prefix = 'INFO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( 1 = 1 ). " Placeholder assertion
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von optionalen Parametern in Interface-Methoden. Der Parameter `iv_prefix` ist als `OPTIONAL` deklariert, was es ermöglicht, die Methode mit oder ohne diesen Parameter aufzurufen. Innerhalb der Implementierung wird `IS SUPPLIED` verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob der optionale Parameter übergeben wurde.
keywords: INTERFACE, Optional Parameter, Object Orientation, IS SUPPLIED

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface, das eine Methode zur Validierung von Daten definiert. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` für Validierungsfehler.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Exception-Klasse und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_validation_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_validation_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_validator.
  METHODS validate_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_data TYPE string
    RAISING
      zcx_validation_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_string_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_validator~validate_data.
    IF iv_data IS INITIAL.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflight` als Parameter akzeptiert. Implementieren Sie diese Methode, um die Flüge nach einem Kriterium zu filtern und die gefilterten Flüge zurückzugeben. Nutzen Sie `FILTER`.

INTERFACE zif_flight_filter.
  TYPES: ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
  METHODS filter_flights
    IMPORTING
      it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflights
      iv_min_occupancy TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflights.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_occupancy_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES zif_flight_filter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_occupancy_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_filter~filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER ty_sflights(
      it_all_flights WHERE ( seatsocc_b + seatsocc_f + seatsocc_y >= iv_min_occupancy )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode (`CARRID`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `WHERE` Klauseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                     FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_aa > 0 ) msg = 'Total price for AA should be positive' ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_lh > 0 ) msg = 'Total price for LH should be positive' ).

    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ).

CLASS zcl_odata_employee_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_employee,
        id   TYPE string,
        name TYPE string,
        age  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_employee,

    METHODS fetch_employees
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE tt_employees.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_employee_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_employees.
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://example.com/odata/v1/Employees'. " Placeholder URL

    DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_web_http_client_manager=>create_by_url( lv_url ).
    lo_http_client->send( ).

    DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
    IF lv_status_code = 200.
      DATA(lv_response_body) = lo_http_client->get_text( ).
      " Simulate JSON parsing for employee data
      " In a real scenario, you would parse lv_response_body
      " For this example, we'll return dummy data
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_employees ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_employee>).
      <fs_employee>-id = '001'.
      <fs_employee>-name = 'Max Mustermann'.
      <fs_employee>-age = 30.

      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_employees ASSIGNING <fs_employee>.
      <fs_employee>-id = '002'.
      <fs_employee>-name = 'Erika Musterfrau'.
      <fs_employee>-age = 25.
    ELSE.
      " Handle error
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = |Error fetching employees: { lv_status_code }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parse eine JSON-Antwort eines OData-Dienstes, die eine Liste von Mitarbeitern enthält, in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_json_parser` oder `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit `ID` für JSON-Deserialisierung.

CLASS zcl_odata_json_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_employee_data,
        id   TYPE string,
        name TYPE string,
        age  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_employee_data,
      tt_employee_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_employee_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE tt_employee_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_json_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_employee_json.
    " Simulate OData response structure, usually wrapped in 'value' array
    DATA(lv_json_with_wrapper) = |{{ "value": {iv_json_string} }}|.

    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_abap_json_parser( iv_json_string = lv_json_with_wrapper ).
    lo_parser->parse( ).

    " Access the 'value' array
    DATA(lt_json_employees) = lo_parser->get_data( '/value' ).

    " Deserialize into internal table
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE json = lt_json_employees
                             RESULT employees = rt_employees.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_employees) = lo_cut->parse_employee_json( lv_json_input ).

Instructions: Implementiere eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für einen simulierten OData-Aufruf, der fehlschlagen kann.
hint: Nutze `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke und spezifische Ausnahmeklassen wie `cx_web_http_client_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_odata_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_odata_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_odata_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://example.com/odata/v1/Employees'. " Placeholder URL

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_web_http_client_manager=>create_by_url( lv_url ).

        IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
          " Simulate an error by setting a non-200 status code
          " In a real scenario, this would come from the actual HTTP response
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_web_http_client_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Simulated HTTP error'
              status_code = 500.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).

        IF lv_status_code = 200.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          " Handle non-200 status codes
          MESSAGE |OData call failed with status { lv_status_code }| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_web_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        MESSAGE |HTTP Client Error: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) } (Status: { lx_http_error->status_code })| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->call_odata_with_error_handling( iv_simulate_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Expected successful call' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->call_odata_with_error_handling( iv_simulate_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Expected failed call' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_odata_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_raw_employee,
        employee_id   TYPE string,
        employee_name TYPE string,
        employee_age  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_raw_employee,
      tt_raw_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_processed_employee,
        id   TYPE string,
        name TYPE string,
        age  TYPE i,
        status TYPE string,
      END OF ty_processed_employee,
      tt_processed_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_employee_data
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_employees TYPE tt_raw_employees
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_employees) TYPE tt_processed_employees.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_employee_data.
    rt_processed_employees = VALUE #( FOR <fs_raw> IN it_raw_employees
                                      ( id     = <fs_raw>-employee_id
                                        name   = <fs_raw>-employee_name
                                        age    = <fs_raw>-employee_age
                                        status = COND string( WHEN <fs_raw>-employee_age >= 18 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_data.
    DATA: lt_raw_employees TYPE zcl_odata_for_transform=>tt_raw_employees,
          ls_raw_employee  TYPE zcl_odata_for_transform=>ty_raw_employee.

    ls_raw_employee-employee_id = '001'.
    ls_raw_employee-employee_name = 'Alice'.
    ls_raw_employee-employee_age = 25.
    APPEND ls_raw_employee TO lt_raw_employees.

    ls_raw_employee-employee_id = '002'.
    ls_raw_employee-employee_name = 'Bob'.
    ls_raw_employee-employee_age = 16.
    APPEND ls_raw_employee TO lt_raw_employees.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->transform_employee_data( lt_raw_employees ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Alice' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Active' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Bob' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Inactive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Transformation von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine andere. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um OData-Antworten in eine anwendungsspezifische Struktur zu überführen und dabei auch bedingte Logik anzuwenden.
keywords: ODATA, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Transformation

Instructions: Finde den Maximalwert der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) unter Verwendung des `MAX`-Aggregatausdrucks.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_flight_price.
    SELECT SINGLE MAX( price ) FROM sflight INTO rv_max_price WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_max_price( ).

    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with prices, and 'LH' also.
    " We need to know expected max values for a robust test.

Instructions: Simuliere das Senden von Mitarbeiterdaten an einen OData-Dienst (POST-Anfrage) unter Verwendung moderner HTTP-Client-Klassen und JSON-Serialisierung.
hint: Nutze `cl_web_http_client_manager`, `cl_http_client` und `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit `ID` für JSON-Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_odata_employee_post DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_new_employee,
        name TYPE string,
        age  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_new_employee.

    METHODS create_employee
      IMPORTING
        is_new_employee TYPE ty_new_employee
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_employee_post IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_employee.
    DATA(lv_url) = 'http://example.com/odata/v1/Employees'. " Placeholder URL
    DATA(lv_json_request) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE new_employee = is_new_employee
                                 RESULT json lv_json_request.

        DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_web_http_client_manager=>create_by_url( lv_url ).
        lo_http_client->set_method( if_web_http_client=>co_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_client->set_text( lv_json_request ).
        lo_http_client->send( ).

        DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300. " 2xx for success
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE |OData POST failed with status { lv_status_code }| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_web_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        MESSAGE |HTTP Client Error: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) } (Status: { lx_http_error->status_code })| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_employee FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_employee.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_odata_employee_post( ).
    DATA(ls_new_employee) TYPE zcl_odata_employee_post=>ty_new_employee.
    ls_new_employee-name = 'New Employee'.
    ls_new_employee-age = 40.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_employee( is_new_employee = ls_new_employee ).
    " This test will likely fail if example.com is not a real OData service
    " and doesn't return a 2xx status code. For a real test, you'd mock the HTTP client.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Expected employee creation to succeed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Senden von Daten an einen OData-Dienst erfordert die Serialisierung von ABAP-Daten in JSON und die Durchführung einer HTTP POST-Anfrage. `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` für JSON-Serialisierung und die HTTP-Client-Klassen (`cl_web_http_client_manager`, `cl_http_client`) bieten hierfür eine moderne und standardisierte Lösung.
keywords: ODATA, API Integration, HTTP POST, JSON, CALL TRANSFORMATION, cl_web_http_client_manager

Instructions: Erstelle einen OData-Query-String mit mehreren Parametern (Filter, OrderBy, Top, Skip) unter Verwendung von String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_odata_query_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_query_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_odata_query_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_employee_query.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Klassenkonstante für einen Steuersatz (z.B. 19%) und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode, um den Bruttopreis aus einem Nettopreis zu berechnen.

CLASS zcl_tax_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Definieren Sie Konstanten für verschiedene Auftragsstatus (z.B. 'NEW', 'IN_PROCESS', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode, um zu bestimmen, ob ein Auftrag aktuell 'offen' ist (NEW oder IN_PROCESS).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-CONSTANTS` und einen `COND`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_status_new       TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'NEW'.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_status_in_process TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'IN_PROCESS'.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_status_completed TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'COMPLETED'.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_status_cancelled TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'CANCELLED'.

    METHODS is_order_open
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_open) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_order_open.
    rv_is_open = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_status = gc_status_new OR iv_status = gc_status_in_process
        THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_order_open FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_order_open.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_order_status_checker( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_checker->is_order_open( zcl_order_status_checker=>gc_status_new )
      msg = 'NEW status should be open'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_checker->is_order_open( zcl_order_status_checker=>gc_status_in_process )
      msg = 'IN_PROCESS status should be open'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_checker->is_order_open( zcl_order_status_checker=>gc_status_completed )
      msg = 'COMPLETED status should not be open'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_checker->is_order_open( zcl_order_status_checker=>gc_status_cancelled )
      msg = 'CANCELLED status should not be open'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `CLASS-CONSTANTS` für Auftragsstatus, was den Code lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht als die Verwendung von 'Magic Strings'. Der `COND`-Ausdruck (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine prägnante Möglichkeit, bedingte Logik zu implementieren und gibt `abap_true` oder `abap_false` basierend auf dem Eingabestatus zurück.
keywords: CONSTANTS, CLASS-CONSTANTS, COND, Conditional Logic, Readability

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `sflights`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_flight_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier_id )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_flight_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_flight_price.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) TYPE s_price.
    DATA(lv_actual_price) TYPE s_price.

    " Annahme: Daten für 'LH' in sflights sind für Testzwecke vorhanden.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights INTO lv_expected_price WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    lv_actual_price = lo_aggregator->get_total_flight_price( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = lv_expected_price
      msg = 'Total flight price for LH is incorrect'
    ).

    " Test mit einem nicht existierenden Carrier
    lv_actual_price = lo_aggregator->get_total_flight_price( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Total flight price for non-existent carrier should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.50+) für eine funktional-orientierte Aggregation. Es iteriert über die Tabelle `sflights`, filtert nach `carrid` und summiert den `price`-Wert in `sum_price`. Dieser Ansatz ist sehr prägnant und ausdrucksstark für komplexe Aggregationen und reduziert Boilerplate-Code.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die Flugnummern (`FLDATE`, `CARRID`, `CONNID`) und einen berechneten reduzierten Preis (Originalpreis abzüglich eines konstanten Rabatts von 10%) für alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` und einer `CLASS-CONSTANT` für den Rabattsatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_discounter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_discount,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             discounted_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_discount.
    TYPES tt_flight_discount TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_discount WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_discount_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.10'. " 10%

    METHODS get_discounted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE tt_flight_discount.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_discounter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_flights.
    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN sflights
      ( fldate           = flight-fldate
        carrid           = flight-carrid
        connid           = flight-connid
        discounted_price = flight-price * ( 1 - gc_discount_rate ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_discounted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_discounted_flights.
    DATA(lo_discounter) = NEW zcl_flight_discounter( ).
    DATA(lt_discounted_flights) = lo_discounter->get_discounted_flights( ).

    " Prüfen, ob die Tabelle nicht leer ist (Annahme: sflights enthält Daten)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_discounted_flights )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Discounted flights table should not be empty'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    " Einen Beispielflug auswählen und den reduzierten Preis überprüfen
    DATA(ls_sample_flight) LIKE LINE OF lt_discounted_flights.
    READ TABLE lt_discounted_flights INDEX 1 INTO ls_sample_flight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_original_price) TYPE s_price.
      SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO lv_original_price
        WHERE fldate = ls_sample_flight-fldate
          AND carrid = ls_sample_flight-carrid
          AND connid = ls_sample_flight-connid.

      DATA(lv_expected_discounted_price) = lv_original_price * ( 1 - zcl_flight_discounter=>gc_discount_rate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_sample_flight-discounted_price
        exp = lv_expected_discounted_price
        msg = 'Discounted price calculation for sample flight is incorrect'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den `FOR`-Ausdruck innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Operators (ABAP 7.40+), um eine neue interne Tabelle durch Transformation vorhandener Daten zu erstellen. Es iteriert durch `sflights`, wendet einen Rabatt (als `CLASS-CONSTANT` definiert) an und konstruiert neue Tabellenzeilen. Dieser funktionale Ansatz ist sehr effizient und lesbar für Datentransformationen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, CONSTANTS, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Bonusbetrag basierend auf einer Verkaufszahl: 5% für Verkäufe >= 1000, 2% für Verkäufe >= 500, sonst 0%. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Zuweisung und `CLASS-CONSTANTS` für die Bonussätze.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_bonus_rate_high TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.05'. " 5%
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_bonus_rate_low  TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.02'. " 2%
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_sales_threshold_high TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '1000.00'.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_sales_threshold_low  TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '500.00'.

    METHODS calculate_bonus
      IMPORTING
        iv_sales_figure TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_bonus_amount) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus.
    rv_bonus_amount = COND p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2(
      WHEN iv_sales_figure >= gc_sales_threshold_high THEN iv_sales_figure * gc_bonus_rate_high

Instructions: Berechnen Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` die durchschnittliche Auslastung (Anzahl belegter Sitze / maximale Sitze) für Flüge zu einem bestimmten Zielort ('NEW YORK'), indem Sie zuerst filtern und dann reduzieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`-Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_to_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_city_to TYPE s_city_to
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_to_city.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflight_tab FROM sflights
                                 WHERE cityto = iv_city_to.

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) = 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE struct(
      INIT total_occupied = 0
           total_max_seats = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT total_occupied = total_occupied + flight-seatsocc
           total_max_seats = total_max_seats + flight-seatsmax
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-total_max_seats > 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = ls_aggregation-total_occupied / ls_aggregation-total_max_seats.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_avg_occupancy_to_city FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_occupancy_to_city.
    DATA(lo_occupancy) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_occupancy) TYPE f.
    DATA(lv_actual_occupancy) TYPE f.

    " Annahme: Daten für 'NEW YORK' in sflights sind für Testzwecke vorhanden.
    DATA(lv_total_occupied) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_total_max_seats) TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) AS occupied, SUM( seatsmax ) AS max_seats
      FROM sflights INTO (lv_total_occupied, lv_total_max_seats)
      WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK'.

    IF lv_total_max_seats > 0.
      lv_expected_occupancy = lv_total_occupied / lv_total_max_seats.
    ELSE.
      lv_expected_occupancy = 0.
    ENDIF.

    lv_actual_occupancy = lo_occupancy->get_avg_occupancy_to_city( 'NEW YORK' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_occupancy
      exp = lv_expected_occupancy
      delta = '0.000001' " Toleranz für Gleitkommazahlen
      msg = 'Average occupancy for NEW YORK is incorrect'
    ).

    " Test mit einem Zielort ohne Flüge
    lv_actual_occupancy = lo_occupancy->get_avg_occupancy_to_city( 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_occupancy
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Average occupancy for non-existent city should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst wird die Tabelle `sflights` nach dem Zielort gefiltert, dann werden die belegten und maximalen Sitze mit `REDUCE` aggregiert, um die durchschnittliche Auslastung zu berechnen. CLASS zcl_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    rt_flight_summaries = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid           = flight-carrid
        total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum_occ = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + member-seatsocc ) )
    ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_joiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_delimiter TYPE string VALUE '; '.

    METHODS join_words
      IMPORTING
        it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_string_joiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_words.
    rv_joined_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR word IN it_words
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN word
        ELSE s && gc_delimiter && word

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Zahlen berechnet. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summation und `COUNT` für die Anzahl der Elemente.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` oder `COUNT` für die Anzahl der Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + number
    ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle Vorkommen des Wortes "ABAP" (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorieren) in einem gegebenen Text und ersetze jedes Vorkommen durch "**MODERN ABAP**".
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF ... IGNORING CASE` und `REPLACE SECTION OF ... WITH ...` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_abap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_abap_keyword
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_abap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_abap_keyword.
    DATA(lv_temp_text) = iv_text.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF 'ABAP' IN lv_temp_text IGNORING CASE RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    " Reverse loop to avoid issues with changing offsets/lengths during replacement
    LOOP AT lt_matches ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_match>) REVERSE.
      REPLACE SECTION OFFSET <fs_match>-offset LENGTH <fs_match>-length OF lv_temp_text WITH '**MODERN ABAP**'.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = lv_temp_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die interne Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Flügen, deren Fluggesellschafts-ID (CARRID) den Buchstaben 'LH' enthält (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorieren).

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE ( FIND( val = carrid sub = 'LH' case = abap_false ) IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_no_lh_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    " Check if any LH flights are found (assuming SFLIGHT contains LH data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_flights WHERE ( FIND( val = carrid sub = 'LH' case = abap_false ) IS INITIAL ) )
      msg = 'All filtered flights should contain LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_flights WHERE ( FIND( val = carrid sub = 'LH' case = abap_false ) IS NOT INITIAL ) )
      msg = 'Should find some LH flights'
    ).

  METHOD test_filter_no_lh_flights.
    " This test assumes a scenario where no LH flights would be found,
    " which is hard to simulate with actual SFLIGHT data without mocking.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_sflight( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft das Wort "Business" (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorieren) in den Feldern 'CARRNAME' und 'CURRCODE' der internen Tabelle SCARR vorkommt.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und `FIND` für die Zählung in jedem Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_keyword_in_scarr
      IMPORTING
        iv_keyword TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_keyword_in_scarr.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_count = 0
      FOR <fs_scarr> IN lt_scarr
      NEXT total_count = total_count
        + COND #( WHEN find( val = <fs_scarr>-carrname sub = iv_keyword case = abap_false ) IS NOT INITIAL THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
        + COND #( WHEN find( val = <fs_scarr>-currcode sub = iv_keyword case = abap_false ) IS NOT INITIAL THEN 1 ELSE 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Text und eine Liste von Suchbegriffen erhält. Die Methode soll prüfen, ob der Text *alle* Suchbegriffe in beliebiger Reihenfolge enthält. Das Suchmuster soll dynamisch aus den Begriffen konstruiert werden.
hint: Konstruieren Sie einen regulären Ausdruck, der alle Begriffe in beliebiger Reihenfolge matcht. Nutzen Sie `FIND REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_find_all_terms DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_all_terms
      IMPORTING
        iv_text       TYPE string
        it_search_terms TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_find_all_terms IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_all_terms.
    IF it_search_terms IS INITIAL.
      rv_found = abap_true. " No terms to search for, so all are 'found'
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `(?i)`. " Case-insensitive flag
    LOOP AT it_search_terms INTO DATA(lv_term).
      " Escape special regex characters in the term
      DATA(lv_escaped_term) = cl_abap_regex=>escape( lv_term ).
      " Build a regex that looks for each term, allowing anything in between
      lv_regex_pattern = lv_regex_pattern && `(?=.*` && lv_escaped_term && `)`.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_regex_pattern = lv_regex_pattern && `.*`. " Match the entire string

    FIND REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_all_terms_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_find_all_terms( ).
    DATA(lt_terms) = VALUE string_table( ( 'ABAP' ) ( 'modern' ) ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Das ist ein modernes ABAP Programm.'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_all_terms( iv_text = lv_text it_search_terms = lt_terms ) ).

    lt_terms = VALUE string_table( ( 'modern' ) ( 'ABAP' ) ). " Order changed
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_all_terms( iv_text = lv_text it_search_terms = lt_terms ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_some_terms_missing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_find_all_terms( ).
    DATA(lt_terms) = VALUE string_table( ( 'ABAP' ) ( 'missing' ) ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Das ist ein modernes ABAP Programm.'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_all_terms( iv_text = lv_text it_search_terms = lt_terms ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_terms_given.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_find_all_terms( ).
    DATA(lt_terms) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Beliebiger Text.'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_all_terms( iv_text = lv_text it_search_terms = lt_terms ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_case_insensitive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_find_all_terms( ).
    DATA(lt_terms) = VALUE string_table( ( 'abap' ) ( 'MODERN' ) ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Das ist ein modernes ABAP Programm.'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_all_terms( iv_text = lv_text it_search_terms = lt_terms ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_special_chars_in_term.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_find_all_terms( ).
    DATA(lt_terms) = VALUE string_table( ( 'ABAP+' ) ( 'modern' ) ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Das ist ein modernes ABAP+ Programm.'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_all_terms( iv_text = lv_text it_search_terms = lt_terms ) ).
    lt_terms = VALUE string_table( ( 'ABAP+' ) ( 'modern.' ) ).
    lv_text = 'Das ist ein modernes ABAP+ Programm.'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_all_terms( iv_text = lv_text it_search_terms = lt_terms ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung eines regulären Ausdrucks. Der Ausdruck `(?=.*TERM)` ist ein "positive lookahead", der prüft, ob `TERM` irgendwo im String vorkommt, ohne die aktuelle Position des Matchers zu verschieben. Durch das Aneinanderreihen mehrerer solcher Lookaheads wird sichergestellt, dass alle Begriffe in beliebiger Reihenfolge vorhanden sind. `cl_abap_regex=>escape` ist wichtig, um Sonderzeichen in den Suchbegriffen korrekt zu behandeln.
keywords: FIND REGEX, Dynamic Programming, Regular Expressions, cl_abap_regex, Lookahead

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie die erste gültige E-Mail-Adresse aus einem gegebenen Text. Wenn keine gefunden wird, geben Sie einen leeren String zurück.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_first_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_email) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_first_email.
    " Simple regex for email, can be more complex for full validation
    DATA(lv_regex) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b`.

    FIND REGEX lv_regex IN iv_text IGNORING CASE MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset) MATCH LENGTH DATA(lv_length).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_email = iv_text+lv_offset(lv_length).
    ELSE.
      rv_email = ''.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aa_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aa_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                           WHERE ( find( val = ls_sflight-carrid sub = 'AA' ) = 0 )
                           ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                             fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_template IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String ein gültiges Datum im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD' enthält, und extrahieren Sie es gegebenenfalls.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_date_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_date_from_string.
    DATA(lv_regex) = `\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}`. " Regex for YYYY-MM-DD

    FIND REGEX lv_regex IN iv_text MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset) MATCH LENGTH DATA(lv_length).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_date = iv_text+lv_offset(lv_length).
    ELSE.
      rv_date = ''.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
