ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_period_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_period_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_count( ).
    DATA(lv_variant) = 'K4'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_period_difference(

      iv_to_fiscal_year = '2025' iv_to_fiscal_period = '002'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält. Füllen Sie dabei die neue Tabelle mit den Feldern CARRID, CONNID und PRICE.
hint: Verwenden Sie den VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit einem FOR-Ausdruck, um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                           ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                             price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Werte zu aggregieren. Hierbei wird implizit die Addition (ADD) verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_flight_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE p(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_flight_price( ).
    " Annahme: SFLIGHT enthält Daten, die eine positive Summe ergeben
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total price should not be zero' ).
    " Beispiel für einen erwarteten Wert, der je nach SFLIGHT-Inhalt variieren kann
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 'XXXX.XX' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale und deklarative Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit einer ADD-Anweisung zu schreiben, wird die Logik zur Summenbildung direkt im Ausdruck gekapselt, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ADD, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und geben Sie die gefilterten Zeilen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle mit den passenden Zeilen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY default WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen ermöglicht (Method Chaining), um ein Objekt schrittweise zu konfigurieren. Eine Methode soll dabei einen optionalen Parameter verwenden.
hint: Methoden, die das aktuelle Objekt (ME) zurückgeben, ermöglichen Method Chaining. Verwenden Sie OPTIONAL für optionale Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_config_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_param1
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_builder.

    METHODS set_param2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_builder.

    METHODS get_config_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_config) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_param2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_param1.
    mv_param1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_param2.
    IF iv_value IS SUPPLIED.
      mv_param2 = iv_value.
    ELSE.
      mv_param2 = 0. " Default value if not supplied
    ENDIF.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_config_string.
    rv_config = |Param1: { mv_param1 }, Param2: { mv_param2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_chaining_all_params FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_chaining_optional_param FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining_all_params.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_config_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_config) = lo_builder->set_param1( 'ValueA' )->set_param2( 123 )->get_config_string( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_config exp = 'Param1: ValueA, Param2: 123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chaining_optional_param.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_config_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_config) = lo_builder->set_param1( 'ValueB' )->get_config_string( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_config exp = 'Param1: ValueB, Param2: 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe aneinandergereiht werden können. Die Verwendung von OPTIONAL-Parametern macht Methoden flexibler und reduziert die Notwendigkeit von Überladungen oder separaten Setter-Methoden.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Optional Parameters, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Die Ergebnisse sollen die Fluggesellschaft und die Gesamtsumme enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Aggregatfunktion SUM und die GROUP BY-Klausel in Open SQL. Hierbei wird implizit die Addition (ADD) verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, SUM( price ) AS total_price
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrier_totals.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregate_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_results ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen, ob LH einen Eintrag hat und der Preis > 0 ist
    READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_lh>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_lh>-total_price > 0 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No entry found for carrier LH' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Moderne Open SQL-Syntax erlaubt die direkte Verwendung von Aggregatfunktionen wie SUM und GROUP BY, um Berechnungen direkt auf der Datenbank durchzuführen. Dies ist performanter als die Aggregation in ABAP und nutzt die Fähigkeiten des Datenbanksystems optimal aus. Die Addition (ADD) wird hierbei durch die SUM-Funktion auf Datenbankebene ausgeführt.
keywords: Open SQL, SUM, GROUP BY, Aggregation, ADD, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur der Tabelle SFLIGHT und fügen Sie dann eine Zeile mit Beispieldaten hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR) und CREATE DATA, um die Tabelle dynamisch zu erzeugen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Get structure description of SFLIGHT
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " Create table type description
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    " Create dynamic work area
    DATA lo_line_data TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA lo_line_data TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_line_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    " Fill work area with example data
    <fs_line>-carrid = 'XX'.
    <fs_line>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_line>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_line>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_line>-currency = 'EUR'.

    " Append to dynamic table
    APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( ).

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 0 ).

    " Check content of the first row
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-carrid exp = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-connid exp = '0001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-price exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) und CREATE DATA ermöglicht es, Datenstrukturen und interne Tabellen zur Laufzeit zu definieren und zu manipulieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Frameworks oder wenn die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Es ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die hohe Flexibilität bietet.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer String-Variablen einen Status ('High', 'Medium', 'Low') basierend auf einem numerischen Wert zu. Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ) für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_evaluator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS evaluate_value_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_evaluator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD evaluate_value_status.
    rv_status = COND #( WHEN iv_value > 100 THEN 'High'
                        WHEN iv_value > 50  THEN 'Medium'
                        ELSE 'Low' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_status_high FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_medium FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_status_low FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_high.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_status_evaluator( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->evaluate_value_status( 150 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'High' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_medium.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_status_evaluator( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->evaluate_value_status( 75 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Medium' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_status_low.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_status_evaluator( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->evaluate_value_status( 25 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Low' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Operator (Conditional Expression) ermöglicht die kompakte und deklarative Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen. Er ersetzt traditionelle IF-ELSEIF-ELSE-Konstrukte für einfache Zuweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expression

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen Tabellenausdruck mit der Index-Operator `[...]` und der `MAX`-Funktion in einem REDUCE-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS get_max_price_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_key) TYPE ty_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flight.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    TRY.
        rs_flight_key = REDUCE ty_flight_key(
          INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_flight_key( )
          FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
          NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > max_flight-price THEN VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid fldate = ls_flight-fldate price = ls_flight-price )
                                    ELSE max_flight ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle case where no flights are found for the carrier
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_price_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_price_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_max_price( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_flight( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_result-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_result-price > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_price_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_max_price( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_max_price_flight( 'ZZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_result-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_result-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke in Kombination mit dem REDUCE-Operator ermöglichen eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Syntax, um komplexe Operationen wie das Finden des Maximums in einer internen Tabelle durchzuführen. Dies ist eine funktionale und moderne Art der Datenverarbeitung, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expressions, REDUCE, MAX, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von drei Zahlen. Verwenden Sie dabei Inline-Deklarationen für die Ergebnisvariable.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine funktionale Methode, die einen Wert berechnet und direkt zurückgibt, ohne dass eine explizite RETURNING-Variable deklariert werden muss.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Methode mit RETURNING VALUE(...) und verwenden Sie den Ausdruck direkt im Methodenrumpf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_negative FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_positive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_method( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_method( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( iv_num1 = 0 iv_num2 = 0 ).

explanation: Funktionale Methoden sind ein Merkmal des modernen ABAP, das es ermöglicht, Methoden so zu definieren, dass sie einen einzelnen Wert zurückgeben, der direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden kann. Dies fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil, reduziert die Notwendigkeit temporärer Variablen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes, insbesondere in Kombination mit anderen Ausdrücken. Die Addition (ADD) wird hier direkt im Ausdruck der Rückgabe verwendet.
keywords: Object Orientation, Functional Method, RETURNING VALUE, ADD

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in ein XSTRING-Format.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>fill_container_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        im_value    = it_sflights
      IMPORTING
        ex_container = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_serializer=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_serializer( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    " Test with empty table
    lv_xstring = lo_cut->serialize_sflights( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_xstring ).

    " Test with some data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.

    lv_xstring = lo_cut->serialize_sflights( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `fill_container_xstring` der Klasse `cl_abap_container_utilities` ermöglicht die einfache und typsichere Serialisierung beliebiger ABAP-Datenobjekte (Tabellen, Strukturen, Variablen) in ein XSTRING-Format. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Speicherung komplexer Daten in Datenbankfeldern oder den Austausch von Daten.
keywords: cl_abap_container_utilities, XSTRING, Serialization, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie ein XSTRING, das zuvor eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten enthielt, zurück in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_deserializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

    cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_container_xstring(

      IMPORTING

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_sflights.
    DATA: lt_original_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_deserializer=>tt_sflight_data,
          lt_deserialized_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_deserializer=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_sflight_serializer( ). " Assuming zcl_sflight_serializer from cont_001 exists
    DATA(lo_deserializer) = NEW zcl_sflight_deserializer( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    " Prepare some data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_original_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_original_sflights.

    " Serialize
    lv_xstring = lo_serializer->serialize_sflights( lt_original_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xstring ).

    " Deserialize
    lt_deserialized_sflights = lo_deserializer->deserialize_sflights( lv_xstring ).

    " Assert equality
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_deserialized_sflights )
      exp = lines( lt_original_sflights )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_deserialized_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = lt_original_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_deserialized_sflights[ 2 ]-price
      exp = lt_original_sflights[ 2 ]-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `read_container_xstring` ist das Gegenstück zu `fill_container_xstring`. Sie ermöglicht die Deserialisierung eines XSTRING-Containers zurück in das ursprüngliche ABAP-Datenobjekt. Dies ist entscheidend, um die zuvor gespeicherten komplexen Daten wiederherzustellen und weiterzuverarbeiten.
keywords: cl_abap_container_utilities, XSTRING, Deserialization, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Status-Text zu, basierend auf einem numerischen Status-Code (z.B. 1='Open', 2='In Progress', 3='Closed').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_status_code
                               WHEN 1 THEN 'Open'
                               WHEN 2 THEN 'In Progress'
                               WHEN 3 THEN 'Closed'
                               ELSE 'Unknown Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_get_status_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_status_mapper( ).
    DATA(lv_status_text) TYPE string.

    lv_status_text = lo_cut->get_status_text( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_text exp = 'Open' ).

    lv_status_text = lo_cut->get_status_text( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_text exp = 'In Progress' ).

    lv_status_text = lo_cut->get_status_text( 3 ).

    lv_status_text = lo_cut->get_status_text( 99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_text exp = 'Unknown Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.40+) bietet eine kompakte und lesbare Alternative zur traditionellen `CASE`-Anweisung, wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Er ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der direkt in Zuweisungen verwendet werden kann.
keywords: SWITCH, WHEN, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie eine Textbeschreibung für einen übergebenen Datentyp (z.B. 'C' für Character, 'I' für Integer).
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` mit `TYPE OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_type_describer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type_description
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_type_describer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data )->type_kind
                               WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char THEN 'Character String'
                               WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int THEN 'Integer Number'
                               WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float THEN 'Floating Point Number'
                               WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed THEN 'Packed Number'
                               WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date THEN 'Date'
                               WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time THEN 'Time'

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, aber nur für Flüge, die einen bestimmten Status haben (z.B. 'C' für Confirmed).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer `WHEN`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1, " Example status field
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_status   TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_status.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                WHERE ( status = iv_status )
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_price_by_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_price_by_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_aggregator=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' status = 'C' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' status = 'O' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251203' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' status = 'C' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251204' price = '75.00' currency = 'EUR' status = 'X' ) TO lt_sflights.

    lv_total_price = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_status( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_status = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '250.00' ). " 100.00 + 150.00

    lv_total_price = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_status( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_status = 'O' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '250.50' ).

    lv_total_price = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_status( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_status = 'Z' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und prägnanten Weise. In Kombination mit der `WHERE`-Klausel kann man direkt eine Bedingung angeben, welche Zeilen in die Aggregation einbezogen werden sollen, was zu sehr effizientem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, WHEN, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge aus SFLIGHTS enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, und fügen Sie ein neues Feld für den Status hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `WHEN` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_input,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_input.
    TYPES tt_sflight_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_output,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_output.
    TYPES tt_sflight_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_with_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_with_status.
    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                 WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
                                 ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   connid    = ls_sflight-connid
                                   fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
                                   price     = ls_sflight-price
                                   currency  = ls_sflight-currency
                                   status_text = COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-price > 500 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Standard' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights_with_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights_input TYPE zcl_sflight_filter_transformer=>tt_sflight_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_output) TYPE zcl_sflight_filter_transformer=>tt_sflight_output.

    " Add past, present, and future flights
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum - 1 price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum + 1 price = '600.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum + 2 price = '75.00' currency = 'SGD' ) TO lt_sflights_input.

    lt_sflights_output = lo_cut->get_future_flights_with_status( lt_sflights_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_output ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_output[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_output[ 1 ]-status_text exp = 'Expensive' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_output[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_output[ 2 ]-status_text exp = 'Standard' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel dient als Filter, während die nachfolgende Klammer die Struktur der neuen Zeilen definiert und dabei auch komplexe Zuweisungen (hier mit `COND`) erlaubt. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu verarbeiten.
keywords: FOR, WHEN, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Transformation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Statusmeldung basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen (z.B. Flugstatus und Verfügbarkeit von Sitzen).

CLASS zcl_flight_status_reporter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_seats_free    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_reporter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_message.
    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN iv_flight_status = 'C' AND iv_seats_free > 10 THEN 'Flight Confirmed, many seats available.'
      WHEN iv_flight_status = 'C' AND iv_seats_free <= 10 AND iv_seats_free > 0 THEN 'Flight Confirmed, few seats left.'
      WHEN iv_flight_status = 'C' AND iv_seats_free = 0 THEN 'Flight Confirmed, fully booked.'
      WHEN iv_flight_status = 'X' THEN 'Flight Cancelled.'
      WHEN iv_flight_status = 'O' THEN 'Flight Open for Booking.'
      ELSE 'Status unknown or invalid.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_reporter( ).
    DATA(lv_message) TYPE string.

    lv_message = lo_cut->get_flight_status_message( iv_flight_status = 'C' iv_seats_free = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Flight Confirmed, many seats available.' ).

    lv_message = lo_cut->get_flight_status_message( iv_flight_status = 'C' iv_seats_free = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Flight Confirmed, few seats left.' ).

    lv_message = lo_cut->get_flight_status_message( iv_flight_status = 'C' iv_seats_free = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Flight Confirmed, fully booked.' ).

    lv_message = lo_cut->get_flight_status_message( iv_flight_status = 'X' iv_seats_free = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Flight Cancelled.' ).

    lv_message = lo_cut->get_flight_status_message( iv_flight_status = 'O' iv_seats_free = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Flight Open for Booking.' ).

    lv_message = lo_cut->get_flight_status_message( iv_flight_status = 'Z' iv_seats_free = 1 ).

explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.40+) ist eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, komplexe bedingte Zuweisungen in einer einzigen Zeile zu formulieren. Er ersetzt verschachtelte `IF`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich, insbesondere wenn mehrere Bedingungen zu einem Ergebnis führen sollen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `WHEN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
             avg_occupancy TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_calculate_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_calculate_occupancy.
    DATA: lv_total_occupied TYPE i,
          lv_total_max      TYPE i.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      lv_total_occupied = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN group_key ( sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsocc ) ).
      lv_total_max      = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN group_key ( sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsmax ) ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid
                      fldate = group_key-fldate
                      avg_occupancy = COND decfloat16( WHEN lv_total_max > 0 THEN ( lv_total_occupied / lv_total_max ) * 100 ELSE 0 ) ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_and_calculate_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_calculate_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_grouper=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) TYPE zcl_sflight_grouper=>tt_grouped_result.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251201' seatsocc = 75 seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' seatsocc = 120 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = '20251202' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.

    lt_result = lo_cut->group_and_calculate_occupancy( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_result_aa_20251201) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20251201' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa_20251201-avg_occupancy exp = '50.00' ). " (50+75)/(100+150) = 125/250 = 0.5 * 100

    DATA(ls_result_lh_20251201) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20251201' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh_20251201-avg_occupancy exp = '60.00' ). " 120/200 = 0.6 * 100

    DATA(ls_result_aa_20251202) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20251202' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa_20251202-avg_occupancy exp = '80.00' ). " 80/100 = 0.8 * 100
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung (ABAP 7.50+) ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature zur Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe und dem `COND`-Ausdruck für bedingte Berechnungen (z.B. Division durch Null vermeiden) ermöglicht dies komplexe Datenanalysen in einem sehr kompakten und modernen Stil.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, REDUCE, WHEN, COND, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum in der Vergangenheit, Gegenwart oder Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck mit Vergleichsoperatoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_period) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_period.
    rv_period = SWITCH #( )
      WHEN iv_date < sy-datum THEN 'Past'
      WHEN iv_date = sy-datum THEN 'Present'
      WHEN iv_date > sy-datum THEN 'Future'
      ELSE 'Invalid Date' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_date_period FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_date_period.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_period) TYPE string.

    lv_period = lo_cut->get_date_period( sy-datum - 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_period exp = 'Past' ).

    lv_period = lo_cut->get_date_period( sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_period exp = 'Present' ).

    lv_period = lo_cut->get_date_period( sy-datum + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_period exp = 'Future' ).

    " Test with initial date (which is '00000000' and typically less than sy-datum)
    lv_period = lo_cut->get_date_period( '00000000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_period exp = 'Past' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck kann auch ohne einen expliziten Prüfausdruck verwendet werden, indem man die Bedingungen direkt in den `WHEN`-Klauseln formuliert. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und lesbare Methode, um bedingte Logik zu implementieren, insbesondere für Vergleiche wie Datumsbereiche.
keywords: SWITCH, WHEN, Date/Time, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der basierend auf der Länge eines Eingabestrings eine andere Begrüßung verwendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit `COND` und `WHEN`.

CLASS zcl_greeting_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_greeting.
    rv_greeting = |{ COND string(
                         WHEN strlen( iv_name ) > 5 THEN 'Hello, long name '
                         ELSE 'Hi, short name '
                       ) }{ iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_formatted_greeting FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_formatted_greeting.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_greeting_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_greeting) TYPE string.

    lv_greeting = lo_cut->get_formatted_greeting( 'Max' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_greeting exp = 'Hi, short name Max!' ).

    lv_greeting = lo_cut->get_formatted_greeting( 'Alexander' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_greeting exp = 'Hello, long name Alexander!' ).

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (`passmax`) pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passmax TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_sflight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_reduce_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE tt_sflight_agg(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_agg( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET current_passmax = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT sum = sum + member-passmax ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_sflight_agg( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid total_passmax = current_passmax ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_reduce_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    " Further assertions could check specific aggregated values if test data is controlled
    " For simplicity, we just check if the table is not empty.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_agg).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrid should not be initial' act = ls_agg-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Total Passmax should not be initial' act = ls_agg-total_passmax ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` für eine effiziente Datenaggregation. Die `FOR GROUPS OF` Syntax ermöglicht es, über Gruppen von Einträgen in einer internen Tabelle zu iterieren und diese zu aggregieren. Der innere `REDUCE` berechnet die Summe der Passagiere pro Gruppe. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung in ABAP.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, GROUP BY, Aggregation, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Begrüßungsstring, der je nach Tageszeit "Guten Morgen" (0-11 Uhr), "Guten Tag" (12-17 Uhr) oder "Guten Abend" (18-23 Uhr) enthält, gefolgt von einem Namen. Verwenden Sie String Templates und eine `COND`-Expression.
hint: Kombinieren Sie String Templates mit `COND` für die bedingte Logik. Nutzen Sie `sy-uzeit` für die aktuelle Uhrzeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_greeting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string
                         RETURNING VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_greeting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    DATA(lv_hour) = sy-uzeit(2). " Extract hour from current time

    rv_greeting = |{ COND string( WHEN lv_hour >= '00' AND lv_hour <= '11' THEN 'Guten Morgen'
                                  WHEN lv_hour >= '12' AND lv_hour <= '17' THEN 'Guten Tag'
                                  ELSE 'Guten Abend' ) }, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_greeting FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_greeting.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_greeting( ).
    DATA(lv_name) = 'Max Mustermann'.
    DATA(lv_greeting) = lo_cut->get_greeting( lv_name ).

    " Test for a specific time range (e.g., assuming current time is 'Guten Tag')
    " This test is time-dependent, for a robust test, one would mock sy-uzeit or pass time as parameter.
    " For demonstration, we check if it contains one of the greetings and the name.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Greeting should contain name' act = lv_greeting CS lv_name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Greeting should contain a valid greeting'
                                       act = ( lv_greeting CS 'Guten Morgen' OR
                                               lv_greeting CS 'Guten Tag' OR
                                               lv_greeting CS 'Guten Abend' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von String Templates und `COND`-Ausdrücken. Der `COND`-Ausdruck bietet eine kompakte Möglichkeit, bedingte Logik direkt in den String Template zu integrieren, was zu sehr ausdrucksstarkem und modernem Code führt.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Attributs eines Objekts zur Laufzeit aus, dessen Name als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` (oder `cl_abap_typedescr`) in Verbindung mit `GET REFERENCE OF` und Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attribute_value IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
                                        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
                                RAISING   cx_sy_ref_is_initial
                                          cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attribute_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attribute_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_any> TYPE any.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.

    IF io_object IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE REF TO io_object->(iv_attribute_name).
        GET REFERENCE OF io_object->(iv_attribute_name) INTO lr_data.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lv_any>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <lv_any>.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING previous = lx_dyn_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Public attribute value should match' act = lv_value exp = 'Public Value' ).

Die Syntax `io_object->(iv_attribute_name)` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Attribute. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für Szenarien, in denen der Attributname erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit klassenbasierten Exceptions ist ebenfalls ein moderner Ansatz.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Exception-Klasse und werfen Sie diese in einer Methode, wenn ein ungültiger Eingabewert übergeben wird. Fangen Sie die Exception ab und geben Sie den Fehlertext aus.
hint: Erben Sie von `cx_static_check` oder `cx_dynamic_check` und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...` im werfenden Code und `TRY...CATCH` im aufrufenden Code.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
                          RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
    METHODS handle_processing IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate some processing
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_processing.
    TRY.
        process_value( iv_value ).
        rv_message = 'Value processed successfully.'.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        rv_message = lx_invalid_input->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING. METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->handle_processing( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected success message' act = lv_message exp = 'Value processed successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->handle_processing( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Expected error message for invalid input' act = lv_message CS 'Invalid input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Implementierung einer eigenen, klassenbasierten Exception (`zcx_invalid_input`), die von `cx_static_check` erbt. Dies erzwingt eine explizite Fehlerbehandlung zur Kompilierzeit. Die Methode `process_value` wirft die Exception bei ungültiger Eingabe, während `handle_processing` diese mit `TRY...CATCH` abfängt und den Fehlertext ausgibt. Dies ist der moderne und robuste Weg der Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP.
keywords: Exceptions, TRY...CATCH, Class-based Exceptions, cx_static_check, RAISE EXCEPTION

Instructions: Schreiben Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) in ein neues Arbeitsblatt einer Excel-Datei. Die erste Zeile soll die Spaltenüberschriften enthalten, gefolgt von den Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` und iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle, um Zellwerte zu setzen. Nutzen Sie `DESCRIBE FIELD` für Spaltennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_write_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS write_sflights_to_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_write_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for example

    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>create_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdaten' ).

    " Write header row
    DATA: lv_col TYPE i VALUE 1.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ).

    LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Write data rows
    DATA: lv_row TYPE i VALUE 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
      lv_col = 1.
      LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_sheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = CONV string( <fs_value> ) ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->save_spreadsheet_to_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_write_table_to_excel FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_write_table_to_excel.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->write_sflights_to_excel( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'XSTRING length should be greater than 0' exp = 0 act = xstrlen( lv_xstring ) ).

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_excel_read( ). " Re-use the reader from exc_002
    DATA(ls_data) = lo_reader->read_simple_excel( lv_xstring ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und einer Mindestanzahl an Passagieren (`passmax`), unter Verwendung von `FILTER` und `WHERE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung für effizientes Filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_sflights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                      iv_min_passmax TYPE i
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND passmax >= iv_min_passmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING. METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_min_passmax) = 100.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_min_passmax = lv_min_passmax ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid should match filter' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Passmax should be greater or equal to min' act = ( ls_flight-passmax >= lv_min_passmax ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'. " Non-existent airline
    DATA(lv_min_passmax) = 1.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_sflights( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_min_passmax = lv_min_passmax ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should be empty for no match' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das effiziente Filtern interner Tabellen mit dem `FILTER`-Operator. Die Syntax `FILTER #( itab WHERE ... )` ist eine moderne und deklarative Art, Einträge basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen auszuwählen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und oft performanter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode (`CLASS-METHODS`) in einer Klasse, die Instanzen verschiedener Unterklassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt und zurückgibt.

CLASS zif_product DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zif_product IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS zif_product~get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS zif_product~get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product IMPORTING iv_type TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
                                 RAISING   cx_sy_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_create_error=>default_text.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für die Darstellung in einem `cl_time_chart_simple` aufbereitet. Die Methode soll die Anzahl der Flüge pro Datum ermitteln und als interne Tabelle zurückgeben, die für ein Zeitdiagramm geeignet ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` oder `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` um die Flüge nach Datum zu gruppieren und die Anzahl zu zählen. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` für die direkte Initialisierung der Ergebnis-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_chart_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data_point,
             date  TYPE sflight-fldate,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data_point.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS:
      get_flights_per_date
        IMPORTING
          iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        RETURNING VALUE(rt_data_points) TYPE tt_flight_data_points.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_chart_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_per_date.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT fldate, carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL.

    rt_data_points = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
      ( date = ls_flight-fldate
        count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_data_points ) > 0 msg = 'Result table should contain data' ).

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine Klasse, die die dynamische Anpassung der Sash-Positionen eines `cl_gui_splitter_container` simuliert. Die Klasse soll eine Methode `adjust_sash_position` bereitstellen, die basierend auf einem Index und einem neuen Größenwert die Konfiguration aktualisiert. Der Unit-Test soll die korrekte Anpassung der Sash-Positionen überprüfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `FOR ... IN` um die interne Tabelle der Sash-Konfiguration zu manipulieren. Nutzen Sie `COND` für kompakte bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sash_config,
             idx  TYPE i,
             size TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sash_config.
    TYPES: tt_sash_config TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sash_config WITH UNIQUE KEY idx.

    METHODS:
      constructor
        IMPORTING
          it_initial_row_sash TYPE tt_sash_config OPTIONAL
          it_initial_col_sash TYPE tt_sash_config OPTIONAL,
      adjust_row_sash_position
        IMPORTING
          iv_idx  TYPE i
          iv_size TYPE i,
      adjust_column_sash_position
        IMPORTING
          iv_idx  TYPE i
          iv_size TYPE i,
      get_row_sash_config
        RETURNING VALUE(rt_row_sash_config) TYPE tt_sash_config,
      get_column_sash_config
        RETURNING VALUE(rt_col_sash_config) TYPE tt_sash_config.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mt_row_sash_config TYPE tt_sash_config,
          mt_col_sash_config TYPE tt_sash_config.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_row_sash_config = it_initial_row_sash.
    mt_col_sash_config = it_initial_col_sash.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD adjust_row_sash_position.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( mt_row_sash_config[ idx = iv_idx ] ).
      mt_row_sash_config[ idx = iv_idx ]-size = iv_size.
    ELSE.
      INSERT VALUE #( idx = iv_idx size = iv_size ) INTO TABLE mt_row_sash_config.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD adjust_column_sash_position.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( mt_col_sash_config[ idx = iv_idx ] ).
      mt_col_sash_config[ idx = iv_idx ]-size = iv_size.
    ELSE.
      INSERT VALUE #( idx = iv_idx size = iv_size ) INTO TABLE mt_col_sash_config.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_row_sash_config.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden, und berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität für diese Flüge. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `WHERE` für das Filtern und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analysis DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_filtered_capacity
        IMPORTING
          iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
          iv_date   TYPE sflight-fldate
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_capacity = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_date )
      NEXT sum_capacity = sum_capacity + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS:
      test_filtered_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_capacity.
    DATA(lo_analysis) = NEW zcl_flight_analysis( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 100. "Datum in der Vergangenheit

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge von LH nach diesem Datum
    DATA(lv_capacity) = lo_analysis->get_filtered_capacity(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_date   = lv_test_date
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_capacity > 0 msg = 'Total capacity should be greater than 0' ).

    " Testfall, wo keine Flüge gefunden werden sollten (sehr weit in der Zukunft)
    DATA(lv_future_date) = sy-datum + 3650.
    DATA(lv_no_capacity) = lo_analysis->get_filtered_capacity(
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
      iv_date   = lv_future_date
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_no_capacity exp = 0 msg = 'Total capacity should be 0 for future date' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR ... IN` mit `WHERE` für das Filtern und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Daten zu verarbeiten, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert und die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen reduziert. Es ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, REDUCE, WHERE, SFLIGHTS, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften aus `SFLIGHTS` mit dem `VALUE` Operator und Target Type Inference initialisiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #(...)` um die interne Tabelle direkt zu füllen, ohne eine explizite `DATA` Deklaration für den Tabellentyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_init DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS:
      get_top_carriers
        IMPORTING
          iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 3
        RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_init IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_carriers.
    DATA: lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.

    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr ( carrid = ls_scarr-carrid carrname = ls_scarr-carrname ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der Compiler leitet den Typ der Zieltabelle automatisch ab, was die Notwendigkeit redundanter Typdeklarationen reduziert. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN` ist dies eine elegante Methode, um Daten aus einer Quelle in eine neue Tabellenstruktur zu transformieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf der Differenz zwischen geplanter und tatsächlicher Ankunftszeit sowie einem Status-Flag mit dem `SWITCH` Ausdruck bestimmt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Ausdruck, um einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      WHEN iv_is_cancelled = abap_true THEN 'Abgesagt'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 0 iv_is_cancelled = abap_false ) exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 15 iv_is_cancelled = abap_false ) exp = 'Leicht verspätet' ).

Er verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich, insbesondere bei komplexeren Bedingungsprüfungen, da er direkt einen Wert zurückgibt und keine expliziten Zuweisungen innerhalb der `WHEN`-Blöcke erfordert.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS:
      test_with_object FOR TESTING,
      test_without_object FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_object.
    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_concrete_provider( 'Actual Value' ).
    DATA(lo_chaining) = NEW zcl_optional_chaining( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_chaining->get_value_safely( lo_provider ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Actual Value' msg = 'Value with object mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_without_object.
    DATA(lo_chaining) = NEW zcl_optional_chaining( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_chaining->get_value_safely( io_object = CAST zif_value_provider( cl_abap_objectdescr=>get_initial_object( ) ) ). " Pass initial object
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Default Value' msg = 'Value without object mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Optional Chaining (`?->`) ist eine Funktion ab ABAP 7.55, die den sicheren Zugriff auf Methoden und Attribute von Objekten ermöglicht, ohne explizite `IF io_object IS BOUND` Prüfungen. Wenn das Objekt initial ist, wird der Ausdruck rechts vom `?->` nicht ausgeführt, und der gesamte Ausdruck liefert einen Initialwert. In Kombination mit dem Null Coalescing Operator (`??`) kann ein Standardwert zugewiesen werden, was den Code robuster und kürzer macht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Optional Chaining, Null Coalescing, Modern ABAP, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der Passagierauslastung für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe der Auslastungen und die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln, und teilen Sie dann die Summe durch die Anzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_average_occupancy
        IMPORTING
          iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DATA(ls_summary) = REDUCE struct(
      INIT sum_occ = 0 TYPE i
           sum_max = 0 TYPE i
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + ls_flight-seatsocc,
           sum_max = sum_max + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).

    IF ls_summary-sum_max > 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = ( CONV decfloat16( ls_summary-sum_occ ) / ls_summary-sum_max ) * 100.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS: test_average_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_occupancy( ).

    " Test mit 'LH' (angenommen, es gibt Daten)
    DATA(lv_avg_lh) = lo_calc->get_average_occupancy( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_avg_lh >= 0 AND lv_avg_lh <= 100 msg = 'Average occupancy for LH should be between 0 and 100' ).

    " Test mit einer nicht existierenden Fluggesellschaft
    DATA(lv_avg_xx) = lo_calc->get_average_occupancy( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_xx exp = 0 msg = 'Average occupancy for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ideal für Aggregationen wie das Berechnen von Summen oder Durchschnitten über interne Tabellen. Hier wird er verwendet, um gleichzeitig die Summe der belegten Sitze und die maximale Sitzkapazität zu ermitteln. Dies ist eine funktionale und effiziente Methode, die den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht als eine traditionelle `LOOP`-Anweisung mit manueller Akkumulation.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die das Datum eines Fluges um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Tagen vor- oder zurücksetzt und das neue Datum zurückgibt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      adjust_date

          iv_date TYPE sy-datum
          iv_days TYPE i
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_new_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_date.
    rv_new_date = iv_date + iv_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adjust_date.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = sy-datum.

    " Test: Datum um 5 Tage vorwärts setzen
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lo_calc->adjust_date( iv_date = lv_start_date iv_days = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_future_date exp = lv_start_date + 5 msg = 'Date adjustment forward mismatch' ).

    " Test: Datum um 10 Tage zurücksetzen

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP unterstützt die direkte arithmetische Operation mit Datumsfeldern, was eine sehr einfache und intuitive Möglichkeit bietet, Daten um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Tagen zu verschieben.
