Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS`, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben, und geben Sie nur die Flugnummern zurück. Verwenden Sie `FILTER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_flights_with_free_seats
        IMPORTING
          iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
        RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-fldate WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats )
      ( ls_flight-fldate ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS: test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).

    " Test mit einer realistischen Anzahl freier Sitze (z.B. 50)
    DATA(lt_flights_50) = lo_filter->get_flights_with_free_seats( 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights_50 IS INITIAL msg = 'Should find flights with 50 free seats' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_flights_50 ) > 0 msg = 'Should find more than 0 flights' ).

    " Test mit einer unrealistisch hohen Anzahl freier Sitze (sollte keine Flüge finden)
    DATA(lt_flights_999) = lo_filter->get_flights_with_free_seats( 999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights_999 IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Should find no flights with 999 free seats' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights_999 ) exp = 0 msg = 'Should find 0 flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Ausdruck ist eine moderne und deklarative Methode, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und oft performanter als eine manuelle Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingungen und `APPEND`. In Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` und `FOR ... IN` ermöglicht es eine sehr kompakte Datenmanipulation.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, FOR, VALUE, SFLIGHTS, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die dynamisch ein Feld aus einer internen Tabelle liest, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie den dynamischen Komponenten-Zugriff mit `(field_name)` oder `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS:
      get_field_value
        IMPORTING
          it_data     TYPE tt_data
          iv_field_name TYPE string
          iv_index    TYPE i
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE ty_data,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    READ TABLE it_data INDEX iv_index ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = |{
          <fs_field> ALIGN = LEFT
        }|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS: test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_field_access=>tt_data(
      ( field1 = 'Value A' field2 = 10 )
      ( field1 = 'Value B' field2 = 20 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).

    " Test: Zugriff auf 'FIELD1' in Zeile 1
    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_accessor->get_field_value(
      it_data = lt_test_data
      iv_field_name = 'FIELD1'
      iv_index = 1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Value A' msg = 'Dynamic access to FIELD1 mismatch' ).

    " Test: Zugriff auf 'FIELD2' in Zeile 2
    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_accessor->get_field_value(
      it_data = lt_test_data
      iv_field_name = 'FIELD2'
      iv_index = 2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '20' msg = 'Dynamic access to FIELD2 mismatch' ).

    " Test: Zugriff auf nicht existierendes Feld
    DATA(lv_value_invalid) = lo_accessor->get_field_value(
      it_data = lt_test_data
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT'
      iv_index = 1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_value_invalid msg = 'Invalid field access should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur oder internen Tabelle mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_field>` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die dynamische Programmierung. Es erlaubt, Feldnamen zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen, was in generischen Anwendungen oder bei der Verarbeitung von Metadaten nützlich ist. Die Verwendung von Field-Symbols (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) ist hierbei essentiell. Die Ausgabe erfolgt über ein String-Template für moderne Formatierung.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstelle ein einfaches Kontextmenü mit zwei Einträgen ('Option 1', 'Option 2') und zeige es an. Der Funktionscode für 'Option 1' soll 'FCODE1' und für 'Option 2' 'FCODE2' sein.

    " In einem echten GUI-Kontext würde man hier ro_menu->show() aufrufen.

Instructions: Generiere einen Code 128 Barcode für den String 'HELLO_ABAP' und gib ihn als XSTRING zurück.
hint: Nutze `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` und die Methode `render_barcode` mit dem Barcode-Typ `CL_RSTX_BARCODE_RENDERER=>CODE128`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_code128 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_code128_barcode
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_barcode_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_code128 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_code128_barcode.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

    TRY.
        rv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
          i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>code128
          i_data         = iv_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_code128_generation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_code128_empty_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_code128_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_barcode_code128( ).
    DATA(lv_barcode) = lo_cut->generate_code128_barcode( 'HELLO_ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_barcode ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_code128_empty_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_barcode_code128( ).
    DATA(lv_barcode) = lo_cut->generate_code128_barcode( '' ).
    " Für Code128 ist ein leerer String oft ungültig und führt zu einer Exception oder leerem XSTRING.
    " Hier wird erwartet, dass es nicht initial ist, wenn die Klasse einen leeren Barcode rendert.
    " Realistisch würde man hier eine Exception erwarten oder einen leeren XSTRING.
    " Da die Klasse eine Exception fängt, wird ein initialer XSTRING zurückgegeben.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_barcode ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Erzeugung eines Barcodes vom Typ Code 128 aus einem String. Die Methode `render_barcode` der Klasse `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` wird dafür verwendet. Fehler bei der Generierung werden mit `cx_rstx_barcode_error` abgefangen.
keywords: cl_rstx_barcode_renderer, Barcode, Code 128, XSTRING, render_barcode

Instructions: Generiere einen Barcode (z.B. Code 128) und speichere ihn als BMP-Datei im temporären Verzeichnis des Anwendungsservers. Gib den Dateipfad zurück.
hint: Nutze `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` zur Generierung und `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` (für Frontend) oder `cl_abap_file_utilities` (für Applikationsserver) zum Speichern. Für den Applikationsserver ist `OPEN DATASET` und `TRANSFER` nötig.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_save_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS save_barcode_to_app_server
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_filepath) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_save_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_barcode_to_app_server.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).
    DATA(lv_barcode_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_bmp_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_temp_dir) TYPE string VALUE '/tmp/'. " Beispiel für Linux-Systeme
    DATA(lv_full_path) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode(
          i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>code128
          i_data         = iv_data
        ).

        IF lv_barcode_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_bmp_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->get_bmp_xstring( ).

          IF lv_bmp_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
            lv_full_path = lv_temp_dir && iv_filename && '.bmp'.

            OPEN DATASET lv_full_path FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              TRANSFER lv_bmp_xstring TO lv_full_path.
              CLOSE DATASET lv_full_path.
              rv_filepath = lv_full_path.
            ELSE.
              MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei auf dem Applikationsserver' TYPE 'E'.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle ein Kontextmenü, das Einträge basierend auf Daten aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle dynamisch generiert. Zeige für jede Fluggesellschaft eine Option an.
hint: Lese Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` und nutze eine `LOOP` über die Ergebnisse, um `add_function` aufzurufen. Verwende `SELECT DISTINCT` für die Fluggesellschaften.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_menu_from_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_menu) TYPE REF TO cl_ctmenu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_menu_from_sflights.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( 'Fluggesellschaften' ).

    DATA lt_carrid TYPE SORTED TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      ro_menu->add_function( fcode = |SHOW_{ lv_carrid }| text = |Flüge von { lv_carrid }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lines( lt_carrid ) = 0.
      ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'NO_DATA' text = 'Keine Fluggesellschaften gefunden' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_menu_from_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_menu_from_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ctmenu_sflights( ).
    DATA(lo_menu) = lo_cut->create_menu_from_sflights( ).

    DATA lt_carrid TYPE SORTED TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_carrid ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu->get_function_text( |SHOW_{ lv_carrid }| ) exp = |Flüge von { lv_carrid }| ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_menu->get_function_text( 'NO_DATA' ) exp = 'Keine Fluggesellschaften gefunden' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Generierung von Kontextmenü-Einträgen basierend auf Datenbankdaten (hier aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle). Es verwendet `SELECT DISTINCT` und eine `LOOP` mit String-Templates, um für jede gefundene Fluggesellschaft einen Menüeintrag zu erstellen, was eine flexible Benutzeroberfläche ermöglicht.
keywords: cl_ctmenu, SFLIGHTS, Dynamisches Menü, Datenbankzugriff, SELECT DISTINCT, LOOP, String Templates

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT und filtern Sie diese nach dem Datenalter, um nur 'heiße' Daten zu erhalten. Beachten Sie, dass die tatsächliche Filterung von der Data-Aging-Konfiguration im System abhängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die DATA AGING Klausel in der SELECT-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hot_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hot_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE fldate > '20230101' " Beispielhafte Filterung für 'heiße' Daten
      DATA AGING. " Diese Klausel stellt sicher, dass nur 'heiße' Daten gelesen werden
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_hot_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_hot_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_hot_flights( ).
    " Da SFLIGHT eine Standardtabelle ist und Data Aging eine Systemkonfiguration erfordert,
    " können wir hier nur prüfen, ob die Tabelle gefüllt ist oder nicht.
    " Ein echter Test würde eine Data-Aging-fähige Tabelle und Konfiguration erfordern.
    " Für dieses Beispiel nehmen wir an, dass ohne spezielle Konfiguration keine 'heißen' Daten gefunden werden.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DATA AGING` Klausel in der `SELECT`-Anweisung ist eine moderne ABAP-Funktion (ab 7.40), die es ermöglicht, Daten basierend auf ihrer 'Temperatur' (heiß, warm, kalt) zu filtern. Dies ist eng mit dem Data Aging Framework und Klassen wie `cl_abap_stack_temperature` verbunden, die intern die Datenklassifizierung verwalten. Die Klausel sorgt dafür, dass nur die als 'heiß' markierten Daten aus der Datenbank gelesen werden, was die Performance bei großen Datenmengen verbessern kann. Die tatsächliche Wirkung hängt von der Systemkonfiguration ab.
keywords: DATA AGING, SELECT, SFLIGHT, Database Access, Performance, cl_abap_stack_temperature

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Query-Parameter aus einer gegebenen URL in eine Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_utility=>parse_url` und dann `get_query_string` in Kombination mit String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_parse_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_query_params TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY key.
    METHODS get_query_params IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_params) TYPE ty_query_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_parse_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_query_params.
    DATA(lo_url) = cl_http_utility=>parse_url( iv_url ).
    DATA(lv_query_string) = lo_url->get_query_string( ).

    IF lv_query_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_pairs) = VALUE string_table( FOR <pair> IN cl_abap_string_utilities=>split_string( iv_string = lv_query_string iv_separator = '&' ) WHERE ( <pair> IS NOT INITIAL ) ( <pair> ) ).
      rt_params = VALUE #( FOR <pair> IN lt_pairs
                           LET lv_pos = find( val = <pair> sub = '=' ) IN
                             ( COND #( WHEN lv_pos IS NOT INITIAL
                                       THEN ( key = cl_http_utility=>url_decode( substring( val = <pair> len = lv_pos ) ) value = cl_http_utility=>url_decode( substring( val = <pair> off = lv_pos + 1 ) ) )
                                       ELSE ( key = cl_http_utility=>url_decode( <pair> ) value = '' ) ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_query_params FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_query_params.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_parse_query( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = `https://example.com/path?param1=value1&param2=value2%20with%20space&param3`.
    DATA(lt_params) = lo_cut->get_query_params( lv_url ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_params[ key = 'param1' ] value exp = 'value1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_params[ key = 'param2' ] value exp = 'value2 with space' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_params[ key = 'param3' ] value exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_params ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(lv_url_no_query) = `https://example.com/path`.
    DATA(lt_params_empty) = lo_cut->get_query_params( lv_url_no_query ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_params_empty ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_http_utility=>parse_url` zur Erzeugung eines URL-Objekts und die Extraktion der Query-String-Komponente. Anschließend werden moderne ABAP-Konstrukte wie `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...` und `COND` verwendet, um die Parameter effizient in eine Hash-Tabelle zu zerlegen und zu dekodieren. Dies ist eine saubere und funktionale Art, URL-Parameter zu verarbeiten.

CLASS zcl_http_gen_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_query_params TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY key.
    METHODS generate_query_string IMPORTING it_params TYPE ty_query_params RETURNING VALUE(rv_query_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_gen_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_query_string.
    DATA(lt_encoded_pairs) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR param IN it_params
      ( |{ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param-key ) }={ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param-value ) }| )
    ).
    rv_query_string = cl_abap_string_utilities=>concatenate_string_table(
                            iv_string_table = lt_encoded_pairs
                            iv_separator    = '&' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine vollständige URL aus einzelnen Komponenten (Schema, Host, Pfad, Query-Parameter) unter Verwendung von String-Templates und funktionalen Methoden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_utility=>url_encode` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_build_url DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_query_params TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY key.
    METHODS build_full_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_scheme TYPE string
        iv_host   TYPE string
        iv_path   TYPE string OPTIONAL
        it_params TYPE ty_query_params OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_full_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_build_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_full_url.
    DATA(lv_query_string) = COND string(
      WHEN it_params IS NOT INITIAL THEN
        REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR param IN it_params
          NEXT s = COND string(
            WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
              |{ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param-key ) }={ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param-value ) }|
            ELSE
              |{ s }&{ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param-key ) }={ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param-value ) }|
          )
        )
      ELSE ''
    ).

    rv_full_url = |{ iv_scheme }://{ iv_host }{ iv_path }{ COND string( WHEN lv_query_string IS NOT INITIAL THEN |?{ lv_query_string }| ELSE '' ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_build_full_url FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_full_url.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_build_url( ).
    DATA(lt_params) = VALUE zcl_http_build_url=>ty_query_params(
      ( key = 'id' value = '123' )
      ( key = 'name' value = 'Test User' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_url) = `https://api.example.com/users?id=123&name=Test%20User`.
    DATA(lv_actual_url) = lo_cut->build_full_url(
      iv_scheme = 'https'
      iv_host   = 'api.example.com'
      iv_path   = '/users'
      it_params = lt_params
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_url exp = lv_expected_url ).

    DATA(lv_simple_url) = lo_cut->build_full_url(
      iv_scheme = 'http'
      iv_host   = 'localhost'
      iv_path   = '/index.html'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_simple_url exp = `http://localhost/index.html` ).

    DATA(lv_url_no_path) = lo_cut->build_full_url(
      iv_scheme = 'ftp'
      iv_host   = 'files.example.com'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_url_no_path exp = `ftp://files.example.com` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Konstruktion einer vollständigen URL aus ihren Komponenten. Es nutzt moderne ABAP-Features wie `REDUCE` für die effiziente Aggregation der Query-Parameter, `COND` für bedingte Logik und String-Templates für die lesbare und performante Zusammenstellung des finalen URL-Strings. `cl_http_utility=>url_encode` stellt sicher, dass Parameterwerte korrekt kodiert werden.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Dateinamen (inkl. Erweiterung) aus einem vollständigen URL-Pfad.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Funktionen wie `find_reverse` und `substring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_filename DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filename_from_path IMPORTING iv_path TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_filename) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_filename IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filename_from_path.
    DATA(lv_last_slash_pos) = find_reverse( val = iv_path sub = '/' ).
    IF lv_last_slash_pos IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_filename = substring( val = iv_path off = lv_last_slash_pos + 1 ).
    ELSE.
      rv_filename = iv_path.
    ENDIF.
    " Optional: Query-Parameter und Fragment entfernen, falls im Pfad enthalten
    DATA(lv_query_pos) = find( val = rv_filename sub = '?' ).
    IF lv_query_pos IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_filename = substring( val = rv_filename len = lv_query_pos ).
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_fragment_pos) = find( val = rv_filename sub = '#' ).
    IF lv_fragment_pos IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_filename = substring( val = rv_filename len = lv_fragment_pos ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_filename_from_path( 'image.jpg' ) exp = 'image.jpg' ).

CLASS zcl_http_headers_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_field,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_header_field.

CLASS zcl_http_headers_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_headers_to_string.
    rv_header_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR header IN it_headers
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
          |{ header-name }: { header-value }|
        ELSE
          |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ header-name }: { header-value }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Header-Felder aus einem HTTP-Header-String in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Funktionen wie `split` und `find` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_string_to_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header_field,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_header_field.
    TYPES tt_header_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_header_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_string_to_headers IMPORTING iv_header_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_headers) TYPE tt_header_fields.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_string_to_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_headers.
    DATA(lt_lines) = VALUE string_table( FOR <line> IN cl_abap_string_utilities=>split_string( iv_string = iv_header_string iv_separator = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) WHERE ( <line> IS NOT INITIAL ) ( <line> ) ).

    rt_headers = VALUE #( FOR <line> IN lt_lines
                          LET lv_colon_pos = find( val = <line> sub = ':' ) IN
                            ( COND #( WHEN lv_colon_pos IS NOT INITIAL
                                      THEN ( name = substring( val = <line> len = lv_colon_pos ) value = substring( val = <line> off = lv_colon_pos + 1 )->trim_leading( ) )
                                      ELSE ( name = <line> value = '' ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Struktur, die zur Laufzeit definiert wird, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` zusammen mit `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_field,
        name TYPE fieldname,
        type TYPE abap_type_kind,
        length TYPE i,
      END OF ty_s_field,
      ty_t_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_fields TYPE ty_t_fields
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA:
      lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
      ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_fields INTO DATA(ls_field).
      ls_component-name = ls_field-name.
      CASE ls_field-type.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( p_length = ls_field-length ). " Corrected to get_c for char
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Handle other types or raise error
          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    " Fill with some dynamic data
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA DATA(lo_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lo_line->* TO <ls_line>.

    " Example: Add two rows
    LOOP AT it_fields INTO ls_field.
      CASE ls_field-name.
        WHEN 'FIELD1'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field1>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_field1> = 'Value A'.
          ENDIF.
        WHEN 'FIELD2'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field2>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_field2> = 100.
          ENDIF.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
    INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

    LOOP AT it_fields INTO ls_field.
      CASE ls_field-name.
        WHEN 'FIELD1'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field1>. " <lv_field1> is still assigned from previous loop
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_field1> = 'Value B'.
          ENDIF.
        WHEN 'FIELD2'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field2>. " <lv_field2> is still assigned from previous loop
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_field2> = 200.
          ENDIF.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
    INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, basierend auf einem übergebenen Methodennamen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS example_method_1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS example_method_2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          RECEIVING
            rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD example_method_1.
    rv_text = 'Method 1 called'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD example_method_2.
    rv_text = 'Method 2 called'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights`, wobei die Spaltenauswahl dynamisch erfolgt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` mit dynamischer Spaltenliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_column_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_dynamic_columns.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    DATA(lv_columns_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <column> IN it_column_names
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <column> ELSE s && ', ' && <column> )
    ).

    IF lv_columns_string IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamically create structure for selected columns
    DATA(lo_sflight_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ) ).

    LOOP AT it_column_names INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      TRY.
          DATA(ls_sflight_comp) = lo_sflight_descr->get_component( lv_column_name ).
          ls_component-name = ls_sflight_comp-name.
          ls_component-type = ls_sflight_comp-type.
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
        CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
          " Ignore non-existent columns
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Dynamic SELECT
    SELECT (lv_columns_string)
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights`, wobei die Spaltenauswahl dynamisch erfolgt und die Daten mit `FOR` und `VALUE` aggregiert werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie dynamische Typbeschreibung mit `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_field,
        name TYPE fieldname,
        type TYPE abap_type_kind,
        length TYPE i,
      END OF ty_s_field,
      ty_t_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_sflights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_group_by_columns TYPE string_table
        iv_aggregate_column TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_sflights_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    DATA(lo_sflight_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ) ).

    " Add group-by columns to dynamic structure
    LOOP AT it_group_by_columns INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      TRY.
          DATA(ls_sflight_comp) = lo_sflight_descr->get_component( lv_column_name ).
          ls_component-name = ls_sflight_comp-name.
          ls_component-type = ls_sflight_comp-type.
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
        CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
          " Ignore non-existent columns
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add aggregate column (e.g., sum of price) to dynamic structure
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_agg_comp) = lo_sflight_descr->get_component( iv_aggregate_column ).
        ls_component-name = |SUM_{iv_aggregate_column}|.
        ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p( p_length = 16 p_decimals = 2 ). " Assuming price-like aggregation
        APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
        " Ignore non-existent aggregate column
    ENDTRY.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_aggregated_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_aggregated_table>.

    " Read all sflights data
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Dynamic aggregation using FOR and VALUE
    DATA(lv_group_key_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <column> IN it_group_by_columns
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |ls_sflight-{<column>}| ELSE s && ` ` && |ls_sflight-{<column>}| )
    ).

    IF lv_group_key_string IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " This part is tricky to make fully dynamic with FOR/VALUE and field symbols for aggregation.
    " A fully dynamic aggregation with FOR/VALUE would require dynamic code generation or a more complex RTTI approach.
    " For this example, we'll simulate the aggregation logic with a loop and ASSIGN COMPONENT.

    DATA lt_temp_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data.
    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF REF TO data
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( key = lv_group_key_string ) " This is pseudo-code, direct dynamic group by is not possible like this
      ( VALUE #( 
          " This part would need dynamic field symbol assignment and aggregation
          " For simplicity, we'll do a manual loop-based aggregation below
        ) 
      ).

    " Manual aggregation for dynamic columns
    DATA(lt_result_temp) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_sflights_sorted) = lt_sflights.
    SORT lt_sflights_sorted BY (it_group_by_columns).

    DATA lo_current_group_line TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_current_group_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_agg_value> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_group_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_sorted INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF lo_current_group_line IS INITIAL.
        CREATE DATA lo_current_group_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_current_group_line->* TO <ls_current_group_line>.
        LOOP AT it_group_by_columns INTO lv_column_name.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_group_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_current_group_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_target_field>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              <lv_target_field> = <lv_group_field>.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT |SUM_{iv_aggregate_column}| OF STRUCTURE <ls_current_group_line> TO <lv_agg_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_aggregate_column OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_source_agg_value>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_agg_value> = <lv_source_agg_value>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        DATA(lv_group_changed) = abap_false.
        LOOP AT it_group_by_columns INTO lv_column_name.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_group_field>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_current_group_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_target_field>).
          IF <lv_group_field> <> <lv_target_field>.
            lv_group_changed = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_group_changed = abap_true.
          INSERT lo_current_group_line INTO TABLE <lt_aggregated_table>.
          CLEAR lo_current_group_line.
          CLEAR <ls_current_group_line>.
          CLEAR <lv_agg_value>.
          CONTINUE. " Restart loop to process new group
        ENDIF.

        " Aggregate within current group
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_aggregate_column OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_source_agg_value>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_agg_value> = <lv_agg_value> + <lv_source_agg_value>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lo_current_group_line IS NOT INITIAL.
      INSERT lo_current_group_line INTO TABLE <lt_aggregated_table>.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_group_by) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_sflights_dynamic(
      it_group_by_columns = lt_group_by
      iv_aggregate_column = 'PRICE'
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_result> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <lt_result>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_result> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_carrid> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_sum_price> TYPE any.

    " Find 'AA' and check sum
    READ TABLE <lt_result> ASSIGNING <ls_line> WITH KEY ('CARRID') = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SUM_PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_sum_price>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_carrid> exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <lv_sum_price> > 0 ). " Just check if it's aggregated
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Could not find aggregated data for CARRID AA.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_aggregate_by_carrid_connid.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_group_by) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_sflights_dynamic(
      it_group_by_columns = lt_group_by
      iv_aggregate_column = 'PRICE'
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_result> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <lt_result>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_result> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_carrid> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_connid> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_sum_price> TYPE any.

    " Find 'AA' and '0017' and check sum
    READ TABLE <lt_result> ASSIGNING <ls_line> WITH KEY ('CARRID') = 'AA' ('CONNID') = '0017'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_connid>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SUM_PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_sum_price>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_carrid> exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_connid> exp = '0017' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <lv_sum_price> > 0 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Could not find aggregated data for CARRID AA, CONNID 0017.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die komplexe dynamische Aggregation von Daten. Während `FOR` und `VALUE` für statische Aggregationen sehr effizient sind, erfordert die vollständige Dynamisierung der Gruppierungs- und Aggregationslogik zur Laufzeit eine Kombination aus RTTI, Feld-Symbolen und manueller Schleifenverarbeitung, da die `GROUP BY` Klausel von `FOR` nicht direkt dynamisch über Feld-Symbole gesteuert werden kann.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Aggregation, RTTI, Field Symbols, FOR, VALUE, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus einer Liste von Flügen alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' heraus und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und Zielorte enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE` Bedingung und dem `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_in,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_in.
    TYPES tt_flight_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_out,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityto TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_out.
    TYPES tt_flight_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_transform
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_flight_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_flight_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_transform.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                             ( connid = ls_flight-connid
                               cityto = ls_flight-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_transform FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_it_for_filter=>tt_flight_in(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'CHICAGO' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[ 2 ]-cityto exp = 'CHICAGO' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Bedingungen zu verwenden, wird die Logik in einer einzigen, lesbaren Zeile ausgedrückt.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filter, Transform

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc, " Occupied seats
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax, " Max seats
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_flight_capacity
        iv_carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_it_reduce_sum=>tt_flight_capacity(
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 120 seatsmax = 250 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( it_flights = lt_input iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( it_flights = lt_input iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 450 ). " 200 + 250
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Weise. Er initialisiert einen Akkumulator (`sum`) und wendet dann eine Operation für jedes Element an, das die `WHERE`-Bedingung erfüllt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum

Instructions: Greifen Sie direkt auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, um den Zielort eines bestimmten Fluges zu ermitteln. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Flug nicht gefunden wird.

CLASS zcl_it_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,

CLASS zcl_it_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, indem Sie eine Klasse erstellen, die mehrere Methoden hat, die jeweils die Instanz der Klasse zurückgeben, um aufeinanderfolgende Aufrufe zu ermöglichen.
hint: Jede Methode sollte `ME` zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_add TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_mult TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS set_initial_value IMPORTING iv_initial TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_mult.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_initial_value.
    mv_value = iv_initial.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).

    lo_calculator->set_initial_value( 5 )->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->mv_value exp = 16 ). " (5 + 3) * 2
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies führt zu einem flüssigeren, lesbareren Code und ist ein gängiges Muster in modernen objektorientierten Sprachen. Jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` mit einer statischen Prüfklasse, um eine Ausnahme zu werfen und diese in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block zu behandeln.

CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_error.

    METHODS call_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_error.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate some operation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        perform_risky_operation( iv_input = iv_value ).
        rv_result = 'Operation successful'.
      CATCH zcx_custom_error.
        rv_result = 'Operation failed: Input was negative'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Unterklassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erzeugt. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer Basisklasse für Dokumente und zwei Unterklassen für 'Rechnung' und 'Lieferschein'.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine statische Factory-Methode in der Basisklasse und `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischem Typ.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document.
  METHODS get_document_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_document_base DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
    CLASS METHODS create_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_type         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zif_document
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_invoice DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_document_base FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_document~get_document_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_delivery_note DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_document_base FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_document~get_document_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = |ZCL_{ iv_type }|.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_document TYPE (lv_class_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_invoice IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_document_type.
    rv_type = 'Rechnung'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delivery_note IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_document~get_document_type.
    rv_type = 'Lieferschein'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_document->zif_document~get_document_type( ) exp = 'Rechnung' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lo_document IS INSTANCE OF zcl_invoice ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_delivery_note.

explanation: Das Factory-Muster ist ein wichtiges Entwurfsmuster in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Eine statische Factory-Methode in der Basisklasse ermöglicht die Erzeugung von Instanzen spezifischer Unterklassen, ohne dass der Aufrufer die konkreten Klassennamen kennen muss. Dies fördert die lose Kopplung und die Erweiterbarkeit des Systems. Die dynamische Objekterzeugung mit `CREATE OBJECT TYPE (lv_class_name)` ist hierbei zentral.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Dynamic Object Creation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Gesamtpassagierkapazität. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_flight_detail
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid)
                           ( carrid         = lv_carrid
                             flight_count   = GROUP SIZE
                             total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_member IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-seatsmax ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_summarize_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_summarize_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_it_group_by=>tt_flight_detail(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' seatsmax = 300 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights_by_carrier( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_summary_lh) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh-total_capacity exp = 450 ). " 200 + 250

    DATA(ls_summary_aa) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_aa-total_capacity exp = 250 ). " 150 + 100

    DATA(ls_summary_ba) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'BA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_ba-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_ba-total_capacity exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS` Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und bietet eine kompaktere Syntax für komplexe Datenmanipulationen.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, Aggregation

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen XML-String, der Flugdaten enthält, in eine interne Tabelle von Flugobjekten. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Laden des XML und `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit einer einfachen Transformation zur Deserialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parse_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parse_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    " Simple XSLT transformation to map XML to ABAP structure
    DATA(lv_transformation) = '<?sap.transform simple?>
      <tt:transform xmlns:tt="http://www.sap.com/transformation-templates">
        <tt:root name="FLIGHTS"/>
        <tt:template>
          <Flights>
            <tt:loop ref=".FLIGHTS">
              <Flight>
                <Carrid tt:value="CARRID"/>
                <Connid tt:value="CONNID"/>
                <Fldate tt:value="FLDATE"/>
              </Flight>
            </tt:loop>
          </Flights>
        </tt:template>
      </tt:transform>'.

    CALL TRANSFORMATION (lv_transformation)
      SOURCE XML lo_xml_document->get_xdocument( )
      RESULT FLIGHTS = rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_flight_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parse_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) =
      `<Flights>` &&
        `<Flight><Carrid>LH</Carrid><Connid>0400</Connid><Fldate>20251128</Fldate></Flight>` &&
        `<Flight><Carrid>AA</Carrid><Connid>0010</Connid><Fldate>20251129</Fldate></Flight>` &&
      `</Flights>`. 

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->parse_flight_xml( lv_xml ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 flights'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'First flight carrier ID mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-connid
      exp = '0010'
      msg = 'Second flight connection ID mismatch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet `cl_xml_document` zum Laden des XML-Strings und `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit einer Inline-Simple-Transformation. Dies ist ein moderner und effizienter Weg, um XML-Daten direkt in ABAP-Strukturen zu deserialisieren, ohne manuelle Knoteniteration.
keywords: XML Processing, cl_xml_document, CALL TRANSFORMATION, Simple Transformation, Deserialization

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen XML-String aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION` mit einer einfachen Transformation und `cl_xml_document` zum Speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_gen_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_gen_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_xml.
    " Simple XSLT transformation to map ABAP structure to XML
    DATA(lv_transformation) = '<?sap.transform simple?>
      <tt:transform xmlns:tt="http://www.sap.com/transformation-templates">
        <tt:root name="FLIGHTS"/>
        <tt:template>
          <Flights>
            <tt:loop ref=".FLIGHTS">
              <Flight>
                <Carrid tt:value="CARRID"/>
                <Connid tt:value="CONNID"/>
                <Fldate tt:value="FLDATE"/>
              </Flight>
            </tt:loop>
          </Flights>
        </tt:template>
      </tt:transform>'.

    DATA(lx_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_encoding(
                                  i_encoding = 'UTF-8'
                                  i_version  = '1.0'
                                ).

    CALL TRANSFORMATION (lv_transformation)
      SOURCE FLIGHTS = it_flights
      RESULT XML lx_xml_document->get_xdocument( ).

    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lx_xml_document->get_xdocument( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_add_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_new_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_parent_xpath TYPE string
        iv_node_name  TYPE string
        iv_node_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_add_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_new_node.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_xml_document->find_node( iv_parent_xpath ).
    IF lo_parent_node IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_new_node) = lo_xml_document->create_node(
                                 i_name = iv_node_name
                                 i_type = if_xml_node=>co_node_type_element
                               ).
      lo_new_node->set_value( iv_node_value ).
      lo_parent_node->append_child( lo_new_node ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_modified_xml = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lo_xml_document->get_xdocument( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_delete_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xml_delete_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_node.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_xml_string ) ).

    DATA(lo_node_to_delete) = lo_xml_document->find_node( iv_xpath ).
    IF lo_node_to_delete IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_node_to_delete->get_parent( ).
      IF lo_parent_node IS BOUND.
        lo_parent_node->remove_child( lo_node_to_delete ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rv_modified_xml = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lo_xml_document->get_xdocument( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_validate_syntax DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Generiere eine interne Tabelle mit zufälligen Flugdaten (Flugnummer, Datum, Preis) für eine bestimmte Anzahl von Einträgen. Nutze dabei die Struktur von SFLIGHT.
hint: Nutze `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion und `cl_abap_random` für die Zufallswerte. Denke daran, einen Seed für `cl_abap_random` zu setzen, um reproduzierbare Tests zu ermöglichen.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_seed  TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( iv_seed ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                           ( carrid = |AA|
                             connid = lo_random->int( ip_min = 100 ip_max = 999 ) && ''
                             fldate = cl_abap_random_date=>create( iv_seed = iv_seed )->get_date( ip_min = 20250101 ip_max = 20251231 )
                             price  = lo_random->float( ip_min = 100.00 ip_max = 1000.00 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeuge einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge, der Großbuchstaben und Ziffern enthält.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random` für die Zeichenauswahl und String Templates für den Aufbau des Strings. Definiere einen Pool von erlaubten Zeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
        iv_seed   TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_char_pool_size) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( iv_seed ).

    rv_random_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                     FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
                                     NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random->int( ip_min = 0 ip_max = lv_char_pool_size - 1 )(1) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_random_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( iv_length = 10 iv_seed = 789 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_string ) exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_random_string exp = 'P90X2Q1R3S' msg = 'Expected specific string with seed' ).

    " Check if all characters are from the allowed pool
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_all_chars_valid) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lv_random_string INTO DATA(lv_char).
      IF NOT ( find( val = lc_chars sub = lv_char ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
        lv_all_chars_valid = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_all_chars_valid msg = 'All characters must be from the defined pool' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( iv_length = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_random_string msg = 'Should return empty string for zero length' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und String Templates, um einen zufälligen String zu generieren. `cl_abap_random` wählt dabei zufällige Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Pool aus. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, Strings in modernem ABAP zu manipulieren und zu erstellen.

hint: Nutze `FILTER` und `cl_abap_random` innerhalb der Filterbedingung, um eine zufällige Auswahl zu treffen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_randomly
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_seed    TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_threshold TYPE f DEFAULT 0.5 " Probability to keep an item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_randomly.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( iv_seed ).

    rt_filtered_numbers = FILTER #( it_numbers USING KEY default
                                    WHERE ( lo_random->float( ) < iv_threshold ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simuliere eine Reihe von 10 Münzwürfen und zähle die Anzahl der 'Kopf'-Ergebnisse. Ein Münzwurf hat eine 50%ige Chance auf 'Kopf'.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` über eine Schleife und `cl_abap_random` für jeden Wurf. Vergleiche die Zufallszahl mit 0.5.
solution:
CLASS zcl_coin_flip_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_coin_flips
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_flips TYPE i
        iv_seed      TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_heads_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_coin_flip_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_coin_flips.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( iv_seed ).

    rv_heads_count = REDUCE i( INIT heads = 0
                                FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_flips
                                NEXT heads = heads + COND i( WHEN lo_random->float( ) < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mische die Einträge einer internen Tabelle von Strings zufällig durch (Shuffle).
hint: Füge ein temporäres Feld mit einem zufälligen Wert hinzu, sortiere die Tabelle nach diesem Feld und entferne es dann wieder. Nutze `VALUE` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_seed    TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_shuffler_item,
             random_key TYPE f,
             value      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_shuffler_item.
    TYPES tt_shuffler_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_shuffler_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( iv_seed ).

    DATA(lt_temp) = VALUE tt_shuffler_items( FOR <fs> IN it_strings
                                             ( random_key = lo_random->float( )
                                               value      = <fs> ) ).

    SORT lt_temp BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_strings = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN lt_temp ( <fs>-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).

    " Check if all original elements are present

    DATA(lt_shuffled_sorted) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_shuffled_sorted ASCENDING.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled_sorted exp = lt_original_sorted msg = 'All elements must be preserved' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_empty ).

Instructions: Wähle eine zufällige Untermenge von N Elementen aus einer internen Tabelle aus, ohne Duplikate.
hint: Mische die Tabelle zuerst und wähle dann die ersten N Elemente aus. Nutze `VALUE`, `FOR` und `cl_abap_random` für das Mischen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_subset_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_subset
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_count   TYPE i
        iv_seed    TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_subset) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_subset_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_subset.
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR it_strings IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_strings ).
    IF iv_count > lv_table_size.
      " Cannot select more items than available, return all or raise error
      rt_subset = it_strings.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " First, shuffle the table (reusing logic from previous example)
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_shuffler_item,
             random_key TYPE f,
             value      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_shuffler_item.
    TYPES tt_shuffler_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_shuffler_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( iv_seed ).

    DATA(lt_temp) = VALUE tt_shuffler_items( FOR <fs> IN it_strings
                                             ( random_key = lo_random->float( )
                                               value      = <fs> ) ).

    SORT lt_temp BY random_key.

    " Then, take the first N elements
    rt_subset = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                           ( lt_temp[ i ]-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach Fluggesellschaft und zähle die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Füge zufällige Flugdaten hinzu.
hint: Nutze `GROUP BY` und `VALUE` mit `cl_abap_random` für die Daten. Aggregiere mit `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_flights TYPE i
        iv_seed        TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( iv_seed ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flights( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_flights
                                         ( carrid = COND #( WHEN lo_random->float( ) < 0.3 THEN 'LH'
                                                            WHEN lo_random->float( ) < 0.6 THEN 'UA'
                                                            ELSE 'AA' )
                                           connid = lo_random->int( ip_min = 100 ip_max = 999 ) && ''
                                           fldate = cl_abap_random_date=>create( iv_seed = iv_seed )->get_date( ip_min = 20250101 ip_max = 20251231 )
                                           price  = lo_random->float( ip_min = 100.00 ip_max = 1000.00 ) ) ).

    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_flights BY flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   count  = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 carriers' ).

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt von 100 zufälligen Ganzzahlen zwischen 1 und 100.
hint: Nutze `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `cl_abap_random` um die Zahlen zu generieren, und dann `REDUCE` für die Summe und den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
        iv_seed  TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF iv_count <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( iv_seed ).

    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                                                                 ( lo_random->int( ip_min = iv_min ip_max = iv_max ) ) ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs> IN lt_numbers NEXT s = s + <fs> ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / iv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (z.B. 'SFLIGHT'), befüllen Sie diese mit Daten und geben Sie den Inhalt aus. Verwenden Sie RTTI und Feld-Symbole.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung. Denken Sie an `UNASSIGN` für Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_field>         TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        " Beispiel: Daten befüllen (hier statisch, könnte auch dynamisch sein)
        IF iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
          SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @<lt_dynamic_table> UP TO 2 ROWS.
        ELSEIF iv_struct_name = 'SCARR'.
          SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @<lt_dynamic_table> UP TO 2 ROWS.
        ENDIF.

        " Ausgabe des Inhalts (dynamisch)
        LOOP AT <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
          DATA(lv_line_output) = ``.
          LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              lv_line_output = lv_line_output && |{ls_component-name}: {<lv_field>}, |.
            ENDIF.
            UNASSIGN <lv_field>. " Wichtig: Feld-Symbol nach Gebrauch unassignen
          ENDLOOP.
          cl_demo_output=>display( lv_line_output ).
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error cx_sy_assign_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        cl_demo_output=>display( 'Fehler bei der dynamischen Tabellenerstellung oder Datenzuweisung.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und weisen Sie dynamisch ein Feld jeder Zeile einem Feld-Symbol zu, um dessen Wert zu ändern.

CLASS zcl_dyn_fs_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS update_field_in_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_value  TYPE string

CLASS zcl_dyn_fs_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_in_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_sflight> TYPE sflight,
                   <lv_field>   TYPE any.

    rv_success = abap_true.
    LOOP AT ct_sflight ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_sflight> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Prüfen, ob der Typ des Feldes mit dem neuen Wert kompatibel ist
        TRY.
            <lv_field> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            cl_demo_output=>display( |Typkonvertierungsfehler für Feld { iv_field_name } mit Wert { iv_new_value }| ).
            rv_success = abap_false.
            EXIT.
        ENDTRY.
      ELSE.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Feld { iv_field_name } nicht in Struktur gefunden.| ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <lv_field>. " Feld-Symbol nach Gebrauch unassignen
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
