Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten (Felder) einer Struktur anhand ihres Namens.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>GET_COMPONENTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_get_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type_kind TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info,
           tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_components_of_struct
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_get_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_components_of_struct.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
            name      = ls_component-name
            type_kind = ls_component-type_descr->type_kind
          ) TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error.
        " Strukturname existiert nicht oder ist kein Strukturtyp
        CLEAR rt_components.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle und befüllen Sie diese mit Daten aus einer anderen dynamischen Tabelle, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie RTTI für die Typbeschreibung, `CREATE DATA` für die Tabellen und Feld-Symbole für den Datenzugriff. Nutzen Sie `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS copy_dynamic_table_fields
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table TYPE REF TO data
        it_field_names  TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_target_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_dynamic_table_fields.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_source> TYPE any,
                   <lt_target> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_target> TYPE any,
                   <lv_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <lv_target_field> TYPE any.

    DATA: lo_source_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_source_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_target_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_target_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_target_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    ASSIGN ir_source_table->* TO <lt_source>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <lt_source> IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_source_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_source> ).
        lo_source_line_descr ?= lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        " Zielstruktur-Komponenten basierend auf gewünschten Feldern erstellen
        LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
          DATA(ls_source_component) = lo_source_line_descr->get_component( lv_field_name ).
          APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr(
            name      = ls_source_component-name
            type_descr = ls_source_component-type_descr
          ) TO lt_target_components.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_target_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_target_components ).
        lo_target_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_target_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_target_table TYPE HANDLE lo_target_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_target_table->* TO <lt_target>.

        " Daten kopieren
        LOOP AT <lt_source> ASSIGNING <ls_source>.
          APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_target> ASSIGNING <ls_target>.
          LOOP AT lt_target_components INTO DATA(ls_target_comp_def).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp_def-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_source> TO <lv_source_field>.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp_def-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_target> TO <lv_target_field>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_target_field> = <lv_source_field>.
            ENDIF.
            UNASSIGN <lv_source_field>. " Wichtig: Feld-Symbole unassignen
            UNASSIGN <lv_target_field>.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error cx_sy_assign_error.
        CLEAR rr_target_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den HMAC für einen Stream von Daten (z.B. eine große Datei), indem Sie die Daten in Chunks verarbeiten. Verwenden Sie SHA-256.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_HMAC=>GET_INSTANCE`, `UPDATE_HMAC` in einer Schleife und `GET_HMAC`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_stream DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac_stream
      IMPORTING
        it_data_chunks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_key         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_stream IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_stream.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = cl_abap_hmac=>get_instance(
      if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      if_key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( iv_key )->get_xstring( )
    ).

    LOOP AT it_data_chunks INTO DATA(lv_chunk).
      lo_hmac->update_hmac( if_data = lv_chunk ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_hmac->get_hmac( IMPORTING ef_hmac = rv_hmac ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_stream_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_stream( ).
    DATA(lv_full_data_string) = 'This is a very long string that needs to be processed in chunks for HMAC calculation.'.
    DATA(lv_key) = 'stream_key'.

    DATA(lt_chunks) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_chunk_size) TYPE i VALUE 10.

    WHILE lv_offset < xstrlen( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( lv_full_data_string )->get_xstring( ) ).
      DATA(lv_current_chunk) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( lv_full_data_string )->get_xstring( lv_offset )+lv_chunk_size.
      APPEND lv_current_chunk TO lt_chunks.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_chunk_size.
    ENDWHILE.

    DATA(lv_expected_hmac) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lo_hmac_calc) = cl_abap_hmac=>get_instance(
      if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      if_key       = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( lv_key )->get_xstring( )

    lo_hmac_calc->calculate_hmac_for_string(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = lv_full_data_string

        ef_hmac = lv_expected_hmac
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_hmac_stream( it_data_chunks = lt_chunks iv_key = lv_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_hmac
      exp = lv_expected_hmac
      msg = 'Stream HMAC calculation failed'

Instructions: Summieren Sie dynamisch den Wert einer Spalte in einer internen Tabelle, deren Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` als Datenquelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>` innerhalb einer Schleife über die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_column
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE p DECIMALS 2. " Using packed decimal for currency/price
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>   TYPE ty_sflight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value>  TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Check if the field symbol is numeric before adding
        IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_value> IS NUMERIC.
          rv_sum = rv_sum + <fs_value>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_invalid_column.

    ).

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_by_column
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_by_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE
      ( LET lv_current_value = '' IN
          ( ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE table_line TO <fs_value> )
          ( IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED THEN
              lv_current_value = |{ <fs_value> }|
            ENDIF )
          ( lv_current_value = iv_filter_value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_column_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value   TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data        TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_column_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ty_sflight_data.

    ct_data = it_data.

    LOOP AT ct_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
        TRY.
            " Attempt to assign the new value, handling type conversion
            <fs_value> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Handle conversion error if new_value cannot be converted to target type
            " For simplicity, we ignore it here, but in real code, log or raise exception
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Dies ist mit `ASSIGN` und `CREATE DATA` komplexer, da die Struktur der Tabelle geändert werden müsste. Eine pragmatische moderne Lösung wäre, eine neue Tabelle mit erweiterter Struktur zu erstellen und die Daten zu mappen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_add_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_base,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_base.
    TYPES tt_sflight_base TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_base WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_dynamic_column
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_sflight_base
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_default_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_new_data) TYPE REF TO data. " Return a reference to a dynamic table
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_add_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_dynamic_column.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    " Get description of base structure
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data[ 1 ] ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Add new component
    ls_component-name = iv_column_name.
    ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    " Create new dynamic structure and table type
    DATA(lo_new_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_new_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_new_struct_descr ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rt_new_data TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_new_data->* TO <fs_new_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_base_line> TYPE ty_sflight_base.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_column_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_base_line>.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_new_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_new_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_new_line->* TO <fs_new_line>.

      " Move existing data
      <fs_new_line>-carrid = <fs_base_line>-carrid.
      <fs_new_line>-connid = <fs_base_line>-connid.
      <fs_new_line>-fldate = <fs_base_line>-fldate.
      <fs_new_line>-price  = <fs_base_line>-price.

      " Set default value for new column
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_new_line> TO <fs_new_column_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_new_column_value> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_new_column_value> = iv_default_value.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND <fs_new_line> TO <fs_new_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Ähnlich wie beim Hinzufügen einer Spalte erfordert dies RTTI, `CREATE DATA` und das Mappen der Daten in eine neue Tabelle mit der umbenannten Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_rename_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_base,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_base.
    TYPES tt_sflight_base TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_base WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS rename_column
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_sflight_base
        iv_old_name    TYPE string
        iv_new_name    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_new_data) TYPE REF TO data. " Return a reference to a dynamic table
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_rename_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD rename_column.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    " Get description of base structure
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data[ 1 ] ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Find and rename component
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
      IF ls_component-name = iv_old_name.
        ls_component-name = iv_new_name.
        MODIFY lt_components FROM ls_component.
        BREAK.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create new dynamic structure and table type
    DATA(lo_new_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_new_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_new_struct_descr ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rt_new_data TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_new_data->* TO <fs_new_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_base_line> TYPE ty_sflight_base.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_old_column_value> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_column_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_base_line>.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_new_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_new_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_new_line->* TO <fs_new_line>.

      " Move existing data and handle renamed column
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_new_line> TO <fs_new_column_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_new_column_value> IS ASSIGNED.
          IF ls_component-name = iv_new_name.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_old_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_base_line> TO <fs_old_column_value>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_old_column_value> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_new_column_value> = <fs_old_column_value>.
            ENDIF.
          ELSE.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_base_line> TO <fs_old_column_value>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_old_column_value> IS ASSIGNED.
              <fs_new_column_value> = <fs_old_column_value>.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND <fs_new_line> TO <fs_new_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_assigned( <fs_non_existent> msg = 'Non-existent column should not appear' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS` erhält und dynamisch eine Spalte löscht, deren Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird.
hint: Ähnlich wie beim Hinzufügen oder Umbenennen einer Spalte erfordert dies RTTI, `CREATE DATA` und das Mappen der Daten in eine neue Tabelle mit reduzierter Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_delete_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_base,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_base.
    TYPES tt_sflight_base TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_base WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_dynamic_column
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_sflight_base
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_new_data) TYPE REF TO data. " Return a reference to a dynamic table
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_delete_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_dynamic_column.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    " Get description of base structure
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data[ 1 ] ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Remove component
    DELETE lt_components WHERE name = iv_column_name.

    " Create new dynamic structure and table type
    DATA(lo_new_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_new_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_new_struct_descr ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rt_new_data TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_new_data->* TO <fs_new_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_base_line> TYPE ty_sflight_base.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_old_column_value> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_column_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_base_line>.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_new_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_new_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_new_line->* TO <fs_new_line>.

      " Move existing data, skipping the deleted column
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_base_line> TO <fs_old_column_value>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_new_line> TO <fs_new_column_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_old_column_value> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_new_column_value> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_new_column_value> = <fs_old_column_value>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND <fs_new_line> TO <fs_new_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS` erhält und dynamisch eine Spalte basierend auf einem übergebenen Namen aggregiert (z.B. Summe, Minimum, Maximum). Die Aggregationsfunktion soll ebenfalls dynamisch sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Spaltenzugriff und eine `CASE`-Anweisung für die dynamische Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_column_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_aggregation_type TYPE string " 'SUM', 'MIN', 'MAX'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_column_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>   TYPE ty_sflight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value>  TYPE any.

    DATA(lv_first_value_set) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_value> IS NUMERIC.
        IF lv_first_value_set = abap_false.
          rv_result = <fs_value>.
          lv_first_value_set = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          CASE iv_aggregation_type.
            WHEN 'SUM'.
              rv_result = rv_result + <fs_value>.
            WHEN 'MIN'.
              IF <fs_value> < rv_result.
                rv_result = <fs_value>.
              ENDIF.
            WHEN 'MAX'.
              IF <fs_value> > rv_result.
                rv_result = <fs_value>.
              ENDIF.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              " Handle unknown aggregation type or raise error
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine einfache hierarchische Struktur von Flugverbindungen (Carrier -> Connection) aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einem `cl_gui_list_tree` an. Die Baumstruktur soll die Fluggesellschaften als Hauptknoten und deren Flugnummern als Unterknoten darstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_list_tree` und dessen Methoden wie `add_node` und `set_table_for_first_display` (für die Datenbindung, falls gewünscht, oder manuelles Hinzufügen von Knoten). Beachten Sie, dass GUI-Controls einen Container benötigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node.

    METHODS build_tree_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container.

    build_tree_data( ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        table_structure_name = 'TY_FLIGHT_NODE'
        table_compressed_data = mt_nodes
        node_key_field = 'NODE_KEY'
        parent_key_field = 'PARENT_KEY'
        text_field = 'TEXT'
    ).

    mo_tree->expand_tree( ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'ROOT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_tree_data.
    DATA: ls_node TYPE ty_flight_node,
          lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey VALUE 0.

    " Root node
    lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
    ls_node-node_key = lv_node_key.
    ls_node-text = 'Fluggesellschaften'.
    ls_node-parent_key = ''. " Root has no parent
    APPEND ls_node TO mt_nodes.
    DATA(lv_root_key) = lv_node_key.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carriers).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      ls_node-node_key = lv_node_key.
      ls_node-text = ls_carrier-carrid.
      ls_node-parent_key = lv_root_key.
      APPEND ls_node TO mt_nodes.
      DATA(lv_carrier_key) = lv_node_key.

      SELECT connid FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @ls_carrier-carrid INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_connections).
      LOOP AT lt_connections INTO DATA(ls_connection).
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        ls_node-node_key = lv_node_key.
        ls_node-text = |Flugnummer: { ls_connection-connid }|.
        ls_node-parent_key = lv_carrier_key.
        APPEND ls_node TO mt_nodes.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der in UTF-8 kodiert ist, in einen String, der in ISO-8859-1 kodiert ist, und umgekehrt. Behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler bei der Konvertierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_codepage` und deren Methode `convert`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_iso
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_iso_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.

    METHODS convert_iso_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_iso_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_codepage_converter(
      EXPORTING
        source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
        target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
    ).

    rv_iso_string = lo_codepage->convert(
      EXPORTING
        source = iv_utf8_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_iso_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_codepage_converter(
      EXPORTING
        source_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
        target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    rv_utf8_string = lo_codepage->convert(
      EXPORTING
        source = iv_iso_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_original_utf8) = 'Hallo Welt mit Umlauten: äöüß'.
    DATA(lv_expected_iso) = 'Hallo Welt mit Umlauten: äöüß'. " Assuming ISO-8859-1 can represent these

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_converted_iso) = lo_converter->convert_utf8_to_iso( lv_original_utf8 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_iso exp = lv_expected_iso msg = 'UTF-8 to ISO conversion failed' ).

        DATA(lv_converted_utf8) = lo_converter->convert_iso_to_utf8( lv_converted_iso ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_utf8 exp = lv_original_utf8 msg = 'ISO to UTF-8 conversion failed' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Conversion error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_codepage_converter(
                                 source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
                                 target_codepage = 'ASCII'
                               )->convert( '€' ). " Euro symbol not in ASCII

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_codepage_converter_error ).
    lo_converter->convert_iso_to_utf8( lv_invalid_string ). " This should raise an error if ISO-8859-1 cannot represent it
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_codepage` bietet eine robuste Möglichkeit zur Konvertierung von Strings zwischen verschiedenen Zeichensätzen. Die Verwendung von `create_codepage_converter` und `convert` ist die moderne und empfohlene Methode, um Kodierungsprobleme zu vermeiden. Inline-Deklarationen und die explizite Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` machen den Code lesbar und sicher.
keywords: Codepage, Encoding, String, cl_abap_codepage, Konvertierung, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und eine berechnete 'Verfügbare Plätze'-Spalte enthält. Verwenden Sie hierfür einen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... ( FIELD = expression )` mit Inline-Strukturerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                             ( carrid     = ls_flight-carrid
                               connid     = ls_flight-connid
                               free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_transformer->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_summaries ) IS NOT INITIAL ).

    " Check a specific entry if possible, or just the structure and calculation logic
    DATA(ls_first_summary) = lt_summaries[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid should be populated' act = ls_first_summary-carrid IS NOT INITIAL exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connid should be populated' act = ls_first_summary-connid IS NOT INITIAL exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Free seats should be non-negative' act = ls_first_summary-free_seats >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP, um interne Tabellen zu transformieren oder neue Tabellen basierend auf bestehenden zu erstellen. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um für jeden Flug in `sflights` eine neue Zeile in `rt_summaries` zu erzeugen, wobei `free_seats` direkt berechnet wird. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als eine traditionelle `LOOP`-Anweisung mit `APPEND`.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, Data Transformation, Functional Programming, sflights, VALUE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') über alle ihre Flüge hinweg. Verwenden Sie hierfür einen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... NEXT ...` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_aggregator->get_total_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has some flights with occupied seats in sflights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_seats > 0 msg = 'Total seats for LH should be greater than 0' ).

    " You might want to fetch the actual sum from DB for a more precise test
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @DATA(lv_expected_sum).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Calculated sum does not match DB sum' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_aggregator->get_total_occupied_seats( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 msg = 'Total seats for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Zeilen iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable (`sum`) aktualisiert. Dies ist eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Art, Summen, Zählungen oder andere Aggregationen durchzuführen, ohne explizite `LOOP`- und `ENDLOOP`-Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), um alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie hierfür einen `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_aa_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aa_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aa_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_aa_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'AA' ).

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_aa_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_aa_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_aa_flights) = lo_filter->get_aa_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table for AA should not be empty' act = lines( lt_aa_flights ) IS NOT INITIAL ).

    LOOP AT lt_aa_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Filtered flight has wrong carrier ID' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_flights.
    " To test 'no flights', we'd need to mock sflights or use a carrier that doesn't exist.
    " For simplicity, we assume 'AA' exists. If 'AA' had no flights, this test would pass.
    " A more robust test would involve setting up test data.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_aa_flights) = lo_filter->get_aa_flights( ).

    " If 'AA' has no flights, lines(lt_aa_flights) would be 0.
    " We can't assert 0 directly without knowing the test data state.
    " Let's assume 'AA' always has flights for this test.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_aa_flights ) > 0 msg = 'Expected flights for AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine sehr elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Anstatt eine `LOOP`-Anweisung mit `IF`-Bedingung zu verwenden, kann man die Filterkriterien direkt im Ausdruck angeben. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft auch effizienterem Code, da der ABAP-Compiler Optimierungen vornehmen kann.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Data Selection, sflights, Expressions

explanation: String-Templates sind die moderne Art, Strings in ABAP zu konstruieren. Sie ersetzen die ältere `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung und bieten eine viel lesbarere und flexiblere Syntax. CLASS zcl_airplane_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen aus. Nutzen Sie hierfür RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_structure
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_structure.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_descr->get_components( ).

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
                             ( name = ls_comp-name
                               type = ls_comp-type_descr_ref->get_type_kind( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Informationen über Datentypen und -objekte zur Laufzeit dynamisch abzufragen. Die Klasse `cl_abap_structdescr` ist hier zentral, um die Beschreibung einer Struktur zu erhalten. Mit `describe_by_data_ref` und `get_components` können alle Komponenten einer Struktur inklusive ihrer Typen ermittelt werden. Dies ist unerlässlich für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen, und nutzt moderne ABAP-Features wie `REF #()` und `FOR`-Ausdrücke.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Struktur (z.B. basierend auf `sflights`) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Nutzen Sie hierfür dynamische Programmierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_structure_name TYPE tabname
        iv_max_rows       TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field>         TYPE ANY.

    " Dynamische Erstellung der internen Tabelle
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_structure_name).
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Erstellen der Tabelle für Struktur { iv_structure_name }|.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamische Erstellung einer Arbeitszeile
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE (iv_structure_name).
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Fehler beim Erstellen der Zeile für Struktur { iv_structure_name }|.
    ENDIF.

    " Daten aus sflights lesen und dynamisch füllen
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_data).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      " Komponenten der Arbeitszeile dynamisch füllen
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = ls_sflight-carrid. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = ls_sflight-connid. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = ls_sflight-fldate. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = ls_sflight-price. ENDIF.

      " ... weitere Felder nach Bedarf

      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_sflights_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_sflights_table.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( iv_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS' iv_max_rows = 5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table reference should not be initial' act = lr_dynamic_table IS NOT INITIAL ).

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_flights> TYPE ANY TABLE.
        ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_flights>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field symbol for table should be assigned' act = <lt_flights> IS ASSIGNED ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_flights> ) exp = 5 msg = 'Dynamic table should contain 5 rows' ).

        " Further checks could involve casting to a known type and checking content
        DATA(lt_sflights_check) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
        ASSIGN <lt_flights> TO lt_sflights_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Casting to sflights table should work' act = lt_sflights_check IS NOT INITIAL ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights_check[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First entry carrid incorrect (assuming test data)' ).

    CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Error creating dynamic table: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_table.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_create_data_error ).
    lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( iv_structure_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung in ABAP ermöglicht es, Datentypen und -objekte zur Laufzeit zu erstellen und zu manipulieren. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `CREATE DATA` eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem dynamisch übergebenen Struktur- oder Tabellennamen erstellt. Die Verwendung von Field-Symbols (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) ist dabei unerlässlich, um auf die dynamisch erstellten Daten zuzugreifen und diese zu füllen. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das für generische Frameworks oder Tools benötigt wird.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols, RTTI, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Wochentag (Montag, Dienstag, etc.) für ein gegebenes Datum. Nutzen Sie hierfür moderne ABAP-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_context_info` oder den `GET BADI` für `IF_ABAP_DATE_UTILITIES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weekday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lv_weekday_num) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday( iv_date = iv_date ).

    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH string(
      lv_weekday_num
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie hierfür die `GROUP BY` Klausel in einer `LOOP`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         ASCENDING
         ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<group_key>).

      DATA(ls_count) = VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count(
        carrid = <group_key>-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ).
      APPEND ls_count TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouping_sflights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_grouping_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping_sflights.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_grouper->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) IS NOT INITIAL ).

    " Check for specific carriers if they exist in sflights
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT VALUE ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 msg = 'LH should have flights' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_flight_counts[ carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT VALUE ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_aa_count-flight_count > 0 msg = 'AA should have flights' ).

    " Verify total count matches original table size (sum of group sizes)
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_total_sflights).
    DATA(lv_sum_grouped_flights) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_counts NEXT sum = sum + ls_count-flight_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_grouped_flights exp = lv_total_sflights msg = 'Sum of grouped flights should match total flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_grouping_empty_table.
    " To test with an empty table, we'd need to mock sflights or pass an empty table.
    " For this example, we'll assume sflights is never empty.
    " If lt_all_flights was empty, rt_flight_counts would be empty.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_grouper->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) > 0 msg = 'Expected some grouped flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung (ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine sehr effiziente und elegante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ermöglicht es, über Gruppen von Zeilen zu iterieren, anstatt über einzelne Zeilen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance bei Gruppierungsaufgaben.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine HASHED TABLE von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und suchen Sie effizient nach einem Eintrag basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_hashed.

    METHODS find_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_flight.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_flight_data().

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO rs_flight
      WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                     connid = iv_connid
                     fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtzahl der Economy-Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` in einer HASHED TABLE unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und eine HASHED TABLE als Akkumulator, um die Summen zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_seats_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS aggregate_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_carrier_seats_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE tt_carrier_seats_hashed(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats_hashed(
      )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET current_entry = result[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid DEFAULT VALUE ty_carrier_seats( carrid = flight-carrid ) ]
      IN
        result = VALUE tt_carrier_seats_hashed(
          result
          ( current_entry-carrid = current_entry-carrid
            total_seats = current_entry-total_seats + flight-seatsocc )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_reduce_agg().
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_seats_by_carrier().

    DATA(ls_aa_seats) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_aa_seats-total_seats ).
    " Annahme: AA hat mindestens einen Flug mit Sitzen
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_seats-total_seats > 0 ).

    DATA(lv_count_carriers) = lines( lt_aggregated ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count_carriers > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Aggregation von Daten. In Kombination mit einer HASHED TABLE als Akkumulator können Summen oder andere Aggregationen effizient gebildet werden, da der Zugriff auf bestehende Einträge über den Schlüssel sehr schnell ist.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, REDUCE, sflights, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine HASHED TABLE zu, indem Sie den Schlüsselwert zur Laufzeit bestimmen. Das Beispiel soll einen Flug basierend auf dynamisch übergebenen Schlüsselkomponenten finden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` oder `LINE OF` mit dynamischen Schlüsselangaben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_hashed.

    METHODS find_flight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_key_components TYPE cl_abap_tabledescr=>components_descr_tab
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid         TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
        iv_fldate         TYPE sflight-fldate OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight)  TYPE ty_flight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_flight_dynamic.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_flight_data().
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_first_cond TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.

    LOOP AT it_key_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF lv_first_cond = abap_false.
        lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && ' AND '.
      ENDIF.
      lv_first_cond = abap_false.

      CASE ls_component-name.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ ls_component-name } = '{ iv_carrid }'|.
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ ls_component-name } = '{ iv_connid }'|.
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          lv_where_clause = lv_where_clause && |{ ls_component-name } = '{ iv_fldate }'|.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Handle other components or raise error
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY (lv_where_clause).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Hier wird eine WHERE-Klausel dynamisch aufgebaut und für den `READ TABLE` Befehl verwendet. Dies erfordert sorgfältige Implementierung, um SQL-Injections zu vermeiden, ist aber für flexible Suchfunktionen unerlässlich.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie die Anzahl der Economy-Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer HASHED TABLE um einen festen Wert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `VALUE` oder `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_modify_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_hashed.

    METHODS increase_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase_by TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_modify_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD increase_seats_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_flight_data().

    rt_modified_flights = VALUE tt_flights_hashed(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid
                 THEN VALUE ty_flight( ls_flight EXCEPT seatsocc ) seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc + iv_increase_by
                 ELSE ls_flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_increase_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_modify_for().
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_increase) = 10.

    DATA(lt_original_flights) = lo_cut->get_flight_data().
    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_cut->increase_seats_for_carrier( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_increase_by = lv_increase ).

    LOOP AT lt_original_flights INTO DATA(ls_original).
      DATA(ls_modified) = lt_modified_flights[ KEY carrid = ls_original-carrid connid = ls_original-connid fldate = ls_original-fldate ].
      IF ls_original-carrid = lv_carrid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_modified-seatsocc exp = ls_original-seatsocc + lv_increase ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_modified-seatsocc exp = ls_original-seatsocc ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR ... IN ...` und dem `VALUE`-Operator mit `COND` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt explizit zu loopen und `MODIFY` zu verwenden, wird hier eine neue HASHED TABLE erstellt, wobei die betroffenen Zeilen mit aktualisierten Werten versehen werden.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, VALUE, COND, MODIFY, Functional Programming

Instructions: Prüfen Sie effizient, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer HASHED TABLE existiert, ohne den gesamten Eintrag zu lesen.

CLASS zcl_hashed_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_hashed.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.

      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_flight_data().

    rv_exists = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                                                    connid = iv_connid
                                                    fldate = iv_fldate ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugdaten in eine HASHED TABLE ein. Wenn ein Eintrag mit demselben Schlüssel bereits existiert, soll der bestehende Eintrag aktualisiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ...` und `MODIFY TABLE ...` oder den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_insert_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS add_or_update_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_new_flight TYPE ty_flight
        CHANGING
          ct_flights TYPE tt_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_insert_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_or_update_flight.
    DATA(lv_subrc) = 0.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM is_new_flight TRANSPORTING planetype seatsocc.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE ct_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_new_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_new_flight.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_hashed_insert_modify=>tt_flights_hashed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_insert_modify().

    DATA(ls_flight1) = VALUE zcl_hashed_insert_modify=>ty_flight(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 100
    ).
    lo_cut->add_or_update_flight( EXPORTING is_new_flight = ls_flight1 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-seatsocc exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_hashed_insert_modify=>tt_flights_hashed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_insert_modify().

    DATA(ls_flight1) = VALUE zcl_hashed_insert_modify=>ty_flight(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 100
    ).
    lo_cut->add_or_update_flight( EXPORTING is_new_flight = ls_flight1 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    DATA(ls_flight2) = VALUE zcl_hashed_insert_modify=>ty_flight(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 200
    ).
    lo_cut->add_or_update_flight( EXPORTING is_new_flight = ls_flight2 CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-seatsocc exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-planetype exp = 'A380' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei HASHED TABLEs ist die Kombination von `MODIFY TABLE` und `INSERT TABLE` eine gängige Methode, um Einträge hinzuzufügen oder zu aktualisieren. `MODIFY` versucht zuerst, einen bestehenden Eintrag zu aktualisieren. Wenn dies fehlschlägt (weil der Schlüssel nicht existiert), wird `INSERT` verwendet, um einen neuen Eintrag hinzuzufügen. Dies gewährleistet die Eindeutigkeit des Schlüssels und effiziente Operationen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, INSERT, MODIFY, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Löschen Sie effizient einen bestimmten Flug aus einer HASHED TABLE.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_initial_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_hashed.

    METHODS delete_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_flight_data.
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flights_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_flight.
    DELETE TABLE ct_flights
      WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                     connid = iv_connid
                     fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_delete().
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_initial_flight_data().
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).

    lo_cut->delete_flight( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_delete().
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_initial_flight_data().
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).

    lo_cut->delete_flight( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20251231' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ). " Sollte immer noch 2 sein
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Löschen von Einträgen aus einer HASHED TABLE mittels `DELETE TABLE WITH TABLE KEY` ist eine sehr effiziente Operation, da der Eintrag direkt über den Hash-Schlüssel gefunden und entfernt werden kann. Dies gewährleistet eine konstante Zugriffszeit (O(1)) für die Löschoperation.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, DELETE, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Standardtabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine HASHED TABLE, wobei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` und `COND` oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_convert_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS convert_and_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashed_flights) TYPE tt_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_convert_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_filter.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE tt_flights_standard.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    rt_hashed_flights = VALUE tt_flights_hashed(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_raw
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion_and_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_convert_filter().
    DATA(lt_hashed) = lo_cut->convert_and_filter( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_hashed ) > 0 ).
    LOOP AT lt_hashed INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_convert_filter().
    DATA(lt_hashed) = lo_cut->convert_and_filter( 'ZZ' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_hashed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung und Filterung von internen Tabellen kann sehr elegant mit dem `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Klausel erfolgen. Dies erstellt eine neue HASHED TABLE, die nur die gefilterten Einträge enthält, und nutzt dabei die Vorteile der HASHED TABLE für schnellen Zugriff.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Conversion, Filter, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflight) erhält und für jeden Flug einen neuen Status basierend auf komplexen Kriterien zuweist. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `FOR`-Operator mit `CASE`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             old_status TYPE sflight-status,
             new_status TYPE sflight-status,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS update_flight_statuses IMPORTING it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_statuses.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                  ( carrid     = flight-carrid
                                    connid     = flight-connid
                                    old_status = flight-status
                                    new_status = CASE flight-status
                                                   WHEN 'A' THEN 'Confirmed'
                                                   WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cancelled'
                                                   WHEN 'D' THEN 'Delayed'
                                                   ELSE 'Unknown'
                                                 END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_statuses.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-status = 'A'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-status = 'C'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_update( ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_statuses( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_updated ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_updated1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated1-new_status exp = 'Confirmed' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_updated2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated2-new_status exp = 'Cancelled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die ein beliebiges Objekt entgegennimmt und dessen Typ dynamisch ermittelt. Basierend auf dem Typ soll eine spezifische Aktion ausgeführt werden (z.B. bei String-Typ die Länge zurückgeben, bei Integer den Wert verdoppeln). Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE TYPE OF` für die dynamische Typunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING io_data TYPE REF TO object RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string, lv_int TYPE i.

    CASE TYPE OF io_data.
      WHEN TYPE string INTO lv_string.
        rv_result = |String Länge: { strlen( lv_string ) }|.
      WHEN TYPE i INTO lv_int.
        rv_result = |Integer verdoppelt: { lv_int * 2 }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = 'Unbekannter Typ'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflight) nach dem höchsten Preis gruppiert und für jede Gruppe den Durchschnittspreis berechnet. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS aggregate_flight_prices IMPORTING it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_prices.
    rt_aggregated_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid AS carrid
                                  ( carrid    = carrid
                                    avg_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.0 cnt = 0
                                                          FOR member IN GROUP ( sum = sum + member-price cnt = cnt + 1 )
                                                          NEXT sum = sum / cnt ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-price = 300.

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-avg_price exp = 150 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'UA' INTO DATA(ls_ua).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua-avg_price exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt komplexe `LOOP`-Konstrukte mit Zwischenvariablen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit erheblich.
keywords: METHOD, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflight) erhält und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur Flüge enthält, die bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen. Die Kriterien sollen dynamisch über eine `CASE`-Expression innerhalb eines `FILTER`-Operators angewendet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und eine `CASE`-Expression in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filter_criteria,
             min_price     TYPE sflight-price,
             max_price     TYPE sflight-price,
             status_filter TYPE sflight-status,
           END OF ty_filter_criteria.
    METHODS filter_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight is_criteria TYPE ty_filter_criteria RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE ( price >= is_criteria-min_price AND price <= is_criteria-max_price )
                                    AND ( CASE is_criteria-status_filter
                                            WHEN 'ALL' THEN abap_true
                                            WHEN status = is_criteria-status_filter THEN abap_true
                                            ELSE abap_false
                                          END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_flight_filter( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht und eine klassenbasierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn der Divisor Null ist. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `RAISING` in der Methodendefinition und `TRY...CATCH`.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide IMPORTING iv_dividend TYPE i iv_divisor TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_math->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    TRY.
        lo_math->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception zcx_division_by_zero' ).
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Klassenbasierte Ausnahmen mit `RAISING` und `TRY...CATCH` sind der moderne Standard für die Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen eine strukturierte und typsichere Fehlerbehandlung, die den Code robuster und wartbarer macht.
keywords: METHOD, RAISING, Exception Handling, Object Orientation

CLASS zcl_number_to_word DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_number_to_word IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Passagiersitze aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Syntax `REDUCE type( INIT var = initial_value FOR ... IN ... NEXT var = var + expression )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
