    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 300 act = lv_total_lh ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 50 act = lv_total_aa ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 0 act = lv_total_xx ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze für eine Liste von Flügen unter Verwendung eines funktionalen Ansatzes.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_seats_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_seats_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).

    DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( it_flights ).

    IF lv_num_flights > 0.
      rv_average = lv_total_seats / lv_num_flights.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_average_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_calculation.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_avg_seats_calc=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_seats_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '150.0' act = lv_average ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_avg_seats_calc=>tt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_seats_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = '0.0' act = lv_average ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination des `REDUCE` Operators zur Aggregation von Werten mit der Funktion `lines()` zur Bestimmung der Anzahl der Elemente, um einen Durchschnitt zu berechnen. Dies ist ein funktionaler und effizienter Weg, um solche Berechnungen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Durchschnitt, Funktionale Programmierung, Internal Tables

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen konditionalen Ausdruck (`COND`) um basierend auf der Auslastung eines Fluges einen Status-Text zu bestimmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND type( WHEN condition1 THEN result1 WHEN condition2 THEN result2 ELSE default_result )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.

    METHODS get_occupancy_status
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_occupancy TYPE ty_flight_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_percentage) = COND decfloat16(
      WHEN is_flight_occupancy-seatsmax > 0
      THEN ( is_flight_occupancy-seatsocc / is_flight_occupancy-seatsmax ) * 100
      ELSE 0
    ).

    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 90 THEN 'Sehr hoch ausgelastet'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 70 THEN 'Hoch ausgelastet'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_percentage >= 50 THEN 'Mittel ausgelastet'
      ELSE 'Gering ausgelastet'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Sehr hoch ausgelastet' act = lo_cut->get_occupancy_status( VALUE #( seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 95 ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Hoch ausgelastet' act = lo_cut->get_occupancy_status( VALUE #( seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 75 ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Mittel ausgelastet' act = lo_cut->get_occupancy_status( VALUE #( seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 55 ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Gering ausgelastet' act = lo_cut->get_occupancy_status( VALUE #( seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 30 ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'Gering ausgelastet' act = lo_cut->get_occupancy_status( VALUE #( seatsmax = 0 seatsocc = 0 ) ) ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen gegebenen `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempel in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit.

solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_to_local DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utclong_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
      EXPORTING
        ev_date    TYPE sy-datum
        ev_time    TYPE sy-uzeit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_to_local IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utclong_to_local.
    DATA(lv_tstmp) = cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_tstmp( iv_utclong ).
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_tstmp TIME ZONE sy-zonlo INTO DATE ev_date TIME ev_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_to_local( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong_fixed) = '20250115103000000000'. " Jan 15, 2025, 10:30:00 UTC
    DATA(lv_date) TYPE sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) TYPE sy-uzeit.

    " Assuming local time zone is UTC+1 for this test (e.g., Germany in winter)
    " If running in a different timezone, expected values need adjustment.
    lo_cut->convert_utclong_to_local( EXPORTING iv_utclong = lv_utclong_fixed IMPORTING ev_date = lv_date ev_time = lv_time ).

    " Adjust expected values based on your system's timezone for accurate testing
    " For example, if system timezone is CET (UTC+1) and no DST:
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_date exp = '20250115' msg = 'Date mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_time exp = '113000' msg = 'Time mismatch (assuming UTC+1)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung von `UTCLONG` in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit erfolgt in zwei Schritten: Zuerst wird `UTCLONG` in einen normalen Zeitstempel (`TSTMP`) umgewandelt, dann wird dieser mit `CONVERT TIME STAMP` unter Berücksichtigung der Systemzeitzone in Datum und Uhrzeit aufgeteilt. Dies ist der standardisierte Weg, um mit Zeitzonen umzugehen.
keywords: UTCLONG, Conversion, Date/Time, Time Zone

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine sortierte interne Tabelle an einer bestimmten Position ein, wobei ein `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempel als Teil des Sortierschlüssels dient.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... INDEX ...` für die explizite Positionierung in einer sortierten Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_utclong DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE utclong,
             message   TYPE string,

                               WITH UNIQUE KEY timestamp.

      IMPORTING
        is_new_entry TYPE ty_log_entry
      CHANGING
        ct_log_entries TYPE tt_log_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_sorted FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_sorted.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_sorted_utclong( ).
    DATA(lt_logs) TYPE zcl_insert_sorted_utclong=>tt_log_entries.

    DATA(ls_entry1) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted_utclong=>ty_log_entry( timestamp = '20250101100000000000' message = 'Log Entry 1' ).
    DATA(ls_entry2) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted_utclong=>ty_log_entry( timestamp = '20250101100010000000' message = 'Log Entry 2' ).
    DATA(ls_entry3) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted_utclong=>ty_log_entry( timestamp = '20250101100005000000' message = 'Log Entry 3' ).

    lo_cut->insert_log_entry( EXPORTING is_new_entry = ls_entry1 CHANGING ct_log_entries = lt_logs ).
    lo_cut->insert_log_entry( EXPORTING is_new_entry = ls_entry2 CHANGING ct_log_entries = lt_logs ).
    lo_cut->insert_log_entry( EXPORTING is_new_entry = ls_entry3 CHANGING ct_log_entries = lt_logs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_logs ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 log entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_logs[ 2 ]-message exp = 'Log Entry 3' msg = 'Entry 3 should be at index 2 due to sorting' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Einfügen in eine sortierte Tabelle mit `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` wird die neue Zeile automatisch an der korrekten Position gemäß dem Tabellenschlüssel eingefügt. Dies ist effizienter als das manuelle Sortieren nach dem Einfügen und stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle immer sortiert bleibt. `UTCLONG` als Schlüssel ermöglicht eine präzise Sortierung nach Zeit.
keywords: INSERT, Sorted Table, UTCLONG, Internal Table, Key

CLASS zcl_insert_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempel aus einem Datum und einer Uhrzeit unter Berücksichtigung einer Zeitzone.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `cl_abap_utclong=>tstmp_to_utclong` nach der Konvertierung von Datum/Uhrzeit in `TSTMP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_local_to_utclong DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_local_to_utclong
      IMPORTING
        iv_date    TYPE sy-datum
        iv_time    TYPE sy-uzeit
        iv_timezone TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utclong) TYPE utclong.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_local_to_utclong IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_local_to_utclong.
    DATA(lv_tstmp) TYPE tstmpl.
    CONVERT DATE iv_date TIME iv_time INTO TIME STAMP lv_tstmp TIME ZONE iv_timezone.
    rv_utclong = cl_abap_utclong=>tstmp_to_utclong( lv_tstmp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_local_to_utclong.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_local_to_utclong( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = '20250115'.
    DATA(lv_time) = '113000'.
    DATA(lv_timezone) = 'CET'. " Central European Time (UTC+1 in winter)

    DATA(lv_utclong) = lo_cut->convert_local_to_utclong( iv_date = lv_date iv_time = lv_time iv_timezone = lv_timezone ).

    " Expected UTCLONG for 2025-01-15 11:30:00 CET (UTC+1) is 2025-01-15 10:30:00 UTC
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_utclong exp = '20250115103000000000' msg = 'UTCLONG conversion mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Erstellung eines `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempels aus lokalen Datums- und Zeitangaben erfordert die Berücksichtigung der Zeitzone. Zuerst wird Datum und Uhrzeit mit `CONVERT ... INTO TIME STAMP` in einen `TSTMP` umgewandelt, dann `cl_abap_utclong=>tstmp_to_utclong` verwendet. Dies ist der korrekte Weg, um lokale Zeiten in das globale UTC-Format zu überführen.
keywords: UTCLONG, Conversion, Date/Time, Time Zone, TSTMP

CLASS zcl_utclong_is_valid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') und extrahieren Sie nur die Flugnummern (`carrid`, `connid`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenausdruck `FOR ... IN ...` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und `VALUE #(...)` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flight_keys
      IMPORTING
        iv_airline TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_keys.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ). " sflights_tab is a standard table type for sflights

    " Populate lt_sflights with some data for demonstration if sflights is empty
    " In a real system, you would SELECT from sflights.
    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_airline )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_keys( 'LH' ).

    " Assert that some flights are found for 'LH' (assuming data exists)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'No flights found for LH, check SFLIGHTS data or test setup.'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_tolerance_none
      severity = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_severity_error
      _if = xsdbool( lines( lt_result ) = 0 )
    ).
    " Assert that all entries are for 'LH'
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_key).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_key-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR ... IN ...` Ausdruck ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge, und `VALUE #(...)` konstruiert die neue Tabelle mit den gewünschten Feldern, was zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code führt.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Filtering, Mapping, VALUE, WHERE

CLASS zcl_for_nested_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_filtered_order_items.

      ( order_id = 1

CLASS zcl_for_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_for_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_airline.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ). " sflights_tab is a standard table type for sflights

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_airline TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_airline.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ). " sflights_tab is a standard table type for sflights

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_airline )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_airline( 'AA' ).

    " For a robust test, you might need to mock SFLIGHTS or ensure test data.
    " Here, we just check if it's not negative (a basic sanity check)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Elemente einer numerischen internen Tabelle. Zeigen Sie sowohl den traditionellen Ansatz mit `LOOP AT` und `ADD` als auch den modernen Ansatz mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Vergleichen Sie `LOOP AT ... ADD` mit `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_add_sum_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_sum_traditional
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
    METHODS get_sum_modern
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_sum_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_traditional.
    rv_sum = 0.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      ADD lv_number TO rv_sum.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum_modern.
    rv_sum = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_val = 0 TYPE i
      FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
      NEXT sum_val = sum_val + lv_number
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_methods FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_methods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_add_sum_table( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE zcl_add_sum_table=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).

    DATA(lv_sum_trad) = lo_cut->get_sum_traditional( lt_test_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_trad exp = 15 ).

    DATA(lv_sum_modern) = lo_cut->get_sum_modern( lt_test_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_modern exp = 15 ).

    DATA(lt_empty_numbers) = VALUE zcl_add_sum_table=>tt_numbers( ).
    lv_sum_trad = lo_cut->get_sum_traditional( lt_empty_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_trad exp = 0 ).

    lv_sum_modern = lo_cut->get_sum_modern( lt_empty_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_modern exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den Unterschied zwischen dem traditionellen `LOOP AT ... ADD`-Ansatz und dem modernen, funktionalen `REDUCE`-Operator zur Summenbildung. Während `ADD` in einer Schleife immer noch funktioniert, ist `REDUCE` die bevorzugte Methode in modernem ABAP, da es den Code kompakter, deklarativer und oft effizienter macht, indem es die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten Schleife und einer separaten Akkumulatorvariable eliminiert.
keywords: ADD, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Sum, Loops, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_add_counter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_add_counter_for IMPLEMENTATION.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE seatsocc > iv_min_capacity.

    " Modern functional approach (alternative to LOOP AT + ADD)

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis (`price`) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'UA') in der `sflights`-Tabelle um einen festen Prozentsatz (z.B. 10%). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den aktualisierten Preisen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und `VALUE #(...)` zur Erstellung einer neuen Tabelle mit den berechneten Preisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_add_update_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_airline TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1 " e.g., 10.0 for 10%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_update_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ). " sflights_tab is a standard table type for sflights

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( COND sflight(
          WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_airline
            THEN CORRESPONDING sflight(
                   ls_flight
                   EXCEPT price
                   price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 )
                 )
          ELSE ls_flight
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_add_update_price( ).
    DATA(lv_percentage) = '10.0'.

    " Create dummy SFLIGHTS data for testing
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_add_update_price=>tt_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0030' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    " Mock the SFLIGHTS_TAB to use test data
    " This part is conceptual as direct mocking of global types is complex.
    " For a real test, you'd pass the table as parameter or use test doubles.
    " For this example, we'll assume the SELECT in solution is commented out
    " and lt_sflights is populated with lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_prices( iv_airline = 'UA' iv_percentage = lv_percentage ).

    " Assertions
    READ TABLE lt_updated INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-price exp = '100.00' msg = 'LH price should be unchanged' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated INTO DATA(ls_ua1) WITH KEY carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua1-price exp = '220.00' msg = 'UA flight 0010 price should be updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated INTO DATA(ls_ua2) WITH KEY carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua2-price exp = '165.00' msg = 'UA flight 0020 price should be updated' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation in internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife zu verwenden und einzelne Einträge zu modifizieren, wird mit `FOR ... IN ...` und `VALUE #(...)` eine *neue* Tabelle erstellt. Für die zu aktualisierenden Einträge wird `COND sflight(...)` in Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING` verwendet, um alle Felder zu kopieren und nur den `price` neu zu berechnen. Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die mindestens einen Flug mit einem Preis über 500 haben. Die Liste der Fluggesellschaften soll eindeutig sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und `DISTINCT` in `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_distinct_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE HASHED KEY table_line.
    METHODS get_airlines_with_expensive_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_airlines) TYPE tt_carrid.

CLASS zcl_for_distinct_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airlines_with_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ). " sflights_tab is a standard table type for sflights

      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    rt_airlines = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > 500 )

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` eine formatierte Beschreibung enthält: 'Flug <Fluggesellschaft> <Flugnummer> von <Abflugort> nach <Zielort>'. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.

CLASS zcl_for_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flight_descriptions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_departure_city TYPE sgeocity-city
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_descriptions) TYPE tt_flight_descriptions.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_descriptions.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ). " sflights_tab is a standard table type for sflights
    DATA(lt_sairports) = VALUE sairport_tab( ). " sairport_tab is a standard table type for sairport

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.
    IF lines( lt_sairports ) = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sairport INTO TABLE lt_sairports UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    rt_descriptions = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_departure_city )
      LET lv_city_to = lt_sairports[ id = ls_flight-airpto ]-city IN
      ( |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } von { ls_flight-cityfrom } nach { lv_city_to }| )
    ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` den `carrid` und einen `status_text` enthält. Der `status_text` soll 'High Price' sein, wenn der Preis über 1000 liegt, 'Normal Price' sonst. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'DL'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `WHERE` und den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung des Status-Textes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status_by_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_airline TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_by_airline.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ). " sflights_tab is a standard table type for sflights

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_airline )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        status_text = COND string(
                        WHEN ls_flight-price > 1000 THEN 'High Price'
                        ELSE 'Normal Price'
                      )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_cond_status FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_logic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status_by_airline( 'DL' ).

    " Assert that some statuses are found (assuming data exists)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'No flight statuses found for DL, check SFLIGHTS data or test setup.'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_tolerance_none
      severity = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_severity_error
      _if = xsdbool( lines( lt_result ) = 0 )
    ).

    " Check for specific status texts (assuming test data or SFLIGHTS content)
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_status).
      IF ls_status-connid = '0010'. " Assuming DL 0010 has price > 1000
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status_text exp = 'High Price' ).
      ELSEIF ls_status-connid = '0020'. " Assuming DL 0020 has price <= 1000
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status_text exp = 'Normal Price' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `COND`-Operators innerhalb eines `FOR ... IN ...` Ausdrucks. `COND` ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in einer einzigen Zeile, was den Code für If-Else-Logik in Zuweisungen extrem kompakt und lesbar macht. In Kombination mit `FOR` für die Tabellenverarbeitung entsteht ein sehr ausdrucksstarker und funktionaler Code.
keywords: FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, VALUE, WHERE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` den `carrid`, `connid` und den `price` enthält. Der `price` soll dabei als `string` mit zwei Dezimalstellen und Tausendertrennzeichen formatiert werden. Filtern Sie nur Flüge, deren `connid` mit '0' beginnt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `WHERE` und `CONV` in Kombination mit `WRITE TO` für die Formatierung des Preises.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_format_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             formatted_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_flight.
    TYPES tt_formatted_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_formatted_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_flights) TYPE tt_formatted_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_format_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ). " sflights_tab is a standard table type for sflights

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    rt_formatted_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( connid CP '0*' )
      LET lv_formatted_price = CONV string( ls_flight-price ) IN
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        formatted_price = lv_formatted_price " For full formatting, use WRITE TO or CL_ABAP_FORMAT
      )
    ).
    " Note: Direct WRITE TO in VALUE expression is not possible. 
    " For full formatting, a helper method or CL_ABAP_FORMAT would be used.
    " The CONV string(price) provides basic conversion.
    " Example for more advanced formatting (would be in a helper method):
    " DATA(lv_price_str) TYPE string.
    " WRITE ls_flight-price TO lv_price_str CURRENCY ls_flight-currency.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_formatted_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_formatted_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_format_price( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'No formatted flights found, check SFLIGHTS data or test setup.'
      level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_tolerance_none
      severity = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_severity_error
      _if = xsdbool( lines( lt_result ) = 0 )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_formatted).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( act = ls_formatted-connid exp = `0\d*` msg = 'CONNID should start with 0.' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( act = ls_formatted-formatted_price exp = `\d+\.\d{2}` msg = 'Price format is incorrect.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FOR ... IN ...` und `VALUE #(...)` zur Transformation von Tabellendaten. Es zeigt, wie man mit `CONV string(...)` numerische Werte in Strings umwandelt. Für komplexere Formatierungen (z.B. mit Tausendertrennzeichen und Währungssymbolen) wäre in einem realen Szenario eine Hilfsmethode oder die Klasse `CL_ABAP_FORMAT` erforderlich, da `WRITE TO` nicht direkt in einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck verwendet werden kann. Der `LET`-Ausdruck hilft, Zwischenergebnisse sauber zu kapseln.
keywords: FOR, CONV, String Conversion, Internal Tables, Transformation, VALUE, WHERE, LET

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in der `sflights`-Tabelle, der von 'NEW YORK' abfliegt und dessen Preis über 800 liegt. Geben Sie die gesamte Flugzeile zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `WHERE` und `FIRST` in `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_first_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_expensive_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_departure_city TYPE sgeocity-city
        iv_min_price      TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_first_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_expensive_flight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ). " sflights_tab is a standard table type for sflights

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    rs_flight = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_departure_city AND price > iv_min_price )
      ( FIRST ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `FOR ... IN ...` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` und dem `FIRST`-Zusatz ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um den ersten Eintrag einer internen Tabelle zu finden, der bestimmte Kriterien erfüllt. Dies ersetzt die traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` Schleife mit `EXIT` und macht den Code deutlich kompakter und lesbarer, insbesondere wenn nur der erste Treffer benötigt wird.

CLASS zcl_json_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges ('Geplant', 'Abgeflogen', 'Angekommen') basierend auf dem Flugdatum und dem aktuellen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck für eine prägnante Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_fldate > sy-datum THEN 'Geplant'
      WHEN iv_fldate = sy-datum THEN 'Abgeflogen'
      ELSE 'Angekommen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    " Test planned flight
    DATA(lv_future_date) = sy-datum + 1.
    DATA(lv_status_planned) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( lv_future_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_planned exp = 'Geplant' msg = 'Future date should be Planned' ).

    " Test current day flight
    DATA(lv_status_today) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_today exp = 'Abgeflogen' msg = 'Current date should be Departed' ).

    " Test past flight
    DATA(lv_past_date) = sy-datum - 1.
    DATA(lv_status_past) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( lv_past_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_past exp = 'Angekommen' msg = 'Past date should be Arrived' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen, ähnlich einem Ternary-Operator in anderen Sprachen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit für `IF...ENDIF`-Blöcke bei einfachen Zuweisungen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `sflights` und sammeln Sie deren Flugnummern (`connid`) in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_collect_connids
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_collect_connids.
    rt_connids = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_all_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_connids.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_filter_flights=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251128' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251129' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20251130' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result_connids) = lo_cut->filter_and_collect_connids(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid      = 'LH'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_connids ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 LH flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_connids[ 1 ] exp = '0400' msg = 'First connid should be 0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_connids[ 2 ] exp = '0500' msg = 'Second connid should be 0500' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE #(...)` und `FOR ... WHERE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und neue Tabellen zu konstruieren. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ... ENDLOOP`-Konstrukte.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, FOR, Functional Programming, VALUE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die es ermöglicht, mehrere Konfigurationsschritte für ein Objekt durch Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) auszuführen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_config_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, Builder Pattern

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges direkt aus einer internen Tabelle, ohne eine `LOOP`-Anweisung zu verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke (`[]`) mit einem Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate  TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    rv_price = it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid, connid = iv_connid, fldate = iv_fldate ]-price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_table_expression=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251128' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251129' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_flight_price(
      it_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid  = 'LH'
      iv_connid  = '0400'
      iv_fldate  = '20251128'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Price for LH 0400 should be 100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_table_expression=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_flight_price(
          it_flights = lt_test_flights
          iv_carrid  = 'XX'
          iv_connid  = '9999'
          iv_fldate  = '20251128'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_sy_itab_line_not_found not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Expected exception cx_sy_itab_line_not_found raised' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`[]`) bieten einen direkten und prägnanten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle über deren Schlüssel. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `READ TABLE` und führt bei nicht gefundenen Einträgen zu einer abfangbaren Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found`.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expressions, READ TABLE, Schlüsselzugriff

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
        currency TYPE s_currcode,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251128' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251129' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20251130' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price(
      it_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid  = 'LH'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price_lh exp = '250.00' msg = 'Total price for LH should be 250.00' ).

    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price(
      it_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid  = 'AA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price_aa exp = '200.00' msg = 'Total price for AA should be 200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Er ist sehr flexibel und kann für Summen, Zählungen, String-Verkettungen und komplexere Aggregationen verwendet werden.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, Math, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle 'sflights' zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `DISTINCT` für die eindeutigen Werte und String-Templates für die Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carrids_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR DISTINCT carrid IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN carrid-carrid
        ELSE |{ result }, { carrid-carrid }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_concat_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_carrid( ).
    DATA(lv_carrids_string) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrids_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_carrids_string msg = 'String should not be initial if SFLIGHT has data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(   act = lv_carrids_string exp = 'LH' msg = 'String should contain LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(   act = lv_carrids_string exp = 'AA' msg = 'String should contain AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR DISTINCT` und String-Templates. Es ermöglicht das Sammeln und Verketten eindeutiger Werte aus einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung, ohne explizite Schleifen oder temporäre Variablen.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Internal Tables, Concatenation, DISTINCT

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis (`PRICE`) aus der Tabelle 'sflights'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und eine Vergleichslogik, um den Maximalwert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_val = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                              FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                              NEXT max_val = nmax( val1 = max_val val2 = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle 'sflight' und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Hash-Tabelle (Map).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer lokalen Hash-Tabelle als Akkumulator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_count_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES tt_carrid_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrid_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_counts) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_count_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_carrid_counts = REDUCE tt_carrid_count(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_carrid_count(
      )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_carrid = flight-carrid IN
      NEXT
        counts = VALUE tt_carrid_count(
          counts
          ( carrid = lv_carrid count = counts[ KEY carrid PRIMARY_KEY carrid = lv_carrid ]-count + 1 )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_carrid_counts FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_count_carrid( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_counts) = lo_cut->get_carrid_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_carrid_counts msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).

    " Annahme: LH und AA existieren in SFLIGHT
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_carrid_counts[ KEY carrid PRIMARY_KEY carrid = 'LH' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_count-count > 0 ) msg = 'LH count should be greater than 0' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'LH not found in counts' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `REDUCE` verwendet werden kann, um eine komplexe Datenstruktur (eine Hash-Tabelle) aufzubauen. Es iteriert über die Flüge und aktualisiert die Zähler für jede Fluggesellschaft. Die Syntax mit `VALUE` und `KEY` für den Zugriff auf die Hash-Tabelle ist ein modernes und effizientes Muster.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Hash Table, Counting, VALUE, KEY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen JSON-String, der eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften und deren Gesamtflugpreise aus der Tabelle 'sflight' enthält. Gruppieren Sie dabei nach Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um den JSON-String zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_json_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_json RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_json_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_json.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_json_items) = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                      FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                      NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) IN
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |{{"carrid":"{ flight-carrid }","total_price":{ lv_total_price }}}|
        ELSE |{ result },{{"carrid":"{ flight-carrid }","total_price":{ lv_total_price }}}|
      )
    ).

    rv_json_string = |[{ lv_json_items }]|
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_json_string) = lo_cut->get_flights_json( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_json_string msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json_string exp = '"carrid"' msg = 'JSON should contain carrid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json_string exp = '"total_price"' msg = 'JSON should contain total_price' ).

    " Optional: JSON-Validierung, z.B. mit CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT=>ASSERT_EQUALS nach Parsen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es ermöglicht die Gruppierung von Daten und die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe, um dann einen komplexen JSON-String zu erstellen. Die Verwendung von String-Templates macht die JSON-Generierung sehr lesbar und effizient.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle 'sflight' nach dem Monat des Flugdatums und berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für jeden Monat. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle mit Monat und Gesamtpreis sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_DATFM` zur Monatsbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_month_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_price,
             month       TYPE sy-monat,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_monthly_price.
    TYPES tt_monthly_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_monthly_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_prices RETURNING VALUE(rt_monthly_prices) TYPE tt_monthly_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_month_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_monthly_prices = VALUE tt_monthly_price(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( month = flight-fldate+4(2) ) ASCENDING
      ( month       = flight-fldate+4(2)
        total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                  FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                  NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_monthly_prices FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_monthly_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_month_price( ).
    DATA(lt_monthly_prices) = lo_cut->get_monthly_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_monthly_prices msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Daten für mindestens einen Monat
    DATA(lv_first_month) = lt_monthly_prices[ 1 ]-month.
    DATA(lv_first_price) = lt_monthly_prices[ 1 ]-total_price.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`. Es ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Daten nach einem Kriterium (hier der Monat des Flugdatums, extrahiert per Offset/Length) und die Aggregation (Summierung der Preise) innerhalb jeder Gruppe in einer einzigen, hochfunktionalen und lesbaren Anweisung. Dies ist ein Kernstück des modernen ABAP für Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUP BY, Grouping, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Date Components

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den letzten Tag des aktuellen Monats.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder `CL_ABAP_DATFM` in Kombination mit Datumsarithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_last_day_of_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_last_day_of_current_month RETURNING VALUE(rv_last_day) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_last_day_of_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_day_of_current_month.
    DATA(lv_first_day_next_month) = sy-datum+0(6) && '01'. " Erster Tag des aktuellen Monats
    lv_first_day_next_month = lv_first_day_next_month + 32. " Gehe weit genug in den nächsten Monat
    lv_first_day_next_month = lv_first_day_next_month+0(6) && '01'. " Erster Tag des nächsten Monats
    rv_last_day = lv_first_day_next_month - 1. " Letzter Tag des aktuellen Monats
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_last_day_of_month FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_last_day_of_month.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_last_day_of_month( ).
    DATA(lv_last_day) = lo_cut->get_last_day_of_current_month( ).

    " Überprüfen, ob der Tag korrekt ist (z.B. 30 für November, 31 für Dezember)
    DATA(lv_current_month) = sy-datum+4(2).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum+0(4).

    CASE lv_current_month.
      WHEN '01' OR '03' OR '05' OR '07' OR '08' OR '10' OR '12'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_last_day+6(2) exp = '31' msg = 'Last day should be 31' ).
      WHEN '04' OR '06' OR '09' OR '11'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_last_day+6(2) exp = '30' msg = 'Last day should be 30' ).
      WHEN '02'.
        IF ( lv_current_year MOD 4 = 0 AND lv_current_year MOD 100 <> 0 ) OR lv_current_year MOD 400 = 0.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_last_day+6(2) exp = '29' msg = 'Last day should be 29 (leap year)' ).
        ELSE.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_last_day+6(2) exp = '28' msg = 'Last day should be 28' ).
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Invalid month for test' ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des letzten Tages eines Monats kann elegant durch Datumsarithmetik gelöst werden: Man nimmt den ersten Tag des *nächsten* Monats und subtrahiert einen Tag. Die String-Operationen mit Offset und Länge sind hier effizient, um den ersten Tag des nächsten Monats zu konstruieren.
keywords: Date Calculation, Last Day of Month, SY-DATUM, Arithmetic

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_for_month.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflight_tab FROM lt_sflights
                                 WHERE ( fldate+4(2) = iv_month ).

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) = 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_seats_occ) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_seats_max) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax
    ).

    IF lv_total_seats_max > 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = lv_total_seats_occ / lv_total_seats_max.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf dem Zeilentyp `SFLIGHT` und füllen Sie diese mit zwei Datensätzen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` mit `CREATE DATA` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Tabellenkopf und die Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_populate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_populate_sflight_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_populate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_line_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    DATA(lo_table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_line_type ).

    CREATE DATA ro_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_type.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    CREATE DATA DATA(lo_line_ref) TYPE HANDLE lo_line_type.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN lo_line_ref->* TO <fs_line>.

    <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_line>-connid = '0400'.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

    <fs_line>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_line>-connid = '0017'.
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_population FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_population.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_populate( ).
    DATA(lo_table_ref) = lo_cut->create_and_populate_sflight_table( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_table> msg = 'Tabelle sollte gebunden sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Tabelle sollte 2 Zeilen haben.' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Erste Zeile CARRID sollte LH sein.' ).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight>-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Zweite Zeile CARRID sollte AA sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene dynamische Tabellenverarbeitung. Es demonstriert, wie man eine interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit erstellt und mit Daten füllt, wenn der Zeilentyp nur dynamisch bekannt ist. Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ einer beliebigen Referenzvariablen zur Laufzeit und geben Sie den Namen des referenzierten Typs zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_refdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_referenced_type()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_ref_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_referenced_type_name
      IMPORTING
        ir_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_ref_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_referenced_type_name.
    DATA(lo_ref_descr) = CAST cl_abap_refdescr(
                               cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_ref ) ).
    DATA(lo_referenced_type) = lo_ref_descr->get_referenced_type( ).
    rv_type_name = lo_referenced_type->get_name( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_referenced_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_referenced_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_ref_type( ).
    DATA lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Test'.
    DATA lr_string TYPE REF TO string.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_string INTO lr_string.

    DATA(lv_type_name) = lo_cut->get_referenced_type_name( lr_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type_name exp = 'STRING' msg = 'Referenzierter Typ sollte STRING sein.' ).

    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA lr_sflight TYPE REF TO sflight.
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_sflight INTO lr_sflight.
    lv_type_name = lo_cut->get_referenced_type_name( lr_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type_name exp = 'SFLIGHT' msg = 'Referenzierter Typ sollte SFLIGHT sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man den Typ eines Objekts, auf das eine Referenz zeigt, zur Laufzeit ermittelt. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Szenarien, in denen generische Referenzen verarbeitet werden und der tatsächliche Typ des referenzierten Objekts zur Laufzeit bekannt sein muss.
keywords: RTTI, REF TO, cl_abap_refdescr, get_referenced_type, Reference Type

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein gegebener Typ ein Interface ist, und geben Sie dessen Methoden zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_intfdescr=>describe_by_name` und das Attribut `methods`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_my_interface.
  METHODS method1.
  METHODS method2.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_rtt_intf_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_interface_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_method_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_intf_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_interface_methods.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_intf_descr) = CAST cl_abap_intfdescr(
                                   cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_interface_name ) ).
        rt_method_names = VALUE #( FOR method IN lo_intf_descr->methods
                                    ( method-name ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
*       Not an interface or type not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_methods.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_intf_methods( ).
    DATA(lt_method_names) = lo_cut->get_interface_methods( 'ZIF_MY_INTERFACE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_method_names[ table_line = 'METHOD1' ] ) msg = 'METHOD1 sollte gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_method_names[ table_line = 'METHOD2' ] ) msg = 'METHOD2 sollte gefunden werden.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_method_names msg = 'Für eine Klasse sollten keine Interface-Methoden gefunden werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die RTTI-Analyse von Interfaces. Mit `cl_abap_intfdescr` kann man überprüfen, ob ein Typ ein Interface ist, und dessen Methoden auslesen. Instructions: Führen Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen den internen Tabellen `itab_sflight` und `itab_spfli` durch, um Flugdaten mit den entsprechenden Flugverbindungen zu verknüpfen. Verwenden Sie dabei die moderne `FOR ... IN` Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR ... IN` Syntax mit `INNER JOIN` für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_inner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_spfli,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight_spfli.
    TYPES tt_sflight_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_joined_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_spfli   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_sflight_spfli.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_inner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_joined_data.
    rt_joined_data = VALUE #( FOR sflight_wa IN it_sflight
                                 FOR spfli_wa IN it_spfli
                                   WHERE ( spfli_wa-carrid = sflight_wa-carrid AND
                                           spfli_wa-connid = sflight_wa-connid )
                                 ( carrid   = sflight_wa-carrid,
                                   connid   = sflight_wa-connid,
                                   fldate   = sflight_wa-fldate,
                                   cityfrom = spfli_wa-cityfrom,
                                   cityto   = spfli_wa-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_inner_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inner_join.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_spfli   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_spfli ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_spfli>).
    <fs_spfli>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_spfli>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_spfli>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.
    <fs_spfli>-cityto = 'NEW YORK'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_inner( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_joined_data( it_sflight = lt_sflight it_spfli = lt_spfli ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ... IN` Syntax ermöglicht es, Schleifen und Joins auf internen Tabellen in einer deklarativen und funktionalen Weise zu schreiben. Dies führt zu kompakterem und besser lesbarem Code im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukten.
keywords: JOINS, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, INNER JOIN

Instructions: Führen Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN zwischen `itab_sflight` und `itab_spfli` durch. Wenn keine passende Flugverbindung gefunden wird, sollen die Felder für `cityfrom` und `cityto` leer bleiben. Nutzen Sie die moderne `FOR ... IN` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und `COND` für die Zuweisung von Standardwerten bei fehlenden Treffern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_left_outer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_spfli,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight_spfli.
    TYPES tt_sflight_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_joined_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_spfli   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_sflight_spfli.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_left_outer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_joined_data.
    rt_joined_data = VALUE #( FOR sflight_wa IN it_sflight
                                 LEFT OUTER JOIN spfli_wa IN it_spfli
                                   ON ( spfli_wa-carrid = sflight_wa-carrid AND
                                        spfli_wa-connid = sflight_wa-connid )
                                 ( carrid   = sflight_wa-carrid,
                                   connid   = sflight_wa-connid,
                                   fldate   = sflight_wa-fldate,
                                   cityfrom = COND #( WHEN spfli_wa IS NOT INITIAL THEN spfli_wa-cityfrom ELSE '' ) ,
                                   cityto   = COND #( WHEN spfli_wa IS NOT INITIAL THEN spfli_wa-cityto ELSE '' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_spfli   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '9999'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_spfli ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_spfli>).
    <fs_spfli>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_spfli>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_spfli>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.
    <fs_spfli>-cityto = 'NEW YORK'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_left_outer( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_joined_data( it_sflight = lt_sflight it_spfli = lt_spfli ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-cityfrom exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN` ermöglicht das Verknüpfen von Tabellen, wobei alle Einträge der linken Tabelle erhalten bleiben, auch wenn keine Übereinstimmung in der rechten Tabelle gefunden wird. `COND #(...)` wird verwendet, um bedingt Werte zuzuweisen, was den Code sehr kompakt macht.
keywords: JOINS, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, LEFT OUTER JOIN, COND

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus den Datenbanktabellen `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` mittels eines `INNER JOIN` in einer einzigen `SELECT` Anweisung. Filtern Sie dabei nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... INNER JOIN ... ON ... WHERE ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      WHERE p~cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_frankfurt_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_inner_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ). " Assuming no test data in SFLIGHT/SPFLI for FRANKFURT by default
    " To make this test more robust, one would need to insert test data into SFLIGHT/SPFLI.
    " For demonstration, we assert it's initial or check for specific known entries if data exists.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SELECT` Anweisung mit `INNER JOIN` ist der Standardweg, um verknüpfte Daten aus mehreren Datenbanktabellen effizient abzurufen. Die Verwendung von Aliasen (`AS s`, `AS p`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit, und `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ist die moderne Inline-Deklaration für die Zieltabelle.
keywords: JOINS, Database Access, SELECT, INNER JOIN, SFLIGHT, SPFLI

Instructions: Verknüpfen Sie zwei interne Tabellen (`itab_data1`, `itab_data2`) basierend auf einer gemeinsamen ID. Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE` um die Daten zu mergen und dabei nur die Felder zu übernehmen, die in der Zielstruktur vorhanden sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( ... ) ... )` für die effiziente Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data1,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data1,
           BEGIN OF ty_data2,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data2,
           BEGIN OF ty_result,
             id    TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES: tt_data1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data1 WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_data2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data2 WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS merge_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data1 TYPE tt_data1
        it_data2 TYPE tt_data2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_merged_data) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_data.
    DATA(lt_temp_result) = VALUE tt_result( FOR ls_data1 IN it_data1
                                            LET ls_data2 = it_data2[ id = ls_data1-id ] IN
                                            ( CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( ls_data1 ) ls_data2 ) ) ).
    rt_merged_data = lt_temp_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_merge_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_data.
    DATA: lt_data1 TYPE zcl_corresponding_join=>tt_data1,
          lt_data2 TYPE zcl_corresponding_join=>tt_data2.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Text A' ) TO lt_data1.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Text B' ) TO lt_data1.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 100 ) TO lt_data2.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 300 ) TO lt_data2.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->merge_data( it_data1 = lt_data1 it_data2 = lt_data2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Text A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-value exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-text exp = 'Text B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-value exp = 0 ). " Value is initial for non-match
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Syntax, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu verschieben. Es ermöglicht das Mergen von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur die passenden Felder übernommen werden. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN` und `LET` wird der Code sehr deklarativ und ausdrucksstark.
keywords: JOINS, Internal Tables, CORRESPONDING, BASE, FOR, VALUE, LET

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie eine numerische Eingabe in 'Klein', 'Mittel', 'Groß' oder 'Unbekannt', wenn der Wert außerhalb der definierten Bereiche liegt. Verwenden Sie eine `CASE` Expression mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE ... WHEN ... THEN ... WHEN OTHERS THEN ... END`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_when_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS categorize_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_when_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_number.
    rv_category = CASE iv_number
                    WHEN 1 TO 10 THEN 'Klein'
                    WHEN 11 TO 100 THEN 'Mittel'
                    WHEN 101 TO 1000 THEN 'Groß'
                    WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannt'
                  END.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null abfängt und einen spezifischen Fehlercode zurückgibt. Für alle anderen unerwarteten Fehler soll ein generischer Fehlercode verwendet werden. Nutzen Sie `TRY ... CATCH` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY ... CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error ... CATCH cx_root WHEN OTHERS ... ENDTRY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      EXCEPTIONS
        division_by_zero
        other_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        IF lx_arith->get_text( ) CS 'division by zero'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero. " Custom exception for clarity
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_other_error. " Custom exception for clarity
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root) WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_other_error. " Custom exception for clarity
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Personen nach ihrem Alter in Kategorien ('Jung', 'Erwachsen', 'Senior'). Personen, die keiner dieser Kategorien zugeordnet werden können, sollen in die Kategorie 'Unbekannt' fallen. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` mit `CASE` und `WHEN OTHERS`.
