CLASS zcl_group_by_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person,
             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_person,
           tt_person TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_person WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_age_group,
             category TYPE string,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_age_group,
           tt_age_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_age_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_by_age_category
      IMPORTING
        it_persons TYPE tt_person
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_age_groups) TYPE tt_age_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_age_category.
    rt_age_groups = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF person IN it_persons
                                GROUP BY ( category = CASE WHEN person-age BETWEEN 0 AND 18 THEN 'Jung'
                                                            WHEN person-age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 THEN 'Erwachsen'
                                                            WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannt'
                                                       END )
                                ( category = CORRESPONDING #( person-category ),
                                  count    = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle, wobei negative Zahlen als 0 behandelt werden und alle anderen Zahlen direkt addiert werden. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `CASE` Expression und `WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und einer `CASE` Expression im `NEXT` Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_case_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_with_filter
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_case_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_with_filter.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR number IN it_numbers
                       NEXT sum = sum + CASE WHEN number < 0 THEN 0
                                             WHEN OTHERS THEN number
                                        END ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE zcl_reduce_case_sum=>tt_numbers.

    APPEND 10 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND -5 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 20 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 0 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 15 TO lt_numbers.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_case_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_with_filter( lt_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 45 ). " 10 + 0 + 20 + 0 + 15 = 45

    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    APPEND -1 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND -2 TO lt_numbers.
    lv_sum = lo_cut->calculate_sum_with_filter( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).

    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    APPEND 1 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_numbers.
    lv_sum = lo_cut->calculate_sum_with_filter( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Integration einer `CASE` Expression mit `WHEN OTHERS` direkt im `NEXT` Block macht den Code extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark, um komplexe Aggregationslogik zu implementieren.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen `INNER JOIN` auf drei internen Tabellen (`itab_sflight`, `itab_spfli`, `itab_sbook`) durch, um Flugdaten, Verbindungsdetails und Buchungsinformationen zu verknüpfen. Nutzen Sie die moderne `FOR ... IN` Syntax.

CLASS zcl_join_triple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_booking_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_booking_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_triple_joined_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_spfli   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF spfli WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_sbook   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_flight_booking_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_triple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_triple_joined_data.
    rt_joined_data = VALUE #( FOR sflight_wa IN it_sflight
                                 FOR spfli_wa IN it_spfli
                                   WHERE ( spfli_wa-carrid = sflight_wa-carrid AND
                                           spfli_wa-connid = sflight_wa-connid )
                                 FOR sbook_wa IN it_sbook
                                   WHERE ( sbook_wa-carrid = sflight_wa-carrid AND
                                           sbook_wa-connid = sflight_wa-connid AND
                                           sbook_wa-fldate = sflight_wa-fldate )
                                 ( carrid   = sflight_wa-carrid,
                                   connid   = sflight_wa-connid,
                                   fldate   = sflight_wa-fldate,
                                   bookid   = sbook_wa-bookid,
                                   cityfrom = spfli_wa-cityfrom,
                                   cityto   = spfli_wa-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_left_outer_sbook DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking_opt,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,

CLASS zcl_db_left_outer_sbook IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flights_with_bookings.

CLASS zcl_object_dispatcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dispatch_object.
    CASE TYPE OF io_processable.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_processor_a THEN
        io_processable->process( ).
      WHEN TYPE zcl_processor_b THEN
        io_processable->process( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        WRITE: / 'Unknown object type, performing default processing.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dispatch_a FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_dispatch_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dispatch_a.
    DATA(lo_processor_a) = NEW zcl_processor_a( ).
    DATA(lo_dispatcher) = NEW zcl_object_dispatcher( ).
    " Redirect output for testing purposes
    DATA(lv_output) TYPE string.
    NEW cl_abap_unit_test_output_capture( )->start_capture( ).
    lo_dispatcher->dispatch_object( lo_processor_a ).
    NEW cl_abap_unit_test_output_capture( )->end_capture( IMPORTING captured_output = lv_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_output exp = 'Processing Type A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dispatch_b.
    DATA(lo_processor_b) = NEW zcl_processor_b( ).
    DATA(lo_dispatcher) = NEW zcl_object_dispatcher( ).
    DATA(lv_output) TYPE string.
    NEW cl_abap_unit_test_output_capture( )->start_capture( ).
    lo_dispatcher->dispatch_object( lo_processor_b ).
    NEW cl_abap_unit_test_output_capture( )->end_capture( IMPORTING captured_output = lv_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_output exp = 'Processing Type B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dispatch_unknown.
    " Create a dummy class that implements the interface but is not explicitly handled
    CLASS zcl_processor_c DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_processable.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcl_processor_c IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD zif_processable~process.
        WRITE: / 'Processing Type C'.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_processor_c) = NEW zcl_processor_c( ).
    DATA(lo_dispatcher) = NEW zcl_object_dispatcher( ).
    DATA(lv_output) TYPE string.
    NEW cl_abap_unit_test_output_capture( )->start_capture( ).
    lo_dispatcher->dispatch_object( lo_processor_c ).
    NEW cl_abap_unit_test_output_capture( )->end_capture( IMPORTING captured_output = lv_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_output exp = 'Unknown object type, performing default processing.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das die dynamische Typidentifikation und -verarbeitung von Objekten erheblich vereinfacht. Es ist eine typsichere Alternative zu `IF TYPE OF`. `WHEN OTHERS` ist hier unerlässlich, um eine Fallback-Logik für alle Objekttypen bereitzustellen, die nicht explizit in den `WHEN TYPE` Klauseln aufgeführt sind, was die Robustheit der Anwendung erhöht.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, Object Orientation, CASE TYPE OF, RTTI, Interfaces

CLASS zcl_table_merge DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD merge_flights.
    rt_merged_flights = VALUE #( it_flights1 ).

CLASS zcl_flight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR flight IN it_flights NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_number_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_number IMPORTING iv_number_str TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_result_str) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS string_to_int IMPORTING iv_str TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_int) TYPE i.
    METHODS double_int IMPORTING iv_int TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_doubled_int) TYPE i.
    METHODS int_to_string IMPORTING iv_int TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_str) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_number.
    rv_result_str = me->string_to_int( iv_number_str )
                       ->double_int( )
                       ->int_to_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD string_to_int.
    TRY.
        rv_int = CONV i( iv_str ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_int = 0. " Default or error handling
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD double_int.
    rv_doubled_int = iv_int * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD int_to_string.
    rv_str = CONV string( iv_int ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Zeigen Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_demo_output` an.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_counts) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_carrid_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights BY flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
    cl_demo_output=>display( rt_carrid_counts ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'BA' ]-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und leistungsstarke Gruppierung von internen Tabellen, was den Code für Aggregationen erheblich vereinfacht. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe. `cl_demo_output` wird zur Anzeige verwendet.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, FOR GROUPS OF, Functional Programming, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen eines bestimmten Carriers und geben Sie die Flugnummern zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und den `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_connid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_connid.
    TYPES: tt_flight_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connids_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_flight_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connids_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                            ( connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_connids_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_connids_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_for( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_connids_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 0 reverse = abap_true msg = 'Should find some flights for LH' ).
    LOOP AT lt_connids INTO DATA(ls_connid).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_connid-connid exp = '' reverse = abap_true msg = 'Connection ID should not be empty' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_for( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_connids_by_carrier( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 0 msg = 'Should find no flights for XX' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Filterung und Projektion von Daten aus internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu verwenden, wird die Logik in einem einzigen Ausdruck zusammengefasst, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Filter, Projection

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 0 reverse = abap_true msg = 'Should find some carrier counts' ).

    " Example: Check if LH has a count (assuming sflight has LH data)
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_lh_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 0 reverse = abap_true msg = 'LH flight count should be positive' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Hier wird die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft effizient und deklarativ berechnet, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, GROUP BY, Aggregation, FOR GROUPS OF

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von einem bestimmten Carrier durchgeführt werden und deren Flugdatum nach einem bestimmten Datum liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit mehreren Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights_multi_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_multi_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > iv_min_fldate )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid, fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_multi_conditions FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match_multi_conditions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_multi_conditions.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_multi_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 30. " Flights in the last 30 days
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_fldate = lv_test_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 0 reverse = abap_true msg = 'Should find some flights for LH after test date' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier should be LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate > lv_test_date ) msg = 'Flight date should be after test date' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match_multi_conditions.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_multi_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_future_date) = sy-datum + 365. " A date far in the future
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_fldate = lv_future_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 0 msg = 'Should find no flights for LH in far future' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht die Kombination mehrerer Bedingungen mit logischen Operatoren wie `AND` oder `OR`, was die Filterlogik direkt und inline in einem einzigen Ausdruck abbildet. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Notwendigkeit temporärer Variablen oder komplexer Schleifenstrukturen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Multiple Conditions, AND

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle mit Flugdaten in eine andere Struktur, die nur Carrier und Flugnummer enthält, und füllen Sie dabei fehlende Felder mit Standardwerten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES: tt_source_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'A', " Default value
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES: tt_target_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights_with_base
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_target_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights_with_base.
    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_flights MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid USING <SOURCE_FIELDS> EXCEPT * ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_flights_with_base FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_flights_with_base.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_base( ).
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_base=>tt_source_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231128' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'NYC' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231128' cityfrom = 'NYC' cityto = 'LAX' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_flights_with_base( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-status exp = 'A' ). " Default value should be kept
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator mit `BASE` ermöglicht die effiziente Zuweisung von Daten zwischen internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Strukturen. Felder, die in der Zielstruktur vorhanden sind, aber nicht in der Quellstruktur, behalten ihre Initialwerte oder vordefinierten Standardwerte, was den Code kompakter und robuster macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, CORRESPONDING, BASE, Data Mapping

explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die direkte Initialisierung von internen Tabellen mit Daten, ohne dass explizite `APPEND`-Anweisungen oder Workareas erforderlich sind. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code, insbesondere bei der Erstellung von Testdaten oder kleinen, festen Datensätzen.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, Initialization

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING.
      DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ).
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        ls_result-flight_count = ls_result-flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 0 reverse = abap_true msg = 'Should find some carrier counts' ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Sie ermöglicht die Verarbeitung von Gruppen von Zeilen, was für Berichte und Analysen sehr nützlich ist. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` innerhalb der Schleife für die Ergebnisstruktur ist ein modernes Muster.
keywords: Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Grouping, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_line_exists_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` so auf, dass sie für eine grafische Darstellung der Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft verwendet werden können. Die Ausgabe soll eine Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und der jeweiligen Fluganzahl sein.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` oder `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` um die Daten zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data_entry,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data_entry.
    TYPES: tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_counts_for_chart
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_counts_for_chart.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                 flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

      rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = 'Field not found'.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (sflights) und befüllen Sie diese mit dem `VALUE` Operator und Inline-Deklarationen. Geben Sie die vorbereiteten Daten zurück, die dann in einem ALV Grid angezeigt werden könnten.

CLASS zcl_alv_data_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_alv_data_value IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights_raw

                               connid    = flight-connid
                               fldate    = flight-fldate
                               planetype = flight-planetype
                               seatsocc  = flight-seatsocc
                               seatsmax  = flight-seatsmax ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen Feldkatalog für ein ALV Grid basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, wobei bestimmte Felder bedingt hinzugefügt werden (z.B. 'PLANETYPE' nur, wenn es Daten enthält).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DESCRIBE TABLE` und `FOR ... IN ...` für die Feldkatalogerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_lvc_s_fcat,
             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
             coltext   TYPE lvc_coltxt,
             outputlen TYPE lvc_outlen,
             col_pos   TYPE lvc_colpos,
             tech      TYPE abap_bool,
             do_sum    TYPE abap_bool,
             no_out    TYPE abap_bool,
             key       TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_lvc_s_fcat.
    TYPES: ty_lvc_t_fcat TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_lvc_s_fcat WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_fieldcatalog
      IMPORTING it_data        TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fieldcatalog) TYPE ty_lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_fieldcatalog.
    DATA(lv_col_pos) = 0.

    rt_fieldcatalog = VALUE #( FOR comp IN CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data )->get_table_line_type( ) )->get_components( )
                                LET lv_col_pos = lv_col_pos + 1 IN
                                ( fieldname = comp-name
                                  coltext   = comp-name
                                  outputlen = comp-length
                                  col_pos   = lv_col_pos
                                  " Beispiel: 'PLANETYPE' nur anzeigen, wenn es Werte gibt
                                  no_out    = COND abap_bool( WHEN comp-name = 'PLANETYPE' AND NOT line_exists( it_data[ planetype IS NOT INITIAL ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).

    " In a real scenario, rt_fieldcatalog would then be passed to cl_gui_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_dynamic_fieldcatalog FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_dynamic_fieldcatalog.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat=>ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_fieldcatalog) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_fieldcatalog( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_fieldcatalog IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_fieldcatalog ) exp = 0 ).

    " Check if PLANETYPE is visible when data exists
    DATA(ls_planetype_fcat) = VALUE #( lt_fieldcatalog[ fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' ] OPTIONAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_planetype_fcat-no_out exp = abap_false ).

    " Test with no PLANETYPE data
    DATA(lt_test_data_no_plane) = VALUE zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat=>ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_fieldcatalog_no_plane) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_fieldcatalog( lt_test_data_no_plane ).
    DATA(ls_planetype_fcat_no_plane) = VALUE #( lt_fieldcatalog_no_plane[ fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' ] OPTIONAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_planetype_fcat_no_plane-no_out exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die dynamische Erstellung des Feldkatalogs basierend auf den Komponenten der Datenstruktur. `COND` wird verwendet, um die Sichtbarkeit des Feldes 'PLANETYPE' basierend auf dem Vorhandensein von Daten in der Eingabetabelle zu steuern, was eine flexible Anpassung des ALV-Layouts ermöglicht. `LINE_EXISTS` prüft effizient, ob ein Eintrag existiert.
keywords: ALV, Field Catalog, FOR, COND, Dynamic, DESCRIBE TABLE, LINE_EXISTS

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) pro Fluggesellschaft. Zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einer internen Tabelle an, die dann in einem ALV Grid dargestellt werden könnte.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_data_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
           END OF ty_aggregated_data.
    TYPES: ty_aggregated_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE ty_aggregated_data_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_data_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE ty_aggregated_data_tt(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_aggregated_data_tt( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights_raw
      GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(group_key)
      ( carrid = group_key
        total_seats_occupied = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP group_key ( sum + member-seatsocc ) ) ) ).

    " In a real scenario, rt_aggregated_data would then be passed to cl_gui_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_aggregated_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_aggregated_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_data_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_sflight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_aggregated_data IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated_data ) exp = 0 ).

    " Example: Check aggregation for a known carrier (e.g., 'LH')
    DATA(ls_lh_data) = VALUE #( lt_aggregated_data[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_lh_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_lh_data-total_seats_occupied exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. Hier wird er verwendet, um Daten nach Fluggesellschaften zu gruppieren und die Summe der belegten Sitze für jede Gruppe zu berechnen, was eine effiziente Datenvorbereitung für das ALV Grid darstellt.
keywords: ALV, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, GROUP BY

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten für ein ALV Grid vor und erstellen Sie eine Styling-Tabelle, die bestimmte Zellen (z.B. Flüge mit einer Auslastung unter 50%) farblich hervorhebt, indem Sie den `COND` Operator verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` für die dynamische Zuweisung von Styling-Informationen in der ALV-Layout-Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_cell_styling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_styled,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             cell_style TYPE lvc_t_styl,
           END OF ty_sflight_styled.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_styled_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_styled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_styled_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_styled_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_styled_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_cell_styling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_styled_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    rt_styled_sflights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights_raw
                                   LET lv_occupancy_rate = COND decfloat16( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) ELSE 0 ) IN
                                   ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                                     connid    = flight-connid
                                     fldate    = flight-fldate
                                     planetype = flight-planetype
                                     seatsocc  = flight-seatsocc
                                     seatsmax  = flight-seatsmax
                                     cell_style = COND lvc_t_styl( WHEN lv_occupancy_rate < '0.5' THEN VALUE #( ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_critical ) ) ELSE VALUE #( ) ) ) ).

    " In a real scenario, rt_styled_sflights would be passed to cl_gui_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
    " with the field 'CELL_STYLE' mapped to the styling column.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine hierarchische Struktur (z.B. Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge) aus der Tabelle `sflight` und bereiten Sie diese als interne Tabelle von Knoten für einen `cl_gui_list_tree` vor, indem Sie moderne Schleifen und den `VALUE` Operator verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und `VALUE #(...)` zur Erstellung der Knotenstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_data_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             tlevel   TYPE i,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: ty_tree_node_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hierarchical_sflight_nodes RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE ty_tree_node_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hierarchical_sflight_nodes.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    SORT lt_sflights_raw BY carrid fldate connid.

    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    rt_tree_nodes = VALUE #( LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter IN
                               FOR car_group IN lt_sflights_raw GROUP BY car_group-carrid ASCENDING
                               LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 IN
                               ( node_key = |C{ lv_node_counter }|
                                 relatkey = ''
                                 text     = car_group-carrid
                                 tlevel   = 0
                                 is_folder = abap_true )
                               FOR flight IN GROUP car_group
                               LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 IN
                               ( node_key = |F{ lv_node_counter }|
                                 relatkey = |C{ lv_node_counter - 1 - ( lines( car_group ) ) }|
                                 text     = |Flug { flight-connid } am { flight-fldate }|
                                 tlevel   = 1
                                 is_folder = abap_false ) ).

    " In a real scenario, rt_tree_nodes would then be passed to cl_gui_list_tree->add_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_carrier_nodes) = lines( FILTER #( lt_tree_nodes WHERE tlevel = 0 ) ).

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_nodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

    TYPES: ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             tlevel   TYPE i,

             icon     TYPE lvc_value,

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_tree_nodes.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    SORT lt_sflights_raw BY carrid fldate connid.

    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    rt_tree_nodes = VALUE #( LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter IN
                               FOR car_group IN lt_sflights_raw GROUP BY car_group-carrid ASCENDING
                               LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 IN
                               ( node_key = |C{ lv_node_counter }|
                                 relatkey = ''
                                 text     = car_group-carrid
                                 tlevel   = 0
                                 is_folder = abap_true
                                 icon     = 'ICON_AIRLINE' ) " Beispiel Icon für Fluggesellschaft
                               FOR flight IN GROUP car_group
                               LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 IN
                               ( node_key = |F{ lv_node_counter }|
                                 relatkey = |C{ lv_node_counter - 1 - ( lines( car_group ) ) }|
                                 text     = |Flug { flight-connid } am { flight-fldate }|
                                 tlevel   = 1
                                 is_folder = abap_false
                                 icon     = SWITCH lvc_value( flight-connid
                                            WHEN '0017' THEN 'ICON_FLIGHT_DEPARTURE' " Beispiel: Spezielles Icon für Flug 0017
                                            ELSE 'ICON_FLIGHT' ) ) ).

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung eines Doppelklick-Events auf einen Knoten eines `cl_gui_list_tree`. Die Event-Parameter sollen mit modernen Syntaxelementen verarbeitet werden, um den geklickten Knoten zu identifizieren und eine Aktion auszuführen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `LINE_EXISTS` zur Verarbeitung von Event-Parametern und zur Suche im Knoten-Cache.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: ty_tree_node_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    EVENTS double_click EXPORTING VALUE(e_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.

    METHODS handle_double_click
      FOR EVENT double_click OF zcl_tree_event_handler
      IMPORTING e_node_key.

    METHODS simulate_event
      IMPORTING iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

    PRIVATE SECTION.
      DATA mt_nodes TYPE ty_tree_node_tt.
      DATA mv_last_clicked_node TYPE lvc_nkey.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_double_click.
    mv_last_clicked_node = e_node_key.
    " In a real scenario, this would trigger further GUI updates or business logic.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_event.
    " Simulate initial node data
    mt_nodes = VALUE #( ( node_key = 'NODE1' text = 'Knoten 1' )
                        ( node_key = 'NODE2' text = 'Knoten 2' )
                        ( node_key = 'NODE3' text = 'Knoten 3' ) ).

    " Raise the event to trigger the handler
    RAISE EVENT double_click EXPORTING e_node_key = iv_node_key.

    " Check if the node exists and was processed
    IF line_exists( mt_nodes[ node_key = mv_last_clicked_node ] ).
      rv_message = |Knoten '{ mv_last_clicked_node }' wurde doppelt geklickt und verarbeitet.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Knoten '{ iv_node_key }' wurde geklickt, aber nicht gefunden oder verarbeitet.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message_existing exp = 'Knoten ''NODE2'' wurde doppelt geklickt und verarbeitet.' ).

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einer internen Tabelle, die die Knoten eines `cl_gui_list_tree` darstellt, nach bestimmten Knoten basierend auf einem Suchkriterium (z.B. Text enthält 'Flug') und markieren Sie diese, indem Sie `FILTER` und `COND` verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um die relevanten Knoten zu finden und `COND` um deren Markierungsstatus zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_search_mark DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             is_marked TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: ty_tree_node_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS search_and_mark_nodes
      IMPORTING iv_search_term TYPE string
      CHANGING  ct_tree_nodes  TYPE ty_tree_node_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_search_mark IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_and_mark_nodes.
    " Initialisiere die Markierung für alle Knoten auf FALSE
    LOOP AT ct_tree_nodes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_node>).
      <fs_node>-is_marked = abap_false.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Markiere Knoten, die dem Suchkriterium entsprechen
    LOOP AT ct_tree_nodes ASSIGNING <fs_node>
      WHERE text CP iv_search_term.
      <fs_node>-is_marked = abap_true.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Alternativ und moderner mit MODIFY ENTRIES OF
    " ct_tree_nodes = VALUE #( FOR node IN ct_tree_nodes
    "                            ( node_key = node-node_key
    "                              text     = node-text
    "                              is_marked = COND abap_bool( WHEN node-text CP iv_search_term THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).

    " Oder noch kürzer mit FOR ... IN ... und WHERE
    " MODIFY TABLE ct_tree_nodes FROM VALUE #( FOR node IN ct_tree_nodes WHERE ( text CP iv_search_term ) ( node_key = node-node_key is_marked = abap_true ) ).

    " Die obige LOOP-Variante ist für CHANGING-Parameter oft klarer, aber die VALUE/FOR-Varianten sind auch möglich.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_search_and_mark_nodes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_search_and_mark_nodes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_search_mark( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE zcl_tree_search_mark=>ty_tree_node_tt(
      ( node_key = 'C1' text = 'Lufthansa' )
      ( node_key = 'F1' text = 'Flug LH400' )
      ( node_key = 'C2' text = 'United Airlines' )
      ( node_key = 'F2' text = 'Flug UA100' )
      ( node_key = 'N1' text = 'Notiz' )
    ).

    " Search for 'Flug'
    lo_cut->search_and_mark_nodes( EXPORTING iv_search_term = 'Flug*' CHANGING ct_tree_nodes = lt_nodes ).

    DATA(ls_node_f1) = VALUE #( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'F1' ] ).
    DATA(ls_node_f2) = VALUE #( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'F2' ] ).
    DATA(ls_node_c1) = VALUE #( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'C1' ] ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_node_f1-is_marked exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_node_f2-is_marked exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_node_c1-is_marked exp = abap_false ).

    " Search for 'Lufthansa'
    lo_cut->search_and_mark_nodes( EXPORTING iv_search_term = 'Lufthansa' CHANGING ct_tree_nodes = lt_nodes ).
    DATA(ls_node_c1_after_search) = VALUE #( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'C1' ] ).
    DATA(ls_node_f1_after_search) = VALUE #( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'F1' ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_node_c1_after_search-is_marked exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_node_f1_after_search-is_marked exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Für die Initialisierung oder Neuzuweisung von Werten kann der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `COND` verwendet werden, um die Logik deklarativ und kompakt zu halten. Dies ist eine moderne Art, Daten für die Anzeige in einem Tree Control vorzubereiten.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine komplexe, rekursive Baumstruktur aus einer flachen Datenquelle (simulierte Materialstücklisten) und bereiten Sie diese für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_list_tree` vor, indem Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Transformation nutzen.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator kann für rekursive Datenaggregation und Transformationen verwendet werden, um eine hierarchische Struktur aufzubauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_recursive_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flat_bom_item,
             parent_id TYPE string,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flat_bom_item.
    TYPES: ty_flat_bom_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flat_bom_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             tlevel   TYPE i,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: ty_tree_node_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_recursive_tree_nodes
      IMPORTING it_flat_bom_data TYPE ty_flat_bom_tt
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE ty_tree_node_tt.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS build_tree_recursive
      IMPORTING it_flat_bom_data TYPE ty_flat_bom_tt
                iv_parent_id     TYPE string
                iv_level         TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes)  TYPE ty_tree_node_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_recursive_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_recursive_tree_nodes.
    rt_tree_nodes = build_tree_recursive( it_flat_bom_data = it_flat_bom_data
                                          iv_parent_id     = '' " Start with root nodes
                                          iv_level         = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_tree_recursive.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    rt_nodes = REDUCE ty_tree_node_tt(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_tree_node_tt( )
      FOR item IN it_flat_bom_data WHERE ( parent_id = iv_parent_id )
      LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 IN
      ( result = VALUE #( BASE result
                           ( node_key = item-item_id
                             relatkey = iv_parent_id
                             text     = item-description
                             tlevel   = iv_level
                             is_folder = COND abap_bool( WHEN line_exists( it_flat_bom_data[ parent_id = item-item_id ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) )
        result = VALUE #( BASE result
                           FOR sub_node IN build_tree_recursive( it_flat_bom_data = it_flat_bom_data
                                                                 iv_parent_id     = item-item_id
                                                                 iv_level         = iv_level + 1 )
                           ( sub_node ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_recursive_tree_nodes FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_recursive_tree_nodes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_recursive_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flat_bom) = VALUE zcl_tree_recursive_reduce=>ty_flat_bom_tt(
      ( parent_id = '' item_id = 'P1' description = 'Produkt A' )
      ( parent_id = 'P1' item_id = 'C1' description = 'Komponente 1' )
      ( parent_id = 'P1' item_id = 'C2' description = 'Komponente 2' )
      ( parent_id = 'C1' item_id = 'M1' description = 'Material X' )
      ( parent_id = 'C2' item_id = 'M2' description = 'Material Y' )
      ( parent_id = 'C2' item_id = 'M3' description = 'Material Z' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_tree_nodes) = lo_cut->get_recursive_tree_nodes( lt_flat_bom ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_tree_nodes IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_tree_nodes ) exp = 6 ).

    " Check root node
    DATA(ls_root_node) = VALUE #( lt_tree_nodes[ node_key = 'P1' ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_root_node-tlevel exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_root_node-is_folder exp = abap_true ).

    " Check child node
    DATA(ls_child_node) = VALUE #( lt_tree_nodes[ node_key = 'C1' ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_child_node-relatkey exp = 'P1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_child_node-tlevel exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_child_node-is_folder exp = abap_true ).

    " Check leaf node
    DATA(ls_leaf_node) = VALUE #( lt_tree_nodes[ node_key = 'M1' ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_leaf_node-relatkey exp = 'C1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_leaf_node-tlevel exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_leaf_node-is_folder exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die die Logik zur Verwaltung von Baumknoten kapselt. Die Klasse soll Methoden zum Hinzufügen und Entfernen von Knoten bereitstellen, die moderne ABAP-Syntax verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` und `DELETE TABLE` mit modernen Syntaxvarianten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_node_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             tlevel   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: ty_tree_node_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH UNIQUE KEY node_key.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS add_node
      IMPORTING iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
                iv_relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey OPTIONAL
                iv_text     TYPE string
                iv_level    TYPE i
      RAISING   cx_sy_table_line_exists.
    METHODS delete_node
      IMPORTING iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
      RAISING   cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    METHODS get_nodes RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE ty_tree_node_tt.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE ty_tree_node_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initial nodes, e.g., a root node
    INSERT VALUE #( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Root Node' tlevel = 0 ) INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_node.
    INSERT VALUE #( node_key = iv_node_key
                    relatkey = iv_relatkey
                    text     = iv_text
                    tlevel   = iv_level ) INTO TABLE mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_node.
    DELETE TABLE mt_nodes WITH TABLE KEY node_key = iv_node_key.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_nodes.
    rt_nodes = mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Datentypen wie `DECFLOAT34` für Berechnungen und zeigen Sie die Ergebnisse in einem ALV Grid an. Berechnen Sie die Auslastung von Flügen aus `sflight` als Dezimalzahl.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_decfloat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_occupancy,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             occupancy_rate TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_sflight_occupancy.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_occupancy_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_occupancy RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_occupancy_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_decfloat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_occupancy.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights_raw
                             ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                               connid    = flight-connid
                               fldate    = flight-fldate
                               seatsocc  = flight-seatsocc
                               seatsmax  = flight-seatsmax
                               occupancy_rate = COND decfloat34( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( CONV decfloat34( flight-seatsocc ) / flight-seatsmax ) ELSE 0 ) ) ).

    " In a real scenario, rt_sflights would then be passed to cl_gui_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_get_sflight_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_decfloat( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_sflights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 0 ).

    DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_sflights[ 1 ].
    IF ls_first_flight-seatsmax > 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_occupancy) = CONV decfloat34( ls_first_flight-seatsocc ) / ls_first_flight-seatsmax.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-occupancy_rate exp = lv_expected_occupancy ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-occupancy_rate exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `DECFLOAT34` (oder `DECFLOAT16`) ist der moderne Standard für Dezimalberechnungen in ABAP, da sie Gleitkommafehler vermeidet, die bei herkömmlichen `P`-Typen auftreten können. In Kombination mit `VALUE`, `FOR` und `COND` ermöglicht dies eine präzise und lesbare Datenaufbereitung für das ALV Grid.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Baumknoten generiert und dabei die `LINE_EXISTS` Expression verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob ein übergeordneter Knoten bereits existiert, bevor ein Kindknoten hinzugefügt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` für effiziente Prüfungen in internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             tlevel   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: ty_tree_node_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH UNIQUE KEY node_key.

    METHODS get_nodes_with_parent_check RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE ty_tree_node_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nodes_with_parent_check.
    DATA(lt_temp_nodes) = VALUE ty_tree_node_tt(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Root' tlevel = 0 )
    ).

    " Add child node if parent 'ROOT' exists
    IF line_exists( lt_temp_nodes[ node_key = 'ROOT' ] ).
      INSERT VALUE #( node_key = 'CHILD1' relatkey = 'ROOT' text = 'Child 1' tlevel = 1 ) INTO TABLE lt_temp_nodes.
    ENDIF.

    " Add grandchild node if parent 'CHILD1' exists
    IF line_exists( lt_temp_nodes[ node_key = 'CHILD1' ] ).
      INSERT VALUE #( node_key = 'GRANDCHILD1' relatkey = 'CHILD1' text = 'Grandchild 1' tlevel = 2 ) INTO TABLE lt_temp_nodes.
    ENDIF.

    " Attempt to add a node with a non-existent parent (will not be added)
    IF line_exists( lt_temp_nodes[ node_key = 'NON_EXISTENT_PARENT' ] ).
      INSERT VALUE #( node_key = 'ORPHAN' relatkey = 'NON_EXISTENT_PARENT' text = 'Orphan' tlevel = 1 ) INTO TABLE lt_temp_nodes.
    ENDIF.

    rt_tree_nodes = lt_temp_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_nodes_with_parent_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_nodes_with_parent_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->get_nodes_with_parent_check( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nodes ) exp = 3 ). " ROOT, CHILD1, GRANDCHILD1

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'ROOT' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'CHILD1' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'GRANDCHILD1' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = line_exists( lt_nodes[ node_key = 'ORPHAN' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LINE_EXISTS` Expression ist eine moderne und performante Möglichkeit, die Existenz eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, ohne eine Schleife oder `READ TABLE` verwenden zu müssen. Dies ist besonders nützlich beim Aufbau hierarchischer Strukturen für Tree Controls, um sicherzustellen, dass übergeordnete Knoten existieren, bevor Kindknoten hinzugefügt werden.
keywords: Tree, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming, VALUE, INSERT

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine Kette von funktionalen Operatoren (`FILTER`, `MAP`, `REDUCE`) um Flugdaten aus `sflight` zu verarbeiten und für ein ALV Grid aufzubereiten. Filtern Sie Flüge, berechnen Sie die Auslastung und aggregieren Sie diese.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER`, `MAP` (implizit durch `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...`), und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_functional_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             occupancy_rate TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES: ty_flight_occupancy_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_occupancy,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE decfloat34,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_aggregated_occupancy.
    TYPES: ty_aggregated_occupancy_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_processed_sflight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE ty_aggregated_occupancy_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_functional_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_processed_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    DATA(lt_filtered_and_mapped) = VALUE ty_flight_occupancy_tt(
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw WHERE seatsmax > 0 )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        occupancy_rate = CONV decfloat34( flight-seatsocc ) / flight-seatsmax ) ).

    rt_aggregated_data = REDUCE ty_aggregated_occupancy_tt(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_aggregated_occupancy_tt( )
      FOR occupancy IN lt_filtered_and_mapped
      GROUP BY occupancy-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(group_key)
      ( carrid = group_key
        avg_occupancy = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP group_key ( sum + member-occupancy_rate ) ) / lines( group_key )
        flight_count  = lines( group_key ) ) ).

    " In a real scenario, rt_aggregated_data would then be passed to cl_gui_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_processed_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_processed_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_functional_chain( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = lo_cut->get_processed_sflight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_aggregated_data IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated_data ) exp = 0 ).

    " Check if average occupancy is within a reasonable range (0 to 1)
    DATA(ls_first_agg) = lt_aggregated_data[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_first_agg-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_first_agg-avg_occupancy <= 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_first_agg-flight_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP durch die Verkettung von Operatoren. Zuerst werden Flüge mit `FILTER` gefiltert, dann wird die Auslastung mit `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...` berechnet (implizites Mapping), und schließlich werden die Daten mit `REDUCE` aggregiert. Diese Kette von Operationen ist sehr effizient und lesbar für komplexe Datenverarbeitungsaufgaben, die oft für ALV-Anzeigen benötigt werden.
keywords: ALV, Functional Programming, FILTER, VALUE, FOR, REDUCE, Aggregation, Data Transformation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum und erstellen Sie eine hierarchische Baumstruktur für einen `cl_gui_list_tree`, die diese Gruppierung widerspiegelt. Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY` Schleifen, um die hierarchische Struktur zu erzeugen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             tlevel   TYPE i,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: ty_tree_node_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_sflight_nodes RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE ty_tree_node_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_sflight_nodes.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    SORT lt_sflights_raw BY carrid fldate connid.

    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    rt_tree_nodes = VALUE #( LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter IN
                               FOR car_group IN lt_sflights_raw GROUP BY car_group-carrid ASCENDING
                               LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 IN
                               ( node_key = |C{ lv_node_counter }|
                                 relatkey = ''
                                 text     = car_group-carrid
                                 tlevel   = 0
                                 is_folder = abap_true )
                               FOR date_group IN GROUP car_group GROUP BY date_group-fldate ASCENDING
                               LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 IN
                               ( node_key = |D{ lv_node_counter }|
                                 relatkey = |C{ lv_node_counter - 1 - ( lines( car_group ) ) }|
                                 text     = |Datum { date_group-fldate DATE = USER }|
                                 tlevel   = 1
                                 is_folder = abap_true )
                               FOR flight IN GROUP date_group
                               LET lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1 IN
                               ( node_key = |F{ lv_node_counter }|
                                 relatkey = |D{ lv_node_counter - 1 - ( lines( date_group ) ) }|
                                 text     = |Flug { flight-connid }|
                                 tlevel   = 2
                                 is_folder = abap_false ) ).

    " In a real scenario, rt_tree_nodes would then be passed to cl_gui_list_tree->add_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_tree_nodes ) exp = 0 ).

    " Check for at least one carrier node (level 0), one date node (level 1), and one flight node (level 2)
    DATA(lv_carrier_nodes) = lines( FILTER #( lt_tree_nodes WHERE tlevel = 0 ) ).

Dies ist ideal für die Datenvorbereitung für `cl_gui_list_tree` und demonstriert fortgeschrittene funktionale Programmierung.

CLASS zcl_zip_create_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_zip_create_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_archive.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
      lo_zip->add(
        name    = ls_file-name
        content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( ls_file-content )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_zip->save( EXPORTING zip = rv_zip_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahiere alle Dateien aus einem gegebenen ZIP-Archiv (XSTRING) und gib sie als interne Tabelle mit Dateinamen und String-Inhalten zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOAD`, `GET_FILES` und `GET` von `CL_ABAP_ZIP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_extract_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_extracted_file,
             name    TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_extracted_file.
    TYPES: tt_extracted_file TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_extracted_file WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_all_files
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_extracted_files) TYPE tt_extracted_file.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_extract_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_files.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( EXPORTING zip = iv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_zip_files) = lo_zip->get_files( ).

    LOOP AT lt_zip_files INTO DATA(ls_zip_file).
      DATA(lv_xstring_content) TYPE xstring.
      lo_zip->get(
        EXPORTING
          name    = ls_zip_file-name
        IMPORTING
          content = lv_xstring_content
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_extracted_file(
        name    = ls_zip_file-name
        content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_by_encoding(
                                     encoding = 'UTF-8'
                                   )->uc_to_string( lv_xstring_content )
      ) TO rt_extracted_files.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_all.
    DATA(lo_create_multi) = NEW zcl_zip_create_multi( ).
    DATA(lo_extract_all) = NEW zcl_zip_extract_all( ).

    DATA(lt_original_files) = VALUE zcl_zip_create_multi=>tt_file_content(
      ( name = 'doc.txt' content = 'This is document one.' )
      ( name = 'report.log' content = 'Report generated at 10:00.' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_create_multi->create_zip_archive( lt_original_files ).
    DATA(lt_extracted_files) = lo_extract_all->extract_all_files( lv_zip_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_extracted_files )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Sollte 2 Dateien extrahieren'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_extracted_files WITH KEY name = 'doc.txt' INTO DATA(ls_doc_file).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_doc_file-content
      exp = 'This is document one.'
      msg = 'Inhalt von doc.txt stimmt nicht überein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das vollständige Extrahieren eines ZIP-Archivs. Es lädt das Archiv, ruft eine Liste der enthaltenen Dateien ab und iteriert dann über diese Liste, um den Inhalt jeder Datei zu extrahieren und in eine strukturierte interne Tabelle zu überführen. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen und dem `VALUE` Operator für die interne Tabelle sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.
keywords: CL_ABAP_ZIP, Extraktion, ZIP-Archiv, Interne Tabelle, XSTRING

  METHOD test_add_to_zip.

  METHOD test_utc_to_local.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timefm_utc_to_local( ).

    DATA(lv_utc_tstmp) = '20251128100000'.

        act = lv_local_tstmp

        msg = 'Lokaler Zeitstempel sollte sich vom UTC-Zeitstempel unterscheiden'

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS unter Verwendung von REDUCE.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit einer Schleife über die interne Tabelle und einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Kombinieren Sie REDUCE mit einer WHERE-Bedingung und String-Templates für die Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_connid_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_connid_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_connid_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connid_list.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_connid_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier AND price > iv_min_price )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_flight>-connid
                           ELSE |{ s }, { <fs_flight>-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             max_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid IN
      NEXT
        result = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
          FOR <fs_entry> IN result
          WHERE ( carrid = lv_carrid )
          ( <fs_entry> )
          ( VALUE ty_flight_summary(
              carrid       = lv_carrid
              flight_count = <fs_entry>-flight_count + 1
              max_price    = nmax( val1 = <fs_entry>-max_price val2 = <fs_flight>-price ) ) )
          ELSE
          ( VALUE ty_flight_summary(
              carrid       = lv_carrid
              flight_count = 1
              max_price    = <fs_flight>-price ) ) ) ).

    rt_summary = lt_grouped_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_carrier_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_count_map.

CLASS zcl_reduce_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_counts = REDUCE ty_carrier_count_map(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_carrier_count_map( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT
        counts = VALUE ty_carrier_count_map(
          FOR <fs_entry> IN counts
          WHERE ( table_line = <fs_flight>-carrid )
          ( <fs_entry> )
          ( VALUE #( <fs_flight>-carrid = <fs_entry>-carrid + 1 ) )
          ELSE
          ( VALUE #( <fs_flight>-carrid = 1 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_max_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                             FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                             NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = <fs_flight>-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
