CLASS zcl_regex_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Flugnummern (z.B. 'LH 400') aus einem gegebenen Text. Eine Flugnummer besteht aus zwei Großbuchstaben, gefolgt von einer Leerstelle und drei Ziffern. Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode FIND_ALL der Klasse CL_ABAP_REGEX und verarbeiten Sie die Ergebnisse.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_flight_numbers.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex(
      pattern = '[A-Z]{2}\s\d{3}' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lt_matches) = VALUE cl_abap_regex=>match_result_tab( ).
    lo_matcher->find_all( CHANGING results = lt_matches ).

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <fs_match> IN lt_matches
      ( <fs_match>-offset_and_length[1]-submatch ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String anhand mehrerer, variabler Trennzeichen (z.B. Komma, Semikolon oder Leerzeichen). Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX, um die Trennzeichen zu finden, und dann eine Schleife, um die Substrings zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_split_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_split_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex(
      pattern = '[\s,;]+' ). " Split by one or more spaces, commas, or semicolons
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lt_matches) = VALUE cl_abap_regex=>match_result_tab( ).
    lo_matcher->find_all( CHANGING results = lt_matches ).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      DATA(lv_part) = iv_text+lv_last_offset( ls_match-offset - lv_last_offset ).
      IF lv_part IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lv_part TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = ls_match-offset + ls_match-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add the last part after the last delimiter
    DATA(lv_last_part) = iv_text+lv_last_offset.
    IF lv_last_part IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_last_part TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein String mit einer bestimmten Zeichenfolge beginnt (z.B. 'FLUG'). Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX.

CLASS zcl_regex_starts_with DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS starts_with_prefix
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_regex_starts_with IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD starts_with_prefix.

      pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Maskieren Sie alle Kreditkartennummern (angenommen: 16 Ziffern, optional durch Leerzeichen oder Bindestriche getrennt) in einem Text, indem Sie nur die letzten 4 Ziffern sichtbar lassen und den Rest durch 'X' ersetzen. Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode REPLACE_ALL mit Backreferences im Ersatzmuster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_mask_cc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS mask_credit_card_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_masked_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_mask_cc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mask_credit_card_numbers.
    " Regex for 16 digits, optionally separated by space or hyphen
    " (\d{4}[ -]?){3} matches first 12 digits with separators
    " (\d{4}) matches the last 4 digits
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex(
      pattern = '(\d{4}[ -]?){3}(\d{4})' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    " Replacement: 'XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-' + last 4 digits (\4 refers to the 4th capturing group)
    rv_masked_text = lo_matcher->replace_all( replacement = 'XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-$4' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Datumsangaben im Format 'JJJJ-MM-TT' aus einem gegebenen Text. Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Regex-Muster für das Datumsformat und nutzen Sie FIND_ALL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_dates
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dates) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_dates.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex(
      pattern = '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    DATA(lt_matches) = VALUE cl_abap_regex=>match_result_tab( ).
    lo_matcher->find_all( CHANGING results = lt_matches ).

    rt_dates = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <fs_match> IN lt_matches
      ( <fs_match>-offset_and_length[1]-submatch ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den CONNID des Fluges mit dem höchsten Preis enthält. Verwenden Sie REDUCE.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE, um eine Hash-Tabelle zu befüllen, die den CONNID und den höchsten Preis pro Fluggesellschaft speichert, und aktualisieren Sie diese bedingt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_highest_price_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           BEGIN OF ty_highest_price_connid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_highest_price_connid,
           tt_highest_price_connid TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_highest_price_connid WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_highest_price_connids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_highest_price_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_highest_price_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_price_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    rt_result = REDUCE tt_highest_price_connid(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_highest_price_connid( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid IN
      NEXT
        result = VALUE tt_highest_price_connid(
          FOR <fs_entry> IN result
          WHERE ( carrid = lv_carrid )
          ( COND ty_highest_price_connid(
              WHEN <fs_flight>-price > <fs_entry>-price THEN VALUE ty_highest_price_connid(
                carrid = lv_carrid
                connid = <fs_flight>-connid
                price  = <fs_flight>-price )
              ELSE <fs_entry> ) )
          ELSE
          ( VALUE ty_highest_price_connid(
              carrid = lv_carrid
              connid = <fs_flight>-connid
              price  = <fs_flight>-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_highest_price_connids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_highest_price_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_highest_price_connid( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_highest_price_connids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table should contain entries' act = lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_entry) = VALUE ty_highest_price_connid( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_entry WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH should be in result' act = sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH price should be > 0' act = ls_lh_entry-price > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH connid should not be initial' act = ls_lh_entry-connid IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_highest_price_connid( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_highest_price_connids( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table should be empty if no data' act = lines( lt_result ) >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel ist eine weitere fortgeschrittene Anwendung von REDUCE zur Aggregation in einer Hash-Tabelle. Für jede Fluggesellschaft wird der Flug mit dem höchsten Preis und dessen CONNID gespeichert. Die COND-Expression innerhalb der FOR-Schleife entscheidet, ob ein bestehender Eintrag aktualisiert oder ein neuer erstellt wird, basierend auf dem Vergleich der Preise. Dies ist ein sehr effizientes Muster für 'Top N per Group'-Szenarien.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Hash Table, COND, Functional Programming

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String eine gültige URL enthält. Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX.
hint: Nutzen Sie ein komplexeres Regex-Muster für URLs und die Methode MATCHES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_url_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_url_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_url.
    " Simplified URL regex for demonstration. Real-world URLs can be very complex.
    " This pattern checks for http/https, domain, and optional path/query.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex(
      pattern = '^(http|https):\/\/[a-zA-Z0-9\-\.]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,3}(\/\S*)?$' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_url ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->matches( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_urls FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_urls FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_urls.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_url_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Valid URL 1' act = lo_cut->is_valid_url( 'http://www.example.com' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Valid URL 2' act = lo_cut->is_valid_url( 'https://sub.domain.net/path/to/page?param=value' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Valid URL 3' act = lo_cut->is_valid_url( 'http://localhost:8080' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_urls.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_url_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Invalid URL 1 (no protocol)' act = lo_cut->is_valid_url( 'www.example.com' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Invalid URL 2 (malformed)' act = lo_cut->is_valid_url( 'http://.com' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Invalid URL 3 (invalid char)' act = lo_cut->is_valid_url( 'http://example.com/ invalid' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Invalid URL 4 (empty)' act = lo_cut->is_valid_url( '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Validierung von URLs ist eine häufige Aufgabe, die mit regulären Ausdrücken elegant gelöst werden kann. Dieses Beispiel verwendet ein Regex-Muster, das gängige URL-Strukturen abdeckt (Protokoll, Domain, optionaler Pfad/Query). Die Methode MATCHES prüft, ob der gesamte Eingabestring dem Muster entspricht. Für eine vollständige URL-Validierung müsste das Regex-Muster noch komplexer sein, aber dies demonstriert das Prinzip.
keywords: CL_ABAP_REGEX, Regex, URL Validation, Pattern Matching, String Validation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie, ob es in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS Flüge gibt, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um ein boolesches Ergebnis zu erhalten.
hint: Initialisieren Sie den Akkumulator mit ABAP_FALSE und setzen Sie ihn auf ABAP_TRUE, sobald eine Bedingung erfüllt ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_any_expensive_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS has_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_expensive) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_any_expensive_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_has_expensive = REDUCE abap_bool(
      INIT found = abap_false
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT
        found = COND abap_bool( WHEN <fs_flight>-price > iv_threshold THEN abap_true ELSE found ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_expensive_flights_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_any_expensive_flight( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should find expensive flights' act = lo_cut->has_expensive_flights( 100 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_any_expensive_flight( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should not find flights above very high threshold' act = lo_cut->has_expensive_flights( 999999 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_any_expensive_flight( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should be false for empty table' act = lo_cut->has_expensive_flights( 100 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie REDUCE verwendet werden kann, um eine 'any'-Prüfung durchzuführen, d.h. zu ermitteln, ob mindestens ein Element in einer Liste eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt. Der Akkumulator wird als boolescher Wert initialisiert und auf TRUE gesetzt, sobald ein Flug gefunden wird, der den Schwellenwert überschreitet. Die COND-Expression sorgt dafür, dass der Wert nicht wieder auf FALSE zurückgesetzt wird.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen, aus einem gegebenen Satz. Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_REGEX.
hint: Nutzen Sie ein Regex-Muster, das auf Großbuchstaben am Wortanfang matcht, und FIND_ALL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_capital_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_capitalized_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_capitalized_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_capitalized_words.
    " Regex: \b (word boundary), [A-Z] (capital letter), \w* (zero or more word characters)
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex(
      pattern = '\b[A-Z]\w*' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_sentence ).

    DATA(lt_matches) = VALUE cl_abap_regex=>match_result_tab( ).
    lo_matcher->find_all( CHANGING results = lt_matches ).

    rt_words = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <fs_match> IN lt_matches
      ( <fs_match>-offset_and_length[1]-submatch ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'SAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'Modern' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[4] exp = 'Effizient' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_case.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_capital_words( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_capitalized_words( 'Ein Wort mit Kleinbuchstaben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_capitalized_words( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Hallo' ).

'[A-Z]\w*' matcht einen Großbuchstaben, gefolgt von null oder mehr Wortzeichen. FIND_ALL extrahiert alle diese Wörter, was nützlich ist für die Analyse von Texten oder die Extraktion von Eigennamen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft eine Liste der Flugverbindungs-IDs (CONNID) enthält, die einen Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert haben. Verwenden Sie REDUCE.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE, um eine Hash-Tabelle zu befüllen, deren Werte interne Tabellen von CONNIDs sind.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_grouped_connids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_connid_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_grouped_connids TYPE HASHED TABLE OF tt_connid_list WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_grouped_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_connids) TYPE tt_grouped_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_grouped_connids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 200 ROWS.

    rt_grouped_connids = REDUCE tt_grouped_connids(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_grouped_connids( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( <fs_flight>-price > iv_threshold )
      LET lv_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid IN
      NEXT
        result = VALUE tt_grouped_connids(
          FOR <fs_entry> IN result
          WHERE ( table_line = lv_carrid )
          ( VALUE tt_connid_list( BASE <fs_entry> ( <fs_flight>-connid ) ) )
          ELSE
          ( VALUE tt_connid_list( ( <fs_flight>-connid ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_connids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_grouped_connids( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_connids( 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table should contain entries' act = lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).

    DATA(lt_lh_connids) = VALUE tt_connid_list( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO lt_lh_connids WITH KEY table_line = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH should be in result' act = sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH connid list should not be empty' act = lines( lt_lh_connids ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_grouped_connids( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_connids( 999999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should be empty for very high threshold' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_grouped_connids( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_connids( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table should be empty if no data' act = lines( lt_result ) >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine komplexe Gruppierung mit REDUCE, bei der der Akkumulator eine Hash-Tabelle ist, deren Werte wiederum interne Tabellen sind. Für jede Fluggesellschaft wird eine Liste von CONNIDs gesammelt, die eine bestimmte Preisbedingung erfüllen. Die COND-Expression fügt den CONNID entweder zu einer bestehenden Liste hinzu (BASE <fs_entry>) oder erstellt eine neue Liste, wenn die Fluggesellschaft zum ersten Mal auftaucht. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für die Transformation von Datenstrukturen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Grouping, Nested Tables, Hash Table, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtere Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflight` basierend auf einem vordefinierten Bereich für die Fluggesellschaft. Simuliere die Verwendung von Konstanten aus `if_fsbp_const_range` zur Definition des Bereichs. Nutze den `FILTER`-Operator für die interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwende `FILTER` mit einer Range-Tabelle und inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES ty_range_carrid_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_low  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_carrid_high TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_bt TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_sflights_tab(
      FOR sflight_wa IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( sflight_wa )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ty_range_carrid_tab( ).
    IF iv_carrid_high IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_bt low = iv_carrid_low high = iv_carrid_high ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ELSE.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = iv_carrid_low ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ENDIF.

    " Use FILTER expression with the range table
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_single_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_range_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_single_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid_low = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_range_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid_low = 'AA' iv_carrid_high = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrid should be within range AA-LH' act = ( ls_flight-carrid GE 'AA' AND ls_flight-carrid LE 'LH' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und prägnante Filterung interner Tabellen. In Kombination mit inline-Deklarationen und Range-Tabellen (deren Konstanten hier `if_fsbp_const_range` simulieren) wird der Code sehr lesbar und effizient.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Ranges, if_fsbp_const_range, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften unter Verwendung von Konstanten, die `if_fsbp_const_range` simulieren, und verwende diese in einer Open SQL `WHERE IN` Klausel, um Daten aus `sflight` zu selektieren.
hint: Nutze inline-Deklaration für die Range-Tabelle und `WHERE carrid IN @<range_table>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES ty_sflight_key_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_list TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_key_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrid_range.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    " Dynamically build range table
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE sflight_carrid_t(
      FOR carrid_val IN iv_carrid_list
      ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = carrid_val )
    ).

    " Use Open SQL with WHERE IN @<range_table>
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid IN @lt_carrid_range
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_with_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_empty_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_with_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sql_range( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrid_range( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrid should be LH or AA' act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_empty_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sql_range( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrid_range( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for empty range' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von Range-Tabellen mit `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und deren direkte Verwendung in Open SQL `WHERE IN @<range_table>` ist ein modernes und sehr effizientes Muster. Es vermeidet explizite `APPEND`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: Open SQL, Ranges, VALUE, FOR, if_fsbp_const_range, Dynamic

Instructions: Simuliere eine Prüfung des Enterprise Search (ESH) Caches mit einer Mock-Klasse für `cl_esh_ca_check`. Basierend auf dem simulierten Ergebnis soll ein Status-String mit dem `COND`-Operator zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutze den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mock_esh_cache_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_cache_active RETURNING VALUE(rv_active) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_esh_cache_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_cache_active.
    " Simulate cache status (e.g., 50% chance of being active)
    DATA(lv_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 1 max = 100 )->get_next( ).
    IF lv_random > 50.
      rv_active = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_active = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_cache_status_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cache_status_message.
    DATA(lo_esh_checker) = NEW zcl_mock_esh_cache_check( ).
    DATA(lv_is_active) = lo_esh_checker->is_cache_active( ).

    " Use COND operator for conditional assignment
    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN lv_is_active = abap_true THEN 'ESH Cache ist aktiv und bereit.'
      WHEN lv_is_active = abap_false THEN 'ESH Cache ist inaktiv oder benötigt Aktualisierung.'
      ELSE 'Unbekannter ESH Cache Status.' " Should not happen with abap_bool
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cache_status_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cache_status_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_cache_status_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Message should not be initial' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Message should indicate active or inactive status' act = ( lv_message = 'ESH Cache ist aktiv und bereit.' OR lv_message = 'ESH Cache ist inaktiv oder benötigt Aktualisierung.' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten, ähnlich einem Ternary-Operator in anderen Sprachen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von `IF`-Blöcken für einfache Zuweisungen und macht den Code funktionaler.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, cl_esh_ca_check, Mocking

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für Flüge, die in einem bestimmten Bereich von Fluggesellschaften liegen (simuliert durch `if_fsbp_const_range`), unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Kombiniere `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine funktionale Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES ty_range_carrid_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_low  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_carrid_high TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_bt TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_sflights_tab(
      FOR sflight_wa IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( sflight_wa )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ty_range_carrid_tab( ).
    IF iv_carrid_high IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_bt low = iv_carrid_low high = iv_carrid_high ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ELSE.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = iv_carrid_low ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ENDIF.

    " Filter flights by range
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).

    " Use REDUCE to sum up occupied seats
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_single_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_range_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_single_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid_low = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total seats for LH should be greater than 0' act = ( lv_total > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_range_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid_low = 'AA' iv_carrid_high = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total seats for range AA-UA should be greater than 0' act = ( lv_total > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid_low = 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrid
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats for non-existent carrid should be 0' act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine funktionale und deklarative Weise. In Kombination mit `FILTER` können komplexe Aggregationen sehr kompakt ausgedrückt werden, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: REDUCE, FILTER, Internal Tables, if_fsbp_const_range, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und Fluggesellschaften enthält, deren Fluggesellschaften in einem bestimmten Bereich liegen (simuliert durch `if_fsbp_const_range`). Nutze `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwende `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_value_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES ty_sflight_key_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES ty_sflight_full_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES ty_range_carrid_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_keys
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_low  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_carrid_high TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE ty_sflight_key_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_value_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_keys.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_bt TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_sflight_full_tab(
      FOR sflight_wa IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( sflight_wa )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ty_range_carrid_tab( ).
    IF iv_carrid_high IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_bt low = iv_carrid_low high = iv_carrid_high ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ELSE.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = iv_carrid_low ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ENDIF.

    " Use VALUE with FOR and WHERE to filter and transform
    rt_flight_keys = VALUE ty_sflight_key_tab(
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid IN lt_carrid_range )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse, die eine simulierte `cl_esh_ca_check`-Funktionalität kapselt und eine Methode `check_cache_status` bereitstellt. Diese Methode soll mögliche Fehler der ESH-Prüfung mit `TRY...CATCH` abfangen und eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zurückgeben.
hint: Verwende `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung und eine Mock-Klasse für die ESH-Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mock_esh_cache_check_err DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_cache_active RETURNING VALUE(rv_active) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS trigger_error RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_esh_cache_check_err IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_cache_active.
    rv_active = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trigger_error.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>cx_static_check.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_wrapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_cache_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_cache_status.
    DATA(lo_esh_mock) = NEW zcl_mock_esh_cache_check_err( ).

    TRY.
        IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
          lo_esh_mock->trigger_error( ).
        ENDIF.
        IF lo_esh_mock->is_cache_active( ) = abap_true.
          rv_status_message = 'ESH Cache ist aktiv und funktioniert einwandfrei.'.
        ELSE.
          rv_status_message = 'ESH Cache ist inaktiv.'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_status_message = |Fehler bei der ESH Cache Prüfung: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|. 
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flugdaten aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechne die durchschnittliche Auslastung, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die in einem bestimmten Bereich liegen (simuliert durch `if_fsbp_const_range`). Nutze `GROUP BY` in Open SQL.
hint: Verwende `SELECT ... GROUP BY ... HAVING ...` mit einer Range-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_group_by_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_occupancy,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_avg_occupancy.
    TYPES ty_avg_occupancy_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES ty_range_carrid_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_low  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_carrid_high TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_occupancy) TYPE ty_avg_occupancy_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_group_by_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_by_carrid.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_bt TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ty_range_carrid_tab( ).
    IF iv_carrid_high IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_bt low = iv_carrid_low high = iv_carrid_high ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ELSE.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = iv_carrid_low ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ENDIF.

    " Use Open SQL with GROUP BY and WHERE IN @<range_table>
    SELECT carrid, AVG( seatsocc / seatsmax ) AS avg_occupancy
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid IN @lt_carrid_range
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_occupancy.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_esh_cache_check_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_id TYPE string
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_mock_esh_cache_check_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_cache_active_for_id.
    " Simulate cache status based on ID (e.g., even IDs are active)
    DATA(lv_num) = 0.

        lv_num = iv_id.

      rv_active = abap_false.

CLASS zcl_conditional_status_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_item,
             id     TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_status_item.

      IMPORTING
        it_ids TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_table) TYPE ty_status_tab.

CLASS zcl_conditional_status_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_status_table.
    DATA(lo_esh_mock) = NEW zcl_mock_esh_cache_check_cond( ).

    " Use VALUE, FOR, and COND to generate the status table
    rt_status_table = VALUE ty_status_tab(
      FOR id_val IN it_ids
      ( id = id_val,
        status = COND string(
          WHEN lo_esh_mock->is_cache_active_for_id( id_val ) = abap_true THEN 'ACTIVE'
          ELSE 'INACTIVE'
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse, die eine Methode zur Validierung von Fluggesellschafts-IDs bereitstellt. Die Methode soll eine Liste von IDs entgegennehmen und mit `if_fsbp_const_range` (simuliert) prüfen, ob diese in einem vordefinierten Satz gültiger IDs enthalten sind. Nutze funktionale Methodenaufrufe.
hint: Verwende eine Range-Tabelle und `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` oder `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_carrid_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES ty_range_carrid_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS is_carrid_valid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_invalid_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE sflight_carrid_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_invalid_carrids) TYPE sflight_carrid_tt.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_valid_carrid_range TYPE ty_range_carrid_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrid_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    " Populate valid carrier range (e.g., LH, AA, UA)
    mt_valid_carrid_range = VALUE ty_range_carrid_tab(
      ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = 'UA' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_carrid_valid.
    " Check if carrid exists in the valid range
    IF line_exists( mt_valid_carrid_range[ sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = iv_carrid ] ).
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_invalid_carrids.
    " Use FOR and COND to filter invalid carrids
    rt_invalid_carrids = VALUE sflight_carrid_tt(
      FOR carrid_val IN it_carrids
      WHERE ( NOT me->is_carrid_valid( carrid_val ) )
      ( carrid_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert filtert. Die Filterkriterien sollen eine Range-Tabelle simulieren, die durch `if_fsbp_const_range` Konstanten definiert wird. Nutze dynamische Token-Erzeugung für den `WHERE`-Zusatz.
hint: Verwende `SELECT ... WHERE (dynamic_condition) ...` und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_whitelist_for_sql`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_all,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_all.
    TYPES ty_sflight_all_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_all WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES ty_range_carrid_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name  TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_all_tab
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_programming.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic_filter.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ty_range_carrid_tab(
      ( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = iv_filter_value )
    ).

    DATA(lv_where_clause) = |{ iv_field_name } IN @lt_carrid_range|.

    " Security check: Whitelist the field name to prevent SQL injection
    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_whitelist_for_sql(
      i_field_name = iv_field_name
      i_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'
    ).

    " Dynamic Open SQL query
    SELECT * FROM sflight
      WHERE (lv_where_clause)
      INTO TABLE @rt_filtered_flights.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (z.B. 'ESH' oder 'BP') unterschiedliche Implementierungen einer Schnittstelle zurückgibt. Eine Implementierung soll eine simulierte `cl_esh_ca_check` verwenden, die andere eine simulierte `if_fsbp_const_range`.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_checker PUBLIC.
  METHODS check_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_esh_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  INTERFACE zif_data_checker ~ check_data.
    METHOD zif_data_checker~check_data.
      " Simulate cl_esh_ca_check
      DATA(lo_esh_mock) = NEW zcl_mock_esh_cache_check( ).
      IF lo_esh_mock->is_cache_active( ) = abap_true.
        rv_result = |ESH: Cache für '{ iv_input }' ist aktiv.|.
      ELSE.
        rv_result = |ESH: Cache für '{ iv_input }' ist inaktiv.|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bp_range_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  INTERFACE zif_data_checker ~ check_data.
    METHOD zif_data_checker~check_data.
      " Simulate if_fsbp_const_range usage
      DATA(lt_valid_ranges) = VALUE sflight_carrid_t(
        ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'A' )
        ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'B' )
        ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'C' )
      ).
      IF line_exists( lt_valid_ranges[ low = iv_input ] ).
        rv_result = |BP: '{ iv_input }' ist in gültigem Bereich.|.
      ELSE.
        rv_result = |BP: '{ iv_input }' ist NICHT in gültigem Bereich.|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_checker_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_checker
      IMPORTING
        iv_checker_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_checker) TYPE REF TO zif_data_checker
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_checker_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_checker.
    ro_checker = SWITCH #( iv_checker_type
      WHEN 'ESH' THEN NEW zcl_esh_checker( )
      WHEN 'BP'  THEN NEW zcl_bp_range_checker( )
      ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_create_object_error=>cx_sy_create_object_error
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den ersten Flug in `sflight`, dessen Fluggesellschaft in einem bestimmten Bereich liegt (simuliert durch `if_fsbp_const_range`), und dessen maximale Sitzplatzkapazität einen Schwellenwert überschreitet. Nutze `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `FIRST`.
hint: Verwende `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( FIRST )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_first_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflights_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid.
    TYPES ty_range_carrid_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_first_matching_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_low  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_carrid_high TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_min_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_first_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_first_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_matching_flight.
    " Simulate constants from if_fsbp_const_range for range definition
    CONSTANTS: lc_sign_i TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
               lc_option_bt TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'BT',
               lc_option_eq TYPE c LENGTH 2 VALUE 'EQ'.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE ty_sflights_tab(
      FOR sflight_wa IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( sflight_wa )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE ty_range_carrid_tab( ).
    IF iv_carrid_high IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_bt low = iv_carrid_low high = iv_carrid_high ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ELSE.
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_carrid( sign = lc_sign_i option = lc_option_eq low = iv_carrid_low ) TO lt_carrid_range.
    ENDIF.

    " Use FOR with WHERE and FIRST to find the first matching flight
    TRY.
        rs_first_flight = VALUE #( 
          FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid IN lt_carrid_range AND seatsmax > iv_min_seatsmax ) ( FIRST )
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        CLEAR rs_first_flight. " No matching flight found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_find_first_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->find_first_matching_flight( iv_carrid_low = 'LH' iv_min_seatsmax = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax > 100 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_non_existing_flight.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

( FIRST )` ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um den ersten Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle zu finden, der bestimmte Kriterien erfüllt. Dies ersetzt ältere `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... EXIT`-Konstrukte und ist besonders nützlich, wenn nur ein einzelnes Ergebnis benötigt wird.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Liste von ESH-Cache-IDs entgegennimmt. Für jede ID soll eine simulierte `cl_esh_ca_check` Prüfung durchgeführt werden. Die Methode soll eine interne Tabelle von Objekten zurückgeben, die den Status jeder ID repräsentieren. Nutze `FOR` und `NEW` für die Objekterstellung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_mock_esh_cache_check_obj DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_cache_active_for_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_active) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_esh_cache_check_obj IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_cache_active_for_id.
    " Simulate cache status based on ID (e.g., IDs ending with '0' are active)
    IF iv_id NS '*0'.
      rv_active = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_active = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_cache_status_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_id TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_id     TYPE string
        iv_status TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cache_status_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_id = iv_id.
    mv_status = iv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_object_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_status_object_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_cache_status_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_status_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_cache_ids TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_objects) TYPE ty_status_object_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_object_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_status_objects.
    DATA(lo_esh_mock) = NEW zcl_mock_esh_cache_check_obj( ).

    " Use FOR and NEW to create a table of status objects
    rt_status_objects = VALUE ty_status_object_tab(
      FOR id_val IN it_cache_ids
      ( NEW zcl_cache_status_object(
          iv_id = id_val,
          iv_status = COND string(
            WHEN lo_esh_mock->is_cache_active_for_id( id_val ) = abap_true THEN 'ACTIVE'
            ELSE 'INACTIVE'
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle, die Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge (Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Initialisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um die äußere Tabelle zu füllen, und einen weiteren `FOR` Ausdruck für die innere Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
        cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
        carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
      END OF ty_carrier_flights,
      tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_carrier_flights = VALUE #( " Outer VALUE for tt_carrier_flights
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
      ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid
        flights = VALUE #( " Inner VALUE for tt_flight_data
          FOR ls_flight_in_group IN carrier_group
          ( carrid   = ls_flight_in_group-carrid
            connid   = ls_flight_in_group-connid
            fldate   = ls_flight_in_group-fldate
            cityfrom = ls_flight_in_group-cityfrom
            cityto   = ls_flight_in_group-cityto ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_flights) = lo_cut->get_carrier_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'sflight table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_carrier_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).

    LOOP AT lt_carrier_flights INTO DATA(ls_carrier_flights).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flights for carrier should not be empty' act = lines( ls_carrier_flights-flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
      LOOP AT ls_carrier_flights-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = ls_carrier_flights-carrid ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt geschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um eine geschachtelte interne Tabelle zu füllen. Der äußere `FOR`-Ausdruck gruppiert die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (`GROUP BY`), während der innere `FOR`-Ausdruck die einzelnen Flüge für jede Gruppe sammelt. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, komplexe Datenstrukturen zu transformieren und zu initialisieren.
keywords: NESTING, INTERNAL TABLES, FOR, VALUE, GROUP BY, SFlight

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template-Method-Pattern für die Generierung von Berichten. Eine abstrakte Basisklasse soll den allgemeinen Ablauf definieren, während konkrete Unterklassen spezifische Schritte (z.B. Datenbeschaffung, Formatierung) implementieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Methode für die Datenbeschaffung und eine weitere für die Formatierung. Die Template-Methode ruft diese in einer festen Reihenfolge auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_report DEFINITION ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report RETURNING VALUE(rv_report_output) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    METHODS format_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_data) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = get_data( ).
    rv_report_output = format_data( lt_raw_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_report DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_report FINAL.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).
    rt_data = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    rv_formatted_data = 'Flight Report:' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      rv_formatted_data = rv_formatted_data && |  Carrier: { <fs_sflight>-carrid }, Flight: { <fs_sflight>-connid }, From: { <fs_sflight>-cityfrom }, To: { <fs_sflight>-cityto }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_report RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_report.
    DATA(lo_report) = NEW zcl_flight_report( ).
    rv_output = lo_report->generate_report( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_report_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_report_generation.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_report_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_report) = lo_generator->create_flight_report( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_report msg = 'Report output should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_report exp = 'Flight Report:' msg = 'Report should contain header' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_report exp = 'Carrier:' msg = 'Report should contain flight data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template-Method-Pattern wird hier durch die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_abstract_report` implementiert. Die Methode `generate_report` definiert den festen Ablauf, während `get_data` und `format_data` als abstrakte Methoden in den konkreten Unterklassen (hier `zcl_flight_report`) implementiert werden müssen. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendung der Berichtslogik und die einfache Erweiterung um neue Berichtstypen. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die moderne Formatierung verwendet.
keywords: ABSTRACT, TEMPLATE METHOD PATTERN, INHERITANCE, REDEFINITION, STRING TEMPLATES

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung geschachtelter `REDUCE`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie den äußeren `REDUCE` für die Fluggesellschaften und den inneren `REDUCE` für die Flüge innerhalb jeder Fluggesellschaft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        total_passengers TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        total_passengers_carrier TYPE i,
        flight_summaries TYPE tt_flight_summary,
      END OF ty_carrier_total,
      tt_carrier_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passenger_totals RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_totals.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_carrier_totals = REDUCE tt_carrier_total(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_total( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
      LET l_flight_summaries = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
                                     INIT flight_res = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
                                     FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight_conn IN carrier_group GROUP BY ls_flight_conn-connid INTO DATA(conn_group)
                                     ( flight_res = VALUE #( flight_res ( carrid = conn_group-carrid
                                                                         connid = conn_group-connid
                                                                         total_passengers = SUM( conn_group-seatsocc ) ) ) ) )
          l_total_passengers_carrier = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_summary IN l_flight_summaries ( sum = sum + ls_summary-total_passengers ) )
      IN
      ( result = VALUE #( result ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid
                                  total_passengers_carrier = l_total_passengers_carrier
                                  flight_summaries = l_flight_summaries ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_passenger_totals FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_passenger_totals.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_totals) = lo_cut->get_passenger_totals( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Carrier totals should not be empty' act = lines( lt_carrier_totals ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).

    LOOP AT lt_carrier_totals INTO DATA(ls_carrier_total).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flight summaries should not be empty' act = lines( ls_carrier_total-flight_summaries ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
      DATA(lv_sum_check) = 0.
      LOOP AT ls_carrier_total-flight_summaries INTO DATA(ls_flight_summary).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_summary-carrid exp = ls_carrier_total-carrid ).
        lv_sum_check = lv_sum_check + ls_flight_summary-total_passengers.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_check exp = ls_carrier_total-total_passengers_carrier ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Verwendung geschachtelter `REDUCE`-Ausdrücke zur Aggregation von Daten. Der äußere `REDUCE` gruppiert Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft, während der innere `REDUCE` die Passagierzahlen pro Flugverbindung innerhalb jeder Fluggesellschaft summiert. Die `LET`-Expression wird verwendet, um Zwischenergebnisse zu speichern und die Lesbarkeit zu verbessern. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und kompakte Art, komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: NESTING, REDUCE, AGGREGATION, GROUP BY, LET, SFlight

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Observer-Pattern für ein einfaches Event-System. Eine abstrakte Klasse soll die Basis für Observer bilden, die auf ein Event reagieren.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für den Subject und eine abstrakte Klasse für den Observer. Nutzen Sie `REF TO` für die Observer-Liste.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_subject.
  METHODS attach_observer IMPORTING io_observer TYPE REF TO zif_observer.
  METHODS detach_observer IMPORTING io_observer TYPE REF TO zif_observer.
  METHODS notify_observers.
ENDINTERFACE.

INTERFACE zif_observer.
  METHODS update IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_abstract_observer DEFINITION ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_observer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_observer IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_observer1 DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_observer FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_observer~update.
    DATA mv_last_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_observer1 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_observer~update.
    mv_last_message = iv_message.
    " Simulate logging or further processing
    " cl_demo_output=>display( |Observer 1 received: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_observer2 DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_observer FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_observer~update.
    DATA mv_last_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_observer2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_observer~update.
    mv_last_message = iv_message.
    " Simulate logging or further processing
    " cl_demo_output=>display( |Observer 2 received: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subject DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_subject.
    METHODS trigger_event IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES tt_observers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_observer WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    DATA mt_observers TYPE tt_observers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subject IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_subject~attach_observer.
    INSERT io_observer INTO TABLE mt_observers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_subject~detach_observer.
    DELETE mt_observers WHERE table_line = io_observer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_subject~notify_observers.
    LOOP AT mt_observers INTO DATA(lo_observer).
      lo_observer->update( iv_message = iv_message ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trigger_event.
    zif_subject~notify_observers( iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_observer_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_demo.
    DATA mo_observer1 TYPE REF TO zcl_concrete_observer1.
    DATA mo_observer2 TYPE REF TO zcl_concrete_observer2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_observer_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_demo.
    DATA(lo_subject) = NEW zcl_event_subject( ).
    mo_observer1 = NEW zcl_concrete_observer1( ).
    mo_observer2 = NEW zcl_concrete_observer2( ).

    lo_subject->attach_observer( mo_observer1 ).
    lo_subject->attach_observer( mo_observer2 ).

    lo_subject->trigger_event( 'First event message' ).
    lo_subject->detach_observer( mo_observer1 ).
    lo_subject->trigger_event( 'Second event message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_observer_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_observer_pattern.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_observer_demo( ).
    lo_demo->run_demo( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_demo->mo_observer1->mv_last_message exp = 'First event message' msg = 'Observer 1 should receive first message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_demo->mo_observer2->mv_last_message exp = 'Second event message' msg = 'Observer 2 should receive second message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert das Observer-Pattern, bei dem ein `Subject` (hier `zcl_event_subject`) Änderungen an seine registrierten `Observer` (abgeleitet von `zcl_abstract_observer`) meldet. Die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_abstract_observer` stellt eine gemeinsame Basis für alle Observer dar und erzwingt die Implementierung der `update`-Methode. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und ermöglicht es, die Anzahl und Art der Observer dynamisch zur Laufzeit zu ändern.
keywords: ABSTRACT, OBSERVER PATTERN, EVENT HANDLING, INTERFACE, POLYMORPHISM

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf dem Datum und der Anzahl der belegten Sitze. Nutzen Sie geschachtelte `COND`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen äußeren `COND` für das Datum und einen inneren `COND` für die Sitze.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status IMPORTING iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc iv_maxseats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_fldate < lv_today THEN 'Past Flight'
      WHEN iv_fldate = lv_today THEN COND string(
        WHEN iv_seatsocc = iv_maxseats THEN 'Fully Booked Today'
        WHEN iv_seatsocc > iv_maxseats / 2 THEN 'Partially Booked Today'
        ELSE 'Few Bookings Today' )
      WHEN iv_fldate > lv_today THEN COND string(
        WHEN iv_seatsocc = iv_maxseats THEN 'Fully Booked Future'
        WHEN iv_seatsocc > iv_maxseats / 2 THEN 'Partially Booked Future'
        ELSE 'Few Bookings Future' )
      ELSE 'Unknown Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_past_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_today_fully_booked FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_future_few_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_past_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum - 1 iv_seatsocc = 10 iv_maxseats = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Past Flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_today_fully_booked.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum iv_seatsocc = 100 iv_maxseats = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Fully Booked Today' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_future_few_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum + 1 iv_seatsocc = 10 iv_maxseats = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Few Bookings Future' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Geschachtelte `COND`-Ausdrücke ermöglichen die kompakte und lesbare Darstellung komplexer bedingter Logik. Anstatt mehrerer `IF-ELSEIF-ENDIF`-Blöcke kann der Status in einer einzigen Anweisung ermittelt werden. Dies verbessert die Wartbarkeit und reduziert die Codezeilen.
keywords: NESTING, COND, CONDITIONAL LOGIC, EXPRESSIONS

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Klasse für die Datenverarbeitung, die eine Methode zum Filtern von Daten und eine abstrakte Methode zur Transformation von Daten bereitstellt. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Klasse, die Flugdaten transformiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die Datenfilterung und eine abstrakte Methode für die spezifische Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_data_processor DEFINITION ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING it_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
                         RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS filter_data IMPORTING it_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE
                        RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    METHODS transform_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_filtered_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lt_filtered) = filter_data( it_raw_data ).
    rt_processed_data = transform_data( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_data.
    " Default implementation: no filtering
    rt_filtered = it_input.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_data_processor FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_data REDEFINITION.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS transform_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    rt_filtered = FILTER #( it_input USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrier_flight TYPE string,
             departure_arrival TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight,
           tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    rt_transformed = VALUE tt_transformed_flight(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_filtered_data
      ( carrier_flight = |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid } { <fs_sflight>-connid }|
        departure_arrival = |{ <fs_sflight>-cityfrom } -> { <fs_sflight>-cityto }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_demo RETURNING VALUE(rt_output) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_demo.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_data_processor( ).
    rt_output = lo_processor->process_data( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_data_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_data_processing.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_data_processor_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_processed_data) = lo_demo->run_demo( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Processed data should not be empty' act = lines( lt_processed_data ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrier_flight TYPE string,
             departure_arrival TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_transformed> TYPE ty_transformed_flight.

    LOOP AT lt_processed_data ASSIGNING <fs_transformed>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = <fs_transformed>-carrier_flight exp = 'LH' msg = 'Only LH flights should be processed' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_transformed>-departure_arrival ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_abstract_data_processor` definiert einen allgemeinen Datenverarbeitungsablauf mit einer konkreten `process_data`-Methode und abstrakten `transform_data`-Methoden. Die `filter_data`-Methode wird hier in der konkreten Klasse `zcl_flight_data_processor` redefiniert, um spezifisches Filtern (hier nach Fluggesellschaft 'LH' mittels `FILTER`-Ausdruck) zu ermöglichen. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Modularität. `VALUE`-Ausdrücke und String-Templates werden für die kompakte Transformation verwendet.
keywords: ABSTRACT, DATA PROCESSING, FILTER, REDEFINITION, INHERITANCE, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine geschachtelte Datenstruktur (Map von String zu Map von String zu Integer), die die Anzahl der Flüge pro Abflug- und Zielort aus `sflights` speichert. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `HASHED TABLE` für die Maps und geschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_map_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_city_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    TYPES: ty_destination_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_city_count_map WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    TYPES: ty_origin_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_destination_map WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_cities RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight_counts) TYPE ty_origin_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_map_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_cities.
    SELECT cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rs_flight_counts = VALUE ty_origin_map(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight_from IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight_from-cityfrom INTO DATA(origin_group)
      ( KEY cityfrom = origin_group-cityfrom
        VALUE = VALUE ty_destination_map(
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight_to IN origin_group GROUP BY ls_flight_to-cityto INTO DATA(destination_group)
          ( KEY cityto = destination_group-cityto
            VALUE = lines( destination_group ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
