Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter aus einem Text, die mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnen, und speichern Sie diese in einer geschachtelten Struktur, gruppiert nach der Länge des extrahierten Wortes.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und anschließend geschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_string_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_word_entry,
             word TYPE string,
           END OF ty_word_entry,
           tt_word_entry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_word_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_word_group,
             length TYPE i,
             words TYPE tt_word_entry,
           END OF ty_word_group,
           tt_word_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_word_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_words_by_length IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string iv_prefix TYPE string
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_word_groups) TYPE tt_word_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_string_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_words_by_length.
    DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.
    DATA(lv_regex) = |\b{ iv_prefix }\w*\b|.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_text RESULTS lt_matches.

    rt_word_groups = VALUE #( " Outer VALUE for tt_word_group
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_match IN lt_matches GROUP BY ls_match-length INTO DATA(length_group)
      ( length = length_group-length
        words = VALUE #( " Inner VALUE for tt_word_entry
          FOR ls_match_in_group IN length_group
          ( word = substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match_in_group-offset len = ls_match_in_group-length ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_words FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matches FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_string_group( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'ABAP ist eine Programmiersprache für SAP-Anwendungen. ABAP ist sehr mächtig.'.
    DATA(lv_prefix) = 'ABAP'.
    DATA(lt_word_groups) = lo_cut->group_words_by_length( iv_text = lv_text iv_prefix = lv_prefix ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_word_groups ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should have one group for length 4' ).
    READ TABLE lt_word_groups INTO DATA(ls_group) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group-length exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_group-words ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group-words[ 1 ]-word exp = 'ABAP' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matches.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_string_group( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_prefix) = 'XYZ'.
    DATA(lt_word_groups) = lo_cut->group_words_by_length( iv_text = lv_text iv_prefix = lv_prefix ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_word_groups msg = 'Should be empty if no matches' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von regulären Ausdrücken für die Mustersuche und die funktionalen Ausdrücke für die Transformation und Gruppierung ist ein sehr moderner und effizienter Ansatz in ABAP.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Abflugort und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse dann nach Zielort. Nutzen Sie geschachtelte `FILTER`- und `FOR`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen äußeren `FILTER` und einen inneren `FOR` mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight,
           tt_filtered_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_destination_flights,
             cityto TYPE sflight-cityto,
             flights TYPE tt_filtered_flight,
           END OF ty_destination_flights,
           tt_destination_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_destination_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_destination_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    DATA(lt_filtered_by_origin) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND cityfrom = iv_cityfrom ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( " Outer VALUE for tt_destination_flights
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_filtered_by_origin GROUP BY ls_flight-cityto INTO DATA(destination_group)
      ( cityto = destination_group-cityto
        flights = VALUE #( " Inner VALUE for tt_filtered_flight
          FOR ls_flight_in_group IN destination_group
          ( carrid   = ls_flight_in_group-carrid
            connid   = ls_flight_in_group-connid
            cityfrom = ls_flight_in_group-cityfrom
            cityto   = ls_flight_in_group-cityto ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_no_results FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_group.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_filter_group( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Grouped flights should not be empty' act = lines( lt_grouped_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_destination_flights).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flights for destination should not be empty' act = lines( ls_destination_flights-flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
      LOOP AT ls_destination_flights-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = ls_destination_flights-cityto ).

  METHOD test_no_results.

    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_cityfrom = 'NOWHERE' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten aus `sflights` in eine geschachtelte JSON-Struktur, die nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Abflugort gruppiert ist. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke mit `GROUP BY` und `cl_abap_conv_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_json_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityto TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_detail,
           tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_city_flights,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_detail,
           END OF ty_city_flights,
           tt_city_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_city_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             origins TYPE tt_city_flights,
           END OF ty_carrier_data,
           tt_carrier_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_as_json RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_json_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_as_json.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    DATA(lt_nested_data) = VALUE tt_carrier_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight_carr IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight_carr-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
      ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid
        origins = VALUE tt_city_flights(
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight_city IN carrier_group GROUP BY ls_flight_city-cityfrom INTO DATA(city_group)
          ( cityfrom = city_group-cityfrom
            flights = VALUE tt_flight_detail(
              FOR ls_flight_detail IN city_group
              ( connid = ls_flight_detail-connid
                fldate = ls_flight_detail-fldate
                cityto = ls_flight_detail-cityto
                seatsocc = ls_flight_detail-seatsocc ) ) ) ) ) ).

    cl_abap_conv_json=>serialize( EXPORTING data = lt_nested_data PRETTY_PRINT = abap_true IMPORTING json = rv_json_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json_string exp = 'cityfrom' ).

    " Optional: Deserialize and check structure
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail_check,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityto TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,

    DATA lt_deserialized TYPE tt_carrier_data_check.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_deserialized[ 1 ]-origins ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Utility-Klasse `zcl_abstract_string_utils` mit einer abstrakten Methode `to_upper` und einer konkreten Methode `reverse_string`. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Utility-Klasse, die `to_upper` bereitstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS ... ABSTRACT` und `METHODS ... ABSTRACT` für die abstrakte Klasse und `REDEFINITION` für die konkrete Implementierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_string_utils DEFINITION ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS reverse_string IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_reversed) TYPE string.
    CLASS-METHODS to_upper ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_upper) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_string_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD reverse_string.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      rv_reversed = rv_reversed && iv_input+((lv_length - sy-index)*1)(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_string_utils DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_string_utils FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS to_upper REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_string_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_upper.
    rv_upper = to_upper( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_utils_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_demo.
    DATA mv_reversed TYPE string.
    DATA mv_upper TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_utils_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_demo.
    mv_reversed = zcl_concrete_string_utils=>reverse_string( 'Hello' ).
    mv_upper = zcl_concrete_string_utils=>to_upper( 'Hello' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_utilities FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_utilities.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_string_utils_demo( ).
    lo_demo->run_demo( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_demo->mv_reversed exp = 'olleH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_demo->mv_upper exp = 'HELLO' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die abstrakte Utility-Klasse `zcl_abstract_string_utils` bietet eine konkrete Methode `reverse_string` und eine abstrakte Methode `to_upper`. Die konkrete Klasse `zcl_concrete_string_utils` implementiert `to_upper` unter Verwendung der eingebauten `to_upper`-Funktion. Dies zeigt, wie abstrakte Klassen für Utility-Funktionen verwendet werden können, um eine gemeinsame Struktur zu erzwingen, während spezifische Implementierungen in Unterklassen erfolgen. `CLASS-METHODS` werden für statische Utility-Funktionen verwendet.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben, und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer Bedingung für freie Sitze und anschließend `FOR` mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             freeslots TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_info,
           tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_info,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights,
           tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats IMPORTING iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).

    rt_carrier_flights = VALUE #( " Outer VALUE for tt_carrier_flights
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
      ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid
        flights = VALUE #( " Inner VALUE for tt_flight_info
          FOR ls_flight_in_group IN carrier_group
          ( carrid = ls_flight_in_group-carrid
            connid = ls_flight_in_group-connid
            fldate = ls_flight_in_group-fldate
            freeslots = ls_flight_in_group-seatsmax - ls_flight_in_group-seatsocc ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_free_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_filter_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Carrier flights should not be empty' act = lines( lt_carrier_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).

    LOOP AT lt_carrier_flights INTO DATA(ls_carrier_flights).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flights for carrier should not be empty' act = lines( ls_carrier_flights-flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).
      LOOP AT ls_carrier_flights-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Free slots should be at least 50' act = ls_flight-freeslots exp = 50 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_ge ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_filter_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( 9999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_carrier_flights msg = 'Should be empty if no flights match criteria' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FILTER`-Ausdrücken mit geschachtelten `FOR`-Ausdrücken und `GROUP BY`, um Flüge basierend auf einer dynamischen Bedingung (Mindestanzahl freier Sitze) zu filtern und die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren. Die Berechnung der freien Sitze erfolgt direkt im `FILTER`-Ausdruck. Dies ist ein sehr effizienter und lesbarer Weg, um Daten zu filtern und in einer geschachtelten Struktur zu organisieren.
keywords: NESTING, FILTER, FOR, VALUE, GROUP BY, DATA FILTERING, SFlight

CLASS zcl_binrel_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sales_order_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_sales_order_key TYPE swo_typeid
        iv_document_key    TYPE swo_typeid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binrel_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sales_order_link.
    DATA: ls_object_a TYPE sibflporb,
          ls_object_b TYPE sibflporb.

    ls_object_a-instid = iv_sales_order_key. " Sales Order Number
    ls_object_a-typeid = 'BUS2032'. " Sales Order Business Object
    ls_object_a-catid  = 'BO'.

    ls_object_b-instid = iv_document_key. " Document ID
    ls_object_b-typeid = 'SOFFPHIO'. " Physical Document

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der binären Verknüpfungen eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. 'ATTA') für ein Dummy-Business-Objekt (BUS2032).

CLASS zcl_binrel_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_links_by_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_key TYPE swo_typeid
        iv_reltype    TYPE bor_reltyp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binrel_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_links_by_type.
    DATA(ls_object) = VALUE sibflporb(
      instid = iv_object_key
      typeid = 'BUS2032'
      catid  = 'BO'
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_links) = cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
          EXPORTING
            is_object = ls_object
            ip_logsys = ''
        ).
        rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR link IN lt_links
                              WHERE ( link-reltype = iv_reltype )
                              NEXT c = c + 1 ).
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        rv_count = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen CSV-String mit Kopfzeile in eine interne Tabelle. Die interne Tabelle soll die Felder 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und 'FLDATE' enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und die Methode `parse_csv_string` in Kombination mit modernen Tabellenoperationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_sflight_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_sflight_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_separator = ','
      i_has_header = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lt_parsed_data) = lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string( iv_csv_string ).

    " Map the parsed data to the target internal table type
    rt_sflight_data = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_parsed_data
                                LET carrid = row-data[1],
                                    connid = row-data[2],
                                    fldate = row-data[3]
                                IN
                                ( carrid = carrid,
                                  connid = connid,
                                  fldate = fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen CSV-String aus einer internen Tabelle, inklusive Kopfzeile, unter Verwendung von `cl_icf_csv`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_icf_csv` und die Methode `create_csv_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_sflight_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflight_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv_generator) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_separator = ','
      i_has_header = abap_true
    ).

    DATA lt_data_for_csv TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_data.

    " Prepare data for CSV generation
    LOOP AT it_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND VALUE cl_icf_csv=>ty_data(
        ( ls_sflight-carrid )
        ( ls_sflight-connid )
        ( ls_sflight-fldate )
      ) TO lt_data_for_csv.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_csv_string = lo_csv_generator->create_csv_string(
      i_data = lt_data_for_csv
      i_header = VALUE cl_icf_csv=>ty_data(
        ( 'CARRID' )
        ( 'CONNID' )
        ( 'FLDATE' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET Request zu einer externen URL durch und lesen Sie die Antwort. Behandeln Sie dabei mögliche Fehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` und die Methoden `create_by_url`, `send`, `receive`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_from_url.
    DATA lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            kernel_error       = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP client creation failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP send failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP receive failed'.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_receive_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_http_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_data_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_client( ).
    " In a real scenario, you would mock cl_http_client for unit testing.
    " For this example, we'll simulate a successful response.
    " Note: This test will attempt a real HTTP call if not mocked externally.
    " For demonstration, we use a known public API that returns simple text.
    DATA(lv_test_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'.
    DATA(lv_response) = lo_cut->get_data_from_url( lv_test_url ).

Moderne ABAP-Features wie Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_http_client)`) und die `TRY...CATCH...ENDTRY`-Struktur für die Ausnahmebehandlung machen den Code robuster und lesbarer. Der `SHTTP`-Kontext bezieht sich auf die zugrundeliegende HTTP-Kommunikation.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine externe URL und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_http_client`, setzen Sie den Content-Type auf `application/json` und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_unit_json` für die JSON-Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_request,
             title TYPE string,
             body  TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post_request.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_response,
             id    TYPE i,
             title TYPE string,
             body  TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post_response.

    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        is_request_data TYPE ty_post_request
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response_data) TYPE ty_post_response
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA lv_json_request TYPE string.
    DATA lv_json_response TYPE string.

    " Convert request data to JSON
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = is_request_data
      RECEIVING
        json        = lv_json_request
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS             = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP client creation failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP send failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP receive failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

        " Convert JSON response to structure
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = lv_json_response
          CHANGING
            data        = rs_response_data
        ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_receive_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_http_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_post_json_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_post_json_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_post_client( ).
    DATA(lv_test_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts'.

    DATA(ls_request) = VALUE zcl_http_post_client=>ty_post_request(
      title = 'foo'
      body  = 'bar'
      userid = 1
    ).

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->post_json_data( iv_url = lv_test_url is_request_data = ls_request ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_response-id IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_response-title exp = 'foo' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_response-body exp = 'bar' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_response-userid exp = 1 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert einen HTTP POST Request mit JSON-Payload. Die Serialisierung und Deserialisierung von JSON-Daten erfolgt mit `/ui2/cl_json`. Die Verwendung von `cl_http_client` für die Kommunikation und die moderne Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` sind zentrale Elemente. Der `SHTTP`-Kontext ist hier ebenfalls relevant.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_connections
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_connections.
    " Simulate sflights data for testing purposes
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.

                          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate = iv_fldate )

explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration mit `WHERE`-Bedingung ist ein leistungsstarkes und modernes Feature in ABAP 7.40+. Es ermöglicht das Filtern und Projizieren von Daten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung, was den Code wesentlich kürzer und verständlicher macht als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND` Konstrukte.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, sflights, Filtering, Projection

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: `REDUCE` ist ideal für Aggregationen und die Transformation von internen Tabellen in einen einzelnen Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    " Simulate sflights data for testing purposes
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce( ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 350 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiger Konstruktorausdruck, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Dies ist ein Beispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, die den Code sehr prägnant und ausdrucksstark macht, im Gegensatz zu einer expliziten `LOOP`-Schleife mit einer Summenvariable.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von funktionalen Methoden (Method Chaining), um eine Reihe von Operationen auf einem Objekt durchzuführen.
hint: Funktionale Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, ermöglichen das Chaining von Aufrufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS add_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor.
    METHODS multiply_by IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_by.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_factor.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_chainable_processor( ).

    DATA(lv_final_result) = lo_processor->add_value( 5 )->multiply_by( 2 )->add_value( 3 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_result exp = 13 ). " (0 + 5) * 2 + 3 = 13
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ist ein objektorientiertes Designmuster, das in modernem ABAP durch funktionale Methoden unterstützt wird, die eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben. Dies ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen, flüssigen Zeile zu verketten, was die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes verbessert und die Notwendigkeit temporärer Variablen reduziert.
keywords: Object Orientation, Functional Methods, Chaining, ME, Design Patterns

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu filtern und die Ergebnisse in eine neue Tabelle zu 'verschieben'.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern, die die Notwendigkeit manueller `LOOP`- und `MOVE`-Operationen reduziert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_move DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_min_occupancy TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_high_occupancy_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_move IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_occupancy.
    rt_high_occupancy_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE seatsocc >= iv_min_occupancy ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_itab_filter_move=>tt_sflight_data.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_itab_filter_move=>ty_sflight_data( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_itab_filter_move=>ty_sflight_data( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_itab_filter_move=>ty_sflight_data( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0055' fldate = '20250103' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_flights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[2]-carrid exp = 'DL' ).

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist ein Konstruktorausdruck, der eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen filtert und eine neue interne Tabelle mit den gefilterten Zeilen zurückgibt. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Alternative zu einer `LOOP`-Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingung und `APPEND`-Anweisungen, die die Daten 'verschieben' würden. Es macht den Code deklarativer und effizienter.
keywords: MOVE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Filtering, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine andere durch, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen und umbenannt werden, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `CORRESPONDING` in einem `VALUE`-Konstrukt, um eine elegante Transformation zu erreichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES tt_source_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight_summary,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_nr  TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_day TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_target_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_target_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_summary) TYPE tt_target_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_target_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source_flights
                                 ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING airline_id = carrid
                                                              flight_nr  = connid
                                                              flight_day = fldate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_transform( ).
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_itab_transform=>tt_source_flight.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_itab_transform=>ty_source_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_itab_transform=>ty_source_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A380' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[1]-airline_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[1]-flight_nr exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[2]-flight_day exp = '20250102' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FOR`-Operator für die Iteration über eine interne Tabelle mit dem `CORRESPONDING`-Operator für die feldweise Zuweisung und Umbenennung in einem `VALUE`-Konstrukt. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke Methode zur Transformation von Tabellendaten, die die Notwendigkeit manueller `LOOP`- und `MOVE`-Anweisungen vollständig eliminiert und den Code extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: MOVE, FOR, CORRESPONDING, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und übergeben Sie Parameter. Die Methode soll zwei Zahlen addieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      execute_dynamic_method
        IMPORTING
          iv_method_name TYPE string
          iv_value1      TYPE i
          iv_value2      TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i,
      add_numbers
        IMPORTING
          iv_num1 TYPE i
          iv_num2 TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA:
      lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
      ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM1'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_mode_input.
    ls_parameter-value = REF #( iv_value1 ).
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM2'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_mode_input.
    ls_parameter-value = REF #( iv_value2 ).
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF ME
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
      RECEIVING
        RESULT rv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'ADD_NUMBERS' iv_value1 = 5 iv_value2 = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Methode CALL METHOD ermöglicht es, den Namen einer aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich für generische Frameworks oder wenn die Logik flexibel an Benutzereingaben angepasst werden muss. Die Parameterübergabe erfolgt über eine Parameter-Tabelle, was eine typsichere und flexible Übergabe von Werten ermöglicht.
keywords: DYNAMIC, Method Call, Reflection, Parameter-Table

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch zur Laufzeit, basierend auf einer übergebenen Strukturdefinition, und fügen Sie Daten hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `cl_abap_tabledescr`. Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
      END OF ty_s_data.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_type_name TYPE string " z.B. 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE_CREATE=>TY_S_DATA'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA:
      lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
      lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
      lo_line_data    TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
      <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
      <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_type_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        CREATE DATA lo_line_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
        ASSIGN lo_line_data->* TO <fs_line>.

        " Erste Zeile
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = 'Wert A'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = 100. ENDIF.
        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

        " Zweite Zeile
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = 'Wert B'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = 200. ENDIF.
        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_create( ).
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE_CREATE=>TY_S_DATA' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_field1> TYPE string,
                   <fs_field2> TYPE i.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 2 entries' act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'First line should not be initial' act = <fs_line> ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field1>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field1 of first line incorrect' act = <fs_field1> exp = 'Wert A' ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field2>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field2 of first line incorrect' act = <fs_field2> exp = 100 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) mit dem `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einem initialen Wert und einer Schleife über die gefilterten Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR  <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier_id )
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_price >= 0 ) ).
    " Für einen exakten Test müsste man Testdaten in sflights einfügen oder mocken.
    " Hier nur ein einfacher Plausibilitätscheck.
  ENDMETHOD.

Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable aktualisiert. Dies führt zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code im Vergleich zu traditionellen LOOP-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die sich selbst zurückgeben, um eine Kette von Aufrufen (Fluent Interface) zu ermöglichen.

CLASS zcl_fluent_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      set_value1
        IMPORTING
          iv_val TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface,

        IMPORTING
          iv_val TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_interface,
      get_sum
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA: mv_value1 TYPE i,
          mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_fluent_interface FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Das Fluent Interface (Method Chaining) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe aneinanderzureihen. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, Method Chaining

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen Sie dessen Wert.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
        id   TYPE i,
        name TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle (`sflights`) transformieren und dabei nur bestimmte Felder auswählen und umbenennen, unter Verwendung des `FOR` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... ( field1 = ... field2 = ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transformation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_summary,
        carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
        connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
        flight_date TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_s_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transformation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                             ( carrier_id    = ls_flight-carrid
                               connection_id = ls_flight-connid
                               flight_date   = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_transformation( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_summaries ) >= 0 ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-carrier_id ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-connection_id ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-flight_date ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Konstruktorausdrücken ermöglicht die Transformation von internen Tabellen auf eine sehr elegante und funktionale Weise. Man kann über eine Quelltabelle iterieren, optional filtern und für jede Zeile eine neue Struktur oder Zeile für die Zieltabelle erstellen. Dies ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Alternative zu `LOOP` und `APPEND`.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, Constructor Expressions, sflights

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft unter Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ( carrid = sflight-carrid )` und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_carrier_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_s_carrier_flight_count.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_s_carrier_flight_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                              flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_flight_counts ) >= 0 ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_count-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_count-flight_count > 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Optional: Prüfen Sie einen spezifischen Wert, wenn Testdaten bekannt sind
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_lh_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt die Notwendigkeit manueller Sortierungen und Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END` und führt zu deutlich lesbarerem und performanterem Code für Gruppierungsaufgaben.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Wochentag für ein gegebenes Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die eingebaute Funktion `GET_WEEK_DAY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weekday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday) TYPE i. " 1=Montag, 7=Sonntag
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday.
    rv_weekday = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( iv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_weekday FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_weekday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weekday_calculator( ).

    " 20251128 ist ein Freitag (5)
    DATA(lv_weekday_friday) = lo_cut->get_weekday( '20251128' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_weekday_friday exp = 5 ).

    " 20251130 ist ein Sonntag (7)
    DATA(lv_weekday_sunday) = lo_cut->get_weekday( '20251130' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_weekday_sunday exp = 7 ).

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens (z.B. 'X') aus einem String, indem Sie `SHIFT` in einer Schleife verwenden. Das Ergebnis soll in einem neuen String gespeichert werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FIND` und `SHIFT` in einer `WHILE`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_remove_char_shift DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_char_to_remove TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_remove_char_shift IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_char.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.

    WHILE lv_offset IS NOT INITIAL.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_char_to_remove IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF rv_cleaned_string MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        SHIFT rv_cleaned_string+lv_offset LEFT BY 1 PLACES.
        rv_cleaned_string = rv_cleaned_string( strlen( rv_cleaned_string ) - 1 ). " Kürzen um ein Zeichen
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die einen String um eine variable Anzahl von Positionen nach rechts verschiebt und die frei werdenden Positionen mit einem Füllzeichen belegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SHIFT RIGHT BY n PLACES` und String-Templates für die Auffüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_shift_right_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_right_and_fill
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_shift_places TYPE i
        iv_fill_char TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT ' '
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_shifted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_shift_right_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_right_and_fill.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    SHIFT lv_temp_string RIGHT BY iv_shift_places PLACES.

    " Fülle die ersten iv_shift_places mit dem Füllzeichen
    rv_shifted_string = |
      { REPEAT( val = iv_fill_char occ = iv_shift_places ) }
      { lv_temp_string+iv_shift_places }
    |.

    " Sicherstellen, dass der String nicht länger als ursprünglich wird
    IF strlen( rv_shifted_string ) > strlen( iv_input_string ).
      rv_shifted_string = rv_shifted_string( strlen( iv_input_string ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: In einer internen Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`), verschieben Sie den `CARRID` jedes Eintrags um eine Position nach rechts und füllen Sie die erste Position mit 'X'. Verwenden Sie moderne Tabellenkonstruktoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit `SHIFT` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_shift_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_shifted,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_shifted.
    TYPES tt_sflight_shifted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_shifted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shift_carrid_in_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shifted_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_shifted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_shift_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_carrid_in_sflights.
    rt_shifted_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                   LET lv_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid IN
                                   ( LET lv_shifted_carrid = lv_carrid IN
                                     SHIFT lv_shifted_carrid RIGHT BY 1 PLACES.
                                     lv_shifted_carrid = |X{ lv_shifted_carrid(3) }| IN " Kürzen auf 4 Zeichen, da CARRID 4 lang ist
                                     carrid   = lv_shifted_carrid,
                                     connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                     fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                     price    = ls_sflight-price,
                                     currency = ls_sflight-currency,
                                     planetype = ls_sflight-planetype,
                                     seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax,
                                     seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shift_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shift_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_shift_carrid( ).

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_shifted) = lo_cut->shift_carrid_in_sflights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shifted ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shifted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'XLH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shifted[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'XAA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Anwendung der `SHIFT`-Anweisung innerhalb eines modernen Tabellenkonstruktors (`VALUE #( FOR ... )`). Es zeigt, wie man Daten in einer internen Tabelle transformiert, indem man für jedes Element eine lokale Variable (`LET`) deklariert, diese mit `SHIFT` manipuliert und dann das Ergebnis in die neue Tabelle einfügt. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: SHIFT, Interne Tabelle, FOR, VALUE, LET, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die einen String so 'rotiert', dass die ersten `n` Zeichen an das Ende des Strings verschoben werden. Verwenden Sie `SHIFT CIRCULAR`.
hint: `SHIFT LEFT CIRCULAR BY n PLACES` ist hier der Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_rotate_circular DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS rotate_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_places       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rotated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_rotate_circular IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD rotate_string.
    rv_rotated_string = iv_input_string.
    IF iv_places < 0.
      " Negative Verschiebung als Rechtsrotation behandeln
      DATA(lv_actual_places) = abs( iv_places ) MOD strlen( rv_rotated_string ).
      SHIFT rv_rotated_string RIGHT CIRCULAR BY lv_actual_places PLACES.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lv_actual_places) = iv_places MOD strlen( rv_rotated_string ).
      SHIFT rv_rotated_string LEFT CIRCULAR BY lv_actual_places PLACES.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_rotate_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rotate_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_rotate_circular( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->rotate_string( iv_input_string = `ABCDEF` iv_places = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `CDEFAB` ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->rotate_string( iv_input_string = `12345` iv_places = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `45123` ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->rotate_string( iv_input_string = `XYZ` iv_places = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `XYZ` ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->rotate_string( iv_input_string = `ABC` iv_places = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `ABC` ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->rotate_string( iv_input_string = `ABCDEF` iv_places = -2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = `EFABCD` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SHIFT CIRCULAR`-Option ist eine sehr mächtige und oft übersehene Funktion der `SHIFT`-Anweisung. Sie ermöglicht das 'Rotieren' von String-Inhalten, wobei die am Ende verschobenen Zeichen am Anfang wieder eingefügt werden (oder umgekehrt). Dies ist besonders nützlich für kryptographische Algorithmen oder spezielle Datenformatierungen und bietet eine kompakte Alternative zu manuellen String-Operationen.
keywords: SHIFT, CIRCULAR, String Rotation, String-Manipulation

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Nullen aus einem numerischen String, der als Text vorliegt. Verwenden Sie `SHIFT` und String-Funktionen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING ZERO` und `SHIFT RIGHT DELETING TRAILING ZERO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_trim_zeros DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trim_leading_trailing_zeros
      IMPORTING
        iv_numeric_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_trimmed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_trim_zeros IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trim_leading_trailing_zeros.
    rv_trimmed_string = iv_numeric_string.
    SHIFT rv_trimmed_string LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'.
    SHIFT rv_trimmed_string RIGHT DELETING TRAILING '0'.

    " Sonderfall: Wenn nur Nullen vorhanden waren, sollte '0' zurückgegeben werden, nicht leer.
    IF rv_trimmed_string IS INITIAL AND iv_numeric_string CP '*0*'.
      rv_trimmed_string = '0'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_trim_zeros FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_trim_zeros.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_trim_zeros( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_trailing_zeros( '001234500' ) exp = '12345' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_trailing_zeros( '123' ) exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_trailing_zeros( '000' ) exp = '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_trailing_zeros( '0' ) exp = '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_trailing_zeros( '' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->trim_leading_trailing_zeros( '010' ) exp = '1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `SHIFT`-Anweisung, um führende und nachfolgende Nullen aus einem String zu entfernen. Die Optionen `LEFT DELETING LEADING '0'` und `RIGHT DELETING TRAILING '0'` sind hierfür sehr spezifisch und effizient. Ein Sonderfall für Strings, die nur aus Nullen bestehen, wird ebenfalls behandelt, um sicherzustellen, dass '0' und nicht ein leerer String zurückgegeben wird.
keywords: SHIFT, String, Nullen, Trimmen, LEFT DELETING, RIGHT DELETING

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( 'LH' ).
    " Annahme: Für LH gibt es Flüge mit Preisen, die eine Summe ergeben.
    " Der genaue Wert hängt von den Daten in SFLIGHTS ab.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob ein Wert zurückgegeben wird und nicht 0 ist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_total msg = 'Total price should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>tolerable_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total price should not be zero' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>tolerable_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. Die `FOR` Iteration mit `WHERE` Klausel filtert die relevanten Einträge direkt.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle von Strings, die für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus SFLIGHTS die Flugnummer (CONNID) und den Flugpreis (PRICE) in einem bestimmten Format kombiniert. Beispiel: 'Flug 0017 (LH): 471.00 EUR'.
hint: Verwende String Templates und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_format_flight_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_format_flight_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE string_table(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( |Flug { flight-connid ALPHA = OUT } ({ flight-carrid }): { flight-price } { flight-currency }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_format_flight_info( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_flights( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Result table should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>tolerable_error ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = |Flug \d+ \(AA\): \d+\.\d{2} EUR| msg = 'First entry format incorrect' ).
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Filtere alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, deren Flugpreis (PRICE) über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt und deren Währung (CURRENCY) 'EUR' ist. Sammle die Flugnummern (CONNID) in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_filter_high_price_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_high_price_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_high_price_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_connids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( price > iv_min_price AND currency = 'EUR' )
                          ( flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_high_price_connids( 500 ).
