Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die eine Liste von Flugobjekten (mit Attributen für Flugnummer, Preis, Währung) entgegennimmt und den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge berechnet. Nutze dabei funktionale Programmierung.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` auf einer internen Tabelle von Objekten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currency,
           END OF ty_flight,
           ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( it_flights ).

    IF lv_num_flights > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_num_flights.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_data( ).
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_data=>ty_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( connid = '0001' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( connid = '0002' price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( connid = '0003' price = 300 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 200 msg = 'Average price calculation incorrect' ).

    " Test with empty table
    CLEAR lt_test_flights.
    lv_average = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 0 msg = 'Average price for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode nutzt `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und `lines()` zur Zählung der Einträge, was eine funktionale und effiziente Berechnung des Durchschnitts ermöglicht. Die Kapselung in einer Klasse fördert die Objektorientierung.
keywords: Object Orientation, REDUCE, NUMBER, Average, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstelle eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und fülle diese mit Beispieldaten. Die Feldnamen und deren Typen sollen dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE abap_typname,
           END OF ty_field_def,
           ty_field_defs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_defs TYPE ty_field_defs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( ls_field_def-type ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY STRUCTURE,
                   <lv_field>         TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

    " Fill with some example data
    DO 2 TIMES.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-index = 1.
          <lv_field> = |Value { sy-tabix } for { ls_component-name }|.
        ELSEIF sy-index = 2.
          <lv_field> = sy-tabix * 100.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA lt_field_defs TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>ty_field_defs.

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'FIELD1' type = 'STRING' ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'FIELD2' type = 'I' ) TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY STRUCTURE,
                   <lv_field1> TYPE STRING,
                   <lv_field2> TYPE I.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( <lt_table> ) msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>tolerable_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Dynamic table should have 2 entries' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field1>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field2>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field1> exp = 'Value 1 for FIELD1' msg = 'Field1 value incorrect' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field2> exp = 100 msg = 'Field2 value incorrect' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von Datenstrukturen und internen Tabellen zur Laufzeit mittels RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CREATE DATA`. Dies ist nützlich für generische Datenverarbeitungsszenarien.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols

Instructions: Konvertiere einen String, der eine Zahl enthält (z.B. '123.45'), in einen Dezimalwert (DECFLOAT34) und führe eine Multiplikation durch. Behandle mögliche Konvertierungsfehler.
hint: Verwende `CONV` und `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_decimal_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_and_multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_string TYPE string
        iv_factor        TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_decimal_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_multiply.
    DATA lv_decimal_value TYPE decfloat34.

    TRY.
        lv_decimal_value = CONV decfloat34( iv_number_string ).
        rv_result = lv_decimal_value * iv_factor.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: z.B. Loggen oder spezifische Fehlermeldung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler bei Konvertierung von '{ iv_number_string }': { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_decimal_conversion( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_and_multiply( iv_number_string = '123.45' iv_factor = '2.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '246.90' msg = 'Conversion and multiplication incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_decimal_conversion( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_and_multiply( iv_number_string = 'ABC' iv_factor = '1.0' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR but none occurred' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR correctly caught' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DECFLOAT34` ist ein moderner Dezimaltyp, der eine hohe Präzision bietet. `CONV` ermöglicht typsichere Konvertierungen, und `TRY...CATCH` ist der Standard für die robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei potenziellen Laufzeitfehlern wie Konvertierungsfehlern.
keywords: NUMBER, DECFLOAT34, CONV, TRY CATCH, Error Handling, Data Types

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermittle für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den höchsten Flugpreis.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             max_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           ty_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE ty_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        num_flights = GROUP SIZE
        max_price   = REDUCE s_price(
                        INIT max_p = 0
                        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP
                        NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = grouped_flight-price )
                      )
      ).
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_summaries ) msg = 'Summaries table should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>tolerable_error ).

    " Find a specific carrier (e.g., 'LH') and check its data
    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = ls_lh_summary-num_flights exp = 0 msg = 'LH should have flights' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = ls_lh_summary-max_price exp = 0 msg = 'LH should have a max price' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke ABAP 7.55 Funktion, die das Gruppieren von Daten in internen Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht. In Kombination mit `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE` können Aggregationen pro Gruppe effizient durchgeführt werden.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie den Cache-Status für ein bestimmtes Enterprise Search Modell (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK`. Geben Sie das Ergebnis der Cache-Prüfung aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK=>GET_INSTANCE` und `CHECK_MODEL_CACHE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_status,
             model_name TYPE string,
             is_cached  TYPE abap_bool,
             status_msg TYPE string,
           END OF ty_cache_status.

    METHODS check_esh_model_cache
      IMPORTING
        iv_model_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_status) TYPE ty_cache_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_esh_model_cache.
    DATA: lo_esh_cache_check TYPE REF TO cl_esh_ca_check,
          lv_is_cached       TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_status_text     TYPE string.

    rs_status-model_name = iv_model_name.

    TRY.
        lo_esh_cache_check = cl_esh_ca_check=>get_instance( ).
        lo_esh_cache_check->check_model_cache(
          EXPORTING
            iv_model_name = iv_model_name
          IMPORTING
            ev_is_cached  = lv_is_cached
            ev_status_text = lv_status_text
        ).
        rs_status-is_cached = lv_is_cached.
        rs_status-status_msg = lv_status_text.
      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
        rs_status-is_cached = abap_false.
        rs_status-status_msg = |Error checking cache: { lx_esh_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rs_status-is_cached = abap_false.
        rs_status-status_msg = |Unexpected error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_esh_cache_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_esh_cache_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_checker( ).
    DATA(ls_status) = lo_cut->check_esh_model_cache( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " Es ist schwierig, den genauen Cache-Status in einem Unit-Test vorherzusagen,
    " da er von der Systemkonfiguration abhängt. Wir prüfen, ob die Methode
    " ohne Dump durchläuft und ein Ergebnis liefert.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_status-model_name msg = 'Model name should be set' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>tolerable_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_status-status_msg msg = 'Status message should be set' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>tolerable_error ).

    " Optional: Test mit einem nicht-existenten Modell, um Fehlerbehandlung zu prüfen
    DATA(ls_error_status) = lo_cut->check_esh_model_cache( 'NON_EXISTENT_MODEL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_error_status-is_cached exp = abap_false msg = 'Non-existent model should not be cached' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( act = ls_error_status-status_msg exp = |Error checking cache:.*| msg = 'Error message expected for non-existent model' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung der spezifischen Klasse `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK` zur Interaktion mit dem Enterprise Search Cache. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken ist entscheidend für eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei externen API-Aufrufen. Die Rückgabe einer Struktur mit dem Status ist eine moderne Art, Ergebnisse zu kapseln.
keywords: cl_esh_ca_check, S_ESH_ENG_CACHE, Cache check, Enterprise Search, Object Orientation, Error Handling

CLASS zcl_map_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Datenmanipulation.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS enthält, deren Flugpreis (PRICE) über dem Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge der gleichen Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) liegt. Nutze dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_above_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currency,
           END OF ty_flight_detail,
           ty_flights_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_above_avg
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_high_price_flights) TYPE ty_flights_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_above_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_above_avg.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_avg_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        COUNT num_flights = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + grouped_flight-price,
             num_flights = num_flights + 1
      ).
      IF lv_avg_price > 0 AND num_flights > 0.
        lv_avg_price = lv_avg_price / num_flights.
      ELSE.
        lv_avg_price = 0.
      ENDIF.

      rt_high_price_flights = VALUE #( BASE rt_high_price_flights
                                       FOR high_flight IN GROUP
                                       WHERE ( high_flight-price > lv_avg_price )
                                       ( high_flight ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flights_above_avg FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_above_avg.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_above_average( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_above_avg( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Result table should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>tolerable_error ).

    " Optional: Prüfen, ob die Preise in der Ergebnistabelle tatsächlich über dem Durchschnitt liegen.
    " Dies erfordert eine manuelle Berechnung des Durchschnitts für eine Fluggesellschaft.
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_high_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      DATA lv_sum_for_carrid TYPE s_price VALUE 0.
      DATA lv_count_for_carrid TYPE i VALUE 0.
      SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights INTO lv_sum_for_carrid WHERE carrid = ls_first_high_flight-carrid.
      SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM sflights INTO lv_count_for_carrid WHERE carrid = ls_first_high_flight-carrid.
      IF lv_count_for_carrid > 0.
        DATA(lv_avg_for_carrid) = lv_sum_for_carrid / lv_count_for_carrid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_first_high_flight-price > lv_avg_for_carrid ) msg = 'Flight price not above average for its carrier' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` zur Berechnung des Durchschnittspreises pro Fluggesellschaft mit einer weiteren `FOR` Expression innerhalb der Gruppe, um nur die Flüge zu sammeln, die über diesem Durchschnitt liegen. Dies demonstriert fortgeschrittene funktionale Programmierung und Datenaggregation.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, NUMBER, Average, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechne die Quadratwurzel einer Liste von Zahlen und runde das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen. Behandle dabei nur positive Zahlen.
hint: Verwende `MAP` (implizit mit `FOR` und `VALUE`) und `SQRT` sowie `ROUND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_rounded_sqrt
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_rounded_sqrt.
    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_numbers WHERE ( number > 0 )
                          ( ROUND( val = sqrt( number ) dec = 2 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_rounded_sqrt FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rounded_sqrt.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA lt_test_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND '4' TO lt_test_numbers.
    APPEND '9' TO lt_test_numbers.
    APPEND '2.25' TO lt_test_numbers.
    APPEND '10' TO lt_test_numbers.
    APPEND '-1' TO lt_test_numbers. " Should be ignored

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->calculate_rounded_sqrt( lt_test_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 4 msg = 'Incorrect number of results' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = '2.00' msg = 'Sqrt of 4 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = '3.00' msg = 'Sqrt of 9 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ] exp = '1.50' msg = 'Sqrt of 2.25 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 4 ] exp = '3.16' msg = 'Sqrt of 10 rounded incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE` Konstruktor-Expression mit `FOR` ermöglicht eine funktionale Transformation einer Liste von Zahlen. Die `WHERE` Klausel filtert ungültige Eingaben. `SQRT` und `ROUND` sind eingebaute Funktionen, die direkt in dieser Expression verwendet werden können, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: NUMBER, SQRT, ROUND, FOR, VALUE, Functional Programming, Math

Instructions: Finde alle Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus SFLIGHTS, die sowohl Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 EUR als auch Flüge mit einem Preis unter 100 EUR anbieten.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `COND` oder `FILTER` und `INTERSECT` (konzeptionell).
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrids_with_mixed_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_with_mixed_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_high_price_carrids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( flight-price > 500 )
      ( flight-carrid ) OPTIONAL UNIQUE ).

    DATA(lt_low_price_carrids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( flight-price < 100 )
      ( flight-carrid ) OPTIONAL UNIQUE ).

    " Find intersection of the two sets
    LOOP AT lt_high_price_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      IF line_exists( lt_low_price_carrids[ table_line = lv_carrid ] ).
        APPEND lv_carrid TO rt_carrids.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    SORT rt_carrids ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_carrids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mixed_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mixed_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_complex_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrids_with_mixed_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Result table should not be initial' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>tolerable_error ).

    " Annahme: LH bietet sowohl teure als auch günstige Flüge an.
    IF line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = 'LH' ] ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'LH found in mixed price carriers' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'LH not found in mixed price carriers, check SFLIGHTS data' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `VALUE` und `FOR` mit `WHERE` zur Erstellung von zwei separaten Listen von Fluggesellschaften basierend auf Preisbedingungen. Anschließend wird die Schnittmenge dieser Listen ermittelt, um Fluggesellschaften zu finden, die beide Kriterien erfüllen. `OPTIONAL UNIQUE` sorgt für eindeutige Einträge in den Zwischenergebnissen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Set Operations, NUMBER, SFLIGHTS, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den 'CURRENCY' aller Flüge in 'sflights' auf 'EUR', wenn der 'PRICE' über 1000 liegt, unter Verwendung eines 'FOR'-Ausdrucks und 'LINE_INDEX'.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'LOOP AT ... FOR ... WHERE ...' und 'MODIFY TABLE ... INDEX ...' in Kombination mit 'LINE_INDEX'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_currency_for_price
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_currency_for_price.
    ro_sflights = io_sflights.

    LOOP AT ro_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN ro_sflights WHERE ( price > 1000 ).
      <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Alternative using MODIFY TABLE with LINE_INDEX (less common with FOR loop, but possible)
    " DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    " LOOP AT ro_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) WHERE price > 1000.
    "   lv_index = sy-tabix.
    "   <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    "   MODIFY TABLE ro_sflights FROM <fs_sflight> INDEX lv_index.
    " ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_currency FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_currency.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_update=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_update( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 1200 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = 800  currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' price = 1500 currency = 'SGD' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_updated_sflights) = lo_cut->update_currency_for_price( lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-currency exp = 'EUR' msg = 'Flight 1 currency should be EUR' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-currency exp = 'USD' msg = 'Flight 2 currency should remain USD' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_flight3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight3-currency exp = 'EUR' msg = 'Flight 3 currency should be EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt einen 'LOOP AT ... FOR ... WHERE ...' Ausdruck, der eine interne Tabelle filtert und gleichzeitig über die gefilterten Zeilen iteriert. Die Zuweisung an ein Feldsymbol (<fs_sflight>) ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation der Tabellenzeile, ohne explizit 'MODIFY TABLE' mit 'INDEX' oder 'TRANSPORTING' verwenden zu müssen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, interne Tabellen zu bearbeiten.
keywords: MODIFY, FOR, LINE_INDEX, Internal Tables, LOOP AT, Field-Symbol

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den 'PRICE' eines spezifischen Fluges in 'sflights' (z.B. 'CARRID = 'LH'', 'CONNID = '0400'', 'FLDATE = 'YYYYMMDD'') auf einen neuen Wert, indem Sie den 'TABLE'-Ausdruck verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie 'MODIFY TABLE itab INDEX ( table_line[ ... ]-line_index ) ...' oder 'MODIFY TABLE itab FROM ... INDEX ( table_line[ ... ]-line_index )'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        is_key      TYPE ty_sflight_key
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    ro_sflights = io_sflights.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_index) = ro_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = is_key-carrid,
                                                          connid = is_key-connid,
                                                          fldate = is_key-fldate ]-line_index.

        IF lv_index IS NOT INITIAL.
          ro_sflights[ lv_index ]-price = iv_new_price.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Flight not found, handle as needed (e.g., do nothing, raise exception)
    ENDTRY.

    " Alternative using MODIFY TABLE with explicit index
    " DATA(ls_flight_to_update) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
    "   carrid = is_key-carrid
    "   connid = is_key-connid
    "   fldate = is_key-fldate
    "   price = iv_new_price
    " ).
    " MODIFY TABLE ro_sflights FROM ls_flight_to_update TRANSPORTING price
    "   WHERE carrid = is_key-carrid AND connid = is_key-connid AND fldate = is_key-fldate.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend wird die Zeile direkt über den Index modifiziert. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Methode, um auf einzelne Zeilen in internen Tabellen zuzugreifen und diese zu aktualisieren, insbesondere bei Tabellen mit eindeutigen Schlüsseln. Die 'TRY...CATCH'-Block ist wichtig, um den Fehler 'cx_sy_itab_line_not_found' abzufangen, falls die Zeile nicht gefunden wird.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den 'PRICE' aller Flüge von 'LH' um 10%. Protokollieren Sie dabei die 'sy-tabix' der geänderten Zeilen in einer separaten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'LOOP AT ... WHERE ...' und 'MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ...' in Kombination mit 'sy-tabix' für die Protokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_sy_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_modified_indices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-tabix WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_and_log_price
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      EXPORTING
        eo_modified_indices TYPE tt_modified_indices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sy_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_and_log_price.
    ro_sflights = io_sflights.

    LOOP AT ro_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.1'.
      APPEND sy-tabix TO eo_modified_indices.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Explizites MODIFY TABLE ist hier nicht nötig, da mit Feldsymbol gearbeitet wird.
    " Wenn man ohne Feldsymbol arbeiten würde:
    " DATA: ls_sflight_wa TYPE ty_sflight_data.
    " LOOP AT ro_sflights INTO ls_sflight_wa WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    "   ls_sflight_wa-price = ls_sflight_wa-price * '1.1'.
    "   APPEND sy-tabix TO eo_modified_indices.
    "   MODIFY TABLE ro_sflights FROM ls_sflight_wa INDEX sy-tabix TRANSPORTING price.
    " ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_and_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_and_log.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_sy_tabix=>tt_sflight_data,
          lt_modified_indices TYPE zcl_sflight_sy_tabix=>tt_modified_indices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_sy_tabix( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 1000 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = 800  currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20251202' price = 2000 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_updated_sflights) = lo_cut->update_and_log_price( EXPORTING io_sflights = lt_sflights IMPORTING eo_modified_indices = lt_modified_indices ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-price exp = 1100 msg = 'Flight 1 price should be 1100' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-price exp = 800 msg = 'Flight 2 price should be unchanged' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_flight3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight3-price exp = 2200 msg = 'Flight 3 price should be 2200' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_modified_indices ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two flights should have been logged' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_modified_indices[ 1 ] exp = 1 msg = 'First logged index should be 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_modified_indices[ 2 ] exp = 3 msg = 'Second logged index should be 3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl 'sy-tabix' in vielen modernen Kontexten durch 'LINE_INDEX' oder implizite Schleifen ersetzt wird, bleibt es in 'LOOP AT'-Konstrukten nützlich, um die aktuelle Zeilennummer zu ermitteln, insbesondere für Protokollierungszwecke oder wenn der absolute Index der Zeile benötigt wird. Die Verwendung eines Feldsymbols (<fs_sflight>) innerhalb des 'LOOP AT' ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation der Tabellenzeile, ohne dass ein explizites 'MODIFY TABLE' mit 'INDEX sy-tabix' erforderlich ist, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: MODIFY, sy-tabix, Internal Tables, LOOP AT, Field-Symbol, Logging

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit Flügen, die nur 'CARRID', 'CONNID', 'FLDATE' und 'PRICE' enthalten, wobei der 'PRICE' initial auf 0 gesetzt wird. Aktualisieren Sie dann den 'PRICE' für alle Flüge mit 'CARRID = 'AA'' auf 500.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'VALUE' Operator zur Initialisierung und 'MODIFY TABLE ... WHERE ...' zur Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_value_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_update_flights
      IMPORTING
        io_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_value_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_update_flights.
    " Initialisierung der neuen Tabelle mit VALUE Operator
    ro_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN io_source_flights
                          ( carrid = ls_source-carrid
                            connid = ls_source-connid
                            fldate = ls_source-fldate
                            price = 0 ) ).

    " Aktualisierung des PRICE für 'AA' Flüge
    MODIFY TABLE ro_flights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = 500 )
      TRANSPORTING price WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Methode zur Tabellenkonstruktion. Die anschließende 'MODIFY TABLE ... WHERE ... TRANSPORTING ...' Anweisung aktualisiert effizient alle Zeilen, die der 'WHERE'-Bedingung entsprechen, ohne dass eine explizite Schleife erforderlich ist. Dies demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit moderner ABAP-Syntax für die Datenmanipulation.
keywords: MODIFY, VALUE, Internal Tables, Table Construction, WHERE clause, TRANSPORTING

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge, deren 'PLANETYPE' 'BOEING' ist. Setzen Sie für diese gefilterten Flüge den 'SEATSMAX' auf 300.
hint: Nutzen Sie 'FILTER' um die zu modifizierenden Zeilen zu identifizieren und dann 'MODIFY TABLE ... INDEX ...' oder 'MODIFY TABLE ... WHERE ...' mit den Schlüsseln der gefilterten Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_seatsmax_for_planetype
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
        iv_new_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_seatsmax_for_planetype.
    ro_sflights = io_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( ro_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE planetype = iv_planetype ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_filtered_flight>).
      ro_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = <fs_filtered_flight>-carrid,
                                                connid = <fs_filtered_flight>-connid,
                                                fldate = <fs_filtered_flight>-fldate ]-seatsmax = iv_new_seatsmax.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Alternative using MODIFY TABLE with WHERE clause (if keys are not unique or for simpler cases)
    " MODIFY TABLE ro_sflights FROM VALUE #( seatsmax = iv_new_seatsmax )
    "   TRANSPORTING seatsmax WHERE planetype = iv_planetype.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_seatsmax FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_seatsmax.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_filter_modify=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter_modify( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' planetype = 'AIRBUS' seatsmax = 250 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' planetype = 'BOEING' seatsmax = 180 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' planetype = 'AIRBUS' seatsmax = 350 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251202' planetype = 'BOEING' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_updated_sflights) = lo_cut->update_seatsmax_for_planetype( io_sflights = lt_sflights iv_planetype = 'BOEING' iv_new_seatsmax = 300 ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-seatsmax exp = 250 msg = 'LH flight seatsmax should be unchanged' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-seatsmax exp = 300 msg = 'AA flight seatsmax should be 300' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251202' INTO DATA(ls_flight_ba).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_ba-seatsmax exp = 300 msg = 'BA flight seatsmax should be 300' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination des 'FILTER'-Operators mit der direkten Tabellenmodifikation. Zuerst wird eine temporäre Tabelle mit dem 'FILTER'-Operator erstellt, die nur die relevanten Flüge enthält. Anschließend wird über diese gefilterte Tabelle iteriert, und die entsprechenden Zeilen in der Originaltabelle werden über den Schlüsselzugriff aktualisiert. Dies ist eine elegante und performante Methode, um gezielte Updates auf Basis komplexer Filterbedingungen durchzuführen, ohne manuelle Schleifen und 'IF'-Bedingungen für die Filterung schreiben zu müssen.
keywords: MODIFY, FILTER, Internal Tables, Table Expressions, Key Access

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die kumulative Summe der 'PRICE' für alle Flüge in 'sflights', wobei der Index ('sy-tabix') der Zeile in die Berechnung einfließt (z.B. 'cumulative_price = cumulative_price + (price * sy-tabix)').
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'REDUCE' Operator und 'sy-tabix' innerhalb des 'LOOP' für die Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_cumulative_price
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cumulative_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_cumulative_price.
    rv_cumulative_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_flight IN io_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-price * sy-tabix ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cumulative_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_reduce_tabix=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce_tabix( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' price = 300 ) TO lt_sflights.

    " Expected: (100 * 1) + (200 * 2) + (300 * 3) = 100 + 400 + 900 = 1400
    DATA(lv_cumulative_price) = lo_cut->calculate_cumulative_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cumulative_price exp = 1400 msg = 'Cumulative price calculation is incorrect' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.
    DATA(lv_cumulative_price_single) = lo_cut->calculate_cumulative_price( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cumulative_price_single exp = 50 msg = 'Cumulative price for single entry is incorrect' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    DATA(lv_cumulative_price_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_cumulative_price( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cumulative_price_empty exp = 0 msg = 'Cumulative price for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'REDUCE'-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug in modernem ABAP, um eine einzelne Ergebniswert aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren. In diesem Beispiel wird 'REDUCE' verwendet, um eine kumulative Summe zu berechnen. Die Besonderheit ist die Verwendung von 'sy-tabix' innerhalb des 'FOR'-Ausdrucks, um den Index der aktuellen Zeile in die Berechnung einzubeziehen. Dies zeigt, dass 'sy-tabix' auch in funktionalen Kontexten weiterhin relevant sein kann, wenn der Zeilenindex eine Rolle spielt.
keywords: REDUCE, sy-tabix, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hilfstabelle mit neuen 'PRICE'-Werten für bestimmte 'CARRID' und 'CONNID'. Aktualisieren Sie die Haupttabelle 'sflights' mit diesen neuen Preisen, indem Sie 'CORRESPONDING' verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie 'MODIFY TABLE ... FROM CORRESPONDING ...'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_update,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_price_update.
    TYPES tt_price_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        io_price_updates TYPE tt_price_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_corresponding.
    ro_sflights = io_sflights.

    LOOP AT io_price_updates ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_update>).
      MODIFY TABLE ro_sflights FROM CORRESPONDING #( <fs_update> )
        TRANSPORTING price WHERE carrid = <fs_update>-carrid AND connid = <fs_update>-connid.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_corresponding.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_corresponding=>tt_sflight_data,
          lt_price_updates TYPE zcl_sflight_corresponding=>tt_price_update.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = 800  currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20251202' price = 2000 currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 1100 ) TO lt_price_updates.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' price = 900 ) TO lt_price_updates.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' price = 700 ) TO lt_price_updates. " This one should not update anything

    DATA(lt_updated_sflights) = lo_cut->update_prices_corresponding( io_sflights = lt_sflights io_price_updates = lt_price_updates ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh1-price exp = 1100 msg = 'LH 0400 price should be 1100' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-price exp = 900 msg = 'AA 0010 price should be 900' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20251202' INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh2-price exp = 2000 msg = 'LH 0500 price should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die 'MODIFY TABLE ... FROM CORRESPONDING ...' Anweisung ist ideal, um Felder einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer anderen Struktur oder Tabelle zu aktualisieren, wenn die Feldnamen übereinstimmen. Hier wird sie in einer Schleife über eine Hilfstabelle verwendet, um gezielt Preise in der Haupttabelle zu aktualisieren. Die 'WHERE'-Klausel stellt sicher, dass nur die passenden Zeilen modifiziert werden. Dies ist eine moderne und typsichere Alternative zu manuellen Zuweisungen und 'READ TABLE'-Operationen.
keywords: MODIFY, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Partial Update, WHERE clause

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flug in 'sflights' ein. Wenn der Flug bereits existiert (basierend auf 'CARRID', 'CONNID', 'FLDATE'), aktualisieren Sie stattdessen den 'PRICE'.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'INSERT ... INTO TABLE ...' und 'MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...' oder den 'MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ...' Befehl, der sowohl Insert als auch Update abdeckt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_insert_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS insert_or_update_flight
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        is_new_flight TYPE ty_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_insert_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_or_update_flight.
    ro_sflights = io_sflights.

    " MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ... (ohne TRANSPORTING) führt ein Insert oder Update durch
    MODIFY TABLE ro_sflights FROM is_new_flight.

    " Alternative mit explizitem INSERT und MODIFY:
    " DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    " READ TABLE ro_sflights WITH KEY carrid = is_new_flight-carrid
    "                               connid = is_new_flight-connid
    "                               fldate = is_new_flight-fldate
    "                               TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    " IF sy-subrc = 0.
    "   MODIFY TABLE ro_sflights FROM is_new_flight TRANSPORTING price INDEX sy-tabix.
    " ELSE.
    "   INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE ro_sflights.
    " ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_or_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_or_update.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_insert_modify=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_insert_modify( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 1000 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.

    " Test 1: Insert new flight
    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE zcl_sflight_insert_modify=>ty_sflight_data(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = 800 currency = 'USD' ).
    DATA(lt_result1) = lo_cut->insert_or_update_flight( io_sflights = lt_sflights is_new_flight = ls_new_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result1 ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table size should be 2 after insert' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result1 WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-price exp = 800 msg = 'New flight price should be 800' ).

    " Test 2: Update existing flight
    DATA(ls_update_flight) = VALUE zcl_sflight_insert_modify=>ty_sflight_data(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 1200 currency = 'EUR' ).
    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->insert_or_update_flight( io_sflights = lt_result1 is_new_flight = ls_update_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result2 ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table size should remain 2 after update' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result2 WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh_updated).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh_updated-price exp = 1200 msg = 'Existing flight price should be 1200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh_updated-currency exp = 'EUR' msg = 'Existing flight currency should be EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die 'MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa' Anweisung ist eine sehr flexible und moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu manipulieren. Wenn die interne Tabelle einen eindeutigen Schlüssel hat und eine Zeile mit diesem Schlüssel in 'wa' existiert, wird die Zeile aktualisiert. Andernfalls wird eine neue Zeile eingefügt. Dies vereinfacht den Code erheblich, da man nicht explizit prüfen muss, ob eine Zeile existiert, bevor man 'INSERT' oder 'MODIFY' aufruft. Es ist eine 'upsert'-Operation für interne Tabellen.
keywords: MODIFY, INSERT, Internal Tables, Upsert, Unique Key

Instructions: Identifizieren Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft ('CARRID') den Flug mit dem höchsten 'PRICE'. Aktualisieren Sie für diese Flüge den 'PLANETYPE' auf 'PREMIUM'.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...' um die höchsten Preise zu finden, und dann 'MODIFY TABLE ... INDEX ...' oder 'MODIFY TABLE ... WHERE ...' für die Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_planetype_for_highest_price
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype_for_highest_price.
    ro_sflights = io_sflights.

    LOOP AT ro_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).

      DATA(ls_highest_price_flight) = REDUCE ty_sflight_data(
        INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_sflight_data( price = -1 )
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP <fs_group>
        NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN <fs_member>-price > max_flight-price THEN <fs_member> ELSE max_flight ) ).

      IF ls_highest_price_flight-price > -1.
        ro_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_highest_price_flight-carrid,
                                                  connid = ls_highest_price_flight-connid,
                                                  fldate = ls_highest_price_flight-fldate ]-planetype = 'PREMIUM'.
      ENDIF.

    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_planetype_group FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_planetype_group.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_group_modify=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_modify( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 1000 planetype = 'AIRBUS' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20251202' price = 1500 planetype = 'BOEING' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = 800  planetype = 'AIRBUS' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251202' price = 900  planetype = 'BOEING' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' price = 1200 planetype = 'AIRBUS' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_updated_sflights) = lo_cut->update_planetype_for_highest_price( lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_lh_low).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_low-planetype exp = 'AIRBUS' msg = 'LH 0400 should be AIRBUS' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' fldate = '20251202' INTO DATA(ls_lh_high).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_high-planetype exp = 'PREMIUM' msg = 'LH 0500 should be PREMIUM' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_aa_low).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_low-planetype exp = 'AIRBUS' msg = 'AA 0010 should be AIRBUS' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251202' INTO DATA(ls_aa_high).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_high-planetype exp = 'PREMIUM' msg = 'AA 0020 should be PREMIUM' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflights WITH KEY carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_sq).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sq-planetype exp = 'PREMIUM' msg = 'SQ 0001 should be PREMIUM' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...' mit dem 'REDUCE'-Operator, um komplexe Aggregationen und anschließende Modifikationen durchzuführen. Zuerst werden die Flüge nach 'CARRID' gruppiert. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird mit 'REDUCE' der Flug mit dem höchsten Preis identifiziert. Anschließend wird der 'PLANETYPE' dieses spezifischen Fluges in der Originaltabelle über den Schlüsselzugriff aktualisiert. Dies zeigt eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten in Gruppen zu verarbeiten und gezielte Updates vorzunehmen.
keywords: MODIFY, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Key Access

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die 'sflights' Tabelle. Wenn 'sy-tabix' ein gerader Wert ist, setzen Sie den 'CURRENCY' auf 'USD'. Wenn 'sy-tabix' ein ungerader Wert ist, setzen Sie den 'CURRENCY' auf 'GBP'. Verwenden Sie 'CONDENSE' auf dem 'PLANETYPE' für alle Zeilen.
hint: Nutzen Sie 'LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)' und 'sy-tabix' für die Bedingung. 'CONDENSE' kann direkt auf dem Feldsymbol angewendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_tabix_condense DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_by_index
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tabix_condense IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_by_index.
    ro_sflights = io_sflights.

    LOOP AT ro_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      IF sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0. " Gerader Index
        <fs_sflight>-currency = 'USD'.
      ELSE. " Ungerader Index
        <fs_sflight>-currency = 'GBP'.
      ENDIF.
      CONDENSE <fs_sflight>-planetype NO-GAPS.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_by_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_by_index.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_tabix_condense=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_tabix_condense( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 1000 currency = 'XXX' planetype = 'AIRBUS A380' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = 800  currency = 'XXX' planetype = 'BOEING 747' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' price = 1500 currency = 'XXX' planetype = 'AIRBUS A320' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251202' price = 900  currency = 'XXX' planetype = 'BOEING 737' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_processed_flights) = lo_cut->process_flights_by_index( lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-currency exp = 'GBP' msg = 'Flight 1 currency should be GBP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-planetype exp = 'AIRBUSA380' msg = 'Flight 1 planetype should be condensed' ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed_flights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-currency exp = 'USD' msg = 'Flight 2 currency should be USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-planetype exp = 'BOEING747' msg = 'Flight 2 planetype should be condensed' ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed_flights INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_flight3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight3-currency exp = 'GBP' msg = 'Flight 3 currency should be GBP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight3-planetype exp = 'AIRBUSA320' msg = 'Flight 3 planetype should be condensed' ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed_flights INDEX 4 INTO DATA(ls_flight4).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight4-currency exp = 'USD' msg = 'Flight 4 currency should be USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight4-planetype exp = 'BOEING737' msg = 'Flight 4 planetype should be condensed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine klassische Verwendung von 'sy-tabix' innerhalb einer 'LOOP AT'-Schleife, um zeilenbasierte, bedingte Logik anzuwenden. Obwohl modernere ABAP-Konstrukte oft 'sy-tabix' vermeiden, ist es für einfache Index-basierte Operationen immer noch sehr nützlich und lesbar. Die direkte Modifikation über ein Feldsymbol (<fs_sflight>) ist die bevorzugte Methode, um die interne Tabelle effizient zu aktualisieren. Die 'CONDENSE NO-GAPS' Anweisung ist eine einfache Möglichkeit, Leerzeichen aus einem String zu entfernen.
keywords: sy-tabix, LOOP AT, Field-Symbol, Conditional Logic, CONDENSE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einem 'PRICE' unter 500 enthält. Für diese Flüge soll der 'CURRENCY' auf 'LOWC' gesetzt werden. Verwenden Sie den 'FOR'-Ausdruck mit 'COND' für die Transformation.
hint: Nutzen Sie den 'FOR'-Ausdruck, um die neue Tabelle zu erstellen und gleichzeitig die Bedingung und die Zuweisung zu handhaben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_low_price_flights
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_low_price_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_for_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_low_price_flights.
    ro_low_price_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN io_sflights
                                    WHERE ( price < 500 )
                                    ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                                      connid   = ls_flight-connid
                                      fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
                                      price    = ls_flight-price
                                      currency = 'LOWC' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_low_price_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_low_price_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sflight_for_cond=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_for_cond( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 1000 currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = 450  currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' price = 300  currency = 'SGD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251202' price = 600  currency = 'GBP' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_result_flights) = lo_cut->get_low_price_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Result table should have 2 entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-price exp = 450 msg = 'AA flight price should be 450' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-currency exp = 'LOWC' msg = 'AA flight currency should be LOWC' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' INTO DATA(ls_flight_sq).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_sq-price exp = 300 msg = 'SQ flight price should be 300' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_sq-currency exp = 'LOWC' msg = 'SQ flight currency should be LOWC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'FOR'-Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug, um neue interne Tabellen zu erstellen, indem man über eine bestehende Tabelle iteriert, filtert und die Zeilen transformiert. Hier wird er verwendet, um nur Flüge mit einem 'PRICE' unter 500 auszuwählen und gleichzeitig deren 'CURRENCY' auf 'LOWC' zu setzen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation, die explizite Schleifen und 'APPEND'-Anweisungen überflüssig macht und den Code deutlich lesbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Transformation, COND

Instructions: Setzen Sie den 'CURRENCY' aller Flüge in 'sflights' auf 'XXX', wenn der 'CARRID' 'LH' ist. Verwenden Sie 'MODIFY TABLE ... WHERE ... TRANSPORTING ...'.
hint: Nutzen Sie die 'MODIFY TABLE' Anweisung mit einer 'WHERE'-Klausel und 'TRANSPORTING', um nur spezifische Felder zu aktualisieren.

explanation: Die 'MODIFY TABLE ... WHERE ... TRANSPORTING ...' Anweisung ist die Standardmethode, um mehrere Zeilen einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu aktualisieren. Durch die 'TRANSPORTING'-Klausel wird sichergestellt, dass nur die angegebenen Felder aktualisiert werden, was effizienter ist, als die gesamte Zeile zu überschreiben. Dies ist eine grundlegende, aber sehr wichtige und moderne ABAP-Funktion für die Tabellenbearbeitung.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Tables, WHERE clause, TRANSPORTING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus 'sflights' enthält, deren 'PRICE' über dem Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge liegt. Setzen Sie für diese Flüge den 'CURRENCY' auf 'HIGH'.
hint: Berechnen Sie zuerst den Durchschnitt mit 'REDUCE'. Verwenden Sie dann 'FOR' mit einer 'WHERE'-Klausel und 'COND' für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_price_flights
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_high_price_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_flights.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN io_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( io_sflights ).
    DATA(lv_average_price) = COND #( WHEN lv_num_flights > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_num_flights ELSE 0 ).

    ro_high_price_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN io_sflights
                                     WHERE ( price > lv_average_price )
                                     ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                                       connid   = ls_flight-connid

CLASS zcl_sflight_tabix_for IMPLEMENTATION.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_switch_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_prices_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        io_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_switch_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_prices_by_carrier.
    ro_adjusted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN io_sflights
                                   ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                                     connid   = ls_flight-connid
                                     fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
                                     currency = ls_flight-currency
                                     price    = SWITCH #( ls_flight-carrid
                                                          WHEN 'LH' THEN ls_flight-price * '1.1'
                                                          WHEN 'AA' THEN ls_flight-price * '1.05'
                                                          ELSE ls_flight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Dynamische Verarbeitung einer internen Tabelle: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle (beliebigen Typs) und einen Feldnamen als String akzeptiert. Die Methode soll den Wert des angegebenen Feldes für jede Zeile der Tabelle auslesen und in einer neuen Tabelle sammeln. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach Gebrauch sicher entkoppelt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Explicitly unassign after use
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) akzeptiert. Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle mit einem Feldsymbol. Wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung (z.B. Fluggesellschaft 'LH') erfüllt ist, soll das Feldsymbol explizit entkoppelt und die Schleife vorzeitig beendet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `UNASSIGN` gefolgt von `EXIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_and_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_s_sflight.

    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid = iv_carrid.
        rv_found = abap_true.
        UNASSIGN <fs_flight>. " Unassign and exit
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die versucht, ein Feldsymbol dynamisch einem nicht existierenden Feld zuzuweisen. Fangen Sie den Fehler ab und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol im Fehlerfall explizit entkoppelt wird, um eine undefinierte Referenz zu vermeiden.

CLASS zcl_fs_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_data TYPE string VALUE 'Some Data'.

    METHODS assign_field_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_field_safely.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN (me)->(iv_field_name) TO <fs_target>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Assignment successful
      rv_success = abap_true.
      " Do something with <fs_target>
      " ...
    ELSE.
      " Assignment failed (e.g., field does not exist)
      rv_success = abap_false.
      UNASSIGN <fs_target>. " Ensure field symbol is unassigned on error
    ENDIF.
    " If successful, <fs_target> might still be assigned here,
    " depending on further logic. For this example, we unassign
    " only on error to highlight the error handling.
    " In a real scenario, it might be unassigned at the end of the method.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_file_xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string " In this example, this path is simulated as the content itself for testing
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_file_access
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_file_xstring_to_string.
    DATA: lv_xstring_content TYPE xstring.

    " Simulate reading a file into xstring (in a real scenario, use OPEN DATASET)
    " For unit testability, we'll assume iv_file_path contains the actual UTF-8 data
    " and convert it to xstring for the purpose of this example.
    " In a real application, you'd read the file directly into xstring.
    " Example: cl_abap_file_utilities=>read_xstring_from_file(
    "   EXPORTING
    "     i_filename = iv_file_path
    "   IMPORTING
    "     e_xstring  = lv_xstring_content
    " ).
    " For this example, we'll just convert the input string to xstring first.
    DATA(lo_out_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_out_conv->write( data = iv_file_path ).
    lv_xstring_content = lo_out_conv->get_buffer( ).

    DATA(lo_in_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      input    = lv_xstring_content
    ).
    lo_in_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_content ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von einer externen Codepage in die Systemcodepage. Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall, dass der Eingabestring ungültige Zeichen für die angegebene Codepage enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERTER_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_encoding     TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string
      EXCEPTIONS
        conversion_failed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_encoding
          input    = iv_input_string
        ).
        lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_output_string ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Handle conversion error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_conv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING conversion_failed.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_conversion.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_handler->convert_with_error_handling( iv_input_string = 'Valid Text' iv_encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = 'Valid Text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_conversion.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handler( ).
    " Simulate invalid UTF-8 sequence (e.g., a lone continuation byte)
    DATA(lv_invalid_utf8) TYPE xstring VALUE 'C328'. " C3 is start of 2-byte sequence, but 28 is not a valid continuation byte
    DATA(lv_invalid_string) TYPE string.
    cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' input = lv_invalid_utf8 )->read( IMPORTING data = lv_invalid_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      EXPORTING
        class_name = 'ZCX_CONVERSION_FAILED' " Assuming a custom exception for the RAISE in solution
      ACT = NEW zcl_conv_error_handler( )->convert_with_error_handling( iv_input_string = lv_invalid_string iv_encoding = 'UTF-8' )
    ). 
    " Note: The above test assumes ZCX_CONVERSION_FAILED is defined and raised. 
    " For simplicity, the solution raises a class-local exception. 
    " A more robust test would check for the specific message or a custom exception.
    " For this example, we'll adjust the solution to raise a simple exception.
    TRY.
        lo_handler->convert_with_error_handling( iv_input_string = lv_invalid_string iv_encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcl_conv_error_handler=>conversion_failed.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Expected exception was raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
