CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utf8_to_iso88591.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_direct_codepage_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hello World ÄÖÜ'.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_iso_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    " Convert original string to UTF-8 xstring
    cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->write( data = lv_original_string )->get_buffer( IMPORTING buffer = lv_utf8_xstring ).

    " Direct conversion from UTF-8 to ISO-8859-1
    lv_iso_xstring = lo_converter->convert_direct(
      iv_input_xstring = lv_utf8_xstring
      iv_source_encoding = 'UTF-8'
      iv_target_encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
    ).

    " Convert back to string from ISO-8859-1 to verify
    DATA(lv_decoded_string) TYPE string.
    cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' input = lv_iso_xstring )->read( IMPORTING data = lv_decoded_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decoded_string exp = lv_original_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_iso88591_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_direct_codepage_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Test mit Sonderzeichen €'.
    DATA(lv_iso_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    " Convert original string to ISO-8859-1 xstring (note: € is not in ISO-8859-1, will be replaced)
    cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' )->write( data = lv_original_string )->get_buffer( IMPORTING buffer = lv_iso_xstring ).

    " Direct conversion from ISO-8859-1 to UTF-8
    lv_utf8_xstring = lo_converter->convert_direct(
      iv_input_xstring = lv_iso_xstring
      iv_source_encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      iv_target_encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    " Convert back to string from UTF-8 to verify
    DATA(lv_decoded_string) TYPE string.
    cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' input = lv_utf8_xstring )->read( IMPORTING data = lv_decoded_string ).
    " The € will be replaced by # during ISO-8859-1 conversion, so expect that in the result
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decoded_string exp = 'Test mit Sonderzeichen #' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CONV_X2X_CE` ermöglicht eine direkte Konvertierung von binären Daten (`XSTRING`) von einer externen Codepage in eine andere, ohne den Umweg über die interne ABAP-Systemcodepage. Dies kann in Szenarien, in denen die Daten nicht als ABAP-String interpretiert werden sollen oder müssen, effizienter sein und potenzielle Datenverluste durch Zwischenkonvertierungen vermeiden. Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der in einer bestimmten Codepage (z.B. UTF-8) vorliegt, in einen `XSTRING` und dann wieder zurück in einen String, um die Roundtrip-Fähigkeit der Konvertierung zu demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` und `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` nacheinander.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_roundtrip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_roundtrip
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_string TYPE string
        iv_encoding        TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_roundtrip_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_roundtrip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_roundtrip.
    DATA: lv_xstring_buffer TYPE xstring.

    " String to XSTRING (external encoding)
    DATA(lo_out_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_encoding
    ).
    lo_out_conv->write( data = iv_original_string ).
    lv_xstring_buffer = lo_out_conv->get_buffer( ).

    " XSTRING (external encoding) back to String (system encoding)
    DATA(lo_in_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_encoding
      input    = lv_xstring_buffer
    ).
    lo_in_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_roundtrip_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_roundtrip_iso88591 FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_roundtrip_utf8.
    DATA(lo_roundtrip) = NEW zcl_codepage_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = 'Simple ASCII Text'.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_roundtrip->perform_roundtrip( iv_original_string = lv_original iv_encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_original ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_roundtrip_iso88591.
    DATA(lo_roundtrip) = NEW zcl_codepage_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = 'Text mit Umlauten: äöü'.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_roundtrip->perform_roundtrip( iv_original_string = lv_original iv_encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_original ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_roundtrip_with_special_chars.
    DATA(lo_roundtrip) = NEW zcl_codepage_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = 'Grüße aus München mit € und ©'.
    " Note: ISO-8859-1 does not support € or ©, so they will be replaced.
    " UTF-8 supports them.
    DATA(lv_result_utf8) = lo_roundtrip->perform_roundtrip( iv_original_string = lv_original iv_encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_utf8 exp = lv_original ).

    DATA(lv_result_iso) = lo_roundtrip->perform_roundtrip( iv_original_string = lv_original iv_encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    " Expected replacement characters for € and © in ISO-8859-1
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_iso exp = 'Grüße aus München mit # und #' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine wichtige Validierung, um sicherzustellen, dass die gewählte Codepage alle benötigten Zeichen korrekt darstellen kann und keine Datenverluste während der Konvertierung auftreten. Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String Steuerzeichen enthält, und entfernen Sie diese gegebenenfalls.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_char_utilities=>control_chars` und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chu_control_chars DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_control_chars
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_contains) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS remove_control_chars
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chu_control_chars IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_control_chars.
    DATA(lv_control_chars) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>control_chars.
    IF iv_input CP '*' && lv_control_chars && '*'.
      rb_contains = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_contains = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_control_chars.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input.
    DATA(lv_control_chars) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>control_chars.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[' && lv_control_chars && ']' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ''.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in einen JSON-String, wobei nur bestimmte Felder ausgewählt und umbenannt werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` und `AS` für die Feldumbenennung in einer lokalen Struktur, bevor Sie `cl_fdt_json` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_sflight_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             flight_id   TYPE sflight-connid,
             carrier_code TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price_value TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_sflight_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_json.
    DATA lt_sflight_data TYPE tt_flight_info.

    SELECT connid AS flight_id,
           carrid AS carrier_code,
           fldate AS flight_date,
           price  AS price_value
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_data.

    DATA(lo_json_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_writer( ).
    lo_json_writer->write_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_data = lt_sflight_data
      RECEIVING
        r_json = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_projection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sflight_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_projection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_sflight_projection( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt Daten für 'AA' in SFLIGHT
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->get_sflight_json( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FLIGHT_ID"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"CARRIER_CODE":"AA"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"PRICE_VALUE"' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sflight_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_sflight_projection( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt keine Daten für 'XX' in SFLIGHT
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->get_sflight_json( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_json exp = '[]' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von `SELECT` mit Feldumbenennungen (`AS`) in eine speziell definierte lokale Struktur kann die Ausgabe der `SFLIGHT`-Daten für die JSON-Serialisierung präzise gesteuert werden. Dies ermöglicht die Erstellung von JSON-Payloads, die exakt den Anforderungen externer Systeme entsprechen.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der eine dynamische Struktur hat (z.B. unbekannte Feldnamen), in ein `DATA` Objekt vom Typ `ANY` oder `DATA`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>create_reader()` und `read_data()` mit einem generischen Datentyp wie `DATA` oder `REF TO DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_deserialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS deserialize_dynamic_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_deserialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_dynamic_json.
    DATA(lo_json_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create_reader( ).
    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE REF TO data.
    lo_json_reader->read_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_json = iv_json_string
      RECEIVING
        r_data = ro_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize_dynamic_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_deserialize_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_dynamic_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_deserialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `{"dynamic_field1":"value1","dynamic_field2":123}`.
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_dynamic_json( lv_json ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <ls_data>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <ls_data> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field1> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DYNAMIC_FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <lv_field1>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field1> exp = 'value1' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field2> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DYNAMIC_FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <lv_field2>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field2> exp = 123 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_deserialize_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_deserialize( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"item_name":"Apple","quantity":10},{"item_name":"Banana","quantity":20}]`.
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_dynamic_json( lv_json ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_data> TYPE any table.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_data> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_data> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_data> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_item>).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_name> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ITEM_NAME' OF STRUCTURE <ls_item> TO <lv_name>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_name> exp = 'Apple' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deserialisierung in einen generischen Datentyp (`REF TO DATA`) ist entscheidend, wenn die Struktur des eingehenden JSON zur Kompilierzeit nicht vollständig bekannt ist. `cl_fdt_json` kann die Daten dynamisch in eine passende ABAP-Struktur oder -Tabelle umwandeln, die dann über Field-Symbols zur Laufzeit analysiert werden kann.
keywords: cl_fdt_json, JSON, Deserialization, Dynamic Data, REF TO DATA, Field-Symbols

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_initial_values( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_json_initial_values=>ty_data(

      field2 = 0 " Initial for I
      field3 = ''  " Initial for STRING
    ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_with_initials( ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FIELD1":"Value1"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FIELD2":0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FIELD3":""' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_initial_values( ).

      field1 = ''

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FIELD1":""' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FIELD2":0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = '"FIELD3":""' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `cl_fdt_json` serialisiert standardmäßig alle Felder einer ABAP-Struktur, auch wenn sie Initialwerte enthalten. Dies ist ein wichtiges Verhalten, das bei der Gestaltung von JSON-Schnittstellen berücksichtigt werden muss, da es zu größeren Payloads führen kann, wenn viele optionale Felder leer sind.
keywords: cl_fdt_json, JSON, Serialization, Initial Values, Empty Fields

Instructions: Behandeln Sie Fehler, die während der Deserialisierung eines ungültigen JSON-Strings auftreten können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um Ausnahmen vom Typ `cx_fdt_json_parse_error` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_simple_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_simple_data
      RAISING
        cx_fdt_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_json_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_json_reader->read_data(
          EXPORTING
            i_json = iv_json_string
          RECEIVING
            r_data = rs_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen der Fehlermeldung
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_fdt_json_parse_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_error->textid
            previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_json FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_json EXPECTING CX_FDT_JSON_PARSE_ERROR.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `{"ID":1,"TEXT":"Valid JSON"}`.
    DATA(ls_data) = lo_cut->deserialize_with_error_handling( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-text exp = 'Valid JSON' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `{"ID":1,"TEXT":"Invalid JSON"`. " Missing closing brace
    lo_cut->deserialize_with_error_handling( lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deserialisierung von JSON-Strings kann fehlschlagen, wenn der String syntaktisch ungültig ist. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahme `cx_fdt_json_parse_error` ist unerlässlich, um solche Fehler abzufangen und robusten Code zu schreiben, der auf ungültige Eingaben reagieren kann.
keywords: cl_fdt_json, JSON, Deserialization, Error Handling, Exception, cx_fdt_json_parse_error

Instructions: Zeigen Sie den Inhalt einer externen URL in einem ABAP-Browser an. Beachten Sie, dass der Zugriff auf externe URLs von der Systemkonfiguration abhängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` um den Inhalt der URL abzurufen und dann `cl_abap_browser=>show_html` zum Anzeigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_brw_show_url DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_url_content IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_brw_show_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_url_content.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_content     TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url( EXPORTING url    = iv_url
                                   IMPORTING client = lo_http_client
                                   EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Client creation failed'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send( EXPORTING timeout = 10
                          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Send failed'.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Receive failed'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_content = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).
    lo_http_client->close( ).

    cl_abap_browser=>show_html( iv_html = lv_content ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_url_content FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_url_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_brw_show_url( ).
    " For unit testing, we cannot reliably access external URLs.
    " This test primarily ensures the method can be called and handles a dummy URL.
    " In a real scenario, you would mock cl_http_client.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_url_content( iv_url = 'https://www.example.com' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Method call should not dump' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Depending on system configuration, external access might be blocked.
        " For a unit test, we might accept this as a valid outcome if external access is not configured.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Error accessing URL: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man externe Web-Inhalte in ABAP integrieren kann. Es verwendet `cl_http_client` zum Abrufen des Inhalts einer URL und `cl_abap_browser` zur Anzeige. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario, das die Interaktion von ABAP mit Web-Ressourcen demonstriert.
keywords: cl_abap_browser, cl_http_client, URL, Web, HTTP, UI

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_input.
    TYPES tt_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_output,
             key   TYPE string,
             data  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_output.
    TYPES tt_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_output) TYPE tt_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_collect.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR ls_input IN it_input
                           WHERE ( id MOD 2 = 0 ) " Nur gerade IDs
                           ( key  = |ID_{ ls_input-id }|
                             data = to_upper( ls_input-value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) und fügen Sie das Ergebnis in eine andere Tabelle ein, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Werte zu summieren oder zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_flight_data IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated) TYPE tt_carrier_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_data.
    DATA(lt_grouped_by_carrier) = VALUE tt_carrier_total(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( sum + ls_group_flight-price ) )
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( count + 1 ) ) ) ).

    rt_aggregated = lt_grouped_by_carrier.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_aggregate( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_itb_reduce_aggregate=>tt_sflight_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250104' price = '50.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_flight_data( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-total_price exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_result) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-total_price exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF` für eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Datenaggregation. Es ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Daten und das Anwenden von Aggregationsfunktionen (wie Summe und Zählung) auf jede Gruppe, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, FOR GROUPS OF, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die Flüge aus `sflights` lädt, filtert und die Anzahl der Ergebnisse zurückgibt, unter Verwendung von Method Chaining.
hint: Entwerfen Sie Methoden, die `ME` (eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Instanz) zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS load_flights RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_method_chaining.
    METHODS filter_by_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
                              RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_flight_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialisierung, falls nötig
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @mt_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_carrier.
    mt_flights = FILTER #( mt_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_count.
    rv_count = lines( mt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_oo_method_chaining( ).

    " Test data setup (assuming sflight has data, or mock it)
    " For simplicity, we'll assume sflight has some data for 'LH'
    " In a real unit test, you'd use test doubles for database access.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_processor->load_flights( )->filter_by_carrier( 'LH' )->get_flight_count( ).

    " Assert that some flights for 'LH' were found (assuming sflight has LH data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_count msg = 'Should find some LH flights' ).

    DATA(lv_count_no_filter) = lo_processor->load_flights( )->get_flight_count( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_count_no_filter msg = 'Should find some flights without filter' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_count_no_filter >= lv_count ) msg = 'Filtered count should be less than or equal to total count' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss von Operationen, indem Methoden eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`ME`) zurückgeben. Dies ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten, was den Code kompakter und ausdrucksstärker macht, ähnlich wie in anderen modernen Programmiersprachen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Internal Tables, sflights, Fluent API

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate_min TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fldate_max TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_aggregate IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_aggregate.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights
                           GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                           ( carrid      = carrid
                             fldate_min  = REDUCE fldate( INIT min_date = ls_flight-fldate FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( COND #( WHEN ls_group_flight-fldate < min_date THEN ls_group_flight-fldate ELSE min_date ) ) )
                             fldate_max  = REDUCE fldate( INIT max_date = ls_flight-fldate FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( COND #( WHEN ls_group_flight-fldate > max_date THEN ls_group_flight-fldate ELSE max_date ) ) )
                             total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( sum + ls_group_flight-price ) )
                             flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( count + 1 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine `RANGE`-Tabelle, die alle Fluggesellschaften außer 'LH' und 'UA' enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und `WHERE` für die Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_exclude_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        it_all_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_exclude_carrid_range.
    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( 
      FOR carrid_val IN it_all_carrids
      WHERE ( carrid_val <> 'LH' AND carrid_val <> 'UA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = carrid_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen wöchentlich wiederkehrenden Termin für 10 Wochen unter Verwendung von `CL_APPOINTMENT`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_app_recurring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_weekly_recurring_appointment
      IMPORTING
        iv_subject TYPE string
        iv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_duration_secs TYPE i
        iv_num_weeks TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_appointment) TYPE REF TO cl_appointment.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_recurring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_weekly_recurring_appointment.
    DATA: lv_end_tstmp TYPE timestampl.

    lv_end_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = iv_start_tstmp iv_secs = iv_duration_secs ).

    ro_appointment = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    ro_appointment->set_subject( iv_subject ).
    ro_appointment->set_start_date_time( iv_start_tstmp ).
    ro_appointment->set_end_date_time( lv_end_tstmp ).

    " Set weekly recurrence
    ro_appointment->set_recurrence_pattern(
      iv_pattern_type = cl_appointment=>co_pattern_weekly
      iv_interval     = 1 " Every week
      iv_end_type     = cl_appointment=>co_end_type_after_occurrences
      iv_occurrences  = iv_num_weeks
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Ändern Sie den Betreff eines bestehenden Termins unter Verwendung von `CL_APPOINTMENT`.

CLASS zcl_app_modify_subject DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_app_modify_subject IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_appointment_subject.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie einen Termin aus einer internen Tabelle von `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekten basierend auf seinem Betreff. Nutzen Sie die moderne `FILTER`-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um die interne Tabelle neu zu erstellen, ohne den zu löschenden Termin.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_remove_from_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_appointment_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_appointment_by_subject
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE ty_appointment_tt
        iv_subject_to_remove TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE ty_appointment_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_remove_from_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_appointment_by_subject.
    rt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #( it_appointments WHERE subject <> iv_subject_to_remove ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_remove_non_existing_app FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_remove_from_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_existing_app.
    DATA: lt_appointments TYPE zcl_app_remove_from_table=>ty_appointment_tt.

    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( ). lo_app1->set_subject( 'Meeting A' ).
    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( ). lo_app2->set_subject( 'Meeting B' ).
    DATA(lo_app3) = NEW cl_appointment( ). lo_app3->set_subject( 'Meeting C' ).

    APPEND lo_app1 TO lt_appointments.
    APPEND lo_app2 TO lt_appointments.
    APPEND lo_app3 TO lt_appointments.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_remove_from_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_appointment_by_subject( it_appointments = lt_appointments iv_subject_to_remove = 'Meeting B' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]->get_subject( ) exp = 'Meeting A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]->get_subject( ) exp = 'Meeting C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_remove_non_existing_app.
    DATA: lt_appointments TYPE zcl_app_remove_from_table=>ty_appointment_tt.

    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( ). lo_app1->set_subject( 'Meeting A' ).
    APPEND lo_app1 TO lt_appointments.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_remove_from_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_appointment_by_subject( it_appointments = lt_appointments iv_subject_to_remove = 'Meeting X' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]->get_subject( ) exp = 'Meeting A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_remove_from_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_appointments TYPE zcl_app_remove_from_table=>ty_appointment_tt.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_remove_from_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_appointment_by_subject( it_appointments = lt_appointments iv_subject_to_remove = 'Meeting A' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das 'Löschen' eines Objekts aus einer internen Tabelle wird in modernem ABAP oft durch die Neuerstellung der Tabelle mittels `FILTER` erreicht, wobei nur die gewünschten Elemente beibehalten werden. Dies ist eine funktionale und effiziente Methode, die die ursprüngliche Tabelle nicht direkt modifiziert.
keywords: CL_APPOINTMENT, Internal Tables, FILTER, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie mehrere `RANGE`-Tabellen zu einer einzigen, die alle Einträge enthält. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die `RANGE`-Tabellen zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_range_of_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid,
           ty_range_of_carrid_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_of_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_ranges TYPE ty_range_of_carrid_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_range) TYPE ty_range_of_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_ranges.
    rt_combined_range = REDUCE #( INIT r = VALUE ty_range_of_carrid( )
                                  FOR one_range IN it_ranges
                                  NEXT r = VALUE ty_range_of_carrid( BASE r ( LINES OF one_range ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_combine_single_range FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_two_ranges.
    DATA: lt_range1 TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid,
          lt_range2 TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid,
          lt_ranges TYPE zcl_rng_combine=>ty_range_of_carrid_tt.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) TO lt_range1.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ) TO lt_range1.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ) TO lt_range2.

    APPEND lt_range1 TO lt_ranges.
    APPEND lt_range2 TO lt_ranges.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->combine_ranges( lt_ranges ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-low exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-low exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-low exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_combine_empty_ranges.
    DATA: lt_ranges TYPE zcl_rng_combine=>ty_range_of_carrid_tt.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->combine_ranges( lt_ranges ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_combine_single_range.
    DATA: lt_range1 TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid,
          lt_ranges TYPE zcl_rng_combine=>ty_range_of_carrid_tt.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) TO lt_range1.
    APPEND lt_range1 TO lt_ranges.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->combine_ranges( lt_ranges ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-low exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für die Aggregation von Daten. Hier wird er verwendet, um iterativ Einträge aus mehreren `RANGE`-Tabellen in eine einzige Zieltabelle zu kopieren. Die `BASE`-Option im `VALUE`-Konstruktor ermöglicht das Hinzufügen neuer Zeilen zu einer bereits bestehenden Tabelle.
keywords: RANGES, REDUCE, Data Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Fluggesellschaft basierend auf ihrer Zugehörigkeit zu einer bestimmten `RANGE` eine Kategorie zu. Nutzen Sie den `CASE` Ausdruck mit `WHEN IN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CASE` Ausdruck mit `WHEN IN` für `RANGE` Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_case_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    METHODS get_carrid_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-DATA gt_premium_carrids TYPE ty_carrid_range.
    CLASS-DATA gt_economy_carrids TYPE ty_carrid_range.

    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_case_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) TO gt_premium_carrids.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ) TO gt_premium_carrids.

    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ) TO gt_economy_carrids.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'DL' ) TO gt_economy_carrids.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_carrid_category.
    rv_category = CASE iv_carrid
                    WHEN IN gt_premium_carrids THEN 'Premium'
                    WHEN IN gt_economy_carrids THEN 'Economy'
                    ELSE 'Other'
                  END CASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob zwei Termine sich zeitlich überschneiden. Nutzen Sie die Start- und Endzeiten der `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekte.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die Start- und Endzeitstempel der beiden Termine. Zwei Intervalle [A, B] und [C, D] überschneiden sich, wenn A <= D und C <= B.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_overlap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_overlap
      IMPORTING
        io_appointment1 TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
        io_appointment2 TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_overlaps) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_overlap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_overlap.
    IF io_appointment1 IS NOT BOUND OR io_appointment2 IS NOT BOUND.
      rv_overlaps = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_start1) = io_appointment1->get_start_date_time( ).
    DATA(lv_end1)   = io_appointment1->get_end_date_time( ).
    DATA(lv_start2) = io_appointment2->get_start_date_time( ).
    DATA(lv_end2)   = io_appointment2->get_end_date_time( ).

    IF lv_start1 <= lv_end2 AND lv_start2 <= lv_end1.
      rv_overlaps = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_overlaps = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_overlapping_appointments FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_overlapping_appointments FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_adjacent_appointments FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_one_contains_other FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unbound_appointment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_overlapping_appointments.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ).

    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app1->set_start_date_time( lv_tstmp_base ).
    lo_app1->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 3600 ) ). " 1 hour

    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app2->set_start_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 1800 ) ). " +30 mins
    lo_app2->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 5400 ) ). " +90 mins

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_overlap( ).
    DATA(lv_overlaps) = lo_cut->check_overlap( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_overlaps ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_overlapping_appointments.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ).

    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app1->set_start_date_time( lv_tstmp_base ).
    lo_app1->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 3600 ) ).

    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app2->set_start_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 7200 ) ). " +2 hours
    lo_app2->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 10800 ) ). " +3 hours

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_overlap( ).
    DATA(lv_overlaps) = lo_cut->check_overlap( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_overlaps ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_adjacent_appointments.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ).

    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app1->set_start_date_time( lv_tstmp_base ).
    lo_app1->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 3600 ) ).

    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app2->set_start_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 3600 ) ). " Starts exactly when app1 ends
    lo_app2->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 7200 ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_overlap( ).
    DATA(lv_overlaps) = lo_cut->check_overlap( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_overlaps ). " Adjacent is considered overlapping by the condition A <= D and C <= B
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_one_contains_other.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ).

    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app1->set_start_date_time( lv_tstmp_base ).
    lo_app1->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 7200 ) ). " 2 hours

    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app2->set_start_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 1800 ) ). " +30 mins
    lo_app2->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 3600 ) ). " +1 hour

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_overlap( ).
    DATA(lv_overlaps) = lo_cut->check_overlap( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_overlaps ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unbound_appointment.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ).
    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app1->set_start_date_time( lv_tstmp_base ).
    lo_app1->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 3600 ) ).

    DATA: lo_app_unbound TYPE REF TO cl_appointment.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_overlap( ).
    DATA(lv_overlaps) = lo_cut->check_overlap( io_appointment1 = lo_app1 io_appointment2 = lo_app_unbound ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_overlaps ).

    lv_overlaps = lo_cut->check_overlap( io_appointment1 = lo_app_unbound io_appointment2 = lo_app1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_overlaps ).

    lv_overlaps = lo_cut->check_overlap( io_appointment1 = lo_app_unbound io_appointment2 = lo_app_unbound ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_overlaps ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `CL_APPOINTMENT` keine direkte Methode zur Überschneidungsprüfung bietet, können die Start- und Endzeitstempel der Objekte verwendet werden, um diese Logik manuell zu implementieren. Die Bedingung `(Start1 <= End2 AND Start2 <= End1)` ist eine gängige und effiziente Methode, um die Überschneidung zweier Zeitintervalle zu bestimmen. Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT`-Abfrage auf der Tabelle `sflights` aus, wobei die Auswahl der Fluggesellschaften über eine `RANGE`-Tabelle gesteuert wird.

CLASS zcl_rng_select_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_result,
           ty_sflight_result_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_result_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_select_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrid_range.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrid_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_with_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_with_empty_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_with_not_in_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_with_range.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid( 
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_select_db( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrid_range( lt_carrid_range ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS contains data for LH and AA
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( flight-carrid = 'LH' ) ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( flight-carrid = 'AA' ) ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( COND #( FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( flight-carrid = 'UA' ) ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_with_empty_range.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_select_db( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrid_range( lt_carrid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_with_not_in_range.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid( 
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) " Exclude LH
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_select_db( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrid_range( lt_carrid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( COND #( FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( flight-carrid = 'LH' ) ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle einzelnen Termine aus einem wiederkehrenden `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekt für einen bestimmten Zeitraum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_OCCURRENCES` der Klasse `CL_APPOINTMENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_get_occurrences DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_single_appointment,
             start_tstmp TYPE timestampl,
             end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_single_appointment,
           ty_single_appointment_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_single_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_recurring_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        io_recurring_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
        iv_period_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_period_end_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occurrences) TYPE ty_single_appointment_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_get_occurrences IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_recurring_occurrences.
    IF io_recurring_appointment IS NOT BOUND OR NOT io_recurring_appointment->is_recurring( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_occurrences_raw) = io_recurring_appointment->get_occurrences(
      iv_period_start_date_time = iv_period_start_tstmp
      iv_period_end_date_time   = iv_period_end_tstmp
    ).

    rt_occurrences = VALUE #( FOR occurrence IN lt_occurrences_raw
                               ( start_tstmp = occurrence-start_date_time
                                 end_tstmp   = occurrence-end_date_time ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_weekly_occurrences.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ).
    DATA(lv_start_period) = lv_tstmp_base.
    DATA(lv_end_period) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 ). " 30 days

    DATA(lo_recurring_app) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_recurring_app->set_subject( 'Weekly Meeting' ).
    lo_recurring_app->set_start_date_time( lv_tstmp_base ).
    lo_recurring_app->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 3600 ) ). " 1 hour duration
    lo_recurring_app->set_recurrence_pattern(
      iv_pattern_type = cl_appointment=>co_pattern_weekly
      iv_interval     = 1
      iv_end_type     = cl_appointment=>co_end_type_after_occurrences
      iv_occurrences  = 5
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_get_occurrences( ).
    DATA(lt_occurrences) = lo_cut->get_recurring_occurrences(
      io_recurring_appointment = lo_recurring_app
      iv_period_start_tstmp    = lv_start_period
      iv_period_end_tstmp      = lv_end_period
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_occurrences ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_occurrences[ 1 ]-start_tstmp exp = lv_tstmp_base ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_occurrences_no_recurrence.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ).
    DATA(lv_start_period) = lv_tstmp_base.
    DATA(lv_end_period) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 3600 ).

    DATA(lo_single_app) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_single_app->set_subject( 'Single Event' ).
    lo_single_app->set_start_date_time( lv_tstmp_base ).
    lo_single_app->set_end_date_time( lv_end_period ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_get_occurrences( ).
    DATA(lt_occurrences) = lo_cut->get_recurring_occurrences(
      io_recurring_appointment = lo_single_app
      iv_period_start_tstmp    = lv_start_period
      iv_period_end_tstmp      = lv_end_period
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_occurrences ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_occurrences_outside_period.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_base) = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ).
    DATA(lv_start_period) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 60 * 60 * 24 * 60 ). " 60 days later
    DATA(lv_end_period) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_start_period iv_secs = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 ).

    DATA(lo_recurring_app) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_recurring_app->set_subject( 'Weekly Meeting' ).
    lo_recurring_app->set_start_date_time( lv_tstmp_base ).
    lo_recurring_app->set_end_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_base iv_secs = 3600 ) ).
    lo_recurring_app->set_recurrence_pattern(
      iv_pattern_type = cl_appointment=>co_pattern_weekly
      iv_interval     = 1
      iv_end_type     = cl_appointment=>co_end_type_after_occurrences
      iv_occurrences  = 5
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_get_occurrences( ).
    DATA(lt_occurrences) = lo_cut->get_recurring_occurrences(
      io_recurring_appointment = lo_recurring_app
      iv_period_start_tstmp    = lv_start_period
      iv_period_end_tstmp      = lv_end_period
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_occurrences ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_filter_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_appointment_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_appointments_by_weekday
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE ty_appointment_tt
        iv_weekday TYPE i " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE ty_appointment_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_filter_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_appointments_by_weekday.
    rt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #( it_appointments WHERE ( 
      get_start_date_time( ) IS NOT INITIAL AND 
      cl_abap_tstmp=>get_weekday( get_start_date_time( ) ) = iv_weekday 
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_monday.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_monday) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp( iv_date = '20251201' iv_time = '090000' ). " Monday
    DATA(lv_tstmp_tuesday) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp( iv_date = '20251202' iv_time = '090000' ). " Tuesday

    DATA(lo_app_tue1) = NEW cl_appointment( ). lo_app_tue1->set_start_date_time( lv_tstmp_tuesday ).
    DATA(lo_app_mon2) = NEW cl_appointment( ). lo_app_mon2->set_start_date_time( cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_monday iv_secs = 60*60*24*7 ) ). " Next Monday

    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE zcl_app_filter_weekday=>ty_appointment_tt( 
      ( lo_app_mon1 ) ( lo_app_tue1 ) ( lo_app_mon2 )

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_filter_weekday( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_appointments_by_weekday( it_appointments = lt_appointments iv_weekday = 1 ). " Monday

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE zcl_app_filter_weekday=>ty_appointment_tt( 
      ( lo_app_tue1 ) 
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_filter_weekday( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_appointments_by_weekday( it_appointments = lt_appointments iv_weekday = 1 ). " Monday

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_filter_weekday( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), um nur Flüge zu erhalten, deren Preis in einem bestimmten `RANGE` liegt und deren Fluggesellschaft nicht 'AA' ist. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit komplexen Bedingungen.

CLASS zcl_rng_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Finde alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Wortes in einem gegebenen Text und gib die Anzahl der Vorkommen zurück.
hint: Nutze die Anweisung `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit der Option `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_word_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_word_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_word TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_word_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_word_occurrences.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_word IN iv_text IGNORING CASE MATCH COUNT rv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_word FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_word.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_find_word_count( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Dies ist ein Test. Ein weiterer Test.`.
    DATA(lv_word) = `Test`.
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_word_occurrences( iv_text = lv_text iv_word = lv_word ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 Vorkommen finden' ).

    lv_count = lo_cut->count_word_occurrences( iv_text = `Kein Wort hier` iv_word = `existiert` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Sollte 0 Vorkommen finden' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF ... MATCH COUNT` Anweisung ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um die Anzahl der Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem String zu ermitteln. Die Option `IGNORING CASE` ermöglicht eine nicht-case-sensitive Suche direkt in der Anweisung.
keywords: FIND, String, Textsuche, Vorkommen, COUNT

Instructions: Extrahiere alle gültigen E-Mail-Adressen aus einem gegebenen Text mittels regulärer Ausdrücke und gib sie als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwende `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit der Option `RESULTS` und einem geeigneten Regex-Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_email_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_email_result,
             email TYPE string,
           END OF ty_email_result,
           tt_email_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_email_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE tt_email_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_email_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_emails.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b`.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text RESULTS lt_match_results.

    LOOP AT lt_match_results INTO DATA(ls_match_result).
      APPEND VALUE ty_email_result( email = iv_text+ls_match_result-offset(ls_match_result-length) ) TO rt_emails.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_emails FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_emails.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_find_email_regex( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Kontaktieren Sie uns unter info@example.com oder support@my-company.de. Ungültig: test@.com`.
    DATA(lt_emails) = lo_cut->extract_emails( iv_text = lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_emails ) exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 E-Mail-Adressen finden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[ 1 ]-email exp = 'info@example.com' msg = 'Erste E-Mail korrekt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[ 2 ]-email exp = 'support@my-company.de' msg = 'Zweite E-Mail korrekt' ).

    CLEAR lt_emails.
    lt_emails = lo_cut->extract_emails( iv_text = `Keine E-Mails hier.` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_emails msg = 'Sollte keine E-Mails finden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit der `RESULTS`-Option ist die moderne und effizienteste Art, Muster in Strings zu finden und die Trefferdetails (Offset, Länge) zu erhalten. Dies ermöglicht eine präzise Extraktion der gefundenen Substrings. Das Regex-Muster ist hier ein gängiges Muster für E-Mail-Adressen.
keywords: FIND, REGEX, String, E-Mail, Extraktion, RESULTS

Instructions: Implementiere eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Unterklassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (z.B. Fluggesellschaftscode) erstellt und zurückgibt. Nutze die Tabelle `sflights` als Datenquelle.
hint: Definiere eine abstrakte Basisklasse und konkrete Unterklassen. Die Factory-Methode sollte als `CLASS-METHOD` implementiert werden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_info.
  METHODS get_flight_details RETURNING VALUE(rv_details) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_base DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_info.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_flight_info~get_flight_details ABSTRACT.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_lh DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_flight_base FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_flight_info~get_flight_details REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_lh IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_info~get_flight_details.
    rv_details = |Lufthansa Flugdetails für { mv_carrid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_ua DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_flight_base FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_flight_info~get_flight_details REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_ua IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_info~get_flight_details.
    rv_details = |United Airlines Flugdetails für { mv_carrid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_flight_info) TYPE REF TO zif_flight_info
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_supported.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_info.
    CASE iv_carrid.
      WHEN 'LH'.
        ro_flight_info = NEW zcl_flight_lh( iv_carrid ).
      WHEN 'UA'.
        ro_flight_info = NEW zcl_flight_ua( iv_carrid ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_supported
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fluggesellschaft { iv_carrid } wird nicht unterstützt|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_factory_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_unsupported FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_creation.
    DATA(lo_flight_lh) = zcl_flight_factory=>create_flight_info( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_flight_lh msg = 'Lufthansa Objekt sollte erstellt werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_flight_lh->get_flight_details( ) exp = 'Lufthansa Flugdetails für LH' msg = 'Lufthansa Details korrekt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lo_flight_lh IS INSTANCE OF zcl_flight_lh ) msg = 'Sollte Instanz von zcl_flight_lh sein' ).

    DATA(lo_flight_ua) = zcl_flight_factory=>create_flight_info( 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_flight_ua msg = 'United Airlines Objekt sollte erstellt werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_flight_ua->get_flight_details( ) exp = 'United Airlines Flugdetails für UA' msg = 'United Airlines Details korrekt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lo_flight_ua IS INSTANCE OF zcl_flight_ua ) msg = 'Sollte Instanz von zcl_flight_ua sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_unsupported.
    TRY.
        zcl_flight_factory=>create_flight_info( 'XX' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Erwartete Ausnahme für nicht unterstützte Fluggesellschaft' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_not_supported.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Korrekte Ausnahme für nicht unterstützte Fluggesellschaft' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Factory-Methode `create_flight_info` ist als `CLASS-METHOD` implementiert, was bedeutet, dass sie ohne Instanz der Klasse aufgerufen werden kann. Dies ist ideal für die Objekterzeugung, da die Factory selbst keine Zustandsdaten benötigt. Das Design nutzt Polymorphie über das Interface `zif_flight_info`, um verschiedene Fluggesellschafts-Objekte einheitlich zu behandeln.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Factory Pattern, Objektorientierung, Polymorphie, Interface

Instructions: Filtern Sie die interne Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, deren 'PLANETYPE' ein bestimmtes Muster enthält, und geben Sie die gefilterten Zeilen zurück. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Tabellenverarbeitung.
hint: Kombiniere `FIND` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck für interne Tabellen, um die Filterung durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_in_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered,
           tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_in_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_planetype.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( FIND iv_pattern IN ls_flight-planetype IGNORING CASE )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                     fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                     planetype = ls_flight-planetype ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_find_in_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_planetype( '747' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge mit '747' im PLANETYPE in SFLIGHTS
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Sollte Flüge finden' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob alle gefundenen Flüge das Muster enthalten
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      FIND '747' IN ls_flight-planetype IGNORING CASE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'PLANETYPE sollte Muster enthalten' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR lt_flights.
    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_flights_by_planetype( 'XYZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Sollte keine Flüge für unbekanntes Muster finden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FIND` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck für interne Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel des `FOR`-Ausdrucks nutzt `FIND`, um dynamisch Zeilen zu filtern, deren `PLANETYPE`-Feld das gesuchte Muster enthält. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Tabellen zu filtern, ohne explizite `LOOP`s oder `READ TABLE`s.
keywords: FIND, Internal Tables, FOR, FILTER, SFLIGHT, PLANETYPE

Instructions: Erstelle eine Utility-Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die prüft, ob ein gegebener String ein Palindrom ist (liest sich vorwärts und rückwärts gleich).
hint: Implementiere die Prüflogik in einer `CLASS-METHOD`. Nutze String-Operationen wie `REVERSE` oder manuelle Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_palindrome
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_palindrome) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_palindrome.
    DATA(lv_cleaned_text) = to_lower( replace( val = iv_text regex = `[^a-zA-Z0-9]` with = `` ) ).
    DATA(lv_reversed_text) = reverse( lv_cleaned_text ).
    IF lv_cleaned_text = lv_reversed_text.
      rv_is_palindrome = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_palindrome = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_is_palindrome FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_palindrome.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_string_utils=>is_palindrome( 'Anna' ) msg = 'Anna sollte ein Palindrom sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_string_utils=>is_palindrome( 'Madam' ) msg = 'Madam sollte ein Palindrom sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_string_utils=>is_palindrome( 'A man, a plan, a canal: Panama' ) msg = 'Satz sollte ein Palindrom sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_string_utils=>is_palindrome( 'Hello' ) msg = 'Hello sollte kein Palindrom sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_string_utils=>is_palindrome( '' ) msg = 'Leerer String ist ein Palindrom' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_string_utils=>is_palindrome( 'A' ) msg = 'Einzelner Buchstabe ist ein Palindrom' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `is_palindrome` ist als `CLASS-METHOD` deklariert, was sie zu einer statischen Methode macht. Dies ist ideal für Utility-Funktionen, die keine Instanzdaten benötigen und direkt über den Klassennamen aufgerufen werden können. Die Lösung nutzt moderne String-Funktionen wie `to_lower`, `replace` (mit Regex) und `reverse` für eine kompakte und effiziente Prüfung.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Utility, Palindrom, String, REVERSE, REPLACE

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem größeren String und gib zusätzlich eine interne Tabelle mit den Startpositionen (Offset) und Längen jedes Vorkommens zurück.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF ... RESULTS` und die Struktur `match_result`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_all_results DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occurrence,
             offset TYPE i,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_occurrence,
           tt_occurrences TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occurrence WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_all_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_pattern  TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_count    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occurrences) TYPE tt_occurrences.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_all_results IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_occurrences.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_pattern IN iv_text
      IGNORING CASE
      MATCH COUNT ev_count

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Finde alle Zahlen (ganze Zahlen) in einem Text, multipliziere jede Zahl mit 2 und gib die Ergebnisse als einen durch Kommas getrennten String zurück. Nutze String Templates und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombiniere `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `REDUCE` und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_process_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers_in_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_process_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers_in_text.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `\d+`.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text RESULTS lt_match_results.

    rv_result_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_match IN lt_match_results
      LET lv_number = CONV i( iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) ) IN
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ lv_number * 2 }|
                 ELSE |{ s }, { lv_number * 2 }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_find_process_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Es gibt 10 Äpfel und 5 Birnen. Insgesamt 15 Früchte.`.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_numbers_in_text( lv_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '20, 10, 30' msg = 'Zahlen sollten korrekt verarbeitet werden' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->process_numbers_in_text( `Keine Zahlen hier.` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' msg = 'Sollte leeren String für keine Zahlen zurückgeben' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->process_numbers_in_text( `Nur eine Zahl: 7` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '14' msg = 'Einzelne Zahl korrekt verarbeitet' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` zur Extraktion von Zahlen und dem `REDUCE`-Operator zur Aggregation und Transformation der Ergebnisse. `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, eine Schleife über die gefundenen Treffer zu iterieren, jede Zahl zu multiplizieren und sie dann mit String Templates zu einem einzigen, kommaseparierten String zu verbinden. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und kompakter Ansatz für komplexe String-Manipulationen.
keywords: FIND, REGEX, String Templates, REDUCE, Zahlen, Transformation

Instructions: Implementiere das Singleton-Pattern für eine Klasse, um sicherzustellen, dass nur eine Instanz dieser Klasse existiert und global zugänglich ist.
hint: Verwende einen privaten Konstruktor, eine private statische Referenz und eine öffentliche `CLASS-METHOD` zum Abrufen der Instanz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_singleton DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton.

    METHODS get_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA go_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_singleton.
    DATA mv_creation_time TYPE timestampl.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_singleton IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD mv_creation_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance.
    IF go_instance IS NOT BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT go_instance.
    ENDIF.
    ro_instance = go_instance.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message.
    rv_message = |Singleton Instanz erstellt um: { mv_creation_time }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_singleton_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_singleton_pattern.
    DATA(lo_instance1) = zcl_singleton=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_instance2) = zcl_singleton=>get_instance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_instance1 msg = 'Erste Instanz sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance1 exp = lo_instance2 msg = 'Beide Instanzen sollten identisch sein' ).

    DATA(lv_message1) = lo_instance1->get_message( ).
    DATA(lv_message2) = lo_instance2->get_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message1 exp = lv_message2 msg = 'Nachrichten sollten identisch sein' ).

    " Test, dass der Konstruktor nur einmal aufgerufen wird (implizit durch die gleiche Instanz)
    " Die Zeitstempel sollten identisch sein.
    DATA(lv_time1) = lo_instance1->mv_creation_time.
    DATA(lv_time2) = lo_instance2->mv_creation_time.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_time1 exp = lv_time2 msg = 'Erstellungszeiten sollten identisch sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Singleton-Pattern wird hier durch einen privaten Konstruktor (`CREATE PRIVATE`) und eine öffentliche `CLASS-METHOD` `get_instance` implementiert. Die `CLASS-METHOD` prüft, ob bereits eine Instanz existiert (`go_instance IS NOT BOUND`). Falls nicht, wird eine neue Instanz erstellt und in der statischen Klassenattribut `go_instance` gespeichert. Bei jedem weiteren Aufruf wird die bereits existierende Instanz zurückgegeben. Dies stellt sicher, dass es immer nur eine einzige Instanz der Klasse gibt.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Singleton, Objektorientierung, Design Pattern, CREATE PRIVATE

Instructions: Führe eine dynamische Suche in einem Text durch, wobei das Suchmuster zur Laufzeit als Variable übergeben wird. Gib alle gefundenen Treffer zurück.
hint: Verwende `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF ... IN ... IN TABLE ...` mit einem dynamischen Muster.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_found_string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_found_string,
           tt_found_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_found_string WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_found_strings) TYPE tt_found_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_dynamic_pattern.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_pattern IN iv_text
      IGNORING CASE
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    rt_found_strings = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_match_results
                                ( value = iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn das Suchkriterium vom Benutzer eingegeben wird oder sich basierend auf anderen Logiken ändert. Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Wortes in einem Text durch ein anderes Wort. Nutzen Sie `REPLACE` mit `FIND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_replace_word DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_all_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text       TYPE string
        iv_old_word   TYPE string
        iv_new_word   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_word IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_all_words.
    rv_result_text = iv_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_word IN rv_result_text
      WITH iv_new_word
      IGNORING CASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse mit einer `CLASS-METHOD`, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften (z.B. aus `sflights`) als Eingabe nimmt und eine interne Tabelle mit den eindeutigen Fluggesellschaftscodes zurückgibt. Nutze moderne ABAP-Syntax.
