Instructions: Suchen Sie in einem gegebenen Text nach allen Wörtern, die mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnen, und geben Sie diese Wörter in Großbuchstaben zurück. Nutzen Sie `FIND` mit Regex und `MAP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und verarbeiten Sie die Ergebnisse mit `MAP` oder `FOR` und `to_upper`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_prefix_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_words TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_and_uppercase_prefix_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE tt_words.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_prefix_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_and_uppercase_prefix_words.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = |\b{ iv_prefix }\w*\b|.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      IGNORING CASE
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    rt_words = VALUE #( FOR ls_match IN lt_match_results
                        ( to_upper( iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words[ 1 ] exp = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words[ 2 ] exp = 'ABAP' ).

Die `RESULTS`-Option liefert die Trefferdetails, die dann mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und der String-Funktion `to_upper` in eine Tabelle von Großbuchstaben-Wörtern umgewandelt werden. Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse mit einer `CLASS-METHOD`, die eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` als Eingabe nimmt und eine aggregierte Statistik (z.B. Gesamtanzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft) zurückgibt. Nutze moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Aggregation.

CLASS zcl_flight_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

           END OF ty_carrid_stats,

CLASS zcl_flight_stats IMPLEMENTATION.

                           flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle einen HTTP-Service, der JSON-Daten über eine POST-Anfrage empfängt. Der Service soll die empfangenen JSON-Daten deserialisieren und einen Wert daraus extrahieren, der dann in der HTTP-Antwort zurückgegeben wird.
hint: Nutze `SERVER->REQUEST->GET_CDATA()` für die JSON-Payload und `/UI2/CL_JSON=>DESERIALIZE` zum Parsen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_post DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_post IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_request) = server->request.
    DATA(lo_response) = server->response.
    DATA lv_json_input TYPE string.
    DATA ls_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_message_value TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_json_input = lo_request->get_cdata( ).

        " Deserialize JSON
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_json_input
                                   CHANGING  data = ls_data ).

        ASSIGN ls_data->* TO <fs_data>.
        IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_data> IS STRUCTURE.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'message' OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_message>).
          IF <fs_message> IS ASSIGNED.
            lv_message_value = <fs_message>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Empfangene Nachricht: { lv_message_value }| ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).

      CATCH /ui2/cl_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( |JSON Deserialisierungsfehler: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Allgemeiner Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Die Verwendung von `DATA REF TO data` und Field-Symbols ermöglicht eine flexible Handhabung unbekannter JSON-Strukturen. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist essentiell.

Instructions: Implementiere einen HTTP-Service, der eine einfache JSON-Antwort zurückgibt, die den aktuellen Zeitstempel enthält.

CLASS zcl_http_json_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_http_json_get IMPLEMENTATION.

             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_response_data.

Instructions: Implementiere einen HTTP-Service, der Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` abruft (gefiltert nach Fluggesellschaft aus einem URL-Parameter) und die Ergebnisse als JSON-Array zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze `SELECT` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und `/UI2/CL_JSON=>SERIALIZE` für JSON. Lese den Filterwert aus einem URL-Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_sflights_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_sflights_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_request) = server->request.
    DATA(lo_response) = server->response.
    DATA lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lv_json_output TYPE string.

Instructions: Implementiere einen HTTP-Service, der bei einer ungültigen Anfrage (z.B. fehlender Parameter) einen HTTP-Statuscode 400 (Bad Request) und eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurückgibt. Bei einem internen Fehler soll ein 500er Statuscode gesendet werden.
hint: Nutze `SERVER->RESPONSE->SET_STATUS()` und `SERVER->RESPONSE->SET_CDATA()` für die Fehlermeldung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_request) = server->request.
    DATA(lo_response) = server->response.
    DATA lv_param TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_param = lo_request->get_form_field( 'required_param' ).

        IF lv_param IS INITIAL.
          " Bad Request
          lo_response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
          lo_response->set_cdata( 'Fehler: Der Parameter "required_param" fehlt.' ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Simulate an internal error for a specific parameter value
        IF lv_param = 'ERROR'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.

        lo_response->set_cdata( |Parameter 'required_param' empfangen: { lv_param }| ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        " Internal Server Error
        lo_response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Interner Fehler aufgetreten: { lx_static_check->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Catch all other unexpected errors
        lo_response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_sflights_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

CLASS zcl_http_sflights_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_response) = server->response.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lv_csv_data TYPE string.
    DATA lv_filename TYPE string.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Build CSV header
    lv_csv_data = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC;CITYFROM;CITYTO'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lv_csv_data.

    " Build CSV data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_csv_data = |{ lv_csv_data }{ ls_flight-carrid };{ ls_flight-connid };{ ls_flight-fldate };{ ls_flight-price };{ ls_flight-currency };{ ls_flight-planetype };{ ls_flight-seatsmax };{ ls_flight-seatsocc };{ ls_flight-cityfrom };{ ls_flight-cityto }\r\n|.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_filename = |sflights_{ sy-datum }-{ sy-uzeit }.csv|.

    lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/csv' ).
    lo_response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Disposition' value = |attachment; filename="{ lv_filename }"| ).
    lo_response->set_cdata( lv_csv_data ).
    lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Zusatz in einer `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( 
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Expected flight counts, but none found.' act = lt_flight_counts ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_flight_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT ls_lh_count ].
    IF ls_lh_count IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'LH flight count should be greater than 0.' act = ls_lh_count-flight_count exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_total_flights.
    DATA(lv_sum_counts) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_count IN lt_flight_counts NEXT s = s + ls_count-flight_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum of grouped counts does not match total flights.' act = lv_sum_counts exp = lv_total_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Summe der gebuchten Sitze (`seatsocc`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupied_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupied_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_seats = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( 
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        total_occupied_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                         FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                         NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_seats) = lo_cut->get_occupied_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Expected carrier seat data, but none found.' act = lt_carrier_seats ).

    DATA(ls_lh_seats) = lt_carrier_seats[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT ls_lh_seats ].
    IF ls_lh_seats IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH occupied seats should be positive.' act = ( ls_lh_seats-total_occupied_seats > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_seatsocc) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight INTO lv_total_seatsocc.
    DATA(lv_sum_grouped_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_item IN lt_carrier_seats NEXT s = s + ls_item-total_occupied_seats ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum of grouped occupied seats does not match total.' act = lv_sum_grouped_seats exp = lv_total_seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` innerhalb eines `VALUE` Ausdrucks ist ein sehr mächtiges Muster in modernem ABAP. Es ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen über gruppierte Daten, ohne explizite Schleifen oder temporäre Variablen, was den Code extrem kompakt und funktional macht.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, Aggregation, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge von 'UA' (United Airlines) aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die mehr als 100 gebuchte Sitze haben, und geben Sie die Summe der freien Sitze (`seatsmax - seatsocc`) dieser Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` gefolgt von `REDUCE` oder `FOR` mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_chain_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_ua_free_seats_sum
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_free_seats_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_chain_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ua_free_seats_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_free_seats_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'UA' AND seatsocc > 100 )
      NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugverbindung (`connid`) und ermitteln Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung (`seatsocc / seatsmax`) pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `GROUP BY` für mehrere Felder und `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_multi_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_load,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             avg_load TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_load.
    TYPES tt_flight_load TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_load WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_load_by_carrier_connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_loads) TYPE tt_flight_load.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_multi_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_load_by_carrier_connid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_loads = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid
      ( 
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        avg_load = COND f(
                     WHEN GROUP SIZE > 0
                     THEN REDUCE f( INIT total_load = 0.0
                                    FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                    NEXT total_load = total_load + ( member-seatsocc / member-seatsmax ) ) / GROUP SIZE
                     ELSE 0.0
                   )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_avg_load FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_load.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_multi_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_loads) = lo_cut->get_avg_load_by_carrier_connid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Expected flight load data, but none found.' act = lt_flight_loads ).

    LOOP AT lt_flight_loads INTO DATA(ls_load).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Average load out of range (0-1).' act = ( ls_load-avg_load >= 0 AND ls_load-avg_load <= 1 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Gruppierung nach mehreren Feldern ist durch die Komma-Trennung im `GROUP BY` Zusatz einfach zu realisieren. Die Berechnung des Durchschnitts innerhalb jeder Gruppe zeigt die Flexibilität von `REDUCE` und `COND` für komplexe Aggregationen.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Multiple Fields, Aggregation, COND, Internal Tables

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `scarr`, für die es mindestens einen Flug in der Tabelle `sflight` gibt, der von dieser Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` auf `scarr` und prüfen Sie mit `LINE_EXISTS` in `sflight`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_active_carriers) TYPE tt_scarr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_flights.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight. 

    DATA(lt_sflight_hashed) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid
                              FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight ( ls_flight-carrid )
                              WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    rt_active_carriers = FILTER #( lt_scarr WHERE LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflight_hashed[ table_line = carrid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_active_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_active_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lt_active_carriers) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Expected active carriers, but none found.' act = lt_active_carriers ).

    DATA(ls_lh_carrier) = lt_active_carriers[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT ls_lh_carrier ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH should be an active carrier.' act = ls_lh_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` für effiziente Existenzprüfungen zwischen internen Tabellen verwendet werden kann. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `READ TABLE` oder `LOOP` mit `CHECK` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: FILTER, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Existence Check, HASHED TABLE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`). Filtern Sie anschließend nur die Gruppen heraus, die mehr als 5 Flüge enthalten, und geben Sie die Fluggesellschaften und deren Fluganzahl zurück.

CLASS zcl_group_filter_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid

Dies ist vergleichbar mit der `HAVING` Klausel in SQL und bietet eine sehr ausdrucksstarke Möglichkeit, Gruppen zu manipulieren.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings dynamisch basierend auf einem übergebenen Muster. Das Muster kann Wildcards (`*`) enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit `MATCHES` für Wildcard-Vergleiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_strings_with_wildcard
      IMPORTING iv_pattern TYPE string
                it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_strings_with_wildcard.
    DATA(lv_pattern_for_match) = iv_pattern.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '*' IN lv_pattern_for_match WITH '%'. " MATCHES uses SQL-like wildcards

    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_strings WHERE table_line MATCHES lv_pattern_for_match ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_wildcard FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_wildcard.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_dynamic( ).
    DATA lt_test_strings TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'APPLE' TO lt_test_strings.
    APPEND 'BANANA' TO lt_test_strings.
    APPEND 'APRICOT' TO lt_test_strings.
    APPEND 'ORANGE' TO lt_test_strings.

    DATA(lt_result1) = lo_cut->filter_strings_with_wildcard( iv_pattern = 'A*E' it_strings = lt_test_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 matches for A*E' act = lines( lt_result1 ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First match incorrect' act = lt_result1[1] exp = 'APPLE' ).

    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->filter_strings_with_wildcard( iv_pattern = '*ANA*' it_strings = lt_test_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 1 match for *ANA*' act = lines( lt_result2 ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second match incorrect' act = lt_result2[1] exp = 'BANANA' ).

    DATA(lt_result3) = lo_cut->filter_strings_with_wildcard( iv_pattern = 'Z*' it_strings = lt_test_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected 0 matches for Z*' act = lt_result3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `MATCHES` Operator im `WHERE` Zusatz des `FILTER` Ausdrucks ermöglicht flexible Wildcard-Vergleiche, ähnlich wie die `LIKE` Klausel in SQL. Dies ist besonders nützlich für dynamische Suchfunktionen, bei denen das Suchmuster zur Laufzeit definiert wird.
keywords: FILTER, MATCHES, Wildcard, Dynamic Filtering, String Processing, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugdatum (`fldate`). Für jede Gruppe sollen die Flugverbindungen (`connid`) als kommaseparierter String gesammelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit String-Templates, um die `connid`s zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_connections,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             connections TYPE string,
           END OF ty_grouped_connections.
    TYPES tt_grouped_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_connections WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connections_by_carrier_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_connections.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections_by_carrier_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid, fldate = ls_flight-fldate
      ( 
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        connections = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                    FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                    NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN member-connid ELSE |{ s }, { member-connid }| ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_connections FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_connections_by_carrier_date( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Expected grouped connections, but none found.' act = lt_result ).

    DATA(ls_entry) = lt_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Connections string should not be empty.' act = ls_entry-connections ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Connections string should contain comma if multiple.' act = ( count( val = ls_entry-connections regex = ',' ) >= 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um eine Liste von Werten innerhalb jeder Gruppe zu einem einzigen String zu verketten. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um aggregierte String-Listen zu erstellen.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, String Templates, String Concatenation, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Objekten (z.B. Instanzen einer Klasse `ZCL_FLIGHT_DATA`) basierend auf einer Eigenschaft des Objekts.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flight_objects.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect carrier in filtered object' act = lt_filtered_aa[1]->carrid exp = 'AA' ).

Der Zugriff auf Objekteigenschaften erfolgt direkt im `WHERE` Zusatz mit dem Objektzugriffsoperator `->`, was eine intuitive und typsichere Filterung ermöglicht.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Zahlen (`i`) nach ihrer Parität (gerade/ungerade) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der Zahlen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `GROUP BY` und einem Ausdruck für die Gruppierung (z.B. `( table_line MOD 2 )`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_parity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parity_sum,
             parity TYPE string, " 'EVEN' or 'ODD'
             sum_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_parity_sum.
    TYPES tt_parity_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parity_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_by_parity
      IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_parity_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_parity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_by_parity.
    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF lv_number IN it_numbers GROUP BY parity = COND string( WHEN ( lv_number MOD 2 ) = 0 THEN 'EVEN' ELSE 'ODD' )
      ( 
        parity = parity
        sum_value = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                              FOR member IN GROUP lv_number
                              NEXT s = s + member )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_parity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_parity( ).
    DATA lt_test_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 1 TO lt_test_numbers.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_test_numbers.
    APPEND 3 TO lt_test_numbers.

CLASS zcl_filter_inline_decl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_inline_decl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_get_valid_entries.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Datensätzen nach einem Datumsfeld (z.B. `fldate` aus `sflights`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe das früheste und späteste Datum sowie die Anzahl der Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für Min/Max-Datum und `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_summary,
             fldate_group TYPE sflight-fldate,
             min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             entry_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_date_summary.
    TYPES tt_date_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_date_summaries
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_date_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY fldate_group = ls_flight-fldate
      ( 
        fldate_group = fldate_group
        min_fldate = REDUCE sflight-fldate( INIT min_d = fldate_group
                                            FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                            NEXT min_d = COND sflight-fldate( WHEN member-fldate < min_d THEN member-fldate ELSE min_d ) )
        max_fldate = REDUCE sflight-fldate( INIT max_d = fldate_group
                                            FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                            NEXT max_d = COND sflight-fldate( WHEN member-fldate > max_d THEN member-fldate ELSE max_d ) )
        entry_count = GROUP SIZE
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_date_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_date_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_date_range( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_date_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Expected date summaries, but none found.' act = lt_result ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Min date should be <= Max date.' act = ( ls_summary-min_fldate <= ls_summary-max_fldate ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Entry count should be positive.' act = ( ls_summary-entry_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Group date should match min/max if only one entry.' act = ls_summary-fldate_group exp = ls_summary-min_fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Group date should match min/max if only one entry.' act = ls_summary-fldate_group exp = ls_summary-max_fldate ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` zur Berechnung von Minima, Maxima und Zählungen innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Die Verwendung von `COND` innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine kompakte Implementierung der Min/Max-Logik.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Date/Time, Aggregation, Internal Tables, COND, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen mithilfe von `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und der modernen Inline-Deklaration `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` für effizientes Lesen großer Datenmengen und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` und Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_in_chunks
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_chunk) PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_sflights_chunk TO rt_all_sflights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_sflights_in_chunks( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ). " Assuming SFLIGHTS has data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `OPEN CURSOR` ermöglicht das zeilenweise oder paketweise Lesen großer Datenmengen, was speicherschonender ist als ein kompletter `SELECT * INTO TABLE`. Die Verwendung von `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ist eine moderne Inline-Deklaration, die den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. `PACKAGE SIZE` optimiert die Performance durch das Holen von Daten in Blöcken.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH NEXT CURSOR, SELECT, INTO TABLE @DATA, Performance, Database Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein strukturiertes Anwendungsprotokoll mit `cl_bal_logobj`, um verschiedene Arten von Nachrichten (Erfolg, Warnung, Fehler) zu erfassen und zu speichern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj` zur Instanziierung, `add_message` für Nachrichten und `save_log` zum Speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_process_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_process_id TYPE string
        iv_success    TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_process_status.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_logobj=>create_log( ).

    IF iv_success = abap_true.
      cl_bal_logobj=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
          i_msgty      = 'S'
          i_msgid      = 'ZMSG_APP' " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine tatsächliche Nachrichtenklasse
          i_msgno      = '001'      " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine tatsächliche Nachrichtennummer
          i_msgv1      = iv_process_id
          i_text       = |Prozess { iv_process_id } erfolgreich abgeschlossen.|
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_bal_logobj=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
          i_msgty      = 'E'
          i_msgid      = 'ZMSG_APP' " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine tatsächliche Nachrichtenklasse
          i_msgno      = '002'      " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine tatsächliche Nachrichtennummer
          i_msgv1      = iv_process_id
          i_text       = |Prozess { iv_process_id } fehlgeschlagen.|
      ).
    ENDIF.

    cl_bal_logobj=>save_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_log_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_success.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_app_logger( ).
    lo_logger->log_process_status( iv_process_id = 'PROC_001' iv_success = abap_true ).
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man das Protokoll lesen, um es zu überprüfen.
    " Für Unit-Tests prüfen wir primär auf das Ausbleiben von Ausnahmen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Platzhalter für erfolgreiche Ausführung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_log_failure.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_app_logger( ).
    lo_logger->log_process_status( iv_process_id = 'PROC_002' iv_success = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Platzhalter für erfolgreiche Ausführung
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_bal_logobj` bietet eine standardisierte und robuste Methode zur Erstellung von Anwendungsprotokollen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Nachverfolgung von Prozessen und die Fehlerbehebung. Die Verwendung von `add_message` mit verschiedenen Nachrichtentypen ermöglicht eine granulare Protokollierung. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die dynamische Nachrichtenerstellung verwendet.
keywords: cl_bal_logobj, Application Log, Logging, BAL, String Templates

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_max
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_max.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights

CLASS zcl_table_expressions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_table_expressions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_planetype_for_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Bilden Sie Daten zwischen zwei Strukturen mit ähnlichen Feldnamen ab, indem Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... )` für die moderne, funktionale Datenabbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_d TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
    " Manuelle Zuweisung für nicht-korrespondierende Felder
    rs_target-field_d = |{ is_source-field_c }_mapped|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_operator( ).
    DATA ls_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_operator=>ty_source_data.
    ls_source-field_a = 'Value A'.
    ls_source-field_b = 123.
    ls_source-field_c = 'Value C'.

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_a exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_b exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_d exp = 'Value C_mapped' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator (`CORRESPONDING #( ... )`) ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit gleichnamigen Feldern abzubilden. Er reduziert den Boilerplate-Code für manuelle Zuweisungen und verbessert die Wartbarkeit, insbesondere bei vielen Feldern. Nicht-korrespondierende Felder können anschließend manuell zugewiesen werden.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Mapping, Structures, Data Transformation

CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax
        FROM sflights
        UP TO 5 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_flights.
      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Einträge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen mit `OPEN CURSOR` und `PACKAGE SIZE`. Sammeln Sie alle gelesenen Daten in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_flights_in_packages RETURNING VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax
        FROM sflights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_all_flights.
        CLEAR lt_package.
      ENDDO.
      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_fetch_packages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fetch_packages.
    DATA(lo_fetcher) = NEW zcl_sflight_cursor_package( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_fetcher->fetch_flights_in_packages( ).

    DATA(lv_sflights_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO lv_sflights_count.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_sflights_count msg = 'Total flights fetched should match SFLIGHTS count' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `PACKAGE SIZE` mit `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` ist entscheidend für die effiziente Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen, da sie den Hauptspeicher schont. Die Daten werden in kleineren Blöcken gelesen und können dann weiterverarbeitet werden. Die `DO...ENDDO`-Schleife mit `sy-subrc`-Prüfung ist die Standardmethode, um alle Pakete zu verarbeiten.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, PACKAGE SIZE, SFLIGHTS, DATABASE, LARGE DATASETS

CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_modern_proc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_and_filter_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_modern_proc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_and_filter_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax
        FROM sflights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        " Modern ABAP processing of the fetched package
        APPEND LINES OF VALUE tt_connid( FOR flight IN lt_package
                                          WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc > 200 )
                                          ( flight-connid ) ) TO rt_connids.

        CLEAR lt_package.
      ENDDO.
      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        UP TO lv_max_rows ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.

      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_error_hndl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_flights_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      EXPORTING
        et_flights    TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_error_hndl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_flights_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_message = |Tabelle '{ iv_table_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc, seatsmax
        FROM (iv_table_name).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_message = |Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors für Tabelle '{ iv_table_name }'. SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }|.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        IF sy-subrc = 4. " No more data
          EXIT.
        ELSE.
          rv_message = |Fehler beim Abrufen von Daten aus Tabelle '{ iv_table_name }'. SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }|.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO et_flights.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    rv_message = |Daten erfolgreich aus Tabelle '{ iv_table_name }' gelesen.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cursor_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight,
          lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO lt_all_flights.
        CLEAR lt_package.
      ENDDO.
      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    ENDIF.

    " Modern ABAP grouping after fetching all data
    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                     count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_sflight_cursor_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_grouper->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_counts msg = 'Should have flight counts for carriers' ).

    " Example: Check count for a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Profilparameter 'rdisp/max_wprun_time'. Wenn der Wert größer als 600 ist, geben Sie eine Warnmeldung zurück, andernfalls eine Erfolgsmeldung. Verwenden Sie eine `COND`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_cond_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_max_wprun_time_threshold RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_cond_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_max_wprun_time_threshold.
    DATA(lv_param_value_str) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( i_name = 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' ).
    DATA(lv_param_value_int) = 0.

    IF lv_param_value_str IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          lv_param_value_int = lv_param_value_str.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Keep 0 if conversion fails
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN lv_param_value_int > 600 THEN |Warnung: rdisp/max_wprun_time ist { lv_param_value_int }, was über dem empfohlenen Wert von 600 liegt.|
      ELSE |rdisp/max_wprun_time ist { lv_param_value_int }, was im akzeptablen Bereich liegt.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Profilparameter, deren Namen ein bestimmtes Muster enthalten (z.B. 'rdisp/'). Geben Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den Namen und Werten der gefundenen Parameter zurück. Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Ergebnisse zu sammeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_ALL_PARAMETERS` und eine `REDUCE`-Expression mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_param_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_profile_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_profile_param.
    TYPES: tt_profile_param TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_profile_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_params_by_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_params) TYPE tt_profile_param.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_params_by_pattern.
    DATA(lt_all_params) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters( ).

    rt_params = REDUCE tt_profile_param(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_profile_param( )
      FOR param IN lt_all_params
      WHERE ( param-name CP iv_pattern )
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( name = param-name, value = param-value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_profile_param_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_rdisp_params) = lo_reducer->get_params_by_pattern( 'rdisp/*' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_rdisp_params msg = 'Should find rdisp parameters' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( FOR param IN lt_rdisp_params
                                                ( param-name CP 'rdisp/*' ) ) IS NOT INITIAL
                                      msg = 'All parameters should match pattern' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_no_match.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_no_params msg = 'Should find no parameters for non-existent pattern' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `REDUCE`-Expression, um eine interne Tabelle basierend auf gefilterten Profilparametern zu erstellen. `REDUCE` ist eine leistungsstarke funktionale Konstruktion in modernem ABAP, die es ermöglicht, eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable (hier eine interne Tabelle) durch Iteration und Transformation einer anderen Datenquelle zu akkumulieren. Instructions: Verketten Sie alle eindeutigen Carrier-IDs aus der Tabelle `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas. Beispiel: 'LH,AA,UA,...'
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression in einem String-Template, um die Daten zu iterieren und zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_concat_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carriers_as_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_concat_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_as_string.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF carrid IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      ( carrid ) ).

    rv_carrier_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR carrier IN lt_unique_carriers
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN carrier
        ELSE s && ',' && carrier ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_concat_for( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_carriers_as_string( ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS contains at least 'LH' and 'AA'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'LH' msg = 'LH nicht im Ergebnis' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'AA' msg = 'AA nicht im Ergebnis' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Ergebnis-String ist leer' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, deren `CARRID` in einer gegebenen `RANGES`-Tabelle enthalten ist. Die `RANGES`-Tabelle soll 'LH' und 'AA' enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit der `IN`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    METHODS filter_sflights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE ty_range_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_all_sflights.

    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE zcl_ranges_filter=>ty_range_carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ) ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_by_carrid( it_carrid_range ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights have CARRID 'LH' or 'AA'
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH' OR <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA' ) msg = 'Unerwarteter CARRID gefunden' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that there are flights for LH and AA (assuming data exists)
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
      lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_lh_count > 0 ) msg = 'Keine LH Flüge gefunden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_aa_count > 0 ) msg = 'Keine AA Flüge gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine moderne und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Die `WHERE ... IN ranges_table`-Syntax ist dabei besonders effizient und lesbar, um Daten anhand einer `RANGES`-Tabelle zu selektieren.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, Internal Tables, IN operator, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle `low`-Werte aus einer `RANGES`-Tabelle auflistet, die als 'I' (Include) und 'EQ' (Equal) definiert sind, getrennt durch ein Semikolon. Beispiel: 'LH;AA;UA'
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die `RANGES`-Tabelle zu verarbeiten und einen String zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    METHODS get_included_carrids_string
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE ty_range_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_included_carrids_string.
    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR entry IN it_carrid_range
      WHERE ( entry-sign = 'I' AND entry-option = 'EQ' )
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN entry-low
        ELSE s && ';' && entry-low ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_reduce_ranges_mixed FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_ranges.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE zcl_ranges_reduce=>ty_range_carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ) ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_included_carrids_string( lt_carrid_range ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH;AA;UA' msg = 'String-Reduktion fehlgeschlagen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_ranges_mixed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE zcl_ranges_reduce=>ty_range_carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' ) " Exclude, should not be in result
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'UA' high = 'US' ) " Between, should not be in result (only EQ)
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'DL' ) ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_included_carrids_string( lt_carrid_range ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH;DL' msg = 'String-Reduktion mit gemischten Einträgen fehlgeschlagen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiger Operator, um interne Tabellen zu aggregieren und in einen einzelnen Wert umzuwandeln. Hier wird er verwendet, um selektive Einträge einer `RANGES`-Tabelle zu filtern und zu einem String zu verketten, was eine sehr funktionale und kompakte Lösung darstellt.
keywords: RANGES, REDUCE, String Processing, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGES`-Tabelle für `CARRID`, die alle Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` enthält, die mehr als 10 Flüge haben, als 'I' (Include) und 'EQ' (Equal) Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF` und `VALUE` mit einer Bedingung, um die `RANGES`-Tabelle dynamisch zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_dynamic_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    METHODS get_carrids_with_many_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE ty_range_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_dynamic_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_with_many_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF carrid IN lt_sflights
                                GROUP BY carrid
                                WHERE ( group_size > 10 ) " group_size is implicitly available
                                ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_dynamic_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_carrids_with_many_flights( ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has more than 10 flights in SFLIGHTS test data
    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_range ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entry>).
      IF <fs_entry>-low = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_found = abap_true.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_lh_found msg = 'LH sollte in der Range sein (mehr als 10 Flüge)' ).

    " Assert that all entries are 'I' 'EQ'
    LOOP AT lt_range ASSIGNING <fs_entry>.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_entry>-option exp = 'EQ' msg = 'Option falsch' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_range ) > 0 ) msg = 'Keine Einträge in der RANGES-Tabelle gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` und der impliziten `group_size`-Variable ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion in ABAP 7.55+, um Daten zu aggregieren und basierend auf Aggregationsergebnissen dynamisch `RANGES`-Tabellen zu erstellen. Dies ersetzt komplexe `LOOP`s mit `AT END OF` oder `COLLECT`.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in ein JSON-Format.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>create` und `serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_json) = cl_fdt_json=>create( ).
        lo_json->serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = lt_sflights
          RECEIVING
            json_string = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Handle error
        rv_json_string = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine verschachtelte ABAP-Struktur, die Flugdaten und zugehörige Buchungen enthält, in ein JSON-Format.
hint: Definieren Sie verschachtelte Typen und verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
             custtype TYPE sbook-custtype,
           END OF ty_booking.
    TYPES tt_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             bookings TYPE tt_booking, " Nested table
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_nested_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_nested_data.
    DATA ls_flight_detail TYPE ty_flight_detail.
    DATA lt_bookings TYPE tt_booking.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_flight_detail
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SELECT bookid, custtype
        FROM sbook
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_bookings
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @ls_flight_detail-fldate.
      ls_flight_detail-bookings = lt_bookings.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_json) = cl_fdt_json=>create( ).
        lo_json->serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = ls_flight_detail
          RECEIVING
            json_string = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_nested FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_nested.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_nested( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_nested_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ). " Assuming LH 0400 exists with bookings
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain BOOKINGS' substring = 'BOOKINGS' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_fdt_json` kann automatisch verschachtelte ABAP-Strukturen und Tabellen in entsprechende JSON-Objekte und -Arrays umwandeln. Dies vereinfacht die Handhabung komplexer Datenmodelle erheblich.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in JSON, wobei Sie für bestimmte Felder benutzerdefinierte JSON-Feldnamen verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `json` Annotation (`@json.name`) für die ABAP-Strukturfelder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_custom_names DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_custom,
             @json.name: 'carrierId'
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             @json.name: 'connectionNumber'
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             @json.name: 'flightPrice'
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_custom.

    METHODS serialize_with_custom_names
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_custom_names IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_with_custom_names.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_custom.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_json) = cl_fdt_json=>create( ).
        lo_json->serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = ls_flight
          RECEIVING
            json_string = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_json_string = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_custom_names FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_custom_names.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_custom_names( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_with_custom_names( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain carrierId' substring = 'carrierId' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain connectionNumber' substring = 'connectionNumber' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain flightPrice' substring = 'flightPrice' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( msg = 'JSON should not contain CARRID' substring = 'CARRID' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.55 können Sie mit der Annotation `@json.name` direkt in der ABAP-Typdefinition festlegen, wie ein Feld im JSON-Output benannt werden soll. Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Objekten enthält, in eine interne Tabelle von ABAP-Objektreferenzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>deserialize` mit einem Tabellentyp von Objektreferenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_obj_ref_deserial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_serializable_json.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    CLASS-METHODS create_from_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_objects) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_json_obj_ref_deserial WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_obj_ref_deserial IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD if_serializable_json~deserialize_json.
    DATA ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    io_json_reader->read( CHANGING data = ls_data ).
    mv_value = ls_data-value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_serializable_json~serialize_json.
    DATA ls_data TYPE ty_data.
    ls_data-value = mv_value.
    io_json_writer->write( data = ls_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_from_json.
    DATA lt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_json) = cl_fdt_json=>create( ).
        lo_json->deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json_string = iv_json_string
          RECEIVING
            data        = lt_raw_data
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_raw_data INTO DATA(ls_raw).
          DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_json_obj_ref_deserial( ).
          lo_instance->mv_value = ls_raw-value.
          APPEND lo_instance TO rt_objects.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize_obj_refs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_obj_refs.
    DATA(lv_json_input) = `[{"VALUE":"Item A"},{"VALUE":"Item B"}]`.
    DATA(lt_objects) = zcl_json_obj_ref_deserial=>create_from_json( lv_json_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should have two objects' act = lines( lt_objects ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_objects INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lo_obj_a).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First object value should be Item A' act = lo_obj_a->get_value( ) exp = 'Item A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `cl_fdt_json` direkt keine Objektreferenzen deserialisieren kann, kann man eine Hilfsstruktur verwenden und dann manuell Instanzen der Zielklasse erstellen und die Daten zuweisen. Dies zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Nutzung für komplexere Szenarien, bei denen die JSON-Daten in ABAP-Objekte umgewandelt werden müssen.
keywords: JSON, Deserialization, Object Reference, cl_fdt_json, if_serializable_json

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHTS und SCARR aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen INNER JOIN und die INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_inner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_inner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_inner( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found for AA' COND lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found at all' COND lt_all_flights IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der INNER JOIN verbindet Zeilen aus SFLIGHTS und SCARR, wo die CARRIER-IDs übereinstimmen. Die `@` Syntax ermöglicht die direkte Übergabe von ABAP-Variablen in Open SQL. INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE füllt die interne Tabelle basierend auf übereinstimmenden Feldnamen.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, SELECT, Open SQL, @, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugverbindungen (SPF_LI) und, falls vorhanden, die zugehörigen Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) aus. Auch Verbindungen ohne aktuelle Flüge sollen angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_left_outer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection_flight,
             carrid   TYPE spfli-carrid,
             connid   TYPE spfli-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_connection_flight.
    METHODS get_connections_with_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_left_outer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections_with_flights.
    SELECT p~carrid, p~connid, p~cityfrom, p~cityto, s~fldate, s~price
      FROM spfli AS p
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflights AS s ON p~carrid = s~carrid AND p~connid = s~connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_connections_with_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_connections_with_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_left_outer( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->get_connections_with_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No data found' COND lt_data IS INITIAL ).
    DATA(lv_has_flight) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_no_flight) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-price IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_has_flight = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        lv_no_flight = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should have entries with flight data' COND lv_has_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should have entries without flight data' COND lv_no_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der LEFT OUTER JOIN stellt sicher, dass alle Einträge aus der linken Tabelle (SPF_LI) im Ergebnis enthalten sind, auch wenn keine passenden Einträge in der rechten Tabelle (SFLIGHTS) gefunden werden. In diesem Fall sind die Felder der rechten Tabelle initial.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SELECT, Open SQL

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 zufälligen Ganzzahlen zwischen 1 und 100.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_numbers.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle von Flügen zufällig durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, um zufällige Positionen zu generieren und die Tabelle entsprechend zu sortieren oder zu tauschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS shuffle_flights IMPORTING CHANGING ct_flights TYPE ty_flight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_flights.
    IF ct_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( ct_flights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = lv_lines ).

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      ASSIGN ct_flights[ lv_random_index ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_random_flight>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(ls_temp) = <fs_flight>.
        <fs_flight> = <fs_random_flight>.
        <fs_random_flight> = ls_temp.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_flights.
    DATA: lt_original_flights TYPE zcl_random_shuffle=>ty_flight_tt,
          lt_shuffled_flights TYPE zcl_random_shuffle=>ty_flight_tt.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_original_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_original_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_original_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '003'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'.

    lt_shuffled_flights = lt_original_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_shuffle( ).
    lo_cut->shuffle_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_shuffled_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_flights ) exp = lines( lt_original_flights ) ).

    SORT lt_original_flights BY carrid connid fldate.
    SORT lt_shuffled_flights BY carrid connid fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled_flights exp = lt_original_flights ).

    DATA(lv_same_order) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_original_flights INTO DATA(ls_orig).
      READ TABLE lt_shuffled_flights INTO DATA(ls_shuff) INDEX sy-tabix.
      IF ls_orig <> ls_shuff.
        lv_same_order = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Table order should be different after shuffle' COND lv_same_order ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Mischen einer internen Tabelle erfolgt durch wiederholtes Tauschen von Elementen an zufälligen Positionen. CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT wird verwendet, um die zufälligen Indizes zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich für Simulationen oder die zufällige Auswahl von Stichproben.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Internal Table, Shuffle, Swap

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, die Flüge von Frankfurt nach New York anbieten, und zeigen Sie deren Namen an. Verwenden Sie eine Common Table Expression (CTE).

CLASS zcl_join_cte DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_name,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_name.
