ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_cte IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_frankfurt_ny.
    WITH
      connections AS (
        SELECT carrid, connid
          FROM spfli
          WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK'
      )
    SELECT DISTINCT c~carrid, s~carrname
      FROM connections AS c
      INNER JOIN scarr AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No carriers found for FRA-NY' COND lt_carriers IS INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, die mindestens 5 Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 EUR anbieten.
hint: Verwenden Sie INNER JOIN, GROUP BY und HAVING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_high_price,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_high_price.
    METHODS get_carriers_with_high_price_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_high_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_high_price_flights.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~price > 500
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING COUNT( * ) >= 5
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No carriers with high price flights found' COND lt_carriers IS INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count too low' COND ls_carrier-flight_count >= 5 ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Wählen Sie 3 zufällige, eindeutige Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle SCARR aus.
hint: Lesen Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, mischen Sie die Tabelle und nehmen Sie die ersten 3 Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    METHODS get_random_unique_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_unique_carriers.
    DATA lt_all_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_all_carriers.

    IF lines( lt_all_carriers ) < 3.
      rt_carriers = lt_all_carriers.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( lt_all_carriers ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = lv_lines ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_carriers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrier>).
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      ASSIGN lt_all_carriers[ lv_random_index ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_random_carrier>).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(ls_temp) = <fs_carrier>.
        <fs_carrier> = <fs_random_carrier>.
        <fs_random_carrier> = ls_temp.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT lt_all_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier) UP TO 3.
      APPEND ls_carrier TO rt_carriers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_random_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_random_unique_carriers( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No random carriers selected' COND lt_carriers IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Less than 3 carriers selected' COND lines( lt_carriers ) <= 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Duplicate carriers found' COND lines( lt_carriers ) = lines( NEW cl_abap_unit_assert=>ty_string_table( FOR ls_c IN lt_carriers ( ls_c-carrid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um eine zufällige Auswahl eindeutiger Elemente zu erhalten, wird die gesamte Liste gemischt und dann die gewünschte Anzahl von Elementen entnommen. Dies stellt sicher, dass die Auswahl zufällig und ohne Duplikate ist.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Internal Table, Shuffle, Unique Selection

CLASS zcl_join_counts IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_stats.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( DISTINCT s~fldate ) AS flight_count, COUNT( DISTINCT p~connid ) AS conn_count
      FROM scarr AS c
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflights AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      LEFT OUTER JOIN spfli AS p ON c~carrid = p~carrid
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) in eine ZIP-Datei im Binärformat. Der Inhalt soll als CSV-Datei im ZIP-Archiv gespeichert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_ZIP` und die Methode `ADD` für den Inhalt sowie `SAVE` zum Erzeugen der Binärdaten. Konvertieren Sie den String-Inhalt mit `CL_ABAP_CONV_CE=>UCCP` in XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_compress_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_sflights_to_zip
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_entry_name TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights.csv'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_compress_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflights_to_zip.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_csv_data TYPE string.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Convert internal table to CSV string
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CONCATENATE lv_csv_data
                  ls_sflight-carrid ','
                  ls_sflight-connid ','
                  ls_sflight-fldate ','
                  ls_sflight-planetype ','
                  ls_sflight-price ','
                  ls_sflight-currency ','
                  ls_sflight-seatsmax ','
                  ls_sflight-seatsocc
                  cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO lv_csv_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add(
      name    = iv_zip_entry_name
      content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_csv_data ) " Convert string to xstring (UTF-8)
    ).
    lo_zip->save( IMPORTING zip_content = rv_zip_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entpacke eine gegebene ZIP-Datei (als XSTRING) und gib den Inhalt einer spezifischen Datei im Archiv als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_ZIP` mit `LOAD` und `GET`. Denken Sie an die Fehlerbehandlung und die Konvertierung von XSTRING zu String.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_decompress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_zip_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring    TYPE xstring
        iv_entry_name     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_decompress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_zip_entry.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
        lo_zip->get(
          EXPORTING
            name    = iv_entry_name
          IMPORTING
            content = DATA(lv_xstring_content)
        ).
        rv_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_xstring_content ). " Convert xstring to string (UTF-8)
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., entry not found or invalid zip
        MESSAGE lx_zip_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hier wichtig, um auf Probleme wie nicht gefundene Einträge zu reagieren. Die Konvertierung von XSTRING zu String erfolgt ebenfalls mit `CL_ABAP_CONV_CE=>UCCP`.

CLASS zcl_zip_list_contents DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_zip_file_info,
             name TYPE string,
             size TYPE i,
           END OF ty_zip_file_info.
    TYPES: tt_zip_file_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_zip_file_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_zip_file_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_file_list) TYPE tt_zip_file_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_list_contents IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_zip_file_list.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
        DATA(lt_zip_files) = lo_zip->get_files( ).
        LOOP AT lt_zip_files INTO DATA(ls_zip_file).
          APPEND VALUE ty_zip_file_info( name = ls_zip_file-name size = ls_zip_file-size ) TO rt_file_list.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        MESSAGE lx_zip_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine passwortgeschützte ZIP-Datei mit einem einzelnen Eintrag. Die Entschlüsselung soll ebenfalls demonstriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `ADD_WITH_PASSWORD` und `LOAD_WITH_PASSWORD` Methoden von `CL_ABAP_ZIP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_password_protect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_protected_zip
      IMPORTING
        iv_content TYPE string
        iv_password TYPE string
        iv_entry_name TYPE string DEFAULT 'secret.txt'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS decompress_protected_zip
      IMPORTING
        iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_password TYPE string
        iv_entry_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_password_protect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_protected_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add_with_password(
      name    = iv_entry_name
      content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_content )
      password = iv_password
    ).
    lo_zip->save( IMPORTING zip_content = rv_zip_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_protected_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load_with_password(
          zip_content = iv_zip_xstring
          password    = iv_password
        ).
        lo_zip->get(
          EXPORTING
            name    = iv_entry_name
          IMPORTING
            content = DATA(lv_xstring_content)
        ).
        rv_content = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_xstring_content ).
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        MESSAGE lx_zip_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_protected_zip_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_protected_zip_wrong_password FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_protected_zip_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_password_protect( ).
    DATA(lv_original_content) = 'Geheimer Inhalt für die ZIP-Datei'.
    DATA(lv_password) = 'MySecret123'.
    DATA(lv_entry_name) = 'secure_doc.txt'.

    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->create_protected_zip(
                               iv_content = lv_original_content
                               iv_password = lv_password
                               iv_entry_name = lv_entry_name ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_zip_xstring msg = 'ZIP xstring sollte nicht initial sein' ).

    DATA(lv_decompressed_content) = lo_cut->decompress_protected_zip(
                                       iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring
                                       iv_password = lv_password
                                       iv_entry_name = lv_entry_name ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decompressed_content exp = lv_original_content msg = 'Inhalt nach Entschlüsselung stimmt nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_protected_zip_wrong_password.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_password_protect( ).
    DATA(lv_original_content) = 'Geheimer Inhalt'.
    DATA(lv_correct_password) = 'CorrectPass'.
    DATA(lv_wrong_password) = 'WrongPass'.
    DATA(lv_entry_name) = 'wrong_pass.txt'.

    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->create_protected_zip(
                               iv_content = lv_original_content
                               iv_password = lv_correct_password
                               iv_entry_name = lv_entry_name ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->decompress_protected_zip(
          iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring
          iv_password = lv_wrong_password
          iv_entry_name = lv_entry_name
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'CX_ABAP_ZIP_ERROR für falsches Passwort erwartet' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'CX_ABAP_ZIP_ERROR wie erwartet abgefangen' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden `ADD_WITH_PASSWORD` und `LOAD_WITH_PASSWORD` von `CL_ABAP_ZIP` ermöglichen das Hinzufügen und Laden von passwortgeschützten Einträgen in ZIP-Archiven. Dies bietet eine einfache Möglichkeit, die Vertraulichkeit von Daten zu gewährleisten. Die Fehlerbehandlung ist hier besonders wichtig, da ein falsches Passwort zu einer Ausnahme führt.
keywords: CL_ABAP_ZIP, Password Protection, Encryption, XSTRING, Security

Instructions: Definiere einen Tabellentyp mit `WITH EMPTY KEY` und fülle ihn mit dem `FOR`-Operator, indem du Daten aus `sflights` transformierst.

CLASS zcl_types_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        total_price = ls_sflight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definiere eine lokale Schnittstelle und eine lokale Klasse, die diese Schnittstelle implementiert, um eine einfache Logger-Funktionalität bereitzustellen. Die Log-Einträge sollen in einer globalen Klassen-Tabelle gespeichert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACES` und `CLASS ... DEFINITION LOCAL` innerhalb der globalen Klasse. Nutzen Sie `CLASS-DATA` für die globale Log-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_types_local_oo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun. " For direct execution in ADT

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
             type      TYPE char1, " I, W, E
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES: tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_log TYPE tt_log_entries.

    INTERFACES lif_logger. " Local interface definition
    CLASS lcl_console_logger DEFINITION. " Local class definition
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES lif_logger.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        " No specific constructor logic needed for this simple example
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD lif_logger~log_message.
        APPEND VALUE ty_log_entry( timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utc_from_system_tstmp( )
                                   message   = iv_message
                                   type      = iv_type ) TO gt_log.
        " In a real scenario, this would write to console/file/etc.
        " For ADT classrun, we'll output later.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE lif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string
      iv_type    TYPE char1 DEFAULT 'I'.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_types_local_oo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW lcl_console_logger( ).
    lo_logger->lif_logger~log_message( iv_message = 'Application started.' iv_type = 'I' ).
    lo_logger->lif_logger~log_message( iv_message = 'Warning: Something happened.' iv_type = 'W' ).
    lo_logger->lif_logger~log_message( iv_message = 'Error: Critical issue!' iv_type = 'E' ).

    out->write( 'Log Entries:' ).
    LOOP AT gt_log INTO DATA(ls_log_entry).
      out->write( |{ ls_log_entry-timestamp } { ls_log_entry-type }: { ls_log_entry-message }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_logger_functionality FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_logger_functionality.
    " Reset global log for test isolation
    CLEAR zcl_types_local_oo=>gt_log.

    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_types_local_oo=>lcl_console_logger( ).
    lo_logger->lif_logger~log_message( iv_message = 'Test message 1' iv_type = 'I' ).
    lo_logger->lif_logger~log_message( iv_message = 'Test message 2' iv_type = 'W' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( zcl_types_local_oo=>gt_log ) exp = 2 msg = 'Erwartet 2 Log-Einträge' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_types_local_oo=>gt_log[ 1 ]-message exp = 'Test message 1' msg = 'Erste Log-Nachricht falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_types_local_oo=>gt_log[ 2 ]-type exp = 'W' msg = 'Zweiter Log-Typ falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Definiere einen lokalen Typ für eine Hash-Tabelle (Hashed Table) mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel und fülle diese mit Daten aus `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES: tt_... TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` und den `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_types_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data_full.

    TYPES: tt_flight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_data_full
                               WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_hashed_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hashed_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_hashed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid    = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
        planetype = ls_sflight-planetype
        price     = ls_sflight-price
        currency  = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_hashed_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_hashed_table_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_hashed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(lt_hashed_flights) = lo_cut->get_hashed_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_hashed_flights msg = 'Hash-Tabelle sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hashed_flights ) exp = 5 msg = 'Sollte 5 Einträge enthalten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hashed_table_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(lt_hashed_flights) = lo_cut->get_hashed_flights( ).

    DATA(ls_flight_entry) = lt_hashed_flights[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_entry-fldate msg = 'Eintrag sollte gefunden werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_entry-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID des gefundenen Eintrags falsch' ).

    TRY.
        " Access non-existent entry
        DATA(ls_non_existent) = lt_hashed_flights[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Zugriff auf nicht existierenden Eintrag sollte Ausnahme werfen' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND wie erwartet abgefangen' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Definition von `HASHED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` ist ideal für den schnellen Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen über einen Schlüssel, da die Zugriffszeit unabhängig von der Tabellengröße ist. Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht eine effiziente und deklarative Füllung solcher Tabellen. Der direkte Zugriff über `itab[ KEY ... COMPONENTS ... ]` ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Syntax.
keywords: TYPES, HASHED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Definiere einen lokalen Typ für eine sortierte Tabelle (Sorted Table) mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel und fülle diese mit Daten aus `sflights`. Demonstriere den Zugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES: tt_... TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` und den `VALUE`-Operator. Der Zugriff erfolgt über den Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_types_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data_sorted,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data_sorted.

    TYPES: tt_flight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data_sorted
                               WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_flight_sorted.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_sorted_flights TYPE tt_flight_sorted
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price  = ls_sflight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    rs_flight = it_sorted_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sorted_table_access FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_sorted_table( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_sorted_flights msg = 'Sortierte Tabelle sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sorted_flights ) exp = 5 msg = 'Sollte 5 Einträge enthalten' ).
    " Verify sorting (assuming sflight data is somewhat predictable)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lt_sorted_flights[ 1 ]-carrid LE lt_sorted_flights[ 2 ]-carrid ) msg = 'Tabelle nicht korrekt sortiert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sorted_table_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_sorted_table( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    DATA(ls_flight_entry) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_key(
                               it_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights
                               iv_carrid = 'LH'
                               iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_entry-fldate msg = 'Eintrag sollte gefunden werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_entry-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID des gefundenen Eintrags falsch' ).

    TRY.
        " Access non-existent entry
        DATA(ls_non_existent) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_key(
                                   it_sorted_flights = lt_sorted_flights
                                   iv_carrid = 'XX'
                                   iv_connid = '9999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Zugriff auf nicht existierenden Eintrag sollte Ausnahme werfen' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND wie erwartet abgefangen' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Definition mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge existieren. Der `VALUE`-Operator füllt die Tabelle, wobei die Sortierung automatisch beibehalten wird. Der Zugriff über `itab[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS ... ]` ist der moderne und performante Weg.

Instructions: Definiere einen lokalen Typ für eine geschachtelte Tabelle (Table of Tables) und fülle diese mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um Flugdaten pro Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_..., tt_... TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_... WITH EMPTY KEY, END OF ty_...` und den `VALUE`-Operator mit geschachtelten `FOR`-Iteratoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_types_nested_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flights_by_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_details,
           END OF ty_flights_by_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_flights_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flights_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nested_flights) TYPE tt_flights_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_nested_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_nested_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUP g OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
      ( carrid = g-key
        flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_grouped_flight IN g
          ( connid = ls_grouped_flight-connid
            fldate = ls_grouped_flight-fldate
            price  = ls_grouped_flight-price )
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_nested_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_nested_table_content FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_nested_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_nested_table( ).
    DATA(lt_nested_flights) = lo_cut->get_nested_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_nested_flights msg = 'Geschachtelte Tabelle sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_nested_flights ) > 0 ) msg = 'Sollte Einträge enthalten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_nested_flights[ 1 ]-carrid msg = 'Carrier ID sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_nested_flights[ 1 ]-flights ) > 0 ) msg = 'Innere Tabelle sollte Einträge enthalten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_nested_table_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_nested_table( ).
    DATA(lt_nested_flights) = lo_cut->get_nested_flights( ).

    LOOP AT lt_nested_flights INTO DATA(ls_carrier_flights).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_carrier_flights-carrid msg = 'Carrier ID in äußerer Tabelle fehlt' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( ls_carrier_flights-flights ) > 0 ) msg = 'Innere Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).
      LOOP AT ls_carrier_flights-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_detail).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_detail-connid msg = 'Connection ID in innerer Tabelle fehlt' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Geschachtelte Tabellen (`Table of Tables`) sind ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Darstellung hierarchischer Datenstrukturen. In Kombination mit dem `FOR GROUP ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck (seit ABAP 7.50) und dem `VALUE`-Operator können solche Strukturen sehr elegant und effizient gefüllt werden, was die Datenaggregation und -transformation erheblich vereinfacht.

Instructions: Definiere einen lokalen Typ für eine Referenz auf eine interne Tabelle und demonstriere die Zuweisung und den Zugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES: tr_... TYPE REF TO tt_...` und den Dereferenzierungsoperator `->*` oder `ASSIGN ... TO <fs>`. Der `VALUE`-Operator kann auch hier verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_types_table_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_string_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tr_string_list TYPE REF TO tt_string_list.

    METHODS get_ref_to_string_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_string_list) TYPE tr_string_list.

    METHODS get_first_element
      IMPORTING
        ir_string_list TYPE tr_string_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_first_element) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_table_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ref_to_string_list.
    DATA(lt_local_list) = VALUE tt_string_list( ( 'Element 1' ) ( 'Element 2' ) ).
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_local_list INTO rr_string_list.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_first_element.
    IF ir_string_list IS BOUND AND NOT ir_string_list->* IS INITIAL.
      rv_first_element = ir_string_list->*[ 1 ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_reference FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_ref_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_ref FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_reference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_table_ref( ).
    DATA(lr_list) = lo_cut->get_ref_to_string_list( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lr_list msg = 'Referenz sollte gebunden sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lr_list->* ) exp = 2 msg = 'Referenzierte Tabelle sollte 2 Einträge haben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_ref_access.

    DATA(lr_list) = lo_cut->get_ref_to_string_list( ).

    DATA(lv_first) = lo_cut->get_first_element( lr_list ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_first exp = 'Element 1' msg = 'Erstes Element falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_ref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_types_table_ref( ).
    DATA(lr_empty_list) TYPE zcl_types_table_ref=>tr_string_list.

Instructions: Definiere einen lokalen Typ für eine generische Struktur (`ANY STRUCTURE`) und eine Methode, die diese Struktur als Parameter akzeptiert und die Feldnamen ausgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES: ty_any_structure TYPE any structure` und RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`) zur Analyse der Strukturfelder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_types_any_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_any_structure TYPE any structure.

    METHODS get_structure_field_names
      IMPORTING
        is_any_structure TYPE ty_any_structure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_types_any_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_field_names.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_any_structure ).
    DATA(lo_struct_type) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_struct_descr ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_type->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_field_names.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein internes Datum und eine interne Uhrzeit in ein externes, benutzerfreundliches Format (z.B. 'DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS').

CLASS zcl_convert_datetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        iv_time TYPE t
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_convert_datetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_external.
    DATA: lv_date_ext TYPE d,
          lv_time_ext TYPE t.

    " CONVERT DATE iv_date INTO INVERTED-DATE lv_date_ext. " Example of CONVERT, though not strictly needed for string templates
    " CONVERT TIME iv_time INTO INVERTED-TIME lv_time_ext. " Example of CONVERT

    rv_external_datetime = |{ iv_date DATE = USER } { iv_time TIME = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.

solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count,
           tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                 ( carrid = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht dies eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Programmierung, die die Notwendigkeit von expliziten Schleifen und `AT END OF` Konstrukten eliminiert.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugdauern (TRAVELTIME) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_traveltime
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_time) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_traveltime.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, traveltime
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_time = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                              NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-traveltime ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.

    " Manuelle Berechnung für den Vergleich (oder Mock-Daten)
    DATA: lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT traveltime FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_test.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_test INTO DATA(ls_flight_test).
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_flight_test-traveltime.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_traveltime( lv_carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Summe der Reisezeiten falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein funktionaler Konstruktorausdruck ab ABAP 7.50, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, die den Code kompakter und leichter verständlich macht als traditionelle `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, AGGREGATION, INTERNAL TABLE, FUNCTIONAL, SFLIGHTS, Math

        entities FOR DELETE zrap_i_flight_m
      RESULT
        RESULT.

    " Beispiel für eine Custom Action
    METHODS set_status_booked FOR BEHAVIOR OF zrap_i_flight_m
      IMPORTING
        keys FOR ACTION set_status_booked
      RESULT
        RESULT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_bhv IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD get_instance_features.
    " Implementierung der Instanz-Features, z.B. welche Felder editierbar sind
    " Dies ist ein Platzhalter, da eine vollständige Implementierung einen RAP-Kontext erfordert.
    LOOP AT keys ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_key>).
      APPEND VALUE #( %tky = <fs_key>-%tky
                      %field-carrid = if_abap_behv=>mk-on
                      %field-connid = if_abap_behv=>mk-on
                      %field-fldate = if_abap_behv=>mk-on ) TO result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create.
    " Implementierung der CREATE-Logik
    " Hier würde die Logik zum Anlegen neuer Flüge stehen.
    " Dies ist ein Platzhalter.
    LOOP AT entities ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entity>).
      " Beispiel: Daten in eine Datenbanktabelle einfügen
      " INSERT INTO zflight_db VALUES <fs_entity>.
      APPEND VALUE #( %tky = <fs_entity>-%tky ) TO result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update.
    " Implementierung der UPDATE-Logik
    " Hier würde die Logik zum Aktualisieren bestehender Flüge stehen.
    " Dies ist ein Platzhalter.
    LOOP AT entities ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entity>).
      " Beispiel: Daten in einer Datenbanktabelle aktualisieren
      " UPDATE zflight_db SET ... WHERE ...
      APPEND VALUE #( %tky = <fs_entity>-%tky ) TO result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete.
    " Implementierung der DELETE-Logik
    " Hier würde die Logik zum Löschen von Flügen stehen.
    " Dies ist ein Platzhalter.
    LOOP AT entities ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entity>).
      " Beispiel: Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle löschen
      " DELETE FROM zflight_db WHERE ...
      APPEND VALUE #( %tky = <fs_entity>-%tky ) TO result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_status_booked.
    " Implementierung der Custom Action 'set_status_booked'
    " Hier würde die Logik stehen, um den Status eines Fluges zu ändern.
    " Dies ist ein Platzhalter.
    LOOP AT keys ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_key>).
      " Beispiel: Status in der Datenbank aktualisieren
      " UPDATE zflight_db SET status = 'BOOKED' WHERE ...
      APPEND VALUE #( %tky = <fs_key>-%tky ) TO result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid      TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filter_operator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_operator=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251203' ) " Duplicate for testing
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251204' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights
                                                iv_carrid      = 'LH'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl der gefilterten Zeilen falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Erste Zeile Carried falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'Erste Zeile Connid falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten zu selektieren, ohne explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen zu verwenden. Die Verwendung von `USING KEY primary_key` optimiert die Performance bei Standardtabellen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) und fügen Sie Daten hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und Feld-Symbole.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        " Get description of the structure (e.g., SFLIGHTS)
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ).

        " Create a table type description based on the structure
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                            p_line_type  = lr_struct_descr
                            p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                            p_unique     = abap_false ).

        " Create dynamic internal table
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

        " Assign data to field symbol
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Fill with some dummy data (or actual data from DB)
        IF iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS'.
          DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
            ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
            ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
          ).
          <lt_dynamic_table> = lt_sflights.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_abap_typeload_error.
        " Handle error if type not found
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_typeload_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_typeload_error=>cx_abap_typeload_error
            type_name = iv_table_name.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als Eingabe akzeptiert und die Anzahl der Zeilen sowie die Namen der Felder zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` zur Laufzeitanalyse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_table_info,
        row_count TYPE i,
        field_names TYPE string_table,
      END OF ty_table_info.

    METHODS get_table_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_info) TYPE ty_table_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_any_table>.

    IF <lt_any_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      rs_info-row_count = lines( <lt_any_table> ).

      DATA(lr_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_any_table> ) ).
      DATA(lr_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

      LOOP AT lr_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND ls_component-name TO rs_info-field_names.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) in das CSV-Format und geben Sie sie als XSTRING zurück, bereit für einen E-Mail-Anhang.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` und `CONCATENATE LINES OF` für die CSV-Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_to_csv_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE sflights_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_csv) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_to_csv_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA: lt_csv_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string,
          lv_csv_string TYPE string.

    " Add header row
    APPEND `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY` TO lt_csv_lines.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price };{ ls_sflight-currency }| TO lt_csv_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Concatenate lines into a single string
    CONCATENATE LINES OF lt_csv_lines INTO lv_csv_string SEPARATED BY cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Convert string to XSTRING (UTF-8)
    rx_csv = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
               iv_string   = lv_csv_string
               iv_codepage = '8400'
             ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators mit `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_value_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      ty_flight_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_price_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE sflights_tab
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_value_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_flights.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                           ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                             connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE sflights_tab
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Unterklassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt, unter Verwendung von `NEW` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW` für die Instanziierung und `COND` für die bedingte Objekterstellung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document~get_type.
    rv_type = 'PDF Document'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_word_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Word Document'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_document_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zif_document.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    ro_document = COND #( WHEN iv_document_type = 'PDF' THEN NEW zcl_pdf_document( )
                          WHEN iv_document_type = 'WORD' THEN NEW zcl_word_document( )
                          ELSE THROW cx_sy_create_object_error( textid = cx_sy_create_object_error=>cx_sy_create_object_error ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'PDF document should be created' act = lo_document ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Document type should be PDF Document' act = lo_document->get_type( ) exp = 'PDF Document' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_word.
    DATA(lo_document) = zcl_document_factory=>create_document( 'WORD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Word document should be created' act = lo_document ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Document type should be Word Document' act = lo_document->get_type( ) exp = 'Word Document' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Pattern unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax. Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, wobei Sie moderne arithmetische Ausdrücke verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_price_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE sflights_tab
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_price_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                             FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                             NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
      ty_carrier_flight_count_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE sflights_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_flight_count_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lt_sflights = VALUE #(

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250104' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should have 3 groups' act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA should have 2 flights' act = lt_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH should have 1 flight' act = lt_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_single_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE sflights_tab.
    lt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should have 1 group' act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA should have 2 flights' act = lt_counts[1]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).

explanation: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ist eine der mächtigsten modernen ABAP-Funktionen für die Datenaggregation und -gruppierung. Er ermöglicht es, interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregatfunktionen (wie `GROUP SIZE` für die Anzahl der Elemente in einer Gruppe) zu verwenden, ohne temporäre Tabellen oder manuelle Schleifen und `AT NEW`/`AT END` Konstrukte. Dies führt zu deutlich kürzerem, lesbarerem und oft performanterem Code.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, GROUP SIZE, sflights

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer beliebigen Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie Feld-Symbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <fs_any_structure>.
    IF <fs_any_structure> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_any_structure> TO <fs_any_field>.
      IF <fs_any_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_field_value = <fs_any_field>.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>cx_sy_assign_component_name
            component_name = iv_field_name.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>cx_sy_assign_initial.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_existing_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_field EXPECTING CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR.
    METHODS test_read_from_initial_structure EXPECTING CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing_field.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0017'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_cut->get_field_value( REF #( ls_sflight ) 'CARRID' ).
    DATA(lv_connid) = lo_cut->get_field_value( REF #( ls_sflight ) 'CONNID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should be AA' act = lv_carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CONNID should be 0017' act = lv_connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_field.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).
    lo_cut->get_field_value( REF #( ls_sflight ) 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_from_initial_structure.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lr_initial_ref) TYPE REF TO data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_reader( ).
    lo_cut->get_field_value( lr_initial_ref 'CARRID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das dynamische Lesen von Feldwerten mittels Feld-Symbolen und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...` ist ein grundlegendes Konzept der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP. Es ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Daten, deren Struktur oder Feldnamen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist unverzichtbar für generische Frameworks, die mit beliebigen Datenstrukturen interagieren müssen, ohne diese zur Designzeit zu kennen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, REF TO DATA

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Determination, die automatisch ein Feld (z.B. `CalculatedValue`) einer Entität basierend auf anderen Feldern (z.B. `Quantity` und `Price`) berechnet, bevor die Entität gespeichert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `FOR DETERMINE ON MODIFY` im Behavior Handler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_behavior_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_entity_data,
             key          TYPE /dmo/uuid, " Example key field
             quantity     TYPE i,
             price        TYPE decfloat16,
             calculated_value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ts_entity_data.
    TYPES tt_entity_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_entity_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS determine_calculated_value
      IMPORTING
        it_entities TYPE tt_entity_data
      EXPORTING
        et_updated_entities TYPE tt_entity_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_behavior_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD determine_calculated_value.
    et_updated_entities = VALUE #( FOR <entity> IN it_entities
                                   ( <entity> WITH calculated_value = <entity>-quantity * <entity>-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_determination FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_determination.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_behavior_example( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_rap_behavior_example=>tt_entity_data(
      ( key = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' quantity = 10 price = '10.50' )
      ( key = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002' quantity = 5  price = '20.00' )
    ).
    DATA lt_updated_entities TYPE zcl_rap_behavior_example=>tt_entity_data.

    lo_cut->determine_calculated_value(
      EXPORTING
        it_entities = lt_input
      IMPORTING
        et_updated_entities = lt_updated_entities
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_entities INTO DATA(ls_entity1) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entity1-calculated_value exp = '105.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_entities INTO DATA(ls_entity2) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entity2-calculated_value exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Determination nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( ... ) )` um eine neue interne Tabelle mit den aktualisierten Werten zu erstellen. Dies ist kompakt, lesbar und vermeidet explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: RAP, Determination, ON MODIFY, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Validierung, die sicherstellt, dass ein bestimmtes Feld (z.B. `Description`) einer Entität nicht leer ist, bevor die Entität gespeichert wird. Bei Verletzung soll eine Fehlermeldung zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE` im Behavior Handler und die `REPORTED` Struktur für Meldungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_behavior_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_entity_data,
             key         TYPE /dmo/uuid,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ts_entity_data.
    TYPES tt_entity_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_entity_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_failed_key,
             key TYPE /dmo/uuid,
           END OF ts_failed_key.
    TYPES tt_failed_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_failed_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_message,
             key TYPE /dmo/uuid,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ts_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_description
      IMPORTING
        it_entities TYPE tt_entity_data
      EXPORTING
        et_failed_keys TYPE tt_failed_keys
        et_messages    TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_behavior_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_description.
    et_failed_keys = VALUE #( FOR <entity> IN it_entities WHERE description IS INITIAL
                              ( key = <entity>-key ) ).

    et_messages = VALUE #( FOR <failed_key> IN et_failed_keys
                           ( key = <failed_key>-key message = 'Description darf nicht leer sein.' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_behavior_example( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_rap_behavior_example=>tt_entity_data(
      ( key = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' description = 'Valid Description' )

    lo_cut->validate_description(
      EXPORTING
        it_entities = lt_input
      IMPORTING
        et_failed_keys = lt_failed_keys
        et_messages     = lt_messages
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_failed_keys ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_messages ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_validation_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_behavior_example( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_rap_behavior_example=>tt_entity_data(
      ( key = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' description = '' )
    ).
    DATA lt_failed_keys TYPE zcl_rap_behavior_example=>tt_failed_keys.
    DATA lt_messages TYPE zcl_rap_behavior_example=>tt_messages.

    lo_cut->validate_description(
      EXPORTING
        it_entities = lt_input
      IMPORTING
        et_failed_keys = lt_failed_keys
        et_messages     = lt_messages
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_failed_keys ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_failed_keys ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_messages ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_message-message exp = 'Description darf nicht leer sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Konsistenz von Daten über mehrere Entitäten hinweg prüft, z.B. ob die Summe der `Item` Mengen die `Header` Gesamtmenge nicht überschreitet.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Determination oder Validierung, die über Associations auf zugehörige Entitäten zugreift.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_behavior_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_header_data,
             key         TYPE /dmo/uuid,
             total_quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ts_header_data.
    TYPES tt_header_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_header_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_item_data,
             key        TYPE /dmo/uuid,
             parent_key TYPE /dmo/uuid,
             quantity   TYPE i,
           END OF ts_item_data.
    TYPES tt_item_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_item_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_failed_key,
             key TYPE /dmo/uuid,
           END OF ts_failed_key.
    TYPES tt_failed_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_failed_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_message,
             key TYPE /dmo/uuid,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ts_message.
    TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_total_quantity
      IMPORTING
        it_header_entities TYPE tt_header_data
        it_all_items       TYPE tt_item_data " Simulate all items for simplicity
      EXPORTING
        et_failed_keys TYPE tt_failed_keys
        et_messages    TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_behavior_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_total_quantity.
    LOOP AT it_header_entities INTO DATA(ls_header).
      DATA(lv_sum_item_quantity) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                            FOR <item> IN it_all_items WHERE ( parent_key = ls_header-key )
                                            NEXT sum = sum + <item>-quantity ).

      IF lv_sum_item_quantity > ls_header-total_quantity.
        APPEND VALUE #( key = ls_header-key ) TO et_failed_keys.
        APPEND VALUE #( key = ls_header-key message = 'Gesamtmenge der Items überschreitet Header-Menge.' ) TO et_messages.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_table_info,
             line_type_name TYPE string,
             key_components TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_info.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).
    IF lo_descr IS INSTANCE OF cl_abap_tabledescr.
      DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr ).
      rs_info-line_type_name = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->get_name( ).
      rs_info-key_components = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR comp IN lo_table_descr->get_keys( ) NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN comp-name ELSE s && ', ' && comp-name ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_meth_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_info,
             name      TYPE string,
             type_name TYPE string,
             kind      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param_info,
           tt_param_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_rtti_meth_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_method_parameters.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).

        name      = ls_param-name

        kind      = SWITCH string( ls_param-kind
                                   WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>importing THEN 'IMPORTING'
                                   WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>exporting THEN 'EXPORTING'
                                   WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>changing  THEN 'CHANGING'
                                   WHEN cl_abap_methdescr=>returning THEN 'RETURNING'
                                   ELSE 'UNKNOWN' )
      ) TO rt_params.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch aufruft und einen String-Parameter übergibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object` und `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object iv_method_name TYPE string iv_param_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object( io_object ).
    DATA(lo_meth_descr) = lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).

    DATA(lv_param_name) = ''.
    LOOP AT lo_meth_descr->parameters INTO DATA(ls_param) WHERE kind = cl_abap_methdescr=>importing AND ls_param-type->get_name( ) = 'STRING'.
      lv_param_name = ls_param-name.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_param_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
            EXPORTING
              (lv_param_name) = iv_param_value
            RECEIVING
              result          = rv_result.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
          rv_result = 'DYNAMIC_CALL_ERROR'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'METHOD_OR_PARAM_NOT_FOUND'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_target IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,

    " Create custom container
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container

    " Add child nodes
    ls_node-node_key = 'CHILD1'.
    ls_node-relatkey = 'ROOT'.

    ls_node-text     = 'Kindknoten 1'.

    ls_node-node_key = 'CHILD2'.

    ls_node-text     = 'Kindknoten 2'.

    lo_tree->add_node( EXPORTING i_node = ls_node ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Column Tree, der Kindknoten erst beim Expandieren eines Elternknotens lädt (Lazy Loading).
hint: Verwenden Sie das Event `node_expand` und die Methode `set_node_has_children` um anzuzeigen, dass ein Knoten Kinder hat, die später geladen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_column_tree_lazy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_column_tree.

    METHODS handle_node_expand
      FOR EVENT node_expand OF cl_gui_column_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_column_tree_lazy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          ls_column    TYPE lvc_s_col,
          ls_node      TYPE mpc_s_node.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_node_expand FOR mo_tree.

    ls_column-fieldname = 'TEXT1'.
    ls_column-coltext   = 'Knoten Text'.
    ls_column-col_id    = 'COL1'.
    mo_tree->add_column( EXPORTING i_column = ls_column ).

    " Add root node with children flag
    ls_node-node_key = 'ROOT'.
    ls_node-text     = 'Wurzelknoten (expandierbar)'.
    ls_node-n_level  = 0.
    ls_node-has_children = abap_true.
    mo_tree->add_node( EXPORTING i_node = ls_node ).

    mo_tree->update_nodes_and_items( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_event=>wait_for_events.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_expand.
    DATA ls_node TYPE mpc_s_node.

    " Simulate loading children
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.

    " Add child nodes to the expanded node
    ls_node-node_key = node_key && '_CHILD_A'.
    ls_node-relatkey = node_key.
    ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child.
    ls_node-text     = 'Dynamisch geladenes Kind A'.
    ls_node-n_level  = 1.
    mo_tree->add_node( EXPORTING i_node = ls_node ).

    ls_node-node_key = node_key && '_CHILD_B'.
    ls_node-relatkey = node_key.
    ls_node-relatship = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child.
    ls_node-text     = 'Dynamisch geladenes Kind B'.
    ls_node-n_level  = 1.
    mo_tree->add_node( EXPORTING i_node = ls_node ).

    " Remove the 'has_children' flag if no more children are expected dynamically
    mo_tree->set_node_has_children( EXPORTING i_node_key = node_key i_has_children = abap_false ).

    mo_tree->update_nodes_and_items( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Drag gestartet für Knoten:' node_key DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.

    IF mv_drag_node_key IS NOT INITIAL AND mv_drag_node_key <> node_key.

      "                     i_relat_ship = cl_gui_column_tree=>relat_last_child ).

  METHOD create_xml_with_attributes.
    DATA: lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_sxml_string_writer.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_writer.

    lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Product' ).
    lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'id' value = 'P123' ).

Instructions: Schreiben Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in ein XML-Dokument, wobei jeder Flug als eigenes Element mit Attributen und Kindelementen dargestellt wird.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie `open_element`, `write_attribute` und `write_value` für jedes Feld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_sflights_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_xml.
    DATA: lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_sxml_string_writer,
          lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_writer.

    lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Flights' ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight.
      lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Flight' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Carrid' value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Connid' value = ls_sflight-connid ).

      lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Fldate' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).

      lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Price' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).

      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flight
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flights

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie `cl_sxml_writer` spezielle XML-Zeichen (z.B. `<`, `>`, `&`, `'`, `"`) korrekt escaped, um XML-Injection zu verhindern.
hint: Die Klasse `cl_sxml_writer` übernimmt das Escaping automatisch. Fügen Sie einfach einen String mit Sonderzeichen ein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_escaping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_xml_with_special_chars RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_escaping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xml_with_special_chars.
    DATA: lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_sxml_string_writer,
          lv_input_text TYPE string VALUE 'Text with < > & " '' special chars.'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_writer.

    lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Message' ).
    lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'source' value = 'User Input <script>' ).
    lo_writer->write_value( value = lv_input_text ).
    lo_writer->close_element( ).

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_xml_escaping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_xml_escaping.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_sxml_writer_escaping,
          lv_xml TYPE string,
          lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_message_node TYPE REF TO if_xml_node,
          lv_source_attr TYPE string,
          lv_message_value TYPE string.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_cut.
    lv_xml = lo_cut->create_xml_with_special_chars( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xml msg = 'XML string should not be empty' ).

    " Expected escaped output for attribute and value
    DATA(lv_expected_attr)  = 'User Input <script>'.
    DATA(lv_expected_value) = 'Text with < > & " ' special chars.'.

    " Parse XML to verify content
    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_ucs2_xstring( lv_xml ) ).

    lo_message_node = lo_xml_document->get_document_element( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message_node->get_name( ) exp = 'Message' msg = 'Root element name mismatch' ).

    lo_message_node->get_attribute_node( name = 'source' IMPORTING value = lv_source_attr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_source_attr exp = lv_expected_attr msg = 'Attribute value not correctly escaped' ).

    lv_message_value = lo_message_node->get_value( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verdeutlicht eine wichtige Sicherheitsfunktion von `cl_sxml_writer`: das automatische Escaping von speziellen XML-Zeichen. Zeichen wie `<`, `>`, `&`, `'` und `"` werden in ihre entsprechenden XML-Entitäten umgewandelt. Dies verhindert effektiv XML-Injection-Angriffe und stellt sicher, dass das generierte XML wohlgeformt und sicher ist, selbst wenn die Eingabedaten unsicher sind.
keywords: cl_sxml_writer, XML, Escaping, Security, Injection Prevention

    lo_writer->open_element( name = 'ElementA' prefix = 'ns1' ).

    lo_writer->open_element( name = 'ElementB' prefix = 'ns2' namespace = 'http://example.com/ns2' ).
    lo_writer->write_value( value = 'Value B in ns2' ).
    lo_writer->close_element( ).

    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close ns1:Root

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS als Beispiel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und Feld-Symbole für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field_value> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <lv_field_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = |{ <lv_field_value> }|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error if type description fails
        rv_value = 'Error: Invalid data type'.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        " Handle error if component assignment fails
        rv_value = 'Error: Field not found'.
    ENDTRY.
