Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer Struktur, die zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und Typen definiert wird. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE abap_typname,
           END OF ty_field_def,
           tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_defs TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_field_def-type ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field>         TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      " Example data filling
      IF lt_components IS NOT INITIAL.
        LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            CASE ls_component-name.
              WHEN 'FIELD1'. <lv_field> = 'Value A'.
              WHEN 'FIELD2'. <lv_field> = 100.
              WHEN 'FIELD3'. <lv_field> = '20250101'.
              WHEN OTHERS. " Default or more complex logic
            ENDCASE.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        CLEAR <ls_dynamic_line>.
        LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            CASE ls_component-name.
              WHEN 'FIELD1'. <lv_field> = 'Value B'.
              WHEN 'FIELD2'. <lv_field> = 200.
              WHEN 'FIELD3'. <lv_field> = '20250102'.
              WHEN OTHERS. " Default or more complex logic
            ENDCASE.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob ein bestimmtes Feld in einer gegebenen Struktur existiert und welchen Typ es hat. Verwenden Sie eine beliebige Struktur, z.B. SFLIGHTS.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` und `cl_abap_typedescr=>kind`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_field_existence_and_type
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists   TYPE abap_bool
        ev_type_kind TYPE abap_typekind
        ev_type_name TYPE abap_typname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_field_existence_and_type.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    ev_exists = abap_false.
    CLEAR: ev_type_kind, ev_type_name.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ev_exists = abap_true.
          ev_type_kind = ls_component-type->kind.
          ev_type_name = ls_component-type->name.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error if is_data is not a structure
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. Fluggesellschaft 'LH'), unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und einer `WHERE` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Assuming some test data for LH exists and sums up to a known value

CLASS zcl_for_transform_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT`-Anweisung mit Aggregationsfunktionen und `GROUP BY` aus, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS zu ermitteln. Nutzen Sie die neue Open SQL Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT FROM ... FIELDS ... GROUP BY ...` und Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
           tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT FROM sflight
      FIELDS carrid, COUNT( * ) AS flight_count
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts msg = 'Flight counts table should not be initial' ).

    " Check if 'LH' exists and has a count > 0
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_count_lh-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'LH flight count should be greater than 0' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'LH carrier not found in flight counts' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die neue Open SQL Syntax ab ABAP 7.40 ermöglicht eine viel flexiblere und leistungsfähigere Datenbankabfrage direkt im ABAP-Code. Aggregationsfunktionen wie `COUNT(*)` und die `GROUP BY`-Klausel können direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung verwendet werden, was die Notwendigkeit von manuellen Schleifen und Aggregationen im ABAP-Programm reduziert. Die `@`-Escape-Zeichen für Host-Variablen und Inline-Deklarationen (`INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) sind ebenfalls moderne Features, die den Code sauberer machen.
keywords: Open SQL, Aggregation, GROUP BY, Database Access, SFLIGHTS, COUNT

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte, unter Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` und der Möglichkeit, die Fehlermeldung abzufangen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_root` und `get_text()` der Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = |{ divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_safe_divide FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_divide.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).

    DATA(lv_result_ok) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_ok exp = '5.0000000000000000E+00' msg = 'Division should be 5' ).

    DATA(lv_result_error) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_error exp = 'Error: Division by zero' msg = 'Division by zero should be handled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die strukturierte Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist ein grundlegendes und modernes Konzept in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht es, Ausnahmen (Exceptions) gezielt abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Die Verwendung von `cx_root` als generischer Catch-Typ oder spezifischeren Ausnahmen wie `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` ist Best Practice. Die Methode `get_text()` der Ausnahme liefert eine lokalisierte Fehlermeldung, die direkt verwendet werden kann. String-Templates verbessern die Ausgabe der Fehlermeldung.
keywords: Error Handling, TRY CATCH, Exceptions, cx_root, cx_sy_arithmetic_error

Instructions: Bereite Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für den Export in ein externes Format vor (z.B. als interne Tabelle).
hint: Verwende `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `cl_salv_ex_util` für die Datenaufbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_data_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_export,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_id  TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price_val  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_export.
    TYPES tt_sflight_export TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_export WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data_for_export
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_export_data) TYPE tt_sflight_export.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_data_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data_for_export.
    SELECT carrid AS carrier_id, connid AS flight_id, fldate AS flight_date, price AS price_val
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    " In a real scenario, cl_salv_ex_util might be used for more complex conversions
    " or to get the data from an existing ALV instance. Here, we simulate the data preparation.
    rt_export_data = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflight_raw ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_data_preparation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_data_preparation_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_preparation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_data_export( ).
    DATA(lt_export_data) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data_for_export( iv_max_rows = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_export_data msg = 'Exportdaten sollten nicht leer sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_export_data ) exp = 5 msg = 'Es sollten 5 Zeilen exportiert werden' ).

    READ TABLE lt_export_data INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_row).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_row-carrier_id msg = 'Carrier ID sollte nicht leer sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_data_preparation_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_data_export( ).
    DATA(lt_export_data) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data_for_export( iv_max_rows = 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_export_data msg = 'Exportdaten sollten leer sein bei 0 Zeilen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne Datenbeschaffung mit `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und die Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING #` für die Zuweisung zu einer neuen Struktur. Obwohl `cl_salv_ex_util` hier nicht direkt für die Konvertierung verwendet wird (da die Daten bereits in einer geeigneten Struktur sind), demonstriert es die Vorbereitung von Daten, die typischerweise für ALV-Exporte verwendet werden. Der Unit-Test überprüft die Anzahl der Zeilen und die Existenz von Daten.
keywords: ALV, EXPORT, SFLIGHT, SELECT, CORRESPONDING

Instructions: Ändere die Überschrift und Sichtbarkeit einer Spalte im Feldkatalog für `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Manipuliere den Feldkatalog, der von `cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog` zurückgegeben wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_column_props DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_field_catalog_column
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE salv_t_fieldcatalog.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_column_props IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_field_catalog_column.
    rt_field_catalog = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog( r_data = NEW tt_sflight( ) ).

    LOOP AT rt_field_catalog ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_catalog>)
      WHERE fieldname = 'CARRID'.
      <fs_field_catalog>-seltext = 'Fluggesellschaft'.
      <fs_field_catalog>-no_out = abap_true.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definiere eine Standard-Layout-Variante für ein ALV, die die Spalte `CARRID` ausblendet und die Spalte `CONNID` als erste Spalte anzeigt.
hint: Nutze `cl_salv_ex_util` und die ALV-Layout-Klassen (`cl_salv_layout`, `cl_salv_columns_list`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_layout_variant DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_default_layout_for_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_layout) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_layout.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_layout_variant IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_default_layout_for_sflight.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_sflight( ). " Dummy data for type reference
    DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = DATA(lr_salv_table)
      CHANGING
        t_table = lt_data
    ).

    ro_layout = lr_salv_table->get_layout( ).
    ro_layout->set_default( abap_true ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = lr_salv_table->get_columns( ).
    DATA(lo_column_carrid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
    lo_column_carrid->set_technical( abap_true ). " Hide column

    DATA(lo_column_connid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' ).
    lo_column_connid->set_position( 1 ). " Set as first column
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_layout_variant_definition FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_layout_variant_definition.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_layout_variant( ).
    DATA(lo_layout) = lo_cut->get_default_layout_for_sflight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_layout msg = 'Layout-Objekt sollte erstellt werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_layout->get_default( ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Layout sollte als Standard gesetzt sein' ).

    DATA(lo_alv_dummy) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = DATA(lr_salv_table_dummy)
      CHANGING
        t_table = VALUE zcl_alv_layout_variant=>tt_sflight( )
    ).
    DATA(lo_columns_dummy) = lr_salv_table_dummy->get_columns( ).
    DATA(lo_column_carrid_dummy) = lo_columns_dummy->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_column_carrid_dummy->get_technical( ) exp = abap_true msg = 'CARRID sollte ausgeblendet sein' ).

    DATA(lo_column_connid_dummy) = lo_columns_dummy->get_column( 'CONNID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_column_connid_dummy->get_position( ) exp = 1 msg = 'CONNID sollte an erster Position sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Konfiguration eines ALV-Layouts, um Spalten auszublenden und ihre Position zu ändern. Es verwendet die Methoden `get_layout`, `set_default`, `get_columns`, `get_column`, `set_technical` und `set_position` der ALV-Klassen. Der Unit-Test überprüft die gesetzten Eigenschaften des Layout- und Spaltenobjekts.
keywords: ALV, LAYOUT, VARIANT, CL_SALV_EX_UTIL, CL_SALV_TABLE, CL_SALV_LAYOUT, CL_SALV_COLUMNS_LIST

CLASS zcl_itb_value_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') anzuzeigen, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrier     TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251203' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20251204' ) ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Flüge für LH gefunden werden.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'Alle gefilterten Flüge sollten von LH sein.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern, ohne explizite Schleifen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Vorbereitung von Daten für Listenanzeigen.
keywords: DATA, FILTER, Internal Tables, List Processing

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug eine kombinierte Zeichenkette aus Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer enthält, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lt_transformed) = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights ... )` und String-Templates für die Kombination.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             flight_description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                               ( flight_description = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: DATA, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, String Templates, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für eine Liste von Flügen (angenommen, jeder Flug hat eine Passagierzahl) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lv_total_passengers) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN it_flights NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-passengers )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                         FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                         NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-passengers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' passengers = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' passengers = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' passengers = 200 ) ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 450
      msg = 'Die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere sollte 450 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data( ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( it_flights = lt_empty_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0
      msg = 'Für eine leere Tabelle sollte die Summe 0 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen Weise. Er initialisiert einen Akkumulator (`sum`) und wendet eine Operation auf jedes Element der Tabelle an, um ein Endergebnis zu erhalten. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen für Summierungen oder andere Reduktionen.
keywords: DATA, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug einen Status ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Unbekannt') basierend auf einem booleschen Wert für 'is_delayed' und einem optionalen Status-Code zu, unter Verwendung des `COND`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lv_status) = COND string( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )` mit verschachtelten Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_is_delayed TYPE abap_bool
        iv_status_code TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_is_delayed = abap_true THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN iv_status_code = 'CANCELED' THEN 'Annulliert'
          ELSE 'Verspätet'
        )
      WHEN iv_is_delayed = abap_false THEN 'Pünktlich'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_on_time FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delayed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_canceled FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_on_time.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_is_delayed = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Pünktlich'
      msg = 'Status sollte Pünktlich sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delayed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_is_delayed = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Verspätet'
      msg = 'Status sollte Verspätet sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_canceled.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_is_delayed = abap_true iv_status_code = 'CANCELED' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Annulliert'
      msg = 'Status sollte Annulliert sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_is_delayed = abap_undefined ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Unbekannt'
      msg = 'Status sollte Unbekannt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu `IF`-`ELSEIF`-`ENDIF`-Konstrukten, besonders nützlich für die dynamische Bestimmung von Texten oder Werten für die Listenanzeige.
keywords: DATA, COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD set_report_header.
    DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout( ).
    lo_list_layout->set_list_header( iv_header_text ).
    " In einem echten Report würde hier WRITE-Anweisungen folgen, um die Liste zu füllen.

  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_header.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_list_layout_header( ).
    " Da cl_abap_list_layout globale Zustände manipuliert und keine direkten Rückgabewerte für set_list_header hat,

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Details eines bestimmten Fluges (z.B. den Flug mit der Flugnummer '0400') aus einer internen Tabelle direkt mit einem Tabellenausdruck. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Flug nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lt_flights[ KEY primary_key WHERE connid = '0400' ]` und fangen Sie `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_by_connid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_connid.
    rs_flight = it_flights[ KEY primary_key WHERE connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_find_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_table_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' ) ).

    DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_connid( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-carrid exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte LH sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_table_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = NEW zcx_sy_itab_line_not_found( )
      msg = 'Es sollte eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, wenn der Flug nicht gefunden wird.' ).
    lo_cut->get_flight_by_connid( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_connid = '9999' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ ... ]`) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten zu lesen, insbesondere wenn ein eindeutiger Schlüssel verwendet wird. Die Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` muss abgefangen werden, wenn die Zeile möglicherweise nicht existiert.
keywords: DATA, Table Expressions, Internal Tables, Exceptions

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine numerische Flugnummer (Typ `s_conn_id`, 4-stellig) in einen String mit führenden Nullen für die Anzeige in einer Liste, unter Verwendung des `CONV`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lv_flight_num_str) = CONV string( |{ iv_connid ALPHA = OUT }| )` oder `CONV string( iv_connid )` und dann String-Funktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_connid_with_leading_zeros
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_connid) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_connid_with_leading_zeros.
    " s_conn_id ist bereits ein CHAR-Typ, der führende Nullen enthält.
    " Die Konvertierung zu STRING ist direkt möglich.
    rv_formatted_connid = CONV string( iv_connid ).
    " Falls iv_connid ein reiner numerischer Typ wäre (z.B. i), würde man String-Templates nutzen:
    " rv_formatted_connid = |{ iv_connid ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 4 PAD = '0' }|.
    " Da s_conn_id bereits CHAR ist, ist die direkte Konvertierung ausreichend.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_connid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_format_connid_short FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->format_connid_with_leading_zeros( iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0400'
      msg = 'Flugnummer sollte korrekt formatiert sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_format_connid_short.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->format_connid_with_leading_zeros( iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0017'
      msg = 'Kurze Flugnummer sollte korrekt formatiert sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV`-Operator ermöglicht die explizite Typkonvertierung in ABAP-Ausdrücken. In diesem Fall wird ein `s_conn_id` (CHAR-Typ mit impliziten führenden Nullen) in einen `string` konvertiert. Für rein numerische Typen, die führende Nullen benötigen, wären String-Templates mit Formatierungsoptionen wie `ALPHA = OUT` oder `PAD = '0'` die modernere Wahl. Hier demonstriert `CONV` die einfache Typanpassung.
keywords: DATA, CONV, Type Conversion, String Formatting

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Chained Method Calls (Methodenketten) zur Konfiguration eines Objekts, z.B. zur Einstellung mehrerer Eigenschaften eines 'List Layout'-Objekts.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um Verkettungen zu ermöglichen. Nutzen Sie `DATA(lo_obj) = NEW zcl_chained_methods( )->set_prop1( ... )->set_prop2( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_property1 TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_property2 TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS set_property1
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_methods.

    METHODS set_property2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_methods.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_property1.
    me->mv_property1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_property2.
    me->mv_property2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chained_calls FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_calls.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chained_methods( )->set_property1( 'Wert 1' )->set_property2( 'Wert 2' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_property1 exp = 'Wert 1'
      msg = 'Property1 sollte gesetzt sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_property2 exp = 'Wert 2'
      msg = 'Property2 sollte gesetzt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenketten (Chained Method Calls) verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem sie es ermöglichen, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf dasselbe Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgibt. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster in der modernen objektorientierten Programmierung.
keywords: DATA, Object Orientation, Chained Methods, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN it_flights GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                                   count  = lines( GROUP ls_group ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251203' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20251204' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251205' ) ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Gruppen gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count exp = 3
      msg = 'LH sollte 3 Flüge haben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count exp = 1
      msg = 'AA sollte 1 Flug haben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE tt_flights( ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_empty_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_counts )
      msg = 'Für eine leere Tabelle sollte keine Gruppe gefunden werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`-Ausdruck ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion ab ABAP 7.50, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu klassischen `LOOP AT ... AT NEW`-Konstrukten und ideal für die Vorbereitung von zusammengefassten Daten für Listen oder Berichte.
keywords: DATA, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp, unter Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` und `ASSIGN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA gr_table TYPE HANDLE r_table_type` und `ASSIGN gr_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_simple_data.
    TYPES tt_simple_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simple_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.

    METHODS fill_and_read_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_content) TYPE tt_simple_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE ir_table_type.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fill_and_read_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Annahme: Der Tabellentyp ist tt_simple_data oder kompatibel
    " Dynamisches Füllen (Beispiel)
    DATA(ls_data1) = VALUE ty_simple_data( field1 = 'Dynamic A' field2 = 10 ).
    INSERT ls_data1 INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    DATA(ls_data2) = VALUE ty_simple_data( field1 = 'Dynamic B' field2 = 20 ).
    INSERT ls_data2 INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

    " Dynamisches Lesen und Konvertieren
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      DATA(ls_simple_data) = CORRESPONDING ty_simple_data( <fs_line> ).
      APPEND ls_simple_data TO rt_content.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_simple_data.
    TYPES tt_simple_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simple_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creation( ).

    " Beschaffung des Tabellentyp-Deskriptors für tt_simple_data
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE_CREATION=>TT_SIMPLE_DATA' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lo_table_descr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lr_dynamic_table
      msg = 'Dynamische Tabelle sollte erstellt werden.' ).

    DATA(lt_content) = lo_cut->fill_and_read_dynamic_table( lr_dynamic_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_content ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Zeilen in der dynamischen Tabelle sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_content[ 1 ]-field1 exp = 'Dynamic A'
      msg = 'Erste Zeile Feld1 ist korrekt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Tabellenerstellung zur Laufzeit ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das mit `CREATE DATA` und Typ-Deskriptoren (`cl_abap_tabledescr`) realisiert wird. Der Zugriff auf die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle erfolgt über Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`). Dies ist nützlich für generische Programme oder Frameworks, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen, z.B. bei der dynamischen Generierung von Listenlayouts.
keywords: DATA, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, Type Descriptors, CREATE DATA, ASSIGN

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH').

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft ein bestimmtes Zeichen (z.B. 'A') in einem gegebenen String vorkommt.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `REDUCE` und `COND` für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_char_in_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_char_in_string.
    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR char IN iv_text
      WHERE ( char = iv_char )
      NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_char FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_char.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_char( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_char_in_string( iv_text = 'ABAP IS GREAT' iv_char = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 msg = 'Sollte 3 A''s zählen.' ).

    lv_count = lo_cut->count_char_in_string( iv_text = 'HELLO WORLD' iv_char = 'Z' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Sollte 0 Z''s zählen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `REDUCE` und `FOR` mit einer `WHERE` Bedingung ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Zählung von Elementen in einem String oder einer internen Tabelle, ohne explizite `LOOP` Anweisungen.
keywords: COUNT, String, REDUCE, FOR, COND

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR` Expression, um die Daten zu gruppieren und dann zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_grouped DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_grouped IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                         ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                           flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_grouped FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_grouped.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_count_grouped( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->count_flights_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein.' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_count_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_count_lh msg = 'LH sollte im Ergebnis sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_count_lh-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'LH sollte Flüge haben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF` Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `GROUP SIZE` ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Syntax, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen (wie das Zählen der Gruppengröße) direkt in einem Ausdruck durchzuführen.
keywords: COUNT, Grouping, FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, GROUP SIZE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Objekte in einer Liste von Objektreferenzen, die eine bestimmte Eigenschaft erfüllen (z.B. eine Methode gibt 'TRUE' zurück).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `COUNT` in Kombination, um die relevanten Objekte zu filtern und dann zu zählen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_countable_object.
  METHODS is_active RETURNING VALUE(rv_active) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_my_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_countable_object.
    DATA mv_active TYPE abap_bool READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_active TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_active = iv_active.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_countable_object~is_active.
    rv_active = mv_active.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_countable_object WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS count_active_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE tt_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_active_objects.
    rv_count = COUNT( FILTER tt_objects( WHERE table_line->is_active( ) = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_active_objects FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_active_objects.
    DATA lt_objects TYPE zcl_object_counter=>tt_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_my_object( iv_active = abap_true ) TO lt_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_my_object( iv_active = abap_false ) TO lt_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_my_object( iv_active = abap_true ) TO lt_objects.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_object_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_active_objects( lt_objects ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 aktive Objekte zählen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `COUNT` ermöglicht eine elegante und funktionale Art, Objekte in einer Liste basierend auf Methodenaufrufen oder Eigenschaften zu filtern und deren Anzahl zu bestimmen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in objektorientierten Szenarien.
keywords: COUNT, FILTER, Object Orientation, Interfaces, Methods

CLASS zcl_count_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

Instructions: Finde alle E-Mail-Adressen in einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` und die Methode `FIND_ALL` mit einem geeigneten Regex-Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_find_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_emails
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_find_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_emails.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_match( ) TO rt_emails.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_emails.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_find_emails( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Kontaktieren Sie uns unter info@example.com oder support@domain.de. Invalid: test@.com`.
    DATA(lt_emails) = lo_cut->find_emails( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_emails ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_emails[1] ). " Check for initial line, then specific values
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[1] exp = 'info@example.com' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_emails[2] exp = 'support@domain.de' ).

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String eine gültige IPv4-Adresse ist.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein Regex-Muster für IPv4 und verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MATCHER=>MATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_validate_ipv4 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_ipv4
      IMPORTING
        iv_ip_address TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_validate_ipv4 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_ipv4.
    DATA(lv_octet) = `(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)`.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = lv_octet && `\.` && lv_octet && `\.` && lv_octet && `\.` && lv_octet.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_ip_address ).

    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_ipv4 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_ipv4 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_validate_ipv4( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '0.0.0.0' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '255.255.255.255' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_validate_ipv4( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.256' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( 'abc.def.ghi.jkl' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '1.2.3' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_ipv4( '1.2.3.4.5' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `MATCH` von `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` prüft, ob der gesamte Eingabestring dem Regex-Muster entspricht. Dies ist ideal für Validierungszwecke. Das Muster wird aus wiederverwendbaren Oktett-Teilen aufgebaut.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie Vorname und Nachname aus einem String im Format 'Nachname, Vorname' unter Verwendung benannter Gruppen.
hint: Definieren Sie benannte Gruppen im Regex-Muster und verwenden Sie `GET_GROUP` von `CL_ABAP_MATCHER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_named_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name_parts,
             first_name TYPE string,
             last_name  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_name_parts.

    METHODS extract_name_parts
      IMPORTING
        iv_full_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_name_parts) TYPE ty_name_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_named_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_name_parts.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(?<LAST_NAME>[^,]+),\s*(?<FIRST_NAME>.+)$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_full_name ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_name_parts-last_name = lo_matcher->get_group( 'LAST_NAME' ).
      rs_name_parts-first_name = lo_matcher->get_group( 'FIRST_NAME' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_extract_name_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_named_groups( ).
    DATA(lv_full_name) = 'Mustermann, Max'.
    DATA(ls_name_parts) = lo_cut->extract_name_parts( lv_full_name ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_name_parts-first_name exp = 'Max' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_name_parts-last_name exp = 'Mustermann' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_name_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_named_groups( ).
    DATA(lv_full_name) = 'Max Mustermann'. " Wrong format
    DATA(ls_name_parts) = lo_cut->extract_name_parts( lv_full_name ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_name_parts-first_name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_name_parts-last_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Benannte Gruppen im Regex-Muster (`?<GROUP_NAME>`) ermöglichen eine klarere und robustere Extraktion von Teilstrings. `CL_ABAP_MATCHER=>GET_GROUP` greift direkt auf diese benannten Gruppen zu, was den Code lesbarer macht.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der durch Semikolon oder Komma getrennte Werte enthält, in eine interne Tabelle auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `FIND_ALL` um die Trennzeichen zu finden und dann die Substrings zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_split_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_string_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_split_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_string_by_regex.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `[^,;]+`." Matches one or more characters that are not comma or semicolon
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_input_string ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find( ).
      DATA(lv_part) = lo_matcher->get_match( ).
      CONDENSE lv_part NO-GAPS.
      IF lv_part IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lv_part TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Datensätze in `ZFLIGHTS_TEMP` ein, aber nur wenn der Datensatz noch nicht existiert (UPSERT-ähnliches Verhalten).

CLASS zcl_db_upsert_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS upsert_flight_records
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_processed) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_upsert_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upsert_flight_records.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      INSERT zflights_temp FROM ls_flight ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_rows_processed = lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis in einer Tabelle von Flügen unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit der `MAX`-Funktion oder einer manuellen Vergleichslogik.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
        INIT max_price = 0
        FOR flight IN it_flights
        NEXT max_price = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_price THEN flight-price ELSE max_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft den höchsten Flugpreis aus einer Tabelle von Flügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe den `REDUCE`-Operator oder eine Schleife, um den `MAX`-Wert zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_price_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_by_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_max_price_by_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_max_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_prices_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_max_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_price_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_prices_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_max_price_in_group) = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT max_price = 0
          FOR flight_in_group IN GROUP ls_group_key
          NEXT max_price = COND #( WHEN flight_in_group-price > max_price THEN flight_in_group-price ELSE max_price ) ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid max_price = lv_max_price_in_group ) TO rt_max_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_max_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_prices.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_max_price_by_carrier=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '250.50' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' price = '120.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '180.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_by_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_max_prices) = lo_cut->get_max_prices_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_max_prices )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should return 2 entries for 2 carriers' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_max) = lt_max_prices[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_max-max_price
      exp = '250.50'
      msg = 'Max price for LH should be 250.50' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_max) = lt_max_prices[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_max-max_price
      exp = '150.00'
      msg = 'Max price for AA should be 150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_max_price_by_carrier=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_price_by_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_max_prices) = lo_cut->get_max_prices_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_max_prices
      msg = 'Should return an empty table for an empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke Syntax für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe ermöglicht dies eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Ermittlung von Maximalwerten pro Gruppe.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, REDUCE, MAXIMUM, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL durch und geben Sie den Antworttext zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` zum Erstellen, Senden und Empfangen der HTTP-Nachricht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_get_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check. " General exception for simplicity, more specific ones in real code
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_get_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Create HTTP client
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine externe URL und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` für den Request und `/UI2/CL_JSON` für die JSON-Serialisierung/Deserialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_data,
             name TYPE string,
             job  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_post_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_response,
             name       TYPE string,
             job        TYPE string,
             id         TYPE string,
             createdat  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_post_response.

    METHODS perform_post_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        is_data TYPE ty_post_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_post_response
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_post_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_json_request TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_response_body TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Serialize ABAP structure to JSON string
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = is_data
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case " Optional: convert field names to camelCase
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_request ).

        " Create HTTP client
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        " Set request method and headers
        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

        " Send request
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->get_last_error( IMPORTING message = lv_error_message ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
        ENDIF.

        " Receive response
        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->get_last_error( IMPORTING message = lv_error_message ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
        ENDIF.

        " Get response body
        lv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

        " Deserialize JSON response to ABAP structure
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = lv_response_body
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
          CHANGING
            data        = rs_response ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |JSON parsing error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
      FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit benutzerdefinierten Headern und Basic-Authentifizierung durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` Methoden wie `set_header_field` und `authenticate`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_auth_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_authenticated_get
      IMPORTING
        iv_url      TYPE string
        iv_username TYPE string
        iv_password TYPE string
        it_headers  TYPE string_table OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_auth_get IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_authenticated_get.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_get ).

        " Set custom headers
        LOOP AT it_headers INTO DATA(lv_header_line).
          DATA(lv_name) = SUBSTRING( val = lv_header_line off = 0 len = FIND( val = lv_header_line sub = ':' ) ).
          DATA(lv_value) = SUBSTRING( val = lv_header_line off = FIND( val = lv_header_line sub = ':' ) + 1 ).
          lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = lv_name value = lv_value ).
        ENDLOOP.

        " Set Basic Authentication
        lo_http_client->authenticate(
          EXPORTING
            username = iv_username
            password = iv_password ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->get_last_error( IMPORTING message = lv_error_message ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->get_last_error( IMPORTING message = lv_error_message ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_error->get_text( ).
      FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators und finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` zum Initialisieren der Tabelle und anschließend `REDUCE` oder `SORT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_max_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_from_value_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_max_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_from_value_table.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    " Find the flight with the maximum price using REDUCE
    rs_max_flight = REDUCE #( 
        INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( )
        FOR flight IN lt_flights
        NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_flight-price THEN flight ELSE max_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_max_price_from_value_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_value_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_price_from_value_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_max_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_max_flight) = lo_cut->get_max_price_from_value_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_max_flight-price
      exp = '250.50'
      msg = 'Should return the flight with the maximum price' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_max_flight-connid
      exp = '0401'
      msg = 'Should return the correct flight connection' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_value_table.
    " This test case is slightly artificial as the VALUE operator always creates a table.
    " To test an 'empty' scenario, one would typically pass an empty table to the method.
    " However, the current method creates its own table.
    " For demonstration, we'll assert that the method works as expected with its hardcoded data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_max_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_max_flight) = lo_cut->get_max_price_from_value_table( ).

    " If the VALUE operator was empty, the result would be initial.
    " Here, we expect a non-initial result based on the provided data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_max_flight-price
      msg = 'Should return a non-initial price from the hardcoded table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` für einen PATCH-Request mit einem JSON-Payload, um eine Ressource teilweise zu aktualisieren.
hint: Setzen Sie die HTTP-Methode auf `PATCH` und verwenden Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON` für den Payload.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_patch_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_patch_data,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_patch_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_patch_response,
             name       TYPE string,
             job        TYPE string,
             updatedat  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_patch_response.

    METHODS perform_patch_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        is_data TYPE ty_patch_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_patch_response
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_patch_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_patch_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_json_request TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_response_body TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = is_data
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_request ).

        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_patch ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->get_last_error( IMPORTING message = lv_error_message ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error sending HTTP request: { lv_error_message }|.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->get_last_error( IMPORTING message = lv_error_message ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Error receiving HTTP response: { lv_error_message }|.
        ENDIF.

        lv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = lv_response_body
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
          CHANGING
            data        = rs_response ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |JSON parsing error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
      FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis in einer internen Tabelle, die mit dem `FILTER`-Operator nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft gefiltert wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und anschließend `REDUCE` oder `SORT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_sflight(
      it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
    ).

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
        INIT max_price = 0
        FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
        NEXT max_price = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_price THEN flight-price ELSE max_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
