CLASS zcl_esh_cache_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_sflight_cache_validity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_sflight_cache_validity.
    " In a real scenario, you would pass the actual object type and possibly instance ID.
    " For SFLIGHT, it's typically a search connector.
    " This example assumes a generic check for a 'SFLIGHT' related search object.
    " The actual object type for ESH cache check might be more complex, e.g.,
    " a specific connector ID or model ID.
    CONSTANTS: lc_object_type TYPE string VALUE 'SFLIGHT_CONNECTOR'. " Placeholder

    TRY.
        rb_is_valid = cl_esh_ca_check=>is_cache_valid(
          i_object_type = lc_object_type
          " i_object_id = '...' " If checking for a specific instance
        ).
      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., ESH not configured or object type unknown
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rb_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_esh_cache_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_esh_cache_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_checker( ).
    DATA(lb_is_valid) = abap_false.

    " This test is highly dependent on the actual ESH configuration
    " and whether a 'SFLIGHT_CONNECTOR' exists and its cache status.
    " For a robust unit test, one might need to mock cl_esh_ca_check,
    " but for a simple demonstration, we call it directly.
    TRY.
        lb_is_valid = lo_cut->check_sflight_cache_validity( ).
        " Assert based on expected system state or mock behavior
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
          act = lb_is_valid
          msg = 'Methode sollte einen booleschen Wert zurückgeben.'
        ).
      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Fehler beim ESH Cache Check: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse cl_esh_ca_check bietet Funktionalität zur Überprüfung des Enterprise Search Caches. Dies ist wichtig, um die Aktualität der Suchergebnisse sicherzustellen und Performance-Probleme zu identifizieren, die durch veraltete Cache-Einträge verursacht werden könnten.
keywords: Enterprise Search, Cache, ESH, cl_esh_ca_check

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere oder von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, unter Verwendung des CORRESPONDING-Operators.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR für die dynamische Typisierung und CREATE DATA für die Instanziierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_template,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_template.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data_template TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_template WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Get description of the template structure
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data_template[ 1 ] ).

    " Create a table type description based on the structure
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    " Assign data (example: copy from template)
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any,
                   <ls_template_line> TYPE ty_flight_template.

    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    LOOP AT it_data_template ASSIGNING <ls_template_line>.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_line_wa>).
      <fs_dynamic_line_wa> = CORRESPONDING #( <ls_template_line> ).
      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line_wa> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lt_template_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table=>tt_flight_template(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_template_data ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = <lt_dynamic_table>
      msg = 'Dynamische Tabelle sollte gebunden sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Dynamische Tabelle sollte 2 Einträge enthalten.'
    ).

    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = <fs_carrid>
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'Erster Eintrag in dynamischer Tabelle sollte LH sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erzeugung von internen Tabellen und Strukturen mittels RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und CREATE DATA ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, die Flexibilität in Szenarien bietet, in denen die Datenstruktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Datenverarbeitung oder Schnittstellen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Internal Tables

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Überprüfen Sie, ob der Datensatz gefunden wurde.
hint: Nutzen Sie SELECT SINGLE mit INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS und prüfen Sie sy-subrc.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_found.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_reader->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_not_found.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_abap_not_found expected' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception cx_abap_not_found caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @data(...)` ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der Zielstruktur. Die Prüfung von `sy-subrc` ist hier immer noch relevant, um festzustellen, ob ein Datensatz gefunden wurde, und wird mit einer modernen Ausnahmebehandlung kombiniert.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme für ungültige Eingaben und demonstrieren Sie deren Verwendung mit TRY...CATCH.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_input_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.

CLASS zcl_input_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value <= 0.

    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_value * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS. Wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator und eine Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle. Prüfen Sie nach dem SELECT, ob die Tabelle initial ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                               FOR flight IN lt_flights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_price.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    " Assuming 'AA' has flights in SFLIGHTS with prices
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total ).
    " Specific assertion depends on actual data, e.g.,
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 'expected_sum' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( 'ZZ' ). " Assuming 'ZZ' has no flights
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_abap_not_found expected' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception cx_abap_not_found caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Zeile, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(lt_flights)` und die Prüfung `IF lt_flights IS INITIAL` sind moderne Praktiken.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Inline Declaration, cx_abap_not_found, Exception Handling

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS, die einen Preis über einem Schwellenwert haben, und geben Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen FOR-Ausdruck mit einer WHERE-Klausel und einer Inline-Deklaration für die Zieltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info,
           ty_flight_info_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_high_price_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_flight_info_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_high_price_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
                                   WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                   ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_results FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with prices > 100
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_high_price_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-price > 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_results.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    " Assuming 'AA' has no flights with prices > 999999
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_high_price_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_price = 999999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE`-Klausel ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern und neue Tabellen zu konstruieren. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND`-Anweisungen und macht den Code viel prägnanter.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Filtering, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine komplexe Ausnahme mit verschachtelten Nachrichten und einer Ursache (previous exception) auslöst, indem Sie Methodenketten und Konstruktorausdrücke verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie NEW cx_...() und ->set_text() in einer Kette.
solution:
CLASS zcx_complex_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_complex_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_complex_error
      RAISING
        zcx_complex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_complex_error.
    DATA(lx_inner_error) = NEW cx_abap_invalid_value(
                               textid = VALUE scx_t100key( msgid = 'SY' msgno = '000' msgv1 = 'Inner Error' ) ).

    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_complex_error
      EXPORTING
        textid = VALUE scx_t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '002' msgv1 = 'Outer Error' )
        previous = lx_inner_error.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_complex_error FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_complex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_error.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_error_generator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_generator->generate_complex_error( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_complex_error expected' ).
      CATCH zcx_complex_error INTO DATA(lx_complex_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_complex_error->previous ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_complex_error->get_text( ) exp = 'Outer Error' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_complex_error->previous->get_text( ) exp = 'Inner Error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Möglichkeit, Ausnahmen mit einer `previous` (vorherigen) Ausnahme zu verketten, ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Fehleranalyse. Die Verwendung von `NEW` und `VALUE` in Kombination mit der `RAISE EXCEPTION` Anweisung ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Erzeugung komplexer Fehlerobjekte. Dies ist Teil der `S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS` Konzepte.
keywords: Object Orientation, Exception Handling, Chained Methods, Constructor Expressions, NEW, VALUE, S_ABAP_EXCEPTIONS

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung einer Hilfsklasse wie `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` (oder eines ähnlichen Konzepts) zur Sammlung und Verarbeitung von Nachrichten, anstatt sie direkt auszugeben.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Message-Collector-Klasse, die Nachrichten sammelt und später ausgibt oder verarbeitet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             type TYPE symsgty,
             id   TYPE symsgid,
             no   TYPE symsgno,
             v1   TYPE symsgv,
             v2   TYPE symsgv,
             v3   TYPE symsgv,
             v4   TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message,
           ty_message_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE symsgty
        iv_id   TYPE symsgid
        iv_no   TYPE symsgno
        iv_v1   TYPE symsgv OPTIONAL
        iv_v2   TYPE symsgv OPTIONAL
        iv_v3   TYPE symsgv OPTIONAL
        iv_v4   TYPE symsgv OPTIONAL.

    METHODS get_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE ty_message_table.

    METHODS has_errors
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_errors) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_messages TYPE ty_message_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_message.
    APPEND VALUE ty_message( type = iv_type id = iv_id no = iv_no v1 = iv_v1 v2 = iv_v2 v3 = iv_v3 v4 = iv_v4 )
      TO mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_messages.
    rt_messages = mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD has_errors.
    rv_has_errors = abap_false.
    LOOP AT mt_messages INTO DATA(ls_msg) WHERE type = 'E' OR type = 'A'.
      rv_has_errors = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_with_messages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_process
      IMPORTING
        io_message_collector TYPE REF TO zcl_message_collector.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_with_messages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_process.
    " Simulate some processing
    io_message_collector->add_message( iv_type = 'S' iv_id = 'ZMSG' iv_no = '003' iv_v1 = 'Schritt 1' iv_v2 = 'erfolgreich' ).

    " Simulate an error
    io_message_collector->add_message( iv_type = 'E' iv_id = 'ZMSG' iv_no = '004' iv_v1 = 'Schritt 2' iv_v2 = 'fehlgeschlagen' ).

    " Simulate a warning
    io_message_collector->add_message( iv_type = 'W' iv_id = 'ZMSG' iv_no = '005' iv_v1 = 'Schritt 3' iv_v2 = 'Warnung' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_message_collection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_message_collection.
    DATA(lo_collector) = NEW zcl_message_collector( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_process_with_messages( ).

    lo_processor->execute_process( io_message_collector ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_collector->get_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_collector->has_errors( ) ).

    DATA(ls_error_msg) = lt_messages[ 2 ].

Sie kapselt die Logik zum Hinzufügen, Abrufen und Prüfen von Nachrichten, was die Testbarkeit und Flexibilität erhöht. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für das Hinzufügen von Nachrichten ist eine moderne Syntax.

Instructions: Verketten Sie eine Liste von Flugnummern zu einem durch Kommas getrennten String. Wenn die Liste leer ist, geben Sie eine entsprechende Nachricht zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit String-Templates für die Verkettung und eine COND-Expression für die leere Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_string_joiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS join_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_joined_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_joiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_flight_numbers.
    rv_joined_string = COND string(
      WHEN it_connids IS INITIAL THEN 'Keine Flugnummern vorhanden.'
      ELSE REDUCE string(
             INIT s = ``
             FOR connid IN it_connids
             NEXT s = COND string(
                        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ connid }|
                        ELSE |{ s }, { connid }| ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert mehrere moderne ABAP-Features: den `REDUCE`-Operator für die iterative String-Verkettung, String-Templates (`|...|`) für die Formatierung und den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung (sowohl für den Gesamtfall einer leeren Tabelle als auch innerhalb des `REDUCE` für das erste Element). Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf mehreren Kriterien (Flugdatum, Statuscode). Verwenden Sie den SWITCH-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den SWITCH-Operator, um einen Wert basierend auf komplexeren Bedingungen zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string(
      iv_status_code
      WHEN 0 THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN iv_fldate < sy-datum THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
          WHEN iv_fldate = sy-datum THEN 'Heute, pünktlich'
          ELSE 'Zukünftig, pünktlich' )
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Abgesagt'
      ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie den GROUP BY-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit GROUP BY und den REDUCE-Operator für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count,
           ty_flight_count_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_grouped_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                   count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT c = c + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_grouped ).

    " Example: Check if 'AA' exists and has a count
    READ TABLE lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_aa_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_group-count > 0 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Carrier AA not found in grouped results' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check total count matches original table (if no filtering)
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_total_flights).
    DATA(lv_sum_grouped_counts) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR entry IN lt_grouped NEXT s = s + entry-count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum_grouped_counts exp = lv_total_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`-Ausdruck ist eine der leistungsstärksten und modernsten Funktionen für die Verarbeitung interner Tabellen. Er ermöglicht komplexe Gruppierungen und Aggregationen direkt im Code, oft in Kombination mit `REDUCE`, was zu extrem kompaktem und effizientem Code führt. Die Prüfung von `sy-subrc` nach `READ TABLE` ist hier immer noch relevant.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation, REDUCE, sy-subrc

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und aktualisieren Sie den Preis für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft direkt über ein Feld-Symbol.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_new_price  TYPE s_price
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_for_carrier.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)
         WHERE carrid = iv_carrier_id.
      <fs_sflight>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-price  = 100.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0017'.
    ls_sflight-price  = 200.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_update( ).
    lo_cut->update_price_for_carrier(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrier_id = 'LH'
        iv_new_price  = 150
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights   = lt_sflights
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_updated_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_updated_lh-price
      exp = 150
      msg = 'Preis für LH sollte aktualisiert sein.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_unchanged_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_unchanged_aa-price
      exp = 200
      msg = 'Preis für AA sollte unverändert sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` in einer `LOOP` ist die effizienteste Methode, um Zeilen einer internen Tabelle direkt zu modifizieren, da keine unnötigen Datenkopien entstehen.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Tables, LOOP AT

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts aufruft, deren Name als String übergeben wird. Die aufgerufene Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.

INTERFACE zif_dynamic_callable.
  METHODS get_value_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_value_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO zif_dynamic_callable
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf von Methode '{ iv_method_name }': { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dynamic_callable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_callable~get_value_a.
    rv_value = 'Value A from Service'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_dynamic_callable~get_value_b.
    rv_value = 'Value B from Service'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Greifen Sie anschließend dynamisch auf die Zeilen zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `ASSIGN (lv_table_name) TO <fs_table>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE tabname
        it_data_to_insert  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_data        TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        " Dynamische Erstellung der internen Tabelle
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type_name).
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Fehler beim Zuweisen der dynamischen Tabelle.|.
        ENDIF.

        " Dynamisches Füllen der Tabelle
        LOOP AT it_data_to_insert INTO DATA(lv_string_value).
          CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE (iv_table_type_name).
          ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_line>.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
              EXPORTING
                text = |Fehler beim Zuweisen der dynamischen Zeile.|.
          ENDIF.
          " Annahme: Die Tabelle hat eine Komponente, die einen String aufnehmen kann
          " Für dieses Beispiel nehmen wir an, es ist eine Tabelle von Strings (TYPE string)
          <fs_line> = lv_string_value.
          APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
        ENDLOOP.

        " Dynamisches Lesen und Verarbeiten der Tabelle
        LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
          APPEND <fs_line> TO rt_processed_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim Erstellen der dynamischen Tabelle: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error INTO DATA(lx_assign_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim Zuweisen: { lx_assign_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_sflights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                    WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier_id )
                                    ( <fs_sflight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie einen übergebenen Wert dynamisch gegen eine Liste von erlaubten Werten, die aus einer Konstantenstruktur von `CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS` stammen. Der Name der Konstantenstruktur wird dynamisch übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` um die Konstantenstruktur dynamisch zu referenzieren und dann deren Komponenten zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_const_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_against_mmpur_const
      IMPORTING
        iv_value             TYPE string
        iv_const_struct_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid)   TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_const_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_against_mmpur_const.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_const_struct> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component>    TYPE any.

    DATA(lv_full_const_path) = |CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS=>{ iv_const_struct_name }|.

    ASSIGN (lv_full_const_path) TO <fs_const_struct>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Konstantenstruktur '{ iv_const_struct_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <fs_const_struct> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      IF <fs_component> = iv_value.
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rv_is_valid = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_totals
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_totals.
    rt_carrier_totals = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                 GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                 ( carrid      = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                   total_price = REDUCE s_price(
                                                   INIT sum = 0
                                                   FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP <fs_sflight>
                                                   NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-price = 100. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-price = 200. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-price = 150. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'BA'. ls_sflight-price = 300. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_totals( it_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_total) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_total-total_price
      exp = 250
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für LH sollte 250 sein.'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_total) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_total-total_price
      exp = 200
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für AA sollte 200 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr expressive und effiziente Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit für explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen.

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere Strings zu einem einzigen Satz, wobei jeder String durch ein Komma und ein Leerzeichen getrennt wird, außer dem letzten String, der mit einem Punkt endet. Verwenden Sie String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit `FOR` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_concatenator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concatenator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    IF it_strings IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = |
      { REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ``
          FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > lines( it_strings )
          NEXT s = COND string(
                     WHEN i = 1 THEN it_strings[ i ]
                     WHEN i = lines( it_strings ) THEN |{ s }, { it_strings[ i ]}.|
                     ELSE |{ s }, { it_strings[ i ]}| ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl unter Verwendung eines funktionalen Ansatzes mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Schleife von 1 bis zur gegebenen Zahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fakultät ist für negative Zahlen nicht definiert.'.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number = 0.
      rv_factorial = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = 1
      FOR n = 1 THEN n + 1 UNTIL n > iv_number
      NEXT result = result * n
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factorial_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factorial_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factorial_negative FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factorial_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_factorial( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Fakultät von 0 sollte 1 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factorial_positive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_factorial( ).
    DATA(lv_result_3) = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_3
      exp = 6
      msg = 'Fakultät von 3 sollte 6 sein.'
    ).
    DATA(lv_result_5) = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_5
      exp = 120
      msg = 'Fakultät von 5 sollte 120 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factorial_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_factorial( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW zcx_sy_arithmetic_error( )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
      msg = 'Fehler sollte bei negativer Zahl ausgelöst werden.'
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_factorial( -1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception wurde nicht ausgelöst.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        " Expected exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Implementierung von Aggregations- und Reduktionsoperationen in einer funktionalen Weise. Dies macht den Code kompakter, lesbarer und oft effizienter als traditionelle Schleifen mit expliziten Akkumulatoren.
keywords: Math, REDUCE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Datumsklassen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` und Schleifen mit Datumskonvertierungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_workday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_workdays
      IMPORTING
        id_start TYPE d
        id_end   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_workday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_workdays.
    DATA: ld_current TYPE d.
    rv_workdays = 0.

    IF id_start > id_end.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ld_current = id_start.
    DO.
      IF ld_current > id_end.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( ld_current ).
      IF lv_weekday <> 6 AND lv_weekday <> 7. " 6 = Samstag, 7 = Sonntag
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.

      ld_current = ld_current + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_workdays FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_workdays_weekend FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_workdays_reverse FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_workdays_single_day FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_workdays.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_workday_calculator( ).
    " 2025-11-24 (Mo) bis 2025-11-28 (Fr) -> 5 Arbeitstage
    DATA(lv_workdays) = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( id_start = '20251124' id_end = '20251128' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_workdays
      exp = 5
      msg = '5 Arbeitstage sollten korrekt berechnet werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_workdays_weekend.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_workday_calculator( ).
    " 2025-11-28 (Fr) bis 2025-12-01 (Mo) -> Fr, Mo = 2 Arbeitstage
    DATA(lv_workdays) = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( id_start = '20251128' id_end = '20251201' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_workdays
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Arbeitstage über Wochenende sollten korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_workdays_reverse.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_workday_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_workdays) = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( id_start = '20251128' id_end = '20251124' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_workdays
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Bei umgekehrten Daten sollte 0 zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_workdays_single_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_workday_calculator( ).
    " 2025-11-29 (Sa) -> 0 Arbeitstage
    DATA(lv_workdays_sa) = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( id_start = '20251129' id_end = '20251129' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_workdays_sa

      msg = 'Samstag sollte 0 Arbeitstage sein.'
    ).
    " 2025-11-28 (Fr) -> 1 Arbeitstag
    DATA(lv_workdays_fr) = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( id_start = '20251128' id_end = '20251128' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_workdays_fr
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Freitag sollte 1 Arbeitstag sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_codepage_utf8_to_iso DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING

      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_utf8_to_iso IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_converter(
      source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      destination_codepage = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
    ).
    rv_iso_string = lo_converter->convert( iv_utf8_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_utf8_to_iso FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_utf8_to_iso( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_input) = 'Grüße aus München'. " Contains German umlauts
    DATA(lv_expected_iso) = 'Grüße aus München'. " ISO-8859-1 can handle these

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_converted) = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_iso( lv_utf8_input ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted exp = lv_expected_iso ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Test with characters not representable in ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_utf8_japanese) = 'こんにちは'. " Japanese characters
    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_iso( lv_utf8_japanese ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_codepage_converter_error for unrepresentable characters' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        " Expected error, test passed
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Inhalt einer simulierten Datei (als XSTRING) von einer Codepage in eine andere.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage` für die Konvertierung von XSTRING zu STRING und dann STRING zu XSTRING mit unterschiedlichen Codepages.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_file_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_file_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_dest_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_dest_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_file_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_file_content.
    " 1. Convert source XSTRING to STRING using source codepage
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source      = iv_source_xstring
      codepage    = iv_source_codepage
      endian      = cl_abap_codepage=>endian_little
    ).

    " 2. Convert STRING to XSTRING using destination codepage
    rv_dest_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source      = lv_temp_string
      codepage    = iv_dest_codepage
      endian      = cl_abap_codepage=>endian_little
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_file_content_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_content_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_file_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Dies ist ein Test mit Sonderzeichen: €ßäöü'.

    " Simulate a UTF-8 encoded file content
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source      = lv_original_string
      codepage    = 'UTF-8'
      endian      = cl_abap_codepage=>endian_little
    ).

    " Convert from UTF-8 to ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_iso_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_file_content(
      iv_source_xstring  = lv_utf8_xstring
      iv_source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      iv_dest_codepage   = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
    ).

    " Convert back from ISO-8859-1 to string to verify
    DATA(lv_converted_back_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source      = lv_iso_xstring
      codepage    = '1100'
      endian      = cl_abap_codepage=>endian_little
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_back_string exp = lv_original_string ).

    " Test with a codepage that cannot represent all characters (e.g., ASCII)
    DATA(lv_ascii_codepage) = '1103'. " US-ASCII
    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_file_content(
          iv_source_xstring  = lv_utf8_xstring
          iv_source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
          iv_dest_codepage   = lv_ascii_codepage
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_codepage_converter_error for unrepresentable characters' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        " Expected error, test passed
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert einen vollständigen Workflow zur Codepage-Konvertierung für Dateiinhalte. Zuerst wird der binäre Inhalt (XSTRING) mit der Quell-Codepage in einen String umgewandelt, dann dieser String mit der Ziel-Codepage wieder in einen XSTRING kodiert. Dies ist ein gängiges Szenario beim Import/Export von Dateien mit unterschiedlichen Zeichensätzen.
keywords: Codepage, XSTRING, STRING, File Conversion, cl_abap_codepage, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1

CLASS zcl_count_per_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_count_per_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_per_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Festwerte einer Domäne aus und ersetzen Sie in deren Kurztexten alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens durch ein anderes. Geben Sie die modifizierten Festwerte zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_ddic_doma` zur Domänenanalyse und die `REPLACE` Anweisung mit `ALL OCCURRENCES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_replace_fixed_val DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             low    TYPE dd07v-domvalue_l,
             text   TYPE dd07v-ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value,
           tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_replace_fixed_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_old_char    TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_new_char    TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fixed_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_replace_fixed_val IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_replace_fixed_values.
    DATA: lt_dd07v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.

    " Simulate reading fixed values from DDIC (cl_reca_ddic_doma would be used in real scenario)
    " For demonstration, we'll use a dummy table or direct select if possible.
    " In a real system, you'd use cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_domain_fixed_values or similar.
    SELECT domvalue_l, ddtext
      FROM dd07v
      INTO TABLE lt_dd07v
      WHERE domname = @iv_domain_name
      AND ddlanguage = @sy-langu.

    rt_fixed_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_dd07v
                                LET lv_modified_text = ls_dd07v-ddtext IN
                                ( low = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l,
                                  text = REPLACE( val = lv_modified_text
                                                  all occurrences of iv_old_char
                                                  with iv_new_char ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_replace_fixed_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_fixed_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ddic_replace_fixed_val( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_and_replace_fixed_values( iv_domain_name = 'ABAP_BOOL' " Example domain
                                                            iv_old_char    = ' '
                                                            iv_new_char    = '_' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " ABAP_BOOL has no fixed values in DD07V by default

    " For a domain with fixed values, e.g., 'XFELD' (Boolean Flag)
    DATA(lt_xfeld_result) = lo_cut->get_and_replace_fixed_values( iv_domain_name = 'XFELD'
                                                                  iv_old_char    = ' '
                                                                  iv_new_char    = '_' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_xfeld_result ).
    DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_xfeld_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-low exp = 'X' ).
    " Assuming 'Yes' becomes 'Yes' (no space to replace) or 'No' becomes 'No'
    " This test needs to be adapted based on actual XFELD texts and expected replacement.
    " Example: If XFELD has 'True ' and 'False', and we replace ' ' with '_'
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_xfeld_result[ low = 'X' ]-text exp = 'True_' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert das Auslesen von Domänenfestwerten (konzeptionell über `cl_reca_ddic_doma` oder direkt aus `DD07V`) und die moderne Transformation der Daten mittels `VALUE` Operator und `FOR` Iteration. Die `REPLACE` Anweisung wird verwendet, um Zeichen im Kurztext effizient zu ersetzen, was zu saubereren und besser lesbaren Daten führt. Inline-Deklarationen und der `VALUE` Operator machen den Code kompakt und ausdrucksstark.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Beschreibung einer Domäne und ersetzen Sie darin alle Platzhalter wie '&1', '&2' durch konkrete Werte. Die Platzhalter können dynamisch sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_reca_ddic_doma` zum Abrufen der Domänenbeschreibung und `REPLACE REGEX` für die dynamische Ersetzung von Platzhaltern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_replace_placeholders DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_domain_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        it_replacements TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_replace_placeholders IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_domain_description.
    DATA: lv_description TYPE dd01t-ddtext.

    " Simulate reading domain description (cl_reca_ddic_doma would be used)
    " For demonstration, we'll use a dummy description.
    " In a real system, you'd use cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_domain_description or similar.
    lv_description = |Domain description with placeholders: &1 for value, &2 for unit.|.

    rv_modified_description = lv_description.
    LOOP AT it_replacements INTO DATA(lv_replacement_value).
      DATA(lv_placeholder) = |&{ sy-tabix }|.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_placeholder IN rv_modified_description WITH lv_replacement_value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne und flexible Art, Texte basierend auf externen Daten zu personalisieren. Instructions: Validieren Sie einen Benutzereingabewert gegen die Festwerte einer Domäne. Vor dem Vergleich sollen führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen entfernt und die Groß-/Kleinschreibung des Eingabewertes an die Domänenfestwerte angepasst werden. Nutzen Sie `REPLACE` für die Normalisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_reca_ddic_doma` für die Domänenfestwerte und `REPLACE` für die Normalisierung des Eingabewertes (z.B. `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` für Leerzeichen, `TO UPPER/LOWER` für Case-Anpassung).
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_validate_input DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_input_against_domain
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_input_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_validate_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_input_against_domain.
    DATA: lt_dd07v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.

    " Simulate reading fixed values from DDIC
    SELECT domvalue_l, ddtext
      FROM dd07v
      INTO TABLE lt_dd07v
      WHERE domname = @iv_domain_name
      AND ddlanguage = @sy-langu.

    IF lt_dd07v IS INITIAL.
      " No fixed values, or domain not found. Consider valid or raise error.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Normalize input value: remove leading/trailing spaces, convert to uppercase
    DATA(lv_normalized_input) = iv_input_value.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '^\s+|\s+$' IN lv_normalized_input WITH ''.
    lv_normalized_input = to_upper( lv_normalized_input ).

    " Check if normalized input matches any normalized fixed value
    rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_dd07v INTO DATA(ls_dd07v).
      DATA(lv_normalized_domain_value) = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '^\s+|\s+$' IN lv_normalized_domain_value WITH ''.
      lv_normalized_domain_value = to_upper( lv_normalized_domain_value ).

      IF lv_normalized_input = lv_normalized_domain_value.
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_extract_and_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_long_text TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_processed_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_ddic_extract_and_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_domain_text.
    DATA(lv_text) = iv_long_text.
    " Regex to find words starting with 'SAP' (case-insensitive)
    " and replace them with 'S.'
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\b(SAP)\w*\b' IN lv_text WITH 'S.'.
    rv_processed_text = lv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie die Anzeige von Domänen-Wertebereichen. Wenn ein Wertebereich als 'MIN-MAX' (z.B. '001-010') vorliegt, soll er in 'MIN bis MAX' (z.B. '1 bis 10') umgewandelt werden. Führende Nullen sollen entfernt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE REGEX` mit Capture Groups, um die MIN- und MAX-Werte zu extrahieren und neu zu formatieren. `COND` kann für die bedingte Formatierung nützlich sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_format_value_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_range_display
      IMPORTING
        iv_range_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_format_value_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_range_display.
    DATA(lv_input) = iv_range_string.
    DATA(lv_regex) = `^(\d+)-(\d+)$`.

    IF lv_input CO lv_regex.
      DATA(lv_min) TYPE string.
      DATA(lv_max) TYPE string.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX lv_regex IN lv_input
        SUBMATCHES lv_min lv_max.

      " Remove leading zeros and format
      rv_formatted_string = |{ CONV i( lv_min ) } bis { CONV i( lv_max ) }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_formatted_string = iv_range_string. " Return original if no match
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung basierend auf den Festwerten einer Domäne. Die Festwerte sollen dabei korrekt in die `WHERE`-Klausel integriert werden, wobei spezielle Zeichen oder Anführungszeichen mit `REPLACE` behandelt werden müssen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_ddic_doma` für die Festwerte. Erstellen Sie die `WHERE`-Klausel mit String-Templates und verwenden Sie `REPLACE` für die korrekte Maskierung von Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_dynamic_where_clause
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_field_name  TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_where_clause) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_dynamic_where_clause.
    DATA: lt_dd07v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.

    " Simulate reading fixed values from DDIC
    SELECT domvalue_l
      FROM dd07v
      INTO TABLE lt_dd07v
      WHERE domname = @iv_domain_name
      AND ddlanguage = @sy-langu.

    IF lt_dd07v IS INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = |1 = 1|. " No restriction if no fixed values
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_quoted_values) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_dd07v
                                                  LET lv_value = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l IN
                                                  ( |'{ REPLACE( val = lv_value all occurrences of '''' with '''''' ) }'| ) ).

    rv_where_clause = |{ iv_field_name } IN ({ REDUCE string(
                                                INIT s = ''
                                                FOR lv_qval IN lt_quoted_values
                                                NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN lv_qval ELSE s && ', ' && lv_qval ) ) })|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_where FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ddic_dynamic_where( ).

    " Test with XFELD domain (fixed values 'X', ' ')
    DATA(lv_where_xfeld) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( iv_domain_name = 'XFELD'
                                                              iv_field_name  = 'FLAG_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_where_xfeld exp = `FLAG_FIELD IN ('X', ' ')` ).

    " Test with a domain that might have a quote in its value (hypothetical)
    " Let's assume a domain 'Z_QUOTED_DOMAIN' with fixed values: 'Value with ''quote''' and 'Another'.
    " For this test, we'll manually create the expected output.
    DATA(lv_where_quoted) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( iv_domain_name = 'Z_QUOTED_DOMAIN' " This domain doesn't exist, test is conceptual
                                                                iv_field_name  = 'TEXT_FIELD' ).
    " Expected: TEXT_FIELD IN ('Value with ''''quote''''', 'Another')
    " Since we can't mock DD07V easily, we'll test the REPLACE logic directly.
    DATA(lt_mock_dd07v) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v( ( domvalue_l = `Value with 'quote'` ) ( domvalue_l = `Another` ) ).
    DATA(lt_quoted_values) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_mock_dd07v
                                                  LET lv_value = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l IN
                                                  ( |'{ REPLACE( val = lv_value all occurrences of '''' with '''''' ) }'| ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected_quoted) = |TEXT_FIELD IN ({ REDUCE string(
                                                INIT s = ''
                                                FOR lv_qval IN lt_quoted_values
                                                NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN lv_qval ELSE s && ', ' && lv_qval ) ) })|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_expected_quoted exp = `TEXT_FIELD IN ('Value with ''''quote''''', 'Another')` ).

    " Test with no fixed values
    DATA(lv_where_no_fixed) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where_clause( iv_domain_name = 'CHAR10'
                                                                 iv_field_name  = 'ANY_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_where_no_fixed exp = '1 = 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung generiert eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für SQL-Abfragen, indem sie die Festwerte einer Domäne ausliest. Der entscheidende Teil ist die Verwendung von `REPLACE` innerhalb eines `VALUE` Operators, um einzelne Anführungszeichen in den Domänenwerten zu maskieren (doppelte Anführungszeichen für SQL-Strings). Der `REDUCE` Operator wird verwendet, um die Liste der maskierten Werte effizient zu einem kommagetrennten String zu aggregieren. Dies ist ein exzellentes Beispiel für moderne, funktionale Programmierung in ABAP zur Erstellung dynamischer SQL-Statements.
keywords: DDIC, Domäne, Dynamisches SQL, WHERE-Klausel, REPLACE, VALUE, REDUCE, String Processing

Instructions: Sanitisieren Sie eine Benutzereingabe, indem Sie alle nicht-numerischen Zeichen entfernen, wenn die zugehörige Domäne einen numerischen Datentyp hat. Verwenden Sie `REPLACE`.
hint: Ermitteln Sie den Datentyp der Domäne (z.B. über `DD01L`). Nutzen Sie dann `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` um unerwünschte Zeichen zu entfernen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sanitize_numeric_input DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sanitize_input
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_input_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sanitized_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sanitize_numeric_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sanitize_input.
    DATA: ls_dd01l TYPE dd01l.

    " Simulate reading domain data type (cl_reca_ddic_doma would be used)
    SELECT SINGLE datatype
      FROM dd01l
      INTO @ls_dd01l-datatype
      WHERE domname = @iv_domain_name.

    rv_sanitized_value = iv_input_value.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ( ls_dd01l-datatype = 'NUMC' OR ls_dd01l-datatype = 'DEC' OR ls_dd01l-datatype = 'INT' ).
      " Remove all non-numeric characters (except optionally sign and decimal separator for DEC)
      " For simplicity, remove all non-digits here.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[^0-9]' IN rv_sanitized_value WITH ''.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_sanitized_dec) = lo_cut->sanitize_input( iv_domain_name = 'DEC13_2'
                                                     iv_input_value = '1,234.56EUR' ).
    " Current regex removes all non-digits, so ',' and '.' are removed.

    " Test with a character domain (e.g., 'CHAR20')

                                                      iv_input_value = 'ABC123DEF' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sanitized_char exp = 'ABC123DEF' ).

    " Test with non-existent domain
    DATA(lv_sanitized_non_existent) = lo_cut->sanitize_input( iv_domain_name = 'Z_NON_EXISTENT'

Der Datentyp wird aus `DD01L` (konzeptionell über `cl_reca_ddic_doma`) ermittelt. Wenn der Datentyp numerisch ist, wird `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[^0-9]' IN ... WITH ''` verwendet, um alle nicht-numerischen Zeichen zu entfernen. Dies ist eine moderne und sichere Methode, um die Datenintegrität bei der Eingabe zu gewährleisten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten Hilfetext aus den Festwerten einer Domäne, wobei jeder Festwert und sein Kurztext in einer neuen Zeile erscheinen und bestimmte Zeichen im Kurztext ersetzt werden.
hint: Lesen Sie die Festwerte aus. Verwenden Sie String-Templates und `REPLACE` für die Formatierung und Zeichenersetzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_f4_help_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_f4_help_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_char_to_replace TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_replacement_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_help_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_f4_help_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_f4_help_text.
    DATA: lt_dd07v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.

    " Simulate reading fixed values from DDIC
    SELECT domvalue_l, ddtext
      FROM dd07v
      INTO TABLE lt_dd07v
      WHERE domname = @iv_domain_name
      AND ddlanguage = @sy-langu.

    rv_help_text = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_dd07v
      LET lv_modified_text = REPLACE( val = ls_dd07v-ddtext
                                      all occurrences of iv_char_to_replace
                                      with iv_replacement_char ) IN
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                             |{ ls_dd07v-domvalue_l } - { lv_modified_text }|
                           ELSE
                             s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                             |{ ls_dd07v-domvalue_l } - { lv_modified_text }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_f4_help_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_f4_help_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ddic_f4_help_text( ).

    " Test with XFELD domain (fixed values 'X' (Yes), ' ' (No))
    DATA(lv_help_text) = lo_cut->generate_f4_help_text( iv_domain_name = 'XFELD'
                                                        iv_char_to_replace = ' '
                                                        iv_replacement_char = '_' ).

    " Expected output (assuming ddtext for XFELD is 'Yes' and 'No')
    " X - Yes
    "   - No
    " If ' ' is replaced by '_', then ' ' (empty value) will be '_' and 'No' will be 'No'
    " This test needs to be adapted based on actual XFELD texts.
    " For example, if XFELD has 'X' -> 'True ' and ' ' -> 'False'
    " Expected: 'X - True_
    "           _ - False'
    " Let's assume for simplicity that the texts are 'Yes' and 'No'
    DATA(lv_expected_text) = |X - Yes{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }  - No|.
    " The actual text for ' ' is usually empty, so the replacement might not be visible.
    " Let's use a more controlled example.

    " Mocking DD07V for a controlled test
    DATA(lt_mock_dd07v) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v(
      ( domvalue_l = 'A' ddtext = 'Value One' )
      ( domvalue_l = 'B' ddtext = 'Value Two' )
    ).
    " Simulate the logic with mock data
    DATA(lv_mock_result) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_mock_dd07v
      LET lv_modified_text = REPLACE( val = ls_dd07v-ddtext
                                      all occurrences of ' ' with '_' ) IN
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                             |{ ls_dd07v-domvalue_l } - { lv_modified_text }|
                           ELSE
                             s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                             |{ ls_dd07v-domvalue_l } - { lv_modified_text }| ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_mock_result
                                        exp = |A - Value_One{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }B - Value_Two| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung generiert einen formatierten Hilfetext aus Domänenfestwerten. Sie nutzt den `REDUCE` Operator, um die einzelnen Festwerte und ihre modifizierten Kurztexte zu einem einzigen String zu aggregieren. Innerhalb des `REDUCE` Operators wird `REPLACE` verwendet, um spezifische Zeichen in den Kurztexten zu ersetzen. String-Templates (`|...|`) und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` sorgen für eine saubere Formatierung mit Zeilenumbrüchen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, dynamische Texte zu erstellen.
keywords: DDIC, Domäne, F4-Hilfe, REPLACE, REDUCE, String Processing, String Templates

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Kurztexte der Festwerte einer Domäne aus. Wenn ein Kurztext ein bestimmtes Präfix enthält, ersetzen Sie dieses Präfix durch ein anderes. Andernfalls lassen Sie den Text unverändert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_ddic_doma` für die Festwerte. Verwenden Sie `COND` und `REPLACE` für die bedingte Ersetzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_conditional_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             low    TYPE dd07v-domvalue_l,
             text   TYPE dd07v-ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value,
           tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_fixed_value_texts
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_prefix_old  TYPE string
        iv_prefix_new  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_conditional_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_fixed_value_texts.
    DATA: lt_dd07v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.

    " Simulate reading fixed values from DDIC
    SELECT domvalue_l, ddtext
      FROM dd07v
      INTO TABLE lt_dd07v
      WHERE domname = @iv_domain_name
      AND ddlanguage = @sy-langu.

    rt_processed_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_dd07v
                                   ( low = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l,
                                     text = COND string(
                                              WHEN ls_dd07v-ddtext CP |{ iv_prefix_old }*|
                                              THEN REPLACE( val = ls_dd07v-ddtext
                                                            substring = iv_prefix_old
                                                            with = iv_prefix_new )
                                              ELSE ls_dd07v-ddtext ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ddic_conditional_replace( ).

    " Mock DD07V data for a controlled test
    DATA(lt_mock_dd07v) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v(
      ( domvalue_l = 'A' ddtext = 'OLD_Value A' )
      ( domvalue_l = 'B' ddtext = 'Another Value B' )
      ( domvalue_l = 'C' ddtext = 'OLD_Value C' )
    ).

    " Simulate the logic with mock data
    DATA(lt_result) = VALUE zcl_ddic_conditional_replace=>tt_fixed_values( FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_mock_dd07v
                                   ( low = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l,
                                     text = COND string(
                                              WHEN ls_dd07v-ddtext CP 'OLD_*'
                                              THEN REPLACE( val = ls_dd07v-ddtext
                                                            substring = 'OLD_'
                                                            with = 'NEW_' )
                                              ELSE ls_dd07v-ddtext ) ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ low = 'A' ]-text exp = 'NEW_Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ low = 'B' ]-text exp = 'Another Value B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ low = 'C' ]-text exp = 'NEW_Value C' ).

    " Test with a real domain (e.g., 'XFELD') - assuming no 'OLD_' prefix
    DATA(lt_xfeld_result) = lo_cut->process_fixed_value_texts( iv_domain_name = 'XFELD'
                                                               iv_prefix_old  = 'OLD_'
                                                               iv_prefix_new  = 'NEW_' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_xfeld_result ).
    " Assert that no replacement happened if prefix not found
    DATA(ls_xfeld_entry) = lt_xfeld_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_starts_with( act = ls_xfeld_entry-text exp = 'NEW_' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und dem `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Implementierung. `COND string(...)` prüft, ob der Text ein bestimmtes Präfix enthält (`CP 'OLD_*'`) und wendet dann selektiv die `REPLACE` Anweisung an. Dies ist ein hervorragendes Beispiel für moderne, funktionale Programmierung, die komplexe Logik in einer Zeile ausdrückt.
