Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob der Kurztext eines Domänenfestwertes eine bestimmte Liste von 'verbotenen' Wörtern enthält. Wenn ja, ersetzen Sie diese Wörter durch Sternchen ('***').
hint: Lesen Sie die Festwerte aus. Verwenden Sie eine Schleife und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` für jedes verbotene Wort.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_censor_fixed_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             low    TYPE dd07v-domvalue_l,
             text   TYPE dd07v-ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value,
           tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS censor_domain_fixed_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        it_forbidden_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_censored_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_censor_fixed_values IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD censor_domain_fixed_values.
    DATA: lt_dd07v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.

    " Simulate reading fixed values from DDIC
    SELECT domvalue_l, ddtext
      FROM dd07v
      INTO TABLE lt_dd07v
      WHERE domname = @iv_domain_name
      AND ddlanguage = @sy-langu.

    rt_censored_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_dd07v
                                   LET lv_censored_text = REDUCE string(
                                                            INIT s = ls_dd07v-ddtext
                                                            FOR lv_forbidden_word IN it_forbidden_words
                                                            NEXT s = REPLACE( val = s
                                                                              all occurrences of lv_forbidden_word
                                                                              with = '***' ) ) IN
                                   ( low = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l,
                                     text = lv_censored_text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_censor_fixed_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_censor_fixed_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ddic_censor_fixed_values( ).

    " Mock DD07V data for a controlled test
    DATA(lt_mock_dd07v) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v(
      ( domvalue_l = 'A' ddtext = 'Bad Word Here' )
      ( domvalue_l = 'B' ddtext = 'Good Value' )
      ( domvalue_l = 'C' ddtext = 'Another Bad Word' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_forbidden) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Bad' ) ( 'Word' ) ).

    " Simulate the logic with mock data
    DATA(lt_result) = VALUE zcl_ddic_censor_fixed_values=>tt_fixed_values( FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_mock_dd07v
                                   LET lv_censored_text = REDUCE string(
                                                            INIT s = ls_dd07v-ddtext
                                                            FOR lv_forbidden_word IN lt_forbidden
                                                            NEXT s = REPLACE( val = s
                                                                              all occurrences of lv_forbidden_word
                                                                              with = '***' ) ) IN
                                   ( low = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l,
                                     text = lv_censored_text ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ low = 'A' ]-text exp = '*** *** Here' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ low = 'B' ]-text exp = 'Good Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ low = 'C' ]-text exp = 'Another *** ***' ).

    " Test with a real domain (e.g., 'XFELD') - assuming no forbidden words
    DATA(lt_xfeld_result) = lo_cut->censor_domain_fixed_values( iv_domain_name = 'XFELD'
                                                                it_forbidden_words = lt_forbidden ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_xfeld_result ).
    " Assert that no censoring happened if forbidden words not found
    DATA(ls_xfeld_entry) = lt_xfeld_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( act = ls_xfeld_entry-text exp = '***' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert das Zensieren von Domänenfestwert-Kurztexten. Sie verwendet den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife, um die Festwerte zu iterieren. Innerhalb dieser Schleife wird der `REDUCE` Operator eingesetzt, um über eine Liste von 'verbotenen' Wörtern zu iterieren und jedes Vorkommen mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` durch Sternchen zu ersetzen. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Textbereinigungsaufgaben zu implementieren.
keywords: DDIC, Domäne, Festwerte, REPLACE, REDUCE, VALUE, FOR, String Processing, Zensur

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in den Kurztexten der Domänenfestwerte alle doppelten Leerzeichen durch einfache Leerzeichen und entfernen Sie führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` für doppelte Leerzeichen und `CONDENSE` oder `REPLACE REGEX` für führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_normalize_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             low    TYPE dd07v-domvalue_l,
             text   TYPE dd07v-ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value,
           tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS normalize_fixed_value_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_normalized_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_normalize_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_fixed_value_spaces.
    DATA: lt_dd07v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF dd07v.

    " Simulate reading fixed values from DDIC
    SELECT domvalue_l, ddtext
      FROM dd07v
      INTO TABLE lt_dd07v
      WHERE domname = @iv_domain_name
      AND ddlanguage = @sy-langu.

    rt_normalized_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_dd07v
                                    LET lv_text = ls_dd07v-ddtext IN
                                    LET lv_cleaned_text = REPLACE( val = lv_text
                                                                   all occurrences of REGEX '\s{2,}'
                                                                   with = ' ' ) IN
                                    LET lv_trimmed_text = REPLACE( val = lv_cleaned_text
                                                                   all occurrences of REGEX '^\s+|\s+$'
                                                                   with = '' ) IN
                                    ( low = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l,
                                      text = lv_trimmed_text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Simulate the logic with mock data
    DATA(lt_result) = VALUE zcl_ddic_normalize_spaces=>tt_fixed_values( FOR ls_dd07v IN lt_mock_dd07v
                                    LET lv_text = ls_dd07v-ddtext IN
                                    LET lv_cleaned_text = REPLACE( val = lv_text
                                                                   all occurrences of REGEX '\s{2,}'
                                                                   with = ' ' ) IN
                                    LET lv_trimmed_text = REPLACE( val = lv_cleaned_text
                                                                   all occurrences of REGEX '^\s+|\s+$'
                                                                   with = '' ) IN
                                    ( low = ls_dd07v-domvalue_l,
                                      text = lv_trimmed_text ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ low = 'A' ]-text exp = 'Value One' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ low = 'B' ]-text exp = 'ValueTwo' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ low = 'C' ]-text exp = 'Another Value' ).

    " Test with a real domain (e.g., 'XFELD')
    DATA(lt_xfeld_result) = lo_cut->normalize_fixed_value_spaces( iv_domain_name = 'XFELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_xfeld_result ).
    " Assuming XFELD texts are already clean, they should remain unchanged.
    DATA(ls_xfeld_entry) = lt_xfeld_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_xfeld_entry-text exp = ls_xfeld_entry-text ). " Should be same as original
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Diese Lösung normalisiert Leerzeichen in Domänenfestwert-Kurztexten. Sie verwendet zwei aufeinanderfolgende `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` Anweisungen innerhalb eines `VALUE` Operators. Die erste ersetzt alle Vorkommen von zwei oder mehr Leerzeichen (`\s{2,}`) durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen. Die zweite entfernt führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen (`^\s+|\s+$`). Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um Texte für eine konsistente Darstellung zu bereinigen.
keywords: DDIC, Domäne, Leerzeichen, Normalisierung, REPLACE REGEX, String Processing, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem Domänen-Langtext alle URLs (beginnend mit 'http://' oder 'https://') durch einen Platzhalter '[LINK]'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem regulären Ausdruck, der URLs erkennt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_replace_urls DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_urls_in_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_long_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_replace_urls IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_urls_in_text.
    rv_processed_text = iv_long_text.
    " Regex to find URLs starting with http:// or https://
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX 'https?://[\w\d\-\./\?#=&%]+' IN rv_processed_text WITH '[LINK]'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_expected_text) = 'Visit our website at [LINK] and also [LINK]'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->replace_urls_in_text( lv_input_text ) exp = lv_expected_text ).

    DATA(lv_no_url) = 'No URLs here.'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->replace_urls_in_text( lv_mixed_text ) exp = 'Text with [LINK] and some other content.' ).

Der reguläre Ausdruck `https?://[\w\d\-\./\?#=&%]+` ist darauf ausgelegt, gängige URL-Strukturen zu erkennen. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke Methode zur Textbereinigung oder Anonymisierung von sensiblen Informationen in Freitextfeldern, wie sie in Domänen-Langtexten vorkommen können.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem Domänen-Kurztext alle Zahlen und fassen Sie diese zu einem einzigen String zusammen. Ersetzen Sie dabei alle nicht-numerischen Zeichen durch Leerzeichen, bevor Sie die Zahlen extrahieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` um nicht-numerische Zeichen zu ersetzen und dann `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` um Leerzeichen zu entfernen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers_from_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_numbers_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers_from_text.
    DATA(lv_temp_text) = iv_text.
    " Replace all non-digits with spaces
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[^0-9]' IN lv_temp_text WITH ' '.
    " Remove all spaces (including multiple spaces)
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ' ' IN lv_temp_text WITH ''.
    rv_numbers_string = lv_temp_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ddic_extract_numbers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_numbers_from_text( 'ABC123DEF456GHI' ) exp = '123456' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_numbers_from_text( 'NoNumbersHere' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_numbers_from_text( '1 2 3 4 5' ) exp = '12345' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_numbers_from_text( '  -123.45  ' ) exp = '12345' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung extrahiert alle numerischen Zeichen aus einem String. Zuerst werden alle nicht-numerischen Zeichen mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[^0-9]' IN ... WITH ' '` durch Leerzeichen ersetzt. Anschließend werden alle Leerzeichen mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ' ' IN ... WITH ''` entfernt, wodurch ein String entsteht, der nur aus den extrahierten Zahlen besteht. Dies ist eine effektive Methode zur Datenextraktion und -bereinigung in modernem ABAP.
keywords: DDIC, Domäne, Zahlenextraktion, REPLACE REGEX, String Processing, Datenbereinigung

hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create` mit `encoding = 'UTF-8'` und die Methode `read` zur Konvertierung des XSTRING in einen STRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_system DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_xstring TYPE xstring " Input is a byte string assumed to be UTF-8
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_system IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'L' " Little Endian is typical for UTF-8
    ).
    lo_conv->read(
      EXPORTING
        data   = iv_utf8_xstring
      IMPORTING
        buffer = rv_system_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Lesen einer Datei (als XSTRING) mit einer unbekannten Kodierung und versuchen Sie, diese in die Systemkodierung zu konvertieren. Demonstrieren Sie dabei die Fehlerbehandlung für ungültige Zeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_codepage_converter_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_file_error_hdl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_file_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding     TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_system_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_file_error_hdl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_file_content.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_encoding
      endian   = 'L'
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv->read(
          EXPORTING
            data   = iv_file_xstring
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_system_string
        ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von XSTRINGs, die jeweils in UTF-8 kodiert sind, in eine Tabelle von STRINGs. Nutzen Sie moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_xstring TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_string  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_xstring_table
      IMPORTING
        it_utf8_xstrings TYPE tt_xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_system_strings) TYPE tt_string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_table.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'L'
    ).

    rt_system_strings = VALUE #( FOR ls_xstring IN it_utf8_xstrings
                                 LET lv_string_buffer TYPE string = '' IN
                                 ( lo_conv->read(
                                     EXPORTING data = ls_xstring
                                     IMPORTING buffer = lv_string_buffer
                                   ) THEN lv_string_buffer ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( 'Zeile 1 mit äöü' )
      ( 'Zeile 2 mit € Zeichen' )
      ( 'Dritte Zeile' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_utf8_xstrings) = VALUE zcl_conv_table_xstring=>tt_xstring(
      FOR ls_string IN lt_original_strings
      ( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( text = ls_string codepage = 'UTF-8' ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result_strings) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_table( lt_utf8_xstrings ).

    ).

    LOOP AT lt_result_strings INTO DATA(lv_result_string).
      READ TABLE lt_original_strings INDEX sy-tabix INTO DATA(lv_original_string).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen neuen Termin mit `cl_appointment`. Die Start- und Endzeiten sollen dabei von modernen `TIMESTAMPL`-Werten in die von `cl_appointment` erwarteten `D`- und `T`-Felder konvertiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_appointment=>factory` zur Instanziierung und `CONVERT TIME STAMP` zur Umwandlung von `TIMESTAMPL` in Datum und Uhrzeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_create_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             subject TYPE string,
             start_tstmp TYPE timestampl,
             end_tstmp TYPE timestampl,
             user_id TYPE syuname,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.

    METHODS create_appointment
      IMPORTING
        is_appointment_data TYPE ty_appointment_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_appointment_id) TYPE szatk_guid. " GUID for appointment
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_create_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_appointment.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = cl_appointment=>factory( ).

    DATA: lv_start_date TYPE d,
          lv_start_time TYPE t,
          lv_end_date   TYPE d,
          lv_end_time   TYPE t.

    CONVERT TIME STAMP is_appointment_data-start_tstmp
      TIME ZONE sy-zonlo
      INTO DATE lv_start_date TIME lv_start_time.

    CONVERT TIME STAMP is_appointment_data-end_tstmp
      TIME ZONE sy-zonlo
      INTO DATE lv_end_date TIME lv_end_time.

    lo_appointment->set_subject( is_appointment_data-subject ).
    lo_appointment->set_start_date( lv_start_date ).
    lo_appointment->set_start_time( lv_start_time ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_date( lv_end_date ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_time( lv_end_time ).
    lo_appointment->set_user( is_appointment_data-user_id ).

    lo_appointment->save( ).
    COMMIT WORK. " Wichtig: Änderungen persistieren
    rv_appointment_id = lo_appointment->get_guid( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Konvertierung von `TIMESTAMPL` in separate Datums- (`D`) und Zeitfelder (`T`) ist notwendig, da ältere Klassen oft diese granularere Struktur erwarten. `CONVERT TIME STAMP` ist hierfür das Standardstatement. `COMMIT WORK` ist entscheidend, um die Änderungen in der Datenbank zu persistieren.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Termine für den aktuellen Benutzer innerhalb eines bestimmten Datumsbereichs und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für das Filtern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_appointment=>get_appointments_for_user` und den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_read_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_info,
             guid    TYPE szatk_guid,
             subject TYPE string,
             start_date TYPE d,
             start_time TYPE t,
             end_date   TYPE d,
             end_time   TYPE t,
           END OF ty_appointment_info,
           tt_appointment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_appointments
      IMPORTING
        iv_user_id   TYPE syuname
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE tt_appointment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_read_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_appointments.
    DATA(lt_all_appointments) = cl_appointment=>get_appointments_for_user( iv_user_id ).

    rt_appointments = FILTER #( lt_all_appointments USING KEY default
                                 WHERE start_date >= iv_start_date AND
                                       end_date   <= iv_end_date ).

    " Map to simpler structure for output
    rt_appointments = VALUE #( FOR ls_app IN rt_appointments
                                ( guid       = ls_app-guid
                                  subject    = ls_app-subject
                                  start_date = ls_app-start_date
                                  start_time = ls_app-start_time
                                  end_date   = ls_app-end_date
                                  end_time   = ls_app-end_time ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_appointments FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_created_guids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF szatk_guid WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Create some dummy appointments for testing
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_app_create_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_app_data1) = VALUE zcl_app_create_basic=>ty_appointment_data(
      subject     = 'Meeting heute'
      start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = sy-datum utc_time = '100000' )->get_timestampl( )
      end_tstmp   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = sy-datum utc_time = '110000' )->get_timestampl( )
      user_id     = sy-uname
    ).
    APPEND lo_creator->create_appointment( ls_app_data1 ) TO mt_created_guids.

    DATA(ls_app_data2) = VALUE zcl_app_create_basic=>ty_appointment_data(
      subject     = 'Meeting morgen'
      start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = sy-datum + 1 utc_time = '140000' )->get_timestampl( )
      end_tstmp   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = sy-datum + 1 utc_time = '150000' )->get_timestampl( )
      user_id     = sy-uname
    ).
    APPEND lo_creator->create_appointment( ls_app_data2 ) TO mt_created_guids.

    DATA(ls_app_data3) = VALUE zcl_app_create_basic=>ty_appointment_data(
      subject     = 'Meeting letzte Woche'
      start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = sy-datum - 7 utc_time = '090000' )->get_timestampl( )
      end_tstmp   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = sy-datum - 7 utc_time = '100000' )->get_timestampl( )
      user_id     = sy-uname
    ).
    APPEND lo_creator->create_appointment( ls_app_data3 ) TO mt_created_guids.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Clean up created appointments
    LOOP AT mt_created_guids INTO DATA(lv_guid).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_appointment_delete) = cl_appointment=>factory( lv_guid ).
          lo_appointment_delete->delete( ).
          COMMIT WORK.
        CATCH cx_szatk_no_authority cx_szatk_not_found.
          " Ignore
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_appointments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_read_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = sy-datum + 1.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_appointments(
      iv_user_id    = sy-uname
      iv_start_date = lv_today
      iv_end_date   = lv_tomorrow
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2 " Erwartet: 'Meeting heute' und 'Meeting morgen'
      msg = 'Es sollten 2 Termine im Filterbereich gefunden werden'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-subject
      exp = 'Meeting heute'
      msg = 'Erster Termin sollte 'Meeting heute' sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP (ab 7.40), um interne Tabellen deklarativ zu filtern. Anstatt eine `LOOP AT WHERE`-Schleife zu verwenden, kann man mit `FILTER` direkt eine neue Tabelle erzeugen, die nur die gewünschten Einträge enthält. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Effizienz des Codes erheblich. Die Methode `get_appointments_for_user` liefert alle Termine, die dann clientseitig gefiltert werden.

CLASS zcl_app_delete_appointment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_appointment
      IMPORTING
        iv_appointment_guid TYPE szatk_guid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_szatk_no_authority.

CLASS zcl_app_delete_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_appointment.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_appointment) = cl_appointment=>factory( iv_appointment_guid ).
        lo_appointment->delete( ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_szatk_not_found.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        " Optional: Loggen, dass der Termin nicht gefunden wurde
      CATCH cx_szatk_no_authority INTO DATA(lx_auth).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_auth.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Termine für den aktuellen Benutzer und gruppieren Sie diese nach dem Startdatum. Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Termine pro Tag. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY`-Zusatz in einer `LOOP AT`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_group_by_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_daily_appointment_count,
             appointment_date TYPE d,
             count            TYPE i,
           END OF ty_daily_appointment_count,
           tt_daily_appointment_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_daily_appointment_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_daily_appointment_counts
      IMPORTING
        iv_user_id TYPE syuname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_daily_counts) TYPE tt_daily_appointment_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_group_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_daily_appointment_counts.
    DATA(lt_all_appointments) = cl_appointment=>get_appointments_for_user( iv_user_id ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_appointments INTO DATA(ls_appointment) GROUP BY ls_appointment-start_date.
      rt_daily_counts = VALUE #( BASE rt_daily_counts
                                 ( appointment_date = ls_appointment-start_date
                                   count            = GROUP SIZE ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Terminen für einen Benutzer generiert, die an einem bestimmten Wochentag (z.B. jeden Montag) in einem gegebenen Zeitraum stattfinden sollen. Nutzen Sie moderne Datum-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_date_helper` oder ähnliche Funktionen, um Wochentage zu bestimmen und Termine iterativ zu erstellen.

CLASS zcl_app_recurring_weekly DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_new_appointment_data,
             subject     TYPE string,
             start_time  TYPE t,
             end_time    TYPE t,
             weekday     TYPE i, " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday
           END OF ty_new_appointment_data,
           tt_guids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF szatk_guid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_weekly_appointments
      IMPORTING
        is_template_data TYPE ty_new_appointment_data
        iv_start_date    TYPE d
        iv_end_date      TYPE d
        iv_user_id       TYPE syuname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_created_guids) TYPE tt_guids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_recurring_weekly IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_weekly_appointments.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d VALUE iv_start_date.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_app_create_basic( ).

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      IF cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ) = is_template_data-weekday.
        DATA(ls_app_data) = VALUE zcl_app_create_basic=>ty_appointment_data(
          subject     = is_template_data-subject
          start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc(
                          utc_date = lv_current_date
                          utc_time = is_template_data-start_time
                        )->get_timestampl( )
          end_tstmp   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc(
                          utc_date = lv_current_date
                          utc_time = is_template_data-end_time
                        )->get_timestampl( )
          user_id     = iv_user_id
        ).
        APPEND lo_creator->create_appointment( ls_app_data ) TO rt_created_guids.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die Dauer eines Termins in Stunden und Minuten. Nutzen Sie moderne Zeitstempel-Operationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` und seine Methoden zur Differenzberechnung.

CLASS zcl_app_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_duration,
             hours   TYPE i,
             minutes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_duration.

    METHODS calculate_appointment_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_duration) TYPE ty_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_appointment_duration.
    DATA(lo_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_start_tstmp ).
    DATA(lo_end_tstmp)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_timestampl( iv_end_tstmp ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = lo_end_tstmp->get_diff_in_seconds( lo_start_tstmp ).

    rs_duration-hours   = lv_diff_seconds DIV 3600.
    rs_duration-minutes = ( lv_diff_seconds MOD 3600 ) DIV 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die prüft, ob ein gegebener Termin mit einem anderen Termin im Kalender des Benutzers kollidiert. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Laden Sie alle Termine des Benutzers und verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` oder `FILTER`, um Überschneidungen zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_collision_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_collision
      IMPORTING
        iv_user_id     TYPE syuname
        iv_new_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_new_end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_collides) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_collision_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_collision.
    DATA(lt_all_appointments) = cl_appointment=>get_appointments_for_user( iv_user_id ).

    " Konvertiere neue Zeitstempel in D/T für Vergleich mit cl_appointment Daten
    DATA: lv_new_start_date TYPE d, lv_new_start_time TYPE t,
          lv_new_end_date   TYPE d, lv_new_end_time   TYPE t.

    CONVERT TIME STAMP iv_new_start_tstmp TIME ZONE sy-zonlo INTO DATE lv_new_start_date TIME lv_new_start_time.
    CONVERT TIME STAMP iv_new_end_tstmp   TIME ZONE sy-zonlo INTO DATE lv_new_end_date   TIME lv_new_end_time.

    " Prüfe auf Überschneidungen: (StartA < EndB) AND (EndA > StartB)
    DATA(lt_colliding_appointments) = FILTER #(
      lt_all_appointments USING KEY default
      WHERE ( start_date < lv_new_end_date OR ( start_date = lv_new_end_date AND start_time < lv_new_end_time ) ) AND
            ( end_date   > lv_new_start_date OR ( end_date   = lv_new_start_date AND end_time   > lv_new_start_time ) )
    ).

    IF lines( lt_colliding_appointments ) > 0.
      rv_collides = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_collides = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '100000' )->get_timestampl( )
      end_tstmp   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '110000' )->get_timestampl( )
      user_id     = sy-uname
    ).

    LOOP AT mt_created_guids INTO DATA(lv_guid).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_appointment_delete) = cl_appointment=>factory( lv_guid ).
          lo_appointment_delete->delete( ).
          COMMIT WORK.
        CATCH cx_szatk_no_authority cx_szatk_not_found.
          " Ignore
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

  METHOD test_collision_detection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_collision_check( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    " Test 1: Colliding appointment (10:30 - 11:30)
    DATA(lv_new_start1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '103000' )->get_timestampl( ).
    DATA(lv_new_end1)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '113000' )->get_timestampl( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->check_collision( sy-uname lv_new_start1 lv_new_end1 )
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Sollte Kollision erkennen (überlappend)'
    ).

    " Test 2: Non-colliding appointment (11:00 - 12:00) - starts exactly when base ends
    DATA(lv_new_start2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '110000' )->get_timestampl( ).
    DATA(lv_new_end2)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '120000' )->get_timestampl( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->check_collision( sy-uname lv_new_start2 lv_new_end2 )
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Sollte keine Kollision erkennen (direkt anschließend)'
    ).

    " Test 3: Non-colliding appointment (09:00 - 10:00) - ends exactly when base starts
    DATA(lv_new_start3) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '090000' )->get_timestampl( ).
    DATA(lv_new_end3)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '100000' )->get_timestampl( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->check_collision( sy-uname lv_new_start3 lv_new_end3 )
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Sollte keine Kollision erkennen (direkt vorangehend)'
    ).

    " Test 4: Non-colliding appointment (09:00 - 09:30)
    DATA(lv_new_start4) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '090000' )->get_timestampl( ).
    DATA(lv_new_end4)   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_today utc_time = '093000' )->get_timestampl( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->check_collision( sy-uname lv_new_start4 lv_new_end4 )
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Sollte keine Kollision erkennen (vor dem Basis-Termin)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kollisionsprüfung von Terminen ist eine klassische Aufgabe in der Terminverwaltung. Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FILTER`-Operator mit einer komplexen `WHERE`-Bedingung, um alle Termine zu finden, die sich mit einem neu geplanten Termin überschneiden. Die Bedingung `(StartA < EndB) AND (EndA > StartB)` ist die Standardlogik zur Erkennung von Zeitüberschneidungen. Die Konvertierung von `TIMESTAMPL` in `D`- und `T`-Felder ist notwendig, um die Daten der `cl_appointment`-Klasse korrekt zu vergleichen.
keywords: Appointment Management, cl_appointment, Collision Detection, Date/Time, FILTER, Conditional Logic, TIMESTAMPL

CLASS zcl_app_get_details DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             guid        TYPE szatk_guid,
             subject     TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_app_get_details IMPLEMENTATION.

                          end_date    = lo_appointment->get_end_date( )
                          end_time    = lo_appointment->get_end_time( )

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die alle Termine eines Benutzers für einen Monat abruft und diese in einer internen Tabelle von Strukturen zurückgibt, die nur die wichtigsten Informationen (Betreff, Datum, Uhrzeit) enthält. Nutzen Sie moderne Tabellenkonstruktoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_appointment=>get_appointments_for_user` und den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` zur Transformation der Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_monthly_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_summary,
             subject    TYPE string,
             start_date TYPE d,
             start_time TYPE t,
           END OF ty_appointment_summary,
           tt_appointment_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_user_id TYPE syuname
        iv_year    TYPE syjahr
        iv_month   TYPE symonth
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_appointment_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_monthly_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_summary.
    DATA(lt_all_appointments) = cl_appointment=>get_appointments_for_user( iv_user_id ).

    DATA(lv_first_day_of_month) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_month(
                                     iv_year  = iv_year
                                     iv_month = iv_month
                                   ).
    DATA(lv_last_day_of_month)  = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_last_day_of_month(
                                     iv_year  = iv_year
                                     iv_month = iv_month
                                   ).

    rt_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_app IN lt_all_appointments
      WHERE ls_app-start_date >= lv_first_day_of_month AND
            ls_app-start_date <= lv_last_day_of_month
      ( subject    = ls_app-subject
        start_date = ls_app-start_date
        start_time = ls_app-start_time )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_monthly_summary FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_app_create_basic( ).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_current_month) = sy-datum+4(2).

    " Termin im aktuellen Monat
    DATA(ls_app_data1) = VALUE zcl_app_create_basic=>ty_appointment_data(
      subject     = 'Monatsmeeting'
      start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = sy-datum utc_time = '090000' )->get_timestampl( )
      end_tstmp   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = sy-datum utc_time = '100000' )->get_timestampl( )
      user_id     = sy-uname
    ).
    APPEND lo_creator->create_appointment( ls_app_data1 ) TO mt_created_guids.

    " Termin im Vormonat
    DATA(lv_prev_month_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_month(
                                  iv_year  = lv_current_year
                                  iv_month = lv_current_month - 1
                                ).
    DATA(ls_app_data2) = VALUE zcl_app_create_basic=>ty_appointment_data(
      subject     = 'Meeting Vormonat'
      start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_prev_month_date utc_time = '100000' )->get_timestampl( )
      end_tstmp   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_prev_month_date utc_time = '110000' )->get_timestampl( )
      user_id     = sy-uname
    ).
    APPEND lo_creator->create_appointment( ls_app_data2 ) TO mt_created_guids.

    " Termin im Folgemonat
    DATA(lv_next_month_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_month(
                                  iv_year  = lv_current_year
                                  iv_month = lv_current_month + 1
                                ).
    DATA(ls_app_data3) = VALUE zcl_app_create_basic=>ty_appointment_data(
      subject     = 'Meeting Folgemonat'
      start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_next_month_date utc_time = '100000' )->get_timestampl( )
      end_tstmp   = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_from_utc( utc_date = lv_next_month_date utc_time = '110000' )->get_timestampl( )
      user_id     = sy-uname
    ).
    APPEND lo_creator->create_appointment( ls_app_data3 ) TO mt_created_guids.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    LOOP AT mt_created_guids INTO DATA(lv_guid).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_appointment_delete) = cl_appointment=>factory( lv_guid ).
          lo_appointment_delete->delete( ).
          COMMIT WORK.
        CATCH cx_szatk_no_authority cx_szatk_not_found.
          " Ignore
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_monthly_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_monthly_summary( ).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_current_month) = sy-datum+4(2).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_monthly_summary(
      iv_user_id = sy-uname
      iv_year    = lv_current_year
      iv_month   = lv_current_month
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_summary )
      exp = 1 " Nur der Termin im aktuellen Monat sollte gefunden werden
      msg = 'Es sollte 1 Termin im aktuellen Monat gefunden werden'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-subject
      exp = 'Monatsmeeting'
      msg = 'Der gefundene Termin sollte der Monatsmeeting sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Datenbeschaffung von `cl_appointment` mit modernen Tabellenkonstruktoren (`FOR` mit `VALUE` und `WHERE`-Klausel) und Datum-Hilfsfunktionen (`cl_abap_date_helper`). CLASS zcl_abstract_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

             calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat34.

    rv_name = 'Generic Shape'.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.

    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * cl_abap_math=>pi( ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.

CLASS zcl_simple_list_xml_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_xml.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Item A' ) ( 'Item B' ) ( 'Item C' ) ).

    DATA(lv_items_xml) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR item IN lt_data
      NEXT s = s && |<item>{ item }</item>|
    ).

    rv_xml = |<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><list>{ lv_items_xml }</list>|.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_nested_structure_xml_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_xml_builder.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_xml REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_structure_xml_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_xml.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entry,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_entry.
    DATA(lt_entries) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_entry(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Entry1' value = 'Value1' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Entry2' value = 'Value2' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_entries_xml) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR entry IN lt_entries
      NEXT s = s && |<entry id="{ entry-id }"><name>{ entry-name }</name><value>{ entry-value }</value></entry>|
    ).

    rv_xml = |<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><root><data>{ lv_entries_xml }</data></root>|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Create target table with same type ASSIGN rt_result TO . LOOP AT ASSIGNING . IF CA mv_filter_value. " Simple contains check APPEND TO rt_result. ENDIF. ENDLOOP. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_application_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
                                    RAISING   cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    METHODS process_with_handler IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
                                   io_handler TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_error_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_value.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Result: { lv_result }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_with_handler.
    TRY.
        perform_risky_operation( iv_value ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        io_handler->handle_error( lx_arith_error ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` verwendet, um nach einer bestimmten Zeit ein Ereignis auszulösen. Im Ereignishandler soll ein Eintrag in eine interne Tabelle eingefügt werden, der den Zeitpunkt des Ereignisses und eine Nachricht enthält.

CLASS zcl_timer_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS start_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 1. " Interval in seconds

    METHODS get_log_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE tt_log_entries.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mt_log   TYPE tt_log_entries.

    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    DATA(ls_log_entry) = VALUE ty_log_entry(
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp( )
      message   = |Timer event triggered after { mo_timer->interval } seconds.|
    ).
    INSERT ls_log_entry INTO TABLE mt_log.
    " Stop the timer after one event for this example
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_log_entries.
    rt_log = mt_log.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

           END OF ty_flight_info.

                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        price   = ls_sflight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` verwendet, um periodisch eine interne Tabelle mit neuen Daten zu aktualisieren. Jede Aktualisierung soll einen neuen Eintrag in eine separate Historientabelle einfügen, der den Zustand der Haupttabelle zu diesem Zeitpunkt widerspiegelt. Verwenden Sie `INSERT TABLE LINE` für die Historientabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_timer` im periodischen Modus. Verwenden Sie `INSERT TABLE LINE` um den aktuellen Zustand der Haupttabelle in die Historientabelle zu kopieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_periodic_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_entry,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_entry.
    TYPES tt_data_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_history_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             data_state TYPE tt_data_entries,
           END OF ty_history_entry.
    TYPES tt_history_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_history_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS start_periodic_update
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 5. " Interval in seconds

    METHODS get_current_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data_entries.

    METHODS get_history
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_history) TYPE tt_history_entries.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mt_current_data TYPE tt_data_entries.
    DATA mt_history      TYPE tt_history_entries.
    DATA mv_counter      TYPE i VALUE 0.

    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_periodic_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_periodic_update.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run_periodically( ).
    " Initial data
    INSERT VALUE ty_data_entry( id = 1 value = 'Initial Data A' ) INTO TABLE mt_current_data.
    INSERT VALUE ty_data_entry( id = 2 value = 'Initial Data B' ) INTO TABLE mt_current_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + 1.
    " Simulate data update
    IF mv_counter = 1.
      mt_current_data[ 1 ]-value = 'Updated Data A (1)'.
      INSERT VALUE ty_data_entry( id = 3 value = 'New Data C' ) INTO TABLE mt_current_data.
    ELSEIF mv_counter = 2.
      mt_current_data[ 2 ]-value = 'Updated Data B (2)'.
    ENDIF.

    " Log current state to history
    DATA(ls_history_entry) = VALUE ty_history_entry(
      timestamp  = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp( )
      data_state = mt_current_data
    ).
    INSERT TABLE LINE ls_history_entry INTO mt_history.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_data.
    rt_data = mt_current_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_history.
    rt_history = mt_history.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_periodic_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_periodic_update.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_periodic_updater( ).
    lo_updater->start_periodic_update( iv_interval = 1 ). " Timer fires every 1 second

    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. " First event
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. " Second event
    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. " Third event

    DATA(lt_history) = lo_updater->get_history( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_history )
      exp = 3 " Initial data + 2 updates
      msg = 'Expected 3 history entries'
    ).

    " Check first history entry
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_history[ 1 ]-data_state )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'First history entry should have 2 data items'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_history[ 1 ]-data_state[ 1 ]-value
      exp = 'Initial Data A'
      msg = 'First history entry data A incorrect'
    ).

    " Check second history entry (after first update)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_history[ 2 ]-data_state )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Second history entry should have 3 data items'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_history[ 2 ]-data_state[ 1 ]-value
      exp = 'Updated Data A (1)'
      msg = 'Second history entry data A incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_history[ 2 ]-data_state[ 3 ]-value
      exp = 'New Data C'
      msg = 'Second history entry data C incorrect'
    ).

    " Check third history entry (after second update)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_history[ 3 ]-data_state )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Third history entry should have 3 data items'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_history[ 3 ]-data_state[ 2 ]-value
      exp = 'Updated Data B (2)'
      msg = 'Third history entry data B incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle einfügt, wobei nur die korrespondierenden Felder übernommen werden. Die Zieltabelle soll eine Untermenge der Felder der Quelltabelle sein. Verwenden Sie `INSERT CORRESPONDING`.

CLASS zcl_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             value   TYPE decfloat16,
             created TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             value   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

        it_source_data TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    LOOP AT it_source_data INTO DATA(ls_source).
      INSERT CORRESPONDING #( ls_source ) INTO TABLE rt_target_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'Item A'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = '10.5'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` für einen einfachen Countdown verwendet. Nach Ablauf des Timers soll eine Meldung (simuliert durch eine String-Rückgabe) ausgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und die `finished` Event-Behandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_countdown_timer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS start_countdown
      IMPORTING
        iv_seconds TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string. " Returns message after countdown

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_countdown_finished TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA mv_result_message     TYPE string.

    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_countdown_timer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_countdown.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_seconds.
    mo_timer->run( ).

    " In a real UI scenario, this would be asynchronous.
    " For a console/test scenario, we simulate waiting.
    DO.
      IF mv_countdown_finished = abap_true.
        rv_message = mv_result_message.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      WAIT UP TO 0.1 SECONDS. " Small wait to prevent busy-waiting
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    mv_result_message = |Countdown finished after { mo_timer->interval } seconds!|.
    mv_countdown_finished = abap_true.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_countdown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_countdown.
    DATA(lo_countdown) = NEW zcl_countdown_timer( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_countdown->start_countdown( iv_seconds = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_message
      needle   = 'Countdown finished after 1 seconds!'
      msg      = 'Expected countdown finished message'
    ).

    DATA(lv_message_long) = lo_countdown->start_countdown( iv_seconds = 0 ). " Interval 0 means immediate
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_message_long
      needle   = 'Countdown finished after 0 seconds!'
      msg      = 'Expected countdown finished message for 0 seconds'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Ereignisbehandlung (`SET HANDLER`) wird genutzt, um auf das `finished`-Ereignis des Timers zu reagieren. Die Simulation des Wartens im `start_countdown` Methode ist für Unit-Tests notwendig, da `cl_gui_timer` asynchron arbeitet. String-Templates werden für die Meldung verwendet.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` verwendet, um einen simulierten Fortschrittsbalken zu aktualisieren. Der Fortschritt soll in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert und mit `REDUCE` aggregiert werden, um den aktuellen Status zu ermitteln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_timer` periodisch und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation des Fortschritts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_progress_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_progress_step,
             step_id TYPE i,
             value   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_progress_step.
    TYPES tt_progress_steps TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_progress_step WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS start_monitoring
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 1. " Interval in seconds

    METHODS get_current_progress
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_progress) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mt_progress_data TYPE tt_progress_steps.
    DATA mv_current_step  TYPE i VALUE 0.

    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_progress_monitor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_monitoring.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run_periodically( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_current_step = mv_current_step + 1.
    DATA(lv_random_value) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp( ) min = 1 max = 10 )->get_next( ).
    INSERT VALUE ty_progress_step( step_id = mv_current_step value = lv_random_value ) INTO TABLE mt_progress_data.

    IF mv_current_step >= 5. " Stop after 5 updates for this example
      mo_timer->stop( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_progress.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Klasse, die `cl_gui_timer` Instanzen basierend auf Konfigurationen erzeugt und diese in einer internen Tabelle speichert. Die Factory soll auch eine Methode zum Starten aller erzeugten Timer bereitstellen. Verwenden Sie `INSERT` für die Timer-Verwaltung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_timer_config,
             id       TYPE string,
             interval TYPE i,
           END OF ty_timer_config.
    TYPES tt_timer_configs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_timer_config WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_managed_timer,
             id    TYPE string,
             timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer,
           END OF ty_managed_timer.
    TYPES tt_managed_timers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_managed_timer WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS create_timers
      IMPORTING
        it_configs TYPE tt_timer_configs.

    METHODS start_all_timers.

    METHODS stop_all_timers.

    METHODS get_managed_timers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_timers) TYPE tt_managed_timers.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_managed_timers TYPE tt_managed_timers.

    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer
      FOR ALL INSTANCES OF zcl_timer_factory.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_timers.
    LOOP AT it_configs INTO DATA(ls_config).
      DATA(lo_timer) = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
      lo_timer->interval = ls_config-interval.
      SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR lo_timer.
      INSERT VALUE ty_managed_timer( id = ls_config-id timer = lo_timer ) INTO TABLE mt_managed_timers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_all_timers.
    LOOP AT mt_managed_timers INTO DATA(ls_managed_timer).
      ls_managed_timer-timer->run( ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_all_timers.
    LOOP AT mt_managed_timers INTO DATA(ls_managed_timer).
      ls_managed_timer-timer->stop( ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    " In a real scenario, you might want to identify which timer fired
    " and log its ID or perform specific actions.
    " For this example, we just acknowledge the event.
    " The sender parameter 'sender' can be used here.
    DATA(lv_message) = |Timer with interval { sender->interval } finished!|.
    " cl_demo_output=>display( lv_message ). " For interactive demo
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_managed_timers.
    rt_timers = mt_managed_timers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. aus `sflights`) nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. Fluggesellschaft) gruppiert und die gruppierten Daten in eine neue Tabelle einfügt. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `INSERT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `INSERT` um die gruppierten Ergebnisse zu speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_line) GROUP BY ls_flight_line-carrid.
      DATA(ls_summary_entry) = VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid      = ls_flight_line-carrid
        num_flights = GROUP SIZE
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR <member> IN GROUP
          NEXT sum = sum + <member>-price
        )
      ).
      INSERT ls_summary_entry INTO TABLE rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die dynamisch eine `cl_gui_timer` Instanz erzeugt und deren `finished` Event-Handler zur Laufzeit registriert. Die Event-Behandlung soll eine dynamisch erstellte Nachricht in eine interne Tabelle einfügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Erzeugung des Timers und `SET HANDLER` mit `FOR` für die dynamische Event-Registrierung. `INSERT` für die Protokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_timer_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_run_dynamic_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_message  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE tt_log_entries.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_dynamic_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_dynamic_message TYPE string.
    DATA mt_dynamic_log   TYPE tt_log_entries.
    DATA mv_timer_finished TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    METHODS handle_dynamic_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_timer_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_run_dynamic_timer.
    " Dynamically create timer object
    CREATE OBJECT mo_dynamic_timer TYPE cl_gui_timer.

    " Store message for event handler
    mv_dynamic_message = iv_message.

    " Dynamically set event handler
    SET HANDLER handle_dynamic_timer_event FOR mo_dynamic_timer.

    mo_dynamic_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_dynamic_timer->run( ).

    DO.
      IF mv_timer_finished = abap_true.
        rt_log = mt_dynamic_log.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      WAIT UP TO 0.1 SECONDS.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_dynamic_timer_event.
    DATA(ls_log_entry) = VALUE ty_log_entry(
      timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp( )
      message   = |Dynamic timer '{ mv_dynamic_message }' finished after { sender->interval } seconds.|
    ).
    INSERT ls_log_entry INTO TABLE mt_dynamic_log.
    mo_dynamic_timer->stop( ).
    mv_timer_finished = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_dynamic_timer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_timer_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_log) = lo_creator->create_and_run_dynamic_timer(
      iv_interval = 1
      iv_message  = 'My Dynamic Timer'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_log )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Expected one log entry from dynamic timer'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lt_log[ 1 ]-message
      needle   = 'Dynamic timer ''My Dynamic Timer'' finished'
      msg      = 'Log message should contain dynamic message'
    ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_error_log,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_error_log.
    TYPES tt_error_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_error_log WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS start_timer_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_log) TYPE tt_error_log.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_error_log TYPE tt_error_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timer_safely.
    DATA(lo_timer) = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
    lo_timer->interval = iv_interval.

    TRY.
        lo_timer->run( ).
        " In a real scenario, you'd wait for the timer or handle its event.
        " For this example, we just check if it started without error.
        lo_timer->stop( ). " Stop immediately for test
      CATCH cx_gui_error INTO DATA(lx_gui_error).
        DATA(ls_error_entry) = VALUE ty_error_log(
          timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp( )
          message   = |Error starting timer: { lx_gui_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
        INSERT ls_error_entry INTO TABLE mt_error_log.
    ENDTRY.

    rt_error_log = mt_error_log.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_error_log )

    " To truly test the CATCH block, you'd need to force an exception,

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. aus `sflights`) in eine andere Tabelle einfügt, aber nur die ersten N Zeilen. Verwenden Sie `INSERT` in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck mit `UNTIL`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_limited_inserter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_limit          TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_limited_inserter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_first_n_flights.
    DATA(lt_limited_source) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_source_flights UNTIL sy-tabix > iv_limit
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
    INSERT LINES OF lt_limited_source INTO TABLE rt_target_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_timer` verwendet, um eine Zeitspanne zu messen. Nach Ablauf des Timers soll die gemessene Dauer in einer internen Tabelle protokolliert werden. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitmessung und `INSERT` für die Protokollierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp()` für Start- und Endzeitstempel und `INSERT` für die Protokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_duration_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_duration_log,
             start_tstmp TYPE timestampl,
             end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl,
             duration_s  TYPE decfloat16,
             message     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_duration_log.
    TYPES tt_duration_log TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_duration_log WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS start_and_log_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE tt_duration_log.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl.
    DATA mt_log         TYPE tt_duration_log.
    DATA mv_finished    TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_duration_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_and_log_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.

    mv_start_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp( ).
    mo_timer->run( ).

    DO.
      IF mv_finished = abap_true.
        rt_log = mt_log.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      WAIT UP TO 0.1 SECONDS.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    DATA(lv_end_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_tstmp( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff( tstmp1 = lv_end_tstmp tstmp2 = mv_start_tstmp ).

    DATA(ls_log_entry) = VALUE ty_duration_log(
      start_tstmp = mv_start_tstmp
      end_tstmp   = lv_end_tstmp
      duration_s  = lv_duration
      message     = |Timer ran for { lv_duration } seconds.|
    ).
    INSERT ls_log_entry INTO TABLE mt_log.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
    mv_finished = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_duration_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_duration_log.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_timer_duration_logger( ).
    DATA(lt_log) = lo_logger->start_and_log_timer( iv_interval = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_log )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Expected one log entry for timer duration'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_log[ 1 ]-start_tstmp
      msg = 'Start timestamp should be filled'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_log[ 1 ]-end_tstmp
      msg = 'End timestamp should be filled'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lt_log[ 1 ]-duration_s >= 1 AND lt_log[ 1 ]-duration_s < 2 )
      msg = 'Duration should be approximately 1 second'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_gui_timer` für die Ausführung einer zeitgesteuerten Aktion mit `cl_abap_tstmp` zur präzisen Messung der Dauer. Die gemessenen Zeitstempel und die Dauer werden mit `INSERT` in eine interne Protokolltabelle geschrieben. Dies demonstriert eine moderne und genaue Methode zur Zeitmessung und Protokollierung in ABAP.

CLASS zcl_itb_loop_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_flight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_loop_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF DATA(ls_flight_filtered)
         WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid > '0400'.
      APPEND ls_flight_filtered TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der Sitzplätze (SEATSMAX).
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT mit GROUP BY und den Aggregationsfunktionen COUNT und SUM.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
         ASCENDING
         ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).

      DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_flight_group_result(
        carrid      = <fs_group>-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_seats = SUM( ls_sflight-seatsmax )
      ).
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH total seats should be positive' act = ( ls_group_lh-total_seats > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.

Dies vereinfacht komplexe Berichtslogik erheblich und ist wesentlich effizienter als manuelle Gruppierungen mit verschachtelten Schleifen.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten alle Einträge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH', indem Sie deren Flugnummer auf '0000' setzen. Verwenden Sie dabei einen Field-Symbol für effiziente Modifikation.

CLASS zcl_itb_loop_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf SFLIGHTS. Wenn die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist, soll der Status 'Active' sein, ansonsten 'Inactive'. Verwenden Sie dabei den COND-Operator innerhalb eines FOR-Ausdrucks.
hint: Kombinieren Sie VALUE, FOR und COND, um die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in einem Ausdruck zu realisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        status = COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der COND-Operator ermöglicht bedingte Zuweisungen direkt in Ausdrücken, was in Kombination mit VALUE und FOR zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von IF-Anweisungen und verbessert die Funktionalität.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und geben Sie die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer aus. Verwenden Sie dabei eine Referenz auf die Tabellenzeile, um unnötiges Kopieren zu vermeiden.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT mit REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_flight), um eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Zeile zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_loop_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_by_ref
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_loop_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_by_ref.
    DATA: lv_temp_output TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_flights REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_flight).
      lv_temp_output = |{ lv_temp_output }{ lr_flight->carrid }-{ lr_flight->connid };|.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_output = lv_temp_output.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe den Flug mit den meisten freien Sitzplätzen (SEATSOCC - SEATSMAX).
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT mit GROUP BY und iterieren Sie innerhalb der Gruppe, um den maximalen Wert zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_max_seats,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_max_seats.
    TYPES tt_flight_max_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_max_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_max_free_seats RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_free_seats) TYPE tt_flight_max_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_max_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
         ASCENDING
         ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).

      DATA: lv_max_free_seats TYPE i VALUE -1,
            ls_flight_with_max TYPE ty_flight_max_seats.

      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group> INTO DATA(ls_member).
        DATA(lv_current_free_seats) = ls_member-seatsmax - ls_member-seatsocc.
        IF lv_current_free_seats > lv_max_free_seats.
          lv_max_free_seats = lv_current_free_seats.
          ls_flight_with_max = VALUE #( carrid = ls_member-carrid
                                        connid = ls_member-connid
                                        free_seats = lv_max_free_seats ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_flight_with_max TO rt_max_free_seats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_max_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_max_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_max( ).
    DATA(lt_max_free_seats) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_max_free_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_max_free_seats ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should contain entries' act = ( lines( lt_max_free_seats ) > 0 ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_max_free_seats INTO DATA(ls_result_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH free seats should be positive' act = ( ls_result_lh-free_seats >= 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von LOOP AT ... GROUP BY mit einer inneren Schleife über GROUP <fs_group> ermöglicht die detaillierte Verarbeitung von Gruppenelementen und die Durchführung komplexerer Aggregationen, wie das Finden von Maximalwerten innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und moderne Art der Datenanalyse.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Aggregation, Internal Tables, MAX, Group Processing

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen und behalten Sie nur die geraden Zahlen bei. Nutzen Sie dafür eine LOOP AT-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT mit einer IF-Bedingung, um die geraden Zahlen zu identifizieren und in eine neue Tabelle zu kopieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_loop_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_even_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_even_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_loop_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_even_numbers.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF lv_number MOD 2 = 0.
        APPEND lv_number TO rt_even_numbers.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
