Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Flugnummer validiert. Wenn die Flugnummer ungültig ist (z.B. leer oder nicht numerisch), soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine lokale Ausnahme-Klasse und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_number DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_num TYPE s_fnum
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_number.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_numeric
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_numeric) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_number.
    IF iv_flight_num IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_number
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_flight_number=>default_text. " Or a specific message ID
    ENDIF.

    IF NOT is_numeric( iv_flight_num ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_number
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_flight_number=>default_text. " Or a specific message ID
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_numeric.
    rv_is_numeric = xsdbool( iv_input CO '0123456789' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_flight_number FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_flight_number_empty FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_flight_number.
    METHODS test_invalid_flight_number_non_numeric FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_flight_number.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_flight_number.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_validator->validate_flight_number( '0001' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected for valid number' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_flight_number.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected exception for valid number' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_flight_number_empty.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( zcx_invalid_flight_number=>default_text ).
    lo_validator->validate_flight_number( '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_flight_number_non_numeric.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( zcx_invalid_flight_number=>default_text ).
    lo_validator->validate_flight_number( 'ABC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme (`zcx_invalid_flight_number`) ermöglicht eine spezifische Fehlerbehandlung. Die `PRIVATE SECTION` wird für die Hilfsmethode `is_numeric` verwendet, die nur intern benötigt wird. Die Validierung erfolgt mit modernen `IF` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` Anweisungen. `cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception` wird für das Testen von Ausnahmen verwendet.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, PRIVATE SECTION, Custom Exception, Validation, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) validiert. Wenn ein Eintrag fehlt (z.B. `carrid` oder `connid` leer), soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die den fehlerhaften Eintrag identifiziert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Iteration und `RAISE EXCEPTION` bei Fehlern.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcx_flight_data_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES if_t100_message.
        DATA mv_index TYPE i READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
            index TYPE i OPTIONAL
            previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_flight_data_error IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CALL METHOD super->constructor
          EXPORTING
            previous = previous.
        me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
        me->mv_index = index.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS process_flight_data
          IMPORTING
            it_flight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
          RAISING
            zcx_flight_data_error.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS check_entry
          IMPORTING
            is_entry TYPE ty_sflight_data
            iv_index TYPE i
          RAISING
            zcx_flight_data_error.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD process_flight_data.
        LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight) INDEX INTO DATA(lv_index).
          check_entry( is_entry = ls_flight iv_index = lv_index ).
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD check_entry.
        IF is_entry-carrid IS INITIAL OR is_entry-connid IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_data_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_flight_data_error=>default_text " Or specific message
              index  = iv_index.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS zcl_functional_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_square_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_squared_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        zcx_conversion_error.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS convert_and_square
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_squared_number) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_square_strings.
    rt_squared_numbers = VALUE #( FOR s IN it_strings ( convert_and_square( s ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_and_square.
    DATA: lv_number TYPE i.
    TRY.
        lv_number = iv_string. " Implicit conversion
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            textid       = zcx_conversion_error=>default_text
            input_string = iv_string.
    ENDTRY.
    rv_squared_number = lv_number * lv_number.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate einer Liste von Zahlen. Wenn eine Zahl in der Liste zu groß ist (z.B. über 1000), um quadriert zu werden, ohne einen Überlauf zu verursachen, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden. Verwenden Sie einen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `THROW` innerhalb des Ausdrucks für die Ausnahmebehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcx_overflow_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING

        value TYPE i OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_overflow_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->mv_value = value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_overflow_error.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_max_value TYPE i VALUE 1000.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_with_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT
        sum = sum +
              COND #(
                WHEN number > gc_max_value THEN
                  THROW zcx_overflow_error( textid = zcx_overflow_error=>default_text value = number )
                ELSE
                  number * number
              )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_unauthorized_access DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_secure_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS increment_counter
      IMPORTING
        iv_user TYPE syuname
      RAISING
        zcx_unauthorized_access.
    METHODS get_current_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i.
    METHODS check_authorization
      IMPORTING
        iv_user TYPE syuname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_authorized) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secure_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_counter = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD increment_counter.
    IF NOT check_authorization( iv_user ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_unauthorized_access
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_unauthorized_access=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_value.
    rv_value = mv_counter.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_authorization.
    " Simulate authorization check: only 'ADMIN' is authorized
    IF iv_user = 'ADMIN'.
      rv_authorized = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_authorized = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach einem bestimmten Flug. Wenn der Flug nicht gefunden wird, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit `TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcx_flight_not_found DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES if_t100_message.
        DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.
        DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
            carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
            connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
            previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcx_flight_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        CALL METHOD super->constructor
          EXPORTING
            previous = previous.
        me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
        me->mv_carrid = carrid.
        me->mv_connid = connid.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS find_flight
          IMPORTING
            it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
            is_key      TYPE ty_sflight_key
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight
          RAISING
            zcx_flight_not_found.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        METHODS get_flight_from_db
          IMPORTING
            is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight
          RAISING
            zcx_flight_not_found.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD find_flight.
        READ TABLE it_sflights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_not_found
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_flight_not_found=>default_text
              carrid = is_key-carrid
              connid = is_key-connid.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD get_flight_from_db.
        SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO rs_flight
          WHERE carrid = is_key-carrid AND connid = is_key-connid.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_not_found
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_flight_not_found=>default_text
              carrid = is_key-carrid
              connid = is_key-connid.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    IF iv_age <= 0.

        EXPORTING

    ENDIF.
    mv_name = iv_name.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_existing_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_data_reader( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_all_flights( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) msg = 'Should find some flights' ).
      CATCH zcx_no_flight_data_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected exception for existing flights' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_no_flights.
    " This test is tricky as SFLIGHT usually has data. 
    " To simulate no data, one would need to clear the table or query for non-existent data.
    " For demonstration, we assume a scenario where no data is found.
    " In a real test, you might mock the database access.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_data_reader( ).
    
    " To force a 'no data found' scenario for testing purposes, 
    " we would typically need to either: 
    " 1. Mock the database call (advanced testing framework).
    " 2. Query for data that is guaranteed not to exist.
    " For this example, we'll simulate the condition directly for simplicity, 
    " but acknowledge this is not a robust way to test DB access.
    
    " Simulate sy-subrc = 4 (no data found) after a SELECT statement
    " This is a conceptual test, as directly manipulating sy-subrc in a unit test is not standard.
    " A more realistic test would involve a SELECT with a WHERE clause that yields no results.
    
    " Example of a SELECT that would likely yield no results:
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_empty_flights WHERE carrid = 'NON' AND connid = 'EXIST'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( zcx_no_flight_data_found=>default_text ).
      " Call the method, knowing it will raise the exception due to no data
      lo_reader->get_all_flights( ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Test setup failed: non-existent flight data found' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist eine gängige Praxis zur Fehlerbehandlung bei Datenbankzugriffen.

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie eine Klasse, die den Status eines Objekts verwaltet (z.B. 'NEW', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED'). Der Status soll nur über eine private Methode geändert werden können, die von öffentlichen Methoden aufgerufen wird. Eine Ausnahme soll ausgelöst werden, wenn ein ungültiger Statusübergang versucht wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für den Status und die Statusänderungsmethode. Nutzen Sie `CASE` für Statusübergänge.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_state_transition DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_current_state TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_attempted_state TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        current_state TYPE string OPTIONAL
        attempted_state TYPE string OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_state_transition IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->mv_current_state = current_state.
    me->mv_attempted_state = attempted_state.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_state_machine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_states,
             new        TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'NEW',
             processing TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'PROCESSING',
             completed  TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'COMPLETED',
           END OF ty_states.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_states,
                 new        TYPE ty_states-new VALUE 'NEW',
                 processing TYPE ty_states-processing VALUE 'PROCESSING',
                 completed  TYPE ty_states-completed VALUE 'COMPLETED',
               END OF gc_states.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_processing
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_state_transition.
    METHODS complete_processing
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_state_transition.
    METHODS get_current_state
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_state) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_state TYPE string.
    METHODS set_state
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_state TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_state_transition.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_state_machine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_state = gc_states-new.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_processing.
    set_state( gc_states-processing ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD complete_processing.
    set_state( gc_states-completed ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_state.
    rv_state = mv_current_state.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_state.
    CASE mv_current_state.
      WHEN gc_states-new.
        IF iv_new_state = gc_states-processing.
          mv_current_state = iv_new_state.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_state_transition
            EXPORTING
              textid          = zcx_invalid_state_transition=>default_text
              current_state   = mv_current_state
              attempted_state = iv_new_state.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN gc_states-processing.
        IF iv_new_state = gc_states-completed.
          mv_current_state = iv_new_state.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_state_transition
            EXPORTING
              textid          = zcx_invalid_state_transition=>default_text
              current_state   = mv_current_state
              attempted_state = iv_new_state.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_state_transition
          EXPORTING
            textid          = zcx_invalid_state_transition=>default_text
            current_state   = mv_current_state
            attempted_state = iv_new_state.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  ENDMETHOD.

Dies erzwingt eine korrekte Statusverwaltung.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) basierend auf einem privaten Kriterium. Die Filterlogik soll in einer privaten Methode gekapselt sein.

solution:
TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_occupancy TYPE s_occ_max.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_min_occupancy TYPE s_occ_max.
    METHODS is_flight_high_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_high_occupancy) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min_occupancy = iv_min_occupancy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING is_flight_high_occupancy ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_flight_high_occupancy.
    IF is_flight-seatsocc >= mv_min_occupancy.
      rv_is_high_occupancy = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_high_occupancy = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( iv_min_occupancy = 100 ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 flights with high occupancy' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[2]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie unterschiedliche Aktionen basierend auf dem Wert des Profilparameters `rdisp/max_wprun_time` aus. Wenn der Wert unter 300 liegt, geben Sie eine Warnung aus; wenn er zwischen 300 und 600 liegt, eine Information; sonst einen Hinweis.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck, um eine Nachricht zu generieren, nachdem Sie den Profilparameter gelesen haben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_action_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_action_message.
    DATA(lv_max_time_str) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' ).
    DATA(lv_max_time) = COND i( WHEN lv_max_time_str IS INITIAL THEN 600 ELSE CONV i( lv_max_time_str ) ).

    rv_message = SWITCH string( lv_max_time
      WHEN < 300 THEN 'Warnung: Maximale Workprozesslaufzeit ist sehr kurz.'
      WHEN BETWEEN 300 AND 600 THEN 'Info: Maximale Workprozesslaufzeit ist moderat.'
      ELSE 'Hinweis: Maximale Workprozesslaufzeit ist hoch eingestellt.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für Flüge der Tabelle `sflights` einen Status ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Unbekannt') basierend auf dem Flugdatum. Flüge in der Vergangenheit sind 'Pünktlich', Flüge in der Zukunft 'Unbekannt', und Flüge am aktuellen Tag 'Verspätet' (vereinfacht).

CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE
             WHEN fldate < @lv_today THEN 'Pünktlich'
             WHEN fldate = @lv_today THEN 'Verspätet'
             ELSE 'Unbekannt'
           END AS status
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_statuses
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erweitern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) um ein Feld `travel_class`, dessen Wert basierend auf dem Preis (`PRICE`) bestimmt wird: unter 200 ist 'Economy', zwischen 200 und 500 ist 'Business', sonst 'First Class'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` in Kombination mit `COND` für die Zuweisung der `travel_class`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_enricher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_enriched,
             carrid      TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price       TYPE sflights-price,
             travel_class TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_enriched.
    TYPES tt_flight_enriched TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS enrich_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_flight_enriched.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_enricher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD enrich_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid
                                     fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                     price  = ls_flight-price
                                     travel_class = COND string(
                                       WHEN ls_flight-price < 200 THEN 'Economy'
                                       WHEN ls_flight-price BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN 'Business'
                                       ELSE 'First Class'
                                     )
                                   ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_enrich_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enrich_flights.
    DATA(lo_enricher) = NEW zcl_flight_enricher( ).
    DATA(lt_enriched) = lo_enricher->enrich_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_enriched ) ##NO_TEXT.

    LOOP AT lt_enriched INTO DATA(ls_enriched).
      CASE ls_enriched-travel_class.
        WHEN 'Economy'.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_enriched-price < 200 ).
        WHEN 'Business'.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_enriched-price >= 200 AND ls_enriched-price <= 500 ).
        WHEN 'First Class'.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_enriched-price > 500 ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Invalid travel class assigned.' ).
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR`-Iteratoren mit `VALUE`-Operatoren und `COND`-Ausdrücken ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke Art, Daten zu transformieren und zu aggregieren, ohne explizite `LOOP`-Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, Data Enrichment, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Flügen (`sflights`) basierend auf einem Schwellenwert für den Preis, der aus dem Profilparameter `z_flight_price_threshold` gelesen wird. Wenn der Parameter nicht existiert, verwenden Sie einen Standardwert von 300.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit `COND` für den Schwellenwert, der aus dem Profilparameter gelesen wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             price  TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_flight_simple.
    TYPES tt_flight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_affordable_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_affordable_flights) TYPE tt_flight_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_affordable_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_threshold_str) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( 'z_flight_price_threshold' ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = COND i(
      WHEN lv_threshold_str IS INITIAL THEN 300 " Default if parameter not found
      ELSE CONV i( lv_threshold_str )
    ).

    rt_affordable_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price < lv_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_affordable) = lo_filter->get_affordable_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_affordable ) ##NO_TEXT.

    LOOP AT lt_affordable INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-price < 300 OR ls_flight-price < CONV i( cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( 'z_flight_price_threshold' ) ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit einem `COND`-Ausdruck zur Bestimmung des Filterkriteriums (hier ein dynamischer Schwellenwert aus einem Profilparameter) entsteht eine sehr flexible und moderne Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise für 'Business'-Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Ein Flug ist 'Business', wenn sein Preis zwischen 200 und 500 liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `WHEN` innerhalb der Aggregationslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_business_flight_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_business_flight_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    rv_sum = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflights-price VALUE 0
                       FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                       NEXT sum = sum + COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN ls_flight-price ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_business_flight_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_business_flight_sum.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_aggregator->get_business_flight_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_sum >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit einem `COND`-Ausdruck innerhalb der `NEXT`-Anweisung kann man bedingte Aggregationen sehr elegant und effizient durchführen, ohne explizite `IF`-Statements.
keywords: REDUCE, WHEN, COND, Aggregation, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen nicht existierenden Profilparameter zu lesen und fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurück.

CLASS zcl_profile_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_parameter_safely
      IMPORTING iv_param_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_parameter_safely.
    TRY.
        rv_value = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( iv_param_name ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_profile_parameter INTO DATA(lx_param_error).
        rv_value = |Fehler beim Lesen des Parameters '{ iv_param_name }': { lx_param_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_value = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_existent_parameter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_non_existent_parameter.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_profile_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->get_parameter_safely( 'z_non_existent_param' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string(
      act = lv_result

Die Verwendung von `WHEN` in `CATCH` ermöglicht es, spezifische Ausnahmen abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, was zu robusterem Code führt. `cx_spfl_profile_parameter` ist die spezifische Ausnahme für Profilparameterfehler.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Profilparameter, dessen Name dynamisch aus einer Eingabe abgeleitet wird. Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` auf den Parameterwert, um eine Konfiguration zurückzugeben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die dynamische Namensbildung für den Profilparameter mit `cl_spfl_profile_parameter` und einem `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_param_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_config_by_param
      IMPORTING iv_param_suffix TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_config_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_param_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_config_by_param.
    DATA(lv_param_name) = |rdisp/wp_no_{ iv_param_suffix }|. " e.g., 'rdisp/wp_no_dia'

    DATA(lv_param_value_str) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( lv_param_name ).
    DATA(lv_param_value) = COND i( WHEN lv_param_value_str IS INITIAL THEN 0 ELSE CONV i( lv_param_value_str ) ).

    rv_config_info = SWITCH string( lv_param_value
      WHEN 0 THEN |{ lv_param_name } ist deaktiviert.|
      WHEN BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN |{ lv_param_name } hat eine geringe Anzahl ({ lv_param_value }).|
      WHEN > 5 THEN |{ lv_param_name } hat eine hohe Anzahl ({ lv_param_value }).|
      ELSE |Unbekannter Wert für { lv_param_name } ({ lv_param_value }).|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die verschiedene Strategie-Objekte basierend auf einem Profilparameter zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` im Factory, um die Instanz zu bestimmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Interface-Hierarchie und eine Factory-Klasse mit `SWITCH` zur Instanziierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processing_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS process RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_strategy_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processing_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_strategy_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processing_strategy~process.
    rv_result = 'Strategy A executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_strategy_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processing_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_strategy_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processing_strategy~process.
    rv_result = 'Strategy B executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_strategy_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_strategy
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_strategy) TYPE REF TO zif_processing_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_strategy_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_strategy.
    DATA(lv_strategy_type) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( 'z_processing_strategy' ).
    ro_strategy = SWITCH #( lv_strategy_type
      WHEN 'A' THEN NEW zcl_strategy_a( )
      WHEN 'B' THEN NEW zcl_strategy_b( )
      ELSE NEW zcl_strategy_a( ) " Default strategy
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_strategy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_strategy.
    DATA(lo_strategy) = zcl_strategy_factory=>get_strategy( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_strategy ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_strategy->process( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_result = 'Strategy A executed' OR lv_result = 'Strategy B executed' )
      msg = 'Strategy should be executed and return a valid result.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Anwendung des Factory-Patterns in modernem ABAP. Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck in der Factory-Methode ermöglicht eine elegante und erweiterbare Auswahl der zu instanziierenden Strategieklasse basierend auf einem dynamischen Wert (hier ein Profilparameter). Dies fördert lose Kopplung und die Einhaltung des Open/Closed-Prinzips.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Strategy Pattern, SWITCH, WHEN, cl_spfl_profile_parameter

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Rabattprozentsatz für einen Flugpreis basierend auf dem Profilparameter `z_discount_level`. Wenn der Parameter 'HIGH' ist, beträgt der Rabatt 20%; bei 'MEDIUM' 10%; sonst 5%.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` um den Rabattprozentsatz zu bestimmen und wenden Sie ihn dann an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING iv_original_price TYPE sflights-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    DATA(lv_discount_level) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( 'z_discount_level' ).
    DATA(lv_discount_percent) = COND decfloat34(
      WHEN lv_discount_level = 'HIGH' THEN '0.20'
      WHEN lv_discount_level = 'MEDIUM' THEN '0.10'
      ELSE '0.05'
    ).
    rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price * ( '1.0' - lv_discount_percent ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie für ein gegebenes Flugdatum, ob es sich um einen 'Wochentag', ein 'Wochenende' oder einen 'Feiertag' handelt. Der 'Feiertag'-Status soll von einem Profilparameter `z_holiday_dates` (kommagetrennte Liste) abhängen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_date TYPE sy-datum

CLASS zcl_date_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_type.
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( iv_date ).
    DATA(lv_holiday_dates) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( 'z_holiday_dates' ).

      WHEN 6 OR 7 THEN 'Wochenende'

        WHEN lv_holiday_dates CS iv_date THEN 'Feiertag' " Simple check for demo
        ELSE 'Wochentag'

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein Objekt einer bestimmten Klasse angehört, deren Name in einem Profilparameter `z_rtti_class_name` gespeichert ist. Geben Sie eine Bestätigung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `IS INSTANCE OF` in Kombination mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_object_type
      IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_instance) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_object_type.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( 'z_rtti_class_name' ).
    IF lv_class_name IS INITIAL.
      rv_is_instance = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( lv_class_name ).
        rv_is_instance = COND abap_bool(
          WHEN io_object IS INSTANCE OF (lv_class_name) THEN abap_true
          ELSE abap_false
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
        rv_is_instance = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine Tabelle von Dezimalzahlen und deserialisieren Sie sie anschließend wieder.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie die Methoden serialize und deserialize in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui2_num_table_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_number,
             value TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_s_number,
           ty_t_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_number_table
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE ty_t_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_serialized_strings) TYPE string_table.

    METHODS deserialize_number_table
      IMPORTING
        it_serialized_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE ty_t_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_num_table_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_number_table.
    rt_serialized_strings = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN it_numbers ( /ui2/cl_number=>serialize( <fs>-value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_number_table.
    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN it_serialized_strings ( value = /ui2/cl_number=>deserialize( <fs> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_serialization.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ui2_num_table_process( ).
    DATA(lt_original_numbers) = VALUE zcl_ui2_num_table_process=>ty_t_numbers(
      ( value = '1.23' )
      ( value = '-45.67' )
      ( value = '0' )
      ( value = '98765.4321' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_serialized) = lo_cut->serialize_number_table( lt_original_numbers ).
    DATA(lt_deserialized) = lo_cut->deserialize_number_table( lt_serialized ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_deserialized ) exp = lines( lt_original_numbers ) msg = 'Table size mismatch' ).
    LOOP AT lt_original_numbers INTO DATA(ls_original).
      READ TABLE lt_deserialized INTO DATA(ls_deserialized) INDEX sy-tabix.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_deserialized-value exp = ls_original-value msg = |Value mismatch at index { sy-tabix }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Anwendung der Serialisierungs- und Deserialisierungsfunktionen auf interne Tabellen. Durch die Verwendung von modernen ABAP-Konstrukten wie `VALUE #( FOR ... )` wird der Code kompakt und lesbar, was die Verarbeitung von Sammlungen numerischer Daten effizient gestaltet.

CLASS zcl_it_delete_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_past_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_delete_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_past_flights.
    DELETE ct_flights WHERE fldate < sy-datum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_past_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_past_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_it_delete_where=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    " Add some test data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lv_today - 1. " Past
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lv_today.     " Today
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0402'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lv_today + 1. " Future

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_delete_where( ).
    lo_cut->delete_past_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 flights remaining (today and future).'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate
      exp = lv_today
      msg = 'First remaining flight should be today.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-fldate
      exp = lv_today + 1
      msg = 'Second remaining flight should be future.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `DELETE itab WHERE` ist die effizienteste und lesbarste Methode, um Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Es vermeidet explizite Schleifen und ist für große Tabellen optimiert.

CLASS zcl_it_del_adj_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_it_del_adj_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    " Wichtig: Tabelle muss nach den Vergleichsfeldern sortiert sein
    SORT ct_flights BY carrid connid.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Passagiersitze für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus einer Tabelle von Flügen.
hint: Nutze eine funktionale Methode mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc, " Occupied seats
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 200.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sum( ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 150 msg = 'Expected 150 seats for LH.' ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 200 msg = 'Expected 200 seats for AA.' ).

    DATA(lv_total_ua) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'UA' ).

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. In Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung ist dies eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Daten zu summieren oder zu verarbeiten.

CLASS zcl_it_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.

             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt und die zu einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft gehören.
hint: Nutze den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      it_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > sy-datum
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_it_filter_future=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lv_today - 1. " Past
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lv_today.     " Today
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0402'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lv_today + 1. " Future
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lv_today + 2. " Future

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_future( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_lh ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 future flight for LH.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_lh[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0402' msg = 'Expected connid 0402 for LH.' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_aa) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_aa ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 future flight for AA.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_aa[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0001' msg = 'Expected connid 0001 for AA.' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_ua) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_ua ) exp = 0 msg = 'Expected 0 future flights for UA.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne und deklarative Möglichkeit, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die eine oder mehrere Bedingungen erfüllen. Er ist sehr effizient und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FILTER, INTERNAL TABLES, DATE, WHERE, VALUE

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die Flugdaten basierend auf optionalen Parametern für Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer filtert. Wenn keine Parameter übergeben werden, sollen alle Flüge zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutze `OPTIONAL` und `DEFAULT` Werte in der Methodensignatur, um optionale Parameter zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_optional_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_filtered
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
        iv_connid      TYPE sflight-connid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_optional_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_filtered.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_all_flights.

    IF iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED.
      DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE carrid <> iv_carrid.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_connid IS SUPPLIED.
      DELETE rt_filtered_flights WHERE connid <> iv_connid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_optional_params FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_optional_params.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_oo_optional_params=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_optional_params( ).

    " Test 1: No parameters supplied
    DATA(lt_res1) = lo_cut->get_flights_filtered( it_all_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res1 ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected all 3 flights.' ).

    " Test 2: Filter by carrid
    DATA(lt_res2) = lo_cut->get_flights_filtered( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res2 ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 flights for LH.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res2[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    " Test 3: Filter by carrid and connid
    DATA(lt_res3) = lo_cut->get_flights_filtered( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res3 ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 flight for LH 0400.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res3[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).

    " Test 4: Filter by non-existent carrid
    DATA(lt_res4) = lo_cut->get_flights_filtered( it_all_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res4 ) exp = 0 msg = 'Expected 0 flights for UA.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `OPTIONAL` in der Methodensignatur ermöglicht es, Parameter wegzulassen. Mit `IS SUPPLIED` kann innerhalb der Methode geprüft werden, ob ein optionaler Parameter tatsächlich übergeben wurde, was eine flexible Gestaltung von Schnittstellen erlaubt.
keywords: METHOD, OPTIONAL, PARAMETERS, IS SUPPLIED, OBJECT ORIENTATION

Instructions: Lösche eine spezifische Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem eindeutigen Schlüssel (Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer).
hint: Nutze `DELETE TABLE itab WITH TABLE KEY` für eine effiziente Löschung über den Tabellenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_delete_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS delete_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        is_key     TYPE ty_sflight_key
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_delete_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flight_by_key.
    DELETE TABLE ct_flights WITH TABLE KEY carrid = is_key-carrid connid = is_key-connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_by_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_by_key.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_it_delete_key=>tt_sflight_key.
    DATA: ls_flight_key TYPE zcl_it_delete_key=>ty_sflight_key.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_delete_key( ).

    " Delete an existing flight
    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight_key-connid = '0400'.
    lo_cut->delete_flight_by_key( is_key = ls_flight_key CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 flights after deleting LH 0400.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ] msg = 'LH 0401 should still exist.' ).

    " Try to delete a non-existent flight
    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'UA'.
    ls_flight_key-connid = '0001'.
    lo_cut->delete_flight_by_key( is_key = ls_flight_key CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 flights after trying to delete non-existent UA 0001.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE TABLE itab WITH TABLE KEY` ist die bevorzugte Methode, um einzelne Zeilen aus internen Tabellen mit einem definierten Schlüssel zu löschen. Sie ist sehr performant, da sie den Tabellenschlüssel direkt nutzt, und ist besonders nützlich für Tabellen mit eindeutigen Schlüsseln.
keywords: DELETE, INTERNAL TABLES, KEY, UNIQUE KEY

Instructions: Erstelle eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, um zuerst Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu filtern und dann die Passagierkapazität dieser Flüge zu summieren.
hint: Designen Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben (für Chaining) oder funktionale Methoden, die direkt weiterverarbeitet werden können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS sum_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      it_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD sum_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_oo_method_chain=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 200.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_method_chain( ).

    " Method chaining: filter then sum
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->sum_occupied_seats(
                           it_flights = lo_cut->filter_by_carrier(
                             it_flights = lt_flights
                             iv_carrid  = 'LH'
                           )
                         ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 150 msg = 'Expected 150 seats for LH via chaining.' ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->sum_occupied_seats(
                           it_flights = lo_cut->filter_by_carrier(
                             it_flights = lt_flights
                             iv_carrid  = 'AA'
                           )
                         ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 200 msg = 'Expected 200 seats for AA via chaining.' ).

    DATA(lv_total_ua) = lo_cut->sum_occupied_seats(
                           it_flights = lo_cut->filter_by_carrier(
                             it_flights = lt_flights
                             iv_carrid  = 'UA'
                           )
                         ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_ua exp = 0 msg = 'Expected 0 seats for UA via chaining.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining wird durch funktionale Methoden ermöglicht, die direkt das Ergebnis eines vorherigen Aufrufs als Eingabe für den nächsten verwenden. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und flüssigem Code, der die Datenverarbeitungsschritte klar abbildet.
keywords: METHOD, CHAINING, FUNCTIONAL, INTERNAL TABLES, FILTER, REDUCE

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme auslöst, wenn eine Fluggesellschaft nicht in der übergebenen Tabelle gefunden wird.
hint: Nutze `RAISING` in der Methodensignatur und `RAISE EXCEPTION` im Implementierungsteil.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_raising_excp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Define a local exception class
    CLASS lcx_carrier_not_found DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcx_carrier_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS check_carrier_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RAISING
        lcx_carrier_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_raising_excp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_carrier_exists.
    READ TABLE it_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_carrier_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = lcx_carrier_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_carrier_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING zcl_oo_raising_excp=>lcx_carrier_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_found.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_oo_raising_excp=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_raising_excp( ).

    " Should not raise an exception
    lo_cut->check_carrier_exists( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc msg = 'No exception expected for existing carrier.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_carrier_not_found.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_oo_raising_excp=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_raising_excp( ).

    " Should raise an exception
    lo_cut->check_carrier_exists( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception lcx_carrier_not_found.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `RAISING` in der Methodensignatur deklariert, welche Ausnahmen eine Methode auslösen kann. Dies ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil der strukturierten Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP OO. `RAISE EXCEPTION` wird verwendet, um eine deklarierte Ausnahme zu werfen, wenn eine Fehlerbedingung eintritt.
keywords: METHOD, EXCEPTION, RAISING, ERROR HANDLING, CX_STATIC_CHECK

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern von Flügen enthält, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben.
hint: Nutze den `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung und einer `CONDENSE`-ähnlichen Transformation innerhalb des `VALUE`-Operators.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_value_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_avail,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             freeseats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_avail.
    TYPES tt_flight_avail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_avail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_available_flights) TYPE tt_flight_avail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_value_for_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_free_seats.
    rt_available_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      LET lv_free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc IN
      WHERE ( lv_free_seats >= iv_min_free_seats )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, freeseats = lv_free_seats )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flights_with_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_it_value_for_cond=>tt_sflight_full.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150. " 50 free
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 140. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150. " 10 free
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 180. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200. " 20 free

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_value_for_cond( ).

    DATA(lt_res1) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_free_seats( it_flights = lt_flights iv_min_free_seats = 25 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_res1 ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 flight with >= 25 free seats.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res1[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_res1[ 1 ]-freeseats exp = 50 ).

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flügen in eine String-Repräsentation umwandelt, wobei jedes Feld durch ein Trennzeichen getrennt ist und jede Zeile in einer neuen Zeile steht.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit String-Templates und `LINES OF` für die effiziente String-Konkatenation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_table_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flights_to_string
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_delimiter TYPE string DEFAULT `|`
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_table_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flights_to_string.
    rv_flight_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                                  |{ flight-carrid }{ iv_delimiter }{ flight-connid }{ iv_delimiter }{ flight-fldate }|
                             ELSE
                                  |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ flight-carrid }{ iv_delimiter }{ flight-connid }{ iv_delimiter }{ flight-fldate }|
                           )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_to_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_to_string.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_oo_table_to_string=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251202'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_table_to_string( ).

    DATA(lv_expected) = |LH|0400|20251201{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }AA|0001|20251202|.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_flights_to_string( it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected msg = 'String representation mismatch.' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_comma) = |LH,0400,20251201{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }AA,0001,20251202|.
    DATA(lv_result_comma) = lo_cut->convert_flights_to_string( it_flights = lt_flights iv_delimiter = `,` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_comma exp = lv_expected_comma msg = 'Comma delimited string representation mismatch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_oo_table_to_string=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_table_to_string( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_flights_to_string( it_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Expected empty string for empty table.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus dem `REDUCE`-Operator und String-Templates ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Art, Strings aus internen Tabellen zu generieren. Der `COND`-Operator innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine bedingte Logik, um beispielsweise den Zeilenumbruch nur zwischen den Zeilen einzufügen. `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` sorgt für plattformunabhängige Zeilenumbrüche.
keywords: METHOD, REDUCE, STRING TEMPLATES, COND, INTERNAL TABLES, STRING PROCESSING

solution:
CLASS zcl_it_delete_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    DELETE ct_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate < sy-datum.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_complex_condition.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_it_delete_complex=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lv_today - 1. " LH, Past -> DELETE

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lv_today - 2. " AA, Past -> KEEP

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_delete_complex( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 flights remaining.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flügen in eine Hash-Tabelle umwandelt, wobei die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer als Schlüssel dienen.
hint: Nutze den `VALUE`-Operator mit `FOR` und der Syntax für Hash-Tabellen, um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_table_to_hash DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_value,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_value.
    TYPES tty_sflight_hash TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_value WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS convert_to_hash_table
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hash_table) TYPE tty_sflight_hash.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_table_to_hash IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_hash_table.
    rt_hash_table = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate, price = flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_value_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_new_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate    TYPE s_date
        iv_planetype TYPE s_planety
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_value_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_new_flight.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A321' )
    ).

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                     connid = iv_connid
                     fldate = iv_fldate
                     planetype = iv_planetype ) INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugnummern für ein bestimmtes Flugdatum und fügen Sie diese in eine bestehende Tabelle ein. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um die neuen Zeilen zu generieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` für die Iteration und `INSERT LINES OF` für die Masseneinfügung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_for_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_id,
           tt_flight_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_and_insert_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_count  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_ids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_insert_flights.
    DATA(lt_existing_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_ids(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_new_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_ids(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i <= iv_count
      ( carrid = iv_carrid connid = |{ 100 + i ALPHA = IN }| fldate = iv_fldate )
    ).

    INSERT LINES OF lt_new_flights INTO TABLE lt_existing_flights.

    rt_flights = lt_existing_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_and_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_and_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_for_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->generate_and_insert_flights( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_fldate = '20250401' iv_count = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 6 ). "1 existing + 5 new
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 6 ]-connid exp = '0105' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Generierung von Tabellenzeilen in einer Schleife. `INSERT LINES OF` ist die moderne und performante Art, mehrere Zeilen aus einer Tabelle in eine andere einzufügen.
keywords: INSERT, FOR, Internal Table, Table Expression

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` ein. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator, um die Arbeitsbereichsstruktur für den `INSERT`-Befehl zu füllen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights(...) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_value_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_value_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_single_flight.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid   = iv_carrid
      connid   = iv_connid
      fldate   = iv_fldate
      price    = iv_price
      currency = iv_currency
      planetype = 'A380'
      seatsocc = 0
      seatsmax = 500
    ).

    INSERT sflights FROM @ls_flight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_db_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_value_db( ).
    " Sicherstellen, dass der Datensatz nicht existiert
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '9999' AND fldate = '20251231'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20251231' iv_price = '1000' iv_currency = 'EUR' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_db_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_value_db( ).
    " Sicherstellen, dass der Datensatz existiert
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'YY' connid = '8888' fldate = '20251130' price = '500' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B737' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 150 ) ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'YY' iv_connid = '8888' iv_fldate = '20251130' iv_price = '500' iv_currency = 'USD' ).

    " Aufräumen

explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator wird verwendet, um eine Struktur vom Typ `SFLIGHTS` direkt mit Werten zu füllen. Die `@`-Syntax ermöglicht die Verwendung von Hostvariablen in Open SQL, was die Lesbarkeit und Sicherheit verbessert. `INSERT FROM @wa` ist die moderne Art, einen einzelnen Datensatz in die Datenbank einzufügen.
