Instructions: Generieren Sie mehrere neue Flugdatensätze für die Tabelle `SFLIGHT` basierend auf einer Liste von Flugnummern und fügen Sie diese in einem einzigen Datenbankaufruf ein. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um die interne Tabelle der einzufügenden Daten zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` zur Erstellung der internen Tabelle und `INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @itab`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_for_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_new_flight_data,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_new_flight_data,
           tt_new_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_new_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_multiple_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        it_data   TYPE tt_new_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_multiple_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights_to_insert) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      FOR ls_data IN it_data
      ( carrid   = iv_carrid
        connid   = ls_data-connid
        fldate   = ls_data-fldate
        price    = '250.00'
        currency = 'EUR'
        planetype = 'A320'
        seatsocc = 0
        seatsmax = 180 )
    ).

    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_insert ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 OR sy-subrc = 4. " 0 for success, 4 for duplicates accepted
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_multiple FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_for_db( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_insert_for_db=>tt_new_flight_data(
      ( connid = '0001' fldate = '20250601' )
      ( connid = '0002' fldate = '20250601' )
      ( connid = '0003' fldate = '20250602' )
    ).

    " Sicherstellen, dass die Datensätze nicht existieren
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'ZZ' AND ( connid = '0001' OR connid = '0002' OR connid = '0003' ) AND ( fldate = '20250601' OR fldate = '20250602' ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_multiple_flights( iv_carrid = 'ZZ' it_data = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).

    DATA(lv_count) TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_count WHERE carrid = 'ZZ' AND ( connid = '0001' OR connid = '0002' OR connid = '0003' ) AND ( fldate = '20250601' OR fldate = '20250602' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'ZZ' AND ( connid = '0001' OR connid = '0002' OR connid = '0003' ) AND ( fldate = '20250601' OR fldate = '20250602' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator wird hier verwendet, um eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS`-Strukturen aus einer einfacheren Eingabetabelle zu generieren. `INSERT FROM TABLE @itab` ist die effizienteste Methode, um mehrere Datensätze in einem einzigen Datenbank-Roundtrip einzufügen. `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` verhindert einen Dump bei doppelten Schlüsseln.
keywords: INSERT, FOR, Database, Open SQL, SFLIGHTS, Mass Insert

Instructions: Formatieren Sie eine kleine Tabelle von Daten (z.B. Produkt-ID und Preis) in einem String, wobei die Spalten durch einen Tabulator getrennt sind. Verwenden Sie String-Templates und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>HORIZONTAL_TAB`.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und die Konstante `cl_abap_char_utilities=>HORIZONTAL_TAB` für Tabulatoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_util_tab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product,
           tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_product_table
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_char_util_tab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_product_table.
    DATA(lv_tab) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>HORIZONTAL_TAB.
    DATA(lv_crlf) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>CR_LF.

    rv_formatted_string = |Produkt ID{ lv_tab }Preis{ lv_crlf }|.

    LOOP AT it_products INTO DATA(ls_product).
      rv_formatted_string = rv_formatted_string &&
                            |{ ls_product-id }{ lv_tab }{ ls_product-price }{ lv_crlf }|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine interne Tabelle ein, wobei einige Felder aus einer Quellstruktur übernommen und andere mit Standardwerten oder expliziten Werten gefüllt werden. Nutzen Sie `INSERT` mit `CORRESPONDING` und `BASE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT VALUE #( BASE ... CORRESPONDING ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_base_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value1    TYPE i,
             value2    TYPE string,
             status    TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS insert_with_base_corr
      IMPORTING
        is_source_data TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_base_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_with_base_corr.
    DATA(lt_existing_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( key_field = 'KEY001' value1 = 10 value2 = 'Initial' status = 'A' )
    ).

    INSERT VALUE #( BASE is_source_data
                     key_field = is_source_data-key_field " Explizit setzen, falls BASE es nicht korrekt macht oder überschrieben werden soll
                     status = 'N' " Neuer Status
                     value2 = |{ is_source_data-value2 }_NEW| ) INTO TABLE lt_existing_data.

    rt_data = lt_existing_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_base_corr FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_base_corr.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_base_corr( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_base_corr=>ty_data(
      key_field = 'KEY002'
      value1 = 20
      value2 = 'SourceValue'
      status = 'X'
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_with_base_corr( is_source_data = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-key_field exp = 'KEY002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-value1 exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-value2 exp = 'SourceValue_NEW' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status exp = 'N' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `BASE` und `CORRESPONDING` im `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht eine flexible und präzise Initialisierung neuer Datenobjekte. `BASE` übernimmt alle Felder aus einer Quellstruktur, die nicht explizit überschrieben werden, während `CORRESPONDING` für die Zuweisung gleichnamiger Felder verwendet wird. Hier wird `BASE` genutzt, um die Quellstruktur als Basis zu nehmen und dann spezifische Felder zu überschreiben oder zu erweitern.
keywords: INSERT, VALUE, BASE, CORRESPONDING, Internal Table

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen in eine interne Hash-Tabelle ein und demonstrieren Sie das Verhalten bei doppelten Schlüsseln. Nutzen Sie `INSERT` mit dem `VALUE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT` und beachten Sie den `sy-subrc` nach dem Einfügen in eine Hash-Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_hashed_items TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_item
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_hashed_items.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_items TYPE tt_hashed_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_item.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = iv_id name = iv_name ) INTO TABLE mt_items.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_items.
    rt_items = mt_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_unique_item FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_item FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_item( iv_id = 1 iv_name = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_items( ) ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_hashed_table( ).
    lo_cut->add_item( iv_id = 1 iv_name = 'Item A' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->add_item( iv_id = 1 iv_name = 'Item B' ). " Duplicate ID
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_items( ) ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_items( )[ id = 1 ]-name exp = 'Item A' ). " Original item remains
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Einfügen in eine Hash-Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel (`UNIQUE KEY`) ist sehr performant. Bei einem Versuch, einen Datensatz mit einem bereits existierenden Schlüssel einzufügen, schlägt der `INSERT`-Befehl fehl (`sy-subrc` ungleich 0), und der bestehende Datensatz bleibt unverändert. Dies wird hier durch die Überprüfung von `sy-subrc` demonstriert.
keywords: INSERT, Hashed Table, Internal Table, UNIQUE KEY, sy-subrc

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Größe eines Zeilenumbruchs und eines horizontalen Tabulators in Bytes. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_char_utilities`.

CLASS zcl_char_util_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_char_sizes
      IMPORTING
        iv_char_type TYPE string " 'NEWLINE' or 'TAB'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_size) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_char_util_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_char_sizes.
    CASE iv_char_type.
      WHEN 'NEWLINE'.

      WHEN 'TAB'.
        rv_size = cl_abap_char_utilities=>HORIZONTAL_TAB_SIZE.
      WHEN OTHERS.

    ENDCASE.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` ein, aber nur, wenn der Schlüssel noch nicht existiert. Nutzen Sie `INSERT` mit `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` und werten Sie `sy-subrc` aus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_accept_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flight_if_new
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_accept_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_if_new.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid   = iv_carrid
      connid   = iv_connid
      fldate   = iv_fldate
      price    = iv_price
      currency = iv_currency
      planetype = 'A320'
      seatsocc = 0
      seatsmax = 180
    ).

    INSERT sflights FROM @ls_flight ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_inserted = abap_true.
    ELSEIF sy-subrc = 4.
      rv_inserted = abap_false. " Duplikat, nicht eingefügt
    ELSE.
      " Fehlerbehandlung für andere sy-subrc Werte
      rv_inserted = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_new FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_duplicate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_new.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_accept_dup( ).
    " Sicherstellen, dass der Datensatz nicht existiert
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '1111' AND fldate = '20250701'.

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_flight_if_new( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '1111' iv_fldate = '20250701' iv_price = '300' iv_currency = 'USD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_inserted ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '1111' AND fldate = '20250701'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_accept_dup( ).
    " Sicherstellen, dass der Datensatz existiert
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'BB' connid = '2222' fldate = '20250801' price = '400' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'B737' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ) ).

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_flight_if_new( iv_carrid = 'BB' iv_connid = '2222' iv_fldate = '20250801' iv_price = '400' iv_currency = 'EUR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_inserted ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'BB' AND connid = '2222' AND fldate = '20250801'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klausel `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` verhindert einen Laufzeitfehler (Dump), wenn versucht wird, einen Datensatz mit einem bereits existierenden Primärschlüssel in die Datenbank einzufügen. Stattdessen wird `sy-subrc` auf 4 gesetzt, was eine kontrollierte Reaktion auf Duplikate ermöglicht, ohne den Programmfluss zu unterbrechen.
keywords: INSERT, Database, SFLIGHTS, ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS, sy-subrc

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von einer beliebigen Quell-Codepage in UTF-8 und geben Sie das Ergebnis als XSTRING zurück. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_char_utilities=>convert_string_to_utf8`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_char_utilities=>convert_string_to_utf8` und beachten Sie die Parameter für die Quell-Codepage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_convert_to_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_codepage     TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT '1100' " Default: UTF-8
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_convert_to_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_utf8.
    rv_utf8_xstring = cl_abap_char_utilities=>convert_string_to_utf8(
      string   = iv_input_string
      codepage = iv_codepage
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_convert_utf8_to_utf8 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_convert_iso_to_utf8 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_utf8_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_to_utf8( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Hello World! ÄÖÜß'.
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = lv_test_string
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_expected_xstring.

    DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_to_utf8( iv_input_string = lv_test_string iv_codepage = '1100' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_convert_iso_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_convert_to_utf8( ).
    DATA(lv_iso_string) = 'Grüße'. " String in ISO-8859-1 (Codepage 1103) angenommen
    DATA(lv_expected_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = lv_iso_string
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_expected_utf8_xstring.

    " Annahme: lv_iso_string ist bereits in der internen Darstellung des Systems, 
    " und wir simulieren die Konvertierung von einer anderen Codepage (z.B. 1103 für ISO-8859-1)
    " In einem realen Szenario müsste der Input-String tatsächlich in der Quell-Codepage vorliegen.
    " Hier wird nur die Funktion selbst getestet.
    DATA(lv_result_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_to_utf8( iv_input_string = lv_iso_string iv_codepage = '1103' ).

    " Da ABAP intern Unicode (UTF-16) verwendet, ist die direkte Simulation einer
    " 'nicht-UTF-8'-Eingabe als STRING schwierig. Der Test prüft, ob die Funktion
    " korrekt aufgerufen wird und ein XSTRING zurückgibt, das dem UTF-8-Äquivalent entspricht.
    " Der Vergleich mit SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING ist hier der beste Weg, um die Korrektheit zu prüfen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_xstring exp = lv_expected_utf8_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_char_utilities=>convert_string_to_utf8` ist die empfohlene Methode zur Konvertierung von Strings in das UTF-8-Format. Dies ist besonders wichtig für die Interaktion mit externen Systemen oder die Erstellung von Dateien, die eine spezifische Codierung erfordern. Die Angabe der Quell-Codepage ermöglicht eine korrekte Interpretation des Eingabestrings.
keywords: cl_abap_char_utilities, convert_string_to_utf8, UTF-8, XSTRING, Codepage

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übertragen werden und die Zieltabelle eine andere Struktur hat. Nutzen Sie `INSERT LINES OF` mit `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF ( CORRESPONDING #( ... ) ) INTO TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_corr_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             comment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             item_id TYPE i,
             item_name TYPE string,
             status  TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target,
           tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transfer_and_insert
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_corr_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_and_insert.
    DATA(lt_existing_target) = VALUE tt_target(
      ( item_id = 100 item_name = 'Existing Item' status = 'A' )
    ).

    INSERT LINES OF ( CORRESPONDING tt_target FROM it_source_data MAPPING item_id = id item_name = name WHERE ( id > 1 ) )
      INTO TABLE lt_existing_target.

    rt_target_data = lt_existing_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transfer_and_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transfer_and_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_corr_lines( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_corr_lines=>tt_source(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item One' comment = 'First item' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item Two' comment = 'Second item' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Item Three' comment = 'Third item' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transfer_and_insert( it_source_data = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ). " 1 existing + 2 new (id > 1)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-item_id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-item_name exp = 'Item Two' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ 2 ]-status ). " Status not mapped, so initial
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-item_id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.55 ermöglicht `INSERT LINES OF ( CORRESPONDING #( ... ) )` das direkte Einfügen von Zeilen, die durch einen `CORRESPONDING`-Ausdruck transformiert wurden. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige und kompakte Syntax, um Daten zwischen internen Tabellen unterschiedlicher Struktur zu verschieben und dabei Feldnamen zuzuordnen oder zu filtern (`WHERE`-Klausel).
keywords: INSERT, LINES OF, CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, MAPPING, WHERE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durchführt und eine Division durch Null mit `TRY...CATCH` abfängt. Geben Sie im Fehlerfall eine spezifische Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_div_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS divide_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_div_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD divide_safe.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
    CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result = 0. 
        MESSAGE 'Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_division_by_zero_safe FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_div_by_zero( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_safe( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).

      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_safe.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_div_by_zero( ).

explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ermöglicht die saubere Abfangen von Laufzeitfehlern wie der Division durch Null (`CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR`). Dies verhindert Programmabbrüche und erlaubt eine kontrollierte Fehlerbehandlung. Die Methode `divide_safe` demonstriert, wie man den Fehler abfängt und eine alternative Logik ausführt.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine gegebene `CARRID` und `CONNID` liest. Wenn keine Daten gefunden werden, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die dann abgefangen wird.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme und verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_no_flight_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_no_flight_found IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        zcx_no_flight_found.

    METHODS get_flight_data_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flight_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_data_safe.
    TRY.
        rs_flight = get_flight_data( iv_carrid = iv_carrid iv_connid = iv_connid ).
    CATCH zcx_no_flight_found.
        CLEAR rs_flight.
        MESSAGE 'Flug nicht gefunden.' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller `PRICE`-Werte für Flüge eines bestimmten `CARRID` aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `FOR` Ausdruck und dem `ADD` Operator (oder `+`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_total_price_non_existing FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @lv_expected_sum.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE #( INIT count = 0
                             FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                             NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme `ZCX_FLIGHT_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED`. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Buchung eines Fluges simuliert. Wenn die angeforderte Anzahl von Sitzen die maximale Kapazität überschreitet, soll diese benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst und vom Aufrufer abgefangen werden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Ausnahme, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_flight_capacity_exceeded DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_requested_seats TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_max_seats TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid           LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous         LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        iv_requested_seats TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_max_seats       TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_flight_capacity_exceeded IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_requested_seats = iv_requested_seats.
    me->mv_max_seats = iv_max_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS book_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid        TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_requested_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_flight_capacity_exceeded.

    METHODS book_flight_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid        TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_requested_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD book_flight.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_capacity_exceeded
        EXPORTING
          iv_requested_seats = iv_requested_seats
          iv_max_seats = 0. " Flight not found, so max seats is 0
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_requested_seats + ls_sflight-seatsocc > ls_sflight-seatsmax.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_capacity_exceeded
        EXPORTING
          iv_requested_seats = iv_requested_seats
          iv_max_seats = ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc.
    ELSE.
      " Simulate booking by updating seatsocc (not persistent in this example)
      ADD iv_requested_seats TO ls_sflight-seatsocc.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD book_flight_safe.
    TRY.
        rv_success = book_flight(
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid
          iv_connid = iv_connid
          iv_fldate = iv_fldate
          iv_requested_seats = iv_requested_seats
        ).
    CATCH zcx_flight_capacity_exceeded INTO DATA(lx_capacity).
        MESSAGE |Buchung fehlgeschlagen: { lx_capacity->mv_requested_seats } Sitze angefragt, nur { lx_capacity->mv_max_seats } verfügbar.| TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Sitze (`SEATSMAX`) und die Summe der Preise (`PRICE`) für alle Flüge eines bestimmten `CARRID` aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung eines einzigen `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Struktur als Akkumulator und dem `ADD` Operator (oder `+`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_multi_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             total_seats TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_multi_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, seatsmax, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rs_summary = REDUCE ty_flight_summary(
      INIT total_seats = 0 total_price = 0.00
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT total_seats = total_seats + <fs_flight>-seatsmax,
           total_price = total_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Verketten von Ausnahmen (Chained Exceptions), indem Sie eine niedrigere Ausnahme abfangen und diese als Ursache einer neu ausgelösten, höherstufigen benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme beibehalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION ... RETAIN`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_low_level_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_low_level_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_high_level_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid   LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_high_level_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_exceptions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_low_level_op
      RAISING
        zcx_low_level_error.

    METHODS perform_high_level_op
      RAISING
        zcx_high_level_error.

    METHODS perform_high_level_op_safe.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_exceptions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_low_level_op.
    " Simulate a low-level error, e.g., division by zero
    DATA(lv_result) = 10 / 0. " This will raise CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR
    " For this example, we'll explicitly raise our custom low-level exception
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_low_level_error.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_high_level_op.
    TRY.
        perform_low_level_op( ).
    CATCH zcx_low_level_error INTO DATA(lx_low_level).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_high_level_error
        EXPORTING
          previous = lx_low_level. " Chain the exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_high_level_op_safe.
    TRY.
        perform_high_level_op( ).
    CATCH zcx_high_level_error INTO DATA(lx_high_level).
      MESSAGE |High-Level Fehler aufgetreten: { lx_high_level->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'E'.
      IF lx_high_level->previous IS BOUND.
        MESSAGE |Ursprünglicher Fehler: { lx_high_level->previous->get_text( ) }| TYPE 'I'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch einen Wert zu einem bestimmten Feld einer internen Tabelle hinzufügt. Der Feldname wird als String übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit Field-Symbols und die `ADD`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_to_field_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_add_value  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_adder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_to_field_dynamic.
    rt_data = it_data.

    LOOP AT rt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
      ENDIF.

      " Check if the field symbol points to a numeric type
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND ( typeof(<fs_field>) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_p( ) OR
                                      typeof(<fs_field>) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_i( ) OR
                                      typeof(<fs_field>) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_f( ) ).
        ADD iv_add_value TO <fs_field>.
      ELSE.
        " Handle non-numeric field or raise another exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_adder( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_adder=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->add_to_field_dynamic( it_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'VALUE' iv_add_value = 5 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_row1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_row1-value exp = 15 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_row2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_row2-value exp = 25 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_to_non_existing_field_raises.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_adder( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_adder=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    lo_cut->add_to_field_dynamic( it_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_add_value = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_to_non_numeric_field_raises.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_adder( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test,
             id TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test.
    DATA lt_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_test>).
    <fs_test>-id = 1.
    <fs_test>-text = 'Hello'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    lo_cut->add_to_field_dynamic( it_data = lt_test iv_data = lt_test iv_field_name = 'TEXT' iv_add_value = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarke Kombination von Field-Symbols und dynamischer Programmierung. Mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` kann zur Laufzeit auf Felder einer Struktur zugegriffen werden, deren Name erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die `ADD`-Anweisung wird dann verwendet, um den Wert dynamisch zu inkrementieren. Die `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke sind hier entscheidend, um Laufzeitfehler bei ungültigen Feldnamen oder Typen abzufangen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer Liste von Zahlen, die als String-Template übergeben werden, wobei die Zahlen durch Kommas getrennt sind. Fangen Sie Konvertierungsfehler ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT`, `FOR` und `REDUCE` mit `CONV` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_string_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_numbers_from_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_string_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numbers_from_string.
    DATA lt_numbers_as_string TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_number_string AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_numbers_as_string.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR lv_num_str IN lt_numbers_as_string
      NEXT total = total + COND i(
        WHEN lv_num_str IS NOT INITIAL THEN
          TRY.
              CONV i( lv_num_str )
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number.
              0 " Default to 0 if conversion fails
          ENDTRY
        ELSE
          0
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `SPLIT`, `REDUCE` und `COND` mit `TRY...CATCH` für eine robuste Verarbeitung von String-Eingaben. Der `REDUCE`-Operator iteriert über die gesplitteten String-Teile. Innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks wird `COND` verwendet, um bedingt eine Konvertierung durchzuführen. Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur fängt `CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER` ab, falls ein String-Teil keine gültige Zahl ist, und setzt den Wert auf 0, wodurch das Programm stabil bleibt und nur gültige Zahlen summiert werden. Die `ADD`-Operation erfolgt implizit durch `total = total + ...`.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Klasse, die diese Methode überschreibt und die Ausnahme abfängt, um eine spezifische Logik auszuführen.

CLASS zcl_abstract_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_processor FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data REDEFINITION.

    METHODS process_data_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    " Simulate an operation that might raise an exception
    IF iv_input = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.
    rv_output = iv_input * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data_safe.
    TRY.
        rv_output = process_data( iv_input = iv_input ).
    CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler bei der Datenverarbeitung: Ungültige Eingabe.' TYPE 'E'.
        rv_output = -1. " Return a default error value
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` nach `CARRID` und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der `PRICE`-Werte und die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `ADD`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` oder direkter Aggregation im Gruppenkörper.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_group_result) = VALUE ty_flight_group_result(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
          INIT sum = 0.00
          FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-price
        )
        flight_count = REDUCE i(
          INIT count = 0
          FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT count = count + 1
        )
      ).
      APPEND ls_group_result TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    READ TABLE lt_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_summary).

    DATA(lv_expected_price_aa) = 0.
    DATA(lv_expected_count_aa) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @lv_expected_price_aa.
    SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @lv_expected_count_aa.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-total_price exp = lv_expected_price_aa ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count exp = lv_expected_count_aa ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_grouped_summary_no_data.
    " This test would require mocking SFLIGHTS or ensuring it's empty, which is complex.
    " For simplicity, we assume SFLIGHTS always has data for this test.
    " A more robust test would involve inserting/deleting test data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( ).
    " If SFLIGHTS is empty, this would be initial.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Innerhalb des Gruppenkörpers kann der `GROUP`-Ausdruck verwendet werden, um über die Mitglieder der aktuellen Gruppe zu iterieren. Hier wird `REDUCE` erneut eingesetzt, um sowohl die Summe der Preise als auch die Anzahl der Flüge pro Carrier zu berechnen. Die `ADD`-Operationen sind in den `REDUCE`-Ausdrücken enthalten.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_into_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,

      IMPORTING

        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_into_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( seatsmax > 100 )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator für Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflights-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR ls_group_member IN GROUP ls_group_key NEXT count = count + 1 ).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_group_member IN GROUP ls_group_key NEXT sum = sum + ls_group_member-seatsmax ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_summary(
        carrid     = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        total_seats   = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 150 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsmax = 90 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 200 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' seatsmax = 100 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summaries( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-total_seats exp = 350 ).

    DATA(ls_ua_summary) = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_summary-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_summary-total_seats exp = 190 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` können Aggregationen für jede Gruppe effizient berechnet werden, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: GROUP BY, INTO TABLE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

  METHOD test_select_flights.
    " Setup test data in sflights (requires actual DB interaction or mocking)

    " In a productive system, ensure test data exists or mock DB.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflights-price.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflights-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = '250.50' ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '50.00' ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '400.50' ). " 100 + 250.50 + 50 = 400.50

    CLEAR lt_sflights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.00' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze (`seatsooc`) für eine Liste von Flügen und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf die nächste ganze Zahl. Verwenden Sie die `COMPUTE`-Anweisung mit Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COMPUTE` in Kombination mit Aggregation und Rundungsfunktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compute_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights READ-ONLY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lv_total_occupied_seats TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_flight_count         TYPE i VALUE 0.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_total_occupied_seats = lv_total_occupied_seats + ls_flight-seatsooc.
      lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      COMPUTE rv_average_seats = CEIL( lv_total_occupied_seats / lv_flight_count ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsooc = 85 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsooc = 92 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' seatsooc = 70 ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_compute_average( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( lt_sflights ).

    " (85 + 92 + 70) / 3 = 247 / 3 = 82.33 -> CEIL(82.33) = 83
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 83 ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COMPUTE`-Anweisung kann auch komplexe arithmetische Ausdrücke und eingebaute Funktionen wie `CEIL` (Aufrunden) verarbeiten. Obwohl `REDUCE` für Aggregationen oft eleganter ist, zeigt dieses Beispiel die Verwendung von `COMPUTE` für eine spezifische Berechnung nach einer manuellen Aggregation.
keywords: COMPUTE, Math, Average, CEIL, Rounding, Internal Tables

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen und verarbeiten Sie jedes Paket, um die Gesamtzahl der verarbeiteten Zeilen zu ermitteln.

CLASS zcl_dba_fetch_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dba_fetch_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_in_packages.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lv_total_rows TYPE i VALUE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      lv_total_rows = lv_total_rows + lines( lt_sflights ).

CLASS zcl_dba_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

           END OF ty_flight_data,

CLASS zcl_dba_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.

      FROM sflights
      ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING

      OFFSET @iv_offset
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Datum und Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle, die für ein Zeitdiagramm geeignet ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_aggregate_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_daily_flight_count,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_daily_flight_count,
           tt_daily_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_daily_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_daily_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_daily_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_aggregate_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_daily_flight_counts.
    rt_aggregated_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                  GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                  ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                    carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie dynamisch Felder aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit der generischen Struktur `DATA`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... (iv_field_list) ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_list TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights_dynamic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    " For simplicity, we select into a fixed structure first, then map.
    " A truly dynamic solution would involve dynamic table creation (CREATE DATA).
    " However, the request implies selecting specific fields into a table.
    " The most direct way to demonstrate dynamic field selection with INTO CORRESPONDING
    " is to have a target table with a subset of fields.
    " For a generic return, we'll use a table of data references.

    DATA(lv_field_list_str) = iv_field_list.

    " Example: If iv_field_list is 'CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE'
    " We need a target structure that can hold these.
    " For a truly dynamic return type, we'd need to create a dynamic internal table.
    " For this example, we'll simulate by selecting into a full SFLIGHTS table
    " and then extracting the requested fields into a generic structure.
    " A more direct approach for dynamic selection into a generic table would be:
    " SELECT (lv_field_list_str) FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_result_dynamic).
    " However, lt_result_dynamic would be a table of type STANDARD TABLE OF DATA,
    " which is not directly usable without field symbols or dynamic access.
    " The prompt asks for 'DATA' structure, which is ambiguous. Assuming a table of references to data.

    DATA: lt_full_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_full_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_full_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      DATA(ls_dynamic_row) = NEW cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_flight> ) )->get_ddic_object_name( ).
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_data) TYPE HANDLE ls_dynamic_row.
      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).

      DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( FOR <field> IN cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( iv_field_list )->get_ddic_object_name( ) ( <field> ) ).

      LOOP AT lt_fields ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_name>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_field_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_field_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_value>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_target_value> = <fs_source_value>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND lr_data TO rt_dynamic_data.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_flight_data( 'CARRID,CONNID,FLDATE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).

    DATA(lr_first_row) = lt_result[1].
    ASSIGN lr_first_row->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_first_row>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_first_row> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_first_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_carrid> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_carrid> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_first_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_connid> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_connid> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_first_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_fldate> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_fldate> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_first_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_price> ). " Should not be bound as not requested
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_flight_data( 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    DATA(lr_first_row) = lt_result[1].
    ASSIGN lr_first_row->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_first_row>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <fs_first_row> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' OF STRUCTURE <fs_first_row> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_invalid_field>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_invalid_field> ). " Should not be bound
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Auswahl von Feldern aus einer Datenbanktabelle. Während Open SQL die dynamische Angabe von Feldlisten direkt unterstützt (`SELECT (field_list) ...`), ist die Handhabung des generischen Rückgabetyps (`STANDARD TABLE OF DATA`) komplexer. Die gezeigte Lösung simuliert die dynamische Extraktion in eine generische Struktur unter Verwendung von RTTI und Feld-Symbolen, um die Flexibilität der dynamischen Programmierung zu verdeutlichen. Für eine echte dynamische Tabellenerstellung müsste `CREATE DATA` mit dynamischen Typen verwendet werden.
keywords: DYNAMIC SQL, SELECT, RTTI, FIELD-SYMBOLS, SFLIGHTS, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die tägliche Preisänderung für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer sortierten Liste von Flugdaten und speichern Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und den vorherigen Wert zu speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mth_price_delta DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price,
           tt_flight_price TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH UNIQUE KEY fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_daily_price_delta,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price_delta TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_daily_price_delta,
           tt_daily_price_delta TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_daily_price_delta WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_daily_price_delta
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_price_deltas) TYPE tt_daily_price_delta.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mth_price_delta IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_daily_price_delta.
    rt_price_deltas = REDUCE tt_daily_price_delta(
      INIT
        lv_prev_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
        lt_deltas     TYPE tt_daily_price_delta
      FOR ls_current_price IN it_flight_prices
      NEXT
        IF lv_prev_price <> 0.
          APPEND VALUE ty_daily_price_delta(
            fldate = ls_current_price-fldate
            price_delta = ls_current_price-price - lv_prev_price
          ) TO lt_deltas.
        ENDIF.
        lv_prev_price = ls_current_price-price
      FINALLY
        rt_price_deltas = lt_deltas
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füllen Sie fehlende Tage in einer Zeitreihen-Datentabelle (Datum und Wert) mit Standardwerten (z.B. 0) für einen gegebenen Datumsbereich.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine vollständige Datumsreihe und verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Zusammenführung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dte_fill_gaps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_value_pair,
             date  TYPE sflight-fldate,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_date_value_pair,
           tt_date_value_pair TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_date_value_pair WITH UNIQUE KEY date.

    METHODS fill_missing_dates
      IMPORTING
        it_input_data TYPE tt_date_value_pair
        iv_start_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_end_date   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filled_data) TYPE tt_date_value_pair.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dte_fill_gaps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_missing_dates.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
          lv_date_diff    TYPE i.

    lv_date_diff = cl_abap_date_helper=>diff( iv_date1 = iv_end_date iv_date2 = iv_start_date ).

    rt_filled_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lv_date_diff
                                LET lv_current_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = iv_start_date iv_days = i ) IN
                                ( COND #( WHEN line_exists( it_input_data[ date = lv_current_date ] )
                                           THEN it_input_data[ date = lv_current_date ]
                                           ELSE VALUE ty_date_value_pair( date = lv_current_date value = 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `MAX`-Aggregationslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_price_flight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flight.
    rs_max_price_flight = REDUCE sflights(
      INIT
        ls_max_flight TYPE sflights
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT
        IF ls_flight-price > ls_max_flight-price.
          ls_max_flight = ls_flight.
        ENDIF.
      FINALLY
        rs_max_price_flight = ls_max_flight
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_delay_minutes TYPE i
        iv_is_cancelled  TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_cl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = SWITCH string(
      WHEN iv_is_cancelled = abap_true THEN 'Abgesagt'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 30      THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 0       THEN 'Leicht verspätet'
      ELSE 'Pünktlich'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine 'Left Outer Join'-ähnliche Operation zwischen zwei internen Tabellen durch, um Flüge mit ihren zugehörigen Buchungen zu verknüpfen, wobei auch Flüge ohne Buchungen enthalten sein sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `LET` und `COND` oder `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_left_outer_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             customid TYPE sbook-customid,
           END OF ty_flight_booking,
           tt_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS perform_left_outer_join
      IMPORTING
        it_flights  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        it_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_flight_booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_left_outer_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_left_outer_join.
    rt_joined_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                LET ls_booking = VALUE sbook( )
                                    lv_booking_found = abap_false IN
                                ( COND #( WHEN line_exists( it_bookings[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                                          connid = ls_flight-connid
                                                                          fldate = ls_flight-fldate ] )
                                           THEN VALUE #( FOR ls_b IN it_bookings
                                                         WHERE ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                                 connid = ls_flight-connid
                                                                 fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
                                                         ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                           connid = ls_flight-connid
                                                           fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                                           bookid = ls_b-bookid
                                                           customid = ls_b-customid ) )
                                           ELSE VALUE #( ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                           connid = ls_flight-connid
                                                           fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                                           bookid = ''
                                                           customid = '' ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_bookings ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_book>).
    <fs_book>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_book>-connid = '400'. <fs_book>-fldate = '20251201'. <fs_book>-bookid = 'B1'. <fs_book>-customid = 'C1'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_bookings ASSIGNING <fs_book>.
    <fs_book>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_book>-connid = '400'. <fs_book>-fldate = '20251201'. <fs_book>-bookid = 'B2'. <fs_book>-customid = 'C2'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_left_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->perform_left_outer_join( it_flights = lt_flights it_bookings = lt_bookings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-bookid exp = 'B1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-bookid exp = 'B2' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[3]-bookid ).

  METHOD test_no_bookings.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.

    DATA(lt_bookings) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_left_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->perform_left_outer_join( it_flights = lt_flights it_bookings = lt_bookings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[1]-bookid ).

    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_left_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->perform_left_outer_join( it_flights = lt_flights it_bookings = lt_bookings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie eine 'Left Outer Join'-Operation zwischen zwei internen Tabellen mit modernen ABAP-Konstrukten (`FOR`, `LET`, `COND`, `LINE_EXISTS`) nachgebildet werden kann. Für jeden Flug wird geprüft, ob entsprechende Buchungen existieren. Wenn ja, werden alle passenden Buchungen mit dem Flug verknüpft; andernfalls wird der Flug mit initialen Buchungsdaten hinzugefügt. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Technik für die Datenintegration ohne Datenbankzugriff.
keywords: FOR, LET, COND, LINE_EXISTS, INTERNAL TABLES, JOIN

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Bericht, der die Top N Fluggesellschaften nach Gesamtumsatz anzeigt, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `SORTED BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summenaggregation und `SORTED BY` für die Sortierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rpt_top_airlines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_revenue,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_revenue TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_airline_revenue,
           tt_airline_revenue TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_revenue WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_airlines_by_revenue
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_top_n    TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_airlines) TYPE tt_airline_revenue.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rpt_top_airlines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_airlines_by_revenue.
    DATA(lt_revenue_by_airline) = REDUCE tt_airline_revenue(
      INIT
        lt_temp_revenue TYPE tt_airline_revenue
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      NEXT
        APPEND VALUE ty_airline_revenue(
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          total_revenue = SUM( ls_flight-price )
        ) TO lt_temp_revenue
      FINALLY
        rt_top_airlines = VALUE #( lt_temp_revenue SORTED BY total_revenue DESCENDING
                                   FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_top_n AND i <= lines( lt_temp_revenue )
                                   ( lt_temp_revenue[ i ] ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine einfache CSV-Zeichenkette aus einer internen Tabelle mit zwei Spalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und den `VALUE`-Operator für die Tabellenerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_gen_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_csv
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_gen_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( field1 = 'Wert A1' field2 = 'Wert B1' )
      ( field1 = 'Wert A2' field2 = 'Wert B2' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_csv_writer) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_separator = ','
      i_crlf      = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( ls_data-field1 ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( ls_data-field2 ).
      lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_csv_string = lo_csv_writer->get_csv_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie eine einfache CSV-Zeichenkette in eine interne Tabelle mit zwei Spalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und die Methode `parse_csv_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parse_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv
      IMPORTING iv_csv_string    TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parse_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_separator = ','
    ).

    lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string( iv_csv_string ).

    DATA(lt_raw_data) = lo_csv_parser->get_fields( ). " Returns table of string_table

    LOOP AT lt_raw_data INTO DATA(ls_raw_row).
      IF lines( ls_raw_row ) >= 2.
        APPEND VALUE ty_data(
          field1 = ls_raw_row[ 1 ]
          field2 = ls_raw_row[ 2 ]
        ) TO rt_parsed_data.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_parse_simple( ).
    DATA(lv_csv) = 'Wert A1,Wert B1' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Wert A2,Wert B2' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_csv( lv_csv ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'First field of first row incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'Wert B2',
      msg = 'Second field of second row incorrect'
    ).

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und generieren Sie eine CSV-Zeichenkette mit der Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Aggregation durchzuführen, und `cl_icf_csv` zur CSV-Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_aggregated_csv
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_aggregated_csv.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid )
      ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group)
      LET lv_count = lines( GROUP <fs_flight> ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_group-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_csv_writer) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_separator = ';' " Using semicolon for variety
      i_crlf       = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    " Add header
    lo_csv_writer->add_field( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_csv_writer->add_field( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
    lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).

    LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( ls_agg_data-carrid ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( CONV string( ls_agg_data-flight_count ) ).
      lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_csv_string = lo_csv_writer->get_csv_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_from_csv
      IMPORTING iv_csv_string TYPE string
                iv_carrier    TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_from_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv( i_separator = ',' ).
    lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string( iv_csv_string ).
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = lo_csv_parser->get_fields( ).

    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    LOOP AT lt_raw_data INTO DATA(ls_raw_row) WHERE sy-tabix > 1. " Skip header
      IF lines( ls_raw_row ) >= 3.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data(
          carrid = ls_raw_row[ 1 ]
          connid = ls_raw_row[ 2 ]
          fldate = ls_raw_row[ 3 ]
        ) TO lt_all_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_custom_delimiter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.

    METHODS generate_csv_with_pipe
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_custom_delimiter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_with_pipe.
    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE tt_product(
      ( id = 'P001' name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.50' )
      ( id = 'P002' name = 'Mouse'  price = '25.99' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_csv_writer) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_separator = '|' " Custom separator
      i_crlf       = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    " Add header using string template
    lo_csv_writer->add_field( |ID| ).
    lo_csv_writer->add_field( |Name| ).
    lo_csv_writer->add_field( |Price| ).
    lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).

    LOOP AT lt_products INTO DATA(ls_product).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( |{ ls_product-id }| ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( |{ ls_product-name }| ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( |{ ls_product-price COUNTRY = 'DE' }| ). " Format price for DE locale
      lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_csv_string = lo_csv_writer->get_csv_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
