Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Dateien aus einem ZIP-Archiv und verarbeiten Sie deren Inhalte, indem Sie die Dateinamen und die ersten 10 Zeichen des Inhalts in einer internen Tabelle sammeln. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip` zum Laden und Extrahieren, und den `FOR`-Operator zur Transformation der Dateiliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_extract_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_extracted_info,
             file_name TYPE string,
             preview   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_extracted_info.
    TYPES tt_extracted_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_extracted_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_and_process_files
      IMPORTING iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_extracted_info) TYPE tt_extracted_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_extract_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_and_process_files.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->load( zip_content = iv_zip_xstring ).

    DATA(lt_files_in_zip) = lo_zip->get_files( ).

    rt_extracted_info = FOR ls_file IN lt_files_in_zip
                        LET lv_content_xstring = lo_zip->get( name = ls_file-name )
                            lv_content_string  = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_content_xstring )
                            lv_preview         = COND string( WHEN strlen( lv_content_string ) > 10 THEN lv_content_string(10) ELSE lv_content_string )
                        IN VALUE #( file_name = ls_file-name preview = lv_preview ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie eine CSV-Zeichenkette, die möglicherweise leere Zeilen oder fehlerhafte Daten enthält, und ignorieren Sie diese robust.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und fügen Sie eine Validierungslogik innerhalb der Schleife hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_robust_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_valid_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_valid_data.
    TYPES tt_valid_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_valid_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_robustly
      IMPORTING iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE tt_valid_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_robust_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_robustly.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv( i_separator = ',' ).
    lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string( iv_csv_string ).
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = lo_csv_parser->get_fields( ).

    LOOP AT lt_raw_data INTO DATA(ls_raw_row).
      " Skip empty rows or rows with insufficient fields
      IF lines( ls_raw_row ) < 2 OR ( ls_raw_row[1] IS INITIAL AND ls_raw_row[2] IS INITIAL ).
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND VALUE ty_valid_data(
        col1 = ls_raw_row[ 1 ]
        col2 = ls_raw_row[ 2 ]
      ) TO rt_parsed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_robust_parse FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_robust_parse.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_robust_parse( ).
    DATA(lv_csv) = 'A,B' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                   'C,D' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                   ''    && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && " Empty line
                   'E'   && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && " Incomplete line
                   'F,G' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_robustly( lv_csv ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      exp = 3,
      msg = 'Should parse 3 valid rows'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-col1,
      exp = 'A',
      msg = 'First valid row incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 3 ]-col2,
      exp = 'G',
      msg = 'Third valid row incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man CSV-Daten robust parst, indem man leere Zeilen oder Zeilen mit unzureichenden Feldern ignoriert. Nach dem Parsen mit `cl_icf_csv` wird in der Schleife eine explizite Validierung durchgeführt, um nur gültige Daten in die Ergebnis-Tabelle aufzunehmen. Dies erhöht die Fehlertoleranz der Anwendung.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine CSV-Zeichenkette aus einer internen Tabelle, wobei die Spaltenüberschriften dynamisch aus den Feldnamen der Struktur abgeleitet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und `cl_icf_csv`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_dynamic_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_csv_dynamic_header
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_dynamic_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_dynamic_header.
    DATA(lo_csv_writer) = NEW cl_icf_csv( i_separator = ',' i_crlf = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).

    " Get field names dynamically using RTTI
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data[ 1 ] ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( ls_component-name ).
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( CONV string( ls_data-id ) ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( ls_data-name ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( CONV string( ls_data-value ) ).
      lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_csv_string = lo_csv_writer->get_csv_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_header FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_header.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_dynamic_header( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_csv_dynamic_header=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = '10.50' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = '20.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_csv) = lo_cut->generate_csv_dynamic_header( lt_test_data ).

    DATA(lv_expected_csv) = 'ID,NAME,VALUE' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            '1,Item A,10.50' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                            '2,Item B,20.00' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_csv,
      exp = lv_expected_csv,
      msg = 'CSV with dynamic header should match expected value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Generierung von CSV-Spaltenüberschriften mithilfe von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information). Die Feldnamen der Struktur der internen Tabelle werden zur Laufzeit über `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` ermittelt und als Headerzeile in die CSV-Datei geschrieben. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität der CSV-Generierung, da der Header nicht hartkodiert werden muss.
keywords: CSV, cl_icf_csv, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Internal Table, Header Generation

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, eine nicht existierende Datei aus einem ZIP-Archiv zu extrahieren und fangen Sie den erwarteten Fehler ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_zip` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_zip_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_non_existent_file
      IMPORTING iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
                iv_file_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_non_existent_file.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( zip_content = iv_zip_xstring ).
        lo_zip->get( name = iv_file_name ). " This should raise an exception
        rv_error_message = 'No error occurred, which is unexpected.'.
      CATCH cx_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_zip_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_zip_creator) = NEW zcl_zip_create_single( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_zip) = lo_zip_creator->create_zip_with_single_file(
      iv_file_name    = 'existing.txt',
      iv_file_content = 'dummy content'
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_error_msg) = lo_cut->extract_non_existent_file(
      iv_zip_xstring = lv_dummy_zip,
      iv_file_name   = 'non_existent.txt'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_error_msg,
      msg = 'An error message should be returned'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = find( val = lv_error_msg sub = 'No error occurred' ),
      msg = 'Should indicate an error occurred'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = find( val = lv_error_msg sub = 'non_existent.txt' ),
      msg = 'Error message should mention the non-existent file'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den robusten Umgang mit Fehlern beim Extrahieren von Dateien aus einem ZIP-Archiv. Wenn versucht wird, eine nicht existierende Datei mit `cl_abap_zip=>get` abzurufen, wird eine Ausnahme vom Typ `cx_zip_error` ausgelöst. Diese wird mit einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block abgefangen, und die Fehlermeldung wird zurückgegeben, was eine kontrollierte Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: ZIP, cl_abap_zip, Error Handling, Exceptions, cx_zip_error, File Handling

CLASS zcl_csv_quoted_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_csv_quoted_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_with_quotes.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE tt_item(
      ( id = 'ITM001' description = 'Laptop, 15 Zoll' quantity = 1 )

    ).

    DATA(lo_csv_writer) = NEW cl_icf_csv(

    " Data
    LOOP AT lt_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( ls_item-id ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( i_value = ls_item-description i_quoted = abap_true ). " Quote description field
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( CONV string( ls_item-quantity ) ).
      lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_csv_string = lo_csv_writer->get_csv_string( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv mit mehreren Dateien, die jeweils aus einer internen Tabelle generiert wurden, und verwenden Sie dabei String-Templates für die Dateinamen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_zip` mit `cl_icf_csv` und String-Templates für dynamische Dateinamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_csv_templates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_report_data,
             report_id TYPE string,
             value1    TYPE string,
             value2    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_report_data.
    TYPES tt_report_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_report_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_zip_from_reports
      IMPORTING it_all_reports TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_report_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_zip_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_csv_templates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_from_reports.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    DATA(lv_report_idx) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_all_reports INTO DATA(lt_current_report).
      lv_report_idx = lv_report_idx + 1.
      DATA(lv_report_id) = COND string( WHEN lines( lt_current_report ) > 0 THEN lt_current_report[ 1 ]-report_id ELSE |Report_{ lv_report_idx }| ).

      DATA(lo_csv_writer) = NEW cl_icf_csv( i_separator = ';' i_crlf = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( 'ID' ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( 'Value1' ).
      lo_csv_writer->add_field( 'Value2' ).
      lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).

      LOOP AT lt_current_report INTO DATA(ls_data).
        lo_csv_writer->add_field( ls_data-report_id ).
        lo_csv_writer->add_field( ls_data-value1 ).
        lo_csv_writer->add_field( ls_data-value2 ).
        lo_csv_writer->new_line( ).
      ENDLOOP.

      DATA(lv_csv_content) = lo_csv_writer->get_csv_string( ).
      DATA(lv_csv_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lv_csv_content ).

      DATA(lv_file_name) = |Report_{ lv_report_id }_Data.csv|.
      lo_zip->add( name = lv_file_name content = lv_csv_xstring ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_zip_xstring = lo_zip->get_zip( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_zip_csv_templates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_zip_csv_templates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_csv_templates( ).

    DATA(lt_report1) = VALUE zcl_zip_csv_templates=>tt_report_data(
      ( report_id = 'RPT001' value1 = 'A' value2 = 'X' )
      ( report_id = 'RPT001' value1 = 'B' value2 = 'Y' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_report2) = VALUE zcl_zip_csv_templates=>tt_report_data(
      ( report_id = 'RPT002' value1 = 'C' value2 = 'Z' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_all_reports) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_zip_csv_templates=>tt_report_data(
      ( lt_report1 )
      ( lt_report2 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_cut->create_zip_from_reports( lt_all_reports ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_zip_xstring,
      msg = 'Generated ZIP xstring should not be empty'
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip_reader) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_reader->load( zip_content = lv_zip_xstring ).
    DATA(lt_files) = lo_zip_reader->get_files( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_files ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'ZIP should contain two files'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = find( val = lt_files[ 1 ]-name sub = 'Report_RPT001_Data.csv' ),
      msg = 'First file name incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = find( val = lt_files[ 2 ]-name sub = 'Report_RPT002_Data.csv' ),
      msg = 'Second file name incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Generierung von CSV-Dateien mit `cl_icf_csv` und die Erstellung eines ZIP-Archivs mit `cl_abap_zip`. Für jede interne Tabelle in der Eingabe wird eine separate CSV-Datei generiert. Die Dateinamen werden dynamisch mithilfe von String-Templates erstellt, was eine flexible Benennung basierend auf den Daten ermöglicht. Dies ist nützlich für das Bündeln mehrerer Berichte oder Datensätze in einem einzigen Archiv.
keywords: ZIP, cl_abap_zip, CSV, cl_icf_csv, String Templates, Dynamic File Names, Internal Table

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine große interne Tabelle und ermitteln Sie deren Speicherverbrauch. Demonstrieren Sie dabei die Verwendung von VALUE für die Initialisierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES=>GET_MEMORY_CONSUMPTION vor und nach der Tabellenfüllung. Verwenden Sie VALUE #( FOR ... ) für die Füllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_table_usage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_memory_usage
      IMPORTING iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_memory_bytes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_table_usage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_memory_usage.
    DATA(lv_mem_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).

    DATA(lt_large_table) = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_entries
      ( id = i, text = |Entry { i }| )
    ).

    DATA(lv_mem_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).
    rv_memory_bytes = lv_mem_after - lv_mem_before.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_table_usage( ).
    DATA(lv_entries) = 10000. " 10.000 Einträge
    DATA(lv_memory_used) = lo_cut->get_table_memory_usage( lv_entries ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Feldern und messen Sie den Speicherverbrauch. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die dynamische Typisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie CREATE DATA mit TYPE HANDLE und CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES. Dynamische Typen können mit RTTS erstellt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_table_memory
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_fields TYPE i
        iv_num_rows   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_memory_bytes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_memory.
    DATA(lv_mem_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).

    " Dynamischen Zeilentyp erstellen
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      p_components = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table(
        FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_fields
        ( name = |FIELD_{ i }|, type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) )
      )
    ).

    " Dynamischen Tabellentyp erstellen
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
    ).

    " Dynamische Tabelle erzeugen
    DATA lr_table TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    " Daten in die dynamische Tabelle einfügen (Beispiel)
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      DATA(ls_dynamic_line) = VALUE REF TO data( ).
      CREATE DATA ls_dynamic_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE ANY.
      ASSIGN ls_dynamic_line->* TO <ls_line>.

      IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
          " Felder der dynamischen Zeile füllen (Beispiel)
          DO iv_num_fields TIMES.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field>).
            IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_field> = |Value { sy-index }-{ sy-loopc }|.
            ENDIF.
          ENDDO.
          INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDDO.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_mem_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).
    rv_memory_bytes = lv_mem_after - lv_mem_before.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Situation, in der der Speicherverbrauch einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet, und demonstrieren Sie, wie man dies erkennen könnte.

CLASS zcl_mem_limit_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_large_data,
             field1 TYPE string LENGTH 255,
             field2 TYPE string LENGTH 255,
             field3 TYPE string LENGTH 255,
           END OF ty_large_data.
    TYPES tt_large_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_large_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_memory_threshold
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold_mb TYPE i " Threshold in MB
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exceeded) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_limit_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_memory_threshold.
    DATA(lv_current_memory_bytes) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).
    DATA(lv_threshold_bytes) = iv_threshold_mb * 1024 * 1024. " Convert MB to Bytes

    IF lv_current_memory_bytes > lv_threshold_bytes.
      rv_exceeded = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exceeded = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_memory_threshold FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_memory_threshold_exceeded FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_threshold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_limit_check( ).
    " Test with a very high threshold, should not be exceeded
    DATA(lv_exceeded) = lo_cut->check_memory_threshold( 1024 ). " 1 GB threshold

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'Memory threshold should not be exceeded with a high limit'
      act = lv_exceeded
      exp = abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_memory_threshold_exceeded.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_limit_check( ).
    " Simulate high memory usage by creating a large table
    DATA(lt_dummy_table) = VALUE zcl_mem_limit_check=>tt_large_data(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO 100000 " 100,000 entries
      ( field1 = |Data { i } A|, field2 = |Data { i } B|, field3 = |Data { i } C| )
    ).

    " Test with a low threshold, should be exceeded
    DATA(lv_exceeded) = lo_cut->check_memory_threshold( 10 ). " 10 MB threshold (might be exceeded by 100k strings)

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'Memory threshold should be exceeded with a low limit and large data'
      act = lv_exceeded
      exp = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Simulation erfolgt durch das Anlegen einer großen internen Tabelle.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie den Speicherverbrauch beim Füllen einer internen Tabelle mit verschiedenen modernen ABAP-Konstrukten wie VALUE #( FOR ... ) und APPEND in einer Schleife.
hint: Messen Sie den Speicherverbrauch vor und nach jeder Operation mit CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES. Verwenden Sie separate Methoden für jede Füllstrategie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_table_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_memory_for_value_fill
      IMPORTING iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_memory_bytes) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_memory_for_append_fill
      IMPORTING iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_memory_bytes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_table_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_memory_for_value_fill.
    DATA(lv_mem_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).

    DATA(lt_table) = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_entries
      ( id = i, text = |Entry { i }| )
    ).

    DATA(lv_mem_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).
    rv_memory_bytes = lv_mem_after - lv_mem_before.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_memory_for_append_fill.
    DATA(lv_mem_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).

    DATA lt_table TYPE tt_data.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = sy-index text = |Entry { sy-index }| ) TO lt_table.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_mem_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).
    rv_memory_bytes = lv_mem_after - lv_mem_before.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_memory_comparison FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_comparison.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_table_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_entries) = 10000.

    DATA(lv_mem_value) = lo_cut->get_memory_for_value_fill( lv_entries ).
    DATA(lv_mem_append) = lo_cut->get_memory_for_append_fill( lv_entries ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'VALUE fill should consume memory' act = lv_mem_value > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'APPEND fill should consume memory' act = lv_mem_append > 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      msg = 'Memory consumption should be comparable for VALUE and APPEND'
      act = ABS( lv_mem_value - lv_mem_append ) < ( lv_mem_value / 2 ) " Within 50% difference
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht den Speicherverbrauch zweier gängiger Methoden zum Füllen interner Tabellen: die moderne VALUE #( FOR ... ) Syntax und die traditionelle DO ... APPEND Schleife. Obwohl die Speichereffizienz in einfachen Fällen ähnlich sein kann, bietet VALUE eine deutlich kompaktere und lesbarere Syntax, die in modernem ABAP bevorzugt wird. CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES ermöglicht die präzise Messung für solche Vergleiche.
keywords: Memory, Speicher, Performance, Internal Table, VALUE, FOR, APPEND, CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES

CLASS zcl_ui5_filtered_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_theme_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_theme_param.
    TYPES tt_theme_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_theme_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_theme_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_theme_name TYPE /ui5/theme_name
        iv_prefix     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_params) TYPE tt_theme_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_filtered_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_theme_parameters.
    DATA lt_all_params TYPE /ui5/cl_theme_util=>tt_theme_parameters.

    TRY.
        lt_all_params = /ui5/cl_theme_util=>get_all_theme_parameters(
                            iv_theme_name = iv_theme_name
                        ).

        rt_filtered_params = VALUE tt_theme_params(
          FOR ls_param IN lt_all_params
          WHERE ( name CP |{ iv_prefix }*| )
          ( name = ls_param-name, value = ls_param-value )
        ).

      CATCH /ui5/cx_theme_error.
        " Handle error
        APPEND VALUE ty_theme_param( name = 'ERROR' value = 'Failed to retrieve theme parameters' ) TO rt_filtered_params.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Freigabe von Speicher für eine interne Tabelle und überprüfen Sie den Effekt auf den Speicherverbrauch. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie CLEAR und FREE für die Tabelle und messen Sie den Speicherverbrauch mit CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_release DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS demonstrate_memory_release
      IMPORTING iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_memory_delta) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_release IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_memory_release.
    DATA(lv_mem_initial) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).

    DATA lt_large_table TYPE tt_data.
    lt_large_table = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_entries
      ( id = i, text = |Entry { i } - { sy-uuid }| )
    ).

    DATA(lv_mem_after_fill) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).

    CLEAR lt_large_table.
    FREE lt_large_table.

    DATA(lv_mem_after_free) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( ).

    rs_memory_delta = lv_mem_after_fill - lv_mem_after_free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_memory_release FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_release.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_release( ).
    DATA(lv_entries) = 50000.
    DATA(lv_memory_released) = lo_cut->demonstrate_memory_release( lv_entries ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      msg = 'Significant memory should be released after CLEAR and FREE'
      act = lv_memory_released > 10000 " Expect at least 10KB released
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den Effekt der Speicherfreigabe für eine interne Tabelle mittels CLEAR und FREE. CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES wird verwendet, um den Speicherverbrauch vor und nach der Freigabe zu messen. Dies ist wichtig für die Optimierung von speicherintensiven Programmen, insbesondere bei der Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen.
keywords: Memory, Speicher, Freigabe, CLEAR, FREE, Internal Table, CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus einer Quelltabelle enthält, außer denen, deren Fluggesellschaft 'AA' ist und die weniger als 100 freie Plätze haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit `EXCEPT IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_excluding_condition
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_excluding_condition.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights EXCEPT IN (
        carrid = 'AA' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) < 100
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_condition FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_condition.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_filter_flights=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 250 seatsmax = 300 ) TO lt_flights. " 50 free seats -> should be excluded
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_flights. " 100 free seats -> should be included
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 300 ) TO lt_flights. " 200 free seats -> should be included

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_excluding_condition( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die gewünschten Einträge enthält. `EXCEPT IN` kehrt die Bedingung um, sodass Einträge, die der Bedingung entsprechen, ausgeschlossen werden. Dies ist eine elegante Alternative zum expliziten Löschen von Einträgen aus einer bestehenden Tabelle.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, DELETE (conceptual)

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen und deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist. Führen Sie dies in einer Testumgebung durch und rollen Sie die Änderungen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM` mit moderner Open SQL Syntax und `COMMIT WORK`/`ROLLBACK WORK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_db_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_old_flights_db
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'LH'
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate DEFAULT sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_db_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights_db.
    " For demonstration, we'll insert some data first and then delete.
    " In a real scenario, this would be existing data.
    DATA(ls_flight_old) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20240101' ).
    DATA(ls_flight_new) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20251231' ).
    DATA(ls_flight_other) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20240101' ).

    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( ls_flight_old ) ( ls_flight_new ) ( ls_flight_other ) ) ).

    " Modern Open SQL DELETE
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND fldate < @iv_fldate.
    rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.

    " Rollback for testability and safety in a demo
    ROLLBACK WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_db FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_db.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_db_modern( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_old_flights_db( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_fldate = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 1 ). " One flight 'LH' 20240101 should be deleted
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen in Open SQL ist eine moderne ABAP-Funktion (ab 7.40), die die Lesbarkeit und Sicherheit verbessert, indem sie SQL-Injections verhindert. `DELETE FROM` ist der Standardbefehl zum Löschen von Datenbankeinträgen. `ROLLBACK WORK` ist hier wichtig, um die Datenbankänderungen im Testfall rückgängig zu machen.
keywords: DELETE, Open SQL, Database, Host Variables, ROLLBACK WORK

Instructions: Bereiten Sie hierarchische Daten für eine `cl_gui_simple_tree` Instanz vor, indem Sie Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungsnummer, Flugdatum) in eine Baumstruktur umwandeln. Die Baumstruktur soll auf der ersten Ebene die Fluggesellschaft und auf der zweiten Ebene die Verbindungsnummern enthalten. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Konstrukte wie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` und `VALUE` um die hierarchische Datenstruktur zu erzeugen, die für `cl_gui_simple_tree` benötigt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_tree_data
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_tree_data.
    DATA: lv_node_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lt_grouped_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    " Ensure unique combinations for grouping
    lt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights ( flight ) ).
    SORT lt_grouped_flights BY carrid connid.

    rt_tree_nodes = VALUE #( LET lv_current_node_key = lv_node_counter IN
        FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_grouped_flights BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
        GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
        LET lv_carrid_key = |CARR_{ lv_current_node_key INCREMENT BY 1 }| IN
        ( VALUE #( ( node_key = lv_carrid_key text = flight-carrid parent_key = '' )
            FOR connid_group IN GROUPS OF flight IN GROUP BY ( connid = flight-connid )
            LET lv_connid_key = |CONN_{ lv_current_node_key INCREMENT BY 1 }| IN
            ( node_key = lv_connid_key text = connid_group-connid parent_key = lv_carrid_key )
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_tree_data_prep FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_tree_data_prep.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_tree_data_prep=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250104' ) TO lt_flights. " Duplicate connid for AA

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_nodes) = lo_cut->prepare_tree_data( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_tree_nodes ) exp = 5 ). " 2 carrid nodes + 3 connid nodes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 1 ]-text exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 2 ]-text exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 3 ]-text exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 4 ]-text exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 5 ]-text exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `VALUE` Ausdrücken, um komplexe hierarchische Datenstrukturen zu erstellen. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, Daten für GUI-Elemente wie `cl_gui_simple_tree` vorzubereiten, ohne explizite Schleifen und manuelle Tabellenfüllungen. Die `LET` Anweisung wird verwendet, um temporäre Variablen für die Knotenschlüssel zu definieren.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle. Erstellen Sie anschließend eine neue Tabelle, die alle Flüge von Fluggesellschaften ausschließt, die weniger als 2 Flüge haben. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Zählung und `FILTER` für die 'Löschung'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation und `FILTER` mit einer Tabelle von auszuschließenden Fluggesellschaften.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_after_count_delete
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_after_count_delete.
    DATA(lt_carrid_counts) = REDUCE tt_carrid_count(
        INIT result = VALUE tt_carrid_count( )
        FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
        GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
        ( result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid count = lines( GROUP flight ) ) ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrids_to_exclude) = VALUE tt_carrid_key(
        FOR carrid_count IN lt_carrid_counts WHERE ( count < 2 )
        ( carrid = carrid_count-carrid )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights EXCEPT IN lt_carrids_to_exclude WHERE carrid = carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_filter_delete FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_filter_delete.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_filter_delete=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250104' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' fldate = '20250105' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_delete( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_after_count_delete( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ). " LH (2) + UA (2) should remain, AA (1) excluded
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ]-carrid ). " AA should be gone
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` zur Aggregation von Daten (Zählen der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft) und anschließend `FILTER` mit `EXCEPT IN` zur Erstellung einer neuen Tabelle, die Einträge basierend auf der Aggregation ausschließt. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und moderner Ansatz zur Datenmanipulation, der explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen minimiert.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, DELETE (conceptual)

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften als String-Template zurückgibt, wobei jede Fluggesellschaft durch ein Komma getrennt ist. Wenn die Liste leer ist, soll ein Standardtext zurückgegeben werden. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` zur String-Verkettung und `COND` für die Bedingungsprüfung des leeren Falls.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_string_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrid_list_string
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_string_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_list_string.
    rv_carrid_string = COND string(
        WHEN it_carrids IS INITIAL THEN 'Keine Fluggesellschaften vorhanden.'
        ELSE REDUCE string(
            INIT s = ``
            FOR carrid IN it_carrids
            NEXT s = COND string(
                WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ carrid }|
                ELSE |{ s }, { carrid }|
            )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrid_list_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrid_list_string.
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid(
        ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'UA' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_string_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_carrid_list_string( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'LH, AA, UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_string_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_carrid_list_string( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Keine Fluggesellschaften vorhanden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` für die effiziente Verkettung von Strings aus einer internen Tabelle. Die `COND` Expression wird verwendet, um elegant zwischen dem Fall einer leeren Tabelle und einer gefüllten Tabelle zu unterscheiden. String-Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine moderne und lesbare Syntax für die String-Formatierung.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, COND, Object Orientation, String Processing

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle doppelten Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, die exakt identisch sind. Behalten Sie dabei nur die erste Instanz jedes Duplikats.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` nach dem Sortieren der Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_exact_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_exact_duplicates
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_exact_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_exact_duplicates.
    SORT ct_flights BY carrid connid fldate seatsocc seatsmax.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_exact_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_exact_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_exact_duplicates=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 300 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_flights. " Duplicate
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250104' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_exact_duplicates( ).
    lo_cut->remove_exact_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist die klassische und effizienteste Methode, um exakt identische Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Obwohl `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` keine neue Syntax ist, ist ihre korrekte Anwendung nach einer Sortierung ein grundlegendes und wichtiges Muster in modernem ABAP.
keywords: DELETE, ADJACENT DUPLICATES, SORT, Internal Tables

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die einen bestimmten Index überschreiten. Verwenden Sie `DELETE` mit `FROM` und `TO` in Kombination mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE` mit `FROM` und `TO` und berechnen Sie den Startindex dynamisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_by_index_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_from_index
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE tt_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_index TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_by_index_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_from_index.
    IF iv_start_index > lines( ct_data ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DELETE ct_data FROM iv_start_index TO lines( ct_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_from_index FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_all FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_none FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_from_index.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_delete_by_index_range=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'A' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'B' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 text = 'C' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 4 text = 'D' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_by_index_range( ).
    lo_cut->delete_from_index( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data IMPORTING iv_start_index = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_all.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_delete_by_index_range=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'A' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'B' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_by_index_range( ).
    lo_cut->delete_from_index( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data IMPORTING iv_start_index = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lines( lt_data ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_none.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_delete_by_index_range=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'A' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_by_index_range( ).
    lo_cut->delete_from_index( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data IMPORTING iv_start_index = 2 ).

explanation: Die `DELETE` Anweisung mit `FROM` und `TO` ermöglicht das Löschen eines Bereichs von Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle. Die Verwendung von `lines( ct_data )` ist eine moderne und präzise Art, die aktuelle Anzahl der Zeilen zu ermitteln, um den Endpunkt des Löschbereichs dynamisch zu bestimmen.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, Index, Range

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften verwaltet. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Fluggesellschaft aus der Liste entfernt und eine weitere Methode, die die verbleibenden Fluggesellschaften als String-Template zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Features wie `CLASS-DATA` für die Liste und funktionale Methoden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-DATA` für die Liste, `DELETE` für das Entfernen und `REDUCE` für die String-Generierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_carrid_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS add_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.

    CLASS-METHODS remove_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.

    CLASS-METHODS get_carrids_as_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrid_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_carrid.
    INSERT iv_carrid INTO TABLE gt_carrids.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_carrid.
    DELETE gt_carrids WHERE table_line = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_carrids_as_string.
    rv_carrid_string = COND string(
        WHEN gt_carrids IS INITIAL THEN 'Keine Fluggesellschaften verwaltet.'
        ELSE REDUCE string(
            INIT s = ``
            FOR carrid IN gt_carrids
            NEXT s = COND string(
                WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ carrid }|
                ELSE |{ s }, { carrid }|
            )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrid_management FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrid_management.
    " Setup
    zcl_carrid_manager=>gt_carrids = VALUE #( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'UA' ) ).

    " Test remove
    zcl_carrid_manager=>remove_carrid( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_carrid_manager=>get_carrids_as_string( ) exp = 'LH, UA' ).

    " Test add
    zcl_carrid_manager=>add_carrid( 'DL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_carrid_manager=>get_carrids_as_string( ) exp = 'LH, UA, DL' ).

    " Test removing non-existent
    zcl_carrid_manager=>remove_carrid( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_carrid_manager=>get_carrids_as_string( ) exp = 'LH, UA, DL' ).

    " Cleanup
    CLEAR zcl_carrid_manager=>gt_carrids.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_carrid_manager=>get_carrids_as_string( ) exp = 'Keine Fluggesellschaften verwaltet.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `CLASS-DATA` für eine statische Liste, die von allen Instanzen der Klasse geteilt wird. Die Methoden `remove_carrid` verwendet `DELETE WHERE table_line = ...` für eine präzise Löschung. `get_carrids_as_string` demonstriert erneut die Effizienz von `REDUCE` und `COND` für die String-Generierung, was zu kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: CLASS-DATA, DELETE, REDUCE, COND, Object Orientation, Static Methods

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, die ein bestimmtes Flugdatum haben und deren Fluggesellschaft nicht 'LH' ist. Verwenden Sie `DELETE` mit einer komplexen `WHERE`-Bedingung.

CLASS zcl_delete_complex_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, die nicht in einer Liste von 'erlaubten' Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um die zu behaltenden Zeilen zu extrahieren.

CLASS zcl_filter_allowed_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.

        it_allowed_carrids TYPE tt_carrid_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_allowed_carrids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_allowed_carrids.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights IN it_allowed_carrids WHERE carrid = carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine `cl_gui_simple_tree` Instanz kapselt und eine Methode zum Hinzufügen von Knoten sowie eine Methode zum Löschen von Knoten nach ihrem Schlüssel bereitstellt. Demonstrieren Sie die Interaktion mit dem GUI-Control.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree` Methoden wie `add_node` und `delete_node`. Achten Sie auf die PBO/PAI-Logik für GUI-Controls.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_tree_wrapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_tree.
    METHODS add_flight_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_text       TYPE lvc_value.
    METHODS delete_tree_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. " Assumes a custom container exists on screen

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    mo_tree->set_top_node( 'ROOT' ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'ROOT' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    mo_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight_node.
    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = iv_parent_key
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_key       = iv_node_key
      i_text           = iv_text
    ).
    mo_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_tree_node.
    mo_tree->delete_node( i_node_key = iv_node_key ).
    mo_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    MESSAGE i_msg(000) WITH 'Node doppelt geklickt:' node_key.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, die ein Flugdatum in der Zukunft haben und deren Fluggesellschaft 'AA' ist. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um die zu behaltenden Zeilen zu extrahieren und `sy-datum` für den Vergleich.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einer komplexen Bedingung, die `sy-datum` einbezieht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_excluding_future_aa
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_excluding_future_aa.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights EXCEPT IN (
        carrid = 'AA' AND fldate > lv_today
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_future_aa FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_future_aa.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_filter_future_flights=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20260101' ) TO lt_flights. " Future AA, should be excluded
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20260101' ) TO lt_flights. " Future UA, should be included
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20240101' ) TO lt_flights. " Past AA, should be included

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_excluding_future_aa( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `FILTER` Operators mit einer komplexen Bedingung, die den Systemdatum (`sy-datum`) für den Vergleich von Daten einbezieht. `EXCEPT IN` wird verwendet, um Zeilen auszuschließen, die der Bedingung entsprechen. Dies ist eine moderne und deklarative Methode, um Daten basierend auf dynamischen Kriterien zu filtern.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sy-datum, Functional Programming, DELETE (conceptual)

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_order_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).

    " Verify sorting (simple check for first two elements)
    IF lines( lt_flights ) >= 2.
      DATA(ls_flight1) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      DATA(ls_flight2) = lt_flights[ 2 ].
      " This is a basic check, a more robust test would iterate
      " and compare all adjacent elements.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight1-carrid LE ls_flight2-carrid ) ).
      IF ls_flight1-carrid = ls_flight2-carrid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight1-fldate GE ls_flight2-fldate ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ORDER BY`-Klausel ermöglicht es, die Sortierung direkt auf der Datenbank durchzuführen, was bei großen Datenmengen performanter ist als eine Sortierung im Applikationsserver. Die Inline-Deklaration ist hier ebenfalls vorteilhaft.

explanation: Die `UP TO N ROWS`-Klausel ist nützlich, um die Anzahl der gelesenen Datensätze zu begrenzen, was die Performance bei der Anzeige von Vorschauen oder bei der Paginierung verbessern kann.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` und deklarieren Sie die interne Tabelle inline.

solution:
CLASS zcl_select_in_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_select_in_table IMPLEMENTATION.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: Der `IN`-Operator mit einer internen Tabelle ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, mehrere Werte in einer `WHERE`-Klausel zu filtern. Dies ist oft performanter als `FOR ALL ENTRIES`, insbesondere wenn die interne Tabelle nicht leer ist.
keywords: SELECT, IN, Internal Table, DATA, Inline Declaration, sflights

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie alle Flüge von 'AA' und 'LH' aus `sflights` in einer einzigen Abfrage mit `UNION ALL` und deklarieren Sie die interne Tabelle inline.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UNION ALL` zwischen zwei `SELECT` Statements.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_union_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_union_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_union_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_union_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).
    rt_sflights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_union_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_union_all( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_union_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).

    " Get counts for individual carriers to compare
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @DATA(lv_count_aa).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @DATA(lv_count_lh).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = lv_count_aa + lv_count_lh ).

    " Verify all entries are either AA or LH
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNION ALL` ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT`-Statements zu kombinieren, ohne Duplikate zu entfernen. Dies ist effizienter als separate Abfragen und das anschließende Zusammenführen und Sortieren im Applikationsserver, insbesondere wenn Duplikate beibehalten werden sollen.
keywords: SELECT, UNION ALL, DATA, Inline Declaration, sflights

Instructions: Lesen Sie die durchschnittliche Flugzeit (`fltime`) pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und deklarieren Sie die Ergebnis-Tabelle inline.

CLASS zcl_select_avg_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Finden Sie die Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights`, die mehr als 10 Flüge haben, und deklarieren Sie die Ergebnis-Tabelle inline.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COUNT(*)`, `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.

CLASS zcl_select_having IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carrier_counts).
    rt_carrier_count = lt_carrier_counts.

ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_carrier_count ) exp = 0 ).

explanation: Die `HAVING`-Klausel ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse von Aggregatfunktionen zu filtern, nachdem die Gruppierung erfolgt ist. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion, um komplexe Filterbedingungen direkt auf der Datenbank anzuwenden und die Datenmenge zu reduzieren, die an den Applikationsserver übertragen wird.
keywords: SELECT, COUNT, GROUP BY, HAVING, DATA, Inline Declaration, sflights

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Wertebereiche (Value Ranges) einer Domäne aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_VALUE_RANGES` der Klasse `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_get_value_ranges DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value_range,
             sign   TYPE ddic_sign,
             option TYPE ddic_option,
             low    TYPE domvalue_l,
             high   TYPE domvalue_l,
           END OF ty_value_range.
    TYPES tt_value_ranges TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ranges
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE domname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_ranges) TYPE tt_value_ranges.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_get_value_ranges IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ranges.
    DATA: lt_ranges_raw TYPE cl_reca_ddic_doma=>tt_value_ranges.

    cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_value_ranges(
      EXPORTING
        id_name   = iv_domain_name
      IMPORTING
        et_ranges = lt_ranges_raw
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_ranges_raw INTO DATA(ls_range_raw).
      APPEND VALUE ty_value_range(
        sign   = ls_range_raw-sign
        option = ls_range_raw-option
        low    = ls_range_raw-low
        high   = ls_range_raw-high
      ) TO rt_ranges.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'NUMC10 sollte Wertebereiche haben' act = lines( lt_ranges ) exp = 0 err_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_err_level_none ).
    " Assuming NUMC10 has at least one range, e.g., '0000000000' to '9999999999'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'NUMC10 sollte Wertebereiche zurückgeben' act = lt_ranges ).

    DATA(ls_expected_range) = VALUE zcl_ddic_get_value_ranges=>ty_value_range(
      sign   = 'I'
      option = 'BT'
      low    = '0000000000'
      high   = '9999999999'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Erwarteter Wertebereich sollte vorhanden sein' table = lt_ranges value = ls_expected_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_ddic_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ddic_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lv_domain_name_domname TYPE domname.

    ).

Obwohl `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA` selbst keine dynamischen Methodenaufrufe erfordert, ist die Fähigkeit, den Domänennamen als String zu übergeben und in den korrekten Typ zu konvertieren, ein grundlegendes Muster für dynamische Szenarien. Die Fehlerbehandlung für ungültige Domänennamen ist hier ebenfalls integriert.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer Data-Aging-fähigen Tabelle, indem Sie explizit den Zugriff auf 'COLD'-Daten aktivieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STACK_TEMPERATURE=>SET_COLD()` und `RESET()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_cold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cold_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_cold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cold_sflights.
    " Annahme: Tabelle SFLIGHT ist Data-Aging-fähig konfiguriert.
    " In einem realen Szenario wäre dies eine kundeneigene Tabelle mit Data Aging.
    cl_abap_stack_temperature=>set_cold( ).
    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, falls SFLIGHT nicht Data-Aging-fähig ist
        " oder andere SQL-Fehler auftreten.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Lesen von SFLIGHT mit COLD-Temperatur' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_stack_temperature=>reset( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_cold_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_cold_sflights.

    ELSEIF iv_mode = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>co_hot.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

      IMPORTING

        cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_data_with_exception.
    DATA(lv_initial_temp) = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature( ).

    cl_abap_stack_temperature=>set_cold( ).
    cl_demo_output=>write( |Temperatur nach SET_COLD: { cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature() }| ).

    TRY.
        IF iv_raise_exception = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.

        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_demo_output=>write( |Ausnahme gefangen!| ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Fehler in Datenverarbeitung'.
      FINALLY.
        cl_abap_stack_temperature=>reset( ).
        cl_demo_output=>write( |Temperatur nach FINALLY-RESET: { cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature() }| ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature() exp = lv_initial_temp ).
    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Data-Aging-Temperatur basierend auf einem Konfigurationsparameter dynamisch setzt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung oder `IF`-Bedingungen, um zwischen `SET_COLD()` und `SET_HOT()` zu wählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_dynamic_cfg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflights_by_config
      IMPORTING
        iv_config_mode TYPE string " 'DEFAULT', 'HOT', 'COLD'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_dynamic_cfg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflights_by_config.
    DATA(lv_initial_temp) = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature( ).

    CASE iv_config_mode.
      WHEN 'COLD'.
        cl_abap_stack_temperature=>set_cold( ).
      WHEN 'HOT'.
        cl_abap_stack_temperature=>set_hot( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Keine Aktion, behält die aktuelle Stack-Temperatur bei
    ENDCASE.

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Lesen von SFLIGHT' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.

    IF iv_config_mode = 'COLD' OR iv_config_mode = 'HOT'.
      cl_abap_stack_temperature=>reset( ).
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature() exp = lv_initial_temp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Data-Aging-Temperatur für eine bestimmte Dauer setzt und dann automatisch zurücksetzt, um eine 'Scope'-ähnliche Funktionalität zu simulieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine lokale Hilfsklasse oder einen `TRY...FINALLY`-Block in Kombination mit einem Zeitstempel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_scoped DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflights_in_scope
      IMPORTING
        iv_mode TYPE cl_abap_stack_temperature=>ty_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_scoped IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflights_in_scope.
    DATA(lv_initial_temp) = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature( ).

    cl_abap_stack_temperature=>set_temperature(
      id_temperature = iv_mode
    ).

    TRY.
        " Simulieren einer Operation, die eine bestimmte Zeit dauert
        WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.

        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.

      CATCH cx_sy_wait_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung für WAIT
      FINALLY.
        cl_abap_stack_temperature=>reset( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_temperature() exp = lv_initial_temp ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Flug mit der Flugnummer 'LH400' und dem Datum '20250101' aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Flug nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke mit `[ ]` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_expr_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_expr_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Populate dummy data for demonstration
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'B747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A380' )
    ).

    " Read using table expression
    TRY.
        rs_flight = lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_expr_read( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-planetype exp = 'A380' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_expr_read( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      ACT = #( lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ) )
      EXPECTED_CLASS = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke ermöglichen das direkte Lesen von Zeilen aus internen Tabellen mit einer kompakten Syntax, die `READ TABLE` ersetzt. Die `VALUE #` Syntax wird hier verwendet, um die interne Tabelle mit Initialwerten zu füllen.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expressions, VALUE, READ TABLE, cx_sy_itab_line_not_found

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und Fluggesellschaften aus einer gegebenen `sflights`-Tabelle enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `IN` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_loop_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_full
        iv_min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_loop_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( fldate > iv_min_fldate )
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_flights_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_loop_in( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_for_loop_in=>tt_sflight_full #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'B747' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '249' fldate = '20250103' planetype = 'A320' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_min_date) = '20250101'.
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_summary( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_min_fldate = lv_min_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #` ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile, was den Code sehr prägnant und funktional macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Looping, Filtering, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (hypothetisch) aus einer Tabelle von Flügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE p DECIMALS 2( INIT sum = 0
                                          FOR ls_flight IN it_flight_prices
                                          NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_flight_price #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' price = '100.50' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '249' price = '50.25' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_prices ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '350.75' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_flight_price #( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_prices ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen oder anderen Datenstrukturen in einer funktionalen Weise, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht als explizite Schleifen mit Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming
