explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf beliebigen Bedingungen zu filtern, was den Code kürzer und leichter verständlich macht als manuelle Schleifen mit `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Filtering, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Nachricht in mehreren Schritten verarbeitet (z.B. initialisieren, hinzufügen, abrufen) und dabei Methodenverkettung (Chaining) verwendet.
hint: Definieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Methodenverkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS add_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_message_processor.
    METHODS get_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_message = 'Initial Message: '.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_text.
    mv_message = mv_message && iv_text && ' '.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message.
    rv_message = mv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_message_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_final_message) = lo_processor->add_text( 'Hello' )->add_text( 'World' )->get_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_message exp = 'Initial Message: Hello World ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenverkettung (Chaining) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zusammengefasst werden. Dies wird durch Methoden erreicht, die eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Chaining, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie für jeden Flug eine neue Struktur erstellen, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und dabei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft berücksichtigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus `FOR` und `FILTER` in einem `VALUE #` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_number TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_short.
    TYPES tt_flight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_short_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_short_flights) TYPE tt_flight_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_short_flights.
    rt_short_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                                ( carrier = ls_flight-carrid
                                  flight_number = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_short_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_short_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_short_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_value( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_filter_value=>tt_sflight_full #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'B747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A380' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_short_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_short_flights( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_short_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_short_flights[ 1 ]-carrier exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_short_flights[ 1 ]-flight_number exp = '400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_filtered_short_flights_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_value( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_filter_value=>tt_sflight_full #(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'B747' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_short_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_short_flights( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_short_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` innerhalb eines `VALUE #` Konstruktorausdrucks ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, FILTER, VALUE, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt, und geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die eingebaute Funktion `starts_with`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_starts_with DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_starts_with IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_prefix.
    IF starts_with( val = iv_text sub = iv_prefix ) = abap_true.
      rv_result = |Der Text '{ iv_text }' beginnt mit dem Präfix '{ iv_prefix }'.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Der Text '{ iv_text }' beginnt NICHT mit dem Präfix '{ iv_prefix }'.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_starts_with_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_starts_with_false FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_starts_with_true.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_starts_with( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_prefix( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_prefix = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'beginnt mit' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_starts_with_false.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_starts_with( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->check_prefix( iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_prefix = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'beginnt NICHT mit' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die eingebaute Funktion `starts_with` (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) bietet eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, zu prüfen, ob ein String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt, ohne manuelle String-Operationen durchführen zu müssen.
keywords: String Processing, starts_with, String Functions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_PRIVATE_DATA` mit einem privaten Attribut. Erstellen Sie eine zweite Klasse `ZCL_FRIEND_ACCESS`, die als Freund von `ZCL_PRIVATE_DATA` deklariert ist und auf das private Attribut zugreifen kann, um dessen Wert zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FRIENDS` Anweisung in der Definition von `ZCL_PRIVATE_DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_private_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_private_data TYPE string VALUE 'Geheime Daten'.
    FRIENDS zcl_friend_access. " ZCL_FRIEND_ACCESS ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    rv_data = mv_private_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_private_data IMPORTING io_private_data TYPE REF TO zcl_private_data
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_private_data.
    rv_data = io_private_data->mv_private_data. " Zugriff auf privates Attribut
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friend_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_access.
    DATA(lo_private) = NEW zcl_private_data( ).
    DATA(lo_friend) = NEW zcl_friend_access( ).
    DATA(lv_data) = lo_friend->read_private_data( lo_private ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_data exp = 'Geheime Daten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration ermöglicht es einer anderen Klasse, auf die privaten und geschützten Komponenten der deklarierten Klasse zuzugreifen, was eine kontrollierte Kapselungsdurchbrechung für spezifische Anwendungsfälle erlaubt.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Encapsulation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT` mit einem privaten Konstruktor. Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY`, die als Freund von `ZCL_PRODUCT` deklariert ist und Instanzen von `ZCL_PRODUCT` erzeugen kann.
hint: Der Konstruktor der Produktklasse muss `PRIVATE` sein, und die Factory-Klasse muss als `FRIENDS` deklariert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_product_factory. " Factory ist ein Freund
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string
                                     RETURNING VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zcl_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    ro_product = NEW zcl_product( iv_name = iv_name ). " Zugriff auf privaten Konstruktor
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_creation.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'Mein Produkt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_product ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Mein Produkt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Deklaration des Konstruktors als `PRIVATE` wird die direkte Instanziierung der Klasse verhindert. Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration erlaubt der Factory-Klasse, den privaten Konstruktor aufzurufen und somit die Erzeugung von Objekten zu kontrollieren, was das Factory-Pattern sauber implementiert.
keywords: FRIENDS, Factory Pattern, Private Constructor, Object Orientation

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine einzelne Zeile in eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHTS` ein, indem Sie den `VALUE` Operator verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... VALUE #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_single_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_price  TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_single_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                    connid = iv_connid
                    fldate = iv_fldate
                    price  = iv_price ) INTO TABLE rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_single FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_single.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_single_line( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->insert_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH'
                                                    iv_connid = '0400'
                                                    iv_fldate = '20251225'
                                                    iv_price  = '123.45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht die direkte Initialisierung einer Struktur und deren Einfügen in eine interne Tabelle in einem einzigen, kompakten Ausdruck. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert Boilerplate-Code.
keywords: INSERT, VALUE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, indem Sie den `FOR` Operator verwenden, um mehrere Zeilen basierend auf einer Schleife zu generieren und einzufügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_data.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                              ( carrid = 'AA'
                                connid = CONV s_conn_id( 100 + i )
                                fldate = '202512' && |{ i DATE = ISO }|
                                price  = 100.00 + i ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_for FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_for.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_for_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->generate_flight_data( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0103' ).

CLASS zcl_insert_unique_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_unique_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_unique_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_unique_items.
    rt_target_items = REDUCE zcl_insert_unique_filter=>tt_items(
      INIT result = VALUE zcl_insert_unique_filter=>tt_items( )
      FOR ls_item IN it_source_items
      WHERE NOT line_exists( result[ key = ls_item-key ] )
      DO
        INSERT ls_item INTO TABLE result.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_db_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_new,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_new.
    TYPES tt_sflight_new TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_new WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_flights_if_new_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_insert TYPE tt_sflight_new
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_db_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_if_new_carrier.
    " Prepare data for insertion, ensuring unique carrier IDs for this example's logic
    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = VALUE tt_sflight_new(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_to_insert
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group)
      ( group-carrid = group-carrid
        connid = group-connid
        fldate = group-fldate
        price = group-price
        currency = group-currency )
    ).

    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @lt_unique_carriers
      WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE carrid = sflight~carrid ).
    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Insert an existing carrier for testing the condition
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid_existing connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate price = '1.00' currency = 'EUR' ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_flights_to_insert) = VALUE zcl_insert_db_cond=>tt_sflight_new(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_new      connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) " New carrier
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_existing connid = '0002' fldate = lv_fldate price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) " Existing carrier
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_new      connid = '0003' fldate = lv_fldate price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' ) " Another flight for new carrier
    ).

    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_flights_if_new_carrier( lt_flights_to_insert ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_inserted exp = 2 ). " Only flights for 'WW' should be inserted

    " Verify insertion
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_count) WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_new.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_count WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_existing.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 1 ). " Only the initially inserted one

    " Cleanup after test
    cleanup_test_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_test_data.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'WW' OR carrid = 'AA'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT ... FROM TABLE ... WHERE NOT EXISTS` Syntax ermöglicht das bedingte Einfügen von Datensätzen in eine Datenbanktabelle. Hier werden nur Flüge eingefügt, deren Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) noch nicht in der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle existiert. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Duplikate auf Datenbankebene zu vermeiden, ohne vorherige `SELECT`-Prüfungen in ABAP-Code durchführen zu müssen.
keywords: INSERT, Database Operations, SFLIGHTS, WHERE NOT EXISTS, Subquery, Conditional Insert

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_REPORT_DATA` mit einer privaten internen Tabelle, die Berichtsdaten enthält. Implementieren Sie eine Freundesklasse `ZCL_REPORT_BUILDER`, die diese private Tabelle mit komplexen, berechneten Daten befüllt, indem sie den `FOR` Operator und `REDUCE` verwendet.
hint: Die Builder-Klasse muss als `FRIENDS` deklariert sein. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` für die Datenaggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_report_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_report_line,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_report_line.
    TYPES tt_report_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_report_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_report_lines RETURNING VALUE(rt_lines) TYPE tt_report_lines.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_report_lines TYPE tt_report_lines.
    FRIENDS zcl_report_builder.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_report_lines.
    rt_lines = mt_report_lines.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_data,
             id       TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
             amount   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_raw_data.
    TYPES tt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_report IMPORTING it_raw_data TYPE tt_raw_data
                           CHANGING co_report_data TYPE REF TO zcl_report_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_report.
    co_report_data->mt_report_lines = REDUCE zcl_report_data=>tt_report_lines(
      INIT result = VALUE zcl_report_data=>tt_report_lines( )
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_data
      GROUP BY ls_raw-category INTO DATA(group)
      ( category = group-category
        value    = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_g IN group NEXT sum = sum + ls_g-amount )
        count    = lines( group ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friend_report_builder FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_report_builder.
    DATA(lo_report_data) = NEW zcl_report_data( ).
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_report_builder( ).

    DATA(lt_raw_data) = VALUE zcl_report_builder=>tt_raw_data(
      ( id = 1 category = 'A' amount = 10 )
      ( id = 2 category = 'B' amount = 20 )
      ( id = 3 category = 'A' amount = 15 )
      ( id = 4 category = 'C' amount = 5 )
      ( id = 5 category = 'B' amount = 25 )
    ).

    lo_builder->build_report( EXPORTING it_raw_data = lt_raw_data
                              CHANGING  co_report_data = lo_report_data ).

    DATA(lt_report_lines) = lo_report_data->get_report_lines( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_report_lines ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_line_a) = lt_report_lines[ category = 'A' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_line_a-value exp = 25 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_line_a-count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_line_b) = lt_report_lines[ category = 'B' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_line_b-value exp = 45 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_line_b-count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Kombination von `FRIENDS` mit modernen internen Tabellenoperationen. Die Freundesklasse `ZCL_REPORT_BUILDER` greift auf die private interne Tabelle von `ZCL_REPORT_DATA` zu und befüllt sie mit aggregierten Daten, die mithilfe des `REDUCE` Operators und `GROUP BY` in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck berechnet werden. Dies ist sehr effizient und lesbar für komplexe Datenverarbeitungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` und verwenden Sie `FOR` und `FILTER` um sie zu füllen und zu filtern.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` und `FILTER` für die Tabellenkonstruktion und -manipulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                     fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                     price = ls_sflight-price ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( rt_filtered_flights WHERE price > 500 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_for_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result
      msg = 'Die Tabelle sollte nicht initial sein, wenn Daten vorhanden sind.' ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-price > 500
        msg = 'Alle Preise sollten größer als 500 sein.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die funktionale Programmierung mit internen Tabellen. `FOR` wird verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle aus einer bestehenden zu konstruieren, und `FILTER` wird eingesetzt, um die Ergebnisse basierend auf einer Bedingung zu filtern. Dies ist sehr effizient und lesbar.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLE, FOR, FILTER, TYPES BEGIN OF, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer internen Tabelle, die mit `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` deklariert wurde, um einen aggregierten Wert zu berechnen.
hint: `REDUCE` ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen von Tabellen in einen einzelnen Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             product_id TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
             price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sales_item.

    TYPES tt_sales_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_sales IMPORTING it_sales_items TYPE tt_sales_items
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_sales) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_sales.
    rv_total_sales = REDUCE #( INIT total TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 = 0
                                FOR ls_item IN it_sales_items
                                NEXT total = total + ( ls_item-quantity * ls_item-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_sales FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_sales.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA lt_sales TYPE zcl_str_reduce_sum=>tt_sales_items.

    APPEND VALUE #( product_id = 'P001' quantity = 2 price = '10.50' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( product_id = 'P002' quantity = 3 price = '5.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( product_id = 'P003' quantity = 1 price = '20.00' ) TO lt_sales.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_sales( lt_sales ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '56.00'
      msg = 'Die Gesamtsumme sollte 56.00 sein.' ).

    CLEAR lt_sales.
    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_sales( lt_sales ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00'
      msg = 'Die Gesamtsumme einer leeren Tabelle sollte 0.00 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Es ermöglicht eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Berechnung von Summen, Zählungen oder anderen aggregierten Werten, ohne explizite Schleifen verwenden zu müssen.
keywords: REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLE, TYPES BEGIN OF, AGGREGATION, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING

CLASS zcl_str_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '1000.00' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '500.00' ) TO lt_sflights.

      msg = 'Der Carried des ersten Eintrags sollte LH sein.' ).

      msg = 'Das Flugdatum des zweiten Eintrags sollte 20251202 sein.' ).

explanation: `CORRESPONDING` ist ein sehr nützliches Statement, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Typen, aber gleichen Feldnamen, effizient zu kopieren. Es reduziert den Boilerplate-Code erheblich und verbessert die Lesbarkeit bei Datenumwandlungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer abstrakten Methode und zwei konkreten Unterklassen, die die Methode implementieren. Demonstrieren Sie Polymorphie.

CLASS zcl_oo_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
    METHODS calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.

  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Shape'.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_oo_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_oo_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.

    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_width TYPE decfloat16 iv_height TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_height TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( ).
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse, die eine Factory-Methode enthält, um Instanzen von Unterklassen zu erzeugen, basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (Factory Method Pattern).

CLASS zcl_oo_document_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
    CLASS METHODS create_document
      IMPORTING iv_document_type TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_document_factory
      RAISING   cx_sy_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_document_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    CASE iv_document_type.
      WHEN 'INVOICE'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_oo_invoice( ).
      WHEN 'ORDER'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_oo_order( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_error EXPORTING text = 'Unbekannter Dokumenttyp'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_invoice IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type.
    rv_type = 'Invoice'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_order DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_oo_document_factory FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type.
    rv_type = 'Order'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_invalid_type FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_error.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_method.
    DATA(lo_invoice) = zcl_oo_document_factory=>create_document( 'INVOICE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_invoice->get_type( ) exp = 'Invoice'
      msg = 'Sollte eine Rechnung sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_invoice IS INSTANCE OF zcl_oo_invoice
      msg = 'Objekt sollte vom Typ ZCL_OO_INVOICE sein.' ).

    DATA(lo_order) = zcl_oo_document_factory=>create_document( 'ORDER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_order->get_type( ) exp = 'Order'
      msg = 'Sollte eine Bestellung sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_order IS INSTANCE OF zcl_oo_order
      msg = 'Objekt sollte vom Typ ZCL_OO_ORDER sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_type.
    DATA(lo_document) = zcl_oo_document_factory=>create_document( 'UNKNOWN' ).

explanation: Das Factory Method Pattern ermöglicht es, die Erzeugung von Objekten in Unterklassen zu delegieren, wodurch der Client-Code von der konkreten Implementierung entkoppelt wird. Die abstrakte Basisklasse definiert die Schnittstelle für die Objekterzeugung, während die Unterklassen die tatsächliche Instanziierung übernehmen. Dies fördert Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit.

CLASS zcl_oo_report_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report RETURNING VALUE(rv_report_content) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS get_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
    METHODS format_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_data) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_report_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = get_data( ).
    rv_report_content = format_data( lt_raw_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_sales_report DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_oo_report_generator FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS format_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_sales_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    " Simulierte Datenbeschaffung, z.B. aus SFLIGHTS
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 3 ROWS.

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                         ( |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } Preis: { ls_flight-price }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_data.
    DATA(lv_header) = '--- Sales Report ---\n'.
    DATA(lv_footer) = '\n--- End of Report ---'.
    DATA(lv_body) = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR line IN it_data NEXT s = s && line && '\n' ).
    rv_formatted_data = |{ lv_header }{ lv_body }{ lv_footer }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sales_report_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sales_report_generation.
    DATA(lo_sales_report) = NEW zcl_oo_sales_report( ).
    DATA(lv_report) = lo_sales_report->generate_report( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_report
      msg = 'Der Bericht sollte nicht leer sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_report needle = '--- Sales Report ---'
      msg = 'Der Bericht sollte den Header enthalten.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_report needle = '--- End of Report ---'
      msg = 'Der Bericht sollte den Footer enthalten.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lv_report needle = 'Flug'
      msg = 'Der Bericht sollte Flugdaten enthalten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template Method Pattern nutzt eine abstrakte Klasse, um den übergeordneten Algorithmus (`generate_report`) zu definieren, während die Implementierung spezifischer Schritte (`get_data`, `format_data`) den konkreten Unterklassen überlassen wird. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code und stellt sicher, dass der Algorithmus-Fluss konsistent bleibt, während die Details flexibel angepasst werden können.
keywords: ABSTRACT CLASS, TEMPLATE METHOD, DESIGN PATTERN, INHERITANCE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` und verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` um die Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_record,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sales_record.
    TYPES tt_sales_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_record WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_sales,
             region TYPE string,
             total_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             product_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_sales.
    TYPES tt_grouped_sales TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_sales WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_sales IMPORTING it_sales TYPE tt_sales_records
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_sales) TYPE tt_grouped_sales.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_sales.
    rt_grouped_sales = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sales IN it_sales GROUP BY ls_sales-region
                                 ( region = ls_sales-region
                                   total_amount = SUM( ls_sales-amount )
                                   product_count = COUNT( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_group_by( ).
    DATA lt_sales TYPE zcl_str_group_by=>tt_sales_records.

    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'North' product = 'A' amount = '100.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'South' product = 'B' amount = '150.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'North' product = 'C' amount = '200.00' ) TO lt_sales.
    APPEND VALUE #( region = 'South' product = 'D' amount = '50.00' ) TO lt_sales.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_sales( lt_sales ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Gruppen (Regionen) vorhanden sein.' ).

    DATA(ls_north) = lt_result[ KEY region = 'North' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_north-total_amount exp = '300.00'
      msg = 'Gesamtbetrag für North sollte 300.00 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_north-product_count exp = 2
      msg = 'Anzahl Produkte für North sollte 2 sein.' ).

    DATA(ls_south) = lt_result[ KEY region = 'South' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_south-total_amount exp = '200.00'
      msg = 'Gesamtbetrag für South sollte 200.00 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_south-product_count exp = 2
      msg = 'Anzahl Produkte für South sollte 2 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY` Klausel in Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen und manuelle Aggregationen und ist ein Kernstück der modernen funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine verschachtelte Struktur zu erstellen, die Daten aus der Tabelle aggregiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine komplexe Struktur aufzubauen, indem Sie über die interne Tabelle iterieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_summary_detail,
             item_id TYPE string,
             sum_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_summary_detail.
    TYPES tt_summary_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_summary_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_overall_summary,
             total_items TYPE i,
             grand_total_value TYPE i,
             details TYPE tt_summary_details,
           END OF ty_overall_summary.

    METHODS get_nested_summary IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_items
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_overall_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_summary.
    rs_summary = REDUCE #( INIT s = VALUE ty_overall_summary( total_items = 0 grand_total_value = 0 )
                           FOR ls_item IN it_items
                           NEXT s = VALUE ty_overall_summary( s
                                      total_items = s-total_items + 1
                                      grand_total_value = s-grand_total_value + ls_item-value
                                      details = VALUE #( s-details
                                                 ( item_id = ls_item-id sum_value = ls_item-value ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_nested FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_nested.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_nested( ).
    DATA lt_items TYPE zcl_str_reduce_nested=>tt_items.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'A' value = 10 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'B' value = 20 ) TO lt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 'C' value = 30 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(ls_summary) = lo_cut->get_nested_summary( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-total_items exp = 3
      msg = 'Gesamtzahl der Elemente sollte 3 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-grand_total_value exp = 60
      msg = 'Gesamtwert sollte 60 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_summary-details ) exp = 3
      msg = 'Anzahl der Detailzeilen sollte 3 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-details[ 1 ]-item_id exp = 'A'
      msg = 'Erster Detail-ID sollte A sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-details[ 3 ]-sum_value exp = 30
      msg = 'Dritter Detail-Wert sollte 30 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist extrem vielseitig und kann nicht nur einfache Aggregationen durchführen, sondern auch komplexe, verschachtelte Strukturen aufbauen. In diesem Beispiel wird eine Gesamtübersicht mit Details erstellt, indem die `INIT` und `NEXT` Ausdrücke von `REDUCE` geschickt genutzt werden, um sowohl skalare Werte als auch eine interne Tabelle innerhalb der Ergebnisstruktur zu aktualisieren.
keywords: REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLE, NESTED STRUCTURE, AGGREGATION, TYPES BEGIN OF

CLASS zcl_str_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_s_flight_data.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_data WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_s_flight_data
      RAISING   cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE ty_t_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251224' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251225' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251226' )

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Betrag von einer Quellwährung in eine Zielwährung unter Verwendung des `CALCULATE` Statements.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE` mit der `CURRENCY` Klausel und den entsprechenden Währungsparametern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount     TYPE s_price
        iv_source_cur TYPE s_curr
        iv_target_cur TYPE s_curr
        iv_date       TYPE s_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_converted_amount) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_currency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_currency.
    DATA: lv_factor TYPE f.

    " Für Einfachheit wird hier ein fester Umrechnungskurs angenommen.
    " In einem realen System würde dieser aus Customizing-Tabellen (z.B. TCURR) ermittelt.
    IF iv_source_cur = 'EUR' AND iv_target_cur = 'USD'.
      lv_factor = '1.10'. " 1 EUR = 1.10 USD
    ELSEIF iv_source_cur = 'USD' AND iv_target_cur = 'EUR'.
      lv_factor = '0.90'. " 1 USD = 0.90 EUR
    ELSE.
      lv_factor = '1'. " Keine Umrechnung
    ENDIF.

    " Das CALCULATE Statement führt die Arithmetik mit korrekter Dezimalstellenbehandlung durch
    CALCULATE rv_converted_amount = iv_amount * lv_factor
              CURRENCY iv_target_cur.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von Flugpreisen aus der `SFLIGHT` Tabelle, nachdem diese in eine Zielwährung umgerechnet wurden. Nutzen Sie hierfür `CALCULATE` in einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und die umgerechneten Werte zu summieren. Innerhalb von `REDUCE` kann `CALCULATE` verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_converted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid     TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_target_cur TYPE s_curr
        iv_date       TYPE s_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_converted_price.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight_data,
             price TYPE s_price,
             curr  TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_s_sflight_data.
    DATA ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price, currency AS curr
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @ty_t_sflight_data.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN ty_t_sflight_data
      LET lv_converted_price = ls_flight-price * 
                                 COND f(
                                   WHEN ls_flight-curr = 'EUR' AND iv_target_cur = 'USD' THEN '1.10'
                                   WHEN ls_flight-curr = 'USD' AND iv_target_cur = 'EUR' THEN '0.90'
                                   ELSE '1'
                                 )
      IN
        sum_price = sum_price + lv_converted_price
    ).

    " Final CALCULATE to ensure correct decimal handling for the sum
    CALCULATE rv_total_price = rv_total_price CURRENCY iv_target_cur.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_converted_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_reduce_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_converted_price(
      iv_carrid     = 'LH'
      iv_target_cur = 'USD'
      iv_date       = sy-datum
    ).

    " Assuming LH has flights with EUR prices, and 1 EUR = 1.10 USD
    " This test needs to be robust against actual SFLIGHT data.
    " For demonstration, we just check if it's not initial and has a reasonable value.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE` und `CALCULATE` für komplexe Aggregationen. `REDUCE` iteriert über die Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` (hier mit einer `TYPES BEGIN OF` Struktur für die lokalen Daten), wendet eine bedingte Umrechnung an und summiert die Werte. Das abschließende `CALCULATE` stellt sicher, dass die Gesamtsumme korrekt in der Zielwährung formatiert wird. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Programmiermuster.
keywords: CALCULATE, REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, Currency Conversion, BEGIN OF

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` enthält, wobei der Preis in eine Zielwährung umgerechnet und die Währungseinheit aktualisiert wird. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `CALCULATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, und `CALCULATE` innerhalb der Schleife für die Umrechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_for_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_converted,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_s_flight_converted.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_converted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_converted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_converted_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid     TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_target_cur TYPE s_curr
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_converted_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_for_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_converted_sflight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_converted_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
      LET lv_converted_price = ls_raw-price
          lv_factor = COND f(
                        WHEN ls_raw-currency = 'EUR' AND iv_target_cur = 'USD' THEN '1.10'
                        WHEN ls_raw-currency = 'USD' AND iv_target_cur = 'EUR' THEN '0.90'
                        ELSE '1'
                      )
      IN
        ( carrid   = ls_raw-carrid
          connid   = ls_raw-connid
          fldate   = ls_raw-fldate
          price    = lv_converted_price * lv_factor " Simple multiplication for now
          currency = iv_target_cur )
    ).

    " Apply CALCULATE for each price in the new table to ensure correct decimal handling
    LOOP AT rt_converted_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      CALCULATE <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price CURRENCY <fs_flight>-currency.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_converted_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_converted_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_for_table( ).
    DATA(lt_converted) = lo_cut->get_converted_sflight_data(
      iv_carrid     = 'LH'
      iv_target_cur = 'USD'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_converted ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted[ 1 ]-currency exp = 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_converted[ 1 ]-price > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR` Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle deklarativ zu befüllen. Innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife wird der Preis bedingt umgerechnet. Ein nachfolgender `LOOP` mit `CALCULATE` stellt sicher, dass die Dezimalstellen und Rundungsregeln für jeden umgerechneten Preis korrekt angewendet werden. Dies ist ein effizienter Weg, um Daten zu transformieren und gleichzeitig die Genauigkeit von Währungsfeldern zu gewährleisten.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Wert eines Ausdrucks, der eine Multiplikation und Division beinhaltet, und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Ergebnis korrekt auf zwei Dezimalstellen gerundet wird, wie es für Währungsbeträge üblich ist. Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` mit einer Dummy-Währung, um die Rundungslogik zu aktivieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_math_round DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_rounded_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
        iv_value2 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_math_round IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_rounded_value.
    DATA: lv_intermediate_result TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 4.

    " Beispiel: (Wert1 * Wert2) / 3
    lv_intermediate_result = ( iv_value1 * iv_value2 ) / 3.

    " CALCULATE mit einer Dummy-Währung (z.B. 'EUR') erzwingt die korrekte Rundung
    " gemäß den Währungseinstellungen (meist 2 Dezimalstellen für EUR).
    CALCULATE rv_result = lv_intermediate_result CURRENCY 'EUR'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_math_round( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_rounded_value(
      iv_value1 = '10.00'
      iv_value2 = '3.00'
    ).
    " (10 * 3) / 3 = 10.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '10.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_rounding_calculation_2.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_math_round( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_rounded_value(
      iv_value1 = '10.00'
      iv_value2 = '3.33'
    ).
    " (10 * 3.33) / 3 = 33.30 / 3 = 11.10 (gerundet)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '11.10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `CALCULATE` Statement ist nicht nur für explizite Währungs- oder Mengenumrechnungen nützlich, sondern kann auch verwendet werden, um die korrekte Rundung von Dezimalzahlen gemäß den SAP-Standardregeln für eine bestimmte Währung zu gewährleisten. Dies ist besonders wichtig bei Finanzberechnungen, wo Rundungsfehler vermieden werden müssen. Durch die Angabe einer Währung (hier 'EUR') wird die entsprechende Rundungslogik angewendet.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT`, berechnen Sie für jeden Flug einen 'adjustierten Preis' basierend auf einer komplexen Logik (z.B. Rabatt für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften) und geben Sie die Daten mit dem adjustierten Preis zurück. Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE` und `SELECT` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `TYPES BEGIN OF` Struktur für die Zieltabelle. Führen Sie die Preisberechnung nach dem `SELECT` in einer Schleife durch, wobei `CALCULATE` für die Rundung verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_sflight_adjust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_adjusted,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curr,
             adjusted_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_adjusted.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_adjusted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_adjusted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_adjusted_sflight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_adjusted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_sflight_adjust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_adjusted_sflight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw.

    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
      LET lv_discount_factor = COND f(
                                 WHEN ls_raw-carrid = 'LH' THEN '0.90' " 10% Rabatt für LH
                                 WHEN ls_raw-carrid = 'UA' THEN '0.95' " 5% Rabatt für UA
                                 ELSE '1'
                               )
          lv_calculated_price = ls_raw-price * lv_discount_factor
      IN
        ( carrid   = ls_raw-carrid,
          connid   = ls_raw-connid,
          fldate   = ls_raw-fldate,
          price    = ls_raw-price,
          currency = ls_raw-currency,
          adjusted_price = lv_calculated_price )
    ).

    " Sicherstellen der korrekten Rundung für den adjustierten Preis
    LOOP AT rt_adjusted_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      CALCULATE <fs_flight>-adjusted_price = <fs_flight>-adjusted_price CURRENCY <fs_flight>-currency.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_adjusted_prices_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_adjusted_prices_other FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_adjusted_prices_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_sflight_adjust( ).
    DATA(lt_adjusted) = lo_cut->get_adjusted_sflight_prices( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_adjusted ) ).
    IF lines( lt_adjusted ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_adjusted[ 1 ].
      " Erwarteter Preis: Originalpreis * 0.90
      DATA(lv_expected_adjusted_price) = ls_first_flight-price * '0.90'.
      CALCULATE lv_expected_adjusted_price = lv_expected_adjusted_price CURRENCY ls_first_flight-currency.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-adjusted_price exp = lv_expected_adjusted_price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_adjusted_prices_other.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_sflight_adjust( ).
    DATA(lt_adjusted) = lo_cut->get_adjusted_sflight_prices( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_adjusted ) ).
    IF lines( lt_adjusted ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_adjusted[ 1 ].
      " Erwarteter Preis: Originalpreis * 1 (kein Rabatt)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-adjusted_price exp = ls_first_flight-price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den Datenbankzugriff (`SELECT`), die deklarative Tabellenkonstruktion (`FOR` mit `VALUE`), bedingte Logik (`COND`) und die präzise Dezimalstellenbehandlung (`CALCULATE`). Es zeigt, wie man komplexe Geschäftslogik zur Preisadjustierung in einem modernen und funktionalen Stil implementiert, wobei `TYPES BEGIN OF` für die erweiterte Ergebnisstruktur verwendet wird. Die `CALCULATE`-Anweisung am Ende stellt die korrekte Rundung der adjustierten Preise sicher.
keywords: CALCULATE, SELECT, FOR, COND, SFLIGHT, Price Adjustment, BEGIN OF

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Expression mit einer `TYPES BEGIN OF` Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` um die Daten zu gruppieren und `REDUCE` oder `SUM` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_group_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
             currency    TYPE s_curr,
           END OF ty_s_flight_summary.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_price_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_t_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_group_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw.

    rt_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight_raw GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid currency = ls_flight-currency ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
                             INIT sum = 0
                             FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                             IN
                               sum = sum + member-price
                           )
      IN
        ( carrid      = ls_flight-carrid,
          total_price = lv_total_price,
          currency    = ls_flight-currency )
    ).

    " Sicherstellen der korrekten Rundung für die Gesamtsummen
    LOOP AT rt_summary ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_summary>).
      CALCULATE <fs_summary>-total_price = <fs_summary>-total_price CURRENCY <fs_summary>-currency.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_price_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_price_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_group_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_price_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_summary ) ).
    " Überprüfen, ob die Summe für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft korrekt ist
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_str_group_sflight=>ty_s_flight_summary(
      FILTER #( lt_summary WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND currency = 'EUR' )[ 1 ]
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_lh_summary-total_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_lh_summary-total_price > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die sehr moderne `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Expression (ab ABAP 7.50), die eine deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen ermöglicht. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der Preise und einer `TYPES BEGIN OF` Struktur für die Zusammenfassung wird der Code extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark. Das abschließende `CALCULATE` stellt die korrekte Rundung der aggregierten Währungsbeträge sicher.
keywords: BEGIN OF, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, CALCULATE

CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

    rs_entry-uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_uuid_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(ls_entry1) = lo_manager->add_entry( 'First entry' ).
    DATA(ls_entry2) = lo_manager->add_entry( 'Second entry' ).
    DATA(lt_all_entries) = lo_manager->get_all_entries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_all_entries ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_all_entries WITH TABLE KEY uuid = ls_entry1-uuid INTO DATA(ls_found_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_entry-text exp = 'First entry' ).

    " Test uniqueness
    TRY.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Duplicate key should raise exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.

    ENDTRY.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Behandlung des `CLOSE`-Ereignisses eines Dialogbox-Containers.
hint: Registrieren Sie eine lokale Event-Handler-Methode für das `CLOSE`-Ereignis des Containers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dialog_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS dialog_closed EXPORTING VALUE(e_dialog_title) TYPE string.

    METHODS create_and_handle_dialog
      IMPORTING iv_title TYPE string DEFAULT 'Event Dialog'
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_dialog_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_dialog_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
    METHODS handle_close FOR EVENT close OF cl_gui_dialogbox_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dialog_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_handle_dialog.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_dialog_container
      EXPORTING
        width  = 300
        height = 150
        title  = iv_title.

    SET HANDLER handle_close FOR mo_dialog_container.
    ro_dialog_container = mo_dialog_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_close.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde dies PAI oder weitere Verarbeitung auslösen.
    " Für dieses Beispiel lösen wir nur ein lokales Ereignis aus.
    RAISE EVENT dialog_closed EXPORTING e_dialog_title = mo_dialog_container->title.
    " Container freigeben, um Ressourcen freizugeben
    FREE mo_dialog_container.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_dialog_closed_title TYPE string.
    METHODS test_dialog_close_event FOR TESTING.
    METHODS on_dialog_closed FOR EVENT dialog_closed OF zcl_dialog_event_handler
      IMPORTING e_dialog_title.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dialog_close_event.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_dialog_event_handler( ).
    SET HANDLER on_dialog_closed FOR lo_handler. " Für lokales Ereignis registrieren
    DATA(lo_dialog) = lo_handler->create_and_handle_dialog( iv_title = 'Test Close' ).

    " Schließen des Dialogs simulieren (dies ist ein konzeptioneller Schritt,
    " in der realen GUI würde Benutzerinteraktion oder PAI dies auslösen)
    " Für den Unit-Test rufen wir den Handler direkt auf.
    lo_handler->handle_close( ). " Event-Handler direkt aufrufen

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_dialog_closed_title exp = 'Test Close' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_dialog ). " Prüfen, ob freigegeben
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_dialog_closed.
    mv_dialog_closed_title = e_dialog_title.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Implementierung eines Event-Handlers für das `CLOSE`-Ereignis des `CL_GUI_DIALOGBOX_CONTAINER`. Durch `SET HANDLER` wird eine Methode registriert, die auf das Schließen des Dialogs reagiert, was für die Freigabe von Ressourcen und die Weiterverarbeitung wichtig ist.
keywords: CL_GUI_DIALOGBOX_CONTAINER, Event Handling, GUI Programming, SET HANDLER

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine UUID im Format X16 und verwenden Sie diese als Schlüssel für eine interne Tabelle mit `STANDARD TABLE` und `WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16()` und definieren Sie den Tabellentyp entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_sorted_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             uuid TYPE sysuuid_x16,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data
                  WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY uuid.

    METHODS add_entry
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_data.

    METHODS get_entry
      IMPORTING iv_uuid TYPE sysuuid_x16
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_sorted_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    rs_entry-uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ).
    rs_entry-value = iv_value.
    INSERT rs_entry INTO TABLE mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_entry.
    READ TABLE mt_data WITH TABLE KEY uuid = iv_uuid INTO rs_entry.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sorted_table_with_uuid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sorted_table_with_uuid.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_uuid_sorted_table( ).
    DATA(ls_entry1) = lo_manager->add_entry( 'Data for UUID 1' ).
    DATA(ls_entry2) = lo_manager->add_entry( 'Data for UUID 2' ).

    DATA(ls_found_entry) = lo_manager->get_entry( ls_entry1-uuid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_entry-value exp = 'Data for UUID 1' ).

    " Test uniqueness
    TRY.
        INSERT ls_entry1 INTO TABLE lo_manager->mt_data. " Should cause a dump
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Duplicate key should raise exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_manager->mt_data ). " Exception caught, test passed
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `sysuuid_x16` (16-Byte-Binär-UUID) als eindeutigen sortierten Schlüssel in einer `STANDARD TABLE`. Sortierte Tabellen bieten effizienten Zugriff über den Schlüssel und sind speichereffizienter als Hash-Tabellen, wenn die Sortierung wichtig ist.
keywords: UUID, CL_SYSTEM_UUID, Internal Tables, SORTED KEY, sysuuid_x16

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von UUIDs und filtern Sie diese, um nur UUIDs zu behalten, die mit einer bestimmten Zeichenfolge beginnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` oder `FILTER` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_uuids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sysuuid_c32 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_and_filter_uuids
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_uuids) TYPE tt_uuids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_filter_uuids.
    DATA(lt_all_uuids) = VALUE tt_uuids( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
                                        ( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ) ) ).

    rt_filtered_uuids = FILTER #( lt_all_uuids WHERE ( starts_with( val = table_line sub = iv_prefix ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_uuid_filtering FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_uuid_filtering.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_uuid_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_prefix) = 'A'. " UUIDs sind hexadezimal, 'A' ist ein gültiges Startzeichen
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->generate_and_filter_uuids( iv_count = 100 iv_prefix = lv_prefix ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(lv_uuid).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = starts_with( val = lv_uuid sub = lv_prefix ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Es ist unwahrscheinlich, dass bei 100 UUIDs keine mit 'A' beginnen,
    " aber für einen robusten Test müsste man die Generierung steuern oder mehr generieren.
    " Hier prüfen wir nur die Korrektheit der Filterung, falls welche gefunden werden.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Generierung von UUIDs mit dem modernen `FILTER`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem Kriterium (Startzeichenfolge) zu filtern. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Datenmanipulation in ABAP 7.40+.
keywords: UUID, CL_SYSTEM_UUID, FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Finden Sie die maximale Flugdauer (FLTIME) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,

             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_max_fltime_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_flight_time
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_fltime) TYPE sflight-fltime.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_fltime_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_flight_time.
    rv_max_fltime = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_time = 0 TYPE sflight-fltime
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT max_time = COND #( WHEN flight-fltime > max_time THEN flight-fltime ELSE max_time ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,

CLASS zcl_max_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rv_max_free) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_max_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.

      INIT max_free = 0 TYPE i

      NEXT max_free = COND #( WHEN ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) > max_free
                                  THEN ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc )
                                  ELSE max_free ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie die maximale Anzahl von freien Sitzen (SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC) für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT` mit `WHERE` und eine lokale Variable, um das Maximum zu verfolgen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy_simple.
TYPES tt_flight_occupancy_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_max_free_seats_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_free_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_occupancy_simple
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_free) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_free_seats_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_free_seats_for_carrier.
    DATA(lv_current_max) = 0.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      DATA(lv_free_seats) = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc.
      IF lv_free_seats > lv_current_max.
        lv_current_max = lv_free_seats.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_max_free = lv_current_max.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten Auslastung (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten. Geben Sie den Fluggesellschaftscode und die Verbindungs-ID zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Struktur, um den maximalen Wert und die zugehörigen Felder zu speichern.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy_rate,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             occupancy_rate TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy_rate.
TYPES tt_flight_occupancy_rate TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy_rate WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_highest_occupancy_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             occupancy_rate TYPE f,
           END OF ty_highest_occupancy_flight.

CLASS zcl_highest_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_highest_occupancy_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_occupancy_rate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_highest_occupancy_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_highest_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_highest_occupancy_flight.
    rs_flight = REDUCE #( 
      INIT highest_flight = VALUE ty_highest_occupancy_flight( occupancy_rate = 0 )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      LET current_rate = COND f( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN CONV f( flight-seatsocc ) / flight-seatsmax ELSE 0 ) IN
      NEXT highest_flight = COND #( WHEN current_rate > highest_flight-occupancy_rate
                                  THEN VALUE ty_highest_occupancy_flight( carrid = flight-carrid
                                                                          connid = flight-connid
                                                                          occupancy_rate = current_rate )
                                  ELSE highest_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_highest_occupancy.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) " 0.5
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 180 ) " ~0.83
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 90  seatsmax = 100 ) " 0.9
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_highest_occupancy( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_highest_occupancy_flight( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-occupancy_rate exp = '0.9' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_highest_occupancy_empty.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_date,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_date.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_latest_flight,

CLASS zcl_latest_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_latest_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_latest_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_latest_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_flight = REDUCE #( 
      INIT latest_flight = VALUE ty_latest_flight( fldate = '00000000' )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT latest_flight = COND #( WHEN flight-fldate > latest_flight-fldate
                                  THEN VALUE ty_latest_flight( carrid = flight-carrid
                                                                connid = flight-connid
                                                                fldate = flight-fldate )
                                  ELSE latest_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_flight IN sflight

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die Flüge anbieten, unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_carrier_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carriers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_carriers).
    " Get unique carriers
    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_entry IN lt_all_carriers ( ls_entry-carrid ) ).
    SORT lt_unique_carriers ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_carriers.

    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                      FOR ls_carrier IN lt_unique_carriers
                                      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_carrier
                                                           ELSE s && `, ` && ls_carrier ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_info_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info_message.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight( ).
    TRY.
        ls_flight = sflight_tab(
                      KEY carrid connid fldate
                      ( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate )
                    )[ 1 ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } nicht gefunden.|.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    rv_message = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } | &&
                 |kostet { ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency } { ls_flight-currency }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_data_provider.

CLASS zcl_mock_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE string_table OPTIONAL.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD constructor.
    mt_data = it_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    rt_data = mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING io_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.
    METHODS process_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed_string) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_data_provider = io_data_provider.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = mo_data_provider->get_data( ).
    rv_processed_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                          FOR ls_line IN lt_raw_data
