Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach einem bestimmten Abflugort und einem Preisbereich, unter Verwendung des FILTER-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue, gefilterte Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_filter_flights_adv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_filtered_flights
          IMPORTING iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
                    iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
                    iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
          RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_filter_flights_adv IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_filtered_flights.
        DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
                                                      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                                        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                                        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                                                        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom
                                                        price    = ls_sflight-price ) ).

        rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                        WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom
                                        AND price BETWEEN iv_min_price AND iv_max_price ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_adv( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' iv_min_price = 500 iv_max_price = 1500 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Should find filtered flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-price >= 500 AND ls_flight-price <= 1500 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die den angegebenen Bedingungen entsprechen, was den Code sehr lesbar und effizient macht.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie numerische Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT für die Anzeige in einem GUI-Control (z.B. ALV Grid) vor, indem Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für Aggregation und Formatierung verwenden. Fokus liegt auf der Datenaufbereitung, die dann an ein Control übergeben werden könnte.
hint: Nutzen Sie VALUE, FOR und String-Templates, um die Daten zu aggregieren und zu formatieren.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alv_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE string, " Formatted price
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_alv_display.
    TYPES: tt_alv_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alv_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_gui_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS prepare_flight_summary
          RETURNING VALUE(rt_alv_data) TYPE tt_alv_display.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_gui_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD prepare_flight_summary.
        DATA(lt_sflight) = SELECT carrid, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights).

        DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_alv_display(
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_flights
          GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
            total_price = |
              { REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                      FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                      NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) CURRENCY = GROUP ls_flight-currency }
            |,
            num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).

        rt_alv_data = lt_grouped_flights.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prepare_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prepare_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_alv_data) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_summary( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_alv_data msg = 'ALV data should not be initial' ).
    LOOP AT lt_alv_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-total_price ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_entry-num_flights > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = ls_entry-total_price exp = 'DM' msg = 'Total price should be formatted with currency' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie moderne ABAP-Syntax (FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, String-Templates mit CURRENCY-Formatierung) verwendet werden kann, um komplexe Datenaggregationen und -formatierungen durchzuführen. Die resultierende interne Tabelle ist ideal für die direkte Übergabe an ein GUI-Control wie `cl_gui_alv_grid`, das von `cl_gui_control` erbt. Dies demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit moderner ABAP-Sprachfeatures bei der Vorbereitung von Daten für die Benutzeroberfläche, wobei der Fokus auf der Datenmanipulation und nicht auf der GUI-Interaktion selbst liegt.
keywords: GUI, Data Preparation, Internal Tables, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, String Templates, NUMBER, SFLIGHT, cl_gui_control

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit 5 Einträgen, wobei jeder Eintrag eine zufällige Menge (zwischen 10 und 100) und einen Preis (zwischen 1 und 10) hat. Berechne dann den Gesamtpreis für jeden Eintrag (Menge * Preis).
hint: Nutze `FOR` für die Tabellenkonstruktion und `cl_abap_random` für die Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_random_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             quantity TYPE i,
             price    TYPE i,
             total    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_and_calculate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_random_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_calculate.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).

    rt_items = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 5
                         ( quantity = lo_random->int( min = 10 max = 100 )
                           price    = lo_random->int( min = 1 max = 10 )
                           total    = 0 ) ).

    LOOP AT rt_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
      <fs_item>-total = <fs_item>-quantity * <fs_item>-price.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_and_calculate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_and_calculate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_random_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_cut->generate_and_calculate( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 5 ).

    LOOP AT lt_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_item-quantity >= 10 AND ls_item-quantity <= 100 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_item-price >= 1 AND ls_item-price <= 10 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item-total exp = ls_item-quantity * ls_item-price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #(...) FOR ...` Syntax ermöglicht eine kompakte Initialisierung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. `cl_abap_random` wird verwendet, um die zufälligen Mengen und Preise zu generieren. Die Berechnung des Gesamtpreises erfolgt in einem einfachen `LOOP`.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, FOR, RANDOM, MULTIPLY, VALUE

Instructions: Multipliziere eine gegebene Zahl mit 2, wenn eine zufällig generierte Zahl (0 oder 1) gleich 1 ist. Andernfalls gib die ursprüngliche Zahl zurück.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random=>create()` und eine `IF` Anweisung oder einen konditionalen Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS multiply_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_conditionally.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_choice) = lo_random->int( min = 0 max = 1 ).

    rv_result = COND #( WHEN lv_random_choice = 1 THEN iv_number * 2 ELSE iv_number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multiply_conditionally FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiply_conditionally.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 10.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->multiply_conditionally( lv_input ).

    " Due to randomness, we can only assert that the result is one of the two possibilities.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result = lv_input OR lv_result = lv_input * 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der konditionale Ausdruck `COND #(...)` ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, Werte basierend auf einer Bedingung zuzuweisen. Hier wird er verwendet, um entweder die ursprüngliche Zahl oder das doppelte der Zahl zurückzugeben, abhängig von einer zufälligen Entscheidung, die mit `cl_abap_random` getroffen wird.
keywords: CONDITIONAL, RANDOM, MULTIPLY, COND

Instructions: Berechne die Summe von 5 Produkten. Jedes Produkt ist das Ergebnis der Multiplikation einer festen Zahl (z.B. 10) mit einer zufälligen Zahl zwischen 1 und 5.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_random`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_random_prod DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_random_products
      IMPORTING
        iv_fixed_factor TYPE i
        iv_count        TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_random_prod IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_random_products.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
                       NEXT s = s + ( iv_fixed_factor * lo_random->int( min = 1 max = 5 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_of_random_products FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_random_products.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_random_prod( ).
    DATA(lv_fixed_factor) = 10.
    DATA(lv_count) = 5.
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_random_products( iv_fixed_factor = lv_fixed_factor iv_count = lv_count ).

    " Minimum possible sum: 5 * (10 * 1) = 50
    " Maximum possible sum: 5 * (10 * 5) = 250
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_sum >= 50 AND lv_sum <= 250 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_sum MOD lv_fixed_factor = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiger funktionaler Operator, der es erlaubt, eine interne Tabelle oder eine Schleife zu aggregieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine Summe von Produkten zu berechnen, wobei jeder Term eine Multiplikation mit einer zufälligen Zahl beinhaltet. Dies ist sehr kompakt und vermeidet explizite `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, RANDOM, MULTIPLY, FUNCTIONAL, AGGREGATION

Instructions: Multipliziere eine gegebene Zahl mit einem zufällig ausgewählten Faktor aus einer Liste von Faktoren (z.B. [2, 3, 5]).
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random` um einen Index für die Faktorliste zu wählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_factor_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS multiply_with_random_factor
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
        it_factors TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_factor_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_with_random_factor.
    IF it_factors IS INITIAL.
      rv_result = iv_number.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_index) = lo_random->int( min = 1 max = lines( it_factors ) ).
    DATA(lv_random_factor) = it_factors[ lv_index ].

    rv_result = iv_number * lv_random_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multiply_with_random_factor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_factors FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiply_with_random_factor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factor_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 10.
    DATA(lt_factors) = VALUE #( ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->multiply_with_random_factor( iv_number = lv_input it_factors = lt_factors ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result = 20 OR lv_result = 30 OR lv_result = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_factors.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_factor_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 10.
    DATA(lt_factors) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_factor_multiply=>tt_factors( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->multiply_with_random_factor( iv_number = lv_input it_factors = lt_factors ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man dynamisch einen Multiplikationsfaktor aus einer Liste auswählt. `cl_abap_random` wird verwendet, um einen gültigen Index für die interne Tabelle der Faktoren zu generieren. Die moderne Tabellenindexierung `it_factors[ lv_index ]` wird genutzt, um den Faktor zu lesen.
keywords: DYNAMIC, RANDOM, MULTIPLY, INTERNAL TABLES, INDEXING

Instructions: Berechne einen zukünftigen Zeitstempel, indem du zu einem Startzeitstempel eine zufällige Anzahl von Sekunden (zwischen 1 und 60) multipliziert mit einem Faktor (z.B. 10) addierst.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random` für die Zufallszahl und `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitstempelberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_random_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_future_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_factor          TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_random_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_future_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_seconds) = lo_random->int( min = 1 max = 60 ).
    DATA(lv_seconds_to_add) = lv_random_seconds * iv_factor.

    rv_future_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = iv_start_timestamp iv_secs = lv_seconds_to_add ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_future_timestamp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_future_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_random_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_start_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ).
    DATA(lv_factor) = 10.
    DATA(lv_future_timestamp) = lo_cut->calculate_future_timestamp( iv_start_timestamp = lv_start_timestamp iv_factor = lv_factor ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_future_timestamp > lv_start_timestamp ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_future_timestamp iv_tstmp2 = lv_start_timestamp ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_diff_seconds >= 1 * lv_factor AND lv_diff_seconds <= 60 * lv_factor ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_diff_seconds MOD lv_factor = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` bietet statische Methoden zur Manipulation von Zeitstempeln, wie z.B. das Hinzufügen von Sekunden. In Kombination mit `cl_abap_random` kann man so dynamisch zukünftige Zeitpunkte berechnen. Dies ist nützlich für Simulationen oder Terminplanungen mit variablen Verzögerungen.
keywords: DATE/TIME, RANDOM, MULTIPLY, TIMESTAMP, CL_ABAP_TSTMP

Instructions: Erstelle einen String, der den Text "Das Produkt ist: " gefolgt von dem Ergebnis einer Multiplikation einer Zufallszahl (1-10) mit 5 enthält.
hint: Nutze String Templates und `cl_abap_random`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_random_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_string_random_product IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_random_product( ).
    DATA(lv_result_string) = lo_cut->get_formatted_product_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

    DATA(lv_prefix) = 'Das Produkt ist: '.

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus `sflights`. Gruppiere die Flüge nach `CARRID` und `CONNID`. Für jede Gruppe, multipliziere den `PRICE` jedes Fluges mit einem festen Faktor (z.B. 1.1 für eine Preiserhöhung) und berechne den neuen Gesamtpreis pro Gruppe.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_factor TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_results) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_new_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ( <fs_flight>-price * iv_price_factor ) ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      connid = ls_group_key-connid
                      total_new_price = lv_total_new_price ) TO rt_grouped_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_price_factor) = '1.1'.
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->process_flights( lv_price_factor ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_results ).

    " Check a specific group if possible, or just general structure
    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_result-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_result-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_result-total_new_price > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Example: Check a known flight combination
    DATA(lv_expected_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_expected_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(ls_test_flight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_expected_carrid connid = lv_expected_connid ).
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_original_price) WHERE carrid = @lv_expected_carrid AND connid = @lv_expected_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_total_for_one) = lv_original_price * lv_price_factor.
      DATA(ls_found_result) = lt_results[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = lv_expected_carrid connid = lv_expected_connid ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_found_result-total_new_price >= lv_expected_total_for_one ). " Could be more if multiple flights for same date
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` kann man Aggregationen pro Gruppe direkt im Schleifenkörper durchführen, ohne temporäre Tabellen oder manuelle Schleifen. Die Multiplikation des Preises erfolgt innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
keywords: GROUP BY, INTERNAL TABLES, MULTIPLY, SFLIGHTS, REDUCE, AGGREGATION

Instructions: Erstelle eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Zahlen akzeptiert. Für jede Zahl in der Liste, generiere eine Zufallszahl (1-10), multipliziere die Eingabezahl mit dieser Zufallszahl und gib nur die Ergebnisse zurück, die größer als 50 sind.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `cl_abap_random` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_filter_products
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_products) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_filter_products.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).

    rt_filtered_products = FILTER #( 
      VALUE #( FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
               ( lv_number * lo_random->int( min = 1 max = 10 ) ) )
      WHERE table_line > 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_and_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_chain( ).
    DATA(lt_input_numbers) = VALUE #( ( 5 ) ( 10 ) ( 15 ) ( 20 ) ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->process_and_filter_products( lt_input_numbers ).

    " Due to randomness, we can only assert that all results are > 50
    " and that the count is within a reasonable range (0 to 4 in this case).
    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(lv_product).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_product > 50 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_results ) >= 0 AND lines( lt_results ) <= 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_chain( ).
    DATA(lt_input_numbers) = VALUE zcl_functional_chain=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->process_and_filter_products( lt_input_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_results ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine funktionale Kette mit `FOR` und `FILTER`. Zuerst wird mit `FOR` eine neue interne Tabelle erstellt, in der jede Eingabezahl mit einer Zufallszahl multipliziert wird. Anschließend wird diese temporäre Tabelle mit `FILTER` nach Produkten gefiltert, die größer als 50 sind. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Art, Daten zu transformieren und zu filtern.
keywords: FUNCTIONAL, FOR, FILTER, RANDOM, MULTIPLY, CHAINING

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt von 10 zufällig generierten Zahlen (1-100), die jeweils mit einem festen Faktor (z.B. 0.5) multipliziert wurden.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` für die Summe und `cl_abap_random`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_random_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_of_random_products
      IMPORTING
        iv_count        TYPE i
        iv_factor       TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_random_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_of_random_products.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).

    DATA(lv_sum_of_products) = REDUCE f( INIT s = 0.0
                                        FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
                                        NEXT s = s + ( lo_random->int( min = 1 max = 100 ) * iv_factor ) ).

    IF iv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum_of_products / iv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_random_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 10.
    DATA(lv_factor) = '0.5'.
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_of_random_products( iv_count = lv_count iv_factor = lv_factor ).

    " Min average: (1 * 0.5) * 10 / 10 = 0.5
    " Max average: (100 * 0.5) * 10 / 10 = 50.0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_average >= 0.5 AND lv_average <= 50.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_random_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_of_random_products( iv_count = 0 iv_factor = '0.5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Zufallszahlengenerierung, Multiplikation und die Aggregation mit `REDUCE` zur Berechnung eines Durchschnitts. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` mit einem `f` (Float) Typ für die Akkumulation ermöglicht präzise Berechnungen mit Dezimalzahlen. Die Division erfolgt am Ende, um den Durchschnitt zu erhalten.
keywords: MATH, RANDOM, MULTIPLY, AVERAGE, REDUCE, FLOAT

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit 20 Einträgen, die jeweils eine zufällige Kategorie (A, B, C) und einen zufälligen Wert (1-100) haben. Gruppiere die Tabelle nach Kategorie und berechne für jede Kategorie die Summe der Werte, die mit einem zufälligen Faktor (1-3) multipliziert wurden.
hint: Nutze `FOR` für die Initialisierung, `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit `cl_abap_random`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grouped_random_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entry,
             category TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_entry.
    TYPES tt_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_category_sum,
             category TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             sum_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_category_sum.
    TYPES tt_category_sums TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_category_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_grouped_random_sum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_category_sums) TYPE tt_category_sums.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grouped_random_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_grouped_random_sum.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ).

    DATA(lt_entries) = VALUE tt_entries( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 20
                                         ( category = lt_categories[ lo_random->int( min = 1 max = 3 ) ]
                                           value    = lo_random->int( min = 1 max = 100 ) ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_entries INTO DATA(ls_entry) GROUP BY ( category = ls_entry-category ) ASCENDING
                                          INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_random_factor) = lo_random->int( min = 1 max = 3 ).

      DATA(lv_sum_for_category) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                                           FOR <fs_entry> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                           NEXT s = s + ( <fs_entry>-value * lv_random_factor ) ).

      APPEND VALUE #( category = ls_group_key-category
                      sum_value = lv_sum_for_category ) TO rt_category_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_random_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_random_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grouped_random_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->calculate_grouped_random_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ). " Expecting 3 categories A, B, C

    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_result-category = 'A' OR ls_result-category = 'B' OR ls_result-category = 'C' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_result-sum_value > 0 ). " Sum should be positive
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert mehrere moderne ABAP-Features: `FOR` für die Initialisierung einer internen Tabelle mit zufälligen Werten, `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Zusätzlich wird für jede Gruppe ein zufälliger Multiplikationsfaktor generiert, was die Dynamik des Beispiels erhöht.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, RANDOM, GROUPING, MULTIPLY, FOR, REDUCE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM

Instructions: Simuliere einen Würfelwurf (1-6) und multipliziere das Ergebnis mit der Anzahl der Würfel, die geworfen wurden.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random` für den Würfelwurf und den `*` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_roll_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_dice_roll_product
      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_product) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_dice_roll_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_dice_roll_product.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_dice_roll_result) = lo_random->int( min = 1 max = 6 ).
    rv_total_product = lv_dice_roll_result * iv_num_dice.
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dice_roll_product FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_dice FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dice_roll_product.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dice_roll_multiply( ).
    DATA(lv_num_dice) = 3.
    DATA(lv_product) = lo_cut->simulate_dice_roll_product( lv_num_dice ).

    " Max product: 6 * 3 = 18

explanation: Ein einfaches Beispiel, das die Simulation eines Würfelwurfs mit `cl_abap_random` zeigt und das Ergebnis mit einem Faktor multipliziert. Dies ist eine grundlegende Anwendung von Zufallszahlen und arithmetischen Operationen in ABAP.
keywords: MATH, RANDOM, MULTIPLY, DICE, SIMULATION

Instructions: Geben Sie eine menschenlesbare Beschreibung für gängige MIME-Typen zurück, z.B. 'Portable Document Format' für PDF. Für unbekannte Typen soll 'Unbekannter Dateityp' zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `SWITCH`-Expression mit `cl_fxs_mime_types` Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_description DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_mimetype TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_description IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( iv_mimetype
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_pdf  THEN 'Portable Document Format'
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_jpeg THEN 'JPEG Image'
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_png  THEN 'PNG Image'
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_xml  THEN 'XML Document'
      ELSE 'Unbekannter Dateityp'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_pdf_description.
    DATA(lo_desc) = NEW zcl_mime_description( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_desc->get_description( cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_pdf ) exp = 'Portable Document Format' ).

hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung mit `cl_fxs_mime_types` Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_mimetype_by_extension
      IMPORTING
        iv_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mimetype) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mimetype_by_extension.
    CASE iv_extension CA 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
      WHEN 'PDF'.
        rv_mimetype = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_pdf.
      WHEN 'JPG' OR 'JPEG'.
        rv_mimetype = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_jpeg.
      WHEN 'PNG'.
        rv_mimetype = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_png.
      WHEN 'XML'.
        rv_mimetype = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_xml.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_mimetype = 'application/octet-stream'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Datensätzen, die jeweils einen Dateinamen und einen MIME-Typ enthalten. Wenn der MIME-Typ 'application/pdf' ist, fügen Sie dem Dateinamen das Präfix 'PDF_' hinzu; sonst das Präfix 'GEN_'.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `COND` für die bedingte Verarbeitung innerhalb der Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_file_data,
         filename TYPE string,
         mimetype TYPE string,
       END OF ty_raw_file_data.
TYPES: tt_raw_file_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_file_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_file_data,
         processed_filename TYPE string,
         original_mimetype  TYPE string,
       END OF ty_processed_file_data.
TYPES: tt_processed_file_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_file_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_mime_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_files_by_mimetype
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_data TYPE tt_raw_file_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE tt_processed_file_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_files_by_mimetype.
    rt_processed_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_file IN it_raw_data
      ( processed_filename = COND string(
                                 WHEN ls_file-mimetype = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_pdf THEN |PDF_{ ls_file-filename }|
                                 ELSE |GEN_{ ls_file-filename }|
                               )
        original_mimetype  = ls_file-mimetype
      ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression, um den ersten MIME-Typ zu speichern und dann alle anderen zu vergleichen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_entry,
         name      TYPE string,
         mimetype  TYPE string,
       END OF ty_file_entry.
TYPES: tt_file_entry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_mime_uniformity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_uniform_mimetype
      IMPORTING
        it_files TYPE tt_file_entry
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_uniform) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_uniformity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_uniform_mimetype.
    IF it_files IS INITIAL.
      rv_is_uniform = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_first_mimetype) = it_files[ 1 ]-mimetype.

    rv_is_uniform = REDUCE abap_bool(
      INIT result = abap_true
      FOR ls_file IN it_files
      WHERE ( ls_file-mimetype <> lv_first_mimetype )
      NEXT result = abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die `FileMetadata`-Objekte (aus MIM_008) basierend auf einer Dateierweiterung und einem Dateinamen erzeugt. Die Factory soll den korrekten MIME-Typ unter Verwendung von `cl_fxs_mime_types` Konstanten ableiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine statische Factory-Methode und eine `SWITCH`-Expression zur MIME-Typ-Ableitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_metadata_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_file_metadata
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_file_metadata) TYPE REF TO zcl_file_metadata.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_metadata_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_file_metadata.
    DATA(lv_extension) = to_lower( substring_after( val = iv_filename sub = '.' ) ).

    DATA(lv_mimetype) = SWITCH #( lv_extension
      WHEN 'pdf'  THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_pdf
      WHEN 'jpg'  THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_jpeg
      WHEN 'jpeg' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_jpeg
      WHEN 'png'  THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_png
      WHEN 'xml'  THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_mimetype_xml
      ELSE 'application/octet-stream'
    ).

    ro_file_metadata = NEW zcl_file_metadata(
      iv_filename = iv_filename,
      iv_mimetype = lv_mimetype
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und Division. Beachten Sie die Division durch Null, wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide
        EXPORTING
          text = 'No flights found for the given airline.'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_avg_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum_price = CONV decfloat16( 0 )
           count     = 0
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price
           count     = count + 1
      FINALLY sum_price / count
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in `sflight` das Verhältnis von Preis zu Meilen (Preis pro Meile) und speichern Sie es in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Vermeiden Sie Division durch Null.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und einer `COND`-Expression für die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price_per_mile DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ratio,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             price_per_mile TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sflight_ratio.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ratio TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ratio WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_price_per_mile
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_ratios) TYPE tt_sflight_ratio.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_per_mile IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_per_mile.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_ratios = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        LET lv_price_per_mile = COND decfloat16(
                                    WHEN ls_sflight-distance > 0
                                    THEN CONV decfloat16( ls_sflight-price ) / ls_sflight-distance
                                    ELSE 0 )
        IN ( carrid       = ls_sflight-carrid
             connid       = ls_sflight-connid
             fldate       = ls_sflight-fldate
             price_per_mile = lv_price_per_mile )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_price_per_mile.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflight_price_per_mile( ).
    DATA(lt_ratios) = lo_calculator->calculate_price_per_mile( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_ratios IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_ratios ).

    " Check a specific entry if possible, or just general properties
    LOOP AT lt_ratios INTO DATA(ls_ratio).
      IF ls_ratio-price_per_mile < 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Price per mile should not be negative at entry { sy-tabix }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Teilen Sie den Wert eines dynamisch angegebenen Feldes einer Struktur durch einen Divisor. Implementieren Sie robuste Fehlerbehandlung für nicht gefundene Felder, Division durch Null und Typkonvertierungsfehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) mit dynamischen Zugriffen (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_field>`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field    TYPE string
        iv_divisor  TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field '{ iv_field }' not found in structure.|.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        rv_result = CONV decfloat34( <fs_field> ) / iv_divisor.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Field '{ iv_field }' cannot be converted to a numeric type: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine Liste von Strings basierend auf ihrer Länge (kürzester zuerst) und bei gleicher Länge alphabetisch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit einem Lambda-Ausdruck für die benutzerdefinierte Vergleichslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_sort_custom DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_strings_by_length
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_sort_custom IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_strings_by_length.
    rt_sorted_strings = it_strings.
    SORT rt_sorted_strings BY (
      ( a, b ) =>
        IF ( strlen( a ) < strlen( b ) ).
          RETURN -1.
        ELSEIF ( strlen( a ) > strlen( b ) ).
          RETURN 1.
        ELSE.
          RETURN COND i( WHEN a < b THEN -1 WHEN a > b THEN 1 ELSE 0 ).
        ENDIF.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle, die geschachtelte Tabellen enthält, basierend auf einem Feld in der geschachtelten Tabelle. Sortieren Sie die Haupttabelle nach der Anzahl der Einträge in der geschachtelten Tabelle (absteigend).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `SORT` innerhalb der Schleife für die innere Tabelle, oder eine temporäre Struktur für die Sortierung der Haupttabelle.

CLASS zcl_nested_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_nested_item,
             item_id TYPE i,
             value   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_nested_item.
    TYPES: tt_nested_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_nested_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_main_entry,
             header_id TYPE i,
             items     TYPE tt_nested_items,
           END OF ty_main_entry.
    TYPES: tt_main_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_main_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_main_by_nested_count
      IMPORTING
        it_main_table TYPE tt_main_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_table) TYPE tt_main_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_main_by_nested_count.
    rt_sorted_table = it_main_table.

    " Sort the main table by the number of items in the nested table (descending)
    SORT rt_sorted_table BY (
      ( a, b ) =>
        IF ( lines( a-items ) > lines( b-items ) ).
          RETURN -1.
        ELSEIF ( lines( a-items ) < lines( b-items ) ).
          RETURN 1.
        ELSE.
          RETURN 0.
        ENDIF.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und sortieren Sie dann die Gruppen nach der Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft (absteigend).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und sortieren Sie die resultierende Gruppentabelle.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             flights    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_sort_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_sorted) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_sort_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
                                               INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_group) = VALUE ty_flight_group(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ( <fs_member> ) )
      ).
      APPEND ls_group TO rt_grouped_sorted.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT rt_grouped_sorted BY flight_count DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft in `sflight` den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Meile. Gruppieren Sie die Daten zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie dann den Durchschnitt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price_per_mile DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_ratio,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price_per_mile TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_ratio.
    TYPES: tt_avg_ratios TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_ratio WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_per_mile
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_ratios) TYPE tt_avg_ratios.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_avg_price_per_mile IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_per_mile.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_price_per_mile) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum_ratio = CONV decfloat16( 0 )
             count     = 0
        FOR  <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_sflight
        NEXT sum_ratio = sum_ratio + COND decfloat16(
                                        WHEN <fs_member>-distance > 0
                                        THEN CONV decfloat16( <fs_member>-price ) / <fs_member>-distance
                                        ELSE 0 )
             count     = count + 1
      ).

      DATA(lv_avg_ratio) = COND decfloat16(
        WHEN lv_sum_price_per_mile IS INITIAL OR count = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE lv_sum_price_per_mile / count
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_avg_ratio(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        avg_price_per_mile = lv_avg_ratio
      ) TO rt_avg_ratios.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflight_avg_price_per_mile( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_avg_ratio).
      IF ls_avg_ratio-avg_price_per_mile < 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Average price per mile should not be negative for { ls_avg_ratio-carrid }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Produkten nach ihrem Nettowert (Netto-Preis * Menge) absteigend. Erstellen Sie eine Beispielstruktur und Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` mit einem temporären Feld oder einer `COMPONENTS OF` Ergänzung, falls der Nettowert nicht direkt im Feld vorhanden ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product_sort_net_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             product_id TYPE string,
             net_price  TYPE decfloat16,
             quantity   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_by_net_value
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_sort_net_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_by_net_value.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product_with_net_value,
             product_id TYPE string,
             net_price  TYPE decfloat16,
             quantity   TYPE i,
             net_value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product_with_net_value.
    DATA: lt_products_with_net_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product_with_net_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_products_with_net_value = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_product IN it_products
      ( product_id = ls_product-product_id
        net_price  = ls_product-net_price
        quantity   = ls_product-quantity
        net_value  = ls_product-net_price * ls_product-quantity )
    ).

    SORT lt_products_with_net_value BY net_value DESCENDING.

    rt_sorted_products = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_product_with_net_value IN lt_products_with_net_value
      ( product_id = ls_product_with_net_value-product_id
        net_price  = ls_product_with_net_value-net_price
        quantity   = ls_product_with_net_value-quantity )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in `sflight` den prozentualen Anteil des Preises am Gesamtpreis aller Flüge der gleichen Fluggesellschaft. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` zur Aggregation des Gesamtpreises pro Fluggesellschaft und dann eine weitere Schleife mit `FOR` und `VALUE` zur Berechnung des prozentualen Anteils.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_percentage,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             price      TYPE s_price,
             percentage TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_percentage.
    TYPES: tt_flight_percentages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_percentage WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_price_percentage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_percentages) TYPE tt_flight_percentages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_percentage.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_total,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrid_total.
    DATA: lt_carrid_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_price_for_carrid) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum_price = CONV decfloat16( 0 )
        FOR  <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_sflight
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_member>-price
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_total(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        total_price = lv_total_price_for_carrid
      ) TO lt_carrid_totals.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_percentages = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        LET lv_total_carrid_price = lt_carrid_totals[ KEY primary_key carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-total_price
            lv_percentage = COND decfloat16(
                                WHEN lv_total_carrid_price > 0
                                THEN ( CONV decfloat16( ls_flight-price ) / lv_total_carrid_price ) * 100
                                ELSE 0 )
        IN ( carrid     = ls_flight-carrid
             connid     = ls_flight-connid
             fldate     = ls_flight-fldate
             price      = ls_flight-price
             percentage = lv_percentage )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_percentage FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_percentage.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflight_price_percentage( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_price_percentage( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    " Check if percentages are within a reasonable range (0-100)
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_percentage).
      IF ls_percentage-percentage < 0 OR ls_percentage-percentage > 100.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Percentage out of range for flight { ls_percentage-carrid }-{ ls_percentage-connid }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine mehrstufige Aggregation und Berechnung. Zuerst wird `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` verwendet, um den Gesamtpreis pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln. Anschließend wird eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` verwendet, um für jeden einzelnen Flug den prozentualen Anteil am Gesamtpreis seiner Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen. Die `COND`-Expression schützt vor Division durch Null. Dies zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit moderner ABAP-Konstruktoren für komplexe Datenanalysen.
keywords: DIVIDE, Internal Tables, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Percentage, sflight, FOR, VALUE

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,

        iv_currency  TYPE sflight-curr
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price, curr
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( price > iv_min_price AND curr = iv_currency )
                                   ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                     connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                     price    = ls_sflight-price,
                                     currency = ls_sflight-curr ) ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen Eintrag zu einer internen Tabelle hinzu, aber nur, wenn ein Eintrag mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel noch nicht existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in einer `IF` Bedingung vor dem `APPEND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_append_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS add_unique_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_key   TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_items TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_append_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_unique_entry.
    IF NOT line_exists( ct_items[ key = iv_key ] ).
      INSERT VALUE #( key = iv_key value = iv_value ) INTO TABLE ct_items.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_unique_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_entry.
    DATA: lt_test_items TYPE zcl_itab_append_unique=>tt_item.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_append_unique( ).

    lo_cut->add_unique_entry( EXPORTING iv_key = 'A' iv_value = 'Value A' CHANGING ct_items = lt_test_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_items ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_items[ key = 'A' ]-value exp = 'Value A' ).

    " Attempt to add duplicate
    lo_cut->add_unique_entry( EXPORTING iv_key = 'A' iv_value = 'New Value A' CHANGING ct_items = lt_test_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_items ) exp = 1 ). " Should still be 1 line
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_items[ key = 'A' ]-value exp = 'Value A' ). " Value should not have changed

    lo_cut->add_unique_entry( EXPORTING iv_key = 'B' iv_value = 'Value B' CHANGING ct_items = lt_test_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_items ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit dem Tabellen-Key-Zugriff ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um zu prüfen, ob ein Eintrag mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel in einer internen Tabelle bereits vorhanden ist. Dies ermöglicht das Hinzufügen von Einträgen nur, wenn sie eindeutig sind, und vermeidet Duplikate.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine Tabelle mit zufälligen Flugpreisen und Währungen. Gruppieren Sie diese dann nach Währung und summieren Sie die Preise.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS` oder `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_random_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             id       TYPE i,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY currency.

    METHODS summarize_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_random_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_random_flights.
    DATA(lo_random_float) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 0 max = 2 ).

    DATA(lt_currencies) = VALUE string_table( ( 'EUR' ) ( 'USD' ) ( 'JPY' ) ).

    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_raw( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_num_flights
                                                 LET lv_curr_idx = lo_random_int->get_next( )
                                                     lv_currency = lt_currencies[ lv_curr_idx + 1 ]
                                                     lv_price = 100 + ( 900 * lo_random_float->get_next( ) )
                                                 IN
                                                 ( id = i, currency = lv_currency, price = lv_price ) ).

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_raw_flights GROUP BY ( currency = ls_flight-currency ) ASCENDING
                                          ( currency = ls_flight-currency,
                                            total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.0 TYPE sflight-price
                                                                    FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                                    NEXT sum = sum + member-price ),
                                            flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_summarize_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_summarize_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_random_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_random_flights( iv_num_flights = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( iv_act = lines( lt_summary ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( lines( lt_summary ) <= 3 ) ). " Max 3 currencies

    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( ls_summary-total_price > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( ls_summary-flight_count > 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `FOR GROUPS`-Syntax in Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation. Es ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Daten und das Berechnen von Summen oder anderen Aggregaten in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck, was die Datenverarbeitung erheblich vereinfacht und modernisiert. Die Generierung von Zufallsdaten mit `cl_abap_random_float` und `cl_abap_random_int` zeigt zudem die flexible Anwendung von Zufallszahlen.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, GROUP BY, cl_abap_random_float, cl_abap_random_int, APPEND, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle filtern und gleichzeitig die Zeilenstruktur transformieren. Verwenden Sie dabei `FILTER` und `VALUE #`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit dem Tabellenkonstruktor `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             flag  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             new_id    TYPE i,
             new_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_transform
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_transform.
    rt_target_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN FILTER tt_source_data FROM it_source_data WHERE ( flag = abap_true )
                                ( new_id = ls_source-id * 10,
                                  new_value = |Transformed: { ls_source-value }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_transform.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter_transform=>tt_source_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'A' flag = abap_true )
      ( id = 2 value = 'B' flag = abap_false )
      ( id = 3 value = 'C' flag = abap_true )
      ( id = 4 value = 'D' flag = abap_false )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->filter_and_transform( it_source_data = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-new_id exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-new_value exp = 'Transformed: A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-new_id exp = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-new_value exp = 'Transformed: C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit dem `FOR`-Ausdruck und dem `VALUE #()`-Konstruktor ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt mehrzeilige `LOOP`-Konstrukte durch ein einziges, gut lesbares Statement und ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen ABAP-Stil.
keywords: FILTER, VALUE #, FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, APPEND

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 100. Verwenden Sie `COND` um jede Zahl als 'Gerade' oder 'Ungerade' zu kennzeichnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `COND` im Tabellenkonstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_cond_parity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_random_parity,
             number TYPE i,
             parity TYPE string,
           END OF ty_random_parity.
    TYPES tt_random_parity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_random_parity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_numbers_with_parity
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers_with_parity) TYPE tt_random_parity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_cond_parity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_numbers_with_parity.
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 1 max = 100 ).

    rt_numbers_with_parity = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_count
                                      LET lv_number = lo_random_int->get_next( ) IN
                                      ( number = lv_number,
                                        parity = COND string( WHEN lv_number MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'Gerade'
                                                              ELSE 'Ungerade' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_parity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_parity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_cond_parity( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_random_numbers_with_parity( iv_count = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 10 ).
    LOOP AT lt_results INTO DATA(ls_result).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( ls_result-number >= 1 AND ls_result-number <= 100 ) ).
      IF ls_result-number MOD 2 = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-parity exp = 'Gerade' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-parity exp = 'Ungerade' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Generierung von Zufallszahlen mit `cl_abap_random_int` und den `COND`-Operator für die bedingte Zuweisung. `COND` ermöglicht es, komplexe `IF-ELSE`-Logik in einem einzigen Ausdruck zu formulieren, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht, insbesondere in Tabellenkonstruktoren.
keywords: cl_abap_random_int, COND, Math, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables, VALUE #, FOR, APPEND

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmtes Datum ein Feiertag in einem bestimmten Feiertagskalender ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_is_holiday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_is_holiday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date          TYPE d
        iv_holiday_calid TYPE tcalid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_holiday) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_is_holiday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_is_holiday.
    DATA(lo_reca_date) = NEW cl_reca_date( ).
    TRY.
        rv_is_holiday = lo_reca_date->is_holiday(
          i_date           = iv_date
          i_holiday_calid  = iv_holiday_calid
        ).
      CATCH cx_reca_date.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. ungültiger Feiertagskalender
        rv_is_holiday = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_is_holiday FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_holiday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_is_holiday( ).
    " Neujahr in Deutschland
    DATA(lv_is_holiday) = lo_cut->check_is_holiday( iv_date = '20250101' iv_holiday_calid = 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_holiday exp = abap_true msg = '01.01.2025 sollte ein Feiertag in DE sein' ).

    " Ein normaler Tag in Deutschland
    lv_is_holiday = lo_cut->check_is_holiday( iv_date = '20250102' iv_holiday_calid = 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_holiday exp = abap_false msg = '02.01.2025 sollte kein Feiertag in DE sein' ).

    " Ungültiger Kalender
    lv_is_holiday = lo_cut->check_is_holiday( iv_date = '20250101' iv_holiday_calid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_holiday exp = abap_false msg = 'Ungültiger Kalender sollte false zurückgeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `IS_HOLIDAY` von `CL_RECA_DATE` ermöglicht eine einfache und zuverlässige Überprüfung von Feiertagen basierend auf SAP-Standardkalendern. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist eine Best Practice für robuste Anwendungen.

      lo_ws_sflights->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).

    lo_ws_scarr->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_style = lo_style_bold ).
    lo_ws_scarr->set_cell_style( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_style = lo_style_bold ).

    LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).
      lv_row = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_ws_scarr->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_scarr-carrid ).
      lo_ws_scarr->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_scarr-carrname ).

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf dem Buchungsstatus. Wenn der Status unbekannt ist, soll 'Unbekannt' zurückgegeben werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_booking_status TYPE s_bstat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH #( iv_booking_status
                               WHEN 'C' THEN 'Confirmed'
                               WHEN 'X' THEN 'Cancelled'
                               WHEN 'R' THEN 'Reserved'
                               WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unknown' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        IF iv_input = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zero_divide.
        ELSE IF iv_input < 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
        ELSE IF iv_input = 99.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. " For generic error test
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = |Operation successful with input { iv_input }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zero_divide.
        rv_result = 'Error: Division by zero occurred.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
        rv_result = 'Error: Arithmetic overflow occurred.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
        rv_result = |Generic Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_zero_divide FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overflow FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_other_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_zero_divide.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( 0 ) exp = 'Error: Division by zero occurred.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( -1 ) exp = 'Error: Arithmetic overflow occurred.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_other_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Generic Error' act = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( 99 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( 10 ) exp = 'Operation successful with input 10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ermöglicht eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung. Das Fangen von `cx_root` mit `WHEN OTHERS` (implizit durch die Reihenfolge der `CATCH`-Anweisungen) stellt sicher, dass alle unerwarteten Ausnahmen abgefangen und behandelt werden, was die Stabilität des Programms erhöht.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, cx_root, Error Handling, Exceptions, WHEN OTHERS

CLASS zcl_ci_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_value,
             attribute_name  TYPE string,
             attribute_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_value.

    METHODS get_check_attribute
      IMPORTING
        iv_check_name TYPE sci_check
        iv_attribute  TYPE string

        VALUE(rs_attribute_value) TYPE ty_attribute_value
      RAISING
        cx_ci_error.

CLASS zcl_ci_attribute_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_check_attribute.
    DATA(lo_ci_query) = NEW cl_ci_query_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_ci_query->get_attributes_for_check( iv_check_name ).

    READ TABLE lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attribute)
      WITH KEY attribute_name = iv_attribute.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_attribute_value-attribute_name = ls_attribute-attribute_name.
      rs_attribute_value-attribute_value = ls_attribute-attribute_value.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_ci_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Attribute '{ iv_attribute }' not found for check '{ iv_check_name }'.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugbuchungen nach dem Buchungsstatus und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Buchungen pro Status. Fassen Sie alle anderen Status unter 'Sonstige' zusammen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einer `SWITCH`-Expression für den Gruppenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             booking_status TYPE string,
             count          TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY (
        booking_status = SWITCH #( ls_sflight-bstatus
                                   WHEN 'C' THEN 'Confirmed'
                                   WHEN 'X' THEN 'Cancelled'
                                   WHEN 'R' THEN 'Reserved'
                                   WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Other' )
        key = booking_status
    ) INTO DATA(ls_group).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
          booking_status = ls_group-booking_status
          count          = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary WITH KEY booking_status = 'Confirmed' INTO DATA(ls_confirmed).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_confirmed-count exp = 0 ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary WITH KEY booking_status = 'Other' INTO DATA(ls_other).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_other-count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung in Kombination mit einer `SWITCH`-Expression für den Gruppenschlüssel ermöglicht eine flexible und leistungsstarke Datenaggregation. `WHEN OTHERS` stellt sicher, dass alle nicht explizit definierten Status in einer 'Other'-Gruppe zusammengefasst werden, was die Übersichtlichkeit erhöht.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, SWITCH, WHEN OTHERS, Grouping, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und weisen Sie jeder Fluggesellschaft einen Ländercode zu. Wenn der Ländercode unbekannt ist, verwenden Sie 'XX' als Standard.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Iteration mit `VALUE` und einer `SWITCH`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_airline_country DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_country,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             country_code TYPE char2,
           END OF ty_airline_country.
    TYPES: tt_airline_country TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_country WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_airline_countries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_airline_countries) TYPE tt_airline_country.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airline_country IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airline_countries.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rt_airline_countries = VALUE tt_airline_country(
      FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr
        ( carrid = ls_scarr-carrid,
          country_code = SWITCH char2( ls_scarr-carrid
                                       WHEN 'AA' THEN 'US'
                                       WHEN 'LH' THEN 'DE'
                                       WHEN 'BA' THEN 'GB'
                                       WHEN OTHERS THEN 'XX' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
