Instructions: Rufen Sie alle Attribute für eine Liste von Code Inspector Prüfungen ab und geben Sie diese zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ci_query_attributes` und die Methode `get_attributes_for_check` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_multi_attribute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_check_attribute,
             check_name      TYPE sci_check,
             attribute_name  TYPE string,
             attribute_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_check_attribute.
    TYPES: tt_check_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_check_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attributes_for_checks
      IMPORTING
        it_check_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sci_check WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_attributes) TYPE tt_check_attributes
      RAISING
        cx_ci_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_multi_attribute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attributes_for_checks.
    DATA(lo_ci_query) = NEW cl_ci_query_attributes( ).

    LOOP AT it_check_names INTO DATA(lv_check_name).
      DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_ci_query->get_attributes_for_check( lv_check_name ).
      LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
        APPEND VALUE ty_check_attribute(
            check_name      = lv_check_name
            attribute_name  = ls_attribute-attribute_name
            attribute_value = ls_attribute-attribute_value
        ) TO rt_all_attributes.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA lt_checks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sci_check.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_attributes ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_attributes ) exp = 0 ).

        READ TABLE lt_attributes WITH KEY check_name = 'ABAP_DOCU_CHECK' attribute_name = 'MAX_LINE_LENGTH' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
      CATCH cx_ci_error.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Daten. Wenn bei der Verarbeitung eines Elements ein Fehler auftritt, protokollieren Sie diesen und fahren Sie mit dem nächsten Element fort. Fangen Sie alle unerwarteten Fehler generisch ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT` mit `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb der Schleife und `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_item.
    TYPES: tt_data_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_item).
      TRY.
          IF ls_item-value = 0.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zero_divide.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND |Item { ls_item-id }: Processed successfully, result = { ls_item-value * 2 }| TO rt_processed_results.
        CATCH cx_sy_zero_divide.
          APPEND |Item { ls_item-id }: Error - Division by zero.| TO rt_processed_results.
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
          APPEND |Item { ls_item-id }: Generic Error - { lx_root->get_text( ) }| TO rt_processed_results.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_data_processor=>tt_data_items.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_data_processor=>ty_data_item( id = 1 value = 5 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_data_processor=>ty_data_item( id = 2 value = 0 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_data_processor=>ty_data_item( id = 3 value = 10 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->process_data( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Item 1: Processed successfully, result = 10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Item 2: Error - Division by zero.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ] exp = 'Item 3: Processed successfully, result = 20' ).

CLASS zcl_ci_check_by_attribute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ci_check_by_attribute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_checks_with_attribute.
    DATA(lo_ci_query) = NEW cl_ci_query_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_all_checks) = lo_ci_query->get_all_checks( ).

    LOOP AT lt_all_checks INTO DATA(lv_check_name).
      DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_ci_query->get_attributes_for_check( lv_check_name ).
      READ TABLE lt_attributes TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY attribute_name = iv_attribute_name.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_check_name TO rt_found_checks.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_profile_param_map IMPLEMENTATION.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in JSON, aber schließen Sie bestimmte Felder von der Serialisierung aus.
hint: Implementieren Sie das Interface `IF_SERIALIZABLE_BY_JSON` in Ihrer Klasse und überschreiben Sie die Methode `GET_JSON_ATTRIBUTES`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_serializable_custom.
  INTERFACES if_serializable_by_json.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_custom_json_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_serializable_custom.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sensitive_data,
             public_field  TYPE string,
             private_field TYPE string,
             secret_field  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sensitive_data.

    DATA ms_data TYPE ty_sensitive_data.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_sensitive_data.

    METHODS serialize_custom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS zif_serializable_custom~get_json_attributes
      REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_json_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_data = is_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD serialize_custom.
    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = me pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_serializable_custom~get_json_attributes.
    " Only include public_field and private_field, exclude secret_field
    APPEND 'PUBLIC_FIELD' TO r_attributes.
    APPEND 'PRIVATE_FIELD' TO r_attributes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_custom_json_serializer=>ty_sensitive_data(
      public_field  = 'Visible Data'
      private_field = 'Internal Data'
      secret_field  = 'Hidden Secret' ).

    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_custom_json_serializer( is_data = ls_data ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_serializer->serialize_custom( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Public field should be in JSON' substring = '"public_field": "Visible Data"' in = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Private field should be in JSON' substring = '"private_field": "Internal Data"' in = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( msg = 'Secret field should NOT be in JSON' substring = '"secret_field"' in = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String und fangen Sie spezifische Fehler ab, z.B. wenn ein Feld fehlt oder der JSON-String ungültig ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit spezifischen Ausnahmen wie `CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_DATE` oder generischen `CX_ROOT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE string,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_root.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_check.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string CHANGING data = rs_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_date INTO DATA(lx_date_error).
        MESSAGE lx_date_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_root.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_comp_name INTO DATA(lx_comp_error).
        MESSAGE lx_comp_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_root.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        MESSAGE lx_general_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_root.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_missing_field_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_json.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = |{{"id":"ITEM001","date":"20231128"}}|
    DATA(ls_data) = lo_handler->deserialize_with_error_check( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-id exp = 'ITEM001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-date exp = '20231128' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_date_json.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = |{{"id":"ITEM002","date":"invalid_date"}}|
    TRY.
        lo_handler->deserialize_with_error_check( lv_json ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_conversion_no_date' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_date.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_sy_conversion_no_date' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Caught unexpected exception type' ).

    TRY.
        lo_handler->deserialize_with_error_check( lv_json ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_struct_comp_name or similar' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_comp_name.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_sy_struct_comp_name' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Caught unexpected exception type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei der JSON-Deserialisierung ist entscheidend. Durch die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit spezifischen Ausnahmeklassen wie `CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_DATE` (für Datumsformatfehler) oder `CX_SY_STRUCT_COMP_NAME` (wenn ein Feld in der ABAP-Struktur fehlt, das im JSON vorhanden ist, oder umgekehrt) kann präzise auf verschiedene Fehler reagiert werden. Die generische `CX_ROOT` fängt alle anderen Ausnahmen ab. Das `RAISING` in der Methodensignatur signalisiert, dass die Methode Ausnahmen weitergeben kann, was eine moderne Praxis ist.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Systemprofilparameter nach ihrem Präfix (z.B. 'rdisp/', 'login/') und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Parameter pro Gruppe.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters` und den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_profile_param_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_group,
             prefix TYPE string,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_param_group.
    TYPES tt_param_groups TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_param_group WITH UNIQUE KEY prefix.

    METHODS group_params_by_prefix
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_param_groups) TYPE tt_param_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_params_by_prefix.
    DATA(lt_all_params) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters( ).

    rt_param_groups = REDUCE tt_param_groups(
      INIT groups = VALUE tt_param_groups( )
      FOR <param> IN lt_all_params
      LET lv_prefix = COND string( WHEN <param> CS '/' THEN substring( val = <param> len = find( val = <param> sub = '/' ) + 1 ) ELSE <param> ) IN
      NEXT groups = VALUE tt_param_groups( groups
                                            ( prefix = lv_prefix
                                              count  = groups[ KEY prefix_key prefix = lv_prefix ]-count + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_params_by_prefix FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_params_by_prefix.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_profile_param_group( ).
    DATA(lt_groups) = lo_grouper->group_params_by_prefix( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Grouped parameters should not be initial' act = lt_groups ).

    " Check for common prefixes like 'rdisp/' and 'login/'
    DATA(lv_rdisp_count) = lt_groups[ KEY prefix_key prefix = 'rdisp/' ]-count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'rdisp/ group should have entries' act = lv_rdisp_count ).

    DATA(lv_login_count) = lt_groups[ KEY prefix_key prefix = 'login/' ]-count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'login/ group should have entries' act = lv_login_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Code demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE` und `FOR` mit `LET` und `COND` Ausdrücken (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.55) zur Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten. Zuerst werden alle Profilparameter abgerufen. Dann wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um eine neue sortierte Tabelle zu erstellen, die die Anzahl der Parameter pro Präfix enthält. `LET` ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Variablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks, und `COND` wird für die bedingte Bestimmung des Präfixes verwendet. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und moderne Art der Datenverarbeitung in ABAP.
keywords: Profile Parameter, Grouping, REDUCE, FOR, LET, COND, System, cl_spfl_profile_parameter

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflight` Daten in einen JSON-String, wobei bestimmte Felder umbenannt oder aggregiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE #(...)` um die Daten vor der Serialisierung in eine neue Struktur zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             carrier   TYPE string,
             departure TYPE string,
             arrival   TYPE string,
             seats_occupied TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_sflights_to_json
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights_to_json.
    DATA(lt_transformed_data) = VALUE tt_flight_summaries(
      FOR <fs> IN it_sflights
      ( flight_id      = |{ <fs>-carrid }-{ <fs>-connid }-{ <fs>-fldate DATE = USER }|
        carrier        = <fs>-carrid
        departure      = <fs>-cityfrom
        arrival        = <fs>-cityto
        seats_occupied = <fs>-seatsocc ) ).

    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = lt_transformed_data pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_sflights_to_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_sflights_to_json.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_json_transform( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_transformer->transform_sflights_to_json( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be initial' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain flight_id' substring = '"flight_id"' in = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain seats_occupied' substring = '"seats_occupied"' in = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( msg = 'JSON should NOT contain fldate directly' substring = '"fldate"' in = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung zeigt, wie Daten vor der JSON-Serialisierung transformiert werden können, um ein spezifisches JSON-Format zu erzeugen. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine neue Struktur, wobei Felder umbenannt, kombiniert oder aggregiert werden können. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden verwendet, um den `flight_id`-Wert dynamisch zu erstellen. Dies ist ein sehr flexibles und modernes Muster für die Datenaufbereitung.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und kategorisieren Sie jeden Flug basierend auf seiner Entfernung (`DISTANCE`) in 'Kurzstrecke' (< 500), 'Mittelstrecke' (500-2000) oder 'Langstrecke' (> 2000). Verwenden Sie eine SQL `CASE`-Expression direkt im `SELECT`-Statement.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `CASE`-Expression direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste, um eine neue Spalte mit der Kategorisierung zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid     TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflights-connid,
             distance   TYPE sflights-distance,
             unit       TYPE sflights-distid,
             category   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES: tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, distance, distid AS unit,
           CASE
             WHEN distance < 500 THEN 'Kurzstrecke'
             WHEN distance BETWEEN 500 AND 2000 THEN 'Mittelstrecke'
             WHEN distance > 2000 THEN 'Langstrecke'
             ELSE 'Unbekannt'
           END AS category
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` die Flugnummer, die Entfernung und eine 'Entfernungsbewertung' enthält. Die Bewertung soll 'Niedrig' sein, wenn die Entfernung < 1000, 'Mittel' wenn 1000-3000, und 'Hoch' wenn > 3000. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `VALUE` und `COND` um die neue Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_rating DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_rating,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             distance TYPE sflights-distance,
             rating   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_rating.
    TYPES: tt_flight_rating TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_rating WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_ratings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_ratings) TYPE tt_flight_rating.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_rating IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_ratings.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, distance FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    rt_ratings = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                          ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                            connid   = ls_flight-connid
                            distance = ls_flight-distance
                            rating   = COND string(
                                         WHEN ls_flight-distance < 1000 THEN 'Niedrig'
                                         WHEN ls_flight-distance >= 1000 AND ls_flight-distance <= 3000 THEN 'Mittel'
                                         WHEN ls_flight-distance > 3000 THEN 'Hoch'
                                         ELSE 'Unbekannt'
                                       )
                          ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (`PRICE`) für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Fluganbieters (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Währung (`CURRENCY`) haben. Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression in Kombination mit `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und `COND` um die Summe bedingt zu erhöhen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_currency TYPE sflights-curr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_cond.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price, curr FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflights-price(
                       INIT sum_price = 0
                       FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                       NEXT sum_price = sum_price + COND #( 
                                                        WHEN ls_flight-curr = iv_currency THEN ls_flight-price
                                                        ELSE 0
                                                      )
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Begrüßungsnachricht, die sich basierend auf der Tageszeit ('Morgen', 'Mittag', 'Abend') ändert. Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Expression innerhalb eines String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_greeting_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    DATA(lv_time_category) = CASE sy-uzeit
                               WHEN BETWEEN '060000' AND '115959' THEN 'Morgen'
                               WHEN BETWEEN '120000' AND '175959' THEN 'Mittag'
                               WHEN BETWEEN '180000' AND '235959' THEN 'Abend'
                               ELSE 'Nacht'
                             END.

    rv_greeting = |Guten { lv_time_category }, willkommen!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Bonus für einen Mitarbeiter basierend auf seiner Leistung (`iv_performance_score`) und seiner Abteilung (`iv_department`). Verwenden Sie eine `COND`-Expression mit einer `LET`-Expression für eine Zwischenberechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LET` innerhalb von `COND` um temporäre Variablen für komplexere Bedingungen zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_bonus
      IMPORTING
        iv_performance_score TYPE i
        iv_department        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_bonus_amount) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus.
    rv_bonus_amount = COND decfloat16(
                        LET base_bonus = COND decfloat16(
                                           WHEN iv_performance_score >= 90 THEN '1000.00'
                                           WHEN iv_performance_score >= 70 THEN '500.00'
                                           ELSE '0.00'
                                         )
                        IN
                          COND decfloat16(
                            WHEN iv_department = 'SALES' THEN base_bonus * '1.20' " 20% extra for sales
                            WHEN iv_department = 'HR' THEN base_bonus * '0.90' " 10% less for HR
                            ELSE base_bonus
                          )
                      ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE COND abap_bool(
                                   WHEN fromcity = 'FRANKFURT' OR tocity = 'NEW YORK' THEN abap_true
                                   ELSE abap_false
                                 ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No filtered flights found' act = lt_filtered ).

        msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } does not match filter criteria|
      ).

    " This test assumes there are no flights from 'NONEXISTENT' to 'NONEXISTENT'

    <fs_flight>-fromcity = 'OTHERCITY'.
    <fs_flight>-tocity = 'ANOTHERCITY'.

    <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.

                                WHERE COND abap_bool(
                                        WHEN fromcity = 'FRANKFURT' OR tocity = 'NEW YORK' THEN abap_true

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Expected no matching flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Liste von Zahlen. Wenn eine Zahl gerade ist, verdoppeln Sie sie; wenn sie ungerade ist, subtrahieren Sie 1. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `SWITCH`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` in Kombination mit `SWITCH` und dem Modulo-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_numbers.
    rt_transformed_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN it_numbers
                                      ( SWITCH i( num MOD 2
                                        WHEN 0 THEN num * 2 " Even
                                        WHEN 1 THEN num - 1 " Odd
                                        ELSE num ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_transformation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_number_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,

    DATA(lt_sflight_decompressed) = VALUE tt_sflight_data( ).

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.

    TRY.

Instructions: Komprimiere einen sehr großen String (simuliert) und dekomprimiere ihn, um die Effizienz von `CL_ABAP_GZIP` bei großen Datenmengen zu demonstrieren.
hint: Erzeuge einen langen String durch Wiederholung und nutze `COMPRESS_TEXT` und `DECOMPRESS_TEXT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_large_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_large_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_string TYPE string
        iv_repetitions TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_large_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_large_string.
    DATA(lv_large_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_repetitions
      NEXT s = s && iv_base_string
    ).

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text( lv_large_string ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    IF lv_decompressed_string = lv_large_string.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_large_string_compression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_large_string_compression.
    DATA(lv_base) = `This is a repeating pattern for a large string. `.
    DATA(lv_repetitions) = 1000. " Erzeugt einen String von ca. 50KB

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_gzip_large_data( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_processor->process_large_string( iv_base_string = lv_base iv_repetitions = lv_repetitions ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success,
      exp = abap_true,
      msg = 'Large string compression and decompression should be successful'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel hebt die Fähigkeit von `CL_ABAP_GZIP` hervor, auch sehr große Datenmengen effizient zu verarbeiten. Durch die Kompression und Dekompression eines künstlich erzeugten langen Strings wird die Performance und Zuverlässigkeit der Klasse bei der Handhabung umfangreicher Textdaten demonstriert. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` zur String-Erzeugung ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Large Data, String, XSTRING, REDUCE, CL_ABAP_GZIP

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.

                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ) INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      IF ls_attribute-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public.
        APPEND ls_attribute-name TO rt_attributes.
      ENDIF.
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, deren Name als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_object`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      constructor,
      get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      call_method_dynamically IMPORTING io_object     TYPE REF TO object
                                        iv_method_name TYPE string
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_message = 'Hello from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_message.
    rv_message = mv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    DATA: lv_method_name TYPE string VALUE iv_method_name.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT io_object RECEIVING RESULT <fs_result>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_result = <fs_result>.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found or call failed.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei beliebige Datentypen zur Laufzeit auf Gleichheit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_hash`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS are_types_equal IMPORTING iv_value1 TYPE any
                                      iv_value2 TYPE any
                              RETURNING VALUE(rb_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_types_equal.
    DATA(lo_descr1) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_value1 ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_value2 ).
    rb_are_equal = COND #( WHEN lo_descr1->get_hash( ) = lo_descr2->get_hash( ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_equal_types FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_different_types FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_struct_types FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_equal_types.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_char1) = 'A'.
    DATA(lv_char2) = 'B'.
    DATA(lb_result) = lo_cut->are_types_equal( iv_value1 = lv_char1 iv_value2 = lv_char2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lb_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_different_types.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_char) = 'A'.
    DATA(lv_int) = 1.
    DATA(lb_result) = lo_cut->are_types_equal( iv_value1 = lv_char iv_value2 = lv_int ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lb_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_struct_types.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_struct1,
            field1 TYPE string,
          END OF ls_struct1.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_struct2,
            field_a TYPE string,
          END OF ls_struct2.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_compare( ).
    DATA(lb_result_equal) = lo_cut->are_types_equal( iv_value1 = ls_struct1 iv_value2 = ls_struct1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lb_result_equal ).

    DATA(lb_result_different) = lo_cut->are_types_equal( iv_value1 = ls_struct1 iv_value2 = ls_struct2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lb_result_different ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_hash` liefert einen eindeutigen Hash-Wert für einen Datentyp. Durch den Vergleich dieser Hash-Werte kann effizient geprüft werden, ob zwei Variablen denselben Typ haben, ohne die Typbeschreibungsobjekte selbst detailliert zu vergleichen.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_typedescr, get_hash, COND, REF TO

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit einer Zeilenstruktur, die zur Laufzeit aus einer anderen Struktur abgeleitet wird, und füllen Sie sie mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data`, `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_from_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_source,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_source.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table IMPORTING is_source_struct TYPE ty_s_source
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_from_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_source_struct ) ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_line>).

      " Fill with some data
      <fs_dynamic_line>-id = 1.
      <fs_dynamic_line>-name = 'Item A'.
      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

      <fs_dynamic_line>-id = 2.
      <fs_dynamic_line>-name = 'Item B'.
      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_from_struct=>ty_s_source( id = 0 name = '' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_from_struct( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( ls_source ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_table_from_struct=>ty_s_source.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-name exp = 'Item A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die dynamische Typbeschreibung einer Struktur mit der dynamischen Erstellung einer internen Tabelle, deren Zeilentyp der beschriebenen Struktur entspricht. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für generische Datenverarbeitung, bei der die Datenstruktur erst zur Laufzeit festgelegt wird.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, REF TO data

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über die Komponenten einer Struktur und setzen Sie deren Werte basierend auf ihrem Typ.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data`, `get_components` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_set_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             char_field TYPE char10,
             int_field  TYPE i,
             date_field TYPE d,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    METHODS set_dynamic_values IMPORTING CHANGING cs_data TYPE ty_s_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_set_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_dynamic_values.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( cs_data ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_field> ).
        CASE lo_type_descr->get_kind_as_string( ).
          WHEN 'C'. " CHAR
            <fs_field> = 'Dynamic'.
          WHEN 'I'. " INT
            <fs_field> = 123.
          WHEN 'D'. " DATE
            <fs_field> = sy-datum.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            " Do nothing or handle other types
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
    END LOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_values FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_values.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_set_fields=>ty_s_data( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_set_fields( ).

    lo_cut->set_dynamic_values( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-char_field exp = 'Dynamic' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-int_field exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-date_field exp = sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man RTTI verwendet, um dynamisch über die Felder einer Struktur zu iterieren und deren Werte basierend auf ihrem ermittelten Datentyp zu setzen. Dies ist ideal für generische Initialisierungsroutinen oder Datenkonvertierungen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, get_components, ASSIGN COMPONENT, REF TO

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit der Struktur der Tabelle SFLIGHT und füllen Sie diese mit den ersten 5 Einträgen aus SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Zugriff auf die Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_sflight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_sflight_data.
    DATA: lo_table_create TYPE REF TO cl_alv_table_create,
          lt_sflight      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Dynamische Tabelle mit SFLIGHT-Struktur erstellen
    CREATE OBJECT lo_table_create EXPORTING i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
    lo_table_create->create_dynamic_table( IMPORTING ep_table = ro_data ).

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHT lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Daten in die dynamische Tabelle füllen
    LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_line>).
      CREATE DATA REF TO (<fs_table>->*). " Neue Zeile erstellen
      ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.

      " Felder kopieren
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = <fs_field>. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = <fs_field>. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = <fs_field>. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      " ... weitere Felder nach Bedarf

      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_dyn_table_sflight( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_sflight_data( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_carrid> TYPE s_carr_id.

    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'Dynamic table should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( <fs_table> ) msg = 'Table should contain data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 5 msg = 'Table should contain 5 rows' ).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'First row should exist' ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'CARRID field should exist' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_carrid> msg = 'CARRID should not be initial' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit, deren Struktur der einer existierenden Datenbanktabelle entspricht. Die Befüllung erfolgt durch iteratives Zuweisen von Feldinhalten mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT`, was für dynamische Szenarien unerlässlich ist.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle für ein ALV, die nur ausgewählte Felder der Tabelle SFLIGHT (CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE) enthält. Benennen Sie FLDATE in 'FLUGDATUM' um. Füllen Sie die Tabelle mit Daten.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Feldkatalogtabelle (`LVC_T_FCAT`) und übergeben Sie diese an `create_dynamic_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_sel_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             flugdatum TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_sflight_subset
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_sel_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_sflight_subset.
    DATA: lo_table_create TYPE REF TO cl_alv_table_create,
          lt_fcat         TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          ls_fcat         TYPE lvc_s_fcat,
          lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Feldkatalog für ausgewählte Felder erstellen
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'FLUGDATUM'. " Feld umbenennen
    APPEND ls_fcat TO lt_fcat.

    " Dynamische Tabelle basierend auf Feldkatalog erstellen
    CREATE OBJECT lo_table_create.
    lo_table_create->create_dynamic_table( EXPORTING i_fieldcatalog = lt_fcat
                                           IMPORTING ep_table       = ro_data ).

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHT lesen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_data UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Daten in die dynamische Tabelle füllen
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_line>).
      CREATE DATA REF TO (<fs_table>->*).
      ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = <fs_field>. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = <fs_field>. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLUGDATUM' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>. " Beachten Sie den neuen Feldnamen
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = <fs_field>. ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_selected_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_selected_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_dyn_table_sel_fields( ).
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_sflight_subset( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( <fs_table> ) msg = 'Table should contain data' ).

    " Überprüfen der Feldnamen
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 msg = 'Table should have 3 components' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[1]-name exp = 'CARRID' msg = 'First component name incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[3]-name exp = 'FLUGDATUM' msg = 'Third component name incorrect (renamed)' ).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'CARRID field should exist' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'FLUGDATUM field should exist' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung einer dynamischen internen Tabelle mit einer benutzerdefinierten Feldliste und umbenannten Spalten. Dies ist nützlich, wenn nur bestimmte Daten angezeigt oder die Spaltenüberschriften angepasst werden sollen, ohne die zugrunde liegende Struktur zu ändern.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus SFLIGHT. Erstellen Sie dann dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, die diese aggregierten Daten enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_aggregated_data
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_aggregated_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lt_aggregated   TYPE tt_sflight_agg,
          lo_table_create TYPE REF TO cl_alv_table_create.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHT lesen
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    " Daten aggregieren mit LOOP AT GROUP BY und REDUCE
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_sflight
        NEXT sum = sum + <member>-seatsmax
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_agg( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   total_seats = lv_total_seats ) TO lt_aggregated.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Dynamische Tabelle mit der Struktur der aggregierten Daten erstellen
    CREATE OBJECT lo_table_create EXPORTING i_structdescr_name = 'ZCL_ALV_DYN_TABLE_AGG=>TY_SFLIGHT_AGG'.
    lo_table_create->create_dynamic_table( IMPORTING ep_table = ro_data ).

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Aggregierte Daten in die dynamische Tabelle kopieren
    <fs_table> = lt_aggregated.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf SFLIGHT, die zusätzlich eine Spalte 'AVAILABLE_SEATS' enthält, berechnet als `SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC`.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Struktur mit den gewünschten Feldern (inkl. der berechneten Spalte) und verwenden Sie diese für `create_dynamic_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_calc_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_extended,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate         TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax       TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc       TYPE s_seatsocc,
             available_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_extended.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_extended TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_extended WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_calculated_data
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dyn_table_calc_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_calculated_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lo_table_create TYPE REF TO cl_alv_table_create.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Dynamische Tabelle mit erweiterter Struktur erstellen
    CREATE OBJECT lo_table_create EXPORTING i_structdescr_name = 'ZCL_ALV_DYN_TABLE_CALC_FIELD=>TY_SFLIGHT_EXTENDED'.
    lo_table_create->create_dynamic_table( IMPORTING ep_table = ro_data ).

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHT lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Daten in die dynamische Tabelle füllen und berechnetes Feld setzen
    LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_line>).
      CREATE DATA REF TO (<fs_table>->*).
      ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.

      " Felder kopieren (modern mit CORRESPONDING)
      <fs_line> = CORRESPONDING #( <fs_sflight_line> ).

      " Berechnetes Feld setzen
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'AVAILABLE_SEATS' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = <fs_sflight_line>-seatsmax - <fs_sflight_line>-seatsocc.
      ENDIF.

      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie Daten aus SFLIGHT herunter und speichern Sie diese als CSV-Datei auf dem lokalen Frontend. Die Datei soll eine Kopfzeile enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` mit den entsprechenden Parametern für die Kopfzeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_frnt_download_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_sflight_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflight_data.csv'
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    METHODS get_csv_header
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_header) TYPE string.
    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv_lines
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_csv_lines) TYPE cl_gui_frontend_services=>filetable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frnt_download_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_sflight_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflight   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_header    TYPE string,
          lt_csv_lines TYPE cl_gui_frontend_services=>filetable.

    lt_sflight = get_sflight_data( ).
    lv_header = get_csv_header( ).
    lt_csv_lines = convert_sflight_to_csv_lines( lt_sflight ).

    " Kopfzeile hinzufügen
    INSERT lv_header INTO lt_csv_lines INDEX 1.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_filename
        filetype                = 'ASC'
        has_field_separator     = abap_true
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_csv_lines
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE rt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_csv_header.
    rv_header = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURR;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC;FLTIME;DEPTIME;ARRTIME;DISTANCE;DISTID;UNIT'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv_lines.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND |
        { ls_sflight-carrid };
        { ls_sflight-connid };
        { ls_sflight-fldate };
        { ls_sflight-price };
        { ls_sflight-curr };
        { ls_sflight-planetype };
        { ls_sflight-seatsmax };
        { ls_sflight-seatsocc };
        { ls_sflight-fltime };
        { ls_sflight-deptime };
        { ls_sflight-arrtime };
        { ls_sflight-distance };
        { ls_sflight-distid };
        { ls_sflight-unit }|
      TO rt_csv_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_download_sflight_csv.
    " GUI_DOWNLOAD kann nicht direkt im Unit-Test ausgeführt werden.
    " Hier wird nur die Vorbereitung der Daten und der Aufruf simuliert.
    " Eine echte Prüfung erfordert manuelle Interaktion oder ein Test-Framework, das GUI-Aufrufe mocken kann.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frnt_download_csv( ).
    DATA(lv_filename) = 'test_sflight.csv'.

    " Test, ob die Methode ohne Syntaxfehler aufrufbar ist.
    " Die eigentliche GUI-Interaktion wird hier nicht geprüft.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->download_sflight_csv( iv_filename ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = 0 msg = 'GUI_DOWNLOAD call simulated (no actual download)' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception during GUI_DOWNLOAD simulation' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_csv_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frnt_download_csv( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_csv_lines) = lo_cut->convert_sflight_to_csv_lines( lt_sflight ).
    DATA(lv_header) = lo_cut->get_csv_header( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_csv_lines ) msg = 'CSV lines should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_csv_lines ) exp = lines( lt_sflight ) msg = 'Number of CSV lines should match SFLIGHT entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_header msg = 'Header should not be empty' ).

    " Überprüfen der ersten CSV-Zeile (ohne Header)
    READ TABLE lt_csv_lines INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_first_line).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'First CSV line should exist' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = find( val = lv_first_line sub = ';' ) msg = 'First CSV line should contain separator' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie eine CSV-Datei vom lokalen Frontend in eine interne Tabelle. Die erste Zeile der CSV-Datei soll als Kopfzeile ignoriert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload` und verarbeiten Sie die Daten entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_frnt_upload_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_uploaded_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_uploaded_data.
    TYPES: tt_uploaded_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_uploaded_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS upload_csv_and_skip_header
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_uploaded_data
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS parse_csv_line
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_line TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_uploaded_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frnt_upload_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_csv_and_skip_header.
    DATA: lt_file_content TYPE cl_gui_frontend_services=>filetable,
          lv_filename     TYPE string.

    " Dateiauswahl-Dialog öffnen (optional, hier direkt Dateiname)
    " cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(...)

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_filename
        filetype                = 'ASC'
        has_field_separator     = abap_true
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.

    " Erste Zeile (Header) überspringen und Daten parsen
    LOOP AT lt_file_content INTO DATA(lv_line) WHERE table_line IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF sy-tabix = 1. " Header überspringen
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND parse_csv_line( lv_line ) TO rt_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD parse_csv_line.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_csv_line AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_components.

    IF lines( lt_components ) >= 1. rs_data-field1 = lt_components[1]. ENDIF.
    IF lines( lt_components ) >= 2. rs_data-field2 = lt_components[2]. ENDIF.
    IF lines( lt_components ) >= 3. rs_data-field3 = lt_components[3]. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_upload_csv_skip_header FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_csv_line FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upload_csv_skip_header.
    " GUI_UPLOAD kann nicht direkt im Unit-Test ausgeführt werden.
    " Hier wird die Logik des Überspringens des Headers und des Parsens getestet.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frnt_upload_csv( ).
    DATA(lv_filename) = 'dummy_file.csv'. " Dummy-Dateiname, da kein echter Upload stattfindet

    " Simulieren des Inhalts einer hochgeladenen Datei
    DATA(lt_simulated_content) TYPE cl_gui_frontend_services=>filetable.
    APPEND 'Header1;Header2;Header3' TO lt_simulated_content.
    APPEND 'Value1A;Value1B;Value1C' TO lt_simulated_content.
    APPEND 'Value2A;Value2B;Value2C' TO lt_simulated_content.

    " Um den GUI_UPLOAD-Aufruf zu umgehen, muss die Methode angepasst oder gemockt werden.
    " Für diesen Test wird die parse_csv_line Methode direkt getestet und die upload_csv_and_skip_header Methode
    " würde in einem echten Szenario gemockt, um lt_file_content zu füllen.
    " Da Mocking hier nicht direkt implementiert wird, testen wir die Parsing-Logik separat.

    " Direkter Test der Parsing-Logik mit simulierten Daten (ohne GUI_UPLOAD)
    DATA(lt_parsed_data) TYPE zcl_frnt_upload_csv=>tt_uploaded_data.
    LOOP AT lt_simulated_content INTO DATA(lv_line).
      IF sy-tabix = 1. " Header überspringen
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lo_cut->parse_csv_line( lv_line ) TO lt_parsed_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_parsed_data ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 data rows after skipping header' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parsed_data[1]-field1 exp = 'Value1A' msg = 'First data row, first field incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parsed_data[2]-field3 exp = 'Value2C' msg = 'Second data row, third field incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_csv_line.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frnt_upload_csv( ).
    DATA(ls_parsed) = lo_cut->parse_csv_line( 'A;B;C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parsed-field1 exp = 'A' msg = 'Field1 parse error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parsed-field2 exp = 'B' msg = 'Field2 parse error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parsed-field3 exp = 'C' msg = 'Field3 parse error' ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine Datei mit einem bestimmten Namen (z.B. 'test.txt') im Standard-Dokumentenverzeichnis des Benutzers existiert.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `get_desktop_directory` und `file_exist`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_frnt_file_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_file_on_desktop
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frnt_file_exist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_file_on_desktop.
    DATA: lv_desktop_path TYPE string,
          lv_full_path    TYPE string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_desktop_directory(
      IMPORTING
        desktop_directory = lv_desktop_path
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS            = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.

    lv_full_path = lv_desktop_path && '\' && iv_filename.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_exist(
      EXPORTING
        filename = lv_full_path
      RECEIVING
        result   = rv_exists
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_file_exist_on_desktop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_exist_on_desktop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frnt_file_exist( ).
    DATA(lv_filename) = 'non_existent_test_file_123.txt'.
    DATA(lv_desktop_path) = 'C:\Users\TestUser\Desktop'. " Simulierter Desktop-Pfad

    " Mocking der Frontend-Services (vereinfacht)
    " In einem echten Szenario würde man ein Test-Framework nutzen, das statische Methoden mocken kann.
    " Hier wird die Logik des Pfadbaus und der Ergebnisverarbeitung getestet.

    " Annahme: file_exist würde FALSE zurückgeben für die nicht existierende Datei
    DATA(lv_exists) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        " Da wir GUI-Aufrufe nicht direkt testen können, wird hier nur der Aufruf simuliert.
        " Die Rückgabe von file_exist müsste gemockt werden.
        " Für diesen Test nehmen wir an, dass die Datei nicht existiert.
        lv_exists = lo_cut->check_file_on_desktop( lv_filename ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false msg = 'File should not exist' ).

        " Annahme: file_exist würde TRUE zurückgeben für eine existierende Datei (simuliert)
        " Dies erfordert ein echtes Mocking-Framework oder eine Anpassung der CUT-Methode für Tests.
        " Für die Demonstration belassen wir es bei der Prüfung des negativen Falls.

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception during file existence check' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die Existenz einer Datei auf dem lokalen Frontend überprüft. Es kombiniert `get_desktop_directory` zur Ermittlung des Pfades und `file_exist` zur eigentlichen Prüfung. Dies ist nützlich, um vor Lese- oder Schreiboperationen die Verfügbarkeit einer Datei zu prüfen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft (Carrid) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach der Anzahl der Flüge absteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und sortieren Sie die resultierende Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_and_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_and_sorted
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrid_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_and_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_and_sorted.
    DATA lt_grouped_data TYPE tt_carrid_count.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                     flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO lt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_grouped_data BY flight_count DESCENDING.
    rt_result = lt_grouped_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights

        VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_as_string.
    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                       FOR <fs_flight> IN SORTED it_flights BY carrid
                                       LET current_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid IN
                                       NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN current_carrid
                                                            ELSE s && `,` && current_carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

        iv_field   TYPE string

CLASS zcl_sort_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_sorted_flights = it_flights.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten Flugnummer (Connid) für jede Fluggesellschaft (Carrid) und sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft aufsteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP BY ( ... )` und `SORTED`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_max_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_max_connid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_carrid_max_connid.
    TYPES tt_carrid_max_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_max_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_connid_per_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrid_max_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_max_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_connid_per_carrid.
    DATA lt_grouped_data TYPE tt_carrid_max_connid.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_max_connid) = REDUCE sflight-connid( INIT m = ``
                                                  FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                  NEXT m = COND #( WHEN <fs_group_member>-connid > m THEN <fs_group_member>-connid ELSE m ) ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_max_connid( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                         max_connid = lv_max_connid ) TO lt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_result = SORTED lt_grouped_data BY carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_count_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_count_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_counts_sorted.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                           ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                             flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Vor- und Nachnamen aus einem String im Format "Nachname, Vorname".
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` und die Methode `match_group`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_name_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name,
             first_name TYPE string,
             last_name  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_name.
    METHODS parse_name IMPORTING iv_full_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rs_name) TYPE ty_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_name_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_name.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(\w+),\s*(\w+)$`. "Group 1: Last Name, Group 2: First Name
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = lv_pattern text = iv_full_name ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_name-last_name = lo_matcher->match_group( group = 1 ).
      rs_name-first_name = lo_matcher->match_group( group = 2 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-last_name exp = 'Mustermann' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-first_name exp = 'Max' ).

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines Regex-Musters, das mehrere Trennzeichen (Komma, Semikolon oder Leerzeichen) berücksichtigt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_matcher` in Kombination mit `find_all` und `offset`/`length` zur Rekonstruktion der Teile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `[,;\s]+`. "Matches one or more commas, semicolons, or spaces
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = lv_pattern text = iv_text ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      DATA(lv_part) = iv_text+lv_last_offset(ls_match-offset - lv_last_offset).
      IF lv_part IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lv_part TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = ls_match-offset + ls_match-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add the remaining part after the last delimiter
    DATA(lv_remaining_part) = iv_text+lv_last_offset.
    IF lv_remaining_part IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_remaining_part TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_multiple_delimiters.
    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW zcl_regex_splitter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_splitter->split_by_regex( 'Apple, Banana;Orange  Grape' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'Banana' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 'Orange' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ] exp = 'Grape' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW zcl_regex_splitter( ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Logik, die sich basierend auf dem Wert des Profilparameters `login/system_client` unterschiedlich verhält.
hint: Lesen Sie den Parameterwert und verwenden Sie ihn in einer `IF`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_client_dependent_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_logic RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_client_dependent_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_logic.
    DATA(lv_client_param) = 'login/system_client'.
    DATA(lv_current_client) = sy-mandt. "Current client

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_system_client) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( i_name = lv_client_param ).
        IF lv_current_client = lv_system_client.
          rv_message = |Current client { lv_current_client } matches system client { lv_system_client }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_message = |Current client { lv_current_client } does NOT match system client { lv_system_client }|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_spfl_profile_parameter_error.
        rv_message = |Error reading parameter { lv_client_param }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ( lv_message CP '*Error reading parameter*' ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die Flugdaten aus `sflights` enthält. Für jeden Flug soll der Gesamtpreis (Preis multipliziert mit einem Faktor von 1.10 für Steuern/Gebühren) berechnet und in einem neuen Feld gespeichert werden. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und den `MULTIPLY` Operator für die Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_prices
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_prices.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( 
        carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid   = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
        price    = ls_flight-price,
        currency = ls_flight-currency,
        total_price = ls_flight-price * 1.10 " Preis multipliziert mit 1.10
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_prices.
    " Testdaten einfügen
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251224' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price calculation incorrect' 
                                          act = ls_first_flight-total_price 
                                          exp = ls_first_flight-price * 1.10 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Testdaten aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20251224'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen und gleichzeitig das Feld `total_price` zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Daten zu transformieren und zu aggregieren, ohne explizite Schleifen. Der `MULTIPLY` Operator wird direkt in der Zuweisung verwendet.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, MULTIPLY, Data Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die zwei Zahlen entgegennimmt und deren Produkt sowie die Summe in einer Struktur zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator, um die Ergebnisstruktur zu füllen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( ... )` für die Struktur und den `MULTIPLY` Operator für die Multiplikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_math_result,
             product TYPE i,
             sum     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_math_result.

    METHODS calculate
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_math_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rs_result = VALUE #( 
      product = iv_num1 * iv_num2
      sum     = iv_num1 + iv_num2
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_ops( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->calculate( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Product incorrect' act = ls_result-product exp = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum incorrect' act = ls_result-sum exp = 8 ).

    ls_result = lo_cut->calculate( iv_num1 = -2 iv_num2 = 4 ).
