explanation: Die Kombination aus VALUE-Operator und FOR-Ausdruck ist ideal für die Transformation von internen Tabellen. Man kann direkt neue Felder berechnen und dabei moderne Syntax wie COND für bedingte Zuweisungen nutzen, um robuste Lösungen zu schaffen, die Division durch Null vermeiden.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, DIVIDE, COND, Data Transformation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Für jede Gruppe sollen die Summe der Preise und die durchschnittliche Auslastung berechnet werden. Verwenden Sie den GROUP BY-Ausdruck mit dem VALUE-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den GROUP BY-Ausdruck in einem FOR-Ausdruck, um die Daten zu gruppieren. Innerhalb der Gruppe können Sie REDUCE verwenden, um Summen und Durchschnitte zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             avg_occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_and_calculate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_and_calculate.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN sflight
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                           connid = ls_sflight-connid )
                                ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                  connid      = ls_sflight-connid,
                                  total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                                          FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                                          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ),
                                  avg_occupancy = REDUCE #( INIT sum_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc VALUE 0
                                                            count TYPE i VALUE 0
                                                            FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                                            NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + <fs_sflight>-seatsocc,
                                                                 count = count + 1
                                                            FINALLY: COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum_occ / count ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouping_and_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping_and_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_and_calculate( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Grouped data should not be empty' act = lt_grouped ).

    " Find a specific group and check its values (example for 'AA', '0017')
    DATA(ls_group_aa_0017) = VALUE #( lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_group_aa_0017 IS NOT INITIAL.

CLASS zcl_price_share_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_share,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price       TYPE sflight-price,
             price_share TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_share.
    TYPES tt_flight_shares TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_share WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_shares
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shares) TYPE tt_flight_shares.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_share_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_shares.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price
    ).

    IF lv_total_price > 0.
      rt_shares = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                             ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid,
                               connid      = ls_sflight-connid,
                               fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate,
                               price       = ls_sflight-price,
                               price_share = ( ls_sflight-price / lv_total_price ) * 100 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Standardabweichung der Flugpreise für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass weniger als zwei Flüge vorhanden sind, da eine Standardabweichung dann nicht sinnvoll ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um Summe und Summe der Quadrate zu berechnen. Nutzen Sie den DIVIDE-Operator und SQRT für die finale Berechnung. Beachten Sie die Fallunterscheidung für die Anzahl der Elemente.

CLASS zcl_std_dev_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_price_std_dev
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_std_dev) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_std_dev_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_std_dev.
    DATA(ls_stats) = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE f VALUE 0
                                sum_sq_price TYPE f VALUE 0
                                count TYPE i VALUE 0
                                FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                NEXT sum_price    = sum_price + ls_sflight-price,
                                     sum_sq_price = sum_sq_price + ( ls_sflight-price * ls_sflight-price ),
                                     count        = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_stats-count > 1.
      DATA(lv_mean) = ls_stats-sum_price / ls_stats-count.
      DATA(lv_variance) = ( ls_stats-sum_sq_price / ls_stats-count ) - ( lv_mean * lv_mean ).
      IF lv_variance >= 0. " Ensure non-negative for SQRT
        rv_std_dev = sqrt( lv_variance ).
      ELSE.
        rv_std_dev = 0.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_std_dev = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_std_dev_multiple_flights.
    " Test data: Prices 100, 200, 300. Mean = 200. Variance = ((100-200)^2 + (200-200)^2 + (300-200)^2)/3 = (10000+0+10000)/3 = 20000/3 = 6666.66
    " Std Dev = sqrt(6666.66) approx 81.65
    DATA: ls_sflight_data TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight_data-carrid = 'XX'. ls_sflight_data-connid = '0001'. ls_sflight_data-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight_data-price = 100. INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight_data.
    ls_sflight_data-connid = '0002'. ls_sflight_data-price = 200. INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight_data.
    ls_sflight_data-connid = '0003'. ls_sflight_data-price = 300. INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_std_dev_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_std_dev) = lo_cut->calculate_price_std_dev( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect standard deviation' exp = 81.649658092772603 act = lv_std_dev DECIMAL = 10 ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_std_dev_single_flight.
    DATA: ls_sflight_data TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight_data-carrid = 'YY'. ls_sflight_data-connid = '0001'. ls_sflight_data-fldate = sy-datum. ls_sflight_data-price = 100. INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_std_dev_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_std_dev) = lo_cut->calculate_price_std_dev( 'YY' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Std dev should be 0 for single flight' exp = 0 act = lv_std_dev ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'YY'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_std_dev_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_std_dev_calculator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Std dev should be 0 for no flights' exp = 0 act = lv_std_dev ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der REDUCE-Operator ist hierfür ideal, da er alle notwendigen Zwischenwerte in einem einzigen Ausdruck sammelt. Die explizite Prüfung der Anzahl der Elemente vor der Division und der Quadratwurzel ist entscheidend für die Robustheit der Berechnung.

CLASS zcl_flights_above_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_flights_above_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_above_average.
    DATA(ls_stats) = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                 count     TYPE i VALUE 0

                                 NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price
                                      count     = count + 1 ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier AND price > lv_avg_price )

CLASS zcl_currency_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_amount,
             value    TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             currency TYPE c LENGTH 3,
           END OF ty_amount.
    TYPES tt_amounts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_amount WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_amounts
      IMPORTING
        it_source_amounts TYPE tt_amounts
        iv_exchange_rate  TYPE f " e.g., 1.2 for 1 EUR = 1.2 USD
        iv_target_currency TYPE c LENGTH 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_amounts) TYPE tt_amounts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_currency_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_amounts.
    rt_converted_amounts = VALUE #( FOR ls_amount IN it_source_amounts
                                    ( value    = COND #( WHEN iv_exchange_rate <> 0 THEN ls_amount-value * iv_exchange_rate ELSE 0 ) " Assuming rate is multiplier
                                      currency = iv_target_currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime     TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime     TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             duration_h  TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_segment.
    TYPES tt_flight_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_durations
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_segments) TYPE tt_flight_segments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_durations.
    rt_segments = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                             LET lv_dep_ts = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp( date = ls_sflight-fldate time = ls_sflight-deptime )
                                 lv_arr_ts = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp( date = ls_sflight-fldate time = ls_sflight-arrtime )
                             IN
                             ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid,
                               connid      = ls_sflight-connid,
                               fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate,
                               deptime     = ls_sflight-deptime,
                               arrtime     = ls_sflight-arrtime,
                               duration_h  = COND #( WHEN lv_arr_ts > lv_dep_ts THEN ( ( lv_arr_ts - lv_dep_ts ) / 3600 ) ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_high_price_flight_share DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_share,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high_price_share TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_carrier_share.
    TYPES tt_carrier_shares TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_share WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_price_shares
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shares) TYPE tt_carrier_shares.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_high_price_flight_share IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_shares.
    rt_shares = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN sflight
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid )
                                ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                  high_price_share = REDUCE #( INIT high_count TYPE i VALUE 0
                                                                total_count TYPE i VALUE 0
                                                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                                                NEXT high_count  = high_count + COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-price > iv_price_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 ),
                                                                     total_count = total_count + 1
                                                                FINALLY: COND #( WHEN total_count > 0 THEN ( high_count / total_count ) * 100 ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stat,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_carrier_stat.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stat WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_statistics
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    rt_stats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN sflight
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid )
                                ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                  flight_count = GROUP SIZE,
                                  avg_price   = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                                          count TYPE i VALUE 0
                                                          FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                                                          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price,
                                                               count = count + 1
                                                          FINALLY: COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum_price / count ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Werte aller Profilparameter, die 'size' im Namen enthalten und numerisch sind. Ignorieren Sie nicht-numerische Werte.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `GET_ALL_PARAMETERS`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Verwenden Sie `COND` für die Konvertierung und Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_prof_sum_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_of_size_params RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_prof_sum_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_of_size_params.
    DATA(lt_all_params) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameters( ).

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR ls_param IN lt_all_params
                       WHERE ( ls_param-name CS 'size' AND ls_param-value IS NOT INITIAL )
                       NEXT sum = sum + COND i( WHEN cl_abap_conv_util=>is_number( ls_param-value ) THEN CONV i( ls_param-value ) ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob die maximale Workprozess-Laufzeit ('rdisp/max_wprun_time') über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert (z.B. 3600 Sekunden) liegt, und geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value` und den `COND`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_prof_cond_wprun DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_wprun_threshold IMPORTING iv_threshold_sec TYPE i
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_prof_cond_wprun IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_wprun_threshold.
    DATA(lv_wprun_time_str) = ``.
    DATA(lv_wprun_time_sec) = 0.

    TRY.
        lv_wprun_time_str = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' ).
        lv_wprun_time_sec = CONV i( lv_wprun_time_str ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_parameter_error cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_message = |Fehler beim Lesen oder Konvertieren von 'rdisp/max_wprun_time'.|.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    rv_message = COND string(
      WHEN lv_wprun_time_sec > iv_threshold_sec
        THEN |Die maximale Workprozess-Laufzeit ({ lv_wprun_time_sec }s) liegt über dem Schwellenwert von { iv_threshold_sec }s.|
      ELSE |Die maximale Workprozess-Laufzeit ({ lv_wprun_time_sec }s) liegt unter oder gleich dem Schwellenwert von { iv_threshold_sec }s.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum in einem der zuvor definierten speziellen Datumsbereiche liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` oder `FILTER` für die Überprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_check_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_range,
             date_from TYPE d,
             date_to   TYPE d,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_date_range,
           tt_date_ranges TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS is_date_in_range
      IMPORTING iv_check_date TYPE d
                it_date_ranges TYPE tt_date_ranges
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_check_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_date_in_range.
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT it_date_ranges INTO DATA(ls_range) WHERE iv_check_date BETWEEN date_from AND date_to.
      lv_found = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_is_in_range = lv_found.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_date_in_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_in_range.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_cal_check_date( ).
    DATA(lt_test_ranges) = VALUE zcl_cal_check_date=>tt_date_ranges(
      ( date_from = '20251224' date_to = '20251226' description = 'Weihnachten' )
      ( date_from = '20260101' date_to = '20260101' description = 'Neujahr' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_checker->is_date_in_range( iv_check_date = '20251225' it_date_ranges = lt_test_ranges ) msg = '25.12.2025 should be in range' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_checker->is_date_in_range( iv_check_date = '20260101' it_date_ranges = lt_test_ranges ) msg = '01.01.2026 should be in range' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_checker->is_date_in_range( iv_check_date = '20251227' it_date_ranges = lt_test_ranges ) msg = '27.12.2025 should not be in range' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_checker->is_date_in_range( iv_check_date = '20260102' it_date_ranges = lt_test_ranges ) msg = '02.01.2026 should not be in range' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHERE`-Klausel in `LOOP AT` mit dem `BETWEEN`-Operator ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Methode, um zu prüfen, ob ein Datum in einem bestimmten Bereich liegt. Dies ist eine typische Anforderung bei der Verarbeitung von Kalenderdaten, z.B. um zu prüfen, ob ein vom Benutzer ausgewähltes Datum ein Feiertag ist.

CLASS zcl_cal_fetch_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

  METHOD get_flights_for_date.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE fldate = @iv_selected_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fetch_flights.
    DATA(lo_fetcher) = NEW zcl_cal_fetch_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = '20000101'. "Datum, für das es typischerweise Daten in SFLIGHTS gibt

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_fetcher->get_flights_for_date( lv_test_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights IS INITIAL exp = abap_false msg = 'Should find flights for 20000101' ).

    DATA(lv_no_data_date) = '99991231'. "Datum, für das es keine Daten geben sollte
    lt_flights = lo_fetcher->get_flights_for_date( lv_no_data_date ).

explanation: Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`@DATA(...)`) und Hostvariablen (`@iv_selected_date`) in Open SQL ist ein zentrales Merkmal von modernem ABAP (ab 7.40). Es macht Datenbankzugriffe kompakter und sicherer, da keine expliziten `SELECT`- oder `DATA`-Deklarationen vorab nötig sind. Dies simuliert, wie eine Kalenderauswahl zu einer dynamischen Datenabfrage führen könnte.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag für ein gegebenes Datum und geben Sie diesen als Text zurück (z.B. 'Montag', 'Dienstag').
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder `CL_ABAP_DATFM` für Datumsformatierung und Wochentagsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_text
      IMPORTING iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_weekday_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_text.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date(
      iv_date = iv_date
      iv_time = '000000'
    ).

    DATA(lv_weekday_num) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_weekday(
      iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp
    ).

    CASE lv_weekday_num.
      WHEN 1 THEN rv_weekday_text = 'Sonntag'.
      WHEN 2 THEN rv_weekday_text = 'Montag'.
      WHEN 3 THEN rv_weekday_text = 'Dienstag'.
      WHEN 4 THEN rv_weekday_text = 'Mittwoch'.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden (Samstag/Sonntag).
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage und nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>GET_WEEKDAY` zur Überprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS calculate_workdays
      IMPORTING iv_date_from TYPE d
                iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_workdays.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d,
          lv_weekday    TYPE i.

    IF iv_date_from > iv_date_to.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_date = iv_date_from.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_date_to.
      lv_weekday = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_weekday(
        cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date(
          iv_date = lv_current_date
          iv_time = '000000'
        )
      ).
      IF lv_weekday <> 1 AND lv_weekday <> 7. "1=Sonntag, 7=Samstag
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).

        iv_string = lv_string
        iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      RECEIVING
        ev_xstring = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein XSTRING, das CSV-Daten enthält, zurück in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Zuerst XSTRING in String konvertieren (`cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string`), dann den String parsen (z.B. mit `SPLIT`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_xstring_to_itf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_xstring_to_itf
      IMPORTING iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_xstring_to_itf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_itf.
    DATA lv_string TYPE string.
    cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string(
      EXPORTING
        iv_xstring = iv_xstring
        iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      RECEIVING
        ev_string = lv_string
    ).

    DATA lt_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    SPLIT lv_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    LOOP AT lt_lines INTO DATA(lv_line) WHERE lv_line IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA ls_sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight_data.
      SPLIT lv_line AT ',' INTO
        ls_sflight_data-carrid
        ls_sflight_data-connid
        ls_sflight_data-fldate
        ls_sflight_data-planetype.
      APPEND ls_sflight_data TO rt_sflights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parse_standard DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_csv_parse_standard IMPLEMENTATION.

      i_data = iv_csv_string

      IMPORTING
        e_table = lt_parsed_data

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_parsed_data ( 
      field1 = row[ 1 ]
      field2 = row[ 2 ]
      field3 = row[ 3 ]
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_generate_standard DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_csv_string
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_generate_standard IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_string.
    DATA lt_csv_data TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_data.
    lt_csv_data = VALUE #( FOR row IN it_data (

solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parse_with_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

CLASS zcl_csv_parse_with_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_with_header.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_data = iv_csv_string

    DATA lt_parsed_data TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_data.
    lo_csv_parser->parse(
      IMPORTING
        e_table = lt_parsed_data
    ).

    " Skip header row and map remaining data
    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_parsed_data INDEX FROM 2 ( 
      carrid    = row[ 1 ]
      connid    = row[ 2 ]
      fldate    = row[ 3 ]
      planetype = row[ 4 ]
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_csv_generate_with_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      ( 'CONNID' )
      ( 'FLDATE' )
      ( 'PLANETYPE' )

    " Add data rows
    APPEND LINES OF VALUE #( FOR row IN it_sflights ( 
      ( row-carrid )
      ( row-connid )
      ( row-fldate )
      ( row-planetype )
    ) ) TO lt_csv_data.

    DATA(lo_csv_renderer) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_data_table = lt_csv_data
    ).

    lo_csv_renderer->render(
      IMPORTING
        e_data = rv_csv_string

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein E-Mail-Dokument mit `cl_document_bcs` und fügen Sie einen HTML-Inhalt sowie einen Anhang (XSTRING) hinzu. Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_convert` für die Konvertierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` für den HTML-Inhalt und den Anhang. Setzen Sie den Dokumenttyp auf 'HTM' für HTML-E-Mails.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_html_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_html_email_document
      IMPORTING iv_html_content TYPE string
                iv_attachment_text TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_html_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_html_email_document.
    DATA lv_html_xstring TYPE xstring.
    cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        iv_string = iv_html_content
        iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      RECEIVING
        ev_xstring = lv_html_xstring
    ).

    DATA lv_attachment_xstring TYPE xstring.
    cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        iv_string = iv_attachment_text
        iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      RECEIVING
        ev_xstring = lv_attachment_xstring
    ).

    DATA lt_soli_html TYPE soli_tab.
    DATA ls_soli_html TYPE soli.
    ls_soli_html-line = iv_html_content.
    APPEND ls_soli_html TO lt_soli_html.

    ro_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'HTM'
      i_text    = lt_soli_html
      i_length  = xstrlen( lv_html_xstring )
      i_subject = 'HTML E-Mail mit Anhang'
    ).

    ro_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
      i_attachment_subject = 'Anhang.txt'
      i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lv_attachment_xstring )
      i_att_content_hex    = lv_attachment_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für zwei verschiedene Fluggesellschaften (`LH` und `AA`) in einer einzigen internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `UNION ALL`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `UNION ALL` Klausel in Open SQL, um die Ergebnisse zweier `SELECT` Anweisungen zu vereinen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_example( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_flights ).
    " Check if both airlines are present (assuming data exists)
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_lh_count > 0 ) msg = 'LH flights should be present' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_aa_count > 0 ) msg = 'AA flights should be present' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UNION ALL` Klausel in Open SQL ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT`-Anweisungen zu kombinieren. Dies ist effizienter als separate `SELECT`-Anweisungen und das anschließende Zusammenführen der Daten in ABAP. Die `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` Syntax ist eine moderne Inline-Deklaration.
keywords: UNION ALL, Open SQL, SELECT, Internal Tables, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie man mit `cl_gui_props_consumer` globale GUI-Eigenschaften abruft, z.B. die aktuelle Sprache der SAP GUI.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_props_consumer` und verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_PROPERTY` oder `GET_LANGUAGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_props_consumer_ex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_gui_language
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_language) TYPE sy-langu.
    METHODS get_gui_property
      IMPORTING
        iv_property_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_property_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_props_consumer_ex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_gui_language.
    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).
    TRY.
        rv_language = lo_props_consumer->get_language( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_handler.
        " Handle case where no GUI is active (e.g., background job)
        rv_language = sy-langu. " Fallback to system language
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_gui_property.
    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).
    TRY.
        rv_property_value = lo_props_consumer->get_property( iv_property_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_handler.
        " Handle case where no GUI is active
        rv_property_value = 'N/A - No GUI'.
      CATCH cx_gui_error.
        " Handle specific GUI errors, e.g., property not found
        rv_property_value = 'Error or Property not found'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_gui_language FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_gui_property FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_gui_language.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_props_consumer_ex( ).
    DATA(lv_language) = lo_cut->get_gui_language( ).

    " In a unit test, there might not be an active GUI.
    " We assert that it returns a language, possibly the system language.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_language msg = 'GUI language should not be initial' ).
    " Further checks could involve mocking cl_gui_props_consumer if possible,
    " but for a basic test, checking for non-initial is sufficient.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_gui_property.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_props_consumer_ex( ).
    DATA(lv_property_value) = lo_cut->get_gui_property( 'SAPGUI/Theme' ). " Example property

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_property_value msg = 'GUI property should not be initial' ).
    " Similar to language, direct assertion of value is hard without a GUI.
    " We check for non-initial or specific error messages if GUI is not present.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_gui_props_consumer` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf globale Eigenschaften der SAP GUI. Dies ist nützlich, um das Verhalten einer Anwendung an die GUI-Umgebung anzupassen. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken ist entscheidend, da diese Klasse in Umgebungen ohne aktive GUI (z.B. Batch-Jobs) zu Ausnahmen führen kann.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine vorhandene Tabelle filtern und die Einträge transformieren, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `WHERE` für die Filterung und einer Transformation für die neue Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_operator_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_expensive_product,
             product_name TYPE string,
             net_price    TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_expensive_product.
    TYPES tt_expensive_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_expensive_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_products
      IMPORTING
        it_all_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_products) TYPE tt_expensive_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_operator_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_products.
    rt_expensive_products = VALUE tt_expensive_products(
      FOR product IN it_all_products
        WHERE ( product-price > 100 )
        ( product_name = product-name
          net_price    = product-price * '0.9' " 10% discount for expensive items
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_operator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_operator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_operator_example( ).
    DATA(lt_input_products) = VALUE zcl_for_operator_example=>tt_products(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Book' price = '50.00' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.00' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Pen' price = '5.00' )
      ( id = 4 name = 'Monitor' price = '250.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expensive_products) = lo_cut->get_expensive_products( it_all_products = lt_input_products ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_expensive_products ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should contain 2 expensive products' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_expensive_products[ 1 ]-product_name exp = 'Laptop' msg = 'First expensive product name incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_expensive_products[ 1 ]-net_price exp = '1080.00' msg = 'Laptop net price incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_expensive_products[ 2 ]-product_name exp = 'Monitor' msg = 'Second expensive product name incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator ermöglicht die Iteration über interne Tabellen und die Erstellung neuer Tabellen oder Strukturen basierend auf den Elementen der Quelltabelle. In Kombination mit `WHERE` kann man filtern und gleichzeitig die Daten transformieren, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, Filtering, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Produkte in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einem `INIT`-Wert und der `NEXT`-Klausel zur Akkumulation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = '0.00'
      FOR product IN it_products
      NEXT sum = sum + product-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_operator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_operator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator_example( ).
    DATA(lt_input_products) = VALUE zcl_reduce_operator_example=>tt_products(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Book' price = '55.50' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.00' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Pen' price = '4.50' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_products = lt_input_products ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = '1260.00' msg = 'Total price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht die Reduktion einer internen Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und einen Akkumulator aktualisiert. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Aggregationen wie Summen, Minima, Maxima usw.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Math

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem Mindestpreis unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit `USING KEY` und `WHERE` für effiziente Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_operator_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    " Assuming a secondary key 'CARRID_PRICE' exists or can be defined for better performance
    " For simplicity, we'll use a generic filter here.
    " In a real scenario, define a sorted or hashed secondary key for carrid.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_operator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_operator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_operator_example( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_operator_example=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights(
      it_all_flights = lt_input_flights
      iv_carrid      = 'LH'
      iv_min_price   = '150.00'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should contain 2 filtered flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'First filtered flight incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0402' msg = 'Second filtered flight incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er kann mit Primär- oder Sekundärschlüsseln verwendet werden, um die Leistung zu optimieren. Die Syntax ist deklarativ und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Declarative, Performance

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in eine interne Tabelle, wobei die Felder automatisch den passenden Komponenten zugewiesen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT * FROM ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` oder `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_data_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype, " Example: not all fields from SFLIGHT
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_data_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).
    rt_flights = lt_sflight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_data_example( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_all_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid msg = 'First flight carrid should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)` Syntax in Open SQL ermöglicht das direkte Lesen von Datenbanktabellen in eine intern deklarierte interne Tabelle. Die Feldzuordnung erfolgt automatisch basierend auf den Namen der Komponenten, was den Code vereinfacht und die Wartbarkeit erhöht.
keywords: Open SQL, SELECT, Inline Declaration, Internal Tables, Corresponding Fields

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining) und die Verwendung von Konstruktorenausdrücken.
hint: Geben Sie in Methoden `ME` zurück, um weitere Methodenaufrufe zu ermöglichen. Nutzen Sie `NEW` für Konstruktorenausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining_example.
    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining_example.
    METHODS get_sum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_result) = NEW zcl_method_chaining_example(
      )->set_value1( 10
      )->set_value2( 20
      )->get_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 msg = 'Sum should be 30' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung aneinandergereiht werden. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. Konstruktorenausdrücke (`NEW`) ermöglichen die direkte Instanziierung und Verwendung von Objekten in Ausdrücken.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Constructor Expression, NEW

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu, unter Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Ausdrucks.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` für die dynamische Typbeschreibung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Zugriff auf Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_flight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_flight_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      CASE lv_field_name.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          ls_component-name = 'CARRID'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( 'S_CARR_ID' ).
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          ls_component-name = 'CONNID'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( 'S_CONN_ID' ).
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          ls_component-name = 'FLDATE'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( 'S_DATE' ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    SELECT (it_field_names) FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_table> UP TO 10 ROWS.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_example( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_flight_table( it_field_names = lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( <lt_table> ) > 0 ) msg = 'Dynamic table should contain entries' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_line> msg = 'First line should be assigned' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lv_carrid> msg = 'CARRID component should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lv_carrid> msg = 'CARRID should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von internen Tabellen zur Laufzeit. Mit den Klassen `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` können Struktur- und Tabellentypen dynamisch definiert werden. Dies ist nützlich für generische Programme, die mit variablen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Der Zugriff auf die Felder erfolgt über Feldsymbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field Symbols, CREATE DATA, cl_abap_tabledescr

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des nächsten Werktags (Montag bis Freitag) ausgehend von einem gegebenen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper` oder manuelle Datumsarithmetik mit `ADD DAYS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_next_weekday_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_weekday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_weekday) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_next_weekday_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_weekday.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_date.
    DO.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
      DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).
      IF lv_day_of_week >= 2 AND lv_day_of_week <= 6. " 2=Monday, 6=Friday
        rv_next_weekday = lv_current_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_next_weekday FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_next_weekday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_next_weekday_example( ).

    " Test a weekday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_next_weekday( '20251124' ) exp = '20251125' msg = 'Mon -> Tue incorrect' ).
    " Test a Friday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_next_weekday( '20251128' ) exp = '20251201' msg = 'Fri -> Mon incorrect' ).
    " Test a Saturday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_next_weekday( '20251129' ) exp = '20251201' msg = 'Sat -> Mon incorrect' ).
    " Test a Sunday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_next_weekday( '20251130' ) exp = '20251201' msg = 'Sun -> Mon incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des nächsten Werktags kann effizient mit der Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper` erfolgen, die Funktionen zur Bestimmung des Wochentags bereitstellt. In Kombination mit einer einfachen Schleife und Datumsarithmetik (`+ 1` für Tage) lässt sich die Logik kompakt implementieren. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu komplexeren Funktionsbausteinen.
keywords: Date, Time, cl_abap_date_helper, Datumsarithmetik, Loop

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier_connid
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier_connid.
    DATA(lt_flights) = it_all_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ls_flight-connid.
      DATA(ls_grouped_flight) = VALUE ty_grouped_flight(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_grouped_flight TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_example( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_example=>tt_flight_data(

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion in ABAP, um interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren. Sie ermöglicht es, Aggregationen (wie `GROUP SIZE` für die Anzahl der Elemente in einer Gruppe) direkt während der Iteration durchzuführen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert, da keine manuellen Sortierungen oder zusätzlichen Schleifen erforderlich sind.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Loop, Functional Programming

Instructions: Verketten Sie die Werte einer Spalte aus einer internen Tabelle zu einem einzelnen String, getrennt durch ein Komma.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit String-Templates, um die Werte zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_concat_column_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_names
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_names) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concat_column_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_names.
    rv_concatenated_names = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR item IN it_items
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN item-name ELSE |{ s }, { item-name }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_concatenate_names FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_names.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_concat_column_example( ).
    DATA(lt_input_items) = VALUE zcl_concat_column_example=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Apple' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Banana' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Cherry' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_names( it_items = lt_input_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Apple, Banana, Cherry' msg = 'Concatenated string incorrect' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_items) = VALUE zcl_concat_column_example=>tt_items( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_names( it_items = lt_empty_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_empty_result exp = '' msg = 'Empty table should result in empty string' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verkettung von Spaltenwerten einer internen Tabelle zu einem String kann elegant mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator und String-Templates gelöst werden. Der `COND`-Operator innerhalb von `REDUCE` hilft dabei, das erste Element ohne vorangehendes Trennzeichen zu behandeln. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der String-Aggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, String Processing, Internal Tables, Concatenation, String Templates, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle aus einer Standardtabelle, um einen schnellen Zugriff auf Einträge über einen Schlüssel zu ermöglichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit dem Tabellentyp `HASHED TABLE` und `WITH UNIQUE KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products_std TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_products_hsh TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_product WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS create_hashed_table
      IMPORTING
        it_products_std TYPE tt_products_std
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_products_hsh) TYPE tt_products_hsh.

    METHODS get_product_by_id
      IMPORTING
        it_products_hsh TYPE tt_products_hsh
        iv_id           TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_product) TYPE ty_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_hashed_table.
    rt_products_hsh = VALUE tt_products_hsh( FOR product IN it_products_std ( product ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_product_by_id.
    TRY.
        rs_product = it_products_hsh[ id = iv_id ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        CLEAR rs_product.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_example( ).
    DATA(lt_std_products) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_example=>tt_products_std(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Apple' price = '1.00' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Banana' price = '0.50' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Cherry' price = '2.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_hsh_products) = lo_cut->create_hashed_table( it_products_std = lt_std_products ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hsh_products ) exp = 3 msg = 'Hashed table should have 3 entries' ).

    DATA(ls_product) = lo_cut->get_product_by_id( it_products_hsh = lt_hsh_products iv_id = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_product-name exp = 'Banana' msg = 'Product with ID 2 incorrect' ).

    DATA(ls_non_existent_product) = lo_cut->get_product_by_id( it_products_hsh = lt_hsh_products iv_id = 99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_non_existent_product-id msg = 'Non-existent product should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Hash-Tabellen (`HASHED TABLE`) bieten einen sehr schnellen Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen über einen eindeutigen Schlüssel, da sie intern einen Hash-Algorithmus verwenden. Die Erstellung aus einer Standardtabelle kann effizient mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und einer `FOR`-Schleife erfolgen. Der Zugriff auf Elemente erfolgt direkt über den Tabellenindex-Operator `[]` mit dem Schlüssel, was zu sehr performantem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: Hashed Table, Internal Tables, Performance, VALUE, FOR, Table Expression

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer Liste basierend auf einer gewichteten Wahrscheinlichkeit.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine kumulative Verteilung und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_item,
         item  TYPE string,
         weight TYPE i,
       END OF ty_weighted_item.
TYPES: ty_weighted_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_weighted_item
      IMPORTING
        it_weighted_items TYPE ty_weighted_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_item) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_weighted_item.
    DATA: lt_cumulative_weights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_total_weight       TYPE i VALUE 0.

    LOOP AT it_weighted_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      lv_total_weight = lv_total_weight + ls_item-weight.
      APPEND lv_total_weight TO lt_cumulative_weights.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_total_weight = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 1
      max = lv_total_weight
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    LOOP AT lt_cumulative_weights INTO DATA(lv_cumulative_weight).
      IF lv_random_value <= lv_cumulative_weight.
        READ TABLE it_weighted_items INTO DATA(ls_selected_item) INDEX sy-tabix.
        rv_selected_item = ls_selected_item-item.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE ty_weighted_item( item = 'C' weight = 3 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA: lv_selected_item TYPE string,
          lt_results       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

      lv_selected_item = lo_cut->select_weighted_item( lt_items ).
      APPEND lv_selected_item TO lt_results.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Selected item must be A, B or C' act = ( lv_selected_item = 'A' OR lv_selected_item = 'B' OR lv_selected_item = 'C' ) ).
    ENDDO.

    " Basic check for distribution (not a strict statistical test)
    DATA(lv_count_a) = lines( FILTER #( lt_results WHERE table_line = 'A' ) ).
    DATA(lv_count_b) = lines( FILTER #( lt_results WHERE table_line = 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lv_count_c) = lines( FILTER #( lt_results WHERE table_line = 'C' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Count A should be > 0' act = ( lv_count_a > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Count B should be > 0' act = ( lv_count_b > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Count C should be > 0' act = ( lv_count_c > 0 ) ).

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines bestimmten Jahresbereichs.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_random_int` mit Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_year TYPE i
        iv_end_year   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = |{ iv_start_year }0101|.
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = |{ iv_end_year }1231|.

    DATA(lv_days_diff) = cl_abap_date_helper=>diff( iv_date1 = lv_end_date iv_date2 = lv_start_date ).

    IF lv_days_diff < 0.
      " Swap if end year is before start year
      DATA(lv_temp_date) = lv_start_date.
      lv_start_date = lv_end_date.
      lv_end_date = lv_temp_date.
      lv_days_diff = cl_abap_date_helper=>diff( iv_date1 = lv_end_date iv_date2 = lv_start_date ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 0
      max = lv_days_diff
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = lv_start_date iv_days = lv_random_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie N zufällige, eindeutige Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Mischen Sie die Tabelle und nehmen Sie die ersten N Einträge.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,

         connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
         fldate   TYPE s_date,

CLASS zcl_random_n_entries DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_n_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
        iv_count   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_n_entries IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_n_random_flights.
    DATA lt_shuffled_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table.
    lt_shuffled_flights = it_flights.

    cl_abap_random=>shuffle( CHANGING c_table = lt_shuffled_flights ).

    IF iv_count <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_shuffled_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_random_flights.
      IF lines( rt_random_flights ) >= iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_structure_components IMPORTING is_structure TYPE any
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_component-name
                      type = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') und fügen Sie einen Eintrag hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA` mit Field-Symbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table IMPORTING iv_typename TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_typename ) ).
    DATA(lo_tabledescr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_structdescr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_structdescr.
      ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.

      IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Dynamically set components (example for SFLIGHT)
        TRY.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_carrid>).
            IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_connid>).
            IF <lv_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_connid> = '0400'. ENDIF.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_fldate>).
            IF <lv_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
            " Handle error if component not found
        ENDTRY.
        APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch alle öffentlichen Methoden einer gegebenen Klasse und deren Parameter.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param_info,
             name TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param_info.
    TYPES: tt_param_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE tt_param_info,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES: tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_methods IMPORTING iv_classname TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_methods.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_classname ).
    DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( lo_typedescr ).

    LOOP AT lo_classdescr->get_methods( ) INTO DATA(ls_method).
      IF ls_method-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public.
        DATA(lt_params) = VALUE tt_param_info( ).
        LOOP AT ls_method-parameters INTO DATA(ls_param).
          APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_param-name
                          kind = ls_param-kind
                          type = ls_param-type_descr->get_name( ) ) TO lt_params.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_method-name
                        parameters = lt_params ) TO rt_methods.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance von zwei verschiedenen Sortieransätzen für eine interne Tabelle und geben Sie die Laufzeiten aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` und vergleichen Sie `SORT` mit einer `FOR`-Iteration zur Erstellung einer sortierten Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_run_compare_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_sort_performance RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_run_compare_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_sort_performance.
    DATA: lt_data_orig TYPE tt_data,
          lt_data_copy1 TYPE tt_data,
          lt_data_copy2 TYPE tt_data.

    " Generate random data
    DO 100000 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( id = sy-index value = |Value { 100000 - sy-index }| ) TO lt_data_orig.
    ENDDO.

    lt_data_copy1 = lt_data_orig.
    lt_data_copy2 = lt_data_orig.

    " Measure SORT performance
    DATA(lv_start_sort) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    SORT lt_data_copy1 BY id ASCENDING.
    DATA(lv_end_sort) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_time_sort) = lv_end_sort - lv_start_sort.

    " Measure FOR (new sorted table) performance
    DATA(lv_start_for) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lt_data_sorted_for) = SORTED TABLE OF ty_data
                                       FOR ls_data IN lt_data_copy2 ASCENDING BY id ( ls_data ).
    DATA(lv_end_for) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_time_for) = lv_end_for - lv_start_for.

    rs_result = |Sort with SORT: { lv_time_sort } µs, Sort with FOR (new table): { lv_time_for } µs|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sort_comparison FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_comparison.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_run_compare_sort( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->compare_sort_performance( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( CONTAINS( val = lv_result sub = 'Sort with SORT:' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( CONTAINS( val = lv_result sub = 'Sort with FOR (new table):' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime`, um die Performance verschiedener Implementierungen (hier zwei Arten der Sortierung/Tabellenbearbeitung) zu vergleichen. Moderne Syntax wie `FOR` für die Tabellenkonstruktion wird verwendet, um eine kompakte und funktionale Alternative zur expliziten `SORT`-Anweisung zu zeigen. String-Templates werden für die formatierte Ausgabe genutzt.
keywords: Performance, Laufzeit, Sortierung, Interne Tabelle, cl_abap_runtime, FOR, String-Templates

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit einer Methode, die eine große interne Tabelle verarbeitet, und geben Sie die Zeit in Millisekunden aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` und eine `REDUCE`-Expression für die Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_run_measure_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_table IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_item
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum_keys) TYPE i.
    METHODS measure_processing_time RETURNING VALUE(rv_milliseconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_run_measure_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table.
    rv_sum_keys = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_item IN it_data NEXT sum = sum + ls_item-key ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_processing_time.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_item.
    DO 500000 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( key = sy-index value = |Item { sy-index }| ) TO lt_data.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = process_table( lt_data ). " Call the method to be measured
    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    rv_milliseconds = ( lv_end_time - lv_start_time ) / 1000.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_processing_measurement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_run_measure_method( ).
    DATA(lv_time_ms) = lo_cut->measure_processing_time( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_time_ms >= 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_time_ms < 5000 ). " Should not take excessively long (e.g., < 5 seconds)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Performance-Messung mit `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` und moderner Tabellenverarbeitung mittels `REDUCE`-Expression. Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist eine funktionale Art, eine Tabelle zu aggregieren, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt. Die Umrechnung von Mikrosekunden in Millisekunden wird ebenfalls demonstriert.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Factory-Methode, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (`sflights`) entgegennimmt und eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgibt, in der jede Flugbuchung eine generierte UUID als eindeutigen Bezeichner hat. Die Methode soll auch sicherstellen, dass keine doppelten UUIDs generiert werden (obwohl unwahrscheinlich, soll der Mechanismus vorhanden sein).
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` oder `FOR` mit `VALUE` und eine `HASHED TABLE` für die Duplikatsprüfung der UUIDs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_uuid_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_uuid,
             uuid      TYPE sysuuid_x16,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             price     TYPE s_price,
             currency  TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_uuid.
    TYPES tt_sflight_uuid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_uuid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS create_sflights_with_unique_uuids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights_orig TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_with_uuid) TYPE tt_sflight_uuid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_uuid_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflights_with_unique_uuids.
    DATA(lt_generated_uuids) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF sysuuid_x16
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    rt_sflights_with_uuid = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight_orig IN it_sflights_orig
                                     LET lv_new_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ) IN
                                     ( uuid      = REDUCE sysuuid_x16( INIT uuid_val = lv_new_uuid
                                                                       FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 100 " Max retries
                                                                       WHILE lt_generated_uuids IS NOT INITIAL AND lt_generated_uuids[ uuid_val ] IS BOUND
                                                                       NEXT uuid_val = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ) )
                                       carrid    = ls_sflight_orig-carrid
                                       connid    = ls_sflight_orig-connid
                                       fldate    = ls_sflight_orig-fldate
                                       price     = ls_sflight_orig-price
                                       currency  = ls_sflight_orig-currency
                                       planetype = ls_sflight_orig-planetype
                                       seatsmax  = ls_sflight_orig-seatsmax
                                       seatsocc  = ls_sflight_orig-seatsocc ) ).

    " Add generated UUIDs to the hashed table for uniqueness check (after generation)
    LOOP AT rt_sflights_with_uuid INTO DATA(ls_sflight_uuid).
      INSERT ls_sflight_uuid-uuid INTO TABLE lt_generated_uuids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
