CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_uuids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_uuids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight UP TO 50 ROWS.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_result) = zcl_sflight_uuid_factory=>create_sflights_with_unique_uuids( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_sflights ) msg = 'Anzahl der Einträge sollte gleich sein.' ).

    DATA(lt_uuids) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF sysuuid_x16 WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                     FOR ls_entry IN lt_result ( ls_entry-uuid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_uuids ) msg = 'Alle generierten UUIDs sollten eindeutig sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel verwendet eine Factory-Methode (`CLASS-METHODS`) und kombiniert `VALUE #( FOR ... LET ... IN ... )` mit einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine UUID zu generieren und gleichzeitig eine (wenn auch unwahrscheinliche) Duplikatprüfung zu implementieren. Die Verwendung einer `HASHED TABLE` für die Duplikatsprüfung ist sehr effizient. Dies zeigt, wie komplexe Logik in einer modernen, funktionalen Weise ausgedrückt werden kann.
keywords: UUID, Factory Method, REDUCE, FOR, VALUE, HASHED TABLE, SFLIGHTS, CL_SYSTEM_UUID, Eindeutigkeit

Instructions: Erstelle ein einfaches Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzeigt. Das Diagramm soll in einem Custom Container angezeigt werden.

CLASS zcl_sflight_bar_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

CLASS zcl_sflight_bar_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>data_type_table.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_aggregated_data).

    " Prepare data for chart engine
    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN lt_aggregated_data
                             ( category = ls_data-carrid
                               value    = ls_data-num_flights ) ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( io_container ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_title( 'Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_category_axis_title( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_value_axis_title( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeige ein Tortendiagramm der Verteilung der Flugpreise (z.B. in Kategorien 'Niedrig', 'Mittel', 'Hoch') für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights`.
hint: Datenaggregation mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR` und dann `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN` für das Tortendiagramm.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_pie_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_pie_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>data_type_table.

    DATA(lt_sflights_filtered) = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                          ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(lt_price_categories) = REDUCE tt_price_category
      INIT categories = VALUE tt_price_category( ( category = 'Niedrig' count = 0 )
                                                 ( category = 'Mittel' count = 0 )
                                                 ( category = 'Hoch' count = 0 ) )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_filtered
      NEXT categories = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price < 200 THEN
                                  VALUE tt_price_category( FOR ls_cat IN categories
                                                           ( category = ls_cat-category
                                                             count    = COND #( WHEN ls_cat-category = 'Niedrig' THEN ls_cat-count + 1 ELSE ls_cat-count ) ) )
                                WHEN ls_flight-price >= 200 AND ls_flight-price < 500 THEN
                                  VALUE tt_price_category( FOR ls_cat IN categories
                                                           ( category = ls_cat-category
                                                             count    = COND #( WHEN ls_cat-category = 'Mittel' THEN ls_cat-count + 1 ELSE ls_cat-count ) ) )
                                ELSE
                                  VALUE tt_price_category( FOR ls_cat IN categories
                                                           ( category = ls_cat-category
                                                             count    = COND #( WHEN ls_cat-category = 'Hoch' THEN ls_cat-count + 1 ELSE ls_cat-count ) ) ) ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_cat IN lt_price_categories
                             ( category = ls_cat-category
                               value    = ls_cat-count ) ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( io_container ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_pie ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_title( |Flugpreisverteilung für { iv_carrid }| ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle ein Liniendiagramm, das die Entwicklung der durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Monat für ein bestimmtes Jahr und eine Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` darstellt. Die Daten sollen dynamisch aufbereitet werden.
hint: Nutze `GROUP BY` mit `CORRESPONDING` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der Monatsdaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_line_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_year      TYPE s_date-year.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_line_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>data_type_table.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_avg,
             month       TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             avg_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_monthly_avg.
    TYPES tt_monthly_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_monthly_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_sflights_filtered) = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
                                          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate+0(4) = iv_year )
                                          ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(lt_monthly_data) = REDUCE tt_monthly_avg
      INIT result = VALUE tt_monthly_avg( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_filtered GROUP BY ( month = ls_flight-fldate+4(2) ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_monthly_avg( BASE result
                                          ( month = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-month
                                            avg_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0 count = 0
                                                                        FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                                        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_member-price
                                                                             count = count + 1
                                                                        FINALLY = sum_price / count ) ) ) ).

    SORT lt_monthly_data BY month.

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN lt_monthly_data
                             ( category = ls_data-month
                               value    = ls_data-avg_price ) ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( io_container ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_line ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_title( |Durchschnittliche Flugpreise für { iv_carrid } im Jahr { iv_year }| ).
    lo_chart->set_category_axis_title( 'Monat' ).
    lo_chart->set_value_axis_title( 'Durchschnittlicher Preis' ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_chart_data_preparation.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250105' price = 100 ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250110' price = 200 ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250215' price = 300 ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250220' price = 400 ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250101' price = 500 ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_sflights_filtered) = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                          WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND fldate+0(4) = '2025' )
                                          ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(lt_monthly_data) = REDUCE tt_monthly_avg
      INIT result = VALUE tt_monthly_avg( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_filtered GROUP BY ( month = ls_flight-fldate+4(2) ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_monthly_avg( BASE result
                                          ( month = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-month
                                            avg_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0 count = 0
                                                                        FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                                        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_member-price
                                                                             count = count + 1
                                                                        FINALLY = sum_price / count ) ) ) ).

    SORT lt_monthly_data BY month.

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>data_type_table( FOR ls_data IN lt_monthly_data
                                                                         ( category = ls_data-month
                                                                           value    = ls_data-avg_price ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chart_data[ category = '01' ]-value exp = 150 msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für Januar ist falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chart_data[ category = '02' ]-value exp = 350 msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für Februar ist falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_stacked_bar_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_stacked_bar_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>data_type_table.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_seats,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             occupied   TYPE i,
             free       TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_seats.
    TYPES tt_carr_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_seats) = REDUCE tt_carr_seats
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carr_seats( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carr_seats( BASE result
                                          ( carrid = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-carrid
                                            occupied = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-seatsocc )
                                            free     = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_member-seatsmax - ls_member-seatsocc ) ) ) ) ).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN lt_aggregated_seats
                             ( category = ls_data-carrid
                               value    = ls_data-occupied
                               series   = 'Belegt' )
                             ( category = ls_data-carrid
                               value    = ls_data-free
                               series   = 'Frei' ) ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( io_container ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_stacked_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_title( 'Sitzplatzbelegung pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_category_axis_title( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_value_axis_title( 'Anzahl Sitze' ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sflight_scatter_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstelle ein Balkendiagramm, das die Top 5 Fluggesellschaften nach Anzahl der Flüge aus `sflights` anzeigt.
hint: Aggregiere die Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, sortiere und wähle die Top N Einträge aus. Nutze `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_top5_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_top5_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>data_type_table.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      ORDER BY num_flights DESC
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_top_carrids).

    lt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN lt_top_carrids
                             ( category = ls_data-carrid
                               value    = ls_data-num_flights ) ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( io_container ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>chart_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_title( 'Top 5 Fluggesellschaften nach Anzahl Flüge' ).
    lo_chart->set_category_axis_title( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_value_axis_title( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_top5_data_preparation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top5_data_preparation.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'DL' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'DL' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BA' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AF' ) ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                        ( carrid = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-carrid
                                          num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).

    SORT lt_aggregated_data BY num_flights DESC.
    DATA(lt_top_carrids) = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 5 AND i <= lines( lt_aggregated_data )
                                    ( lt_aggregated_data[ i ] ) ).

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>data_type_table( FOR ls_data IN lt_top_carrids
                             ( category = ls_data-carrid
                               value    = ls_data-num_flights ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_chart_data ) exp = 5 msg = 'Es sollten 5 Top-Einträge vorhanden sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chart_data[ 1 ]-category exp = 'BA' msg = 'Erste Fluggesellschaft sollte BA sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chart_data[ 1 ]-value exp = 4 msg = 'BA sollte 4 Flüge haben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man die Top N Einträge einer aggregierten Datenmenge für ein Diagramm vorbereitet. Es verwendet `SELECT ... GROUP BY ... ORDER BY ... UP TO N ROWS` für die Datenbankabfrage und `VALUE #( FOR ... )` für die Datenaufbereitung. Der Unit-Test simuliert die Aggregation und Auswahl der Top-Einträge, um die Logik zu validieren.
keywords: Chart, Balkendiagramm, SFLIGHTS, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, UP TO N ROWS, VALUE, CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN, Top N

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (`PRICE`) aus einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHT`.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_sflight_orig) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflight_orig ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der in einer bestimmten Codepage vorliegt, in einen String in einer anderen Codepage und weisen Sie das Ergebnis zu. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `CONV` für die Zuweisung des konvertierten Wertes.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` für die Konvertierung und `CONV` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_codepage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_codepage
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_source_cp    TYPE abap_codepage VALUE 'UTF-8'
        iv_target_cp    TYPE abap_codepage VALUE 'ISO-8859-1'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_codepage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_codepage.
    DATA(lo_codepage_converter) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_codepage_converter(
                                       source_codepage = iv_source_cp
                                       target_codepage = iv_target_cp ).
    rv_converted_string = CONV string( lo_codepage_converter->convert( iv_input_string ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_codepage_conv_simple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_codepage_conv_special FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_codepage_conv_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_codepage( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_string_codepage(
                           iv_input_string = 'Test String'
                           iv_source_cp    = 'UTF-8'
                           iv_target_cp    = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Test String' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_codepage_conv_special.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_codepage( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Grüße'. " 'ü' is a special character
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_string_codepage(
                           iv_input_string = lv_input
                           iv_source_cp    = 'UTF-8'
                           iv_target_cp    = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    " The actual byte representation might differ, but for string type, ABAP handles it internally.
    " We assert the string content remains the same after conversion if valid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV` Operator ermöglicht eine explizite Typumwandlung direkt bei der Zuweisung. In diesem Beispiel wird das Ergebnis der Codepage-Konvertierung, die von `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` durchgeführt wird, direkt in einen String-Typ konvertiert und zugewiesen, was die Notwendigkeit einer separaten `MOVE`-Anweisung eliminiert.
keywords: CONV, TYPE CONVERSION, CODEPAGE, CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE

CLASS zcl_string_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der 'seatsocc'-Spalte einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von REDUCE und FOR.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE und FOR-Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupied_seats_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupied_seats_sum.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_seats.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_analyzer->get_occupied_seats_sum( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_sum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_sum >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: REDUCE-Ausdrücke ermöglichen die Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen auf eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Weise. In Kombination mit FOR-Iteratoren und der WHERE-Klausel wird die Datenverarbeitung effizient und lesbar.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Open SQL, DATA, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben, unter Verwendung des FILTER-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_free_seats.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      it_flights
      WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc >= iv_min_free_seats )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 90. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 20. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 80.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_free_seats(
      it_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_min_free_seats = 20
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should return 2 flights with at least 20 free seats'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer Bedingung zu filtern. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und lesbarer als traditionelle LOOP-Anweisungen mit IF-Bedingungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, DATA, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'P' für geplant, 'C' für gecancelt) in einen lesbaren Text umwandelt. Nutzen Sie hierfür den COND-Ausdruck.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung. Nutzen Sie die moderne Open SQL Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration der internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).
    rt_flights = lt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Konfiguration für eine Anwendung repräsentiert. Implementieren Sie Methoden, die es ermöglichen, Konfigurationsparameter über Method Chaining zu setzen.
hint: Geben Sie in den Setter-Methoden die Instanz der Klasse zurück (ME->).
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_param1
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_app_config.
    METHODS set_param2
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_app_config.
    METHODS get_config_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_param2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_param1.
    me->mv_param1 = iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_param2.
    me->mv_param2 = iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_config_summary.
    rv_summary = |Param1: { me->mv_param1 }, Param2: { me->mv_param2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_config) = NEW zcl_app_config( ).
    DATA(lv_summary) = lo_config->set_param1( 'Value A' )->set_param2( 123 )->get_config_summary( ).

    DATA(lv_expected) = 'Param1: Value A, Param2: 123'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_summary
      exp = lv_expected
      msg = 'Configuration summary should match expected value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (auch Fluent Interface genannt) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden können. Dies wird durch die Rückgabe der Objektinstanz (ME->) in den Setter-Methoden erreicht. Die FINAL-Klasse verhindert die Vererbung und stellt sicher, dass die Implementierung nicht verändert wird.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, FINAL, NEW, DATA

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name in einer Konstante gespeichert ist. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_greeting = 'Hello from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_ref TYPE REF TO zcl_dynamic_caller.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_ref.

    CALL METHOD lo_ref->(gc_method_name)

ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD` und einer Konstante für den Methodennamen ermöglicht flexible Programmierlösungen. Die Verwendung von Konstanten verbessert die Wartbarkeit und Lesbarkeit, da der Methodenname nicht hartkodiert ist. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_caller)`) sind hier ebenfalls ein modernes Feature.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus SFLIGHT und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte hinzu, die den Prozentsatz der belegten Sitze berechnet. Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit `LET` für Zwischenberechnungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR mit `LET` und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_sflight_raw,
      tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_occupancy,
        carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
        occupancy_percent TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1,
      END OF ty_sflight_occupancy,
      tt_sflight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_sflight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflight_raw TYPE tt_sflight_raw.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflight_raw
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight_raw
      LET occupancy = COND p(
                          WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / flight-seatsmax
                          ELSE 0
                        )
      IN
        ( carrid = flight-carrid,
          connid = flight-connid,
          occupancy_percent = occupancy )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_occupancy_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_calculator->calculate_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_occupancy )
      msg = 'Should return at least one entry'
    ).

    IF lines( lt_occupancy ) > 0.
      READ TABLE lt_occupancy INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_first_flight-occupancy_percent >= 0 AND ls_first_flight-occupancy_percent <= 100
        msg = 'Occupancy percentage should be between 0 and 100'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `LET` ermöglicht die Transformation und Berechnung von Daten in internen Tabellen auf eine sehr elegante und funktionale Weise. `LET` erlaubt die Definition von lokalen Hilfsvariablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks, was den Code sauberer und lesbarer macht. Die Verwendung von `COND` innerhalb von `LET` zeigt die Verschachtelung moderner Ausdrücke.
keywords: FOR, LET, Internal Tables, COND, DATA, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für eine Factory-Methode, die Objekte eines bestimmten Typs erzeugt. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer konkreten Factory-Klasse, die eine Konstante für den Objekttyp verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, CONSTANTS und den NEW-Operator mit Typangabe.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_object_factory.

Konstanten für Klassennamen vermeiden Magic Strings und verbessern die Wartbarkeit. `IMPLEMENTS` bindet die Factory an das Interface.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine SORTED TABLE vom Typ `sflight` mit dem Primärschlüssel `carrid` und `connid`. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflight` und geben Sie die ersten 5 Einträge aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die Tabellendefinition und `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` für die Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_flights ).

explanation: `SORTED TABLE` ist eine interne Tabellenart, die ihre Einträge automatisch nach einem definierten Schlüssel sortiert hält. Dies ermöglicht einen sehr effizienten Zugriff über den Schlüssel. Die Definition mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge existieren.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine `SORTED TABLE` von `sflight`. Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag effizient mittels des Tabellenschlüssels.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY` oder den Inline-Deklarations-Operator `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted OPTIONAL.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF it_flights IS SUPPLIED.
      mt_flights = it_flights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_flights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    READ TABLE mt_flights INTO rs_flight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_flight RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_read=>tt_sflight_sorted.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_key( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_flight_by_key( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_read_error expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception cx_sy_read_error caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Zugriff auf `SORTED TABLE`s über den Schlüssel ist extrem performant, da ABAP eine binäre Suche verwendet. `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY` ist die klassische Methode, während `LINE_EXISTS` oder `VALUE #( FOR ... )` modernere, funktionalere Ansätze bieten, die `sy-subrc` oft überflüssig machen. Hier wird `sy-subrc` noch zur Fehlerbehandlung verwendet.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, WITH TABLE KEY, sy-subrc, cx_sy_read_error

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den `planetype` eines Eintrags in einer `SORTED TABLE` von `sflight` basierend auf `carrid` und `connid`. Verwenden Sie moderne Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit `TABLE KEY` und `COND` für eine moderne Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted OPTIONAL.

    METHODS update_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF it_flights IS SUPPLIED.
      mt_flights = it_flights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_flights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_planetype.
    MODIFY TABLE mt_flights FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid planetype = iv_planetype )
      TRANSPORTING planetype.
    rv_success = COND abap_bool( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_existing_flight.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_modify=>tt_sflight_sorted.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' planetype = 'BOEING' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_planetype( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_planetype = 'AIRBUS' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Update should be successful' ).
    DATA(lt_updated_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated_flights[ 1 ]-planetype exp = 'AIRBUS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_planetype( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_planetype = 'UNKNOWN' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Update should not be successful' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MODIFY TABLE` ist der Standardbefehl zum Ändern von Einträgen in internen Tabellen. Durch die Angabe von `TABLE KEY` wird der Eintrag in einer `SORTED TABLE` effizient über den Schlüssel gefunden und aktualisiert. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die zu ändernde Zeile und `COND` für die Rückgabe des Erfolgsstatus ist moderner ABAP-Stil.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, MODIFY TABLE, TABLE KEY, VALUE, COND, sy-subrc

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von `sflight` nach einem bestimmten `carrid` und geben Sie die gefilterten Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted OPTIONAL.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF it_flights IS SUPPLIED.
      mt_flights = it_flights.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lt_sflight_db) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_db UP TO 20 ROWS.
      LOOP AT lt_sflight_db ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
        INSERT <fs_sflight> INTO TABLE mt_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( mt_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_existing_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_non_existing_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_existing_carrier.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_filter=>tt_sflight_sorted.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_non_existing_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'ZZ' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'No flights expected for non-existing carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator (ABAP 7.40+) bietet eine prägnante und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Für `SORTED TABLE`s kann der Filter-Operator die Sortierung nutzen, um die Suche zu optimieren, wenn die Filterkriterien mit dem Tabellenschlüssel übereinstimmen.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` von `sflight` in eine neue Tabelle, die nur `carrid`, `connid` und eine berechnete `flight_id` (Konkatenation von `carrid` und `connid`) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck für Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted OPTIONAL.

    METHODS get_flight_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_ids) TYPE tt_flight_info.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF it_flights IS SUPPLIED.
      mt_flights = it_flights.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lt_sflight_db) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_db UP TO 20 ROWS.
      LOOP AT lt_sflight_db ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
        INSERT <fs_sflight> INTO TABLE mt_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_ids.
    rt_flight_ids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
                             ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
                               connid    = ls_flight-connid
                               flight_id = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_ids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_ids_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_ids.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_for=>tt_sflight_sorted.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_for( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_ids ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flight_ids[ 1 ]-flight_id exp = 'AA-0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flight_ids[ 2 ]-flight_id exp = 'LH-0400' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation von Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE #(` kann eine neue Tabelle basierend auf den Elementen einer Quelltabelle erstellt werden, wobei jede Zeile transformiert wird. String Templates (`|...|`) sind eine moderne Art der String-Konkatenation.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flug aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflight` basierend auf `carrid` und `connid`. Überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc`, um festzustellen, ob der Eintrag gefunden wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und anschließend eine `IF sy-subrc = 0` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sysubrc_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_single_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sysubrc_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight_status.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_existing_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_existing_key) UP TO 1 ROWS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ).
      ls_existing_key-carrid = 'AA'.

explanation: `sy-subrc` ist eine Systemvariable, die den Rückgabewert des letzten ABAP-Statements enthält. Ein Wert von 0 bedeutet in der Regel Erfolg. Hier wird es verwendet, um den Erfolg eines `SELECT SINGLE` auf eine Datenbanktabelle zu überprüfen.

Instructions: Rufen Sie einen Funktionsbaustein auf, der `sy-subrc` setzt, und behandeln Sie die verschiedenen Rückgabewerte mit einer `CASE` Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL FUNCTION` und anschließend `CASE sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sysubrc_function DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_function_and_check_rc
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sysubrc_function IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_function_and_check_rc.
    " Beispiel: Funktionsbaustein 'NUMBER_GET_NEXT' (existiert in jedem System)
    " Dieser Baustein setzt sy-subrc bei Fehlern (z.B. wenn kein Nummernkreisobjekt gefunden wird)
    DATA: lv_number TYPE i.

    CALL FUNCTION 'NUMBER_GET_NEXT'
      EXPORTING
        nr_range_nr             = '01'
        object                  = 'DEBITOR'
      IMPORTING
        quantity                = lv_number
      EXCEPTIONS
        interval_not_found      = 1
        number_range_not_intern = 2
        object_not_found        = 3
        quantity_is_0           = 4
        quantity_is_not_1       = 5
        wrong_interval_sequence = 6
        OTHERS                  = 7.

    CASE sy-subrc.
      WHEN 0.
        rv_message = |Nummer { lv_number } erfolgreich abgerufen.|.
      WHEN 1.
        rv_message = 'Fehler: Nummernkreisintervall nicht gefunden.'.
      WHEN 2.
        rv_message = 'Fehler: Nummernkreis nicht intern.'.
      WHEN 3.
        rv_message = 'Fehler: Nummernkreisobjekt nicht gefunden.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = |Unbekannter Fehler beim Abrufen der Nummer (sy-subrc: { sy-subrc }).|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_function_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_function_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_function_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sysubrc_function( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->call_function_and_check_rc( 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'erfolgreich abgerufen' msg = 'Expected success message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_function_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sysubrc_function( ).
    " Forcing an error by using a non-existent object or range
    " This test might be fragile if NUMBER_GET_NEXT behavior changes or if 'XYZ' becomes a valid object.
    " A more robust test would mock the function call.
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->call_function_and_check_rc( 0 ). " Input not used, but for signature

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'Fehler' msg = 'Expected error message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei Funktionsbausteinen ist `sy-subrc` oft der primäre Mechanismus zur Fehlerbehandlung. Eine `CASE sy-subrc` Anweisung ermöglicht es, spezifische Fehlercodes zu identifizieren und entsprechend zu reagieren. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster in älterem ABAP, aber immer noch relevant, wenn mit bestehenden Funktionsbausteinen interagiert wird.
keywords: sy-subrc, CALL FUNCTION, CASE, Error Handling, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert, ohne `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und `sy-subrc` zu verwenden. Nutzen Sie stattdessen eine moderne Alternative.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sysubrc_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_standard OPTIONAL.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_standard.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sysubrc_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF it_flights IS SUPPLIED.
      mt_flights = it_flights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_flights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( mt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_exists_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_line_exists_false FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_exists_true.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_sysubrc_line_exists=>tt_sflight_standard.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sysubrc_line_exists( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exists msg = 'Flight should exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_line_exists_false.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sysubrc_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_exists msg = 'Flight should not exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` (ABAP 7.40+) ist eine funktionale Methode, um die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle anhand ihres Schlüssels zu überprüfen. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbarere Alternative zu `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` gefolgt von einer `sy-subrc`-Prüfung, da es direkt einen booleschen Wert zurückgibt und keine implizite Systemvariable verwendet.
keywords: sy-subrc, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40, COND

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flug in eine `STANDARD TABLE` ein. Wenn der Einfügevorgang fehlschlägt (z.B. bei einem `UNIQUE KEY` Verstoß in einer `HASHED TABLE` oder `SORTED TABLE`), geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück. Nutzen Sie `INSERT` und `sy-subrc`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` direkt danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sysubrc_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed OPTIONAL.

    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_new_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sysubrc_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF it_flights IS SUPPLIED.
      mt_flights = it_flights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_flights UP TO 5 ROWS.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight.
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE mt_flights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_message = |Flug { is_new_flight-carrid }-{ is_new_flight-connid } erfolgreich hinzugefügt.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Fehler beim Hinzufügen von Flug { is_new_flight-carrid }-{ is_new_flight-connid }. Möglicherweise existiert er bereits.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_unique_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_duplicate_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_flight.
    DATA: lt_initial_flights TYPE zcl_sysubrc_insert=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sysubrc_insert( it_flights = lt_initial_flights ).
    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->add_flight( ls_new_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'erfolgreich hinzugefügt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_flights( ) ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_flight.
    DATA: lt_initial_flights TYPE zcl_sysubrc_insert=>tt_sflight_hashed.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sysubrc_insert( it_flights = lt_initial_flights ).
    DATA(ls_duplicate_flight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->add_flight( ls_duplicate_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'Fehler' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_flights( ) ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl moderne ABAP-Syntax oft darauf abzielt, `sy-subrc` zu vermeiden, ist es bei Operationen wie `INSERT INTO TABLE` immer noch relevant, um den Erfolg oder Misserfolg des Vorgangs zu überprüfen, insbesondere bei Tabellen mit eindeutigen Schlüsseln. Hier wird `sy-subrc` direkt nach dem `INSERT` geprüft, um auf einen möglichen doppelten Schlüssel zu reagieren.
keywords: sy-subrc, INSERT INTO TABLE, HASHED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Aktion nur dann aus, wenn ein bestimmter Flug in einer `SORTED TABLE` existiert. Verwenden Sie `COND` und `LINE_EXISTS` anstelle von `IF sy-subrc = 0`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `COND` mit `LINE_EXISTS` für eine prägnante Bedingungsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sysubrc_cond_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted OPTIONAL.

    METHODS get_flight_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sysubrc_cond_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF it_flights IS SUPPLIED.
      mt_flights = it_flights.
    ELSE.
      INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'BOEING' ) INTO TABLE mt_flights.
      INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'AIRBUS' ) INTO TABLE mt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_description.
    rv_description = COND string(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( mt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] )
        THEN |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } existiert. Flugzeugtyp: { mt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-planetype }|
      ELSE
        |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_flight_description FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_flight_description FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_flight_description.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sysubrc_cond_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_cut->get_flight_description( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description exp = 'existiert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_description exp = 'BOEING' ).

  METHOD test_non_existing_flight_description.

explanation: Die Kombination von `COND` (ABAP 7.40+) und `LINE_EXISTS` (ABAP 7.40+) ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Stil. Sie ermöglicht es, komplexe Bedingungen und deren Ergebnisse in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung zu formulieren, wodurch die Notwendigkeit expliziter `IF sy-subrc = 0` Prüfungen für interne Tabellenzugriffe entfällt und der Code kompakter wird.
keywords: sy-subrc, COND, LINE_EXISTS, SORTED TABLE, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Struktur aus einer Quellstruktur, wobei ein Feld von Typ `string` in `char10` konvertiert wird.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
      END OF ty_source,
      BEGIN OF ty_target,
        field1 TYPE char10,
        field2 TYPE i,
      END OF ty_target.

      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_structure.
    rs_target = VALUE #( 
      field1 = CONV char10( is_source-field1 )
      field2 = is_source-field2
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

solution:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie numerische Werte aus einer Quelltabelle in Strings konvertieren und nur Einträge mit einem Wert größer als 10 filtern.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `CONV` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_for_table_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE i,
      END OF ty_source_line,
      ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
        id    TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target_line,
      ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_and_filter_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_for_table_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_filter_table.
    rt_target = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_source IN it_source WHERE ( ls_source-value > 10 )
      (
        id    = CONV string( ls_source-id )
        value = CONV string( ls_source-value )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_and_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_for_table_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_conv_for_table_demo=>ty_source_table(
      ( id = 1 value = 5 )
      ( id = 2 value = 15 )
      ( id = 3 value = 20 )
      ( id = 4 value = 8 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->convert_and_filter_table( lt_source ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_conv_for_table_demo=>ty_target_table(
      ( id = '2' value = '15' )
      ( id = '3' value = '20' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE`, `FOR` und `CONV` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen, was die Code-Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: CONV, FOR, Internal Tables, Table Expression, VALUE, Filter, Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische WHERE-Klausel für eine SELECT-Anweisung, die optionale Filter für Fluggesellschaftscode und Flugnummer berücksichtigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und bedingte Logik zur Konstruktion der WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_where_clause DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_where_clause IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_where) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_where_clause IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_where_clause.
    DATA(lv_conditions) = VALUE string_table( ).
    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND |carrid = '{ iv_carrid }'| TO lv_conditions.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND |connid = '{ iv_connid }'| TO lv_conditions.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_conditions IS NOT INITIAL.
      CONCATENATE LINES OF lv_conditions INTO rv_where SEPARATED BY ' AND '.
      rv_where = |WHERE { rv_where }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in Blöcken von 5 Zeilen, um große Datenmengen effizient zu verarbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_chunk_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    METHODS read_sflights_in_chunks IMPORTING iv_chunk_size TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_chunk_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.
    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_keys PACKAGE SIZE @iv_chunk_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_str_url_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_str_url_query IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_query_parts) = VALUE string_table( FOR param IN it_params ( |{ param-key }={ param-value }| ) ).

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und lesen Sie nur die Felder `CARRID` und `CONNID` zeilenweise, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit einer Feldliste und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in eine Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_id.
    METHODS read_flight_ids_cursor RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_ids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flight_ids_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor, ls_flight_id TYPE ty_flight_id.
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights ORDER BY carrid, connid.
    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_flight_id.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight_id TO rt_flight_ids.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` mit einem Cursor und filtern Sie diese in ABAP nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. Preis über einem Schwellenwert), das nicht direkt in der SQL-WHERE-Klausel ausgedrückt werden kann.
hint: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für alle relevanten Daten und filtern Sie dann mit einer IF-Bedingung in ABAP.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_custom_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE s_price RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_custom_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor, ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_data.
    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.
    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_sflight-price > iv_min_price.
        APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_filtered_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Obwohl moderne ABAP-SQL-Features viele Filter direkt in der Datenbank ermöglichen, ist die Cursor-basierte Verarbeitung mit nachfolgender ABAP-Filterung immer noch eine Option für komplexe, nicht-SQL-native Filterkriterien oder wenn die Daten bereits in Chunks gelesen werden. hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und String-Templates, um die JSON-Struktur aufzubauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_json_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS build_json_from_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_json_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_json_from_flights.
    DATA(lv_flights_json) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL
        THEN |{ `{"carrid":"{ ls_flight-carrid }","connid":"{ ls_flight-connid }","fldate":"{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }","price":{ ls_flight-price }}` }|
        ELSE |{ s },{ `{"carrid":"{ ls_flight-carrid }","connid":"{ ls_flight-connid }","fldate":"{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }","price":{ ls_flight-price }}` }|
      )
    ).
    rv_json = |[{ lv_flights_json }]|
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_str_json_builder=>ty_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251128' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251129' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->build_json_from_flights( lt_flights ).
    DATA(lv_expected_json) = `[{"carrid":"LH","connid":"0400","fldate":"2025-11-28","price":100.00},{"carrid":"UA","connid":"0010","fldate":"2025-11-29","price":200.00}]`.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_json exp = lv_expected_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist deutlich kompakter und lesbarer als manuelle String-Verkettungen oder die Verwendung älterer JSON-Bibliotheken.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und den Abflugort aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, für Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_info,
           tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_frankfurt_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_flights) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_frankfurt_flights) = lo_flights->get_frankfurt_flights( ).
    out->write( |Flüge ab Frankfurt: { lines( lt_frankfurt_flights ) } gefunden.| ).
    LOOP AT lt_frankfurt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |Flug { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } von { ls_flight-cityfrom }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
                          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
                            cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_flights( ).
    " Assuming SFLIGHT might be empty or no Frankfurt flights in test system. Adjust assertion if test data is different.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
    " Example: cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    " Example: cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Implementierung von `IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN` macht die Klasse direkt in ADT ausführbar.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, Filter, SFLIGHT, IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem Akkumulator, um die Werte zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_total_passengers) = lo_demo->calculate_total_passengers( ).
    out->write( |Gesamtzahl der Passagiere in SFLIGHT: { lv_total_passengers }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                         FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                         NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( ).
    " This test assumes SFLIGHT has data. If not, it might return 0.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking SFLIGHT or ensuring test data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_result >= 0 ) ).
    " Example: cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife mit einem Akkumulator in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung zu formulieren, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem Schlüssel und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           tt_sflight_filtered TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_demo->get_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    out->write( |LH Flüge gefunden: { lines( lt_lh_flights ) }| ).
    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |Flug { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die die Flugnummern aus SFLIGHT in Kleinbuchstaben umwandelt und nur die ersten 5 Zeichen der Fluggesellschaft anzeigt. Nutzen Sie den `MAP`-Operator.
hint: Der `MAP`-Operator ist eine Erweiterung des `FOR`-Ausdrucks für die Transformation von Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_map_flights_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapped_flight,
             carrid_short TYPE sflight-carrid LENGTH 5,
             connid_lower TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mapped_flight,
           tt_mapped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_map_flights_demo IMPLEMENTATION.

    out->write( |Abgebildete Flüge: { lines( lt_mapped_flights ) } gefunden.| ).
    LOOP AT lt_mapped_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |{ ls_flight-carrid_short } - { ls_flight-connid_lower }| ).

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_mapped_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
