Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einem `FOR`-Konstruktor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group,
           tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_demo->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    out->write( |Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft: { lines( lt_flight_counts ) } Gruppen gefunden.| ).
    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_group).
      out->write( |Fluggesellschaft { ls_group-carrid }: { ls_group-flight_count } Flüge| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus SFLIGHT basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Datum. Nutzen Sie den optimierten Tabellenzugriff mit `LINE_EXISTS` und `TABLE_LINE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` zur Prüfung und `TABLE_LINE` zum direkten Zugriff auf den Datensatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_optimized_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_optimized_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_optimized_table_access( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_demo->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20251128' ).
    IF ls_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      out->write( |Gefundener Flug: { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate }| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Flug nicht gefunden.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_single_flight.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    IF line_exists( lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      rs_flight = lt_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ].
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Zahlungssummen pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und der jeweiligen Gesamtzahlungssumme sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY mit der Aggregationsfunktion SUM.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_payments,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_payments TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_payments.

    METHODS get_total_payments_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_payments WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_payments_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_payments(
        carrid         = group_key->carrid
        total_payments = SUM( ls_sflight-paymentsum )
      ) TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und sammeln Sie alle Verbindungs-IDs für jede Gruppe in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle sein, die pro Fluggesellschaft eine Liste ihrer Verbindungs-IDs enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `VALUE #` und einer inneren `FOR` Schleife für die Gruppenelemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connections,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_carrier_connections.

    METHODS get_connections_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_connections WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_collect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connections_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid )
                           WITHOUT MEMBERS
                           (
                             carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
                             connections = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP ( member-connid ) )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und filtern Sie nur die Gruppen heraus, deren Gesamt-Zahlungssumme einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Das Ergebnis soll nur die Fluggesellschaften und deren Gesamtzahlungssummen enthalten, die den Schwellenwert überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit einer `WHERE` Klausel, die auf einer Aggregationsfunktion basiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_payments,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_payments TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_payments.

    METHODS get_high_value_carriers
      IMPORTING iv_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_payments WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_value_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid )
                           WHERE ( SUM( ls_sflight-paymentsum ) > iv_threshold )
                           WITHOUT MEMBERS
                           (
                             carrid         = ls_sflight-carrid
                             total_payments = SUM( ls_sflight-paymentsum )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungs-ID und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die minimale, maximale und durchschnittliche Zahlungssumme. Das Ergebnis soll eine interne Tabelle mit diesen aggregierten Werten sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit mehreren Aggregationsfunktionen wie `MIN`, `MAX` und `AVG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_multi_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_stats,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
             min_paymentsum TYPE s_price,
             max_paymentsum TYPE s_price,
             avg_paymentsum TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_stats.

    METHODS get_flight_stats
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_multi_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_stats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                      connid = ls_sflight-connid )
                           WITHOUT MEMBERS
                           (
                             carrid         = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             connid         = ls_sflight-connid,
                             min_paymentsum = MIN( ls_sflight-paymentsum ),
                             max_paymentsum = MAX( ls_sflight-paymentsum ),
                             avg_paymentsum = AVG( ls_sflight-paymentsum )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie mit `REDUCE` die Summe der Zahlungssummen nur für Flüge, die mit 'BOEING'-Flugzeugtypen durchgeführt wurden. Das Ergebnis soll pro Fluggesellschaft die Summe dieser spezifischen Zahlungen enthalten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `REDUCE` und einer `FOR` Schleife mit `WHERE` innerhalb des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_boeing_payments,
             carrid          TYPE s_carr_id,
             boeing_payments TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_boeing_payments.

    METHODS get_boeing_payments_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_boeing_payments WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_boeing_payments_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid )
                           WITHOUT MEMBERS
                           (
                             carrid          = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             boeing_payments = REDUCE s_price(
                                                 INIT sum_boeing = 0
                                                 FOR member IN GROUP WHERE ( planetype = 'BOEING' )
                                                 NEXT sum_boeing = sum_boeing + member-paymentsum
                                               )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " ENDIF.

Es ermöglicht die Durchführung komplexer, bedingter Aggregationen pro Gruppe, indem eine innere `FOR` Schleife mit einer `WHERE` Klausel verwendet wird, um nur relevante Gruppenelemente zu berücksichtigen.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, WHERE, Internal Tables, Conditional Aggregation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Byte-Offset eines bestimmten Zeichens (basierend auf seinem Zeichen-Offset) in einem String. Dies ist wichtig, wenn der String Multibyte-Zeichen enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>CHAR_BYTE_OFFSET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_byte_offset DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_byte_offset
      IMPORTING iv_string      TYPE string
                iv_char_offset TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_byte_offset) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_char_byte_offset IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_byte_offset.
    rv_byte_offset = cl_abap_char_utilities=>char_byte_offset(
                       iv_string      = iv_string
                       iv_char_offset = iv_char_offset
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_byte_offset FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_byte_offset.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_byte_offset( ).

    " String 'Grüße' (5 characters, 6 bytes in UTF-8)
    " G (0, 0) r (1, 1) ü (2, 2) ß (3, 4) e (4, 5)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_byte_offset( iv_string = 'Grüße' iv_char_offset = 0 ) exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_byte_offset( iv_string = 'Grüße' iv_char_offset = 1 ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_byte_offset( iv_string = 'Grüße' iv_char_offset = 2 ) exp = 2 ). " 'ü' starts at byte offset 2
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_byte_offset( iv_string = 'Grüße' iv_char_offset = 3 ) exp = 4 ). " 'ß' starts at byte offset 4
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_byte_offset( iv_string = 'Grüße' iv_char_offset = 4 ) exp = 5 ).

    " String 'Hello' (5 characters, 5 bytes)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_byte_offset( iv_string = 'Hello' iv_char_offset = 2 ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: In Unicode-Systemen kann die Zeichenlänge von der Byte-Länge abweichen. `CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>CHAR_BYTE_OFFSET` ist unerlässlich, um den korrekten Byte-Offset eines Zeichens zu erhalten, wenn man mit Offsets in XSTRINGs oder bei der Verarbeitung von externen Datenströmen arbeitet.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES, String, Byte Offset, Unicode, Character Offset

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_dec_to_str DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_decfloat TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_conv_dec_to_str IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_decfloat_to_string.
    " Define a local packed number type with 2 decimal places
    TYPES: lty_p_2_decimals TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
    " Convert DECFLOAT to packed number (handles rounding), then packed number to string
    DATA(lv_packed_value) = CONV lty_p_2_decimals( iv_decfloat ).
    rv_string = CONV string( lv_packed_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie die erste Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), die einem bestimmten Kriterium entspricht, und geben Sie die gelöschte Zeile zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... FROM ...` in Kombination mit `READ TABLE` oder `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_first_match DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_first_flight_and_return
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrid       TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid       TYPE s_conn_id
      EXPORTING
        ev_deleted_flight TYPE sflights OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_first_match IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_first_flight_and_return.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights. " Copy input table

    DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid = iv_carrid AND <fs_flight>-connid = iv_connid.
        lv_index = sy-tabix.
        ev_deleted_flight = <fs_flight>.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_index IS NOT INITIAL.
      DELETE rt_sflights INDEX lv_index.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_with_blacklist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_from_blacklist.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights. " Copy input table

    " Using a LOOP and DELETE for demonstration, FILTER is often more functional
    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      READ TABLE it_blacklist TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH TABLE KEY carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                      connid = <fs_flight>-connid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DELETE rt_sflights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Alternative using FILTER (more modern/functional, but not directly 'DELETE')
    " rt_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights EXCEPT IN it_blacklist WHERE carrid = carrid AND connid = connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), die keine gültige Flugverbindung (z.B. `CONNID` ist '0000') haben, und geben Sie die Anzahl der gelöschten Zeilen zurück. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Anzahl zu zählen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_and_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_invalid_flights_and_count
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      EXPORTING
        ev_deleted_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_and_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_invalid_flights_and_count.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights. " Copy input table

    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( rt_sflights ).
    DELETE rt_sflights WHERE connid = '0000'.
    ev_deleted_count = lv_initial_lines - lines( rt_sflights ).

    " Alternative using REDUCE for counting (if DELETE was not used)
    " ev_deleted_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
    "                           FOR flight IN it_sflights
    "                           WHERE ( connid = '0000' )
    "                           NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Obwohl der `REDUCE` Operator hier nicht direkt für das Löschen verwendet wird, könnte er alternativ genutzt werden, um die Anzahl der zu löschenden Zeilen vorab zu ermitteln, was eine funktionale Zählweise darstellt.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `SORT` mit einem temporären Zufallsfeld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             rand_key TYPE i, " Temporäres Feld für Zufallszahl
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = 1000000 ). " Großer Bereich für bessere Zufälligkeit

    rt_shuffled_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                    ( ls_sflight WITH rand_key = lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).

    SORT rt_shuffled_sflights BY rand_key.

    " Entferne das temporäre Feld, falls nicht benötigt
    LOOP AT rt_shuffled_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      CLEAR <fs_sflight>-rand_key.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             rand_key TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_original TYPE tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' ) INTO TABLE lt_original.
    INSERT VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' ) INTO TABLE lt_original.
    INSERT VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'CC' connid = '003' fldate = '20250103' ) INTO TABLE lt_original.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).
    DATA lt_sorted_original TYPE tt_sflight.
    lt_sorted_original = lt_original.
    SORT lt_sorted_original BY carrid.

    DATA lt_sorted_shuffled TYPE tt_sflight.
    lt_sorted_shuffled = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled exp = lt_sorted_original ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Tabelle wird mit einem temporären Zufallsfeld erweitert. Jede Zeile erhält eine Zufallszahl. Anschließend wird die Tabelle nach diesem Zufallsfeld sortiert, was zu einer zufälligen Reihenfolge führt. `VALUE #(...) FOR ...` wird für die Transformation verwendet.
keywords: RANDOM, Internal Tables, Shuffle, SORT, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Bestimmen Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen und generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_entry
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_entry) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_entry.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_sflights ).
    IF lv_lines = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_lines ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE it_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_random_entry.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_time_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data_point,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl, " Datum/Uhrzeit für Zeitachse
             value     TYPE decfloat16,  " Wert für Y-Achse
           END OF ty_chart_data_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_data_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weekly_sales_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sales_data) TYPE tt_chart_data_points.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_time_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekly_sales_data.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lo_random_float) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).

    DO 7 TIMES. " Daten für 7 Tage generieren
      DATA(lv_sales_value) = lo_random_float->get_next( ) * 1000 + 500. " Zufälliger Umsatz zwischen 500 und 1500
      DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add(
                              tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( )
                              days  = sy-index - 7 " Start 6 Tage vor heute
                            ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_chart_data_point(
        timestamp = lv_timestamp
        value     = lv_sales_value
      ) TO rt_sales_data.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data_point,
             category TYPE string,      " Kategorie (z.B. Fluggesellschaft)
             value    TYPE i,          " Wert (z.B. Anzahl Flüge)
           END OF ty_chart_data_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_data_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_chart_data_points.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Aggregieren der Fluganzahl pro Fluggesellschaft
    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights BY ls_sflight-carrid
                              ( category = ls_sflight-carrid
                                value    = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>now( ) days = -1 ) value = 130 )

    " io_chart->add_series( id = 'LH' title = 'Airline LH' data = lt_data_lh ).

    " Für den Unit-Test und zur Demonstration, dass die Methode aufgerufen wurde,
    " könnte man hier eine Logik einbauen, die die "Eigenschaften" speichert
    " oder einen Mock verwendet.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_multiple_series.
    DATA lo_mock_chart TYPE REF TO if_abap_time_chart_simple.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_mock_chart TYPE cl_abap_unit_test_mock.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_series_data_point,

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_prices = REDUCE tt_carrier_prices(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_prices( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights BY ls_sflight-carrid
      LET lv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                             INIT sum = 0
                             FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_sflight
                             NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-price )
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( result ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid total_price = lv_total_price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_prices) = lo_cut->calculate_total_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_carrier_prices IS NOT INITIAL ).
    " Prüfen, ob die Summe für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft korrekt ist (Beispiel)
    DATA ls_aa_price TYPE zcl_reduce_flight_prices=>ty_carrier_price.
    READ TABLE lt_carrier_prices INTO ls_aa_price WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_price-total_price > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF`, um die Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft zu aggregieren. Ein inneres `REDUCE` summiert die Preise innerhalb jeder Gruppe, während das äußere `REDUCE` die Ergebniszeilen für jede Fluggesellschaft erstellt. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, Grouping, Aggregation, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflight` in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, unter Verwendung von `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                              ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_table_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->transform_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flight_keys IS NOT INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_flight_keys ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_key>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_key>-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_key>-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration in Kombination mit `VALUE #` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation einer internen Tabelle. Hier werden nur die Felder `carrid` und `connid` aus der Quelltabelle in die Zieltabelle übernommen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, sflights

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein Flug aus der Tabelle `sflights` überbucht ist, basierend auf der Anzahl der gebuchten Sitze und der maximalen Kapazität. Verwenden Sie eine moderne IF-Anweisung.

CLASS zcl_flight_overbooked DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_flight_overbooked

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch als Datenreferenz entgegennimmt und die Anzahl der Zeilen zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REF TO data` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_table_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_row_count
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_table_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_row_count.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_count = lines( <fs_table> ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_count.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_table_count( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->get_table_row_count( REF #( lt_sflight ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Should count 2 lines' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_table_count( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->get_table_row_count( REF #( lt_sflight ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Innerhalb der Methode wird ein `FIELD-SYMBOLS` verwendet, um auf den Inhalt der Referenz zuzugreifen und die Anzahl der Zeilen mit `lines()` zu ermitteln. Dies ermöglicht generische Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: REF TO data, FIELD-SYMBOLS, dynamische Programmierung, interne Tabellen

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden, die verkettet werden können, um eine Zeichenkette schrittweise zu manipulieren (z.B. Großbuchstaben, Trimmen, Präfix hinzufügen).
hint: Methoden, die `ME->` zurückgeben, ermöglichen das Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS add_prefix IMPORTING iv_prefix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_string = to_upper( mv_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    mv_string = condense( mv_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    mv_string = iv_prefix && mv_string.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_string_builder( '  hello world  ' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->trim( )->to_upper( )->add_prefix( 'PREFIX: ' )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'PREFIX: HELLO WORLD' msg = 'Chaining failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch das Zurückgeben einer Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME->`) in den Manipulationsmethoden (`to_upper`, `trim`, `add_prefix`) kann eine flüssige Schnittstelle (Fluent Interface) implementiert werden, die Methodenverkettung ermöglicht. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes.
keywords: METHOD, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, Object Orientation, String Processing

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Objektnamen und einen Methodennamen als String entgegennimmt und die Methode dynamisch aufruft. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT`, `CALL METHOD` und `REF TO data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    DATA: lr_result TYPE REF TO data.
    CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING result = lr_result.

    IF lr_result IS BOUND.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN lr_result->* TO <fs_result>.
      IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_result = <fs_result>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_text = 'Hello from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method_call RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_HELPER_DYNAMIC'
      iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from dynamic method!' msg = 'Dynamic call failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method_call.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    TRY.
        lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
          iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_HELPER_DYNAMIC'
          iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_call_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Klassen und Methoden zur Laufzeit dynamisch instanziiert und aufruft. `CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name)` erstellt ein Objekt basierend auf einem String. `CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING result = lr_result` ruft die Methode dynamisch auf. `REF TO data` wird verwendet, um das Ergebnis generisch zu empfangen und über `FIELD-SYMBOLS` darauf zuzugreifen.
keywords: REF TO object, CALL METHOD, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine funktionale Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflight) entgegennimmt und den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft zurückgibt, wobei `REDUCE` verwendet wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und eine funktionale Methode, die den Preis extrahiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_price
        iv_carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflight_data
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT total = total + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_for_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA: lt_flight_prices TYPE zcl_flight_calculator=>tt_sflight_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 ) TO lt_flight_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = 200 ) TO lt_flight_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = 500 ) TO lt_flight_prices.

    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_flight_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_calc->get_total_price_for_carrier(
      it_sflight_data = lt_flight_prices
      iv_carrid       = 'LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 300 msg = 'Total price for LH should be 300' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_flight_prices TYPE zcl_flight_calculator=>tt_sflight_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = 500 ) TO lt_flight_prices.

    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_flight_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_calc->get_total_price_for_carrier(
      it_sflight_data = lt_flight_prices
      iv_carrid       = 'LH'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_total_price_for_carrier` ist eine funktionale Methode, die einen Wert zurückgibt. Sie nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Preise der Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft zu aggregieren. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen, ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: METHOD, Functional Method, REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflight

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für Objekte, die eine Nachricht ausgeben können. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei verschiedenen Klassen und erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Interface-Referenzen entgegennimmt und die Nachrichten aller Objekte ausgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE`, `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING`, `REF TO interface`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_provider.
  METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_greeting_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_provider.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_provider~get_message.
    rv_message = |Hello, { mv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_farewell_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_provider.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_reason TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_reason TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_farewell_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_provider~get_message.
    rv_message = |Goodbye, due to { mv_reason }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_reason = iv_reason.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_messages
      IMPORTING
        it_message_providers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_message_provider
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_messages.
    LOOP AT it_message_providers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_provider>).
      APPEND <fs_provider>->get_message( ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphic_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphic_messages.
    DATA: lt_providers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_message_provider.
    APPEND NEW zcl_greeting_provider( 'World' ) TO lt_providers.
    APPEND NEW zcl_farewell_provider( 'meeting end' ) TO lt_providers.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_message_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_processor->process_messages( lt_providers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should process 2 messages' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[1] exp = 'Hello, World!' msg = 'First message incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[2] exp = 'Goodbye, due to meeting end.' msg = 'Second message incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert Polymorphie durch die Verwendung von Interface-Referenzen (`REF TO zif_message_provider`). Die Methode `process_messages` kann Objekte verschiedener Klassen verarbeiten, solange diese das `zif_message_provider`-Interface implementieren. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erweiterbaren Code.
keywords: REF TO interface, INTERFACE, METHOD, Polymorphism, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die zwei Zahlen addiert. Die zweite Zahl soll optional sein und einen Standardwert von 0 haben, wenn sie nicht übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPTIONAL` oder `DEFAULT` für Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    IF iv_num2 IS SUPPLIED.
      rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
    ELSE.
      rv_sum = iv_num1. " Default to adding 0 if not supplied
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_two_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_one_number FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_two_numbers.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_calc->add_numbers( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 8 msg = '5 + 3 should be 8' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_one_number.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_calc->add_numbers( iv_num1 = 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 7 msg = '7 + 0 should be 7' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Methode `add_numbers` verwendet den `OPTIONAL`-Zusatz für den Parameter `iv_num2`. Dies ermöglicht es, die Methode mit oder ohne den zweiten Parameter aufzurufen. Innerhalb der Methode kann `IS SUPPLIED` verwendet werden, um zu prüfen, ob der optionale Parameter übergeben wurde, und entsprechend zu reagieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Datenreferenz auf eine beliebige Struktur entgegennimmt und den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes (angegeben als String) aus dieser Struktur ausliest.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_struct_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_struct_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF <fs_structure> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_value = <fs_field>.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure.|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Structure reference is not bound.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    METHODS test_get_field_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existent_field RAISING cx_sy_assign_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unbound_reference RAISING cx_sy_assign_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_test_struct.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Test Value'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_generic_struct_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_reader->get_field_value(
      ir_structure  = REF #( ls_data )
      iv_field_name = 'FIELD1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Test Value' msg = 'Should retrieve FIELD1 value' ).

    lv_value = lo_reader->get_field_value(
      ir_structure  = REF #( ls_data )
      iv_field_name = 'FIELD2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = '123' msg = 'Should retrieve FIELD2 value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_non_existent_field.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_test_struct.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_generic_struct_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_field_value(
          ir_structure  = REF #( ls_data )
          iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for non-existent field' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unbound_reference.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data. " Unbound reference
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_generic_struct_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_field_value(
          ir_structure  = lr_data
          iv_field_name = 'FIELD1'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_assign_error for unbound reference' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode nutzt `REF TO data` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`, um generisch auf Felder einer beliebigen Struktur zuzugreifen. Dies ist nützlich für dynamische Datenverarbeitung, bei der die Struktur zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist.
keywords: REF TO data, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Dynamic Programming, RTTI

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Factory Method Pattern. Erstellen Sie ein Interface für Produkte und zwei konkrete Produktklassen. Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter eine Instanz der korrekten Produktklasse zurückgibt (als Interface-Referenz).
hint: Statische Factory-Methode, `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE` und `REF TO interface`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_product_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_product_info.
    rv_info = 'This is Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_product_info.
    rv_info = 'This is Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unknown product type: { iv_product_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_product_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_product_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_unknown_product RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_product_a.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_product msg = 'Product A should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_product_info( ) exp = 'This is Product A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_product_b.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_product msg = 'Product B should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_product_info( ) exp = 'This is Product B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_unknown_product.
    TRY.
        zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'C' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_create_object_error for unknown product type' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory Method Pattern wird hier mit einer statischen Methode (`CLASS-METHODS`) in der Factory-Klasse implementiert. Diese Methode gibt eine Referenz auf das Produkt-Interface (`REF TO zif_product`) zurück, was die konkrete Implementierung der Produktklasse vom aufrufenden Code entkoppelt und Polymorphie fördert.
keywords: METHOD, CLASS-METHODS, Factory Method, Design Patterns, Object Orientation, REF TO interface

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Datenreferenz entgegennimmt und den Datentyp des referenzierten Objekts mithilfe von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) als String zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF` und die Attribute des Typbeschreibungs-Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_type_name
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_type_name.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    IF ir_data IS BOUND.
      lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
      rv_type_name = lo_typedescr->get_name( ).
    ELSE.
      rv_type_name = 'UNBOUND_REFERENCE'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_primitive_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_structure_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unbound_ref FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_primitive_type.
    DATA(lv_value) = 'Hello'.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_type) = lo_analyzer->get_data_type_name( REF #( lv_value ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type exp = 'STRING' msg = 'Should identify STRING type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_structure_type.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test,
             field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_test.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_type) = lo_analyzer->get_data_type_name( REF #( ls_data ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type exp = 'TY_TEST' msg = 'Should identify structure type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_type.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_type) = lo_analyzer->get_data_type_name( REF #( lt_data ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type exp = 'STANDARD TABLE OF I' msg = 'Should identify table type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unbound_ref.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_type) = lo_analyzer->get_data_type_name( lr_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type exp = 'UNBOUND_REFERENCE' msg = 'Should handle unbound reference' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode nutzt RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) über `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF`, um den Datentyp eines Objekts, auf das eine Datenreferenz (`REF TO data`) zeigt, zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Frameworks und dynamische Anwendungen.
keywords: REF TO data, RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen entgegennimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die geraden Zahlen enthält, wobei `FILTER` verwendet wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer Inline-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_even_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_even_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_even_numbers.
    rt_even_numbers = FILTER #( it_numbers USING KEY default WHERE ( table_line MOD 2 = 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_even FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_even FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_even.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_number_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_even_numbers( lt_input ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Should filter even numbers' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_empty.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_number_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_even_numbers( lt_input ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Referenz auf eine Instanz einer anderen Klasse entgegennimmt und eine Methode dieser Instanz aufruft, um eine Eigenschaft zu setzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REF TO` für die Objektübergabe und den Pfeiloperator `->` für den Methodenaufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_target_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_new_value TYPE string.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_current_value) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_target_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_data = iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_value.
    rv_current_value = mv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_controller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_target_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_target_object TYPE REF TO zcl_target_object
        iv_value         TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_controller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_target_value.
    IF ir_target_object IS BOUND.
      ir_target_object->set_value( iv_new_value = iv_value ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_target FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_unbound_target FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_target.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_target_object( ).
    DATA(lo_controller) = NEW zcl_controller( ).

    lo_controller->update_target_value( ir_target_object = lo_target iv_value = 'Updated by Controller' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_target->get_value( ) exp = 'Updated by Controller' msg = 'Target object value should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_unbound_target.
    DATA: lo_target TYPE REF TO zcl_target_object. " Unbound
    DATA(lo_controller) = NEW zcl_controller( ).

    " No exception expected, as IS BOUND check prevents call
    lo_controller->update_target_value( ir_target_object = lo_target iv_value = 'Should not update' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'No error when updating unbound target' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Interaktion zwischen Objekten durch die Übergabe von Objekt-Referenzen (`REF TO zcl_target_object`). Die `update_target_value`-Methode des Controllers empfängt eine Referenz auf ein `zcl_target_object` und ruft dessen `set_value`-Methode auf. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Prinzip der objektorientierten Programmierung für die Kommunikation zwischen Objekten.
keywords: REF TO object, METHOD, Object Orientation, Dependency Injection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf eine Exception-Klasse entgegennimmt und eine Instanz dieser Exception erzeugt und auslöst.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE REF TO cx_static_check` und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_raiser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS raise_dynamic_exception
      IMPORTING
        ir_exception_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_raiser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD raise_dynamic_exception.
    DATA: lo_exception TYPE REF TO cx_static_check.

    IF ir_exception_type IS BOUND.
      " Create object of the actual exception type
      CREATE OBJECT lo_exception TYPE (ir_exception_type->get_class_name( )).
      RAISE EXCEPTION lo_exception.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_raise_specific_exception RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_raise_unbound_ref RAISING cx_sy_ref_is_initial FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_raise_specific_exception.
    DATA(lo_raiser) = NEW zcl_exception_raiser( ).
    TRY.
        lo_raiser->raise_dynamic_exception( REF #( NEW cx_sy_arithmetic_error( ) ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_arithmetic_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_sy_arithmetic_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_raise_unbound_ref.
    DATA: lr_exception_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_exception. " Unbound
    DATA(lo_raiser) = NEW zcl_exception_raiser( ).
    TRY.
        lo_raiser->raise_dynamic_exception( lr_exception_type ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_ref_is_initial' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_sy_ref_is_initial' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert, wie man dynamisch Exceptions auslösen kann, indem man eine Referenz auf eine Exception-Klasse (`REF TO cl_abap_exception`) übergibt. Mit `CREATE OBJECT` und dem Klassennamen der Referenz wird eine Instanz der spezifischen Exception erzeugt und dann mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` ausgelöst. Dies ist nützlich für generische Fehlerbehandlungsmechanismen.
keywords: REF TO exception, METHOD, Exception Handling, Dynamic Programming, RAISE EXCEPTION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflight) entgegennimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft und den Flugpreis enthält, wobei `FOR` und `VALUE` verwendet werden.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation von Tabellendaten, indem für jede Zeile der Quelltabelle eine neue Zeile in der Zieltabelle erzeugt wird.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf eine Methode (Methoden-Referenz) entgegennimmt und diese Methode mit einem gegebenen Parameter aufruft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` für den Parameter und `CALL METHOD` mit der Methoden-Referenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_ref
      IMPORTING
        ir_method_ref TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_ref.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA: ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmbind.
    DATA: lr_param_data TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: lr_result_data TYPE REF TO data.

    " Assuming the method reference belongs to a static method for simplicity
    " For instance methods, an object instance would be needed.
    " Here, we'll simulate a static method call or assume a pre-existing object.
    " For a real scenario, you'd need to pass the object reference too.

    " Create data reference for the parameter
    CREATE DATA lr_param_data TYPE string.
    ASSIGN iv_param_value TO lr_param_data->*.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Assuming the method has an IMPORTING parameter named IV_INPUT
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_parmdescr=>importing.
    GET REFERENCE OF lr_param_data->* INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    " Dynamically call the method using the method reference
    CALL METHOD (ir_method_ref->get_name( ))
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
      RECEIVING RESULTS
        VALUE(result) = lr_result_data.

    IF lr_result_data IS BOUND.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN lr_result_data->* TO <fs_result>.
      IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_result = <fs_result>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class with a static method to be called dynamically
CLASS zcl_static_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS process_input
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_static_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_input.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_call_method_ref FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_call_invalid_method_ref RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_call_method_ref.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.

    lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_STATIC_HELPER' ).
    lo_method_descr = lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( 'PROCESS_INPUT' ).

    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_method_ref(
      ir_method_ref  = lo_method_descr
      iv_param_value = 'TestValue'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processed: TestValue' msg = 'Dynamic method call via reference failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_call_invalid_method_ref.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.

    lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_STATIC_HELPER' ).
    " Get a method that doesn't exist or has different signature
    TRY.
        lo_method_descr = lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for non-existent method' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for non-existent method' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von RTTI, um eine Methode dynamisch über eine Methoden-Referenz (`REF TO cl_abap_methdescr`) aufzurufen. Parameter werden dynamisch mit `CREATE DATA` und `abap_parmbind_tab` gebunden. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für Metaprogrammierung und Framework-Entwicklung, erfordert aber präzise Kenntnis der Methodensignaturen zur Laufzeit.
keywords: REF TO cl_abap_methdescr, METHOD, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CALL METHOD, Parameter-Table

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und eine maximale Sitzplatzkapazität von über 200 haben. Geben Sie die gefilterten Flüge zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin_airport TYPE sflight-airpfrom
        iv_min_capacity   TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE airpfrom = iv_origin_airport
                                    AND   seatsmax > iv_min_capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_origin_airport = 'FRA' iv_min_capacity = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Origin airport must be FRA' act = 'FRA' exp = 'FRA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Max capacity must be > 200' act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax > 200 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen. Er ist kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Schleifen und nutzt interne Optimierungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sflight, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) so, dass nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Flugdatum enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie dabei eine neue Struktur und den `FOR` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator für Tabellen-Comprehensions.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simplified_flight,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_simplified_flight.

    METHODS transform_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_simplified_flights) TYPE tt_simplified_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_simplified_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                     ( carrier_id    = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                       connection_id = ls_sflight-connid,
                                       flight_date   = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Connection ID must not be initial' act = ls_flight-connection_id ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight Date must not be initial' act = ls_flight-flight_date ).

keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, sflight

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitzplätze aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle sflights. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator kann für Aggregationen verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_seats_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_occupied_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_seats_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier_id
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_occupied_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                        FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                        NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_calculate_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_seats_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_sum_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_occupied_seats( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Sum for LH should not be 0' act = lv_sum_lh exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Sum for AA should not be 0' act = lv_sum_aa exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Sum for LH should be positive' act = ( lv_sum_lh > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, prägnanten Anweisung. Dies ersetzt die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariable und verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, sflight, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Flugdatum eines Fluges enthält. Verwenden Sie String Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie Backticks (`) für String Templates und `&&` für Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_template_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS format_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_template_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_info.
    rv_formatted_string = |Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } am { is_flight-fldate DATE = USER } ist geplant.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_format_flight_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_info.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE zcl_string_template_demo=>ty_flight_info.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_template_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->format_flight_info( ls_flight ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_occupied TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seats_max      TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status)  TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = COND decfloat34( WHEN iv_seats_max = 0 THEN 0
                                              ELSE ( iv_seats_occupied / iv_seats_max ) * 100 ).

    rv_status = SWITCH string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate > 90 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 50 THEN 'Gut gebucht'
      ELSE 'Verfügbar'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit zwei Spalten (STRING und INT), füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten und geben Sie den Inhalt aus. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` für die dynamische Typdefinition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.

    ls_component-name = 'FIELD1'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'FIELD2'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any table line.

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field1>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field2>).

    IF <lv_field1> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_field2> IS ASSIGNED.
      <lv_field1> = 'Hello'.
      <lv_field2> = 1.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.

      <lv_field1> = 'World'.
      <lv_field2> = 2.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any table line.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' act = <lt_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 2 lines' act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field1>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field2>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First line FIELD1 mismatch' act = <lv_field1> exp = 'Hello' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First line FIELD2 mismatch' act = <lv_field2> exp = 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Typdefinition und Datenmanipulation mittels RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ist ein mächtiges Feature im modernen ABAP. Es ermöglicht die Erstellung von Datenstrukturen zur Laufzeit, was für generische Frameworks oder Schnittstellen unerlässlich ist. Die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und Field-Symbols ist der moderne Weg hierfür.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field-Symbols, CREATE DATA, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei gegebenen Datumsangaben. Nutzen Sie die modernen Datums- und Zeitfunktionen.

CLASS zcl_date_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
