Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle sflights nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `FOR` Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_key.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                  GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING
                                  ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid,
                                    connid = GROUP KEY-connid,
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_group_flights_by_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights_by_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_key( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_group_lh).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH 0400 group should exist' act = ls_group_lh ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count for LH 0400 should be positive' act = ( ls_group_lh-flight_count > 0 ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' INTO DATA(ls_group_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'AA 0017 group should exist' act = ls_group_aa ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count for AA 0017 should be positive' act = ( ls_group_aa-flight_count > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Es ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen und Transformationen in einer deklarativen Weise, die SQL-ähnlich ist und die Lesbarkeit sowie Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping, sflight

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein übergebenes Datenobjekt eine interne Tabelle ist und welche Art von Zeilentyp es hat (Struktur oder Elementart).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_table_type
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_table_type.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    IF lo_descr->is_table_type( ) = abap_true.
      DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr ).
      DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

      IF lo_line_descr->is_struct_type( ) = abap_true.
        rv_type_info = |Interne Tabelle mit strukturiertem Zeilentyp: { lo_line_descr->get_name( ) }|.
      ELSEIF lo_line_descr->is_initial( ) = abap_true.
        rv_type_info = |Interne Tabelle mit initialem Zeilentyp (z.B. leere Tabelle).|.
      ELSE.
        rv_type_info = |Interne Tabelle mit elementarem Zeilentyp: { lo_line_descr->get_name( ) }|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_type_info = 'Keine interne Tabelle'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_check_table_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_table_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_table_check( ).

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_string TYPE string.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_substring( msg = 'Should detect structured table' act = lo_cut->check_table_type( REF #( lt_sflights ) ) exp = 'strukturiertem Zeilentyp' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_substring( msg = 'Should detect elementary table' act = lo_cut->check_table_type( REF #( lt_string_table ) ) exp = 'elementarem Zeilentyp' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should detect non-table' act = lo_cut->check_table_type( REF #( lv_string ) ) exp = 'Keine interne Tabelle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Die Klassen `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` sind die modernen Werkzeuge, um Informationen über Datenobjekte zu erhalten, was für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen oder Frameworks unerlässlich ist.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Type Information, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_tabledescr

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Terminen (simuliert durch eine interne Tabelle) verarbeitet und für jeden Termin eine 'cl_appointment'-ähnliche Objektinstanz erstellt. Nutzen Sie dabei den `FOR` Operator und den `NEW` Operator für die Objekterstellung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` für Tabellen-Comprehensions mit `NEW` für die Objekterstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_appointment,
             id          TYPE numc10,
             description TYPE string,
             date        TYPE sy-datum,
             time        TYPE sy-uzeit,
           END OF ty_raw_appointment.
    TYPES tt_raw_appointment TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_simple_appointment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA: mv_id          TYPE numc10 READ-ONLY,
              mv_description TYPE string READ-ONLY,
              mv_date        TYPE sy-datum READ-ONLY,
              mv_time        TYPE sy-uzeit READ-ONLY.

        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            iv_id          TYPE numc10
            iv_description TYPE string
            iv_date        TYPE sy-datum
            iv_time        TYPE sy-uzeit.
    END-CLASS.

    METHODS process_appointments
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_appointments TYPE tt_raw_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_simple_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_processor IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings. Nutzen Sie moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONDENSE` mit `NO-GAPS` oder String-Methoden wie `replace` mit Regex.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    lv_temp_string = |{ lv_temp_string ALPHA = OUT }|.

    " Replace multiple spaces with single space
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_temp_string WITH ' '.

    rv_cleaned_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleanup( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Test 2' act = lo_cut->clean_string( 'SingleWord' ) exp = 'SingleWord' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Test 3' act = lo_cut->clean_string( '  ' ) exp = '' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle `sflights` und berechnen Sie anschließend die Gesamtzahl der maximalen Sitzplätze (`seatsmax`) für diese gefilterten Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator für eine effiziente Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_for_carrier.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN FILTER tt_sflight FROM it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
      NEXT total = total + <fs_flight>-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die eine Auslastung von über 75% haben, und geben Sie eine neue Tabelle mit diesen Flügen zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_calc_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_occupancy_percent TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_calc_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_occupancy.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_sflight FROM it_sflights
      WHERE ( seatsocc / seatsmax ) * 100 > iv_min_occupancy_percent.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).

CLASS zcl_filter_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,

CLASS zcl_filter_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_sort_flights.
    rt_filtered_sorted_flights = FILTER tt_sflight FROM it_sflights

    SORT rt_filtered_sorted_flights BY connid ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_list_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             filename   TYPE string,
             filetype   TYPE string,
             created_by TYPE syuname,

CLASS zcl_gos_list_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachments.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).

CLASS zcl_gos_get_attachment_content DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gos_get_attachment_content IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).

                                      iv_with_content = abap_true " Request content

Instructions: Für eine gegebene Liste von Business-Objekt-IDs, ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Anlagen für jedes Objekt.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Objekte und verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query`, aggregieren Sie die Ergebnisse mit `REDUCE` oder `LOOP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_count_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_key,
             obj_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             obj_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
           END OF ty_object_key.
    TYPES: tt_object_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_object_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_count,
             obj_type TYPE borident-objtype,
             obj_key  TYPE borident-objkey,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_attachment_count.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_attachments_for_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_object_keys TYPE tt_object_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_attachment_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_count_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_attachments_for_objects.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).

    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR ls_obj_key IN it_object_keys
                           LET ls_borident = VALUE borident( objtype = ls_obj_key-obj_type objkey = ls_obj_key-obj_key )
                               lt_attachments = lo_gos_query->query_attachments( is_object = ls_borident iv_with_content = abap_false ) IN
                           ( obj_type = ls_obj_key-obj_type
                             obj_key  = ls_obj_key-obj_key
                             count    = lines( lt_attachments ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob für ein gegebenes Business-Objekt überhaupt Anlagen vorhanden sind.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_check_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS has_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_obj_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_obj_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_attachments) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_check_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_attachments.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA(ls_borident)  = VALUE borident( objtype = iv_obj_type objkey = iv_obj_key ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_attachments) = lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
                                  is_object = ls_borident
                                  iv_with_content = abap_false
                                ).

        IF lines( lt_attachments ) > 0.
          rv_has_attachments = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_has_attachments = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
        " Handle error, assume no attachments if error occurs
        rv_has_attachments = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_download_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_file_to_frontend
      IMPORTING
        iv_app_server_path TYPE string
        iv_frontend_path   TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_download_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_file_to_frontend.
    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename              = iv_frontend_path
            filetype              = 'BIN'
            appserver             = abap_true
            appserver_filename    = iv_app_server_path
          EXCEPTIONS
            file_write_error      = 1
            no_authority          = 2
            unknown_error         = 3
            bad_data_format       = 4
            cant_calculate_line   = 5
            conversion_error      = 6
            wf_not_supported      = 7
            gui_refuse_filetransfer = 8
            OTHERS                = 9
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
            EXPORTING
              text = |Fehler beim Herunterladen der Datei: { sy-subrc }|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_fes).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_fes->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_download_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_download_file( ).

    " under ideal (mocked) conditions or that the logic around it is sound.

    DATA(lv_app_path) = '/tmp/test_file.txt'. " Dummy path on app server
    DATA(lv_fe_path)  = 'C:\temp\downloaded_test.txt'. " Dummy path on frontend

    " Create a dummy file on the application server for the test

    TRANSFER 'Test content' TO lv_app_path.
    CLOSE DATASET lv_app_path.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->download_file_to_frontend(
          iv_app_server_path = lv_app_path

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein bestimmter Anlagentyp (z.B. 'XLS') für ein Business-Objekt existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` und die `LINE_EXISTS` Funktion mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_check_filetype DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS has_attachment_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_obj_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_obj_key  TYPE borident-objkey
        iv_filetype TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_check_filetype IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_attachment_type.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA(ls_borident)  = VALUE borident( objtype = iv_obj_type objkey = iv_obj_key ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_attachments) = lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
                                  is_object = ls_borident
                                  iv_with_content = abap_false
                                ).

        rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN line_exists( lt_attachments[ filetype = iv_filetype ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).

      CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_dialog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_fes_file_dialog IMPLEMENTATION.

            default_filename        = ''

          rv_selected_file = lt_file_table[ 1 ].

          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
            EXPORTING
              text = |Dateiauswahldialog fehlgeschlagen oder abgebrochen: { lv_rc }|.

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_fes).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services

            text = lx_fes->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

CLASS zcl_fes_create_dir DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_frontend_directory
      IMPORTING
        iv_directory_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_create_dir IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_frontend_directory.
    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>create_directory(
          EXPORTING
            directory = iv_directory_path
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS    = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
            EXPORTING
              text = |Fehler beim Erstellen des Verzeichnisses: { sy-subrc }|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_fes).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_fes->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_directory_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_directory_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_directory_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_create_dir( ).
    DATA(lv_test_dir) = 'C:\temp\TestDir_' && sy-uzeit. " Unique directory name
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lv_success = lo_cut->create_frontend_directory( iv_directory_path = lv_test_dir ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success
          MSG = |Directory '{ lv_test_dir }' should be created| ).

        " Clean up: Attempt to delete the created directory
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>delete_directory(
          EXPORTING
            directory = lv_test_dir
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS    = 1
        ).

    CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_fes).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Exception caught: { lx_fes->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_directory_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fes_create_dir( ).
    " Attempt to create a directory in a protected system path (e.g., root of C: without admin rights)
    DATA(lv_protected_path) = 'C:\ProtectedTestDir'.
    DATA(lv_success) = abap_true.

    TRY.
        lv_success = lo_cut->create_frontend_directory( iv_directory_path = lv_protected_path ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for creating directory in protected path' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Expected exception caught
          MSG = 'Expected exception for directory creation failure' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein Verzeichnis auf dem Frontend des Benutzers erstellt wird. Die Methode `cl_gui_frontend_services=>create_directory` wird verwendet. Die Rückgabe erfolgt als `abap_bool`, um den Erfolg der Operation anzuzeigen. Die Fehlerbehandlung ist über `TRY...CATCH` implementiert.
keywords: Frontend, Directory, Create, GUI, abap_bool

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Flugdaten zusammen mit einer fortlaufenden Nummer (basierend auf dem Index der Zeile in der Schleife) enthält. Verwenden Sie dabei den `VALUE` Operator und `sy-tabix`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und `sy-tabix` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_syt_flight_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_indexed,
             index TYPE i,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_indexed.
    TYPES tt_flight_indexed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_indexed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_index
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_indexed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_syt_flight_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_index.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                            ( index = sy-tabix
                              carrid = flight-carrid
                              connid = flight-connid
                              fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_index FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_index.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_syt_flight_index( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_index( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry index should be 1' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-index exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry index should be 2' act = lt_result[ 2 ]-index exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `VALUE` Operators in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu füllen. `sy-tabix` wird innerhalb der Schleife verwendet, um den aktuellen Zeilenindex zu erhalten, was eine kompakte und lesbare Art der Datenaggregation ermöglicht.
keywords: sy-tabix, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die einen geraden Zeilenindex (basierend auf der Reihenfolge der Selektion) haben. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator und `LINE_INDEX`.

CLASS zcl_syt_filter_even_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_even_indexed_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_syt_filter_even_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_even_indexed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE ( ( line_index( ) MOD 2 ) = 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die kumulative Summe der Flugpreise für die ersten 5 Flüge aus SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator und `sy-tabix` (oder `LINE_INDEX`).
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und die Summe zu akkumulieren. Beachten Sie, dass `sy-tabix` in `REDUCE` nicht direkt verfügbar ist, aber `LINE_INDEX` in einem `FOR` Ausdruck verwendet werden kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_syt_cumulative_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_cumulative_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_cumulative_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_syt_cumulative_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cumulative_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rv_cumulative_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_cumulative_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_cumulative_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_syt_cumulative_price( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Cumulative price should not be zero' act = lv_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Cumulative price should be positive' act = lv_result > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und kumulative Berechnungen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle zu durchlaufen und einen einzelnen Wert zu berechnen, ohne explizite Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen. Obwohl `sy-tabix` hier nicht direkt verwendet wird, ist das Konzept der sequentiellen Verarbeitung und Indexierung relevant, und `REDUCE` bietet eine modernere Alternative für solche Szenarien.
keywords: sy-tabix, REDUCE, Data Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS. Geben Sie dann den 'carrid' des dritten Eintrags aus, indem Sie einen Tabellenausdruck mit dem Index verwenden. Demonstrieren Sie, wie `sy-tabix` indirekt durch den Index in Tabellenausdrücken ersetzt wird.

CLASS zcl_syt_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_third_flight_carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.

CLASS zcl_syt_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_third_flight_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) >= 3.
      rv_carrid = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-carrid.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus SFLIGHTS. Formatieren Sie diese Liste als einen einzigen String, wobei jede Fluggesellschaft mit ihrer fortlaufenden Nummer (1., 2., 3. usw.) versehen ist. Nutzen Sie String-Templates und `sy-tabix`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP` Schleife mit `sy-tabix` und String-Templates zur Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_syt_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_carrids_with_index
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_syt_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_carrids_with_index.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      rv_formatted_string = rv_formatted_string && |{ sy-tabix }. { ls_flight-carrid }\n|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_syt_string_template( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->format_carrids_with_index( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result string should not be empty' act = lv_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Result should contain index 1' act = lv_result exp = '1.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Result should contain index 2' act = lv_result exp = '2.' ).

explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind eine moderne und sehr flexible Art, Strings in ABAP zu konstruieren. In Kombination mit `sy-tabix` innerhalb einer `LOOP` Schleife können dynamische, formatierte Ausgaben einfach erstellt werden.
keywords: sy-tabix, String Templates, LOOP, SFLIGHTS

hint: Die Klasse `cl_pak_package_queries` bietet keine direkte Methode zum Abrufen von Objekten. Kombinieren Sie sie mit `SELECT` auf `TADIR` und `TRDIR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_get_classes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_classes_in_package
      IMPORTING iv_package_name TYPE pak_package_name
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_class_names) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF seoclassname WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_get_classes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_classes_in_package.
    DATA lt_tadir TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tadir WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT obj_name FROM tadir INTO TABLE @lt_tadir

solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_sql_union_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen oder mit unterschiedlichen Kriterien in einem einzigen Datenbankzugriff zu aggregieren.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flugverbindungen (CONNID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' angeboten werden, aber NICHT von der Fluggesellschaft 'AA'.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sql_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_only_connids.
    SELECT DISTINCT connid
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    EXCEPT

      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_connids IS INITIAL ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt Verbindungen, die nur LH anbietet
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Sollte mindestens eine Verbindung finden' act = lines( lt_connids ) > 0 ).
    " Überprüfung, ob eine bekannte LH-Verbindung enthalten ist, die AA nicht hat
    " (Dies erfordert Kenntnis der Testdaten, hier ein Beispiel)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Sollte CONNID 0400 enthalten (Beispiel)' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_connids[ table_line = '0400' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Sollte CONNID 0017 nicht enthalten (Beispiel, da von AA angeboten)' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_connids[ table_line = '0017' ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `EXCEPT` Operator in Open SQL ist eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, die Differenzmenge zweier Ergebnismengen zu ermitteln. Er liefert alle Zeilen, die in der ersten `SELECT`-Anweisung vorhanden sind, aber nicht in der zweiten. Dies ist effizienter und lesbarer als manuelle Vergleiche mit `NOT IN` oder `LEFT JOIN` mit `IS NULL`.
keywords: Open SQL, EXCEPT, SFLIGHTS, Set Operations, Data Filtering

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft für 'LH' und 'AA' aus SFLIGHTS und fügen Sie eine Spalte hinzu, die angibt, ob es sich um eine 'High-Price' (Preis > 500) oder 'Low-Price' (Preis <= 500) Kategorie handelt. Verwenden Sie `UNION` und `CASE` im `SELECT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UNION ALL` mit einer `CASE`-Anweisung im `SELECT`-Statement, um die Kategorie zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price_cat TYPE string,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flight_counts.
    SELECT carrid, 
           CASE WHEN price > 500 THEN 'High-Price' ELSE 'Low-Price' END AS price_cat,
           COUNT(*) AS num_flights
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      GROUP BY carrid, CASE WHEN price > 500 THEN 'High-Price' ELSE 'Low-Price' END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, 
           CASE WHEN price > 500 THEN 'High-Price' ELSE 'Low-Price' END AS price_cat,
           COUNT(*) AS num_flights
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      GROUP BY carrid, CASE WHEN price > 500 THEN 'High-Price' ELSE 'Low-Price' END
      INTO TABLE @rt_summaries.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_union_case FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_case.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_case( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_categorized_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_summaries IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Sollte LH High-Price enthalten' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_summaries[ carrid = 'LH' price_cat = 'High-Price' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Sollte AA Low-Price enthalten' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_summaries[ carrid = 'AA' price_cat = 'Low-Price' ] ) ) ).
    
    DATA(lv_total_flights_lh) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_summary) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_total_flights_lh = lv_total_flights_lh + ls_summary-num_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH sollte Flüge haben' act = lv_total_flights_lh > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `UNION ALL` mit `CASE`-Ausdrücken direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Kategorisierung und Aggregation von Daten direkt auf der Datenbankebene, was die Datenverarbeitung im ABAP-Programm reduziert und die Performance verbessert. Die `GROUP BY`-Klausel muss alle nicht-aggregierten Felder enthalten, einschließlich des `CASE`-Ausdrucks.
keywords: Open SQL, UNION ALL, CASE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Data Categorization

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Ganzzahlen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und anschließend die Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
    IF lines( it_numbers ) > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lines( it_numbers ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `MAX` in einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um den maximalen Wert zu finden und das zugehörige Tabellenfeld zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_flight_price RETURNING VALUE(rs_max_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rs_max_flight = REDUCE ty_sflight_price(
          INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_sflight_price( price = 0 )
          FOR flight IN lt_sflights
          WHERE ( price IS NOT INITIAL )
          NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_flight-price THEN VALUE ty_sflight_price( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid price = flight-price ) ELSE max_flight )
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_timer` und registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `TICK`-Ereignis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` und definieren Sie eine Methode `FOR EVENT TICK OF cl_gui_timer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS tick_event EXPORTING VALUE(sender) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS setup_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_timer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.
    METHODS handle_tick FOR EVENT tick OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    SET HANDLER handle_tick FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->start( ).
    ro_timer = mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_tick.
    " In a real GUI context, this method would be called periodically.
    " For demonstration, we just know it's registered.
    " We raise a custom event to make it testable if needed, though the timer itself won't tick in unit test.
    RAISE EVENT tick_event EXPORTING sender = sender.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_event_receiver TYPE REF TO lcl_event_receiver.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS test_event_handler_registration FOR TESTING.

  CLASS lcl_event_receiver DEFINITION FOR TESTING.
    PUBLIC SECTION.
      CLASS-METHODS handle_custom_tick FOR EVENT tick_event OF zcl_gui_timer_event IMPORTING sender.
      CLASS-DATA gv_tick_received TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS lcl_event_receiver IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD handle_custom_tick.
      gv_tick_received = abap_true.
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    CLEAR lcl_event_receiver=>gv_tick_received.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_event_handler_registration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_event( ).
    DATA(lv_interval) = 100.

    " Register handler for the custom event raised by the solution class
    SET HANDLER lcl_event_receiver=>handle_custom_tick FOR lo_cut.

    DATA(lo_timer) = lo_cut->setup_timer( lv_interval ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Timer object should be created' act = lo_timer ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Timer interval should be set correctly' exp = lv_interval act = lo_timer->interval ).

    " Note: We cannot directly test if the cl_gui_timer's TICK event fired.
    " The test verifies that the setup for event handling is correctly implemented.
    " If the timer were to tick in a GUI context, the handle_tick method would be called.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Registrierung eines Event-Handlers (`handle_tick`) für das `TICK`-Ereignis des `cl_gui_timer`. Die Methode `FOR EVENT ... OF ...` ist der moderne Weg, Event-Handler zu definieren. `SET HANDLER` verbindet den Handler mit der Timer-Instanz. Der Unit-Test kann die Registrierung des Handlers überprüfen, aber nicht die tatsächliche Ausführung des `TICK`-Ereignisses, da dies einen aktiven GUI-Kontext erfordert.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, EVENTS, SET HANDLER, TICK, Event Handling, GUI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_timer`, starten Sie ihn und stoppen Sie ihn dann wieder, inklusive Freigabe der Ressourcen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `start()`, `stop()` und `free()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_stop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_timer_cycle
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_timer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_stop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_timer_cycle.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_timer.
    ro_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    ro_timer->start( ).
    " In a real scenario, there would be some processing or waiting here
    " before stopping. For this example, we stop immediately.
    ro_timer->stop( ).
    " Optionally free the control to release GUI resources
    CALL METHOD ro_timer->free
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error        = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS            = 3.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_timer_stop_and_free FOR TESTING RAISING cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_stop_and_free.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_stop( ).
    DATA(lv_interval) = 1000.
    DATA(lo_timer) = lo_cut->run_timer_cycle( lv_interval ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Timer object should be created' act = lo_timer ).
    " We cannot assert that the timer is actually 'stopped' or 'freed' in a headless test
    " beyond ensuring the methods can be called without immediate exceptions.
    " The successful execution of run_timer_cycle implies stop() and free() were called.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den Lebenszyklus eines `cl_gui_timer` von der Erstellung über das Starten und Stoppen bis zur Freigabe der GUI-Ressourcen mit `free()`. Das explizite Freigeben von GUI-Controls ist wichtig, um Speicherlecks und Performance-Probleme in GUI-Anwendungen zu vermeiden. Der Unit-Test bestätigt die korrekte Aufrufbarkeit der Methoden.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, stop, free, Resource Management, GUI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Beschreiben Sie die konzeptionelle Verwendung eines `cl_gui_timer` zur Auslösung von Hintergrundaufgaben in einem GUI-Kontext.
hint: Timer-Ereignisse können zur periodischen Aktualisierung von Daten oder zur Ausführung leichter Hintergrundaufgaben genutzt werden, ohne das GUI zu blockieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_background DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS setup_background_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 5000 " 5 seconds
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_timer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.
    METHODS handle_background_task FOR EVENT tick OF cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS get_task_counter RETURNING VALUE(rv_counter) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_background IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup_background_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_timer.
    ro_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    SET HANDLER handle_background_task FOR ro_timer.
    ro_timer->start( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_background_task.
    " This method would be called periodically by the timer.
    " Here, we simulate a light background task, e.g., checking for new messages.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + 1.
    " In a real application, this might involve:
    " - Calling a function module in a new task (CALL FUNCTION ... STARTING NEW TASK)
    " - Updating a GUI element with new data
    " - Checking a status
    " IMPORTANT: Heavy processing should NOT be done directly in event handlers
    " as it blocks the GUI. Use asynchronous calls or separate processes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_task_counter.
    rv_counter = mv_counter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_background_timer_setup FOR TESTING RAISING cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_background_timer_setup.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_background( ).
    DATA(lv_interval) = 2000.
    DATA(lo_timer) = lo_cut->setup_background_timer( lv_interval ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Timer object should be created' act = lo_timer ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Timer interval should be set correctly' exp = lv_interval act = lo_timer->interval ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Initial counter should be 0' exp = 0 act = lo_cut->get_task_counter( ) ).

    " Note: The actual execution of handle_background_task via the timer's TICK event
    " cannot be tested in a headless ABAP Unit environment. This test verifies the setup.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erläutert die konzeptionelle Verwendung von `cl_gui_timer` zur Auslösung periodischer, leichter Hintergrundaufgaben in einer GUI-Anwendung. Der Timer löst ein `TICK`-Ereignis aus, das von einem Event-Handler verarbeitet wird. Dies ermöglicht es, Aufgaben auszuführen (z.B. Datenaktualisierung, Statusprüfung), ohne die Benutzeroberfläche zu blockieren. Für rechenintensive Aufgaben sollten asynchrone Methoden (z.B. `CALL FUNCTION ... STARTING NEW TASK`) verwendet werden, um die GUI-Performance nicht zu beeinträchtigen.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, Background Task, Asynchronous, Event Handling, GUI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die grundlegende Fehlerbehandlung beim Umgang mit `cl_gui_timer`.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_timer_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_timer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_timer_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_timer.
        ro_timer->interval = iv_interval.
        ro_timer->start( ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
        " Handle GUI exceptions, e.g., if GUI environment is not available
        " or control creation fails.
        MESSAGE lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        CLEAR ro_timer.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

    " depends on the underlying GUI environment. This test focuses on the successful path.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_error_handling_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_interval) = 1000.

Da `cl_gui_timer` ein GUI-Control ist, können Fehler auftreten, wenn keine GUI-Umgebung verfügbar ist oder andere GUI-bezogene Probleme vorliegen. Eine robuste Anwendung sollte solche Ausnahmen abfangen und entsprechend reagieren.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights`, die mindestens eine Verbindung mit einer Kapazität von über 300 Plätzen haben. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT DISTINCT` in Kombination mit einer Subquery oder einem `EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_distinct_carriers_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carriers_with_high_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distinct_carriers_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_high_capacity.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights AS s1
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sflights AS s2
                       WHERE s2~carrid = s1~carrid
                         AND s2~seatsmax > 300 )
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_carriers_with_high_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carriers_with_high_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_distinct_carriers_capacity( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_high_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has connections with seatsmax > 300
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY table_line = 'LH' TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 msg = 'LH should be in the list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `SELECT DISTINCT` mit einer korrelierten Subquery unter Verwendung von `EXISTS`. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Datensätze zu filtern, die bestimmte Bedingungen in einer verknüpften Tabelle erfüllen. Die Inline-Deklaration und der Host-Variablen-Escape-Operator (`@`) tragen zur modernen Syntax bei.
keywords: SELECT DISTINCT, EXISTS, Subquery, Database Access, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_s_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <lv_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_access( ).
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE zcl_dyn_field_access=>ty_s_data.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Hello'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 123.

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Test Field1' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = '123' msg = 'Test Field2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_access( ).
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE zcl_dyn_field_access=>ty_s_data.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Hello'.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Field not found' msg = 'Test Non-existent Field' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` Anweisung ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit. Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, basierend auf einem Index, und ändern Sie einen Feldwert in dieser Zeile.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ct_flights[ index ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_row_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_index      TYPE i
        iv_new_price  TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_row_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_flight> TYPE ty_s_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_price>  TYPE sflight-price.

    " Dynamischer Zugriff auf die Zeile
    ASSIGN ct_flights[ iv_index ] TO <ls_flight>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Dynamischer Zugriff auf die Komponente 'PRICE' in der Zeile
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_flight> TO <lv_price>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_price> = iv_new_price.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (object_ref)->(method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      method_a IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string,
      method_b IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string,
      execute_dynamic_method
        IMPORTING
          iv_method_name TYPE string
          iv_input_value TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_output = |Method A called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_output = |Method B called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        " Dynamischer Methodenaufruf
        CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name) EXPORTING iv_input = iv_input_value RECEIVING rv_output = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or invalid call.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'METHOD_A' iv_input_value = 'Test A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Method A called with: Test A' msg = 'Call Method A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'METHOD_B' iv_input_value = 'Test B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Method B called with: Test B' msg = 'Call Method B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' iv_input_value = 'Invalid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Method ''NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'' not found or invalid call.' msg = 'Call Invalid Method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD (object_ref)->(method_name)` ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible und erweiterbare Architekturen. Es erlaubt, die auszuführende Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen, was in Szenarien wie Plugin-Architekturen oder generischen Event-Handlern nützlich ist. Der `TRY...CATCH` Block ist entscheidend, um Fehler bei nicht existierenden Methoden abzufangen.
keywords: CALL METHOD, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, Method Call, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und modifizieren Sie die Zeilen direkt mit einem Feldsymbol.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_item.
    TYPES: ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      CHANGING
        ct_items TYPE ty_t_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_item> TYPE ty_s_item.

    LOOP AT ct_items ASSIGNING <ls_item>.
      <ls_item>-value = |Processed: { <ls_item>-value }|.
      <ls_item>-id = <ls_item>-id * 10.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_assigning( ).
    DATA: lt_test_items TYPE zcl_loop_assigning=>ty_t_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'Item A' ) TO lt_test_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 'Item B' ) TO lt_test_items.

    lo_cut->process_items( CHANGING ct_items = lt_test_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_items[ 1 ]-value exp = 'Processed: Item A' msg = 'First item value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_items[ 1 ]-id exp = 10 msg = 'First item id' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_items[ 2 ]-value exp = 'Processed: Item B' msg = 'Second item value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_items[ 2 ]-id exp = 20 msg = 'Second item id' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>`-Anweisung ist die effizienteste Methode, um interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen, wenn Zeilen direkt modifiziert werden müssen. Im Gegensatz zu `LOOP AT ... INTO wa` wird hier keine Kopie der Zeile erstellt, sondern das Feldsymbol zeigt direkt auf die Tabellenzeile. Dies spart Speicher und verbessert die Performance, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: LOOP AT, ASSIGNING, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit definierten Strukturtyp und fügen Sie Daten hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` für den Zeilentyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    " Define components dynamically
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " All fields as string for simplicity
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create dynamic structure type
    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Create dynamic internal table type
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Add data dynamically
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line_data) TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_line_data->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

    " Fill first row
    ASSIGN COMPONENT it_field_names[ 1 ] OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_field_val>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <lv_field_val> = 'Value 1A'.
    ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT it_field_names[ 2 ] OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_val>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <lv_field_val> = 'Value 1B'.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill second row
    ASSIGN COMPONENT it_field_names[ 1 ] OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_val>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <lv_field_val> = 'Value 2A'.
    ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT it_field_names[ 2 ] OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_val>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <lv_field_val> = 'Value 2B'.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_itab_create( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD_A' ) ( 'FIELD_B' ) ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_names ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_dynamic_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table should have 2 entries' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ls_line> msg = 'First line should be assigned' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field_val> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field_val>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field_val> exp = 'Value 1A' msg = 'First line, Field A' ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field_val>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field_val> exp = 'Value 1B' msg = 'First line, Field B' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field_val>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field_val> exp = 'Value 2A' msg = 'Second line, Field A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Es wird zur Laufzeit ein Strukturtyp mit variablen Komponenten definiert und darauf basierend eine interne Tabelle erstellt. Die `CREATE DATA` Anweisung mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` ist hierbei zentral, um mit generischen Datenreferenzen und Feldsymbolen zu arbeiten. Dies ist nützlich für generische Schnittstellen oder Tools, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen.
keywords: CREATE DATA, TYPE HANDLE, ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, RTTI

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Downcast von einer generischen Referenz auf eine spezifische Klasse durch und greifen Sie auf eine Methode der spezifischen Klasse zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN (object_ref)->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und dann `CAST` oder `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_generic_object.
  METHODS get_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_specific_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_generic_object.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i.
    METHODS get_specific_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_id TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_specific_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_id = iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_generic_object~get_id.
    rv_id = mv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_specific_name.
    rv_name = |Specific Object { mv_id }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_downcast_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_generic_object
      IMPORTING
        io_generic_object TYPE REF TO zif_generic_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_downcast_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_generic_object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lo_specific> TYPE zcl_specific_object.

    " Versuch des Downcasts
    ASSIGN io_generic_object->* TO <lo_specific> CASTING.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_result = |ID: { <lo_specific>->zif_generic_object~get_id() }, Name: { <lo_specific>->get_specific_name() }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Object is not of type ZCL_SPECIFIC_OBJECT'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_downcast FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_downcast FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_downcast.
    DATA(lo_specific) = NEW zcl_specific_object( 10 ).
    DATA(lo_generic) = CAST zif_generic_object( lo_specific ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_downcast_demo( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_generic_object( lo_generic_object = lo_generic ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ID: 10, Name: Specific Object 10' msg = 'Successful downcast' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_downcast.
    " Create a dummy object that implements the interface but is not ZCL_SPECIFIC_OBJECT
    CLASS lcl_another_object DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_generic_object.
        METHODS zif_generic_object~get_id.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_another_object IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_generic_object~get_id.
        RETURN.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_another) = NEW lcl_another_object( ).
    DATA(lo_generic) = CAST zif_generic_object( lo_another ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_downcast_demo( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_generic_object( lo_generic_object = lo_generic ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Object is not of type ZCL_SPECIFIC_OBJECT' msg = 'Failed downcast' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den Downcast von einer generischen Interface-Referenz auf eine spezifische Klassenreferenz unter Verwendung von `ASSIGN ... CASTING`. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept der Objektorientierung, das es ermöglicht, auf spezifische Methoden einer Klasse zuzugreifen, die nicht Teil des generischen Interfaces sind. Es ist wichtig, den `sy-subrc` nach dem `ASSIGN` zu prüfen, um sicherzustellen, dass der Downcast erfolgreich war und Laufzeitfehler vermieden werden.
keywords: ASSIGN, CASTING, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Object Orientation, RTTI, Downcast, Interface

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten zwischen zwei Strukturen mit unterschiedlichen Feldnamen, aber ähnlicher Semantik, unter Verwendung von `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit `BEGIN OF ... END OF` Strukturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_source,
             id      TYPE i,
             text    TYPE string,
             amount  TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_s_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_target,
             item_id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             value   TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             status  TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_s_target.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_s_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_s_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    " MOVE-CORRESPONDING kopiert Felder mit gleichen Namen
    " oder durch Mapping-Regeln definierte Felder.
    " Hier: id -> item_id, text -> description, amount -> value
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING is_source TO rs_target BY NAMES.

    " Zusätzliche Felder manuell setzen
    rs_target-status = 'A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_corresponding( ).
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_move_corresponding=>ty_s_source.
    ls_source-id = 100.
    ls_source-text = 'Sample Text'.
    ls_source-amount = '123.45'.

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-item_id exp = 100 msg = 'ID mapped to ITEM_ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-description exp = 'Sample Text' msg = 'TEXT mapped to DESCRIPTION' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-value exp = '123.45' msg = 'AMOUNT mapped to VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'A' msg = 'STATUS set manually' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `MOVE-CORRESPONDING ... BY NAMES` ist eine effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu kopieren, deren Komponenten zwar unterschiedliche Namen, aber gleiche Typen und semantische Bedeutung haben. Sie erspart das manuelle Zuweisen jedes einzelnen Feldes und ist besonders nützlich bei der Transformation von Daten zwischen verschiedenen Schichten einer Anwendung. Die Verwendung von `BEGIN OF ... END OF` zur Definition der Strukturen ist hierbei die klassische und weiterhin gültige Methode.

CLASS zcl_dyn_deep_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_address,
             street TYPE string,
             city   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_address.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_person,
             name    TYPE string,
             age     TYPE i,
             address TYPE ty_s_address,
           END OF ty_s_person.

    METHODS get_deep_value
      IMPORTING
        is_person      TYPE ty_s_person
        iv_component_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_deep_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_deep_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field> TYPE any.

    " Dynamischer Zugriff auf eine tiefe Komponente
    ASSIGN (iv_component_path) OF STRUCTURE is_person TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <lv_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component path not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise pro Gruppe, ohne explizite `LOOP AT ... ENDLOOP` mit `COLLECT` oder `AT NEW` zu verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `ASSIGNING` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carr_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_carr_total.
    TYPES: ty_t_carr_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carr_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carr_totals) TYPE ty_t_carr_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sorted_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight.

    " Sortieren ist für GROUP BY nicht zwingend, aber gute Praxis für konsistente Ergebnisse
    lt_sorted_flights = SORT it_flights BY carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_sorted_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_flight>)
      GROUP BY <ls_flight>-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR <ls_group_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <ls_group_member>-price
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_carr_totals.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_reduce( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_group_by_reduce=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = '150.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' fldate = sy-datum price = '250.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_carr_totals) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carr_totals ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 carrier totals' ).

    DATA(ls_lh_total) = lt_carr_totals[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_total-total_price exp = '250.00' msg = 'LH total price' ).

    DATA(ls_ua_total) = lt_carr_totals[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_total-total_price exp = '450.00' msg = 'UA total price' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

GROUP BY` Anweisung in Kombination mit `ASSIGNING` und dem funktionalen Operator `REDUCE` ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt die älteren `AT NEW`/`AT END` Konstrukte und bietet eine klarere Syntax. `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_flight>)` stellt sicher, dass keine unnötigen Datenkopien erstellt werden, was die Performance weiter verbessert.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten, und verwenden Sie dabei eine moderne Syntax.

CLASS zcl_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_carrier     TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    " Filtern der internen Tabelle mit dem FILTER Operator
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Komponenten einer Struktur und deren Typen und geben Sie diese aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI-Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field_char TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_int  TYPE i,
             field_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_s_data.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_s_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lr_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    " Get RTTI description for the structure
    CREATE DATA lr_data_ref LIKE is_data.
    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_data_ref ).
    lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
      APPEND |Component: { ls_component-name }, Type: { ls_component-type_descr->get_type_kind_as_char() } ({ ls_component-type_descr->get_length() })| TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle (beliebigen Typs) als Referenz entgegennimmt und eine bestimmte Spalte dynamisch summiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die Tabelle und die Spalte, sowie `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sum_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value1    TYPE i,
             value2    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_dynamic_column
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data " Generic reference to any internal table
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sum_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_dynamic_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_any_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_any_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_data->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <lt_any_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_sum = REDUCE p(
      INIT total_sum = 0
      FOR <ls_line> IN <lt_any_table>
      NEXT
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_any_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_any_value> IS ASSIGNED.
          total_sum = total_sum + <lv_any_value>.
        ENDIF
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lr_table_ref) = REF #( lt_test_data ).

    DATA(lr_table_ref) = REF #( lt_test_data ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_sum_column( ).
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_dyn_sum_column=>ty_t_data.

    DATA(lr_table_ref) = REF #( lt_test_data ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_dynamic_column( ir_table_data = lr_table_ref iv_column_name = 'VALUE1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '0.00' msg = 'Sum of empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
