Die Methode akzeptiert eine generische Referenz auf eine interne Tabelle (`REF TO data`) und summiert dynamisch eine angegebene Spalte. Dies wird durch die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die Tabelle und die Zeilen sowie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Spaltenzugriff ermöglicht. Der `REDUCE` Operator bietet eine prägnante und effiziente Möglichkeit, die Summe zu berechnen, ohne eine explizite `LOOP` Schleife mit Zwischenvariablen zu benötigen.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, REDUCE, Generic, BEGIN OF

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine lokale Struktur und eine interne Tabelle mit Kopfzeile, um die Verwendung von `BEGIN OF ... OCCURS 0` zu demonstrieren (obwohl veraltet, ist es wichtig, es zu kennen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA: BEGIN OF ... OCCURS 0 ... END OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_old_header_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_s_flight_data.

    " Veraltete Deklaration einer internen Tabelle mit Kopfzeile
    DATA: BEGIN OF gt_flights OCCURS 0,
            carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
            connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
            fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
          END OF gt_flights.

    METHODS fill_and_read_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_old_header_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_and_read_flights.
    " Daten in die Kopfzeile schreiben und an die Tabelle anhängen
    gt_flights-carrid = 'LH'.
    gt_flights-connid = '0400'.
    gt_flights-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND gt_flights.

    gt_flights-carrid = 'UA'.
    gt_flights-connid = '0010'.
    gt_flights-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND gt_flights.

    " Lesen der Tabelle über die Kopfzeile
    LOOP AT gt_flights.
      APPEND |Carrier: { gt_flights-carrid }, Connection: { gt_flights-connid }| TO rt_flight_info.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Tabelle leeren (wichtig bei Kopfzeilen)
    CLEAR gt_flights.
    REFRESH gt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_fill_and_read.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_old_header_line( ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine gegebene Datenreferenz auf eine Struktur verweist, die eine bestimmte Komponente enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_component_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data_a,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data_a.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data_b,
             field_x TYPE string,
             field_y TYPE d,
           END OF ty_s_data_b.

    METHODS has_component
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref   TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_component) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_component_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_component.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_component> TYPE any.

    " Check if the data reference points to a structure
    ASSIGN ir_data_ref->* TO <ls_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR NOT ( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <ls_structure> )->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct ).
      rv_has_component = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Attempt to assign the component dynamically
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_structure> TO <lv_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_has_component = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_has_component = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `ASSIGNING` um eine neue Tabelle zu generieren, die nur bestimmte Felder enthält und diese modifiziert.

CLASS zcl_for_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_summary,
             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             adjusted_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_summary.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_t_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR <ls_flight> IN it_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>)
      ( carrier = <fs_flight>-carrid
        flight_id = <fs_flight>-connid
        adjusted_price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.10' ) " 10% Preiserhöhung
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die Kombination aus dem `FOR` Operator und `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(...)` innerhalb einer `VALUE #(...)` Konstruktion ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke Art, interne Tabellen zu transformieren. Sie ermöglicht es, eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, indem man über eine bestehende iteriert und dabei direkt auf die Zeilen der Quelltabelle zugreift (ohne Kopie). Dies ist effizient und führt zu sehr kompaktem, funktionalem Code, der die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit verbessert. Die Verwendung von `BEGIN OF ... END OF` zur Definition der Strukturen ist hierbei die klassische und weiterhin gültige Methode.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle (beliebigen Typs) als Referenz entgegennimmt und eine neue Tabelle zurückgibt, die nur die Werte einer dynamisch angegebenen Spalte enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... ASSIGNING ...` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb von `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_extract_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value1    TYPE i,
             value2    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_column_values
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data " Generic reference to any internal table
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_column_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_extract_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_any_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_any_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_data->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <lt_any_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_column_values = VALUE #(
      FOR <ls_line> IN <lt_any_table>
      LET lv_extracted_value = '' IN
      ( COND string(
          WHEN sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_any_value> IS ASSIGNED THEN |
            ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_any_value>.
            { <lv_any_value> }|
          ELSE ''
        )
      )
    ).

    " The above LET/COND is a bit complex for direct assignment. A simpler approach:
    CLEAR rt_column_values.
    LOOP AT <lt_any_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_any_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_any_value> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND |{ <lv_any_value> }| TO rt_column_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Obwohl der `FOR` Operator mit `LET/COND` eine funktionale Lösung bieten könnte, ist eine explizite `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` Schleife mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` oft klarer und einfacher zu implementieren, wenn dynamische Zuweisungen innerhalb der Schleife erforderlich sind. Dies ist ein Kernstück der dynamischen Datenverarbeitung in ABAP.

CLASS zcl_xco_rest_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS:
      call_rest_api
        IMPORTING
          iv_url TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rs_json_data) TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_xco_rest_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1'.
    TRY.
        DATA(lr_json_data) = call_rest_api( lv_url ).
        " Output the parsed JSON (for demonstration)
        DATA(lv_json_string) = xco_cp_json=>serialization_factory->create( lr_json_data )->get_json( ).
        out->write( |JSON Response from { lv_url }:{ NEWLINE }{ lv_json_string }| ).
      CATCH cx_xco_cp_http_client_error cx_xco_cp_json_error INTO DATA(lx_xco_error).
        out->write( |Error calling REST API: { lx_xco_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_rest_api.
    DATA(lo_http_client) = xco_cp_http_client=>for_url( iv_url ).
    DATA(lo_http_response) = lo_http_client->get( ).
    DATA(lv_response_body) = lo_http_response->get_body( ).

    " Parse JSON response
    rs_json_data = xco_cp_json=>parsing_factory->create( lv_response_body )->as_data_reference( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_odata_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

      generate_odata_service
        IMPORTING
          iv_service_name TYPE xco_gen_odata_service_name
          iv_cds_view     TYPE xco_gen_cds_view_name.

CLASS zcl_xco_odata_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_service_name) = 'Z_MY_ODATA_SERVICE'.
    DATA(lv_cds_view) = 'I_PRODUCT'. "Using a standard CDS view for demonstration

    out->write( |Attempting to generate OData Service '{ lv_service_name }' for CDS View '{ lv_cds_view }'...| ).
    TRY.
        generate_odata_service(
          iv_service_name = lv_service_name
          iv_cds_view     = lv_cds_view
        ).
        out->write( |OData Service generation initiated successfully (check system for actual creation).| ).
      CATCH cx_xco_cp_generation_error INTO DATA(lx_gen_error).
        out->write( |Error during OData Service generation: { lx_gen_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD generate_odata_service.
    DATA(lo_generation_request) = xco_cp_generation_factory=>create_request( ).
    DATA(lo_odata_service_definition) = lo_generation_request->for_odata_service_definition( ).

    lo_odata_service_definition->set_name( iv_service_name
      )->set_description( |Generated OData Service for { iv_cds_view }|
      )->set_version( xco_cp_odata_service_definition=>version->v2
      )->set_binding_type( xco_cp_odata_service_definition=>binding_type->odata_v2_ui
      )->set_source_cds_view( iv_cds_view ).

    lo_generation_request->execute( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein gegebenes Bild (als XSTRING) von einem Format in ein anderes (z.B. von BMP zu PNG) unter Verwendung von CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode CONVERT_IMAGE der Klasse CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR. Beachten Sie, dass die Klasse möglicherweise nicht in allen Systemen verfügbar ist oder spezielle Konfigurationen erfordert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_img_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS:
      convert_image_format
        IMPORTING
          iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
          iv_target_format TYPE string " e.g., 'PNG', 'JPG'
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_converted_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    " Dummy BMP image data (minimal valid BMP header + 1 pixel, red)
    DATA(lv_bmp_xstring) = '424D3A0000000000000036000000280000000100000001000000010018000000000004000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000FF0000'.
    DATA(lv_target_format) = 'PNG'.

    out->write( |Attempting to convert image to { lv_target_format }...| ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_converted_xstring) = convert_image_format(
          iv_image_xstring = lv_bmp_xstring
          iv_target_format = lv_target_format
        ).
        IF lv_converted_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
          out->write( |Image converted successfully. Length: { xstrlen( lv_converted_xstring ) } bytes.| ).
        ELSE.
          out->write( |Image conversion failed or resulted in empty data.| ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_processor INTO DATA(lx_img_error).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für XCO-basierte externe API-Aufrufe, indem Sie spezifische XCO-Exception-Klassen abfangen.
hint: Nutzen Sie TRY...CATCH Blöcke und fangen Sie spezifische XCO-Exception-Klassen wie CX_XCO_CP_HTTP_CLIENT_ERROR ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS:
      call_api_with_error_handling
        IMPORTING
          iv_url TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    " Test with a valid URL
    out->write( |Calling valid API...| ).
    call_api_with_error_handling( 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1' ).
    out->write( NEWLINE ).

    " Test with an invalid URL to trigger an error
    out->write( |Calling invalid API...| ).
    call_api_with_error_handling( 'https://invalid.example.com/nonexistent' ).
    out->write( NEWLINE ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_api_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_http_client) = xco_cp_http_client=>for_url( iv_url ).
        DATA(lo_http_response) = lo_http_client->get( ).
        DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_http_response->get_status_code( ).
        IF lv_status_code >= 200 AND lv_status_code < 300.
          out->write( |API call to { iv_url } successful. Status: { lv_status_code }| ).
        ELSE.
          out->write( |API call to { iv_url } failed with status: { lv_status_code }| ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xco_cp_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        out->write( |Caught HTTP Client Error for { iv_url }: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_xco_cp_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        out->write( |Caught JSON Error for { iv_url }: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_xco_cp_exception INTO DATA(lx_xco_general_error).
        out->write( |Caught general XCO Error for { iv_url }: { lx_xco_general_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        out->write( |Caught unexpected Error for { iv_url }: { lx_general_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_api_call FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_api_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_error_handler( ).
    " This test primarily checks for no exception on a valid call.
    " Output is handled by if_oo_adt_classrun~main, so we just ensure it runs.
    lo_cut->call_api_with_error_handling( 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'No exception expected for valid call' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_api_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_error_handler( ).
    " This test expects an exception to be caught internally, not raised to the caller.
    " We can't directly assert the internal catch block, but we can ensure no unhandled dump.
    lo_cut->call_api_with_error_handling( 'https://invalid.example.com/nonexistent' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'No unhandled exception expected for invalid call' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_odata_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_service_url) = 'https://services.odata.org/V2/Northwind/Northwind.svc/'.
    DATA(lv_entity_set) = 'Customers'.

    out->write( |Consuming OData Service '{ lv_service_url }' Entity Set '{ lv_entity_set }'...| ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lr_odata_data) = consume_odata_service(
          iv_service_url = lv_service_url
          iv_entity_set  = lv_entity_set
        ).
        IF lr_odata_data IS NOT INITIAL.
          " For demonstration, we'll just indicate success and count entries.
          DATA(lt_data_table) = CAST cl_abap_table_descr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_odata_data ) )->get_table_line_type( ).
          DATA(lv_lines) = lines( CAST #( lr_odata_data )->* ).
          out->write( |Successfully retrieved { lv_lines } entries from '{ lv_entity_set }'.| ).
        ELSE.
          out->write( |No data retrieved from '{ lv_entity_set }'.| ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xco_cp_odata_client_error INTO DATA(lx_odata_error).
        out->write( |Error consuming OData Service: { lx_odata_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_xco_cp_exception INTO DATA(lx_xco_general_error).
        out->write( |Caught general XCO Error: { lx_xco_general_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD consume_odata_service.
    DATA(lo_odata_client) = xco_cp_odata_client=>for_url( iv_service_url ).
    DATA(lo_entity_set) = lo_odata_client->get_entity_set( iv_entity_set ).

    " Execute a GET request to retrieve data
    rt_odata_data = lo_entity_set->get( )->as_data_reference( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_xco_comm_system_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

          iv_system_name TYPE xco_comm_system_name

CLASS zcl_xco_comm_system_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_system_name) = 'SAP_COM_0001'. "Example: A standard communication system

    out->write( |Attempting to read Communication System '{ lv_system_name }' metadata...| ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lr_metadata) = read_communication_system_metadata( lv_system_name ).
        IF lr_metadata IS NOT INITIAL.
          out->write( |Metadata for '{ lv_system_name }' read successfully.| ).
        ELSE.
          out->write( |Communication System '{ lv_system_name }' not found or no metadata.| ).

      CATCH cx_xco_cp_comm_system_error INTO DATA(lx_comm_system_error).
        out->write( |Error reading Communication System metadata: { lx_comm_system_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_communication_system_metadata.
    DATA(lo_comm_system) = xco_cp_communication_system=>for( iv_system_name ).
    rs_metadata = lo_comm_system->read( )->as_data_reference( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_lister DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_bus_obj_key,
             objtype TYPE sibftypeid,
             objkey  TYPE sibfkey,
           END OF ty_bus_obj_key,
           BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             filename    TYPE string,
             created_by  TYPE syuname,
             created_at  TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_attachment_info,
           tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachment_details IMPORTING is_bus_obj_key TYPE ty_bus_obj_key
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_lister IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_details.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA lt_att_list TYPE cl_gos_attachment_query=>tt_attachment_list.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_query->get_attachment_list(
          EXPORTING
            ip_objtype = is_bus_obj_key-objtype
            ip_objkey  = is_bus_obj_key-objkey
          IMPORTING
            ep_attachment_list = lt_att_list
        ).

        rt_attachments = VALUE #( FOR <fs_att> IN lt_att_list ( 
                                    filename   = <fs_att>-filename,
                                    created_by = <fs_att>-created_by,
                                    created_at = <fs_att>-created_at
                                  ) ).
      CATCH cx_gos_api_error.
        " No attachments or other error, rt_attachments remains empty
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_latest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_bus_obj_key,
             objtype TYPE sibftypeid,
             objkey  TYPE sibfkey,
           END OF ty_bus_obj_key.

    METHODS get_latest_attachment_filename IMPORTING is_bus_obj_key TYPE ty_bus_obj_key
                                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_filename) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_latest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_attachment_filename.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA lt_att_list TYPE cl_gos_attachment_query=>tt_attachment_list.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_query->get_attachment_list(
          EXPORTING
            ip_objtype = is_bus_obj_key-objtype
            ip_objkey  = is_bus_obj_key-objkey
          IMPORTING
            ep_attachment_list = lt_att_list
        ).

        IF lt_att_list IS NOT INITIAL.
          SORT lt_att_list BY created_at DESCENDING.
          rv_filename = lt_att_list[ 1 ]-filename.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gos_api_error.
        " No attachments or other error, rv_filename remains initial
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anhänge pro Dokumenttyp für ein Business-Objekt und geben Sie das Ergebnis als Map zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_ATTACHMENT_LIST` und anschließend `REDUCE` für die interne Tabelle, um die Zählung durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_type_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_bus_obj_key,
             objtype TYPE sibftypeid,
             objkey  TYPE sibfkey,
           END OF ty_bus_obj_key,
           ty_doc_type_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                                 WITH VALUE TYPE so_obj_tp.

    METHODS get_attachment_count_by_type IMPORTING is_bus_obj_key TYPE ty_bus_obj_key
                                         RETURNING VALUE(rm_type_counts) TYPE ty_doc_type_count_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_type_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_count_by_type.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW cl_gos_attachment_query( ).
    DATA lt_att_list TYPE cl_gos_attachment_query=>tt_attachment_list.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_query->get_attachment_list(
          EXPORTING
            ip_objtype = is_bus_obj_key-objtype
            ip_objkey  = is_bus_obj_key-objkey
          IMPORTING
            ep_attachment_list = lt_att_list
        ).

        rm_type_counts = REDUCE ty_doc_type_count_map(
          INIT counts = VALUE ty_doc_type_count_map( )
          FOR <fs_att> IN lt_att_list
          LET doc_type = <fs_att>-doc_type IN
          NEXT counts = VALUE ty_doc_type_count_map( BASE counts ( key = doc_type value = counts[ key = doc_type ] + 1 ) )
        ).

      CATCH cx_gos_api_error.
        " No attachments or other error, rm_type_counts remains empty
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_bus_obj_key) = VALUE zcl_gos_attachment_type_count=>ty_bus_obj_key(
      objtype = 'BUS2000116'

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Rabatt für einen Flugpreis. Wenn der Preis über 1000 liegt, beträgt der Rabatt 10%, ansonsten 5%. Nutzen Sie hierfür den COND-Operator.

CLASS zcl_cond_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discount
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discount.
    rv_discounted_price = COND #( WHEN iv_price > 1000 THEN iv_price * '0.90'
                                  ELSE iv_price * '0.95' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Flügen, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen und deren Preis über 500 liegt. Nutzen Sie eine FOR-Expression mit WHEN-Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator mit einer WHERE-Klausel und WHEN für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( cityto = 'NEW YORK' AND price > 500 )
                                   ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Assert that all returned flights meet the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'CityTo mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > 500 ) msg = 'Price too low' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that at least some flights are found (assuming SFLIGHTS has such data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No flights found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FOR-Expression in Kombination mit einer WHERE-Klausel ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Sie ermöglicht es, eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, die nur die Elemente enthält, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, ohne explizite LOOP- und APPEND-Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, WHEN, FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge von 'FRANKFURT' nach 'NEW YORK' aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, aber nur für Flüge, die nach dem 01.01.2025 stattfinden. Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit einer WHEN-Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um eine Aggregation mit bedingter Logik durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_revenue
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_revenue.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                      WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND cityto = 'NEW YORK' AND flight-fldate > '20250101' )
                                      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_revenue FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_revenue.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_revenue( ).

    " This test assumes there is data in SFLIGHTS matching the criteria.
    " For a robust test, one might mock SFLIGHTS or insert test data.
    " Here, we just assert it's not initial, implying some calculation happened.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_total exp = abap_false msg = 'Total revenue is zero, check SFLIGHTS data or logic.' ).
    " More specific test would require knowing expected sum from test data.
    " Example: cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 1234.56 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit FOR und WHERE ermöglicht er, komplexe Berechnungen mit bedingter Logik in einer sehr prägnanten und funktionalen Weise durchzuführen, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: REDUCE, WHEN, Aggregation, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

        cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( if_abap_session_temperature=>co_temperature_cold ).

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS und kategorisieren Sie den Preis direkt in der SELECT-Anweisung als 'Günstig', 'Normal' oder 'Teuer' basierend auf Schwellenwerten (z.B. < 300, < 700, >= 700). Nutzen Sie hierfür CASE WHEN in Open SQL.
hint: Verwenden Sie die CASE-Expression direkt in der SELECT-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_case_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             price_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_case_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price,
           CASE WHEN price < 300 THEN 'Günstig'
                WHEN price < 700 THEN 'Normal'
                ELSE 'Teuer'
           END AS price_category
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_categorized_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_categorized_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categorized_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_case_when( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_categorized_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No flights found' ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price < 300.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'Günstig' msg = 'Category mismatch for cheap flight' ).
      ELSE IF ls_flight-price < 700.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'Normal' msg = 'Category mismatch for normal flight' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price_category exp = 'Teuer' msg = 'Category mismatch for expensive flight' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von CASE WHEN direkt in der SELECT-Anweisung von Open SQL ermöglicht es, Daten bereits auf Datenbankebene zu transformieren und zu kategorisieren. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von nachfolgenden Verarbeitungen in ABAP und kann die Performance verbessern, da weniger Daten übertragen und verarbeitet werden müssen. Es ist ein Beispiel für die erweiterte Funktionalität von Open SQL in modernen ABAP-Versionen.
keywords: SELECT, CASE WHEN, Open SQL, Database Access, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und für jede Gruppe, zählen Sie nur die Flüge, deren Preis über 600 liegt. Nutzen Sie eine FOR-Expression mit GROUP BY und einer WHEN-Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ... GROUP BY ... mit einer inneren FOR-Expression und WHEN für die bedingte Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             high_price_flights_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_high_price_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_high_price_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                                  ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                    high_price_flights_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                                        WHERE ( member-price > 600 )
                                                                        NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_grouped_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_when( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_high_price_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No grouped results found' ).

    " Example: Check if a specific carrier has a count (requires knowledge of SFLIGHTS data)
    DATA(ls_group_lh) = VALUE #( lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_group_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_group_lh-high_price_flights_count >= 0 ) msg = 'Count for LH is negative' ).
      " More specific test would require knowing expected count from test data.
      " Example: cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_lh-high_price_flights_count exp = 5 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von FOR-Expressions mit GROUP BY und einer inneren REDUCE-Expression mit WHEN-Bedingung ist ein sehr fortgeschrittenes und leistungsstarkes Muster in modernem ABAP. Es ermöglicht komplexe Gruppierungen und Aggregationen von Daten in internen Tabellen mit bedingter Logik, alles in einer deklarativen und funktionalen Weise. Dies ist wesentlich effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle LOOP- und AT NEW/END-Konstrukte.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, WHEN, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Fehlermeldung basierend auf einem Fehlercode generiert. Wenn der Fehlercode '001' ist, soll eine spezifische Meldung zurückgegeben werden, ansonsten eine generische. Nutzen Sie den MESSAGE IN A STRING-Operator mit WHEN.

solution:
CLASS zcl_message_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_error_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_code TYPE c LENGTH 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_message.
    DATA(lv_msgid) = 'ZMSG'. " Assuming a message class ZMSG exists
    DATA(lv_msgno) = SWITCH i( iv_error_code
                               WHEN '001' THEN 001 " Specific message number
                               ELSE 999 ).          " Generic message number

    MESSAGE ID lv_msgid TYPE 'I' NUMBER lv_msgno INTO rv_message.
    " For a real scenario, you would use a proper message type (E, A, W, S) and handle it.
    " Here, 'I' is used to avoid program termination in unit test.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften zurückgibt. Wenn die Session-Temperatur 'HOT' ist, sollen nur Fluggesellschaften zurückgegeben werden, die in den letzten 30 Tagen Flüge hatten. Wenn 'COLD', sollen alle Fluggesellschaften zurückgegeben werden. Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE und eine bedingte FOR-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_SESSION_TEMPERATURE=>GET_SESSION_TEMPERATURE und eine FOR-Expression mit WHEN, um die Filterung zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_by_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_by_temperature.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_date_30_days_ago) = lv_current_date - 30.

    SELECT carrid fldate
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_current_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_session_temperature( ).

    IF lv_current_temp = if_abap_session_temperature=>co_temperature_hot.
      " Filter for flights in the last 30 days for HOT temperature
      rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                             WHERE ( EXISTS( FOR member IN GROUP flight WHERE ( member-fldate >= lv_date_30_days_ago ) ( 1 ) ) )
                             ( flight-carrid ) ).
    ELSEIF lv_current_temp = if_abap_session_temperature=>co_temperature_cold.
      " Return all carriers for COLD temperature
      rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
                             ( flight-carrid ) ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle unknown temperature, e.g., return empty table
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " More specific tests would require mocking SFLIGHTS data with specific dates.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cold_no_filter.
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_session_temperature( if_abap_session_temperature=>co_temperature_cold ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_cold_carriers) = lo_cut->get_carriers_by_temperature( ).

Basierend auf der aktuellen Session-Temperatur wird eine unterschiedliche Filterlogik auf die SFLIGHTS-Daten angewendet. Bei 'HOT' werden nur Fluggesellschaften mit kürzlichen Flügen berücksichtigt, während bei 'COLD' alle Fluggesellschaften zurückgegeben werden. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem Feldnamen sortiert. Wenn der Feldname 'PRICE' ist, soll absteigend sortiert werden, ansonsten aufsteigend. Nutzen Sie den SORT-Operator mit einer WHEN-Bedingung für die Sortierrichtung.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS sort_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_sort_field TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights_dynamically.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_sorted_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights ).

    " Dynamic sort using a field symbol and conditional direction
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_sort_field OF STRUCTURE rt_sorted_flights[ 1 ] TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SORT rt_sorted_flights BY (iv_sort_field) ASCENDING.
      IF iv_sort_field = 'PRICE'.
        SORT rt_sorted_flights BY (iv_sort_field) DESCENDING.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " A more modern approach for dynamic sort direction with WHEN is not directly available
    " in the SORT statement itself for dynamic fields. The conditional logic must be external.
    " The example above shows the closest modern approach without full dynamic SQL for sorting.
    " For true dynamic sort direction, one might use dynamic SQL or a custom sort method.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sort_by_price_desc FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sort_by_carrid_asc FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_price_desc.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort_when( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_flights_dynamically( 'PRICE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_sorted ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No flights to sort' ).
    IF lines( lt_sorted ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_sorted[ 1 ]-price >= lt_sorted[ 2 ]-price ) msg = 'Price not sorted descending' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_carrid_asc.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort_when( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_flights_dynamically( 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_sorted ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No flights to sort' ).
    IF lines( lt_sorted ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_sorted[ 1 ]-carrid LE lt_sorted[ 2 ]-carrid ) msg = 'Carrid not sorted ascending' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Sortierung interner Tabellen ist ein klassisches Szenario für dynamische Programmierung. Während der SORT-Operator selbst keine direkte 'WHEN'-Syntax für die Sortierrichtung bei dynamischen Feldern bietet, kann die bedingte Logik extern angewendet werden, um die Sortierreihenfolge zu steuern. Dies zeigt, wie moderne ABAP-Features (wie CORRESPONDING für die Datenübernahme) mit traditioneller dynamischer Programmierung kombiniert werden können, um flexible Lösungen zu erstellen.
keywords: SORT, Dynamic Programming, WHEN, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_MESSAGE_PROVIDER` mit einer Methode `GET_MESSAGE` (returning `string`). Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: `ZCL_GREETING_MESSAGE` und `ZCL_FAREWELL_MESSAGE`. Die erste soll 'Hello ABAP!' zurückgeben, die zweite 'Goodbye ABAP!'. Demonstrieren Sie die polymorphe Verwendung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACES` in der Klassendefinition und `ALIASES` für die Methoden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_provider PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_greeting_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_provider~get_message.
    rv_message = 'Hello ABAP!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_farewell_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_farewell_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_provider~get_message.
    rv_message = 'Goodbye ABAP!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS process_messages
      IMPORTING
        it_providers TYPE TABLE OF REF TO zif_message_provider
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_messages.
    LOOP AT it_providers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_provider>).
      APPEND <fs_provider>->get_message( ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_message_providers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_message_providers.
    DATA: lt_providers TYPE TABLE OF REF TO zif_message_provider,
          lt_messages  TYPE string_table.

    APPEND NEW zcl_greeting_message( ) TO lt_providers.
    APPEND NEW zcl_farewell_message( ) TO lt_providers.

    lt_messages = zcl_message_processor=>process_messages( lt_providers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_messages )
      exp = 2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_messages[ 1 ]
      exp = 'Hello ABAP!'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_messages[ 2 ]
      exp = 'Goodbye ABAP!'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von Interfaces für Polymorphie. Die Methode `process_messages` kann mit jeder Klasse arbeiten, die `ZIF_MESSAGE_PROVIDER` implementiert, ohne deren konkreten Typ zu kennen. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und Erweiterbarkeit.
keywords: INTERFACE, Polymorphie, Object Orientation, CLASS, METHODS, NEW, LOOP AT, FIELD-SYMBOL

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das Interface `ZIF_MESSAGE_PROVIDER_V2` um eine Standardmethode `GET_DEFAULT_MESSAGE`, die 'Default Message' zurückgibt. Implementieren Sie eine neue Klasse `ZCL_DEFAULT_MESSAGE` die dieses Interface nutzt, aber die Standardmethode nicht überschreibt. Erstellen Sie eine weitere Klasse `ZCL_CUSTOM_DEFAULT_MESSAGE`, die die Standardmethode überschreibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DEFAULT` in der Interface-Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_provider_v2 PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_default_message DEFAULT 'Default Message' RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_default_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES zif_message_provider_v2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_default_message IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_custom_default_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_provider_v2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_default_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_provider_v2~get_message.
    rv_message = 'Another Specific Message'.
  ENDMETHOD.

    rv_message = 'Custom Default Message'.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_message_processor_v2 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS process_all_messages
      IMPORTING
        io_provider TYPE REF TO zif_message_provider_v2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor_v2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_all_messages.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_methods FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_methods.
    DATA: lt_messages TYPE string_table.

    " Test class using default implementation
    DATA(lo_default) = NEW zcl_default_message( ).
    lt_messages = zcl_message_processor_v2=>process_all_messages( lo_default ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ] exp = 'Specific Message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ] exp = 'Default Message' ).

    " Test class overriding default implementation
    DATA(lo_custom_default) = NEW zcl_custom_default_message( ).
    CLEAR lt_messages.
    lt_messages = zcl_message_processor_v2=>process_all_messages( lo_custom_default ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ] exp = 'Another Specific Message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ] exp = 'Custom Default Message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.50 führte Standardmethoden in Interfaces ein. Dies ermöglicht es, Interfaces zu erweitern, ohne alle implementierenden Klassen sofort anpassen zu müssen. Implementierende Klassen können die Standardimplementierung nutzen oder überschreiben.
keywords: INTERFACE, DEFAULT, ABAP 7.50, Object Orientation, NEW, DATA

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster. Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_CALCULATION_STRATEGY` mit einer Methode `CALCULATE` (Importing `iv_val1`, `iv_val2` vom Typ `i`, Returning `rv_result` vom Typ `i`). Erstellen Sie zwei Implementierungen: `ZCL_ADD_STRATEGY` und `ZCL_MULTIPLY_STRATEGY`. Eine Kontextklasse `ZCL_CALCULATOR` soll eine Strategie zur Laufzeit setzen und ausführen können.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Referenz auf das Interface in der Kontextklasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculation_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate
    IMPORTING
      iv_val1   TYPE i
      iv_val2   TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_val1 * iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_strategy
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy.
    METHODS execute_calculation
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1   TYPE i
        iv_val2   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD execute_calculation.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_result = mo_strategy->calculate( iv_val1 = iv_val1 iv_val2 = iv_val2 ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategy_pattern FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_strategy_set FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_pattern.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).

    " Test addition strategy
    lo_calculator->set_strategy( NEW zcl_add_strategy( ) ).
    DATA(lv_result_add) = lo_calculator->execute_calculation( iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_add exp = 8 ).

    " Test multiplication strategy
    lo_calculator->set_strategy( NEW zcl_multiply_strategy( ) ).
    DATA(lv_result_mul) = lo_calculator->execute_calculation( iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_mul exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_strategy_set.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    lo_calculator->execute_calculation( iv_val1 = 1 iv_val2 = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster ermöglicht es, Algorithmen zur Laufzeit auszutauschen. Durch die Verwendung eines Interfaces wird die `ZCL_CALCULATOR`-Klasse von den konkreten Implementierungen der Berechnungslogik entkoppelt. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit.
keywords: INTERFACE, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, Polymorphie, NEW, DATA, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_FLIGHT_DATA_PROVIDER` mit einer Methode `GET_FLIGHTS` (Importing `iv_carrid` TYPE `s_carr_id`, Returning `rt_flights` TYPE `sflights_tab`). Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `ZCL_DB_FLIGHT_PROVIDER`, die Daten aus der `sflight`-Tabelle liest.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `WHERE` Klauseln.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
TYPES: ty_sflights_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

INTERFACE zif_flight_data_provider PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_flights
    IMPORTING
      iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_tab.

CLASS zcl_db_flight_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_data_provider.

CLASS zcl_db_flight_provider IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS analyze_carrier_flights
      IMPORTING
        io_provider TYPE REF TO zif_flight_data_provider
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_carrier_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = io_provider->get_flights( iv_carrid = iv_carrid ).
    rv_flight_count = lines( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_db_flight_provider FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_db_flight_provider.
    DATA(lo_db_provider) = NEW zcl_db_flight_provider( ).
    DATA(lv_flight_count) = zcl_flight_analyzer=>analyze_carrier_flights(
                               io_provider = lo_db_provider
                               iv_carrid   = 'LH'

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Interfaces verwendet werden können, um verschiedene Datenquellen zu abstrahieren. Die `ZCL_FLIGHT_ANALYZER`-Klasse ist unabhängig davon, wie die Flugdaten tatsächlich abgerufen werden, was das Testen und die Erweiterbarkeit verbessert. Die Verwendung von `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ist moderne Open SQL Syntax.
keywords: INTERFACE, Data Access, Open SQL, SELECT, INTO TABLE, DATA, sflight, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface `ZIF_VALIDATOR` mit einer Methode `VALIDATE` (Importing `iv_value` TYPE `string`). Die Methode soll eine Exception `ZCX_VALIDATION_ERROR` auslösen, wenn der Wert leer ist. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `ZCL_NOT_EMPTY_VALIDATOR`. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung mit `TRY...CATCH`.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Exception-Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_validation_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_validation_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_validator PUBLIC.
  METHODS validate
    IMPORTING
      iv_value TYPE string
    RAISING
      zcx_validation_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_validator~validate.
    IF iv_value IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_validation_error( textid = zcx_validation_error=>default_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validation_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS process_input
      IMPORTING
        io_validator TYPE REF TO zif_validator
        iv_input     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validation_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_input.
    TRY.
        io_validator->validate( iv_value = iv_input ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH zcx_validation_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_not_empty_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = zcl_validation_processor=>process_input(
                               io_validator = lo_validator
                               iv_input     = 'Some Value'
                             ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_not_empty_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = zcl_validation_processor=>process_input(
                               io_validator = lo_validator
                               iv_input     = ''
                             ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von Interfaces in Kombination mit modernen ABAP-Exception-Handling-Mechanismen (`TRY...CATCH`, eigene Exception-Klassen). Das Interface `ZIF_VALIDATOR` definiert einen Vertrag für Validierungslogik, und die aufrufende Klasse kann generisch mit verschiedenen Validatoren umgehen.
keywords: INTERFACE, Exception Handling, TRY...CATCH, RAISING, CLASS, INHERITING FROM, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_ECL_VIEWER_HANDLER`, die eine Methode `DISPLAY_URL_IN_VIEWER` bereitstellt. Diese Methode soll konzeptionell einen `cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox` instanziieren und eine URL anzeigen. Da eine direkte GUI-Interaktion im Unit-Test schwierig ist, soll der Unit-Test überprüfen, ob die Methode korrekt aufgerufen wird (simuliert).
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox` und rufen Sie `create_viewer` und `display_url` auf. Für den Unit-Test kann man die Interaktion mit dem GUI-Objekt mocken oder nur die Vorbereitung der Daten testen. Hier wird die Logik der Parameterübergabe getestet.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_ECL_XML_GENERATOR`, die eine Methode `GET_FLIGHT_XML` bereitstellt. Diese Methode soll Flugdaten aus der `sflight`-Tabelle (für einen gegebenen Carrier) in einem einfachen XML-Format generieren, das von einem `cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox` angezeigt werden könnte.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und String-Templates für die XML-Generierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_xml,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_xml.
TYPES: ty_sflights_xml_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_xml WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_ecl_xml_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_xml_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_xml.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE ty_sflights_xml_tab( ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_xml_content = |
<Flights>
{ FOR flight IN lt_flights
  ( |  <Flight>
    <Carrier>{ flight-carrid }</Carrier>
    <Connection>{ flight-connid }</Connection>
    <Date>{ flight-fldate }</Date>
    <Price>{ flight-price }</Price>
    <Currency>{ flight-currency }</Currency>
  </Flight>| ) }
</Flights>|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_flight_xml FOR TESTING.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
TYPES: ty_flight_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

INTERFACE zif_ecl_viewer_config PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_url RETURNING VALUE(rv_url) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_title RETURNING VALUE(rv_title) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_ecl_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_ecl_viewer_config.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_ecl_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_flights WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_ecl_viewer_config~get_url.
    rv_url = |https://www.example.com/flights/{ mv_carrid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_ecl_viewer_config~get_title.
    DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN mt_flights
      WHERE ( flight-carrid = mv_carrid )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
    rv_title = |Flugübersicht für { mv_carrid } ({ lv_flight_count } Flüge)|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_config_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_viewer_info
      IMPORTING
        io_config_provider TYPE REF TO zif_ecl_viewer_config
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_info) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_config_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_viewer_info.
    " For demonstration, we return a structure description, not actual viewer info.
    " In a real scenario, this would pass config to cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_viewer_data,
            url   TYPE string,
            title TYPE string,
          END OF ls_viewer_data.
    ls_viewer_data-url = io_config_provider->get_url( ).
    ls_viewer_data-title = io_config_provider->get_title( ).
    rs_info = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ls_viewer_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen festen Wert von jedem Element einer internen Tabelle von Ganzzahlen und geben Sie die neue Tabelle zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_math_subtract_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS subtract_from_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_value_to_subtract TYPE i
        it_numbers           TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result)     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_subtract_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_from_table.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR <number> IN it_numbers ( <number> - iv_value_to_subtract ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_subtract_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_item,
           ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_cond_subtract_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_conditionally.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR item IN it_items
                           WHERE ( value > iv_threshold )
                           ( id = item-id value = item-value - iv_value_to_sub ) ).
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die verbleibende Menge pro Material, indem Sie eine Abzugsmenge von der Gesamtmenge subtrahieren. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` um die Daten zu gruppieren und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_subtract_qty DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_material_movement,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
             movement_type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_s_material_movement,
           ty_t_material_movements TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_material_movement WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_material_stock,
             material TYPE string,
             remaining_quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_material_stock,
           ty_t_material_stock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_material_stock WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_stock
      IMPORTING
        it_movements TYPE ty_t_material_movements
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stock) TYPE ty_t_material_stock.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_subtract_qty IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_stock.
    LOOP AT it_movements INTO DATA(ls_movement) GROUP BY ls_movement-material ASCENDING
                                                 INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_remaining_qty) = REDUCE i(
        INIT total_qty = 0
        FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT total_qty = COND i(
                                WHEN <member>-movement_type = 'I' THEN total_qty + <member>-quantity " Inbound
                                WHEN <member>-movement_type = 'O' THEN total_qty - <member>-quantity " Outbound
                                ELSE total_qty
                              )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_s_material_stock( material = ls_group_key-material
                                        remaining_quantity = lv_remaining_qty ) TO rt_stock.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_remaining_stock FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_remaining_stock.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_subtract_qty( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_material_movement,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
             movement_type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_s_material_movement,
           ty_t_material_movements TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_material_movement WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_material_stock,
             material TYPE string,
             remaining_quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_material_stock,
           ty_t_material_stock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_material_stock WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_movements) = VALUE ty_t_material_movements(
      ( material = 'A' quantity = 100 movement_type = 'I' )
      ( material = 'B' quantity = 50  movement_type = 'I' )
      ( material = 'A' quantity = 20  movement_type = 'O' )
      ( material = 'C' quantity = 30  movement_type = 'I' )
      ( material = 'B' quantity = 10  movement_type = 'O' )
      ( material = 'A' quantity = 10  movement_type = 'O' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected_stock) = VALUE ty_t_material_stock(
      ( material = 'A' remaining_quantity = 70 ) " 100 - 20 - 10
      ( material = 'B' remaining_quantity = 40 ) " 50 - 10
      ( material = 'C' remaining_quantity = 30 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result_stock) = lo_cut->calculate_remaining_stock( it_movements ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_stock ) exp = lines( lt_expected_stock ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_expected_stock INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      READ TABLE lt_result_stock INTO DATA(ls_result) WITH KEY material = ls_expected-material.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-remaining_quantity exp = ls_expected-remaining_quantity
                                          msg = |Material { ls_expected-material } quantity mismatch| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`. `GROUP BY` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Schlüsseln, während `REDUCE` innerhalb jeder Gruppe eine flexible Aggregation (hier kumulative Subtraktion/Addition) durchführt. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster für die Datenverarbeitung in ABAP, das komplexe Aggregationen in wenigen Zeilen Code ermöglicht.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Table, Quantity, Subtract, Aggregation

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie den Wert eines Feldes von einem anderen Feld innerhalb jedes Eintrags einer internen Tabelle und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einem neuen Feld.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit Strukturzuweisung.

CLASS zcl_table_field_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value1 TYPE i,
             value2 TYPE i,
             difference TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data,
           ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_difference
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_field_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_difference.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN it_input
                           ( id = ls_data-id
                             value1 = ls_data-value1
                             value2 = ls_data-value2
                             difference = ls_data-value1 - ls_data-value2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie die Mengen von zwei internen Tabellen basierend auf einem gemeinsamen Schlüssel (z.B. Materialnummer), um den Nettobestand zu ermitteln. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `CORRESPONDING` und `BASE` um die Mengen zu subtrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_subtract_by_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_stock,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_stock,
           ty_t_stock TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_s_stock WITH UNIQUE KEY material.

    METHODS calculate_net_stock
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_stock TYPE ty_t_stock
        it_outbound_qty  TYPE ty_t_stock
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_net_stock) TYPE ty_t_stock.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_subtract_by_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_net_stock.
    rt_net_stock = VALUE #( BASE it_initial_stock
                             FOR ls_outbound IN it_outbound_qty
                             LET lv_initial_qty = it_initial_stock[ KEY material = ls_outbound-material ]-quantity IN
                             ( material = ls_outbound-material
                               quantity = lv_initial_qty - ls_outbound-quantity ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_calculate_net_stock.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_subtract_by_key( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_stock,
             material TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_stock,
           ty_t_stock TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_s_stock WITH UNIQUE KEY material.

    DATA(lt_initial_stock) = VALUE ty_t_stock(
      ( material = 'MAT1' quantity = 100 )
      ( material = 'MAT2' quantity = 50 )
      ( material = 'MAT3' quantity = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_outbound_qty) = VALUE ty_t_stock(
      ( material = 'MAT1' quantity = 30 )
      ( material = 'MAT2' quantity = 10 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected_net_stock) = VALUE ty_t_stock(
      ( material = 'MAT1' quantity = 70 ) " 100 - 30
      ( material = 'MAT2' quantity = 40 ) " 50 - 10
      ( material = 'MAT3' quantity = 200 ) " Unchanged
    ).

    DATA(lt_result_net_stock) = lo_cut->calculate_net_stock(
      it_initial_stock = lt_initial_stock
      it_outbound_qty  = lt_outbound_qty
    ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `BASE` und `LET` für eine effiziente und deklarative Mengenberechnung. `BASE` ermöglicht es, eine bestehende Tabelle als Grundlage für die neue Tabelle zu verwenden, während `FOR` über eine andere Tabelle iteriert. `LET` wird verwendet, um temporäre Variablen zu definieren, was den Code lesbarer macht. Die direkte Tabellenzeilen-Zugriff mit `KEY` ist hier entscheidend. Dies ist ein sehr modernes Muster für die Transformation und Aggregation von Daten aus mehreren internen Tabellen.
keywords: FOR, BASE, LET, Internal Table, Subtract, Key Access, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_ida_double_click_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_event

CLASS zcl_ida_double_click_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_event.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR io_alv_ida.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.

    " In a real scenario, you would use the i_row_id to read the data
    " from the underlying data source or the ALV's internal buffer.
    " For simplicity, we'll simulate fetching CARRID based on row_id.
    " This part is highly dependent on the actual ALV implementation and data access.
    " A direct read from SFLIGHTS based on row_id is not directly supported by IDA events.
    " Instead, you'd typically use the ALV's data provider to get the selected row's data.

    " For demonstration, let's assume we can get the CARRID from the first row for any double click.
    " This is a simplification for unit testing purposes.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM sflights INTO @lv_carrid UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE |Doppelklick auf Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrid }| TYPE 'I'.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_handler->register_event( lo_alv_ida ).

    " Assert that the handler is set. This is difficult to test directly
    " without mocking the ALV object or using a framework that allows event simulation.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Event registration should complete without error' act = '' ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine dynamische Filterung für ein ALV mit IDA auf der Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') anzuzeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden des `if_salv_gui_table_ida_filter` Interfaces, das Sie über `get_filter()` erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ida_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS apply_carrid_filter
      IMPORTING
        io_alv_ida TYPE REF TO if_salv_gui_table_ida
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_carrid_filter.
    DATA(lo_filter) = io_alv_ida->get_filter( ).

    " Bestehende Filter löschen, um nur den neuen Filter anzuwenden
    lo_filter->clear_filter_conditions( ).

    " Neuen Filter hinzufügen: CARRID = iv_carrid
    lo_filter->add_filter_condition(
      iv_field_name = 'CARRID'
      iv_operator   = if_salv_gui_table_ida_filter=>co_operator_equal
      iv_value      = iv_carrid
    ).

    " Filter anwenden (ALV wird aktualisiert)
    lo_filter->apply_filter_conditions( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_alv_ida) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create_for_table( iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS' ).

    DATA(lv_carrid_to_filter) = 'LH'.

    lo_cut->apply_carrid_filter( io_alv_ida = lo_alv_ida iv_carrid = lv_carrid_to_filter ).

    DATA(lo_filter) = lo_alv_ida->get_filter( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'Filter field name should be CARRID',
      act = ls_condition-field_name,
      exp = 'CARRID'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'Filter operator should be EQUAL',
      act = ls_condition-operator,
