Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS`. Sortieren Sie diese Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und entfernen Sie anschließend Duplikate, sodass nur die erste Instanz jedes eindeutigen Fluges erhalten bleibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` oder den `DISTINCT` Operator im `SELECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_unique_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_unique_flight.
    TYPES tt_unique_flight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_unique_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_unique_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_unique_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Select distinct flights directly from DB for efficiency
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_temp_flights).

    " Convert to sorted table type for unique key enforcement
    rt_unique_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_temp_flights
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                   connid = flight-connid,
                                   fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_unique_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_flights.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_unique_flights( ).
    DATA ls_flight_test TYPE sflight.

    " Insert test data with duplicates
    ls_flight_test-carrid = 'XX'.
    ls_flight_test-connid = '1000'.
    ls_flight_test-fldate = sy-datum.
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight_test.
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight_test. " Duplicate

    ls_flight_test-connid = '1001'.
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight_test.

    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_unique) = lo_selector->get_unique_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique ) exp = 2 ). " Expect 2 unique flights for 'XX'

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_first_unique) = lt_unique[ carrid = 'XX' connid = '1000' fldate = sy-datum ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_unique ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unique flight XX 1000 not found.' ).
    ENDTRY.

    DELETE sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `SELECT DISTINCT` ist die effizienteste Methode, um Duplikate direkt auf der Datenbankebene zu eliminieren. Die Zuweisung zu einer `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass auch bei der weiteren Verarbeitung in ABAP die Eindeutigkeit der Schlüsselkombinationen gewährleistet ist, was zu robustem und performantem Code führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, DISTINCT, SELECT, Duplicates, Sorted Table, Unique Key, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Binärdatei vom Applikationsserver in einen `XSTRING` und schreiben Sie einen `XSTRING` als Binärdatei auf den Applikationsserver.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Funktionsbausteine `ARCHIVFILE_SERVER_TO_TABLE` und `ARCHIVFILE_CLIENT_TO_SERVER` (oder `OPEN DATASET` für modernere Ansätze).
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_file_io DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_binary_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring_content) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

    METHODS write_binary_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_xstring_content TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_file_io IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_binary_file.
    DATA lv_file_size TYPE i.
    DATA lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.

    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = 'Error opening file for read'.
    ENDIF.

    GET DATASET iv_file_path POSITION lv_file_size.
    lv_length = lv_file_size.
    TRANSFER iv_file_path TO rv_xstring_content LENGTH lv_length.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = 'Error closing file after read'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD write_binary_file.
    OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = 'Error opening file for write'.
    ENDIF.

    TRANSFER iv_xstring_content TO iv_file_path.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_file_path.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = 'Error closing file after write'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_binary_file_io FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_binary_file_io.
    DATA(lo_file_io) = NEW zcl_binary_file_io( ).
    DATA(lv_test_file) = '/tmp/test_binary_file.bin'. " Adjust path for your system
    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = '0123456789ABCDEF'X.
    DATA(lv_long_xstring) = lv_original_xstring && lv_original_xstring && lv_original_xstring.

    " Write binary data to file
    lo_file_io->write_binary_file( iv_file_path = lv_test_file iv_xstring_content = lv_long_xstring ).

    " Read binary data from file
    DATA(lv_read_xstring) = lo_file_io->read_binary_file( lv_test_file ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_read_xstring exp = lv_long_xstring ).

    " Clean up: delete the test file
    DELETE DATASET lv_test_file.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `OPEN DATASET`, `TRANSFER` und `CLOSE DATASET` Statements sind die grundlegenden Bausteine für die Dateiverarbeitung auf dem Applikationsserver. Im `BINARY MODE` ermöglichen sie das direkte Lesen und Schreiben von `XSTRING`-Daten, was für die Handhabung von nicht-textuellen Dateien wie Bildern, PDFs oder komprimierten Archiven unerlässlich ist. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `sy-subrc` und Ausnahmen ist hierbei wichtig.
keywords: Binary Data, XSTRING, File Handling, Application Server, OPEN DATASET, TRANSFER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS`. Transformieren Sie diese Tabelle in eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Flugdatum enthält, und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'FLIGHT_KEY' hinzu, die eine Verkettung dieser drei Felder darstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und String-Templates für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_key TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                        connid = flight-connid,
                                        fldate = flight-fldate,
                                        flight_key = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate DATE = ISO }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_transformed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 16 ). " Assuming SFLIGHTS has 16 entries by default

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_first_transformed) = lt_transformed[ 1 ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_transformed-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_transformed-connid exp = '0017' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_transformed-flight_key exp = |AA-0017-{ ls_first_transformed-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'First transformed flight entry not found.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE`, `FOR`-Operator und String-Templates ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke Methode zur Transformation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht die Erstellung neuer Tabellen mit abgeleiteten oder kombinierten Feldern in einer einzigen, gut lesbaren Anweisung, was die Datenmanipulation erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, String Templates, Transformation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`), aber nur mit ausgewählten Feldern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` zur dynamischen Typbeschreibung und `CREATE DATA` für die Instanziierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflights_subset,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflights_subset.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        it_fields     TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    " Get description of the source table
    DATA(lo_struct_descr_source) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
        cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ) ).

    " Filter components based on requested fields
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr_source->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_source_component).
      IF line_exists( it_fields[ table_line = ls_source_component-name ] ).
        ls_component-name = ls_source_component-name.
        ls_component-type = ls_source_component-type.
        APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create dynamic structure type
    DATA(lo_struct_descr_dynamic) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Create dynamic table type
    DATA(lo_table_descr_dynamic) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
        p_line_type = lo_struct_descr_dynamic
        p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
        p_unique = abap_false ).

    " Create data reference for the dynamic table
    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr_dynamic.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ).
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table(
        iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        it_fields     = lt_fields ).

    " Check if data reference is created
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Data reference should not be initial' act = lo_data IS NOT BOUND ).

    " Check if the type is a table type
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lo_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Type should be a table type' act = lo_type_descr->kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_table ).

    " Check the structure of the created table
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_type_descr ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of components should be 2' act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First component name should be CARRID' act = lt_components[ 1 ]-name exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second component name should be CONNID' act = lt_components[ 2 ]-name exp = 'CONNID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von Datentypen und Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit mittels RTTI (Run Time Type Information). `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` ermöglichen es, die Struktur einer Tabelle zu analysieren und eine neue, angepasste Tabellenstruktur zu definieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Frameworks oder wenn die genaue Struktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` und `DATA()` für Inline-Deklarationen und `CAST` für Typumwandlungen sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CREATE DATA, Internal Tables

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine generische Methode, die die Anzahl der Zeilen einer beliebigen internen Tabelle zurückgibt, die einen bestimmten Wert in einem bestimmten Feld enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Tabellen und Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_rows_with_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_rows_with_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF <lt_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_field> = iv_value.
        rv_count = rv_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_sflights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_custom_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_processor( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_rows_with_value(
        ir_table      = REF TO lt_sflights
        iv_field_name = 'CARRID'
        iv_value      = 'AA' ).

    " Assert that the count is greater than 0 if 'AA' exists
    " (assuming 'AA' exists in SFLIGHTS data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Count should be greater than 0 for CARRID AA' act = lv_count > 0 ).

    " Test with a value that likely doesn't exist
    DATA(lv_count_no_match) = lo_cut->count_rows_with_value(
        ir_table      = REF TO lt_sflights
        iv_field_name = 'CARRID'
        iv_value      = 'ZZ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Count should be 0 for CARRID ZZ' act = lv_count_no_match exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_custom_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = 1 text = 'Hello' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = 2 text = 'World' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = 3 text = 'Hello' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_rows_with_value(
        ir_table      = REF TO lt_data
        iv_field_name = 'TEXT'
        iv_value      = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Count should be 2 for TEXT Hello' act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode zeigt, wie man mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `REF TO DATA` generische Operationen auf internen Tabellen durchführt, deren Typ zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt ist. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP. Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den flexiblen Zugriff auf die Daten.
keywords: RTTI, Generic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, REF TO DATA, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch einen Feldkatalog für ein ALV Grid, basierend auf der Struktur einer beliebigen internen Tabelle, die zur Laufzeit übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_SALV_TABLE` zur Generierung des Feldkatalogs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_alv_fieldcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_catalog
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fieldcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_alv_fieldcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_catalog.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_table_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF <lt_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_line_type( ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(ls_fieldcat_line) = VALUE lvc_s_fcat(
          fieldname = ls_component-name
          coltext   = ls_component-name
          outputlen = COND #( WHEN ls_component-type->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_char THEN ls_component-type->length
                              WHEN ls_component-type->kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_num THEN ls_component-type->length
                              ELSE 10 ) " Default length for other types
      ).
      APPEND ls_fieldcat_line TO rt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fieldcat_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fieldcat_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_alv_fieldcat( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = lo_cut->get_field_catalog( REF TO lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field catalog should not be empty' act = lt_fieldcat IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of fields should match SFLIGHTS structure'
                                        act = lines( lt_fieldcat )
                                        exp = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ) )->get_components( )->* ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First field should be MANDT' act = lt_fieldcat[ 1 ]-fieldname exp = 'MANDT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung eines Feldkatalogs für ALV-Listen mithilfe von RTTI. Die Methode `get_field_catalog` akzeptiert eine Referenz auf eine beliebige interne Tabelle und extrahiert deren Strukturinformationen über `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`. Dies ermöglicht die Erstellung generischer ALV-Anzeigen, ohne den Feldkatalog manuell definieren zu müssen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` und `COND` für die Inline-Initialisierung und bedingte Zuweisung ist ein Merkmal von modernem ABAP.
keywords: RTTI, ALV, UI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Datentyp und die Länge eines beliebigen Feldes einer Struktur zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS get_field_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_type_kind  TYPE string
        ev_length     TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_data> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <ls_data>.
    IF <ls_data> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <ls_data> ) ).
    DATA(ls_component) = lo_struct_descr->get_component( iv_field_name ).
    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type ).

    ev_type_kind = lo_elem_descr->kind_name.
    ev_length    = lo_elem_descr->length.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_info.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_inspector( ).
    DATA ls_test_data TYPE zcl_rtti_type_inspector=>ty_data.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Test'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 123.

    DATA lv_type_kind TYPE string.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.

    lo_cut->get_field_info(
        EXPORTING
            ir_data       = REF TO ls_test_data
            iv_field_name = 'FIELD1'
        IMPORTING
            ev_type_kind  = lv_type_kind
            ev_length     = lv_length ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Type kind for FIELD1 should be STRING' act = lv_type_kind exp = 'STRING' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für einen `SELECT`-Befehl basierend auf einer Struktur, in der Felder mit Werten gefüllt sind, die als Filterkriterien dienen sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` zur Iteration über die Struktur und zum Aufbau der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflights_filter,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_sflights_filter.

    METHODS build_dynamic_where
      IMPORTING
        is_filter_criteria TYPE ty_sflights_filter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_where_clause) TYPE string.

    METHODS select_sflights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_filter_criteria TYPE ty_sflights_filter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_filter_criteria ) ).
    DATA: lt_conditions TYPE string_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field_value> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_filter_criteria TO <lv_field_value>.
      IF <lv_field_value> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_field_value> IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND |{ ls_component-name } = '{ <lv_field_value> }'| TO lt_conditions.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_conditions IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR wa IN lt_conditions NEXT s = COND #( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN wa ELSE s && ` AND ` && wa ) ) .
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD select_sflights_dynamically.
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = build_dynamic_where( is_filter_criteria ).

    IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE rt_sflights WHERE (lv_where_clause).
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE rt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Fallback if no filter
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_clause FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_select_dynamically FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where_clause.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA ls_filter TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_where=>ty_sflights_filter.

    " Test with one criterion
    ls_filter-carrid = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_where1) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where( ls_filter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Single criterion WHERE clause' act = lv_where1 exp = `CARRID = 'AA'` ).

    " Test with multiple criteria
    ls_filter-connid = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_where2) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where( ls_filter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Multiple criteria WHERE clause' act = lv_where2 exp = `CARRID = 'AA' AND CONNID = '0017'` ).

    " Test with empty filter
    CLEAR ls_filter.
    DATA(lv_where3) = lo_cut->build_dynamic_where( ls_filter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Empty WHERE clause for empty filter' act = lv_where3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA ls_filter TYPE zcl_rtti_dynamic_where=>ty_sflights_filter.

    " Test with a specific filter (assuming 'AA' and '0017' exist)
    ls_filter-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_filter-connid = '0017'.
    DATA(lt_results1) = lo_cut->select_sflights_dynamically( ls_filter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Results should not be empty for valid filter' act = lt_results1 IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Results should contain entries for valid filter' act = lines( lt_results1 ) > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'All results should have CARRID AA' act = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR s IN lt_results1 WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ) exp = lines( lt_results1 ) ).

    " Test with an empty filter (should return some rows, e.g., 100)
    CLEAR ls_filter.
    DATA(lt_results2) = lo_cut->select_sflights_dynamically( ls_filter ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Results should not be empty for empty filter (fallback)' act = lt_results2 IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Results should contain entries for empty filter (fallback)' act = lines( lt_results2 ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamische `WHERE`-Klauseln für `SELECT`-Anweisungen erstellt, indem man RTTI verwendet, um eine Filterstruktur zu inspizieren. Die Methode `build_dynamic_where` iteriert über die Komponenten der Filterstruktur und baut die Klausel nur für gefüllte Felder auf. Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung wird verwendet, um die einzelnen Bedingungen effizient zu einem String zu verketten. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Technik für generische Suchfunktionen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld sortiert, wobei die Sortierreihenfolge (auf- oder absteigend) ebenfalls dynamisch ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und `SORT` mit dynamischen Feldnamen und Sortierrichtung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_descending TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_table_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF <lt_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_line_type( ) ).

    " Check if field exists
    TRY.
        lo_line_descr->get_component( iv_field_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_component_error.
        MESSAGE e001(sy) WITH |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' existiert nicht in der Tabelle.|.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lv_sort_order) = COND string( WHEN iv_descending = abap_true THEN 'DESCENDING' ELSE 'ASCENDING' ).

    SORT <lt_table> BY (iv_field_name) (lv_sort_order).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_sflights_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically(
        ir_table_data = REF TO lt_sflights
        iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).

    " Check if sorted by CARRID ascending
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = ''.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table not sorted by CARRID ascending' act = ls_sflight-carrid GE lv_prev_carrid ).
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_sflights_fldate_desc.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically(
        ir_table_data = REF TO lt_sflights
        iv_field_name = 'FLDATE'
        iv_descending = abap_true ).

CLASS zcl_rtti_key_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             key_field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             key_field2 TYPE i,
             data_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data,
           tt_test_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field1 key_field2.

    METHODS get_key_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_key_name   TYPE string OPTIONAL " For secondary keys
      EXPORTING
        ev_key_exists TYPE abap_bool
        et_key_fields TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_key_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_key_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_table_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF <lt_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ) ).
    DATA(lt_keys) = lo_table_descr->get_keys( ).

    DATA(ls_key_info) = VALUE cl_abap_tabledescr=>key_info(
        key_name = COND string( WHEN iv_key_name IS INITIAL THEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>primary_key ELSE iv_key_name ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_keys INTO DATA(ls_key) WHERE key_name = ls_key_info-key_name.
      ev_key_exists = abap_true.
      LOOP AT ls_key-key_components INTO DATA(ls_component_name).
        APPEND ls_component_name TO et_key_fields.
      ENDLOOP.
      RETURN.
    ENDLOOP.

    ev_key_exists = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_primary_key_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_key_inspector( ).
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_rtti_key_inspector=>tt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field1 = 'A' key_field2 = 1 data_field = 'Data1' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA lv_key_exists TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lt_key_fields TYPE string_table.

    lo_cut->get_key_info(
        EXPORTING
            ir_table_data = REF TO lt_test_data
        IMPORTING
            ev_key_exists = lv_key_exists
            et_key_fields = lt_key_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Primary key should exist' act = lv_key_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of primary key fields' act = lines( lt_key_fields ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First key field' act = lt_key_fields[ 1 ] exp = 'KEY_FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second key field' act = lt_key_fields[ 2 ] exp = 'KEY_FIELD2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_secondary_key_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_key_inspector( ).
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_rtti_key_inspector=>tt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field1 = 'A' key_field2 = 1 data_field = 'Data1' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA lv_key_exists TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lt_key_fields TYPE string_table.

    lo_cut->get_key_info(
        EXPORTING
            ir_table_data = REF TO lt_test_data
            iv_key_name   = 'NON_EXISTENT_KEY'
        IMPORTING
            ev_key_exists = lv_key_exists
            et_key_fields = lt_key_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Non-existent key should not exist' act = lv_key_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Key fields should be empty' act = lt_key_fields ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_key_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_key_inspector( ).
    DATA lt_standard_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_standard_table UP TO 1 ROWS.

    DATA lv_key_exists TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lt_key_fields TYPE string_table.

    lo_cut->get_key_info(
        EXPORTING
            ir_table_data = REF TO lt_standard_table
        IMPORTING
            ev_key_exists = lv_key_exists
            et_key_fields = lt_key_fields ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Primary key should exist for standard table (implicit key)' act = lv_key_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Key fields should be empty for standard table implicit key' act = lt_key_fields ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle filtert, indem sie Zeilen entfernt, die in einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld einen bestimmten Wert enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`, `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `DELETE` mit dynamischen Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF <lt_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_line_type( ) ).

    " Check if field exists
    TRY.
        lo_line_descr->get_component( iv_field_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_component_error.
        MESSAGE e001(sy) WITH |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' existiert nicht in der Tabelle.|.
    ENDTRY.

    DELETE <lt_table> WHERE (iv_field_name) = iv_value.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_invalid_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_struct_component_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lv_carrid_aa_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR s IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).

    lo_cut->filter_table_dynamically(
        ir_table_data = REF TO lt_sflights
        iv_field_name = 'CARRID'
        iv_value      = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Rows with CARRID AA should be deleted' act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = lv_initial_lines - lv_carrid_aa_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'No rows with CARRID AA should remain' act = line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_struct_component_error ).
    lo_cut->filter_table_dynamically(
        ir_table_data = REF TO lt_sflights
        iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
        iv_value      = 'X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das dynamische Filtern einer internen Tabelle. Die `DELETE`-Anweisung unterstützt dynamische `WHERE`-Klauseln, bei denen der Feldname in Klammern `(iv_field_name)` angegeben wird. RTTI-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) werden verwendet, um die Gültigkeit des dynamisch übergebenen Feldnamens zu überprüfen und so robuste, generische Filterfunktionen zu ermöglichen. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Daten zur Laufzeit basierend auf variablen Kriterien zu manipulieren.

CLASS zcl_html_viewer_iframe DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

CLASS zcl_html_viewer_iframe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_external_website.
    DATA(lv_external_url) = 'https://help.sap.com/doc/abapdocu_752_index_htm/7.52/en-US/abenabap_language_elements.htm'.
    DATA(lv_html) = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>External Website</title>` &&
                    `<style>body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; } iframe { width: 100vw; height: 100vh; border: none; }</style>` &&
                    `</head><body>` &&
                    `<iframe src="` && lv_external_url && `"></iframe>` &&
                    `</body></html>`.

    DATA(lo_html_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_html_viewer(
        parent = iv_container ).

    lo_html_viewer->load_data(
        EXPORTING
            url            = 'EXTERNAL_SITE_HTML'
            size           = xstrlen( lv_html )
            type           = 'text'
            subtype        = 'html'
            data_table     = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_html ) ).

    lo_html_viewer->show_url( url = 'EXTERNAL_SITE_HTML' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in eine `SORTED TABLE` und bereiten Sie diese für die Anzeige in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` vor. Die Daten sollen nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` sortiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)`. Deklarieren Sie `lt_sflights` als `SORTED TABLE` mit passenden Schlüsseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary
                                     WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = NEW zcl_flight_data_provider( )->get_sorted_flights( ).

    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_flight_summary_sorted(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary_sorted(
      ) " Initial value for the result table
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid
      INTO DATA(group_key)
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary_sorted(
        BASE result
        ( carrid = group_key
          flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid_connid TYPE string,
             fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom      TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto        TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_transformed_flights_sorted.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = NEW zcl_flight_data_provider( )->get_sorted_flights( ).

    rt_transformed = VALUE tt_transformed_flights_sorted(
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
      ( carrid_connid = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
        fldate        = flight-fldate
        cityfrom      = flight-cityfrom
        cityto        = flight-cityto )

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES: tt_source_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_source_flight
                                     WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node_data,
             key      TYPE string, " Unique key for tree node
             text     TYPE string, " Main text for tree node
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate, " Renamed field
             departure_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom, " Renamed field
             arrival_city TYPE sflight-cityto, " Renamed field
           END OF ty_tree_node_data.
    TYPES: tt_tree_node_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_tree_node_data
                                     WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS map_flights_to_tree_data
      IMPORTING it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flights_sorted
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_data) TYPE tt_tree_node_data_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights_to_tree_data.
    rt_tree_data = VALUE tt_tree_node_data_sorted(
      FOR flight IN it_source_flights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( flight
           MAPPING flight_date = fldate
                   departure_city = cityfrom
                   arrival_city = cityto
           EXCEPT carrid connid " Exclude to handle manually if needed, or let CORRESPONDING handle
         )
        key = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
        text = |Flight { flight-carrid } { flight-connid }|
        carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_source) = lo_provider->get_sorted_flights( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch die Spaltendefinitionen für einen `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` basierend auf der Struktur einer `SORTED TABLE` (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) unter Verwendung von RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` oder `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_column_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_definition,
             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
             coltext   TYPE lvc_coltxt,
             col_pos   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_column_definition.
    TYPES: tt_column_definitions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_definition WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_columns_from_table
      IMPORTING it_any_table      TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_columns) TYPE tt_column_definitions.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_column_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_columns_from_table.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lv_col_pos) = 0.

    rt_columns = VALUE tt_column_definitions(
      FOR ls_component IN lt_components
      LET lv_col_pos = lv_col_pos + 1 IN
      ( fieldname = ls_component-name
        coltext   = ls_component-name
        col_pos   = lv_col_pos )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_searcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.

    METHODS handle_node_double_click
      IMPORTING iv_node_key TYPE string " Key from the tree node
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_selected_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING   cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
          lv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.

    " Assuming node_key is in format 'CARRID-CONNID'
    SPLIT iv_node_key AT '-' INTO lv_carrid lv_connid.

    TRY.
        rs_selected_flight = mt_flights[ KEY primary_key carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie Methodenaufrufe, um Flugdaten zu filtern und dann zu transformieren, bevor sie für einen `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` bereitgestellt werden. Nutzen Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` als Basis.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_display_data,
             key      TYPE string,
             text     TYPE string,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_display_data.
    TYPES: tt_display_data_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_display_data
                                   WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS constructor.

    METHODS filter_by_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_processor.

    METHODS transform_for_display
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_processor.

    METHODS get_processed_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_display_data_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_current_flights TYPE tt_flight_data_sorted.
    DATA mt_display_data    TYPE tt_display_data_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_current_flights = NEW zcl_flight_data_provider( )->get_sorted_flights( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_carrier.
    mt_current_flights = FILTER #( mt_current_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_for_display.
    mt_display_data = VALUE tt_display_data_sorted(
      FOR flight IN mt_current_flights
      ( key    = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
        text   = |{ flight-carrid } { flight-connid } - { flight-cityfrom } to { flight-cityto }|
        carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_processed_data.
    rt_data = mt_display_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->filter_by_carrier( 'LH' )->transform_for_display( )->get_processed_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator_gt ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect CARRID after filtering' act = ls_entry-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Key should not be initial' act = ls_entry-key ).

explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, was den Code flüssiger und lesbarer macht. CLASS zcl_flight_cond_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

           END OF ty_flight_data_with_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data_with_status_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_data_with_status
                                              WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data_with_status_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = NEW zcl_flight_data_provider( )->get_sorted_flights( ).

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data_with_status_sorted(
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
      ( carrid   = flight-carrid
        connid   = flight-connid
        fldate   = flight-fldate
        cityfrom = flight-cityfrom

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine `SORTED TABLE` aus einer beliebigen Datenbanktabelle lädt und die Daten für die Anzeige in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` vorbereitet. Die Sortierung soll dynamisch über einen Feldnamen erfolgen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und `ORDER BY` in `SELECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_loader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_display_line,
             key  TYPE string,
             text TYPE string,
             data TYPE string,
           END OF ty_tree_display_line.
    TYPES: tt_tree_display_lines TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_tree_display_line
                                  WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS load_dynamic_sorted_table
      IMPORTING iv_table_name TYPE tabname
                iv_sort_field TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_display_data) TYPE tt_tree_display_lines
      RAISING   cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_loader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD load_dynamic_sorted_table.
    DATA: lr_data       TYPE REF TO DATA,
          lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_type  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY STRUCTURE,
                   <lv_field_value>   TYPE ANY.

    TRY.
        " Dynamische Typbeschreibung der Tabellenzeile
        lr_line_type = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                           cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ) ).

        " Dynamische Typbeschreibung der SORTED TABLE
        lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                            p_line_type  = lr_line_type
                            p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_sorted
                            p_unique     = abap_true
                            p_key        = VALUE cl_abap_tabledescr=>t_key_comp(
                                               ( iv_sort_field ) ) ).

        " Dynamische Erzeugung der SORTED TABLE
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Dynamischer SELECT mit ORDER BY
        SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> ORDER BY (iv_sort_field).

        " Daten für die Anzeige im Tree aufbereiten
        rt_display_data = VALUE tt_tree_display_lines(
          FOR ls_line IN <lt_dynamic_table>
          LET lv_key_value = '' IN
          ( key  = |
            text = |
            data = |
          )
        ).

        " Populate key, text, and data dynamically
        LOOP AT <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_sort_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            DATA(lv_key) = |{ <lv_field_value> }|.
            DATA(lv_text) = |{ <lv_field_value> } - { <ls_dynamic_line> }|.
            DATA(lv_data) = cl_abap_conv_json_writer=>pretty_print(
                                  i_data = <ls_dynamic_line>
                                  i_pretty_mode = cl_abap_conv_json_writer=>pretty_mode-all ).

            INSERT VALUE #( key = lv_key text = lv_text data = lv_data ) INTO TABLE rt_display_data.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_osql).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_osql.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create).
        " Handle error
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_create.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation_error INTO DATA(lx_struct).
        " Handle error
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_struct.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Setzen Sie den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch in einer Struktur (z.B. einer SFLIGHT-Zeile), dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String bekannt ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_write DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_write IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ir_data->* TO <fs_any>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_any> = iv_new_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error if new_value type does not match field type
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " Handle error: field not found
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS has_component
      IMPORTING

        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_component) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_component.
    DATA(lo_descr_ref) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr_ref ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF ls_component-name = iv_component_name.
        rv_has_component = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_has_component = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' fldate = '20250105' ) TO lt_sflight.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (`sflights`) basierend auf der Differenz zwischen Maximal- und Belegter Kapazität (MAX_SEATS - SEATSOCC) absteigend. Fügen Sie dazu ein temporäres Feld hinzu.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine lokale Struktur mit dem zusätzlichen Feld und verwenden Sie `APPEND CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_calculated_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_diff,
             sflight TYPE sflight,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_diff.
    TYPES tt_sflight_with_diff TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_diff WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_by_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_with_diff.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_calculated_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_by_free_seats.
    DATA: lt_temp_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_with_diff.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(ls_temp_line) = VALUE ty_sflight_with_diff( sflight = ls_sflight
                                                      free_seats = ls_sflight-max_seats - ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
      APPEND ls_temp_line TO lt_temp_sflights.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_temp_sflights BY free_seats DESCENDING.

    rt_sorted_sflights = lt_temp_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' max_seats = 200 seatsocc = 180 ) TO lt_sflight. " Free: 20
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0010' max_seats = 150 seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflight. " Free: 100
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0400' max_seats = 120 seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflight. " Free: 20

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_calculated_field( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_by_free_seats( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-free_seats exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-sflight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-free_seats exp = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-sflight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 4 ]-free_seats exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 4 ]-sflight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Stabilität des `SORT`-Befehls, indem Sie eine Tabelle zuerst nach einem sekundären Feld und dann nach einem primären Feld sortieren. Die ursprüngliche Reihenfolge der gleichen Werte im primären Feld soll beibehalten werden.
hint: `SORT` ist in ABAP standardmäßig stabil. Sortieren Sie zuerst nach dem sekundären Feld, dann nach dem primären.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_stable_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             group TYPE char1,
             order TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS perform_stable_sort
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_stable_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_stable_sort.
    rt_sorted_data = it_data.

    " First sort by the secondary criterion (e.g., 'order')
    SORT rt_sorted_data BY order ASCENDING.

    " Then sort by the primary criterion (e.g., 'group').
    " ABAP's SORT is stable, so items with the same 'group' will retain their 'order' sort.
    SORT rt_sorted_data BY group ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_stable_sort FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_stable_sort.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_sort_stable_demo=>tt_data.

    APPEND VALUE zcl_sort_stable_demo=>ty_data( group = 'A' order = 2 value = 'A2' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_sort_stable_demo=>ty_data( group = 'B' order = 1 value = 'B1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_sort_stable_demo=>ty_data( group = 'A' order = 1 value = 'A1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_sort_stable_demo( group = 'C' order = 3 value = 'C3' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_sort_stable_demo( group = 'B' order = 3 value = 'B3' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_stable_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->perform_stable_sort( lt_data ).

    " Expected order after stable sort:
    " A1 (order 1)
    " A2 (order 2)
    " B1 (order 1)
    " B3 (order 3)
    " C3 (order 3)

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-value exp = 'A1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-value exp = 'A2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-value exp = 'B1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 4 ]-value exp = 'B3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 5 ]-value exp = 'C3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SORT`-Anweisung in ABAP ist standardmäßig stabil. Das bedeutet, dass die relative Reihenfolge von Zeilen, die in den Sortierkriterien gleich sind, beibehalten wird. Dies wird demonstriert, indem zuerst nach einem sekundären Kriterium und dann nach einem primären Kriterium sortiert wird. Die Reihenfolge der Elemente mit gleichem primären Kriterium bleibt dabei erhalten, wie sie durch die vorherige Sortierung festgelegt wurde.
keywords: SORT, Stable Sort, Internal Tables, Reihenfolge

CLASS zcl_sort_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sort_top_n IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflight
      ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING carrid ASCENDING
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_sflights).

    rt_top_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_all_sflights ( 1 TO iv_top_n ) ( ls_sflight ) ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n.
    " Ensure there are enough entries in SFLIGHT for the test

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (`sflights`) dynamisch nach einem Feld, dessen Name als Parameter übergeben wird. Berücksichtigen Sie auch eine dynamische Sortierreihenfolge (ASCENDING/DESCENDING).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SORT` mit `BY (field_name)` und nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Existenz des Feldes zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_sort_order TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE IS INITIAL.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_sort_order,
                 ascending  TYPE ty_sort_order VALUE 'A',
                 descending TYPE ty_sort_order VALUE 'D',
               END OF gc_sort_order.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_sort_order TYPE ty_sort_order DEFAULT gc_sort_order-ascending
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    rt_sorted_data = it_data.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    " Check if the field exists in the structure
    DATA(lv_field_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lo_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF ls_component-name = iv_field_name.
        lv_field_exists = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_field_exists = abap_false.
      " Handle error: field not found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_sort_order = gc_sort_order-descending.
      SORT rt_sorted_data BY (iv_field_name) DESCENDING.
    ELSE.
      SORT rt_sorted_data BY (iv_field_name) ASCENDING.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `SORT`-Anweisung verwendet dann die dynamische Feldnamenspezifikation `BY (iv_field_name)`. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für generische Sortierfunktionen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle filtert. Der Filter soll dynamisch auf Basis eines Feldnamens und eines Vergleichswertes angewendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen `WHERE`-Ausdruck, der durch RTTI und Feld-Symbole aufgebaut wird. Alternativ: `LOOP AT ... ASSIGN COMPONENT ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    " Check if the field exists
    DATA(lv_field_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lo_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF ls_component-name = iv_field_name.
        lv_field_exists = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_field_exists = abap_false.
      rt_filtered_data = it_data. " Return original table if field not found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <fs_field> = iv_value.
          APPEND <fs_line> TO rt_filtered_data.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle nach mehreren dynamisch übergebenen Feldern sortiert. Die Feldnamen und Sortierreihenfolgen sollen in einer separaten Tabelle übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORT` mit der dynamischen `BY` Klausel, die aus einer internen Tabelle von Feldnamen und Richtungen aufgebaut wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_multi_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sort_criterion,
             field_name TYPE string,
             direction  TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_sort_criterion.
    TYPES tt_sort_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sort_criterion WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        it_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_sort_criteria TYPE tt_sort_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_multi_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_by_criteria.
    rt_sorted_data = it_data.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    DATA: lt_dynamic_sort_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    LOOP AT it_sort_criteria INTO DATA(ls_criterion).
      " Check if the field exists
      DATA(lv_field_exists) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lo_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        IF ls_component-name = ls_criterion-field_name.
          lv_field_exists = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_field_exists = abap_false.
        " Skip non-existing fields
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_criterion-direction = 'D'. " Descending
        APPEND |{ ls_criterion-field_name } DESCENDING| TO lt_dynamic_sort_fields.
      ELSE.
        APPEND ls_criterion-field_name TO lt_dynamic_sort_fields.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_dynamic_sort_fields IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT rt_sorted_data BY (lt_dynamic_sort_fields).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_earliest_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gegeben ein Abflugdatum und eine Flugverbindung, finden Sie den nächsten verfügbaren Flug (nach Datum/Uhrzeit) in einer vorsortierten internen Tabelle von `sflights`.
hint: Sortieren Sie die Tabelle, finden Sie den Referenzflug und verwenden Sie dann `sy-tabix` für den nächsten Eintrag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_next_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             deptime TYPE sflights-deptime,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate deptime.

    METHODS get_next_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        is_current_flight TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_next_flight) TYPE sflights
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_next_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_flight.
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.

    READ TABLE it_flights WITH KEY carrid = is_current_flight-carrid
                                 connid = is_current_flight-connid
                                 fldate = is_current_flight-fldate
                                 deptime = is_current_flight-deptime
                                 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_index = sy-tabix.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = |Current flight not found in table|.
    ENDIF.

    " Find the next flight
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO rs_next_flight FROM lv_index + 1.
      IF rs_next_flight-carrid = is_current_flight-carrid AND
         rs_next_flight-connid = is_current_flight-connid.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
      EXPORTING
        text = |No next flight found for the given connection|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_service_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_service_class
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflights-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_service_class) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_service_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_service_class.
    rv_service_class = CASE  WHEN iv_price < 200 THEN 'Economy'
                             WHEN iv_price >= 200 AND iv_price <= 500 THEN 'Business'
                             WHEN iv_price > 500 THEN 'First'
                             ELSE 'Economy' " Default case
                       END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle Flüge von `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('AA') in Blöcken von 2 ab und stoppen Sie nach insgesamt 4 Flügen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` für die blockweise Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chunked_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i DEFAULT 2
        iv_max_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 4
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chunked_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_chunk  TYPE tt_flights,
          lv_fetched_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid ORDER BY fldate, deptime.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = |No flights found for airline { iv_carrid }|.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_chunk UP TO @iv_chunk_size ROWS.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND LINES OF lt_chunk TO rt_flights.
      lv_fetched_count = lv_fetched_count + lines( lt_chunk ).

      IF lv_fetched_count >= iv_max_flights.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      CLEAR lt_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle von Flugdetails. Für jeden Flug, wenn der Flugzeugtyp (`planetype`) initial ist, setzen Sie ihn auf 'UNKNOWN'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit `FOR` und einem `IF`-Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_with_default
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_with_default.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( ls_flight WITH
          planetype = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-planetype IS INITIAL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
                              ELSE ls_flight-planetype ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie die ersten 3 Flüge aus einer gegebenen internen Tabelle von `sflights` ab, die nach einem bestimmten Datum abfliegen.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights_after_date
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_date    TYPE sflights-fldate
        iv_count   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights_after_date.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
        WHERE ( fldate > iv_date )
        UP TO iv_count ROWS
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen. Geben Sie 0 zurück, wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einem `IF`-Ausdruck für den Initialwert oder innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflights-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT lv_sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT lv_sum = lv_sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Für eine gegebene Liste von Fluggesellschaften, finden Sie den *ersten* Flug (frühestes Datum und Uhrzeit) für jede Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit `ORDER BY` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_first_flight_per_airline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_key,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
           END OF ty_airline_key,
           tt_airline_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_key WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_flight_per_airline
      IMPORTING
        it_airlines TYPE tt_airline_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_first_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_first_flight_per_airline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight_per_airline.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    IF it_airlines IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflights
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_all_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_airlines
        WHERE carrid = @it_airlines-carrid
        ORDER BY carrid ASCENDING, fldate ASCENDING, deptime ASCENDING.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        SORT lt_all_flights BY carrid fldate deptime.
        DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_all_flights COMPARING carrid.
        rt_first_flights = lt_all_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_description TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_description.
    rv_formatted_string = COND #( WHEN iv_description IS INITIAL THEN 'No Description Available'
                                  ELSE |{ REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN iv_description WITH ' ' }| ).
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces after regex replacement
    CONDENSE rv_formatted_string NO-GAPS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten Anzahl an belegten Sitzen für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus einer internen Tabelle. Wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden, geben Sie einen initialen Flug zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` und `READ TABLE` oder einen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck mit `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_occupancy_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflights-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_flight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_occupancy_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_occupancy.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_flights(
      it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
    ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT lt_filtered_flights BY seatsocc DESCENDING.
      rs_max_flight = lt_filtered_flights[1].
    ELSE.
      CLEAR rs_max_flight. " Explicitly clear if no flights found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
