Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den Flug mit der höchsten Anzahl an belegten Sitzen enthält. Wenn eine Fluggesellschaft keine Flüge hat, soll sie nicht in der Ergebnistabelle erscheinen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_occupancy_per_carr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_flight_per_carr,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_max_flight_per_carr,
           tt_max_flights_per_carr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_flight_per_carr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_occupancy_per_airline
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_flights) TYPE tt_max_flights_per_carr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_occupancy_per_carr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_occupancy_per_airline.
    rt_max_flights = VALUE tt_max_flights_per_carr(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights BY ls_group-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid   = ls_group-carrid
        connid   = REDUCE sflights-connid(
          INIT ls_max_flight = VALUE sflights( seatsocc = -1 )
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT ls_max_flight = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc > ls_max_flight-seatsocc THEN ls_flight ELSE ls_max_flight ) ) -connid
        fldate   = REDUCE sflights-fldate(
          INIT ls_max_flight = VALUE sflights( seatsocc = -1 )
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT ls_max_flight = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc > ls_max_flight-seatsocc THEN ls_flight ELSE ls_max_flight ) ) -fldate
        seatsocc = REDUCE sflights-seatsocc(
          INIT lv_max_seats = 0
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT lv_max_seats = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc > lv_max_seats THEN ls_flight-seatsocc ELSE lv_max_seats ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie die ersten 5 Flüge aus `sflights` aus, die nach einem bestimmten Datum abfliegen und deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist. Verwenden Sie hierfür eine moderne `SELECT`-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE ... ORDER BY ... UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_select_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflights-fldate
        iv_count  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_select_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND fldate > @iv_fldate
      ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING, deptime ASCENDING
      UP TO @iv_count ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den 'Reisehinweis' für einen Flug basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft. Für 'LH' ist es 'Lufthansa Service', für 'AA' 'American Airlines Service', für 'UA' 'United Airlines Service'. Für alle anderen Fluggesellschaften soll 'Standard Service' zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck für eine elegante Mehrfachverzweigung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_travel_advice DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_travel_advice
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_advice) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_travel_advice IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_travel_advice.
    rv_advice = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
                          WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa Service'
                          WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines Service'
                          WHEN 'UA' THEN 'United Airlines Service'
                          ELSE 'Standard Service' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in einer internen Tabelle, der eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen (`seatsfree`) aufweist. Wenn kein solcher Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie einen initialen Flug zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE` und `FIRST`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_first_available_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_flight_with_min_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_min_seats_free TYPE sflights-seatsfree
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_first_available_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight_with_min_seats.
    rs_flight = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
        WHERE ( seatsfree >= iv_min_seats_free )
        ( ls_flight ) OPTIONAL
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_first_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsfree = 10 ) 
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsfree = 50 ) 
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' seatsfree = 5 ) 
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' seatsfree = 100 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_first_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_first_available_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_first_flight_with_min_seats( it_flights = mt_flights iv_min_seats_free = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-connid exp = '0401' msg = 'First flight with enough seats mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-seatsfree exp = 50 msg = 'Seats free mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_first_available_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_first_flight_with_min_seats( it_flights = mt_flights iv_min_seats_free = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-carrid msg = 'Result should be initial for no flight found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_first_available_flight( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE tt_flights( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_first_flight_with_min_seats( it_flights = lt_empty_flights iv_min_seats_free = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-carrid msg = 'Result should be initial for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und der `OPTIONAL`-Klausel (ab ABAP 7.50) um den ersten passenden Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle zu finden. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Flüge nach der Bedingung der freien Sitze. `OPTIONAL` stellt sicher, dass, wenn kein passender Flug gefunden wird, der Rückgabewert initial bleibt, was der `ELSE`-Logik entspricht. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, 'FETCH NEXT' mit einer Bedingung zu implementieren.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, OPTIONAL, Internal Table, FETCH NEXT, ELSE

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Implementierung einer `SET_INITIAL_STATE` Methode in einem RAP Behavior Handler, die ein Feld basierend auf einer Bedingung als schreibgeschützt markiert. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenmanipulation.
hint: In einem echten RAP-Szenario würde dies in einer `LOCAL HANDLER FOR ...` Klasse geschehen. Hier wird die Logik isoliert demonstriert. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` oder `SWITCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_field_control DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entity_data,
             key      TYPE string,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             field_a  TYPE string,
             field_b  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_entity_data.
    TYPES tt_entity_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_entity_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_control,
             key      TYPE string,
             field_a  TYPE abap_bool, " true = read-only
             field_b  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_field_control.
    TYPES tt_field_control TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_control WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_field_read_only
      IMPORTING
        it_entity_data TYPE tt_entity_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_control) TYPE tt_field_control.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_field_control IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_read_only.
    rt_field_control = VALUE #( 
        FOR <entity> IN it_entity_data
        ( key     = <entity>-key
          field_a = COND #( WHEN <entity>-status = 'X' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
          field_b = abap_false " Always editable for this example
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_field_control FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_field_control.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             key      TYPE string,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             field_a  TYPE string,
             field_b  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE tt_test_data(
        ( key = 'ITEM1' status = 'X' field_a = 'ValA1' field_b = 'ValB1' )
        ( key = 'ITEM2' status = ''  field_a = 'ValA2' field_b = 'ValB2' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_field_control( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->set_field_read_only( lt_input ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_item1_fc) WITH KEY key = 'ITEM1'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Item1 not found' act = ls_item1_fc IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field A of Item1 should be read-only' act = ls_item1_fc-field_a exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field B of Item1 should be editable' act = ls_item1_fc-field_b exp = abap_false ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_item2_fc) WITH KEY key = 'ITEM2'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Item2 not found' act = ls_item2_fc IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field A of Item2 should be editable' act = ls_item2_fc-field_a exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field B of Item2 should be editable' act = ls_item2_fc-field_b exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert ein gängiges RAP-Szenario, bei dem Feldeigenschaften (wie schreibgeschützt) dynamisch bestimmt werden. Es verwendet `VALUE #( FOR ... ( ... ) )` für die prägnante Tabellenkonstruktion und `COND #()` für bedingte Zuweisungen, die Kennzeichen von modernem ABAP sind.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie eine vereinfachte RAP-Aktion, die den Status von Entitäten aktualisiert. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und `line_exists` für die Datenzuweisung.
hint: In einem echten RAP-Szenario würde dies in einer `METHOD FOR MODIFY ...` oder `METHOD FOR ACTION ...` Implementierung geschehen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_action_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entity_key,
             key TYPE string,
           END OF ty_entity_key.
    TYPES tt_entity_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_entity_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entity_data,
             key      TYPE string,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             changed_at TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_entity_data.
    TYPES tt_entity_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_entity_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_status_action
      IMPORTING
        it_keys TYPE tt_entity_key
        iv_new_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      CHANGING
        ct_entities TYPE tt_entity_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_action_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_status_action.
    LOOP AT ct_entities ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entity>).
      IF line_exists( it_keys[ key = <fs_entity>-key ] ).
        <fs_entity>-status = iv_new_status.
        GET TIME STAMP FIELD <fs_entity>-changed_at.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_status.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             key      TYPE string,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             changed_at TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_entities) = VALUE tt_test_data(
        ( key = 'ITEM1' status = 'A' )
        ( key = 'ITEM2' status = 'B' )
        ( key = 'ITEM3' status = 'C' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_keys_to_update) = VALUE zcl_rap_action_handler=>tt_entity_key(
        ( key = 'ITEM1' )
        ( key = 'ITEM3' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rap_action_handler( ).
    lo_cut->update_status_action(
        EXPORTING
            it_keys       = lt_keys_to_update
            iv_new_status = 'X'
        CHANGING
            ct_entities   = lt_entities
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_entities INTO DATA(ls_item1) WITH KEY key = 'ITEM1'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item1-status exp = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Changed at for Item1 should not be initial' act = ls_item1-changed_at IS INITIAL ).

    READ TABLE lt_entities INTO DATA(ls_item2) WITH KEY key = 'ITEM2'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item2-status exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Changed at for Item2 should be initial' act = ls_item2-changed_at IS INITIAL ).

    READ TABLE lt_entities INTO DATA(ls_item3) WITH KEY key = 'ITEM3'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item3-status exp = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Changed at for Item3 should not be initial' act = ls_item3-changed_at IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dies demonstriert ein gängiges Muster in RAP Behavior Handlern: Iteration über Entitäten, um Änderungen anzuwenden. Es verwendet `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für effiziente Modifikation und `line_exists` zur Überprüfung der Existenz in einer anderen Tabelle, zusammen mit `GET TIME STAMP FIELD` zum Setzen von Zeitstempeln.
keywords: CL_ABAP_BEHAVIOR_HANDLER, RAP, ACTION, LOOP AT, FIELD-SYMBOLS, LINE_EXISTS, GET TIME STAMP

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine vereinfachte RAP-Validierung, die prüft, ob ein bestimmtes Feld nicht leer ist. Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... WHERE ... ( ... ) )` für die Selektion der zu validierenden Daten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entity_data,
             key      TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_entity_data.

CLASS zcl_rap_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_value_field.
    rt_failed_keys = VALUE #( 
        FOR <entity> IN it_entities
        WHERE ( value_field IS INITIAL )
        ( key = <entity>-key )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Zeit von einer Zeitzone in eine andere. Die Methode soll ein Objekt mit der konvertierten Zeit und dem Datum zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TIMEFM=>CONVERT_TIME_TO_TIMEZONE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timezone_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_time_to_timezone
      IMPORTING
        iv_time      TYPE tims
        iv_date      TYPE dats
        iv_from_tzone TYPE timezone
        iv_to_tzone   TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_converted_time) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_timefm=>ty_s_time_in_timezone.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timezone_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_time_to_timezone.
    TRY.
        rs_converted_time = cl_abap_timefm=>convert_time_to_timezone(
                                iv_time       = iv_time
                                iv_date       = iv_date
                                iv_from_tzone = iv_from_tzone
                                iv_to_tzone   = iv_to_tzone ).
      CATCH cx_abap_timefm_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid timezone
        " In a real scenario, you might raise an exception or log.
        rs_converted_time = NEW cl_abap_timefm=>ty_s_time_in_timezone( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timezone_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_timezone_conversion_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timezone_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_timezone_converter( ).
    DATA(ls_converted) = lo_converter->convert_time_to_timezone(
                             iv_time       = '120000'
                             iv_date       = '20251128'
                             iv_from_tzone = 'CET' " Central European Time
                             iv_to_tzone   = 'EST' " Eastern Standard Time
                         ).
    " CET is usually +6 hours from EST (during standard time, not daylight saving)
    " 12:00 CET = 06:00 EST

Instructions: In einem RAP-Kontext: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (aus `sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `sflights` und die moderne Gruppierungs- und Reduktionssyntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rap_flight_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rap_flight_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( 
        FOR GROUPS OF <flight> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <flight>-carrid
        ( carrid = <flight>-carrid
          flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP <flight> NEXT count = count + 1 ) 
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS in Paketen und berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitze für jede Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung moderner interner Tabellenoperationen (REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF).
hint: Kombinieren Sie OPEN CURSOR mit FOR GROUPS OF und REDUCE für die Aggregation innerhalb der Datenpakete.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_agg.
    TYPES: tt_flight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_sflights_seats RETURNING VALUE(rt_agg_data) TYPE tt_flight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_sflights_seats.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights_chunk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights PACKAGE SIZE 500.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights_chunk.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_chunk_agg) = REDUCE tt_flight_agg(
        INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_agg( )
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_chunk GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
        LET total_seats_for_group = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsmax ) IN
        NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_seats = total_seats_for_group ) )
      ).

      LOOP AT lt_chunk_agg INTO DATA(ls_chunk_agg).
        READ TABLE rt_agg_data INTO DATA(ls_existing_agg) WITH KEY carrid = ls_chunk_agg-carrid.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ls_existing_agg-total_seats = ls_existing_agg-total_seats + ls_chunk_agg-total_seats.
          MODIFY TABLE rt_agg_data FROM ls_existing_agg.
        ELSE.
          APPEND ls_chunk_agg TO rt_agg_data.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      CLEAR lt_sflights_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_agg_data) = lo_cut->aggregate_sflights_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_agg_data ) > 0 ) msg = 'No aggregated data found' ).

    READ TABLE lt_agg_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_agg_lh-total_seats > 0 ) msg = 'LH total seats should be greater than 0' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_data,
             id TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_combined_data.
    TYPES: tt_combined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined) TYPE tt_combined_data.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_data.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_chunk TYPE tt_combined_data PACKAGE SIZE 100.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT FROM sflights AS f
             FIELDS f~carrid AS id, f~connid AS description
        UNION ALL
      SELECT FROM scarr AS c
             FIELDS c~carrid AS id, c~carrname AS description.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_chunk.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND LINES OF lt_chunk TO rt_combined.
      CLEAR lt_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights_chunk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights PACKAGE SIZE 100.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights_chunk.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_filtered_chunk) = FILTER #( lt_sflights_chunk USING KEY primary_key WHERE seatsmax - seatsocc > 10 ).
      APPEND LINES OF lt_filtered_chunk TO rt_filtered_flights.

      CLEAR lt_sflights_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie ein komplexes XML-Dokument mit verschachtelten Elementen und Attributen, das Daten aus mehreren internen Tabellen (z.B. SFLIGHTS und SCARR) kombiniert, unter Verwendung von cl_sec_sxml_writer.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_complex_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_complex_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr UP TO 2 ROWS.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    lo_writer->open_element( 'AviationData' ).
    LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Carrier' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'ID' value = ls_scarr-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'Name' value = ls_scarr-carrname ).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
      DATA(lt_carrier_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = ls_scarr-carrid ).
      LOOP AT lt_carrier_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        lo_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
        lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'Connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).
        lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'Date' value = ls_flight-fldate ).
        lo_writer->open_element( 'Seats' ).
        lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-seatsmax ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flight
      ENDLOOP.
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flights
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Carrier
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close AviationData

    lo_writer->flush( ).
    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_flight_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lt_sflights_chunk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights PACKAGE SIZE 100.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights_chunk.

      APPEND LINES OF lt_sflights_chunk TO lt_sflights_all.
      CLEAR lt_sflights_chunk.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_dynamic_flight_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_writer_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dynamic_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr UP TO 3 ROWS.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    lo_writer->open_element( 'FlightSchedule' ).
    LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Airline' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'Code' value = ls_scarr-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'Name' value = ls_scarr-carrname ).

      DATA(lt_flights_for_carrier) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = ls_scarr-carrid ).
      IF lt_flights_for_carrier IS NOT INITIAL.
        lo_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
        LOOP AT lt_flights_for_carrier INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          lo_writer->open_element( 'FlightDetail' ).
          lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'Connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).
          lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'Date' value = ls_flight-fldate ).
          lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'Departure' value = ls_flight-deptime ).
          lo_writer->write_attribute( local_name = 'Arrival' value = ls_flight-arrtime ).
          lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close FlightDetail
        ENDLOOP.
        lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flights
      ENDIF.
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Airline
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close FlightSchedule

    lo_writer->flush( ).
    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller ID-Werte einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_sum IMPORTING it_data TYPE ty_t_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_entry IN it_data NEXT sum = sum + ls_entry-id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_io DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_io IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_language_file.
    " In a real scenario, you would use cl_cts_language_file_io methods here.

CLASS zcl_chain_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_raw,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_raw.
    TYPES ty_t_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_t_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING it_raw TYPE ty_t_raw
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed) TYPE ty_t_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chain_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rt_processed = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN FILTER #( it_raw WHERE active = abap_true AND id > 10 )
                              ( |ID: { ls_entry-id }, Wert: { ls_entry-value }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_chaining_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chain_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_chain_operations=>ty_t_raw(
      ( id = 5 value = 'A' active = abap_true )
      ( id = 12 value = 'B' active = abap_true )
      ( id = 15 value = 'C' active = abap_false )
      ( id = 20 value = 'D' active = abap_true )
    ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_data( lt_raw ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ] exp = 'ID: 12, Wert: B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ] exp = 'ID: 20, Wert: D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chaining_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chain_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_chain_operations=>ty_t_raw(
      ( id = 5 value = 'A' active = abap_true )
    ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_data( lt_raw ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_processed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verkettung von `FILTER`, `FOR` und `VALUE` können komplexe Datenmanipulationen auf internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, flüssigen und gut lesbaren Anweisung ausgedrückt werden. Dies fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Chaining, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

solution:
CLASS zcl_ida_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_salv_gui_table_ida_events.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_event.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_event.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
        lo_alv->set_event_receiver( me ).
        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_salv_gui_table_ida_events~on_double_click.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflights( ).
    io_alv->get_selected_rows_data( IMPORTING et_data = DATA(lt_selected_data) ).
    READ TABLE lt_selected_data INDEX 1 INTO ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Flug:' ls_sflight-carrid ls_sflight-connid ls_sflight-fldate DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Transport Layer eines gegebenen ABAP-Pakets (z.B. '$TMP').
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES=>GET_INSTANCE` und `GET_PACKAGE_ATTRIBUTES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_get_transport_layer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_transport_layer
      IMPORTING iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_transport_layer) TYPE trlayer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_get_transport_layer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transport_layer.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
        DATA(ls_attributes) = lo_package_queries->get_package_attributes( iv_package_name ).
        rv_transport_layer = ls_attributes-transport_layer.
      CATCH cx_pak_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., package not found
        rv_transport_layer = 'ERROR'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_transport_layer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_transport_layer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_get_transport_layer( ).

    " Test with a known local package
    DATA(lv_transport_layer_tmp) = lo_cut->get_transport_layer( '$TMP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_transport_layer_tmp exp = '' ). " $TMP usually has no transport layer

    " Test with a known global package (e.g., 'SABAP_DEMOS' or 'SAP_BASIS')
    DATA(lv_transport_layer_sap) = lo_cut->get_transport_layer( 'SABAP_DEMOS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_transport_layer_sap ). " Should have a transport layer

    " Test with a non-existent package
    DATA(lv_transport_layer_non_existent) = lo_cut->get_transport_layer( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT_PAK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_transport_layer_non_existent exp = 'ERROR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES` bietet eine standardisierte API zur Abfrage von ABAP-Paketinformationen. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man den Transport Layer eines Pakets ermittelt, was für die Verwaltung von Entwicklungsobjekten und Transporten wichtig ist. Die Verwendung von `GET_INSTANCE` stellt sicher, dass nur eine Instanz der Query-Klasse verwendet wird.
keywords: Package, Transport Layer, CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES, GET_PACKAGE_ATTRIBUTES

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Klassenobjekte, die direkt in einem gegebenen ABAP-Paket (z.B. 'SABAP_DEMOS') enthalten sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_PACKAGE_OBJECTS` und filtern Sie nach dem Objekttyp 'CLAS'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_get_classes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_class_info,
             object_name TYPE trobj_name,
             object_type TYPE trobjtype,
           END OF ty_class_info,
           tt_class_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_class_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_classes_in_package
      IMPORTING iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_classes) TYPE tt_class_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_get_classes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_classes_in_package.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
        DATA(lt_objects) = lo_package_queries->get_package_objects( iv_package_name ).

        rt_classes = FILTER #( lt_objects USING KEY primary_key WHERE object_type = 'CLAS' ).

      CATCH cx_pak_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_classes_in_package FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_classes_in_package.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_get_classes( ).

    " Test with a package known to contain classes (e.g., 'SABAP_DEMOS')
    DATA(lt_classes) = lo_cut->get_classes_in_package( 'SABAP_DEMOS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_classes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_classes ) > 0 ).

    " Check if all returned objects are indeed classes
    LOOP AT lt_classes INTO DATA(ls_class).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_class-object_type exp = 'CLAS' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with a package known to contain no classes (or very few, depending on system)
    DATA(lt_classes_tmp) = lo_cut->get_classes_in_package( '$TMP' ).
    " $TMP might contain some local classes, so we check if it's not excessively large
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_classes_tmp ) < 100 ). " Arbitrary small number
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die Methode `GET_PACKAGE_OBJECTS` der `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES` Klasse, um alle Entwicklungsobjekte eines Pakets abzurufen. Anschließend wird der moderne `FILTER`-Operator verwendet, um nur die Objekte vom Typ 'CLAS' (Klassen) zu extrahieren. Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Unterpakete eines gegebenen Pakets (z.B. 'SABAP_DEMOS') unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES=>GET_SUB_PACKAGES` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_reduce_sub_packages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_sub_packages
      IMPORTING iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_reduce_sub_packages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_sub_packages.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_package_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
        DATA(lt_sub_packages) = lo_package_queries->get_sub_packages( iv_package_name ).

        rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR sub_pak IN lt_sub_packages WHERE ( sub_pak IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).

      CATCH cx_pak_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_sub_packages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_sub_packages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pak_reduce_sub_packages( ).

    " Test with a package known to have sub-packages (e.g., 'SABAP_DEMOS')
    DATA(lv_count_demos) = lo_cut->count_sub_packages( 'SABAP_DEMOS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count_demos > 0 ).

    " Test with a package known to have no sub-packages (e.g., '$TMP')
    DATA(lv_count_tmp) = lo_cut->count_sub_packages( '$TMP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_tmp exp = 0 ).

    " Test with a non-existent package (should return 0 or handle error)
    DATA(lv_count_non_existent) = lo_cut->count_sub_packages( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT_PAK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_non_existent exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein funktionales Programmierkonzept in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um die Anzahl der Unterpakete zu zählen, die von `CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES` zurückgegeben werden. Dies ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: Package, Sub-packages, CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Count

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine zufällige Ganzzahl innerhalb eines angegebenen Bereichs (einschließlich Minimum und Maximum).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und skalieren Sie das Ergebnis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_integer
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i
        iv_max TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_integer.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_float) = lo_random->get_next( ).
    rv_integer = iv_min + trunc( lv_float * ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_integer FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_integer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_int_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_min) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max) = 100.
    DATA(lv_int) = lo_cut->get_random_integer( iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_int >= lv_min AND lv_int <= lv_max ) ).

    " Test with different range
    lv_min = -10.
    lv_max = 10.
    lv_int = lo_cut->get_random_integer( iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max ).

explanation: Diese Lösung zeigt, wie man eine zufällige Gleitkommazahl in eine zufällige Ganzzahl innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs umwandelt. Die Formel `iv_min + trunc( lv_float * ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ) )` skaliert den 0-1-Float-Wert auf den gewünschten Ganzzahlbereich. `trunc` wird verwendet, um den Nachkommateil abzuschneiden.
keywords: Random, Integer, Range, Math, Skalierung

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` aus.
hint: Lesen Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle, ermitteln Sie deren Größe, generieren Sie einen zufälligen Index und verwenden Sie `READ TABLE INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights WHERE fldate >= sy-datum ( ls_sflight ) ).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = trunc( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_table_size ) + 1.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight_selector( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) = lo_cut->get_random_sflight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_sflight-carrid exp = abap_false msg = 'Should return a flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_sflight-connid exp = abap_false msg = 'Should return a flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_sflight-fldate exp = abap_false msg = 'Should return a flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Generierung von Zufallszahlen mit Operationen auf internen Tabellen. Es liest zunächst alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle. Dann wird ein zufälliger Index basierend auf der Tabellengröße generiert und der entsprechende Eintrag mit `READ TABLE INDEX` gelesen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` und `FOR` für das Füllen der internen Tabelle ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: Random, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, READ TABLE, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen booleschen Wert (wahr oder falsch).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und vergleichen Sie den Wert mit 0.5.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_boolean_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_boolean RETURNING VALUE(rv_boolean) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_boolean_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_boolean.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_float) = lo_random->get_next( ).
    IF lv_float < 0.5.
      rv_boolean = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_boolean = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_boolean FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_boolean.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_boolean_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_true_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_false_count) = 0.

    DO 100 TIMES.
      IF lo_cut->get_random_boolean( ) = abap_true.
        lv_true_count = lv_true_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_false_count = lv_false_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    " Assert that both true and false values were generated at least once
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_true_count > 0 ) msg = 'Should generate true at least once' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_false_count > 0 ) msg = 'Should generate false at least once' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine einfache Anwendung von Zufallszahlen zur Erzeugung eines booleschen Werts. Durch den Vergleich der generierten Gleitkommazahl mit 0.5 wird eine 50/50-Chance für `TRUE` oder `FALSE` simuliert. Der Unit-Test führt die Generierung mehrfach aus, um zu überprüfen, ob beide Werte erzeugt werden können (probabilistisch).
keywords: Random, Boolean, Logic, Zufallsentscheidung

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Sequenz von Zufallszahlen unter Verwendung eines spezifischen Seeds, um die Reproduzierbarkeit zu gewährleisten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_seeded_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_sequence
      IMPORTING
        iv_seed TYPE i
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sequence) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_seeded_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sequence.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( iv_seed = iv_seed ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND lo_random->get_next( ) TO rt_sequence.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_seeded_random FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_seeded_random.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_seeded_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_seed) = 12345.
    DATA(lv_count) = 5.

    DATA(lt_sequence1) = lo_cut->get_random_sequence( iv_seed = lv_seed iv_count = lv_count ).
    DATA(lt_sequence2) = lo_cut->get_random_sequence( iv_seed = lv_seed iv_count = lv_count ).
    DATA(lt_sequence3) = lo_cut->get_random_sequence( iv_seed = 54321 iv_count = lv_count ).

Dies ist nützlich für Tests oder Simulationen, bei denen konsistente Ergebnisse erforderlich sind.
keywords: Random, Seed, Reproducibility, Zufallszahlengenerator

CLASS zcl_abapedit_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_code
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_abapedit_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " In a real scenario, mo_container would be a custom container on a screen.
    " For demonstration, we use screen0, which is a global container for simple controls.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container EXPORTING container_name = cl_gui_container=>screen0.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_code.
    IF mo_editor IS BOUND.
      mo_editor->set_text_as_r3table( it_text_r3 = it_code_lines ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_retrieve DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_destroy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS create_editor.
    METHODS destroy_editor.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_destroy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container EXPORTING container_name = cl_gui_container=>screen0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_editor.
    IF mo_editor IS NOT BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_editor
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD destroy_editor.
    IF mo_editor IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_editor->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_editor.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free( ).
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
    " Alternatively, to free all custom controls:
    " cl_gui_container=>free_custom_controls( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abapedit_destroy( ).

    lo_cut->create_editor( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    " Assert that editor object is created (bound)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_cut->mo_editor msg = 'Editor should be bound after creation' ).

    lo_cut->destroy_editor( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    " Assert that editor object is freed (not bound)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( act = lo_cut->mo_editor msg = 'Editor should be freed after destruction' ).

    cl_gui_container=>free_custom_controls( ). " Ensure all controls are freed for subsequent tests
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Klasse `zcl_abapedit_destroy` bietet Methoden zum Erstellen (`create_editor`) und Zerstören (`destroy_editor`) des `cl_gui_abapedit`-Objekts. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flügen für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_prices_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_prices_by_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflight_prices( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sflight_prices=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result_lh) = lo_cut->sum_prices_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_lh exp = '600.00' msg = 'Sum for LH incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_result_ua) = lo_cut->sum_prices_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_carrid = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_ua exp = '150.00' msg = 'Sum for UA incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_result_xx) = lo_cut->sum_prices_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_xx exp = '0.00' msg = 'Sum for non-existent carrier incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle zu iterieren und dabei einen einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um komplexe Berechnungen auf Tabellendaten durchzuführen, ohne explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen. Es ersetzt oft die Notwendigkeit für 'LOOP AT ... SUM'.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, COMPUTE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in einer gegebenen Tabelle den Flugpreis in einer anderen Währung (z.B. EUR) berechnet und die neue Währung als Feld hinzufügt. Nutzen Sie den FOR-Operator.
hint: Der FOR-Operator in Kombination mit VALUE ermöglicht die Transformation von Tabellenzeilen mit Inline-Berechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_sflight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_converted,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             price_eur TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_converted.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_converted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_converted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_prices_to_eur
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_exchange_rate TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_sflight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_prices_to_eur.
    rt_converted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                    ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                                      connid    = flight-connid
                                      price_eur = flight-price * iv_exchange_rate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_sflight_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_for_sflight_transform=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_exchange_rate) = '0.90'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->convert_prices_to_eur( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_exchange_rate = lv_exchange_rate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price_eur exp = '90.00' msg = 'First price conversion incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price_eur exp = '180.00' msg = 'Second price conversion incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Operator in einem VALUE-Konstruktor ermöglicht die Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle durch Iteration und Transformation einer bestehenden Tabelle. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Methode, um Daten zu manipulieren und ersetzt oft explizite LOOP-Anweisungen mit APPEND-Operationen.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, COMPUTE, VALUE, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Quadratwurzel einer Zahl mithilfe einer funktionalen Methode der Klasse CL_ABAP_MATH.
hint: Nutzen Sie die statische Methode CL_ABAP_MATH=>SQRT für die Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_sqrt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sqrt
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sqrt_value) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_sqrt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sqrt.
    rv_sqrt_value = cl_abap_math=>sqrt( iv_number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sqrt_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sqrt_zero FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_sqrt_negative FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sqrt_positive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_sqrt( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sqrt( '9.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '3.0' msg = 'SQRT of 9 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sqrt_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_sqrt( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sqrt( '0.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.0' msg = 'SQRT of 0 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sqrt_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_sqrt( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_sqrt( '-4.0' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR for negative number' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR correctly raised' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung funktionaler Methoden, insbesondere statischer Methoden von Utility-Klassen wie CL_ABAP_MATH, ist der moderne Weg, um komplexe mathematische Operationen durchzuführen. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code und die Lesbarkeit, da die Funktion der Methode direkt aus ihrem Namen ersichtlich ist. Es ersetzt manuelle Implementierungen oder ältere Funktionsbausteine.
keywords: COMPUTE, Functional Method, Math, CL_ABAP_MATH

Instructions: Geben Sie mehrere Zeilen Text nacheinander aus, um einen einfachen Bericht zu simulieren. Nutzen Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining) mit CL_DEMO_OUTPUT.
hint: Method Chaining mit CL_DEMO_OUTPUT=>WRITE und CL_DEMO_OUTPUT=>DISPLAY ermöglicht eine flüssige Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_output DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_output IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_report.
    cl_demo_output=>write( |--- Start Bericht ---| )
                   ->write( |Dies ist die erste Zeile.| )
                   ->write( |Dies ist die zweite Zeile mit { sy-uname }.| )
                   ->display( |--- Ende Bericht ---| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_display_report FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_report.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chained_output( ).
    " Da CL_DEMO_OUTPUT direkt auf den Ausgabestrom schreibt, ist ein direkter Unit-Test des Outputs schwierig.
    " Stattdessen wird hier nur der Aufruf der Methode getestet, um die Code-Abdeckung zu gewährleisten.
    " In realen Szenarien würde man die Ausgabe in eine String-Variable umleiten oder Mocking verwenden.
    lo_cut->display_report( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Method call should complete without dump' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, also die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen, erhöht die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, insbesondere bei Utility-Klassen wie CL_DEMO_OUTPUT. Anstatt separate 'WRITE'-Anweisungen zu verwenden, können mehrere Ausgaben in einer einzigen, fließenden Anweisung zusammengefasst werden. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zur klassischen 'WRITE'-Anweisung für die Bildschirmausgabe.
keywords: WRITE, Output, Method Chaining, CL_DEMO_OUTPUT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Endpreis eines Artikels nach Anwendung eines Rabatts und anschließender Steuer, wobei Zwischenergebnisse klar definiert sind. Nutzen Sie den LET-Operator.
hint: Der LET-Operator ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_let_price_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_final_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_price    TYPE decfloat16
        iv_discount_rate TYPE decfloat16
        iv_tax_rate      TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_let_price_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_final_price.
    rv_final_price = LET
                       discount_amount = iv_base_price * iv_discount_rate / 100
                       price_after_discount = iv_base_price - discount_amount
                     IN
                       price_after_discount * ( 1 + iv_tax_rate / 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_final_price_calc FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_final_price_no_discount FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_final_price_calc.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_let_price_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_final_price( iv_base_price = '100.00' iv_discount_rate = '10.00' iv_tax_rate = '19.00' ).
    " 100 - 10% = 90. 90 * 1.19 = 107.10
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '107.10' msg = 'Final price calculation incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_final_price_no_discount.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_let_price_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_final_price( iv_base_price = '100.00' iv_discount_rate = '0.00' iv_tax_rate = '19.00' ).
    " 100 * 1.19 = 119.00
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '119.00' msg = 'Final price with no discount incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der LET-Operator ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen, temporären Variablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit komplexer Berechnungen erheblich, da Zwischenergebnisse benannt und wiederverwendet werden können, ohne separate Variablen deklarieren zu müssen. Es ist ein Merkmal der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: COMPUTE, LET, Functional Programming, Math, Expressions

Instructions: Geben Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle in einem lesbaren Format aus. Nutzen Sie eine LOOP-Anweisung und String-Templates.
hint: Kombinieren Sie LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...) mit String-Templates für die formatierte Ausgabe jeder Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_sflight_output DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_sflight_output IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_by_carrier.
    cl_demo_output=>write( |--- Flüge für { iv_carrid } ---| ).
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      cl_demo_output=>write( |Flug: { ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }, Datum: { ls_sflight-fldate }, Preis: { ls_sflight-price } { ls_sflight-currency }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |--- Ende der Liste ---| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_display_flights FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_display_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_sflight_output( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_loop_sflight_output=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    " Auch hier ist ein direkter Test der CL_DEMO_OUTPUT-Ausgabe schwierig.
    " Der Test stellt sicher, dass die Methode ohne Fehler durchläuft.
    lo_cut->display_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Method call for LH should complete without dump' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_sflight_output( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_loop_sflight_output=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    lo_cut->display_flights_by_carrier( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Method call for non-existent carrier should complete without dump' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus der modernen Inline-Deklaration in der LOOP-Anweisung (LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)) und String-Templates für die Ausgabe ist der Standardweg, um Daten aus internen Tabellen zu verarbeiten und zu präsentieren. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und wartungsfreundlicher als ältere Ansätze mit expliziten Work Areas und WRITE-Anweisungen.
keywords: WRITE, LOOP, Internal Tables, String Templates, Output

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug basierend auf seinem Preis eine Preiskategorie zu ('Günstig', 'Standard', 'Premium'). Nutzen Sie den CASE-Operator.
hint: Der CASE-Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante bedingte Zuweisung basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_price_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_price_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_category.
    rv_category = CASE WHEN iv_price < 200 THEN 'Günstig'
                       WHEN iv_price >= 200 AND iv_price < 500 THEN 'Standard'
                       ELSE 'Premium'
                  END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_category_premium FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_category_cheap.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_price_category( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_price_category( '150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Günstig' msg = 'Category for cheap price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_category_standard.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_price_category( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_price_category( '350.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Standard' msg = 'Category for standard price incorrect' ).

  METHOD test_category_premium.

explanation: Der CASE-Operator für bedingte Ausdrücke ist eine moderne und sehr lesbare Alternative zu verschachtelten IF-Anweisungen. Er ermöglicht es, einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zuzuweisen, was den Code kompakter und leichter verständlich macht. Dies ist eine Form der funktionalen Zuweisung.
keywords: COMPUTE, CASE, Conditional Logic, Assignment, Expressions

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (sflights) nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator.
hint: Der FILTER-Operator ist die moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_expensive_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_price_threshold ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflight_prices( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_filter_sflight_prices=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '250.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_threshold) = '200.00'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_expensive_flights( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_price_threshold = lv_threshold ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0401' msg = 'First filtered flight incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0402' msg = 'Second filtered flight incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflight_prices( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_filter_sflight_prices=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_threshold) = '200.00'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_expensive_flights( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_price_threshold = lv_threshold ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Should return no flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ist die moderne und effiziente Methode, um interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ersetzt explizite LOOP-Anweisungen mit IF-Bedingungen und APPEND-Operationen und führt zu kompakterem und besser lesbarem Code. Die Verwendung eines Schlüssels (hier `primary_key`) kann die Performance weiter optimieren.
keywords: COMPUTE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Filtering, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Länge eines Strings und geben Sie diese aus. Nutzen Sie die Funktion STRLEN und String-Templates.
hint: STRLEN ist eine eingebaute Funktion zur Bestimmung der String-Länge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_string_length_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_string_length_info.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    rv_output_string = |Der String '{ iv_input_string }' hat die Länge { lv_length } Zeichen.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_string_length FOR TESTING.
  METHODS test_empty_string_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_length( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_string_length_info( 'Hallo Welt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Der String ''Hallo Welt'' hat die Länge 10 Zeichen.' msg = 'String length incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string_length.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen Selektionsbildschirm mit einem Parameter und einem Select-Option für Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES=>GENERIC` und die Struktur `SCI_ATTTAB`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_sel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_selection_screen
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string DEFAULT 'Flugdatenselektion'
      EXPORTING
        ev_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        et_connid TYPE RANGE OF s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_flight_sel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_selection_screen.
    DATA: lt_attributes TYPE sci_atttab,
          ls_attribute  TYPE sci_att.

    " Parameter for Carrier ID
    ls_attribute-kind = 'S'. " Parameter
    ls_attribute-name = 'P_CARRID'.
    ls_attribute-text = 'Fluggesellschaft'.
    GET REFERENCE OF ev_carrid INTO ls_attribute-ref.
    APPEND ls_attribute TO lt_attributes.

    " Select-Option for Connection ID
    CLEAR ls_attribute.
    ls_attribute-kind = 'T'. " Select-Option (without intervals)
    ls_attribute-name = 'S_CONNID'.
    ls_attribute-text = 'Flugnummer'.
    GET REFERENCE OF et_connid INTO ls_attribute-ref.
    APPEND ls_attribute TO lt_attributes.

    cl_ci_query_attributes=>generic(
      EXPORTING
        p_name       = sy-repid
        p_title      = iv_title
        p_attributes = lt_attributes
        p_display    = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_screen_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_screen_generation.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
          lt_connid TYPE RANGE OF s_conn_id.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_flight_sel( ).

    " We cannot assert user interaction, but we can ensure the method runs without dump.
    " The actual screen display is a UI event.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_selection_screen(
          EXPORTING
            iv_title  = 'Test Flugdatenselektion'
          IMPORTING
            ev_carrid = lv_carrid
            et_connid = lt_connid
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Screen generation should not dump' act = '' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Screen generation caused a dump' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist nützlich für schnelle Prototypen oder interne Tools, ohne auf klassische Dynpros zurückgreifen zu müssen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen Selektionsbildschirm mit Checkboxen und Radiobuttons zur Auswahl von Optionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `KIND` 'C' für Checkboxen und 'R' für Radiobuttons in `SCI_ATTTAB`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_options_sel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_option_screen
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string DEFAULT 'Optionen auswählen'
      EXPORTING
        ev_option1 TYPE abap_bool
        ev_option2 TYPE abap_bool
        ev_group1_val TYPE char1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_options_sel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_option_screen.
    DATA: lt_attributes TYPE sci_atttab,
          ls_attribute  TYPE sci_att.

    " Checkbox Option 1
    ls_attribute-kind = 'C'. " Checkbox
    ls_attribute-name = 'CB_OPT1'.
    ls_attribute-text = 'Option 1 aktivieren'.
    GET REFERENCE OF ev_option1 INTO ls_attribute-ref.
    APPEND ls_attribute TO lt_attributes.

    " Checkbox Option 2
    CLEAR ls_attribute.
    ls_attribute-kind = 'C'. " Checkbox
    ls_attribute-name = 'CB_OPT2'.
    ls_attribute-text = 'Option 2 aktivieren'.
    GET REFERENCE OF ev_option2 INTO ls_attribute-ref.
    APPEND ls_attribute TO lt_attributes.

    " Radiobutton Group 1 - Value A
    CLEAR ls_attribute.
    ls_attribute-kind = 'R'. " Radiobutton
    ls_attribute-name = 'RB_GRP1_A'.
    ls_attribute-text = 'Gruppe 1 - Auswahl A'.
    ls_attribute-group = 'GRP1'. " Group name
    ls_attribute-value = 'A'.
    GET REFERENCE OF ev_group1_val INTO ls_attribute-ref.
    APPEND ls_attribute TO lt_attributes.

    " Radiobutton Group 1 - Value B
    CLEAR ls_attribute.
    ls_attribute-kind = 'R'. " Radiobutton
    ls_attribute-name = 'RB_GRP1_B'.
    ls_attribute-text = 'Gruppe 1 - Auswahl B'.
    ls_attribute-group = 'GRP1'. " Group name
    ls_attribute-value = 'B'.
    GET REFERENCE OF ev_group1_val INTO ls_attribute-ref.
    APPEND ls_attribute TO lt_attributes.

    cl_ci_query_attributes=>generic(
      EXPORTING
        p_name       = sy-repid
        p_title      = iv_title
        p_attributes = lt_attributes
        p_display    = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle (`sflights`) basierend auf einem Kriterium und speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,

             cityto   TYPE s_city,

           END OF ty_flight.

    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Anstatt explizite Schleifen zu schreiben, kann die Filterbedingung direkt im Ausdruck angegeben werden, was den Code kürzer und wartbarer macht.
