Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) und berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_prices TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS calculate_total_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_prices.
    rt_carrier_prices = REDUCE tt_carrier_prices(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_prices( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      LET current_price = result[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid ]-total_price IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrier_prices(
        result
        ( carrid = flight-carrid total_price = current_price + flight-price )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_prices TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_price WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS test_reduce_operator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_operator.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'LH' price = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'AA' price = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'LH' price = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'BA' price = 300 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_prices( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'LH' ]-total_price exp = 250 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ]-total_price exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'BA' ]-total_price exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ABAP 7.50+) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert oder eine neue Tabelle zu reduzieren, indem man über die Elemente iteriert und einen Akkumulator aktualisiert. Die `LET`-Expression verbessert die Lesbarkeit, indem sie temporäre Variablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks definiert. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Beispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50, Functional Programming, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Standardimplementierung für eine Methode und überschreiben Sie diese in einer Klasse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DEFAULT` für Interface-Methoden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string
    DEFAULT VIA zcl_default_logger.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_default_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_default_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " Default implementation: write to system log
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Default Log: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " Custom implementation: write to a different output
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Custom Log: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_implementation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_custom_implementation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_implementation.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_default_logger( ).
    " This test would typically involve checking system log or a mock object
    " For simplicity, we just call it and ensure no dump.
    TRY.
        lo_logger->zif_logger~log_message( 'Test default log' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Default log should not dump' act = '' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Default log caused a dump' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_custom_implementation.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_custom_logger( ).
    TRY.
        lo_logger->zif_logger~log_message( 'Test custom log' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Custom log should not dump' act = '' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Custom log caused a dump' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Mit ABAP 7.50+ können Interfaces Standardimplementierungen für Methoden über die `DEFAULT VIA`-Syntax erhalten. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code in implementierenden Klassen, da sie die Methode nur überschreiben müssen, wenn ein abweichendes Verhalten gewünscht ist. Es fördert eine flexiblere und erweiterbarere objektorientierte Architektur, indem es eine Basisimplementierung direkt im Interface bereitstellt.
keywords: Interface, DEFAULT VIA, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.50, Polymorphism

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Unterschied zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Sekunden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timestamp_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_diff_in_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_diff_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_diff_in_seconds.
    rv_diff_seconds = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff(
      iv_tstmp1 = iv_tstmp1
      iv_tstmp2 = iv_tstmp2
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timestamp_diff FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timestamp_diff.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timestamp_diff( ).

    DATA(lv_tstmp_now) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utc_from_system_tstmp( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_later) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_tstmp_now iv_secs = 60 ).

    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_cut->calculate_diff_in_seconds(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_later
      iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_now
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 60 ).

    DATA(lv_diff_negative) = lo_cut->calculate_diff_in_seconds(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_now
      iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_later
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff_negative exp = -60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.40+) bietet eine robuste und typsichere Möglichkeit, mit Zeitstempeln zu arbeiten. Die Methode `DIFF` berechnet den Unterschied zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Sekunden, was die manuelle Berechnung überflüssig macht und Fehlerquellen reduziert. Dies ist ein Standard für die Handhabung von Datums- und Zeitoperationen in modernem ABAP.
keywords: Date/Time, Timestamp, CL_ABAP_TSTMP, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_is_active TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(

  METHOD test_cond_operator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator( ).

    DATA(lv_active_text) = lo_cut->get_status_text( abap_true ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein bestimmtes Muster enthält, und extrahieren Sie bei Erfolg den passenden Teil.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FIND` Anweisung mit `MATCH OFFSET` und `MATCH LENGTH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_string_pattern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_and_extract_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_found   TYPE abap_bool
        ev_match   TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_strg_par_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_string_pattern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_and_extract_pattern.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i,
          lv_length TYPE i.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_pattern IN SECTION OFFSET 0 OF iv_text
      MATCH OFFSET lv_offset
      MATCH LENGTH lv_length.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ev_found = abap_true.
      ev_match = iv_text+lv_offset(lv_length).
    ELSE.
      ev_found = abap_false.
      CLEAR ev_match.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Einträge pro Gruppe.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_and_count
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_results) TYPE tt_grouped_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_and_count.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        carrid = group_key-carrid
        connid = group_key-connid
        count  = group_key->* =>lines( )
      ) TO rt_grouped_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_0400-count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_0017) = lt_result[ KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ].

Der Zugriff auf die Gruppenelemente über `group_key->*` und die Methode `lines()` zur Zählung sind moderne Features, die die Datenverarbeitung in ABAP erheblich vereinfachen.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_group_by_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE zcl_group_by_sflight=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_result_aa) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_aa-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_result_lh) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_lh-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_result_ua) = lt_grouped[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_ua-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature ab ABAP 7.40, das die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht. Es ersetzt komplexe manuelle Gruppierungslogiken und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, SFLIGHT, aggregation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer ABAP-Struktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI-Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    METHODS get_component_names
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_names.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_component_names.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error if ir_data is not a structure
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, dynamic programming, structure, reflection

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Kette von Verantwortlichkeiten (Chain of Responsibility) unter Verwendung von Interfaces und Method Chaining.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für Handler und lassen Sie jede Implementierung den nächsten Handler aufrufen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_handler.
  METHODS set_next_handler
    IMPORTING
      io_next_handler TYPE REF TO zif_handler
    RETURNING
      VALUE(ro_handler) TYPE REF TO zif_handler.
  METHODS handle_request
    IMPORTING
      iv_request TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_concrete_handler_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    INTERFACES zif_handler.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_next_handler TYPE REF TO zif_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_handler_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_handler~set_next_handler.
    mo_next_handler = io_next_handler.
    ro_handler = io_next_handler.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_handler~handle_request.
    IF iv_request = 'Request A'.
      rv_result = 'Handler A processed Request A'.
    ELSEIF mo_next_handler IS BOUND.
      rv_result = mo_next_handler->handle_request( iv_request ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Request not handled'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_handler_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    INTERFACES zif_handler.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_next_handler TYPE REF TO zif_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_handler_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_handler~set_next_handler.
    mo_next_handler = io_next_handler.
    ro_handler = io_next_handler.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_handler~handle_request.
    IF iv_request = 'Request B'.
      rv_result = 'Handler B processed Request B'.
    ELSEIF mo_next_handler IS BOUND.
      rv_result = mo_next_handler->handle_request( iv_request ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Request not handled'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_chain_of_responsibility FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chain_of_responsibility.
    DATA(lo_handler_a) = NEW zcl_concrete_handler_a( ).
    DATA(lo_handler_b) = NEW zcl_concrete_handler_b( ).

    lo_handler_a->zif_handler~set_next_handler( lo_handler_b ).

    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_handler_a->zif_handler~handle_request( 'Request A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_a exp = 'Handler A processed Request A' ).

    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_handler_a->zif_handler~handle_request( 'Request B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_b exp = 'Handler B processed Request B' ).

    DATA(lv_result_c) = lo_handler_a->zif_handler~handle_request( 'Request C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_c exp = 'Request not handled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Chain of Responsibility-Designmuster ist ein klassisches objektorientiertes Muster, das in ABAP elegant mit Interfaces und Method Chaining implementiert werden kann. Es fördert lose Kopplung und Flexibilität bei der Verarbeitung von Anfragen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Chain of Responsibility, Interfaces, Method Chaining

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine Hashed Table für Flugdaten (`sflights`) und fügen Sie Einträge hinzu. Greifen Sie effizient über den Primärschlüssel auf einen Eintrag zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES HASHED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` und `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed_t TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS create_and_populate_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflights_hashed_t.
    METHODS read_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_flight_by_key.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = create_and_populate_table( ).
    READ TABLE lt_sflights INTO rs_sflight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_read FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_read.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->create_and_populate_table( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).

    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->read_flight_by_key( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_basic( ).
    lo_cut->read_flight_by_key( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '19000101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Hashed Tables bieten eine durchschnittliche Zugriffszeit von O(1) für Primärschlüsselzugriffe, was sie extrem effizient für große Datenmengen macht, bei denen der Zugriff über den Schlüssel erfolgt. Die `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY` Syntax ist der moderne und performante Weg, um auf Einträge zuzugreifen.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, UNIQUE KEY, READ TABLE, SFLIGHTS, PERFORMANCE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table für Flugdaten mit einem Primärschlüssel und einem sekundären Hashed Key. Greifen Sie über beide Schlüsseltypen zu.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_primary_key FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_secondary_key FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_sec_key_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  METHOD test_read_primary_key.

    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->read_by_primary_key( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

explanation: Sekundärschlüssel ermöglichen effiziente Zugriffe auf interne Tabellen über alternative Schlüssel, ohne die Tabelle neu sortieren oder eine Loop über alle Einträge durchführen zu müssen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Hashed Tables, da der Zugriff über den Primärschlüssel zwar O(1) ist, aber andere Felder ohne Sekundärschlüssel einen O(N) Zugriff erfordern würden.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Eintrag in einer Hashed Table basierend auf dem Primärschlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed_t TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS create_and_populate_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflights_hashed_t.
    METHODS modify_flight_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE ty_sflights_hashed_t
      RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD modify_flight_seats.
    DATA(ls_flight_new) = VALUE ty_sflight(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
      seatsocc = iv_new_seatsocc
    ).

    MODIFY TABLE ct_sflights FROM ls_flight_new.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_existing_entry FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_existing_entry FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate

      UP TO 5 ROWS

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_flight_by_key.
    DELETE TABLE ct_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Stellen Sie sicher, dass ein Timer ordnungsgemäß gestoppt und freigegeben wird, auch wenn Fehler auftreten. Verwenden Sie einen `FINALLY`-Block.
hint: Platzieren Sie die `DEACTIVATE` und `FREE` Methoden des Timers im `FINALLY`-Block einer `TRY...CATCH...ENDTRY` Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_is_freed TYPE abap_bool READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_and_stop_with_cleanup IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_and_stop_with_cleanup.
    TRY.
        mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
        mo_timer->activate( ).

        IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
          " Simulate an error
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.

        mo_timer->deactivate( ).

      CATCH cx_root.
        " Error handling
        MESSAGE 'An error occurred, but timer will be cleaned up.' TYPE 'I'.
      FINALLY.
        IF mo_timer IS BOUND.
          mo_timer->deactivate( ).
          FREE mo_timer.
          mv_is_freed = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    " Event handler logic (not directly tested here, focus is on cleanup)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( mo_cut->mv_is_freed ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_on_error.
    TRY.
        mo_cut->start_and_stop_with_cleanup( iv_interval = 1 iv_simulate_error = abap_true ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised' ).

explanation: Der `FINALLY`-Block in einer `TRY...CATCH...ENDTRY` Struktur garantiert, dass der Code innerhalb des Blocks immer ausgeführt wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht. Dies ist entscheidend für die ordnungsgemäße Freigabe von GUI-Objekten wie `cl_gui_timer`, um Ressourcenlecks und unerwartetes Verhalten zu vermeiden.

    mv_max_count = iv_max_triggers.
    mv_current_count = 0.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
    mv_is_active = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS BOUND.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
      FREE mo_timer.
      mv_is_active = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    ADD 1 TO mv_current_count.
    IF mv_current_count >= mv_max_count.
      stop_timer( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Hashed Table basierend auf einem Kriterium und erstellen Sie eine neue Hashed Table mit den gefilterten Ergebnissen unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed_t TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS create_and_populate_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflights_hashed_t.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE ty_sflights_hashed_t
        iv_min_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_hashed_t.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights_by_seats.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_source_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE seatsocc >= iv_min_seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->create_and_populate_table( ).

    DATA(lv_min_seats) = 100.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_seats( it_source_flights = lt_all_flights iv_min_seatsocc = lv_min_seats ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL ).

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit Hashed Tables und der Angabe eines Schlüssels (`USING KEY primary_key`) kann die Filterung sehr performant sein, da der Zugriff auf die Elemente über den Hashed Key erfolgt.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) aus einer Hashed Table zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem Initialwert und einer Iteration über die Hashed Table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed_t TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS create_and_populate_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflights_hashed_t.
    METHODS calculate_total_seatsocc
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_hashed_t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_table.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_seatsocc.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN it_flights NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_seatsocc FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_seatsocc.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->create_and_populate_table( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_flight-seatsocc.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seatsocc( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (ab 7.50) ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulationslogik anwendet. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, REDUCE, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, MODERN ABAP, SFLIGHTS, AGGREGATION

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Timer, der eine Methode in einem anderen Objekt aufruft, um eine lose Kopplung zu demonstrieren.
hint: Der Timer-Event-Handler soll eine Methode eines Interfaces aufrufen, das von einem anderen Objekt implementiert wird.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_timer_consumer PUBLIC.
  METHODS receive_timer_tick.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_loosely_coupled DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_consumer TYPE REF TO zif_timer_consumer.
    METHODS start_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mo_consumer TYPE REF TO zif_timer_consumer.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_loosely_coupled IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    mo_consumer = io_consumer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->deactivate( ).
    FREE mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    IF mo_consumer IS BOUND.
      mo_consumer->receive_timer_tick( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_test_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_timer_consumer.
    DATA mv_tick_count TYPE i READ-ONLY.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS zif_timer_consumer~receive_timer_tick.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_test_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_timer_consumer~receive_timer_tick.
    ADD 1 TO mv_tick_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_consumer TYPE REF TO zcl_timer_test_consumer.
    DATA mo_timer_wrapper TYPE REF TO zcl_gui_timer_loosely_coupled.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    METHODS test_loosely_coupled_timer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mo_consumer = NEW zcl_timer_test_consumer( ).
    mo_timer_wrapper = NEW zcl_gui_timer_loosely_coupled( io_consumer = mo_consumer ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    mo_timer_wrapper->stop_timer( ).
    CLEAR mo_timer_wrapper.
    CLEAR mo_consumer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_loosely_coupled_timer.
    mo_timer_wrapper->start_timer( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mo_consumer->mv_tick_count exp = 0 ).

    " Simulate timer event
    mo_timer_wrapper->handle_timer_event( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mo_consumer->mv_tick_count exp = 1 ).

    mo_timer_wrapper->handle_timer_event( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mo_consumer->mv_tick_count exp = 2 ).

    mo_timer_wrapper->stop_timer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung eines Interfaces (`zif_timer_consumer`) wird eine lose Kopplung zwischen dem Timer-Objekt und dem Objekt, das auf die Timer-Ereignisse reagiert, erreicht. Der Timer kennt nur das Interface, nicht die konkrete Implementierung des Konsumenten. Dies fördert die Modularität und Wartbarkeit des Codes.

CLASS zcl_codepage_convert IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Grüße'. " UTF-8 string with umlaut

    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(

    DATA(lv_iso_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(

                                      iv_source_cp    = 'UTF-8'
                                      iv_target_cp    = '1100' ).

                                        source = lv_converted_string
                                        codepage = '1100' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_input_iso_char) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_converter( source_codepage = 'UTF-8' target_codepage = '1100' )->convert( 'ü' ).
    DATA(lv_input_iso) = 'Gr' && lv_input_iso_char && 'ße'.
    DATA(lv_expected_utf8) = 'Grüße'.

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->convert_string_codepage(
                                      iv_input_string = lv_input_iso
                                      iv_source_cp    = '1100'
                                      iv_target_cp    = 'UTF-8' ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in eine andere Codepage und fangen Sie mögliche Konvertierungsfehler ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERTER_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_source_cp    TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp    TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_converter) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_converter(
          source_codepage = iv_source_cp
          target_codepage = iv_target_cp
        ).
        rv_output_string = lo_converter->convert( iv_input_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Z.B. Loggen des Fehlers oder Rückgabe eines leeren Strings
        rv_output_string = 'ERROR: ' && lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello'.
    DATA(lv_converted) = lo_cut->convert_string_with_error_handling(
                                iv_input_string = lv_input
                                iv_source_cp    = 'UTF-8'
                                iv_target_cp    = '1100' ).
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_input codepage = '1100' ).
    DATA(lv_actual_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_converted codepage = '1100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_error_handling( ).
    " Simulate an invalid character for the target codepage (e.g., a character not representable in 7-bit ASCII)
    " For demonstration, we'll use a character that might cause issues if not handled.
    " A direct way to force an error is difficult without a truly incompatible character set or malformed input.
    " Let's assume '9999' is an invalid codepage for the purpose of this test.
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Test mit Sonderzeichen €'.
    DATA(lv_converted) = lo_cut->convert_string_with_error_handling(
                                iv_input_string = lv_input
                                iv_source_cp    = 'UTF-8'
                                iv_target_cp    = 'ASCII' ). " ASCII (codepage 1103) cannot represent '€'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = find( val = lv_converted sub = 'ERROR:' ) ). " Check if error message is present
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung zwischen Codepages kann fehlschlagen, wenn Zeichen in der Quell-Codepage nicht in der Ziel-Codepage darstellbar sind. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit der Ausnahme `CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERTER_ERROR` ist entscheidend für eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert der Komponente 'CARRID' aus der ersten Zeile der Tabelle 'sflights' und geben Sie ihn mit 'cl_demo_output' aus. Stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nach Gebrauch zurückgesetzt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_read_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights, 
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights,
          lv_component_name TYPE string VALUE 'CARRID'.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 1 ROWS.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX 1 INTO ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_carrid = <fs_value>.
        cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Dynamisch gelesener CARRID: { rv_carrid }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_value>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie dynamisch den Wert der Komponente 'PRICE' in der ersten Zeile einer internen Tabelle, die auf 'sflights' basiert. Geben Sie den alten und neuen Wert mit 'cl_demo_output' aus. Verwenden Sie `UNASSIGN` für das Feldsymbol.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN (lv_table_name)[lv_index] TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_modify_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_price IMPORTING iv_new_price TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_modify_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lv_table_name TYPE string VALUE 'LT_SFLIGHTS',
          lv_component_name TYPE string VALUE 'PRICE',
          lv_old_price TYPE s_price.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_price> TYPE any.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 1 ROWS.

    ASSIGN (lv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN <fs_table>[ 1 ] TO <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_price>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_old_price = <fs_price>.
          <fs_price> = iv_new_price.
          cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Alter Preis: { lv_old_price }, Neuer Preis: { <fs_price> }| ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_price>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

          lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,

    " Dynamische Parameterübergabe vorbereiten
    CREATE DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYN_METHOD_CALL' ).
    lo_method_descr = lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( lv_method_name ).

    " Parameter für die Methode vorbereiten
    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_MESSAGE'.
    CREATE DATA ls_parameter-value TYPE string.
    ASSIGN ls_parameter-value->* TO <fs_param_value>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_param_value> = iv_input.
      INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamischen Methodenaufruf durchführen
    CALL METHOD me->(lv_method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

    cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Dynamischer Methodenaufruf abgeschlossen mit Input: { iv_input }| ).

    " Feldsymbol freigeben
    UNASSIGN <fs_param_value>.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _display_message.
    cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Nachricht von dynamischem Aufruf: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE s_price
                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).

    cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Gesamtpreis für LH: { rv_total_price }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_polymorphism_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_polymorphism.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_polymorphism_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_polymorphism.
    DATA: lo_animal TYPE REF TO zcl_base_animal,
          lo_dog    TYPE REF TO zcl_dog,
          lo_cat    TYPE REF TO zcl_cat.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_animal> TYPE REF TO zcl_base_animal,
                   <fs_dog>    TYPE REF TO zcl_dog,
                   <fs_cat>    TYPE REF TO zcl_cat.

    lo_dog = NEW zcl_dog( ).
    lo_cat = NEW zcl_cat( ).

    " Zuweisung an Basisklassen-Feldsymbol
    ASSIGN lo_dog TO <fs_animal>.
    IF <fs_animal> IS ASSIGNED.
      cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Feldsymbol als Tier: { <fs_animal>->get_sound( ) }| ).
      UNASSIGN <fs_animal>.
    ENDIF.

    " Zuweisung und Casting an abgeleitete Klasse
    ASSIGN lo_dog TO <fs_dog> CASTING.
    IF <fs_dog> IS ASSIGNED.
      cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Feldsymbol als Hund: { <fs_dog>->get_sound( ) }| ).
      UNASSIGN <fs_dog>.
    ENDIF.

    " CASE TYPE OF mit Feldsymbol
    lo_animal = lo_cat.
    ASSIGN lo_animal TO <fs_animal>.
    IF <fs_animal> IS ASSIGNED.
      CASE TYPE OF <fs_animal>.
        WHEN TYPE zcl_dog THEN
          ASSIGN <fs_animal> TO <fs_dog> CASTING.
          cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Tier ist ein Hund: { <fs_dog>->get_sound( ) }| ).
          UNASSIGN <fs_dog>.
        WHEN TYPE zcl_cat THEN
          ASSIGN <fs_animal> TO <fs_cat> CASTING.
          cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Tier ist eine Katze: { <fs_cat>->get_sound( ) }| ).
          UNASSIGN <fs_cat>.
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
          cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Unbekanntes Tier| ).
      ENDCASE.
      UNASSIGN <fs_animal>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Feldsymbole werden verwendet, um auf Objekte verschiedener Typen zu verweisen und diese bei Bedarf zu casten. `UNASSIGN` ist hier wichtig, um die Feldsymbole nach der Verarbeitung jedes Objekttyps explizit freizugeben und so die Kontrolle über die Referenzen zu behalten. `cl_demo_output` zeigt die Ergebnisse der polymorphen Aufrufe.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit dynamischem Zeilentyp (z.B. basierend auf 'sflights'), füllen Sie sie mit Daten und geben Sie die Daten mit 'cl_demo_output' aus. Verwenden Sie `UNASSIGN` für alle Feldsymbole.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA ... TYPE TABLE OF ...`, `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_display_dynamic_itab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_dynamic_itab.
    DATA: lr_itab_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_data     TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_line     TYPE REF TO data,
          lv_type_name TYPE string VALUE 'SFLIGHTS'.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    " Dynamische interne Tabelle erstellen
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE TABLE OF (lv_type_name).

    " Feldsymbol auf die Tabelle zuweisen
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Daten füllen (Beispielhaft mit SELECT)
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE <fs_table> UP TO 3 ROWS.

      cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Inhalt der dynamischen Tabelle:| ).
      cl_demo_output=>display_data( <fs_table> ).

      " Einzelne Zeile dynamisch lesen und ausgeben
      READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Erste Zeile dynamisch: { <fs_line> }| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " Feldsymbole freigeben
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED AND <fs_line> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Bestätigung: Alle Feldsymbole sind UNASSIGNED.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Struktur mit zwei Komponenten ('FIELD1' TYPE string, 'FIELD2' TYPE i), füllen Sie sie mit Werten und geben Sie die Struktur mit 'cl_demo_output' aus. Verwenden Sie `UNASSIGN` für alle Feldsymbole.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA ... TYPE HANDLE ...` mit `cl_abap_structdescr`, `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_display_dynamic_struct.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_dynamic_struct.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_struct> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field>  TYPE any.

    " Komponenten für die dynamische Struktur definieren
    ls_component-name = 'FIELD1'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    ls_component-name = 'FIELD2'.
    ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
    INSERT ls_component INTO TABLE lt_components.

    " Strukturtyp erstellen
    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Dynamische Struktur erstellen
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.

    " Feldsymbol auf die Struktur zuweisen
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_struct>.

    IF <fs_struct> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Werte dynamisch zuweisen
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = 'Dynamischer Wert'. UNASSIGN <fs_field>. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_struct> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = 123. UNASSIGN <fs_field>. ENDIF.

      cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Inhalt der dynamischen Struktur:| ).
      cl_demo_output=>display_data( <fs_struct> ).
    ENDIF.

    " Feldsymbol freigeben
    UNASSIGN <fs_struct>.

    IF <fs_struct> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      cl_demo_output=>display_text( |Bestätigung: Alle Feldsymbole sind UNASSIGNED.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einer Liste von Dokument-IDs, die ein bestimmtes Muster enthalten (z.B. 'DOC_XYZ_123'), den numerischen Teil am Ende des Strings.

CLASS zcl_doc_id_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: tt_doc_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_numeric_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_numeric_part
      IMPORTING
        it_doc_ids TYPE tt_doc_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numeric_parts) TYPE tt_numeric_ids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_doc_id_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numeric_part.
    rt_numeric_parts = VALUE #( FOR doc_id IN it_doc_ids
                                LET lv_offset = find( val = doc_id regex = '\d+$' ) IN
                                WHERE ( lv_offset IS NOT INITIAL )
                                ( substring( val = doc_id off = lv_offset ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die je nach übergebenem Parameter (z.B. 'ARCHIVELINK' oder 'FSBP') ein spezifisches Objekt (z.B. für ArchiveLink-Verwaltung oder FSBP-Selektion) instanziiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie Interfaces für Polymorphie und den `NEW` Operator in der Factory-Methode. Fehlerbehandlung mit `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_handler.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_archivelink_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    INTERFACES zif_data_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_archivelink_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_handler~process_data.
    rv_output = |ArchiveLink Handler processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsbp_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    INTERFACES zif_data_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsbp_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_handler~process_data.
    rv_output = |FSBP Handler processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_handler_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    CLASS-METHODS create_handler
      IMPORTING
        iv_handler_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_handler) TYPE REF TO zif_data_handler
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_handler_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_handler.
    CASE iv_handler_type.
      WHEN 'ARCHIVELINK'.
        ro_handler = NEW zcl_archivelink_handler( ).
      WHEN 'FSBP'.
        ro_handler = NEW zcl_fsbp_handler( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Handler-Typ: { iv_handler_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Dokumente pro Business-Objekt-Typ aus einer internen Tabelle von ArchiveLink-Verbindungen (simuliert) und geben Sie das Ergebnis als Map zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_alink_conn_data,
         object_id   TYPE string,
         document_id TYPE string,
         doc_type    TYPE string,
       END OF ty_s_alink_conn_data.
TYPES: ty_t_alink_conn_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_alink_conn_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: ty_h_doc_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

CLASS zcl_doc_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS count_documents_by_type
      IMPORTING
        it_connections TYPE ty_t_alink_conn_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rh_doc_counts) TYPE ty_h_doc_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_doc_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_documents_by_type.
    rh_doc_counts = REDUCE ty_h_doc_count(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_h_doc_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF conn IN it_connections BY ( doc_type = conn-doc_type ) ASCENDING
      GROUP BY doc_type
      LET lv_count = lines( GROUP conn ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( key = conn-doc_type value = result[ conn-doc_type ] + lv_count ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine simulierte Operation ausführt und dabei moderne Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` verwendet.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Exception-Klasse und nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke.
solution:
CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_error.

  PROTECTED SECTION:
    METHODS _simulate_failure
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_should_fail) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    TRY.
        IF _simulate_failure( iv_input ) = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Operation failed for input: { iv_input }|.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = |Operation successful for: { iv_input }|.
      CATCH zcx_custom_error INTO DATA(lx_custom_error).
        " Log the error or perform recovery actions
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_custom_error->get_text( ) }|.
        " Re-raise if necessary, or handle completely
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_custom_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _simulate_failure.
    IF iv_input = 'FAIL'.
      rv_should_fail = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_should_fail = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      CATCH zcx_custom_error INTO DATA(lx_error).

Die `perform_operation`-Methode verwendet einen `TRY...CATCH`-Block, um potenzielle Fehler abzufangen. Bei einem simulierten Fehler wird eine Instanz der benutzerdefinierten Exception erstellt und mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` ausgelöst, was eine saubere Trennung von Geschäftslogik und Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamically.

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht in Struktur gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_date_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES: ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_date_range
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_t_flights

CLASS zcl_flight_date_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_date_range.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
           END OF ty_s_flight_raw.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_transformed,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sy-datum,
             departure_time TYPE sy-uzeit,
             arrival_time TYPE sy-uzeit,

CLASS zcl_flight_data_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flight_data.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
                                      ( airline_id = ls_raw-carrid

                                        flight_date = ls_raw-fldate
                                        departure_time = ls_raw-deptime
                                        arrival_time = ls_raw-arrtime
                                        flight_duration = |{ ls_raw-deptime } - { ls_raw-arrtime }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_typedescr` für RTTI.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_component_info,
         name TYPE string,
         type TYPE string,
       END OF ty_s_component_info.
TYPES: ty_t_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE ty_t_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_cast_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Referenz zeigt nicht auf eine Struktur: { lx_cast_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR comp IN lo_struct_descr->get_components( )
                              ( name = comp-name
                                type = comp-type_descr_ref->get_relative_name( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf der Abflugzeit und einer Status-Flag, unter Verwendung moderner Konditionaloperatoren.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND`-Operator für kompakte bedingte Zuweisungen.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_status_input,
             deptime TYPE sflight-deptime,
             is_delayed TYPE abap_bool,
             is_cancelled TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_flight_status_input.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_s_flight_status_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN is_flight_data-is_cancelled = abap_true THEN 'Abgesagt'
      WHEN is_flight_data-is_delayed = abap_true THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN is_flight_data-deptime < '120000' THEN 'Vormittagsflug'
      WHEN is_flight_data-deptime >= '120000' THEN 'Pünktlich'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_price.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_flight_price
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ) ).

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Elemente aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur Elemente übernommen werden, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen und noch nicht in der Zieltabelle vorhanden sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `WHERE` und `COND` für die bedingte Einfügung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_merger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS merge_unique_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE ty_t_data
        it_target_data TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_min_id      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_merged_data) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_merger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_unique_data.
    rt_merged_data = it_target_data.

    rt_merged_data = VALUE #( BASE rt_merged_data
                               FOR ls_source IN it_source_data
                               WHERE ( id > iv_min_id AND NOT line_exists( rt_merged_data[ id = ls_source-id ] ) )
                               ( ls_source ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `WHERE`-Klausel im `FOR`-Ausdruck filtert Elemente aus der Quelltabelle basierend auf einem `iv_min_id`-Kriterium und stellt mit `NOT line_exists()` sicher, dass nur eindeutige Elemente (die noch nicht in der Zieltabelle vorhanden sind) hinzugefügt werden. Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis eines Fluges inklusive einer Servicegebühr von 10% direkt in der SELECT-Anweisung. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `CALCULATE` Funktion in Open SQL für arithmetische Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price       TYPE sflight-price,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_prices
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_prices.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price,
           CALCULATE( price * 1.10 ) AS total_price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_prices
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_calculate_price( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = lo_cut->get_flight_prices( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Es wurden keine Daten gefunden.' act = lt_prices ).
    LOOP AT lt_prices INTO DATA(ls_price).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_price-total_price,
        exp = ls_price-price * 1.10,
        msg = 'Der berechnete Gesamtpreis ist falsch.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies reduziert den Datenverkehr und die Verarbeitungslogik im Anwendungsserver, was zu einer effizienteren Datenbeschaffung führt.
keywords: CALCULATE, Open SQL, Arithmetic, SELECT, SFLIGHT

CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_avg_dur DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_duration,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_duration  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_duration.

CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_avg_dur IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_flight_duration.

           CALCULATE( AVG( fltime ) ) AS avg_duration
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_avg_durations.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen rabattierten Preis für Flüge aus `sflight`: Wenn der Originalpreis über 500 liegt, geben Sie 10% Rabatt, ansonsten den Originalpreis. Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung innerhalb von `CALCULATE` für bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_discount,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
             price         TYPE sflight-price,
             discounted_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_discount.
    TYPES tt_flight_discounts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_discount WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_discounted_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_discounts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price,
           CALCULATE( CASE WHEN price > 500 THEN price * 0.90 ELSE price END ) AS discounted_price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_discounted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discounted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_calculate_discount( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_discounted_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Es wurden keine Flüge gefunden.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price > 500.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-discounted_price,
          exp = ls_flight-price * 0.90,
          msg = 'Rabattierter Preis ist falsch für Preis > 500.' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-discounted_price,
          exp = ls_flight-price,
          msg = 'Rabattierter Preis ist falsch für Preis <= 500.' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit von `CALCULATE` in Kombination mit `CASE`-Ausdrücken in Open SQL. Bedingte Logik kann direkt auf der Datenbank angewendet werden, um dynamische Berechnungen durchzuführen. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster, um komplexe Geschäftslogik in die Datenbank zu verlagern.
keywords: CALCULATE, Open SQL, Conditional Logic, CASE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein komplexes XML-Dokument mit verschachtelten Elementen, das Flugsegmente für einen Flug aus der Tabelle `sflight` darstellt. Nutzen Sie `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `open_element()` und `close_element()` Aufrufe, um die Hierarchie zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sec_xml_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_segment.

CLASS zcl_sec_xml_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_nested_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
    LOOP AT it_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Carrier' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).

      lo_writer->open_element( 'Departure' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-cityfrom ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).

      lo_writer->open_element( 'Arrival' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-cityto ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).

      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flight
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flights

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_flight_data TYPE zcl_sec_xml_nested=>tt_flight_segments,

    ls_flight_data = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ).
    INSERT ls_flight_data INTO TABLE lt_flight_data.

      msg = 'Verschachtelter XML-Inhalt stimmt nicht überein.' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das voraussichtliche Ankunftsdatum und die Ankunftszeit für Flüge aus `sflight`, basierend auf dem Abflugdatum, der Abflugzeit und der Flugdauer. Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` mit Datums-/Zeitfunktionen wie `ADD_SECONDS` oder manueller Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_arrival DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_arrival,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             fltime      TYPE sflight-fltime,
             deptime     TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrdate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             arrtime     TYPE sflight-deptime,
           END OF ty_flight_arrival.
    TYPES tt_flight_arrivals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_arrival WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_arrivals
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_arrivals) TYPE tt_flight_arrivals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_arrival IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_arrivals.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, fltime,
           CALCULATE( CAST( fldate AS abap.dats ) + ( CAST( deptime AS abap.tims ) + ( fltime * 60 ) ) ) AS arrdate,
           CALCULATE( CAST( fldate AS abap.dats ) + ( CAST( deptime AS abap.tims ) + ( fltime * 60 ) ) ) AS arrtime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_arrivals
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_arrival FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_arrival.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_calculate_arrival( ).
    DATA(lt_arrivals) = lo_cut->get_flight_arrivals( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_arrivals msg = 'Es wurden keine Ankunftszeiten gefunden.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_arrivals INTO DATA(ls_arrival).
      DATA(lv_departure_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp(
                                        date = ls_arrival-fldate
                                        time = ls_arrival-deptime ).
      DATA(lv_expected_arrival_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add(
                                               tstmp = lv_departure_timestamp
                                               secs  = ls_arrival-fltime * 60 ).
      DATA(lv_expected_arrdate) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date(
                                      tstmp = lv_expected_arrival_timestamp ).
      DATA(lv_expected_arrtime) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_time(
                                      tstmp = lv_expected_arrival_timestamp ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_arrival-arrdate,
        exp = lv_expected_arrdate,
        msg = 'Berechnetes Ankunftsdatum ist falsch.' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_arrival-arrtime,
        exp = lv_expected_arrtime,
        msg = 'Berechnete Ankunftszeit ist falsch.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine komplexe Datums- und Zeitberechnung mit `CALCULATE` in Open SQL. Es demonstriert, wie man Datums- und Zeitfelder kombiniert und arithmetische Operationen (Addition von Sekunden) direkt auf der Datenbank durchführt, um abgeleitete Zeitstempel zu erhalten. Die Typumwandlung mit `CAST` ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: CALCULATE, Open SQL, Date/Time, CAST, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Währung und den Preis eines Fluges aus `sflight` zu einem String-Feld im Format 'Währung Preis' direkt in der SELECT-Anweisung. Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates oder die `CONCAT` Funktion innerhalb von `CALCULATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_text,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price_text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_price_text.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_texts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_text WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_price_texts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_price_texts) TYPE tt_flight_price_texts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_texts.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CALCULATE( CONCAT_WITH_BLANK( currency, CAST( price AS abap.char(15) ), 1 ) ) AS price_text
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_price_texts
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_concat FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_concat.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_calculate_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_price_texts) = lo_cut->get_flight_price_texts( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_price_texts msg = 'Es wurden keine Preis-Texte gefunden.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_price_texts INTO DATA(ls_price_text).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches(
        act = ls_price_text-price_text,
        exp = `^[A-Z]{3} \d+(\.\d+)?$`, " Z.B. 'EUR 123.45'
        msg = 'Preis-Text-Format ist falsch.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `CALCULATE` in Open SQL, um String-Operationen wie die Verkettung von Währung und Preis direkt auf der Datenbank durchzuführen. Die Funktion `CONCAT_WITH_BLANK` ist hier besonders nützlich. Dies ist effizient, da die Formatierung bereits auf der Datenbank erfolgt und der Anwendungsserver entlastet wird.
keywords: CALCULATE, Open SQL, String Processing, CONCAT, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight` und fügen Sie eine Spalte für die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere hinzu. Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COUNT(*)` und `SUM()` innerhalb von `CALCULATE` mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_count_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_count_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT carrid,
           CALCULATE( COUNT(*) ) AS flight_count,
           CALCULATE( SUM( seatsocc ) ) AS total_passengers
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_summaries
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften und deren Namen aus der Tabelle `scarr` enthält. Nutzen Sie `cl_sec_sxml_writer` und moderne ABAP-Features zur Datenbeschaffung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und iterieren Sie über die Ergebnisse, um XML zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sec_xml_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr_data,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr_data.
    TYPES tt_scarr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_xml_from_scarr
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sec_xml_scarr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_xml_from_scarr.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).

    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carriers)
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Carriers' ).
    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Carrier' ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'ID' value = ls_carrier-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_element( name = 'Name' value = ls_carrier-carrname ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Carrier
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Carriers

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
