Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug aus `sflight` die Auslastung in Prozent (seatsocc / seatsmax * 100) und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen. Nutzen Sie `CALCULATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` mit Division, Multiplikation und der `ROUND` Funktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupancy_percent TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancies TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_occupancy
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancies) TYPE tt_flight_occupancies.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_calculate_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occupancy.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CALCULATE( ROUND( ( CAST( seatsocc AS decfloat16 ) / seatsmax ) * 100, 2 ) ) AS occupancy_percent
      FROM sflight
      WHERE seatsmax > 0 " Division durch Null vermeiden
      INTO TABLE @rt_occupancies
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_calculate_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancies) = lo_cut->get_flight_occupancy( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_occupancies msg = 'Es wurden keine Auslastungsdaten gefunden.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_occupancies INTO DATA(ls_occupancy).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than_or_equal(
        act = ls_occupancy-occupancy_percent,
        exp = 0,
        msg = 'Auslastung sollte >= 0 sein.' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_than_or_equal(
        act = ls_occupancy-occupancy_percent,
        exp = 100,
        msg = 'Auslastung sollte <= 100 sein.' ).
      " Überprüfen der Rundung (Beispiel: 12.345 -> 12.35)
      DATA(lv_rounded_value) = ls_occupancy-occupancy_percent * 100.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lv_rounded_value MOD 1,
        exp = 0,
        msg = 'Wert ist nicht auf zwei Dezimalstellen gerundet.',
        tolerance = '0.00001' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `CALCULATE` für komplexere Berechnungen, einschließlich Division, Multiplikation und der `ROUND`-Funktion, um die Auslastung von Flügen zu ermitteln und zu runden. Die Typumwandlung zu `DECFLOAT16` ist wichtig, um präzise Dezimalberechnungen zu gewährleisten. Dies verlagert die Berechnungslogik effizient auf die Datenbank.
keywords: CALCULATE, Open SQL, Rounding, Division, DECFLOAT16, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein XML-Dokument, das eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `scarr` enthält, wobei jede Fluggesellschaft ein Attribut 'active' basierend auf einer Bedingung (z.B. 'LH' ist aktiv) hat. Nutzen Sie `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine bedingte Logik, um den Wert des Attributs 'active' zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sec_xml_conditional_attr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr_data,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr_data.
    TYPES tt_scarr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_xml_conditional_attr
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sec_xml_conditional_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_xml_conditional_attr.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).

    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carriers)
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Carriers' ).
    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      DATA(lv_is_active) = COND string( WHEN ls_carrier-carrid = 'LH' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' ).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Carrier' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'id' value = ls_carrier-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'active' value = lv_is_active ).
      lo_writer->write_value( ls_carrier-carrname ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Carrier
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Carriers

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_attr FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_attr.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sec_xml_conditional_attr( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->generate_xml_conditional_attr( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xml msg = 'XML-String sollte nicht initial sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_xml,
      exp = '<Carrier id="LH" active="true">LUFTHANSA</Carrier>',
      msg = 'LH Carrier sollte als aktiv markiert sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_xml,
      exp = 'active="false"',
      msg = 'Andere Carrier sollten als inaktiv markiert sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Zuweisung von Attributwerten basierend auf einer Bedingung während der XML-Generierung mit `cl_sec_sxml_writer`. Die Verwendung des `COND`-Ausdrucks ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature (ab 7.40), das die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in einer kompakten und lesbaren Form ermöglicht.
keywords: XML, Attributes, Conditional Logic, COND, cl_sec_sxml_writer, SXML, SCARR

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Code-128-Barcode für eine gegebene Zeichenkette und speichern Sie das resultierende BMP-Bild (XSTRING) in einer benutzerdefinierten Datenbanktabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>create_barcode` und `UPDATE dbtab SET field = @data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_gen_store DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_barcode_data,
             id        TYPE numc10,
             text      TYPE string,
             barcode_bmp TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_barcode_data.
    METHODS generate_and_store_barcode
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE numc10
        iv_text TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_gen_store IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_and_store_barcode.
    DATA(lv_barcode_xstring) = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>create_barcode(
      i_symbology = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_code128
      i_text      = iv_text
    ).

    " Annahme: Eine transparente Tabelle ZBARCODE_STORAGE existiert mit Feldern ID (NUMC10), TEXT (STRING), BARCODE_BMP (XSTRING)
    MODIFY zbarcode_storage FROM @( VALUE ty_barcode_data(
      id          = iv_id
      text        = iv_text
      barcode_bmp = lv_barcode_xstring
    ) ).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung, falls Speichern fehlschlägt
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_rstx_barcode_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Speichern des Barcodes in der Datenbank.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_and_store FOR TESTING RAISING cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_and_store.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_barcode_gen_store( ).
    DATA(lv_test_id) = '0000000001'.
    DATA(lv_test_text) = 'TESTBARCODE123'.

    " Vorbereitung: Löschen Sie ggf. vorhandene Testdaten
    DELETE FROM zbarcode_storage WHERE id = @lv_test_id.

    lo_cut->generate_and_store_barcode( iv_id = lv_test_id iv_text = lv_test_text ).

    DATA(ls_result) = VALUE zbarcode_storage( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM zbarcode_storage INTO @ls_result WHERE id = @lv_test_id.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'Eintrag sollte gefunden werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-text exp = lv_test_text msg = 'Text sollte übereinstimmen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_result-barcode_bmp msg = 'Barcode BMP sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM zbarcode_storage WHERE id = @lv_test_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die objektorientierte Barcode-Generierung mit `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` und die Speicherung des binären Ergebnisses (XSTRING) in einer Datenbanktabelle unter Verwendung der modernen `MODIFY` Anweisung mit Inline-Deklaration und Value-Operator. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt über Ausnahmen.
keywords: cl_rstx_barcode_renderer, UPDATE, XSTRING, Object Orientation, Data Handling

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle `sflight` um 10%, basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE dbtab FROM @(itab)` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_airlines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Daten für die Aktualisierung vorbereiten
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_orig)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_airlines
      WHERE carrid = @it_airlines-table_line.

    lt_sflight_update = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_orig
                                 ( ls_flight WITH price = ls_flight-price * '1.1' ) ).

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight_update.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_price_update( ).
    DATA: lt_airlines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_airlines.
    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_airlines.

    " Testdaten sichern und manipulieren
    DATA(lt_sflight_backup) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_backup
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_airlines
      WHERE carrid = @lt_airlines-table_line.

    " Preise für LH und AA um 10% erhöhen
    DATA(lv_updated_rows) = lo_cut->update_flight_prices( lt_airlines ).

    DATA(lt_sflight_after_update) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_after_update
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_airlines
      WHERE carrid = @lt_airlines-table_line.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_updated_rows msg = 'Es sollten Zeilen aktualisiert worden sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflight_backup ) exp = lines( lt_sflight_after_update ) msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte gleich bleiben' ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_after_update INTO DATA(ls_after).
      READ TABLE lt_sflight_backup INTO DATA(ls_before) WITH KEY carrid = ls_after-carrid connid = ls_after-connid fldate = ls_after-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_after-price exp = ls_before-price * '1.1' msg = 'Preis sollte um 10% erhöht sein' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Aufräumen: Preise zurücksetzen
    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight_backup.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die moderne `UPDATE dbtab FROM TABLE @itab` Syntax, die eine effiziente Massenaktualisierung von Datenbanktabellen ermöglicht. Der `FOR` Ausdruck wird verwendet, um die zu aktualisierenden Daten aus der Originaltabelle zu transformieren, bevor sie an die `UPDATE` Anweisung übergeben werden. Dies ist performanter als einzelne `UPDATE` Statements in einer Schleife.
keywords: UPDATE, Internal Tables, FOR, Database Operations, sflight

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Status von Flügen in `sflight` auf 'C' (Cancelled), wenn das Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt und der Status noch 'A' (Active) ist. Verwenden Sie eine moderne `UPDATE` Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE dbtab SET field = value WHERE condition` mit `@sy-datum`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_status_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_old_flights_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_status_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_old_flights_status.
    UPDATE sflight SET status = 'C'
      WHERE fldate < @sy-datum AND status = 'A'.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_status_update( ).
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH',
          lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0400',
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20200101'.

    " Testdaten vorbereiten: Einen alten Flug mit Status 'A' einfügen
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid = lv_carrid
      connid = lv_connid
      fldate = lv_fldate
      price  = '100.00'
      currency = 'EUR'
      planetype = 'BOEING747'
      seatsmax = 300
      seatsocc = 100
      status = 'A'
    ) ).

    DATA(lv_updated_rows) = lo_cut->update_old_flights_status( ).

    DATA(ls_sflight_after) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight_after
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_after-status exp = 'C' msg = 'Status sollte auf C aktualisiert werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_rows exp = 1 msg = 'Eine Zeile sollte aktualisiert worden sein' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines Fluges in `sflight` nur, wenn der Flug existiert und der aktuelle Preis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE EXISTS`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `UPDATE` mit einer `WHERE EXISTS` Unterabfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
        iv_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price_cond.
    UPDATE sflight SET price = @iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
        AND EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sflight
                       WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
                         AND connid = @iv_connid
                         AND fldate = @iv_fldate
                         AND price < @iv_threshold ).
    IF sy-dbcnt = 1.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Barcode und senden Sie ihn als E-Mail-Anhang an einen Empfänger. Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs` für den E-Mail-Versand.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` für den Barcode und `cl_bcs` für den E-Mail-Versand mit Anhang.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_email_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_barcode_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_text      TYPE string
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE so_obj_des
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_email_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_barcode_email.
    DATA(lv_barcode_xstring) = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>create_barcode(
      i_symbology = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_code128
      i_text      = iv_text
    ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    " Dokument erstellen
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_text( ( line = 'Anbei Ihr Barcode.' ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    " Anhang hinzufügen
    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'BMP'
      i_attachment_subject = 'Barcode.bmp'
      i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( lv_barcode_xstring )
      i_att_content_hex    = lv_barcode_xstring
    ).

    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Empfänger hinzufügen
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    " Senden
    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).
    lo_send_request->send( ).

    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine pessimistische Sperre für einen Flugdatensatz in `sflight` vor der Aktualisierung, um Race Conditions zu vermeiden. Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE` und `MODIFY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE` gefolgt von `MODIFY` und `COMMIT WORK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_lock_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_with_lock
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_lock_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_with_lock.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    TRY.
        " Pessimistische Sperre und Lesen des Datensatzes
        SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
            AND connid = @iv_connid
            AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Datensatz gefunden und gesperrt, nun aktualisieren
          ls_sflight-price = iv_new_price.
          MODIFY sflight FROM @ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            COMMIT WORK.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          ELSE.
            ROLLBACK WORK.
            rv_success = abap_false.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          " Datensatz nicht gefunden
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db_error INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        " Fehler beim Sperren oder DB-Zugriff
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        MESSAGE lx_db_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_with_lock FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_no_record FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_with_lock.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_lock_update( ).
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'DL',
          lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0004',
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20250901'.

    " Testdaten vorbereiten
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid = lv_carrid
      connid = lv_connid
      fldate = lv_fldate
      price  = '300.00'
      currency = 'USD'
      planetype = 'B787'
      seatsmax = 250
      seatsocc = 150
      status = 'A'
    ) ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_with_lock(
      iv_carrid    = lv_carrid
      iv_connid    = lv_connid
      iv_fldate    = lv_fldate
      iv_new_price = '350.00'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Update sollte erfolgreich sein' ).
    DATA(ls_sflight_after) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight_after-price
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_after-price exp = '350.00' msg = 'Preis sollte aktualisiert sein' ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_no_record.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_lock_update( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_with_lock(
      iv_carrid    = 'XX'
      iv_connid    = '9998'
      iv_fldate    = '20250101'
      iv_new_price = '100.00'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Kein Update, da Flug nicht existiert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE` und `MODIFY` innerhalb einer Transaktion ist der Standardweg für pessimistische Sperren in ABAP. `FOR UPDATE` sperrt den Datensatz, sodass andere Transaktionen ihn nicht ändern können, bis die aktuelle Transaktion mit `COMMIT WORK` oder `ROLLBACK WORK` beendet ist. Dies verhindert Dateninkonsistenzen bei gleichzeitigen Zugriffen.
keywords: UPDATE, SELECT FOR UPDATE, MODIFY, COMMIT WORK, ROLLBACK WORK, Concurrency, sflight

        it_premium_airlines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_premium_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights_to_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights)
      WHERE status = 'A'.

    lt_flights_to_update = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary
                                     WHERE carrid IN it_premium_airlines ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-status = 'X'.
    ENDLOOP.

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_update.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein generierter Barcode (XSTRING) leer ist, um festzustellen, ob die Generierung erfolgreich war.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF lv_barcode_xstring IS INITIAL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_check_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_barcode_generated
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_generated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_check_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_barcode_generated.
    DATA(lv_barcode_xstring) = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>create_barcode(
      i_symbology = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_code128
      i_text      = iv_text
    ).

    IF lv_barcode_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_is_generated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_generated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_barcode_check_initial( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_barcode_check_initial( ).
    " Ein Text, der einen Fehler verursachen würde, um einen leeren XSTRING zu erhalten

    " Für diesen Test wird angenommen, dass create_barcode bei einem leeren String einen leeren XSTRING zurückgibt oder eine Exception wirft, die hier nicht gefangen wird.

CLASS zcl_sflight_single_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Barcode-XSTRINGs in eine interne Tabelle von Strings (Base64-kodiert), um sie z.B. in einer Web-Anwendung anzuzeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_utility=>encode_x_base64` in einer `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_to_base64 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_xstring TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_string  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_barcodes_to_base64
      IMPORTING
        it_barcodes_xstring TYPE tt_xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_barcodes_base64) TYPE tt_string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_to_base64 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_barcodes_to_base64.
    rt_barcodes_base64 = VALUE #( FOR lv_xstring IN it_barcodes_xstring
                                  ( cl_http_utility=>encode_x_base64( lv_xstring ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_barcode_to_base64( ).
    DATA: lt_test_xstrings TYPE zcl_barcode_to_base64=>tt_xstring.

    " Generiere einige Beispiel-Barcodes als XSTRING
    DATA(lv_barcode1) = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>create_barcode(
      i_symbology = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_symbology_code128

Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit der statischen Methode `cl_http_utility=>encode_x_base64` bietet eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Möglichkeit, diese Transformation für eine ganze interne Tabelle durchzuführen.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Preise von Flügen in `sflight` basierend auf einer internen Tabelle, die sowohl die Schlüssel als auch die neuen Preise enthält. Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM @(itab)` mit `REDUCE` um die Daten vorzubereiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die interne Tabelle für das `UPDATE` Statement zu formen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_update,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             new_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_price_update,
           tt_price_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_from_itab
      IMPORTING
        it_price_changes TYPE tt_price_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_from_itab.
    DATA(lt_sflight_update) = REDUCE sflight_tt(
      INIT result TYPE sflight_tt
      FOR ls_change IN it_price_changes
      NEXT result = VALUE sflight_tt( BASE result
                                      ( carrid = ls_change-carrid
                                        connid = ls_change-connid
                                        fldate = ls_change-fldate
                                        price  = ls_change-new_price ) )
    ).

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_sflight_update.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce_update( ).
    DATA: lv_carrid1 TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH',
          lv_connid1 TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0401',
          lv_fldate1 TYPE s_date VALUE '20250601',
          lv_carrid2 TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA',
          lv_connid2 TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0008',
          lv_fldate2 TYPE s_date VALUE '20250602'.

    " Testdaten vorbereiten
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid = lv_carrid1 connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate1 price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'BOEING747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 status = 'A'
    ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid = lv_carrid2 connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate2 price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 50 status = 'A'
    ) ).

    DATA(lt_price_changes) = VALUE zcl_sflight_reduce_update=>tt_price_update(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid1 connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate1 new_price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid2 connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate2 new_price = '220.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_updated_rows) = lo_cut->update_prices_from_itab( lt_price_changes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_rows exp = 2 msg = 'Zwei Zeilen sollten aktualisiert werden' ).

    DATA(ls_flight1_after) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @ls_flight1_after-price WHERE carrid = lv_carrid1 AND connid = lv_connid1 AND fldate = lv_fldate1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1_after-price exp = '120.00' msg = 'Preis von Flug 1 sollte aktualisiert sein' ).

    DATA(ls_flight2_after) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @ls_flight2_after-price WHERE carrid = lv_carrid2 AND connid = lv_connid2 AND fldate = lv_fldate2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2_after-price exp = '220.00' msg = 'Preis von Flug 2 sollte aktualisiert sein' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid1 AND connid = lv_connid1 AND fldate = lv_fldate1.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid2 AND connid = lv_connid2 AND fldate = lv_fldate2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator wird hier verwendet, um eine interne Tabelle (`it_price_changes`) in das Format der Datenbanktabelle (`sflight_tt`) zu transformieren, das für die `UPDATE FROM TABLE @itab` Anweisung benötigt wird. Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `CASE TYPE OF` zur polymorphen Behandlung verschiedener Objekttypen, die ein gemeinsames Interface implementieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie ein Basis-Interface und mehrere implementierende Klassen. `CASE TYPE OF` ermöglicht eine typsichere Abfrage des tatsächlichen Objekttyps.
solution:
INTERFACE if_animal.
  METHODS make_sound RETURNING VALUE(rv_sound) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS lcl_dog DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_animal.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_dog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_animal~make_sound.
    rv_sound = 'Woof'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_cat DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_animal.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_cat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_animal~make_sound.
    rv_sound = 'Meow'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oop_case_type_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_animal IMPORTING io_animal TYPE REF TO if_animal RETURNING VALUE(rv_sound) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oop_case_type_of IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_animal.
    CASE TYPE OF io_animal.
      WHEN TYPE lcl_dog INTO DATA(lo_dog).
        rv_sound = lo_dog->if_animal~make_sound( ).
      WHEN TYPE lcl_cat INTO DATA(lo_cat).
        rv_sound = lo_cat->if_animal~make_sound( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_sound = 'Unknown sound'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Objekten enthält, und iterieren Sie über die Elemente, um spezifische Werte zu sammeln, unter Verwendung von `cl_clb_parse_json`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_array` um das JSON-Array zu erhalten, und dann eine `LOOP`-Anweisung, um über die Elemente zu iterieren und `get_object` sowie `get_value` für jedes Element zu nutzen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
         id   TYPE i,
         name TYPE string,
       END OF ty_item,
       tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_json_array_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_json_array IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_array_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_json_array.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = cl_clb_parse_json=>create( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(ls_item) LIKE LINE OF rt_items.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_json_array) = lo_json_parser->get_array( 'products' ).
        DATA(lv_array_size) = lo_json_array->get_size( ).

        DO lv_array_size TIMES.
          DATA(lo_array_element) = lo_json_array->get_element( sy-index - 1 ).
          DATA(lo_product_object) = lo_array_element->get_object( ).
          ls_item-id = lo_product_object->get_value( 'id' ).
          ls_item-name = lo_product_object->get_value( 'name' ).
          APPEND ls_item TO rt_items.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or return empty table
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
         id   TYPE i,
         text TYPE string,
       END OF ty_data,
       tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_itab_value_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_conditional_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_value_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_conditional_table.
    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 5
                         ( id = i
                           text = CASE i
                                    WHEN 1 THEN 'Erster Eintrag'
                                    WHEN 2 THEN 'Zweiter Eintrag'
                                    WHEN 3 THEN 'Dritter Eintrag'
                                    ELSE 'Anderer Eintrag'
                                  END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle, indem Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator verwenden und innerhalb der Reduktion bedingte Logik mit `CASE` anwenden.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator kann einen `CASE`-Ausdruck für die Akkumulation nutzen, um Werte basierend auf Bedingungen zu summieren oder zu verarbeiten.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
         carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
         price    TYPE s_price,
         currency TYPE s_currcode,
         fldate   TYPE s_date,
       END OF ty_flight,
       tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_reduce_case_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_case_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT total = total + CASE ls_flight-currency
                               WHEN 'EUR' THEN ls_flight-price
                               WHEN 'USD' THEN ls_flight-price * '0.90' " Beispielhafter Umrechnungskurs
                               ELSE 0
                             END ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

         carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

         price    TYPE s_price,

         fldate   TYPE s_date,
       END OF ty_flight,
       tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_currencies FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' price = 200 currency = 'USD' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' price = 50  currency = 'JPY' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_case_agg( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).

    " Expected: 100 (EUR) + 200 * 0.90 (USD) + 0 (JPY) = 100 + 180 = 280
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 280 msg = 'Incorrect total price' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_case_agg( ).

CLASS zcl_rtti_case_type_of IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHEN TYPE lcl_numeric_processor INTO DATA(lo_num_proc).

CLASS zcl_error_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_error_category TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS: gc_category_critical TYPE ty_error_category VALUE 'CRITICAL',
               gc_category_warning  TYPE ty_error_category VALUE 'WARNING',
               gc_category_info     TYPE ty_error_category VALUE 'INFO',
               gc_category_unknown  TYPE ty_error_category VALUE 'UNKNOWN'.

    METHODS get_error_category IMPORTING iv_error_code TYPE i
                                         iv_error_text TYPE string OPTIONAL
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_category) TYPE ty_error_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_category.
    CASE iv_error_code.
      WHEN 100 OR 101.
        rv_category = gc_category_critical.
      WHEN 200.
        rv_category = gc_category_warning.
      WHEN 300.
        rv_category = gc_category_info.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        IF iv_error_text IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_error_text CA 'Authorization'.
          rv_category = gc_category_critical.
        ELSE.
          rv_category = gc_category_unknown.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in Kleinbuchstaben und dann den ersten Buchstaben jedes Wortes in Großbuchstaben (Titel-Case), unter Verwendung von String-Funktionen und `CASE`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_title_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS to_title_case IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_title_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_title_case.
    DATA: lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1,
          lv_prev_char TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE ' '.

    rv_output = to_lower( iv_input ).

    DO AND UNTIL sy-index > strlen( rv_output ).
      lv_char = rv_output+sy-index-1(1).
      IF lv_prev_char = ' ' OR lv_prev_char = '-' OR lv_prev_char = '_'. " Worte trennen bei Leerzeichen, Bindestrich, Unterstrich
        rv_output+sy-index-1(1) = to_upper( lv_char ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_char = lv_char.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, wobei die Struktur der Tabelle zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem `CASE`-Statement bestimmt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Zugriff auf Felder. Die Struktur kann mit `CASE` basierend auf einem Parameter gewählt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_a,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_a,
           BEGIN OF ty_data_b,
             field_x TYPE string,
             field_y TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_b.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING iv_table_type TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    DATA: lv_line_type TYPE string.

    CASE iv_table_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        lv_line_type = 'TY_DATA_A'.
      WHEN 'B'.
        lv_line_type = 'TY_DATA_B'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RETURN. " Invalid type
    ENDCASE.

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (lv_line_type).
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.

    DO 2 TIMES.
      ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.
      CASE iv_table_type.
        WHEN 'A'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = |Value A{ sy-index }|.
          ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = sy-index.
          ENDIF.
        WHEN 'B'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_X' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = |X{ sy-index }|.
          ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_Y' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = |Y{ sy-index }|.
          ENDIF.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      connid = iv_connid

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_simple
        iv_filter_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_target_flights) = VALUE ty_t_sflight_simple(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' )
    ).

    INSERT LINES OF
      VALUE ty_t_sflight_simple(
        FOR ls_flight IN it_source_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_filter_carrid ) (
          carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid
        )
      )
      INTO TABLE lt_target_flights.

    rt_target_flights = lt_target_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue interne Tabelle, wobei ein Feld mit `CONV` und einem `COND` Ausdruck bedingt umgewandelt wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CONV`, `COND` und `FOR` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_cond_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE string,
             price_eur TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES ty_t_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status_and_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE ty_t_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_cond_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_and_price.
    rt_flight_info = VALUE ty_t_flight_info(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights (
        carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid    = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
        status    = COND string(
                      WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc = 0 THEN 'Available'
                      WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc < ls_sflight-seatsmax THEN 'Few Seats Left'
                      ELSE 'Booked Out'
                    )
        price_eur = CONV s_price(
                      COND #(
                        WHEN ls_sflight-currency = 'USD' THEN ls_sflight-price * '0.9'
                        ELSE ls_sflight-price
                      )
                    )

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, aber nur, wenn die Zeilen in der Zieltabelle noch nicht existieren (basierend auf einem Schlüssel).
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... FROM TABLE` mit `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` und optional `FOR` oder `FILTER` für die Quelltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE i,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE HASH KEY key_field.

    METHODS insert_unique_rows
      IMPORTING
        it_target_table TYPE ty_t_data
        it_source_table TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_table) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_unique_rows.
    DATA(lt_target) = it_target_table.

    INSERT LINES OF it_source_table INTO TABLE lt_target ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    rt_updated_table = lt_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_new_unique FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_with_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_empty_source FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_new_unique.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_initial) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_unique=>ty_t_data(
      ( key_field = 1 value = 'A' )
      ( key_field = 2 value = 'B' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_unique=>ty_t_data(
      ( key_field = 3 value = 'C' )
      ( key_field = 4 value = 'D' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_unique_rows(
      it_target_table = lt_initial
      it_source_table = lt_source
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-value exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_with_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_initial) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_unique=>ty_t_data(
      ( key_field = 1 value = 'A' )
      ( key_field = 2 value = 'B' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_unique=>ty_t_data(
      ( key_field = 2 value = 'B_new' ) " Duplicate key
      ( key_field = 3 value = 'C' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_unique_rows(
      it_target_table = lt_initial
      it_source_table = lt_source
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-value exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-value exp = 'B' ). " Original value retained
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-value exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_empty_source.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_initial) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_unique=>ty_t_data(
      ( key_field = 1 value = 'A' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_unique=>ty_t_data( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_unique_rows(
      it_target_table = lt_initial
      it_source_table = lt_source
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-value exp = 'A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle einfügt, wobei Duplikate basierend auf dem Tabellenschlüssel ignoriert werden. Die Klausel `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` ist hier entscheidend. Sie verhindert einen Laufzeitfehler, wenn versucht wird, eine Zeile mit einem bereits existierenden Schlüssel einzufügen, und sorgt dafür, dass nur die neuen, eindeutigen Zeilen hinzugefügt werden. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um zwei Tabellen zu mergen und dabei die Eindeutigkeit der Schlüsselfelder zu wahren.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Table, Duplicate Keys, HASH TABLE, Merging

CLASS zcl_conv_json_to_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_json_data.

CLASS zcl_conv_json_to_struct IMPLEMENTATION.

    LOOP AT it_json_strings INTO DATA(lv_json_string).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` in eine neue Tabelle, wobei das Feld `price` in einen `decfloat34` umgewandelt und gleichzeitig ein Rabatt angewendet wird, wenn der Preis über einem Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CONV`, `COND` und `FOR` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck für bedingte Umwandlung und Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_discount_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_discounted_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             original_price TYPE s_price,
             discounted_price TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_discounted_flight.
    TYPES ty_t_discounted_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_discounted_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS apply_discount_to_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_threshold TYPE s_price
        iv_discount_rate TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE ty_t_discounted_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_discount_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_discount_to_flights.
    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE ty_t_discounted_flight(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights (
        carrid         = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid         = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate         = ls_flight-fldate,
        original_price = ls_flight-price,
        discounted_price = CONV decfloat34(
                             COND #(
                               WHEN ls_flight-price > iv_threshold
                                 THEN ls_flight-price * ( 1 - iv_discount_rate )
                               ELSE ls_flight-price
                             )
                           )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Fügen Sie eine temporäre Zufallszahlenspalte hinzu und sortieren Sie danach. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE string,
             random_key TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table IMPORTING it_input TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_shuffled) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 1000000 ).

    DATA lt_temp_data TYPE tt_data.
    LOOP AT it_input INTO DATA(lv_value).
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( value = lv_value random_key = lo_random->get_next( ) ) TO lt_temp_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_temp_data BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN lt_temp_data ( ls_data-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).
    SORT lt_original ASCENDING.
    SORT lt_shuffled ASCENDING.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und eine `HASHED TABLE`, um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_low   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_high  TYPE i DEFAULT 20
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR iv_low > iv_high OR iv_count > ( iv_high - iv_low + 1 ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = iv_low
      high = iv_high
    ).
    DATA lt_generated_numbers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    WHILE lines( lt_generated_numbers ) < iv_count.
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_new_number INTO TABLE lt_generated_numbers. " Duplicates will be ignored by HASHED TABLE
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_unique_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN lt_generated_numbers ( num ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_low = 1 iv_high = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 ).
    DATA lt_check_uniqueness TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      INSERT lv_num INTO TABLE lt_check_uniqueness.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_uniqueness ) exp = 5 ).

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO lv_num.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( iv_act = lv_num iv_low = 1 iv_high = 20 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 10 iv_low = 1 iv_high = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lines( lt_numbers ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um eindeutige Zufallszahlen zu generieren, wird eine `WHILE`-Schleife verwendet, die Zahlen generiert und in eine `HASHED TABLE` einfügt. Die `HASHED TABLE` stellt sicher, dass nur eindeutige Werte gespeichert werden. Die Schleife läuft, bis die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen erreicht ist.
keywords: Random, Unique, Internal Tables, HASHED TABLE, WHILE, cl_abap_random_int

CLASS zcl_xco_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_class_name TYPE xco_ar_object_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_xco_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_methods.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class) = xco_cp_abap_repository=>object->class( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lo_methods) = lo_class->methods( ).

        LOOP AT lo_methods->all( ) INTO DATA(lo_method).
          APPEND lo_method->name->value( ) TO rt_methods.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_xco_ar_object_not_found.
        MESSAGE 'Class not found' TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_xco_ar_object_access_error.
        MESSAGE 'Error accessing class metadata' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

METHOD get_sflights_html. " Read data using modern Open SQL SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights) UP TO 10 ROWS. " Generate HTML table using string templates and FOR expressions rv_html = |SFLIGHTS| && || && |

Flight Data (SFLIGHTS)

| && || && || && REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights NEXT s = s && || ) && |
Carrier IDConnection IDFlight DatePriceCurrency
{ ls_flight-carrid }{ ls_flight-connid }{ ls_flight-fldate }{ ls_flight-price }{ ls_flight-currency }
|. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

    ro_appointment->set_end_date( iv_end_date ).
    ro_appointment->set_end_time( iv_end_time ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Termin-Daten (simuliert als `ty_appointment_data`) nach einem Start- und Enddatum filtert und nur die Termine zurückgibt, die in diesem Bereich liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             id          TYPE sy-uuid,
             start_date  TYPE d,
             start_time  TYPE t,
             end_date    TYPE d,
             end_time    TYPE t,
             subject     TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.
    TYPES tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING it_appointments TYPE tt_appointment_data
                iv_filter_start TYPE d
                iv_filter_end   TYPE d
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE tt_appointment_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_appointments_by_date.
    rt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #( it_appointments USING KEY primary_key
                                         WHERE start_date >= iv_filter_start
                                           AND start_date <= iv_filter_end ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_appointments_by_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_appointments_by_date.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = sy-datum + 1.
    DATA(lv_yesterday) = sy-datum - 1.

    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE zcl_appointment_filter=>tt_appointment_data(
      ( id = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ) start_date = lv_yesterday start_time = '090000' end_date = lv_yesterday end_time = '100000' subject = 'Old Meeting' )
      ( id = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ) start_date = lv_today     start_time = '110000' end_date = lv_today     end_time = '120000' subject = 'Current Meeting' )
      ( id = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ) start_date = lv_tomorrow  start_time = '140000' end_date = lv_tomorrow  end_time = '150000' subject = 'Future Meeting' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_appointments_by_date( it_appointments = lt_appointments
                                                              iv_filter_start = lv_today
                                                              iv_filter_end   = lv_today ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should find 1 appointment' exp = 1 act = lines( lt_filtered ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Subject should be Current Meeting' exp = 'Current Meeting' act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-subject ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die die Dauer eines `cl_appointment`-Objekts in Minuten berechnet und zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden `get_start_timestamp` und `get_end_timestamp` von `cl_appointment` und die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` zur Berechnung der Differenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_duration_in_minutes
      IMPORTING io_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_duration_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_duration_in_minutes.
    IF io_appointment IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = io_appointment->get_start_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_end_tstmp) = io_appointment->get_end_timestamp( ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_end_tstmp
                                                 iv_tstmp2 = lv_start_tstmp ).

    rv_duration_minutes = lv_diff_seconds / 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_appointment->set_start_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_appointment->set_start_time( '090000' ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_date( sy-datum ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_time( '103000' ). " 1 hour 30 minutes

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_duration( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Duration should be 90 minutes' exp = 90 act = lv_duration ).

    lv_duration = lo_cut->calculate_duration_in_minutes( io_appointment = lo_appointment ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von `cl_appointment`-Objekten in eine interne Tabelle von `ty_appointment_data` (vereinfachte Datenstruktur) umwandelt, um sie z.B. für die Persistenz vorzubereiten.

solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             id          TYPE sy-uuid,
             start_date  TYPE d,
             start_time  TYPE t,
             end_date    TYPE d,
             end_time    TYPE t,
             subject     TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.
    TYPES tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_to_data_table
      IMPORTING it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data_table) TYPE tt_appointment_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_to_data_table.
    rt_data_table = VALUE #( FOR lo_app IN it_appointments
                             ( id          = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ) " Simulate ID generation
                               start_date  = lo_app->get_start_date( )
                               start_time  = lo_app->get_start_time( )
                               end_date    = lo_app->get_end_date( )
                               end_time    = lo_app->get_end_time( )
                               subject     = lo_app->get_subject( )
                               description = lo_app->get_description( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die versucht, einen Termin mit ungültigen Daten (z.B. Enddatum vor Startdatum) zu erstellen und die dabei ausgelöste Ausnahme (`cx_apc_error`) abfängt und verarbeitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und die Ausnahme `cx_apc_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_invalid_appointment
      IMPORTING iv_start_date TYPE d
                iv_start_time TYPE t
                iv_end_date   TYPE d
                iv_end_time   TYPE t
                iv_subject    TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_invalid_appointment.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).

    TRY.
        lo_appointment->set_start_date( iv_start_date ).
        lo_appointment->set_start_time( iv_start_time ).
        lo_appointment->set_end_date( iv_end_date ).
        lo_appointment->set_end_time( iv_end_time ).
        lo_appointment->set_subject( iv_subject ).

        rv_error_message = 'Appointment created successfully (unexpected for invalid data)'.

      CATCH cx_apc_error INTO DATA(lx_apc_error).
        rv_error_message = |Error creating appointment: { lx_apc_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_range_error).
        rv_error_message = |Range error: { lx_range_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_invalid_appointment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_invalid_appointment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_error_handler( ).

    " Attempt to create an appointment where end date is before start date
    DATA(lv_error_msg) = lo_cut->create_invalid_appointment(
      iv_start_date = sy-datum
      iv_start_time = '100000'
      iv_end_date   = sy-datum - 1 " Invalid: End date before start date
      iv_end_time   = '090000'
      iv_subject    = 'Invalid Test'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Error message should not be empty' act = lv_error_msg IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Error message should indicate an error' exp = 'Error creating appointment:' act = lv_error_msg ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Error message should mention date issue' exp = 'End date' act = lv_error_msg ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` zur strukturierten Fehlerbehandlung ist ein grundlegender Bestandteil modernen ABAP-Codes. Das Abfangen spezifischer Ausnahmen wie `cx_apc_error` (oder allgemeiner `cx_static_check`/`cx_dynamic_check`) ermöglicht eine robuste Reaktion auf ungültige Eingaben oder Systemfehler.
keywords: Error Handling, Exceptions, TRY CATCH, cl_appointment

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von `cl_appointment`-Objekten gruppiert, um die Anzahl der Termine pro Tag zu ermitteln.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_count_per_day,
             appointment_date TYPE d,
             count            TYPE i,
           END OF ty_appointment_count_per_day.
    TYPES tt_appointment_count_per_day TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_count_per_day WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_appointments_by_day
      IMPORTING it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_daily_counts) TYPE tt_appointment_count_per_day.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_appointments_by_day.
    rt_daily_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_app IN it_appointments GROUP BY ( appointment_date = ls_app->get_start_date( ) ) ASCENDING
                                ( appointment_date = ls_app-appointment_date
                                  count            = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_appointments_by_day FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_appointments_by_day.
    DATA(lo_app1) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app1->set_start_date( sy-datum ).
    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app2->set_start_date( sy-datum ).
    DATA(lo_app3) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_app3->set_start_date( sy-datum + 1 ).

    DATA(lt_appointments) = VALUE zcl_appointment_grouper=>tt_appointments(
      ( lo_app1 )
      ( lo_app2 )
      ( lo_app3 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_appointment_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_daily_counts) = lo_cut->group_appointments_by_day( it_appointments = lt_appointments ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should have 2 entries for 2 days' exp = 2 act = lines( lt_daily_counts ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Count for today should be 2' exp = 2 act = lt_daily_counts[ 1 ]-count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Date for first entry should be today' exp = sy-datum act = lt_daily_counts[ 1 ]-appointment_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Count for tomorrow should be 1' exp = 1 act = lt_daily_counts[ 2 ]-count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke Funktion in ABAP, um interne Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Er ersetzt komplexe Schleifen und `COLLECT`-Anweisungen durch eine deklarative und effiziente Syntax.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Flugdatensatz aus SFLIGHTS und mappen Sie die Felder auf eine lokale Struktur, die eine geschachtelte Struktur für die Flugdetails enthält. Demonstrieren Sie, wie INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS die Top-Level-Felder mappt.
hint: Definieren Sie eine geschachtelte Struktur und verwenden Sie INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS. Beachten Sie, dass nur direkt übereinstimmende Feldnamen gemappt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_corr_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_details,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_details.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_record,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             details TYPE ty_flight_details, " Nested structure
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_record.

    METHODS get_flight_record
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_record) TYPE ty_flight_record.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_corr_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_record.
    " INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS mappt nur Top-Level-Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen.
    " Für geschachtelte Strukturen muss man entweder die Felder explizit auswählen
    " oder MOVE-CORRESPONDING nach dem SELECT * verwenden.
    " Hier demonstrieren wir das Mapping von Top-Level-Feldern.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight_record.

    " Um die geschachtelte Struktur zu füllen, müsste man entweder:
    " 1. Die Felder einzeln zuweisen:
    "    rs_flight_record-details-connid = iv_connid.
    "    rs_flight_record-details-fldate = iv_fldate.
    " 2. Oder einen SELECT * machen und dann MOVE-CORRESPONDING auf die geschachtelte Struktur anwenden.
    "    Da der Fokus auf INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS im SELECT liegt,
    "    zeigen wir hier nur das Top-Level-Mapping.
    "    Für die Demonstration füllen wir die Details manuell.
    rs_flight_record-details-connid = iv_connid.
    rs_flight_record-details-fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_record FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_record.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_corr_nested( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum. " Annahme: Es gibt einen Flug für heute
    " Suchen Sie einen existierenden Flug, um den Test stabil zu machen
    SELECT TOP 1 carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO (DATA(lv_carrid), DATA(lv_connid), lv_fldate). ENDSELECT.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fallback, falls keine Flüge gefunden werden (unwahrscheinlich für SFLIGHTS)
      lv_carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_connid = '0400'.
      lv_fldate = '20251129'. " Beispiel-Datum
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_record) = lo_cut->get_flight_record(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_record-carrid exp = lv_carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_record-details-connid exp = lv_connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_record-details-fldate exp = lv_fldate ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_record-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS mappt Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen auf der Top-Level-Ebene der Struktur. Geschachtelte Strukturen werden nicht automatisch gefüllt, es sei denn, die Datenbankfelder haben exakt denselben Pfadnamen (was bei Standardtabellen nicht der Fall ist). Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Top-Level-Felder mappt und die geschachtelte Struktur manuell füllt oder eine andere Strategie wählen müsste.
keywords: INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Nested Structures, Data Handling, SFLIGHTS, Structures

hint: Verwenden Sie INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE und eine zusätzliche Schleife oder eine funktionale Methode zur Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_corr_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price_text TYPE string, " Price as string
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES: tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_corr_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_raw_flight.
    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_raw_flights.

    " Transformation des Preises in einen String mit Währung
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_flights
                                      ( carrid     = ls_raw-carrid
                                        connid     = ls_raw-connid
                                        fldate     = ls_raw-fldate
                                        price_text = |{ ls_raw-price } { ls_raw-currency }|
                                      ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_transformed_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->get_transformed_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_transformed ).
    LOOP AT lt_transformed INTO DATA(ls_transformed).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_transformed-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_transformed-price_text IS NOT INITIAL ).
      " Überprüfen Sie das Format des Preis-Strings (z.B. '100.00 EUR')
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( matches( val = ls_transformed-price_text regex = '\d+\.\d{2} [A-Z]{3}' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE für das initiale Laden der Daten mit einer modernen funktionalen Iteration (FOR-Ausdruck) und String-Templates, um die Daten anschließend zu transformieren. Dies ist ein effizienter und lesbarer Weg, um Daten zu verarbeiten und anzupassen.
keywords: INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE, FOR, VALUE, String Templates, Data Transformation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in `sflights`, die eine Mindestkapazität von 100 Economy-Sitzen haben, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem Zähler und einer `FOR`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_by_capacity IMPORTING iv_min_eco TYPE s_seatsocc
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0
                             FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             WHERE ( seatsocc_e >= iv_min_eco )
                             NEXT c = c + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_reduce_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_count( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_capacity( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Count should be greater than or equal to 0' act = lv_count >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators, um eine Aggregation (hier das Zählen) über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen. Die `FOR`-Schleife mit `WHERE`-Bedingung filtert die relevanten Einträge, und der Zähler `c` wird inkrementiert. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und kompakte Schreibweise.
keywords: COUNT, REDUCE, FOR, INTERNAL TABLES, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen MESH-Typ, um Flugdaten (`sflights`) und Fluggesellschaftsdaten (`scarr`) miteinander zu verknüpfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES MESH` und `ASSOCIATION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mesh_type_def DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF MESH ty_flight_mesh,
             flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate,
             carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid
               ASSOCIATION _to_flights TO flights ON carrid = flights~carrid,
           END OF MESH ty_flight_mesh.

    METHODS get_mesh_data RETURNING VALUE(rs_mesh) TYPE ty_flight_mesh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mesh_type_def IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mesh_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    SELECT * FROM scarr UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    rs_mesh-flights = lt_sflights.
    rs_mesh-carriers = lt_scarr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_mesh_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_mesh) = lo_cut->get_mesh_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flights table should not be empty' act = lines( ls_mesh-flights ) > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carriers table should not be empty' act = lines( ls_mesh-carriers ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: MESH-Typen (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglichen die Definition von Beziehungen (Assoziationen) zwischen internen Tabellen direkt im Datentyp. Dies vereinfacht die Navigation und den Zugriff auf verknüpfte Daten erheblich und ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für komplexe Datenmodelle im Speicher.
