Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine HTML-Tabelle aus einer internen Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) und konvertieren Sie diese für die Verwendung als E-Mail-Inhalt.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` gefolgt von `cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_html_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, price TYPE sflight-price, currency TYPE sflight-currency, END OF ty_sflight. TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY. METHODS get_html_email_content IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_solix) TYPE solix_tab. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_bcs_html_email IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_html_email_content. DATA(lv_html_header) = `Flugdaten

Flugübersicht

`. DATA(lv_html_footer) = `
AirlineFlugnr.DatumPreisWährung
`. DATA(lv_html_rows) = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR IN it_sflights NEXT s = s && `` && -carrid && `` && -connid && `` && -fldate && `` && -price && `` && -currency && `` ). DATA(lv_full_html) = lv_html_header && lv_html_rows && lv_html_footer. DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring( iv_string = lv_full_html iv_codepage = 'UTF-8' ). rt_solix = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix( iv_xstring = lv_xstring ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_html_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_html_conversion.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_bcs_html_email=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_html_email( ).
    DATA(lt_solix_content) = lo_cut->get_html_email_content( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_act = lines( lt_solix_content ) iv_msg = 'SOLIX table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( iv_act = lines( lt_solix_content ) iv_msg = 'SOLIX table should contain data' ).

    " Optional: Convert back to string to check content (simplified check)
    DATA(lv_xstring_back) = cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_xstring( lt_solix_content ).
    DATA(lv_string_back) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string( lv_xstring_back ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( iv_act = lv_string_back iv_exp = 'Flugübersicht' iv_msg = 'HTML content should contain header' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( iv_act = lv_string_back iv_exp = 'LH' iv_msg = 'HTML content should contain flight data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt moderne ABAP-Features wie String-Templates und den `REDUCE`-Operator, um dynamisch HTML-Inhalt zu generieren. Die `cl_bcs_convert` Klasse wird verwendet, um den String in ein XSTRING und dann in eine SOLIX-Tabelle zu konvertieren, was für die Integration in E-Mails über Business Communication Services (BCS) notwendig ist. Dies ist effizient, da es die manuelle String-Verkettung minimiert und die Konvertierung standardisiert.
keywords: cl_bcs_convert, HTML, Email, String Templates, REDUCE, SOLIX, XSTRING

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) in das CSV-Format und bereiten Sie sie als E-Mail-Anhang vor.
hint: Generieren Sie den CSV-String manuell und nutzen Sie dann `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring` und `cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_csv_attachment_content
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_solix) TYPE solix_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_csv_attachment_content.
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = `Airline;Flugnr.;Datum;Preis;Währung`.

    DATA(lv_csv_rows) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = s && |
| && <fs_sflight>-carrid && `;` && <fs_sflight>-connid && `;` && <fs_sflight>-fldate && `;` && <fs_sflight>-price && `;` && <fs_sflight>-currency
    ).

    DATA(lv_full_csv) = lv_csv_header && lv_csv_rows.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      iv_string = lv_full_csv
      iv_codepage = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    rt_solix = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix(
      iv_xstring = lv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_csv_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_csv_conversion.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_bcs_csv_attachment=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.

CLASS zcl_chart_bar_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_base_data) = VALUE tt_dynamic_data(
      ( category = 'A' value = 10 )
      ( category = 'B' value = 20 )
      ( category = 'C' value = 15 )
    ).

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN lt_base_data
                              ( category = ls_data-category
                                value = ls_data-value * iv_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_line_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_time_series,
             date  TYPE sy-datum,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_time_series.
    TYPES tt_time_series TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_time_series WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_time_series
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_data TYPE tt_time_series
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_end_date   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_time_series.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_line_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_time_series.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_raw_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE date BETWEEN iv_start_date AND iv_end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_time_series FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_time_series.
    DATA: lt_raw_data TYPE zcl_chart_line_filter=>tt_time_series.
    APPEND VALUE #( date = '20230101' value = 10 ) TO lt_raw_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( date = '20230115' value = 12 ) TO lt_raw_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( date = '20230201' value = 15 ) TO lt_raw_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( date = '20230210' value = 11 ) TO lt_raw_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_line_filter( ).

    " Filter for January
    DATA(lt_jan_data) = lo_cut->get_filtered_time_series(
      it_raw_data = lt_raw_data
      iv_start_date = '20230101'
      iv_end_date = '20230131'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_jan_data ) exp = 2 iv_msg = 'Should have 2 entries for January' ).

    " Filter for February
    DATA(lt_feb_data) = lo_cut->get_filtered_time_series(
      it_raw_data = lt_raw_data
      iv_start_date = '20230201'
      iv_end_date = '20230228'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_feb_data ) exp = 2 iv_msg = 'Should have 2 entries for February' ).

    " Filter for a specific day
    DATA(lt_single_day_data) = lo_cut->get_filtered_time_series(
      it_raw_data = lt_raw_data
      iv_start_date = '20230115'
      iv_end_date = '20230115'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_single_day_data ) exp = 1 iv_msg = 'Should have 1 entry for 20230115' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_top_n_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_value,
             item  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_value.
    TYPES tt_item_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_all_items TYPE tt_item_value

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_chart_top_n_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_items.
    SORT it_all_items BY value DESCENDING.
    rt_top_n_items = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_n AND i <= lines( it_all_items )
                               ( it_all_items[i] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data)     TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line>  TYPE ANY.

    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.
      ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_line>.

      IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        TRY.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_carrid>).
            IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_carrid> = 'AA'.
            ENDIF.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_connid>).
            IF <lv_connid> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_connid> = '0001'.
            ENDIF.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_fldate>).
            IF <lv_fldate> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_fldate> = sy-datum.
            ENDIF.
            INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
            IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_carrid> = 'LH'.
            ENDIF.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_connid>.
            IF <lv_connid> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_connid> = '0400'.
            ENDIF.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_fldate>.
            IF <lv_fldate> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_fldate> = sy-datum - 1.
            ENDIF.
            INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

          CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
            " Handle error if component does not exist
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lr_sflight_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

Die Zuweisung an ein `FIELD-SYMBOL <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE` ermöglicht den generischen Zugriff. Das Befüllen erfolgt ebenfalls dynamisch über `CREATE DATA LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`. Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      add_numbers
        IMPORTING
          iv_num1 TYPE i
          iv_num2 TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i,
      subtract_numbers
        IMPORTING
          iv_num1 TYPE i
          iv_num2 TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i,
      call_dynamic_method
        IMPORTING
          iv_method_name TYPE string
          iv_num1        TYPE i
          iv_num2        TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_num1 - iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM1'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>exporting.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_num1 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM2'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_num2 INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_RESULT'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>returning.
    GET REFERENCE OF rv_output INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_output = -1.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_add.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Addition should be 15' act = lv_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_invalid_method.

explanation: Diese Lösung zeigt den dynamischen Aufruf einer Methode, deren Name zur Laufzeit in einer Variablen gespeichert ist. `CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters` ermöglicht dies. Die Parameter werden dabei in einer Tabelle vom Typ `abap_parmbind_tab` übergeben, wobei Referenzen auf die tatsächlichen Werte verwendet werden. CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Vergleichswert.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer dynamisch erzeugten Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight      TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_compare_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflight_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_component> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT it_sflight ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_sflight> TO <lv_component>.
      IF <lv_component> IS ASSIGNED.
        IF <lv_component> = iv_compare_value.
          APPEND <ls_sflight> TO rt_filtered.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem `FIELD-SYMBOL` dynamisch eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, basierend auf einem Index oder einer Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... INDEX ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` oder `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY (dynamic_key_components) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_fs_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_row_by_index
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.

    METHODS assign_row_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_key_field_name TYPE string
        iv_key_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_fs_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_row_by_index.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_data> TYPE ty_data.
    READ TABLE it_data INDEX iv_index ASSIGNING <ls_data>.
    IF <ls_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      GET REFERENCE OF <ls_data> INTO rr_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD assign_row_by_key.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_data> TYPE ty_data.
    DATA: lt_key_components TYPE abap_component_tab.
    DATA: ls_key_component TYPE abap_componentname.

    ls_key_component-name = iv_key_field_name.
    INSERT ls_key_component INTO TABLE lt_key_components.

    READ TABLE it_data WITH KEY (lt_key_components) = iv_key_value ASSIGNING <ls_data>.
    IF <ls_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      GET REFERENCE OF <ls_data> INTO rr_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT`-Anweisung aus, bei der die auszuwählenden Spalten dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT (column_list) FROM ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_sflight_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        iv_column_list TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_sflight_dynamic_columns.
    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lv_column_list_internal TYPE string.

    " Ensure column list is valid for SFLIGHT
    lv_column_list_internal = iv_column_list.

    TRY.
        SELECT (lv_column_list_internal) FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflight_raw UP TO 5 ROWS.

        " Dynamically create data references for each row to return generic data
        LOOP AT lt_sflight_raw ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_sflight_raw>).
          DATA(lr_data) = REF TO data( <ls_sflight_raw> ).
          APPEND lr_data TO rt_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid column list
        CLEAR rt_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit dynamischer Zeilenstruktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle, wobei die Feldzuordnung dynamisch erfolgt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Struktur und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit `EXPANDING TABLES` oder `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_map_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_source_data
        iv_target_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_target_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_map_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_target> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_source> TYPE ty_source_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_target> TYPE ANY.

    CREATE DATA rr_target_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_target_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_target_table->* TO <lt_target>.

    IF <lt_target> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_target_line) LIKE LINE OF <lt_target>.
      ASSIGN lr_target_line->* TO <ls_target>.

      LOOP AT it_source_data ASSIGNING <ls_source>.
        IF <ls_target> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Dynamic field mapping (simplified: assuming same field names)
          TRY.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_target> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_id>).
              IF <lv_id> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_id> = <ls_source>-id. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NAME' OF STRUCTURE <ls_target> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_name>).
              IF <lv_name> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_name> = <ls_source>-name. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'VALUE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_target> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_value>).
              IF <lv_value> IS ASSIGNED. <lv_value> = <ls_source>-value. ENDIF.
            CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
              " Handle missing fields in target structure
          ENDTRY.
          INSERT <ls_target> INTO TABLE <lt_target>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Struktur einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit aus und geben Sie die Feldnamen und Typen aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run Time Type Information) mit `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_example,
             field_char TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_int  TYPE i,
             field_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_example.
    TYPES: tt_example TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_example WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_structure
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_structure_info) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_structure.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: ls_component TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    TRY.
        lr_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table_data ).
        lr_struct_descr ?= lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
          APPEND |Name: { ls_component-name }, Type: { ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) }| TO rt_structure_info.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        APPEND 'Error: Not a table type or invalid data reference.' TO rt_structure_info.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_param_error.
        APPEND 'Error: Invalid type description parameter.' TO rt_structure_info.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie dynamisch Platzhalter in einem String-Template durch Werte, die in einer dynamischen Struktur oder Tabelle enthalten sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` oder `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>replace_variables` (falls verfügbar und passend) in Kombination mit dynamischem Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             name TYPE string,
             city TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS process_dynamic_template
      IMPORTING
        iv_template TYPE string
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_template.
    DATA: lv_processed_string TYPE string VALUE iv_template.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_component> TYPE ANY.

    " Regex to find placeholders like {NAME}, {CITY}, {AGE}
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '{\w+}' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = lv_processed_string ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      DATA(lv_placeholder) = lo_matcher->get_matched_substring( ).
      DATA(lv_field_name) = lv_placeholder+1( strlen( lv_placeholder ) - 2 ). " Remove {} brackets
      CONDENSE lv_field_name NO-GAPS.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <lv_component>.
      IF <lv_component> IS ASSIGNED.
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_placeholder IN lv_processed_string WITH <lv_component>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_result = lv_processed_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie dynamisch Werte einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit definierten Aggregationsfeld und einer Aggregationsfunktion (z.B. Summe).
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und einer `REDUCE`-Expression oder manueller Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             group_field TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             group_field TYPE string,
             sum_value   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES: tt_result TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_result WITH UNIQUE KEY group_field.

    METHODS aggregate_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data           TYPE tt_data
        iv_group_field    TYPE string
        iv_value_field    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated) TYPE tt_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_data> TYPE ty_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_group_component> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_value_component> TYPE ANY.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <ls_data>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <lv_group_component>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_value_field OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <lv_value_component>.

      IF <lv_group_component> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_value_component> IS ASSIGNED.
        DATA(lv_current_group) = <lv_group_component>.
        DATA(lv_current_value) = <lv_value_component>.

        READ TABLE rt_aggregated WITH KEY group_field = lv_current_group ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_result>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <ls_result>-sum_value = <ls_result>-sum_value + lv_current_value.
        ELSE.
          INSERT VALUE #( group_field = lv_current_group sum_value = lv_current_value ) INTO TABLE rt_aggregated.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_by_group_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_aggregation( ).
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_dyn_aggregation=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( group_field = 'A' value_field = 10 ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( group_field = 'B' value_field = 20 ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( group_field = 'A' value_field = 15 ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_dynamic( it_data = lt_data iv_group_field = 'GROUP_FIELD' iv_value_field = 'VALUE_FIELD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result table should have 2 entries' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY group_field = 'A' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_result_a>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum for A should be 25' act = <ls_result_a>-sum_value exp = 25 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY group_field = 'B' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_result_b>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum for B should be 20' act = <ls_result_b>-sum_value exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_aggregate_with_different_value_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_aggregation( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_alt,
             category TYPE string,
             amount   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_alt.
    TYPES: tt_data_alt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_alt WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA: lt_data_alt TYPE tt_data_alt.
    INSERT VALUE #( category = 'X' amount = 5 ) INTO TABLE lt_data_alt.
    INSERT VALUE #( category = 'Y' amount = 10 ) INTO TABLE lt_data_alt.
    INSERT VALUE #( category = 'X' amount = 3 ) INTO TABLE lt_data_alt.

    " This test requires a more complex dynamic aggregation or a different approach
    " as the input table type is fixed in the method signature. For this example,
    " we stick to the defined ty_data.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_dynamic( it_data = VALUE #( ( group_field = 'X' value_field = 5 ) ( group_field = 'Y' value_field = 10 ) ( group_field = 'X' value_field = 3 ) ) iv_group_field = 'GROUP_FIELD' iv_value_field = 'VALUE_FIELD' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY group_field = 'X' ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_result_x>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum for X should be 8' act = <ls_result_x>-sum_value exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_aggregate_invalid_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_aggregation( ).
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_dyn_aggregation=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( group_field = 'A' value_field = 10 ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_dynamic( it_data = lt_data iv_group_field = 'INVALID_GROUP' iv_value_field = 'VALUE_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be empty for invalid group field' act = lt_result ).

    CLEAR lt_result.
    lt_result = lo_cut->aggregate_dynamic( it_data = lt_data iv_group_field = 'GROUP_FIELD' iv_value_field = 'INVALID_VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be empty for invalid value field' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Aggregation von Daten in einer internen Tabelle. Die Gruppierungs- und Wertfelder werden zur Laufzeit als Strings übergeben. Mittels `LOOP AT` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` wird auf die Feldwerte zugegriffen und die Aggregation (hier eine Summe) manuell durchgeführt. Dies ist eine flexible Lösung für Berichte oder Analysen, bei denen die Aggregationskriterien dynamisch sind.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_fxs_image_processor` dynamisch, um eine Bildoperation (z.B. Skalierung) durchzuführen, wobei die Parameter dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE OBJECT` und `CALL METHOD` dynamisch für `cl_fxs_image_processor` und deren Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_image_proc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_image_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_method_name   TYPE string " e.g., 'SCALE_IMAGE'
        iv_width         TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_height        TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_image) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_image_proc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_image_dynamic.
    DATA: lo_image_processor TYPE REF TO cl_fxs_image_processor.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_image_processor.

        " Dynamically prepare parameters for the method call
        IF iv_method_name = 'SCALE_IMAGE'.
          IF iv_width IS SUPPLIED.
            ls_parameter-name = 'I_WIDTH'.
            ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>exporting.
            GET REFERENCE OF iv_width INTO ls_parameter-value.
            INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.
          ENDIF.
          IF iv_height IS SUPPLIED.
            ls_parameter-name = 'I_HEIGHT'.
            ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>exporting.
            GET REFERENCE OF iv_height INTO ls_parameter-value.
            INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.
          ENDIF.

          ls_parameter-name = 'I_IMAGE_XSTRING'.
          GET REFERENCE OF iv_image_xstring INTO ls_parameter-value.
          INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

          ls_parameter-name = 'E_IMAGE_XSTRING'.
          ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>importing.
          GET REFERENCE OF rv_processed_image INTO ls_parameter-value.
          INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

          CALL METHOD lo_image_processor->(iv_method_name)
            PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
        ELSE.
          " Handle other dynamic methods or unsupported method
          rv_processed_image = iv_image_xstring. " Return original if method not handled
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        " Handle error during object creation
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Handle error during dynamic method call
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_processor_error.
        " Handle image processor specific errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches Datenobjekt vom Typ einer internen Tabelle und füllen Sie es mit Werten, die aus einer anderen dynamischen Tabelle stammen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` für beide Tabellen und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff und die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES: tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table TYPE REF TO data
        iv_target_type_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_target_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_source> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_target> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_source_line> TYPE ANY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_target_line> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_source_table->* TO <lt_source>.
    IF <lt_source> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA rr_target_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_target_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_target_table->* TO <lt_target>.

    IF <lt_target> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_target_line_ref) LIKE LINE OF <lt_target>.
      ASSIGN lr_target_line_ref->* TO <ls_target_line>.

      LOOP AT <lt_source> ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
        IF <ls_target_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Attempt to move corresponding fields dynamically
          MOVE-CORRESPONDING <ls_source_line> TO <ls_target_line>.
          INSERT <ls_target_line> INTO TABLE <lt_target>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_copy_subset_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_copy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Target table ref should not be initial' act = lr_target_ref ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_target> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_target_ref->* TO <lt_target>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Target table should have 1 entry' act = lines( <lt_target> ) exp = 1 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_target> TYPE ty_target_line.
    READ TABLE <lt_target> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_target>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry COL1 should be X' act = <ls_target>-col1 exp = 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry COL2 should be 100' act = <ls_target>-col2 exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'COL3 should be initial' act = <ls_target>-col3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_copy_invalid_target_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_copy( ).

    DATA(lr_source_ref) = REF TO data( lt_source ).
    DATA(lr_target_ref) = lo_cut->copy_dynamic_table( ir_source_table = lr_source_ref iv_target_type_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_TABLE_TYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Target table ref should be initial for invalid type' act = lr_target_ref ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine dynamische Zieltabelle erstellt und mit Daten aus einer dynamischen Quelltabelle füllt. Beide Tabellen werden über Datenreferenzen und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` generisch behandelt. `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` wird verwendet, um Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen automatisch zu kopieren. Dies ist nützlich für generische Datenverarbeitungspipelines, bei denen die genauen Tabellenstrukturen zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt sind.
keywords: DYNAMIC, CREATE DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Table, MOVE-CORRESPONDING

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.

        mt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid connid fldate ]-price = iv_new_price.
        rv_updated = abap_true.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge in einer HASHED TABLE.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS calculate_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) ) 
                               FOR ls_flight IN mt_flights
                               NEXT total = total + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge in einer HASHED TABLE nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUP` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS get_avg_price_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_avg_price_by_carrier.
    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN mt_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) 
                               LET lv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                                               FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                               NEXT total = total + ls_member-price )
                                   lv_count = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) IN
                               ( carrid = CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )-carrid
                                 avg_price = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flüge in eine HASHED TABLE ein und behandeln Sie mögliche Duplikate.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT` oder `MODIFY` mit `TRANSPORTING` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
    METHODS add_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_added_count) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_flights_current RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flights.
    LOOP AT it_new_flights INTO DATA(ls_new_flight).
      INSERT ls_new_flight INTO TABLE mt_flights.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_added_count = rv_added_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_current.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_new_flights.
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_insert=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_insert( it_flights = lt_initial_flights ).

    DATA(lt_flights_to_add) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_insert=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_added_count) = lo_cut->add_flights( it_new_flights = lt_flights_to_add ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_added_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_flights_current( ) ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_duplicate_flights.
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_insert=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_insert( it_flights = lt_initial_flights ).

    DATA(lt_flights_to_add) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_insert=>tt_sflight_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_added_count) = lo_cut->add_flights( it_new_flights = lt_flights_to_add ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_added_count exp = 1 ). " Only LH added
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_flights_current( ) ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` ist die gängige Methode zum Hinzufügen von Zeilen. Bei HASHED TABLEs mit UNIQUE KEY wird ein Duplikat nicht eingefügt und `sy-subrc` ist ungleich 0, was eine einfache Duplikatsbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, INSERT, Duplicates, sy-subrc

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Standardtabelle von Flugdaten in eine HASHED TABLE, um schnelle Zugriffe zu ermöglichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...)` mit `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS convert_to_hashed
      IMPORTING
        it_standard_flights TYPE tt_sflight_standard
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_hashed.
    rt_hashed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_standard_flights ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lt_standard) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_convert=>tt_sflight_standard(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_convert( ).

    DATA(lt_hashed) = lo_cut->convert_to_hashed( it_standard_flights = lt_standard ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hashed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_hashed[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ]-price exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_duplicates.
    DATA(lt_standard) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_convert=>tt_sflight_standard(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '110.00' ) " Duplicate key
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_convert( ).

    DATA(lt_hashed) = lo_cut->convert_to_hashed( it_standard_flights = lt_standard ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hashed ) exp = 1 ). " Only one entry due to unique key
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_hashed[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' ]-price exp = '100.00' ). " First entry wins
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung einer Standardtabelle in eine HASHED TABLE kann effizient mit `VALUE #(...)` und einer `FOR`-Schleife erfolgen. `CORRESPONDING #(...)` vereinfacht die Feldzuweisung. Duplikate im Primärschlüssel der HASHED TABLE werden automatisch ignoriert, wobei der erste Eintrag beibehalten wird.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie hierarchische Flugdaten für die Anzeige in einem `CL_GUI_LIST_TREE` vor, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer.
hint: Strukturieren Sie die Daten in einer internen Tabelle, die die Hierarchie-Informationen (Parent-ID, Node-ID) enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_id   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_id TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text      TYPE lvc_value,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_tree_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_root_node TYPE lvc_nkey VALUE 'ROOT'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_tree_data.
    DATA: lv_node_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.

    " Add root node
    APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node( node_id = gc_root_node text = 'Flüge' is_folder = abap_true ) TO rt_nodes.

    " Group sflights by carrid and connid
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_tree_nodes( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) 
                                                    ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_carrier_conn_node_id) = |C{ ls_grouped_flight-carrid }_N{ ls_grouped_flight-connid }|.

      " Add carrier-connid node
      APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node( node_id = lv_carrier_conn_node_id
                                 parent_id = gc_root_node
                                 text = |{ ls_grouped_flight-carrid } - { ls_grouped_flight-connid }|
                                 is_folder = abap_true
                                 carrid = ls_grouped_flight-carrid
                                 connid = ls_grouped_flight-connid ) TO rt_nodes.

      " Add individual flight nodes
      LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = ls_grouped_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_grouped_flight-connid.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node( node_id = |F{ lv_node_counter }|
                                   parent_id = lv_carrier_conn_node_id
                                   text = |Datum: { ls_flight-fldate }, Preis: { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-curr }|
                                   is_folder = abap_false
                                   carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid
                                   fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                   price = ls_flight-price ) TO rt_nodes.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_grp_flight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ts_flight_sum,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        total_price TYPE s_price,
      END OF ts_flight_sum,
      tt_flight_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_sums) TYPE tt_flight_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_flight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_flight_sum) = VALUE ts_flight_sum( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                  total_price = SUM( ls_flight-price ) ).
      APPEND ls_flight_sum TO rt_flight_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_collect_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ts_flight_detail,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
        price TYPE s_price,
      END OF ts_flight_detail,
      tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ts_carrier_flights,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        flights TYPE tt_flight_details,
      END OF ts_carrier_flights,
      tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS collect_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_collect_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_carrier_flights) = VALUE ts_carrier_flights(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flights = VALUE tt_flight_details(
          FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
            ( fldate = member-fldate
              price = member-price )
        )
      ).
      APPEND ls_carrier_flights TO rt_carrier_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_grp_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_carriers_by_flight_count.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

                                              WHERE GROUP SIZE >= iv_min_flights.
      DATA(ls_carrier) = VALUE ts_carrier_info( carrid = ls_flight-carrid

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft den Durchschnittspreis und die maximale Kapazität aller Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ts_flight_agg,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        avg_price TYPE s_price,
        max_capacity TYPE s_max_seats,
      END OF ts_flight_agg,
      tt_flight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_flight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_agg) = REDUCE ts_flight_agg(
        INIT
          l_carrid TYPE s_carr_id = ls_flight-carrid
          l_total_price TYPE s_price = 0
          l_flight_count TYPE i = 0
          l_max_capacity TYPE s_max_seats = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT
          l_total_price = l_total_price + member-price
          l_flight_count = l_flight_count + 1
          l_max_capacity = nmax( val1 = l_max_capacity val2 = member-seatsmax )
        FINALLY
          carrid = l_carrid
          avg_price = COND s_price( WHEN l_flight_count > 0 THEN l_total_price / l_flight_count ELSE 0 )
          max_capacity = l_max_capacity
      ).
      APPEND ls_agg TO rt_aggregated_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_basic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_excel.
    DATA: lo_xlsx TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.
        lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx->add_worksheet( 'Flugdaten' ).

        " Header
        lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
        lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flugnummer' ).
        lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Preis' ).

        " Data (example from sflights)
        DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
        SELECT FROM sflights UP TO 3 ROWS
               FIELDS carrid, connid, price
               INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

        DATA(lv_row) = 2.
        LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
          lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_flight-connid ).
          lo_worksheet->set_cell( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_flight-price ).
          lv_row = lv_row + 1.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_xlsx->save( iv_file_path ).
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_xlsx_document_error INTO DATA(lx_xlsx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_xlsx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_filtered_table_excel
      IMPORTING iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_filtered_table_excel.
    DATA: lo_xlsx TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx.
        lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx->add_worksheet( 'Flugtabelle' ).

        " Select data for the table
        SELECT FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS
               FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
               INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

        " Define table headers
        DATA(lt_headers) = VALUE cl_xlsx_worksheet=>tt_table_headers(
          ( name = 'Fluggesellschaft' ) ( name = 'Flugnummer' ) ( name = 'Flugdatum' ) ( name = 'Preis' ) ( name = 'Währung' )
        ).

        " Add table to worksheet
        lo_worksheet->add_table(
          ip_row_start    = 1
          ip_column_start = 1
          ip_row_end      = lines( lt_sflights ) + 1
          ip_column_end   = 5
          it_headers      = lt_headers
          it_data         = lt_sflights
          iv_table_name   = 'FlightData'
          iv_display_name = 'FlightData'
        ).

        " Set autofilter for the table range
        lo_worksheet->set_autofilter(
          ip_row_start    = 1
          ip_column_start = 1
          ip_row_end      = 1
          ip_column_end   = 5
        ).

        lo_xlsx->save( iv_file_path ).
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_xlsx_document_error INTO DATA(lx_xlsx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_xlsx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String und fangen Sie mögliche Konvertierungsfehler ab, die auftreten, wenn Zeichen in der Ziel-Codepage nicht darstellbar sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_source_cp     TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp     TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        rv_converted_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
          source_codepage = iv_source_cp
          target_codepage = iv_target_cp
          source_string   = iv_source_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_conversion
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error
            textid   = lx_conv_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_successful_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_error      FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_converted) = lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling(
      iv_source_string = lv_input
      iv_source_cp     = 'UTF-8'
      iv_target_cp     = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted exp = lv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_input_with_unrepresentable) = '你好'. " UTF-8 Chinese characters

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = lo_cut
      meth = convert_with_error_handling
      msg = 'Expected cx_sy_codepage_conversion for unrepresentable characters'
      EXPECTED_CLASS = 'CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION'
      parameters = VALUE #( (
        name = 'IV_SOURCE_STRING' value = REF #( lv_input_with_unrepresentable ) )
        ( name = 'IV_SOURCE_CP' value = REF #( 'UTF-8' ) )
        ( name = 'IV_TARGET_CP' value = REF #( '1100' ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion` ist entscheidend, um Laufzeitfehler abzufangen, die bei der Konvertierung von Zeichen auftreten können, die in der Ziel-Codepage nicht darstellbar sind. Dies erhöht die Robustheit der Anwendung.
keywords: CODEPAGE, CONVERSION, ERROR HANDLING, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String basierend auf einer dynamisch übergebenen Ziel-Codepage. Fangen Sie dabei mögliche Fehler ab.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` mit variablen Parametern und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_dynamic_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_source_cp     TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp     TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_dynamic_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_dynamic.
    TRY.
        rv_converted_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
          source_codepage = iv_source_cp
          target_codepage = iv_target_cp
          source_string   = iv_source_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_conversion
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error
            textid   = lx_conv_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in einen JSON-String und konvertieren Sie diesen dann in `XSTRING` unter Berücksichtigung einer bestimmten Codepage (z.B. UTF-8).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_json_writer` für die JSON-Serialisierung und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` für die `XSTRING`-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_struct_to_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.

    METHODS serialize_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        is_data          TYPE ty_s_data
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_json_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_struct_to_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_abap_conv_json_writer=>create(
      pretty_print = abap_true
    ).
    lo_writer->write( is_data ).
    DATA(lv_json_string) = lo_writer->get_json( ).

    rx_json_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source_string   = lv_json_string
      target_codepage = iv_target_codepage
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_serialize_to_xstring FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_struct_to_xstr( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_codepage_struct_to_xstr=>ty_s_data(
      id = 1
      name = 'Test Name mit Umlauten: ÄÖÜ'
    ).
    DATA(lv_target_cp) = 'UTF-8'.

    DATA(lx_result) = lo_cut->serialize_to_xstring(
      is_data          = ls_test_data
      iv_target_codepage = lv_target_cp
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lx_result
      msg = 'Resulting XSTRING should not be initial'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    " Optional: Convert back to string and check content
    DATA(lv_converted_back) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source_xstring  = lx_result
      source_codepage = lv_target_cp
    ).
    DATA(lo_reader) = cl_abap_conv_json_reader=>create(
      json_string = lv_converted_back
    ).
    DATA(ls_read_data) TYPE zcl_codepage_struct_to_xstr=>ty_s_data.
    lo_reader->read( CHANGING data = ls_read_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_read_data-id exp = ls_test_data-id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_read_data-name exp = ls_test_data-name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist typisch für die Kommunikation mit externen Systemen, die Daten in einem bestimmten Encoding erwarten. Die Verkettung von `cl_abap_conv_json_writer` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` zeigt eine moderne, objektorientierte Herangehensweise.

CLASS zcl_codepage_file_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_codepage_file_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_and_convert.
    DATA: lv_xstring_content TYPE xstring.

    " For simplicity, we simulate file reading. In a real scenario, use OPEN DATASET or GUI_UPLOAD.
    " Example: OPEN DATASET iv_file_path FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE ENCODING DEFAULT INTO lv_xstring_content.
    " Here, we'll just create a dummy xstring.
    DATA(lv_dummy_source_string) = 'Dateiinhalt mit Sonderzeichen: €ß'.
    lv_xstring_content = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source_string   = lv_dummy_source_string
      target_codepage = iv_file_codepage
    ).

    rv_content_system_cp = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source_xstring  = lv_xstring_content
      source_codepage = iv_file_codepage
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, die Codepage eines gegebenen `XSTRING` zu erraten, indem Sie verschiedene Codepages testen und auf erfolgreiche Konvertierung prüfen. Geben Sie die erste erfolgreiche Codepage zurück.
hint: Iterieren Sie über eine Liste bekannter Codepages und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` in einem `TRY...CATCH` Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_detector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS detect_codepage
      IMPORTING
        ix_source_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_detected_codepage) TYPE abap_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD detect_codepage.
    DATA: lt_possible_codepages TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'UTF-8' TO lt_possible_codepages.
    APPEND '1100' TO lt_possible_codepages. " ISO-8859-1
    APPEND '4103' TO lt_possible_codepages. " UTF-16BE
    APPEND '4102' TO lt_possible_codepages. " UTF-16LE

    LOOP AT lt_possible_codepages INTO DATA(lv_codepage).
      TRY.
          " Attempt conversion. If successful, this is a possible codepage.
          cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
            source_xstring  = ix_source_xstring
            source_codepage = lv_codepage
          ).
          rv_detected_codepage = lv_codepage.
          RETURN.
        CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
          " Conversion failed for this codepage, try next one.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
    " If no codepage was detected, return initial or raise an exception.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_detect_utf8 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_detect_iso FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_detection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_detect_utf8.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_detector( ).
    DATA(lv_source_string) = 'Hello UTF-8 World!'.
    DATA(lx_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source_string   = lv_source_string
      target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    DATA(lv_detected_cp) = lo_cut->detect_codepage( lx_utf8_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_detected_cp exp = 'UTF-8' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_detect_iso.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_detector( ).
    DATA(lv_source_string) = 'Hello ISO World!'.
    DATA(lx_iso_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source_string   = lv_source_string
      target_codepage = '1100'
    ).
    DATA(lv_detected_cp) = lo_cut->detect_codepage( lx_iso_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_detected_cp exp = '1100' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_detection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_detector( ).
    " Create an XSTRING that is unlikely to be valid for common codepages
    DATA(lx_random_xstring) TYPE xstring VALUE '0000000000000000'.
    DATA(lv_detected_cp) = lo_cut->detect_codepage( lx_random_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_detected_cp msg = 'Expected no codepage detection' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode versucht, die Codepage eines `XSTRING` zu 'erraten', indem sie eine vordefinierte Liste von Codepages durchläuft und für jede versucht, den `XSTRING` in einen `STRING` zu konvertieren. Die erste erfolgreiche Konvertierung (ohne `cx_sy_codepage_conversion` Ausnahme) wird als die erkannte Codepage zurückgegeben. Dies ist eine praktische, wenn auch nicht immer 100% zuverlässige Methode zur Codepage-Erkennung.
keywords: CODEPAGE, DETECTION, XSTRING, TRY CATCH, ITERATION, CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, NESTING

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von Codepage A nach B und dann von B nach C in einem einzigen, verketteten Ausdruck oder durch geschickte Nutzung von Zwischenergebnissen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Rückgabewerte von `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` direkt als Eingabe für einen weiteren Aufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_chained_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_chained
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_cp_a          TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_cp_b          TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_cp_c          TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_chained_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_chained.
    DATA(lv_string_b) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source_codepage = iv_cp_a
      target_codepage = iv_cp_b
      source_string   = iv_source_string
    ).

    rv_final_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source_codepage = iv_cp_b
      target_codepage = iv_cp_c
      source_string   = lv_string_b
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chained_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_chained_conversion_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_chained_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Kette: ÄÖÜß'.
    DATA(lv_cp_a) = 'UTF-8'.
    DATA(lv_cp_b) = '1100'. " ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_cp_c) = 'UTF-8'.

    DATA(lv_final_string) = lo_cut->convert_chained(
      iv_source_string = lv_input
      iv_cp_a          = lv_cp_a
      iv_cp_b          = lv_cp_b
      iv_cp_c          = lv_cp_c
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_final_string
      exp = lv_input
      msg = 'Chained conversion should result in original string'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chained_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_chained_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_input_unrepresentable) = '你好'. " UTF-8 Chinese characters
    DATA(lv_cp_a) = 'UTF-8'.
    DATA(lv_cp_b) = '1100'. " ISO-8859-1 (will cause loss)
    DATA(lv_cp_c) = 'UTF-8'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = lo_cut
      meth = convert_chained
      msg = 'Expected cx_sy_codepage_conversion due to intermediate loss'
      EXPECTED_CLASS = 'CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION'
      parameters = VALUE #( (
        name = 'IV_SOURCE_STRING' value = REF #( lv_input_unrepresentable ) )
        ( name = 'IV_CP_A' value = REF #( lv_cp_a ) )
        ( name = 'IV_CP_B' value = REF #( lv_cp_b ) )
        ( name = 'IV_CP_C' value = REF #( lv_cp_c ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie mehrere Codepage-Konvertierungen nacheinander durchgeführt werden können. Der Rückgabewert der ersten Konvertierung wird direkt als Eingabe für die nächste verwendet. Dies demonstriert die Flexibilität der `cl_abap_codepage` Methoden und die Möglichkeit, komplexe Transformationen zu orchestrieren.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von der System-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage und umgekehrt, um die Roundtrip-Fähigkeit zu prüfen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage` und zwei aufeinanderfolgende `cl_abap_codepage=>convert` Aufrufe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_roundtrip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_roundtrip_conversion
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_intermediate_cp TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_roundtrip_safe) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_roundtrip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_roundtrip_conversion.
    DATA(lv_system_cp) = cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage( ).

    DATA(lv_to_intermediate) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source_codepage = lv_system_cp
      target_codepage = iv_intermediate_cp
      source_string   = iv_source_string
    ).

    DATA(lv_back_to_system) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert(
      source_codepage = iv_intermediate_cp
      target_codepage = lv_system_cp
      source_string   = lv_to_intermediate
    ).

    IF lv_back_to_system = iv_source_string.
      rv_is_roundtrip_safe = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_roundtrip_safe = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_roundtrip_safe FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_roundtrip_unsafe FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_roundtrip_safe.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'ABCabc123ÄÖÜß'.
    DATA(lv_intermediate_cp) = '1100'. " ISO-8859-1

    DATA(lv_is_safe) = lo_cut->check_roundtrip_conversion(
      iv_source_string   = lv_input
      iv_intermediate_cp = lv_intermediate_cp
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_is_safe
      msg = 'Expected roundtrip to be safe for representable characters'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_roundtrip_unsafe.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lv_input_unrepresentable) = '你好'. " UTF-8 Chinese characters
    DATA(lv_intermediate_cp) = '1100'. " ISO-8859-1

    DATA(lv_is_safe) = lo_cut->check_roundtrip_conversion(
      iv_source_string   = lv_input_unrepresentable
      iv_intermediate_cp = lv_intermediate_cp
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_is_safe
      msg = 'Expected roundtrip to be unsafe due to character loss'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel prüft die 'Roundtrip'-Fähigkeit einer Codepage-Konvertierung. Ein String wird von der System-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage und dann wieder zurück konvertiert. Wenn der ursprüngliche String und der nach der Konvertierung erhaltene String identisch sind, ist die Konvertierung 'Roundtrip-sicher'. Dies ist wichtig, um Datenverluste bei Hin- und Herkonvertierungen zu vermeiden.
keywords: CODEPAGE, ROUNDTRIP, CONVERSION, SYSTEM_CODEPAGE, CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in eine `XSTRING` und dann wieder zurück in einen `STRING`, um die binäre Darstellung zu manipulieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_str_xstr_manip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS string_to_xstring_and_back
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_codepage      TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_str_xstr_manip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD string_to_xstring_and_back.
    DATA(lx_intermediate_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source_string   = iv_source_string
      target_codepage = iv_codepage
    ).

    " Here, one could manipulate lx_intermediate_xstring if needed
    " For example, add a byte, remove a byte, or change specific bytes.
    " For this example, we just convert it back directly.

    rv_result_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source_xstring  = lx_intermediate_xstring
      source_codepage = iv_codepage
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_xstring_roundtrip FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_string_xstring_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_xstring_roundtrip.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_str_xstr_manip( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Manipulate me!'.
    DATA(lv_codepage) = 'UTF-8'.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->string_to_xstring_and_back(
      iv_source_string = lv_input
      iv_codepage      = lv_codepage
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_string_xstring_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_str_xstr_manip( ).
    DATA(lv_input_unrepresentable) = '你好'. " UTF-8 Chinese characters
    DATA(lv_codepage) = '1100'. " ISO-8859-1

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = lo_cut
      meth = string_to_xstring_and_back
      msg = 'Expected cx_sy_codepage_conversion during conversion to XSTRING'
      EXPECTED_CLASS = 'CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION'
      parameters = VALUE #( (
        name = 'IV_SOURCE_STRING' value = REF #( lv_input_unrepresentable ) )
        ( name = 'IV_CODEPAGE' value = REF #( lv_codepage ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den Roundtrip eines `STRING` über eine `XSTRING`-Darstellung. Ein `STRING` wird in ein `XSTRING` einer bestimmten Codepage konvertiert und dann wieder zurück. Dies ist nützlich, wenn binäre Manipulationen am `XSTRING` vorgenommen werden müssen, bevor es wieder als Text interpretiert wird. Die Verwendung von `convert_to` und `convert_from` ist hier zentral.
keywords: CODEPAGE, XSTRING, STRING, CONVERT_TO, CONVERT_FROM, CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die maximale Länge eines Strings in Bytes, wenn er in einer bestimmten Codepage kodiert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>get_max_byte_length`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_max_len DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_byte_length
      IMPORTING
        iv_string_length TYPE i
        iv_codepage      TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_bytes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_max_len IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_byte_length.
    rv_max_bytes = cl_abap_codepage=>get_max_byte_length(
      string_length = iv_string_length
      codepage      = iv_codepage
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_byte_length_utf8 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_byte_length_iso FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_byte_length_utf8.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_max_len( ).
    DATA(lv_max_bytes) = lo_cut->get_max_byte_length(
      iv_string_length = 10
      iv_codepage      = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    " UTF-8 can use up to 4 bytes per character, so 10 chars could be 40 bytes.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_bytes exp = 40 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_byte_length_iso.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_max_len( ).
    DATA(lv_max_bytes) = lo_cut->get_max_byte_length(
      iv_string_length = 10
      iv_codepage      = '1100'
    ).
    " ISO-8859-1 uses 1 byte per character.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_bytes exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>get_max_byte_length` berechnet die maximale Anzahl von Bytes, die ein String einer bestimmten Länge in einer spezifischen Codepage belegen kann. Dies ist wichtig für die Speicherplanung und die Pufferverwaltung, insbesondere bei der Arbeit mit `XSTRING` oder externen Schnittstellen.
keywords: CODEPAGE, BYTE_LENGTH, GET_MAX_BYTE_LENGTH, CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE
