Instructions: Berechne die Summe eines numerischen Feldes einer internen Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS-PRICE) mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` mit `INIT` und `NEXT` und dem `COMPUTE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '200.50'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '350.50' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. In Kombination mit `INIT` für den Startwert und `FOR ... IN ... NEXT` für die Iteration und Akkumulation, ermöglicht er eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Summenberechnung. Der `COMPUTE`-Operator ist hier implizit durch die arithmetische Operation `sum + <fs_sflight>-price` enthalten.
keywords: REDUCE, COMPUTE, Sum, Internal Table, SFLIGHTS, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die aus einer bestehenden Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) abgeleitet ist und ein neues Feld enthält, das aus einer Berechnung der Originalfelder resultiert.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COMPUTE` für die Berechnung des neuen Feldes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_transform_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             original_price TYPE sflight-price,
             discounted_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES: tt_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_for_transform_table IMPLEMENTATION.

                                        original_price = ls_flight-price

CLASS zcl_cond_compute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_region TYPE string

CLASS zcl_cond_compute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_bonus.
    rv_bonus = COND #( WHEN iv_region = 'EAST' AND iv_sales > 10000 THEN iv_sales * '0.05'
                       WHEN iv_region = 'WEST' AND iv_sales > 5000 THEN iv_sales * '0.03'
                       ELSE iv_sales * '0.01' ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt eines numerischen Feldes einer internen Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS-PRICE) mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` um Summe und Anzahl zu ermitteln, dann `COMPUTE` für den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( INIT sum   = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                 count = 0
                                 FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                 NEXT sum   = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
                                 NEXT count = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_average_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_average=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '300.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_average( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '200.00' ).

    CLEAR lt_sflights.
    lv_average = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator kann auch verwendet werden, um mehrere Werte (hier Summe und Anzahl) gleichzeitig zu akkumulieren. Dies ist ideal für die Berechnung von Durchschnitten. Die abschließende Division (`COMPUTE` implizit) erfolgt nach der Reduktion. Dies hält den Code kompakt und die Logik klar getrennt.
keywords: REDUCE, COMPUTE, Average, Internal Table, SFLIGHTS, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Extrahiere einen Wert aus einem JSON-String basierend auf einem dynamisch angegebenen Pfad.
hint: `cl_fdt_json` bietet Methoden für den Zugriff auf JSON-Elemente über Pfade.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_path DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_by_path
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_json_path   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_path IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_by_path.
    DATA(lo_json_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create( ).
    DATA(lo_json_node) = lo_json_reader->deserialize_to_node( iv_json_string ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_target_node) = lo_json_node->get_node_by_path( iv_json_path ).
        rv_value = lo_target_node->get_string( ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_value = 'Error: ' && lx_json_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_value_by_path FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_value_by_path_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_value_by_path.
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"data":{"user":{"name":"John Doe","age":30},"status":"active"}}'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_path( ).

    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->get_value_by_path( iv_json_string = lv_json iv_json_path = '/data/user/name' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'John Doe' ).

    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_value_by_path( iv_json_string = lv_json iv_json_path = '/data/status' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'active' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_value_by_path_error.
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"data":{"user":{"name":"John Doe"}}}'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_dynamic_path( ).

    DATA(lv_invalid_path) = lo_cut->get_value_by_path( iv_json_string = lv_json iv_json_path = '/data/user/email' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_invalid_path exp = 'Error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `deserialize_to_node` von `cl_fdt_json` erstellt eine Baumstruktur des JSON-Dokuments. Mit `get_node_by_path` kann dann dynamisch auf beliebige Elemente im JSON-Baum zugegriffen werden, indem ein Pfad im JSON-Pointer-Format angegeben wird. Dies ist extrem flexibel für die Verarbeitung unbekannter oder variabler JSON-Strukturen.
keywords: JSON, Deserialization, Dynamic, Path, cl_fdt_json, JSON Pointer

Instructions: Gruppiere eine interne Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) nach einem Feld und berechne für jede Gruppe die Summe eines anderen Feldes mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_and_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_and_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_group_total) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-price ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      total_price = lv_group_total ) TO rt_carrier_totals.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_and_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_group_and_sum=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-price = '150.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_and_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_totals ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_price exp = '350.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_totals[ carrid = 'UA' ]-total_price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Muster für Aggregationen in internen Tabellen. Es ermöglicht die Gruppierung von Daten und die gleichzeitige Berechnung von Summen, Durchschnitten oder anderen Aggregaten für jede Gruppe in einem sehr kompakten und lesbaren Codeblock. Der `COMPUTE`-Operator ist hier implizit in der Summenbildung innerhalb von `REDUCE` enthalten.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, COMPUTE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Deserialisiere einen JSON-String und fange mögliche Fehler bei der Deserialisierung ab.
hint: Verwende `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_fdt_json_error`.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        es_data        TYPE ty_data
        ev_error_msg   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_json_reader) = cl_fdt_json=>create( ).
    TRY.
        lo_json_reader->deserialize( EXPORTING json_string = iv_json_string IMPORTING data = es_data ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        ev_error_msg = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere eine interne Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) basierend auf einer Bedingung und berechne die Summe eines Feldes der gefilterten Ergebnisse mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombiniere `FILTER` für die Vorselektion und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_filtered_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_carrier  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_filtered_sum.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary
                                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_and_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_filtered_sum( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_and_sum_no_match.

Zuerst wird die Tabelle mit `FILTER` deklarativ auf die relevanten Einträge reduziert, dann wird mit `REDUCE` die Summe der gefilterten Daten berechnet. Dies ist sehr effizient und gut lesbar, da die Schritte der Datenverarbeitung klar voneinander getrennt sind. Der `COMPUTE`-Operator ist hier implizit in der Summenbildung innerhalb von `REDUCE` enthalten.

CLASS zcl_json_dynamic_rename DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe eines Feldes einer internen Tabelle, aber nur für die ersten N Einträge, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR ... WHERE ... UNTIL ...` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_until_condition DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_until_condition
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_until_condition IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_until_condition.
    rv_sum = REDUCE #( INIT total_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                        FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                        WHERE price <= iv_max_price
                        UNTIL total_price > 300 OR ls_flight-carrid = 'XX'
                        NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_until_condition FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_until_condition_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_until_condition_all_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_until_condition.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_until_condition=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '150.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '70.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'XX'. <fs_sflight>-price = '10.00'. " This should stop the loop

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_until_condition( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_until_condition( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_max_price = '200.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '350.00' ). " 100 + 150 + 200 = 450, but stops at 300 or XX
                                                                  " 100 + 150 = 250. Next is 200. Total 450. But UNTIL total_price > 300. So it should be 100+150+200 = 450. The condition is total_price > 300. So it should stop after 200. So 100+150 = 250. Then 250+200 = 450. This is > 300. So it should be 250. Let's re-evaluate.
                                                                  " 100 (total=100) -> 150 (total=250) -> 200 (total=450, condition met, stop before adding 200). So 250.
                                                                  " The UNTIL condition is checked *before* NEXT. So 100+150 = 250. Next is 200. Total would be 450. Is 250 > 300? No. Add 200. Total is 450. Is 450 > 300? Yes. Stop. So 450.
                                                                  " Let's re-read the documentation for UNTIL. 'The loop is terminated if the logical expression cond is true before the current loop pass.'
                                                                  " So, if total_price is 250, is 250 > 300? No. Process 200. total_price becomes 450. Is 450 > 300? Yes. Stop. So 450.
                                                                  " The 'XX' condition: if ls_flight-carrid = 'XX' is true, it also stops. So if 'XX' is encountered before total_price > 300, it stops.
                                                                  " 100 (total=100) -> 150 (total=250) -> 200 (total=450). At this point, total_price is 450. The next item is 70. Before processing 70, check UNTIL: is 450 > 300? Yes. Stop. So 450.
                                                                  " Let's adjust the test data to make it clearer.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '450.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_until_condition_empty.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_until_condition=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_until_condition( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_until_condition( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_max_price = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_until_condition_all_match.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_until_condition=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '50.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '50.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = '50.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_until_condition( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_until_condition( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_max_price = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Schleife in Kombination mit `REDUCE` kann durch `WHERE` und `UNTIL` sehr präzise gesteuert werden. `WHERE` filtert die Elemente, die in die Schleife gelangen, während `UNTIL` die Schleife vorzeitig beendet, sobald eine Bedingung erfüllt ist. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationslogiken in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck. Der `COMPUTE`-Operator ist hier implizit in der Summenbildung enthalten.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, COMPUTE, UNTIL, WHERE, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die in einem Range definiert ist, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle `sflights` (hier simuliert).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_range,
             sign   TYPE ddoption,
             option TYPE ddoption,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrid_range.
    TYPES tt_carrid_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carrid_range TYPE tt_carrid_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_range )
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Range-Tabelle für Flugnummern (CONNID) basierend auf einer Bedingung (z.B. nur Flugnummern > '0100') und wenden Sie diese auf eine interne Tabelle an. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` innerhalb des `VALUE`-Operators, um die Range-Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connid_range,
             sign   TYPE ddoption,
             option TYPE ddoption,
             low    TYPE s_conn_id,
             high   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_connid_range.
    TYPES tt_connid_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connid_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_dynamic_range) = VALUE tt_connid_range(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 1000 " Simulate a loop for dynamic values
      LET lv_connid = |{ i ALPHA = OUT }|
      WHERE iv_min_connid IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_connid > iv_min_connid
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = lv_connid )
    ).

    IF lt_dynamic_range IS INITIAL.
      " If no dynamic range created, return all flights or handle as needed
      rt_filtered_flights = it_all_flights.
    ELSE.
      rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE connid IN lt_dynamic_range ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei ein Feld nur dann übertragen wird, wenn sein Wert in einem bestimmten Range liegt, unter Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und einer `COND`-Expression für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             value1 TYPE string,
             value2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id     TYPE i,
             value1 TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_id_range,
             sign   TYPE ddoption,
             option TYPE ddoption,
             low    TYPE i,
             high   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_id_range.
    TYPES tt_id_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_id_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
        it_id_range TYPE tt_id_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING
      value1 = COND string(
        WHEN is_source-id IN it_id_range THEN is_source-value1
        ELSE 'N/A' )
      status = COND string(
        WHEN is_source-id IN it_id_range THEN 'Processed'
        ELSE 'Skipped' )
    ).
    rs_target-id = is_source-id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_data_in_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_data_out_of_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data_in_range.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_data_mapper( ).

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapper=>ty_source( id = 10 value1 = 'TestValue' value2 = 'Other' ).
    DATA(lt_id_range) = VALUE zcl_data_mapper=>tt_id_range(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 10 )
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_mapper->map_data( is_source = ls_source it_id_range = lt_id_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-value1 exp = 'TestValue' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'Processed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_data_out_of_range.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_data_mapper( ).

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapper=>ty_source( id = 20 value1 = 'TestValue' value2 = 'Other' ).
    DATA(lt_id_range) = VALUE zcl_data_mapper=>tt_id_range(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 10 )
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_mapper->map_data( is_source = ls_source it_id_range = lt_id_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-value1 exp = 'N/A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'Skipped' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und `COND`-Ausdrücken bietet eine sehr flexible und moderne Art der Datenübertragung zwischen Strukturen oder Tabellen. Es erlaubt bedingte Zuweisungen und Transformationen direkt im Mapping-Prozess, was den Code sauberer und wartbarer macht.

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie Fluggesellschaften in 'Major' und 'Minor' für die Beschriftung eines Diagramms unter Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Operators. Die Kategorisierung soll auf einer Liste von 'Major'-Fluggesellschaften basieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Zuweisung des Kategorienamens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_airline_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_category,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_airline_category.
    TYPES tt_airline_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.

    METHODS categorize_airlines
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categories) TYPE tt_airline_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airline_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_airline.
    DATA(lt_major_airlines) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'DL' ) ( 'UA' ) ).

    rv_category = SWITCH string(
      WHEN iv_carrid IN lt_major_airlines THEN 'Major Airline'
      ELSE 'Minor Airline'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD categorize_airlines.
    rt_categories = VALUE #( FOR carrid IN it_carrids
                             ( carrid = carrid
                               category = categorize_airline( carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode zur Datenvorbereitung für ein Diagramm, die einen optionalen Parameter für eine Filterbedingung (Fluggesellschaft) akzeptiert. Wenn der Parameter nicht übergeben wird, sollen alle Daten berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Parameter als `OPTIONAL` und prüfen Sie auf `IS SUPPLIED`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_chart_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_chart_data.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250104' )
    ).

    IF iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED.
      rt_data = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ELSE.
      rt_data = lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), die nur die Fluggesellschaften enthält, die mehr als 100 gebuchte Sitze haben. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` und `WHERE` innerhalb des `VALUE`-Operators, um die gewünschten Einträge zu filtern und in die Range-Tabelle zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_from_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_range,
             sign   TYPE ddoption,
             option TYPE ddoption,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrid_range.
    TYPES tt_carrid_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrid_range_by_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_range) TYPE tt_carrid_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_from_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_range_by_seats.
    rt_range = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid
                        LET total_seats = REDUCE s_seatsocc(
                                            INIT s = 0
                                            FOR <fs_group_flight> IN GROUP flight
                                            NEXT s = s + <fs_group_flight>-seatsocc )
                        WHERE total_seats > 100
                        ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_carrid_range_by_seats FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrid_range_by_seats.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_range_from_itab( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_range_from_itab=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 80 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' seatsocc = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' seatsocc = 30 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_range) = lo_builder->get_carrid_range_by_seats( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-low exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_carrid_range_no_match.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_range_from_itab( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_range_from_itab=>tt_sflight(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der Kombination von `FOR GROUPS`, `LET` und `REDUCE` innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Operators. Es ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten pro Gruppe und die anschließende Filterung dieser Gruppen, um dynamisch eine Range-Tabelle zu erstellen. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für funktionale Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, VALUE, REDUCE, LET, RANGE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Daten für ein Diagramm kapselt und Methoden zur Manipulation dieser Daten bereitstellt. Nutzen Sie `READ-ONLY` Attribute und `FINAL` Methoden, um die Datenintegrität zu gewährleisten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ-ONLY` für Attribute, die nach der Initialisierung nicht mehr geändert werden sollen, und `FINAL` für Methoden, die nicht überschrieben werden dürfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_model DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_point,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_point.
    TYPES tt_data_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_data_points TYPE tt_data_points READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_title TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_data_points TYPE tt_data_points
        iv_title       TYPE string.

    METHODS get_total_value FINAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_data_point_by_label FINAL
      IMPORTING
        iv_label TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data_point) TYPE ty_data_point
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_model IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mt_data_points = it_data_points.
    me->mv_title = iv_title.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_value.
    rv_total = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_point> IN mt_data_points
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_point>-value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data_point_by_label.
    rs_data_point = mt_data_points[ label = iv_label ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_model->mt_data_points ) exp = 2 ).

      ( label = 'A' value = 10 )
    ).

explanation: `READ-ONLY` Attribute und `FINAL` Methoden sind wichtige Konzepte der modernen ABAP-Objektorientierung, um die Kapselung und Datenintegrität zu verbessern. `READ-ONLY` stellt sicher, dass Attribute nach der Initialisierung nur noch gelesen werden können, während `FINAL` verhindert, dass Methoden in Unterklassen überschrieben werden, was die Konsistenz des Verhaltens gewährleistet.

CLASS zcl_fe_execute_program IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_notepad.
    DATA(lv_command) = 'notepad.exe'.

      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error         = 1
        error_no_gui       = 2
        bad_parameter      = 3
        file_not_found     = 4
        OTHERS             = 5.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fe_dir_check( ).

    " Test mit einem bekannten existierenden Verzeichnis (z.B. C:\ oder /tmp auf Linux)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fe_file_check( ).
    DATA(lv_temp_file) = 'C:\temp\dummy_test_file.txt'. " Pfad ggf. anpassen

    " Temporäre Datei für den Test erstellen
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename = lv_temp_file
        filetype = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab = VALUE string_table( ( 'Test content' ) )

    ).

          filename = lv_temp_file
        EXCEPTIONS

      ).
    ENDIF.

    ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

CLASS zcl_dialog_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.

                                  height = 200
                                  caption = iv_title ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier ein Dynpro den Dialog anzeigen
    " und auf das Schließen warten.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_close.

    " Hier könnte weitere Logik ausgeführt werden, z.B. Aufräumarbeiten.
    " MESSAGE 'Dialog wurde geschlossen!' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob es Flüge von 'FRANKFURT' nach 'NEW YORK' gibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
                iv_cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool(
                  WHEN LINE_EXISTS( FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom AND cityto = iv_cityto ) )
                  THEN abap_true
                  ELSE abap_false
                ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' iv_cityto = 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true msg = 'Flight from FRA to NYC should exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_cityfrom = 'NONEXISTENT' iv_cityto = 'CITY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false msg = 'Flight from NONEXISTENT to CITY should not exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `LINE_EXISTS` (oft in einem `COND`-Ausdruck) ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Prüfung, ob eine interne Tabelle nach einer Filterung noch Einträge enthält. Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, die jeweils eine interne Tabelle ihrer Flüge enthält. Filtern Sie diese Haupttabelle so, dass nur Fluggesellschaften übrig bleiben, die mindestens einen Flug von 'FRANKFURT' anbieten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer Sub-Expression, die `LINE_EXISTS` auf der geschachtelten Tabelle anwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_nested_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_flights,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights  TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_airline_flights.
    TYPES tt_airline_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_airlines_with_fra_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_airlines) TYPE tt_airline_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_nested_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airlines_with_fra_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 200 ROWS. " More rows for better demo

    " Group flights by airline into a nested table structure
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = VALUE tt_airline_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      (
        carrid = flight-carrid,
        flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
          FOR member IN GROUP flight
          (
            connid = member-connid,
            fldate = member-fldate,
            cityfrom = member-cityfrom,
            cityto = member-cityto
          )
        )
      )
    ).

    " Filter airlines that have at least one flight from FRANKFURT
    rt_airlines = FILTER #( lt_grouped_flights WHERE LINE_EXISTS( flights[ cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_nested.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_nested_table( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_airlines) = lo_cut->get_airlines_with_fra_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = FILTER #( lt_filtered_airlines WHERE NOT LINE_EXISTS( flights[ cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ] ) )
      msg = 'All remaining airlines should have flights from FRANKFURT'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagierkapazität (`seatsocc`) für diese Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_fra
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_fra.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_reduce.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_fra( ).

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE ls_flight-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_flight-seatsocc.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats
      exp = lv_expected_sum
      msg = 'Total seats should match the sum of filtered flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine elegante und effiziente Aggregation von Daten nach einer Filterung. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, die den Code kompakter, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht als manuelle Schleifen und Summierungen.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflight, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Zeigen Sie die `sflights`-Daten in einem ALV an und implementieren Sie eine einfache Ereignisbehandlung für einen Doppelklick auf eine Zeile, die die Flugnummer (`connid`) der ausgewählten Zeile in einer Nachricht anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_events_table` und registrieren Sie einen Handler für das `double_click`-Ereignis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_sflights_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_events.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_salv_events_table
      IMPORTING r_salv_model r_salv_column row column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_sflights_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_events.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_events) = lo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).
        SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR lo_events.

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_data_ref) = r_salv_model->get_data_ref( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <lt_sflights>.

    READ TABLE <lt_sflights> INDEX row INTO ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Flugnummer:' ls_sflight-connid DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen WHERE-Zusatz, der mit `CONDENSE` und `CONCATENATE` oder String-Templates erstellt wird.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING iv_field_name TYPE string
                iv_field_value TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_condition) = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_field_value }'|.

    TRY.
        rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE (lv_condition) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle error if dynamic condition is invalid or field not found
        MESSAGE 'Invalid filter condition or field name' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über eine interne Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) und lesen Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes mit FIELD-SYMBOLS. Geben Sie eine Liste der gelesenen Werte zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT <itab> ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT <field_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_string TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_field_values
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE tt_string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_line> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_wa>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |
{ <fs_component> }| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_values.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dynamic_read( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_field_values( it_data = lt_sflights iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrids ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrids[ 1 ] exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrids[ 2 ] exp = 'AA' ).

    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_field_values( it_data = lt_sflights iv_field_name = 'CONNID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connids[ 1 ] exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_field_name TYPE string

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_modify IMPLEMENTATION.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp (z.B. 'SFLIGHTS') und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten. Geben Sie eine Datenreferenz auf die gefüllte Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` zum Füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lr_descr_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_descr_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        lr_line_descr ?= lr_descr_type->get_table_line_type( ).

        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_descr_type.
        ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          CREATE DATA DATA(lr_wa) TYPE HANDLE lr_line_descr.
          ASSIGN lr_wa->* TO <fs_line>.

          IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
            " Fill with dummy data (example for SFLIGHT)
            IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHTS'.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
              IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
              IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = '0400'. ENDIF.
              APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.

              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
              IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_connid>.
              IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = '0017'. ENDIF.
              APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_table_line_type_error cx_sy_dyn_by_data_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dynamic_table_create( ).
    DATA(lr_sflights_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'SFLIGHTS' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_sflights_data->* TO <lt_sflights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_sflights_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_sflights> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflights> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE <lt_sflights> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_sflight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_sflight>-connid exp = '0400' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp, füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten und serialisieren Sie die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle anschließend in einen JSON-String.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_json_dynamic_serialize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_fill_and_serialize
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_json_dynamic_serialize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_fill_and_serialize.
    DATA: lr_descr_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_descr_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        lr_line_descr ?= lr_descr_type->get_table_line_type( ).

        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_descr_type.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          CREATE DATA DATA(lr_wa) TYPE HANDLE lr_line_descr.
          ASSIGN lr_wa->* TO <fs_line>.

          IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
            " Fill with dummy data (example for SFLIGHT)
            IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHTS'.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
              IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
              IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = '0400'. ENDIF.
              APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.

              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
              IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_connid2>).
              IF <fs_connid2> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid2> = '0017'. ENDIF.
              APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = <fs_table> pretty_print = abap_true ).

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_table_line_type_error cx_sy_dyn_by_data_error cx_sy_json_serializer_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_check_field_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_field_existence
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists_and_not_initial) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_check_field_exist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_field_existence.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_component> IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_exists_and_not_initial = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists_and_not_initial = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
