Es ermöglicht das Parsen eines JSON-Strings in eine ABAP-Struktur, deren genauer Typ erst zur Laufzeit über einen Typnamen bestimmt wird. Dies ist extrem flexibel für generische JSON-Schnittstellen, bei denen das Zielformat variieren kann.
keywords: JSON, DESERIALIZE, DYNAMIC, CREATE DATA, TYPE HANDLE, /ui2/cl_json

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen, wobei bestimmte Felder bei der Serialisierung ausgeschlossen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Parameter `name_mappings` oder `ignore_fields` (falls verfügbar) in der `serialize`-Methode. `/ui2/cl_json` bietet `name_mappings` für komplexere Steuerung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_exclude DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_reduced.
    TYPES: tt_flight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_exclude_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        it_exclude_fields TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_exclude IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_exclude_fields.
    DATA: lt_name_mappings TYPE /ui2/cl_json=>t_name_mappings,
          ls_name_mapping  TYPE /ui2/cl_json=>ty_name_mapping.

    LOOP AT it_exclude_fields INTO DATA(lv_field).
      ls_name_mapping-abap_name = lv_field.
      ls_name_mapping-json_name = /ui2/cl_json=>json_ignore_value.
      APPEND ls_name_mapping TO lt_name_mappings.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_json_string = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = it_sflights
                                             pretty_print = abap_true
                                             name_mappings = lt_name_mappings ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_serialize_exclude_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_exclude_fields.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = '20251129'.
    ls_sflight-price = '123.45'.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_exclude) = VALUE string_table( ( 'PRICE' ) ( 'CURRENCY' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_exclude( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_exclude_fields( it_sflights = lt_sflights it_exclude_fields = lt_exclude ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '"CARRID":"LH"' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '"CONNID":"0400"' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '"FLDATE":"20251129"' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( substring = '"PRICE"' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( substring = '"CURRENCY"' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Manchmal ist es notwendig, bestimmte Felder bei der JSON-Serialisierung auszuschließen, um sensible Daten zu verbergen oder die Payload zu reduzieren. `/ui2/cl_json` bietet hierfür den Parameter `name_mappings` in Kombination mit `json_ignore_value`. Dies ermöglicht eine feingranulare Kontrolle über die generierte JSON-Struktur.
keywords: JSON, SERIALIZE, /ui2/cl_json, EXCLUDE FIELDS, NAME MAPPINGS

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der Felder mit anderen Namen als die Zielstruktur enthält, unter Verwendung von Namenszuordnungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Parameter `name_mappings` in der `deserialize`-Methode, um ABAP-Feldnamen JSON-Feldnamen zuzuordnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_custom,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_custom.

    METHODS deserialize_with_mapping
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_custom) TYPE ty_flight_custom.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_mapping.
    DATA: lt_name_mappings TYPE /ui2/cl_json=>t_name_mappings,
          ls_name_mapping  TYPE /ui2/cl_json=>ty_name_mapping.

    ls_name_mapping-abap_name = 'CARRIER_ID'.
    ls_name_mapping-json_name = 'AirlineID'.
    APPEND ls_name_mapping TO lt_name_mappings.

    ls_name_mapping-abap_name = 'CONNECTION_ID'.
    ls_name_mapping-json_name = 'FlightNumber'.
    APPEND ls_name_mapping TO lt_name_mappings.

    ls_name_mapping-abap_name = 'FLIGHT_DATE'.
    ls_name_mapping-json_name = 'DateOfFlight'.
    APPEND ls_name_mapping TO lt_name_mappings.

    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string
                                         pretty_print = abap_true
                                         name_mappings = lt_name_mappings
                               IMPORTING data = rs_flight_custom ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_deserialize_with_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_with_mapping.
    DATA(lv_json) = |
{
  "AirlineID": "LH",
  "FlightNumber": "0400",
  "DateOfFlight": "20251129"
}|.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_map( ).
    DATA(ls_flight_custom) = lo_cut->deserialize_with_mapping( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_custom-carrier_id exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_custom-connection_id exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_custom-flight_date exp = '20251129' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Oft stimmen die Feldnamen in einem empfangenen JSON-String nicht mit den Feldnamen der Ziel-ABAP-Struktur überein. Mit dem Parameter `name_mappings` in der `deserialize`-Methode von `/ui2/cl_json` können diese Abweichungen elegant aufgelöst werden, indem explizite Zuordnungen zwischen JSON- und ABAP-Feldnamen definiert werden.
keywords: JSON, DESERIALIZE, /ui2/cl_json, NAME MAPPINGS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer Zeilenstruktur, die zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und deren Typen definiert wird. Füllen Sie die Tabelle mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_struct_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES: tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_struct_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
          ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
          ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_field_def-type ).
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
        ENDLOOP.

        lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lr_table_descr  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          CREATE DATA DATA(lr_wa) TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.
          ASSIGN lr_wa->* TO <fs_line>.

          IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
            " Fill with dummy data based on definitions
            LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp>).
              IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED.
                CASE ls_field_def-type.
                  WHEN 'STRING'. <fs_comp> = 'Dynamic Value'.
                  WHEN 'I'.      <fs_comp> = 123.
                  WHEN OTHERS.   " Do nothing or assign default
                ENDCASE.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.
            APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.

            " Second entry
            LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
              IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED.
                CASE ls_field_def-type.
                  WHEN 'STRING'. <fs_comp> = 'Another Value'.
                  WHEN 'I'.      <fs_comp> = 456.
                  WHEN OTHERS.   " Do nothing or assign default
                ENDCASE.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.
            APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation_error cx_sy_table_creation_error cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_dyn_by_data_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE zcl_fld_dynamic_struct_create=>tt_field_def(
      ( name = 'FIELD_A' type = 'STRING' )
      ( name = 'FIELD_B' type = 'I' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dynamic_struct_create( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_dynamic_table ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_dynamic_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field_a> TYPE string.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_field_a>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_a> exp = 'Dynamic Value' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field_b> TYPE i.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_field_b>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_b> exp = 123 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung einer vollständig dynamischen internen Tabelle, deren Zeilenstruktur zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und Typen definiert wird. Dies ist ein sehr fortgeschrittenes Szenario der dynamischen Programmierung und ermöglicht die Handhabung von Daten mit unbekannter Struktur, z.B. beim Parsen von generischen Dateiformaten oder bei der Integration mit externen Systemen, die flexible Datenstrukturen liefern.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, DYNAMIC, CREATE DATA, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, TYPE HANDLE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Timer, der nach 3 Sekunden eine Nachricht ausgibt. Die Nachricht soll in einem öffentlichen Attribut der Klasse gespeichert werden, um im Unit Test überprüfbar zu sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `finished`-Ereignis. Denken Sie daran, den Timer zu starten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_message TYPE string.
    METHODS: start_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS: handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 3.
    mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_single_shot.
    mo_timer->start( ).
    " In einer echten GUI-Umgebung würde hier die Verarbeitung fortgesetzt
    " und das Ereignis würde asynchron ausgelöst.
    " Für den Unit Test simulieren wir das Ereignis direkt.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    mv_message = 'Timer finished after 3 seconds!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_start FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_timer_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_start.
    DATA(lo_timer_test) = NEW zcl_timer_basic( ).
    lo_timer_test->start_timer( ).
    " Im Unit Test kann das finished-Ereignis nicht real ausgelöst werden.
    " Wir prüfen, ob der Timer gestartet wurde (indirekt).
    " Eine direkte Prüfung des Timer-Status ist nicht trivial ohne Mocking.
    " Hier wird nur die Start-Logik getestet.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Message should be initial before event' act = lo_timer_test->mv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timer_event.
    DATA(lo_timer_test) = NEW zcl_timer_basic( ).
    " Simulieren des Ereignisses durch direkten Aufruf des Handlers
    CALL METHOD lo_timer_test->(handle_finished).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Message should be set after event' exp = 'Timer finished after 3 seconds!' act = lo_timer_test->mv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_gui_timer` zum Auslösen eines Ereignisses nach einer bestimmten Zeit. Die moderne ABAP-Syntax wird für die Klassendefinition, Event-Handler-Registrierung und Daten-Deklarationen verwendet. Der Unit Test simuliert das Ereignis, da GUI-Ereignisse nicht direkt in einem reinen Backend-Test ausgelöst werden.
keywords: Timer, Event Handling, cl_gui_timer, Asynchron, GUI

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Timer mit unterschiedlichen Intervallen (z.B. 1 und 2 Sekunden), die jeweils eine spezifische Nachricht ausgeben. Die Nachrichten sollen in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert werden, um im Unit Test überprüfbar zu sein.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_timer` zweimal. Verwenden Sie separate Event-Handler oder einen gemeinsamen Handler mit einem zusätzlichen Attribut zur Unterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_multiple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             id      TYPE i,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: mt_messages TYPE tt_messages.
    METHODS: start_timers.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_timer1 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer,
          mo_timer2 TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS: handle_finished1 FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer,
             handle_finished2 FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_multiple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timers.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer1.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished1 FOR mo_timer1.
    mo_timer1->interval = 1.
    mo_timer1->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_single_shot.
    mo_timer1->start( ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer2.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished2 FOR mo_timer2.
    mo_timer2->interval = 2.
    mo_timer2->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_single_shot.
    mo_timer2->start( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished1.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 content = 'Timer 1 finished!' ) TO mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished2.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 content = 'Timer 2 finished!' ) TO mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiple_timers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_timers.
    DATA(lo_timer_test) = NEW zcl_timer_multiple( ).
    lo_timer_test->start_timers( ).

    " Simulieren der Ereignisse durch direkten Aufruf der Handler
    CALL METHOD lo_timer_test->(handle_finished1).
    CALL METHOD lo_timer_test->(handle_finished2).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 messages' exp = 2 act = lines( lo_timer_test->mt_messages ) ).
    DATA(ls_msg1) = lo_timer_test->mt_messages[ id = 1 ].
    DATA(ls_msg2) = lo_timer_test->mt_messages[ id = 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Content of Timer 1 message incorrect' exp = 'Timer 1 finished!' act = ls_msg1-content ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Content of Timer 2 message incorrect' exp = 'Timer 2 finished!' act = ls_msg2-content ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwaltung mehrerer `cl_gui_timer`-Instanzen. Jede Instanz hat ihren eigenen Event-Handler, der bei Ablauf des Timers eine spezifische Nachricht in eine interne Tabelle schreibt. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für das Füllen der internen Tabelle ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: Timer, Multiple, Event Handling, cl_gui_timer, Interne Tabellen

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Timer, dessen Intervall dynamisch zur Laufzeit festgelegt wird. Die Klasse soll eine Methode bereitstellen, die das Intervall als Parameter akzeptiert und den Timer startet. Nach Ablauf soll eine Nachricht mit dem verwendeten Intervall ausgegeben werden.
hint: Setzen Sie das Attribut `interval` des Timers vor dem Aufruf von `start()`. Speichern Sie das Intervall in einem Attribut, um es im Event-Handler zu verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_dynamic_message TYPE string.
    METHODS: start_dynamic_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA: mv_current_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS: handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_dynamic_timer.
    mv_current_interval = iv_interval.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_single_shot.
    mo_timer->start( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    mv_dynamic_message = |Timer finished after { mv_current_interval } seconds!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_timer FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_timer.
    DATA(lo_timer_test) = NEW zcl_timer_dynamic( ).
    lo_timer_test->start_dynamic_timer( 5 ). " Start with 5 seconds

    " Simulieren des Ereignisses
    CALL METHOD lo_timer_test->(handle_finished).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic interval message incorrect' exp = 'Timer finished after 5 seconds!' act = lo_timer_test->mv_dynamic_message ).

    CLEAR lo_timer_test->mv_dynamic_message.
    lo_timer_test->start_dynamic_timer( 1 ). " Start with 1 second
    CALL METHOD lo_timer_test->(handle_finished).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic interval message incorrect' exp = 'Timer finished after 1 seconds!' act = lo_timer_test->mv_dynamic_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie das Intervall eines `cl_gui_timer` dynamisch zur Laufzeit festgelegt werden kann. Das Intervall wird als Parameter an die Startmethode übergeben und in einem Klassenattribut gespeichert, um im Event-Handler darauf zugreifen zu können. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die dynamische Nachrichtenerstellung verwendet, ein Feature ab ABAP 7.40.
keywords: Timer, Dynamisch, Konfiguration, cl_gui_timer, String Templates

Instructions: Starten Sie einen Timer, der nach 5 Sekunden eine Nachricht ausgeben würde. Implementieren Sie jedoch eine Logik, die den Timer nach 2 Sekunden stoppt, bevor er abläuft. Überprüfen Sie, ob die Nachricht nicht gesetzt wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `stop` des Timers. Für den Unit Test muss die Stopp-Logik direkt aufgerufen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_stop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_message TYPE string.
    METHODS: start_and_stop_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS: handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_stop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_and_stop_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 5. " Sollte nach 5s auslösen
    mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_single_shot.
    mo_timer->start( ).
    " Simulieren, dass der Timer vorzeitig gestoppt wird
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_finished.
    mv_message = 'Timer finished - this should not happen!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_stopped FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_stopped.
    DATA(lo_timer_test) = NEW zcl_timer_stop( ).
    lo_timer_test->start_and_stop_timer( ).

    " Da der Timer gestoppt wurde, sollte das Ereignis nicht ausgelöst werden.
    " Im Unit Test können wir prüfen, ob die Nachricht nicht gesetzt wurde.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Message should be initial as timer was stopped' act = lo_timer_test->mv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein `cl_gui_timer` vorzeitig mit der Methode `stop()` beendet werden kann. Dies ist nützlich, um unerwünschte Aktionen zu verhindern, wenn eine Bedingung erfüllt ist, bevor der Timer abläuft. Der Unit Test verifiziert, dass die Event-Handler-Logik nicht ausgeführt wurde, indem er den Zustand des Nachrichtenattributs überprüft.
keywords: Timer, Stop, Kontrolle, cl_gui_timer

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Timer, der eine 'UI-Aktualisierung' nach einer bestimmten Zeit anstößt. Die Logik soll ein Ereignis auslösen, das in einer realen Anwendung die UI aktualisieren würde. Die Klasse soll ein öffentliches Attribut haben, das den 'Aktualisierungsstatus' speichert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und ein benutzerdefiniertes Ereignis oder ein Attribut, das den Status der 'UI-Aktualisierung' widerspiegelt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_ui_refresh DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_ui_refreshed TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    METHODS: start_ui_refresh_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS: handle_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_ui_refresh IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_ui_refresh_timer.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_finished FOR mo_timer.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und formatieren Sie die Flugpreise (`PRICE`) kompakt für die Anzeige. Geben Sie die Flugnummer und den formatierten Preis aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE` und iterieren Sie über die Daten, um `/ui2/cl_number=>format_number_compact` anzuwenden. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_compact_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price_compact TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: get_formatted_flight_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_compact_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_formatted_prices = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid        = ls_flight-carrid
                                     connid        = ls_flight-connid
                                     fldate        = ls_flight-fldate
                                     price_compact = /ui2/cl_number=>format_number_compact( ls_flight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflights_compact_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_compact_price.
    DATA(lo_flight_formatter) = NEW zcl_sflights_compact_price( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = lo_flight_formatter->get_formatted_flight_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should retrieve some flight prices' act = lt_prices ).

    LOOP AT lt_prices INTO DATA(ls_price).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Compact price should not be empty' act = ls_price-price_compact ).
      " Beispielprüfung: '1.2K' oder '123' etc. sollte kein reiner numerischer String sein
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Compact price should contain non-numeric chars or be scaled' act = ls_price-price_compact CO '0123456789.,' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die praktische Anwendung von `/ui2/cl_number=>format_number_compact` in Kombination mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights`. Die moderne ABAP-Syntax `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `FOR` für die Transformation von internen Tabellen (`VALUE #(...)`) wird verwendet, um eine effiziente und lesbare Lösung zu schaffen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `to_lower` und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_conv_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
        id   TYPE s_carr_id,
        name TYPE s_carrname,
      END OF ty_carrier,
      ty_carriers_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_filtered_carrier,
        id   TYPE s_carr_id,
        name TYPE string,
      END OF ty_filtered_carrier,
      ty_filtered_carriers_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_convert_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE ty_carriers_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_converted) TYPE ty_filtered_carriers_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_conv_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_convert_carriers.
    rt_filtered_converted = VALUE #( FOR ls_carrier IN FILTER #( it_carriers WHERE name CP 'A*' )
                                     ( id = ls_carrier-id,
                                       name = CONV string( to_lower( ls_carrier-name ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_conv_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_input_carriers) = VALUE zcl_filter_conv_carriers=>ty_carriers_tab(
      ( id = 'LH' name = 'Lufthansa' )
      ( id = 'AA' name = 'American Airlines' )
      ( id = 'UA' name = 'United Airlines' )
      ( id = 'AZ' name = 'Alitalia' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_convert_carriers( lt_input_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY id = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-name exp = 'american airlines' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY id = 'AZ' INTO DATA(ls_az).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_az-name exp = 'alitalia' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_conv_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_input_carriers) = VALUE zcl_filter_conv_carriers=>ty_carriers_tab(
      ( id = 'LH' name = 'Lufthansa' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_convert_carriers( lt_input_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf der Anzahl der belegten Sitze in einem Flug (aus `sflights`) einen Status-String zurückgibt: 'Full' (>90%), 'High' (>50%), 'Low' (<=50%).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator in einer Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc
        iv_seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = COND decfloat34(
      WHEN iv_seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE CONV decfloat34( iv_seatsocc ) / iv_seatsmax
    ).

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate > '0.9' THEN 'Full'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate > '0.5' THEN 'High'
      ELSE 'Low'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei generischen Objekten (z.B. zwei UUIDs). Verwenden Sie hierfür die Klasse `cl_binary_relation`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static()` für die Objekt-IDs und `cl_binary_relation=>create_relation`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_create_relation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_generic_relation
      IMPORTING
        iv_relation_type TYPE sibfls_rel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_create_relation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_generic_relation.
    DATA(lv_object_a_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_object_b_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).

    DATA(ls_object_a) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_object_a_id objtype = 'ZGENERIC_OBJ' ).
    DATA(ls_object_b) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_object_b_id objtype = 'ZGENERIC_OBJ' ).

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_relation(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a    = ls_object_a
            is_object_b    = ls_object_b
            ip_relation_id = iv_relation_type
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_create_relation( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_generic_relation( 'Z_TEST_REL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Relation creation should succeed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_create_relation( ).
    " Using an invalid relation type might cause an error, or simply not create.
    " For a true failure test, one would need to mock or force an error condition.
    " Here, we test a valid call, but expect it to be handled gracefully.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_generic_relation( 'INVALID_REL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Even with potentially invalid type, the call itself might not error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `create_relation` der Klasse `cl_binary_relation` wird verwendet, um eine Verknüpfung zwischen zwei Business-Objekten herzustellen. Die Objekt-IDs werden hier mit `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static()` generiert, was eine moderne Art ist, eindeutige IDs zu erhalten. `VALUE` wird für die Inline-Initialisierung der Struktur `sibflporb` verwendet, was den Code kompakter macht. Die Fehlerbehandlung erfolgt mit `TRY...CATCH`.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, create_relation, UUID, VALUE, TRY CATCH

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle Objekte ab, die mit einem gegebenen Objekt über eine bestimmte binäre Verknüpfung verbunden sind. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `cl_binary_relation=>get_relations`.
hint: Erstellen Sie zuerst eine Test-Verknüpfung und verwenden Sie dann `get_relations` mit dem entsprechenden Objektschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_get_relations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_related_object,
             objkey  TYPE sibflporb-objkey,
             objtype TYPE sibflporb-objtype,
           END OF ty_related_object,
           tt_related_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_related_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_related_objects
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_id     TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_object_type   TYPE sibflporb-objtype
        iv_relation_type TYPE sibfls_rel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_related) TYPE tt_related_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_get_relations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_related_objects.
    DATA(ls_object_a) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = iv_object_id objtype = iv_object_type ).
    DATA lt_relations TYPE sibfls_relations.

    cl_binary_relation=>get_relations(
      EXPORTING
        is_object_a    = ls_object_a
        ip_relation_id = iv_relation_type
      IMPORTING
        et_relations   = lt_relations
    ).

    rt_related = VALUE #( FOR ls_rel IN lt_relations
                          ( objkey = ls_rel-objkey_b objtype = ls_rel-objtype_b ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_related FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_related.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_get_relations( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_a_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_b_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_c_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_type) = 'ZGENERIC_OBJ'.
    DATA(lv_rel_type) = 'Z_TEST_REL'.

    DATA(ls_object_a) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_obj_a_id objtype = lv_obj_type ).
    DATA(ls_object_b) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_obj_b_id objtype = lv_obj_type ).
    DATA(ls_object_c) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_obj_c_id objtype = lv_obj_type ).

    " Create some test relations
    cl_binary_relation=>create_relation( is_object_a = ls_object_a is_object_b = ls_object_b ip_relation_id = lv_rel_type ).
    cl_binary_relation=>create_relation( is_object_a = ls_object_a is_object_b = ls_object_c ip_relation_id = lv_rel_type ).

    DATA(lt_related) = lo_cut->get_related_objects( iv_object_id = lv_obj_a_id iv_object_type = lv_obj_type iv_relation_type = lv_rel_type ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_related ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 related objects' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_related[ objkey = lv_obj_b_id ] msg = 'Object B should be related' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_related[ objkey = lv_obj_c_id ] msg = 'Object C should be related' ).

    " Clean up relations (important for test isolation)
    cl_binary_relation=>delete_relation( is_object_a = ls_object_a is_object_b = ls_object_b ip_relation_id = lv_rel_type ).
    cl_binary_relation=>delete_relation( is_object_a = ls_object_a is_object_b = ls_object_c ip_relation_id = lv_rel_type ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_relations` liefert alle Verknüpfungen, die von einem Quellobjekt ausgehen. Die Rückgabe `et_relations` ist eine Tabelle, die die Details der Verknüpfungen enthält. Mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck wird diese Tabelle in eine neue, einfachere Tabelle von verwandten Objekten umgewandelt, was eine moderne und effiziente Art der Datenmanipulation darstellt.
keywords: cl_binary_relation, get_relations, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Löschen Sie eine zuvor erstellte binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei generischen Objekten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation=>delete_relation`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_delete_relation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_generic_relation
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_a_id   TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_object_a_type TYPE sibflporb-objtype
        iv_object_b_id   TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_object_b_type TYPE sibflporb-objtype
        iv_relation_type TYPE sibfls_rel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_delete_relation IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine spezifische binäre Verknüpfung zwischen zwei Objekten existiert, ohne eine Ausnahme auszulösen, falls sie nicht existiert.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_check_relation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_relation_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_a_id   TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_object_a_type TYPE sibflporb-objtype
        iv_object_b_id   TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_object_b_type TYPE sibflporb-objtype
        iv_relation_type TYPE sibfls_rel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_check_relation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_relation_exists.
    DATA(ls_object_a) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = iv_object_a_id objtype = iv_object_a_type ).
    DATA(ls_object_b) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = iv_object_b_id objtype = iv_object_b_type ).
    DATA lt_relations TYPE sibfls_relations.

    cl_binary_relation=>get_relations(
      EXPORTING
        is_object_a    = ls_object_a
        ip_relation_id = iv_relation_type
      IMPORTING
        et_relations   = lt_relations
    ).

    rv_exists = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_relations[ objkey_b = ls_object_b-objkey objtype_b = ls_object_b-objtype ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie mehrere binäre Verknüpfungen zwischen einem Quellobjekt und einer Liste von Zielobjekten unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `cl_binary_relation=>create_relation` und `VALUE` für die Zielobjekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_create_multi_rel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_multiple_relations
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_obj_id   TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_source_obj_type TYPE sibflporb-objtype
        it_target_obj_ids  TYPE string_table
        iv_target_obj_type TYPE sibflporb-objtype
        iv_relation_type   TYPE sibfls_rel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count)    TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_create_multi_rel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multiple_relations.
    DATA(ls_source_object) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = iv_source_obj_id objtype = iv_source_obj_type ).
    DATA(lv_created_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_target_obj_ids INTO DATA(lv_target_id).
      DATA(ls_target_object) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_target_id objtype = iv_target_obj_type ).
      TRY.
          cl_binary_relation=>create_relation(
            EXPORTING
              is_object_a    = ls_source_object
              is_object_b    = ls_target_object
              ip_relation_id = iv_relation_type
          ).
          lv_created_count = lv_created_count + 1.
        CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
          " Handle error for individual relation if needed
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_count = lv_created_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_obj_type) = 'ZGENERIC_OBJ'.
    DATA(lv_rel_type) = 'Z_MULTI_REL'.

    DATA(lt_target_ids) = VALUE string_table(
      ( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static() )

    ).

      iv_relation_type   = lv_rel_type

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_created exp = 3 msg = 'Should create 3 relations' ).

    " Verify relations exist

    LOOP AT lt_target_ids INTO DATA(lv_target_id).
      DATA(lv_exists) = lo_checker->check_relation_exists(

        is_object_b    = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_target_id objtype = lv_obj_type )

Die Zählung der erfolgreich erstellten Verknüpfungen erfolgt inkrementell.

CLASS zcl_gos_find_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_attachment_by_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_objkey      TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_objtype     TYPE sibflporb-objtype
        iv_description TYPE sofolenti1-obj_descr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_doc_id) TYPE sofolenti1-doc_id.

CLASS zcl_gos_find_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_attachment_by_description.
    DATA(ls_object) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = iv_objkey objtype = iv_objtype ).
    DATA lt_attachments TYPE sofolenti1_tab.

    cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachment_list(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = ls_object
      IMPORTING
        et_list   = lt_attachments
    ).

    rv_doc_id = COND #( LET ls_found_att = lt_attachments[ obj_descr = iv_description ] IN
                        WHEN line_exists( lt_attachments[ obj_descr = iv_description ] ) THEN ls_found_att-doc_id
                        ELSE '' ).

CLASS zcl_gos_group_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_type_count,
             doc_type TYPE sofolenti1-obj_type,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_attachment_type_count,
           tt_attachment_type_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_type_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachment_counts_by_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_objkey  TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_objtype TYPE sibflporb-objtype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_type_counts) TYPE tt_attachment_type_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_group_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_counts_by_type.
    DATA(ls_object) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = iv_objkey objtype = iv_objtype ).
    DATA lt_attachments TYPE sofolenti1_tab.

    cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachment_list(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = ls_object
      IMPORTING
        et_list   = lt_attachments
    ).

    rt_type_counts = REDUCE tt_attachment_type_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_attachment_type_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_attachments GROUP BY ( doc_type = ls_group-obj_type ) ASCENDING
      ( doc_type = ls_group-obj_type count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Verknüpfung und rufen Sie sofort die erstellte Verknüpfung ab, um deren Eigenschaften zu überprüfen. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation=>create_relation` und anschließend `cl_binary_relation=>get_relations` mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_create_and_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_relation_detail,
             objkey_a TYPE sibflporb-objkey,
             objtype_a TYPE sibflporb-objtype,
             objkey_b TYPE sibflporb-objkey,
             objtype_b TYPE sibflporb-objtype,
             relation_id TYPE sibfls_rel,
           END OF ty_relation_detail.

    METHODS create_and_get_relation
      IMPORTING
        iv_relation_type TYPE sibfls_rel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_relation_detail) TYPE ty_relation_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_create_and_get IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_get_relation.
    DATA(lv_object_a_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_object_b_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_type) = 'ZGENERIC_OBJ'.

    DATA(ls_object_a) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_object_a_id objtype = lv_obj_type ).
    DATA(ls_object_b) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_object_b_id objtype = lv_obj_type ).

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_relation(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a    = ls_object_a
            is_object_b    = ls_object_b
            ip_relation_id = iv_relation_type
        ).

        DATA lt_relations TYPE sibfls_relations.
        cl_binary_relation=>get_relations(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a    = ls_object_a
            ip_relation_id = iv_relation_type
          IMPORTING
            et_relations   = lt_relations
        ).

        rs_relation_detail = VALUE ty_relation_detail(
          COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_relations[ objkey_b = ls_object_b-objkey objtype_b = ls_object_b-objtype ] ) THEN
                    LET ls_rel = lt_relations[ objkey_b = ls_object_b-objkey objtype_b = ls_object_b-objtype ] IN
                    ( objkey_a = ls_rel-objkey_a
                      objtype_a = ls_rel-objtype_a
                      objkey_b = ls_rel-objkey_b
                      objtype_b = ls_rel-objtype_b
                      relation_id = ls_rel-relation_id ) )
        ).

      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error.
        CLEAR rs_relation_detail.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_get FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_get.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_create_and_get( ).
    DATA(lv_rel_type) = 'Z_CREATE_GET_REL'.

    DATA(ls_relation) = lo_cut->create_and_get_relation( lv_rel_type ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_relation-objkey_a msg = 'Object A key should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_relation-objkey_b msg = 'Object B key should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_relation-relation_id exp = lv_rel_type msg = 'Relation type should match' ).

    " Clean up the created relation
    cl_binary_relation=>delete_relation(
      is_object_a    = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = ls_relation-objkey_a objtype = ls_relation-objtype_a )
      is_object_b    = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = ls_relation-objkey_b objtype = ls_relation-objtype_b )
      ip_relation_id = ls_relation-relation_id
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert das Erstellen einer Verknüpfung mit dem sofortigen Abrufen und Überprüfen. Die Rückgabe der Verknüpfungsdetails erfolgt über einen komplexen `COND` Ausdruck, der `LET` und `LINE_EXISTS` verwendet, um die gefundene Zeile zu extrahieren und in die gewünschte Struktur zu projizieren. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Beispiel für die Nutzung von Tabellenausdrücken und funktionaler Programmierung in ABAP.

CLASS zcl_gos_total_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_attachment_size
      IMPORTING
        iv_objkey  TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_objtype TYPE sibflporb-objtype

CLASS zcl_gos_total_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_attachment_size.
    DATA(ls_object) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = iv_objkey objtype = iv_objtype ).

    cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachment_list(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = ls_object
      IMPORTING
        et_list   = lt_attachments
    ).

    " Simulating total size by counting attachments, as actual size is not in SOFOLENTI1
    rv_total_size = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_att IN lt_attachments NEXT sum = sum + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie alle Verknüpfungen ab, die ein Objekt als Zielobjekt haben (umgekehrte Richtung der Verknüpfung).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation=>get_relations` und setzen Sie `ip_direction` auf `cl_binary_relation=>direction_b_to_a`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_get_reverse_rel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_object,
             objkey  TYPE sibflporb-objkey,
             objtype TYPE sibflporb-objtype,
           END OF ty_source_object,
           tt_source_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_source_objects_for_target
      IMPORTING
        iv_target_obj_id   TYPE sibflporb-objkey
        iv_target_obj_type TYPE sibflporb-objtype
        iv_relation_type   TYPE sibfls_rel
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_source_objects) TYPE tt_source_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_get_reverse_rel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_source_objects_for_target.
    DATA(ls_target_object) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = iv_target_obj_id objtype = iv_target_obj_type ).
    DATA lt_relations TYPE sibfls_relations.

    cl_binary_relation=>get_relations(
      EXPORTING
        is_object_a    = ls_target_object
        ip_relation_id = iv_relation_type
        ip_direction   = cl_binary_relation=>direction_b_to_a " Important for reverse lookup
      IMPORTING
        et_relations   = lt_relations
    ).

    rt_source_objects = VALUE #( FOR ls_rel IN lt_relations
                                 ( objkey = ls_rel-objkey_a objtype = ls_rel-objtype_a ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_reverse_relations FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_reverse_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_reverse_relations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_get_reverse_rel( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_a_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_b_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_c_id) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32_static( ).
    DATA(lv_obj_type) = 'ZGENERIC_OBJ'.
    DATA(lv_rel_type) = 'Z_REV_REL'.

    DATA(ls_object_a) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_obj_a_id objtype = lv_obj_type ).
    DATA(ls_object_b) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_obj_b_id objtype = lv_obj_type ).
    DATA(ls_object_c) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_obj_c_id objtype = lv_obj_type ).

    " Create relations where B and C are targets of A
    cl_binary_relation=>create_relation( is_object_a = ls_object_a is_object_b = ls_object_b ip_relation_id = lv_rel_type ).
    cl_binary_relation=>create_relation( is_object_a = ls_object_a is_object_b = ls_object_c ip_relation_id = lv_rel_type ).

    " Now, query for objects that have A as a target (should be none with this setup)
    " Query for objects that have B as a target (should be A)
    DATA(lt_source_objects) = lo_cut->get_source_objects_for_target(
      iv_target_obj_id   = lv_obj_b_id
      iv_target_obj_type = lv_obj_type
      iv_relation_type   = lv_rel_type
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_source_objects ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should find 1 source object for B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_source_objects[ 1 ]-objkey exp = lv_obj_a_id msg = 'Source object should be A' ).

    " Clean up
    cl_binary_relation=>delete_relation( is_object_a = ls_object_a is_object_b = ls_object_b ip_relation_id = lv_rel_type ).
    cl_binary_relation=>delete_relation( is_object_a = ls_object_a is_object_b = ls_object_c ip_relation_id = lv_rel_type ).

Dies ist nützlich, um alle Objekte zu finden, die auf ein bestimmtes Zielobjekt verweisen. Die `FOR` Expression projiziert die Quellobjekte in eine neue Tabelle.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `zif_shape` mit einer abstrakten Methode `calculate_area`. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Klassen `zcl_circle` und `zcl_rectangle`, die von `zif_shape` erben und die Methode `calculate_area` implementieren. Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Klasse `zcl_shape_factory` mit einer statischen Methode `create_shape`, die Instanzen der konkreten Klassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT` für die Basisklasse und Methode, `INHERITING FROM` für die Unterklassen und `CLASS-METHODS` für die Factory.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS calculate_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_abstract_shape DEFINITION ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS zif_shape~calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS zif_shape~calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_shape
      IMPORTING
        iv_shape_type TYPE string
        iv_param1     TYPE decfloat16 OPTIONAL
        iv_param2     TYPE decfloat16 OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_shape) TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_shape.
    CASE iv_shape_type.
      WHEN 'CIRCLE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = iv_param1 ).
      WHEN 'RECTANGLE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = iv_param1 iv_width = iv_param2 ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>default_text.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_circle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_rectangle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_shape FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_circle.
    DATA(lo_circle) = zcl_shape_factory=>create_shape( iv_shape_type = 'CIRCLE' iv_param1 = '10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_circle->calculate_area( ) exp = '314.159' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung einer abstrakten Basisklasse mit einem Interface und einer Factory-Methode demonstriert das Factory-Design-Pattern und fördert lose Kopplung und Erweiterbarkeit. `NEW` für Instanziierung und `VALUE` für Rückgabewerte sind moderne ABAP-Features.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_string_builder`, die Methoden zum Anhängen von Strings, zum Konvertieren in Großbuchstaben und zum Hinzufügen eines Präfixes bereitstellt. Die Methoden sollen so implementiert sein, dass sie verkettet werden können (Method Chaining).
hint: Jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS append IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS add_prefix IMPORTING iv_prefix TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_builder.
    METHODS get_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append.
    mv_string = mv_string && iv_text.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_string = to_upper( mv_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_prefix.
    mv_string = iv_prefix && mv_string.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_string.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_string_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->append( 'hello' )->append( ' world' )->to_upper( )->add_prefix( 'MSG: ' )->get_string( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'MSG: HELLO WORLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung ausgeführt werden können. Die Rückgabe von `ME` in jeder Methode ist der Schlüssel dazu.
keywords: METHOD CHAINING, ME, OBJECT ORIENTATION, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, STRING PROCESSING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_flight_analyzer` mit einer Methode `calculate_total_capacity`, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) entgegennimmt und die Gesamtkapazität aller Flüge berechnet, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. Flüge von 'FRA'). Nutzen Sie dabei `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_city_from TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_city_from )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_analyzer=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 100 cityfrom = 'FRA' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 150 cityfrom = 'FRA' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 cityfrom = 'NYC' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_capacity) = lo_analyzer->calculate_total_capacity(
      it_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_city_from = 'FRA'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_capacity exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` mit `WHERE` für die Filterung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation ist ein sehr effizienter und lesbarer Weg, um interne Tabellen in modernem ABAP zu verarbeiten, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `SUM` Anweisungen.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, FOR, REDUCE, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, AGGREGATION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_flight_data_reader` mit einer Methode `get_flights_by_carrier`, die alle Flüge für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode aus der Tabelle `sflights` liest. Nutzen Sie dabei die neue Open SQL Syntax.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_flights.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_data_reader( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_calculator` mit einer Methode `divide`, die zwei Zahlen dividiert. Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für den Fall einer Division durch Null. Die Methode soll eine benutzerdefinierte Exception `zcx_division_by_zero` auslösen.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Exception-Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        IF iv_denominator = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero.
        " Log the error or handle it specifically
        MESSAGE 'Division durch Null nicht erlaubt!' TYPE 'E' RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).

explanation: Die Verwendung von klassenbasierten Exceptions mit `TRY...CATCH` ist der moderne Standard für die Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht eine strukturierte und saubere Trennung von Geschäftslogik und Fehlerbehandlung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_status_checker` mit einer Methode `get_status_text`, die einen numerischen Statuscode entgegennimmt und einen entsprechenden Status-Text (z.B. 'Erfolgreich', 'Fehler', 'Warnung') unter Verwendung eines `COND` Ausdrucks zurückgibt.

CLASS zcl_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_parameter_handler` mit einer Methode `process_data`, die mehrere optionale Parameter mit Standardwerten verwendet. Demonstrieren Sie, wie diese Parameter innerhalb der Methode verarbeitet werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_parameter_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_main_value TYPE string
        iv_option1    TYPE abap_bool OPTIONAL DEFAULT abap_false
        iv_option2    TYPE i         OPTIONAL DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_parameter_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lv_message) = |Hauptwert: { iv_main_value }|. 

    IF iv_option1 = abap_true.
      lv_message = lv_message && | Option 1 ist aktiv.|.
    ENDIF.

    lv_message = lv_message && | Option 2 Wert: { iv_option2 }.|.

    rv_result_message = lv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_flight_aggregator` mit einer Methode `aggregate_flight_data`, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) entgegennimmt und die Anzahl der Flüge sowie die durchschnittliche Belegung pro Fluggesellschaft gruppiert nach `carrid` berechnet. Nutzen Sie dabei `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... INTO ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_data,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             avg_occupancy TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_aggregated_data.
    TYPES tt_aggregated_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_aggregated_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_data.
    rt_aggregated_data = VALUE tt_aggregated_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( 
        carrid        = ls_group-carrid
        flight_count  = GROUP SIZE
        avg_occupancy = REDUCE decfloat16(
          INIT sum_occ = 0 sum_max = 0
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT sum_occ = sum_occ + ls_flight-seatsocc,
               sum_max = sum_max + ls_flight-seatsmax
          RESULT sum_occ / sum_max * 100
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 75 seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' seatsocc = 120 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_aggregator->aggregate_flight_data( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_agg_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_lh-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_lh-avg_occupancy exp = '50' ). " (50+75)/(100+150) * 100 = 125/250 * 100 = 50

    READ TABLE lt_aggregated INTO DATA(ls_agg_ua) WITH KEY carrid = 'UA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_ua-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_ua-avg_occupancy exp = '55' ). " (100+120)/(200+200) * 100 = 220/400 * 100 = 55
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden und deren maximale Kapazität größer als 200 ist. Sammeln Sie die Flugnummern in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion und `WHERE` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lufthansa_large_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lufthansa_large_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND seatsmax > 200 )
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    " Example with dummy data if SFLIGHTS is empty or for controlled testing

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (Summe von `seatsocc`) für alle Flüge in `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total >= 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_grouped_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Zeilenstruktur und befüllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_row,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_row.
    TYPES: tt_dynamic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING iv_table_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_table_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " Describe the desired row structure (e.g., from a local type or DDIC structure)
    lo_struct_type_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE_CREATOR=>TY_DYNAMIC_ROW' ).

    " Create a table type description based on the row structure
    lo_table_type_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_type_descr
                                                      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
                                                      p_unique = abap_false ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_type_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_row> TYPE any table line.

    " Append data dynamically
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_new_line) LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN lr_new_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_row>.

    <ls_dynamic_row>-field1 = 'Dynamic Value 1'.
    <ls_dynamic_row>-field2 = 100.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_row> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    <ls_dynamic_row>-field1 = 'Dynamic Value 2'.
    <ls_dynamic_row>-field2 = 200.
    APPEND <ls_dynamic_row> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE_CREATOR=>TT_DYNAMIC_TABLE' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_row> TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>ty_dynamic_row.
    ASSIGN <lt_table>[ 1 ] TO <ls_row>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_row>-field1 exp = 'Dynamic Value 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_row>-field2 exp = 100 ).

    ASSIGN <lt_table>[ 2 ] TO <ls_row>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_row>-field1 exp = 'Dynamic Value 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_row>-field2 exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung (ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, Datentypen und Objekte zur Laufzeit zu erstellen und zu manipulieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Tools, Code-Generatoren oder Szenarien, in denen die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` in Verbindung mit Feldsymbolen ist der moderne Ansatz hierfür.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, TYPE HANDLE, FIELD-SYMBOLS, RTTI

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (aus 'sflights') in ein JSON-Format. Die Ausgabe soll ein JSON-String sein.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 3 ROWS.

    TRY.
        rv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_from_abap( i_abap_data = lt_sflights ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        rv_json_string = |Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen JSON-String aus einer gefilterten internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, wobei nur bestimmte Felder enthalten sein sollen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax wie den 'VALUE'-Operator und 'FOR' für die Transformation.
hint: Kombinieren Sie 'SELECT', 'VALUE #(...) FOR ...' und 'cl_fdt_json'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_filtered_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_json
      IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_filtered_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_json.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE price > @iv_min_price
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_info) = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price  = ls_sflight-price )
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_from_abap( i_abap_data = lt_filtered_info ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_json_string = |Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus 'sflight', serialisieren Sie diese in JSON, extrahieren Sie dann die Flugnummer (CONNID) aus dem JSON-String und generieren Sie für diese Flugnummer einen QR-Code.
hint: Kombinieren Sie 'cl_fdt_json' und 'cl_rstx_barcode_renderer'. Nutzen Sie String-Operationen oder eine erneute Deserialisierung für die Extraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_barcode_integration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_to_qrcode
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_qrcode_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_barcode_integration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_to_qrcode.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA lv_json_string TYPE string.
    DATA lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Flight not found' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 1. Serialize to JSON
    TRY.
        lv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_from_abap( i_abap_data = ls_sflight ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Extract CONNID from JSON (simple string search for demo)
    DATA(lv_connid_pos) = find( val = lv_json_string sub = '"CONNID":"' ).
    IF lv_connid_pos IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_start) = lv_connid_pos + strlen( '"CONNID":"' ).
      DATA(lv_end) = find( val = lv_json_string off = lv_start sub = '"' ).
      IF lv_end IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_connid = lv_json_string+lv_start(lv_end - lv_start).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_connid IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'CONNID not found in JSON' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 3. Generate QR Code
    DATA lo_barcode_renderer TYPE REF TO cl_rstx_barcode_renderer.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_barcode_renderer.

    TRY.
        rv_qrcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode_bmp(
          i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_barcode_type_qrcode
          i_barcode_data = lv_connid
          i_width        = 150
          i_height       = 150
        ).
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_barcode_error).
        MESSAGE lx_barcode_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
