Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in JSON, wobei Datumsfelder im ISO 8601-Format ('YYYY-MM-DD') ausgegeben werden sollen. Nutzen Sie eine Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'CALL TRANSFORMATION ID' mit einer angepassten XSLT-Transformation, um das Datumsformat zu steuern. 'cl_fdt_json' bietet hier keine direkte Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_iso_date_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_sflights_iso_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_iso_date_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights_iso_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lv_xml_string TYPE string.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 1 ROWS.

    " XSLT-Transformation zur Datumsformatierung und JSON-Generierung
    DATA(lv_xslt_transform) = `
      <xsl:transform version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:sap="http://www.sap.com/sapxsl">
        <xsl:output method="text" encoding="utf-8"/>
        <xsl:template match="/">
          <xsl:text>[</xsl:text>
          <xsl:for-each select="SFLIGHT_TAB/item">
            <xsl:if test="position() > 1"><xsl:text>,</xsl:text></xsl:if>
            <xsl:text>{"CARRID":"</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="CARRID"/>
            <xsl:text>","CONNID":"</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="CONNID"/>
            <xsl:text>","FLDATE":"</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="substring(FLDATE,1,4)"/>-<xsl:value-of select="substring(FLDATE,5,2)"/>-<xsl:value-of select="substring(FLDATE,7,2)"/>
            <xsl:text>","PRICE":</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="PRICE"/>
            <xsl:text>,"CURRENCY":"</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="CURRENCY"/>
            <xsl:text>"}</xsl:text>
          </xsl:for-each>
          <xsl:text>]</xsl:text>
        </xsl:template>
      </xsl:transform>`.

    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION (lv_xslt_transform)
          SOURCE sflight_tab = lt_sflights
          RESULT XML lv_xml_string.
        rv_json_string = lv_xml_string.
      CATCH cx_xslt_exception INTO DATA(lx_xslt_exception).
        rv_json_string = |Error: { lx_xslt_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_sflights_iso_date( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'JSON string should contain ISO date format' act = contains( val = lv_json sub = 'FLDATE":"19' ) AND contains( val = lv_json sub = '-' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen JSON-String, der verschachtelte Daten enthält (z.B. Flugdaten mit einer Liste von Passagieren), in entsprechende ABAP-Strukturen. Erstellen Sie hierfür einen passenden ABAP-Typ.

CLASS zcl_json_nested_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger,
             name TYPE string,
             seat TYPE string,
           END OF ty_passenger.
    TYPES: tt_passengers TYPE TABLE OF ty_passenger WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             passengers TYPE tt_passengers,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in JSON, wobei leere Felder (initiale Werte) im JSON-Output unterdrückt werden sollen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_json_suppress_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS serialize_sflights_suppress

CLASS zcl_json_suppress_initial IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AZ'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0001'.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.

    TRY.

          i_abap_data            = lt_sflights
          i_suppress_initial_values = abap_true
        ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_json_string = |Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Code 39 Barcode und speichern Sie die Binärdaten in einer internen Tabelle vom Typ 'solix_t' (für spätere Verwendung, z.B. in E-Mails oder als Anhang).
hint: Konvertieren Sie den XSTRING-Output von 'create_barcode_bmp' in eine Tabelle vom Typ 'solix_t' mit 'cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix'.

CLASS zcl_barcode_to_solix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_code39_to_solix
      IMPORTING iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_solix_table) TYPE solix_t.

CLASS zcl_barcode_to_solix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_code39_to_solix.
    DATA lo_barcode_renderer TYPE REF TO cl_rstx_barcode_renderer.
    DATA lv_barcode_xstring TYPE xstring.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_barcode_renderer.

        lv_barcode_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->create_barcode_bmp(

          EXPORTING
            iv_xstring = lv_barcode_xstring

      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_barcode_error).
        MESSAGE lx_barcode_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_replacement,
             placeholder TYPE string,
             value       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_replacement.
    TYPES tt_replacements TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_replacement WITH UNIQUE KEY placeholder.

    METHODS replace_placeholders
      IMPORTING
        iv_text        TYPE string
        it_replacements TYPE tt_replacements
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_placeholders.
    rv_result = iv_text.
    LOOP AT it_replacements INTO DATA(ls_replacement).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ls_replacement-placeholder IN rv_result WITH ls_replacement-value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen expliziten Datenbank-Cursor für die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, lesen Sie die ersten 5 Einträge und schließen Sie den Cursor anschließend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen expliziten Cursor. Simulieren Sie einen Fehler während des `FETCH`-Vorgangs und stellen Sie sicher, dass der Cursor in jedem Fall (auch bei Fehlern) ordnungsgemäß geschlossen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY` um die Cursor-Ressource sicher freizugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_error.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
            FROM sflights
            ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

        DO 10 TIMES. " Try to fetch 10 records
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.

          IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true AND sy-tabix = 3. " Simulate error after 3 fetches
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error
              EXPORTING
                textid = cx_sy_open_sql_error=>cx_sy_open_sql_error.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen expliziten Cursor für eine dynamisch angegebene Tabelle und Spaltenliste. Lesen Sie einige Einträge und schließen Sie den Cursor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit dynamischen Angaben (`(table_name)`, `(column_list)`) und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name  TYPE tabname
        iv_column1     TYPE fieldname
        iv_column2     TYPE fieldname
        iv_max_rows    TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_dynamic_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_dynamic_data TYPE ty_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lv_column_list TYPE string.

    lv_column_list = |{ iv_column1 }, { iv_column2 }|.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT (lv_column_list)
            FROM (iv_table_name)
            ORDER BY (iv_column1).

        DO iv_max_rows TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_dynamic_data.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_dynamic_data TO rt_data.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_dyn_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_dyn_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine große Menge von Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` in Blöcken (Chunks) von 100 Einträgen, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Cursor nach der Verarbeitung geschlossen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_package_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_chunk,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_chunk.
    TYPES tt_sflight_chunk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_chunk WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_package_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_sflight_package TYPE tt_sflight_chunk.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_sflight_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Simulate processing of the chunk
      rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + lines( lt_sflight_package ).
      CLEAR lt_sflight_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwalten Sie zwei gleichzeitig geöffnete explizite Cursor für unterschiedliche Abfragen auf der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Lesen Sie Daten von beiden Cursorn und schließen Sie sie anschließend ordnungsgemäß.
hint: Deklarieren Sie zwei separate `CURSOR` Variablen und verwenden Sie `OPEN`, `FETCH` und `CLOSE` für jede davon.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_multiple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_short,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_short.
    TYPES tt_sflight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_long,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_long.
    TYPES tt_sflight_long TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_long WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_data_from_multiple_cursors
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO struct_results.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_results,
             flights_short TYPE tt_sflight_short,
             flights_long  TYPE tt_sflight_long,
           END OF struct_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_multiple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_from_multiple_cursors.
    DATA: lv_cursor1 TYPE cursor,
          lv_cursor2 TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight_short TYPE ty_sflight_short,
          ls_sflight_long  TYPE ty_sflight_long.

    CREATE DATA rs_results.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor1 FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid
            FROM sflights
            WHERE carrid = 'AA'
            ORDER BY carrid, connid.

        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor2 FOR
          SELECT carrid, fldate, price
            FROM sflights
            WHERE carrid = 'LH'
            ORDER BY carrid, fldate.

        " Fetch from cursor 1
        DO 3 TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor1 INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight_short.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight_short TO rs_results->flights_short.
        ENDDO.

        " Fetch from cursor 2
        DO 3 TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor2 INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight_long.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight_long TO rs_results->flights_long.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sql_error. " Re-raise or handle as appropriate
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor1 IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor1.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_cursor2 IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor2.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_results->flights_short ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results->flights_short[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results->flights_long[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwaltung mehrerer expliziter Cursor gleichzeitig. Dies kann in Szenarien notwendig sein, in denen Daten aus verschiedenen, voneinander unabhängigen Abfragen parallel oder interleaved verarbeitet werden müssen. Die korrekte Verwendung von `CLOSE CURSOR` für jeden geöffneten Cursor, idealerweise in einem `FINALLY`-Block, ist entscheidend, um Ressourcenlecks zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings und ersetzen Sie diese durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REPLACE` mit `REGEX` für die Bereinigung von Leerzeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_clean_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_text      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_clean_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string_spaces.
    rv_result = iv_text.
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    rv_result = condense( rv_result ).
    " Replace multiple spaces with single space using regex
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_result WITH ' '.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Datenbankoperation durch, die potenziell fehlschlagen kann (z.B. ein `INSERT` mit doppelten Schlüsseln). Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und stellen Sie sicher, dass ein zuvor geöffneter Cursor im Fehlerfall geschlossen wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY` für die Fehlerbehandlung und `CLOSE CURSOR` im `FINALLY`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_error_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_table,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_table.
    TYPES tt_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_table WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS create_test_table.
    METHODS drop_test_table.

    METHODS insert_and_close_cursor
      IMPORTING
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_error_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_test_table.
    " Create a dummy table for testing
    EXEC SQL.
      CREATE TABLE ZTEST_CURSOR_ERR (
        ID   INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        TEXT VARCHAR(255)
      )
    ENDEXEC.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD drop_test_table.
    " Drop the dummy table
    EXEC SQL.
      DROP TABLE ZTEST_CURSOR_ERR
    ENDEXEC.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD insert_and_close_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_test_table.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Open a dummy cursor (not directly related to insert, but for demonstration)
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT id, text FROM ztest_cursor_err ORDER BY id.

        " Attempt to insert data
        INSERT INTO ztest_cursor_err VALUES ( @( VALUE ty_test_table( id = iv_id text = iv_text ) ) ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einem URL-String alle Query-Parameter, die ein bestimmtes Präfix haben (z.B. 'old_'), durch neue Parameter mit einem anderen Präfix (z.B. 'new_').
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE` mit `REGEX` und Capture Groups.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_url_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_url_query_params
      IMPORTING
        iv_url        TYPE string
        iv_old_prefix TYPE string
        iv_new_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_url_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_url_query_params.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = |(&|\?){iv_old_prefix}([^=]+)=([^&]*)|.
    DATA(lv_replacement) = |$1{iv_new_prefix}$2=$3|.

    rv_result = iv_url.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN rv_result WITH lv_replacement.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen expliziten Cursor öffnet, Daten in einer Schleife verarbeitet und den Cursor schließt. Die Methode soll auch eine Option bieten, die Verarbeitung vorzeitig abzubrechen, wobei der Cursor dennoch geschlossen werden muss.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH`, `CLOSE CURSOR` und eine `IF` Bedingung mit `EXIT` innerhalb der Schleife, um den Abbruch zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_abort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_with_abort
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_records TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_abort_after TYPE i DEFAULT 0 " 0 means no abort
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_abort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_with_abort.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_simple.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid.

    DO iv_max_records TIMES.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_processed_flights.

      IF iv_abort_after > 0 AND lines( rt_processed_flights ) >= iv_abort_after.
        EXIT. " Abort processing early
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein expliziter Cursor geöffnet, Daten in einer Schleife verarbeitet und der Cursor anschließend geschlossen wird. Die Möglichkeit, die Verarbeitung vorzeitig abzubrechen (`EXIT`), ist wichtig für flexible Anwendungen. Unabhängig vom Abbruchpfad stellt `CLOSE CURSOR` sicher, dass die Datenbankressource ordnungsgemäß freigegeben wird, was für die Systemstabilität entscheidend ist.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_sflights.

CLASS zcl_ida_dyn_sel_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_sflights.
    DATA: lt_where_clause TYPE rsds_t_where_clause,
          ls_where_clause LIKE LINE OF lt_where_clause.

    " Example: Select flights with CARRID = 'AA' AND PRICE > 100
    ls_where_clause-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_where_clause-sign      = 'I'.
    ls_where_clause-option    = 'EQ'.
    ls_where_clause-low       = 'AA'.
    APPEND ls_where_clause TO lt_where_clause.

    CLEAR ls_where_clause.
    ls_where_clause-fieldname = 'PRICE'.
    ls_where_clause-sign      = 'I'.
    ls_where_clause-option    = 'GT'.
    ls_where_clause-low       = '100'.
    APPEND ls_where_clause TO lt_where_clause.

    DATA(lo_ida_alv) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create_for_selection_screen( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    lo_ida_alv->set_selection_conditions( lt_where_clause ).
    lo_ida_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) in ein CSV-Format als UTF-8 XSTRING.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle, formatieren Sie jede Zeile mit String-Templates und konvertieren Sie den resultierenden String mit `cl_abap_conv_out_ce`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_sflights_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_sflights_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_csv.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_separator) = ';'.

    lv_csv_string = |CARRID{lv_separator}CONNID{lv_separator}FLDATE{lv_separator}PRICE{lv_separator}CURRENCY{cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf}|.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string &&
                      |{ ls_sflight-carrid }{lv_separator}| &&
                      |{ ls_sflight-connid }{lv_separator}| &&
                      |{ ls_sflight-fldate }{lv_separator}| &&
                      |{ ls_sflight-price }{lv_separator}| &&
                      |{ ls_sflight-currency }{cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf}|.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_csv_string ).
    rv_csv_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_sflights_to_csv( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_conv_sflights_to_csv=>tt_sflight_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_actual_csv_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_sflights_to_csv( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(lv_expected_csv_string) =
      'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
      'LH;0400;20250101;100.00;EUR' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
      'AA;0017;20250102;250.50;USD' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    DATA(lo_conv_exp) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    lo_conv_exp->write( EXPORTING data = lv_expected_csv_string ).
    DATA(lv_expected_csv_xstring) = lo_conv_exp->get_buffer( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_csv_xstring
      exp = lv_expected_csv_xstring
      msg = 'SFLIGHTS to CSV UTF-8 conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Konvertierung einer internen Tabelle in ein CSV-Format und anschließend in eine UTF-8 XSTRING-Repräsentation. Moderne ABAP-Features wie String-Templates (`|...|`) und `VALUE #(...)` für die Tabellenbefüllung werden genutzt. Die `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` Klasse ist hierbei unerlässlich, um die korrekte Zeichenkodierung für die Ausgabe sicherzustellen, was besonders bei Dateiexporten wichtig ist.

        DATA(lx_intermediate_png) TYPE xstring.

          EXPORTING

        lo_converter->convert_image(
          EXPORTING
            i_image_xstring   = lx_intermediate_png
            i_mimetype_source = 'image/png'
            i_mimetype_target = 'image/gif'

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_decimal_to_big_endian

        iv_input_decimal TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2

        VALUE(rv_be_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( endian = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_big ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_dec_to_be( ).
    DATA(lv_test_decimal) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '123.45'.
    " Internal representation of 123.45 (P length 8 decimals 2) is 0000000000012345C
    " As XSTRING, this would be '0000000000012345C' (hex for 12345 with sign C)
    " The actual XSTRING depends on how 'P' is mapped to binary by the converter.
    " For a P(8) DECIMALS 2, it's 8 bytes. 123.45 -> 12345C. 
    " The converter will treat this as raw bytes. So, the hex representation of the packed decimal.
    " 123.45 -> 00 00 00 00 00 01 23 45 C (packed decimal, 8 bytes)
    " The 'C' is the sign nibble. So, 000000000001234C (last nibble is sign)
    " Let's assume the converter handles packed decimal as raw bytes.
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) = '000000000001234C'. " This is the raw packed decimal representation
    DATA(lv_actual_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_decimal_to_big_endian( lv_test_decimal ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_xstring
      exp = lv_expected_xstring
      msg = 'Decimal to Big-Endian conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Zeichenkette, die alle Flugverbindungen (CARRID-CONNID) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus einer übergebenen internen Tabelle durch Komma getrennt auflistet.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_connections_string
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflights
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connections) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_connections_string.
    rv_connections = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
        ELSE |{ result }, { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_connid_of_max_price_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflights
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connid_of_max_price_flight.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_flight_info,
             max_price TYPE s_price,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_max_flight_info.

    DATA(ls_max_info) = REDUCE ty_max_flight_info(
      INIT max_price = 0
           connid    = ''
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT max_price = COND s_price(
        WHEN flight-price > max_price THEN flight-price
        ELSE max_price
      ),
      connid = COND s_conn_id(
        WHEN flight-price > max_price THEN flight-connid
        ELSE connid
      )
    ).
    rv_connid = ls_max_info-connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_distinct_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_distinct_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_distinct_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_distinct_carriers.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_distinct_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_distinct_carrier,
           ty_distinct_carriers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_distinct_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    DATA(lt_distinct_carriers) = REDUCE ty_distinct_carriers(
      INIT distinct_carriers = VALUE ty_distinct_carriers( )
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT distinct_carriers = VALUE ty_distinct_carriers(
        distinct_carriers
        ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      )
    ).
    rv_count = lines( lt_distinct_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtflugpreis für jede Fluggesellschaft in einer übergebenen internen Tabelle von Flugdaten und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und Gesamtpreis.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total,
           ty_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE ty_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_totals = REDUCE ty_carrier_totals(
      INIT totals = VALUE ty_carrier_totals( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights BY carrid
      GROUP BY carrid
      NEXT totals = VALUE ty_carrier_totals(
        totals
        ( carrid      = flight-carrid
          total_price = REDUCE s_price(
            INIT sum_price = 0
            FOR member IN GROUP flight
            NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Innerhalb der `NEXT totals` wird ein weiterer `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um die Preise der einzelnen Mitglieder der Gruppe zu summieren. CLASS zcl_salv_field_catalog IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO DATA.

      EXPORTING

      IMPORTING

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in ein XML-Format unter Verwendung von `cl_salv_ex_util`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_table_to_xml DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,

CLASS zcl_salv_table_to_xml IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flights_to_xml.
    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO DATA.
    GET REFERENCE OF it_sflights INTO lr_data.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_ex_util=>if_salv_ex_util_xml~table_to_xml(
          EXPORTING
            r_data = lr_data
          IMPORTING

        ).
      CATCH cx_salv_ex_util.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder leeren String zurückgeben
        rv_xml_string = 'Error during XML conversion'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_for_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_value_for_table IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine verschachtelte Struktur, die pro Fluggesellschaft eine Liste ihrer Flüge enthält, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_nested_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_detail,
           ty_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights TYPE ty_flight_details,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights,
           ty_carrier_flights_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nested_flights) TYPE ty_carrier_flights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_nested_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_nested_flights = REDUCE ty_carrier_flights_tab(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_carrier_flights_tab( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights BY carrid
      GROUP BY carrid
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_carrier_flights_tab(
        result
        ( carrid  = flight-carrid
          flights = VALUE ty_flight_details(
            FOR member IN GROUP flight
            ( connid = member-connid fldate = member-fldate price = member-price )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine kommagetrennte Liste aller Flugnummern (CONNID) für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus einer übergebenen internen Tabelle, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `FILTER`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine effiziente Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_price_connids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflights
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_connids.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price ).

    rv_connid_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid
        ELSE |{ result }, { flight-connid }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer übergebenen internen Tabelle. Wenn der Gesamtpreis 1000 übersteigt, geben Sie stattdessen 1000 zurück. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `COND` für die bedingte Rückgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_cond_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_capped_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflights
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_capped_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_cond_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_capped_total_price.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).

    rv_capped_price = COND s_price(
      WHEN lv_total_price > 1000 THEN 1000
      ELSE lv_total_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_ex_util` und `REDUCE`, um eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten zu gruppieren (Gesamtpreis pro Fluggesellschaft) und dann einen Feldkatalog für die aggregierten Daten zu erstellen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS` für die Aggregation und `cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog` für den Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_group_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           ty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total,
           ty_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_fcat
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_group_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_fcat.
    DATA(lt_grouped_totals) = REDUCE ty_carrier_totals(
      INIT totals = VALUE ty_carrier_totals( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights BY carrid
      GROUP BY carrid
      NEXT totals = VALUE ty_carrier_totals(
        totals
        ( carrid      = flight-carrid
          total_price = REDUCE s_price(
            INIT sum_price = 0
            FOR member IN GROUP flight
            NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price
          )
        )
      )
    ).

    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO DATA.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_grouped_totals INTO lr_data.

    cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog(
      EXPORTING
        r_data         = lr_data
      IMPORTING
        et_field_catalog = rt_field_catalog
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von eindeutigen Zufallszahlen innerhalb eines Bereichs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einer `HASHED TABLE`, um die Eindeutigkeit zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_randoms
      IMPORTING
        iv_min    TYPE i
        iv_max    TYPE i
        iv_count  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_randoms.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = iv_min
      max = iv_max
    ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    WHILE lines( lt_temp_numbers ) < iv_count AND lines( lt_temp_numbers ) < ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ).
      INSERT lo_random->get_next( ) INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_unique_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN lt_temp_numbers ( number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_numbers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Konstruieren Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung basierend auf einer Liste von Kriterien unter Verwendung von String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um die `WHERE`-Klausel zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_criteria,
             field TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_criteria.
    TYPES: tt_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_criteria WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        it_criteria TYPE tt_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sql_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_by_criteria.
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR criterion IN it_criteria
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL
        THEN |{ criterion-field } = '{ criterion-value }'|
        ELSE |{ s } AND { criterion-field } = '{ criterion-value }'|
      )
    ).

    IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE rt_sflights WHERE (lv_where_clause).
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE rt_sflights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie 3 zufällige Einträge aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Gesamtzahl der Einträge, generieren Sie zufällige Indizes und verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit `INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflights.
    DATA: lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_all_sflights.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_all_sflights ).
    IF lv_total_flights = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      min = 1
      max = lv_total_flights
    ).

    DATA(lt_selected_indices) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    WHILE lines( lt_selected_indices ) < iv_count AND lines( lt_selected_indices ) < lv_total_flights.
      INSERT lo_random_index->get_next( ) INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
    ENDWHILE.

    LOOP AT lt_selected_indices INTO DATA(lv_index).
      READ TABLE lt_all_sflights INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_flight TO rt_random_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 zufälligen Produktcodes. Jeder Code soll aus einem 3-stelligen alphanumerischen Präfix, gefolgt von einem Bindestrich und einer 4-stelligen Zufallszahl bestehen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_random_char` und `cl_abap_random_int` mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_product_codes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_product_codes
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_product_codes) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_random_product_codes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_product_codes.
    DATA(lo_random_char) = cl_abap_random_char=>create( ).
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1000 max = 9999 ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_prefix) = lo_random_char->get_next_c( 3 ).
      DATA(lv_suffix) = lo_random_int->get_next( ).
      APPEND |{ lv_prefix }-{ lv_suffix }| TO rt_product_codes.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      act = lines( lt_codes )

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT alle Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und deren Flugpreis über 500 liegt. Bilden Sie dann eine neue Tabelle mit Flugnummer, Flugdatum und Flugpreis und geben Sie diese mit CL_DEMO_OUTPUT aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit FILTER und MAP (oder VALUE #(... FOR ... IN ...)).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
    METHODS display_filtered_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND price > 500
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight_raw
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid
                            connid = flight-connid
                            fldate = flight-fldate
                            price  = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_filtered_flights( ).
    cl_demo_output=>new( )->write( 'Gefilterte Flüge von Frankfurt mit Preis > 500:' )->write( lt_flights )->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt mindestens einen solchen Flug in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result ),

      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error
    ).
    " Überprüfen Sie, ob die Bedingungen erfüllt sind (z.B. Preis > 500)
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

        msg = 'Flugpreis sollte über 500 liegen.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Daten werden direkt aus der Datenbank selektiert und dann in die gewünschte Struktur gemappt. CL_DEMO_OUTPUT wird hier verwendet, um die Ergebnisse übersichtlich darzustellen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren funktionalen Methoden, die verkettet werden können, um eine Zeichenkette zu manipulieren (z.B. Großschreibung, Leerzeichen entfernen, umkehren). Geben Sie das Endergebnis mit CL_DEMO_OUTPUT aus.
hint: Definieren Sie Methoden als FUNCTIONAL und geben Sie SELF zurück, um Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_manipulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_manipulator.
    METHODS trim_spaces RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_manipulator.
    METHODS reverse_string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_manipulator.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    METHODS display_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_manipulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_string = to_upper( mv_string ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim_spaces.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN mv_string WITH ' '.
    mv_string = condense( mv_string ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reverse_string.
    DATA(lv_reversed) TYPE string.
    DO strlen( mv_string ) TIMES.
      lv_reversed = lv_reversed && mv_string+((strlen( mv_string ) - sy-index)*1)(1).
    ENDDO.
    mv_string = lv_reversed.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_result.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Manipulierter String: '{ mv_string }'| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_string_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_chaining.
    DATA(lo_manipulator) = NEW zcl_string_manipulator( '  hello   world  ' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_manipulator->trim_spaces( )->to_upper( )->reverse_string( )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'DLROW OLLEH',
      msg = 'String sollte korrekt manipuliert und verkettet sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Definition von Methoden als FUNCTIONAL und die Rückgabe einer Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (SELF) können Methodenaufrufe verkettet werden (Method Chaining). Dies führt zu einem flüssigeren und oft lesbareren Code, insbesondere bei sequenziellen Operationen. CL_DEMO_OUTPUT zeigt das Endergebnis an.
keywords: Functional Methods, Method Chaining, Object Orientation, String Manipulation, CL_DEMO_OUTPUT

solution:
CLASS zcl_select_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_select_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.

      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_basic( ).

    " For demonstration, we assert it's not initial if data is expected.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COUNT(*)` und `GROUP BY` in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_counts
      GROUP BY carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).
    IF lines( lt_counts ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_counts ).
      " Example: Check if LH has some flights (assuming LH exists in sflights)
      DATA(ls_lh_count) = VALUE zcl_select_agg=>ty_carrier_flight_count( ).
      READ TABLE lt_counts INTO ls_lh_count WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_counts ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von Aggregatfunktionen wie `COUNT(*)` direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` ermöglicht die effiziente Berechnung von zusammengefassten Daten direkt auf der Datenbankebene, was die Performance verbessert und die Datenübertragung reduziert.
keywords: SELECT, Aggregation, GROUP BY, COUNT, Open SQL

CLASS zcl_select_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_carrier_name,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_names.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights` für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus, die in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einer modernen internen Tabelle als Quelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_fae IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_fae FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_fae.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_fae( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_select_fae=>tt_carriers(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carriers ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
      " Check if at least one flight for LH or AA is present
      DATA(lv_found_lh) = abap_false.
      DATA(lv_found_aa) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
          lv_found_lh = abap_true.
        ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
          lv_found_aa = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_lh OR lv_found_aa ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR ALL ENTRIES` ist ein leistungsstarkes Open SQL-Feature, um Daten basierend auf Werten in einer internen Tabelle zu filtern. Die moderne Verwendung mit Inline-Deklarationen und dem `@`-Zeichen für Hostvariablen macht den Code sauberer und lesbarer. Es ist wichtig, die interne Tabelle vor der Verwendung auf `IS NOT INITIAL` zu prüfen, um unerwünschte Ergebnisse zu vermeiden.
keywords: SELECT, FOR ALL ENTRIES, Internal Tables, Open SQL, WHERE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das neueste Flugdatum für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ORDER BY` in absteigender Reihenfolge und `SELECT SINGLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_latest_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_date,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_date.

    METHODS get_latest_flight_date
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_fldate) TYPE s_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_latest_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight_date.
    SELECT SINGLE fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO @rv_fldate
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_latest_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_latest_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_latest_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_latest_date) = lo_cut->get_latest_flight_date( 'LH' ).
    " This test assumes 'LH' has flights.
    " A more robust test would insert test data or check against known data.
    IF lv_latest_date IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_latest_date ).
      " Example: Check if the date is in a plausible range (e.g., not 00000000)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_latest_date > '19000101' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_latest_date ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `ORDER BY DESCENDING` und `SELECT SINGLE` ist eine effiziente Methode, um den neuesten oder ältesten Eintrag basierend auf einem Datums- oder Zeitfeld zu ermitteln. Die Datenbank sortiert die Ergebnisse und liefert nur den ersten Treffer zurück, was die Performance optimiert.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, ORDER BY, DESCENDING, Open SQL, Date

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie alle Flüge von 'LH' mit allen Flügen von 'AA' aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `UNION` Operator in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_combined_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_union( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
      " Check if both LH and AA flights are present
      DATA(lv_found_lh) = abap_false.
      DATA(lv_found_aa) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
          lv_found_lh = abap_true.
        ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
          lv_found_aa = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `UNION`-Operator (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht das Kombinieren der Ergebnismengen von zwei oder mehr `SELECT`-Anweisungen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um disjunkte Datensätze aus der Datenbank zu holen, ohne mehrere separate Abfragen ausführen und die Ergebnisse manuell zusammenführen zu müssen.
keywords: SELECT, UNION, Open SQL, Set Operations

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Fluggesellschaften aus `scarr` aus, die mindestens einen Flug in `sflights` haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Subquery mit `EXISTS` in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_flights.
    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sflights WHERE carrid = scarr~carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carriers_with_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carriers_with_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_subquery( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_flights( ).
    IF lines( lt_carriers ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_carriers ).
      " Check if 'LH' is among the carriers (assuming LH has flights)
      DATA(lv_found_lh) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
        IF ls_carrier-carrid = 'LH'.
          lv_found_lh = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_lh ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_carriers ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Subqueries mit `EXISTS` sind eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, Datensätze basierend auf der Existenz von korrespondierenden Einträgen in einer anderen Tabelle zu filtern. Die Datenbank optimiert diese Art von Abfrage oft sehr effizient.
keywords: SELECT, Subquery, EXISTS, Open SQL, WHERE

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flüge für einen bestimmten Mandanten (z.B. '001') aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus, ohne die automatische Mandantenfilterung zu verwenden, und füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit passenden Feldern.

CLASS zcl_select_client_spec DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             mandt    TYPE mandt,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,

      IMPORTING iv_client TYPE mandt
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_client_spec IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_client.
    SELECT mandt, carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights CLIENT SPECIFIED
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE mandt = @iv_client.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flights_client FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_client.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_client_spec( ).
    " Assuming client '000' or '001' might have data in a test system
    DATA(lv_client) = '000'. " Or sy-mandt for current client
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_client( lv_client ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in Chunks und verarbeiten Sie jeden Chunk, um eine Liste von Flugnummern zu erhalten, die einen bestimmten Status haben (hier: Preis über 1000).
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` und `VALUE #( FOR ... WHERE ... )` für die Chunk-Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_chunk DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_chunk IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_flights_chunk TYPE tt_flight_data.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        ORDER BY fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_flights_chunk PACKAGE SIZE @iv_chunk_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Modern processing of the chunk
      APPEND LINES OF VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_flights_chunk WHERE ( price > 1000 ) ( flight-connid ) ) TO rt_connids.
      CLEAR lt_flights_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_in_chunks FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_in_chunks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_chunk( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_flights_in_chunks( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_chunk_size = 50 ).

    " Assuming there are some LH flights with price > 1000 in sflights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_connids ) >= 0 ).
    IF lines( lt_connids ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_connids ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

WHERE ... )` moderne ABAP-Syntax zum Filtern und Mappen von Daten im abgerufenen Chunk, wodurch explizite `LOOP`- und `APPEND`-Anweisungen vermieden werden.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, PACKAGE SIZE, FOR, VALUE, sflights, Database Access

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` mit einer dynamischen `WHERE`-Klausel, die zur Laufzeit erstellt wird. Verwenden Sie String-Templates für die dynamische SQL-Erstellung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `WHERE (lv_dynamic_where)` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic_where
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic_where.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lv_dynamic_where TYPE string,
          ls_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key.

    " Build dynamic WHERE clause using string templates
    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_dynamic_where = |CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }'|.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF lv_dynamic_where IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_dynamic_where = |{ lv_dynamic_where } AND CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'|.
      ELSE.
        lv_dynamic_where = |CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_dynamic_where IS INITIAL.
      lv_dynamic_where = '1 = 1'.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflights
        WHERE (lv_dynamic_where)
        ORDER BY carrid, connid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_flight_key.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight_key TO rt_flight_keys.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_dynamic( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_open_cursor_dynamic=>tt_flight_key.

    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic_where( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic_where( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).

    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic_where( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `OPEN CURSOR` für effiziente Datenabfrage mit dynamischem SQL unter Verwendung einer `WHERE (lv_dynamic_where)`-Klausel. Der String `lv_dynamic_where` wird mit modernen String-Templates (`|...|`) konstruiert, die eine saubere und lesbare Methode zur Erstellung dynamischer Strings, insbesondere für SQL-Anweisungen, bieten.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, Dynamic SQL, String Templates, WHERE (dynamic), ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und bestimmen Sie für jede Gruppe, ob es sich um eine "Major Carrier" oder "Minor Carrier" handelt, basierend auf der Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und eine `COND` Expression mit `WHEN` innerhalb der Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrier_type TYPE string,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( group group_ref ).
      DATA(lv_carrier_type) = COND string(
        WHEN lv_flight_count > 50 THEN 'Major Carrier'
        ELSE 'Minor Carrier'
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid       = group_ref->carrid
        carrier_type = lv_carrier_type
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_when( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE #( lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_lh_summary IS SUPPLIED.
      IF ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 50.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-carrier_type exp = 'Major Carrier' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-carrier_type exp = 'Minor Carrier' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Anweisung `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` (ABAP 7.50) zum Gruppieren von internen Tabellendaten. Innerhalb der Gruppenschleife wird ein `COND`-Ausdruck mit `WHEN` verwendet, um den `carrier_type` dynamisch basierend auf der `flight_count` jeder Gruppe zu bestimmen, was moderne Datenverarbeitung und bedingte Logik zeigt.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, COND, WHEN, Internal Tables, Grouping, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` mit `OPEN CURSOR` und sammeln Sie die eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `INSERT` in eine `SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE SORTED TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_unique_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflights.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, aber nur für Flüge, die über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` Expression mit `COND` und `WHEN` Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_filtered_price_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_filtered_price_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + COND s_price(
                                      WHEN flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN flight-price
                                      ELSE 0
                                    )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filtered_price_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_when( ).
    DATA lv_expected_sum TYPE s_price.
    DATA lv_actual_sum TYPE s_price.

    " Test with LH, threshold 1000. Assuming LH has flights with prices 1200, 1500, etc.
    " For a robust test, you'd need to know the exact data in sflights or insert test data.
    " Here, we'll just check if it's not zero if there are such flights.
    lv_actual_sum = lo_cut->calculate_filtered_price_sum( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_price_threshold = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_actual_sum >= 0 ).

    " Test with a threshold that should result in 0 (e.g., very high threshold)
    lv_actual_sum = lo_cut->calculate_filtered_price_sum( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_price_threshold = 999999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf funktionale Weise. In Kombination mit einem `COND`-Ausdruck, der `WHEN`-Bedingungen verwendet, kann die Aggregation selektiv basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien erfolgen, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für eine nicht existierende Tabelle und fangen Sie den Fehler mit `TRY...CATCH` ab, um eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zurückzugeben.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS open_cursor_with_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_cursor_with_error.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA ls_data TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA ls_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_table_name).

        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name).

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        rv_message = |Cursor für Tabelle '{ iv_table_name }' erfolgreich geöffnet und geschlossen.|.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        rv_message = |Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors für Tabelle '{ iv_table_name }': { lx_sql_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        rv_message = |Fehler beim Erstellen des Datenobjekts für Tabelle '{ iv_table_name }': { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
