Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `FOR ALL ENTRIES` (simuliert) und `ORDER BY` für eine performante, sortierte Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen aus `sflights` basierend auf einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `WHERE IN` und `ORDER BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_fae DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_fae IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA ls_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info.

    IF it_carrids IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid IN @it_carrids
        ORDER BY carrid, fldate.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_flight_info.
      IF sy_subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight_info TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flights_for_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_fae( ).
    DATA lt_carrids TYPE zcl_open_cursor_fae=>tt_carrid.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_carrids.
    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_carrids.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( it_carrids = lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).

    " Check if results are sorted by carrid and fldate
    DATA lv_prev_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE ' '.
    DATA lv_prev_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '00000000'.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Results not sorted by carrid' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-fldate < lv_prev_fldate.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Results not sorted by fldate within carrid' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` in Kombination mit einer `WHERE IN`-Klausel, um Daten für eine Liste von Werten effizient abzurufen. Die `ORDER BY`-Klausel im Cursor stellt sicher, dass die Daten bereits sortiert vom Datenbankserver kommen, was die Notwendigkeit einer nachträglichen Sortierung in ABAP eliminiert und die Performance verbessert.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, WHERE IN, ORDER BY, Database Access, Performance, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Flugzeit für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, indem Sie `OPEN CURSOR` verwenden und die Aggregation manuell durchführen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und eine `REDUCE` Expression für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             fltime TYPE s_fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.
    TYPES tt_flight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_flight_time
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_time) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_flight_time.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_duration.
    DATA lt_flight_times TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_fltime WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_flight.
      IF sy_subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight-fltime TO lt_flight_times.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    IF lt_flight_times IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_total_minutes) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum_minutes = 0
        FOR time_val IN lt_flight_times
        NEXT sum_minutes = sum_minutes + (
          ( CONV i( time_val(2) ) * 60 ) + CONV i( time_val+2(2) ) " HHMMSS to minutes
        )
      ).
      rv_avg_time = lv_total_minutes / lines( lt_flight_times ).
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_time = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_flight_time FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_flight_time.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_avg( ).
    DATA lv_avg_time TYPE decfloat16.

    " Test with LH (assuming some flights exist)
    lv_avg_time = lo_cut->get_average_flight_time( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_avg_time >= 0 ).

    " Test with a non-existent carrier
    lv_avg_time = lo_cut->get_average_flight_time( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_time exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `OPEN CURSOR` zur iterativen Abfrage von Flugdaten. Die eigentliche Aggregation (Berechnung der durchschnittlichen Flugzeit) erfolgt dann im ABAP-Code mit einer `REDUCE`-Expression. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Datenbank-Aggregationsfunktionen nicht ausreichen oder komplexere Logik in ABAP erforderlich ist. Die Umwandlung von `s_fltime` (HHMMSS) in Minuten und die Berechnung des Durchschnitts zeigen moderne Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, REDUCE, Aggregation, Data Transformation, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT`-Abfrage mit `OPEN CURSOR` aus, bei der die Spaltenliste und die `WHERE`-Klausel zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Zugriff auf die Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit dynamischer Spaltenliste und `WHERE`-Klausel, sowie `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_columns    TYPE string
        iv_where_clause TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_dynamic_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_data.
    DATA lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_table_name).
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.

        DATA(lv_select_statement) = |SELECT { iv_columns } FROM { iv_table_name }|.
        IF iv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_select_statement = |{ lv_select_statement } WHERE { iv_where_clause }|.
        ENDIF.

        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_select_statement).

        DO.
          CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <fs_data>.
          ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_line>.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @<fs_line>.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND lr_data TO rt_data.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).

CLASS zcl_syst_subrc_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_read_table_subrc IMPORTING iv_key TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_syst_subrc_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_read_table_subrc.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_data,
             key TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ts_data.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE ts_data( key = 'A' value = 'Value A' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE ts_data( key = 'B' value = 'Value B' ) TO lt_data.

    READ TABLE lt_data WITH KEY key = iv_key INTO DATA(ls_found_entry).

    IF cl_abap_syst=>get_subrc( ) = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_pic_sflights_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flight_picture
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

CLASS zcl_pic_sflights_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_picture.
    DATA(lo_picture) = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = io_container ).
    DATA(lv_picture_url) TYPE string.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, carrname
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CASE ls_flight_data-carrid.
        WHEN 'LH'. " Lufthansa
          lv_picture_url = '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/sap_logo.gif'. " Placeholder
        WHEN 'AA'. " American Airlines
          lv_picture_url = '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/sap_logo.gif'. " Placeholder
        WHEN OTHERS.
          lv_picture_url = '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/default_logo.gif'. " Default
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      lv_picture_url = '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/not_found.gif'. " Not found
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_picture->load_picture_from_url( url = lv_picture_url ).
        lo_picture->set_display_mode( cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Laden Sie ein Bild asynchron in ein `cl_gui_picture` Control, um die GUI nicht zu blockieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_picture->load_picture_from_url_as_data` und `cl_gui_picture->set_picture_from_data` in Kombination mit einem Event-Handler für `LOAD_FINISHED`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pic_async_load DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS load_async_picture
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_async_load IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD load_async_picture.
    DATA(lo_picture) = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = io_container ).
    DATA(lv_mime_url) = '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/sap_logo.gif'.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_load_finished FOR EVENT load_finished OF cl_gui_picture
          IMPORTING sender data_x data_y data_len data_type.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_load_finished.
        MESSAGE 'Bild asynchron geladen!' TYPE 'I'.
        " Here you could process the loaded data if needed, or just confirm.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_event_handler) = NEW lcl_event_handler( ).
    SET HANDLER lo_event_handler->on_load_finished FOR lo_picture.

    TRY.
        lo_picture->load_picture_from_url_as_data( url = lv_mime_url ).
        " The picture will be set by the control itself once data is loaded.
        lo_picture->set_display_mode( cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie ein Bild in einem `cl_gui_picture` Control an, dessen URL aus einer Konfigurationstabelle (z.B. `Z_PIC_CONFIG`) gelesen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` aus einer benutzerdefinierten Tabelle und `cl_gui_picture->load_picture_from_url`.

CLASS zcl_pic_config_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_configured_picture
      IMPORTING
        iv_config_key TYPE string
        io_container  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pic_config_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_configured_picture.
    DATA(lo_picture) = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = io_container ).
    DATA(lv_picture_url) TYPE string.

    " Assume Z_PIC_CONFIG is a custom table with fields KEY (string) and URL (string)
    " For demonstration, we'll simulate reading from it.
    " SELECT SINGLE url FROM z_pic_config WHERE key = @iv_config_key INTO @lv_picture_url.

    IF iv_config_key = 'DEFAULT_LOGO'.
      lv_picture_url = '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/sap_logo.gif'.
    ELSEIF iv_config_key = 'ERROR_LOGO'.
      lv_picture_url = '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/not_found.gif'.
    ELSE.
      lv_picture_url = '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/default_logo.gif'.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_picture_url IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          lo_picture->load_picture_from_url( url = lv_picture_url ).
          lo_picture->set_display_mode( cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch ).
        CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
          MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Bild-URL in Konfiguration gefunden.' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = 0 " No exception raised " ).

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aufsteigend und dann nach Flugdatum (FLDATE) absteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie die SORT-Anweisung mit mehreren Feldern und der Angabe ASCENDING/DESCENDING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights.
    rt_sorted_flights = it_flights.
    SORT rt_sorted_flights BY carrid ASCENDING fldate DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_sorter=>tt_flights,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_flight_sorter=>ty_flight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250105' price = '200' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250105' price = '150' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '250' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_sorter( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_flights( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte AA sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250105' msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte Datum 20250105 haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Zweiter Eintrag sollte AA sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' msg = 'Zweiter Eintrag sollte Datum 20250101 haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Dritter Eintrag sollte LH sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20250105' msg = 'Dritter Eintrag sollte Datum 20250105 haben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 4 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Vierter Eintrag sollte LH sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 4 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' msg = 'Vierter Eintrag sollte Datum 20250101 haben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

In modernem ABAP wird sie oft in Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen und funktionalen Ansätzen verwendet, um den Code lesbarer und kompakter zu gestalten. Die explizite Angabe von ASCENDING/DESCENDING pro Feld ermöglicht eine präzise Sortierreihenfolge.

CLASS zcl_flight_sorted_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sorted_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    rt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_source_flights SORTED BY carrid ASCENDING connid ASCENDING
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie die dynamische Variante der SORT-Anweisung mit einem Feldnamen in Klammern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_field_name   TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_table) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    rt_sorted_table = it_source_table.
    SORT rt_sorted_table BY (iv_field_name) ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_dynamic_sorter=>tt_flight_data,

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250105' price = '150' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '250' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sorter( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( it_source_table = lt_flights iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte AA sein' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus SFLIGHTS und sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Flugdatum (FLDATE) aufsteigend.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FILTER- und SORTED BY-Operatoren in einer VALUE-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sort_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_sorted_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_carrid         TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sort_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sorted_flights.
    rt_result_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN it_source_flights 
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) 
        SORTED BY fldate ASCENDING
      ( ls_flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) basierend auf dem Datenbanktyp: Wenn es sich um eine HANA-Datenbank handelt, sortieren Sie nach Flugdatum (FLDATE) absteigend; andernfalls sortieren Sie nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aufsteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_DB_SYS=>IS_HANA_DB() in einer IF-Anweisung und die SORT-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights_conditionally.
    rt_sorted_flights = it_source_flights.

    IF cl_db_sys=>is_hana_db( ) EQ abap_true.
      SORT rt_sorted_flights BY fldate DESCENDING.
    ELSE.
      SORT rt_sorted_flights BY carrid ASCENDING.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und sortieren Sie die Flüge innerhalb jeder Gruppe nach Flugdatum (FLDATE) absteigend. Geben Sie eine Tabelle mit den Fluggesellschaften und ihren sortierten Flügen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die GROUP BY-Klausel in einer FOR-Expression und SORTED BY für die interne Sortierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sort_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights  TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_sort_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_sorted) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sort_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_sort_flights.
    rt_grouped_sorted = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_source_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key)
      ( carrid = group_key
        flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP group_key SORTED BY fldate DESCENDING
          ( ls_grouped_flight )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtsumme der Preise aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'DL' (Delta Airlines) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um die relevanten Flüge zu selektieren, und den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Preise zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                   FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                                   NEXT total_price = total_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'DL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total >= 0 ). " Total price should be non-negative
    " For a precise test, you'd need to know the exact sum or mock sflight.
    " Assuming DL flights exist and have prices, the sum should be > 0.
    IF lv_total > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Total price for DL is greater than 0' ).
    ELSE.

    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Integer-Zahl (z.B. 42) in einen String der Länge 5 mit führenden Nullen (z.B. '00042').

CLASS zcl_conv_num_to_str_alpha DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_number_with_leading_zeros IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i iv_length TYPE i OPTIONAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_num_to_str_alpha IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_number_with_leading_zeros.
    DATA lv_target_length TYPE i VALUE 5.
    IF iv_length IS SUPPLIED AND iv_length > 0.
      lv_target_length = iv_length.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_char_field) = VALUE c( lv_target_length ).
    lv_char_field = CONV #( ALPHA = 'IN' iv_number ).
    rv_formatted_string = lv_char_field.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > 100 )
                             GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
                             ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
                               flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die in den nächsten 30 Tagen stattfinden (basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemdatum).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer dynamischen Datumsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_upcoming_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_upcoming_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lv_today + 30.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE fldate BETWEEN lv_today AND lv_future_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = lv_today + 30.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-fldate >= lv_today ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-fldate <= lv_future_date ).

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine Tabelle von Integern, wobei ungültige Einträge übersprungen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `CONV` innerhalb eines `VALUE` Operators.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_str_to_int_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table_to_int IMPORTING it_string_values TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_int_values) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_str_to_int_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_int.
    rt_int_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_string IN it_string_values
                                 WHERE ( COND #( WHEN ls_string CO '0123456789' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) = abap_true )
                                 ( CONV i( ls_string ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 123 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren. Innerhalb der Schleife wird `WHERE` mit einer `COND`-Expression verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob der String nur Ziffern enthält (`CO '0123456789'`). Nur gültige Strings werden dann mit `CONV i(...)` in Integer konvertiert und der Ergebnistabelle hinzugefügt. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und kompakte Art der Transformation und Filterung.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, deren Fluggesellschaft mit 'S' beginnt, und konvertieren Sie die Flugnummern in Kleinbuchstaben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `to_lower` (String-Funktion).
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_conv_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid_lc TYPE string,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES tt_filtered_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_and_converted_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_conv_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_and_converted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid CP 'S*' )
                             ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                               connid_lc = to_lower( ls_flight-connid ),
                               fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_and_converted FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_and_converted.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_conv_string( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_converted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-carrid CP 'S*' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid_lc exp = to_lower( ls_flight-connid_lc ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    " This test is harder without mocking sflights. Assuming 'ZZ' is not a carrier starting with S.
    " For a real scenario, you'd mock the sflights data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_conv_string( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_mock) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights_mock ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'ZZ'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    " In a real test, you'd inject this mock data.
    " For this example, we rely on the actual sflights data not having 'ZZ' starting with 'S'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_and_converted_flights( ).
    " If no carriers start with 'S' in sflights, this would be initial.
    " For a robust test, ensure sflights has 'S' carriers or mock it.
    IF lines( lt_result ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'No flights found starting with S, as expected (or due to test data)' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Flights found starting with S' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FILTER` Operator mit dem `FOR` Ausdruck innerhalb des `VALUE` Operators. Zuerst werden Flüge gefiltert, deren Fluggesellschaft mit 'S' beginnt (`CP 'S*'`). Anschließend wird für jede gefilterte Zeile die Flugnummer mit der String-Funktion `to_lower` in Kleinbuchstaben konvertiert. Dies demonstriert eine effiziente und funktionale Transformation von Daten während der Filterung.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, String Functions, to_lower, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Objektreferenzen eines Basistyps in eine Liste von Referenzen eines abgeleiteten Typs, wobei nur die tatsächlich kompatiblen Referenzen übernommen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `CAST` und `IS INSTANCE OF` innerhalb eines `VALUE` Operators.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_cast_objects DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    CLASS cl_base_object DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS cl_derived_object DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_base_object.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_type REDEFINITION.
        METHODS get_specific_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES tt_base_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_base_object WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_derived_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_derived_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_cast_to_derived IMPORTING it_base_objects TYPE tt_base_objects RETURNING VALUE(rt_derived_objects) TYPE tt_derived_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_cast_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  CLASS cl_base_object IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD get_type.
      rv_type = 'Base'.
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS cl_derived_object IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD get_type.
      rv_type = 'Derived'.
    ENDMETHOD.
    METHOD get_specific_data.
      rv_data = 'Specific Derived Data'.
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.

  METHOD filter_and_cast_to_derived.
    rt_derived_objects = VALUE #( FOR lo_base IN it_base_objects
                                     WHERE ( lo_base IS INSTANCE OF cl_derived_object )
                                     ( CAST cl_derived_object( lo_base ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_and_cast FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_cast.
    DATA lo_base_obj TYPE REF TO zcl_conv_cast_objects=>cl_base_object.
    DATA lo_derived_obj TYPE REF TO zcl_conv_cast_objects=>cl_derived_object.
    DATA lt_input TYPE zcl_conv_cast_objects=>tt_base_objects.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_base_obj.
    APPEND lo_base_obj TO lt_input.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_derived_obj.
    APPEND lo_derived_obj TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_cast_objects( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_cast_to_derived( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]->get_type( ) exp = 'Derived' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]->get_specific_data( ) exp = 'Specific Derived Data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA lt_input TYPE zcl_conv_cast_objects=>tt_base_objects.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_cast_objects( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_cast_to_derived( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Konvertierung und Filterung von Objektreferenzen in einem funktionalen Stil. Der `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife iteriert über eine Liste von Basistyp-Referenzen. Die `WHERE`-Bedingung verwendet `IS INSTANCE OF`, um zu prüfen, ob eine Referenz tatsächlich auf ein Objekt des abgeleiteten Typs zeigt. Nur diese kompatiblen Referenzen werden dann mit `CAST` in den abgeleiteten Typ konvertiert und in die Ergebnistabelle aufgenommen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und typsichere Methode für die Arbeit mit Polymorphie.
keywords: CONV, CAST, IS INSTANCE OF, FOR, VALUE, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften aus `sflight` enthält, deren Land 'DE' ist. Für dieses Beispiel filtern wir nach der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa), die in Deutschland ansässig ist.
hint: Nutze `FOR` und `VALUE` in Kombination mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flights_from_germany
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_germany.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                            connid = flight-connid,
                            fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_itb_for_value=>get_flights_from_germany( ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge direkt während der Iteration.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Loop, Filter, Declarative

CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHEN iv_status_code = 'C' THEN 'Abgesagt'

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der belegten Sitzplätze aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutze die `REDUCE` Expression für eine funktionale Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_total_occupied_seats_for_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats_for_airline.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_seats.
    " Dieser Test ist abhängig von den Daten in SFLIGHT. Für einen echten Unit Test
    " müsste SFLIGHT gemockt oder Testdaten eingefügt werden.
    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob das Ergebnis nicht negativ ist.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = zcl_itb_reduce=>get_total_occupied_seats_for_airline( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_seats >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_no_flights.
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = zcl_itb_reduce=>get_total_occupied_seats_for_airline( 'XX' ). " Nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen Weise. Sie initialisiert eine Variable (`INIT`) und wendet dann eine Operation (`NEXT`) auf jedes Element der Tabelle an, um ein Endergebnis zu berechnen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional, Expression

CLASS zcl_inline_data_decl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    CLASS-METHODS get_single_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_data_decl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight_data). " Inline declaration

    rs_flight = ls_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null abfängt und eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst.

solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_division_by_zero( textid = zcx_division_by_zero=>default_text ).
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere alle Flüge aus `sflight`, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Nutze die `FILTER` Expression für eine deklarative Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flights_after_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_after_date.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate > iv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge nach '20250101'
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_itb_filter=>get_flights_after_date( '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate > '20250101' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    " Annahme: Es gibt keine Flüge nach '20500101'
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_itb_filter=>get_flights_after_date( '20500101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Sie ist leistungsfähiger und lesbarer als manuelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE`-Konstrukte, insbesondere bei komplexeren Filterbedingungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Selection, Date, Expression, Declarative

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und zähle die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_nr TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flight_count_by_airline
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_airline.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    flight_nr = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_airline FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_airline.
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = zcl_itb_group_by=>get_flight_count_by_airline( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_counts ).

    " Überprüfe, ob die Summe der gezählten Flüge der Gesamtzahl der Flüge entspricht
    DATA(lv_total_flights_counted) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                              FOR count_entry IN lt_flight_counts
                                              NEXT sum = sum + count_entry-flight_nr ).

    DATA(lv_total_flights_in_db) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @lv_total_flights_in_db.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_flights_counted exp = lv_total_flights_in_db ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion, um interne Tabellen direkt im ABAP-Code zu gruppieren. Sie ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten und die Berechnung von Gruppeninformationen (wie `GROUP SIZE`) ohne zusätzliche manuelle Schleifen oder Hash-Tabellen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, Functional

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitzplätze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `DIVIDE` oder manueller Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                     NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
      rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lines( lt_sflights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_existing_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_no_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_single_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_existing_flights.
    " Annahme: 'LH' hat Flüge mit belegten Sitzen
    DATA(lv_average) = zcl_math_average=>get_average_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_average >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_no_flights.
    DATA(lv_average) = zcl_math_average=>get_average_occupied_seats( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_single_flight.
    " Für diesen Test müssten Testdaten in SFLIGHT eingefügt werden, um einen spezifischen Durchschnitt zu prüfen.
    " Hier nur eine allgemeine Prüfung.
    DATA(lv_average) = zcl_math_average=>get_average_occupied_seats( 'AA' ). " Annahme: 'AA' hat Flüge
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_average >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die `REDUCE`-Expression zur Summenbildung mit einer einfachen Division, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen. Die Verwendung von `DECFLOAT34` gewährleistet eine präzise Gleitkommaarithmetik, die für Durchschnittsberechnungen oft notwendig ist. Die Prüfung auf leere Tabellen verhindert eine Division durch Null.
keywords: Math, Average, REDUCE, Internal Tables, DECFLOAT34

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (CARRID) aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, die mit 'LH' beginnen, und konvertieren Sie diese in Kleinbuchstaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_lowercase_carrids
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_lowercase_carrids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid CP 'LH*' )
                          ( CONV string( to_lower( <fs_flight>-carrid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_lowercase_carrids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All entries should start with lh' act = ( lt_result[ 1 ] CP 'lh*' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. `to_lower` konvertiert den String in Kleinbuchstaben.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE s_price = 0
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Flugpreis (PRICE) einer `sflights`-Struktur einen Status-String zurückgibt: "Günstig" (< 100), "Standard" (100-500), "Teuer" (> 500).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_status
      IMPORTING is_flight TYPE sflights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN is_flight-price < 100 THEN 'Günstig'
      WHEN is_flight-price >= 100 AND is_flight-price <= 500 THEN 'Standard'
      ELSE 'Teuer'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_logic( ).
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflights.

    ls_flight-price = 50.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price 50 should be Günstig' act = lo_cut->get_price_status( ls_flight ) exp = 'Günstig' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Fluggesellschafts-IDs (CARRID) aus `sflights` auflistet, getrennt durch Kommas, aber nur die ersten 5 eindeutigen IDs.

CLASS zcl_str_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carrids_string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_unique_carrids) = VALUE string_table( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights ( <fs_flight>-carrid ) ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_carrids.

    rv_carrids_string = |{ FOR <fs_carrid> IN lt_unique_carrids UP TO 5 ROWS ( <fs_carrid> ) SEPARATED BY ', ' }|.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.
    TYPES tt_carrid_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_gui_picture_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_picture

    mo_picture->load_picture_from_url(
      EXPORTING
        url = iv_url
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` (bis zu 5 Flüge) einen anonymen Datentyp enthält. Dieser soll die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und einen Status ('Langstrecke' wenn DISTANCE > 5000, sonst 'Kurzstrecke') umfassen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE`, `FOR` und `COND` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_chain_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO data. " Anonymous type requires REF TO data
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_chain_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid distance FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_summary = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                                 ( NEW #( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                          distance_type = COND string( WHEN <fs_flight>-distance > 5000 THEN 'Langstrecke' ELSE 'Kurzstrecke' ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chained_operations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_operations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_chain_ops( ).
    DATA(lt_result_refs) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result table should have 5 entries' act = lines( lt_result_refs ) exp = 5 ).

    LOOP AT lt_result_refs INTO DATA(lo_data_ref).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_summary> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <ls_summary>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_carrid> TYPE s_carr_id.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_distance_type> TYPE string.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_summary> TO <lv_carrid>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CARRID should not be initial' act = <lv_carrid> ).

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DISTANCE_TYPE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_summary> TO <lv_distance_type>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'DISTANCE_TYPE should be Langstrecke or Kurzstrecke' act = ( <lv_distance_type> = 'Langstrecke' OR <lv_distance_type> = 'Kurzstrecke' ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE`, `FOR` und `COND` ermöglicht komplexe Transformationen und die Erstellung von internen Tabellen mit anonymen Strukturen in einer sehr kompakten und lesbaren funktionalen Syntax. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit temporärer Variablen und expliziter Schleifen.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Anonymous Types, Functional Programming, Chaining

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der Flugpreise (PRICE) für alle Flüge in `sflights` unter Verwendung von funktionalen Operatoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines` für die Anzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_flight_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                          FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                                          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).

    DATA(lv_number_of_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    IF lv_number_of_flights > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_number_of_flights.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc + ls_sflight-seatsmax - ls_sflight-seatsocc " Total capacity is seatsocc + seatsfree

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_flight_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_nested_flight_pairs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung (Passagiere / Kapazität) für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, aber nur für Flüge, die in einem bestimmten Jahr stattgefunden haben. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: `REDUCE #( INIT count = 0, total_load = 0 FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... NEXT count = count + 1, total_load = total_load + COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_load DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_load
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_year   TYPE sy-datum(4)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_load) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_load IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_load.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_result,
            count      TYPE i,
            total_load TYPE f,
          END OF ls_result.

    ls_result = REDUCE #( 
      INIT count = 0 total_load = 0.0
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate CP |{ iv_year }*| )
      NEXT
        count = count + 1,
        total_load = total_load + COND f(
          WHEN ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_sflight-seatsocc / ls_sflight-seatsmax )
          ELSE 0.0
        )
    ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_avg_load = ls_result-total_load / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_load = 0.0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_load FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_load.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_load( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_year) = '2025'.

    " Manuelle Berechnung für Vergleich
    DATA: lv_sum_load TYPE f VALUE 0,
          lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    SELECT seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_for_test)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND fldate CP @|{ lv_year }*|.

    LOOP AT lt_flights_for_test INTO DATA(ls_flight_for_test).
      IF ls_flight_for_test-seatsmax > 0.
        lv_sum_load = lv_sum_load + ( ls_flight_for_test-seatsocc / ls_flight_for_test-seatsmax ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_expected_avg) = COND f(
      WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_load / lv_count
      ELSE 0.0
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_avg) = lo_cut->get_average_load( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_year = lv_year ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_avg exp = lv_expected_avg tolerance = '0.001' msg = 'Durchschnittliche Auslastung stimmt nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `REDUCE` Operator für Aggregation mit dem `COND` Operator für bedingte Logik innerhalb der Schleife. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Berechnungen wie die durchschnittliche Auslastung, wobei Division durch Null vermieden wird, alles in einem sehr kompakten und funktionalen Stil. Die `FOR` Schleife mit `WHERE` filtert die relevanten Daten direkt.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Conditional Logic

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN sflights

CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( ls_sflight-carrid = iv_carrid AND ls_sflight-seatsfree >= iv_min_seatsfree )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `SFLIGHTS` eine berechnete 'Auslastungsrate' (seatsocc / seatsmax) als Dezimalzahl enthält. Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` Schleife und einer Inline-Berechnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( ... ) )` und führen Sie die Berechnung direkt im Konstrukt durch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_load_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_load,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             load_rate TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_load.
    TYPES tt_flight_loads TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_load WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_load_rates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_loads) TYPE tt_flight_loads.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_load_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_load_rates.
    rt_flight_loads = VALUE tt_flight_loads(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
        load_rate = COND f(
          WHEN ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_sflight-seatsocc / ls_sflight-seatsmax )
          ELSE 0.0
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_load_rates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_load_rates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_load_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_loads) = lo_cut->calculate_load_rates( ).

    DATA(lt_expected_loads) = VALUE zcl_flight_load_calculator=>tt_flight_loads( ).
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw).
      DATA(lv_load_rate) = COND f(
        WHEN ls_sflight_raw-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_sflight_raw-seatsocc / ls_sflight_raw-seatsmax )
        ELSE 0.0
      ).
      APPEND VALUE zcl_flight_load_calculator=>ty_flight_load(
        carrid = ls_sflight_raw-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight_raw-connid,
        fldate = ls_sflight_raw-fldate,
        load_rate = lv_load_rate
      ) TO lt_expected_loads.
    ENDLOOP.
    SORT lt_expected_loads BY carrid connid fldate.
    SORT lt_actual_loads BY carrid connid fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_loads exp = lt_expected_loads tolerance = '0.001' msg = 'Berechnete Auslastungsraten stimmen nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` Schleife ist hervorragend geeignet, um interne Tabellen zu transformieren und dabei neue Felder mit berechneten Werten zu füllen. Die Kombination mit dem `COND` Operator innerhalb des `VALUE`-Konstrukts ermöglicht es, bedingte Berechnungen (z.B. Vermeidung von Division durch Null) direkt und inline durchzuführen, was den Code sehr kompakt und funktional macht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, SFLIGHTS, Calculation, COND

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) nach dem ersten Flug, der eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer hat. Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `WHERE` und `FIRST`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ...` oder `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( FIRST ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.

    METHODS find_first_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_detail) TYPE ty_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_flight.
    rs_flight_detail = VALUE ty_flight_detail(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = is_key-carrid AND connid = is_key-connid )
      ( FIRST #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                  connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                  fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
                  seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_first_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_first_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_finder( ).
    DATA(ls_search_key) = VALUE zcl_flight_finder=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).

    DATA(ls_expected_flight) = VALUE zcl_flight_finder=>ty_flight_detail( ).
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO @ls_expected_flight
      WHERE carrid = @ls_search_key-carrid AND connid = @ls_search_key-connid.

    DATA(ls_actual_flight) = lo_cut->find_first_flight( ls_search_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_flight exp = ls_expected_flight msg = 'Gefundener Flug stimmt nicht überein' ).

    " Test for non-existent flight
    ls_search_key = VALUE zcl_flight_finder=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).
    ls_actual_flight = lo_cut->find_first_flight( ls_search_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_actual_flight-carrid msg = 'Es sollte kein Flug gefunden werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( FIRST #( ... ) )` ist eine moderne und sehr prägnante Art, den ersten Treffer in einer internen Tabelle zu finden, der eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt. Dies ist eine funktionale Alternative zu `READ TABLE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit, insbesondere wenn die Struktur des Ergebnisses direkt im Konstrukt definiert wird.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, FIRST, Internal Tables, Search, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der freien Plätze auf einen neuen Wert setzen. Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `IN` und `SET`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... SET ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_mod,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             seatsfree TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_mod.
    TYPES tt_flight_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_mod WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_seats_free
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_new_seatsfree TYPE s_seatsocc
      CHANGING
        ct_flights     TYPE tt_flight_mod.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_seats_free.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-seatsfree = iv_new_seatsfree.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_seats_free FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_seats_free.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_modifier( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_new_seatsfree) = 50.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_modifier=>tt_flight_mod(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsfree = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_modifier=>tt_flight_mod(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsfree = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' seatsfree = 50 )
    ).

    lo_cut->modify_seats_free( EXPORTING iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_new_seatsfree = lv_new_seatsfree CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_flights exp = lt_expected_flights msg = 'Modifizierte Flüge stimmen nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für die direkte Modifikation einer internen Tabelle ist die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL ... WHERE ... ENDLOOP`-Konstruktion immer noch die gängigste und effizienteste Methode. Obwohl es keine direkte `FOR ... IN ... SET ...` Syntax gibt, die eine ganze Tabelle in einem Ausdruck modifiziert, ist die Verwendung von Field-Symbolen in einer `LOOP` die moderne Art, Elemente einer Tabelle zu ändern, ohne eine Kopie zu erstellen. Dies ist performanter als das Arbeiten mit Work-Areas bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Modification, Field-Symbols, LOOP AT

CLASS zcl_string_table_concatenator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_string_table_concatenator IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflight) generiert wird. Jede Zeile soll als 'Flug <CARRID>-<CONNID> am <FLDATE>' formatiert und durch ein Semikolon getrennt werden. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und String Templates.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    rv_summary = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |Flug { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid } am { flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|
                 ELSE |{ s }; Flug { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid } am { flight-fldate DATE = ISO }|
               )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_flight_summary FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_template( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_str_reduce_template=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_summary
                                       exp = 'Flug LH-0400 am 2025-01-01; Flug AA-0017 am 2025-01-02' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `REDUCE` und String Templates ist eine sehr elegante und performante Methode, um Strings aus Tabellendaten zu aggregieren. `COND` innerhalb von `REDUCE` erlaubt eine saubere Handhabung des ersten Elements, um unnötige Trennzeichen zu vermeiden. Die `DATE = ISO` Option im String Template formatiert das Datum automatisch.
keywords: REDUCE, String Templates, Aggregation, Functional Programming, NESTING

CLASS zcl_tab_for_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem numerischen Akkumulator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_prices TYPE tt_flight_price
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_prices
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_flight_price(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '1234' price = '50.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_prices ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist perfekt für Aggregationsaufgaben wie das Summieren von Werten. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP` Schleifen mit einer lokalen Variablen für die Summe und macht den Code viel kompakter und funktionaler. Die Initialisierung des Akkumulators (`INIT sum = 0`) ist dabei obligatorisch.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Sum, Functional Programming, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, die aus der `sflight` Datenbanktabelle gelesen werden. solution:
CLASS zcl_select_inline_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                         iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_inline_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND price > @iv_min_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    " Setup test data in sflight if not already present
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100
    ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '80.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 50
    ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = '737' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 120
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_inline_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = '100.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).

    " Cleanup test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid IN ('0400', '0401').
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration von internen Tabellen direkt im `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` einer `SELECT` Anweisung ist ein Kernfeature von ABAP 7.40+. Es reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Tabellen explizit zu deklarieren, und macht den Code kompakter. Die Verwendung von Host-Variablen mit `@` in der `WHERE` Klausel ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature, das die Lesbarkeit verbessert und SQL-Injections vorbeugt.
keywords: SELECT, Inline Declaration, Internal Tables, Filtering, Database Access

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe einen `REDUCE` oder `LINES` Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_group_by_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_count.

CLASS zcl_group_by_count IMPLEMENTATION.
