                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid

In Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` für das Füllen der Ergebnistabelle und `lines( GROUP ... )` für die Zählung der Gruppenelemente wird der Code sehr deklarativ und effizient. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den teuersten Flug (Flugnummer und Preis) enthält. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe einen `REDUCE` Ausdruck, um den Maximalwert zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_max_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrid_max_price.
    TYPES tt_carrid_max_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_max_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
                                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_prices) TYPE tt_carrid_max_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(ls_max_flight) = REDUCE ty_sflight_data(
        INIT max_f = VALUE ty_sflight_data( price = 0 )
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT max_f = COND ty_sflight_data(
                       WHEN grouped_flight-price > max_f-price THEN grouped_flight
                       ELSE max_f )
      ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      connid = ls_max_flight-connid
                      max_price = ls_max_flight-price ) TO rt_max_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_max( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_max=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '1234' price = '50.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_max_prices) = lo_cut->get_max_price_per_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_max_prices ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_max_prices[ carrid = 'LH' ]-max_price exp = '120.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_max_prices[ carrid = 'LH' ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_max_prices[ carrid = 'AA' ]-max_price exp = '250.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_max_prices[ carrid = 'AA' ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einem geschachtelten `REDUCE` Ausdruck, um komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis zu finden. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster, das die Leistungsfähigkeit moderner ABAP-Ausdrücke für Datenverarbeitung demonstriert und den Code extrem kompakt und effizient macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `sflight` und fügen Sie einen Eintrag hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name`, `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_type ).

        " Create dynamic internal table
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                       <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY.

        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Create dynamic work area
        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_type.
        ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

        " Fill dynamic work area (example for sflight)
        IF iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
          IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_carrid> = 'LH'.
          ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
          IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_connid> = '0400'.
          ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
          IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_fldate> = sy-datum.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        " Append to dynamic table
        INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_descr_type.
        " Handle error: type not found
        RETURN.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        " Handle error: component not found
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_sflight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should be created' act = lr_data ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' act = <lt_sflight> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should contain one entry' act = lines( <lt_sflight> ) exp = 1 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_sflight> INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should be LH' act = ls_sflight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CONNID should be 0400' act = ls_sflight-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'FLDATE should be SY-DATUM' act = ls_sflight-fldate exp = sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_table_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No table should be created for invalid type' act = lr_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von Datenobjekten (hier: einer internen Tabelle) zur Laufzeit. Dies ist nützlich für generische Programme, die mit unterschiedlichen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` sind die Schlüssel dazu.
keywords: cl_abap_dyn_prg, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field Symbols, CREATE DATA

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf und übergeben Sie Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen und `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS test_method_one
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS test_method_two
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_exceptions TYPE abap_excpbind_tab.
    DATA: lv_result_data TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE it_parameters
          RECEIVING
            VALUE(lv_result_data) = lv_result_data
          EXCEPTION-TABLE lt_exceptions.

        IF lv_result_data IS BOUND.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE ANY.
          ASSIGN lv_result_data->* TO <fs_result>.
          IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
            rv_result = <fs_result>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |Generic Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method_one.
    rv_output = |Input was: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method_two.
    rv_output = 'No input method called'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_with_param FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_no_param FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_with_param.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA(lv_input_param) = 'Dynamic Test'.
    INSERT VALUE abap_parmbind( name = 'IV_INPUT' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_input value = REF #( lv_input_param ) ) INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object     = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'TEST_METHOD_ONE'
      it_parameters = lt_parameters
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Method one result incorrect' act = lv_result exp = 'Input was: Dynamic Test' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_no_param.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object     = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'TEST_METHOD_TWO'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Method two result incorrect' act = lv_result exp = 'No input method called' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object     = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should return error for invalid method' sub = 'Error' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name)` und `PARAMETER-TABLE` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks oder zur Implementierung von Plugins, bei denen die aufzurufende Methode erst zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, CALL METHOD, PARAMETER-TABLE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Flugnummern (`CONNID`) von Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' starten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER` Tabellenausdruck mit einer `FOR`-Schleife für die Projektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_proj DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_connids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_proj IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_connids.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) ( ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_frankfurt_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_frankfurt_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_for_proj( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_connids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    DATA(lv_first_connid) = lt_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'First connid should not be initial' act = lv_first_connid ).

    " Verify that all returned connids actually belong to Frankfurt flights
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(lv_connid).
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_sflights_all INTO DATA(ls_flight_all) WHERE connid = lv_connid AND cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = |Connid { lv_connid } not from FRANKFURT| act = lv_found ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert den `FILTER` Tabellenausdruck zur Vorfilterung der Daten mit einer `FOR`-Schleife innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktors, um die gewünschten `CONNID`-Werte in eine neue Tabelle zu projizieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Datenmanipulation.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Projection

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob es Flüge von 'FRANKFURT' gibt, die mehr als 100 belegte Sitze haben, ohne die gesamte Tabelle zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_high_occupancy_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_high_occupancy_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_exists = COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND seatsocc > 100 ) ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_high_occupancy_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_high_occupancy_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_occupancy_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_high_occupancy_flights( ).

    " This test assumes there are such flights in SFLIGHT. Adjust if SFLIGHT data changes.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'High occupancy flights from FRANKFURT should exist' act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_high_occupancy_not_exists.
    " To test 'not exists', we need to simulate data or filter for an unlikely scenario.
    " For simplicity, we'll create a dummy table and filter for an impossible condition.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_line_exists( ).
    " Temporarily override SFLIGHT data for this test if possible, or create a separate method.
    " For this example, we'll just assert false, assuming the standard SFLIGHT data.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking the SELECT or providing controlled test data.

    " Simulate a scenario where no such flights exist (e.g., from a non-existent city)
    DATA lt_sflights_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'DUMMYCITY' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_sflights_mock.

    " This part is tricky without mocking the SELECT statement.
    " For a real test, you'd inject the data or use a test double.
    " As a workaround for this example, we'll just check a condition that is unlikely to be true.
    DATA(lv_exists) = COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( FILTER #( lt_sflights_mock WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND seatsocc > 100 ) ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'High occupancy flights from DUMMYCITY should not exist for FRANKFURT filter' act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `LINE_EXISTS` ist sehr effizient, um zu prüfen, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert, der bestimmte Kriterien erfüllt. Es wird kein vollständiger Loop benötigt, und die Operation stoppt, sobald der erste passende Eintrag gefunden wird.
keywords: FILTER, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Existence Check, COND

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `SELECT`-Anweisung aus, deren Zielstruktur dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Zielstruktur und Feld-Symbole für `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_into DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_into_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_dbtab_name TYPE string

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_into IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_into_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_type ).

        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Dynamic SELECT statement
        SELECT * FROM (iv_dbtab_name) INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_descr_type.
        " Handle error: type not found
        RETURN.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle error: dynamic SQL error
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' starten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_frankfurt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_frankfurt.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_seats_frankfurt FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats_frankfurt.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_frankfurt( ).

    " Calculate expected value manually for comparison
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_all INTO DATA(ls_flight_all) WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_flight_all-seatsocc.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats for Frankfurt flights incorrect' act = lv_total_seats exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die Kombination von `FILTER` zur Auswahl relevanter Flüge und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation der `seatsocc`-Werte. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen auf gefilterten Daten durchzuführen, ohne explizite Schleifen und Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten, deren Typen und Namen zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` mit einer dynamisch erstellten Komponententabelle und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_variable_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_def.
    TYPES tt_component_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_component_defs TYPE tt_component_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_variable_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lr_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_component_defs INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
      DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_comp_def-name
        type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_comp_def-type )
      ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( p_components = lt_components ).
        lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_type ).

        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_descr_type INTO DATA(lx_invalid_type).
        " Handle error: invalid type name provided
        RETURN.
      CATCH cx_abap_struct_creation_error INTO DATA(lx_struct_error).
        " Handle error: structure creation failed
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_table_two_cols FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_table_invalid_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_table_two_cols.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_variable_cols( ).
    DATA lt_comp_defs TYPE zcl_dyn_table_variable_cols=>tt_component_def.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_dyn_table_variable_cols=>ty_component_def( name = 'ID' type = 'I' ) TO lt_comp_defs.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_dyn_table_variable_cols=>ty_component_def( name = 'TEXT' type = 'STRING' ) TO lt_comp_defs.

    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_comp_defs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should be created' act = lr_data ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should be empty initially' act = <lt_dynamic_table> ).

    " Verify structure by trying to add data
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE ANY.
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_id>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( msg = 'ID component should be assigned' act = <fs_id> ).
    <fs_id> = 1.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TEXT' OF <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_text>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( msg = 'TEXT component should be assigned' act = <fs_text> ).
    <fs_text> = 'Dynamic Entry'.

    INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have one entry' act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_table_invalid_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_variable_cols( ).
    DATA lt_comp_defs TYPE zcl_dyn_table_variable_cols=>tt_component_def.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_dyn_table_variable_cols=>ty_component_def( name = 'INVALID_FIELD' type = 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' ) TO lt_comp_defs.

    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_comp_defs ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No table should be created for invalid component type' act = lr_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene dynamische Programmierung, bei der nicht nur die Zeilenstruktur, sondern auch die Anzahl und Eigenschaften der Spalten einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit definiert werden. Dies wird durch die dynamische Erstellung einer Komponententabelle für `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` erreicht, gefolgt von der Erstellung des Tabellentyps.
keywords: cl_abap_dyn_prg, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' starten, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Projektion in eine neue Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_flights_reduced
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_flights_reduced.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
                           ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                             connid = ls_flight-connid,
                             fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_frankfurt_flights_reduced FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_frankfurt_flights_reduced.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_for_struct( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_frankfurt_flights_reduced( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_reduced).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CARRID should not be initial' act = ls_flight_reduced-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CONNID should not be initial' act = ls_flight_reduced-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'FLDATE should not be initial' act = ls_flight_reduced-fldate ).

      " Verify that the original cityfrom was FRANKFURT (requires re-reading SFLIGHT or mocking)
      DATA ls_sflight_original TYPE sflight.
      SELECT SINGLE cityfrom FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight_original-cityfrom
        WHERE carrid = @ls_flight_reduced-carrid AND connid = @ls_flight_reduced-connid AND fldate = @ls_flight_reduced-fldate.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Original city from should be FRANKFURT' act = ls_sflight_original-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktors, um nicht nur Zeilen zu filtern, sondern auch die Struktur der Ergebniszeilen zu transformieren (Projektion). Dies ermöglicht die Erstellung maßgeschneiderter Ergebnistabellen in einer einzigen, sehr kompakten Anweisung.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Projection, Structure Transformation

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob ein bestimmtes Feld in einer gegebenen Struktur existiert und welchen Typ es hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` oder `describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_component_type`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_check_field_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sample_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_sample_data.

    METHODS get_field_type_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
        iv_field_name  TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists      TYPE abap_bool
        ev_type_name   TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_descr_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_check_field_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_info.
    DATA lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lr_component_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    ev_exists = abap_false.
    ev_type_name = ''.

    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).

    TRY.
        lr_component_type = lr_struct_descr->get_component_type( iv_field_name ).
        ev_exists = abap_true.
        ev_type_name = lr_component_type->get_name( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_name.
        " Component not found, ev_exists remains abap_false
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischem Klassennamen und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_create_call_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_test_interface.

    METHODS create_and_call_dynamic_class
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input       TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_test_interface.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_data TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_create_call_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call_dynamic_class.
    DATA lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA lv_result_data TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        IF iv_input IS SUPPLIED.
          INSERT VALUE abap_parmbind( name = 'IV_DATA' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_input value = REF #( iv_input ) ) INTO TABLE lt_parameters.
        ENDIF.

        CALL METHOD (lo_dynamic_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING
            VALUE(lv_result_data) = lv_result_data.

        IF lv_result_data IS BOUND.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE ANY.
          ASSIGN lv_result_data->* TO <fs_result>.
          IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
            rv_result = <fs_result>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        rv_result = |Error creating object: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error calling method: { lx_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |Generic Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for dynamic instantiation and method call
CLASS zcl_dynamic_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_test_interface.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_test_interface~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_data }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_create_and_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_create_invalid_class FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_invalid_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_create_and_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_create_call_class( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_call_dynamic_class(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_HELPER'
      iv_method_name = 'IF_TEST_INTERFACE~PROCESS_DATA'
      iv_input       = 'Hello Dynamic World'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic call result incorrect' act = lv_result exp = 'Processed: Hello Dynamic World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_create_invalid_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_create_call_class( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_call_dynamic_class(
      iv_class_name  = 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
      iv_method_name = 'ANY_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should return error for invalid class' sub = 'Error creating object' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_create_call_class( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_call_dynamic_class(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_HELPER'
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should return error for invalid method' sub = 'Error calling method' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Instanziierung von Klassen und den Aufruf ihrer Methoden. Dies ist ein Eckpfeiler der Plugin-Architekturen und generischer Frameworks, bei denen die konkrete Implementierung erst zur Laufzeit über den Klassennamen bestimmt wird. Die Verwendung von `CREATE OBJECT TYPE (class_name)` und `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name)` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE` ermöglicht diese Flexibilität.
keywords: cl_abap_dyn_prg, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, CREATE OBJECT, CALL METHOD, RTTI

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und deklarieren Sie die Workarea inline im `LOOP AT` Statement. Verkettung der Namen mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(ls_line)` und `REDUCE` für die Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_loop_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_item,
           ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE ty_t_items
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_concatenated_names) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_loop_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    rv_concatenated_names = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                           FOR ls_item IN it_items
                                           NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_item-name ELSE s && ` ` && ls_item-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_loop_inline FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_inline.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_loop_data( ).
    DATA(lt_test_items) = VALUE zcl_inline_loop_data=>ty_t_items(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Apple' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Banana' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Cherry' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_items( lt_test_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Apple Banana Cherry' msg = 'Namen sollten korrekt verkettet sein' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_items) = VALUE zcl_inline_loop_data=>ty_t_items( ).
    DATA(lv_result_empty) = lo_cut->process_items( lt_empty_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_empty exp = '' msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte leeren String ergeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration der Workarea im `LOOP AT` Statement (`INTO DATA(ls_item)`) ist eine sehr häufige und effektive Modernisierung. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE` Ausdruck wird der Code zur Datenaggregation extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark.
keywords: DATA, Inline Declaration, Internal Table, LOOP AT, Workarea, REDUCE, String Concatenation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie Daten aus einer bestehenden Tabelle transformieren und dabei den `FOR` Ausdruck verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lt_new_table) = VALUE type( FOR ... IN ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_itab_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_original,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_original,
           ty_t_original TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_original WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_s_transformed,
             key   TYPE string,
             data  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_transformed,
           ty_t_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_data
      IMPORTING it_original TYPE ty_t_original
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE ty_t_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_itab_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rt_transformed = VALUE ty_t_transformed(
      FOR ls_original IN it_original
      ( key = |KEY_{ ls_original-id }| data = to_upper( ls_original-value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_itab_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_for_itab_transform=>ty_t_original(
      ( id = 1 value = 'first' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'second' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_data( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Zeilen transformiert werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-key exp = 'KEY_1' msg = 'Erster Schlüssel sollte KEY_1 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-data exp = 'FIRST' msg = 'Erster Wert sollte in Großbuchstaben sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck innerhalb eines `VALUE` Operators ermöglicht eine elegante und funktionale Transformation von Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit `APPEND` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie numerische Werte aus einer internen Tabelle zu einem einzelnen Summenwert unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE type(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_value,
             category TYPE string,
             amount   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_value,
           ty_t_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_amount
      IMPORTING it_values TYPE ty_t_values
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_amount.
    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                         FOR ls_value IN it_values
                         NEXT s = s + ls_value-amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lt_test_values) = VALUE zcl_reduce_aggregation=>ty_t_values(
      ( category = 'A' amount = 10 )
      ( category = 'B' amount = 20 )
      ( category = 'A' amount = 5 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_amount( lt_test_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 35 msg = 'Die Gesamtsumme sollte 35 sein' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_values) = VALUE zcl_reduce_aggregation=>ty_t_values( ).
    DATA(lv_total_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_total_amount( lt_empty_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_empty exp = 0 msg = 'Die Gesamtsumme für leere Tabelle sollte 0 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren), was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht, ohne explizite Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen.
keywords: DATA, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Table, Functional Programming, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER type(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_itab_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_product,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_product,
           ty_t_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_active_products
      IMPORTING it_all_products TYPE ty_t_products
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_active_products) TYPE ty_t_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_itab_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_products.
    rt_active_products = FILTER #( it_all_products WHERE active = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_products FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_products.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_itab_selection( ).
    DATA(lt_all_products) = VALUE zcl_filter_itab_selection=>ty_t_products(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Product A' active = abap_true )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Product B' active = abap_false )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Product C' active = abap_true )
      ( id = 4 name = 'Product D' active = abap_false )
    ).

    DATA(lt_active_products) = lo_cut->get_active_products( lt_all_products ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_active_products ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 aktive Produkte gefunden werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_active_products[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Product A' msg = 'Erstes aktives Produkt sollte Product A sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_active_products[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Product C' msg = 'Zweites aktives Produkt sollte Product C sein' ).

    DATA(lt_no_active_products) = VALUE zcl_filter_itab_selection=>ty_t_products(
      ( id = 5 name = 'Product E' active = abap_false )
    ).
    DATA(lt_empty_result) = lo_cut->get_active_products( lt_no_active_products ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_empty_result ) exp = 0 msg = 'Keine aktiven Produkte gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Ausdruck bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und dem anschließenden `APPEND` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen.
keywords: DATA, FILTER, Internal Table, Selection, Constructor Expression, Functional Programming

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, indem Sie `INSERT LINES OF` mit `VALUE` und `FOR` Ausdrücken verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT LINES OF VALUE type( FOR ... IN ... ) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_target)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_multiple_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             key   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data,
           ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_multiple_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    DATA(lt_initial_target) = VALUE ty_t_data(
      ( key = 1 value = 'Initial' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed_source) = VALUE ty_t_data(
      FOR ls_source IN it_source
      ( key = ls_source-key + 100 value = |Transformed_{ ls_source-value }| )
    ).

    INSERT LINES OF lt_transformed_source INTO TABLE lt_initial_target.

    rt_target = lt_initial_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_multiple_lines( ).
    DATA(lt_source_data) = VALUE zcl_insert_multiple_lines=>ty_t_data(
      ( key = 10 value = 'A' )
      ( key = 20 value = 'B' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transfer_data( lt_source_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 Einträge in der Zieltabelle sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-key exp = 110 msg = 'Key des ersten transformierten Eintrags sollte 110 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-value exp = 'Transformed_B' msg = 'Value des zweiten transformierten Eintrags sollte korrekt sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `INSERT LINES OF` mit `VALUE` und `FOR` Ausdrücken ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Übertragung und Transformation von Daten zwischen internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke moderne Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen und `APPEND` Operationen.
keywords: INSERT, DATA, VALUE, FOR, Internal Table, Multiple Rows, Data Manipulation, Constructor Expression

CLASS zcl_insert_db_single IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_select_insert_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_info,
           ty_t_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_add_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_insert_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_add_flights.
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE ty_t_flight_info(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
    ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_selected_flights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 2 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      INSERT LINES OF lt_selected_flights INTO TABLE lt_initial_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_all_flights = lt_initial_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflights FROM @ls_flight2 ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 Einträge in der Zieltabelle sein (1 initial + 2 selektiert)' ).

Instructions: Finde den Flug mit der höchsten Sitzplatzkapazität aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHTS und gib diese Kapazität zurück.
hint: Nutze eine funktionale Methode und die `REDUCE` Expression, um die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_seats_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_seats_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsmax.

CLASS zcl_max_seats_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_max_seats = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax(
      INIT max_val = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_val = nmax( max_val, flight-seatsmax )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den maximalen Wert eines dynamisch angegebenen numerischen Feldes in einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Strukturen.
hint: Nutze RTTI (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) und dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten, um den Feldnamen zur Laufzeit zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_max_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error
        cx_sy_dyn_literal_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_max_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_dynamic_field.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA lv_current_value TYPE i.
    rv_max_value = 0.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            lv_current_value = <fs_component>.
            rv_max_value = nmax( rv_max_value, lv_current_value ).
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Feld ist nicht numerisch, überspringen oder Fehlerbehandlung
            CONTINUE.
        ENDTRY.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_literal_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) und dynamischem Zugriff in ABAP. Anstatt den Feldnamen hart zu kodieren, wird er zur Laufzeit übergeben. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität der Methode erheblich. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf die Komponente, während `nmax` für die effiziente Maximalwertbestimmung sorgt. Fehlerbehandlung für nicht-numerische oder nicht existierende Felder ist ebenfalls integriert.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field Symbols, Maximum, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_max_date_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    rv_latest_date = REDUCE sflight-fldate(
      INIT latest_date = '00000000'
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT latest_date = nmax( latest_date, flight-fldate )

    " rv_latest_date = REDUCE sflight-fldate(

hint: Nutze die `FOR GROUPS` Expression, um Daten nach CARRID zu gruppieren und dann den Maximalwert zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grouped_max_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_seats_by_carrid,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_seats  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_max_seats_by_carrid.
    TYPES tt_max_seats_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_seats_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_seats_per_airline RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_max_seats_by_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grouped_max_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats_per_airline.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                         GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
                         ( carrid    = carrid
                           max_seats = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax(
                                         INIT max_val = 0
                                         FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                         NEXT max_val = nmax( max_val, member-seatsmax )
                                       ) )
                       ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_max FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_max.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grouped_max_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_seats_per_airline( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein.' ).

    " Beispielprüfung für eine spezifische Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH')
    DATA(ls_lh_max) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT IS INITIAL ].
    IF ls_lh_max IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_act = ( ls_lh_max-max_seats > 0 ) msg = 'Maximalwert für LH sollte > 0 sein.' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Weitere Prüfungen für andere Fluggesellschaften oder die Gesamtlogik
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS` Expression ist ein mächtiges Feature in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und aggregierte Ergebnisse zu erzeugen. Hier wird für jede Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) eine Gruppe gebildet, und innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird mittels `REDUCE` die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) ermittelt. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `AT NEW` und `COLLECT` durch eine deklarative und lesbare Syntax.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, Internal Table, Grouping, Maximum, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse mit funktionalen Methoden, die verkettet werden können (Method Chaining), um einen Startwert zu manipulieren und das Maximum mit einem anderen Wert zu finden.
hint: Jede Methode sollte eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben, um die Verkettung zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_calculator.
    METHODS subtract IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_calculator.
    METHODS get_max_with IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_calculator.
    METHODS get_current_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value - iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_max_with.
    mv_current_value = nmax( mv_current_value, iv_value ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_value.
    rv_value = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_in_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_chained_calculator( 10 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->add( 5 )->subtract( 2 )->get_current_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 13 msg = 'Kettenberechnung falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_in_chain.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_chained_calculator( 10 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->add( 5 )->get_max_with( 20 )->subtract( 3 )->get_current_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 17 msg = 'Maximum in Kette falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile verkettet werden können. Jede Methode, die die Kette fortsetzen soll, gibt eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`ME`) zurück. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster in der objektorientierten Programmierung, um APIs intuitiver zu gestalten.
keywords: Method Chaining, Functional Method, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, NMAX

Instructions: Finde die maximale Länge aller Strings in einer internen Tabelle von Texten.
hint: Nutze die `REDUCE` Expression in Kombination mit `STRLEN` und `nmax`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_string_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_length
      IMPORTING
        it_texts TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_length) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_string_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_length.
    rv_max_length = REDUCE i(
      INIT max_len = 0
      FOR text IN it_texts
      NEXT max_len = nmax( max_len, strlen( text ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_various_strings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_various_strings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_string_length( ).
    DATA lt_texts TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Hello' TO lt_texts.
    APPEND 'World!' TO lt_texts.
    APPEND 'ABAP' TO lt_texts.
    APPEND 'Longer String' TO lt_texts.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_max_length( lt_texts ) exp = 13 msg = 'Falsche maximale Stringlänge.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_string_length( ).
    DATA lt_texts TYPE string_table.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_max_length( lt_texts ) exp = 0 msg = 'Leere Tabelle sollte 0 zurückgeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_string_length( ).
    DATA lt_texts TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Single' TO lt_texts.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_max_length( lt_texts ) exp = 6 msg = 'Einzelner String falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression bietet eine elegante Möglichkeit, eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen. Hier wird die `STRLEN` Funktion verwendet, um die Länge jedes Strings zu ermitteln, und `nmax` findet dann das Maximum dieser Längen. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Alternative zu einer expliziten Schleife mit einer Hilfsvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, String, Maximum, STRLEN, Functional Programming, NMAX

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Hashed Table, die Flugnummern und deren Sitzplatzkapazitäten enthält. Finde die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität in dieser Tabelle.
hint: Nutze die `REDUCE` Expression, um über die Hashed Table zu iterieren und den Maximalwert zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_in_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax   TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacity TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH UNIQUE KEY fldate.

    METHODS get_max_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_capacity) TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_in_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_capacity.
    rv_max_capacity = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax(
      INIT max_val = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flight_data
      NEXT max_val = nmax( max_val, flight-seatsmax )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    INSERT VALUE #( fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 150 ) INTO TABLE lt_flight_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_flight_data.

    INSERT VALUE #( fldate = '20250104' seatsmax = 250 ) INTO TABLE lt_flight_data.

explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist vielseitig einsetzbar und funktioniert auch hervorragend mit Hashed Tables. Sie ermöglicht eine deklarative Iteration über die Tabelle und die Aggregation von Werten, ohne eine explizite `LOOP` Anweisung schreiben zu müssen. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und funktionalerem Code, der die Absicht klarer ausdrückt.
keywords: Hashed Table, REDUCE, Maximum, Internal Table, Functional Programming, NMAX

Instructions: Berechne für jeden Flug die Differenz zwischen maximaler und belegter Sitzplatzkapazität (`SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC`) und finde den maximalen Wert dieser Differenzen.

CLASS zcl_max_seat_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_seat_difference RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_diff) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_max_seat_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seat_difference.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_max_diff = REDUCE i(
      INIT max_diff = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_diff = nmax( max_diff, flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle eine abstrakte Klasse `ZCL_SHAPE` mit einer abstrakten Methode `GET_AREA` und implementiere zwei konkrete Klassen `ZCL_CIRCLE` und `ZCL_RECTANGLE`, die diese Methode überschreiben. Erstelle dann eine Methode, die das Maximum der Flächen von mehreren Formen berechnet.
hint: Nutze Polymorphie und eine `REDUCE` Expression, um die maximale Fläche zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shape DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    CONSTANTS gc_pi TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '3.141592653589793'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_area.
    rv_area = gc_pi * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_shape FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_area REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_area_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_area
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_shape WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_area_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_area.
    rv_max_area = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT max_area = 0
      FOR shape IN it_shapes
      NEXT max_area = nmax( max_area, shape->get_area( ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_area_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_shapes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_area_polymorphism.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_area_calculator( ).
    DATA lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5.0' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = '4.0' iv_width = '6.0' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '3.0' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = '10.0' iv_width = '2.0' ) TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lv_max_area) = lo_calc->get_max_area( lt_shapes ).
    " Erwartete Flächen: Kreis(5) ~78.54, Rechteck(4x6)=24, Kreis(3)~28.27, Rechteck(10x2)=20
    " Maximalwert sollte 78.54 sein (gerundet)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_area exp = '78.53981633974483' msg = 'Falsche maximale Fläche ermittelt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_shapes.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_area_calculator( ).
    DATA lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_max_area) = lo_calc->get_max_area( lt_shapes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_area exp = '0.0' msg = 'Leere Liste sollte 0 zurückgeben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kernprinzipien der Objektorientierung: Abstraktion, Vererbung und Polymorphie. Die abstrakte Klasse `ZCL_SHAPE` definiert eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle (`GET_AREA`), die von den konkreten Klassen `ZCL_CIRCLE` und `ZCL_RECTANGLE` implementiert wird. Die `get_max_area` Methode nutzt Polymorphie, indem sie eine Tabelle von Referenzen auf `ZCL_SHAPE` akzeptiert und die spezifische `GET_AREA`-Implementierung jeder Form zur Laufzeit aufruft. Die `REDUCE` Expression aggregiert die Ergebnisse effizient.
keywords: Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Abstract Class, Method Redefinition, REDUCE, Maximum, NMAX

Instructions: Erstelle eine funktionale Methode, die basierend auf einem booleschen Flag entweder das Maximum zweier Zahlen oder das Minimum zweier Zahlen zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze eine funktionale Methode und die bedingte Expression `COND` in Kombination mit `nmax` und `nmin`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_max_min DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_conditional_extreme
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1    TYPE i
        iv_val2    TYPE i
        iv_get_max TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_max_min IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditional_extreme.
    rv_result = COND i(
      WHEN iv_get_max = abap_true THEN nmax( iv_val1, iv_val2 )
      ELSE nmin( iv_val1, iv_val2 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_max FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_min FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_max_min( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_conditional_extreme( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 20 iv_get_max = abap_true ) exp = 20 msg = 'Maximum falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_conditional_extreme( iv_val1 = 30 iv_val2 = 5 iv_get_max = abap_true ) exp = 30 msg = 'Maximum falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_min.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_max_min( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_conditional_extreme( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 20 iv_get_max = abap_false ) exp = 10 msg = 'Minimum falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_conditional_extreme( iv_val1 = 30 iv_val2 = 5 iv_get_max = abap_false ) exp = 5 msg = 'Minimum falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND` Expression ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, bedingte Zuweisungen in ABAP durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt die traditionelle `IF...ENDIF`-Struktur für einfache Bedingungen und macht den Code funktionaler und lesbarer. In Kombination mit `nmax` und `nmin` ermöglicht sie eine sehr kompakte Implementierung der Logik.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, Functional Method, NMAX, NMIN, ABAP_BOOL

Instructions: Finde den Flug mit der höchsten durchschnittlichen Auslastung (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX) pro Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und gib die Fluggesellschaft und die maximale durchschnittliche Auslastung zurück.
hint: Nutze `FOR GROUPS` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der durchschnittlichen Auslastung und das Finden des Maximums.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_avg_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_avg_occupancy RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_avg_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_avg_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA lt_avg_occupancy_per_carrid TYPE tt_avg_occupancy.

    lt_avg_occupancy_per_carrid = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                                           GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
                                           ( carrid = carrid,
                                             avg_occupancy = REDUCE decfloat16(
                                                               INIT total_occ = 0.0 total_max = 0.0
                                                               FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                               NEXT total_occ = total_occ + member-seatsocc,
                                                                    total_max = total_max + member-seatsmax
                                                               FINALLY = COND decfloat16(
                                                                           WHEN total_max > 0 THEN total_occ / total_max
                                                                           ELSE 0.0
                                                                         ) )
                                           ) ).

    rs_result = REDUCE ty_avg_occupancy(
      INIT max_entry = VALUE ty_avg_occupancy( carrid = '' avg_occupancy = 0.0 )
      FOR entry IN lt_avg_occupancy_per_carrid
      NEXT max_entry = COND ty_avg_occupancy(
                         WHEN entry-avg_occupancy > max_entry-avg_occupancy THEN entry
                         ELSE max_entry
                       )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Wert in einer Spalte einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die interne Tabelle zu iterieren und den Maximalwert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_max_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id    TYPE i,
        value TYPE i,
      END OF ty_data,
      tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_value
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_max_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_value.
    rv_max_value = REDUCE i(
      INIT max_val = 0
      FOR <fs_data> IN it_data
      NEXT max_val = COND #( WHEN <fs_data>-value > max_val THEN <fs_data>-value ELSE max_val )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Struktur und füllen Sie diese.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      ty_sflight_key_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_keys TYPE ty_sflight_key_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data. "Returns a reference to a dynamically created table
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_sflights.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " Get description of SFLIGHT structure
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    " Create table type description based on SFLIGHT
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique = abap_false
    ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_sflights>.

    " Populate the dynamic table
    IF <lt_sflights> IS ASSIGNED.
      SELECT * FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_keys
        WHERE carrid = @it_keys-carrid AND connid = @it_keys-connid
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_sflights>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_empty_keys FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lt_keys) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table=>ty_sflight_key_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->get_dynamic_sflights( lt_keys ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_sflights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( act = <lt_sflights> msg = 'Dynamic table should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_sflights> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflights> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table should contain 2 entries' ).

    " Verify content (example for one field)

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle nach einem Feld und zählen Sie die Einträge pro Gruppe mit `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        category TYPE string,
        value    TYPE i,
      END OF ty_item,
      tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
        category TYPE string,
        count    TYPE i,
        total_value TYPE i,
      END OF ty_grouped_result,
      tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_count
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_count.
    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN it_items GROUP BY <fs_group>-category
      ( category = <fs_group>-category
        count = GROUP SIZE
        total_value = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP <fs_group> NEXT s = s + <fs_member>-value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_and_count.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_group_by_for( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_group_by_for=>tt_item(
      ( category = 'A' value = 10 )
      ( category = 'B' value = 20 )
      ( category = 'A' value = 15 )
      ( category = 'C' value = 5 )
      ( category = 'B' value = 25 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_and_count( lt_items ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_group_by_for=>tt_grouped_result(
      ( category = 'A' count = 2 total_value = 25 )
      ( category = 'B' count = 2 total_value = 45 )
      ( category = 'C' count = 1 total_value = 5 )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 groups' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Grouped result should match expected' ).

GROUP BY ...`-Expression in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator bietet eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` und `SCARR` mit einem `JOIN` und projizieren Sie nur benötigte Felder in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... JOIN ... ON ... FIELDS ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        carrname TYPE s_carrname,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_info,
      tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT
        s~carrid,
        c~carrname,
        s~connid,
        s~fldate,
        s~price
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details_no_data FOR TESTING.
