CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_open_sql_join( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_reader->get_flight_details( 'LH' ). "Assuming 'LH' has data

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_details msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_details ) > 0 msg = 'Should retrieve at least one flight' ).

    DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_details[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-carrname msg = 'Carrier name should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_details_no_data.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_open_sql_join( ).
    DATA(lt_details) = lo_reader->get_flight_details( 'XX' ). "Assuming 'XX' has no data

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_details msg = 'Result table should be empty for non-existent carrier' ).

explanation: Die moderne Open SQL-Syntax ermöglicht die direkte Projektion von Feldern aus gejointen Tabellen in eine interne Tabelle (`INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`). Dies ist effizienter als `SELECT *` und die anschließende manuelle Verarbeitung, da nur die benötigten Daten vom Datenbankserver übertragen werden. Die Verwendung von Aliasen (`AS s`, `AS c`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit bei Joins.
keywords: Open SQL, JOIN, SFLIGHTS, SCARR, Data Projection, Hostvariable

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Zahlen mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und teilen Sie diese durch die Anzahl der Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR n IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + n
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem String mit dem `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_string_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_all_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_value    TYPE string
        iv_new_value    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_all_occurrences.
    rv_output_string = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_value IN rv_output_string WITH iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_flight_txt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_flight_data_as_txt.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_text_content TYPE string,
          lt_solix_content TYPE solix_tab.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_text_content = lv_text_content && |Carrier: { ls_flight-carrid }, Connection: { ls_flight-connid }, Date: { ls_flight-fldate }\n|.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Convert string to SOLIX (binary table) for attachment
    lt_solix_content = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
      iv_string = lv_text_content
      iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      iv_add_bom = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    " Create document
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcsy_text( ( line = 'Flugdaten als TXT-Anhang' ) )
      i_subject = 'Flugdatenbericht (TXT)'
    ).

    " Add attachment
    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
      i_attachment_subject = 'Flugdaten.txt'
      i_att_content_hex    = lt_solix_content
    ).

    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Add recipient
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_address_string = iv_recipient ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient ).

    " Send email
    lo_send_request->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'CSV'

    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

Instructions: Lösche programmatisch alle GOS-Anhänge für ein bestimmtes `SFLIGHT`-Objekt.
hint: Verwende `CL_GOS_MANAGER` und die Methode `DELETE_ATTACHMENT` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_delete_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_all_sflight_attachments
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_gos_api.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_delete_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_all_sflight_attachments.
    DATA: ls_object TYPE sibflporb,
          lt_attachments TYPE gos_attachment_list.

    " Define the business object key for SFLIGHT
    ls_object-instid = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    ls_object-typeid = 'BUS2017'. " Example: SFLIGHT business object type
    ls_object-catid  = 'BO'.

    " Create GOS manager
    DATA(lo_gos_manager) = NEW cl_gos_manager(
      is_object = ls_object
    ).

    " Get all attachments
    lo_gos_manager->get_attachments(
      EXPORTING
        i_object = ls_object
      IMPORTING
        et_attachments = lt_attachments
    ).

    rv_deleted_count = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_attachments INTO DATA(ls_attachment).
      lo_gos_manager->delete_attachment(
        i_attachment_id = ls_attachment-doc_id
      ).
      rv_deleted_count = rv_deleted_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF rv_deleted_count > 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sende eine E-Mail mit einem PDF-Anhang, der aus einer internen Tabelle (SFLIGHT) generiert wurde. (Hinweis: Die PDF-Generierung selbst ist komplex und wird hier simuliert).
hint: Simuliere die PDF-Generierung als XSTRING und verwende `CL_BCS_CONVERT` für die Umwandlung in SOLIX.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_pdf_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_flight_data_as_pdf
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_pdf_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_flight_data_as_pdf.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_pdf_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lt_solix_content TYPE solix_tab.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 2 ROWS.

    " Simulate PDF generation from flight data
    " In a real scenario, this would involve a PDF generation library (e.g., ADS, custom code)
    DATA(lv_simulated_pdf_text) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = 'Simulated PDF Content for Flight Data:\n'
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT s = s && |  { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }\n|
    ).
    " Convert simulated text to XSTRING to mimic a PDF binary
    lv_pdf_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
      iv_string = lv_simulated_pdf_text
      iv_codepage = '4103'
    ).

    " Convert XSTRING to SOLIX (binary table) for attachment
    lt_solix_content = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix(
      iv_xstring = lv_pdf_xstring
    ).

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    " Create document
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcsy_text( ( line = 'Flugdaten als PDF-Anhang' ) )
      i_subject = 'Flugdatenbericht (PDF)'
    ).

    " Add attachment
    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'PDF'
      i_attachment_subject = 'Flugdaten.pdf'
      i_att_content_hex    = lt_solix_content
    ).

    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Add recipient
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_address_string = iv_recipient ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient ).

    " Send email
    lo_send_request->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      RETURNING

      RAISING
        cx_gos_api.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_read_notes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_notes.
    DATA: ls_object TYPE sibflporb,
          lt_notes TYPE gos_note_list,
          lt_note_text TYPE bcsy_text.

    " Define the business object key for SFLIGHT
    ls_object-instid = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    ls_object-typeid = 'BUS2017'. " Example: SFLIGHT business object type
    ls_object-catid  = 'BO'.

    " Create GOS manager
    DATA(lo_gos_manager) = NEW cl_gos_manager(
      is_object = ls_object
    ).

    " Get all notes
    lo_gos_manager->get_notes(
      EXPORTING
        i_object = ls_object
      IMPORTING
        et_notes = lt_notes
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_notes INTO DATA(ls_note).
      " Get note content
      lo_gos_manager->get_note_content(
        i_note_id = ls_note-doc_id
        IMPORTING
          e_content = lt_note_text
      ).
      " Concatenate note lines into a single string and add to result table
      rt_notes = VALUE #( BASE rt_notes
                          FOR ls_line IN lt_note_text
                          ( ls_line-line ) ).
      rt_notes = VALUE #( BASE rt_notes ( |--- End of Note { ls_note-doc_id } ---| ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      CASE iv_weekday
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Sonntag'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Montag'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Dienstag'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Mittwoch'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Donnerstag'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Freitag'

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die Flugdaten aus SFlight enthält. Fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'FlightStatus' hinzu, deren Wert basierend auf dem Feld 'FLDATE' (Flugdatum) und dem aktuellen Datum gesetzt wird (z.B. 'Past', 'Future', 'Today'). Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression mit CASE WHEN.
hint: Nutzen Sie FOR ... IN ... und VALUE #( CASE ... WHEN ... THEN ... END ) für die neue Spalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_status,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flightstatus TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_status.
    TYPES tt_sflight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_raw
        ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
          flightstatus = VALUE #( 
            CASE
              WHEN ls_sflight-fldate < lv_today THEN 'Past'
              WHEN ls_sflight-fldate = lv_today THEN 'Today'
              WHEN ls_sflight-fldate > lv_today THEN 'Future'
              ELSE 'Unknown'
            END
          )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_flight_status_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_mapper->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    " Check if at least one flight has a status
    DATA(lv_found_status) = abap_false.

        lv_found_status = abap_true.
        EXIT.

    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus FOR-Expression und VALUE-Expression mit CASE WHEN ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Muster in ABAP 7.40+. Es ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen, indem es über Elemente iteriert und neue Strukturen mit bedingten Werten erstellt, ohne explizite LOOP- und APPEND-Anweisungen. Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und funktionalerem Code.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, CASE WHEN, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.40, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFlight, aber wenden Sie einen Rabatt an, wenn der Flugpreis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie eine REDUCE-Expression mit CASE WHEN.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE ... FOR ... NEXT ... und CASE WHEN für die bedingte Rabattberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
        iv_discount_rate   TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_total_price.
    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_price IN lt_prices
      NEXT sum = sum + VALUE #( 
        CASE
          WHEN ls_price-price > iv_price_threshold THEN ls_price-price * ( 1 - iv_discount_rate )
          ELSE ls_price-price
        END
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_discounted_reduction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discounted_reduction.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_flight_price_reducer( ).

    DATA(lv_total_no_discount) = lo_reducer->calculate_discounted_total_price(
                                     iv_price_threshold = 999999
                                     iv_discount_rate   = '0.1' ).

    DATA(lv_total_with_discount) = lo_reducer->calculate_discounted_total_price(
                                       iv_price_threshold = 0
                                       iv_discount_rate   = '0.1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less( act = lv_total_with_discount exp = lv_total_no_discount msg = 'Discount not applied correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die REDUCE-Expression, verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50, ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit CASE WHEN ermöglicht sie komplexe bedingte Berechnungen innerhalb eines einzigen, deklarativen Ausdrucks. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von expliziten Schleifen und temporären Variablen, was den Code prägnanter und fehlerresistenter macht.
keywords: REDUCE, CASE WHEN, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50, Functional Programming

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFlight und fügen Sie eine berechnete Spalte 'PriceCategory' hinzu. Diese soll 'Low', 'Medium' oder 'High' sein, basierend auf dem Flugpreis. Verwenden Sie eine SQL-CASE-Expression direkt im SELECT-Statement.
hint: Nutzen Sie CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END AS 'PriceCategory' im SELECT-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sql_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_cat,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price         TYPE sflight-price,
             pricecategory TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_price_cat.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_cat TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_cat WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_price_category RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_price_cat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sql_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_price_category.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price,
           CASE
             WHEN price < 200 THEN 'Low'
             WHEN price >= 200 AND price < 500 THEN 'Medium'
             ELSE 'High'
           END AS pricecategory
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_flights) = NEW zcl_flight_sql_case( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_cat) = lo_flights->get_flights_with_price_category( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_with_cat ).

    " Check if at least one flight has a category assigned
    DATA(lv_found_category) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights_with_cat INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-pricecategory IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_found_category = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Optional: Check specific categories if test data allows
    " DATA(lv_low_price_count) = lines( FILTER #( lt_flights_with_cat WHERE pricecategory = 'Low' ) ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lv_low_price_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator, um einen Status basierend auf einer Bedingung zuzuweisen. Wenn ein Wert größer als 100 ist, soll der Status 'High' sein, sonst 'Low'.
hint: Nutzen Sie COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_by_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_by_value.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_value > 100 THEN 'High'
      ELSE 'Low'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cond_operator FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cond_operator.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_cond_operator_demo( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_demo->get_status_by_value( 150 ) exp = 'High' msg = 'High status failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_demo->get_status_by_value( 50 ) exp = 'Low' msg = 'Low status failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_demo->get_status_by_value( 100 ) exp = 'Low' msg = 'Boundary condition failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine Kurzform für bedingte Zuweisungen und ersetzt einfache IF-ELSE-Konstrukte. Er macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer, insbesondere wenn der zugewiesene Wert von einer Bedingung abhängt. Er ist eine syntaktische Vereinfachung, die die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP unterstützt.
keywords: COND, WHEN, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten aus SFlight nach Flügen, die entweder 'LH' als Fluggesellschaft haben oder deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Verwenden Sie eine FILTER-Expression mit WHEN.
hint: Nutzen Sie FILTER #( WHERE ... WHEN ... THEN ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR fldate > lv_today
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_filter.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_all_valid) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid <> 'LH' AND ls_flight-fldate <= lv_today.
        lv_all_valid = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_all_valid msg = 'Filter condition not met for all entries' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FILTER-Expression (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern von internen Tabellen. Obwohl 'WHEN' hier nicht direkt als Schlüsselwort verwendet wird, ist die WHERE-Klausel der FILTER-Expression eine Form der bedingten Logik, die ähnliche Anwendungsfälle wie 'CASE WHEN' abdeckt, aber speziell für das Filtern von Tabellen optimiert ist. Sie ist effizienter und lesbarer als manuelle LOOP- und DELETE-Anweisungen.
keywords: FILTER, WHERE, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen String empfängt und basierend auf seinem Inhalt einen formatierten Ausgabestring zurückgibt. Wenn der String 'ERROR' enthält, soll 'Fehler aufgetreten: [Originalstring]' zurückgegeben werden, sonst 'Erfolgreich: [Originalstring]'. Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit bedingter Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_message IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_message.
    rv_output = |
      { COND string(
          WHEN iv_input CS 'ERROR' THEN 'Fehler aufgetreten: '
          ELSE 'Erfolgreich: '
        ) }{ iv_input }
    |.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_message FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_success_message FOR TESTING.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Fehler aufgetreten: An ERROR occurred.' msg = 'Error message formatting failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_success_message.

Sie ermöglicht die direkte Einbettung von bedingter Logik in den String, was den Code extrem kompakt und lesbar macht, ohne temporäre Variablen oder komplexe Verkettungen.
keywords: String Templates, COND, WHEN, String Processing, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge zusammen mit den zugehörigen Fluggesellschaftsnamen aus den Tabellen SFLIGHT und SCARR.
hint: Verwenden Sie INNER JOIN zwischen SFLIGHT und SCARR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_name,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_flight_with_name,
           tt_flight_with_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_names
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_names.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, c~carrname
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_names FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_names.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simple_inner_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_names( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if at least one entry has a carrier name
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_flight-carrname, msg = 'Carrier name should be filled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert einen einfachen INNER JOIN zwischen den Tabellen SFLIGHT und SCARR. Die moderne Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration (INTO TABLE @DATA(...)) und Alias-Namen (s~carrid, c~carrname) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, SELECT, Database, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Fluggesellschaften und, falls vorhanden, die Anzahl ihrer Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Fluggesellschaften ohne Flüge sollen ebenfalls angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie LEFT OUTER JOIN mit einer Aggregatfunktion (COUNT) und GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_left_outer_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_flight_count,
           tt_carr_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carr_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_left_outer_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_counts.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( s~carrid ) AS num_flights
      FROM scarr AS c
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sflight AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_carrier_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_left_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if a carrier with 0 flights (if any) is present
    DATA(lv_found_zero_flights) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE num_flights = 0.
      lv_found_zero_flights = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_zero_flights, msg = 'Expected to find at least one carrier with 0 flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet einen LEFT OUTER JOIN, um alle Fluggesellschaften aus SCARR zu erhalten und optional die Anzahl ihrer Flüge aus SFLIGHT zu aggregieren. Die COUNT-Funktion und GROUP BY sind Standard-SQL-Features, die hier mit moderner ABAP-Syntax kombiniert werden. Der LEFT OUTER JOIN stellt sicher, dass auch Fluggesellschaften ohne zugehörige Flüge im Ergebnis enthalten sind, wobei 'num_flights' dann 0 ist.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, GROUP BY, COUNT, Database, Aggregation

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Integer-Wert innerhalb des gültigen Bereichs für einen 4-Byte-Integer (Typ I) liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie SABP_CORE_MIN_INT4 und SABP_CORE_MAX_INT4 von CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_int4
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_int4.
    IF iv_value >= cl_abap_exceptional_values=>s_abp_core_min_int4 AND
       iv_value <= cl_abap_exceptional_values=>s_abp_core_max_int4.
      rv_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_is_valid_int4 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_valid_int4.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_validator( ).

    " Test valid values
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_int4( 100 ), msg = '100 should be valid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_int4( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>s_abp_core_min_int4 ), msg = 'Min INT4 should be valid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_int4( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>s_abp_core_max_int4 ), msg = 'Max INT4 should be valid' ).

    " Test invalid values
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_int4( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>s_abp_core_min_int4 - 1 ), msg = 'Value below min INT4 should be invalid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_int4( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>s_abp_core_max_int4 + 1 ), msg = 'Value above max INT4 should be invalid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die praktische Anwendung von CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES für die Datenbereichsvalidierung. Durch die Verwendung der Konstanten für den minimalen und maximalen Wert eines 4-Byte-Integers wird der Code robuster und leichter wartbar, da keine festen Zahlen im Code stehen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES, Validation, INT4, Data Types, Range Check

Instructions: Führen Sie einen JOIN zwischen der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT und einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften durch, um nur Flüge von bestimmten Fluggesellschaften zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den JOIN-Operator mit einer internen Tabelle im FROM-Teil der SELECT-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_with_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carr,
           tt_carr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING it_carriers TYPE tt_carr
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_with_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    SELECT s~*
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN @it_carriers AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_for_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_for_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_with_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_selected_carriers) = VALUE zcl_join_with_itab=>tt_carr(
      ( carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_selected_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if all results are from the selected carriers
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_is_valid_carrier) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_selected_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier) WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
        lv_is_valid_carrier = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_is_valid_carrier, msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } is not from selected carriers| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine leistungsstarke Funktion ab ABAP 7.50: den direkten JOIN zwischen einer Datenbanktabelle (SFLIGHT) und einer internen Tabelle (@it_carriers). Dies ermöglicht es, Daten aus dem Arbeitsspeicher effizient mit Datenbankdaten zu verknüpfen, was die Performance und die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert, da keine separaten Schleifen oder FOR ALL ENTRIES benötigt werden.
keywords: JOIN, Internal Table, SELECT, Database, ABAP 7.50, Performance

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie alle Flüge von Lufthansa (LH) und United Airlines (UA) in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste, einschließlich Duplikaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den UNION ALL Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_combined_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'UA'
    INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_combined_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if all results are from LH or UA
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'UA', msg = |Unexpected carrier { ls_flight-carrid }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check if the count is roughly the sum of individual counts (assuming no exact duplicates for simplicity)
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @DATA(lv_count_lh).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'UA' INTO @DATA(lv_count_ua).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_count_lh + lv_count_ua, msg = 'Total flight count mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der UNION ALL-Operator ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse mehrerer SELECT-Anweisungen zu kombinieren, wobei alle Zeilen, einschließlich Duplikate, beibehalten werden. Dies ist effizient, da die Operation direkt auf der Datenbankebene ausgeführt wird und die moderne ABAP-Syntax die Integration vereinfacht.
keywords: UNION ALL, SELECT, Database, Combine Results

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge, für die es mindestens eine Buchung in der Tabelle SBOOK gibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen EXISTS-Unterquery in der WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_with_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_with_bookings
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_with_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_bookings.
    SELECT * FROM sflight AS s
      WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT * FROM sbook
          WHERE sbook~carrid = s~carrid
            AND sbook~connid = s~connid
            AND sbook~fldate = s~fldate
      )
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_with_bookings( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_bookings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Verify that at least one flight has a booking (requires test data in SBOOK)
    " For a more robust test, one would insert test data into SBOOK and SFLIGHT.
    " Here, we assume standard SFLIGHT/SBOOK data has some matching entries.
    DATA(lv_has_booking) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      SELECT SINGLE FROM sbook
        WHERE carrid = @ls_flight-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_flight-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_flight-fldate
        INTO @DATA(ls_sbook_entry).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_has_booking = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_booking, msg = 'Expected to find flights with bookings' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der EXISTS-Unterquery ist eine effiziente Methode, um die Existenz von abhängigen Datensätzen zu prüfen, ohne die Tabellen tatsächlich zu joinen. Dies vermeidet die Erzeugung von Duplikaten im Ergebnis und kann bei großen Datenmengen performanter sein als ein INNER JOIN, wenn nur die Existenzprüfung relevant ist.
keywords: JOIN, EXISTS, Subquery, SELECT, Database, Performance

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und kategorisieren Sie diese als 'Kurzstrecke' (unter 500 km) oder 'Langstrecke' (500 km oder mehr).
hint: Verwenden Sie INNER JOIN, CASE-Ausdrücke in Aggregatfunktionen (SUM) und GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid             TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname           TYPE scarr-carrname,
             short_haul_flights TYPE i,
             long_haul_flights  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname,
           SUM( CASE WHEN s~distance < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS short_haul_flights,
           SUM( CASE WHEN s~distance >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS long_haul_flights
      FROM scarr AS c
      INNER JOIN sflight AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_category( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check a specific carrier (e.g., 'LH') for expected counts
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_summary-short_haul_flights, msg = 'LH should have short-haul flights' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_summary-long_haul_flights, msg = 'LH should have long-haul flights' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-short_haul_flights > 0 OR ls_lh_summary-long_haul_flights > 0, msg = 'LH should have total flights' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Carrier LH not found in summary' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ermöglicht die bedingte Zählung von Flügen basierend auf ihrer Distanz direkt in der Datenbankabfrage. Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Flüge, die keine Buchungen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN mit einer WHERE-Klausel, die auf NULL-Werte prüft, oder NOT EXISTS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_no_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_without_bookings
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_no_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_without_bookings.
    SELECT s~*
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid
                                AND s~connid = b~connid
                                AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      WHERE b~carrid IS NULL
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_without_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_without_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_no_bookings( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_without_bookings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result, msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    " It's possible for all flights to have bookings in test systems, so we can't assert not_initial without specific test data.
    " Instead, we verify that any returned flight indeed has no booking.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      SELECT SINGLE FROM sbook
        WHERE carrid = @ls_flight-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_flight-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_flight-fldate
        INTO @DATA(ls_sbook_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( sy-subrc, msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }-{ ls_flight-fldate } should have no booking| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet einen LEFT OUTER JOIN in Kombination mit einer WHERE-Klausel, die auf NULL-Werte im rechten Teil der JOIN-Operation prüft. Dies ist eine gängige und effiziente Methode, um Datensätze zu finden, für die keine zugehörigen Einträge in einer anderen Tabelle existieren. Die moderne ABAP-Syntax verbessert die Lesbarkeit der Abfrage.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, NULL, WHERE, Database, NOT EXISTS

solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_hashed.
    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_sflights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    READ TABLE mt_flights WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate INTO rs_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_read=>ty_sflights_hashed(

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_read( lt_test_flights ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '100.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_read=>ty_sflights_hashed(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_read( lt_test_flights ).

        i_method = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0001' iv_fldate = '20250101' )
      )

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der Zugriff auf HASHED TABLES über den vollständigen Schlüssel ist extrem performant (konstante Zeitkomplexität O(1)). Die Verwendung von `RAISE EXCEPTION` bei nicht gefundenen Einträgen ist eine moderne Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, READ TABLE, Unique Key, Performance, Exception Handling

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-price exp = '150.00' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer HASHED TABLE unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Initialisieren Sie eine Variable und addieren Sie in der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_hashed
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT total_price = total_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein spezifischer Flugdatensatz in einer HASHED TABLE existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` mit dem Tabellenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING it_flights TYPE ty_sflights_hashed.
    METHODS flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE ty_sflights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD flight_exists.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( mt_flights[ KEY carrid connid fldate COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_get_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_public_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_method_names) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_xco_cp_abap_class_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_get_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_methods.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class) = cl_xco_cp_abap_class=>for( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class->methods( )->all( ).

        rt_method_names = VALUE #( FOR ls_method IN lt_methods
                                    WHERE ( visibility = cl_xco_cp_abap_method=>visibility->public )
                                    ( ls_method->name->value ) ).

      CATCH cx_xco_cp_abap_class_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_xco_cp_abap_class_not_found EXPORTING previous = lx_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
